text: Upii aapiikpen yaa doo aan nsin beenin nya, ni mu aa ki ye mpiikpen pu, le nsin ngbaan nya kaa door kan, waa bi chain, le ni bi ke waah joo mpiikpen kan, waah kaa bi chain pu na la.

ref: Anything that she rests on or sits on during this time is also unclean, just as it would be during her period.
text: N‑yoonn mu nsin ngbaan beenin nya na, tiwandookaan nimɔk u doon ni pu na, ni tiwan nimɔk u kal ni pu na, aa ki bi chain.

ref: If you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
text: Le unii umɔk meeh tiwan ngbaan na mu aa ki bi chain, see u finn waawanpeenkaan, ki fu nnyun, kaan li bi chain ki ti saa kijook wɔb.

ref: Seven days after the woman gets well, she will be considered clean.
text: Nee aapuwɔb, nsin ngbaan yaa gii kaa ki nya kan, u li bi ki ti saa iwiin ilole daal le ki nin ŋa chain.

ref: On the eighth day, she must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
text: Winiin daal kan, upii ngbaan ban ŋinanjel ŋilee, bee ŋibɔrnanjel ŋilee, ki di buen Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni, Waabool aabisamɔb, utotoor chee.

ref: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me; then I will consider the woman completely clean.
text: Le utotoor ga di libaa toor titunwanbir aatork, ki di liken mu toor kitork ki bi joo seer mmii ni na aatork. Kina le u ga toor ki ŋa upii ngbaan chain.

ref: When any of you are unclean, you must stay away from the rest of the community of Israel. Otherwise, my sacred tent will become unclean, and the whole nation will die.
text: Uwumbɔr nan bui Moses ke u sur Israel yaab baah kaa bi chain pu na, nima kan, bi li nyi ki taa bii Waabool li u bi li ponn ni, ki si bikaasisik ni na, ke bi yaa bii li kan, u ga ku bi.

ref: Two of Aaron's sons had already lost their lives for disobeying the Lord, so the Lord told Moses to say to Aaron: I, the Lord, appear in a cloud over the place of mercy on the sacred chest, which is behind the inside curtain of the sacred tent. And I warn you not to go there except at the proper time. Otherwise, you will die!
text: le Uwumbɔr len Moses chee ke, “Bui aakpel Aaronn ke u taa li koo Chain Chain Aapepel ni, nin chee likekeln gii Libool ngbaan ni na yɔl yɔl, see n‑yoonn mu u ga koo ni ponn ni na ti fuu, ba pu? nima chee le m bi ntaalangbam ni, Maakaal Aadakaa aabiil aapaacham. U yaa yii ki koo kan, u ga kpo.

ref: Before entering this most holy place, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for your sins and a ram as a sacrifice to please me.
text: N‑yoonn mu u ti joo ni unaajabo u nan toor titunwanbir aatork, ni upihja u u joo ni u nan toor kitork ki bi joo seer mmii ni na, le u ga ŋmaa koo nima chee.”

ref: You will take a bath and put on the sacred linen clothes, including the underwear, the robe, the sash, and the turban.
text: Uwumbɔr nan ki di baah ga li ŋani pu na tuk u. Waahr aan Aaronn koo Chain Chain Aapepel ni na, see u fu nnyun, ki di utotoor aawanpeenkaan peen: nima le ye ŋitanyaan aabɔkul ni lipeetugeln, ni ligbapapaln, ni kiyikpupuk.

ref: Then the community of Israel will bring you a ram and two goats, both of them males. The goats are to be used as sacrifices for sin, and the ram is to be used as a sacrifice to please me.
text: Israel yaab mɔmɔk ga kpaan tii Aaronn iŋoja ilee u di toor titunwanbir aatork, ni upihja u di toor kitork ki bi joo seer mmii ni na aapiin aatork.

ref: Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
text: U di unaaja toor kitork ki nyan ubaa, ni waamaal aatunwanbir.

ref: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent,
text: Le u ga di iŋoja ilee na buen Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni, Waabool aabisamɔb chee.

ref: where I will show you which goat will be sacrificed to me and which one will be sent into the desert to the demon Azazel.
text: U ban ŋitakpal ŋilee nima chee ki daan libaa pu ke, “Uwumbɔr yaan,” ki daan liken pu ke, “Titunwanbir aanyam aaŋoob,” ki too inaan.

ref: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin,
text: Le Aaronn ga di uŋoob u ye Uwumbɔr yoo na, ki di toor titunwanbir aatork ki tii u.

ref: the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.
text: Uŋoob u ye titunwanbir aanyam aaŋoob na, Aaronn ga di u tii Uwumbɔr, u fuub, aan bi di u buen kipɔɔk ni, ki ti di u lii, u li cha, le u ga di binib ngbaan aatunwanbir buen.

ref: You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
text: N‑yoonn mu Aaronn di unaaja na toor titunwanbir aatork ki nyan ubaa, ni waamaal aatunwanbir na,

ref: Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place.
text: u yoor mmii aasambil ki ban kitork aabimbiln pu mmiisakɔl, ki lee tulalee aayon mu nu mɔ na iŋaal ilee, aan ki li joo ni Chain Chain Aapepel ni.

ref: There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there!
text: Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni, nima chee, u di tulalee aayon ngbaan paan mmii pu, lisambil ni, le iŋmanyuu ga fii biin Uwumbɔr Aakaal Aadakaa aabiil pu, nima kan, waan kan libiil ngbaan, ki kpo.

ref: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
text: U ga di uŋanbik bɔ unaaja na aasin ni, ki di ngem yɔk yɔk libiil ngbaan aamɔb pu, ki di ngem yɔk yɔk Uwumbɔr Aakaal Aadakaa chee, nfum mulole.

ref: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
text: U yaa ŋa kina doo kan, u kɔr uŋoja ki di toor binib ngbaan aatunwanbir aatork, ki li joo ni waasin Chain Chain Aapepel ni, aan ki nan di mu yɔk yɔk Uwumbɔr Aakaal Aadakaa chee, ni waabiil pu, ke waah di unaaja aasin ŋa pu na.

ref: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.
text: Kina le u ga toor ki ŋa Chain Chain Aapepel ni chain, ki nyan Israel yaab aah kaa bi chain pu na, ni baatunwanbir. U ŋa Libool ngbaan kina, ba pu? li si binib ngbaan aah ka pu na aakaasisik ni la, le baa bi chain.

ref: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.
text: u nyan buen kitork ki bi joo seer mmii ni na aabimbiln chee, ki ti ŋa li chain. U ban unaaja aasin ngem, ni uŋoja aasin ngem, ki di ŋa libimbiln ngbaan aamɔju aalɔlɔ ni.

ref: Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.
text: U di uŋanbik bɔ nsin ngbaan ni, ki di ngem yɔk yɔk libimbiln ngbaan pu nfum mulole. Kina le u ga ŋa li, ki nyan li Israel yaab aatunwanbir ni, ki ŋa li chain. Uŋoob u nyani baatunwanbir na aabɔr

ref: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
text: N‑yoonn mu Aaronn toor Chain Chain Aapepel, ni Uwumbɔr Aabool aapepel li gur na, ni kitork aabimbiln doo na, u di uŋoob u nyani baatunwanbir na, ki di siin Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni.

ref: There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins.
text: U di uŋaal ilee paan uŋoob ngbaan aayil pu, ki kpiir Israel yaab aatunwanbir, ni baah yii Uwumbɔr aamɔb pu na mɔmɔk, ŋa uyil pu, ki nyan uja ubaa, u jenn uŋoob ngbaan buen kipɔɔk ni.

ref: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
text: Le uŋoob ngbaan ga di baatunwanbir ti bi u pu na buen nin chee binib aa bi na.

ref: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
text: U ban nnyun ki fu mu, chain aapepel ni, ki ki di ubaa aawanpeenkaan peen. U yaa ŋa kina doo kan, u nya ki ti toor kitork ki bi joo seer mmii ni na, ki nyan ubaa, ni Israel yaab mɔmɔk mu aatunwanbir.

ref: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
text: U di kiwakork ki u di toor titunwanbir aatork na aakpan see mmii, kitork aabimbiln paab.

ref: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
text: Uja u jenn uŋoob u nyan baatunwanbir na buen kipɔɔk ni na, finn waawanpeenkaan ki fu nnyun waahr aan ki nin kun linampal biken chee.

ref: The remains of the bull and the goat whose blood was taken into the most holy place must be taken outside the camp and burned.
text: Unaaja ni uŋoob ni bi di toor titunwanbir aatork na aasin mu bi joo ni Chain Chain Aapepel ni ke mu nyan titunwanbir na, bi di i nya lipaal nibaa chee ki ti see i mmii ni. Bi di igban, ni tinann, ni tineer mɔmɔk see mmii ni.

ref: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
text: Udaan u di ni see mmii ni na finn waawanpeenkaan ki fu nnyun waahr aan ki nin gir kun linampal biken chee. Baah ga joo titunwanbir aatork aawiindaal pu na aabɔr

ref: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
text: Ni li dii ikaal imina ki cha n‑yoonn mu choo na mɔmɔk. Ŋmalole aawinpiik daal kan, Israel yaab, ni biwɔwɔm mɔmɔk bi koo bi chee na kpaan ki lul bumɔb, ki taa tun lituln libaa liyaadaal ngbaan.

ref: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
text: Liyaadaal kan, utotoor toor ki nyan binib ngbaan baatunwanbir mɔmɔk ni, ki ŋa bi chain.

ref: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.
text: Liyaadaal ngbaan ye chain chain aawiin la. Ni lul bumɔb liyaadaal ngbaan, ki taa tun lituln libaa. Ni li joo ikaal ngbaan ki cha n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: The high priest must offer the sacrifices for cleansing from sin, while wearing the sacred linen clothes.
text: Utotoorninkpel u bi di nkpan kpir uyil pu, ki kaan u mbamɔm, ke u nan gaa ute aajal na le ga toor kitork ki nyani titunwanbir na. U di utotoor aawanpeenkaan peen,

ref: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
text: aan ki toor Chain Chain Aapepel, ni Uwumbɔr Aabool aapepel li gur na, ni kitork aabimbiln, ni bitotoorb, ni binib ngbaan mɔmɔk ki ŋa ni mɔmɔk chain.

ref: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
text: Ni li joo ikaal ngbaan ki cha n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Libiln ni kan, ni toor kitork ngbaan nfum mubaa, ki nyan Israel yaab mɔmɔk baatunwanbir ni, ki ŋa bi chain. Kina pu na, Moses nan ŋa Uwumbɔr aah tuk u pu na.

ref: The Lord told Moses
text: Le Uwumbɔr bui Moses

ref: to tell Aaron, his sons, and everyone else in Israel:
text: ke u di ikaal imina di tii Aaronn ni ujapɔtiib, ni Israel yaab mɔmɔk.

ref: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
text: Israel aanii umɔk kɔr unaa, bee upiih, bee uŋoob ki di toor kitork tii Uwumbɔr lipaal nibaa chee, kaa di buen Uwumbɔr Aabool aabisamɔb chee unimbiin ni na kan, u bii Uwumbɔr aakaal la. U nyan tiwan ni fu na aamɔfal yɔli; waan ki li ye Uwumbɔr aanib ponn ni ubaa.

ref: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
text: Le utotoor ga di nsin mee kpir kpir kitork aabimbiln aapepel mɔmɔk, Libool aabisamɔb chee, ki di nkpan see mmii, aan ni nyan nnumɔɔn, ki li nu mɔ Uwumbɔr chee.

ref: Don't ever turn from me again and offer sacrifices to goat-demons. This law will never change.
text: Israel aanib taa ki yii Uwumbɔr ki li kɔr baawakor tisar, ni ŋinampal, ki toor kitork tii kinimbɔŋ. Israel aanib mɔmɔk li joo nkaal ngbaan ki cha n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people. Do Not Eat Blood The Lord said:
text: ki tii Uwumbɔr, kaa di buen Waabool aabisamɔb chee kan, waan ki li ye Uwumbɔr aanib ponn ni ubaa.

text: Tiwanfuurkaan mɔmɔk aamɔfal bi nsin ni la, kina pu le Uwumbɔr siin nkaal ke ni nyan tiwakor aasin mɔmɔk ŋa kitork aabimbiln pu, aan mu nyan binib ngbaan aatunwanbir. Nsin, mu ye limɔfal na, le nyani titunwanbir.

ref: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
text: Israel aanii ubaa, bee biwɔwɔm bi koo ni chee na ubaa yaa buen kikpaŋ ki ku upeel, bee unyoon u ni ga ji u na kan, u kɔr u ki nyan nsin lii kitiŋ, ki di titan biin mu pu.

ref: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
text: Ba pu? tiwanfuurkaan mɔmɔk aamɔfal bi nsin ni la, nima pu le Uwumbɔr bui Israel yaab ke bi taa ji tinann ti nsin bi ti ponn ni na, ke unii umɔk ŋa kina na, waan ki li ye Uwumbɔr aanib ponn ni ubaa.

ref: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
text: Israel aanii, bee uwɔwɔnja umɔk jin kiwakork ki kpo kibaa pu, bee upeel yaa chuu kiwakork ki ki ŋman gur na kan, udaan finn waawanpeenkaan ki fu nnyun, ki li kii kijook wɔb aan ki nin ŋa chain.

text: ke u tuk Israel yaab ke, “Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr.

text: Ni taa dii Ijipt yaab bi ni nan bi bi chee na aah ŋani pu na, bee Kanaann yaab bi aatiŋ pu m joo nimi cha na aah ŋani pu na.

ref: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.
text: Ni kii ki li joo maakaal ki ŋa maah bui nimi pu na. Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr.

text: Le Uwumbɔr nan di ikaal imina tuk bi. Ni taa doon nimi aamaal ni aapii ubaa chee.

text: Taa koo ki ti doon aatewaa, bee aatekpel aapuu chee, u mu ye aapuul la.

ref: Don't have sex with your daughter-in-law
text: Taa koo ki ti doon aabipuu chee,

ref: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
text: Aa taa koo ki ti doon upii u aa doon u chee na aabisal, bee uyaabil chee, bi ye saamaal ni aanib la, le naa ŋan ke aa ŋa kina.

ref: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
text: Aapuu yaa beenin bi limɔfal ni kan, aa taa ki yoor unaal, bee ukpel, ki di ŋa aapuu.

ref: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
text: Upii yaa joo mpiikpen kan, taa koo ki ti doon u chee, ba pu? waah bi chain.

ref: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
text: Taa koo ki ti doon aaŋeen aatɔ aapuu chee; ni ga cha ni taa ki li bi chain.

ref: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
text: Taa di nimi aabim tii ke bi di toor kitork tii liwaal Molek, ba pu? ni ga joo ni inimɔɔn Nidindaan Uwumbɔr aayimbil pu.

ref: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
text: Uja ubaa taa koo ti doon uja ŋeen aatɔ chee; Uwumbɔr aa gee kina.

ref: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
text: Ni taa cha tiwan nimina mɔmɔk bii nimi ki ŋa nimi tijɔŋ; kina le binib bi kaa dii Uwumbɔr na ŋani le kaa bi chain, binib kina aaboln le bi kitiŋ ki ni chaa koo ki ni na, le Uwumbɔr ga jenn nyan bi, aan ni gaa ki.

ref: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
text: Baah tun pu na le cha kitiŋ ngbaan aa bi chain, le kina pu Uwumbɔr ŋa kitiŋ ngbaan fam, le binib ngbaan aa ŋman bi koo ki ponn ni.

ref: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
text: le kitiŋ ngbaan ga li ŋan tii nimi, kaan yii nimi ke kaah nan yii binib bi nan koo ki ponn ni na.

ref: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
text: Le Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Ni kii ki li joo maah di ikaal i tuk nimi na, ki taa dii binib bi koo kitiŋ ngbaan ni na aah ŋani pu na ki cha baabimbin ngbaan bii nimi, ki ŋa nimi tijɔŋ. Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr.”

ref: The Lord told Moses
text: Uwumbɔr nan bui Moses

ref: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
text: ke u tuk Israel yaab ke, “Ni li bi chain, ba pu? min Nidindaan Uwumbɔr bi chain la.

ref: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
text: “Ni taa yii mi aan ki li dooni ŋiwaa, ni taa di tikur naan ŋiwaa ki doon ŋi. Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr.

ref: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.
text: “N‑yoonn mu ni kɔr kiwakork ki ŋa kimɔbaan aatork na, ni li joo ikaal i m tuk nimi na, le m ga gaa kitork ngbaan.

ref: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
text: Bundaal ni kɔr kitork ngbaan aawakork na kan, ni ŋmɔ tinann ngbaan liyaadaal, ni kitaak ki ga ki woln na. Wintaa daal, tinann ngbaan yaa ki gur kan, ni taa ŋmɔ ti, ni see ti mmii ni,

ref: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
text: ba pu? taa ki bi chain, le umɔk ŋman ti na kan, maan ki gaa waapiin aatork.

ref: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
text: Unii umɔk ŋman ti na aabɔr ga bii, ke waa lik faar tiwan ni bi di tii mi na, waan ki li ye maanib ponn ni ubaa.

ref: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
text: “Ni yaa bi chee tijikaar, nimi aasar ni kan, tijikaar ti bi mmogbaan na, ni taa chee ti, ki taa ki gir buen naah chee nimi aasar ti ni na, ki ti lɔi tijikaar ti gur na.

ref: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
text: Ni taa ki gir buen nimi aasubil aasar ni, ki ti lɔi ŋisubil ŋi gur, ni ŋi lir kitiŋ na; di cha ŋi man, aan bigiim ni biwɔwɔm buen ti lɔi. Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr.

ref: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
text: “Ni taa su kinaayuk, bee ni ji niŋeen aatɔ pem pem, bee ni gii inyamɔn.

ref: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
text: Ni yaa kaan ŋmaa giin tipuur kan, ni taa puu ti maayimbil pu. Mbimbin kina joo ni inimɔɔn le maayimbil pu. Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr.

ref: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
text: “Ni taa ji unii ubaa pem pem, bee ni gaa waawan. Unii yaa tun saatuln kan, pɔɔn aabaa ki pa u, ki taa cha ni woln kitaak.

ref: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
text: Ni li san min ijawaan man, ki taa puun lii utafakpaa pu, ki taa di tiwan bil ujoon aasan ni ke u gbeer ki lir. Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr.

ref: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
text: Ni taa li geei inyamɔn paani unii ubaa. Bi yaa bi ji unii ubaa aabɔr aan u ban u nyan nkun ni, aan aa nyi ke u kpa mbamɔn kan, ter u ki gaa u lii. Min le ye Uwumbɔr.

ref: Don't hold grudges. On the other hand, it's wrong not to correct someone who needs correcting.
text: “Aa taa li joo aaŋeen aatɔ liŋuul; pɔɔn aabaa ki toor nimi aabɔr ni man, nima kan, saan tun titunwanbir u pu.

ref: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
text: Aa taa li ban ke aa teen ubaa bakaa, ki li nan udaan ki cha n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, tɔ, aa li gee aaŋeen aatɔ ke saah gee aabaa pu na. Min le ye Uwumbɔr.

ref: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
text: “Ni li joo maakaal. Ni taa di linampal aawakor ti kaa kpaa na kpaan tɔb chee ke ti dur. Ni taa di njikaabim mulee aabɔŋ kpaan bu bukpaab bubaa ni, ki taa di tikokonn ni tiwan ni kaa ye tikokonn na ŋmal tɔb ni ki di ŋa tiwanpeenkaan.

ref: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
text: “Uja yaa puu ke u ga di waanaagbiipiibo kooh tii uja ŋeen aatɔ ke u li ye upuu, le uja u ban u daa upiibo na yaa kaa kee pan, le uja uken yaa doon upiibo ngbaan chee kan, ni daa bitafal, ni taa ku bi; ba pu? unaagbiipii ngbaan laa beenin ye udindaan yoo la.

ref: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
text: Le utotoor ga toor ki ŋa u chain ki nyan u waatunwanbir ni, le min Uwumbɔr ga di cha pinn u.

ref: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
text: “Ni yaa ti fuu Kanaann aatiŋ ni, ki bun ŋisubil aasui aaboln i na kan, ni taa kee ji yaasubil ngbaan ki ti saa ŋibin ŋitaa, ba pu? ni kɔ. Ŋibin ŋitaa ngbaan ni, ni taa ji ŋi.

ref: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
text: Libiln nanar ni kan, ni di ŋisubil ngbaan mɔmɔk tii mi Uwumbɔr, ni li ye nimi aadoon aatork.

ref: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
text: Libiln ŋmuŋmur ni kan, ni ga ŋmaa ji ŋisubil ngbaan. Ni yaa ŋa maah mɔk nimi pu na kan, nimi aasubil aasui ga lu sakpen. Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr.

ref: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
text: “Ni taa ŋmɔ tinann ti nsin beenin bi ti ni na. Ni taa li ŋani bibɔɔb aatuln ki ji inyɔk.

ref: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
text: bee ni daan nimi aawon pu nibaa chee, bee ni geei geei niwon utekpiir pu. Min le ye Uwumbɔr.

ref: Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.
text: “Ni taa di nibisatiib ŋa tiwaadir ni aadagoob ki jinn bi inimɔɔn; ni yaa ŋa kina kan, ni ga fenn dii ŋiwaa, le kitiŋ ngbaan ga gbiin kidagook aatuln ŋmeen.

ref: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
text: Ni li joo Likpaakool aawiin chain, ki li pak nin chee ni dooni mi na. Min le ye Uwumbɔr.

ref: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
text: “Ni taa ban binib bi baa bitekpiib chee tibɔr na aasurm. Ni yaa ŋa kina kan, ni ga bii nibaa, kaan ki li bi chain. Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr.

ref: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
text: “Min le ye Uwumbɔr, ni li san mi ijawaan, ki li pak binib bi jer nimi na, ki li nyuŋni bi.

ref: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
text: “Ni taa ŋa biwɔwɔm bi koo ni chee na mbiin.

ref: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
text: Ni li ŋani bi tiŋann ke naah ŋani niŋeen aatɔtiib Israel yaab biken pu na, ki li gee bi ke naah gee nibaa pu na. Ni teer ke ni mu nan ye biwɔwɔm le Ijipt aatiŋ ni. Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr.

ref: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
text: Ni li joo mbamɔn aawan ŋaŋni tiwan mɔmɔk. Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr, le ki nyan ni nimi Ijipt aatiŋ ni.

ref: and I command you to obey my laws.
text: Ni li joo maakaal ki ŋa maah len pu na mɔmɔk. Min le ye Uwumbɔr.”

ref: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
text: “Nimi Israel yaab, bee biwɔwɔm bi koo gbɔk nimi na ubaa yaa di nimi aabo ubaa toor kitork tii Liwaal Molek kan, ni mɔmɔk mee ŋitakpal ki ku u.

ref: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
text: Ubaa yaa di waabo toor kitork tii Liwaal Molek ki bii Maabool, aan laa ki bi chain, ki jinn maayimbil li bi chain na inimɔɔn kan, m ga daa utafal; waan ki li ye maanib ponn ni ubaa.

ref: Some of you may let them get away with human sacrifice,
text: Nimi maanib bi gur na yaa kaa gar u waah ŋa pu na, kaa ku u kan,

ref: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
text: min mbaa le ga daa uja ngbaan, ni waamaal, ni bimɔk kpee u pu ki doon liwaal Molek na aatafal. Baan ki li ye maanib ponn ni bibaa.

ref: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
text: “Ubaa yaa buen bibɔɔb chee u ti ban nsurm bitekpiib chee kan, m ga daa utafal, waan ki li ye maanib ponn ni ubaa.

ref: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
text: Ni di nibaa tii mi, ki li joo nibaa chain, ba pu? min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr.

ref: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
text: Ni li joo maakaal chain, ba pu? Min le ye Uwumbɔr, le ki ŋa nimi chain.”

ref: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
text: Uwumbɔr le nan di ikaal imina mɔk bi: Ubaa yaa len tibɔbir lii ute, bee una pu kan, ni ku udaan, uma le ku ubaa.

ref: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
text: Ubaa yaa koo ti doon uŋeen aatɔ Israel aanii uken aapuu chee kan, ni kpaan ki ku uja ni upii ngbaan mɔk bilee.

ref: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
text: Uja yaa koo ti doon ute aapuu chee kan, u jinn ute inimɔɔn la, le ni ga kpaan ki ku uja ni upii ngbaan mɔk bilee. Bima bilee ngbaan le ku bibaa.

ref: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
text: Uja yaa koo ti doon ubipuu chee kan, ni kpaan ki ku uja ni upii ngbaan mɔk bilee. Bima bilee ngbaan le kpaan ki ŋa kininsuŋ aawan ngbaan, ki ku bibaa.

ref: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
text: Uja ubaa yaa koo ti doon ujatɔ chee kan, bi kpaan ŋa inimɔɔn aawan la, ni kpaan ki ku bimɔk bilee. Bima le ku bibaa.

ref: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
text: Uja yaa kpaan joo upii ni una, bi li ye upuutiib kan, ni kpaan see bi mmii ki ku bi, ba pu? bi ŋa inimɔɔn aawan la, ni taa kii kina aabimbin li bi nikaasisik ni.

ref: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
text: Upii yaa ban ke kiwakork doon u chee kan, ni kpaan ki ku upii ni kiwakork ngbaan. Bima le ku bibaa.

ref: If you marry one of your sisters, you will be punished, and the two of you will be disgraced by being openly forced out of the community.
text: Uja yaa yoor ute aabisal, bee una aabisal, ki di ŋa upuu kan, ni nyan bi mpaan pu ki jinn bi inimɔɔn, aan ki nyan bi nibaa chee. U doon uninkpan chee la, ni cha u ji kina aafalaa.

ref: If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel.
text: Uja yaa doon upii u joo mpiikpen na chee kan, ni kpaan ki jenn nyan bi nibaa chee, ba pu? bi kool mbimbin mu bi chain na aakoobil a.

ref: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
text: Uja yaa doon upuul, bee unawaa chee kan, ni kpaan ŋa bimɔk bilee falaa, ba pu? bi ŋa kininsuŋ la.

ref: If you have sex with your uncle's wife, neither you nor she will ever have any children.
text: Uja yaa doon utewaa, bee utekpel aapuu chee kan, u jinn utewaa, bee utekpel inimɔɔn a, bi mɔmɔk bilee ga kan ntafadaan, bimɔk bilee aan maa mbim.

ref: Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out.
text: Uwumbɔr nan ki bui ke, “Ni li joo maakaal mbamɔm, ki ŋa maah len pu na mɔmɔk, nima kan, Kanaann aatiŋ ki m ban m di tii nimi na aan yii nimi.

ref: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.
text: Ni taa gaa kitiŋ ngbaan aanib aakaal; m ban m jenn nyan bakadam ngbaan aan ni koo kitiŋ ngbaan ni. Baah ŋani tiwan nimɔk na aa ŋan, m nan baabimbin mu bir na sakpen a.

ref: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
text: M puu ke m ga di kitiŋ ki kpa tiwakor aamoŋmɔpaan ni ŋisubil sakpen na tii nimi ki li ye nimi yaan, le m ga sil di ki tii nimi. Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr, le ki nyan nimi nibaa ŋinibol mɔmɔk ni.

ref: That's why you must make a difference between animals and birds that I have said are clean and unclean—this will keep you from becoming disgusting to me.
text: Nima pu na, ni lik ki bee ipeel ni inyoon i kɔ na, ni i kaa kɔ na. Ni taa ji ipeel, bee inyoon i kɔ na. Min le nyan i ke i kɔ, le ni yaa ji i kan, naan ki li bi chain.

ref: I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
text: Ni li bi chain aan ki li ye maanib, ba pu? Min le ye Uwumbɔr le ki bi chain. M nyan ni nimi ŋinibol mɔmɔk ni ke min baanja le li yeh nimi.

ref: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
text: “Uja, bee upii umɔk ye ubɔɔ na kan, ni mae ŋitakpal ki ku udaan ngbaan, unii umɔk ŋa kina na le ku ubaa.”

ref: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
text: Uwumbɔr nan bui Moses ke u tuk Aaronn aajapɔtiib bi ye bitotoorb na ke,

ref: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.
text: bee aaninkpan u kaa kee mɔn uja na kan, utotoor taa ŋa waakpuul aawan nibaa ki bii ubaa.

ref: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
text: Ni yaa ye uchootiib wɔb kan, u taa buen baakpuul ki bii ubaa.

ref: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
text: “Utotoor ubaa taa kuu uyikpir, bee u chee ulangbaln, bee u gii uwon nibaa chee ke u wii ikpowiil.

ref: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
text: U li bi chain aan ki taa jinn maayimbil inimɔɔn. Waah joo tijikaar aatork seer mmii ni tii mi na, ni ŋan ke u li bi chain.

ref: Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy,
text: Utotoor taa yoor upii u puun ye pateer na, bee upii u puun nyi uja na, bee upii u puun mɔn uja ki ki nyan u chee na, ba pu? utotoor bi chain la.

ref: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
text: Binib mɔmɔk li nyi ke utotoor ye chain aanii la, ba pu? uma le joo tijikaar aatork tii mi. Min le ye Uwumbɔr, m bi chain la, le ki ŋa maanib chain.

ref: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
text: Utotoor aabisal yaa ŋa ubaa udagoor kan, u jinn ute le inimɔɔn; ni see u mmii ki ku u.

ref: If you are the high priest, you must not mess up your hair or tear your clothes in order to mourn for the dead.
text: “Utotoorninkpel ye unii u bi di nkpan kpir uyil pu na la, le min Uwumbɔr nyan u ke u tun waatuln ki li peeni bitotoorb aawanpeenkaan, nima pu na, u taa di uyikpir lii ke waan chaar ti, ki taa kar waawanpeenkaan, ke u bi wii ikpowiil la.

ref: If you leave the sacred place to attend a funeral, both you and the sacred place become unclean, because you are the high priest.
text: Bi di u tii min Uwumbɔr la, le naa ŋan ke u bii ubaa. U taa nya Maabool ni ki ti li koo linikpol do, hali ni yaa ye ute, bee una kan, naa ŋan ke u bii Maabool.

ref: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin
text: U yoor upii u kaa nyi uja na.

ref: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
text: U taa kpan ukpopii, ki taa yoor upii u nyan uchal chee na, ki taa yoor pateer mu. U yoor waanibol ponn ni aapii u kaa nyi uja na.

ref: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
text: Ni yaa kaa ye kina kan, waabim bi ba ga li ye chain aabim na aan li bi chain. Min le ye Uwumbɔr ki nyan u ke u li ye Utotoorninkpel.”

ref: The Lord told Moses
text: Uwumbɔr nan ki bui Moses

ref: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other,
text: Uja umɔk aawon aa ŋan na taa ŋa ipiin ngbaan aatork; unii u ye ujoon, bee udeen, bee unii u aanimbil wɔb kpa kidaŋ na, bee unii u aawon kpa kidaŋ na,

ref: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed,
text: bee unii u aaŋaal bee utaal faan na;

ref: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.
text: bee unii u ye ugodaan, bee kinigengeŋ, bee unii u kpa inimbiween na, bee unii u kpa tiwon aaween na, bee uja u bi lee u na, taa ŋa kina aatork aatuln.

ref: These men may not serve as my priests and burn sacrifices to me.
text: Aaronn u ye utotoor na aayaabitiib ponn ni ubaa yaa kpa tiwon aaween kina aaboln kan, u taa di tijikaar aapiin aatork tii min.

ref: but they may not enter the sacred place or serve me at the altar. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
text: U mu aah kpa tiwon aaween na, u taa duun ni chain aakekeln li bi di gii Libool ni na, ki taa duun ni kitork aabimbiln mu chee. U taa bii chain aawan nee mɔmɔk, ba pu? Min le ye Uwumbɔr le ki ŋa tiwan ngbaan chain.”

ref: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
text: Le Moses nan di tibɔr ngbaan tuk Aaronn, ni ujapɔtiib, ni Israel yaab mɔmɔk.

ref: The Lord told Moses
text: Uwumbɔr nan bui Moses

ref: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.
text: ke u tuk Aaronn ni ujapɔtiib ke, “Ni li joo ipiin i Israel yaab di tii mi i bi chain na mbamɔm, aan ki taa jinn maayimbil li bi chain na inimɔɔn. Min le ye Uwumbɔr.

ref: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen,
text: “Aaronn aayaabitiib ponn ni ubaa yaa kpa tiwon aaween i bir na, bee tinar yaa nya uwon pu kan, u taa ji ipiin i bi chain na aatork aajikaar, see bi toor u, u ŋa chain. Utotoor umɔk meeh tiwan ni meeh utekpiir kaa bi chain na, bee tijar nya u ni,

text: Ni di libipiiŋmu aabiln siin gaa‑mbaa‑lii, ki tii kitiŋ ngbaan ni aanib mɔmɔk. Libiln ngbaan ni, unii yaa nan daa uken aakpaakon n‑yoonn mu jer na kan, u giin mu tii uwandaan, bee waamaal; bi yaa nan di unii ubaa kooh aan u ye unaagbiija kan, di u lii, u gir kun udo yaab chee.

ref: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
text: Ni ŋa maah len pu na, ki ji kitiŋ ngbaan aah ŋa tijikaar ti na. Libiln ngbaan ga li ye chain ki tii nimi.

ref: During this year, all property must go back to its original owner.
text: Libiln ngbaan ni kan, binib bimɔk nan daa ikpaakon, bee ŋidichal, n‑yoonn mu jer na, bi giin ni tii biwandam.

ref: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
text: Ŋibin ngbaan yaa wiir kan, tipar mu li wiir. Ŋibin mu yaa kaa wiir kan, tipar mu taa li wiir, ba pu? kitiŋ ngbaan aah ga ŋmaa ŋa tijikaar pu na le aa ga di pa ki pu.

ref: I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.
text: Ni li san Nidindaan Uwumbɔr ijawaan ki taa ji niŋeen aatɔ Israel aanii pem pem. Libilolole aabɔr

ref: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
text: Kitiŋ ngbaan ga ŋa kaajikaar, le ni ga li kpa naah ban pu na mɔmɔk, ni ji, aan ki li kpa nsuudoon.

ref: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
text: Nibaakan, ubaa ga baa ke, “Libilolole ni, ti yaa kaa kon ki mu aa chee kan, ti ga ji ba?”

ref: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.
text: Tɔ, Uwumbɔr ga ŋa kitiŋ ngbaan tinyoor ki cha ki ŋa tijikaar libiloloob ponn ni, aan ni ji ti ŋibin ŋilee.

ref: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
text: Le ni yaa kon ki bun nimi aasar ni njikaabim libininiin ni kan, ni ga li beenin kpa libiloloob aabiln aajikaar ki ji, ki ti saa tijikaar ti ni kon libiln ngbaan ni na aan ki nin chee ti. Giintii aabɔr

ref: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
text: Ni taa di nimi aatiŋ kooh tii ubaa u li joo ki kookoo, ba pu? nimi le aa yeh kitiŋ ngbaan, Uwumbɔr le yeh ki. Ni naahn biwɔwɔm la, le u di ki tii nimi, ni li ko ki ji.

ref: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
text: Ni yaa kooh kitiŋ nibaa chee kan, ni li nyi ke utindaan ga nan ki gir daa ki, unii u nan daa na chee.

ref: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back,
text: Igiin yaa chuu Israel aanii ubaa aan u di waatiŋ kooh kan, waamaal ni aanii ubaa ki gir daa ki tii u.

ref: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
text: U yaa ga ki gir daa ki kan, u pɔɔn ubaa ki pa ŋimombil ŋi ga fuu libiln li unii u puen daa kitiŋ na ba ga nan giin kitiŋ ngbaan tii u na aayoonn, aan ki li nyi ke u ba ga nan ki gir gaa ki Giintii aabiln ni.

ref: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
text: U yaa kaa kpa ŋimombil ŋi ŋeer u pa gaa ki na kan, unii u nan daa ki na li beenin joo ki, aan ni ti saa libiln li u ga nan giin ki tii uwandaan na. Libiln ngbaan ni kan, u giin ki tii uwandaan.

ref: If you sell a house in a walled city, you have only one year in which to buy it back.
text: Uja yaa di waadichal li bi kitiŋ ki bi maa ligoln gob ki na ni kooh kan, u kpa nsan ke libiln yaa nan saa buyoonn u nan kooh li na kan, u ki gir daa li.

ref: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
text: U yaa kaa ŋmaa daa li n‑yoonn ngbaan kan, waa ki kpa nsan u ki daa li, le lidichal ngbaan gur ye unii u daa li na yaal la, li ga ŋa u ni waamaal yaan la. Waan ki giin li tii u libiln li bi giini biwandam aawan tii bi na.

ref: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
text: Tɔ, ŋidichal ŋi kaa bi ŋigon aatim ni, ki bi itingbaan ni na, ŋi bi le ke tikpaasar na, uwandaan kpa nsan ke u ki gir daa lidichal ngbaan n‑yoonn mu u gee na. Giintii aabiln yoonn ma kan, see bi giin ŋi tii biwandam.

ref: If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back.
text: Liifai yaab ma kpa nsan ke bi ki gir daa baawan mɔmɔk ntim mu bi di tii bi na ni, n‑yoonn mu bi gee na.

ref: And any houses that they do not buy back will be returned to them in the Year of Celebration, because these homes are their permanent property among the people of Israel.
text: Ŋidichal ŋi bi ntim ni Liifai yaab yeh ŋi aan ki di kooh na, bi yaa kaa ki ŋmaa gir daa ŋi kan, Giintii aabiln yoonn yaa fuu ni kan, ni giin ŋi tii bi, ba pu? Liifai yaab aadichal ŋi bi ntim ni na ye biyaan le n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, Israel yaab ni.

ref: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
text: Tɔ, kimoŋmɔpɔɔk kimɔk mann goln Liifai yaab aatim na, bi taa di mu kooh, ni ye baafaal le ki cha n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Baah ga pinn ŋimombil tii bigiim pu na aabɔr

ref: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
text: Nimi Israel aanii ubaa yaa ŋa ugiin kaa ki ŋmaa lik ubaa kan, waah bi gbɔk udo yoo u na pɔɔn ubaa ki li lik u ni waadichal, ke waah lik upaaja pu na, nima kan, u ga li beenin koo ni chee.

ref: Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live.
text: Aa yaa pinn ŋimombil tii u kan, taa cha u pa jer saah pinn u pu na, ki mu taa cha u pa jer saah kooh tijikaar ngbaan tii u pu na.

ref: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
text: Nidindaan Uwumbɔr aakaal le na, uma le nyan ni nimi Ijipt aatiŋ ni, ke u di Kanaann aatiŋ tii nimi, aan ki li ye nimi Aawumbɔr. Baah ga di binaagbiib lii pu na aabɔr

ref: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.
text: Nimi Israel aanii ubaa yaa ŋa ugiin kaa ki ŋman u lik ubaa, ki di ubaa kooh tii uken kan, sin u daa u na taa cha u tun lituln ke unaagbiija na.

ref: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free,
text: Cha u li koo aa chee ke upaaja bee uchaan na, ki li tun tii si ki ti saa Giintii Aabiln yoonn.

ref: so they and their children may return home to their families and property.
text: N‑yoonn ngbaan kan, u ni waabim gir kun waamaal chee ki ti gaa uyaajatiib aakpaakon.

ref: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.
text: Israel aanib ye Uwumbɔr aanaagbiib la, le u nyan ni bi Ijipt aatiŋ ni; ni taa di bi ŋa binaagbiib.

ref: So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.
text: Ni li san Uwumbɔr ijawaan, ki taa li ŋani bi mbiin.

ref: or from the foreigners who live in your own country, and make them your property.
text: Ni ga ki ŋmaa daa biwɔwɔm bi koo ni chee na aabim, aan bi li ye nimi aawan.

ref: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
text: Le bi ga li tun tii nimi, ni nimi aabim, ki li ye nimi aafaal ki ti saa baamɔfal mɔk. Nido yaab Israel aanib ma kan, ni taa ŋa bi mbiin.

ref: Even if some of you Israelites become so much in debt that you must sell yourselves to foreigners in your country,
text: Biwɔwɔm bi koo ni chee na ubaa yaa ŋa uwankpadaan, le Israel aanii ubaa yaa ŋa ugiin ki di ubaa kooh tii u, bee uwankpadaan ngbaan aadoyoo ubaa, ki ŋa waanaagbiija kan,

ref: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother
text: nee aapuwɔb, ni ga ki ŋmaa gir daa u uwɔwɔnja ngbaan chee. Ni cha una aabo,

ref: by paying your owner for the number of years you would still be a slave before the next Year of Celebration.
text: U pɔɔn ubaa ki kan uwɔwɔnja u nan daa u na, aan bi piin ki kahn libiln li u nan daa u na ki ti saa Giintii Aabiln, ki siin tipar ni ŋeer ututunn aah ga gaa waapar pu na.

ref: The longer the time until then, the more you will have to pay.
text: U ki pa ŋibin ŋi gur na aamombil,

ref: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.
text: aan ni li bi ke waah tun lituln tii u libiln le na. Ni taa cha waaninkpel ŋa u mbiin.

ref: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.
text: Hali, u yaa kaa ŋmaa ŋa kina ki gaa ubaa lii kan, Giintii Aabiln li paa na ni, unii u daa u na di u ni waabim lii.

ref: People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.
text: Naa ŋan ke Israel aanii li ye unaagbiija kina ki cha, ba pu? Israel yaab ye Uwumbɔr aanaagbiib la. Uma le nyan ni bi Ijipt aatiŋ ni, ki ye Bidindaan Uwumbɔr.

ref: I am the Lord your God! So don't make or worship idols or images.
text: Uwumbɔr nan bui ke, “Ni taa naan ŋiwaa, bee ni maa ŋitakpal aajaatɔlk tiib, bee ni kpii ŋitakpal aawaa ki doon ŋi. Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr.

ref: Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord.
text: Ni li ŋani maah mɔk nimi pu na aajim, ki li nyuŋni naah dooni mi nin chee na. Min le ye Uwumbɔr.

ref: and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit.
text: m ga cha utaal nu waayoonn, nima kan, kitiŋ ngbaan ga ŋa tijikaar, le isui mu ga lu ŋisubil.

ref: I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks.
text: “M ga tii nimi nsuudoon nimi aatiŋ ngbaan ni, le ni ga li dɔ geen kaa san ijawaan ibaa. M ga kuln tipeewanbir timɔk bi nimi aatiŋ ni na, le butɔb aan ki li bi nima chee.

ref: You will chase and destroy your enemies,
text: M ga cha ni nyaŋ nimi aadim,

ref: I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you.
text: M ga ŋa nimi tinyoor ki tii nimi mbim pam. Maah puu tipuur ti tii nimi na, m ga ŋa min yaan.

ref: I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust.
text: M ga li bi ni chee, Maabool li bi chain na ni, le maan di nimi lii kpala.

ref: I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people.
text: M ga li ye nimi Aawumbɔr ki li bi ni chee, le ni li ye maanib.

ref: I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high. Punishment for Disobeying the Lord The Lord said:
text: Min, Nidindaan Uwumbɔr le nyan ni nimi Ijipt aatiŋ ni, ke ni taa ki li ye binaagbiib. Min le nyan nimi mpɔɔn mu nan joo nimi na ni, le ki cha ni chuun aan niyil yaa paacham.” Limɔyiir aatafadaan (Ikaal

ref: If you disobey me and my laws, and if you break our agreement,
text: Ni yaa yii, kaa dii maakaal, ni maah len pu na, ki bii tipuur ti m puu tii nimi na kan,

ref: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant,
text: m ga daa nitafal. M ga cha tibɔbir dan ni pu, le iween i kaan sɔŋ na ga dan ni pu, ki ga cha nimi aawon toŋ, ki ga cha ni jɔb, ki ŋa fam. Ni ga bu njikaabim, le ni mu aan ter nimi, ba pu? nimi aadim le ga dan nan nyaŋ nimi, ki ji naah kon tijikaar ti na.

ref: and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack.
text: M ga fenn ki cha nimi, nima kan, binib bi nan nimi na ga nyaŋ nimi ki li joo nimi, le ijawaan ga chuu nimi sakpen; ubaa aan li san dii nimi, le ni san.

ref: Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins,
text: “Le nimina mɔmɔk yaa pii nimi, ni beenin yiil maamɔb kan, m ga kpee nimi aatafadaan nfum mulole pu.

ref: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.
text: M ga bii nimi aatafalaaŋun aagaak ki ni kpa na; le utaal aan ki nu, kitiŋ ngbaan ga kuur ki pɔɔk ke tikur na.

ref: All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.
text: Le naah ga li pɔɔni nibaa ki tun sakpen pu na, naan ter nimi, ba pu? nimi aatiŋ aan ki ŋa tijikaar, le nimi aasui mu aan ki lu ŋisubil.

ref: If you keep rebelling against me, I'll punish you seven times worse, just as your sins deserve!
text: “Le ni yaa beenin yiil maamɔb kan, m ga ki kpee nimi aatafadaan nfum mulole pu,

ref: I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.
text: le ki cha tipeewanbir dan ni pu, le ti ku nimi aabim, ki bii nimi aawakor, le nimi bi ga gur na aan ki li wiir, ki cha nimi aasan doon nkuun.

ref: I'll remain your enemy and punish you even worse.
text: m ga fenn lir ni pu ki kpee nimi aatafadaan nfum mulole.

ref: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
text: Le m ga cha nimi aajikaar taa ki ŋa mbamɔm, le kina pu, bipiib kipiik ga di baah kpa tijikaar ti na kpaan ŋaan likumbuul libaa ni. Le bi yaa yakr ti, ni jin kan, naan bab. Nkon ga li beenin joo nimi.

ref: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.
text: M ga cha nkon lir ni pu ki li pɔɔ sakpen, le ni ga ku nimi aabim ki ŋmɔ bi.

ref: I'll destroy your shrines and tear down your incense altars, leaving your dead bodies piled on top of your idols. And you will be disgusting to me.
text: M ga bii naah dooni ŋiwaa ŋi ŋigongon paab na, ki gbaa wiir nimi aanyɔknii aatork aabimbin, le ki di nimi aanikpol mae paan nimi aawaa ŋi lir dɔ na pu, le m ga nuur nimi.

ref: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
text: M ga bii nimi aatim doo, ki bii nin chee ni dooni ŋiwaa na, kaan gaa nimi aatork.

ref: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
text: M ga bii nimi aatim, kina pu na, nimi aadim bi ga gaa mu na aasui ga gar maah ga ŋa mu pu na.

ref: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
text: M ga cha nimi aadim to nimi butɔb ki jenn yaa nimi koon ntiyayam ni. Nimi aatim ga bii doo, le ubaa aan ki li bi nimi aatiŋ ni.

ref: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
text: Le naah kaan ki koo kitiŋ ngbaan pu na, ki ga doon fuur kibaa pu. Naah ga ti li bi nimi aadim aatim ponn ni, tinaagbiir ni na, le kitiŋ ngbaan ga doon fuur kibaa pu.

ref: In the land of your enemies, you will tremble at the rustle of a leaf, as though it were a sword. And you will become so weak that you will stumble and fall over each other, even when no one is chasing you.
text: Nimi aadim aan kee lir ni pu, le ni ga li san ki lɔkr tɔb ki lir kitiŋ, kaan ŋmaa to nimi aadim butɔb.

ref: Many of you will die in foreign lands,
text: Ni ga kpoi tinaagbiir ni la, le nimi aadim aatim ga ji nimi.

ref: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
text: Nimi bi gur siib nimi aadim aatiŋ ni ki ŋmar na aatunwanbir, ni niyaajatiib aatunwanbir pu, naan ki li bi tibaa ni.

ref: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right,
text: ki cha m fenn daa bitafal, aan ki cha baadim chur bi buen baatim ni tinaagbiir ni na. Aayaabitiib yaa nan sunn bibaa taab, ki kan baah bii pu na aatafadaan kan,

ref: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
text: m ga teer tipuur ti m nan puu tii Jakob, ni Aisak, ni Abraham na, ki ki fikr tipuur ngbaan, ki giin maanib aatiŋ tii bi.

ref: and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.
text: Njan aabɔkpaan le ye ke bi jenn nyan niyaabitiib kitiŋ ngbaan ni, nima kan, ki ga doon fuur kibaa pu, le bi ga ji falaa, baah yii maakaal, kaa kii maah len pu na pu.

ref: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
text: Tɔ, hali bi yaa beenin bi baadim aatiŋ ni kan, maan yii bi, kaan bii bi kookoo, kaan bii tipuur ti m nan puu tii bi na, ba pu? m ye Bidindaan Uwumbɔr.

ref: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
text: M ga fikr tipuur ti m nan puu tii biyaajatiib n‑yoonn mu m nan di maapɔɔn mɔk ŋinibol mɔmɔk aan ki nyan ni maanib Ijipt aatiŋ ni na, ke min Uwumbɔr li ye Bidindaan.”

ref: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
text: Uwumbɔr nan di ikaal imina, ni baah ga dii u pu na, le ki di tuk Moses, Sainai Aajool paab, ke u di mɔk Israel yaab.

ref: to say to the community of Israel: If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me,
text: ke u di mɔk Israel yaab. Ni yaa di unibɔn le pan tii Uwumbɔr ni giin tipuur kpaan aapɔln kan, ni ga ŋmaa pa ŋimombil ŋi aabɔr paa na ki gaa udaan lii.

ref: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
text: Ni yaa kan tiwan nimɔk kitiŋ ngbaan ni na, ni yaa ye njikaabim, bee ŋisubil kan, ni ŋaŋ ki ti saa nfum kipiik, ki nyan nibaa, ni li ye Uwumbɔr yaan.

ref: If you try to substitute any other animal, no matter how good, for the one you promised, they will both become holy and must be sacrificed.
text: nima pu na, uja u puu tipuur ngbaan na taa ki ban kiwakork yayan ki di kpeln njan yaak na. Udaan yaa ŋa kina kan, tiwakor tilee ngbaan ŋa Uwumbɔr yaan la.

ref: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
text: Uja u puu tipuur ngbaan na yaa ye ugiin, kaan ŋmaa pa maah siin pu na kan, u li joo ni waah ban u di unii u pa na utotoor chee, le utotoor ngbaan ga siin kidaak ki diin na, ki ŋeer upɔndaan aah ga ŋmaa pa pu na.

ref: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.
text: Ni yaa ye kiwakork ki ŋeer kitork ki u ga di toor tii Uwumbɔr na kan, ki ye Uwumbɔr yaan la,

ref: Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest,
text: Tipuur ngbaan aawakork yaa ye ki kɔ na, ki mu aa ŋeer bi di ki toor Uwumbɔr aatork kan, uwandaan di kiwakork ngbaan buen utotoor chee.

ref: But if you want to buy it back, you must pay an additional
text: Uja ngbaan yaa ban u gir daa kiwakork ngbaan kan, u pa paan kaadaak pu.

ref: If you promise a house to me, a priest will set the price, whatever the condition of the house.
text: Ubaa yaa di waadichal tii Uwumbɔr ipiin kan, utotoor le ga siin lidichal ngbaan aah ŋan, ni laah kaa ŋan, ki ŋeer pu na aadaak, le waah len pu na, nima le ga sil.

ref: If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every
text: Uja yaa di waatiŋ nibaa chee ki di tii Uwumbɔr ipiin kan, njikaabim mu bi ga di bu bukpaab ngbaan ponn ni aah ga li wiir ki saa pu na, bu aadaak mu ŋeer kina la, njikaabim kuruwaa moninko ye tikunabr aamombil kipiik la.

ref: If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price.
text: Giintii Uwandaan aabiln yaa jer naa yunn le u di kitiŋ ngbaan tii ipiin kan, kaadaak aah ye pu na, le u ga pa.

ref: But any time after that, the price will be figured according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration.
text: Giintii Uwandaan aabiln yaa jer ni yunn kan, utotoor ŋaŋ ki, ki ŋeer ŋibin ŋi gur na ki ti saa Giintii Uwandaan aabiln li paa ni na aah ga nan saa buyoonn na, ki bar kidaak ngbaan pu.

ref: If you decide to buy back the land, you must pay the price plus an additional
text: Utindaan yaa ki ban ke u daa kitiŋ ngbaan kan, u pa baah siin kaadaak pu na, ki ki paan.

ref: When the Year of Celebration comes, the land becomes holy because it belongs to me, and it will be given to the priests.
text: Ni yaa nan ŋeer bi giin biwandam aawan tii bi, Giintii Uwandaan aabiln li paa ni na kan, kitiŋ ngbaan gur ye Uwumbɔr yaan la, le ni ga di kitiŋ ngbaan tii bitotoorb.

ref: If you promise me a field that you have bought,
text: Uja yaa daa kitiŋ ki di ki tii Uwumbɔr kan,

ref: its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine.
text: bitotoorb le ga siin kitiŋ ngbaan aadaak ni ŋeer ŋibin ŋi gur ki ti saa Giintii Uwandaan aabiln li paa ni na, le ni ŋan ke u pa kaamombil liyaadaal ngbaan, le limombil ngbaan ye Uwumbɔr yaan la.

ref: However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner.
text: Giintii Uwandaan aabiln yaa nan fuu kan, ni giin kitiŋ ngbaan tii utindaan, bee waabim.

ref: Every price will be set by the official standards. Various Offerings The Lord said:
text: Tiwan ngbaan mɔmɔk aadaak ga sil maah siin pu na la.

ref: All first-born animals of your flocks and herds are already mine, and so you cannot promise any of them to me.
