ref: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
text: Uwumbɔr aah cha m diŋ kaa ki kpa mpɔɔn mubaa na, le bi di liŋuusakpeln lir m pu.

ref: Their attacks never stop, though I am defenseless, and my feet are trapped.
text: Liniwoln fii nan bib m pu la; bi gor baakookoo aatakm la; le ki cha m chuun san.

ref: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
text: Ijawaan le nyaŋ mi; maayimbil buen ke litakpiln libaa aabuln na la, le maawangol jer buen ke ntaalangbam na.

ref: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
text: Tɔ, m bi kpu le na; lifuur libaa aa bi maafalaa wee ni.

ref: Night chews on my bones, causing endless torment,
text: Kinyeek kan, maakpab mɔmɔk wu la; iween i ŋmɔ mi na aa door.

ref: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.
text: Uwumbɔr chɔb chuu maabɔkul aaneen la, le ki goŋ goŋ maawanpeenkaan.

ref: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
text: U di mi mee lii tikpakpar ni; titan soor mi.

ref: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
text: Uwumbɔr, m wii yin si, le saa gar mi kpala; le m yaa ki mee si kan, aatafal aa bi m ni.

ref: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
text: M nyi ke aa joo mi cha maakun ni la, aa joo mi cha ndoon mu dɔ kii unii mɔmɔk na ni la.

ref: No one refuses help to others, when disaster strikes.
text: Ba ŋa aa tak unii u kuln kookoo ki mee ban kinimbaak baanja na?

ref: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
text: M nan mak ban mpopiin ni nwiihn la, le tibɔbir ni mbɔmbɔɔn labr dan.

ref: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
text: Ilandak ni iween le daa par par mi; Iwiin mɔmɔk kan, m kani falaa la.

ref: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
text: M chuun le ni bɔɔn mi, le nwindam aa choo kpala; Kinipaak ni, le m si ki gaŋni ban nterm.

ref: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
text: Nneen bi suuna le kaa ki mɔ ki naahn ikakal ni taataa aaneel.

ref: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
text: Nwon kpaln tibɔmbɔnn la; nwon ton kina kpan kpan.

ref: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
text: M puu tipuukpaan le ke maan di lineel aanimbil lik usapɔɔn daalbaadaal.

ref: God All-Powerful punishes men who do that.
text: Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan ŋani timi ba? U teeni unibɔn aatun kinye?

ref: In fact, God sends disaster on all who sin,
text: U joo ni tibɔbir ni libiil le nan tii binib bi tun taani na.

ref: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
text: Uwumbɔr nyi maah tun pu na mɔmɔk; u kani litaal limɔk m yoor na.

ref: and I beg God to prove my innocence.
text: Cha Uwumbɔr ŋaŋ mi tiwaŋaŋkaan bamɔnn ni, ki kan maah kaa tun taani pu na.

ref: If I have disobeyed him or even wanted to,
text: M yaa fenn mpuwɔb tii nsanyaan, bee m di mbaa tii kinimbɔŋ ki cha ŋŋaal meeh titunwanbir kan,

ref: then others can eat my harvest and uproot my crops.
text: cha maajikaar bii doo, bee aa cha biken ji tijikaar ti m bun na.

ref: If I have desired someone's wife and chased after her,
text: Nlaasaab yaa koo ŋŋeen aatɔ aapuu ni, ki yaa tam ki kii u waabisamɔb kan,

ref: then let some stranger steal my wife from me.
text: cha mpuu ti mɔn uja yayan aasaa, ki doon uja yayan aawandookaan pu.

ref: If I took someone's wife, it would be a horrible crime,
text: Nkun li ye kina aabiin aatafadaan.

ref: sending me to destruction and my crops to the flames.
text: Ni ga li ye mmii sakpiin aabiil li ga di maawan mɔmɔk wu na la.

ref: When my servants complained against me, I was fair to them.
text: Maatutunn ubaa yaa nan len mi tibɔr kan, m nan pel le ki ŋa u mbamɔm.

ref: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
text: Uwumbɔr u naan mi na, Uwumbɔr chachaan ngbaan le naan maatutum mu.

ref: I have never cheated widows or others in need,
text: Maa kee yii kaa ter bigiim; kaa kee cha ukpopii dakl ke waa kpa uteter daalbaadaal,

ref: and I have always shared my food with orphans.
text: kaa ka ji tijikaar ki cha ukpobo chuun nkon.

ref: Since the time I was young, I have cared for orphans and helped widows.
text: M joo bi maamɔfal mɔmɔk ni la.

ref: and I was praised for supplying woolen garments to keep them warm.
text: m nan tii u baah di maapiih aakor luu tiwanpeenkaan ni na la. Le u ga di usui mɔmɔk pak mi.

ref: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
text: M yaa nan jin ukpobo pem pem daalbaadaal ki nyi ke m ga ti nya libɔjil ni kan,

ref: I hope that arm will fall from its socket.
text: cha ŋŋaal kool kool; cha i par nya mbɔgbin pu.

ref: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.
text: Maah san Uwumbɔr aatafadaan na, maa nan ŋa kina aawan daalbaadaal.

ref: I have never trusted the power of wealth,
text: Maa kee tii liwankpal naadii,

ref: or taken pride in owning many possessions. *
text: kaa kpa kigaak liwangol pu.

ref: Such horrible sins would have deserved punishment from God.
text: Kina aatunwanbir aatafadaan le ye nkun; ti yiil Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan la.

ref: I have never laughed when my enemies were struck by disaster.
text: Maa kee kpa mpopiin maadim aafalaa ponn ni, kaa mɔɔni buyoonn tibɔbir kan bi na.

ref: Neither have I sinned by asking God to send down on them the curse of death.
text: Maa kee bui Uwumbɔr ke u ku bi, ki tun kina aatunwanbir daalbaadaal.

ref: No one ever went hungry at my house,
text: Binib bi mɔmɔk tun maatuln na nyi ke m gaal bicham n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la.

ref: Many have attempted to hide their sins from others— but I refused.
text: Binib biken pɔɔni bibaa ki joo baatunwanbir bɔrni la, le mma aa kee bɔr maatunwanbir pu daalbaadaal.

ref: And the fear of public disgrace never forced me to keep silent about what I had done. Why Doesn't God Listen?
text: Maa kee san binib aah ga len pu na aanimɔɔn; maa kee ka ŋmin, kaa kee bee kidiik ni, binib aalaar pu.

ref: Why doesn't God All-Powerful listen and answer? If God has something against me, let him speak up or put it in writing!
text: Ubaa aan pel maah len pu na aa? M puu ke libɔbil mɔk gbii la. Cha Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan gar mi. Maadim aah len mi tibɔr ti na yaa ba ŋmee dɔ aan m waa ti kan,

ref: Then I would wear his charges on my clothes and forehead.
text: m ba ga di ti leen mbɔgbin pu ni limakl ŋmeen, ki di ti chiŋ n‑yil pu ke kibɔryikpupuk na.

ref: And with my head held high, I would tell him everything I have ever done.
text: M ba ga bui Uwumbɔr maah tun pu na mɔmɔk, aan n‑yil li yaa unimbiin ni.

ref: I have never mistreated the land I farmed and made it mourn.
text: M yaa nan sun kitiŋ ki m ko na, ki gaa ki ukpaakon daan chee,

ref: If I had, I would pray for weeds instead of wheat to grow in my fields. After saying these things, Job was silent.
text: cha njikaabim mu m bun nima na kpaln timoor ni ikokon. Job aabɔr nan doo do la.

ref: Finally, these three men stopped arguing with Job, because he refused to admit he was guilty.
text: Job aah nan tii naadii usui ni ke waah kpa taani na, bijab bitaa ngbaan aa nan ki kpa tibaa bi gar u.

ref: He was also angry with Job's three friends for not being able to prove that Job was wrong.
text: Waaŋuul nan ki fii Job aajɔtiib bitaa na mu pu. Baa nan ki nyi baah ga gar Job pu na, le ni naahn ke Uwumbɔr aabɔr le aa kaa ŋan na.

ref: Elihu was younger than these three, and he let them speak first.
text: Elihu le nan ye uwaatiir nima chee, kina pu na, u nan si ŋmin le unii mɔk ti len doo.

ref: But he became irritated when they could not answer Job,
text: Waah nan ti kan ke bijab bitaa ngbaan aa ki kpa tibaa bi gar Job na, le waaŋuul fii,

ref: and he said to them: I am much younger than you, so I have shown respect by keeping silent.
text: le u piin ki len. Elihu aah len pu na M laa par, le nimi ma pɔɔk, kina pu le ijawaan ba joo mi ke m tuk nimi maah dak pu na.

ref: now I truly realize wisdom comes from God.
text: Tɔ, Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan Aafuur Nyaan le choo binib chee le ki tii bi nlan.

ref: That's why I ask you to listen to me. I Eagerly Listened *
text: Kina pu na, m ban ke ni pel m chee la; cha m bui nimi maah dak pu na.

ref: You shouldn't say, “We know what's right! Let God punish him.”
text: Ni ga ŋa kinye ki bui ke ni kan nlan? Uwumbɔr le ga gar Job, ba pu? ni nyaŋ nimi a.

ref: Job hasn't spoken against me, and so I won't answer him with your arguments.
text: Job ba len nimi le chee tibɔr, naa ye mi, le maan giin u ngiin mu ni giin u na daalbaadaal.

ref: All of you are shocked; you don't know what to say.
text: Job, baa kan ŋibɔbil bi di len; baa kpa ngarm ki ga tii si.

ref: But am I to remain silent, just because you have stopped speaking?
text: Baah si ŋmin na, ni ŋan ke m li beenin si kii ii? Bima le si na, kaa ki kpa tibaa bi len.

ref: because I have so much to say, that I can't keep quiet.
text: Ni ye mi kijejek le ke m len, maan ki ŋmaa chuu mbaa.

ref: I am like a swollen wineskin, and I will burst
text: M yaa kaa kan nsan m len kan, m ga puu ke ndapɔm aatuun na la.

ref: if I don't speak. *
text: Maan ki ŋman, m ga len la.

ref: I don't know how to be unfair or to flatter anyone—
text: Maan kpee ubaa pu kinikpakpak kee ponn ni; maan di kimɔmɔɔn ŋa ubaa.

ref: if I did, my Creator would quickly destroy me!
text: Maa nyi kimɔmɔɔn. M yaa ŋa kina kan, Uwumbɔr ga daa ntafal mala.

ref: Job, listen to me! Pay close attention. *
text: Tɔ, Job, li pel mbamɔm maah kpa timɔk m len na.

ref: Everything I will say
text: M ga len maah joo pu na mɔmɔk.

ref: is true and sincere,
text: Maabɔbil mɔmɔk ye ibamɔn, le m len ibamɔn.

ref: just as surely as the Spirit of God All-Powerful gave me the breath of life.
text: Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan le naan mi ki tii mi limɔfal.

ref: Now line up your arguments and prepare to face me.
text: Aa yaa ga ŋman kan, aa gar mi. Gor saanikpakpak.

ref: We each were made from clay, and God has no favorites,
text: M ni sin ye tiwanbaan le Uwumbɔr chee, tiyakr le u nan di ŋa ti mɔmɔk bilee.

ref: so don't be afraid of me or what I might do. I Have Heard You Argue
text: Kina na, saa kpa nsan ke aa li san mi; maan nyaŋ si.

ref: I have heard you argue
text: Tɔ, maah ŋun aa len tibɔr ti na sɔ:

ref: that you are innocent, guilty of nothing.
text: “Maabɔr aa bii; maa tun taani ubaa. Maabɔr ŋan, le maa kpa titunwanbir.

ref: You claim that God has made you his enemy,
text: Le Uwumbɔr ban isan i u joo tak mi ki ŋani mi ke udin na.

ref: that he has bound your feet and blocked your path.
text: U di tikululn le baa ntaa; u lik maah yoor litaal limɔk na.”

ref: But, Job, you're wrong— God is greater than any human.
text: Job, le m ban m bui si ke taa gbii. Uwumbɔr jer unibɔn mɔmɔk.

ref: So why do you challenge God to answer you?
text: Ba ŋa aa galni Uwumbɔr ke waa kee gar unii aabɔr?

ref: God speaks in different ways, and we don't always recognize his voice. *
text: Tɔ, Uwumbɔr len le ki gir len, ubaa mu aa pel waah len pu na.

ref: Sometimes in the night, he uses terrifying dreams
text: Binib yaa dɔ geen kinyeek kan, le Uwumbɔr len tibɔr tidaŋ ni.

ref: God does this to make us turn from sin and pride
text: Uwumbɔr len ke bi di cha titunwanbir aatum, ki taa yoor kigaak.

ref: and to protect us from being swept away to the world of the dead.
text: Waan cha bi kuln; u nyani bi nkun ni.

ref: Sometimes we are punished with a serious illness and aching joints.
text: Uwumbɔr joo iween le mɔk unii ni ŋan na, le ki cha uwon mɔmɔk wu.

ref: Merely the thought of our favorite food makes our stomachs sick,
text: Ubun aa neen tijikaar, le tijikaar ti ŋan sakpen na ye u ipoween la.

ref: and we become so skinny that our bones stick out.
text: Le uwon donn ti doo; aa ga li waa waakpab mɔmɔk;

ref: We feel death and the grave taking us in their grip.
text: le u gur bi ntekpiisan ni.

ref: One of a thousand angels then comes to our rescue by saying we are innocent.
text: Nibaakan Uwumbɔr aatuun ga dan nan ter u, Nibaakan, Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib ŋichur ponn ni ubaa u teer binib baatuln aah ye pu na le ga dan nan ter u.

ref: The angel shows kindness, commanding death to release us, because the price was paid.
text: Linimbaasaln ni, le ntuun ngbaan ga bui ke, “Di u lii, naa ye ke u buen bitekpiib aatiŋ ni. Saah ga di u lii pu na aapar sɔ.”

ref: Our health is restored, we feel young again,
text: Le uwon ga ki pɔnn ki pɔɔk;

ref: and we ask God to accept us. Then we joyfully worship God, and we are rewarded because we are innocent.
text: le u yaa mee limeel kan, Uwumbɔr ga kii waameel; le u di mpopiin doon Uwumbɔr; le Uwumbɔr ga ki gir ŋa waawan mbamɔm tii u.

ref: When that happens, we tell everyone, “I sinned and did wrong, but God forgave me
text: Le u ga sil binib ni ki len ke, “M tun titunwanbir. Maa tun ni ŋan na, le Uwumbɔr tee di cha pinn mi.

ref: and rescued me from death! Now I will see the light.”
text: Waa cha m buen bitekpiib aatiŋ ni, le m beenin fu.”

ref: God gives each of us chance after chance
text: Uwumbɔr ŋani nimina n‑yoonn mɔmɔk;

ref: to be saved from death and brought into the light that gives life.
text: u gaal unii aamɔfal lir, le ki tii u limɔfal aamɔɔn.

ref: though I would gladly listen to anything you say that proves you are right.
text: Tɔ, aa yaa tee kpa tibaa aa len kan, cha m ŋun ti; le aa yaa kpa mbamɔn kan, m ga kii ni mpopiin ke saabɔr ŋan.

ref: You men think you are wise, but just listen to me!
text: Nimi bijab bimina kpa nlan, ni kpa nlan sakpen a; li pel man maah bi len pu na.

ref: Then we can decide the case and give a just verdict.
text: Ni ye timi aatuln le ke ti lik tibɔr ngbaan ni.

ref: Job claims he is innocent and God is guilty of mistreating him.
text: Job bui ke waa kpa taani, ke Uwumbɔr le yii kaa tii u waabamɔn.

ref: Job also argues that God considers him a liar and that he is suffering severely in spite of his innocence.
text: U baa le ke, “M ga ŋa kinye ki gii nnyamɔn, ki bui ke m tun taani? Maa tun titunwanbir, le ki mu tee kan iweenkpaan.”

ref: But to tell the truth, Job is shameless!
text: Ni kee kan Job aaboln aa? Waa kee pak Uwumbɔr daalbaadaal.

ref: He spends his time with sinners,
text: U gee bibiindam aabɔr le ki chuun diir titunwanbirdam.

ref: because he has said, “It doesn't pay to please God.” If Any of You Are Smart
text: U len le ke aa yaa pɔɔni aabaa ke aa dii Uwumbɔr aageehn kan, naa kpa tinyoor tibaa.

ref: If any of you are smart, you will listen and learn that God All-Powerful does what is right.
text: Nimi binib bi kpa ŋuntii na, li pel m chee man. Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan ga ŋmaa ŋa tiwan ni kaa ŋan na aa?

ref: and he is never unfair.
text: Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan aa tun titunwanbir; waa ŋani ubaa beebee aatuln.

ref: From the very beginning, God has been in control of all the world.
text: Uwumbɔr kan waapɔɔn ŋma chee? Ŋma di u ŋa dulnyaa aayidaan?

ref: If God took back the breath that he breathed into us,
text: Uwumbɔr yaa chuu gaa limɔfal aafuurk kan,

ref: we humans would die and return to the soil.
text: unii u mɔmɔk kpa limɔfal na ba ga kpo le ki ki gir kpaln titan.

ref: So be smart and listen!
text: Aa yaa kpa nlan kan, pel m chee.

ref: The mighty God is the one who brings about justice, and you are condemning him.
text: Uwumbɔr mbimbinyaan daan le aa bui ke waabɔr aa ŋan aa? Aa dak ke waa gee ibamɔn aa?

ref: Indeed, God is the one who condemns unfair rulers.
text: Bibɔrb ni bijojoob yaa kaa bi tibaa ni, bee bi yaa kpa mbiin kan, Uwumbɔr bii baabɔr.

ref: And God created us all; he has no favorites, whether rich or poor.
text: Waa len tibɔr kpae bijojoob pu kaa ter uwankpadaan ki cha ugiin, ba pu? uma le naan unii mɔmɔk.

ref: Even powerful rulers die in the darkness of night when they least expect it, just like the rest of us. God Watches Everything We Do
text: Unii ga ŋmaa kpo kinyeek naa sɔk ntan. Uwumbɔr gbaa binib bilni le bi kpoi; waa joo mpɔɔn le ku binikpaam.

ref: God watches everything we do.
text: U lik binib aah yoor litaal limɔk na.

ref: No evil person can hide in the deepest darkness.
text: Mbɔmbɔɔn mubaa aa bi ki bɔɔn sakpen ki ga ŋmaa bɔr titunwanbirdaan Uwumbɔr chee.

ref: And so, God doesn't need to set a time for judgment.
text: Uwumbɔr aa ga li ban ke u siin n‑yoonn mu binib ga buen u chee libɔjil na.

ref: Without asking for advice, God removes mighty leaders and puts others in their place.
text: Waan li ban ke u fiir lik bisalolm aabɔr waahr aan ki nyan bi ki di biken kaan baabuu ni.

ref: He knows what they are like, and he wipes them out in the middle of the night.
text: Waah nyi baah tun pu na, u nyani bi le ki doo bi kinyeek.

ref: And while others look on, he punishes them because they were evil
text: Binib aanimbil ni le u dar titunwanbirdam aatafal,

ref: The persons they mistreated had prayed for help, until God answered their prayers.
text: Baabiin cha bigiim wii mpɔɔn yin Uwumbɔr, le u ŋun baaterm aayim ngbaan.

ref: When God does nothing, can any person or nation find fault with him?
text: Uwumbɔr yaa yii ke waan ŋa nibaa kan, ubaa aan ŋmaa galn u. U yaa di ubaa bɔr kan, binib aan ki li kpa nterm.

ref: But still, he punishes rulers who abuse their people.
text: Ŋitimbol aan ki ŋmaa ŋa nibaa aan bibiindam bi kaa nyi Uwumbɔr na taa joo bi.

ref: Job, you should tell God that you are guilty and promise to do better.
text: Job, aa kpiir saatunwanbir tuk Uwumbɔr ki puu ke saan ki tun titunwanbir aa?

ref: Then ask him to point out what you did wrong, so you won't do it again.
text: Aa baa Uwumbɔr ke u mɔk si saataani, ki kii ke aa ga di cha titunwanbir aa?

ref: Do you make the rules, or does God? You have to decide— I can't do it for you; now make up your mind.
text: Saah kaa kii tii Uwumbɔr aah ŋani pu na na, aa dak ke u ga ŋa saah ban pu na aa? Timina ye sin yaar la, naa ye min yaar; bui timi saah dak pu na.

ref: that you are speaking nonsense and lack good judgment.
text: u ga bui ke Job aa nyi le ki gbaa, ki bui ke waabɔr tibaa aa kpa tataa.

ref: So I pray for you to suffer as much as possible for talking like a sinner.
text: Dakl lik Job aah len pu na mɔmɔk ni; aa ga kan ke u len tibɔr ke utunwanbirdaan na la.

ref: You have rebelled against God, time after time, and have even insulted us.
text: U joo limɔyiir le kpae titunwanbir pu; le ki ŋani Uwumbɔr mbɔnyun ti mɔmɔk aanimbil ni.

ref: Job, are you really innocent in the sight of God?
text: Job, saa kpa nsan ke aa len Uwumbɔr chee ke saabɔr ŋan,

ref: Don't you honestly believe it pays to obey him?
text: bee aa baa Uwumbɔr ke, “Maatunwanbir muk si kinye? Maah kaa tun titunwanbir na, m kan ba aanyoor?”

ref: I will give the answers to you and your friends. *
text: M ban m giin aa ni aajɔtiib mɔk la.

ref: Look up to the heavens
text: Lik kitaapaak. Lik ntaalangbam chee aah daa pu na.

ref: Is any good you may have done at all helpful to him?
text: Saabimbinyaan tii u ba aaterm? Uwumbɔr aa ban nibaa aa chee.

ref: The evil or good you do only affects other humans.
text: Aanibɔn ŋeen aatɔ le ji falaa saatunwanbir pu, le ki ki kani nterm saaŋann pu.

ref: In times of trouble, everyone begs the mighty God to have mercy.
text: Binib yaa ji falaa kan, bi du la; le ki wii ban ke ubaa gaa bi lii,

ref: But after their Creator helps them through hard times, they forget about him,
text: kaa tee cha Uwumbɔr u naan bi ki cha bi gaa ilahn kinyeek na chee.

ref: though he makes us wiser than animals or birds.
text: Baa cha Uwumbɔr u cha ti kpa nlan ki jer tiwakor ni inyoon na chee.

ref: God won't listen to the prayers of proud and evil people.
text: Bi wii ban nterm, baagaak ni titunwanbir pu, le Uwumbɔr aan gar bi.

ref: If God All-Powerful refuses to answer their empty prayers,
text: Baawiil ye fam la; Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan aa waa bi le kaa kpaan ŋun bi pu.

ref: he will surely deny your impatient request to face him in court.
text: Job, aa bui ke saa waa Uwumbɔr; tɔ, ji limɔr, saabɔr bi u chee.

ref: Job, you were wrong to say God doesn't punish sin.
text: Aa dak ke Uwumbɔr aa dar binib aatafal, ke utafal bi titunwanbir ni siib kina la.

ref: Be patient a while longer; I have something else to say in God's defense.
text: Ji limɔr ki pel maah kpa pu m len tii Uwumbɔr na siib kpee.

ref: God always does right— and this knowledge comes straight from God.
text: Maalan nyaŋ a; m ga di maah nyi pu na le ki mɔk ke Uwumbɔr u naan mi na ye ubamɔndaan la.

ref: You can rest assured that what I say is true.
text: Maah len pu aa chee na mɔk gbii la; ulandaan le aa waa u si aa chee na.

ref: Although God is mighty, he cares about everyone and makes fair decisions.
text: Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn nyaŋ a. Waa lik seeni ubaa; tiwan nibaa aa bi aan waa nyi naatataa.

ref: The wicked are cut down, and those who are wronged receive justice.
text: Waa cha titunwanbirdam kpa limɔfafɔfɔŋ, le ki ŋani bigiim mbamɔm n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: God watches over good people and places them in positions of power and honor forever.
text: U kii binib bi aabimbin ŋan na; u tii bi nsan le bi joo binib ke bibɔrb na ki cha bi nyuŋni bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *
text: Binib yaa bi tikululn ni, ki ji baatuln aafalaa kan,

ref: God points out their sin and their pride,
text: Uwumbɔr mɔk bi baatunwanbir ni baagaak la.

ref: then he warns them to turn back to him.
text: U cha bi ŋun waah sak bi pu na ke ni cha bi yii titunwanbir.

ref: And if they obey, they will be successful and happy from then on.
text: Bi yaa kii tii Uwumbɔr ki dii u kan, bi bi nsuudoon, ni nkam ni, le ki yunn ti chaar jer.

ref: But if they foolishly refuse, they will be rewarded with a violent death. Godless People Are Too Angry
text: Tɔ, bi yaa yii kan, le bi ga kpo maanyi ni, le ki koo kitekpiitiŋ ni.

ref: Godless people are too angry to ask God for help when he punishes them.
text: Binib bi kaa nyi Uwumbɔr na aaŋuul fiir n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, hali bi yaa kan ntafadaan kan, baa mee Uwumbɔr ki ban nterm.

ref: So they die young in shameful disgrace.
text: Bi laa pɔɔn le ki kpo, inimɔɔn le ŋman ku bi.

ref: Hard times and trouble are God's way of getting our attention!
text: Le Uwumbɔr joo falaa mɔk binib ichiin, le ki joo nsuubiin wolni binimbil.

ref: And at this very moment, God deeply desires to lead you from trouble and to spread your table with your favorite food.
text: Uwumbɔr nyan si tibɔr ni, le ki cha aa bi ŋŋmarm ni; u tii si tijikaar sakpen.

ref: Now that the judgment for your sins has fallen upon you,
text: Tɔ, dandana wee le aa kan ntafadaan mu ŋeer si na.

ref: don't let your anger and the pain you endured make you sneer at God.
text: Li nyi ki taa cha igaŋgaŋlik ŋmann si, ki taa cha liwankpal di si yenn.

ref: nor can you find safety in the dark world below.
text: Taa li wii ban ke kinyeek fuu ni, n‑yoonn mu ŋitimbol ga kuln na.

ref: Be on guard! Don't turn to evil as a way of escape.
text: Li nyi ki taa gir buen kinimbɔŋ aapepel; saafalaa dan ke u nyan si nima chee la.

ref: God's power is unlimited. He needs no teachers
text: Teer Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn aah nyaŋ pu na; uma le ye umɔmɔkr kpaan ki jer bimɔmɔkb mɔmɔk.

ref: to guide or correct him. Others Have Praised God
text: Ubaa aan ŋmaa bui Uwumbɔr waah ga ŋa pu na, kaan ŋmaa galn u ke u tun titunwanbir.

ref: Others have praised God for what he has done, so join with them.
text: U kani kipak waatun mɔmɔk ni, n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la; ni ye saatuln le ke aa mu pak u.

ref: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen
text: Unibɔn mɔk kan waah tun pu na; le ti tee ga li si dandar le ki lik.

ref: how great God is— God is more than we imagine; no one can count the years he has lived. *
text: Taan ŋmaa bee waapɔɔn aah ti nyaŋ pu na, kaan ŋmaa kahn waabin aah ye pu na.

ref: God gathers moisture into the clouds
text: Uwumbɔr le nyani nnyun kitiŋ ni le ki di mu kpaln ntaanyun.

ref: Who can understand how God scatters the clouds and speaks from his home in the thunderstorm?
text: Ubaa aa nyi ntaalangbam ngbaan aah chuun pu na, kaa nyi utaal aah tar pu ki diir kitaapaak, Uwumbɔr aah koo nin chee na.

ref: And when God sends lightning, it can be seen at the bottom of the sea.
text: U cha utaal moor kitaapaak mɔmɔk ni, le nnyusakpem aataab ma bɔɔn le kaa woln kpala.

ref: By producing such rainstorms, God rules the world and provides us with food.
text: Kina le u joo binib le ki tii bi tijikaar ki ti nyaŋ.

ref: Each flash of lightning is one of his arrows striking its target,
text: U di uŋaal le chuu ntaamii le ki cha mu buen waah mɔk nin chee na.

ref: and the thunder tells of his anger against sin.
text: Utaal aah gbin pu na le mɔk ke kitaabuŋ choo, le tiwakor nyi ke ki choo.

ref: I am frightened and tremble all over,
text: Kitaabuŋ cha mpobil gbaa lib lib.

ref: when I hear the roaring voice of God in the thunder,
text: Ni mɔmɔk li pel man Uwumbɔr aaneel, li pel man utaal aah gbin ki nyani umɔb ni pu na.

ref: and when I see his lightning flash across the sky.
text: U cha utaal moor ki puur kitaapaak ki nya kitiŋ lipepel libaa ki ti saa liken.

ref: creating miracles too marvelous for us to understand.
text: Uwumbɔr aamɔboln pu le iwaan aawan ŋani, lijinjiir aawan ni taan ŋmaa bee naatataa na ŋani.

ref: make us stop and think about God's power,
text: U chur unibɔn aatuln siini; u mɔk bi waah ga ŋmaa tun pu na la.

ref: and they force animals to seek shelter.
text: Ipeel chaa yaakookoo yaan ni la.

ref: and the breath of God freezes streams and rivers.
text: Uwumbɔr aafuurk cha nnyun kpaln ŋitaanal, ki cha ŋi pɔɔk ke litakpal na.

ref: Rain clouds filled with lightning appear at God's command,
text: Utaal moor lak lak ntaalangbam ni,

ref: to release their cargo— sometimes as punishment for sin, sometimes as kindness. Consider Carefully
text: Uwumbɔr tuni utaal le u nan sɔŋni kitiŋ, u ga ŋmaa di u daa unibɔn aatafal, ki ga ŋmaa di u mɔk bi waaŋann.

ref: Job, consider carefully the many wonders of God.
text: Job, sil siib, ki pel; dakl lik lijinjiir aawan ni Uwumbɔr ŋani na.

ref: Can you explain why lightning flashes at the orders
text: Aa nyi Uwumbɔr aah tii waamɔboln pu ki cha utaal moor lak lak ntaalangbam ni na aa?

ref: of God who knows all things? Or how he hangs the clouds in empty space?
text: Aa nyi ntaalangbam aah ŋa pu ki dee kitaapaak na aa? Ni ye Uwumbɔr u nyi tiwan mɔmɔk na aawaan aatuln la.

ref: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.
text: Ŋŋangii wɔb aabuln yaa muk kitiŋ le kan, aa ga ji ntoton aafalaa.

ref: God can hammer out the clouds in spite of the oppressive heat, but can you?
text: Aa ga ŋmaa ter Uwumbɔr aan u daa taln kitaapaak ki cha ki li pɔɔ ke tikur ti joon kpal kpal na aa?

ref: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.
text: Mɔk timi taah ga len Uwumbɔr chee pu na. Nibaa aa bi tiyil ponn ni; taa nyi taah ga len pu na.

ref: Should I risk my life by telling God that I want to speak?
text: Maan mee nsan ke m ni Uwumbɔr len tɔb chee tibɔr; maan tii u nsan ke u kuln mi.

ref: No one can stare at the sun after a breeze has blown the clouds from the sky.
text: Tɔ, dandana wee, le nwiihn mu bi kitaapaak na deer ŋinimbil, mu wiin ki jer taah ga ŋmaa lik pu na; le libuln ŋar kitaapaak woln chain.

ref: Yet the glorious splendor of God All-Powerful is brighter by far.
text: Nwiihn mu naahn salmaa na bi ŋŋangan wɔb, le Uwumbɔr aapak chuu timi ijawaan.

ref: God cannot be seen— but his power is great, and he is always fair.
text: Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn nyaŋ sakpen, le taan ŋmaa duun ni u; u kpa mbimbinyaan ki bi chob unibɔn chee.

ref: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.
text: Kina pu na, naa kpa iwaan ke unii mɔmɔk san u ijawaan, kina pu na, utafal aa bi binib bi bui ke bi kpa nlan na ni.

ref: From out of a storm, the Lord said to Job:
text: Le Uwumbɔr aaneel nyan ni kitaabuŋ ni ki len Job chee tibɔr. Uwumbɔr aah len pu na

ref: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?
text: Aa mu ye ŋma ke aa di maanyi ni bɔfam tɔŋ maalan?

ref: Now get ready to face me! Can you answer the questions I ask?
text: Fii sil ke uja na ki giin maabaan mu m baa si na.

ref: How did I lay the foundation for the earth? Were you there?
text: Maah nan naan dulnyaa na, aa nan bi ii? Aa yaa nyi sakpen kan, bui mi ti ponn ni.

ref: When the ocean was born, I set its boundaries
text: Nnyusakpem aah nan puu nyan ni kitiŋ aapuul ni na, ŋma nan di ibisamɔi piin kiir mu?

ref: and wrapped it in blankets of thickest fog.
text: Min le nan di ntaalangbam biin nnyusakpem pu ki di mu ŋa mbɔmbɔɔn ni.

ref: Then I built a wall around it, locked the gates,
text: M nan daan nnyusakpem aanaanmɔk ki di mu siin ibisamɔi i laŋ na aapuwɔb.

ref: and said, “Your powerful waves stop here! They can go no farther.” Did You Ever Tell the Sun To Rise?
text: M nan bui mu ke, “Sil nima ki taa ki foor. Do le saanyunkpenn ti pɔɔ sakpen na ga sil.”

ref: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?
text: Job, saamɔfal mɔmɔk ni, aa kee bui kitaak kibaa ke ki woln aa?

ref: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?
text: Aa kee bui kitaak ke ki chɔb chuu kitiŋ ki dam ki, aan bibiindam nya ni baah bɔr nin chee na aa?

ref: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.
text: Nwiin pu aawiihn wiin sakpen bibiindam chee ki cha baa ŋmaa tun mbiin aatun.

ref: Job, have you ever walked on the ocean floor?
text: Aa kee buen nnyusakpem taab aayayak aanyunbun na chee ee? Aa kee chuun nnyusakpem taab aatiŋ pu uu?

ref: Have you seen the gate to the world of the dead?
text: Ubaa kee mɔk si ibisamɔi i kiir kitekpiitiŋ ki bɔɔn na aa?

ref: And how large is the earth? Tell me, if you know!
text: Aa nyi dulnyaa aawiwiir aah ye pu na aa? Aa yaa nyi kan, gar mi.

ref: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?
text: Aa nyi nwiin aah nya ni nin chee na, bee mbɔmbɔɔn aah nya ni nin chee na aa?

ref: I'm certain you must be able to, since you were already born when I created everything.
text: M kpa limakl ke aa ga ŋman, ba pu? aa por sakpen ki nan bi buyoonn dulnyaa nan naan na.

ref: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail,
text: Aa kee buen tidir ti ponn ni m siini ŋitaanal ni itaapiin na chee ee?

ref: until I use them to punish and conquer nations?
text: M siin ni ŋi kiir tibɔr yoonn la, ŋi si kii butɔb ni kijaak aawiin la.

ref: Who carves out a path for thunderstorms? Who sends torrents of rain
text: Ŋma nan gbii nnyunsan tii utaal u bar kpir ni na? Ŋma nan naan nsan tii utaal aah gbin kitaabuŋ ki ponn ni na?

ref: on empty deserts where no one lives?
text: Ŋma cha utaal nu binib aah kaa koo nin chee na?

ref: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.
text: Ŋma tii kitiŋ ki kuur aan nnyunyuu mu joo ki na nnyun ki cha timoor punn?

ref: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?
text: Utaal bee limaln kpa te ee?

ref: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock? Can You Arrange Stars?
text: Ŋitaatakpal ni likpakpal, ni cha nnyun kpaln litakpal ki cha nnyusakpem aapaacham pɔɔk na aana ye ŋma?

ref: Can you arrange stars in groups such as Orion and the Pleiades?
text: Aa ga ŋmaa buu kiŋmabipaak kpaan tɔb ni ii? bee aa ga ŋmaa sɔkr tiwan ni joo uŋmadar na lii la aa?

ref: Do you control the stars or set in place the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper?
text: Aa ga ŋmaa mɔk iŋmabi n‑yoonn mubaa ki ti saa muken aa? ki ga ŋmaa mɔk iŋmabi i bi yin i ke Upeel sakpiin na ni yaabim nsan aa?

ref: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?
text: Aa nyi ikaal i joo kitaapaak na aa? Aa ga ŋmaa di ikaal ngbaan joo kitiŋ aa?

ref: Can you order the clouds to send a downpour,
text: Aa ga ŋmaa teen tuk ntaalangbam ki cha mu cha utaal bar nnyun aa?

ref: Did you teach birds to know that rain or floods are on their way?
text: Ŋma tuk Nail aamɔɔl aanyoon na ke Nail ga nya nwam, bee ŋma tuk ukooja ke utaal ga nu?

ref: Can you count the clouds or pour out their water
text: Ŋma kpa nlan sakpen ki ga ŋmaa kahn ntaalangbam, ki ga ŋmaa gbuun mu aan utaal bar nnyun kpir,

ref: on the dry, lumpy soil?
text: aan kitangbaak ŋmaan ki pɔɔk?

ref: When lions are hungry, do you help them hunt?
text: Aa ban tijikaar tii ichinn ke i ji, ki cha ichinn aabim ji babr

ref: Do you send an animal into their den?
text: buyoonn i dɔ bɔr yaatakpaluŋ ni, bee buyoonn i dɔ yaadɔdooyaan ki kii na aa?

ref: And when starving young ravens cry out to me for food, do you satisfy their hunger?
text: Ŋma kpiini ikaabɔn buyoonn i bi kpak aan nkon joo i, aan yaabim wii ban tijikaar m chee na?

ref: When do mountain goats and deer give birth? Have you been there when their young are born? *
text: Aa nyi buyoonn ŋijoo paab aaŋoob maa na aa? Aa kee kan upeeman aah bi maa pu na aa?

ref: Soon their young grow strong and then leave to be on their own.
text: Timoor ni le yaabim ŋani mpɔɔn, le ki siir kaan ki gir ni.

ref: They stay far from crowded cities and refuse to be tamed.
text: Yaa duuni ntim mu kpa kifuuk sakpen na chee, le ubaa aan ŋmaa tiŋ i ki cha i tun lituln.

ref: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
text: Umonaa ga tun lituln tii si ii? U ga li gee ke u sil saanaakook ni kinyeek aa?

ref: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
text: Aa ga ŋmaa di ŋŋmin leen ubaa ki cha u ko tii si ii? Bee aa ga ŋmaa cha u kpar saasikpel tii si ii?

ref: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?
text: Aa ga ŋmaa li mak waapɔɔnsakpiin pu ki dakl ke u tun lituln li pɔɔ na tii si ii?

ref: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place? An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
text: Aa dak ke u ga ŋmaa kuun saah chee tijikaar ti na ki faar njikaabim ŋipaa pu uu?

ref: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
text: Taataa aafeen gbaa mala mala pam. Taataa ubaa mu aan ŋmaa fii ke uneepɔɔn na.

ref: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.
text: Taataa too waajen bilni kitiŋ le ke titan aatoton cha ŋi li ton.

ref: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.
text: Waa nyi ke unii aataa ŋmaa taar wiil ŋi, kaa nyi ke upeel ubaa ga ŋmaa wii ŋi.

ref: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.
text: U ŋani ke ŋijen ngbaan aah kaa ye uyaan le na, le utafal aa bi ŋi ni ke waatuln bee yooli.

ref: I myself made her foolish and without common sense.
text: Min le ŋa u ujɔr kaa tii u nlan.

ref: But once she starts running, she laughs at a rider on the fastest horse. Did You Give Horses Their Strength?
text: Tɔ, u yaa piin litaasaln kan, u ga ŋmaa laa utaan ni unii u jak u na mɔk.

ref: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?
text: Job, sin le nan cha itaan kpa mpɔɔn sakpen ki tii i itangbar i fɔk na aa?

ref: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?
text: Sin le cha i yuk ke itoon na ki joo yaah fɔi pu na faani binib aa?

ref: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.
text: I kur kitangbaak kifataŋ ni, i joo yaapɔɔn mɔmɔk le ber ti koo butɔb ni.

ref: Laughing at fear, they rush toward the fighting,
text: Yaa nyi ijawaan aah ye pu na, le kijaak aajuk aan ŋmaa cha i fenn ipuwɔb.

ref: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.
text: Bijab bi jak i na aah joo tijawan ni na weeni le ki moor nwiin ni lak lak.

ref: Unable to stand still, they gallop eagerly into battle when trumpets blast.
text: Itaan ngbaan aasui piir le iwon gbaa kpab kpab, le i tur cha. Ukpiin yaa wii kan, yaa ki ŋmaa chuu ibaa.

ref: Stirred by the distant smells and sounds of war, they snort in reply to the trumpet.
text: Ukpiin yaa wii nfum mubaa kan, le i fɔi, i ŋun butɔb aanunun waahr le ki nin duun bu, le ki ŋun bijab aaninkpiib aah len baajab chee pu na.

ref: Did you teach hawks to fly south for the winter? *
text: Ukaa yaa taln ufeen toŋ ŋŋangii wɔb kan, sin chee le u bae waah ga fii pu na aa?

ref: where they can look down to spot their next meal?
text: Nima chee le li lik kɔnkɔni, ni dandar ke li kan nibaa ki chuu ki ji.

ref: Then their young gather to feast wherever the victim lies.
text: Ŋikaagii kuuni gonni liwankpol la, le ŋaabim nyu liwankpol ngbaan aasin.

ref: but you have argued that I am wrong. Now you must answer me.
text: Job, aa kpak Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan; aa ga di cha le aan aa ga gar la? Job aah gar pu na

ref: I did speak once or twice, but never again.
text: M puun len jer maah ba ga len pu na a.

ref: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:
text: Le Uwumbɔr ki len Job chee kitaabuŋ ni. Uwumbɔr aah ki len pu na

ref: Face me and answer the questions I ask!
text: Fii sil ke uja na, ki gar maabaan.

ref: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?
text: Aa ban ke aa mɔk ke maa bi chob, ki bui ke maabɔr bii le aa ma yaar ŋan aa?

ref: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?
text: Aa kpa mpɔɔn ke min na aa? Aaneel ga li ŋmaa pɔɔ ke min yaan na aa?

ref: If so, then surround yourself with glory and majesty. *
text: Ni yaa ye kina kan, di saanyuŋ ni limakl fii sil; di mpɔɔn ni kipak biin aabaa pu.

ref: Show your furious anger! Throw down and crush
text: Lik binib bi kpa kigaak na; nyan saaŋuul ki sunn bi taab.

ref: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
text: Di bi mɔmɔk sub kitiŋ; baa bi kaan kitekpiitiŋ ni.

ref: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
text: Le m ga li ye u ga puen pak si ki kii ke aabaa pu le aa nyaŋ na.

ref: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox,
text: Lik kipeewanbiik umɔɔpeel; min le naan u, ki naan aa mu, u ŋmɔ timoor ke unaa na la.

ref: but look at the mighty muscles in its body
text: Tɔ, lik mpɔɔn mu bi uwon ni na, ki lik mpɔɔn mu bi waagiin ni na.

ref: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
text: Waajuul si paacham ke santina aasub na la, le ŋigir ŋi bi utaa ni na pɔɔ.

ref: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.
text: Waakpab pɔɔ ke tikumann na la, le utaa bi ke ikudɔ na.

ref: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.
text: Uma le ye iwaan aawan maawanfuurkaan mɔmɔk ni. Min u naan u na baanja le ga ŋmaa nyaŋ u.

ref: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
text: Timoor ti ga kpiin u na muuni ŋigongon paab nin chee ipeel gbiir na la.

ref: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank
text: U doo ikokon taab la, le ki bɔrni timɔɔmoor ni, kipuuk ni.

ref: It remains calm and unafraid with the Jordan River rushing and splashing in its face.
text: Waa san limɔɔl aanyunja ijawaan; Jɔɔdann aamɔɔl aanyun yaa peei unimbil wɔb kan, u ŋmin suuna la.

ref: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
text: Ŋma ga ŋmaa ŋum unimbil ki chuu u? Ŋma ga ŋmaa pen gaawɔb chuu umɔfal?

ref: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
text: Aa ga ŋmaa di njapiin chuu unyiib, bee aa ga di ŋŋmin gbin ulambil aa?

ref: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?
text: Aa ga ŋmaa di ŋŋmin ŋa umɔfal ni, bee aa di njapiin lɔk ulakpak ni ii?

ref: Can it be tied by the leg like a pet bird for little girls?
text: Aa ga ŋmaa baa u ke unyoon u aa kpiini u na aa? Aa ga ŋmaa baa u ke tiwan ni saanaagbiipiibim ga li gbiir na aa?

ref: Is it ever chopped up and its pieces bargained for in the fish-market?
text: Bijanbam ga kpak waadaak pu uu? Binib bi tiir kitiirk na ga chɔi waanann ke bi ti tiir aa?

ref: Merely a glimpse of this monster makes all courage melt.
text: Unii umɔk kan unyiib ngbaan na aataakpab yɔl le u lir kitiŋ.

ref: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?
text: Aa yaa gbee kpir u kan, u bir sakpen; ubaa aan kaa ki sil u chee.

ref: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.
text: Ŋma ga ŋmaa tak u ki ŋmar? Ubaa aa bi dulnyaa wee ni ki ga ŋa kina.

ref: What powerful legs, what a stout body this monster possesses!
text: Cha m tuk si waataa aabɔr, ki tuk si waah pɔɔ ti nyaŋ pu na.

ref: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?
text: Ubaa aan ŋmaa kar waapaacham aagban, bee u saa chaar waajaak aabɔkul li u pee na.

ref: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
text: Ŋma ga ŋmaa cha u waar umɔb u gbii ijawaan aanyin na?

ref: than breath to breath. When This Monster Sneezes
text: Ti mɔmɔk bub joo tɔb kin kin, le nibaa aan ŋmaa daa yakr ti.

ref: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.
text: U yaa chiin ichiin kan, mmii moor la, le unimbil nyakr ke nwiin aah bi puur pu na.

ref: Sparks and fiery flames explode from its mouth.
text: Imiigaal gaal le ki nya ni umɔb ni, le mmiibil poor ki nya ni.

ref: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
text: Iŋmanyuu nya ni umɔfal ni ke idɔ i bi wu likumbuul taab na la.

ref: while its blazing breath scorches everything in sight.
text: Waafuurk cha mmii gaal la; le imiigaal yuk nya ni umɔb ni.

ref: Its neck is so tremendous that everyone trembles,
text: Usil pɔɔ sakpen, le unii umɔk to u nsan ni na san ijawaan.

ref: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron,
text: Waagban nibaa chee aa bi ki diin; mu pɔɔ le kaa geei kpala ke tikur na.

ref: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
text: U yaa fii sil kan, hali bipɔɔndam san ijawaan la; ijawaan le ban i nyaŋ bi.

ref: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.
text: Tikur diin u chee ke kimook na la, le tikumann diin sɔk sɔk ke ndɔ mu bur na.

ref: Rocks thrown from a sling cause it no more harm than husks of grain. This monster fears no arrows,
text: Mpiin mubaa aa bi ki ga ŋmaa cha u san; le ŋitakpal ŋi yur u na naahn kimook la.

ref: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.
text: Lichakukul bi u chee ke mmoon na la, le binib yaa too u tikpaatunn kan, u laa la.

ref: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.
text: Tikakr ti bi upɔtiŋ taab na bi ke ncheen na la; ŋi geei tikpakpar aatiŋ ke likuul na la.

ref: And when it swims down deep, the sea starts churning like boiling oil,
text: U gbir nnyusakpem ke nnyuntom aah leer pu na, le ki cha mu kpenni ke likpakumbuul na.

ref: and it leaves behind a trail of shining white foam.
text: U chuun le ki cha kipɔtiŋ taab piin ki paa u pu, le ki cha nnyusakpem kpaln tipupur pipiin.

ref: No other creature on earth is so fearless.
text: Uŋeen aatɔ aa bi kitiŋ pu; u ye tiwanfuurkaan ni kaa san ijawaan na.

ref: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
text: U lik seen ipeel i kpa kigaak sakpen na la; uma le ye tiwakor mɔmɔk aabɔr.

ref: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
text: Uwumbɔr, m nyi ke aa ye mpɔɔnsakpiindaan la; ki nyi ke aa ga ŋmaa ŋa tiwan ni mɔmɔk aa ban na.

ref: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
text: Aa baa ke maa nyi nibaa ki ŋa kinye aan ki ti pen si nlan. M len tiwan ni aabɔr maa nyi na ki len ŋijinjii aawansakpenn ni maan ŋmaa bee naatataa na aabɔr.

ref: You told me to listen and answer your questions.
text: Aa bui mi ke m li pel aan aa len, ki pɔɔn mbaa ki gar saabaan.

ref: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
text: N‑yoonn mu jer na m nan nyi biken aah tuk mi pu na baanja la, le dandana ma nnimbigbaŋ kan si.

ref: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
text: Uwumbɔr aah len Job chee tibɔr ti doo na, le u bui Elifas ke, “Maaŋuul fii aa ni aajɔtiib bilee na pu, ba pu? naa len ibamɔn m pu ke maatutunn Job aah len pu na.

ref: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
text: Tɔ, dandana chuu man inaaja ilole ni ipihja ilole ki di buen Job chee, ki ti toor kitork tii nibaa pu. Job ga mee limeel tii nimi, le m ga kii waameel, ki taa jinn nimi inimɔɔn naah ŋeer pu na. Naa len ibamɔn m pu ke waah len pu na.”

ref: Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar obeyed the Lord, and he answered Job's prayer. A Happy Ending
text: Elifas, ni Bildad, ni Sofar nan ŋa Uwumbɔr aah bui bi ke bi ŋa pu na, le Uwumbɔr kii Job aameel.

ref: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
text: Tɔ, Job aah nan mee Uwumbɔr tii ujɔtiib bitaa ngbaan doo na, le Uwumbɔr ki tii u liwangol, ki tii u nfum mulee pu waah nan kpa pu na.

ref: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
text: Job aakpetiib, ni unaatiib, ni uninkpatiib, ni ujɔtiib mɔmɔk nan dan nan mann u ki jin njim u chee waadichal ni. Bi nan san u kinimbaak ki sɔŋ usui, tibɔbir ti Uwumbɔr di tii u na pu. Bi mɔmɔk ubaabaa nan tii u ŋimombil ni salmaa aabɔmbik.

ref: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
text: Job nan ma mbijabim bilole ni mpiibim mutaa.

ref: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
text: Bipiib aa nan ki bi dulnyaa wee mɔmɔk ponn ni ki ŋan ke Job aabisatiib na. Bite nan cha bi ni bininjatiib kpaan ki yakr waafaal la.

ref: and when he finally died, he was very old.
text: le ki nan por sakpen sakpen ki nin kpo.

ref: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
text: Binib bi yii titunwanbirdam aasurm, kaa dii kinimbɔŋdam aabimbin, kaa kpaani binib bi kaa nyi Uwumbɔr na chee na kpa mpopiin.

ref: ) The Way to Happiness
text: ) Mpopiin bamɔnn

ref: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
text: Baah gee pu na le ye ke bi keei Uwumbɔr Aakaal aah len pu na, le ki bae mu nwiin pu ni kinyeek.

ref: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
text: Bi naahn isui i si gbɔk nkpen na la; i lu ŋisubionn mu ŋeer na la, le yaafar aa kuur. Bi kani tinyoor baatuln mɔmɔk ni.

ref: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
text: Le titunwanbirdam ma aa bi kina kpala; bi naahn tigbengbir ti libuln daar joo cha na la.

ref: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
text: Uwumbɔr ga bui ke kinimbɔŋdam aabɔr bii ki taa cha bi kpaan uma Uwumbɔr aanib chee.

ref: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
text: Uwumbɔr le kiir ki joo bininyaam, le titunwanbirdam ma cha baadoon ni.

ref: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
text: Ba ŋa ŋinibol kpokl ke ŋi yii Uwumbɔr aamɔb? Ba ŋa binib dak ilandak i kaa kpa tinyoor na?

ref: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
text: Baabɔrb yiil Uwumbɔr aamɔb, le baajojoob kpaani ki kpokl Uwumbɔr, ni waah lee ubɔr u na pu.

ref: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
text: Bi len ke, “Cha ti gaa tibaa bi chee man, cha ti di baasan mee man.”

ref: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
text: Le Uwumbɔr ka waabɔrjal pu paacham, ki laa bi, ki ŋani bi yaansara, baalandak i kaa pɔɔ na pu.

ref: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
text: Le waaŋuul ponn ni u sak bi, ki di waaŋuul faan bi.

ref: “I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.”
text: U bui ke, “Maagongoln Sionn li bi chain na pu, le m maa kaan maabɔr.”

ref: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
text: Ubɔr ngbaan len ke, “M ga moon Uwumbɔr aah len pu na. U bui mi ke, ‘Sin le ye maabo, din wee le m ma si.

ref: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
text: Mee mi, aan m ga di ŋitimbol ngbaan mɔmɔk tii si; kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk ga li ye sin yaan la.

ref: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
text: Aa ga di tikur aadabil gbaa kool bi; aa ga gbaa wii bi yak yak ke tiyakr aabuul na la.’”

ref: Be smart, all you rulers, and pay close attention.
text: Nimi bibɔrb, li pel man nsurm mue; nimi dulnyaa aajojoob, bae man mbaem mue:

ref: Serve and honor the Lord; be glad and tremble.
text: Di ijawaan dii Uwumbɔr man,

ref: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
text: li gbeer man ki ti gbaan unimbiin ni; naa ye kina kan, waaŋuul ga fii mala, le ni ga kpo libuul ngbaan ni. Binib bi mɔmɔk chaa u chee ti ban ke u kiir bi na kpa mpopiin.

ref: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
text: Uwumbɔr, m kpa bidim sakpen a, binib bi kaa gee mi na wiir sakpen a.

ref: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
text: Bi len mi, le ki bui ke, “Uwumbɔr aan ter u.”

ref: But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.
text: Uwumbɔr, le sin le ye kijaak aapeln li kii mi tibɔbir chee na; aa tii mi linyaŋ, ki pɔɔk ntaakpab.

ref: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
text: M yin Uwumbɔr ki ban nterm, le u bi waagongoln li bi chain na pu ki keei maayim.

ref: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
text: M doo ki geeni, le Uwumbɔr ye maakikiir kinyeek mɔk.

ref: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
text: Maa san bidim ŋichur ŋichur ŋi mann gob mi na ijawaan.

ref: Come and save me, Lord God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth,
text: Uwumbɔr, dan. Maawumbɔr, gaa mi lii. Sin le dar maadim mɔmɔk aatafal, le baa ki kpa mpɔɔn mubaa bi tun mi titunwanbir.

ref: because you protect and bless your people.
text: Linyaŋ nyani Uwumbɔr chee la, u ŋa waanyoor ŋa waanib pu.

ref: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
text: Maawumbɔr, maakikiir, m yaa mee si kan, kii mi. Maah nan bi limukl ni na, aa nan ter mi. San mi kinimbaak dandana wee, ki pel maameel.

ref: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
text: Nimi binib bimina, ni ga seei mi ki ti saa bayoonn? Ni ga li gee tiwan ni kaa kpa tinyoor tibaa na, ki chuun dii inyamɔn aawan ki ti saa bayoonn?

ref: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
text: Teer man ke Uwumbɔr le lee bininyaam ke bi li ye waanib, le m yaa yin u ki ban nterm kan, u ŋun maayim ngbaan.

ref: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
text: Di cha titunwanbir, ki li jii ijawaan pu. Ni yaa dɔ suuna nimi aawandookaan pu kan, ni dakl lik nimina mbamɔm man.

ref: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord.
text: Toor man kitork ki tok na tii Uwumbɔr, ki di naadii tii u.

ref: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
text: Binib pam le mee ke: “Uwumbɔr, moo tii timi saanyoor. San timi kinimbaak.”

ref: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
text: Le saah tii mi mpopiin mu na jer baah ga di tijikaar ni ndaan sakpen kan mpopiin mu na.

ref: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
text: M yaa doon kan, le m geen suuna; Uwumbɔr, sin baanja le kii mi mbamɔm.

ref: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
text: Uwumbɔr, li pel maamɔboln, ki ŋun maah ker idun pu na.

ref: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
text: Maawumbɔr u ye maabɔr na, li ŋun maah yin si ki ban nterm pu na. Uwumbɔr, m mee si la;

ref: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
text: aa ŋun maameel kichakpiik ni; nwiin yaa puu kan, le m di maameel tii si, ki kii saah ga gar mu pu na.

ref: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
text: Aa ye Uwumbɔr u kaa gee titunwanbir na la; saa cha kinimbɔŋ duun ni si.

ref: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
text: Aa bii binyamɔndam mɔmɔk doo ki lik seeni binib bi bir ki ŋmanni biken na.

ref: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord, and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.
text: Le saageehm sakpem pu m ga ŋmaa koo ni Saadichal ni; m ga ŋmaa doon si Saadichal li bi chain na ponn ni, ki di kipak gbaan aanimbiin ni.

ref: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
text: Uwumbɔr, m kpa bidim sakpen a. Mɔk mi saageehn, ki cha m bee saalandak ki dii mu.

ref: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
text: Maan kii tii maadim aah len pu na; bi ban bi li bii baanja la. Baamɔliin mɔ le ki joon; le ki tee gbii ŋŋmann mu ga ku na.

ref: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
text: Uwumbɔr, bii baabɔr ki daa bitafal; cha bibaa aakpokl ku bi doo. Baatunwanbir sakpenn, ni baah yii saamɔb pu na, jenn nyan bi aanimbiin ni.

ref: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
text: Le binib bi kan ŋŋmarm aa chee na ma ga li mɔɔni; bi ga ŋmaa gaa ilahn mpopiin pu n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Li kii binib bi mɔmɔk gee si na; ba pu? sin pu le bi kpa mpopiin bamɔnn.

ref: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa ŋani tinyoor ŋani bi keei saamɔb na pu; le saageehm kii bi ke kijaak aapeln na.

ref: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
text: Uwumbɔr, taa gee m pu liŋuul ki kae mi. Taa daa ntafal saaŋuul ponn ni.

ref: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
text: Uwumbɔr, nwon mɔmɔk kpo a, san mi kinimbaak. M bak sakpen a; pɔɔk ntaakpab,

ref: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
text: m bi limukl ponn ni la. Uwumbɔr, aa ga yunn kinye aan ki nan nin ter mi?

ref: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
text: Uwumbɔr, dan nan gaa mi lii; di saanimbaak nyan mi nkun ni.

ref: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
text: Ubaa aa teer aabɔr kitekpiitiŋ ni; ubaa aan ŋmaa pak si nima.

ref: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
text: Mpombiin cha nwon mɔmɔk kpo a; maah wii kinyeek mɔmɔk pu na cha maawandookaan sɔŋ a, tinyunyunn sɔŋ maayikukur a.

ref: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
text: Maadim aah cha m wii pu na duun duun nnimbil a, le maa ki waa mbamɔm.

ref: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
text: Nimi kinimbɔŋdam, siir m chee man, Uwumbɔr ŋun maah wii pu na;

ref: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
text: u pel maah wii ban nterm pu na, ki ga kii maameel.

ref: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
text: Maadim ga bee nlirm aanimɔɔn aah wu pu na; libuul ngbaan ni le bilan ga ŋmal, le bi jenn yaa bi.

ref: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
text: Ndindaan Uwumbɔr, m dan aa chee ki ban nterm la; li kii mi ki gaa mi binib bi mɔmɔk san dii mi na chee lii,

ref: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
text: kina kan, aa cha maadim li san dii mi ki chuu mi, cha bi chɔi chɔi mi ki ku mi, ki cha m kpo doon kitiŋ.

ref: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
text: Uwumbɔr, di saaŋuul fii sil. Fii sil ki teŋ maadim aaŋuul; fiin aabaa paacham ki ter mi. Saah ban tiwan ni na le ye ibamɔn,

ref: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
text: kina pu na, kuun binib mɔmɔk nan mann goln si, ki li bi paacham ki ye baajojoor.

ref: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
text: Sin le ye unibɔn mɔmɔk aabɔjir. Uwumbɔr, len tibɔr kpee m pu; aa nyi ke maa tun taani ubaa.

ref: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa ye ubamɔndaan la, ki nyi tisui ponn ni aah bi pu na. Kuln kinimbɔŋdam aabiin; ki pa binib bi ŋan na baapar.

ref: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
text: Uwumbɔr le ye maakikiir; u gaal binib bi mɔmɔk kii waamɔb na lir.

ref: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
text: Uwumbɔr ye ubɔjir u len ibamɔn na la, le ki bii bibiindam aabɔr.

ref: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
text: Bi yaa kaa kpeln baabimbin kan, Uwumbɔr luun waajaak aajuk. U pel waatɔm ki gor bu kiir;

ref: Your deadly arrows are ready with flaming tips.
text: u yoor waajawan ni bir na, ki di waapiin i gaal mmii na kaan bibiindam pu.

ref: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
text: Lik bibiindam aah dakl tibɔbir pu na; bi kpokl tibɔbir, le ki ŋmanni biken.

ref: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
text: Le baah pen biken gaawɔb mam bi na ki gir chur bima bibaa.

ref: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
text: Kina pu na, bibaa aatunwanbir le dar bitafal, le baabimbin mu pɔɔ na mu tii bi titotonn.

ref: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
text: M doon Uwumbɔr waabamɔn pu, m gaa ilahn ki pak Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan.

ref: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
text: bibilb ni mbipɔm gaa ilahn ki pak si. Saadim mɔmɔk aan ŋmaa ŋa si nibaa; unii umɔk aa keei saamɔb na, aa chur u siin ni libuul ni la.

ref: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
text: M yaa lik kitaapaak ki aa naan na, ni uŋmal, ni iŋmabi, i aa di kaan yaabuu ni na kan,

ref: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
text: unibɔn ye ba aan aa teer ubɔr? unibɔn aabo mu ye ba aan aatafal bi u ni?

ref: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
text: Sin baanja le jer u; aa di kipak ni liyimbil le di tii u.

ref: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
text: Aa lee u ke u le ye saah naan tiwan ni na aayidaan, aa di u ŋa tiwanaankaan mɔmɔk aayidaan:

ref: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
text: aa di u ŋa ipiih, ni inaa, ni timoor ni aapeel,

ref: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
text: ni inyoon, ni ijan, ni tiwanfuurkaan ni bi nnyusakpem ni na aayidaan.

ref: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr, dulnyaa mɔmɔk nyi saayimbil pu.

ref: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
text: Uwumbɔr, m ga di nsui mɔmɔk pak si, m ga len saah ŋa lijinjiir aawan ni mɔmɔk na aabɔr.

ref: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
text: Sin pu le m ga di mpopiin gaa ilahn. Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan, m ga gaa ilahn ki pak si.

ref: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
text: Maadim yaa kan si kan, le bi fenn bipuwɔb, ki lir ki kpoi.

ref: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
text: Aa si chob saabɔjil ni, le ki len tibɔr kpeei m pu.

ref: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
text: Aa bii binib bi kaa nyi si na, le ki ku door bibiindam; ubaa aan ki teer bibɔr daalbaadaal.

ref: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
text: Timi aadim doo kookoo a; aa kuln baatim, le ubaa aa ki teer bibɔr.

ref: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
text: Le Uwumbɔr tee ye ubɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk; u gor waabɔrjal kiir libɔjil.

ref: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
text: Ibamɔn pu le u joo dulnyaa wee; u joo ibamɔn le ji ŋinibol aabɔr.

ref: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
text: Uwumbɔr le gaal bimukdam lir, tibɔr aayoonn kan, uma chee le bi kani lifuur.

ref: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
text: Uwumbɔr, binib bi nyi si na ga tii si naadii; Saa siir cha umɔk dan aa chee na.

ref: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
text: Gaa ilahn ki pak Uwumbɔr u bi Sionn pu ki joo waanib na man. Bui linibol mɔmɔk man waah ŋa pu na.

ref: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
text: Uwumbɔr teer binib bi ji falaa na pu; waa suln baawiil bɔr, le ki dar binib bi tun bi taani na aatafal.

ref: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
text: Uwumbɔr, san mi kinimbaak. Lik maadim aah ŋani mi falaa pu na. Uwumbɔr, nyan mi nkun ni,

ref: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
text: aan m ŋmaa sil Jerusalem aanib aanimbiin ni, ki bui bi tiwan nimɔk pu m pak si na. Saah gaa mi lii pu na le m mɔɔni.

ref: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
text: Binib bi kaa nyi si na gbii libuul, le ki lir li ponn ni; bibaa aagaawɔb mam le chur bi.

ref: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
text: Uwumbɔr aah joo ibamɔn ji tibɔr pu na, le u cha ti bee waah bi pu na; le bibiindaan aatunwanbir chur bi ke gaawɔb na.

ref: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
text: Uwumbɔr aah tii bibiindam ni binib bi mɔmɔk yii u na liwangol li na le ye nkun.

ref: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.
text: Uwumbɔr aan suln binib bi kaa kpa na bɔr; le bigiim aamakl aan doo kookoo.

ref: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
text: Uwumbɔr, fiin. Taa cha binib bii si. Kuun ni binib bi kaa nyi si na aanimbiin ni, ki nan bui bi baabɔr aah bii pu na.

ref: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
text: Uwumbɔr, cha bi li san ijawaan; cha bi bee ke bi ye tiwan ni ga kpo na la.

ref: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
text: Uwumbɔr, ba ŋa aa daa ti chee kina? Ba ŋa aa joo aabaa bɔrni buyoonn ti bi tibɔr ni na?

ref: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
text: Bibiindam kpa kigaak, le ki muk bigiim, cha bima bibaa aah pen gaawɔb mam bi na chur bi.

ref: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
text: Ubiindaan kpa kigaak waanimbɔŋ aageehn aatuln pu la, le ukumɔndaan seei Uwumbɔr ki yii u.

ref: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
text: Ubiindaan aatafal aa bi Uwumbɔr ni; waagaak ponn ni le u dak ke Uwumbɔr aa bi tibɔr tibaa ni.

ref: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
text: Ubiindaan kani tinyoor waatuln mɔmɔk ni la. Waa beer Uwumbɔr aabɔjil aatataa; u lik seeni waadim la.

ref: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
text: U bui ubaa le ke, “Maan lir kpala; maan koo tibɔr ni daalbaadaal.”

ref: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
text: Waamɔliin ye tipuun, ni inyamɔn, ni tifaan ŋmeen la, le ki len titunwanbir, ni kinanaŋ aabɔr mala mala.

ref: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
text: ki di ubaa bɔr ke uchinn na. U dɔ kii bigiim, le ki pen gaawɔb chur bi, ki dar bi buen.

ref: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
text: Uwumbɔr, daa bibiindam ngbaan aatafal, teer binib bi ji falaa na bɔr.

ref: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
text: Ubiindaan lik seen Uwumbɔr, le ki bui ubaa ke, “Waan daa ntafal.”

ref: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
text: Le aa kani, aa chur falaa ni tibɔbir mɔmɔk bilni, le ki gor n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ke aa ter binib. Unii u kaa kpa uteter na di ubaa tii si la, aa ter binib bi lann na n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
text: Bii bibiindam ni kinimbɔŋdam aapɔɔn. Daa bitafal baah ŋani taani u na pu, ki ti saa buyoonn bi ga di cha na.

ref: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
text: Uwumbɔr le ye ubɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Binib bi dooni ŋiwaa na ga kuln waatiŋ pu.

ref: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa ga ŋun binib bi sunn bibaa taab na aameel, aa ga pɔɔk bitaakpab.

ref: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
text: Aa ga ŋun bimukdam ni nkpobim aawiil, aa ga len tibɔr kpee bi pu, aan unibɔn u ye tiwan ni ga kpo na taa ki faan ubaa.

ref: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, “Escape like a bird to the mountains!”
text: M tii Uwumbɔr aah kii mi pu na naadii. Ni ye kijɔrk le ke aa bui mi ke, “Fii ke unyoon na ki ti bɔr ŋijoo paab,

ref: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
text: ba pu? bibiindam yoor baatɔi ki taln baapiin mɔk ke bi too bininyaam mbɔmbɔɔn ni.

ref: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
text: Tiwan mɔmɔk yaa bii kan, uninyaan ma ga ki ŋa kinye?”

ref: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
text: Uwumbɔr bi Waadichal li bi chain na ponn ni; waabɔrjal bi paacham la. U lik binib, ni kookoo, le ki nyi baah ŋani pu na.

ref: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
text: U tɔŋni ki lik binib bi ŋan na, ni bi kaa ŋan na mɔmɔk la, kaa gee binib bi kaa dii waakaal na.

ref: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
text: U cha mmiisakɔn ni chirbil u gaal mmii na lir ni bibiindam pu; u joo libuln li ton na le dar bitafal.

ref: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
text: Uwumbɔr ŋani ni ŋan na, le ki gee lituln li ŋan na; le binib bi kpa mbimbinyaan na ga li bi unimbiin ni.

ref: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
text: Uwumbɔr, ter timi; ujanyaan ubaa kina aa gur; binib bi si chob na aa ki bi.

ref: Everyone tells lies, and no one is sincere.
text: Bi mɔmɔk geei tɔb inyamɔn la; bi joo kimɔmɔɔn le ŋmanni tɔb.

ref: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
text: Uwumbɔr, cha ŋilambil ŋi kpa kimɔmɔɔn ngbaan na ŋmin chii. Ŋeeb imɔi i kpa kipupuk ki len ke,

ref: They say to themselves, “We are great speakers. No one else has a chance.”
text: “Ti joo timi aamɔmɔɔn le kani taah ban pu na. Ti ga len taah gee pu na, le ubaa aan ŋmaa ŋmin timi.”

ref: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
text: Le Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Tɔ, m ga dan dandana wee, ba pu? binib bi kaa kpa na bi limukl ni la, le baah muk bi pu na, bi ker iween aadun. M ga tii bi lifuur li bi wii ban n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na.”

ref: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
text: Aa ga ŋmaa tii Uwumbɔr aah len pu na naadii; waah len pu na ye ibamɔn ke tikunabr ti bi pun ti mmii ni nfum mulole ke bi nyan taajɔŋ na la.

ref: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
text: Bibiindam bi ni kookoo la, le unii mɔmɔk pak tiwan ni ye kinimbɔŋ na. Uwumbɔr, gaa timi, ki nyan timi kina aanib chee.

ref: How much longer, Lord, will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?
text: Uwumbɔr, aa ga suln m bɔr ki ti saa bayoonn? N‑yoonn mɔmɔk aa? Aa ga di aabaa bɔr mi ki ti saa bayoonn?

ref: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
text: M ga li bi limukl ni ki ti saa bayoonn? M ga li joo mpombiin nwiin pu ni kinyeek ki ti saa bayoonn? Maadim ga li nyaŋni mi ki ti saa bayoonn?

ref: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
text: Ndindaan Uwumbɔr, lik mi, ki gar mi. Giin maapɔɔn tii mi, taa cha m kpo.

ref: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
text: Taa cha maadim bui ke, “Ti nyaŋ u a.” Taa cha maalirm piir bisui.

ref: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
text: M mak saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu; nsui ga piir, ba pu? aa ga gaa mi lii.

ref: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
text: Uwumbɔr, m ga gaa ilahn tii si, ba pu? aa kpa tiŋann m pu la.

ref: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
text: Bijɔrb bui bibaa le ke, “Uwumbɔr aa bi.” Bi mɔmɔk ye beebeedam la, le ki tun ŋitun ŋi kaa ŋan na, ubaa aa bi ki ŋani ni ŋan na.

ref: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
text: Uwumbɔr bi paacham le ki lik ni unibɔn, ke u lik ke bibaa bi ki kpa nlan aan baa bi, ke bibaa bi ki dooni u aan baa bi.

ref: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
text: Le Uwumbɔr baa ke, “Baa nyi la aa? Titunwanbirdam ngbaan mɔmɔk ye binib bi kaa nyi na la aa? Bi su maanib kinaayuk le ki joo kpiini bibaa, kaa mee mi.”

ref: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
text: Tɔ, ijawaan sakpiin ga chuu bi, ba pu? Uwumbɔr bi binib bi kii waamɔb na chee.

ref: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
text: Titunwanbirdam bii unii u sunn ubaa taab na aatuln la, le Uwumbɔr mu tee ye waakikiir.

ref: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
text: Maameel le ye ke linyaŋ nya ni Sionn pu ki dan Israel yaab chee. Uwumbɔr yaa ki cha Israel yaab ki ŋa biwankpadam kan, ba aapopiin aan bi ga li kpa na.

ref: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
text: Uwumbɔr, ŋma ga ŋmaa koo saadichal ni? Ŋma ga ŋmaa doon si Sionn, saagongoln li bi chain na pu?

ref: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth
text: Unii u keei Uwumbɔr aamɔb tiwan mɔmɔk ni, ki ŋani ni ŋan na n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, aan waamɔliin ye ibamɔn ki gbii na,

ref: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
text: kaa bii biken aayimbil na le ga ŋmaa koo. Waa ŋani uŋeen aatɔ taani, kaa mooni tibɔr ti kaa gbii na uŋeen aatɔ pu.

ref: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
text: Binib bi Uwumbɔr yii bi na, kina aanii lik bi fam la, le ki tee nyuŋni binib bi keei Uwumbɔr aamɔb na. U yaa puu ke u ga ŋa pu na kan, kina le u ŋani, kaa dakl lik naah ga bii waatuln pu na.

ref: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
text: U pinni binib ilik kaa ban ipaar, kaa gaa igaŋgaŋlik ke u mɔnn inyamɔn paan unii u kaa kpa taani ubaa na pu. Unii umɔk ŋani tiwan nee mɔmɔk na kpa ukikiir.

ref: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
text: Uwumbɔr, li kii mi, m kpa gaakii aa pu ke aa ga biin m pu.

ref: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
text: M bui Uwumbɔr ke, “Sin le ye Ndindaan; tiwanyaan nimɔk m kpa na nyan ni aa chee la.”

ref: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
text: Binib bi san chaa ŋiwaa chee na joo ni tibɔbir le nan tii bibaa. Maan kpaan bi chee baatork ni; maan doon baawaa.

ref: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
text: Uwumbɔr, sin le ye maawangol, le aa tii mi maah ban pu na; maataak ki ga woln na bi sin le aaŋaal ni.

ref: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
text: Saah tii mi ipiin i na kpa iwaan; i ŋan sakpen a.

ref: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr man, ba pu? u mɔk mi nsan, le kinyeek kan, maalandak sur mi,

ref: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
text: M kani Uwumbɔr m chee n‑yoonn mɔmɔk; U duun mi, le nibaa aan ŋmaa foor mi.

ref: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
text: Nima pu le m kpa mpopiin ki dooni u, le m kpa limakl ke nibaa aan ŋa mi,

ref: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
text: ba pu? sin Uwumbɔr le kii mi nkun aapɔɔn chee, le saan cha saatutunn u ŋan na bee fam kitekpiitiŋ ni.

ref: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
text: Aa ga mɔk mi limɔfal aasan; saah bi m chee pu na le gbiini mi mpopiin, ki joo ni mi mmɔɔn n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
text: Uwumbɔr, li pel maah gaŋni si ki ban ibamɔn pu na; pel maah wii ki ban nterm pu na. Ŋun maameel li bi chob na.

ref: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
text: Aa ga len tibɔr kpee m pu, ba pu? aa nyi ni ye ibamɔn na.

ref: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
text: Aa nyi nsui. Aa dan m chee kinyeek ki nan tɔŋ mi mbamɔm, ki kan ke maa kpa titunwanbir tibaa.

ref: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.
text: Maa len tibɔbir ke biken na; m kii ki dii saamɔkm, kaa dii mbimbin mu pɔɔ na aasan.

ref: I have followed you, without ever stumbling.
text: M chuun saasan ponn ni le n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, kaa kee yenn mu ni.

ref: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
text: Uwumbɔr, m mee si la, ba pu? aa keei mi, kina pu na, fenn ni m chee ki ŋun maamɔbon.

ref: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
text: Kpiir saageehm mu kpa iwaan na ki gaa mi lii; m yaa si gbɔk si kan, m fuur maadim chee.

ref: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
text: Li kii mi ke saah ga kiir aabaa aanimbil pu na; di mi bɔr saafeen aajunjuŋ ni,

ref: Don't let my brutal enemies attack from all sides and kill me.
text: aan bibiindam taa pii mi. Bidim bi bir na mann goln mi la;

ref: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
text: baa san kinimbaak, le ki len kigaak aaliin.

ref: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
text: M yaa fenn niwɔb na kan, bi mann goln mi la, ki kii ke bi kan nsan siib ki daa mi lii.

ref: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
text: Bi si kiir mi ke ichinn na la, ki ban ke bi daa par par mi.

ref: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
text: Uwumbɔr, fii, laŋ maadim aasan ki nyaŋ bi. Di saajaak aajuk gaa mi lii bibiindam chee.

ref: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
text: Gaa mi binib bi kpa baah ban pu na mɔmɔk dulnyaa wee ni na chee lii. Di saah di ntafadaan mu siin kiir bi na daa bitafal; cha ntafadaan ngbaan gur ki nan pii baabim aan muken mu le kii biyaabitiib.

ref: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
text: Le mma ga kan si, ba pu? maa tun taani ubaa; le m yaa finn ngeen pu kan, saah bi m chee pu na ga tii mi mpopiin.

ref: I love you, Lord God, and you make me strong.
text: Uwumbɔr, maah gee si pu na aa kpa ŋŋaŋ. Sin le ye maapɔɔn.

ref: You are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector, the rock where I am safe, my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter.
text: Uwumbɔr le ye maakikiir; uma le ye maadiik ki pɔɔ na. Maawumbɔr le ye u kii mi na, le m yaa bi u chee kan, m ŋmar. U kii mi ke kijaak aapeln na la; u kii mi le m bi ŋŋmarm ni.

ref: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
text: M yin Uwumbɔr, le u gaa mi maadim chee lii. Pak Uwumbɔr man.

ref: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
text: Nkun aanimaln le nan mann gob mi; mbiin aabuln nan mann goln mi.

ref: Ropes from the world of the dead had coiled around me, and death had set a trap in my path.
text: Nkun aanimaln le nan mann gob mi, le likaakul pen mi laagaawɔb.

ref: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
text: M yin Uwumbɔr maamukl ni; m yin Maawumbɔr ki ban nterm. Le u bi waadichal ni ki ŋun maaneel; u nan ŋun maaterm aawiil pu.

ref: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
text: Le kitiŋ dam ki deŋ; ŋijoo aah baa nin chee na dam ki jii, ba pu? Uwumbɔr aaŋuul le nan fii.

ref: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
text: Iŋmanyuu nan nyan ni umɔfataabun ni, le mmiigaal, ni mmiisakɔn nyan ni umɔb ni.

ref: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
text: U nan daa kar kitaalangbaŋ ki sunn ni, le ntaalangbam bɔmbɔm bi utaapɔtan taab.

ref: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
text: U nan fii mala, tiwan ni kpa ifeen na pu, u nan chuun libuln pu la.
