ref: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
text: U nan di mbɔmbɔɔn le biin ubaa pu, ntaalangbam mu nyuun ki gbii ntaanyun na le nan mann goln u.

ref: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
text: Ŋitaatakpal ni mmii mu moor na le nan gaal ki loln u pu nsan, le ki woln ntaalangbam mu nyuun na ponn ni.

ref: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
text: Le Uwumbɔr bi kitaapaak ki teen ke utaal na; le binib mɔmɔk ŋun Uwumbɔr u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na aaneel pu.

ref: You scattered your enemies with arrows of lightning.
text: U nan too waapiin, le waadim yaa; u nan cha utaal moor, le bi san.

ref: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
text: Buyoonn Uwumbɔr aaŋuul fii, aan u kae waadim ki ŋuun ke uchinn na, nnyunsakpem aataab nan doon nkuun, le kitiŋ aah baa nin chee na chuu piir waan.

ref: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
text: Uwumbɔr nan nyan ni paacham le ki laan chuu mi; u nan daa nyan mi nnyun mu nyoo na ni.

ref: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
text: Maah nan bi tibɔr ni na, le bi nan tak mi, le Uwumbɔr nan kiir mi.

ref: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
text: U nan nyan mi linimaln ni; usui aah nan piin m pu pu na, le u nan gaa mi lii.

ref: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
text: Maah tun ni ŋan na pu na, le Uwumbɔr pan mi kina aapal; maah kaa tun taani ubaa pu na, le u ŋani waanyoor ŋani m pu.

ref: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
text: M kii Uwumbɔr aakaal; maa fenn mpuwɔb tii Maawumbɔr.

ref: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
text: M dii waakaal mɔmɔk; maa yii waamɔbon.

ref: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
text: U nyi ke maa ŋa taani ubaa, u nyi ke maa tun titunwanbir.

ref: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
text: Kina pu le u pa mi maatunyaan pu, ba pu? u nyi ke maa tun taani ubaa.

ref: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.
text: Uwumbɔr, binib bi si aapuwɔb na, aa mu si bipuwɔb, ki ŋan sakpen, binib bi ŋan na chee.

ref: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
text: Aa bi chain, binib bi bi chain na chee, le kaa gee bibiindam.

ref: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
text: Aa gaal binib bi sunn bibaa taab na lir, le ki sunn binib bi kpa kigaak na taab.

ref: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
text: Uwumbɔr, sin le tii mi nwiihn; sin le jenn maabɔmbɔɔn.

ref: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
text: Uwumbɔr ma aabimbin ŋan ti nyaŋ le aa ga ŋmaa li kpa waamɔbon pu limakl. U naahn kijaak aapeln le ki tii binib bimɔk ban waaterm na.

ref: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
text: Uwumbɔr baanja le ye Uwumbɔr; Uwumbɔr baanja le ye u kii timi na.

ref: You give me strength and guide me right.
text: Uma le ye Uwumbɔr u tii mi mpɔɔn na, uma le nyani tibɔbir maasan ponn ni.

ref: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
text: U cha m san mala mala ke upeeman na; u nyani mi linimaln ni, ŋijoo paab.

ref: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
text: Uma le bae mi butɔb aabaem, le m ŋmaa joo butɔm bu pɔɔ sakpen na too.

ref: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa kii mi, le ki gaal mi lir, saaterm tii mi liyimbil, le saapɔɔn tii mi ŋŋmarm.

ref: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
text: Saa cha maadim chuu mi, le maa kee lir.

ref: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
text: M san dii maadim, le ki chur bi; see m ti ku doo bi, le ki nin sil.

ref: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
text: M gbaa bi bilni, le baa ki ŋmaa fii, m nyaŋni bi, le bi dɔ nnimbiin ni.

ref: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
text: Aa tii mi butɔb aapɔɔn ki tii mi linyaŋ maadim pu.

ref: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
text: Aa cha maadim san m chee la; le m ku door binib bi kaa gee mi na.

ref: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
text: Bi wii ban nterm, le ubaa mu aan gaa bi lii; bi yin Uwumbɔr, le waan gar bi.

ref: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
text: M nan bi, le bi kpaln kitangbaak ki libuln daar joo cha na. M taa bi pu kitiŋ ponn ni ke tikpakpar na la.

ref: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
text: Aa gaa mi binib bi yii maamɔb na chee lii, ki ŋa mi ŋitimbol aayidaan, maah kaa nan nyi binib bi na le gur ye maatutum.

ref: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
text: Bitaakpab yɔl la, le bi san gbeer nyani baapɔɔn aatim ni.

ref: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
text: Uwumbɔr bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Pak maakikiir man. Moon man ke Uwumbɔr kpa mpɔɔn; u gaal mi lir na pɔɔ sakpen a.

ref: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
text: U tii mi linyaŋ maadim pu; u sunni ŋitimbol ŋani ntaapɔtan ni,

ref: You protected me from violent enemies and made me much greater than all of them.
text: ki gaal mi maadim chee lir. Uwumbɔr, aa tii mi linyaŋ maadim pu ki kii mi bijab bi bir na chee.

ref: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
text: Kina pu le m pak si ŋitimbol ponn ni; m gaa ilahn ki pak si.

ref: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
text: Uwumbɔr le tii mi, waabɔr, linyaŋ sakpeln ngbaan; u mɔk waah lee u na ngeehm n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la, u mɔk mi, David, ni n‑yaabitiib waageehm ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
text: Kitaapaak kpiir Uwumbɔr aapak aah bi pu na ki mɔk chain. Ki mɔk waah tun pu na chain.

ref: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
text: Baa joo bimɔi len ti, binib aa ŋun kifuuk kibaa pu;

ref: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
text: le bineel mu tee chaa dulnyaa wee mɔmɔk ni, le kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk pu ŋun. Uwumbɔr maa lidichal kitaapaak le tii nwiin;

ref: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
text: mu nya ni kichakpiik ni ke upiidinn u kpa mpopiin na la, ki naahn utaasann u gor ubaa pu ki cha litaasaln na la.

ref: It travels all the way across the sky. Nothing hides from its heat.
text: Mu piini kitaapaak liwipuul wɔb la, le ki chuun ti saa liwilir wɔb. Nibaa aan ŋmaa bɔr mu aatotoŋ chee. Uwumbɔr aakaal

ref: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
text: Uwumbɔr aakaal si chob la; le ki tii binib mpɔɔn pɔɔn. Aa ga ŋmaa mak Uwumbɔr aakaal pu, mu tii nlan aah par binib bi na nlan.

ref: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
text: Uwumbɔr aakaal ye ibamɔn la, le binib bi kii tii i na kpa mpopiin. Uwumbɔr aakaal si chob la, le ki tii unibɔn aasui ŋuntii.

ref: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
text: Aa yaa dooni Uwumbɔr kan, ni ŋan; naan li kpa ndoon. Uwumbɔr aabɔjil si chob la; li dii ibamɔn la.

ref: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
text: Uwumbɔr aamɔbon ŋan jer salmaa u bi pun u mmii ni ki nyan waajɔŋ mɔmɔk na, ŋi mɔ jer tisiir ti wiin chain na.

ref: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
text: Ŋi tii mi, saatutunn nlan; le aa pa mi maah kii tii ŋi pu na.

ref: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
text: Ubaa aan ŋmaa kan waah yenn waatuln ponn ni nin chee na; Uwumbɔr, nyan mi titunwanbir ti bɔr na ni,

ref: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
text: ki ki nyan mi titunwanbir ti m nyi ki tun ti na ni; taa cha ti li kpa mpɔɔn m pu, aan m li ŋan chain ki taa li kpa titunwanbir tibaa.

ref: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
text: Uwumbɔr u gaal mi lir ki tii mi lifuur na, cha maamɔbon ni maalandak li ŋan aa chee.

ref: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
text: Aa yaa bi limukl ni kan, Uwumbɔr ŋun saameel. Uwumbɔr u Jakob mu nan dii u na li kii si.

ref: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
text: U cha nterm nya ni waadichal ponn ni ki choo aa chee, ki cha nterm nya Sionn Aajool pu ki pii ni si.

ref: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
text: U gaa saatork mɔmɔk, aan saatork mɔmɔk piin usui.

ref: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
text: U tii si saah ban pu na mɔmɔk, ki cha saalandak mɔmɔk ŋa saah ban pu na.

ref: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
text: Le ti ga di mpopiin teen mpɔɔn pu, saanyaŋ pu, ki di ngbiir pak timi Aawumbɔr saanyaŋ pu. Uwumbɔr ŋa saah mee pu na mɔmɔk tii si.

ref: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
text: M bee dandana wee ke Uwumbɔr le tii waah lee ubɔr u na linyaŋ; u bi waapaacham ni bi chain na ni, le ki keei u, ki joo waapɔɔn tii u linyaŋ.

ref: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
text: Bibaa tii baatɔb aataan aatɔroku le naadii, le biken mu tii baataan naadii, le tima tii Tidindaan Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn naadii.

ref: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
text: Kina aanib ga gbeer le ki lir, le tima ga fii nyal sil.

ref: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
text: Uwumbɔr, tiin ubɔr linyaŋ; ti yaa yin si kan, aa kii timi.

ref: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
text: Uwumbɔr, ubɔr aasui piir, ba pu? aa tii u mpɔɔn; saah tii u linyaŋ pu na le u kpa mpopiin.

ref: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
text: Aa tii u usui aah ban pu na; aa kii waameel.

ref: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
text: Aa joo ni u tinyoor sakpen le ki di salmaa aabɔryikpupuk chiŋ u.

ref: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
text: U mee si limɔfal, le aa tii u limɔfal li fɔk kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
text: Saaterm pu le waapak wiir; aa tii u liyimbil ni mpɔɔn,

ref: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
text: le saanyoor bi u pu n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, saah bi u chee pu na le tii u mpopiin.

ref: Lord Most High, the king trusts you, and your kindness keeps him from defeat.
text: Ubɔr tii Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan naadii; le Uwumbɔr aageehm mu kaa kpa ndoon na pu, u bi ŋŋmarm ni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk,

ref: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
text: Ubɔr ngbaan ga chur waadim mɔmɔk; u ga chur binib bi mɔmɔk kaa gee u na.

ref: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
text: U yaa nyan ni kan, u ga bii bi mɔmɔk doo ke mmii mu wu na la. Uwumbɔr aaŋuul ni le u ga di bi mɔmɔk nab ke mmii mu wu na.

ref: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
text: Biyaabitiib ponn ni ubaa aan ŋmar, ubɔr ga ku bi mɔmɔk.

ref: All their plans to harm you will come to nothing.
text: Bi dakl baalandak le ki kpokl u pu, bi mu aan ŋman.

ref: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
text: U ga too bi waapiin, ki cha bi fenn bipuwɔb ki san.

ref: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
text: Uwumbɔr, ti pak si, saapɔɔn sakpiin pu. Ti ga gaa ilahn ki pak saapɔɔn.

ref: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
text: Maawumbɔr, Maawumbɔr, ba pu aa siir cha mi? M wii sakpen ki ban nterm, le mu aa kee choo.

ref: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
text: Maawumbɔr, nwiin pu kan, m wii yin si la, le saa gar mi. M yin si kinyeek mu, le kaa kani lifuur.

ref: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
text: Le aa ka libɔrjal pu ki bi chain, sin le ye Uwumbɔr u Israel yaab pak u na.

ref: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
text: bi nan yin si, le ki nyan linimaln ni, bi nan tii si naadii, le kaa jin inimɔɔn.

ref: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
text: Tɔ, mma aa ki ye unibɔn; m gur ye likpaambil la, le bi mɔmɔk lik seen mi, ki seei mi.

ref: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
text: Binib bi mɔmɔk kan mi na laa mi, bi leeni bilambil le ki gbakr biyil.

ref: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
text: Bi len ke, “U gaa Uwumbɔr ki kii, ba ŋa waa gaa u lii? Uwumbɔr yaa gee u kan, ba ŋa waa ter u?”

ref: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
text: Uwumbɔr, sin le nan nyan ni mi nna aaponn ni le m fu, le maah nan laa ye ubo pu na, aa kii mi.

ref: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
text: Bundaal bi maa mi na le m nan di naadii tii si, le aa ye Maawumbɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
text: Taa li daa mi. Tibɔbir duun mi, le ubaa aa bi ki ga ter mi.

ref: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
text: Bidim pam le mann goln mi ke inaaja na; bi mann gob mi la, ki naahn Basann aatiŋ aanaaja i bir na.

ref: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.
text: Bi waa bimɔi ke ichinn na la, ki ŋuuni ki dar par mi.

ref: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
text: Maapɔɔn mɔmɔk doo ke nnyun mu kpir kitiŋ na aah foor pu na. Bi tukl maakpab mɔmɔk; le mpobil donn ke tisikakpiin na.

ref: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
text: Nneen ni kuur ke titan na la, le nlambil tam nlakpaŋ. Aa di cha mi titan ni, ki di mi tii nkun.

ref: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
text: Titunwanbirdam kuun goln mi ke kibɔpaak na, ki ban mi; bi dar par ntaa ni ŋŋaal.

ref: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
text: M ga ŋmaa kahn maakpab mɔmɔk. Maadim lik mi, le ki nan mi.

ref: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
text: Bi di maawanpeenkaan yakr tii tɔb, ki too inaan maakpalk pu.

ref: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
text: Uwumbɔr, taa li daa mi. Dan mala ki nan gaa mi lii.

ref: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
text: Nyan mi kijaak aajuk ni; nyan maamɔfal ibɔ yee ni.

ref: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
text: Gaa mi ichinn yee chee; maa kpa mpɔɔn mubaa inaajabir yee chee.

ref: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
text: M ga bui maanib saah tun pu na; m ga pak si baah kuun nin chee na:

ref: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
text: “Nimi bi ye Uwumbɔr aatutum na, pak u man. Nimi Jakob aayaabitiib, nyuŋ u man. Nimi Israel aanib, doon u man.

ref: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
text: Waa suln bigiim ni bifalaadam bɔr; waa fenn upuwɔb tii bi, u keei bi.”

ref: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
text: Kinipaak aah kuun nin chee na, le m ga pak si saah tun pu na pu. Binib bi dooni si na aanimbiin ni, le m ga toor kitork ki m nan puu na.

ref: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
text: Bigiim ga ji baah ban pu na la; binib bi choo Uwumbɔr chee na ga pak u. Tii bi nkam n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
text: Ŋitimbol mɔmɔk ga teer Uwumbɔr bɔr. Bi ga nya ni dulnyaa aapepel mɔmɔk ni, ki dan u chee; Ŋinibol mɔmɔk ga doon u.

ref: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
text: Uwumbɔr le ye ubɔr, le ki joo ŋitimbol mɔmɔk.

ref: In the future, everyone will worship and learn about you, our Lord.
text: N‑yoonn mu choo na yaab ga nan tun tii u; binib ga len Uwumbɔr aabɔr n‑yoonn mu choo na yaab chee.

ref: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
text: Bi ga bui binib bi baa kee ma bi na ke: “Uwumbɔr gaa waanib lii.”

ref: You, Lord, are my shepherd. I will never be in need.
text: Uwumbɔr le ye u joo mi ke upihdaan aah joo waapiih pu na; m kpa maah ban tiwan nimɔk na.

ref: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
text: U tii mi lifuur timosɔnn aah bi nin chee na, ki mɔk mi uyayak aanyun mu soon na chee.

ref: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
text: U tii mi limɔfapɔln, le ki mɔk mi isan i ŋan na, waah nan puu pu na.

ref: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
text: Uwumbɔr, m yaa chuun kifataŋ ki bɔɔn ke nkun na kan, maan san ijawaan, ba pu? aa bi m chee. Saapihkpaajaangbeek ni lichakukul le kii mi.

ref: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
text: Aa gor tijikaar ti wiir na siin mi, maadim mɔmɔk aanimbil ni; aa gaa mi ke uchanyuun na ki cha maayikuuk gbiin ki ti bar kpir.

ref: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
text: M nyi ke aa ga li gee mi, ki ŋani mi tiŋann, ki ti saa maakundaal; le saadichal ga li ye ndo maamɔfal ni ki ti saa maakundaal.

ref: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
text: Uwumbɔr le yeh dulnyaa, ni tiwan nimɔk bi u ponn ni na; kitiŋ kee, ni bi mɔmɔk bi ki pu na ye u yaab la.

ref: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
text: U maa kitiŋ na nnyun mu nyoo ki bi kitiŋ aataab pu na la, le ki ŋa kaadinyikl nnyusakpem aataab.

ref: Who may climb the Lord's hill or stand in his holy temple?
text: Ŋma ŋeer ke u jon Uwumbɔr aagongoln? Ŋma ŋeer ke u koo Waadichal li bi chain na ponn ni?

ref: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ni baalandak ŋan na, kaa dii ŋiwaa, kaa puur tipuur ti kaa gbiini na, bima baanja le kpa kina aasan.

ref: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
text: Uwumbɔr ga ŋa waanyoor ŋa bi pu ki gaa bi lii; Uwumbɔr ga bui ke baabɔr ŋan.

ref: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
text: Chuu piir waan man ibisamɔi, piir man n‑yaayoonn na aajaaleŋ mam na, ki cha ubɔrkpaan ngbaan koo ni.

ref: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
text: Ŋma ye ubɔrkpaan ngbaan? Uma le ye Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan u pɔɔ na, Uwumbɔr u nyaŋni butɔb ni na.

ref: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
text: Chuu piir waan man ibisamɔi; piir man n‑yaayoonn na aajaaleŋ mam na, ki cha ubɔrkpaan ngbaan koo ni.

ref: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
text: Ŋma ye ubɔrkpaan ngbaan? Uwumbɔr linyaŋdaan le ye ubɔrkpaan ngbaan.

ref: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
text: Uwumbɔr, sin le m joo maameel tii,

ref: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
text: Maawumbɔr, sin le m gaa ki kii. Taa cha m ji inimɔɔn; taa cha maadim nyaŋ mi.

ref: Don't disappoint any of your worshipers, but disappoint all deceitful liars.
text: Binib bi kpa gaakii tii si na aa lir, le binib bi nya aapuwɔb mala na ma lir la.

ref: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
text: Uwumbɔr, mɔk mi saasan, cha m bee i.

ref: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
text: Mɔk mi aan m li bi ke saabamɔn aah ban pu na, ba pu? sin le ye Maawumbɔr u gaal mi lir na. M ga li kpa gaakii tii si n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Please, Lord, remember, you have always been patient and kind.
text: Uwumbɔr, teer saaŋann, ni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk aageehm mu aa di mɔk mi n‑yoonn mu jer na.

ref: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
text: Di maabiyar ponn ni aatunwanbir ni taani cha pinn mi. Uwumbɔr, saah kpa ngeehm ni tiŋann n‑yoonn mɔmɔk pu na, teer mbɔr.

ref: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
text: Uwumbɔr aah ŋan sakpen pu na, le u mɔk titunwanbirdam nsan mu bi ga dii na.

ref: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
text: U mɔk binib bi sunn bibaa taab na nsanyaan, le ki mɔk bi waageehn.

ref: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
text: U gee binib bi tii waah pu tipuur ti na naadii ki keei waamɔb na; u mɔk bi waasan, ki ŋani waah len pu na.

ref: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
text: Uwumbɔr, li joo saah puu tipuur ti na, ki di maatunwanbir ti wiir sakpen na cha pinn mi,

ref: You will show the right path to all who worship you.
text: Binib bi keei Uwumbɔr aamɔb na, ga bee u chee nsan mu bi ga dii na.

ref: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
text: Bi ga li ye biwankpadam n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la, le baabim ga nan li yeh kitiŋ kee.

ref: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
text: Uwumbɔr aajɔtiib le ye binib bi keei waamɔb na, le u mɔk bi waah puu tipuur ti na aatataa.

ref: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
text: Uwumbɔr chee le m ban nterm n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, le u nyani mi linimaln ni.

ref: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
text: Uwumbɔr, fenn lik mi, ki san mi kinimbaak, ba pu? ubaa aa bi m chee, le nwon yɔl.

ref: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
text: Nyan mi maalandak ni, ni maabɔbir mɔmɔk ni.

ref: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
text: Lik maasuubiin, ni maafalaa wee, ki di maatunwanbir mɔmɔk cha pinn mi.

ref: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
text: Lik maah kpa bidim pu na, lik baah nan mi pu na.

ref: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
text: Li kii mi ki gaa mi lii, ki taa cha maadim ngbaan nyaŋ mi, sin chee le m choo ban limɔfal.

ref: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
text: Cha maaŋann ni maabamɔn gaa mi lii; ba pu? m kpa gaakii aa pu.

ref: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
text: Uwumbɔr, nyan Israel aanib baabɔr mɔmɔk ni.

ref: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
text: Uwumbɔr, cha unii mɔk bee ke maatunyaan pu maa kpa taani, le ki kpa gaakii aa pu.

ref: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
text: Uwumbɔr, tɔŋ mi ki lik mi mbamɔm; lik maah ban pu na, ni maalandak mbamɔm.

ref: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
text: Saayoonn mɔmɔk aageehm le mɔk mi nsan, saabamɔn le mɔk mi nsan.

ref: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
text: Uwumbɔr, m ŋir ŋŋaal le ki mɔk ke maa kpa taani ubaa, le ki chuun manni saatork aabimbiln ki dooni si.

ref: while gratefully singing about your wonders.
text: M gaa idoon aalahn le ki tuk binib saajinjiir aatun mɔmɔk aabɔr.

ref: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
text: Uwumbɔr, m gee saah koo lidichal li ponn ni na, nin chee saapak bi na,

ref: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
text: Taa di mi kpaan titunwanbirdam chee ki ku mi; nyan mi binikurb aadoon ni,

ref: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
text: Mma kan, m ŋani ni ŋan na la; san mi kinimbaak ki gaa mi lii.

ref: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
text: M ŋmar tibɔr mɔmɔk chee a; Uwumbɔr aanib mɔmɔk aakuun ni, le m pak u.

ref: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
text: Uwumbɔr le ye maawiihn, uma le gaal mi lir; Maan san ubaa ijawaan. Uwumbɔr kii mi le ki nyani mi linimaln mɔmɔk ni; maan li san ijawaan kpala.

ref: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
text: Bibiindam yaa tak mi ki pɔɔni bibaa ke bi ku mi kan, bi gbeer le ki lir.

ref: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
text: Hali bijab lichur yaa gob mi kan, maan li san ijawaan; hali bidim yaa tak mi kan, m ga li beenin mak Uwumbɔr pu la.

ref: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
text: M mee Uwumbɔr tiwan nibaa la; tiwan nibaa baanja le m ban, ke m li bi Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ki mee u, u mɔk mi waasan, aan waaŋann li ye iwaan aawan m chee.

ref: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
text: Tibɔr aayoonn kan, u ga li bii m pu; u ga li kii mi Waadichal ni, ki cha m kal litakpal li paa na pu,

ref: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
text: aan m kan linyaŋ maadim bi mann goln mi na pu. M ga di mpopiin aafuuk toor kitork Waadichal ni; M ga gaa ilahn, m ga pak Uwumbɔr.

ref: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
text: Uwumbɔr, m yaa yin si kan, kii mi. San mi kinimbaak ki gar mi.

ref: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
text: Saah nan bui ke, “Dan ki nan doon mi” na, m nan gar ke, “Uwumbɔr, m ga dan;” taa di aabaa bɔr mi.

ref: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
text: Uwumbɔr u gaal mi lir na, taa gee liŋuul m pu; m ye saatutunn la, taa jenn mi aa chee. Sin le ter mi; taa di mi lii, taa siir cha mi.

ref: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
text: Nibaakan nte ni nna ga di mi lii, le Uwumbɔr ma ga li joo mi.

ref: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
text: Uwumbɔr, mɔk mi saah ban ke m ŋa pu na, ki mɔk mi limɔfal aasan, ba pu? m kpa bidim pam.

ref: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
text: Taa di mi lii aan maadim bi joo inyamɔn ni nfaan tak mi na pii mi.

ref: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
text: M nyi ke m ga li bi limɔfal ni le ki ti kan Uwumbɔr aaŋann buyoonn m bi din wee aabimbin ni na.

ref: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
text: Di naadii tii Uwumbɔr. Li kpa gaakii, taa cha aataakpab yɔl; di naadii tii Uwumbɔr.

ref: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
text: Uwumbɔr, maakikiir, m yin si la; ŋun maawiil pu. Aa yaa kaa gar mi kan, m ga dii binib bi sunni cha bitekpiido na.

ref: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
text: M yaa wii yin si ki ban nterm, ki yoor ŋŋaal mɔk Saadichal li bi chain na kan, pel m chee.

ref: Don't drag me away, Lord, with those cruel people, who speak kind words, while planning trouble.
text: Aa yaa ban aa bii bibiindam, ni binib bi tun titunwanbir aan baamɔliin naahn kijɔtiik ki mu tee kpa kinanaŋ bisui ni na kan, taa di mi kpaan bi chee.

ref: Treat them as they deserve! Punish them for their sins.
text: Daa bitafal baah tun titunwanbir ti na pu. Daa bitafal baatun mɔmɔk pu, tiin bi baah ŋeer pu na.

ref: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
text: Baa dakl lik Uwumbɔr aah tun pu na, ni waah naan tiwan ni na; kina pu le u ga daa bitafal ki kuln bi kookoo.

ref: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
text: Di kipak tii Uwumbɔr, ba pu? u ŋun maah wii ki ban nterm pu na.

ref: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
text: Uwumbɔr kii mi le ki lik mi; le m di naadii tii u. U tii mi nterm ki piir nsui; m joo mpopiin aalahn le pak u.

ref: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
text: Uwumbɔr kii waanib la; u ter waah lee ubɔr u na, le ki gaal u lir.

ref: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
text: Uwumbɔr, gaa saanib lii, ki ŋa saanyoor ŋa saah yeh binib bi na pu, ki li ye u kpaa bi ki lik bi pu n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na.

ref: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
text: Nimi paacham yaab, pak Uwumbɔr man, pak waapɔɔn ni waanyuŋ man.

ref: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr aayimbil li kpa kipak na man. Peen tiwanpeenkaan ni ye chain na, ki li dooni u man.

ref: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
text: Bi ŋun Uwumbɔr aaneel nnyusakpem pu; Uwumbɔr u kpa kipak na tar ke utaal na, le uneel ti keei nnyusakpem ni.

ref: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.
text: Bi ŋun Uwumbɔr aaneel mu pɔɔ ki nyuun na pu.

ref: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
text: Uwumbɔr aaneel kool ŋikpan aasui la, hali ŋikpan aasui i bi Lebanonn aatiŋ ni na mu kool la.

ref: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
text: U cha Lebanonn aajoo yukr ke inaabi na la, ki cha Hemonn aajoo yukr ke unaajabo na.

ref: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
text: Uwumbɔr aaneel cha utaal moor la.

ref: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
text: Waaneel cha nteersakpiin aatiŋ jii la; u damni Kades aateersakpiin aatiŋ mu.

ref: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
text: Uwumbɔr aaneel cha isui jii la, le ki cha isui mɔmɔk aafar gbar lir; le binib bi mɔmɔk bi Waadichal ni na tar ke, “Pak Uwumbɔr man.”

ref: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
text: Uwumbɔr le joo nnyun mu nyoo na, u ye ubɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la.

ref: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
text: Uwumbɔr le tii waanib mpɔɔn, ki ŋani tinyoor ŋani bi pu, ki tii bi nsuudoon.

ref: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
text: Uwumbɔr, m pak si, ba pu? aa gaa mi lii, kaa cha maadin aasui piir m pu.

ref: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
text: Ndindaan Uwumbɔr, m wii yin si ki ban nterm, le aa tii mi laafee;

ref: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
text: Uwumbɔr aanib bi dii u mbamɔm na, gaa ilahn ki pak u man. Teer man U bi Chain na aah ŋa pu na, ki doon u man.

ref: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
text: Waaŋuul aa fiir ni yunni, le waaŋann ma aa kpa ndoon. Iwiil ga li bi kinyeek, le kichakpiik ni nan kpaln mpopiin.

ref: I felt secure and thought, “I'll never be shaken!”
text: M nan kan mbaa le ki bui ke, “Ubaa aan ki ŋmaa nyaŋ mi.”

ref: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa nan kpa m pu tiŋann; aa nan kii mi ke lijool pu aatiŋ ki kpa mpɔɔn na la. Tɔ, le aa nan ki di aabaa bɔr mi, le ijawaan chuu mi.

ref: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
text: Uwumbɔr, m yin si, m gaŋ si ki ban nterm:

ref: “What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?
text: “M yaa kpo kan, ba aanyoor aa ga kan? M yaa kun bitekpiido kan, ba aanyoor aa kan? Binib bi kpoi na ga ŋmaa pak si ii? Bi ga ŋmaa di saaŋann ti kaa door na moon aa?

ref: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
text: Aa kpeln maasuubiin ŋa mpopiin aawaal; aa chuu nyan maasuubiin m chee, ki di mpopiin gob mi.

ref: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
text: Kina pu na, maan li ŋmin, m ga gaa ilahn ki pak si. Uwumbɔr, sin le ye Maawumbɔr, m ga li dooni si n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: I come to you, Lord, for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.
text: Uwumbɔr, m dan aa chee, ki ban ke aa li kii mi la; taa cha bi nyaŋ mi daalbaadaal. Aa ye Uwumbɔr u ŋani ni ŋan na, m mee si, gaa mi lii.

ref: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
text: Pel m chee. Gaa mi lii dandana. Li ye u ga li kii mi na; li ye u ga gaa mi lii na.

ref: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
text: Sin le ye u kii mi na; loln m pu nsan, saah nan puu ke aa ga mɔk mi maah ga dii pu na pu.

ref: Protect me from hidden traps and keep me safe.
text: Nyan mi gaawɔb u bi di pen mi na ni; li kii mi linimaln chee.

ref: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
text: Saa gee binib bi dooni ŋiwaa na, le mma tii si naadii.

ref: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
text: Saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu le nsui ga li piin, le m mɔɔni. Aa kani maafalaa, ki nyi maah bi tibɔr ti ponn ni na.

ref: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
text: Saa cha maadim nyaŋ mi ki chuu mi, aa tii mi nsan ke m buen maah gee nimɔk na.

ref: Have pity, Lord! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.
text: Uwumbɔr, san mi kinimbaak, ba pu? m bi tibɔr ni la; maah wii sakpen pu na le nnimbil wu, nwon mɔmɔk kpo la.

ref: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
text: Mpombiin pu le nwon yɔl, le iwiil gii maamɔfal pu. Nwon yɔl maabɔbir mɔmɔk pu la, hali maakpab bi dur la.

ref: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
text: Maadim mɔmɔk, ni binib bi koo gbɔk mi na lik seeni mi la; binib bi nyi mi na yaa kan mi kitiŋ ponn ni kan, bi san mi ijawaan, le ki san.

ref: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
text: Unii mɔmɔk suln m bɔr ke maah kpo le na; m naahn tiwan ni bi di mee na la.

ref: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
text: M ŋun maadim looni ki len; tibɔbir le mann goln mi. Bi bi ban isan m pu la, bi kpokl ke bi ku mi la.

ref: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
text: Uwumbɔr, le m tii si naadii; sin le ye Maawumbɔr.

ref: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
text: N‑yoonn mɔmɔk m bi aaŋaal ni la; nyan mi maadim aaŋaal ni, nyan mi binib bi ban bi ku mi na aaŋaal ni.

ref: Smile on me, your servant. Have pity and rescue me.
text: Li kpa mi saatutunn pu tiŋann. Di saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na gaa mi lii.

ref: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
text: Uwumbɔr, m yin si la; taa cha m ji inimɔɔn. Cha titunwanbirdam ma ji inimɔɔn, cha bi sunn kitekpiitiŋ ni aan ubaa taa ŋun bi pu.

ref: Silence those proud liars! Make them stop bragging and insulting your people.
text: Ŋmin binyamɔndam aafuuk, ŋmin bigaadam ni bimakdam bi len bininyaam bɔfam na aafuuk.

ref: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.
text: Saah ŋa tiwan ni tii binib bi nyuŋ si na kpa iwaan. Unii mɔmɔk nyi saah ŋan pu na, ki nyi saah kii binib bi tii si naadii na pu na.

ref: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr man. Baah nan gob mi ki tak mi na le u nan mɔk mi ngeehm mu nyaŋ sakpen na.

ref: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
text: M nan san ijawaan ki bui ke u jenn nyan mi unimbiin ni la. Le buyoonn m yin u ki ban nterm na, u ŋun maawiil.

ref: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
text: Uwumbɔr aanib bi dii u mbamɔm na mɔmɔk, li gee u man. Uwumbɔr kii binib bi dii u mbamɔm na la, le ki dar bigaadam aatafal baah ŋeer pu na.

ref: All who trust the Lord, be cheerful and strong.
text: Nimi bi mɔmɔk kpa Uwumbɔr pu limakl na, cha nitaakpab pɔɔk, nyal sil man.

ref: Our Lord, you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.
text: Binib bi Uwumbɔr di cha pinn baatunwanbir na le kpa mpopiin, Uwumbɔr aah di cha binib bi aataani pinn bi na le kpa mpopiin.

ref: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
text: Binib bi Uwumbɔr aan len ke baabɔr bii na, ni binib bi kaa gee inyamɔn na, bima le kpa mpopiin.

ref: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.
text: Maah kaa nan kpiir maatunwanbir na, iwiin mɔmɔk aawiil le nan cha nwon kpo,

ref: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa nan dar ntafal nwiin pu ni kinyeek; le maapɔɔn doo, ke limaln aah kuur lipeel aatotoŋ chee pu na.

ref: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
text: Le m kpiir maatunwanbir tuk si, maa nan di maataani bɔr si. M nan kii ki kpiir ti tuk si, le aa di cha maatunwanbir pinn mi.

ref: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
text: Kina na, binib bi mɔmɔk kii saamɔb na yaa bi tibɔr ni kan, bi mee si; le tibɔr yaa choo bi chee ke nwam na kan, ti taa pii bi.

ref: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
text: Sin le ye maabɔbɔryaan; aa ga nyan mi tibɔr ni. M gaa ilahn mpɔɔn pu, saah gaal mi lir pu na, ba pu? sin le kii mi.

ref: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “M ga mɔk si nsan mu aa ga dii na; m ga mɔk si le ki lik si.

ref: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
text: Taa li kpa kijɔrk ke utaan bee ubon u bi ga di itangar ni iŋmin ŋa umɔb ni ke u dii nsan.”

ref: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
text: Bibiindam ga ji falaa, le Uwumbɔr ga li kii binib bi tii u naadii na ki tii bi waageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na.

ref: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
text: Di tibar doon Uwumbɔr man, di ikuŋmin aawangbaakaan gaa ilahn tii u man.

ref: Sing a new song. Shout! Play beautiful music.
text: Gaa nlahnpɔɔn tii u man, di nwanyim gbaa kibeek ngbaan man, ki li tar ni mpopiin.

ref: The Lord is truthful; he can be trusted.
text: Uwumbɔr aamɔbon gbii la, le aa ga ŋmaa nyii waatun pu ki sil.

ref: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
text: Uwumbɔr gee lituln li ŋan ki bi chob na la; kitiŋ kee pu ye waageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na ŋmeen la.

ref: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
text: Uwumbɔr len, le paacham naan, le ki ki len, le nwiin, ni uŋmal, ni iŋmabi naan.

ref: He scooped up the ocean and stored the water.
text: U kuun nnyusakpem mɔmɔk ti kpaan libubaan ni; le ki di nnyusakpem aanyonyoon laŋ libubaan ni.

ref: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
text: Kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk, li san Uwumbɔr ijawaan. Dulnyaa aanib mɔmɔk, nyuŋ u man.

ref: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
text: U nan di umɔb le len, le dulnyaa naan; le waamɔboln cha tiwan mɔmɔk nyan ni.

ref: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.
text: Uwumbɔr bii ŋinibol aalandak la; u cha baa ŋmaa tun baah ba dak pu na.

ref: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
text: Le uma aalandak bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk; waalandak aa kpa ndoon.

ref: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
text: Litimbol li dii Tidindaan Uwumbɔr na, lima le kpa mpopiin; waah lee binib bi ke bi ye uyaab na, bima le kpa mpopiin.

ref: The Lord looks at the world
text: Uwumbɔr bi paacham le ki lik waa unibɔn mɔmɔk.

ref: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
text: Uma le naani baalandak mɔmɔk, le ki nyi baah tun pu na mɔmɔk.

ref: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
text: Naa ye ubɔr aajab bi pɔɔ na pu le ubɔr nyaŋni butɔb ni, kaa ye butɔb aaja aapɔɔn pu le u mu nyaŋni butɔb ni.

ref: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
text: Butɔb aataan aan ŋmaa cha binib nyaŋ baadim, yaapɔɔn aan ŋmaa gaa ubaa lii.

ref: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.
text: Uwumbɔr lik binib bi keei waamɔb ki tii waageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na naadii na pu la.

ref: He protects them from death and starvation.
text: U nyani bi nkun ni; le ki kpiini bi nkon aayoonn.

ref: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
text: Ti di timi aamakl ŋa Uwumbɔr aaŋaal ni la; uma le ye u kii timi ki ter timi na.

ref: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
text: Uma pu le tisui piin, ti tii waayimbil li bi chain na naadii.

ref: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
text: M ga pak u waah ŋa tiwan ni na pu; cha binib bi bi limukl ni na li ŋun aan bisui piir.

ref: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
text: M mee Uwumbɔr, le u gar mi, u nyan mi maajawaan mɔmɔk ni.

ref: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
text: Baah muk binib bi na di bibaa tii u, le bisui piir; baan ji inimɔɔn kpala.

ref: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
text: Binib bi kaa kpa biteterb na yin uma la, le u gar bi; u nyani bi baabɔr mɔmɔk ni.

ref: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
text: Uwumbɔr aatuun le kii binib bi keei waamɔb na, le ki nyani bi linimaln ni.

ref: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
text: Nimi nibaa lik man ki kan Uwumbɔr aah kpa tiŋann pu na. Binib bi kan ŋŋmarm u chee na le kpa mpopiin.

ref: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
text: Uwumbɔr aanib mɔmɔk, kii waamɔb man; binib bi keei waamɔb na kani baah ban nimɔk na.

ref: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
text: Hali ichinn chuun nkon, kaa kani tijiir, le binib bi keei Uwumbɔr aamɔb na aa lann tiwan ni ŋan na nibaa.

ref: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
text: Njɔtiib bi laa ye binachipɔm na, dan man, ki nan ŋun m chee man, aan m mɔk nimi ni nyuŋ Uwumbɔr.

ref: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?
text: Aa ban ke aa ji tinachipɔnn aa? Aa ban limɔfal li mɔ ki fɔk na aa?

ref: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
text: Kina kan, taa len tibɔbir, ki taa mɔnn inyamɔn.

ref: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
text: Fenn aapuwɔb tii titunwanbir, ki tun lituln li ŋan na; di aasui mɔmɔk ban nsuudoon linimaln.

ref: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
text: Uwumbɔr lik binib bi aabimbin ŋan na pu, le ki ŋun baawiil pu;

ref: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
text: ki yiil binib bi tun titunwanbir na, le bi yaa kpo kan, bi suln bibɔr mala.

ref: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na yin Uwumbɔr, le u ŋun; u nyani bi baabɔr mɔmɔk ni.

ref: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
text: Uwumbɔr bi duun binib bi aataakpab yɔl na la; le ki gaal binib bi kaa ki kpa limakl libaa na lir.

ref: The Lord's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.
text: Uninyaan kani ŋimuk aabɔŋ aabɔŋ la, le Uwumbɔr nyani u ŋi mɔmɔk ni;

ref: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.
text: Uwumbɔr le bii u pu mbamɔm, le waakpab ponn ni libaa aan koo.

ref: Wicked people are killed by their own evil deeds, and if you hate God's people you will be punished.
text: Titunwanbir le ga ku mbiindam; u ga daa binib bi kaa gee bininyaam na aatafal.

ref: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
text: Uwumbɔr ga gaa waanib lii; binib bi chaa u chee ke u li kii bi na ga ŋmar.

ref: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.
text: Yoor saakpaatuŋ ni kichɔk ki kiir binib bi san dii mi na. Bui mi ke aa ga gaa mi lii.

ref: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.
text: Nyaŋ binib bi pɔɔni bibaa ke bi ku mi na ki jinn bi inimɔɔn. Cha binib bi kpokl m pu na aalan ŋmal, aan bi fenn bipuwɔb.

ref: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
text: Uwumbɔr aatuun aah san dii bi pu na, Cha bi li bi ke kimook ki libuln daar joo cha na,

ref: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.
text: Uwumbɔr aatuun aah gbaa bi lir pu na, cha baasan li bɔɔn ki ŋar.

ref: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
text: Maa ŋa bi nibaa, le bi tee pen mi gaawɔb, ki gbii libuul li nyoo na bil mi.

ref: Surprise them with disaster! Trap them in their own nets and let them fall and rot in the pits they have dug.
text: Le mbiin ga pii bi n‑yoonn mu baa nyi mubɔr na; bibaa aagaawɔb le ga chur bi, le bi lir ki kuln.

ref: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
text: Le Uwumbɔr pu, nsui ga piir; waah gaa mi lii pu na, le m ga li kpa mpopiin.

ref: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
text: M ga di nsui mɔmɔk bui Uwumbɔr ke, “Ubaa aa ki bi ke sin na. Aa kii bigiim, binib bi pɔɔ na chee, ki kii bifalaadam binib bi muk bi na chee.”

ref: Liars accuse me of crimes I know nothing about.
text: Titunwanbirdam mɔnn inyamɔn paani mi, ki galni mi taani u pu maa nyi na.

ref: They repay evil for good, and I feel all alone.
text: Bi joo mbiin le pa mi maaŋann pu, le nsuubiin joo mi sunni cha taab.

ref: When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and went without food. I truly prayed for them,
text: Le baah nan bun na, maa nan kpa mpopiin, le ki yii tijikaar; m nan tim n‑yil taab le ki mee Uwumbɔr bi pu,

ref: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
text: ke maah ba ga mee pu tii njɔ, bee nna aabo na. M nan chuun tii n‑yil le ki wii ikpowiil, ke unii aana aah kpo kan, u wii likpuul pu na.

ref: I have stumbled, and worthless liars I don't even know surround me and sneer.
text: Le mma aah nan bi tibɔr ni na, bisui piir, le bi kuun ke bi ŋa mi mbɔnyun; biwɔwɔm gbaa mi, ki ki gbaa mi.

ref: Worthless people make fun and never stop laughing.
text: Bi laa mi ki saan mi la, kinanaŋ pu le bi ŋmɔ ŋinyin m pu.

ref: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa ga li ka lik kina ki ti saa bayoonn? Nyan mi baah tak mi pu na ni; gaa maamɔfal ichinn yee chee lii.

ref: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
text: Le m ga doon si saanib mɔmɔk aah kuun nin chee na, m ga pak si bi mɔmɔk aanimbil ni.

ref: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.
text: Taa cha maadim aasui piir maalirm pu; bi ye binyamɔndam la. Taa cha binib bi nan mi fam na laa mi, maasuubiin pu.

ref: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
text: Baabɔlen aa ŋan, le bi mɔnn inyamɔn mɔk aabɔŋ paani binib bi gee nsuudoon aabɔr na.

ref: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
text: Bi galni mi, ki tar ke, “Ti kan saah tun pu na.”

ref: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
text: Uwumbɔr, le aa kan ni. Uwumbɔr, kina pu na, taa li ŋmin; taa li daa m chee.

ref: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me
text: Uwumbɔr, aa ji binib tibɔr mbamɔm la, kina pu na, bui ke maabɔr ŋan; taa cha maadim aasui piir maafalaa pu.

ref: or say to each other, “Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up!”
text: Taa cha bi bui bibaa ke, “Ti doo u a, taah ban pu na le na.”

ref: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
text: Cha binib bi aasui piir maafalaa pu na aalan ŋmal aan bi lir kookoo; Cha binib bi len ke bi soor mi na kpaln inimɔɔn aanib.

ref: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
text: Cha binib bi ban ke bi kan ke m nyan tibɔr ni na li tar mpopiin pu ki len, ki ki gir len ke, “Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn nyaŋ a. Usui piir waatutunn aah kan linyaŋ pu na pu.”

ref: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
text: Le m ga moon saatunyaan aabɔr ki li pak si nwiin ni mu aalirm.

ref: Sinners don't respect God; sin is all they think about.
text: Ubiindaan aasui ponn ni ye titunwanbir la; u yii Uwumbɔr kaa pak u.

ref: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.
text: U dak ke waah nyuun sakpen pu na, Uwumbɔr aan ŋmaa kan waatunwanbir ki bui ke taa ŋan.

ref: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
text: Waabɔlen ye mbiin ŋmeen, le ki gbii inyamɔn; waa ki kpa nlan, kaa ki ŋani tiwan ni ŋan na.

ref: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
text: U yaa dɔ kan, u dak ilandak i kaa ŋan na la; waatun mɔmɔk aa ŋan, le kaa yiil titunwanbir aatuln. Uwumbɔr aah ŋan pu na

ref: Your love is faithful, Lord, and even the clouds in the sky can depend on you.
text: Uwumbɔr, saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na fuu paacham, le saaŋann taln ti fuu kitaapaak.

ref: Your decisions are always fair. They are firm like mountains, deep like the sea, and all people and animals are under your care.
text: Saah ŋan sakpen pu na naahn ŋijoo aah paa pu na la; le saabamɔn naahn nnyusakpem aah nyoo pu na. Sin le lik unibɔn ni tiwakor mɔmɔk.

ref: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
text: Uwumbɔr, saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na jer liwangol mɔmɔk la, ti kan mbɔbɔryaan aa chee ke ikoobi aah kani pu ina aafeen taab na.

ref: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
text: Saah tii timi tijikaar sakpen ti na le kpiini timi; le ti nyu nnyun saaŋann aamɔɔ na ni.

ref: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
text: Sin chee le limɔfal mɔmɔk nya ni, le saawiihn cha ti waa nwiihn.

ref: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
text: Tɔ, li beenin gee binib bi nyi si na, ki ŋa bininyaam tiŋann.

ref: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
text: Taa cha kigaadam tak mi, ki taa cha bibiindam faan mi aan m san.

ref: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
text: Lik titunwanbirdam aah lir nin chee na. Bi dɔ nima le kaa ki ŋmaa fii.

ref: Don't be annoyed by anyone who does wrong, and don't envy them.
text: Taa cha bibiindam aabɔr muk si; taa li kpa lipiipoln binib bi tun taani na pu.

ref: Trust the Lord and live right! The land will be yours, and you will be safe.
text: Di naadii tii Uwumbɔr, ki li ŋani ni ŋan na; li bi kitiŋ kee pu ki li kpa limɔfal.

ref: Do what the Lord wants, and he will give you your heart's desire.
text: Li ban saamɔɔn Uwumbɔr chee, le u ga tii si aasui aah ban pu na.

ref: Let the Lord lead you and trust him to help.
text: Di aabaa tii Uwumbɔr; di naadii tii u, aan u ter si;

ref: Then it will be as clear as the noonday sun that you were right.
text: U ga cha saah ŋan pu na li wiin ke nwiin pu aawiin na.

ref: Be patient and trust the Lord. Don't let it bother you when all goes well for those who do sinful things.
text: Ji limɔr ki li kii Uwumbɔr aah ga ŋa pu na; taa cha binib bi kani nkam na, bee bi kani tinyoor baatunwanbir aatun ponn ni na aabɔr li muk si.

ref: Don't be angry or furious. Anger can lead to sin.
text: Taa cha nsuubiin ni liŋuul aabɔr nyaŋ si; ni ga di si buen tibɔr ni la.

ref: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord, the land will be yours.
text: Binib bi di naadii tii Uwumbɔr na le ga li yeh kitiŋ kee, le Uwumbɔr ga jenn nyan bibiindam ma.

ref: Sinners will soon disappear, never to be found,
text: Naan yunn le bibiindam ga wɔŋ; aa ga lik ban bi, ki mu aan kan bi;

ref: but the poor will take the land and enjoy a big harvest.
text: binib bi sunn bibaa taab na le ga li yeh kitiŋ kee, ki ji tinyoor ni nsuudoon aamɔɔn.

ref: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
text: Ubiindaan kpokl ki ban uninyaan la, le ki lik u ni kinanaŋ.

ref: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
text: Le Uwumbɔr ma laa bibiindam, ba pu? u nyi ke naan yunn le bi kuln.

ref: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.
text: Bibiindam ŋɔi baajaak aajum le ki moo pel baatɔi ke bi ku bigiim bi kaa kpa nibaa na, ke bi kɔr binib bi tun ni ŋan na;

ref: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.
text: le bibaa aajaak aajum ga ku bi, le baatɔi mu ga kool.

ref: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.
text: Uninyaan aah kpa siib ni na jer bibiindam mɔmɔk aawangol,

ref: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.
text: ba pu? Uwumbɔr ga gaa bibiindam aapɔɔn, le ki tee li kiir bininyaam.

ref: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.
text: Uwumbɔr le kiir binib bi keei waamɔb na, bima le ga li yeh kitiŋ kee ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.
text: N‑yoonn yaa kaa nan ki ŋan kan, baan ji falaa; le nkon aayoonn kan, bi ga li kpa ni ŋeer bi na.

ref: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.
text: Le bibiindam ma ga tee kpoi, Uwumbɔr aadim ga wɔŋ ke nsupuun na la; bi ga wɔŋ ke iŋmanyuu na la.

ref: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.
text: Ubiindaan yaa pinn tiwan kan, waa ki teeni, le uninyaan ma tii waapiin usui mɔmɔk.

ref: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.
text: Uwumbɔr aah ŋa waanyoor ŋa binib bi pu na le ga li yeh kitiŋ kee, le waah puun lii binib bi pu na ma ga yaa koo timoor ni.

ref: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.
text: Uwumbɔr le mɔk unii nsan mu u ga dii na, le ki kii binib bi unimbil gbiin bi na.

ref: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.
text: Bi yaa lir kan, baan doon kitiŋ, ba pu? Uwumbɔr le ter bi.

ref: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
text: Dandana m ye uninkpel la; m yunn pam, le maa kee kan ke Uwumbɔr siir cha bininyaam, ki mu aa kee kan ke baabim chuun mee tijiir.

ref: They gladly give and lend, and their children turn out good.
text: N‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, bi tii la, le ki pinni tii binib biken kaa gaal nibaa, le baabim mu ye bi tinyoor.

ref: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
text: Fenn aapuwɔb tii titunwanbir, ki li ŋani ni ŋan na, le aayaabitiib nan li bi kitiŋ kee pu n‑yoonn mɔmɔk,

ref: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.
text: ba pu? Uwumbɔr gee tiwan ni ŋan na la, kaa siir cha waanib bi dii u mbamɔm na. U kii bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, le ki ga jenn nyan bibiindam ma.

ref: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.
text: Uninyaan aamɔbon ye nlan la, le ki kpa ibamɔn n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: They remember God's teachings, and they never take a wrong step.
text: U joo Waawumbɔr aakaal usui ni la, le kaa yenni i chee.

ref: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
text: Ubiindaan lik uninyaan aah chuun pu na la, le ki pɔɔni ubaa ke u ku u;

ref: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
text: le Uwumbɔr aan di u ŋa waadim aaŋaal ni, ki mu aan cha bi bui ke waabɔr aa ŋan, buyoonn bi bi ji u tibɔr na.

ref: Trust the Lord and follow him. He will give you the land, and you will see the wicked destroyed.
text: Li kpa Uwumbɔr pu limakl, ki kii tii waamɔbon; waah ga nyuŋ si pu na le ye ke u di kitiŋ kee tii si, le aa ga kan ke u jenn nyan bibiindam.

ref: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
text: M nan nyi ubiindaan ubaa, le u nan kpa mbiin ni ti nyaŋ; u nan ti jer binib mɔmɔk pu ke Lebanonn aasui i fɔk sakpen na la;

ref: Suddenly they disappeared! I looked, but they were gone and no longer there.
text: Puwɔb le m nan ki jer nima le waa nan ki bi; m nan ban u le kaa ki kan u.

ref: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
text: Lik bee uninyaan, lik unii u ŋan na mbamɔm unii u kpa nsuudoon na kpa yaabitiib la,

ref: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
text: le titunwanbirdam ma kulni la, le bi ŋar biyaabitiib ŋŋaan.

ref: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
text: Uwumbɔr le gaal binib bi ŋan na lir, le ki kii bi tibɔbir aayoonn.

ref: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
text: U ter bi le ki gaal bi lir; u gaal bi bibiindam chee lir, ba pu? bi chaa u chee ti ban nterm.

ref: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
text: Saapiin tii mi titotonn; aa faa mi lii kitiŋ.

ref: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins
text: Saaŋuul pu, le m bi iween sakpiin ni; maatunwanbir pu le nwon mɔmɔk kpaln iween ŋmeen.

ref: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.
text: Maajɔrk pu, le maabuun bur ki nu.

ref: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
text: M gur boo la, m lir kookoo a; m wii le nwiin ti lir.

ref: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
text: Nwon mɔmɔk ton sakpen la, le maa ki daa nkun.

ref: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.
text: Nwon mɔmɔk kpo, le m lir kookoo, nsui mɔmɔk bii a, le m ker iween aadun.

ref: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa nyi maah ban ni na; aa ŋun maadun mɔmɔk pu.

ref: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
text: Mpobil gbaa la, le maapɔɔn mɔmɔk doo, le nnimbil aa ki waa chain.

ref: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
text: Maabuun pu, njɔtiib, ni binib bi koo gbɔk mi na aan ki duun ni mi; hali maachiln ni yaab gur daa mi la.

ref: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.
text: Binib bi ban bi ku mi na pen mi gaawɔb mam la, le binib bi ban bi tii mi titotonn na pɔɔni bibaa ke bi doo mi; n‑yoonn mɔmɔk bi kpokl ban mi la.

ref: I am not able to hear or speak a word;
text: M gur naahn utafakpaa la, le kaa ki ŋun, ki naahn ubir kaa ki ŋmaa len.

ref: I am completely deaf and can't make a sound.
text: M bi ke uja u kaa ŋun, kaa gar na la.

ref: I trust you, Lord God, and you will do something.
text: Uwumbɔr, le m tii sin ma naadii. Ndindaan Uwumbɔr, le sin ma ga gar mi.

ref: I said, “Don't let them laugh or brag when I slip and fall.”
text: Taa cha maadim aasui piir maasuubiin pu; taa cha bi li kpa kipupuk maalirm pu.

ref: I am about to collapse from constant pain.
text: Nwon wu n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la, le m ban m lir.

ref: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
text: M kpiir maatunwanbir ti tii mi nsuubiin na la.

ref: Many deadly and powerful enemies hate me,
text: Maadim kpa laafee le ki pɔɔ; binib pam le nan mi fam.

ref: and they repay evil for good because I try to do right.
text: Binib bi joo mbiin pa tiŋann na bii maayimbil buyoonn m pɔɔni mbaa ke m li ŋani ni ŋan na.

ref: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
text: Uwumbɔr, taa siir cha mi; Maawumbɔr, taa li daa mi.

ref: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
text: Uwumbɔr u gaal mi lir na, ter mi dandana wee.

ref: I told myself, “I'll be careful not to sin by what I say, and I'll muzzle my mouth when evil people are near.”
text: M len ke, “M ga chuu mbaa maatuln chee, ki taa cha nlambil di mi koon titunwanbir ni. Buyoonn titunwanbirdam bi m chee na kan, maan len tibaa.”

ref: I kept completely silent, but it did no good, and I hurt even worse.
text: M nan ŋmin suuna, kaa len tibaa, hali maa len litunyaan libaa aabɔr. Le maafalaa moo kpae,

ref: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:
text: le maalandak ban i ku mi. M yaa moo dak ilandak kan, le ni moo muk mi; le m nan baa ke,

ref: “Please, Lord, show me my future. Will I soon be gone?
text: “Uwumbɔr, maamɔfal fɔk kinye? Bayoonn aan m ga kpo? Bui mi maamɔfal aah ga kuln n‑yoonn mu na.”

ref: You made my life short, so brief that the time means nothing to you. “Human life is but a breath,
text: Aa kuln maamɔfal mala. Aa chee kan, maamɔfal aayoonn aa ye nibaa. Mbamɔn, unibɔn aamɔfal aa jer litakpiln libaa aabuln,

ref: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.
text: li ye kijunjuŋ la. Waatuln mɔmɔk ye fam la; u ban liwangol bilni, kaa tee nyi u ga li yeh li na.

ref: “What am I waiting for? I depend on you, Lord!
text: Uwumbɔr, ni ki ye ba aan m ga mak ni pu? M mak sin pu la.

ref: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
text: Nyan mi maatunwanbir mɔmɔk ni, ki taa cha bijɔrb laa mi.

ref: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
text: M ga li ŋmin, kaan len tibaa, ba pu? Sin le cha m ji falaa wee.

ref: “Won't you stop punishing me? You have worn me down.
text: Taa ki daa ntafal kpee; saagbar ban ti ku mi la.

ref: You punish us severely because of our sins. Like a moth, you destroy what we treasure most. We are as frail as a breath.
text: Saah ga kae unii pu na, le aa joo dar utafal waatunwanbir pu, le ki bii waah gee tiwan ni na ke ŋipandakur aah bii likekeln pu na. Mbamɔn, unibɔn aa jer litakpiln libaa aabuln.

ref: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
text: Uwumbɔr, ŋun maameel, ki ŋun maawiil; m yaa wii kan, dan ki nan ter mi. Aa chee, m yunn siib ke uchaan na le dulnyaa wee ni, ke n‑yaajatiib aah nan bi pu na la.

ref: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
text: Di cha mi suuna aan m kan mpopiin siib waahr aan m nin buen ki taa ki gir ni.

ref: I patiently waited, Lord, for you to hear my prayer. You listened
text: M nan ka suuna le ki kii Uwumbɔr aaterm; le u pel m chee ki ŋun maawiil.

ref: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm,
text: U daa nyan mi mbuu mu bir na ni, u nyan mi tikpakpar ti nyoo na ponn ni, ki di mi kaan litakpal li paa na pu, le nibaa aan ki pii mi nima.

ref: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.
text: U nan mɔk mi nlahnpɔɔn ke m gaa, nlahn mu m ga gaa pak uma Uwumbɔr na. Binib bi kan kina na pam ga li san u, ki di naadii tii u.

ref: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
text: Binib bi di naadii tii Uwumbɔr, kaa dii ŋiwaa, kaa kpaani binib bi dii ŋiwaa na chee na, bima le kpa mpopiin sakpen.

ref: You, Lord God, have done many wonderful things, and you have planned marvelous things for us. No one is like you! I would never be able to tell all you have done.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr, aa ŋa tiwan pam tii timi; ubaa aa bi ke sin na. Aa dak ke aa ga ŋa iwaan aatun tii timi, maa nan ŋmaa len ŋi mɔmɔk pu, ŋaakahm wiir sakpen a.

ref: Sacrifices and offerings are not what please you; gifts and payment for sin are not what you demand. But you made me willing to listen and obey.
text: Saa ban tiwakor ni tijikaar aatork; saa ban ke m di tiwakor toor kitork ki di see mmii kitork aabimbiln paab tii si, kaa ban ke m toor kitork titunwanbir pu, aa tee tii mi ŋitafal ke m ŋun tii si,

ref: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
text: kina pu le m gar ke, “M sɔ. Saah ban ke m li ŋani pu na bi Nkaal Aagbaŋ ponn ni la.

ref: ‘I enjoy pleasing you. Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
text: Maawumbɔr, m gee sakpen ke m ŋa saageehn, m joo saamɔkm nsui ni la.”

ref: When your people worshiped, you know I told them, “Our Lord always helps!”
text: Uwumbɔr, saanib mɔmɔk aakuun ni, le m len tibɔnyaan ke aa gaa timi lii. Aa nyi ke m ga li len ti, kaan di cha.

ref: When all your people met, I did not keep silent. I said, “Our Lord is kind. He is faithful and caring, and he saves us.”
text: Maa di tibɔnyaan ngbaan di bɔr, n‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, m len saah ŋan sakpen ki ter mi pu na la. Maan li si ŋmin saanib mɔmɔk aakuun ni, m ga len saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na, ni saah si chob pu na aabɔr.

ref: You, Lord, never fail to have pity on me; your love and faithfulness always keep me secure.
text: Uwumbɔr, m nyi ke saan di cha kaan san mi kinimbaak. Saageehm, ni saah si chob pu na le ga li kii mi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Limeel li ban nterm na (Ilahn

ref: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.
text: Tibɔr pam le mann goln mi, tibɔbir ti maan ŋmaa kahn ti na. Maatunwanbir chuu mi a, le maa ki waa; ti wiir jer n‑yil paab aayikpir, le ntaakpab yɔl.

ref: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
text: Uwumbɔr, gaa mi lii. Ter mi dandana wee.

ref: Disgrace and confuse all who want me dead; turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
text: Cha binib bi ban ke bi ku mi na aalan ŋmal aan bi lir kookoo. Cha binib bi aasui piir maah bi tibɔr ni pu na di inimɔɔn labr.

ref: Embarrass and shame everyone who says, “Just look at you now!”
text: Cha binib bi laa mi na kan nsuubiin baalirm pu.

ref: Our Lord, let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, “The Lord is wonderful!”
text: Cha binib bimɔk choo aa chee na kan mpopiin ni mmɔɔn. Cha binib bimɔk dooni si saah gaa bi lii pu na len n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ke, “Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn nyaŋ a.”

ref: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
text: Uwumbɔr, nwon yɔl, le m ye ugiin, le saa suln mbɔr. Sin le ye Maawumbɔr u gaal mi lir na, ŋa mala ki nan ter mi.

ref: You, Lord God, bless everyone who cares for the poor, and you rescue those people in times of trouble.
text: Binib bi aatafal bi bigiim wɔb na, bima le kpa mpopiin; Uwumbɔr ga ter bi buyoonn bi bi tibɔr ni na.

ref: You protect them and keep them alive. You make them happy here in this land, and you don't hand them over to their enemies.
text: Uwumbɔr ga li kii bi le ki bɔr baamɔfal mbamɔm. U ga cha bi li kpa mpopiin kitiŋ kee pu; waan cha baadim aapɔɔn pii bi.

ref: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.
text: Bi yaa bun kan, Uwumbɔr ga ter bi ki cha bi pɔɔk.

ref: I prayed, “Have pity, Lord! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.”
text: M len ke, “Uwumbɔr, m tun si titunwanbir; san mi kinimbaak ki tii mi laafee.”

ref: My vicious enemies ask me, “When will you die and be forgotten?”
text: Maadim len mi tibɔr ti kaa ŋan na. Bi ban ke m kpo aan binib suln m bɔr la.

ref: When visitors come, all they ever bring are worthless words, and when they leave, they spread gossip.
text: Binib bi choo nan manni mi na ye binyamɔndam la; bi chuun ban maabɔbir la, le ki di buen ni kookoo ki ti len ti.

ref: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
text: Bi len le ke, “Waabunbunn ngbaan nyaŋ u a; waan ki fii daalbaadaal.”

ref: My most trusted friend has turned against me, though he ate at my table.
text: Hali njɔnyaan, u m tii u naadii sakpen na, aan m ni u kpaan ni ji lisambil libaa ni na, uma le fii sil m pu.

ref: Have pity, Lord! Heal me, so I can pay them back.
text: Uwumbɔr, san mi kinimbaak, ki tii mi laafee, aan m teen maadim.

ref: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
text: Baan nyaŋ mi, le m ga bee ke aasui piin m pu.

ref: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
text: Aa ga ter mi, ba pu? m ŋani ni ŋan na la; aa ga cha m li bi aanimbiin ni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.
text: Pak timi Israel yaab Aadindaan Uwumbɔr man. Li pak u man dandana, ni n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Amii amii. LELEE AAGBAŊ (Ilahn

ref: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.
text: Uwumbɔr, upeeman aah ban mbun mu aanyun soon na pu na, kina le m mu ban si.

ref: In my heart, I am thirsty for you, the living God. When will I see your face?
text: Sin Uwumbɔr u bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na, m wii ban si la; bayoonn aan m ga ŋmaa buen aanimbiin ni ki ti doon si?

ref: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, “Where is your God?”
text: M wii nwiin pu ni kinyeek la, le maanyunyunn ye maajikaar; n‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, maadim baa mi le ke, “Saawumbɔr ngbaan bi la?”

ref: Sorrow floods my heart, when I remember leading the worshipers to your house. I can still hear them shout their joyful praises.
text: M yaa teer n‑yoonn mu jer na aabɔr kan, le nsui bii, n‑yoonn ngbaan le m nan dii kinipaak buen Uwumbɔr do ki loln bi pu nsan na, kinipaak ngbaan aasui nan piin, le bi gaa ilahn ki tar ki pak Uwumbɔr.

ref: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I should trust you, Lord. I will praise you again because you help me,
text: Ba ŋa nsui aa piin? Ba ŋa nsui bii kina? M mak Uwumbɔr pu la, le m ga ki pak u, uma le ye Maawumbɔr u gaal mi lir na.

ref: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.
text: Uwumbɔr tii mi waageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na nwiin pu, aan m nan li kpa limeel aalahn kinyeek ki gaa mee Uwumbɔr u tii mi limɔfal na.

ref: You are my mighty rock. Why have you forgotten me? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
text: M len Uwumbɔr u ye maakikiir na chee ke, “Ba ŋa aa suln mbɔr? Ba ŋa m beenin ji falaa, maadim aah ŋa mi mbiin pu na pu?”

ref: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
text: Baasiibil le doo mi. Bi baa mi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ke, “Saawumbɔr ngbaan bi la?”

ref: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
text: Ba ŋa nsui aa piin? Ba ŋa nsui bii kina? M mak Uwumbɔr pu la, le m ga ki pak u, uma le ye Maawumbɔr u gaal mi lir na.

ref: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.
text: Uwumbɔr, bui ke maabɔr ŋan, ki len tii mi binib bi kaa dii si na chee; nyan mi binyamɔndam ni titunwanbirdam aaŋaal ni.

ref: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
text: Sin le ye u kii mi na; ba ŋa aa siir cha mi? ba ŋa m beenin ji falaa, maadim aah ŋa mi mbiin pu na pu?

ref: Send your light and your truth to guide me. Let them lead me to your house on your sacred mountain.
text: Cha saawiihn ni saabamɔn dan; cha ni loln m pu nsan ki giin ni mi saagongoln li bi chain na pu, ki ti fuu saadichal, li ponn ni aa koo na,

ref: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
text: le m ga buen saatork aabimbiln chee; sin Uwumbɔr chee le m kani mpopiin. Uwumbɔr, Maawumbɔr, m ga gbaa maabeek ki gaa ilahn pak si.

ref: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
text: Ba ŋa nsui aa piin? Ba ŋa nsui bii kina? M mak Uwumbɔr pu la, le m ga ki pak u, uma le ye Maawumbɔr u gaal mi lir na.

ref: Our God, our ancestors told us what wonders you worked and we listened carefully.
text: Uwumbɔr, tiyaajatiib bui timi, le titafal ŋun saah nan tun ŋitukpaan ŋi baayoonn mu jer ki yunn na.

ref: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.
text: Sin aabaa le nan jenn nyan binib bi kaa dii si na, ki di saanib kaan baatiŋ pu. Aa nan daa binib ngbaan aatafal ki cha saanib kan tinyoor.

ref: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
text: Saanib aa nan di baajaak aajum le nyaŋ ki gaa kitiŋ ngbaan; baa nan di bibaa aapɔɔn le di kan linyaŋ ngbaan; ni nan ye sin aapɔɔn pu la; saah nan bi bi chee pu na le nan cha bi nyaŋ, le ki mɔk ke aa gee bi.

ref: You are my God and King, and you give victory to the people of Jacob.
text: Sin le ye Maawumbɔr ni maabɔr; aa tii saanib linyaŋ,

ref: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.
text: le ti joo saapɔɔn nyaŋni timi aadim.

ref: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
text: Maa mak maatɔm pu, kaa mak maajaak aajuk pu ke ni gaa mi lii;

ref: But you saved us from our hateful enemies, and you put them to shame.
text: le sin ma gaa timi, timi aadim aaŋaal ni lii, le ki nyaŋ binib bi kaa gee timi na.

ref: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.
text: Ti ga pak si n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, ki li dooni si ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: But now you have rejected us; you don't lead us into battle, and we look foolish.
text: Le dandana wee aa yii timi ki cha bi nyaŋ timi. Saa ki diir timi aajab chaa butɔb ni.

ref: You made us retreat, and our enemies have taken everything we own.
text: Aa cha timi aadim jenn timi, le ki yoor timi aawangol.

ref: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.
text: Aa cha bi kɔr timi ke ipiih na la, aa cha ti yaa koo ntiyayam ni.

ref: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
text: Aa di saanib kooh kidaak ki kaa pɔɔ na kaa kan tinyoor tibaa.

ref: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
text: Timi ni binib bi koo gbɔk tɔb na kani saah ŋani timi pu na, le bi ŋani timi mbɔnyun ki laa timi.

ref: I am embarrassed every day, and I blush with shame.
text: N‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, m bi inimɔɔn ni la;

ref: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.
text: maah ŋun maadim ni binib bi nan mi na aasiibil ni tilaar pu na m ye unimɔɔnii la.

ref: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.
text: Nimina mɔmɔk ŋa timi n‑yoonn mu taa suln aabɔr kaa bii tipuukpaan ti aa nan puu tii timi na.

ref: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
text: Taa nyan aapuwɔb, taa yii saamɔbon.

ref: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.
text: Le aa siir cha timi tipeewanbir aakaasisik ni; aa siir cha timi mbɔmbɔɔn sakpen ponn ni la.

ref: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
text: Ti yaa ba di cha kaa ki dooni si, timi Aawumbɔr, ki mee liwaal libaa kan,

ref: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
text: aa ba ga bee, ba pu? aa nyi tisui aah bi pu na.

ref: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
text: Tɔ, sin pu le bi ku timi iwiin mɔmɔk, le ti naahn ipiih i bi ban bi ti kɔr i na la.

ref: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.
text: Uwumbɔr, finn ngeen pu. Ba ŋa aa dɔ geen? Fii sil paacham. Taa yii timi kookoo.

ref: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.
text: Ba ŋa aa joo aabaa bɔrni timi? Taa suln timi aafalaa ni timi aamuk bɔr.

ref: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
text: Ti lir wɔb ki dɔ kitiŋ la; ti lir ki dɔ titan ponn ni la.

ref: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
text: Dan nan ter timi. Gaa timi lii, saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu.

ref: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.
