text: Ŋimɔbonyaan le gbii nsui ni, le m naan nlahn mue m tii ubɔr. Nlambil gor ke li di nlahn lii ke ugbaŋmeer nyaan aagbaŋmeemoon aah ga ŋmee pu na.

ref: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.
text: Sin ubɔr le ŋan jer bijab mɔmɔk; aa ye unii u ŋmaa len na la. Uwumbɔr ŋani tinyoor ŋani aa pu n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la.

ref: Mighty king, glorious ruler, strap on your sword
text: Ubɔr sakpiin, di saajaak aajuk peen; aa kpa mpɔɔn ni kipak.

ref: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
text: Di mpɔɔn buen ki ti kan mbamɔn ni mbimbinyaan aanyaŋ. Saapɔɔn le ga cha aa kan linyaŋ sakpeln.

ref: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.
text: Saapiin ka pam, i too chaar saadim aapobil, le ŋitimbol lir gbaani aanimbiin ni.

ref: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
text: Nnaan mu Uwumbɔr di tii si na ga li bi ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Aa joo saanib mbamɔm la;

ref: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.
text: aa gee lituln li ŋan na, le ki nan titunwanbir. Kina pu le Uwumbɔr u ye Saawumbɔr na lee si ki tii si mpopiin ki jer bibɔrb biken.

ref: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
text: Tulalee tiib bi bi yin bi ke mir ni alos na le gbii saakeken pu; le bilahngaab ni biwangbaab bi ŋibɔrchin ŋi bi di iluub aanyin di toor ŋi na ponn ni ki pak si.

ref: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
text: Bibɔrb aabisatiib ŋmal bipiib bi bi saachiln ni na, le ubɔrpii si libɔrjal chee aaŋangii wɔb, ki pee salmaa nyaan aaleen.

ref: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
text: Ubɔr aabɔndinn, li pel maah len pu na, suln saanib, ni aado yaab bɔr.

ref: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.
text: Saanyaan le ga cha ubɔr li gee si; uma le ye saaninkpel, kina pu na, kii waamɔb.

ref: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you
text: Taya aatiŋ aanib ga joo ni si ipiin, biwankpadam ga dan nan ban ke bi piir aasui.

ref: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
text: Ubɔr aabɔndinn u mu ye ubɔr aabisal na koo ni ki ŋan sakpen a. Bi di salmaa aakokonn le luu waabɔkul.

ref: Wearing the finest garments, she is brought to you, followed by her young friends, the bridesmaids.
text: U pee waabɔkul li ŋmal ŋitanyaan na, le bi di u buen ubɔr chee, le unaakoontiib dii u, le bi mu ti fuu ubɔr ngbaan chee.

ref: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
text: Bi di mpopiin ni mmɔɔn le ti koo libɔrchiln ni.

ref: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.
text: Sin maabɔr, m ga tii si japɔtiib pam, le bi nan gaa aayaajatiib aanaan, le aa ga ŋa bi kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk aajojoob.

ref: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
text: Maalahn le ga cha saayimbil li bi ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na, le binib mɔmɔk ga li pak si n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.
text: Uwumbɔr le ye timi aakikiir, ni timi aapɔɔn, tibɔr aayoonn mɔmɔk kan, u gor le ki ter timi.

ref: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.
text: Kina pu na, taan san ijawaan, hali kitiŋ yaa dam aan ŋijoo ber lir nnyusakpem aataab kan, taan san ijawaan;

ref: Let the ocean roar and foam, and its raging waves shake the mountains.
text: hali nnyusakpem yaa fii ti lir aan ŋigongon dam kina pu kan, taan san ijawaan.

ref: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.
text: Limɔɔl libaa le bi, ki joo ni mpopiin nan tii Uwumbɔr u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na aatiŋ ki ponn ni waadichal bi na.

ref: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
text: Uwumbɔr bi kitiŋ ngbaan ni, kina pu na, kaan bii daalbaadaal; lichakpitaawoln le u ga dan nan ter ki.

ref: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
text: Ijawaan chur ŋitimbol, le nnaan mɔmɔk jii; Uwumbɔr tar, le kitiŋ bunn doo.

ref: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
text: Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan bi ti chee; uma u nan ye Jakob Aawumbɔr na le ye timi aabɔbɔryaan.

ref: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
text: Dan nan lik man Uwumbɔr aah ŋa tiwan ni na. Lik man waah ŋa lijinjiir aawan ni kitiŋ pu na.

ref: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
text: U cha butɔb door dulnyaa wee mɔmɔk ni; U kool itɔi, ki bii tikpaatunn, ki seer kijaak aapen mmii.

ref: Our God says, “Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.”
text: U len ke, “Di cha kijaak man, ki bee ke min le ye Uwumbɔr, m ye ŋitimbol mɔmɔk aayidaan, ni dulnyaa mɔmɔk aayidaan.”

ref: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
text: Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan bi ti chee; uma u nan ye Jakob Aawumbɔr na le ye timi aabɔbɔryaan.

ref: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
text: Binib mɔmɔk, faa ŋibambaan mpopiin pu man. Gaa ilahn mpɔɔn pu ki pak Uwumbɔr man.

ref: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
text: Li san man Uwumbɔr u kpa mpɔɔn jer mpɔɔn mɔmɔk na; u ye ubɔrkpaan la, le ki joo dulnyaa wee mɔmɔk.

ref: God has put every nation under our power,
text: U cha ti nyaŋ binib; u cha ti joo ŋitimbol ŋiken.

ref: and he chose for us the land that was the pride of Jacob, his favorite.
text: U lee kitiŋ ki ti ga li bi ki pu na tii timi, liwangol li ye waah gee binib bi na yaan na.

ref: God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.
text: Uwumbɔr jon kal waabɔrjal pu. Mpopiin aafuuk ni kakaan mam wii n‑yoonn mu Uwumbɔr cha paacham na la.

ref: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
text: Uwumbɔr le ye dulnyaa wee mɔmɔk aabɔr; di ilahn pak u man.

ref: God rules the nations from his sacred throne.
text: Uwumbɔr ka waabɔrjal li bi chain na pu; u joo ŋitimbol mɔmɔk.

ref: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
text: Ŋitimbol aajojoob kuun ni unimbiin ni, ke bi ye uma Uwumbɔr u Abraham nan dii u na aanib la. Uwumbɔr kpa mpɔɔn jer bijab mɔmɔk; waanijoom nyaŋ a.

ref: The Lord God is wonderful! He deserves all praise in the city where he lives. His holy mountain,
text: Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn nyaŋ sakpen, ni ŋan ke ti li pak u mbamɔm, waagongoln li bi chain na paab.

ref: beautiful and majestic, brings joy to all on earth. Mount Zion, truly sacred, is home for the Great King.
text: Uwumbɔr aajool Sionn fɔk paacham, le ki ŋan; Ubɔrkpaan ngbaan aatiŋ joo ni mpopiin le nan tii dulnyaa mɔmɔk.

ref: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
text: Uwumbɔr mɔk ke lifuur bi u chee, waatiŋ ki bi maa ŋigon kiir ki na ponn ni.

ref: Kings joined forces to attack the city,
text: Bibɔrb nan kuun tɔb ki dan ke bi nan tak Sionn Aajool.

ref: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.
text: Tɔ, baah nan kan li na, le ni ŋa bi iwaan; ijawaan nan chuu bi, le bi san.

ref: or like seagoing ships wrecked by eastern winds.
text: ki naahn buŋɔb aah yeŋni kitaabuŋ ni pu na.

ref: We had heard about it, and now we have seen it in the city of our God, the Lord All-Powerful. This is the city that God will let stand forever.
text: Ti ŋun Uwumbɔr aah tun pu na, le dandana ma kan, tinimbil kani waatun, waatiŋ ni. Uma le ye Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan; u ga cha lifuur li bi kitiŋ ngbaan ni, ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: Our God, here in your temple we think about your love.
text: Uwumbɔr, Saadichal ponn ni le ti dakl saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu.

ref: You are famous and praised everywhere on earth, as you win victories with your powerful arm.
text: Binib bi bi ni mɔmɔk na pak si la, le saayimbil yaa ki buen kitiŋ kee aapepel mɔmɔk ni. Ibamɔn pu le aa joo saanib;

ref: Mount Zion will celebrate, and all Judah will be glad, because you bring justice.
text: Cha Sionn aanib li kpa mpopiin. Aa ji tibɔr ni ibamɔn la; cha mpopiin li bi Juda aatim pu.

ref: Let's walk around Zion and count its towers.
text: Uwumbɔr aanib, chuun mann Sionn aatiŋ man, ki kahn kaadifɔfɔŋ ngbaan;

ref: We will see its strong walls and visit each fortress. Then you can say to future generations,
text: moo lik man kaagon ŋi bi maa gob ki na, ni tidir ti kpa mpɔɔn na mbamɔm, aan ki nan bui binib bi paa ni puwɔb na ke,

ref: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
text: Ni mɔmɔk li pel man tibɔr tee, binib bi mɔmɔk bi ni kookoo na,

ref: Listen, no matter who you are, rich or poor.
text: binikpaam ni biwaatiib mɔmɔk, biwankpadam ni bigiim mɔmɔk, li pel man.

ref: I speak words of wisdom, and my thoughts make sense.
text: Nsui ga li nyoo pam; m ga len nlan aabɔr.

ref: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
text: M ga labr koo ŋiyataŋak ni la, le ki di kibeek gbaa kpiir ŋaatataa.

ref: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?
text: Linimaln ni, buyoonn maadim mann goln mi na kan, maa san ijawaan;

ref: They trust in their riches and brag about all their wealth.
text: kaa san titunwanbirdam bi di naadii tii baawangol, ki puur tipupuur baawankpal sakpeln ngbaan pu na ijawaan.

ref: You cannot buy back your life or pay off God!
text: Unii aan ŋmaa pa ki gaa ubaa aamɔfal; waan ŋmaa pa Uwumbɔr waamɔfal pu,

ref: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
text: ba pu? unibɔn aamɔfal aadaak pɔɔ sakpen a. Waah ga di tiwan ni pa na ga li par

ref: We see that wise people die, and so do stupid fools. Then their money is left for someone else.
text: Unii mɔk kani ke binib bi kpa nlan na mu kpoi, ke bijɔrb ni bilatiirb na la. Bi mɔmɔk kpoi le ki cha baawangol siini biyaabitiib.

ref: The grave will be their home forever and ever, although they once had land of their own.
text: Baakaakul ga li ye bido ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na; nima chee le bi ga li bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, bi mu nan tee kpa bibaa aatim n‑yoonn mubaa.

ref: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
text: Unii aawangol aan ŋmaa nyan u nkun ni; u ga nan kpo ke kiwakork na la.

ref: Here is what happens to fools and to those who trust the words of fools:
text: Lik man tiwan ni ŋani binib bi tii bibaa naadii na, lik man binib bi bui ke bi bab liwangol na aadoon,

ref: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.
text: bi ga nan kpo ke ipiih na la, nkun le ga nan li ye u kpaa bi na. Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na ga laa bi, buyoonn biwon bi bur kitekpiitiŋ ki daa bido na ni.

ref: But God will rescue me from the power of death.
text: Le Uwumbɔr ga gaa mi lii, u ga nyan mi nkun aapɔɔn ni.

ref: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.
text: Unii yaa kan liwangol kan, taa cha aasui bii, hali ki ti saa buyoonn waawangol ngbaan moo kpee na;

ref: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
text: U yaa nan kpo kan, waan ŋmaa yoor li buen ubaa chee; waawangol aan dii u koo likaakul ni.

ref: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
text: Hali unii yaa bui ke nibaa aa muk u aan binib pak u kina pu kan,

ref: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.
text: u ga nan ti pii uyaajatiib nkun ni, nin chee mbɔmbɔɔn aan doo na.

ref: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
text: Unii aawangol aan ŋmaa nyan u nkun ni, u ga nan kpo ke kiwakork na la.

ref: From east to west, the powerful Lord God has been calling together everyone on earth.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan le len na; u yin kitiŋ kee pu yaab mɔmɔk ki nyan liwipuul ki ti saa liwilir wɔb.

ref: God shines brightly from Zion, the most beautiful city.
text: Uwumbɔr wiin Sionn aatiŋ ki ŋan sakpen na ni.

ref: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.
text: Timi Aawumbɔr choo, le kifuuk dii u; mmii mu gaal mpɔɔn pu na le loln u pu nsan, le libuln li pɔɔ sakpen na mann goln u.

ref: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
text: U yin paacham, ni taab, ke ni nan li ye seeraadam ki kan waah ga ji waanib tibɔr pu na.

ref: “Call my followers together! They offered me a sacrifice, and we made an agreement.”
text: U bui ke, “Kuun ni maanib bi kpa gaakii ki di kitork puu tipuur tii mi na tii ni mi.”

ref: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
text: Paacham len ke Uwumbɔr aabimbin ŋan, ke uma le ye ubɔjir.

ref: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
text: “Maanib, li pel man, aan m len tibɔr, M ga kpiir sin Israel yaab pu. Min le ye Uwumbɔr, m ye nimi Aawumbɔr la.

ref: I won't accept your offerings of bulls and goats.
text: ki mu aa ban nimi aasar ponn ni aanaaja, ni iŋoob nimi aaŋoob ni;

ref: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
text: tiwakor timɔk bi kichook ni na ye min yaan la, le inaa imɔk bi ŋigongon ŋichur ŋichur pu na mu ye min yaan.

ref: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.
text: Min le yeh inyoon imɔk bi timoor ni na, ni tiwan nimɔk fu ki bi tikpaasar ni na.

ref: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
text: Nkon yaa ba joo mi kan, maa ba ga tuk nimi, ba pu? dulnyaa wee mɔmɔk, ni nimɔk bi u ni na ye min yaan la.

ref: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.
text: M ŋmɔ inaaja aanann la aa? M nyu iŋoob aasin la aa?

ref: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
text: Cha man idoon baanja li ye kitork ki ni joo tii mi na, ki tii mi Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan tiwan nimɔk ni puu ke ni ga tii mi na.

ref: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
text: Tibɔr yaa dan kan, ni yin mi le m ga gaa nimi lii aan ni ga pak mi.”

ref: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
text: Le Uwumbɔr bui bibiindam ma ke, “Ba ŋa ni cha maakaal bi nimɔb ni? Ba ŋa ni len maah puu tipuur ti na aabɔr?

ref: You refused correction and rejected my commands.
text: Ni yii, ke m taa mɔk nimi buyoonn ni yenn na; ni yii maamɔbon.

ref: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
text: Ni yaa kan unaayuk umɔk na kan, le ni kpaan kpaln ujɔtiib, le ki mu diir bidagoob.

ref: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
text: N‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, ni gor ki ban ke ni len tibɔbir la; le ki mɔni inyamɔn n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.”
text: Ni gor n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ke ni galn nina aabim la, ki ban ke ni kan baataani.

ref: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
text: Ni ŋani nimina mɔmɔk, le maa len tibaa, kina pu le ni dakl ke m mu bi kina la. Tɔ, dandana ma kan, m ban m galn nimi la, ki nyan tibɔr ngbaan lipaal tii nimi.

ref: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.
text: Nimi bi yii mi na, li pel man tibɔr tee, naa ye kina kan, m ga ku doo nimi, le ubaa aan li bi ki ga gaa nimi lii.

ref: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
text: Idoon le ye kitork ki ga nyuŋ mi na, le m ga sil gaa binib bimɔk kii maamɔb na lii.”

ref: You are kind, God! Please have pity on me. You are always merciful! Please wipe away my sins.
text: Uwumbɔr, san mi kinimbaak, saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu. Saanimbaasaln sakpeln pu, finn nyan maatunwanbir.

ref: Wash me clean from all of my sin and guilt.
text: Finn nyan maabɔbir mɔmɔk ki cha m nyan maatunwanbir ni chain.

ref: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.
text: M bee maataani mɔmɔk, n‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, m nyi maatunwanbir bɔr.

ref: You are really the one I have sinned against; I have disobeyed you and have done wrong. So it is right and fair for you to correct and punish me.
text: M tun si titunwanbir, sin baanja le m tun titunwanbir, ki ŋani tiwan ni ye aa chee tibir na, kina pu na, aa yaa jin mi tibɔr kan, ni ŋan, aa kpa mbamɔn ke aa bui ke maabɔr bii.

ref: I have sinned and done wrong since the day I was born.
text: N‑yoonn mu bi ma mi na, le m kpa titunwanbir, ki nyan nwiin mundaal bi ma mi na, le m ye titunwanbirdaan.

ref: But you want complete honesty, so teach me true wisdom.
text: Saah ban pu na le ye mbimbinyaan, ni ibamɔn; di saalan gbiin mi.

ref: Wash me with hyssop until I am clean and whiter than snow.
text: Nyan mi maatunwanbir ni, aan m nya chain; finn mi, aan m piir chain ke tikokonn na.

ref: Let me be happy and joyful! You crushed my bones, now let them celebrate.
text: Cha mpopiin ni mmɔɔn gbiin mi, le saah kool mi doo pu na nsui ga ki piir.

ref: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.
text: Taa cha aanimbil kan maatunwanbir, ki finn nyan maabɔbir mɔmɔk.

ref: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.
text: Uwumbɔr, naan nsui mu ŋan na tii mi, ki di nsuupɔɔn mu ga kii saamɔb na tii mi.

ref: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
text: Taa jenn mi aanimbiin ni kookoo; taa chuu nyan Saafuur Nyaan m chee.

ref: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
text: Gaa mi lii, aan m ki kan mpopiin, ki cha m li ye unii u keei saamɔb na,

ref: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.
text: le m ga mɔk titunwanbirdam saakaal aan bi fenn gir ni aa chee.

ref: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
text: Uwumbɔr, taa junn maamɔfal. Nya mi tibɔbir ni, aan m di mpopiin moon saah kpa mbimbinyaan pu na.

ref: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
text: Uwumbɔr, ter mi aan m ŋmaa len ki pak si.

ref: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.
text: Uwumbɔr, saatork ki aa gee na le ye nsui mu sunn mubaa taab ki ŋmaa kpiir mu aatunwanbir na.

ref: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
text: Uwumbɔr, san Sionn aanib kinimbaak ki ter bi, ki gir maa Jerusalem aagon.

ref: Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices, and we will offer bulls on your altar once again.
text: N‑yoonn ngbaan le aasui ga piir kitork baamɔŋ, ni timi aatork ki ti joo seer mmii ni tii si na pu, le bi ga kɔr inaaja toor kitork saatork aabimbiln paab.

ref: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.
text: Unikpaan, ba ŋa aa kpa kipupuk saatunwanbir pu? Uwumbɔr aageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.
text: Aa ban isan ke aa kuln biken; saalambil ka ke kijukaŋ na la. N‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, aa naani inyamɔn la.

ref: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
text: Aa gee titunwanbir ki jer litunyaan, ki gee inyamɔn jer mbamɔn.

ref: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
text: Sin unyamɔndaan, aa gee ke aa li joo saamɔbon bii biken aasui.

ref: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.
text: Kina pu le Uwumbɔr ga kuln si, u ga yoor si ki nya saadichal ni. U ga nyan si binib bi kpa limɔfal dulnyaa wee na ni.

ref: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say,
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na ga kan kina, le ijawaan ga chuu bi; le bi ga laa si ki bui ke,

ref: “Just look at them now! Instead of trusting God, they trusted their wealth and their cruelty.”
text: “Lik, uja u kaa nan di Uwumbɔr yin nibaa na sɔ, u nan lik waawangol pu la, ki dak ke mbiin le ga tii u lifuur ki gaa u lii.”

ref: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.
text: Le mma bi ke olif aakpan aasub bu si Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni na; m kpa waageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu limakl.

ref: I will always thank God for what he has done; I will praise his good name when his people meet.
text: Uwumbɔr, m ga li dooni si n‑yoonn mɔmɔk saah ŋa pu tii mi na pu. Saanib aanimbil ni le m ga len ke aa ŋan.

ref: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless! They are heartless and cruel and never do right.
text: Bijɔrb le bui bibaa ke, “Uwumbɔr aa bi.” Bi mɔmɔk ye beebeedam la, le ki tun ŋitun ŋi kaa ŋan na; ubaa aa bi ki tun lituln li ŋan na.

ref: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
text: Uwumbɔr bi paacham le ki lik ni unibɔn pu taab, ke u lik ke bibaa bi ki kpa nlan ki dii u aan baa bi.

ref: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
text: Le bi mɔmɔk fenn bipuwɔb tii u, bi mɔmɔk aa ŋan. Ubaa aa bi ki tun lituln li ŋan na, ubaa baanja aa bi.

ref: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.
text: Le Uwumbɔr baa ke, “Baa nyi la aa? Titunwanbirdam bee aa nyi la aa? Bi su maanib kinaayuk le ki ji, le kaa dooni mi kpala.”

ref: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
text: Tɔ, ijawaan mu tee ga chuu bi, ke yaah kaa kee chuu bi pu na; ba pu? Uwumbɔr ga di waanib aadim aakpab yaa. Uwumbɔr yii bi, kina pu le Israel yaab ga nyaŋ bi kookoo.

ref: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
text: M mee Uwumbɔr ke linyaŋ ga nya ni Sionn ki dan Israel yaab chee. Uwumbɔr yaa tii Israel yaab nkam kan, bi ga li kpa mpopiin sakpen.

ref: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
text: Uwumbɔr, di saapɔɔn gaa mi lii; di saapɔɔn sakpiin na nya mi.

ref: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
text: Uwumbɔr, ŋun maameel; pel maabɔr.

ref: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
text: Kigaadam le choo bi nan tak mi; mbiindam bi aatafal aa bi sin Uwumbɔr ni na le ban bi ku mi.

ref: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
text: Uwumbɔr mu le ye u ter mi na. Uma Uwumbɔr le ye maakikiir.

ref: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
text: Uwumbɔr di maadim aatunwanbir giin daa bitafal. U tun waah siin pu na, nima le u ga kuln bi.

ref: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord. I will praise your name because you are good.
text: Uwumbɔr, m ga di mpopiin le toor kitork tii si, saah ŋan pu na le ga cha m li dooni si.

ref: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
text: Aa nyan mi maabɔr mɔmɔk ni, le m kan maadim aah lir pu na.

ref: Listen, God, to my prayer! Don't reject my request.
text: Uwumbɔr, ŋun maameel, taa fenn aapuwɔb tii maah gaŋni si pu na.

ref: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning
text: Pel m chee ki kii maayim; maamuk cha nwon yɔl la.

ref: because my enemies attack with loud shouts. They treat me terribly and hold angry grudges.
text: Ijawaan joo mi maadim aah faani mi pu na la, bibiindam aamuk ku mi a. Bi joo ni mi tibɔr la; baaŋuul fii m pu, le bi nan mi.

ref: My heart is racing fast, and I am afraid of dying.
text: Ijawaan le joo mi, le nkun aajawaan ku mi.

ref: I am trembling with fear, completely terrified.
text: Ijawaan chuu mi, le nwon jii, ijawaan nyaŋ mi a.

ref: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.
text: M yaa ba kpa ifeen ke linanjel na, m ba ga fii buen dandar, ki ti ban lifuur nima chee.

ref: I would go and live in some distant desert.
text: M ba ga fii buen dandar, ki ti maa maadichal nteersakpiin pu.

ref: I would quickly find shelter from howling winds and raging storms.
text: M ba ga ŋa mala ki kan nin chee m ga di n‑yil peŋ na, aan libupɔɔl ni kitaabuŋ taa pii mi.

ref: Confuse my enemies, Lord! Upset their plans. Cruelty and violence are all I see in the city,
text: Uwumbɔr, cha maadim aalan ŋmal aan bi taa ŋmaa len. M waa tijar, ni kifuuk, kitiŋ ngbaan ni;

ref: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil,
text: ni mann goln ki, nwiin pu ni kinyeek, ki joo ni titunwanbir ni tibɔr.

ref: and corruption. Troublemakers and liars freely roam the streets.
text: Libiil le bi ni kookoo, limukl ni ŋŋmann le gbii ki ponn ni.

ref: My enemies are not the ones who sneer and make fun. I could put up with that or even hide from them.
text: Ni yaa ba ye ke maadin le laa mi kan, m ba ga ŋmaa joo ti; ni yaa ba ye ke unii u kpak mi na le bi kpa kipupuk kan, m ba ga ŋmaa di mbaa bɔr.

ref: But it was my closest friend, the one I trusted most.
text: Le ni tee ye sin njɔ la, m ni u diir tɔb na, ki ye njɔ bamɔnn na.

ref: We enjoyed being together, when we went with others to your house, our God.
text: M ni uma nan gbaa tibaa aabɔr, ki kpaani ki dooni Uwumbɔr waadichal ni.

ref: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
text: Cha maadim kpo aan baayoonn taa kee fuu; cha bi laa li fu ki sunn buen kitekpiitiŋ ni. Tibir bi bido, ni bisui ni la.

ref: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
text: Le m yin Tidindaan Uwumbɔr ke u ter mi, le u ga gaa mi lii.

ref: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.
text: Maamuk ni maadun chaa u chee kichakpiik ni, ni nwiin pu, ni kinyeek, le u ga ŋun maaneel pu.

ref: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.
text: U ga giin ni mi butɔb bumɔk m ni maadim bi maa nyi bi mɔk na jaa na ni.

ref: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
text: Uwumbɔr u joo binib ki nyan dulnyaa aah piin buyoonn na ga ŋun m pu ki nyaŋ bi, ba pu? bi yii, kaa kpeln baabimbin, kaa san u mu.

ref: My friend turned against me and broke his promise.
text: Maajan aajɔ le tak ujɔtiib, u bii waah puu tipuur ti na a.

ref: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.
text: Waamɔbon nan mɔ ke tisiir na, le uponn ni ma tee to; waamɔbon nan sɔŋni unii aasui ke nkpapem na, le ki tee geei ke kijaak aajuk ki ka na.

ref: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
text: Di saamuk di tii Uwumbɔr, le u ga kiir si, waan cha bi nyaŋ binib bi aabimbin ŋan na.

ref: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
text: Uwumbɔr, sin ma ga joo ni binikurb, ni binyamɔndam ngbaan baakaakul ni aan baamɔfal ligeln nin doo. Mma kan, m ga di naadii tii sin la.

ref: Have pity, God Most High! My enemies chase me all day.
text: Uwumbɔr, san mi kinimbaak, ba pu? binib ban mi ni linimaln la; maadim muk mi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la.

ref: Many of them are pursuing and attacking me,
text: Maadim tak mi kina le nwiin ti lir. Binib bi tak mi na wiir sakpen a.

ref: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
text: Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan, buyoonn ijawaan ti joo mi na le m kpa aa pu gaakii.

ref: I praise your promises! I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
text: M kpa Uwumbɔr pu gaakii le kaa san ijawaan; m pak u waah puu tipuur ti na pu. Unibɔn aan ŋmaa ŋa mi nibaa.

ref: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
text: Maadim ban tibɔr tii mi kina le nwiin ti lir; n‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, bi ban isan le ke bi tii mi titotonn.

ref: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.
text: Bi kuuni tɔb le ki bɔrni ki lik maah ŋani tiwan ni mɔmɔk na, ki mak ke bi ku mi.

ref: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
text: Uwumbɔr, daa bitafal, baatunwanbir pu, nyaŋ binib ngbaan buyoonn saaŋuul fii na.

ref: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.
text: Aa nyi naah muk mi pu na; aa nyi maanyunyunn aakahm, aa ŋmee ti ŋa saagbaŋ ni.

ref: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
text: Bundaal m ti yin si na kan, maadim ga fenn bipuwɔb. M nyi ke Uwumbɔr bi m chee.

ref: I praise your promises!
text: M pak waah puu tipuur ti na,

ref: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
text: m kpa uma pu le gaakii, kaan li san ijawaan, unibɔn aan ŋmaa ŋa mi nibaa.

ref: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
text: Uwumbɔr, maah puu ke m ga tii si pu na, m ga ŋa kina; m ga tii si maadoon aapiin;

ref: You protected me from death and kept me from stumbling, so that I would please you and follow the light that leads to life.
text: ba pu? sin le nyan mi nkun ni, kaa cha maadim nyaŋ mi. Kina pu na, m bi Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni, nwiihn mu wiin binib bi kpa limɔfal na ni la.

ref: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.
text: San mi kinimbaak, Uwumbɔr, san mi kinimbaak; ba pu? m dan aa chee ki ban ŋŋmarm la. Saafeen ponn ni le m kani lifuur ki ti saa buyoonn ŋimuk sakpiin ga ti jer doo na.

ref: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.
text: U ga li bi paacham le ki kii maayim ki gaa mi lii; u ga nyaŋ binib bi muk mi na. Uwumbɔr ga mɔk mi waageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na ki ga ŋa waah puu ke u ga ŋa pu na.

ref: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
text: Maadim mann gonn mi la, bi naahn ichinn i ŋmɔ binib na la. Baanyin naahn tikpaatunn ni ipiin la; le baalambil bi ke kijaak aajum mu ka na.

ref: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
text: Uwumbɔr, mɔk saah pɔɔ sakpen pu na kitaapaak ni, ki mɔk saapak kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk pu.

ref: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.
text: Maadim di kipɔɔk le pen mi ke ki chuu mi; ntaakpayɔl le nyaŋ mi. Bi gbii libuul bil maasan ni, le ki labr lir li ponn ni bibaa.

ref: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.
text: Uwumbɔr, m kpa limakl, m ga gaa ilahn ki pak si.

ref: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.
text: M ga fii sil, m ga moo pel maabar, m ga gaa ilahn lichakpitaawoln.

ref: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear, and I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
text: Uwumbɔr, m ga doon si ŋitimbol ni; m ga pak si binib ni.

ref: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
text: Saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na fuur paacham; le saaŋann taln ti fuu kitaapaak.

ref: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
text: Uwumbɔr, mɔk saah pɔɔ sakpen pu na kitaapaak ni, ki mɔk saapak kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk pu.

ref: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?
text: Nimi bibɔjirb, ni kee jin tibɔr ibamɔn ni ii? Ni ji binib mɔmɔk aabɔr mbamɔm aa?

ref: You have done wrong and lied from the day you were born.
text: Titunwanbirdam tun tiwan ni kaa ŋan na le baamɔfal aayoonn mɔmɔk; bundaal bi ma bi na le bi piin ki geei inyamɔn.

ref: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra
text: Bi kpa liluul ke iwaa na la, le ki ŋeeb bitafal

ref: Make them disappear like leaking water, and make their arrows miss.
text: Cha bi wɔŋ ke nnyun mu bi foor na; cha bi yɔl ke timoor ti dɔ nsan ni na.

ref: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.
text: Cha bi li bi ke naawor mam bi bunn ki kpaln kijɔŋjɔŋ na. Cha bi taa kan nwiin ke ubo u kpo una aaponn ni ki nyan ni na.

ref: Wipe them out quicker than a pot can be heated by setting thorns on fire.
text: Bi ga per bi ke timoor na, aan bi nin bee; Uwumbɔr aaŋuusakpeln ponn ni le u pii bi libuln buen aan bi beenin fu.

ref: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
text: Uwumbɔr yaa daa mbiindam aatafal kan, le ni piir binib bi aabimbin ŋan na aasui, le bi ga lul bibiindam aasin ponn ni ki jer.

ref: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
text: Le binib ga bui ke, “Uwumbɔr sil pa binib bi aabimbin ŋan na tipar;” ki ki len ke, “Uwumbɔr u ji dulnyaa yaab tibɔr na sil bi.”

ref: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.
text: Gaa mi titunwanbirdam chee lii; Chuu gaa mi binikurb chee lii.

ref: Merciless enemies, Lord, are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.
text: Uwumbɔr, lik baah dɔ kii mi pu ke bi ku mi na; bibiindam le bi kuuni ki ban mi. Naa ye ke m tun titunwanbir, bee taani ubaa la,

ref: But they are ready to attack. Do something! Help me! Look at what's happening.
text: kaa ki ye maataani pu le bi san ban bi tak mi.

ref: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
text: Ndindaan Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan, fii sil ki nan ter mi; Israel yaab Aawumbɔr, si aabaa waa. Fii sil ki daa binib bi kaa dii saasan na aatafal. Taa san titunwanbirdam bi fii sil aa pu na kinimbaak.

ref: My enemies return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
text: Kijook kan, le bi gir ni, ki san gbii ŋinyin ke ibɔ na kitiŋ ponn ni.

ref: They curse, and their words cut like swords, as they say to themselves, “No one can hear us!”
text: Li pel baah seei ki faani pu na. Baanyin bi ke kijaak aajum na le bimɔi ni, le ki dak ke ubaa aa pel bi chee la.

ref: You, Lord, laugh at them and sneer at the nations.
text: Uwumbɔr, le sin ma laa bi; aa ŋani binib bi kaa dii saasan na mbɔnyun la.

ref: You are my mighty fortress, and I depend on you.
text: M kpa limakl saapɔɔn pu; Uwumbɔr, sin le ye maabɔbɔryaan.

ref: You love me and will let me see my enemies defeated.
text: Maawumbɔr gee mi, ki ga nan ter mi; u ga cha m kan maadim aah ga lir pu na.

ref: Don't kill them, or everyone may forget! Just use your mighty power to make them tremble and fall. You are a shield for your people.
text: Uwumbɔr, taa ku bi ki cha maanib suln baatafadaan bɔr. Uwumbɔr u kii timi na, di saapɔɔn yaa bi ki nyaŋ bi.

ref: My enemies are liars! So let them be trapped by their boastful lies.
text: Tibɔbir bi bimɔi ni, le baamɔbon mɔmɔk ye tibɔbir la; cha baagaak di bi koon tibɔr ni, Baah puuni ki geei inyamɔn pu na,

ref: Get angry and destroy them. Leave them in ruin. Then all the nations will know that you rule in Israel.
text: kuln bi pel pel saaŋuul ponn ni. Kina kan, unii mɔmɔk ga bee ke Uwumbɔr le joo Israel aanib, ki joo unii mɔmɔk kitiŋ kee pu.

ref: Those liars return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
text: Kijook le maadim gir ni, ki san gbii ŋinyin ke ibɔ na kitiŋ ponn ni;

ref: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
text: bi san kpak ke ibɔ i chuu kpak ban tijikaar na la, i yaa kaa jin bab kan, le i ŋuuni.

ref: But I will sing about your strength, my God, and I will celebrate because of your love. You are my fortress, my place of protection in times of trouble.
text: Le mma ga gaa ilahn ki mɔk saah pɔɔ pu na; saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu, m ga gaa ilahn mpɔɔn pu kichakpiik mɔmɔk ni. Aa chee le m bɔrni, linimaln aayoonn kan, aa chee le m bɔrni.

ref: I will sing your praises! You are my mighty fortress, and you love me.
text: Maakikiir, m ga pak si. Maabɔbɔryaan le ye Uwumbɔr, Uwumbɔr u gee mi na.

ref: You, God, are angry with us! We are rejected and crushed. Make us strong again!
text: Uwumbɔr, aa yii timi, le ki nyaŋ timi; aa nan gee liŋuul ti pu, dandana ma kan, gir gaa timi.

ref: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.
text: Aa cha kitiŋ jii, le ki cha ki gii ki taa nween; dandana ma kan, toor ki, ba pu? ki bi lir la.

ref: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.
text: Aa cha saanib jin falaa sakpen a. Ti chuun gbeer ke taah nyun ndaan le na.

ref: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
text: Aa sak binib bi san si na, aan baadim taa nyaŋ bi.

ref: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
text: Ŋun timi aameel, di saapɔɔn gaa timi lii, aan saah gee binib bi na ŋmar.

ref: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
text: Uwumbɔr bi waadichal li bi chain na ni ki len ke, “M ga di linyaŋ yakr Sekem aatiŋ ki yakr Sukof aafataŋ tii maanib.

ref: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
text: Gilead ni Manase aatim ye min yaan la; Efraim aatiŋ le ye maakur aayikpupuk, le Juda ye maabɔr aajaangbeek.

ref: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
text: Moab aatiŋ le ga li ye maasapeek. M ga di maanaatak di mee paan Edom pu, ki mɔk ke ki ye mbaa aatiŋ la. M nyaŋ Filistia aatiŋ le ki teen mpɔɔn pu.”

ref: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
text: Uwumbɔr, ŋmaa ga di mi buen kitiŋ ki bi maa ŋigon gob ki na ponn ni? Ŋma ga cheen mi Edom aatiŋ ponn ni?

ref: Have you rejected us and deserted our armies?
text: Aa sil yii timi la aa? Saan ki dii timi aajab buen butɔb ni ii?

ref: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
text: Ter timi, timi aadim chee; unibɔn aaterm aa ye nibaa.

ref: You will give us victory and crush our enemies.
text: Uwumbɔr yaa bi ti chee kan, ti ga nyaŋ, u ga nyaŋ timi aadim.

ref: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
text: Uwumbɔr, ŋun maawiil, li pel maameel.

ref: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.
text: Buyoonn maa bi linampal aan nsui bii na, le m yin si. Di mi buen mbɔbɔryaan mu ŋan na chee,

ref: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.
text: ba pu? sin le ye u kii mi na, ki ye u pɔɔ ki kii mi maadim chee na.

ref: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
text: Cha m li bi saadichal ni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk; cha m bɔr aaŋmaŋ ni ki ŋmar.

ref: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa ŋun maah puu tipuur ti na, le ki tii mi binib bi nyuŋni si na aawan.

ref: Let the king have a long and healthy life.
text: Moo di ŋibin kpee ubɔr aamɔfal pu; cha u li bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
text: Uwumbɔr, cha u li bi aanimbiin ni ki joo waanib n‑yoonn mɔmɔk; li joo saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na, ni saaŋann na kii u.

ref: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
text: Le m ga li gaa ilahn ki pak si n‑yoonn mumɔk m tii si maah puu pu iwiin mɔmɔk aatork ni na.

ref: Only God can save me, and I calmly wait for him.
text: M jin limɔr le ki kii Uwumbɔr ke u gaa mi lii; uma baanja pu le m ga ŋmaa nyii ki sil.

ref: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
text: Uma baanja le kii ki gaal mi lir; uma le kii mi, le ubaa aan ŋmaa nyaŋ mi.

ref: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?
text: Ni mɔmɔk ga li tak unii, ni ti yunn kinye? unii u bi ke ligoln li taa taa iween na.

ref: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
text: Ni ban ke ni nyan u waah bi nin chee ki kpa kipak na, le ki jinn u inimɔɔn; ni geei inyamɔn le ni mɔ nimi. Ni len tinyoor aabɔlen la, le nisui ponn ni ma kan, ni puuni lir u pu.

ref: Only God gives inward peace, and I depend on him.
text: Uwumbɔr baanja pu le m nyii ki bi; m kpa u pu limakl.

ref: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
text: Uma baanja le kii mi, ki gaal mi lir; uma le kii mi, le ubaa aan ŋmaa nyaŋ mi.

ref: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
text: Maaŋmarm ni maapak bi Uwumbɔr chee la; u pɔɔ le ki ye u kii mi na; u ye maabɔbɔryaan la.

ref: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
text: Maanib, tii Uwumbɔr naadii n‑yoonn mɔmɔk man. Bui u nimi aamuk mɔmɔk man, ba pu? uma le ye timi aabɔbɔryaan.

ref: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
text: Unibɔn naahn litakpiln libaa aabuln la; binikpaam ni biwaatiib mɔmɔk aa kpa tinyoor. Di bi tɔŋ likakl pu, le aa ga bee ke baa nyuun kpala, libuln nyuun jer bi.

ref: Don't trust in violence or depend on dishonesty or rely on great wealth.
text: Taa tii mbimbinpɔɔl naadii; taa li mak ke nnaayupɔɔn ga tii si tinyoor tibaa; hali saawangol yaa moo kpae kan, taa li ka nyiibaa li pu.

ref: I heard God say two things: “I am powerful,
text: M ŋun ni jer nfum mubaa Uwumbɔr len ke mpɔɔn ye uyaan la,

ref: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
text: ki ki len ke waageehm bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Uwumbɔr, si aabaa le pa unii waatuln aah ŋeer pu na.

ref: You are my God. I worship you. In my heart, I long for you, as I would long for a stream in a scorching desert.
text: Uwumbɔr, sin le ye Maawumbɔr, le m neen si. Nsui, ni nwon mɔmɔk ban si ke kitiŋ ki kuur, ki laa itiween, kaa kpa nnyun na aah ban nnyun pu na la.

ref: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.
text: Cha m kan si saadichal ni, cha m kan saah kpa mpɔɔn, ni kipak pu na.

ref: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
text: Saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na ŋan jer limɔfal, kina pu le m ga pak si.

ref: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
text: M ga bab ke maah jin tijikaar ti ŋan sakpen na le na, le m ga gaa mpopiin aalahn ki pak si.

ref: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
text: M yaa dɔ tiwandookaan pu kan, m teer aabɔr la; kinyeek mɔmɔk kan, m dak sin pu la;

ref: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
text: ba pu? sin le ter mi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Aaŋmaŋ taab le m ga gaa mpopiin aalahn.

ref: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
text: M bub joo si la, le aaŋaal tii mi ŋŋmarm.

ref: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
text: Binib bi ban ke bi ku mi na ga sunn buen kitekpiitiŋ ni.

ref: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
text: Butɔb ponn ni le bi ga ku bi, le takɔ mam ŋmɔ biwon.

ref: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
text: Uwumbɔr aah tii ubɔr linyaŋ pu na, le u ga li mɔɔni. Binib bi puur tipuur Uwumbɔr aayimbil pu na ga pak u, le binyamɔndam ma aamɔi ga ŋmin.

ref: Listen to my concerns, God, and protect me from my enemies' threats.
text: Uwumbɔr, m bi tibɔr ni la, ŋun maameel. M san maadim ijawaan la, gaa maamɔfal lii.

ref: Keep me safe from secret plots of corrupt and evil gangs.
text: Li kiir mi aan bibiindam aah gor kiir mi pu na taa pii mi, nyan mi titunwanbirdam bi wiir na ni.

ref: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
text: Bi luuni baalambil ŋi ka ke kijaak aajum na la, le ki len tibɔbir ti tok kaa yenni ke ipiin na.

ref: They fearlessly ambush and shoot innocent people.
text: Bi mooni baanyamɔn kaa san inimɔɔn kpala; bi joo inyamɔn le kulni bininyaam.

ref: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
text: Bi pɔɔni tɔb aataakpab, baalandak i kaa ŋan na ponn ni, bi kpokl nin chee bi ga pen baagaawɔb mam na la. Bi len le ke, “Ubaa aan kan timi.”

ref: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
text: Bi kpokl ilandak i kaa ŋan na, le ki bui ke, “Ti kpokl titunwanbir aalandak i ŋan sakpen a.” Saan ŋmaa bee unibɔn aasui, ni waalandak aatataa.

ref: But God will shoot his arrows and quickly wound them.
text: Le Uwumbɔr too bi waapiin, libuul ngbaan ni le bi kani titotonn.

ref: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.
text: Baamɔbon ngbaan pu le u ga kuln bi; le binib bimɔk kan bi na ga gbɔk biyil.

ref: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
text: Bi mɔmɔk ga san ijawaan; bi ga li dak Uwumbɔr aah tun pu na le ki tuk binib waabimbin aah bi pu na.

ref: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.
text: Binib bimɔk aabimbin ŋan na ga li mɔɔni Uwumbɔr aah ŋa pu na pu. Bi ga kan u chee ŋŋmarm; bininyaam mɔmɔk ga pak u.

ref: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
text: Uwumbɔr, ni ŋan ke ti pak si Sionn aatiŋ ni, ki li joo taah puu tipuur ti tii si na,

ref: Everyone will come to you because you answer prayer.
text: ba pu? aa keei limeel mɔmɔk.

ref: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.
text: Saah lee binib bi ke bi li koo saadichal ni na kpa mpopiin. Tiwanyaan ni bi saadichal ponn ni, ki ye Lidichal ngbaan aanyoor na ga tii timi mpopiin.

ref: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.
text: Saah tii timi linyaŋ li na le ye ke aa keei timi aayim, le ki tun lijinjiir aawan ki gaal timi lir. Dulnyaa wee mɔmɔk ni aanib, ni binib bi bi nnyusakpem aapuwɔb na tii si naadii.

ref: You are strong, and your mighty power put the mountains in place.
text: Saapɔɔn pu le aa di ŋijoo siin ŋaabuu ni, ki mɔk saapɔɔn sakpiin.

ref: You silence the roaring waves and the noisy shouts of the nations.
text: Aa cha nnyusakpem ŋmini chii; ki cha mu aanyunkpenn ŋmini chii; binib yaa faa kifuuk kan, le aa ŋmin bi chii.

ref: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
text: Saah tun ŋitun sakpiin ŋi na cha dulnyaa mɔmɔk san si la. Saabimbin joo ni mpopiin, le ki nyan ni kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk pu.

ref: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
text: Saah gee kitiŋ pu na, le aa cha utaal nu; aa cha ki nyuun le ki kpa tijikaar. Aa cha nnyun gbiini ikpen; aa tii kitiŋ tijikaar. Saah ŋani ni pu na sɔ:

ref: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
text: Aa cha utaal nu ikpaakon i bi toor bil na ponn ni pam, le i sɔŋ mbamɔm. Aa cha titaapupur sɔŋni kitiŋ, ki cha tijikaar ti laa punn na muuni.

ref: Wherever your footsteps touch the earth, a rich harvest is gathered.
text: Saaŋann tii tinyoor sakpen a. Aa yaa buen nimɔk na kan, nkam le bi.

ref: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
text: Ipiih le gbii nkpaatan aatiŋ ni; tifatann mɔmɔk ni ye njikaabim la. Tiwan mɔmɔk tar le ki gaa mpopiin aalahn.

ref: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
text: Binib mɔmɔk, di mpopiin pak Uwumbɔr mpɔɔn pu man.

ref: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
text: Gaa ilahn ki nyuŋ waayimbil, ki tii u kinyuŋ aapak.

ref: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
text: Bui Uwumbɔr ke, “Saah ŋa tiwan ni na nyaŋ a. Saapɔɔn nyaŋ, le saadim san ijawaan ki gbaani aanimbiin ni.

ref: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
text: Unii umɔk bi kitiŋ kee pu na dooni si la; bi gaa ilahn ki pak si; bi gaa ilahn ki pak saayimbil.”

ref: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
text: Dan ki nan lik man Uwumbɔr aah ŋa waatusakpeln li binib ponn ni na.

ref: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
text: U cha nnyusakpem kpaln kitikuun; tiyaajatiib chuun bitaa pu le ki puur limɔɔl. Nima chee le ti nan mɔɔni waah tun pu na pu.

ref: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
text: U joo waapɔɔn lik binib pu ki cha n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na, ki cha unimbil paa ŋitimbol mɔmɔk pu. Taa cha ubaa nya upuwɔb.

ref: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
text: Ŋitimbol mɔmɔk, pak timi Aawumbɔr man; cha unii mɔmɔk ŋun nimi aapak pu.

ref: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.
text: Uma le cha ti kpa limɔfal kaa cha ti lir.

ref: Our God, you tested us, just as silver is tested.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa tɔŋ timi; baah pu tikunabr mmii ni pu ki nyani tijɔŋ na, kina le aa tɔŋ timi.

ref: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
text: Aa cha ti lir gaawɔb mam ponn ni ki di ŋitun ŋi nyuun na paan ti pu.

ref: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
text: Aa cha timi aadim taa taa ti pu; ti chuun mmii ni nwam ponn ni, le dandana ma aa joo ni timi nan kaan lifuur ponn ni.

ref: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised
text: M ga joo ni kitork ki bi ga di see mmii ni na saadichal ni, m ga tii si maah puu pu na.

ref: I will sacrifice my best sheep and offer bulls and goats on your altar.
text: M ga tii ipiih aan bi di see mmii ni, kitork aabimbiln paab; m ga toor inaaja ni iŋoob aatork, le yaaŋmanyuu fii buen kitaapaak.

ref: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
text: Binib bi mɔmɔk nyuŋ Uwumbɔr na, dan ki nan pel man, aan m bui nimi waah tun pu tii mi na.

ref: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
text: M nan wii ki ban nterm u chee; m di ilahn pak u.

ref: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
text: M yaa nan ba di maatunwanbir bɔr nsui ni kan, Uwumbɔr aa ba ga pel m chee.

ref: But God did listen and answered my prayer.
text: Tɔ, Uwumbɔr tee pel m chee; u pel maameel.

ref: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
text: M pak Uwumbɔr, ba pu? waa yii maameel, kaa munn mi waageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na.

ref: Our God, be kind and bless us! Be pleased and smile.
text: Uwumbɔr, san timi kinimbaak ki ŋa saanyoor ŋa ti pu,

ref: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
text: aan dulnyaa wee mɔmɔk li nyi saah gee timi pu na, aan ŋitimbol mɔmɔk kan saaŋmarm.

ref: Make everyone praise you and shout your praises.
text: Uwumbɔr, cha binib pak si; cha binib mɔmɔk pak si.

ref: Let the nations celebrate with joyful songs, because you judge fairly and guide all nations.
text: Cha ŋitimbol li kpa mpopiin ki gaa mpopiin aalahn; ba pu? aa joo ibamɔn le ji binib tibɔr, le ki mɔk litimbol mɔmɔk kitiŋ kee pu saasan.

ref: Make everyone praise you, God, and shout your praises.
text: Uwumbɔr, cha binib pak si; cha binib mɔmɔk pak si.

ref: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
text: Kitiŋ nyan kaajikaar; Uwumbɔr, timi Aawumbɔr ŋa waanyoor ŋa ti pu.

ref: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
text: Uwumbɔr ŋa waanyoor ŋa ti pu; Cha binib bi bi ni kookoo na nyuŋ u.

ref: Do something, God! Scatter your hateful enemies. Make them turn and run.
text: Uwumbɔr fii sil ki cha waadim yaa tɔb chee. Binib bi kaa gee u na lir le ki san.

ref: Scatter them like smoke! When you come near, make them melt like wax in a fire.
text: Libuln aah daar iŋmanyuu cha pu na, kina le u jenni bi cha; nsiigban aah donni mmii chee pu na, kina le bibiindam kulni Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni.

ref: But let your people be happy and celebrate because of you.
text: Le bininyaam ma kpa mpopiin ki mɔɔni unimbiin ni, bi kpa mpopiin le ki tar mmɔɔn pu.

ref: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord, and we celebrate as we worship you.
text: Gaa ilahn tii Uwumbɔr man, gaa ilahn ki pak waayimbil man; toor nsan tii Uwumbɔr u chuun ntaalangbam pu na man. Waayimbil le ye Uwumbɔr, cha nisui li piin unimbiin ni man.

ref: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.
text: Uwumbɔr u bi waadichal li bi chain na ponn ni na lik nkpobim, le ki kii bikpopiib.

ref: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.
text: U tii binib bi kaa kpa ubaa na nkookoo yaan, le ki nyani biyom kooni mpopiin aafuur ni, le binib bi yii waamɔb na ma ga li bi kitiŋ ki kaa kpa nibaa na ponn ni.

ref: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
text: Uwumbɔr, saah nan cheen saanib buyoonn, ki nan di bi bɔ dii nteersakpiin ni na,

ref: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.
text: kitiŋ nan dam, le utaal nyan ni kitaapaak ki lir ni, ba pu? Uwumbɔr u nan len Sainai Aajool pu na le nan choo, Israel yaab Aawumbɔr le nan choo.

ref: When your land was thirsty, you sent showers to refresh it.
text: Aa nan cha utaasakpiin nun, le saatiŋ ki nan sar na ki gir,

ref: Your people settled there, and you were generous to everyone in need.
text: le saanib maa baadichal nima chee; saaŋann sakpenn pu le aa tii bigiim baah ban pu na.

ref: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
text: Uwumbɔr tii nsan, le bipiib pam moon tibɔr ngbaan ke,

ref: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
text: “Bibɔrb ni baajab san la.” Bipiib bi nan bi linampal na yakr bijab aah jan ki gaa tiwan ni na.

ref: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.”
text: Nima le ye baah di tikunabr naan ŋinanjel ŋi, aan ki di salmaa boon ŋifeen na.

ref: God All-Powerful, you scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.
text: Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan aah nan yaa bibɔrb Salmonn Aajool pu na, u nan cha ŋitaanal lir nima chee.

ref: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
text: Basann aajool ye lijool sakpeln la, lijool li kpa ŋijoomɔju sakpen na.

ref: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
text: Uwumbɔr ga di waataan aatɔroku mam ŋichur ŋichur bi kpa mpɔɔn na nyan ni Sainai aajool ki nan koo ni nin chee bi chain na.

ref: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
text: U joo binaagbiib pam ki chaa paacham; u gaal ipiin binib bi yii waamɔb na chee. Tidindaan Uwumbɔr le ga li bi nima.

ref: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr man, u tu timi aatun iwiin mɔmɔk na; uma le ye Uwumbɔr u gaal timi lir na.

ref: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
text: Uwumbɔr ga sil wii waadim aayil, u ga wii binib bi tun titunwanbir n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na aayil.

ref: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “M ga giin ni nimi aadim ki nya ni Basann; M ga giin nyan ni bi nnyusakpem aataab,

ref: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
text: aan ni lul baasin ponn ni ki jer, aan nimi aabɔ ga ŋmaa lakr yaa gee pu na.”

ref: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.
text: Uwumbɔr, binib mɔmɔk kan saanyaŋ aasachuln, bi kan Uwumbɔr, u ye maabɔr na, aasachuln li u di koo waadichal ponn ni na.

ref: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
text: Bilahngaab le loln nsan, le biwangbaab paa puwɔb, le bisapɔm bi gbaa ŋidabun na bi kaasisik ni.

ref: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
text: “Pak Uwumbɔr, waanib aakuun ni man; Nimi bimɔk ye Jakob aayaabitiib na, pak Uwumbɔr man.”

ref: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
text: Njan, Benjaminn aanibol li par sakpen na le loln nsan, le Juda aayidam ni baanib paan bi pu, le Sebulunn ni Naftali aayidam paan.

ref: Our God, show your strength! Show us once again.
text: Uwumbɔr, mɔk saapɔɔn, mɔk saapɔɔn mu aa di tun timi pu,

ref: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
text: ki nyan Saadichal li bi Jerusalem ponn ni, nin chee bibɔrb joo ni si baapiin na.

ref: Punish that animal that lives in the swamp! Punish that nation whose leaders and people are like wild bulls. Make them come crawling with gifts of silver. Scatter those nations that enjoy making war.
text: Kae kipeewanbiik Ijipt u bi likal ni na; kae ŋitimbol ŋi ye inaaja ni yaanaabi na, ki ti saa buyoonn bi mɔmɔk ga nan gbaan ki tii si tikunabr aapiin na. Yaa binib bi gee butɔb na.

ref: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.
text: Bininkpiib ga nya ni Ijipt ki dan; Kus yaab ga yoor biŋaal paacham ki mee Uwumbɔr.

ref: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
text: Dulnyaa wee ni aanaan, gaa ilahn tii Uwumbɔr man, gaa ilahn ki pak uma Uwumbɔr

ref: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
text: u chuun n‑yaayoonn na aataapaak ni na. Li pel man waah tar mpɔɔn pu pu na.

ref: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
text: Moon Uwumbɔr aah kpa mpɔɔn pu na; waanaan aapɔɔn le joo Israel yaab, waapɔɔn bi kitaapaak ni.

ref: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
text: Uwumbɔr aah nyan waadichal ni ki choo pu na kpa ijawaan la. Uma le ye Israel yaab Aawumbɔr. U tii waanib mpɔɔn ni tiwon aapɔɔn. Pak Uwumbɔr man.

ref: Save me, God! I am about to drown.
text: Uwumbɔr, gaa mi lii. Nnyun ti saa nneen ni mɔk la;

ref: I am sinking deep in the mud, and my feet are slipping. I am about to be swept under by a mighty flood.
text: M bi chɔi tikpakpar ni, nin chee kitiŋ aa bi ntaal ga taa na la; M bi nnyun mu nyoo na ni la, le tinyunkpenn ban ti di mi muin.

ref: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
text: Maah yin si pu ki ban nterm na le nneel ti waab, le nneen ni gur wu. Maah lik pu ki ban saaterm na, le nnimbil aa ti ki waa.

ref: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
text: Binib bi nan mi fam na wiir jer tiyikpir ti bi n‑yil pu na, Maadim mɔni inyamɔn le paani mi, bi kpa mpɔɔn le ki ban bi ku mi. Bi cha m joo tiwan ni maa sun na le giini tii.

ref: You know my foolish sins. Not one is hidden from you.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa waa maatunwanbir; aa nyi maah tun kijɔrk aatuln pu na.

ref: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
text: Sin pu le bi seei mi, le m gur ye unimɔɔnii.

ref: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
text: M gur naahn uchaan le ndo yaab chee, ki naahn uwɔwɔnja nna aabim chee.

ref: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.
text: Maah neen saadichal pu na bi ke mmii le aah wu mponn ni na; ŋisiibil ŋi ye sin yee na choo min chee la.

ref: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
text: M sunn mbaa taab ki lulni bumɔb, le binib seei mi;

ref: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
text: m pee ŋikpokeken, le bi laa mi.

ref: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
text: Bi kaa kitiŋ ponn ni le ki len mi, le bidanyurb naani mi ilahn.

ref: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
text: Uwumbɔr, le m ma ga mee si; Uwumbɔr, kii mi buyoonn aa gee na. Saageehm sakpiin pu, kii maayim, ba pu? aa joo saapuur ti aa puu ke aa ga gaa binib lii na.

ref: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.
text: Nyan mi maah bi chɔi tikpakpar ti ponn ni na; gaa mi maadim chee lii, nyan mi nnyun nyonyoon mue ni.

ref: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
text: Taa cha nwam ngbaan biin m pu; taa cha m sunn buen nnyun nyonyoon ni, ki taa cha m sunn buen likaakul ni.

ref: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
text: Uwumbɔr, saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu, ŋun maayim; di saah san kinimbaak sakpen pu na fenn lik mi.

ref: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
text: Taa di aabaa bɔr saatutunn, m bi tibɔr sakpenn ni la, kii maayim dandana.

ref: Come and save me from my enemies.
text: Dan ki nan gaa mi lii; nyan mi maadim chee.

ref: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
text: Aa nyi baah seei mi pu na, ki nyi baah jinni mi inimɔɔn ki bii mi pu na, aa nyi maadim mɔmɔk.

ref: I am crushed by insults, and I feel sick. I had hoped for mercy and pity, but there was none.
text: Ŋisiibil le bii nsui, le ntaakpab yɔl. M nan mak ke ubaa ga san mi kinimbaak, le ubaa aa gar, m nan mak ke ubaa ga nan sɔŋ nsui, le kaa kan ubaa,

ref: Make their table a trap for them and their friends.
text: Cha baajikaar aajim kpaln baadoon; cha baawaatork kpaln baalirm.

ref: Blind them with darkness and make them tremble.
text: Cha ijoon chuu bi mɔmɔk, cha bipuwɔb taa li pɔɔ.

ref: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
text: Cha saaŋuul lir bi pu; cha saaŋuusakpeln nyaŋ bi.

ref: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
text: Cha baakookoo yaan kpaln tilangbenn, taa cha ubaa gur baadichal ni.

ref: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
text: Bi ŋani saah daa binib bi aatafal na mbiin; le ki joo saah tii binib bi titotonn na aafalaa mooni.

ref: Make them guiltier than ever and don't forgive them.
text: Ŋmee baatunwanbir mɔmɔk bil, taa cha bi kan saaŋmarm siib kina.

ref: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.
text: Ber baayimbil limɔfal aagbaŋ ni; taa cha bi kpaan saanib ni.

ref: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
text: Tɔ, iween ni itaakpayɔl le joo mi; Uwumbɔr, fiin mi siin ki gaa mi lii.

ref: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
text: M ga di nlahn le pak Uwumbɔr; m ga di idoon le moon waah kpa mpɔɔn pu na.

ref: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
text: Nimina le ga mɔɔr Uwumbɔr ki jer inaa aatork, ki jer unaaja u filk na aatork.

ref: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
text: Binib bi bi limukl ni na yaa kan kina kan, bisui ga piir; le binib bi dooni Uwumbɔr na aataakpab ga pɔɔk.

ref: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
text: Uwumbɔr ŋun binib bi kaa kpa na aayim, kaa suln waanib bi bi kiyondiik ni na aabɔr.

ref: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
text: Paacham ni kitiŋ, pak Uwumbɔr man, nnyusakpem ni tiwanfuurkaan nimɔk bi mu ni na mu pak u.

ref: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
text: U ga gaa Jerusalem lii ki gir maa Juda aatim. Waanib le ga li koo nima ki li yeh kitiŋ ngbaan;

ref: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
text: le waatutunn aayaabitiib nan ji kaafaal, le binib bi gee u na li koo nima.

ref: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
text: Uwumbɔr, gaa mi lii, ter mi dandana wee.

ref: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
text: Cha binib bi ban ke bi ku mi na aalan ŋmal aan bi lir. Cha binib bi aasui piin maafalaa pu na di inimɔɔn gir bipuwɔb.

ref: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
text: Cha binib bi laa mi na aataakpab yɔl aan bi lir.

ref: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
text: Cha binib bi choo aa chee na li kpa mpopiin ni mmɔɔn. Cha binib bi dooni si saah gaa bi lii pu na li len n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ke, “Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn nyaŋ sakpen a.”

ref: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
text: Nwon yɔl, le maa kpa nterm mubaa; Uwumbɔr, dan m chee dandana. Uwumbɔr, sin le ye u gaal mi lir na, san mala ki nan ter mi.

ref: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
text: Uwumbɔr, gaa mi lii, ter mi dandana wee.

ref: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
text: Cha binib bi ban ke bi ku mi na aalan ŋmal aan bi lir. Cha binib bi aasui piin maafalaa pu na di inimɔɔn gir bipuwɔb.

ref: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
text: Cha binib bi laa mi na aataakpab yɔl aan bi lir.

ref: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
text: Cha binib bi choo aa chee na li kpa mpopiin ni mmɔɔn. Cha binib bi dooni si saah gaa bi lii pu na li len n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ke, “Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn nyaŋ sakpen a.”

ref: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
text: Nwon yɔl, le maa kpa nterm mubaa; Uwumbɔr, dan m chee dandana. Uwumbɔr, sin le ye u gaal mi lir na, san mala ki nan ter mi.

ref: I run to you, Lord, for protection. Don't disappoint me.
text: Uwumbɔr, m dan aa chee ki ban nkiirm la, taa cha ubaa nyaŋ mi kpala.

ref: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
text: Saabimbinyaan pu, ter mi ki gaa mi lii. Pel m chee ki ter mi.

ref: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
text: Li ye maakikiir u m mak u pu na, ki li bi ke kitiŋ ki bi maa ŋigon gob ki na, ki li kii mi; sin chee le m ga ŋmaa bɔr aan aa li kii mi.

ref: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
text: Maawumbɔr, gaa mi bibiindam chee lii, nyan mi bibiindam ni titunwanbirdam aapɔɔn ni.

ref: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
text: Uwumbɔr, sin pu le m kpa limakl; maah nan laa ye ubo pu na, le m nan di naadii tii si.

ref: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
text: Sin pu le m nyii maamɔfal mɔmɔk ni; baah ma mi bundaal na, le aa piin ki kii mi. M ga pak si n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
text: Maamɔfal ye limɔkl le ki tii binib pam; ba pu? sin le ye maakikiir u pɔɔ na.

ref: and I praise and honor you all day long.
text: M pak si ni nwiin aah ga ti lir pu na, ki mooni saapak aah bi pu na.

ref: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
text: N‑yoonn mu m por na, taa yii mi; taa yii mi n‑yoonn mu maa ki kpa mpɔɔn na.

ref: My enemies are plotting because they want me dead.
text: Maadim ban bi ku mi la; bi len le ki kpokl m pu.

ref: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
text: Bi len le ke, “Uwumbɔr siir cha u a; cha ti li dii u man ki ti chuu u, ubaa aa bi ki ga gaa u lii.”

ref: Come closer, God! Please hurry and help.
text: Uwumbɔr, taa li daa m chee; Maawumbɔr, ŋa mala ki nan ter mi.

ref: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
text: Cha binib bi tak mi na lir ki kuln pel pel. Cha binib bi pɔɔni bibaa ke bi tii mi iween na ji inimɔɔn.

ref: I will never give up hope or stop praising you.
text: Sin pu le m ga li kpa limakl n‑yoonn mɔmɔk; m ga pak si, ki moo pak si.

ref: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
text: M ga bui binib saah kpa tiŋann pu na; m ga li len saah gaal binib lir pu na ki ti saa nwiin aah ga lir pu na, tɔ, ni mu tee jer maah ga ŋmaa bee pu na.

ref: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
text: Ndindaan Uwumbɔr, m ga pak saapɔɔn; m ga moon sin baanja aaŋann le pu.

ref: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
text: Maah nan laa ye ubo pu na, le aa mɔk mi saatun, le m beenin len saatun sakpiin ŋi aa tun na.

ref: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.
text: Uwumbɔr, n‑yoonn mu m por aan n‑yil bi piir na, taa siir cha mi. Li bi m chee aan m moon saapɔɔn aah nyaŋ pu na tii n‑yoonn mu choo na aanib mɔmɔk.

ref: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
text: Uwumbɔr, saabimbinyaan fuur kitaapaak, aa tun ŋitun ŋi nyaŋ na, ubaa aa bi ke si na.

ref: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
text: Aa cha tibɔbir ni falaa dan m pu, le aa ga ki giin ni maapɔɔn, saan cha m kpo.

ref: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
text: Aa ga moo tii mi mpɔɔn ki jer njan na; aa ga ki sɔŋ nsui.

ref: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
text: M ga sil di kibeek gaa ilahn ki pak si. Maawumbɔr, m ga pak si saaŋann sakpenn pu. M ga di maabeek tii sin u ye Israel yaab Aawumbɔr u bi chain na kipak.

ref: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
text: Buyoonn m bi gbaa kibeek pak si na, le m ga li tar mpopiin pu; saah gaa mi lii pu na, le m ga li pak si.

ref: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
text: M ga li len binib chee saah kpa tiŋann sakpen pu na, ki ti saa nwiin aah ga lir pu na; ba pu? binib bi pɔɔn bibaa ke bi tii mi titotonn na lir, le ki jin inimɔɔn.

ref: Let peace and justice rule every mountain and hill.
text: Cha nwankam ni tiŋann li bi kitiŋ ngbaan pu;

ref: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.
text: Cha ubɔr ji bigiim aabɔr mbamɔm, ki ter binib bi kaa kpa na, ki nyaŋ binib bi muk bi na.

ref: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.
text: Cha ubɔr li bi ke utaal aah nu ikpaakon i pu na, ki naahn titaapupur aah pui kitiŋ pu pu na.

ref: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
text: Cha tiŋann li bi waayoonn, ki cha nwankam li bi ki yunn ke uŋmal aah ga yunn pu na.

ref: Let his kingdom reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River across all the earth.
text: Waanaan ga taln ti saa ni mɔmɔk, ki nya Yufrates aamɔɔl ni ki ti saa kitiŋ aanaanmɔk.

ref: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
text: Nteersakpiin pu aanib ga gbaan unimbiin ni; waadim ga tar lir kitiŋ, unimbiin ni.

ref: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
text: Speenn aatiŋ, ni ŋidik pu aabɔrb ga tii u ipiin; Arabia ni Itiopia aatim aabɔrb ga joo ni ipiin.

ref: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
text: Bibɔrb mɔmɔk ga gbaan unimbiin ni; ŋitimbol mɔmɔk ga li dii uma la.

ref: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
text: Bigiim bi wii yin u na, u gaal bi lir, ki ter binib bi kaa kpa aan binib yii bi na.

ref: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
text: U san bigiim ni binib bi kaa kpa mpɔɔn na kinimbaak; u gaal binib bi kaa kpa na aamɔfal lir.

ref: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
text: U nyani bi ŋimuk ni mbimbin mu pɔɔ na ni; baamɔfal ye liwangol le u chee.

ref: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
text: Uwumbɔr tii ubɔr limɔfal li fɔk na. Cha Arabia yaab tii u salmaa; cha bi mee limeel tii u n‑yoonn mɔmɔk; cha Uwumbɔr aanyoor li bi u pu n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.
text: Cha tijikaar li bi waatiŋ pu; cha tijikaar li bi ŋigongon pu, ke Lebanonn aagongon pu na. Cha binib li gbii ntim ponn ni, ke timoor aah gbii ikpaakon ni pu na.

ref: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
text: Taa cha ubɔr aayimbil kuln; cha waayimbil yunn ke nwiin aah ga yunn pu na. Cha bi mee Uwumbɔr aan u ŋa tinyoor ŋa bi pu ke waah ŋa tinyoor ŋa ubɔr pu pu na.

ref: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr u ye timi Israel yaab Aadindaan na. Uma baanja le tun ŋitusakpiin ngbaan.

ref: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
text: Li pak waayimbil li kpa kipak na n‑yoonn mɔmɔk man. Cha waapak gbii dulnyaa wee mɔmɔk. Amii, amii.

ref: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
text: Jese aajapɔɔn David aameel mɔmɔk le na. TAATAA AAGBAŊ (Ilahn

ref: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
text: Uwumbɔr sil kpa Israel yaab pu tiŋann, u kpa binib bi aasui ponn ni ŋan na pu tiŋann.

ref: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
text: Maah kan ke bibiindam aatuln mɔmɔk kpa tinyoor na, le m nan kpa bigaadam pu lipiipoln.

ref: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
text: Baa ji iween aafalaa; bi pɔɔ le ki kpa laafee.

ref: and they don't have troubles like everyone else.
text: Baa ji falaa ke binib biken na; baa kani tibɔbir ti biken kani na.

ref: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.
text: Kina pu le bi di kigaak ŋa nneeleen ki di peen, ki di mbimbinpɔɔl ŋa tiwanpeenkaan;

ref: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
text: tibɔbir le nyani bisui ni, le baalandak ye mbiin aalandak ŋmeen la.

ref: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
text: Bi laa binib biken, le ki len tibɔbir; bi kpa kigaak, le ki kpokl ke bi muk biken.

ref: They dare to speak against God and to order others around.
text: Bi len Uwumbɔr u bi paacham na tibɔbir, le ki tii binib bi bi kitiŋ pu na kigaak aatun,

ref: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
text: ki cha Uwumbɔr aanib fenn buen bi chee, ki ti kpaan kii baah len pu na mala.

ref: Only evil people would say, “God Most High cannot know everything!”
text: Bi len le ke, “Uwumbɔr aan li nyi; Mpɔɔndaan u bi paacham na aan bee.”

ref: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
text: Bibiindam bi kina la. Bi kpa sakpen, le ki moo kani n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
text: Maah cha maabimbin ŋan aan maa tun titunwanbir na ye fam la aa?

ref: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa cha m jin falaa le nwiin ti lir; aa dar ntafal kichakpiik mɔmɔk ni.

ref: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
text: M yaa len kina aabɔr kan, maa ba ga li tun ke saanib ponn ni ubaa na.

ref: It was hard for me to understand all this!
text: M pɔɔn mbaa ke m dakl lik tibɔr ngbaan ponn ni, le ti pɔɔ ti nyaŋ mi.

ref: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
text: Le m ti baan di ti buen Saadichal ni. Nima chee le m bee tiwan ni ga ŋa bibiindam na.

ref: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.
text: Aa ga di bi siin nin chee ŋar na, ki cha bi lir ki kuln kookoo.

ref: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
text: Libuul ngbaan ni le bi kuln, baah ga ti doo pu na ga li kpa ijawaan.

ref: Once I was bitter and brokenhearted.
text: Buyoonn maalandak nan bii nsui aan mmɔb ponn ni choŋ na,

ref: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
text: m nan jɔr ke kiwakork na la; maa nan kee bee saabimbin.

ref: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
text: Tɔ, m mu nan beenin bi gbɔk si, le aa di aaŋaal chuu mi.

ref: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
text: Aa di saamɔkm le mɔk mi nsan, le nimina aadoon na, aa ga nan di kinyuŋ le gaa mi.

ref: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
text: M ki kpa ba paacham kaa ye sin? Maah kpa sin na, maa ki ban nibaa kitiŋ do.

ref: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.
text: Nibaakan, maalandak ni nwon ga yɔl, le Uwumbɔr ma ye maapɔɔn; uma le ye tiwan ni m ban n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na.

ref: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
text: Binib bi yii si na ga sil kuln; aa ga doo binib bi nyan aapuwɔb na.

ref: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
text: Mma chee kan, ni ŋan ki ti nyaŋ ke m li duun Uwumbɔr; ni ŋan ti nyaŋ ke m kan Ndindaan Uwumbɔr chee nkiirm, ki moon waah ŋa pu na mɔmɔk.

ref: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
text: Uwumbɔr, ba ŋa aa san cha mi kina? Aa gee aabaa aanib pu liŋuul li kaa kpa ndoon na la aa?

ref: Remember the people you rescued long ago, the tribe you chose for your very own. Think of Mount Zion, your home;
text: Teer saanib bi aa nan lee bi n‑yoonn mu jer na pu, saanib bi aa nan nyan ni bi tinaagbiir ni ke bi nan li ye saanibol na. Teer Lijool Sionn, nin chee aa nan koo na bɔr.

ref: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.
text: Chuun baah ber ntim mu kookoo na pu; timi aadim bii doo tiwan ni mɔmɔk bi Saadichal ni na.
