ref: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
text: Saadim teen mpɔɔn pu Saadichal ni, baah kan linyaŋ pu na pu; bi di baatuutaa mam ŋum nima chee ke ni li ye limɔkl ki tii baanyaŋ ngbaan.

ref: It looks like a forest chopped to pieces.
text: Bi naahn bijab bi gaar isui na la li ki joo baachɔm gaar isui lir.

ref: They used axes and hatchets to smash the carvings.
text: Bi di baachɔm ni ligagaar fɔfɔk gbaa wiir baah di idɔ ŋa Saadichal aawan mɔmɔk ni na.

ref: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
text: Bi nan ban ke bi wɔi timi kookoo la; bi see nin chee mɔk bi chain kitiŋ kee pu na mmii.

ref: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
text: Timi aawan nimɔk ye kitork aawan na buen a; saabɔnabtiib aa ki gur, le ubaa aa nyi nimina aah ga yunn ki ti saa pu na.

ref: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?
text: Uwumbɔr, timi aadim ga laa si ki saa bayoonn? Bi ga li seei si ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na la aa?

ref: Why don't you punish them? Why are you holding back?
text: Ba ŋa aa yii kaa ter timi? Ba ŋa aa di aaŋaal bɔɔb aabaa ki si?

ref: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
text: Uwumbɔr, mpiin na, sin le nan ye timi aabɔr; n‑yoonn, n‑yoonn pam le aa gaa timi lii.

ref: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
text: Aa di saapɔɔn sakpiin le di yakr nnyusakpem, le ki wii nnyusakpem ponn ni aapeewanbiik aayil,

ref: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
text: aa wii nnyusakpem ponn ni aapɔɔndaan aayil, ki cha nteersakpiin ponn ni aapeel ŋman waawon.

ref: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
text: Aa cha uyayak aanyunbun puu; aa cha ŋimɔɔ ŋi wiir na foor ki kuur.

ref: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
text: Aa naan nwiin pu ni kinyeek; ki mɔk nwiin ni uŋmal naakakaa chee;

ref: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
text: aa mɔk kitiŋ kaanaanmɔk; aa ŋa kitotoŋ ni tiwoor aayoonn.

ref: Remember your enemies, Lord! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.
text: Uwumbɔr, teer ke saadim laa si, li nyi ke baa dii si, le ki lik si fam.

ref: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
text: Taa di saanib bi kaa kpa uteter na tii baadim bi ye bibiindam na; taa suln saanib bi bi ban bi ku bi na bɔr.

ref: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
text: Teer saah nan puu tipuur ti tii timi na bɔr. Mbimbin mu pɔɔ na bi kitiŋ kee pu ŋipepel mɔmɔk pu la.

ref: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
text: Taa cha baah muk binib bi na ji inimɔɔn; cha bigiim ni binib bi kaa kpa na pak si.

ref: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
text: Uwumbɔr, fii sil ki len saabɔr. Teer ke binib bi kaa dii si na laa si le nwiin ti lir.

ref: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.
text: Uwumbɔr, ti dooni si, ti dooni si. Ti mooni saah kpa mpɔɔn sakpen pu na, ki tuk binib saah tun ŋitusakpiin ŋi na aabɔr.

ref: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
text: Tɔ, tiwanfuurkaan mɔmɔk aawon yaa gbaa, aan kitiŋ kibaa mu jii kan, m ga cha kaatinyik li pɔɔ kin kin.

ref: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
text: M ga bui bibiindam ke bi taa li kpa kigaak;

ref: Stop bragging! Quit telling me how great you are.”
text: M ga bui bi ke bi di cha kipupuk.

ref: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
text: Libɔjil aa nyani liwipuul, kaa nyani liwilir, kaa nyani ŋŋangan, kaa nyani ŋŋangii wɔb;

ref: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
text: Uwumbɔr le ji tibɔr, u bii bibaa aabɔr, le ki bui biken ke baabɔr ŋan.

ref: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.
text: Uwumbɔr joo kiyikuuk uŋaal ni, kiyikuuk ngbaan gbii ndapɔɔl mu ye waaŋuul na la. U bar mu, le bibiindam mɔmɔk nyun mu; bi nyun mu mɔmɔk pel pel.

ref: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
text: Le mma ga li beenin len Uwumbɔr u Jakob mu nan dii u na aabɔr, ki ga li gaa ilahn ki pak u.

ref: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
text: U ga wii bibiindam aapɔɔn, le ki tee moo kpee binib bi aabimbin ŋan na mpɔɔn.

ref: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
text: Juda aatiŋ yaab mɔmɔk nyi Uwumbɔr bɔr; Israel yaab nyuŋni waayimbil.

ref: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
text: Udo le ye Jerusalem; u koo Sionn Aajool paab la.

ref: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.
text: Nima chee le u kool waadim aapiin, u kool baajaak aapen ni njum; mbamɔn, u kool baajawan mɔmɔk.

ref: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.
text: Baajab bi nan kaar na nan lann baawan mɔmɔk ki gur dɔ geen ntekpiigeen; baapɔɔn ni baalan mɔmɔk nan ye fam la.

ref: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
text: Uwumbɔr u tiyaaja Jakob mu nan dii u na, saah nan faan bi buyoonn na, baataan ni binib bi dik i pu na nan lir ki kpoi.

ref: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
text: Uwumbɔr, binib mɔmɔk san si ijawaan la. Buyoonn saaŋuul ti fii na kan, ubaa aan ki ŋmaa sil aanimbiin ni.

ref: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent
text: Aa bi paacham le ki cha binib mɔmɔk bee ke aa ga ji bi tibɔr le ijawaan nan chuu dulnyaa wee mɔmɔk,

ref: when you took over as judge, ready to rescue everyone in need.
text: n‑yoonn mu aa fii sil ke aa ji tibɔr ki gaa baah muk binib bi na lii na, le ni ŋmin chii.

ref: Even the most angry people will praise you when you are furious.
text: Unibɔn aaŋuul moo joo ni kipak le nan tii si, binib bi ŋmar butɔb ni na ga li ji saajim.

ref: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
text: Tiin Uwumbɔr naah puu ke ni ga tii u pu na; ŋitimbol ŋi mɔmɔk bi ki duun na, li joo ni ipiin nan tii u man. Uwumbɔr cha unibɔn san u ijawaan;

ref: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
text: u sunn biyidam bi kpa kigaak na taab ki cha bibɔrkpaam san u ijawaan sakpen.

ref: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
text: M wii mpɔɔn pu ki yin Uwumbɔr, m wii mpɔɔn pu, le u ŋun maawiil pu.

ref: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
text: Limukl yoonn le m mee Uwumbɔr. Kinyeek ni kitaak aawoln pu, m yoor ŋŋaal paacham le ki mee u, le kaa tee kani nsuudoon.

ref: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
text: U cha m dɔ waa le kitaak ti woln; ni muk mi sakpen, le maa ti ki ŋmaa len tibɔr.

ref: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
text: M dakl lik iwiin i jer na; le ki teer ŋibin ŋi jer n‑yaayoonn na.

ref: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
text: “Uwumbɔr ga li yiil timi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la aa? Waan ki li kpa mpopiin ti pu uu?

ref: Is this the end of your love and your promises?
text: U di cha kaa ki tii timi ngeehm la aa? Waah puu tipuur ti na aa ki si la aa?

ref: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
text: Uwumbɔr suln kaa ki san kinimbaak la aa? Liŋuul le gaa kinimbaak aabuul ni ii?”

ref: Then I said, “God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.”
text: Le m bui ke, “Tiwan ni wu mi sakpen na le ye nimina; ke Uwumbɔr u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na aa ki ter timi ke waah nan ter timi n‑yoonn mu jer na.”

ref: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
text: Uwumbɔr, m ga teer saah tun ŋitukpaan ŋi na bɔr; m ga teer ŋitukpaan ŋi aa tun n‑yoonn mu jer na bɔr.

ref: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
text: Uwumbɔr, saah ŋa tiwan ni mɔmɔk na bi chain la, liwaal libaa aa bi ki kpa mpɔɔn ke sin na.

ref: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
text: Sin le ye Uwumbɔr u tun iwaan aatun na; aa mɔk ŋitimbol saapɔɔn sakpiin.

ref: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
text: Aa di saapɔɔn gaa Jakob ni Josef aayaabitiib bi ye saanib na lii.

ref: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
text: Uwumbɔr, nnyun aah kan si na, le ijawaan chuu mu, le nnyusakpem aataab deŋni,

ref: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
text: le ntaalangbam bar nnyun kpir ni, le utaal nyan kitaapaak ki teen ni, le utaal moor ni kookoo lak lak.

ref: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
text: Utaal aah tar pu na buen ni kookoo a, le utaal aah moor pu na cha dulnyaa mɔmɔk woln chain; le kitiŋ dam ki jii.

ref: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
text: Aa chuun tinyunkpenn ni ki jer; aa lul nnyusakpem mu nyoo na ni ki puur, le ubaa aa kan saataabuu.

ref: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
text: Aa loln saanib pu nsan ke upihdaan na, ki cha Moses ni Aaronn joo bi.

ref: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.
text: Maanib, li pel maamɔkm man, ki pel maah ban m len pu na mbamɔm.

ref: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
text: M ban m di nlan aabɔr le len ki kpiir tuk nimi n‑yaayoonn na aabɔbɔrkaan,

ref: These are things we learned from our ancestors,
text: tibɔr ti ti ŋun ki nyi ti na, tibɔr ti tiyaajatiib tuk timi na.

ref: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord.
text: Ti ga cha timi aabilb li nyi ti. Ti ga bui tiyaabitiib Uwumbɔr aah kpa mpɔɔn ki tun liyimbil aatun ŋi na, ni iwaan aatun ŋi u tun na.

ref: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
text: U tii Jakob aayaabitiib, Israel yaab, ŋikoobil ni ikaal. U nan bui tiyaajatiib tibɔr ke bi mɔk baabilb waakaal,

ref: so that each new generation would know his Law and tell it to the next.
text: aan biyaabitiib mu ga nan ŋmaa bee i ki mu nan di i mɔk baabilb.

ref: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
text: Efraim yaab nan joo itɔi ni ipiin, le ki nan tee san butɔb daal.

ref: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
text: Baa nan joo tipuur ti bi nan puu tii Uwumbɔr na; bi yii, kaa joo waakaal.

ref: They forgot all he had done, even the mighty miracles
text: Bi suln waah tun pu na, iwaan aatun ŋi u nan tun aan bi kan na, bi suln ŋibɔr.

ref: he did for their ancestors near Zoan in Egypt.
text: Biyaajatiib nan si lik, le Uwumbɔr tun iwaan aatun Soann aapaan mu bi Ijipt aatiŋ ni na.

ref: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.
text: U nan yakr nnyusakpem nfum mulee pu, ki di bi dii mu ni jer; u nan cha nnyun fii sil ke ŋigon na.

ref: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
text: Nwiin pu kan, u nan loln bi pu nsan, ntaalangbam ponn ni la, le ki ye mmii ki wiin ki loln bi pu nsan kinyeek, ni kitaak aah ga ti woln pu na.

ref: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
text: U bɔɔl ŋitakpal nteersakpiin ni, ki cha nnyun nyan ni nin chee nyoo na ki tii bi, bi nyun.

ref: He made streams gush out like rivers from rocks.
text: U cha nkpen puu nyan ni litakpal ni, ki cha nnyun puu ke limɔɔl na,

ref: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.
text: le bi yii, ki beenin tun Uwumbɔr titunwanbir, le ki yii uma Uwumbɔr u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na aamɔb, nteersakpiin ngbaan ni.

ref: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
text: Bi nyi le ki tɔŋ Uwumbɔr ki bui ke u tii bi tijikaar ti bi ban na.

ref: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
text: Bi nan len Uwumbɔr le ki bui ke, “Uwumbɔr ga ŋmaa tii timi tijikaar nteersakpiin ni ii?

ref: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
text: Ni ye mbamɔn ke u faa litakpal, le nnyun puu nyan ni ke nwam na; tɔ, u ga ŋmaa tii timi tijikaar aa? u ga ŋmaa tii timi waanib tinann mu uu?”

ref: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.
text: Uwumbɔr aah ŋun waanib len kina na, le waaŋuul fii, le u di mmii tak bi, le waaŋuul moo fii bi pu,

ref: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
text: ba pu? baa nan gaa Uwumbɔr ki kii kaa tii naadii ke u ga ŋmaa gaa bi lii.

ref: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
text: Le u len kitaapaak chee tibɔr ki bui ke kaabisamɔi chuu piir;

ref: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
text: Kina pu le bi nan jin Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib aajikaar, le Uwumbɔr tii bi baah ban pu na mɔmɔk.

ref: God's mighty power sent a strong wind from the southeast,
text: U nan ki cha liwipuul wɔb aabuln daa, ki cha waapɔɔn fiin ŋŋangii wɔb aabuln,

ref: and it brought birds that covered the ground, like sand on the beach.
text: ki cha inyoon lir ni kitiŋ ki wiir ke limɔɔtambol na, le waanib chur i;

ref: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
text: i nan lir baakakaa chee, baah doo nin chee na.

ref: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.
text: Le binib ngbaan nan jin ki ŋman ki bab; Uwumbɔr nan tii bi baah ban pu na.

ref: But before they had swallowed the last bite,
text: Tɔ, baakpeek aa nan kee doo; bi nan beenin ji,

ref: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
text: le Uwumbɔr aaŋuul nan fii bi pu, le u ku baajab bi pɔɔ sakpen ki ye Israel yaab aanachipɔm na.

ref: But the rest kept on sinning and would not trust God's miracles.
text: Nimina mɔmɔk aapuwɔb, binib ngbaan nan beenin tun titunwanbir; Waajinjiir aatun na mɔmɔk aapuwɔb na baa nan beenin tii u naadii.

ref: So he cut their lives short and made them terrified.
text: Le u kuln baawiin ke kifuurk kibaa na, ki di tibɔbir kuln baamɔfal.

ref: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
text: Buyoonn u ti ku bi ponn bibaa na, le bi gur na tee fenn gir ni u chee, ki yii titunwanbir ki di bisui mɔmɔk mee u.

ref: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
text: Bi nan teer ke Uwumbɔr le ye baakikiir, ki teer ke uma Uwumbɔr u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na le ter bi.

ref: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
text: Tɔ, baamɔbon tee ye inyamɔn la; baabɔr mɔmɔk aa gbiini.

ref: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
text: Le Uwumbɔr ma nan san waanib kinimbaak. U nan di cha pinn bi baatunwanbir kaa kuln bi. N‑yoonn n‑yoonn pam le waa di waaŋuul tun lituln, ki chuu waaŋuusakpeln.

ref: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
text: U nan teer ke bi ye binibɔm la, ki naahn libuln li daar jer cha na la.

ref: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.
text: N‑yoonn mɔmɔk ni, bi nan yiil waamɔb nteersakpiin ni la; N‑yoonn mɔmɔk bi nan bii usui la.

ref: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
text: Bi tɔŋni Uwumbɔr, ki ki gir tɔŋni u, ki cha uma Israel yaab Aawumbɔr u bi chain na aasui bii.

ref: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
text: Bi suln waapɔɔnsakpiin bɔr, ni nwiin mundaal u nan gaa bi baadim chee lii na,

ref: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
text: ni bundaal u nan tun waatukpaan Soann aapaan mu bi Ijipt aatiŋ ni na bɔr.

ref: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
text: U nan cha ŋimɔɔ kpaln nsin, le Ijipt yaab aa nan ki kpa nnyun bi nyu.

ref: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
text: U nan tun ni tisibir nan lii bi pu, le ti muk bi, ni ŋipulaatal ŋi bii baatiŋ na.

ref: God let worms and grasshoppers eat their crops.
text: U cha itoon dan nan di baajikaar ŋman ki bii baakpaakon doo.

ref: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
text: U cha ŋitaatakpal lir ki kool baadaan aasubil, ni baasubil ŋiken aasui.

ref: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
text: U cha ŋitaatakpal le ku baanaa ki cha utaal aah moor pu na ku tiwakor ti gur na.

ref: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
text: Waaŋuusakpeln ponn ni le u nan cha nkun aatuuntiib dan ki nan bii bi pam.

ref: God released his anger and slaughtered them in a terrible way.
text: Waa ki chuu waaŋuul, kaa di cha baamɔfal; u cha iween ku bi.

ref: He killed the first-born son of each Egyptian family.
text: U nan ku bima Ijipt yaab aadichadaan mɔk aajan aabijabim,

ref: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
text: le ki nin cheen waanib nyan ke upihdaan na, ki mɔk bi nsan, nteersakpiin ni.

ref: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
text: U nan cheen bi mbamɔm, le ijawaan aa nan joo bi; u cha nnyusakpem nan biin baadim pu, ki di bi buen.

ref: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
text: U nan di bi nan fuu waatiŋ ki bi chain na pu, u di bi nan fuu ŋijoo ŋi pu uma ubaa nan jan ki gaa ŋi na.

ref: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
text: Waanib aah tur koo ni pu na le u jenn ntim ngbaan aanib le ki yakr baatim tii Israel aanibol ki di bido tii waanib ngbaan.

ref: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
text: Le bi tee nyan Uwumbɔr u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na aapuwɔb, ki tɔŋ u; baa nan joo waakaal;

ref: They were as unfaithful as their ancestors, and they were as crooked as a twisted arrow.
text: bi tee nyan upuwɔb kaa dii waah len pu na ke biyaajatiib na, kaa si chob ke mpiin mu gɔr na.

ref: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
text: Bi nan cha waaŋuul fii baah dooni ŋiwaa nin chee na pu, ki cha usui fii baawaa ngbaan pu.

ref: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
text: Uwumbɔr aah kan kina na, le waaŋuul fii, le u yii waanib kookoo.

ref: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
text: U nan nyan cha Waabool li nan bi Silo aatiŋ ni ki nan ye Waadichal li ponn ni u nan koo tikaasisik ni na.

ref: He let enemies capture the sacred chest and let them dishonor him.
text: U nan cha timi aadim nyaŋ timi ki gaa Nkaal Aadakaa u ye waapɔɔn ni kipak aamɔkl na.

ref: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
text: Waaŋuul nan fii waanib pu pam, le u cha baadim ku bi.

ref: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
text: Binachipɔm nan kpoi butɔb ni le bipiisapɔm aa ki kan ubaa bi mɔn.

ref: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
text: Bitotoorb nan kpoi mpɔɔkun la, le baakpopiib aa nan kpa nsan ke bi wii baakpuu.

ref: Finally the Lord woke up, like a soldier startled from a drunken sleep.
text: Nee aapuwɔb le Uwumbɔr nan fii ke waah finn ngeen pu le na; u nan bi ke unachipɔɔn u nyun ndaan aan ni mɔɔr u na.

ref: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
text: U nan jenn waadim giin inimɔɔn aalirm mu kaa kpa ndoon na ni.

ref: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
text: U nan tee yii Josef aayaabitiib; waa nan lee Efraim aanibol.

ref: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
text: U nan tee lee Juda aanibol, ni Sionn Aajool li u gee mbamɔm na la.

ref: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
text: Nima chee le u maa Waadichal ke udo ni bi paacham na; u nan cha li nyal sil ke kitiŋ kibaa aah si chob pu aan nibaa aa ŋmaa ŋa ki, ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na la.

ref: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
text: U nan lee waatutunn David la. U nan ti nyan ni u kinaakpaamook ni,

ref: and from caring for lambs. Then God made him the leader of Israel, his own nation.
text: nin chee u bi kpaa waapiih na, le ki di u ŋa Israel yaab aabɔr, Uwumbɔr aanib aapihdaan.

ref: David treated the people fairly and guided them with wisdom.
text: David nan di lineen le ki joo bi, ki loln bi pu nsan, ki nan kpa nlan.

ref: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.
text: Uwumbɔr, binib bi kaa nyi si na koo ni saatiŋ ni. Bi bii Saadichal li bi chain na, le ki cha Jerusalem gur ye tilangbenn.

ref: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
text: Bi cha nangba mam gbaa saanib aawon, ipeel le ŋman saatutum aanann.

ref: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
text: Bi cha saanib aasin nyan ke nnyun na; nsin nan puu ni kookoo Jerusalem ponn ni ke nnyun na la, le unii aa nan gur ke u sub ŋinikpol.

ref: Our Lord, will you keep on being angry? Will your angry feelings keep flaming up like fire?
text: Uwumbɔr, saaŋuul ga li bi ti pu n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la aa? Saaŋuul ga li beenin gaal ke mmii na la aa?

ref: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
text: Cha li fenn lir binib bi kaa dooni si na pu, Cha li fenn lir binib bi kaa mee limeel tii si na pu,

ref: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
text: ba pu? bima le ku saanib; bi kuln saatingbaln a.

ref: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
text: Taa di tiyaajatiib aatunwanbir daa timi aatafal. San timi kinimbaak dandana wee; taa ki kpa limakl libaa.

ref: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
text: Uwumbɔr, ter timi, ki gaa timi lii; sin aabaa aanyuŋ pu, gaa timi lii, ki di cha timi aatunwanbir pinn timi.

ref: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
text: Ni ŋa kinye aan ŋitimbol baa timi ke, “Nimi Aawumbɔr bi la chee?” Ŋitimbol aah cha saatutum aasin nyan pu na, cha ti kan saah ga daa bitafal pu na.

ref: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
text: Li pel binib bi bi tiyondir ponn ni na aah ker idun pu na, ki di saapɔɔn mu nyaŋ na nyan binib bi bi siin ke bi ku bi na lii.

ref: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
text: Uwumbɔr, pa ŋitimbol ŋi seei si ŋisiibil mɔmɔk aabɔŋ na nfum mulole pu baah seei si pu na.

ref: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
text: Le timi saanib bi ye saadiik ni yaab na, ga doon si ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na, ki li pak si n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ki cha.

ref: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
text: Israel yaab Aakikiir, li pel ni ti chee; sin u lolni saanib pu nsan na, ŋun ni ti chee. Sin u ka saabɔrjal pu, tiwan ni kpa ifeen na aapaacham,

ref: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
text: di aabaa mɔk Efraim, ni Benjaminn, ni Manase aanibol. Mɔk timi saapɔɔn, ki nan gaa timi lii.

ref: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
text: Uwumbɔr, giin ni timi aabaa chee. San timi kinimbaak, aan ti ŋmar.

ref: Lord God All-Powerful, how much longer will the prayers of your people make you angry?
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr, Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan, ni ga yunn kinye aan saaŋuul ti sɔŋ saanib aameel pu?

ref: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
text: Aa tii timi mpombiin le ke ti ji ki tii timi tinyunyunn kiyikusakpeŋ ni ke ti nyu.

ref: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
text: Aa cha ŋitimbol ŋi mann goln timi na jaa timi aatiŋ pu; timi aadim seei timi la.

ref: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
text: Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan, giin ni timi aabaa chee. San timi kinimbaak, aan ti ŋmar.

ref: We were like a grapevine you brought out of Egypt. You chased other nations away and planted us here.
text: Aa nan di ŋisubil aasub nyan ni Ijipt aatiŋ ni; aa nan jenn nyan ŋinibol le ki di bu ŋum baatiŋ ni.

ref: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
text: Aa nan beer mpaan tii bu ke bu muun; busub ngbaan aanyaan nan chɔb baan, le bu taln gaa kitiŋ ngbaan mɔmɔk pu.

ref: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
text: Bu aaboon nan biin ŋigongon pu; le bu aapan too chaar santina aasui i fɔk sakpen na pu.

ref: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
text: Bu nan taln bu aapan ti fuu Kaasisik ni Aanyusakpem na chee, ki ti ki saa Yufrates aamɔɔl ni.

ref: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
text: Ba ŋa aa chuu ber idɔ i aa nan di gob bu na? Unii umɔk jer bu chee dandana wee na ga ŋmaa su bu aasubil;

ref: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
text: ipɔɔgbeer le ga taa taa ŋaasubil pu, le ipeel ga li joo ŋi ŋmɔ.

ref: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
text: Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan, fenn lik ni timi. Aa bi paacham; li lik ni timi; dan ki nan gaa timi saanib lii.

ref: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
text: Ti ye saasubil aasub bu aa nan ŋum aan bu laa ye buwaatiir, aan aa cha bu kpa mpɔɔn na, dan ki nan gaa timi lii.

ref: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
text: Timi aadim gaa bu lii a, le ki see bu mmii; di saaŋuul lik bi ki kuln bi.

ref: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
text: Li kii ki kaan binib bi aa lee aan bi ye linibol li aa tii mpɔɔn na.

ref: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
text: Taan ki fenn tipuwɔb tii si daalbaadaal; cha ti li kpa limɔfal aan ki pak si.

ref: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr, Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan, giin ni timi aabaa chee. San timi kinimbaak, aan ti ŋmar.

ref: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
text: Uwumbɔr u ye timi aakikiir na pu, di mpopiin teen mpɔɔn pu man; gaa kipak aalahn tii Uwumbɔr. Uma le tiyaaja Jakob mu nan dii.

ref: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
text: Piin ŋigangan aagbaam man, ki li gbaa ŋidabun man; li joo tibar mɔmɔk aabɔŋ gbaa ki gaa ilahn i mɔ na man.

ref: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
text: Pii kakaan njim ngbaan pu, uŋmapɔɔn aayoonn, ni uŋmapiin aayoonn.

ref: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.
text: Nimina ye nkaal le ki tii Israel yaab; Jakob Aawumbɔr le siin mu.

ref: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
text: Buyoonn u nan tak Ijipt yaab na, le u nan di mu tii Israel yaab. M ŋun nneel mubaa bi len ke,

ref: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
text: “M chuu gaa nimi aatun ŋi nyuun na; m cha ni tuur nimi aatun ŋi nyuun ki ye ŋitambil na bil.

ref: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
text: Buyoonn ni nan bi tibɔr ni na, le ni nan yin mi, le m gaa nimi lii. M nan bi maabɔbɔryaan mu ye kitaabuŋ ni na, le ki kii nimi aayim ngbaan. M nan tɔŋ nimi Meriba aanyunbun na chee.

ref: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
text: Maanib, li pel man tibɔr ti m joo sur nimi na; Israel yaab, m ba gee sakpen ke ni li ŋun tii mi.

ref: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
text: Ni taa ki doon liwaal libaa kpala.

ref: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
text: Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr u nyan ni nimi Ijipt aatiŋ ni na. Waar nimɔi man, aan m kpiin nimi.

ref: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
text: Le maanib aa ŋun tii mi; Maanib Israel yaab aa kii tii mi.

ref: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
text: Kina pu le m cha bi kpa tafalaaŋun le ki ŋani baah gee pu na.

ref: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
text: M ba gee sakpen ke maanib li kpa ŋuntii ki tii mi; m ba gee sakpen ke bi li keei maamɔb.

ref: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
text: M ba ga ŋa mala ki nyaŋ baadim, ki daa bi mɔmɔk aatafal.

ref: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
text: Binib bi nan mi na ba ga san ijawaan ki nan gbaan nnimbiin ni; baatafadaan aa ba ga li kpa ndoon.

ref: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
text: Le m ba ga di njikaabim mu ŋan sakpen na kpiin nimi ki cha ni ji tisiir ti bab.”

ref: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
text: Uwumbɔr le ye paacham aaninkpiib aakuun ni aayidaan; bitinjoob aakuun ni, u tii bi waalandak ke,

ref: “How long will you keep judging unfairly and favoring evil people?
text: “Di cha nimi aabamɔn gangal ngbaan aabɔjil; taa ki joo ibamɔn tii bibiindam man.

ref: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
text: Cha bigiim ni nkpobim kan baabamɔn; cha binib bi kaa kpa na, ni binib bi kaa kpa biteterb na kan baabamɔn.

ref: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
text: Nyan bi titunwanbirdam aapɔɔn ni man.

ref: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
text: Naa nyi nibaa. Ni ye bijɔrb la. Ni sil ye bijinjirb la, le ibamɔn san dulnyaa wee ni.

ref: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
text: M bui ke, ‘Ni ye maabim la; ni mɔmɔk ye Min Uwumbɔr u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na aajapɔtiib la.’

ref: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.”
text: Tɔ, ni mu ga kpoi ke unibɔn na la; nimɔfal ga doo ke uyidaan mɔk aah ga doo pu na la.”

ref: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
text: Uwumbɔr, dan, ki nan joo dulnyaa; ŋitimbol mɔmɔk ye sin yaan la.

ref: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!
text: Uwumbɔr, taa li ŋmin; taa li si suuna ki ŋmin kina.

ref: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
text: Lik, saadim fii sil aa pu la, le binib bi nan si na fii sil aa pu.

ref: They are sly, and they plot against those you treasure.
text: Bi bi looni ki kpokl saanib pu la; saah kii binib bi na, le bi bi kpokl bi pu.

ref: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
text: Bi len le ke, “Dan man aan ti ti bii doo Israel yaab aatimbol, aan ubaa taa ki teer bi pu ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.”

ref: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
text: Bi kpokl le ki kii tii tɔb, le ki ŋa limaantɔl ki fii sil aa pu;

ref: Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;
text: Edom ni Ismael yaab kpaani la; le Moab yaab ni Hagar yaab kpaan;

ref: Even Assyria has joined forces with Moab and Ammon.
text: Asiria yaab mu kpee Amonn ni Moab yaab bi ye Lot aayaabitiib na pu, ki pɔɔ pam.

ref: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
text: Ŋa bi ke saah nan ŋa Midiann yaab, ni Sisera, ni Jabinn pu, Kisonn Aamɔɔl ni pu na.

ref: near Endor, and let their bodies rot.
text: Aa nan nyaŋ bi Endor aatiŋ pu, le bi dɔ nima ki ti bur.

ref: Treat their leaders as you did Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna.
text: Ŋa baayidam ke saah nan ŋa Oreb ni Seeb pu na; nyaŋ baasalolm ke saah nan nyaŋ Seba ni Salmuna pu na.

ref: All of them said, “We'll take God's valuable land!”
text: Bi mɔmɔk nan len ke “Ti ga gaa kitiŋ ki ye Uwumbɔr aatiŋ na.”

ref: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
text: Uwumbɔr, yaa bi ke kitangbaak na, cha bi yaa ke libuln aah yaani timoor pu na.

ref: Just as flames destroy forests on the mountains,
text: Mmii aah wu kichook pu na, ni mmiigaal aah cha ŋigongon paab gaal mmii pu na,

ref: pursue and terrify them with storms of your own.
text: di saataabuŋ ki pɔɔ na jenn bi, ki cha saabuŋ ki kpa ijawaan na faan bi.

ref: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
text: Uwumbɔr, cha bi kpaln binimɔɔndam, ki cha bi bee saah kpa mpɔɔn pu na.

ref: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
text: Cha bi lir ki san ijawaan ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na; cha bi kpoi nnimɔɔnkun.

ref: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
text: Cha bi bee ke sin baanja le ye Uwumbɔr, ki ye kitiŋ kee aayidaan u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na.

ref: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!
text: Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan, m gee Saadichal sakpen.

ref: Deep in my heart I long for your temple, and with all that I am I sing joyful songs to you.
text: M gee sakpen ke m li bi li ponn ni. M neen ke m li bi Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni. M di nsui mɔmɔk gaa mpopiin aalahn tii Uwumbɔr u bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na.

ref: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
text: Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan u ye maabɔr ni Maawumbɔr na, iyaar ŋa yaanyandil la, le naakpaa mam kpa bido, baabim bi duun saatork aabimbiln la.

ref: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
text: Binib bi koo Saadichal ni na kpa mpopiin, le ki gaa ilahn ki pak si n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
text: Binib bi aapɔɔn nyan ni aa chee na kpa mpopiin, le bi neen ke bi chuun buen Sionn Aajool paab.

ref: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
text: Baah dii Baka aafatankuun ni ki jer na, le nima chee kpaln uyayak aanyunbun ŋmeen; le unaalantaal cha tibɔr gbiin nima.

ref: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
text: Baah cha na le bi moo pɔɔk; bi ga kan dindatiib mɔmɔk Aawumbɔr Sionn pu.

ref: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
text: Ndindaan Uwumbɔr, Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan, ŋun maameel. Uwumbɔr u n‑yaaja Jakob nan dii u na, li pel.

ref: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
text: Uwumbɔr, ŋa saanyoor ŋa timi aabɔr u sin aabaa lee u na pu.

ref: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
text: M yaa bi Saadichal ponn ni nwiin mubaa kan, ni ŋan jer ke m li bi nibaa chee iwiin lichur; m yaa si Maawumbɔr Aadichal aabisamɔb kan, ni soor ni ke m li koo bibiindam do.

ref: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr le ye timi aakikiir, ni timi aabɔr u kpa kipak sakpen na, u ŋani timi tiŋann ki tii timi bunyuŋ. Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na, waa cha bi lanni tiwanyaan nibaa.

ref: Lord God All-Powerful, you bless everyone who trusts you.
text: Uwumbɔr, Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan, binib bi tii si naadii na kpa mpopiin.

ref: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa san saatiŋ kinimbaak; aa ki cha Israel yaab kan liwankpal.

ref: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
text: Aa di saanib aatunwanbir pinn bi, ki di baataani mɔmɔk pinn bi.

ref: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
text: Aa di cha kaa ki gee bi pu liŋuul, ki chuu saaŋuusakpeln na.

ref: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
text: Uwumbɔr u gaal timi lir na, giin ni timi aabaa chee, ki cha aasui li piin ti pu.

ref: Will you always be angry with us and our families?
text: Saaŋuul timi pu aan doo la aa? Saaŋuul aa kpa ndoon la aa?

ref: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
text: Ki tii timi mpɔɔn, aan timi saanib ga pak si.

ref: Show us your love and save us!
text: Uwumbɔr, mɔk timi saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na, ki tii timi saaŋmarm aaterm.

ref: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
text: M bi pel Ndindaan Uwumbɔr aah len pu na la; u puu ke u ga tii timi waanib nsuudoon; ti mu taa ki gir buen timi aajɔrk ponn ni.

ref: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
text: Mbamɔn, binib bi nyuŋni u na, u ga sil gaa bi lii, le waapɔɔn ga li bi timi aatiŋ ni ki gaa timi lii.

ref: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
text: Ngeehm ni ibamɔn ga chuu tɔb; le mbimbinyaan ni nsuudoon ga bob tɔb.

ref: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
text: Unibɔn aanaadii bi taab ki likni paacham, le Uwumbɔr aabimbinyaan bi paacham ki likni taab.

ref: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
text: Uwumbɔr ga tii timi liwankpal, le timi aatiŋ ŋa tijikaar pam.

ref: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
text: Mbimbinyaan le ga loln Uwumbɔr pu nsan, ki toor nsan tii u.

ref: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
text: Uwumbɔr, pel m chee ki kii maayim, ba pu? maa kpa uteter, kaa kpa mpɔɔn mu.

ref: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
text: Maah keei saamɔb pu na, nyan mi nkun ni; gaa mi lii, m ye saatutunn u tii si naadii na la.

ref: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
text: Aa ye Maawumbɔr la, san mi kinimbaak; m mee si le nwiin ti lir.

ref: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
text: Uwumbɔr, tii mi saatutunn mpopiin, ba pu? maameel chaa aa chee paacham.

ref: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
text: Aa kpa ti pu tiŋann le ki joo cha pinni timi aatunwanbir; saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na bi binib bi mee si na chee.

ref: Please listen, Lord! Answer my prayer for help.
text: Uwumbɔr, pel maameel; ŋun maah wii ki ban nterm pu na.

ref: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
text: Saah keei maameel pu na, le m yin si buyoonn m bi tibɔr ni na.

ref: No other gods are like you; only you work miracles.
text: Uwumbɔr, liwaal libaa aa bi ke sin na, ubaa aa kee ŋa tiwan ni aa ŋa na.

ref: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
text: Saah naan ŋitimbol ŋi mɔmɔk na ga dan ki nan gbaan aanimbiin ni; bi ga pak saah tun ŋitukpaan ŋi na.

ref: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
text: Saapɔɔn nyaŋ, le aa tun ŋitukpaan; sin baanja le ye Uwumbɔr.

ref: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.
text: Uwumbɔr, mɔk mi saah ban ke m tun pu na, le m ga kii saamɔb mbamɔm; mɔk mi saasan aan m di nsui mɔmɔk tun saatuln.

ref: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
text: Ndindaan Uwumbɔr, m ga di nsui mɔmɔk pak si, m ga li mooni saah tun ŋitukpaan ŋi na pu n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
text: Saageehm mu aa kpa m pu n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na nyaŋ sakpen a. Aa nyan mi likaakul ni.

ref: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
text: Uwumbɔr, bigaadam choo ki ban mi la; bibiindam le kuun ki ban bi ku mi, bi ye binib bi aatafal aa bi aa ni na la.

ref: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
text: Uwumbɔr, le aa ma ye Uwumbɔr u san kinimbaak ki kpa ngeehm na, ki kpa suklaa ni tiŋann, ki ŋani saah puu ke aa ga ŋa pu na n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
text: San mi kinimbaak ki fenn lik ni mi; gaa mi lii ki tii mi mpɔɔn, ba pu? m ye saatutunn ki tun tii si ke unaagbiija na.

ref: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
text: Uwumbɔr, mɔk mi saaŋann aamɔkl; binib bi nan mi na yaa kan ke aa ter mi ki tii mi mmɔɔn kan, bi ga ji inimɔɔn.

ref: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
text: Uwumbɔr maa waatiŋ ligongoln li bi chain na pu la.

ref: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
text: U gee Jerusalem aatiŋ jer Israel aatim mɔmɔk.

ref: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
text: Uwumbɔr aatiŋ, li pel waah len tibɔnyaan ti aa pu na.

ref: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
text: “M yaa ban m ŋmee ŋitimbol ŋi kii maamɔb na aayimbil bil kan, m ga di Ijipt ni Babiloŋ aayimbil mu kpee; m ga kahn Filistia yaab, ni Taya yaab, ni Kus yaab kpee Jerusalem aanib pu.”

ref: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
text: Bi ga len ke ŋitimbol mɔmɔk ye Sionn yaan la, le Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔndaan ga tii Sionn mpɔɔn.

ref: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
text: Uwumbɔr ga ŋmee binib mɔmɔk aayimbil ki kpee Jerusalem aanib pu.

ref: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
text: Bi waa liwaal le ki gaa nlahn ke, “Sionn ponn ni le timi aanyoor mɔmɔk bi.”

ref: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
text: Ndindaan Uwumbɔr u gaal mi lir na, m wii le nwiin ti lir, le kinyeek kan, m bi aanimbiin ni.

ref: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
text: Ŋun maameel; li pel maah wii ki ban nterm pu na.

ref: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
text: Tibɔr pam le kan mi, le maa ki daa nkun chee.

ref: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.
text: Saaŋuul dɔ nyik m pu la, le laanyunyuun nyii mi bil taab.

ref: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape,
text: Aa cha njɔtiib san cha mi; aa cha m gur nu bi chee la. M gur ye kaasisik ni aajangeln la kaan ŋmaa minn buen nibaa chee;

ref: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
text: falaa pu, nnimbil aa ki waa mbamɔm. Uwumbɔr, idaa mɔmɔk, m yin si la le ki yoor ŋŋaal paacham ki mee si.

ref: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
text: Saa tun iwaan aatun tii bitekpiib. Baa fii sil ki pak si.

ref: Are your love and loyalty announced in the world of the dead?
text: Baa len saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu likaakul ni. Baa len saah tun saapuur aatun ŋi na aabɔr kitekpiitiŋ ni.

ref: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
text: Baa kani saatukpaan na mbɔmbɔɔn aah bi nin chee na, kaa kani saaŋann kitiŋ ki bi suln kaanib bɔr na ni.

ref: Each morning I pray to you, Lord.
text: Uwumbɔr, m yin si ki ban nterm la; m mee si kichakpiik mɔmɔk ni.

ref: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
text: Uwumbɔr, ba ŋa aa yii mi? Ba ŋa aa fenn aapuwɔb tii mi?

ref: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
text: Maah fii ubo pu na, m ji falaa le ki duun nkun; saah dar ntafal pu na, le maa ti ki kpa mpɔɔn mubaa.

ref: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
text: Saaŋuusakpeln le nyiir mi bilni; maah san si ijawaan pu na le bii mi doo.

ref: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
text: Aa cha njɔnyaan mu ti san cha mi, le mbɔmbɔɔn baanja gur ye njɔ.

ref: Our Lord, I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.
text: Uwumbɔr, n‑yoonn mɔmɔk m ga li gaa ilahn saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu; m ga li mooni ke aa ŋani saah len pu na ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
text: M nyi ke saageehm ga li bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na, ki nyi ke aa tun saah puu tipuur ti na, kaa kpelni daalbaadaal ke kitaapaak aah kaa kpelni pu na.

ref: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
text: Aa len ke, “M puu tipuur tii uja u m lee u na, uma le ye maatutunn David; m puu tii u ke,

ref: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
text: Paacham aawan gaa ilahn saatukpaan na pu la; Uwumbɔr, bi gaa ilahn saah ŋani saah len pu na pu.

ref: None who live in the heavens can compare with you.
text: Uwumbɔr, ubaa aa bi paacham ki bi ke sin na; paacham yaab ubaa aaŋeen aatɔ aa ye si.

ref: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
text: Saatuuntiib aakuun ni kan, bi mɔmɔk pak si la; le bi mɔmɔk san si ijawaan.

ref: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr, Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan, ubaa aa bi ki kpa mpɔɔn ke sin na; Uwumbɔr, aa ŋani saah puu pu na mɔmɔk la.

ref: You rule the roaring sea and calm its waves.
text: Sin le joo nnyusakpem mu pɔɔ sakpen na; aa cha mu aanyunkpenn doon suuna.

ref: You crushed the monster Rahab, and with your powerful arm you scattered your enemies.
text: Aa wɔb kipeewanbiik Rahab, ki ku ki; aa di saapɔɔn sakpiin le nyaŋ saadim.

ref: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
text: Paacham ni kitiŋ mɔmɔk ye sin yaan la, sin le naan dulnyaa ni tiwan ni mɔmɔk bi u ni na.

ref: and everything else. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon gladly praise you.
text: Sin le naan ŋŋangan ni ŋŋangii; Tabor Aajool ni Hemonn Aajool gaa mpopiin aalahn aa pu.

ref: You are strong and mighty!
text: Saapɔɔn nyaŋ a. Aa kpa mpɔɔn sakpen a.

ref: Your kingdom is ruled by justice and fairness with love and faithfulness leading the way.
text: Saanaan si mbimbinyaan ni ibamɔn pu la; saatuln mɔmɔk ni kan, saageehm ni saah bi chob pu na nyani mpaan pu la.

ref: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
text: Binib bi joo ilahn dooni si, aan ki bi saaŋann aawiin ni na kpa mpopiin.

ref: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
text: Sin pu le bi mɔɔni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, le ki pak si, saaŋann pu.

ref: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
text: Aa tii timi ŋinyaŋ sakpiin, saageehm cha ti nyaŋ.

ref: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.
text: Uwumbɔr, sin le nyan timi aakikiir, sin Israel yaab Aawumbɔr u bi chain na le tii timi, timi aabɔr. Uwumbɔr aah puu tipuur ti tii David na

ref: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
text: N‑yoonn mu jer na le aa nan kpiir tuk saatutum bi dii si mbamɔm na ke, “M tii butɔb aajakpaan ubaa nterm; m di libɔrjal tii unii u m lee u binib ngbaan ponn ni na.

ref: David, my servant, is the one I chose to be king,
text: M di maakpan mu bi chain na kpir maatutunn David aayil pu, ki ŋa u ubɔr.

ref: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
text: Maapɔɔn ga li bi u chee n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, maapɔɔn le ga tii u mpɔɔn.

ref: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
text: Waadim aan ŋmaa nyaŋ u daalbaadaal; bibiindam aan ŋmaa nyaŋ u.

ref: I will strike down and crush his troublesome enemies.
text: M ga ku waadim, ki ku binib bi mɔmɔk nan u na.

ref: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
text: M ga li gee u, ki li si upuwɔb; m ga cha u li kani linyaŋ.

ref: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.
text: M ga taln waanaan ki nya Kaasisik ni Aanyusakpem mɔk ki ti saa Yufrates Aamɔɔl mɔk.

ref: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
text: U ga bui mi ke, ‘Sin le ye nte, ni Maawumbɔr; sin le ye maakikiir, sin le ye u gaal mi lir na.’

ref: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
text: M ga ŋa u njapɔpol, uma le ga li ye ubɔrkpaan u jer bibɔrb mɔmɔk na.

ref: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
text: M ga li joo maah puu tipuur ti na tii u n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, le min ni uma aamɔbaan ga li bi ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
text: Uyaabitiib aan doo ke kitaapaak aah kaa door pu na; uyaabil ga li ye ubɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
text: Tɔ, uyaabitiib yaa yii, kaa dii maakaal, kaa bi ke maah mɔk bi pu na,

ref: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
text: ki yaa kaa lik faar maamɔkm, kaa joo maakaal kan,

ref: Then I will correct and punish them because of their sins.
text: m ga daa bitafal, baatunwanbir pu; m ga cha bi ji falaa, baataani pu.

ref: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
text: Tɔ, m ga li beenin gee David ma, ki ga li beenin joo maah puur tipuur ti na tii u.

ref: “I won't break my agreement or go back on my word.
text: Maan bii maah puu tipuur tii u na, kaan bar tipuur ngbaan pu kibaa.

ref: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
text: M puu maayimbil li bi chain na pu ke maan gii inyamɔn tuk David.

ref: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
text: U ga li kpa yaabitiib n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, le m ga li lik waanaan pu ki ti saa dulnyaa aadoon.

ref: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
text: Le saaŋuul fii saah lee ubɔr u na pu; aa siir cha u ki yii u.

ref: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
text: Aa bii tipuur ti aa nan puu tii saatutunn ngbaan na, ki di waabɔryikpupuk mee lii tikpakpar ni.

ref: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.
text: Aa tur waatiŋ aagon lii kitiŋ, le ki cha waajawan aadir kpaln ŋilangben.

ref: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.
text: Unii umɔk jer na su waawangol la; binib bi koo gbɔk u na laa u la.

ref: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
text: Aa di linyaŋ tii waadim; ki tii bi mpopiin.

ref: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
text: Aa cha waajawan aa ki kpa tinyoor, ki cha bi nyaŋ u butɔb ni.

ref: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
text: Aa chuu gaa u chee nnaan aajaangbeek ki di waabɔrjal mee lii kitiŋ,

ref: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
text: Aa cha u por kaa kee fuu waayoonn, ki cha u kpaln unimɔɔnii. Ŋŋmarm aameel

ref: How much longer, Lord? Will you hide forever? How long will your anger keep burning like fire?
text: Uwumbɔr, aa ga di aabaa bɔr kookoo la aa? Saaŋuul ga li wu ke mmii na ki ti saa bayoonn?

ref: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
text: Teer ke maamɔfal aa fɔk; teer ke aa naan ti mɔmɔk aan ti ye tiwan ni ga kpo na la.

ref: No one can escape the power of death and the grave.
text: Ŋma ga li bi kaan kpo? Unibɔn aan ŋmaa mɔk ke waan kpo.

ref: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
text: Ndindaan, saajan aageehm na bi la chee? Saah nan puu tipuur ti tii Ubɔr David na bi la chee?

ref: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
text: Taa suln baah seei mi saatutunn pu na bɔr, taa suln binib bi kaa nyi si na aamɔpuur aah lir m pu pu na.

ref: I am your chosen one, but your enemies chase and make fun of me.
text: Uwumbɔr, saadim seei saah lee ubɔr u na. Bi seei u waah cha nin chee mɔmɔk na la.

ref: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk man. Amii, amii. NAANAA AAGBAŊ (Ilahn

ref: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.
text: Uwumbɔr, n‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, sin le ye timi aakookoo yaan.

ref: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
text: Waahr aan aa nin naan ŋigongon ni dulnyaa na, aa nan ye Uwumbɔr u kaa kpa ndoon na, ki ga li beenin ye Uwumbɔr ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
text: Ŋibin lichur naahn liwinbaal le aa chee; ŋi bi ke fen u jer na la, ki naahn kikurk kibaa aah ga yunn kinyeek pu na.

ref: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
text: Aa joo timi cha ke nwam na la; timi aamɔfal aa fɔk ke tidaŋ na la. Ti naahn timoor ti ga punn kichakpiik ni,

ref: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
text: ki muun mala ki kpaan faa mpuun, le kijook kan, ti kuur ki kpo na la.

ref: Your furious anger frightens and destroys us,
text: Saaŋuul le kuln timi; saaŋuusakpeln cha ijawaan chur timi la.

ref: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
text: Saaŋuul le junn timi aamɔfal; timi aamɔfal wɔŋni ke tibɔlɔikaan na la.

ref: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
text: Timi aabin ye imonko itaa ni kipiik baanja la, le binib bi pɔɔ na fuur imonko inaa; tɔ, ŋi mu aah joo ni tiwan ni na tii timi na le ye tibɔr ni nsuubiin; limɔfal kpaan doo le na, timi aadoon le na.

ref: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
text: Ŋma kee kan saaŋuul aapɔɔn mbamɔm? Ŋma nyi saaŋuusakpeln aah ga joo ni ijawaan i na.

ref: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
text: Mɔk timi, timi aamɔfal aafɔfɔk aah ye pu na, aan ti ŋa nlan.

ref: Help us, Lord! Don't wait! Pity your servants.
text: Saaŋuul ga ki yunn ki ti saa kinye? Uwumbɔr, san saatutum kinimbaak.

ref: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
text: Kichakpiik mɔk ni kan, di saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na gbiin timi, aan ti gaa ilahn ki li kpa mpopiin ki ti saa timi aamɔfal aadoon.

ref: Make us happy for as long as you caused us trouble and sorrow.
text: Tii timi mpopiin dandana wee ke saah nan tii timi mpombiin pu timi aafalaa aabin mɔmɔk yoonn na.

ref: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
text: Cha timi saatutum kan saapɔɔn sakpiin aatun; Cha timi aayaabitiib kan saapak sakpeŋ.

ref: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr, cha saanyoor li bi ti pu. Tii timi tinyoor timi aatun mɔmɔk ni.

ref: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
text: Unii umɔk chaa Uwumbɔr chee ti ban nkiirm na, unii umɔk bi Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan aaŋaal ni na

ref: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
text: ga bui u ke, “Sin le kii mi ki joo mi. Sin le ye Maawumbɔr, sin pu le m mak.”

ref: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
text: U ga nyan si tibɔbir timɔk bɔɔ na ni, ni nkun aaween mɔmɔk ni.

ref: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.
text: U ga taln waafeen biin aa pu; aa ga kan u chee ŋŋmarm; waaŋann le ga li kii si ki joo si.

ref: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
text: Saan san kinyeek aajawaan ibaa, kaan san nwiin pu aabɔlirkaan tibaa,

ref: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.
text: kaan san tiweenbir ti chur binib mbɔmbɔɔn ni na, kaan san nwiin pu aawanbir ti ku na.

ref: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.
text: Nibaakan, lichur ga lir ki kpo aa chee, le ŋichur kipiik kpo ki dɔ goln si, le nibaa aan ŋa sin ma.

ref: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
text: Aa ga lik le ki kan Uwumbɔr aah dar bibiindam aatafal pu na.

ref: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
text: Aa di Uwumbɔr le ŋa u kiir si na, uma Uwumbɔr u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na le ye saakikiir,

ref: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
text: kina pu na, kinimbɔŋ kibaa aan kan si, mbimbinpɔɔl mubaa aan duun ni saadichal.

ref: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
text: Uwumbɔr ga cha waatuuntiib li joo si ki li kii si nimɔk aa cha na.

ref: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
text: Bi ga li joo si biŋaal ponn ni paacham, aataal taa gbeer ŋitakpal.

ref: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
text: Aa ga taa taa ichinn ni ikuub pu, aa ga taa taa ichinn ni ikuub i bir na pu.

ref: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “M ga gaa binib bi gee mi na lii, ki li kii binib bi nyi mi ke m ye Uwumbɔr na.

ref: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
text: Bi yaa yin mi kan, m ga kii baayim; bi yaa bi tibɔr ni kan, m ga li bi bi chee. M ga nyan bi tibɔr ni, ki nyuŋ bi.

ref: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
text: M ga di limɔfafɔfɔŋ le tii bi; m ga gaa bi lii.”

ref: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!
text: Uwumbɔr, ni ŋan sakpen ke ti doon si, Uwumbɔr u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na, ni ŋan ke ti gaa ilahn ki nyuŋ si,

ref: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.
text: ni ŋan ke ti li mooni saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na, kichakpiik mɔk ni, ki moon ke aa ŋani saah puu tipuur ti na, kinyeek,

ref: I enjoy praising your name to the music of harps,
text: ni ŋan ke ti di ibeeŋmin aawan ni tibar gaa ilahn ki pak si.

ref: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.
text: Uwumbɔr, saatukpaan na tii mi mpopiin; saah tun pu na, le m ga gaa mpopiin aalahn.

ref: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
text: Uwumbɔr, saatun nyaŋ sakpen. Saalandak nyoo pam.

ref: for an ignorant fool to know or understand.
text: Nimina le ye tiwan ni ujɔr aan ŋmaa bee na; ulatiir mu aan ŋmaa bee naatataa.

ref: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
text: Bibiindam ga ŋmaa muun ke timoor na, binib bi tun taani na ga ŋmaa kan tinyoor, tɔ, liwinbaal le bi ga nan kuln kookoo,

ref: But you will rule over all of us forever,
text: ba pu? sin Uwumbɔr le bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ki kpa mpɔɔn jer mpɔɔn mɔmɔk.

ref: and your hateful enemies will be scattered and then destroyed.
text: Ti nyi ke saadim ga kpoi, le bibiindam mɔmɔk ga lir.

ref: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
text: Aa cha m pɔɔ ke upɔɔnaa na la; aa tii mi mpopiin.

ref: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
text: M kan maadim aah lir pu na, ki ŋun bibiindam aah wii pu na.

ref: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na ga ŋa tinyoor ke libɔkpal aasui na la; bi ga muun ke Lebanonn aasantina aasui na la.

ref: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
text: Bi naahn isui i bi ŋum i Uwumbɔr Aadichal chee na la, bi muuni timi Aawumbɔr Aadichal aachiln ni la,

ref: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
text: le ki beenin lu ŋisubil buyoonn i por na, ki kpa tifasɔnn ki pɔɔ n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
text: Nimina le mɔk ke Uwumbɔr si chob la, maakikiir aa kpa ngalm mubaa.

ref: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
text: Uwumbɔr le ye ubɔr. U kpa nnaan aapak ni mpɔɔn. Kitiŋ nyal si kaabuul ni, kaan foor.

ref: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.
text: Uwumbɔr, ki nyan mpiin na, saabɔrjal si chob la, aa nan bi le n‑yoonn nin piin.

ref: The ocean is roaring, Lord! The sea is pounding hard.
text: Uwumbɔr, nnyusakpem aanyunkpenn aafuuk nyan paacham la; tinyunkpenn na fii le ki kpa kifuuk.

ref: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
text: Uwumbɔr lik paacham aawan mɔmɔk ki joo ni, u pɔɔ jer nnyusakpem aah ŋuuni pu na, ki pɔɔ jer nnyusakpem aanyunkpenn.

ref: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
text: Uwumbɔr, saakaal bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, le Saadichal sil bi chain n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
text: Ndindaan Uwumbɔr u dar binib aatafal na, kpiir saaŋuul mɔk binib.

ref: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
text: Sin le ye unibɔn mɔmɔk aabɔjir; fii sil ki tii bigaadam tiwan ni ŋeer bi na.

ref: How long will the wicked celebrate and be glad?
text: Taa cha bibiindam aapopiin ki yunn. Uwumbɔr, taa cha ni ki yunn.

ref: All of those cruel people strut and boast,
text: Taa cha titunwanbirdam aagaak ki yunn, aan bi li beenin kpa kipupuk baatunwanbir aatuln pu.

ref: and they crush and wound your chosen nation, Lord.
text: Uwumbɔr, bi wɔi saanib; bi muk binib bi ye saanib na.

ref: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
text: Bi len le ke, “Uwumbɔr aa waa timi; uma u ye Israel yaab Aawumbɔr na aa nyi.”

ref: Can't you fools see? Won't you ever learn?
text: Maanib, ba ŋa ni ye bigbaam ni bijɔrb kina? Bayoonn aan ni ga bae?

ref: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
text: Uwumbɔr le naan timi aatafal, kina pu na u ŋun. Uma le naan timi aanimbil, kina pu na, u waa.

ref: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?
text: Uma le sur ŋitimbol, u dar ŋitafal. Uma le ye unibɔn mɔmɔk aamɔmɔkr, kina pu na, u nyi tiwan mɔmɔk aabɔr.

ref: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
text: Uwumbɔr nyi baalandak; u nyi ke baalandak ye kijɔrk ŋmeen la.

ref: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
text: Uwumbɔr, saah bae unii u ki joo saakaal mɔk u na kpa mpopiin.

ref: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
text: Aa tii u lifuur, tibɔr aawiin daal, ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu bi gbii libuul bilni bibiindam na.

ref: You won't turn your back on your chosen nation.
text: Uwumbɔr aan siir cha waanib; waan suln binib bi ye waanib na aabɔr.

ref: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
text: Bi ga ki kan ibamɔn libɔjil ni, le binib bimɔk aabimbin ŋan na ga sil ibamɔn ngbaan aachaŋ ni.

ref: Who will stand up for me against those cruel people?
text: Ŋma nan sil nchaŋ ni bibiindam chee? Ŋma nan sil mpuwɔb titunwanbirdam chee?

ref: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
text: Uwumbɔr yaa kaa ba nan ter mi kan, kina m ba nan san mala sunn bitekpiib chee.

ref: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
text: Uwumbɔr, m bui ke, “M bi lir la;” le saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na chuu mi siin chob.

ref: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
text: N‑yoonn mumɔk m dak ilandak aan ni muk mi na, le aa sɔŋ nsui ki tii mi mpopiin.

ref: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
text: le Uwumbɔr tee si mpuwɔb; Maawumbɔr le kii mi.

ref: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
text: U ga daa bitafal baabiin pu, ki kuln bi baatunwanbir pu; Tidindaan Uwumbɔr ga kuln bi.

ref: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
text: Dan man, aan ti nan pak Uwumbɔr. Cha ti gaa mpopiin aalahn tii Uwumbɔr u kii timi na man.

ref: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
text: Cha ti di idoon dan unimbiin ni man, ki gaa mpopiin aapak aalahn man,

ref: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
text: ba pu? Uwumbɔr ye Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan la, ubɔr mpɔɔnsakpiindaan u joo dindatiib mɔmɔk na.

ref: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
text: Uma le joo kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk, ki nya kitakpaluŋ ki nyoo sakpen na ni ki ti saa ligongoln li paa sakpen na paab.

ref: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
text: Uma le lik waah naan nnyusakpem mu na pu, ni kitiŋ ki u naan na mu pu.

ref: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
text: Uma le ye timi Aawumbɔr; timi le ye binib bi u lik ti pu na, ki ye binib bi u tii bi tiwan na. Li pel man waah len pu din wee na;

ref: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
text: “Taa cha nitafal li pɔɔ ke niyaajatiib aah nan bi pu Meriba aatiŋ ni na, ke baah nan ŋa pu nteersakpiin ni, Masa aatiŋ ni na.

ref: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
text: Nima chee bi nan tɔŋ mi ki lik, ki nyi maah tun pu tii bi na.

ref: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
text: Nlaasaab nan nyan binib ngbaan ni, ŋibin imonko ilee ponn ni. Le m bui ke, ‘Baa si mpuwɔb kpala. Bi yii, kaa joo maakaal.’

ref: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
text: Maaŋuul nan fii, le m puu tipuukpaan ke, ‘Naan koo kitiŋ ki ponn ni m ba ga tii nimi lifuur na.’”

ref: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
text: Gaa nlahnpɔɔn tii Uwumbɔr man. Dulnyaa wee mɔmɔk, gaa ilahn tii Uwumbɔr man.

ref: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
text: Gaa ilahn tii Uwumbɔr man, ki pak u. Iwiin mɔmɔk kan, ni li mooni waah gaa timi lii pu na aabɔnyaan.

ref: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
text: Moon waah kpa kipak pu na ki tuk ŋitimbol, ki moon waah tun ŋitukpaan pu na tuk binib mɔmɔk.

ref: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
text: Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn nyaŋ sakpen, le ni ŋan ke ti pak u sakpen; ti ga nyuŋ u ki jer dindatiib mɔmɔk.

ref: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
text: Ŋitimbol ŋiken na mɔmɔk aawaa po ye tiwan ni bi naan ni na la, le Uwumbɔr naan paacham.

ref: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
text: Kipak ni nnaan aapɔɔn le mann goln u; le mpɔɔn ni kinyaan gbii Waadichal ni.

ref: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
text: Kitiŋ kee aanib mɔmɔk, li pak Uwumbɔr man; pak man waapɔɔn ni waah kpa kinyuŋ sakpen pu na.

ref: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr aayimbil li kpa kinyuŋ na man; li joo ni ipiin ki di dan man Waadichal ponn ni.

ref: Everyone on earth, now tremble and worship the Lord, majestic and holy.”
text: Uwumbɔr u bi chain na yaa choo kan, gbaan unimbiin ni man; kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk li jii unimbiin ni.

ref: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
text: Bui ŋitimbol mɔmɔk ke, “Uwumbɔr le ye ubɔr. Kitiŋ si kaabuul ni chib, kaan ŋmaa foor daalbaadaal; u ga di ibamɔn ji binib tibɔr.”

ref: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
text: Kitiŋ ni kitaapaak, li mɔɔni man. Nnyusakpem, ni tiwanfuurkaan nimɔk bi aa ponn ni na, faa kifuuk man;

ref: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
text: Uwumbɔr le ye ubɔr, kina pu na, kitiŋ, li mɔɔni. Nnyusakpem aadik, li mɔɔni man.

ref: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
text: Ntaalangbam, ni mbɔmbɔɔn le mann goln u; u joo mbimbinyaan ni ibamɔn le joo binib.

ref: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
text: Mmii le lolni u pu nsan le ki wu waadim bi mann goln u na.

ref: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
text: Waawiihn mu moor ke utaal na le wolni dulnyaa pu; kitiŋ kan kina le ki jii.

ref: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
text: Ŋigongon donn ke nsiikpan na le Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni, ŋi donn kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk Aadindaan aanimbiin ni la.

ref: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
text: Paacham aawan mooni waah kpa mbimbinyaan pu na, le ŋitimbol waa waah kpa kinyuŋ pu na.

ref: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
text: Unii umɔk dooni ŋiwaa na jin inimɔɔn a; ŋiwaa mɔmɔk gbaani Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni la.

ref: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
text: Sionn aanib kpa mpopiin, le Juda aatim mɔɔni. Uwumbɔr, saabɔjil pu le bi mɔɔni.

ref: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
text: Uwumbɔr u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na, sin le ye kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk aajojoor; saapɔɔn nyaŋ dindatiib mɔmɔk aapɔɔn.

ref: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
text: Uwumbɔr gee binib bi kaa gee titunwanbir na; u kii waanib aamɔfal; u gaal bi bibiindam chee lir.

ref: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
text: Nwiihn woln binib bi aabimbin ŋan na pu, le mmɔɔn bi bininyaam chee.

ref: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
text: Gaa nlahnpɔɔn tii Uwumbɔr man; u tun ŋitukpaan; u di ubaa aapɔɔn mu bi chain na le kan linyaŋ.

ref: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
text: Uwumbɔr moon waah kan linyaŋ pu na; u cha ŋitimbol bee ke u kpa mpɔɔn ki joo gaal binib lir.

ref: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
text: U joo waah puu tipuur ti tii waanib Israel yaab na. Waa nya bipuwɔb, le ki kpa ngeehm tii bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Binib bimɔk bi ni kookoo na kan timi Aawumbɔr aanyaŋ.

ref: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
text: Kitiŋ mɔmɔk, gaa mpopiin aalahn tii Uwumbɔr, di ilahn pak u ki li joo mpopiin tar.

ref: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
text: Gaa ilahn pak Uwumbɔr man. Di tibar gaa ilahn man.

ref: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
text: Pii kakaan ni ikpiin man, ki di mpopiin teen mpɔɔn pu tii Uwumbɔr u ye timi aabɔr na.

ref: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
text: Nnyusakpem, ni tiwanfuurkaan ni mɔmɔk bi aa ponn ni na, faa kifuuk man; kitiŋ, ni binib bi mɔmɔk bi aa pu na, gaa ilahn man.

ref: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
text: Nimi ŋimɔɔ, faa kifuuk man; nimi ŋigongon, kpaan man ki gaa mpopiin aalahn Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni,

ref: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
text: ba pu? u choo ke u nan joo dulnyaa la; u ga di mbimbinyaan ni ibamɔn le joo dulnyaa aanib.

ref: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
text: Uwumbɔr le ye ubɔr, le binib aawon gbaa. U ka waabɔrjal pu, tiwan ni kpa ifeen na aapaacham, le kitiŋ jii.

ref: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
text: Uwumbɔr kpa mpɔɔn Sionn pu, uma le ye ŋitimbol mɔmɔk aayidaan.

ref: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
text: Unii mɔmɔk ga pak waayimbikpaan li kpa ijawaan na. U bi chain la.

ref: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
text: Ubɔrkpaan, aa gee ibamɔn aawan la; aa cha ibamɔn bi Israel aatiŋ pu; aa joo ni mbimbinyaan ni ibamɔn.

ref: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
text: Pak Tidindaan Uwumbɔr man; li dooni u man waabɔrjal taab. U bi chain la.

ref: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
text: Moses ni Aaronn le nan ye waatotoorb, le Samuel nan ye unii u mee u na; bi nan yin Uwumbɔr, le u kii baayim ngbaan.

ref: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
text: U nan bi ntaalangbam ni le ki len bi chee tibɔr; bi nan kii waakaal, ni waah bui bi pu na.

ref: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr, aa kii saanib aayim; aa mɔk bi ke aa ye Uwumbɔr u joo cha pinni taani na la, tɔ, aa nan tee daa bitafal, baatunwanbir pu.

ref: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
text: Pak Tidindaan Uwumbɔr man, li dooni u waagongoln li bi chain na pu man. Tidindaan Uwumbɔr bi chain la.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
text: Dulnyaa mɔmɔk, gaa ilahn tii Uwumbɔr man.

ref: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
text: Di mpopiin doon Uwumbɔr man; di mpopiin aalahn dan u chee man.

ref: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
text: Taa suln man ke Uwumbɔr ye Tidindaan la. Uma le nan ŋa timi ŋitimbol, le ti ye uyaab; ti ye waanib la, ti ye waapiih la.

ref: Be thankful and praise the Lord as you enter his temple.
text: Di idoon jer waadichal aabisamɔi ni, di kipak koo waachiln ni. Doon u ki pak u man.

ref: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
text: Uwumbɔr, maalahn ye ibamɔn ni ngeehm aalahn la, le m gaa mu tii si.

ref: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
text: Maatuln aan li kpa tijɔŋ. Bayoonn aan aa ga dan m chee? M ga li joo mbimbin mu ŋan na le bi maadichal ponn ni,

ref: I refuse to be corrupt or to take part in anything crooked,
text: kaan kii tii titunwanbir kpala. M nan binib bi fenn bipuwɔb tii Uwumbɔr na; m ni bima aan kpaan ki tun lituln.

ref: and I won't be dishonest or deceitful.
text: Maan tun beebee aatuln, kaan tun titunwanbirdam chee lituln.

ref: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
text: M ga jenn nyan unii umɔk looni len titunwanbir uŋeen aatɔ pu na; maan kii tii unii u kpa kigaak ni inimpoo na.

ref: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
text: M ga kii tii binib bi kii tii Uwumbɔr na ki cha bi li koo maabɔrchiln ni. Binib bi kaa kpa taani na ga li kpa nsan ki tun maatuln.

ref: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
text: Unyamɔndaan ubaa aan kan nkookoo yaan maabɔrchiln ni; uŋmaŋmannii ubaa aan sil nnimbiin ni.

ref: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
text: Iwiin mɔmɔk kan, m ga li ku bibiindam bi bi timi aatiŋ pu na la; m ga jenn nyan titunwanbirdam mɔmɔk Uwumbɔr aatiŋ ponn ni.

ref: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen.
text: Uwumbɔr, li pel maameel ki ŋun maah wii ki ban nterm pu na.

ref: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.
text: M yaa bi tibɔr ni kan, taa fenn aapuwɔb tii mi, li pel m chee, ki kii mi mala buyoonn m yin si na.

ref: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
text: Maamɔfal bi wɔŋni ke iŋmanyuu na la; nwon bi wu ke mmii na la.

ref: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.
text: Bi gbaa mi bil ke timokuun na la; maa ki neen tijikaar tibaa.

ref: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
text: M ker idun mpɔɔn pu la; m gur ye ngban ni ikpab ŋmeen la.

ref: or a restless sparrow alone on a roof.
text: M dɔ waa kinyeek la; m naahn unyoon u ka kidiipaab ubaa baanja na la.

ref: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
text: Maadim seei mi le nwiin ti lir; binib bi ŋani mi mbɔnyun na joo maayimbil puuni lir biken pu la.

ref: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
text: Maamɔfal gur naahn kijook aajunjuŋ la; m gur bi ke timokuun na la.

ref: Our Lord, you are King forever and will always be famous.
text: Uwumbɔr, le sin ma ye ubɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk; n‑yoonn mɔmɔk aanib ga teer aabɔr.

ref: You will show pity to Zion because the time has come.
text: Aa ga fii sil ki san Sionn kinimbaak; n‑yoonn fuu ni ke aa san ki kinimbaak; n‑yoonn mu ŋan na sɔ.
