ref: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
text: Kaah ber ki kuln pu na, saatutum beenin gee ki la; kaah gur tilangbenn pu na, bi san ki kinimbaak la.

ref: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
text: Ŋitimbol ga li san Uwumbɔr ijawaan la; kitiŋ kee aabɔrb mɔmɔk ga li san waapɔɔn ijawaan la.

ref: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
text: Uwumbɔr yaa ki gir maa Sionn kan, u ga nyan waapɔɔn sakpiin mpaan pu.

ref: and the prayers of the homeless will be answered.
text: U ga ŋun waah yii waanib bi na pu ki pel baameel.

ref: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
text: u ŋun binib bi bi tiyondir ni na aah ker idun pu na, ki gaa baah siin ke bi ku binib bi na lir.

ref: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
text: n‑yoonn mu ŋitimbol ni nnaan mɔmɔk dan ke bi nan kpaan ki doon u na.

ref: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
text: M laa ye unachipɔɔn la, le Uwumbɔr cha maa ki kpa mpɔɔn, u gii maamɔfal pu.

ref: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
text: Uwumbɔr, taa yoor mi buen dandana; cha m por waahr. Uwumbɔr, aa bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la;

ref: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
text: n‑yoonn mu jer na le aa nan naan kitiŋ, ki di aabaa aaŋaal naan paacham.

ref: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
text: Kitiŋ ni paacham ga doo, le aa ma ga li beenin bi; ni mɔmɔk ga kpoi ke ŋibɔkul na, aa ga di ni mae ke kikekekpiik na, ni mɔmɔk ga wɔŋ.

ref: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
text: Le sin ma beenin bi, kaan kpeln, saayoonn aan doo.

ref: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
text: Timi aabilb ga li bi lifuur ni, le aa ga li kii bi, le biyaabitiib ga nan kan ŋŋmarm.

ref: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
text: M joo nsui mɔmɔk pak Uwumbɔr la. M joo nwon mɔmɔk pak waayimbil li bi chain na la.

ref: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
text: M joo nsui mɔmɔk pak Uwumbɔr la, kaan suln waah ŋa mi tiŋann pu na.

ref: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
text: U cha pinn mi maatunwanbir, le ki sɔŋni maaween mɔmɔk.

ref: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
text: U nyani mi nkun ni, le ki joo ngeehm ni linimbaasaln aanyoor ŋani mi.

ref: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
text: U tii mi tiwanyaan ŋmeen la, le m bi, ki pɔɔ, ki kpa mpɔɔn ke likaagiil na.

ref: For all who are mistreated, the Lord brings justice.
text: Uwumbɔr nyi baah muk binib bi na bɔr le ki ter bi ki tii bi baabamɔn.

ref: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
text: U nan di waah ban u tun pu na kpiir mɔk Moses, le ki cha Israel aanib kan waapɔɔn aatun.

ref: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
text: Uwumbɔr ye unimbaasaln la, le ki gee timi, waaŋuul aa fiir woween, le u gee timi sakpen.

ref: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
text: Waa galni binib ki ti cha dik dik, waaŋuul sɔŋni mala mala la.

ref: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
text: Kitiŋ ni kitaapaak aah daa tɔb chee pu na, kina le waageehm wiir binib bi san u na chee.

ref: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
text: Liwipuul ni liwilir aah daa tɔb chee pu na, kina le u nyan timi aatunwanbir ti chee ki di buen dandar.

ref: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
text: Ubo aate aah gee u sakpen pu na, kina le Uwumbɔr gee binib bi san u na.

ref: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
text: Tima kan, timi aamɔfal bi ke timoor na la. Ti muuni woween ki ŋan ke nsupuun na la;

ref: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
text: libuln le daar mu pu, le ki di mu buen; le ubaa aan ki kan mu.

ref: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
text: Uwumbɔr aageehm aa door binib bi san u na ma chee,

ref: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
text: Uwumbɔr di waabɔrjal siin paacham; uma le ye unibɔn ni tiwan mɔmɔk aabɔr.

ref: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
text: Nimi Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib bi pɔɔ sakpen ki kii waah len pu na, ki pel waah len pu na, pak uma Uwumbɔr man.

ref: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
text: Paacham yaab bi kpa mpɔɔn na mɔmɔk, ni nimi waatutum bi ŋani waageehn na, pak Uwumbɔr man.

ref: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
text: Tiwanfuurkaan ni mɔmɔk bi waah joo nin chee mɔmɔk na, pak Uwumbɔr man. M joo nsui mɔmɔk pak Uwumbɔr la.

ref: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
text: M joo nsui mɔmɔk pak Uwumbɔr la. Ndindaan Uwumbɔr, saapɔɔn nyaŋ sakpen a. Aa kpa nnaan aapɔɔn ni nnyuŋ;

ref: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
text: aa ye nwiihn ŋmeen la. Aa taln paacham ke likekeln na la,

ref: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
text: le ki maa saadichal nnyun mu bi paab na aapaacham. Aa di ntaalangbam le ŋa saataan aatɔroku, le ki dik libuln aafeen pu.

ref: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
text: Libuln le ye saatuuntiib, le imiigaal ye saatutum.

ref: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
text: Aa di kitiŋ nyal siin kaabuul ni, le kaan ki foor daalbaadaal.

ref: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
text: Aa di nnyusakpem paan ki pu ke likekeln na, le nnyun biin ŋijoo pu.

ref: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
text: Mu puu labr ŋijoo pu le ki sunni tifatann ni, ki buen saah toor nin chee tii mu na.

ref: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
text: Aa siin mu aanaanmɔk, nin chee mu aan ki ŋmaa jer na, ke mu taa ki ŋmaa biin kitiŋ pu.

ref: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
text: Aa cha uyayak aanyunbun puu tifatann ni, le ŋimɔɔ puu ŋigongon aakaasisik ni.

ref: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
text: Muma le tii ipeel nnyun aan i nyu; nima chee le timoor ni aabon aanyunyuu door.

ref: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
text: Isui i si gbɔk nima chee na ponn ni le inyoon ter yaanyandil ki gaa ilahn.

ref: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
text: Aa cha utaal nya kitaapaak ki lir ni ŋigongon pu, le ki cha kitiŋ kani saanyoor.

ref: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food,
text: Aa cha timoor muuni, le tiwakor kani ki ŋmɔ, ki tii unibɔn njikaabim, muma le u joo ko kisaak ki kani tijikaar,

ref: wine to cheer us up, olive oil for our skin, and grain for our health.
text: ki cha u kani ndaan mu piir usui na, ki tii u olif aasui aakpan mu cha unimbil wɔb ŋan na, ni tijikaar ti ga tii u mpɔɔn na.

ref: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
text: Lebanonn aasantina aasui kani utaal, ima le ye Uwumbɔr ubaa aasui i u bun na.

ref: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
text: Nima chee inyoon ter yaanyandil; le inaakpaapiin mam kpiini yaabim isui i fɔk na ponn ni.

ref: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
text: Ipɔɔŋoob bi ŋijoo ŋi paa na pu la, le ŋijoo paab aalapol bɔrni ŋijootakpal ni.

ref: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
text: Aa naan uŋmal ke u li mɔk iŋmal aawiin; nwiin nyi buyoonn mu ga lir na.

ref: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
text: Sin le naan kinyeek, le ipeel mɔmɔk nya ni mbɔmbɔɔn ni.

ref: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
text: Ichinn yaa chuun ban tinann kan, i ŋuuni, le ki ban tijikaar ti Uwumbɔr tii i na.

ref: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
text: Nwiin yaa ti puu kan, le i gir ti doon yaabuu ni,

ref: then we go out to work until the end of day.
text: le binib nya ki buen baatuln ni, ki ti bi tun, ki ti saa kijook.

ref: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa naan tiwan sakpen a. Aa di nlansakpem le naan ni mɔmɔk, saawanfuurkaan le gbii kitiŋ pu.

ref: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
text: Nnyusakpem bi, le ki waa sakpen; mu ponn ni le tiwanfuurkaan ni wiir sakpen na bi, ni filk na, ni niwaatiir mɔmɔk bi.

ref: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
text: Iŋɔsakpiin chuun mu pu, le nnyun ni aapeesakpiin na gbiir mu ponn ni. Sin le naan nnyun ni aapeesakpiin ngbaan.

ref: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
text: Ni mɔmɔk lik sin pu le ke aa tii ni tijikaar buyoonn ni ban ti na.

ref: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
text: Aa tii ni, le ni ji ti, aa tii ni tijikaar, le ni ji babr.

ref: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
text: Aa yaa fenn siir kan, le ijawaan chuu ni; aa yaa chuu naafuurk kan, le ni kpo, ki gir kpaln titan ti ponn ni ni nyan ni na.

ref: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
text: Tɔ, aa yaa tii ni kifuurk kan, le ni kpaln tiwan ni aa naan na; sin le tii kitiŋ aawan limɔfapɔln.

ref: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
text: Uwumbɔr aapak ga yunn ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Uwumbɔr aasui ga li piin waah naan tiwan ni na pu.

ref: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
text: U yaa lik kitiŋ pu kan, ki jii la; u yaa meeh ŋijoo kan, le iŋmanyuu nya ni.

ref: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
text: Maamɔfal mɔmɔk aayoonn ni, m ga li gaa ilahn tii Uwumbɔr; m ga li gaa ilahn ki pak Maawumbɔr n‑yoonn mumɔk m bi limɔfal ponn ni na.

ref: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
text: Usui li piin maalahn pu, ba pu? maapopiin mɔmɔk nya ni uma chee la.

ref: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
text: U kuln titunwanbirdam mɔmɔk kitiŋ kee pu; bibiindam taa ki li bi kpala. M joo nsui mɔmɔk pak Uwumbɔr la. Pak Uwumbɔr man.

ref: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
text: Di idoon tii Uwumbɔr man, moon waah kpa mpɔɔn pu na man; bui ŋitimbol waah tun ŋitun ŋi na man.

ref: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
text: Gaa ilahn ki pak Uwumbɔr man; ki tuk binib waah tun ŋitukpaan ŋi na.

ref: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.
text: Taah ye waanib pu na, cha tisui li piin man; Cha binib bimɔk dooni u na li kpa mpopiin.

ref: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.
text: Li cha Uwumbɔr chee ti ban nterm man; ki li dooni u n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
text: Nimi waatutunn Abraham aayaabitiib, nimi bi ye Jakob aayaabitiib bi u nyan bi na, teer Uwumbɔr aah tun lijinjiir aatun ŋi na, ni waah nan jin binib tibɔr pu na man.

ref: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
text: Uwumbɔr le ye Tidindaan, waakaal ye dulnyaa wee mɔmɔk aakaal la.

ref: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
text: U ga li joo waah puu tipuur ti na ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob,
text: Uwumbɔr puu tipuur ti kaa kpa ndoon na tii Jakob.

ref: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
text: U bui ke, “M ga di Kanaann aatiŋ tii si, ki ga li ye saatiŋ la.”

ref: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
text: Uwumbɔr aanib aa nan wiir, le ki ye biwɔwɔm Kanaann aatiŋ ni.

ref: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
text: Uwumbɔr aa nan cha ubaa muk bi; waah nan ban u li kii bi pu na, le u nan sak bibɔrb ke,

ref: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
text: “Taa tii maatutum titotonn man; taa meeh maabɔnabtiib man.”

ref: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
text: Uwumbɔr nan tun ni nkon baatiŋ pu, ki chuu gaa baajikaar mɔmɔk.

ref: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
text: Bi nan di tikululn gbin utaa, ki di tikur aabuen leen usil

ref: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
text: ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu u nan puu ke tiwan ni ga ŋa na gbiin kina. Uwumbɔr aamɔboln nan mɔk ke u sil ye ubamɔndaan.

ref: Then the king of Egypt set Joseph free
text: Le Ijipt aabɔr cha u kan ubaa; ŋitimbol aajojoor ngbaan gaa u lii.

ref: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
text: U nan di tininkpir tii u ki cha u ye kitiŋ ngbaan kookoo aabɔr,

ref: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
text: ki kpa mpɔɔn ki lik ubɔr aaninkpiib, ki kpa mpɔɔn ke u bui ubɔr aasusurb baah ga ŋa pu na.

ref: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
text: Le Jakob nan buen Ijipt ki ti kal nima.

ref: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
text: Uwumbɔr nan cha waanib pɔr pam, ki cha bi kpa mpɔɔn jer baadim.

ref: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
text: U nan cha Ijipt yaab nann waanib ki ŋmanni bi.

ref: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
text: Le u nan tun waatutunn Moses, ni Aaronn, u u nan lee u na.

ref: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
text: Uwumbɔr nan cha bi tun waatukpaan ki tun iwaan aatun Ijipt aatiŋ ni.

ref: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
text: Baa nan yii waamɔb. Uwumbɔr nan cha mbɔmbɔɔn biin kitiŋ ngbaan pu,

ref: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
text: U nan cha baamɔɔ aanyun kpaln nsin ki ku baajan mɔmɔk.

ref: Frogs were everywhere, even in the royal palace.
text: Ŋipulaatal nan gaa baatiŋ, hali ki ti kpaan gbiin libɔrchiln ni mu.

ref: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
text: Uwumbɔr nan di umɔb len, le tisibir ni tinaapulor gbiin kitiŋ ngbaan mɔmɔk ni.

ref: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
text: U nan cha ŋitaanal lir, ki cha utaal moor kitiŋ ngbaan ni, kaa cha utaal nun.

ref: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
text: U nan bii baadaan aasubil ni ŋisubil ŋiken aasui, ki kool isui mɔmɔk lir.

ref: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
text: U nan di waamɔb le len, le itoon churbakaa u kaa kpa nkahm na dan.

ref: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
text: I nan di timoor ni tisufar ti mɔmɔk bi kitiŋ ngbaan pu na ŋman; i nan ŋman baajikaar mɔmɔk pel pel.

ref: Then God took the life of every first-born son.
text: U nan ku Ijipt aadichadaan mɔmɔk aajan aabijabim,

ref: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
text: le ki nin cheen Israel yaab nyan kitiŋ ngbaan ponn ni. Bi nan tu tikunabr ni salmaa mam, le bi mɔmɔk kpa laafee ki pɔɔ.

ref: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.
text: Uwumbɔr nan di ntaalangbam le biin waanib pu, ki tii bi mmii kinyeek ke mu tii bi nwiihn.

ref: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.
text: Bi nan mee Uwumbɔr le u cha ichakpee dan; u nan cha tijikaar nyan ni paacham ke bi nan ji ki bab.

ref: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
text: U nan chuu piir litakpal, le nnyun chee nyan ni, ki puu nteersakpiin ni ke limɔɔl na.

ref: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
text: U nan teer waah nan puu tipuukpaan ti tii waatutunn Abraham na.

ref: When the Lord rescued his chosen people from Egypt, they celebrated with songs.
text: Kina le u nan cheen waanib bi u gann bi na nyan, le bi nan gaa ilahn ki tar mpopiin pu.

ref: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
text: U nan di binib biken aatim tii bi, ki cha bi gaa baakpaakon,

ref: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: aan ni cha bi kii waamɔb ki li joo waakaal. Pak Uwumbɔr man.

ref: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr man. Doon Uwumbɔr man, ba pu? u kpa tiŋann; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
text: Ŋma ga ŋmaa bee waah tun ŋitukpaan ŋi na? Kipak kibaa aa bi ki ga ŋeer u.

ref: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
text: Binib bi keei waamɔb ki ŋani ni ŋan na n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na kpa mpopiin la.

ref: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
text: Cha m kan saah tii saanib liwangol li na, ki mu kan mpopiin mu aa di tii saatimbol na, ki kan binib bi ye saanib na aapopiin aamakl.

ref: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
text: Tiyaajatiib aah nan bi Ijipt aatiŋ ni na, baa nan bee Uwumbɔr aatukpaan aatataa; bi nan suln waah mɔk bi waageehm kaa ti ki nyi mumɔk pu na, le ki yii waamɔb Limɔɔkal Aanyusakpem na chee.

ref: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
text: Tɔ, waah nan puu pu na, u nan gaa bi lii, ke ni mɔk waah kpa mpɔɔn sakpiin mu na.

ref: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
text: U nan di umɔb le tuk Limɔɔkal Aanyusakpem ngbaan, le mu foor, le u cha waanib chuun kitikuun pu ki puur.

ref: and drowned every one of their enemies.
text: Tɔ, baadim ma nan tee bee nnyun ni; ubaa kina aa nan gur.

ref: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.
text: Le waanib nan tii waah puu tipuur ti na naadii, ki gaa ilahn ki pak u.

ref: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.
text: Tɔ, naa yunn le bi kpaan suln waah tun pu na, le kaa sɔŋ bisui ke u sur bi, le ki ŋani baageehn.

ref: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
text: Le nteersakpiin ngbaan ni, kikpeek cha bi tɔŋ Uwumbɔr;

ref: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
text: le u tii bi baah ban pu na, ki mu ki cha iween sakpiin ibaa lir bi pu.

ref: Everyone in camp was jealous of Moses and of Aaron, your chosen priest.
text: Nteersakpiin ngbaan ni le bi nan kpa lipiipoln Moses ni Aaronn u Uwumbɔr nan lee u na pu,

ref: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
text: le kitiŋ chuu piir ki di Datann nab, ki biin Abiram ni waadichal pu;

ref: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
text: le mmii ker lir ni baadidiliib pu le ki wun ku bibiindam ngbaan.

ref: At Horeb your people made and worshiped the statue
text: Sainai aajoo chee le bi nan di salmaa naan unaajabo le ki dooni liwaal ngbaan;

ref: of a bull, instead of you, their glorious God.
text: bi nan di Uwumbɔr aapak tii kiwakork ki ŋmɔ timoor na aanaŋ.

ref: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you
text: Bi suln Uwumbɔr u nan di waapɔɔn sakpiin tun ŋitun Ijipt aatiŋ ni ki gaa bi lii na aabɔr.

ref: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.
text: Uwumbɔr aah nan bui ke u ga kuln waanib na, waatutunn Moses, u u nan lee u na aa nan kii kina; u nan kiir Uwumbɔr, le waaŋuul aa kuln bi.

ref: They would not trust you, Lord, and they did not like the promised land.
text: Le bi nan yii mmɔɔn aatiŋ; ba pu? baa nan pak ke Uwumbɔr ga ŋa waah puu tipuur ti na.

ref: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
text: Bi nan gaar baakakar ponn ni le ki ŋulni, kaa pel Uwumbɔr aah len pu na.

ref: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
text: Kina pu le u nan sak bi mbamɔm ke u ga cha bi kpoi nteersakpiin ngbaan ni,

ref: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
text: Peor aatiŋ ni, le Uwumbɔr aanib ti kpee binib bi dooni liwaal Baal na pu, le ki jin baah di tiwan ni toor tii ŋiwaa ŋi po ye unibɔn aawanaankaan na.

ref: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
text: Baatun le nan fiin Uwumbɔr aaŋuul, le iween i bir sakpen na lir ni bikaasisik ni.

ref: At Meribah Spring they turned against you and made you furious.
text: Meriba aanyunbun chee le binib ngbaan nan ki cha Uwumbɔr aaŋuul fii. Bi pu, Moses nan koo tibɔr ni.

ref: Our Lord, they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.
text: Uwumbɔr aah nan bui ke bi ku binib bi kaa nyi u na, baa nan ŋa kina,

ref: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
text: bi tee labr, le bi ni bima yoor tɔb aabim, le ki gaa binib ngbaan aabimbin,

ref: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
text: le ki dooni ŋiwaa, le nimina kuln bi.

ref: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
text: Bi nan di bijapɔtiib ni bibisatiib toor kitork tii kinimbɔŋ.

ref: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
text: Binikurb ngbaan aah nan ku mbim mu kaa tun taani ubaa na, le ni bii kitiŋ ngbaan.

ref: By doing such gruesome things, they also became filthy.
text: Baatun nan cha bi ŋa bibaa tijɔŋdam, le kaa ki si Uwumbɔr aapuwɔb.

ref: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
text: Le Uwumbɔr aaŋuul nan fii bima waanib pu; bi nan gur sukr uponn ni la.

ref: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
text: Le u siir cha bi, ki di bi ŋa binib bi kaa nyi u na aapɔɔn ni, le baadim gur joo bi.

ref: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies,
text: Baadim nan muk bi, le bi kpaln baanaagbiib.

ref: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
text: N‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, Uwumbɔr nan gaal waanib lir la, le bi yii, ki ki nyan upuwɔb ki moo koo titunwanbir ni.

ref: that their enemies had pity on them.
text: U nan cha binib bimɔk muk bi na san bi kinimbaak.

ref: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr, gaa timi lii, ki nyan ni timi ŋitimbol ngbaan ni ki giin ni, aan ti ga li kpa idoon ki pak saayimbil li bi chain na.

ref: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
text: Pak Uwumbɔr u ye Israel yaab Aadindaan na man; li pak u dandana, ni n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Cha unii mɔmɔk len ke, “Amii”. Pak Uwumbɔr man. ŊMUŊMU AAGBAŊ (Ilahn

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
text: “Uwumbɔr aah kpa tiŋann pu na, ni di idoon tii u, waageehm aa kpa ndoon.”

ref: Everyone the Lord has rescued from trouble should praise him,
text: Nimi bi mɔmɔk kan waaŋmarm na, di tibɔbaan ngbaan giin pak u man. U gaa nimi, nimi aadim chee lii,

ref: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
text: ki nyan nimi ntiyayam ni ki giin ni nimi, nimi aatiŋ ni; u nyan ni nimi liwipuul ni liwilir wɔb, ki nyan ni nimi ŋŋangan ni ŋŋangii wɔb.

ref: Some of you were lost in the scorching desert, far from a town.
text: Bibaa nan chuun yiini nteersakpiin mu kaa kpa isan na, kaa kan kitiŋ ki ponn ni bi ga li koo na.

ref: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
text: Nkon ni nnyunyuu nan chuu bi, le biwon mɔmɔk yɔl.

ref: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
text: Le baamukl ni, bi yin Uwumbɔr, le u nyan bi baafalaa ngbaan ni.

ref: At once he brought you to a town.
text: U nan di bi buen kitiŋ ki ponn ni bi ga ti li koo na.

ref: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
text: Ni ŋan ke bi doon Uwumbɔr waageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu, ni ŋitukpaan ŋi u tun tii bi na pu.

ref: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
text: U tii nnyunyuu aah joo binib bi na nnyun, le ki tii nkon aah joo binib bi na tijikaar ti ŋan na.

ref: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
text: Binib bibaa nan bi mpombiin, ni mbɔmbɔɔn ni, ki ye biyom, ki bi tikululn aafalaa ni,

ref: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
text: ba pu? bi nan yii Uwumbɔr u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na aakaal, ki yii waah mɔk bi pu na.

ref: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
text: Le litupɔɔl nan cha bi diŋ; bi nan lir, le ubaa aa bi ki ter bi.

ref: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
text: Le baamukl ponn ni bi yin Uwumbɔr, le u nyan bi baafalaa ngbaan ni.

ref: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
text: U nan nyan bi baapombiin ni mbɔmbɔɔn ni, ki geei baakululn na yuk yuk.

ref: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
text: Ni ŋan ke bi di idoon tii Uwumbɔr, waageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu, ni ŋitukpaan ŋi u tun tii bi na pu.

ref: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
text: U gbaa wiil tikumann aajaaleŋ mam, ki gbaa wɔi tikur aadɔ.

ref: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
text: Binib bibaa nan ye bijɔrb, le ki ji baatunwanbir aafalaa le baabiin aatun pu;

ref: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
text: baa nan gee ke binimbil kan tijikaar, le nkon ti ban mu ku bi.

ref: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
text: Le baamukl ponn ni bi yin Uwumbɔr, le u nyan bi baafalaa ni.

ref: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
text: U nan di waamɔboln le tii bi laafee, ki nyan bi nkun ponn ni.

ref: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
text: Ni ŋan ke bi di idoon tii Uwumbɔr, waageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu, ni ŋitukpaan ŋi u tun tii bi na pu.

ref: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
text: Ni ŋan ke bi di kitork aapiin tii u idoon, ki di mpopiin aalahn len waah tun pu na mɔmɔk.

ref: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea,
text: Bibaa nan koo iŋɔi ni ki puur nnyusakpem, nnyusakpem ponn ni, le baajikaar nan nyan ni.

ref: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
text: Bi kan Uwumbɔr aah ga ŋmaa tun waatukpaan ŋi nnyusakpem pu na.

ref: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
text: U nan di umɔb le len, le libusakpeln piin ki bi daar le ki fiin tinyunkpenn.

ref: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
text: Iŋɔi nan fii paacham paacham ki gir nan lir nnyonyoon ponn ni, kina aanimaln ponn ni le biŋɔŋaab aataakpab yɔl.

ref: You staggered like drunkards and gave up all hope.
text: Biwon nan gbaa, le bi chuun gbeer ke bidagbiirb na, baah nan kpa nlan mu na bee fam.

ref: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
text: Le baamukl ponn ni bi yin Uwumbɔr, le u nyan bi baafalaa ni.

ref: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
text: U nan cha kitaabuŋ ŋmin chii, le tinyunkpenn doon suuna.

ref: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
text: Bisui nan piir kina pu, le u cha bi di baaŋɔi ti fuu baah cha nin chee na.

ref: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
text: Ni ŋan ke bi di idoon tii uma Uwumbɔr, waageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu, ni ŋitukpaan ŋi u tun tii bi na pu.

ref: Honor the Lord when you and your leaders meet to worship.
text: Ni ŋan ke bi moon waah kpa mpɔɔn pu na, kinipaak aah kuun nin chee na, ki pak u bininkpiib aakuun ni.

ref: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
text: Uwumbɔr cha ŋimɔɔ foor pel pel ki kuur, ki cha inyunbun aa ki bun.

ref: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.
text: U cha kitiŋ ki kpa tijikaar na kpaln nteersakpiin, bibiindam bi koo nima chee na pu.

ref: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
text: U kpeln nteersakpiin ŋa tibɔr ti kpa nnyun na ki cha kitikuun kpaln inyunbun i puu na aatiŋ.

ref: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
text: U cha nkon aah joo binib bi na kun nima chee, le ki maa kitiŋ ki koo nima.

ref: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
text: Bi nan kon ikpaakon ki ŋum ŋisubil aasui ki nan kan tijikaar sakpen.

ref: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
text: U nan ŋa waanyoor ŋa waanib pu, le bi ma mbim pam, ki cha baawakor moo pɔr.

ref: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
text: Bidim aah nan nyaŋ Uwumbɔr aanib ki joo mbiin ni falaa jinni bi inimɔɔn ni na,

ref: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
text: u nan lik seen binib bi muk bi na, ki cha bi chuun yiini nteersakpiin mu kaa kpa isan na ponn ni.

ref: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.
text: Tɔ, u nan nyan binib bi kaa kpa na baanimbaak ni, ki cha baadichal pɔr ke ipiih na.

ref: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na kani kina, le ni mɔ bi, le bibiindam ma ŋmin chii.

ref: Be wise! Remember this and think about the kindness of the Lord.
text: Cha binib bi kpa nlan na li dakl lik timina; Cha bi dakl lik Uwumbɔr aageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na.

ref: Our God, I am faithful to you with all my heart, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you with all that I am.
text: Uwumbɔr, m kpa limakl. M ga gaa ilahn ki pak si. M ga fii sil,

ref: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
text: ki ga moo pel maabar. M ga gaa ilahn lichakpitaawoln.

ref: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
text: Uwumbɔr, m ga doon si ŋitimbol ni. M ga pak si binib ni.

ref: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
text: Saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na chaar jer paacham; le saaŋann fuur kitaapaak.

ref: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
text: Uwumbɔr, mɔk saah pɔɔ sakpen pu na kitaapaak ni, ki mɔk saapak kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk pu.

ref: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
text: Ŋun maameel, ki di saapɔɔn gaa timi lii, aan saah gee binib bi na ŋmar.

ref: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
text: Uwumbɔr bi waadichal li bi chain na ni ki len ke, “M ga di linyaŋ yakr Sekem aatiŋ, ki yakr Sukof aafataŋ tii maanib.

ref: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
text: Gilead ni Manase aatim ye min yaan la, Efraim aatiŋ le ye maakur aayikpupuk, le Juda ye maabɔr aajaangbeek.

ref: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
text: Uwumbɔr, ŋma ga di mi buen kitiŋ ki bi maa ŋigon gob ki na ponn ni? Ŋma ga cheen mi Edom aatiŋ ponn ni?

ref: Have you rejected us? You don't lead our armies.
text: Aa sil yii timi la aa? Saan ki dii timi aajab buen butɔb ni ii?

ref: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
text: Ter timi, timi aadim chee; unibɔn aaterm aa ye nibaa.

ref: Only you give us victory and crush our enemies.
text: Uwumbɔr yaa bi ti chee kan, ti ga nyaŋ, u ga nyaŋ timi aadim.

ref: I praise you, God! Don't keep silent.
text: Uwumbɔr, m pak si la, taa li ŋmin.

ref: Destructive and deceitful lies are told about me,
text: Bibiindam ni binyamɔndam tak mi la, bi gee inyamɔn paani mi la,

ref: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
text: M gee bi, ki mee Uwumbɔr tii bi, le baa lik waa kina, ki galn mi.

ref: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
text: Bi joo mbiin le pa mi maaŋann pu, ki joo kinanaŋ pa mi maah gee bi pu na.

ref: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
text: Nyan ubeebeedaan ubaa aan u ji maadin tibɔr, ki cha waadin ubaa galn u.

ref: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
text: Cha bi ji u tibɔr ki len ke waabɔr bii; cha waameel li ye tibɔbir aa chee.

ref: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
text: Cha waamɔfal kuln dandana; cha uja uken gaa waatuln.

ref: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
text: Cha waabim kpaln nkpobim, ki cha upuu kpaln ukpopii.

ref: make his children beg for food and live in the slums.
text: Cha waabim kpaln biwanmeeb bi kaa kpa do na; Cha bi jenn nyan bi baah koo tilangbenn ti ponn ni na.

ref: “Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.
text: Cha waah joo binib bi aapɔln na gaa waawangol mɔmɔk, ki cha biwɔwɔm gaa waah tun ki kan tiwan ni mɔmɔk na.

ref: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
text: Taa cha ubaa li kpa u pu tiŋann, ki taa cha ubaa kpiin waakpobim bi gaar puwɔb na.

ref: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
text: Cha uyaabitiib mɔmɔk kpo, ki cha n‑yoonn mu choo na yaab suln waayimbil bɔr.

ref: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
text: Uwumbɔr, teer uyaajatiib aatunwanbir bɔr, ki taa cha una aatunwanbir pinn u kpala.

ref: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
text: Cha Uwumbɔr li teer baatunwanbir bɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, ki tee cha ubaa taa ki teer bima bɔr kpala.

ref: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.
text: Uja ngbaan aa dakl daalbaadaal ke u ŋa binib tiŋann; u nan muk binib le ki ku bigiim ni bifalaadam, ni binib bi kaa kpa nterm na.

ref: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
text: U nan gee timɔpur, kina pu na, cha bi puun timɔpur lii u pu. Waa nan gee ke u mee Uwumbɔr aanyoor ŋa ubaa pu, kina pu na, ubaa mu taa mee Uwumbɔr aanyoor ŋa u pu.

ref: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
text: U nan puuni timɔpur ke waah peeni tiwan pu na la; cha ubaa aamɔpur gir ni u pu ke nnyun aah sɔŋni tiwan pu na, ki koo waakpab ni ke nkpan na.

ref: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
text: Cha ti biin u pu ke tiwanpeenkaan na, ki mann goln u ke waah buu ligbapapaln le na.

ref: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
text: Uwumbɔr, daa maadim bi len tibɔbir m pu na aatafal kina.

ref: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
text: Ndindaan Uwumbɔr, tee ter mi ke saah nan puu ke aa ga ŋa pu na, ki gaa mi lii saageehm nyaan sakpem pu.

ref: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
text: M ye ugiin le kaa kpa nibaa, maamuk ti dɔ nsui ni taab taab la.

ref: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
text: M bi ke kijook aajunjuŋ na la, le ki ban m wɔŋ; libuln daa mi buen ke unaaduun na la.

ref: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
text: Maah kaa ki ji tijikaar na, le ntaaŋaayil yɔl, m gur ye igban ni ikpab ŋmeen la,

ref: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
text: Binib yaa kan mi kan, bi laa mi la, le ki ŋani mi mbɔnyun ki gbakr biyil.

ref: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
text: Ndindaan Uwumbɔr, ter mi; saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu, gaa mi lii,

ref: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
text: Cha maadim bee ke sin le gaal mi lir.

ref: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
text: Bi ga li puuni timɔpur lir m pu, le aa ma ga li ŋani saanyoor ŋani m pu. Cha binib bi muk mi na lir, ki cha min, saatutunn, kan mpopiin.

ref: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
text: Cha maadim kpaln inimɔɔn aanib; cha inimɔɔn li ye baawanpeenkaan.

ref: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
text: M ga doon Uwumbɔr mpɔɔn pu; m ga pak u binib aah kuun nin chee na,

ref: You help everyone in need, and you save them from death.
text: ba pu? uma le kii ugiin ki gaal u binib bi siin ke bi ku u na chee lir.

ref: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
text: Uwumbɔr bui ndindaan ke, “Kaln ŋŋangii wɔb ki ti saa buyoonn m ga di saadim mɔmɔk ŋa aataapɔtan ni na.”

ref: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
text: Uwumbɔr ga taln saanaan aapɔɔn ki nya Sionn ni. U ki len ke, “Li ye saadim aajojoor.”

ref: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
text: Nwiin mundaal aa ga tak saadim na, saanib ga nya sil ki ter si bibaa pu la. Saanachipɔm ga dan aa chee ŋijoo ŋi bi chain na pu ke kichakpiik ni aamaln na la.

ref: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
text: Uwumbɔr puu tipuukpaan, kaan kpeln ti ke, “Aa ga li ye utotoor ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na ke Melkisedek aah nan ye pu na la.”

ref: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
text: Tidindaan bi aaŋangii wɔb; waaŋuul yaa fii kan, u ga nyaŋ bibɔrb.

ref: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
text: U ga ji ŋitimbol tibɔr, ki cha baah to butɔb nin chee na kpaln ŋinikpol ŋmeen; u ga nyaŋ bibɔrb, kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk pu.

ref: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
text: Ubɔr ngbaan ga nyu nnyun nkpen mu bi nsan chee na, aan ki moo pɔɔk ki kan linyaŋ.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr man. M ga di nsui mɔmɔk pak Uwumbɔr, waanib aah kuun nin chee na.

ref: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
text: Uwumbɔr aah tun ŋitun ŋi na nyaŋ a. Binib bi mɔmɔk aasui piir ŋi pu na ban ke bi bee ŋaatataa.

ref: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
text: Waah tun ni mɔmɔk na kpa kipak ni nnaan aapɔɔn la; waabimbinyaan aa kpa ndoon.

ref: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
text: Uwumbɔr cha ti teer waatukpaan na pu, u kpa tiŋann le ki san kinimbaak mu.

ref: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
text: U tii binib bi nyuŋni u na tijikaar; waa suln waah puu tipuur ti na bɔr.

ref: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
text: Waah gaa biwɔwɔm aatiŋ tii waanib pu na, le u mɔk bi waapɔɔn.

ref: They are true and right and will stand forever.
text: Waakaal aa kpa ndoon; yaabimbin ŋan le ki ye ibamɔn.

ref: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
text: U gaa waanib lii ki puu tipuur ti kaa kpa ndoon na tii bi. U bi chain le ki kpa mpɔɔn.

ref: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
text: Aa yaa ban aa li kpa nlan kan, nyuŋ Uwumbɔr; u tii binib bi keei waamɔb na nlan. Ni ŋan ke ti pak u n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr man. Unii umɔk nyuŋni Uwumbɔr ki gee ke u li joo waakaal na kpa mpopiin.

ref: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
text: Uninyaan aabim ga li kpa mpɔɔn kitiŋ pu; uyaabitiib ga kan tinyoor.

ref: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
text: Waadichal ga li kpa liwangol ni ŋimombil, le u ga li ye uwankpadaan n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
text: Bininyaam yaa bi mbɔmbɔɔn ni kan, ni ye nwiihn ŋmeen la; ni ye nwiihn ki tii binib bi san kinimbaak, ki kpa tiŋann, ki si chob na.

ref: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
text: Unii u pinn biken tiwan, kaa san ijawaan, kaa kpa beebee waatuln ni na kpa mpopiin.

ref: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
text: Uninyaan aan ŋmaa lir daalbaadaal; bi ga li teer u bɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
text: Bi yaa tuk u nsuubiin aabɔr kan, naa chur u ijawaan; u kpa gaakii u pɔɔ na, le ki kpa Uwumbɔr pu limakl.

ref: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
text: Waa san ijawaan, le nibaa aa muk u; u ga sil kan ke waadim lir.

ref: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
text: U tii binib bi kaa kpa na, ni usui mɔmɔk la, le waaŋann aa kpa ndoon; u ga li kpa mpɔɔn ni kipak.

ref: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
text: Bibiindam kani kina, le baaŋuul fiir; bi gbee ŋiningbee le ki siir mala; baamakl mɔmɔk doo a.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr man. Nimi Uwumbɔr aatutum, pak waayimbil man.

ref: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
text: Bi li pak waayimbil n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr aayimbil man, ki nya liwipuul ki ti saa liwilir.

ref: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
text: Uwumbɔr le ye ŋitimbol mɔmɔk aajojoor; waah kpa kipak ki na jer paacham.

ref: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
text: Ubaa aa bi ke Tidindaan Uwumbɔr na. U koo paacham paacham la,

ref: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
text: le ki tee gbuuni taab ki lik ni kitaapaak ni kitiŋ.

ref: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
text: U fiini bigiim bi dɔ titan ni na siini paacham; ki nyani binib bi kaa kpa tiwan na baanimbaak ni,

ref: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
text: ki joo bi ŋani biyidam aajɔtiib, binib bi ye waanib na aajojoob aajɔtiib.

ref: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: U nyuŋni upii u kaa kpa ubo na waadichal ni; u tii u mbim, le usui piir. Pak Uwumbɔr man.

ref: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
text: Israel yaab aah nan nyan Ijipt aatiŋ ni na, bima Jakob aayaabitiib aah nan nyan kiwɔwɔtiŋ ngbaan ni buyoonn na,

ref: He made Judah his holy place and ruled over Israel.
text: le Juda yaab nan kpaln Uwumbɔr aanib bi u bi bikaasisik ni na, Israel yaab nan kpaln Uwumbɔr yaab.

ref: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
text: Nnyusakpem Mamam nan lik le ki san; le Jɔɔdann Aamɔɔl sil kaa ki puu.

ref: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
text: Ŋijoo nan yuk ja ja ke iŋoob na; le ŋigongon yuk ke ipihbi na.

ref: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
text: Nnyunsakpem, ba nan ŋa aan aa san? Jɔɔdann aamɔɔl, ba nan ŋa aan aa sil kaa ki puu?

ref: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
text: Kitiŋ, li jii; ba pu? Uwumbɔr choo, Uwumbɔr u tiyaaja Jakob mu nan dii u na,

ref: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
text: Uwumbɔr u kpelni ŋitakpal ŋani nnyun, ki kpelni ŋijootakpal ŋani inyunbun i puu na, li jii uma aanimbiin ni.

ref: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
text: Uwumbɔr, sin baanja, sin baanja, kaa ye timi, le ti ga tii kipak; ba pu? aa kpa ngeehm n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, ki ŋani saah puu ke aa ga ŋa pu na.

ref: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
text: Ŋitimbol aa kpa nsan ke ŋi baa timi ke, “Nimi Aawumbɔr bi la chee?”

ref: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
text: Timi Aawumbɔr bi paacham la; u ŋani waah gee pu na.

ref: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold.
text: Bima kan, bi di tikunabr ni salmaa le naan baawaa, unibɔn aaŋaal le naan ŋi.

ref: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
text: Ŋi kpa imɔi le kaa tee ŋmaa len, ki kpa ŋinimbil, kaa tee waa.

ref: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
text: Ŋi kpa ŋitafal, kaa tee ŋun, ki kpa ŋimɔfal, kaa tee ŋun nnunun.

ref: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
text: Ŋi kpa iŋaal, kaa tee ŋmaa chur tiwan, ki kpa ŋitaa, kaa tee ŋmaa chuun; ŋaan ŋmaa faa kifuuk.

ref: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
text: Cha binib bi mɔmɔk naan ŋi ki kpa ŋi pu limakl na li gur bi ke ŋiwaa ŋi bi naan na.

ref: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
text: Nimi Israel aanib, li kpa Uwumbɔr pu limakl man. U ter nimi, le ki kii nimi.

ref: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
text: Nimi Uwumbɔr aatotoorb, li kpa limakl Uwumbɔr pu man. U ter nimi, le ki kii nimi.

ref: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
text: Nimi bimɔk dooni u na, li kpa limakl Uwumbɔr pu man. U ter nimi, le ki kii nimi.

ref: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
text: Uwumbɔr teer ti bɔr le ki ga ŋa waanyoor ŋa ti pu; u ga ŋa waanyoor ŋa Israel aanib pu ki ŋa waatotoorb mɔmɔk pu waanyoor.

ref: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
text: U ga ŋa waanyoor ŋa binib bi mɔmɔk nyuŋni u na pu, binikpaam ni biwaatiib mɔmɔk pu.

ref: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
text: Uwumbɔr u naan paacham ni kitiŋ na ŋa waanyoor ŋa ni pu.

ref: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
text: Uwumbɔr baanja le yeh paacham, le u tee di kitiŋ tii unibɔn.

ref: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord,
text: Bitekpiib le aa pak Uwumbɔr, unii umɔk sunn buen kitekpiitiŋ ni na aa pak u,

ref: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: le timi bi fu na ma ga di idoon tii u; ti ga doon u dandana ni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Pak Uwumbɔr man.

ref: I love you, Lord! You answered my prayers.
text: Uwumbɔr aah ŋun maayim pu na, le m gee u, u pel maameel,

ref: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
text: n‑yoonn mumɔk m yin u na kan, u pel m chee la.

ref: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
text: Nkun aanimaln nan mann goln mi; le likaakul aajawaan gob mi siin; ijawaan sakpiin le nan chuu mi,

ref: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
text: le m yin Uwumbɔr, m nan bui ke, “Uwumbɔr, m gaŋ si, gaa mi lii.”

ref: You are kind, Lord, so good and merciful.
text: Uwumbɔr san kinimbaak le ki kpa tiŋann; timi Aawumbɔr ye unimbaasaln la.

ref: You protect ordinary people, and when I was helpless, you saved me
text: Uwumbɔr le kii binib bi kaa kpa nterm na; maah nan bi limukl ni na, u nan nyan mi.

ref: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
text: Uwumbɔr aah kpa m pu tiŋann pu na, le m kpa nsuudoon.

ref: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
text: Uwumbɔr nyan mi nkun ni; u pir maanyunyunn, kaa cha m lir.

ref: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
text: Kina pu na, m bi Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni le dulnyaa aanib ponn ni.

ref: I was faithful to you when I was suffering,
text: Buyoonn m nan bui ke, “M doo kookoo a” na, m nan beenin mak u pu,

ref: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
text: Ba aan m ga di tii Uwumbɔr, waaŋann sakpenn tee pu?

ref: I will pour out an offering of wine to you, and I will pray in your name because you have saved me.
text: Uwumbɔr aah gaa mi lii pu na, m joo ni ndaan aapiin ki nan dooni u.

ref: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.
text: Waanib mɔmɔk aanimbil ni le m ga tii u maah puu ke m ga tii u ni na.

ref: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
text: Uwumbɔr aanii ubaa yaa kpo kan, ni wu u sakpen.

ref: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
text: Uwumbɔr, m ye saatutunn la; m tun saatuln ke nna aah nan tun pu na la. Aa nyan mi nkun ni.

ref: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
text: M ga tii si idoon aapiin, ki di maameel tii si.

ref: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
text: Ŋitimbol mɔmɔk, pak Uwumbɔr man. Binib mɔmɔk, pak Uwumbɔr man.

ref: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Waah kpa ngeehm mu ti pu na pɔɔ pam, u ye mbamɔndaan n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la. Pak Uwumbɔr man.

ref: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
text: Uwumbɔr aah kpa tiŋann pu na, ni li dooni u man; waageehm bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Let Israel shout, “God is always merciful!”
text: Cha Israel aanib len ke, “Waageehm bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.”

ref: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
text: Cha Uwumbɔr aatotoorb len ke, “Waageehm bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.”

ref: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
text: Cha binib bi mɔmɔk dooni u na len ke, “Waageehm bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.”

ref: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
text: Buyoonn nsui nan bii na, le m nan yin Uwumbɔr, le u nan kii maayim ki gaa mi lii.

ref: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
text: Uwumbɔr bi m chee, kina pu na, maan san ijawaan; ubaa aan ŋmaa ŋa mi nibaa.

ref: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
text: Uwumbɔr le ye u ter mi na, le m ga kan maadim aah ga lir pu na.

ref: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
text: Aa yaa mak Uwumbɔr pu kan, ni ŋan jer ke aa li mak unibɔn pu.

ref: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
text: Bidim pam le nan mann goln mi; le m nan di Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn doo bi mɔmɔk.

ref: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
text: Bi nan mann goln mi ŋipepel mɔmɔk, le m di Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn doo bi mɔmɔk.

ref: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
text: Bi nan san gonni mi ke inangbee na la, le bi mɔmɔk wun mala ke mmii aah wu ikokon pu na; m nan di Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn le doo bi.

ref: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
text: Bi nan di tijar le tak mi ki ban bi nyaŋ mi, le Uwumbɔr tee ter mi.

ref: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
text: Uwumbɔr tii mi mpɔɔn sakpiin, u gaa mi lii.

ref: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
text: Li pel Uwumbɔr aanib aakookoo yaan ponn ni linyaŋ aapopiin aafuuk aah nyani pu na ke, “Uwumbɔr di waapɔɔnsakpiin na nyaŋ;

ref: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
text: waapɔɔn joo ni timi linyaŋ; waapɔɔnsakpiin mu u joo to butɔb na le nyaŋ kina.”

ref: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
text: Maan kpo, m ga li kpa limɔfal, le ki moon Uwumbɔr aah tun pu na aabɔr.

ref: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
text: U daa ntafal sakpen a; u mu aa tee cha m kpo.

ref: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
text: Chuu piir Uwumbɔr Aadichal aabisamɔi tii mi; m ga koo li ponn ni le ki ti doon u.

ref: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
text: Uwumbɔr aabisamɔb sɔ; binib bi aabimbin ŋan na baanja le ga ŋmaa koo ni.

ref: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa ŋun maayim pu ki tii mi linyaŋ, nima pu le m pak si.

ref: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
text: Litakpal li bidimaab yii li na, lima le ye litakpajal.

ref: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
text: Uwumbɔr le ŋa kina, li ni gar timi pam.

ref: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
text: Uwumbɔr aanyaŋ aawiin daal le na; cha ti li kpa mpopiin, cha ti li mɔɔni man.

ref: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
text: Uwumbɔr, gaa timi lii. Uwumbɔr, tii timi linyaŋ.

ref: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
text: Tinyoor bi unii u choo Uwumbɔr aayimbil pu na. Ti bi Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni le ki mee waanyoor ŋani nimi pu.

ref: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
text: Uwumbɔr ye Tidindaan la, u kpa ti pu tiŋann. Bar isubon ŋa niŋaal ni man, ki piin kitork aajim ngbaan, ki chuun mann goln kitork aabimbiln.

ref: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
text: Aa ye Maawumbɔr la, le m dooni si, m ga moon saah kpa mpɔɔn pu na.

ref: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
text: Uwumbɔr aah kpa tiŋann pu na, ni li dooni u man. Waageehm bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Our Lord, you bless everyone who lives right and obeys your Law.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan aan bi dii Uwumbɔr aakaal na kpa mpopiin.

ref: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
text: Binib bi joo waamɔboln ki kii tii u bisui mɔmɔk ni na kpa mpopiin,

ref: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
text: baa tun taani ubaa; bi dii Uwumbɔr aasan la.

ref: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;
text: Uwumbɔr, aa di saakaal tii timi le ki mɔk timi ke ti li dii i mbamɔm.

ref: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
text: M ba mak ke m li kpa naadii ki li joo saakaal.

ref: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
text: M yaa kpa saamɔbon pu ntafaŋum kan, maan ji inimɔɔn daalbaadaal.

ref: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
text: Buyoonn m bi bae saakaal nyaan ngbaan mbamɔm na kan, m ga di nsui mɔmɔk pak si.

ref: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
text: M ga kii tii saakaal, kina pu na, taa di mi lii. Saah ga kii Uwumbɔr aakaal pu na

ref: Young people can live a clean life by obeying your word.
text: Binib bi laa diin na yaa ban baabimbin li ŋan kan, see bi kii saakaal.

ref: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
text: M joo nsui mɔmɔk le pɔɔni mbaa ke m li tun saatuln; taa cha m yii saakaal.

ref: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
text: M joo saakaal nsui ni, ke m taa tun si titunwanbir.

ref: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
text: Uwumbɔr, m pak si; kina pu na, mɔk mi saasan.

ref: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
text: M ga ki gir len mpɔɔn pu saah tii ikaal i mɔmɔk na.

ref: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
text: M gee ke m li dii saakaal ki jer ke m li kpa liwangosakpeln.

ref: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
text: M bae saakaal, m moo lik saah mɔk mmɔkm pu na.

ref: I will take pleasure in your laws and remember your words.
text: Saakaal tii mi mpopiin, maan suln saakaal bɔr. Uwumbɔr aakaal aah kpa mpopiin pu na

ref: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
text: Li kpa tiŋann min saatutunn pu, aan m li bi ki kii saah mɔk mi pu na.

ref: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
text: Woln nnimbil aan m kan ibamɔnkpaan i bi saakaal ni na.

ref: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
text: Maan yunn kitiŋ kee pu, kina pu na, taa di saakaal bɔr mi.

ref: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
text: Nnimbil man ke m li nyi saakaal n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
text: Aa kae binib bi kpa kigaak na mbamɔm; ki puuni lir binib bi yii saakaal na pu.

ref: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
text: Maah joo saakaal pu na, nyan mi baasiibil ni baalaar ni.

ref: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
text: Bitinjoob kuuni le ki kpokl m pu, le mma ga li bae saakaal.

ref: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
text: Saah mɔk mmɔkm pu na tii mi mpopiin; muma le ye maasusur. Pɔɔn aabaa ki kii Uwumbɔr aakaal

ref: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
text: M lir le ki dɔ titan ponn ni, cha maamɔfal ki gir ni ke saah puu ke aa ga ŋa pu na.

ref: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
text: M kpiir maah tun pu na, le aa kii tii mi; mɔk mi saasan.

ref: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
text: Ter mi aan m bee saakaal aatataa, aan m li dakl lik saah tun litukpaan pu na.

ref: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
text: Mpombiin le nyaŋ mi kookoo; cha nwon pɔɔk ke saah nan puu ke aa ga ŋa pu na.

ref: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
text: Taa cha m yenn buen kinimbɔŋ wɔb, di saaŋann sakpenn mɔk mi saakaal.

ref: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
text: M kii ke m ga li si chob; m kpa ŋuntii ki tii saakaal.

ref: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
text: Uwumbɔr, m dii saah mɔk pu na; taa cha m ji inimɔɔn.

ref: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
text: M ga di lineen kii saakaal, ba pu? aa ga cha m moo bee yaatataa. Ŋuntii aameel

ref: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
text: Uwumbɔr, mɔk mi saakaal aatataa, le m ga kii i n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
text: Kpiir saakaal aatataa mɔk mi, aan m kii tii i. M ga di nsui mɔmɔk joo i.

ref: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
text: Taa cha m nya saakaal aapuwɔb, ba pu? ima chee le m kani mpopiin.

ref: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
text: Cha m li kpa lineen saakaal pu ki jer liwangol.

ref: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
text: Taa cha ntafal li bi tiwan ni kaa kpa tinyoor na ni; saah puu pu na, li kpa m pu tiŋann.

ref: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
text: Li joo tipuur ti aa puu tii mi, saatutunn na, saapuur ti aa nan puu tii binib bi kii saamɔb na.

ref: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
text: Nyan mi ŋisiibil ŋi m san ŋi ijawaan na ni; saakaal ye ikaal kpaan la.

ref: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
text: M gee ke m joo saakaal; saabimbinyaan pu, tii mi limɔfapɔln. Tii Uwumbɔr aakaal naadii

ref: Show me your love and save me, Lord, as you have promised.
text: Uwumbɔr, mɔk mi saah gee mi pu na, ki gaa mi lii, saah nan puu ke aa ga ŋa pu na.

ref: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
text: Le m ga ŋmaa gar binib bi seei mi na, ba pu? m tii saamɔboln naadii.

ref: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
text: Maamakl aah bi saakaal ponn ni pu na, cha m li ŋmaa len ibamɔn n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
text: M ga kii tii saakaal n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
text: Maah pɔɔni mbaa ke m li joo saakaal na, nibaa aan muk mi maamɔfal ni.

ref: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
text: M ga di saakaal moon tii bibɔrb, kaan san inimɔɔn.

ref: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
text: Maah gee saakaal pu na, i tii mi lineen la.

ref: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
text: M gee saakaal ki pak i, m ga li dak i pu. Uwumbɔr aakaal aapɔɔn

ref: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
text: Teer saah nan puu tipuur ti tii mi, saatutunn na; ti tii mi limakl.

ref: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
text: Buyoonn m nan bi falaa ni na m nan kpa mpopiin; ba pu? saah puu tipuur ti na nan tii mi limɔfal.

ref: Conceited people sneer at me, but I obey your Law.
text: Bigaadam lik seeni mi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la, le maa yii saakaal ki nyan ipuwɔb.

ref: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
text: Uwumbɔr, m teer saakaal i bi n‑yoonn mu jer na pu, le i joo ni mi mpopiin.

ref: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
text: M yaa kan bibiindam bi bii saakaal kan, maaŋuul fiir la.

ref: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
text: N‑yoonn siib mu ponn ni m bi kitiŋ kee pu na, m di saakaal naan ilahn.

ref: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
text: Uwumbɔr, kinyeek kan, m teer saabɔr, le ki dak saakaal pu.

ref: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
text: M joo saakaal le ki kani maapopiin. Di aabaa tii Uwumbɔr aakaal

ref: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
text: Uwumbɔr, sin baanja le ye tiwan ni m ban na, m puu ke m ga li joo saakaal.

ref: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
text: M joo nsui mɔmɔk mee si ke aa san mi kinimbaak ke saah puu ke aa ga ŋa pu na.

ref: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
text: M lik maabimbin suuna, le ki puu ke m ga li dii saakaal la.

ref: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
text: M kii saakaal kaan taan kpala.

ref: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
text: Bibiindam pen mi kitaŋ la, le maan tee suln saakaal pu.

ref: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
text: M fii kinyetaasiik le ki pak si, saakaal i bi chob na pu.

ref: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
text: M ye binib bi mɔmɔk tun saatuln ki kii saakaal na aajɔ la.

ref: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
text: Uwumbɔr, saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na gbii kitiŋ kee pu la; mɔk mi saakaal. Uwumbɔr aakaal aah kpa tinyoor pu na

ref: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa joo saah nan puu tipuur ti na, aa kpa tiŋann min saatutunn pu.

ref: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
text: Maah tii saakaal naadii pu na, tii mi saalan ni ichiin.

ref: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
text: Waahr aan aa nin daa ntafal na, m nan tun taani; tɔ, dandana ma kan, m kii saamɔb.

ref: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
text: Aa kpa tiŋann sakpen a. Mɔk mi saakaal.

ref: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
text: Binib bi kpa kigaak na geei inyamɔn paani mi, le m tee joo nsui mɔmɔk keei tii saakaal.

ref: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
text: Binib bimina aa kpa ŋuntii, le mma neen saakaal.

ref: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
text: Maatafadaan nan ŋan tii mi la, ba pu? mu cha m bae saakaal.

ref: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
text: Saah tii ikaal i na kpa tinyoor tii mi ki jer dulnyaa wee ni aamombil mɔmɔk. Uwumbɔr aakaal aah bi chob pu na

ref: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
text: Sin le naan mi, ki cha m kpa limɔfal; tii mi nlan aan m di bae saakaal.

ref: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
text: M kii tii saah len pu na, kina pu le binib bi nyuŋni si na yaa kan mi kan, bi ga li kpa mpopiin.

ref: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
text: Uwumbɔr, m nyi ke saakaal ŋan, ki nyi ke saabamɔn pu le aa daa ntafal.

ref: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
text: Cha saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na sɔŋ nsui ke saah nan puu pu tii mi, saatutunn na.

ref: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
text: Maah neen saakaal pu na, san mi kinimbaak, ki tii mi limɔfal.

ref: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
text: Cha binib bi kpa kigaak na ji inimɔɔn baah geei inyamɔn i paani mi na pu; mma kan, m ga dakl suuna ki lik saakaal aatataa.

ref: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
text: Cha binib bi nyuŋni si ki nyi saakaal na dan m chee.

ref: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
text: Cha m li joo saakaal, saah ban pu na, ki nya nlirm aanimɔɔn ni. Limeel li ban ŋŋmarm na

ref: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
text: Uwumbɔr, maah kii si ke aa nan gaa mi lii pu na cha nwon mɔmɔk kpo a; m di maagaakii ŋa saabɔr ni la.

ref: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
text: Maah lik ki ban tiwan ni aa puu ke aa ga ŋa na pu na le nnimbil ti gur wu, le m baa ke, “Bayoonn aan aa ga ter mi?”

ref: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
text: Maa ki bi tibɔr tibaa ni, ke lidabuul li kpa nween na la; tɔ, m mu aa tee suln saakaal bɔr.

ref: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
text: M kiir si ki ti bak a; bayoonn aan aa ga daa binib bi muk mi na aatafal?

ref: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
text: Binib bi kpa kigaak, kaa dii saakaal na, gbii ibuu bil mi.

ref: Your laws can be trusted! Protect me from cruel liars.
text: Unii ga ŋmaa nyii saakaal pu ki fii sil; binib joo inyamɔn le muk mi, kina pu na, ter mi.

ref: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
text: Ni gur pɔkaa kina bi ku mi a, le m beenin joo saakaal.

ref: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
text: Li kpa m pu tiŋann saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu, nima kan, m ga ŋmaa li joo saakaal. Li kpa naadii Uwumbɔr aakaal pu

ref: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
text: Uwumbɔr, saamɔboln ga li bi ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na; li bi paacham kaa kpa ndoon.

ref: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
text: Saabamɔn ga li bi ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na; aa baa kitiŋ siin libubaan ni, le kaan ki ŋmaa foor.

ref: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
text: Saakaal pu le tiwan mɔmɔk beenin bi ki nan saa din wee, ba pu? ni mɔmɔk ye saatutum la;

ref: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
text: Maapopiin aah nyan ni saakaal ni na, kina pu le maafalaa aa ku mi.

ref: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
text: Saakaal pu, le maa kpo, kina pu na, maan ŋmaa suln i bɔr.

ref: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
text: Sin le yeh mi, gaa mi lii. M pɔɔni mbaa ke m li joo saakaal.

ref: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
text: Bibiindam kii mi ke bi ku mi la, le m ga li dakl lik saakaal aatataa.

ref: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
text: M gee saakaal sakpen a. M dakl i pu le nwiin ti lir.

ref: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
text: Saakaal bi m chee n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la, ki cha m moo kani nlan jer maadim.

ref: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
text: Maah dakl lik saakaal aatataa na, m moo beer tiwan aatataa jer binib bi mɔk mi na mɔmɔk.

ref: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
text: Maah dii saakaal na, m kpa nlan sakpen ki jer bininkpiib.

ref: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
text: Maah ban ke m kii saamɔboln na m yii mbimbin mu kaa ŋan na mɔmɔk.

ref: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
text: Sin aabaa aah ye maamɔmɔkr na, maa lik saakaal fam.

ref: Your teachings are sweeter than honey.
text: Saakaal mɔ sakpen a, i mɔ jer tisiir.

ref: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
text: Saamɔboln ye karyaa u mɔk mi nsan na la, le ki wiin maasan ni.

ref: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
text: M ga li joo maapuur kpaan ti m puu ke m ga li dii saakaal bamɔnn na.

ref: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
text: Uwumbɔr, maafalaa nyaŋ sakpen a; cha m li kpa limɔfal saah nan puu ke m ga li kpa pu na.

ref: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
text: Uwumbɔr, gaa maah tii si idoon i na, ki mɔk mi saakaal.

ref: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
text: M kii n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ke m di maamɔfal pa talmaa; maan suln saakaal.

ref: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
text: Bibiindam pen mi kitaŋ la, le maa yii saakaal.

ref: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
text: Saakaal le ye maawangol ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na; ima le ye maapopiin.

ref: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
text: M nyan sil ke m li dii saakaal ki ti saa maakundaal. Uwumbɔr aakaal aah ŋan pu na

ref: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
text: M nan binib bi kaa di bisui mɔmɔk tii si na, le ki tee gee saakaal ma.

ref: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
text: Sin le ye maakikiir, m kpa limakl saah len pu na pu.

ref: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
text: Nimi titunwanbirdam, siir m chee man. M ga li dii Maawumbɔr aakaal la.

ref: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
text: Saah nan puu pu na, tii mi mpɔɔn, aan m li kpa limɔfal; taa cha maamakl bee fam.

ref: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
text: Chuu mi, aan m li bi ŋŋmarm ni, ki li kpa ŋuntii saakaal pu.

ref: You reject all deceitful liars because they refuse your teachings.
text: Unii umɔk yii saakaal na, aa mu yii uma la; le baabeebee aakpokl na ye fam.

ref: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
text: Aa ŋani bibiindam mɔmɔk ke timoor na la, kina pu le m gee saakaal.

ref: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
text: M san sin le ijawaan; saakaal pu le ijawaan joo mi. Taa nya Uwumbɔr aakaal aapuwɔb

ref: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
text: M tun tiwan ni ŋan ki si chob na, taa di mi tii maadim,

ref: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
text: Puu ke aa ga ter saatutunn; taa cha binib bi kpa kipupuk na li muk mi.

ref: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
text: Maah lik ki ban ke aa gaa mi lii ke saah nan puu pu na le cha nnimbil ti wu.

ref: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
text: Li joo mi, saatutunn, ke saageehm na aah ban pu na, ki mɔk mi saakaal.

ref: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.
text: M ye saatutunn la; tii mi nlan aan m li nyi saakaal aatataa.

ref: Do something, Lord! They have broken your Law.
text: Uwumbɔr, binib aah yii saakaal pu na, ni ŋeer ke aa fii sil.

ref: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
text: M gee saakaal ki jer salmaa u bi pun u mmii ni ki nyan waajɔŋ na.

ref: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
text: Kina pu na, m dii saakaal mɔmɔk; le kaa gee nsan mumɔk kaa ŋan na. Uwumbɔr aakaal aadiim aaneen

ref: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
text: Saakaal ye ikaal kpaan la; m di nsui mɔmɔk le kii tii i.

ref: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
text: Saakaal aatataa tii inimbiwoln la, le ki tii maanyidam nlan.

ref: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
text: Maah kpa saakaal pu lineen pu na, le m gur ka waa mmɔb ki fuur yiŋni.

ref: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
text: Fenn ni m chee ki san mi kinimbaak ke saah san binib bi gee si na kinimbaak pu na.

ref: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
text: Saah nan puu pu na, taa cha m lir, ki taa cha kinimbɔŋ nyaŋ mi.

ref: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
text: Nyan mi binib bi muk mi na aaŋaal ni, aan m ŋmaa dii saakaal.

ref: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
text: Di saanyoor gbii mi ki mɔk mi saakaal.

ref: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
text: Uwumbɔr, saabimbin ŋan la, le saakaal si chob.

ref: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.
text: Saah tii ikaal i na ŋan le ki si chob.

ref: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
text: Maadim aah kaa lik faar saakaal na, le ni wu mponn ni ke mmii na.

ref: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
text: Saah puu tipuur ti na aa kpeln. Min u ye saatutunn na gee ti sakpen a.

ref: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
text: Maa ye unikpaan, le bi lik seen mi, m mu aa tee suln saakaal bɔr.

ref: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
text: Saabimbinyaan ga li bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, le saakaal ye mbamɔn n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
text: Tibɔr muk mi sakpen, le saakaal ma joo ni mi mpopiin.

ref: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
text: M yin si ni maalandak mɔmɔk la; Uwumbɔr, pel m chee, aan m dii saakaal.

ref: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
text: M yin si la; gaa mi lii, aan m li joo saakaal.

ref: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
text: M fii lichakpitaawoln le ki yin si ki ban nterm; maamakl bi saah puu tipuur ti na ni la.

ref: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
text: M yaa dɔ kinyeek kan, m dɔ waa la, ke m dakl suuna ki lik saakaal aatataa.

ref: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
text: Uwumbɔr, saageehm aah bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na, pel m chee; san mi kinimbaak, ki gaa maamɔfal lii.

ref: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
text: Binib bi kaa joo saakaal kpala na kpokl m pu, ki moo foor duuni mi la.

ref: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
text: Uwumbɔr, le sin le bi gbɔk mi, le saakaal mɔmɔk aa kpelni.

ref: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
text: N‑yoonn mu jer na le m nan bae saakaal; aa siin i ke i li bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la. Nterm aagaŋ

ref: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
text: Maah kaa yii saakaal na, lik maah ji falaa pu na, ki gaa mi lii.

ref: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
text: Ter mi maabɔr ni, ki gaa mi lii, saah nan puu pu na, gaa mi lii.

ref: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
text: Bibiindam aah yii saakaal na, saan gaa bi lii.

ref: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
text: Uwumbɔr, le saanimbaasaln nyaŋ sakpen a; san mi kinimbaak ki gaa mi lii.

ref: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
text: M kpa bidim, ni binib bi muk mi na sakpen, tɔ, m tee beenin dii saakaal.

ref: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
text: Bibɔmbɔtukb ngbaan aah kaa dii saakaal na, m yaa kan bi kan, ni bii nsui la.

ref: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
text: Uwumbɔr, lik maah gee saakaal pu na. Saageehm aa kpelni, kina pu na, gaa mi lii.

ref: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
text: Saamɔbon mɔmɔk ye ibamɔn la, le saakaal mɔmɔk aa kpa ndoon. Di aabaa tii Uwumbɔr aakaal

ref: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
text: Bipɔɔndam joo inyamɔn i kaa kpa tataa na le tak mi, le mma pak saakaal.

ref: because they bring happiness like treasures taken in war.
text: Saah puu tipuur ti na pu le m kpa mpopiin ke unii u pii liwangol na la.

ref: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
text: Maa gee ke m kan inyamɔn kpala, le ki tee gee saakaal ma.

ref: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
text: Saakaal i bi chob na pu, le m dooni si nfum mulole liwinbaal.

ref: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
text: Binib bi gee saakaal na bi lifuur ni la, le nibaa aa bi ki ga nyaŋ bi.

ref: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
text: Uwumbɔr, m kii si le ke aa nan gaa mi lii, le ki ŋani saah ban pu na.

ref: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
text: M gee saakaal ni nsui mɔmɔk, le ki dii i.

ref: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
