text: M dii saakaal ni saah mɔk mi pu na; aa kani maah ŋani tiwan ni mɔmɔk na. Limeel li ban nterm na

ref: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
text: Uwumbɔr, cha maaterm aawiil pii si. Saah nan puu pu na, tii mi nlan mu m ga li joo beer tiwan aatataa na.

ref: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
text: Saah nan puu pu na, ŋun maameel, ki gaa mi lii.

ref: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
text: Saah mɔk mi saakaal na, m ga li pak si n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
text: Saakaal aah bi chob pu na, m ga di i gaa ilahn.

ref: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
text: Maah dii saakaal pu na, gor n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ki ter mi.

ref: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
text: Uwumbɔr, m kiir buyoonn aa ga gaa mi lii na, ki ti bak a. Saakaal ponn ni le m kani mpopiin.

ref: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
text: Tii mi limɔfal, aan m pak si; cha saakaal ter mi.

ref: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
text: M chuun yiini ke upiih u wɔŋ na la; maah kaa yii saakaal pu na, dan nan ban kan mi, saatutunn.

ref: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
text: Uwumbɔr, nyan mi binyamɔndam ni biŋmaŋmannim chee.

ref: What punishment is fitting for you deceitful liars?
text: Nimi binyamɔndam, Uwumbɔr ga ŋa nimi kinye? U ga daa nitafal kinye?

ref: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
text: Ni chee aakookoon aa ŋan ke unii u koo Mesek ni, kaa ŋan ke unii u koo Kedar aanib chee na la.

ref: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
text: M koo binib bi kaa gee nsuudoon na chee ni yunn sakpen a.

ref: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
text: Buyoonn m ti len nsuudoon aabɔr na kan, bima ban butɔb la.

ref: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
text: M lik ŋijoo paab; la chee aan maaterm ga nya ni?

ref: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
text: Maaterm ga nya ni Uwumbɔr, u naan paacham ni taab na chee la.

ref: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
text: Waan cha aa lir; saakikiir ka waa n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la.

ref: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
text: Israel yaab aakikiir aa geeni kpala.

ref: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
text: Uwumbɔr ga li kii si, u si gbɔk si ke u li kii si la.

ref: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
text: Nwiin pu kan, nwiin aan see si, le uŋmal mu aan ŋa si nibaa kinyeek.

ref: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
text: Uwumbɔr ga li kii si linimaln mɔmɔk ni, u ga li joo si, nibaa taa pii si.

ref: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
text: M nan kpa mpopiin buyoonn bi nan bui mi ke, “Cha ti buen Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni” na.

ref: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
text: Le dandana ti si Jerusalem aabisamɔi ni.

ref: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
text: Uwumbɔr aanib choo nima la, ke bi nan doon u, waakaal aah mɔk pu na.

ref: David's royal throne is here where justice rules.
text: Nima chee le Israel yaab aabɔrb nan kal ki jin baanib tibɔr.

ref: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
text: Mee Uwumbɔr ke u cha nsuudoon li bi Jerusalem ni man; “Cha binib bi gee Jerusalem na kan liwangol.

ref: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
text: Cha nsuudoon li bi Jerusalem ni, ki cha lifuur li bi kaabɔrdichal ni.”

ref: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
text: Ndo yaab ni njɔtiib pu le m bui Jerusalem aatiŋ ke, “Nsuudoon li bi aa pu.”

ref: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr Aadichal pu le m mee limeel ke Jerusalem kan liwangol.

ref: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
text: Uwumbɔr, m lik sin pu la, m lik paacham, nin chee aa bi ki joo dulnyaa na.

ref: Servants look to their master, but we will look to you, until you have mercy on us.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr, unaagbiija aah bi udindaan pu, aan unaagbiipiibo mu bi udindaan pu pu na, kina le ti mu lik aa pu, ki kii n‑yoonn mu aa ga san timi kinimbaak na.

ref: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
text: Uwumbɔr, san timi kinimbaak; bi lik seen timi sakpen a, san timi kinimbaak.

ref: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
text: Biwankpadam laa timi, ni yunn sakpen, le bigaadam bi muk timi na ŋani timi mbɔnyun.

ref: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
text: Israel yaab, gar mi man, Uwumbɔr yaa kaa ba si tipuwɔb kan, ti ba bi la?

ref: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
text: “Uwumbɔr yaa kaa ba si tipuwɔb buyoonn timi aadim tak timi na kan,

ref: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
text: bi ba ga nan di baaŋuusakpeln li bi kpa ti pu na nab timi;

ref: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
text: bi ba ga nan di timi buen ke nwam na, ki biin ti pu ke tinyunkpenn na,

ref: of high and roaring waves.”
text: tinyunkpenn sakpenn ngbaan ba ga cha ti bee nnyun ni.”

ref: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
text: Cha ti doon Uwumbɔr u kaa cha timi aadim kuln timi na.

ref: and we escaped like birds from a hunter's torn net.
text: Ti ŋmar ke unyoon aah ŋmar nya ukpan aataŋ ni pu na la; baataŋ koo, le ti ŋmar.

ref: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
text: Timi aaterm nyani Uwumbɔr u naan paacham ni kitiŋ na chee la.

ref: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
text: Binib bi kii tii Uwumbɔr na naahn Sionn Aajool li kaa damni, kaa foor kpala na la.

ref: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
text: Ŋijoo aah mann goln Jerusalem aatiŋ pu na, kina le Uwumbɔr mu mann goln waanib n‑yoonn mue, ni n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.
text: Bibiindam aan ŋmaa li joo bininyaam n‑yoonn mɔmɔk; bi yaa joo bi kina kan, nibaakan, bininyaam ngbaan mu ga nan tun titunwanbir.

ref: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
text: Uwumbɔr, li kpa bininyaam bi joo saakaal na pu tiŋann.

ref: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
text: Tɔ, aa yaa nan daa bibiindam aatafal kan, aa daa binib bi yii saasan na mu aatafal. Nsuudoon li bi Israel yaab pu.

ref: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
text: Uwumbɔr aah nan di timi giin Jerusalem aatiŋ ni na, ni nan naahn tidaŋ la.

ref: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
text: Ti nan laa, le ki gaa mpopiin aalahn. Le ŋitimbol ŋiken nan bui ke, “Uwumbɔr tun ŋitukpaan tii bi.”

ref: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
text: Mbamɔn, u sil tun ŋitukpaan tii timi; ti kpa mpopiin sakpen a.

ref: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
text: Uwumbɔr, giin timi buen timi aatiŋ pu, ke utaal aah joo ni nnyun nan tii imɔɔsan i kuur na pu na.

ref: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
text: Cha binib bi nan bi bu baajikaabim ki wii na nan chee ti, ni mpopiin.

ref: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
text: Binib bi tu lijikaabuul cha ki wii na ga di mpopiin aalahn le gir ni, ba pu? bi ga chee njikaabim pam.

ref: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.
text: Uwumbɔr yaa kaa maa lidichal kan, udimaar aatuln ye fam la; Uwumbɔr yaa kaa kiir kitiŋ kan, ukikiir u si kii na aatuln ye fam la.

ref: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
text: Aa yaa fii kichakpiik ni mala ki nan gir ni kijoobɔŋ ke aa tun ki kan kan, ni ye fam la. Uwumbɔr aah gee binib bi na dɔ geen le u tii bi baah ban pu na.

ref: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
text: Mbim ye Uwumbɔr aapiin le ki tii timi; bi ye tinyoor bamɔnn la.

ref: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.
text: Uja yaa pɔɔn ki kpa mbijabim kan, bi bi ke ipiin i bi uja aaŋaal ni na la.

ref: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
text: Uja u kpa kina aapiin sakpen na kpa mpopiin. U yaa ti yiŋ waadim libɔjil chee kan, waan lir kpala.

ref: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
text: Binib bi san Uwumbɔr ki joo waakaal na kpa mpopiin.

ref: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
text: Saatuln le ga tii si saah ban pu na; aa ga kan liwangol ki li kpa mpopiin.

ref: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
text: Aapuu ga li bi ke ŋisubil aasub bu lu na le saachiln ni, le saabim ga li bi ke olif aasui i laa diin na saasambil taab.

ref: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
text: Uja u kii tii Uwumbɔr na ga sil kan kina aanyoor.

ref: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
text: Uwumbɔr u bi Sionn ni na, ŋa waanyoor ŋa aa pu. Uwumbɔr cha Jerusalem aatiŋ kan liwangol saamɔfal aayoonn.

ref: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
text: Uwumbɔr cha aa li bi ki nan kan aayaabitiib. Nsuudoon li bi Israel yaab pu.

ref: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
text: Israel aatimbol, bui timi saah nan laa diin aan saadim muk si pu na aabɔr:

ref: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
text: “Maah nan laa ye ubo pu na le maadim nan joo mbiin muk mi, le kaa ŋmaa nyaŋ mi.

ref: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
text: Bi nan chɔi mpuwɔb le ni naahn ke baah mann ipɔn le bukpaab ni na.

ref: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.
text: Le Uwumbɔr u ŋan na nan nyan mi tinaagbiir ni.”

ref: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
text: Cha bi nyaŋ ki jenn giin unii umɔk kaa gee Sionn aatiŋ na.

ref: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
text: Cha bi li bi ke timoor ti punn kidiik paab, ki kuur kaa kee muun na;

ref: Don't let them be like wheat gathered in bundles.
text: Ubaa aa chee ti, ki kuun ti, ki buu ti.

ref: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
text: Ubaa aan jer bi chee ki bui ke, “Uwumbɔr ŋa waanyoor ŋa ni pu;” kaan bui ke, “Ti mee tinyoor Uwumbɔr aayimbil pu ŋa ni pu.”

ref: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
text: Uwumbɔr, maasuubiin ponn ni le m yin si.

ref: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
text: Ndindaan, pel maawiil; pel maah yin ki ban nterm pu na.

ref: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
text: Aa yaa ba ŋmee timi aatunwanbir mɔmɔk bilni kan, ubaa aa ba ga ŋmar kaa kpo.

ref: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
text: Le aa di cha pinn timi, ke ti li san si ijawaan.

ref: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
text: M kpa kikpeek le ki kii Uwumbɔr aaterm, waamɔboln pu le m kpa limakl.

ref: I wait for you more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn. Yes, I wait more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn.
text: M kpa kikpeek ki kii Uwumbɔr ki jer kinyeek aakikiir aah kii kitaak aah ga woln buyoonn pu na.

ref: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
text: Uwumbɔr aageehm aah kaa kpelni na aan u gee ke u gaa nimi lii n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na, nimi Israel yaab, tii u naadii man.

ref: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
text: Uma le ga nyan waanib Israel yaab baatunwanbir mɔmɔk ni.

ref: I am not conceited, Lord, and I don't waste my time on impossible schemes.
text: Uwumbɔr, m di cha kigaak aatuln kaa ki kpa kalimbaani. Ntafal aa bi tibɔr ti jer mi na ni, kaa bi tiwan ni pɔɔ jer maalan na ni.

ref: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
text: M bi suuna, le ki faar maah kpa ni na. M bi suuna ke ubo aah pui una aataa pu pu na la.

ref: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
text: Israel yaab, tii Uwumbɔr naadii man dandana ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
text: Uwumbɔr, taa suln David, ni waah nan jin falaa u mɔmɔk na pu.

ref: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
text: U nan puu ke, “Maan kun linampal, kaan doon geen,

ref: or close my eyelids,
text: maan fuur, kaan geen,

ref: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
text: see m ti maa nin chee Uwumbɔr ga li koo na, uma Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔndaan u tiyaaja Jakob nan dii u na.”

ref: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
text: Betlehem ni le ti ŋun Nkaal Aadakaa bɔr, le ki ti kan u Jearim aakpaakon ni.

ref: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
text: Le ti bui ke, “Cha ti buen Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni man; cha ti li dooni u waabɔrjal taab man.”

ref: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
text: Uwumbɔr, dii Nkaal Aadakaa u ye saapɔɔn aamɔkl na koo Saadichal ni, ki nan li bi nima n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
text: Cha saatotoorb li tun lituln li ŋan na n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Cha saanib gaa mpopiin aalahn.

ref: David is your chosen one, so don't reject him.
text: Uwumbɔr, saah nan puu tipuur ti tii saatutunn David na; taa yii saah lee ubɔr u na.

ref: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
text: Aa nan puu tipuur ti saan cha ti bee fam na tii David ke, “M ga ŋa aajapɔɔn ubaa ubɔr, uma le ga paan aa pu ki ji nnaan.

ref: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.”
text: Aajapɔtiib yaa dii mi mbamɔm, ki kii ikaal i m di tii bi na kan, bijapɔtiib mu le ga nan gaa nnaan, ki li ye bibɔrb n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.”

ref: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
text: Uwumbɔr lee Sionn la; u ban u di nima le ŋa udo;

ref: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
text: u len ke, “Do le m ga li bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, do le m ban ke m li joo maanib.

ref: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
text: M ga di liwangol limɔk Sionn aatiŋ ban na tii ki; m ga tii kaagiim tijikaar bi ji bab.

ref: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
text: M ga ŋa maanyoor ŋa kaatotoorb aatuln mɔmɔk pu, le kaanib ga gaa mpopiin aalahn mpɔɔn pu.

ref: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
text: Do le m ga ŋa David aayaabitiib ubaa ubɔrkpaan; do le m ga kaan ubɔr u m lee u na ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
text: M ga jinn waadim inimɔɔn, le waanaan ma ga pɔɔk ki kan liwangol.”

ref: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
text: Uwumbɔr aanib yaa koo tɔb chee ni kimɔbaan kan, ni kpa mpopiin sakpen a.

ref: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
text: Ni bi ke Uwumbɔr aakpan mu puu sunni Aaronn aayil, ni ulangbaln, ki puu ti kɔl waawanpeenkaan aaneen ni na la.

ref: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
text: Ni naahn limaln li bi Hemonn Aajool paab, ki lir ni Sionn aagongon pu na la. Nima chee le Uwumbɔr puu ke u ga ŋa waanyoor ti ye limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na ŋa bi pu.

ref: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
text: Nimi Uwumbɔr aatutum mɔmɔk, dan ki nan pak u man, nimi bi mɔmɔk dooni u Waadichal ni kinyeek na, dan nan pak u man.

ref: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
text: Yoor niŋaal paacham Waadichal ni, ki mee uma Uwumbɔr ki pak u man.

ref: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
text: Uwumbɔr u naan paacham ni taab, ki bi Sionn pu na, ŋa waanyoor ŋa ni pu.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr man. Uwumbɔr aatutum, pak waayimbil man.

ref: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
text: Nimi bi si Tidindaan Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni na, pak u man.

ref: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
text: Uwumbɔr aah ŋan pu na, pak u man; u kpa tiŋann, gaa ilahn pak u man.

ref: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
text: U nyan Jakob ke u li ye uyoo, u nyan Jakob aayaabitiib Israel yaab ke bi li ye waanib.

ref: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
text: M nyi ke Uwumbɔr kpa mpɔɔn, u kpa mpɔɔn jer ŋiwaa.

ref: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
text: U ŋani waah gee pu na paacham ni taab, ni nnyusakpem aataab.

ref: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
text: U cha kitaabuŋ nyani kitiŋ aanaanmɔk; ki tii kitaabuŋ mmii mu moor lak lak na, uma le ki cha libuln nyan ni waah siini waawan nin chee na.

ref: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
text: U nan ku njan aabijabim ni tiwakor aajan aawanja mɔmɔk Ijipt ni.

ref: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
text: Nima chee le u nan tun iwaan aatun, ki di daa nima chee aabɔr, ni waaninkpiib aatafal.

ref: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
text: U kuln ŋitimbol pam ki ku bibɔrkpaam;

ref: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan
text: u nan ku Amor yaab aabɔr Sihonn, ni Basann yaab aabɔr Og, ni Kanaann aatiŋ aabɔrb mɔmɔk.

ref: and gave their property to his people Israel.
text: U di baatim tii waanib Israel yaab.

ref: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
text: Uwumbɔr, n‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, bi ga li mooni ke aa ye Uwumbɔr la. Bi ga li teer saabɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
text: Uwumbɔr ga li kii waanib; u ga san waatutum kinimbaak.

ref: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
text: Ŋitimbol ŋi kaa nyi Uwumbɔr na di tikunabr ni salmaa le naan ŋiwaa; unibɔn aaŋaal le naan ŋi.

ref: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
text: Ŋi kpa imɔi, le kaa tee ŋmaa len, ki kpa ŋinimbil, kaa tee waa.

ref: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.
text: Ŋi kpa ŋitafal, kaa tee ŋun, ŋaa kpaan ŋmaa fuur.

ref: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
text: Cha binib bi mɔmɔk naan ŋi ki kpa ŋi pu limakl na li gur bi ke ŋiwaa ŋi bi naan na.

ref: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
text: Israel aanib, pak Uwumbɔr man; nimi Uwumbɔr aatotoorb, pak u man.

ref: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
text: Nimi Liifai yaab, pak Uwumbɔr man; nimi bi mɔmɔk dooni u na, pak u man.

ref: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Pak Uwumbɔr, Sionn aatiŋ ni, pak u, udo Jerusalem ni man. Pak Uwumbɔr man.

ref: Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails.
text: Uwumbɔr ŋan, kina pu na, doon u man; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
text: Di idoon tii Uwumbɔr u jer ŋiwaa mɔmɔk na; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
text: Di idoon tii Uwumbɔr u jer dindatiib mɔmɔk na; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.
text: Uma baanja le tun iwaan aatukpaan; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
text: U di waalan le naan paacham; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
text: U maa kitiŋ tɔŋ nnyun mu nyoo na pu; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
text: U naan nwiin ni uŋmal; waageehm aa kpa ndoon;

ref: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
text: ke nwiin li wiin nwiin pu; waageehm aa kpa ndoon

ref: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
text: ke uŋmal ni iŋmabi li wiin kinyeek; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
text: U nan ku Ijipt yaab aajan aabijabim; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.
text: U nan nyan Israel yaab Ijipt aatiŋ ni; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
text: U nan di waaŋaal mu kpa mpɔɔn sakpen na le ŋa kina; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
text: U nan chuu yakr Limɔɔkal Aanyusakpem nfum mulee; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
text: U nan di waanib dii nima jer; waageehm aa kpa ndoon;

ref: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.
text: le ki tee cha Ijipt aabɔr ni waajab bee Nnyusakpem ngbaan ni; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
text: U nan di waanib bɔ dii nteersakpiin ni; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
text: U ku bibɔrb bi kpa mpɔɔn na; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
text: U ku bibɔrkpaam; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
text: U ku Amor yaab aabɔr Sihonn; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
text: U ku Basann aatiŋ aabɔr Og; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: God took away their land. God's love never fails.
text: U nan di baatim tii waanib Israel yaab; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
text: U nan di mu tii waatutunn Israel aatimbol; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
text: Bidim aah nyaŋ timi na, waa nan suln ti bɔr; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
text: U nan gaa timi, timi aadim chee lii; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
text: U tii tiwanfuurkaan mɔmɔk tijikaar; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails.
text: Di idoon tii Uwumbɔr u bi paacham na man; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.

ref: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
text: Babiloŋ aamɔɔ chee le ti nan kal; nima chee le ti nan teer Sionn aabɔr le ki wii.

ref: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
text: Ti nan di timi aabar leen isui i si nima na pu.

ref: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
text: Binib bi nan chur timi na nan bui timi ke ti gaa ilahn; bi bui timi ke ti gaa mpopiin aalahn tii bi, ki len ke, “Gaa nlahn mu ye Sionn aalahn na tii timi.”

ref: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
text: Ti ga ŋa kinye ki gaa nlahn tii Uwumbɔr kitiyayaŋ ponn ni?

ref: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
text: M yaa suln Jerusalem pu kan, m taa ki ŋmaa gbaa kibeek daalbaadaal.

ref: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
text: M yaa kaa teer aabɔr, ki dak aa pu ke sin le ye maamɔɔn sakpiin kan, m taa ki ŋmaa gaa ilahn kpala.

ref: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
text: Uwumbɔr, teer Edom yaab aah nan ŋa pu nwiin mundaal bidim nan nyaŋ Jerusalem na. Teer baah nan len kpakpaayuk pu na ke, “Ber ki bil kitiŋ man.”

ref: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
text: Babiloŋ aatiŋ, aa ga kuln. Unii u teen si saah nan tun timi pu na kpa mpopiin,

ref: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
text: Unii u yoor saabipɔm ki di lɔe ŋitakpal aan bi kpoi na kpa mpopiin.

ref: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
text: Uwumbɔr, m joo nsui mɔmɔk dooni si la; m gaa kipak aalahn tii si, bijojoob chee la.

ref: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
text: Saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na, ni saah ŋani saah len pu na, le m fenn lik saadichal wɔb, ki gbaan kitiŋ ki pak saayimbil, ba pu? aa mɔk ke saayimbil ni saakaal le jer tiwan mɔmɔk.

ref: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
text: M nan yin si, le aa kii maayim; aa di saapɔɔn le tii mi mpɔɔn.

ref: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
text: Uwumbɔr, dulnyaa wee ni aabɔrb mɔmɔk aah ŋun saah len pu na, le bi ga pak si.

ref: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
text: Bi ga di saah tun pu na, ni saapak sakpeŋ gaa ilahn.

ref: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
text: Aa bi paacham paacham la, le aatafal tee bi binib bi sunn bibaa taab na ni, le binib bi kpa kigaak na aan ŋmaa bɔr si.

ref: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
text: Buyoonn tibɔr ti mann goln mi ni kookoo na, le aa gaal mi lir. Aa kiir maadim bi aaŋuul fii na ki joo saapɔɔn gaal mi lir.

ref: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
text: Aa ga ŋa saah puu tipuur ti na mɔmɔk. Uwumbɔr, saageehm aa kpa ndoon. Doo lituln li aa piin li na.

ref: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord, and you know all about me.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa ŋaŋ mi ki nyi maah bi pu na.

ref: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
text: Aa nyi maah ŋani tiwan nimɔk na; aa bi dandar le ki nyi maah dak pu na.

ref: You notice everything I do and everywhere I go.
text: M yaa bi tun, bee m yaa ka fuur kan, aa waa mi; aa nyi maatuln mɔmɔk.

ref: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
text: Waahr aan m nin len tibɔr na, aa puun nyi maah ga len pu na.

ref: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
text: Aa mann le ki ti goln mi ni kookoo; saapɔɔn le aa joo kii mi.

ref: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
text: Saah nyi mi pu na ti nyaŋ sakpen a; ni nyaŋ maah nyi pu na.

ref: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
text: Maan ŋmaa buen nibaa chee aan saa bi nima. Maan ŋmaa buen nibaa chee kaa bi aanimbiin ni.

ref: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.
text: M yaa ba buen paacham kan, aa bi nima chee; m yaa ba sunn ti doon kitekpiitiŋ ni kan, aa bi nima chee.

ref: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.
text: M yaa ba fii paacham ki buen liwipuul, bee m yaa ba buen ti koo liwilir wɔb dandar dandar kan,

ref: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
text: aa ba ga li bi nima ki loln m pu nsan, aa ba ga li bi nima ki ter mi.

ref: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
text: M ba ga bui libɔmbɔln ke li bɔr mi, bee m bui nwiihn mu mann goln mi na ke mu kpaln kinyeek;

ref: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
text: le mbɔmbɔɔn aa bɔɔn aa chee, kinyeek wiin chain ke nwiin pu na aa chee. Mbɔmbɔɔn ni nwiihn ye tiwanbaan le aa chee.

ref: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
text: Sin le naan nwon mɔmɔk; aa di mi kpaan tɔb ni, nna aaponn ni.

ref: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
text: M pak si; ba pu? Saah naan mi pu na kpa mi iwaan ni lijinjiir, saatun mɔmɔk kpa iwaan, le aa nyi mi mbamɔm.

ref: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
text: Buyoonn maakpab nan bi naani suuna nna aaponn ni, aan m bi muuni nima ubaa aa nyi na, aa nan nyi ke m bi nima,

ref: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
text: aa nan kan mi le bi nin ma mi. Iwiin imɔk aa di tii mi na ŋmee ki bi saagbaŋ ni waahr aan iwiin ngbaan ibaa nin piin.

ref: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
text: Uwumbɔr, saalandak ye m chee tiwankpaan la; i wiir sakpen a.

ref: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
text: M yaa ban m kahn i kan, i ga li wiir jer limɔɔtambol. M yaa dɔ geen ki ti finn kan, m beenin bi aa chee la.

ref: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
text: Uwumbɔr, m ba gee sakpen ke aa ku bibiindam. M ba gee ke binib bi aabimbin pɔɔ na ba di cha mi suuna.

ref: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
text: Bi len aa pu tibɔbir; bi len tiwan ni kaa ŋan na saayimbil pu.

ref: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
text: Uwumbɔr, m nan binib bi nan si na sakpen. M lik seen binib bi yii si ki nyan aapuwɔb na.

ref: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
text: M sil nan bi kinanabamɔŋ la, m yin bi maadim la.

ref: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
text: Uwumbɔr, ŋaŋ mi, ki li nyi nsui ni; tɔŋ mi, ki bee maalandak.

ref: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
text: Lik ke m kpa titunwanbir tibaa aan maa kpa, ki mɔk mi nsan mu nan bi n‑yaayoonn na.

ref: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
text: Uwumbɔr, gaa mi titunwanbirdam chee lii; nyan mi binib bi aabimbin pɔɔ na chee.

ref: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.
text: N‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, bi kpokl titunwanbir la, bi ban kijaak n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la.

ref: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
text: Bilambil bi ke uwaa u kpa liluul na la; baamɔbon kpa liluul ke saapa aaluul na la.

ref: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
text: Binib bi kpa kigaak na pen mi kitaŋ; bi pen kakpalkaa mam, le ki pen gaawɔb mam nsan ni kiir mi.

ref: You, Lord, are my God! Please listen to my prayer.
text: M bui Uwumbɔr ke, “Sin le ye Maawumbɔr,” Uwumbɔr, ŋun maah wii ki ban nterm pu na.

ref: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
text: Ndindaan Uwumbɔr, u ye maakikiir, ki ye mpɔɔndaan na, aa kiir mi butɔb ni.

ref: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
text: Uwumbɔr, taa tii bibiindam baah ban pu na; taa cha baah kpokl pu na tun lituln.

ref: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.
text: Taa cha maadim kan linyaŋ; cha baah faani mi pu na gir lir bi pu;

ref: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
text: Cha mmiisakɔn mu kpa mmii na lir bi pu; cha bi di bi mee ŋa mbuu mu ponn ni baan ki ŋmaa nya ni na.

ref: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
text: Uwumbɔr, m nyi ke aa ter bigiim baabɔr ni, ki tii maa‑kpa‑dam baabamɔn.

ref: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na ga sil pak si; bi ga li bi aanimbiin ni la.

ref: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
text: Uwumbɔr, m yin si; nan ter mi dandana. Buyoonn m yin si na kan, pel m chee.

ref: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.
text: Gaa maameel ke tulalee aayon aatork na, ki gaa maaŋaal i m yoor paacham na ke kijook aatork na.

ref: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
text: Uwumbɔr, ban ukikiir kiir maamɔb, ki taa cha m len tibɔr ti kaa ŋa na.

ref: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
text: Li kii mi aan m taa li neen ke m tun taani, ki li kii mi m taa kpaan titunwanbirdam chee baabiin aatuln ni. Taa cha m kpaan bi chee baajim ponn ni.

ref: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
text: Unii u aabimbin ŋan na ga ŋmaa daa ntafal ki di tibɔnyaan sur mi. Maan tee gaa kinyuŋ titunwanbirdam chee, ba pu? n‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, m mee limeel baatunwanbir ngbaan pu la.

ref: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
text: Buyoonn baajojoob ti nyan ŋijoo paab ki ker lir ni na, le binib ngbaan ga tii naadii ke maabɔr nan gbii.

ref: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.
text: Baah lar idɔ pu ki chɔi chɔi i na, kina le baakpab ga yaa likaakul aamɔgben chee.

ref: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
text: Ndindaan Uwumbɔr, le m ma kii tii si n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. M ban saakiirn; taa cha m kpo.

ref: Protect me from the traps of those violent people,
text: Li kii mi, m taa koo gaawɔb, ni kakpalkaa mam bi titunwanbirdam di pen mi na ni.

ref: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
text: Cha bibiindam gir lir bibaa aagaawɔb mam ponn ni, aan mma taa koo titotonn tibaa ni.

ref: I pray to you, Lord. I beg for mercy.
text: M yin Uwumbɔr ki ban nterm la; m gaŋni u la.

ref: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
text: M joo ni maamuk mɔmɔk u chee la; m tuk u maabɔr mɔmɔk.

ref: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
text: Buyoonn m ti gor ke m di cha na, u nyi maah ba ga ŋa tiwan ni na. Maah chuun nsan mu pu na le maadim pen mi gaawɔb.

ref: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
text: M yaa fenn lik nsikakl mɔmɔk kan, ubaa aa bi ki ga ter mi, ubaa aa bi ki ga li kii mi, ubaa aatafal aa bi m ni.

ref: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
text: Uwumbɔr, m wii yin si ki ban nterm la; Uwumbɔr, sin le ye u kii mi na. Sin le ye tiwan ni mɔmɔk m ban maamɔfal ponn ni na.

ref: Help! They are chasing me, and they are too strong.
text: Pel maaterm aawiil yee, itaakpayɔl le ban i ku mi. Gaa mi maadim chee lii; bi pɔɔ nyaŋ mi.

ref: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
text: Nyan mi maasuubiin ni, le m ga pak si, saanib aakuun ni, ba pu? aa kpa m pu tiŋann sakpen.

ref: Listen, Lord, as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.
text: Uwumbɔr, ŋun maameel. Saaŋann pu, ŋun maah gaŋni si pu na. Aa ye mbamɔndaan, kii maagaŋ ngbaan.

ref: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
text: Taa ji mi, saatutunn tibɔr; ubaa aa bi kaa kpa taani aa chee.

ref: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
text: Maadin ban mi, ki chuu mi, ki nyaŋ mi kookoo a. U di mi ŋa kiyondiik bɔmbɔɔn na ni, le m gur bi ke binib bi kpoi n‑yaayoonn na.

ref: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
text: Kina pu na, m gor ke m di cha la, ntaakpab yɔl kookoo a.

ref: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
text: M teer n‑yoonn mu jer na; m dak saah nan tun pu n‑yoonn ngbaan na, saatun mɔmɔk beenin bi n‑yil ni.

ref: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
text: M yoor ŋŋaal paacham ki mee si; m neen si ke kitikuun aah neen nnyun pu na la.

ref: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
text: Uwumbɔr, ŋun maayim dandana wee, maa ki kpa ntaakpab pɔɔn mubaa. Taa di aabaa bɔr mi, ni yaa kaa ye kina kan, m ga li gur kpaan binib bi bi kitekpiitiŋ ni na chee la.

ref: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
text: Kichakpiik mɔmɔk ni kan, teer mi saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu; ba pu? sin pu le m kpa limakl. Maameel chaa aa chee paacham la; mɔk mi nsan mu m ga dii na.

ref: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa chee le m chaa ti ban nkiirm; gaa mi maadim chee lii.

ref: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
text: Sin le ye Maawumbɔr; mɔk mi aan m ŋa saageehn. Li gee mi, ki mɔk mi nsanyaan.

ref: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
text: Uwumbɔr, saah nan puu ke aa ga ŋa pu na, gaa mi lii; saaŋann sakpenn pu, nyan mi maabɔr ni.

ref: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.
text: Saah gee mi pu na pu, ku maadim, ki kuln binib bi mɔmɔk muk mi na, ba pu? m ye saatutunn la.

ref: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr man, u ye maakikiir la. U gor mi kiir kijaak ki toor mi kiir butɔb.

ref: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
text: Uma le ye maakikiir, ki si mpuwɔb; uma le ye nin chee m bɔrni na, uma le gaal mi lir, u chee le m mak ke nibaa aan ŋa mi. U cha m ye ŋitimbol aayidaan.

ref: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
text: Uwumbɔr, unibɔn ye ba aan aatafal bi u ni; unibɔn mu, le aa cha aatafal bi u ni.

ref: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
text: U bi ke litakpiln libaa aabuln na la; waamɔfal naahn kijunjuŋ ki bi jer na la.

ref: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
text: Uwumbɔr, chuu daa kar kitaapaak ki sunn ni; di aaŋaal meeh ŋijoo, aan ŋi nya iŋmanyuu.

ref: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
text: Cha utaal moor ki yaa saadim; too saapiin aan bi san yaa.

ref: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
text: Nya ni paacham, chuu daa nyan mi nnyun mu nyoo na ni, ki gaa mi lii; nyan mi biwɔwɔm bi kaa len ibamɔn,

ref: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
text: ki puur tipuur inyamɔn pu na aapɔɔn ni.

ref: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
text: Uwumbɔr, m ga gaa nlahnpɔɔn tii si, m ga gbaa kibeek ki gaa ilahn tii si.

ref: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
text: Aa tii bibɔrb linyaŋ, ki gaa saatutunn David lii.

ref: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?
text: Gaa mi maadim bi ye bibiindam na chee lii; nyan mi biwɔwɔm bi kaa len ibamɔn ki puur tipuur inyamɔn ni na aapɔɔn ni.

ref: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
text: Cha tijapɔtiib li bi ke isui i muuni ki pɔɔ na baanachipɔnn ni. Cha tibisatiib li bi ke ŋigonyaan ŋi tii libɔrchiln kinyaan na.

ref: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
text: Cha timi aapil li gbii tijikaar mɔmɔk aabɔŋ. Cha timi aapiih i bi kipihkpaamook ni na pɔr churbakaa.

ref: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.
text: Cha timi aanaa pɔr ki taa li nyeeni lir, ki taa kpoi. Taa cha mpombiin aawiil li bi timi aatim ponn ni.

ref: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
text: Litimbol li kpa kina na kpa mpopiin; binib bi Aadindaan ye Uwumbɔr na kpa mpopiin.

ref: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
text: M ga li dooni si iwiin mɔmɔk; m ga li pak si ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
text: Uwumbɔr kpa mpɔɔn, kina pu le ni ŋan ke ti pak u sakpen; waapɔɔn nyaŋ a.

ref: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
text: Bi ga li len saah kpa mpɔɔn ni kipak pu na, le m ga li dakl lik saatukpaan ngbaan.

ref: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
text: Binib ga len saah tun ŋitukpaan ŋi na aabɔr, le m ga moon saah kpa mpɔɔn sakpiin mu na.

ref: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
text: Bi ga len saah kpa tiŋann ti mɔmɔk na, ki di gaa ilahn.

ref: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
text: Uwumbɔr kpa ngeehm le ki san kinimbaak, waaŋuul aa fiir mala mala, le waageehm wiir, kaa kpa ndoon.

ref: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
text: U kpa unibɔn mɔmɔk pu tiŋann, ki san waah naan tiwan ni mɔmɔk na kinimbaak.

ref: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
text: Uwumbɔr, saawanfuurkaan mɔmɔk ga pak si, le saanib mɔmɔk ga doon si.

ref: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
text: Bi ga len saanaan aapɔɔn aah kpa kinyuŋ pu na, ki len saah kpa mpɔɔn pu na,

ref: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
text: le unii mɔmɔk ga bee saatukpaan na, ni kinyuŋ aapɔɔn mu saanaan kpa na.

ref: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
text: Saah ga joo binib pu na aa kpa ndoon. Aa ga li ye ubɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Uwumbɔr ŋani waah puu tipuur ti na mɔmɔk, ki san kinimbaak waatuln mɔmɔk ni.

ref: When someone stumbles or falls, you give a helping hand.
text: U ter binib bi bi tibɔr ni na; u fiini binib bi lir ki dɔ na.

ref: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
text: Uwumbɔr, tiwanfuurkaan mɔmɔk lik sin pu le ki mak, le buyoonn ni ban tijikaar na, aa tii ni.

ref: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
text: Aa tii ni, ni ŋeer ni na, le ni mɔmɔk ji ki babr.

ref: Our Lord, everything you do is kind and thoughtful,
text: Uwumbɔr aah tun pu na mɔmɔk ŋan, u san kinimbaak waatuln mɔmɔk ni.

ref: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
text: U bi duun binib bi yin u ni bisui mɔmɔk na.

ref: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
text: U tii binib bimɔk nyuŋni u na baah ban pu na; u ŋun baawiil le ki nyani bi tibɔr ni.

ref: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
text: U kiir unii umɔk gee u na, le ki tee ga kuln bibiindam.

ref: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
text: M ga pak Uwumbɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Cha waawanfuurkaan mɔmɔk li pak waayimbil li bi chain na ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.
text: Maamɔfal mɔmɔk ni, m ga pak u; m ga gaa ilahn tii Maawumbɔr maamɔfal mɔmɔk ni.

ref: You can't depend on anyone, not even a great leader.
text: Taa li kpa limakl unibɔn aayidam pu, unibɔn aan ŋmaa nyan si tibɔr ni.

ref: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
text: Bi yaa nan kpo kan, bi ki kpaln titan la; baah ŋani ilandak i na mɔmɔk doo liyaadaal ngbaan le na.

ref: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
text: Uwumbɔr aah ter unii u aan udaan kpa limakl Udindaan Uwumbɔr pu na kpa mpopiin la.

ref: He gives justice to the poor and food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free
text: u len tibɔr ter baah muk binib bi na, ki tii nkon aah joo binib bi na tijikaar. Uwumbɔr nyani binib bi bi tiyondir ponn ni na lir,

ref: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
text: le ki likr bijoom aanimbil. U fiini binib bi lir ki dɔ na siini paacham; u gee waanib bi aabimbin ŋan na.

ref: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
text: Uma le joo bicham bi bi timi aatiŋ pu na; u ter bikpopiib ni nkpobim, le ki tee bii bibiindam aah kpokl pu na.

ref: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Uwumbɔr le ye ubɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Sionn aatiŋ aanib, nimi Aawumbɔr aanaan aan doo. Pak Uwumbɔr man.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr man. Ni ŋan ke ti li gaa ilahn ki pak Uwumbɔr; ni kpa mmɔɔn ki ŋan ke ti pak u.

ref: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and brings the people of Israel back home again.
text: Uwumbɔr ki bi maa Jerusalem la; u bi giini binib bi nan bi tinaagbiir ni na la.

ref: He renews our hopes and heals our bodies.
text: U sɔŋni binib bi aasui bii na aasui, ki poo biini baabuun pu.

ref: Our Lord is great and powerful! He understands everything.
text: Tidindaan ye Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan la; ubaa aa nyi waalan aah ti saa pu na.

ref: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
text: U fiini binib bi suln bibaa taab na paacham, le ki tee wɔi bibiindam bilni kitiŋ.

ref: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
text: Gaa kipak aalahn tii Uwumbɔr man; di kibeek gaa ilahn tii timi Aawumbɔr man.

ref: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
text: U cha ntaalangbam biini kitaapaak pu; u cha utaal nu kitiŋ pu, ki cha timoor punni ŋigongon pu.

ref: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
text: U tii tiwakor taajikaar, le ŋikakaa aabim yaa wii kan, u kpiini bi.

ref: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
text: Utafal aa bi itaan i pɔɔ na ni, kaa bi bijab bi kaar na ni;

ref: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.
text: u neen binib bi nyuŋni u ki mak waageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu la.

ref: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
text: Jerusalem, pak Uwumbɔr. Sionn, pak Saawumbɔr.

ref: He makes your city gates strong and blesses your people.
text: U cha saagon aabisamɔi pɔɔ, u ŋani waanyoor ŋani saanib pu.

ref: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
text: U joo saatiŋ aanaanmɔk le bidim aan ŋmaa koo ni, ki tii si njikaabim mu ŋan sakpen na le aa ji babr.

ref: As soon as God speaks, the earth obeys.
text: U tii kitiŋ limɔboln, le waah len pu na ŋani mala.

ref: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.
text: U taln ŋitaanal ke likekeln na la, ki cha likpakpal yaani ke kitangbaak na.

ref: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
text: U cha ŋitaatakpal lir ni ke isak na; tiwoor ti u tun ni na nyaŋ sakpen a,

ref: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.
text: le u tii limɔboln, le ŋitaanal donn, u tun ni libuln, le nnyun puu cha.

ref: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
text: U joo waamɔboln tii waanib Israel yaab, u tii bi waakaal ni waamɔkm.

ref: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Waa tun kina tii ŋitimbol ŋiken; baa nyi waakaal. Pak Uwumbɔr man.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr man. Paacham yaab, pak Uwumbɔr man, nimi bi bi paacham paacham na, pak u man.

ref: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
text: Nimi waatuuntiib mɔmɔk bi bi paacham na, pak u man.

ref: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
text: Nwiin ni uŋmal, pak u man; iŋmabi i moor lak lak na, pak u man.

ref: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
text: Paacham paacham yaab, pak u man, nnyun mu bi kitaapaak paab na, pak u.

ref: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
text: Cha bi mɔmɔk pak Uwumbɔr aayimbil. Waamɔboln le nan naan ni mɔmɔk.

ref: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
text: Waamɔboln le nan di ni mɔmɔk siin naabuu ponn ni ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na; le naa ŋmaa yii waamɔb.

ref: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
text: Nimi kitiŋ yaab, pak Uwumbɔr man, nimi nnyusakpem ni aawansakpiin, ni tiwan ni bi mu aanyonyoo ni na, pak u man;

ref: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
text: utaal aah moor pu na, ni ŋitaanal, ni ntaalangbam, ni ŋibun ŋi pɔɔ ki kii waakaal na, pak u man.

ref: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
text: Nimi ŋijoo, ni ŋigongon, pak u man, nimi ŋisubil aasui, ni tichoor, pak u man,

ref: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
text: nimi tiwakor mɔmɔk, linampal ni timoor ni aawakor, pak u man, nimi ikuub, ni inyoon, pak u man.

ref: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
text: nimi bisapɔm, ni binachipɔm, pak u man, nimi bininkpiib, ni mbim mu, pak u man.

ref: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
text: Cha bi mɔmɔk pak Uwumbɔr aayimbil. Waayimbil jer ŋiyimbil mɔmɔk, waanyuŋ jer paacham ni kitiŋ.

ref: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: U nan gee waatimbol Israel yaab pam ki tii bi mpɔɔn, nima pu le bi pak u. Pak Uwumbɔr man.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr man. Gaa nlahnpɔɔn tii Uwumbɔr man; pak u waanib bi kii waamɔb na aakuun ni.

ref: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
text: Israel yaab, li kpa mpopiin Uwumbɔr u nan ŋa nimi litimbol na pu; Sionn yaab, li mɔɔni Uwumbɔr u ye nimi aabɔr na pu man.

ref: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
text: Li waa liwaal pak waayimbil man; di ŋigangan ni tibar pak u man.

ref: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
text: Uwumbɔr neen waanib; u joo linyaŋ tii binib bi sunn bibaa taab na ki nyuŋni bi.

ref: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
text: Cha Uwumbɔr aanib li mɔɔni baah nyaŋ pu na pu, ki gaa mpopiin aalahn ti woln kitaak.

ref: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
text: Cha bi li tar mpɔɔn pu ki pak Uwumbɔr, ki li joo baajaak aajum mu ka na biŋaal ni,

ref: Take revenge and punish the nations.
text: ki nyaŋ ŋitimbol ŋi kaa dii Uwumbɔr aasan na, ki daa bitafal;

ref: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
text: ki di tikur aakululn buu baabɔrb ni baayidam;

ref: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: ki daa ŋitimbol ngbaan aatafal Uwumbɔr aah siin pu na. Uwumbɔr aanib aanyaŋ le bi na. Pak Uwumbɔr man.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
text: Pak Uwumbɔr man. Pak Uwumbɔr, Waadichal ni man. Pak waapɔɔn paacham man.

ref: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
text: Pak u, waatukpaan ŋi u tun na pu. Pak waanaan aapɔɔn mu nyaŋ na.

ref: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
text: Di kakaan mam pak u man. Di tibar ni ikuŋmin aabar pak u man.

ref: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
text: Di ŋigangan ki waa liwaal pak u man. Di tibar ni kulufeeŋ mam pak u man.

ref: Praise God with cymbals, with clashing cymbals.
text: Di ichayakrtuun pak u mpɔɔn pu man.

ref: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Nimi tiwanfuurkaan mɔmɔk, pak Uwumbɔr man. Pak Uwumbɔr man.

ref: These are the proverbs of King Solomon of Israel, the son of David.
text: Israel yaab aabɔr David aajapɔɔn Solomonn u mu nan ye ubɔr na aayataŋak.

ref: Proverbs will teach you wisdom and self-control and how to understand sayings with deep meanings.
text: Ŋiyataŋak ŋimina le ga cha aa bee nlan ni nsurm mu ŋan na, ki bee imɔliin i kpa tataa na.

ref: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
text: Ŋi ga ŋmaa ŋa unii u kaa kpa ichiin na ulandaan, ki mɔk binib bi laa diin na baah ga li bi mbimbin mu na.

ref: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
text: Ŋiyataŋak ŋee ga ŋmaa kpee bilandam nlan, ki ga mɔk binib bi bae mbaem na nsan,

ref: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
text: aan bi moo bee ŋiyataŋak ŋi bilandam ŋakl na aatataa. Binib bi laa diin na aasurm

ref: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
text: Waahr aan aa nin kan nlan na, see aa kpa kipak ni ijawaan ki tii Uwumbɔr. Bijɔrb ma aa ban nlan, ki yii ke baan bae mu.

ref: My child, obey the teachings of your parents,
text: Maabo, li pel aate ni aana aah tuk si pu na.

ref: and wear their teachings as you would a pretty hat or a lovely necklace.
text: Baamɔkm ga toor saabimbin, ke kiyikpupuk nyaan, ni nleenyaan aah ga kpee si kinyaan pu na.

ref: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen
text: Maabo, kinimbɔŋdam yaa ŋmann si kan, taa kii tii bi.

ref: They're well and healthy now, but we'll finish them off once and for all.
text: Ti yaa ti kan bi kan, bi ga li fu ki pɔɔ, le ti ti doo na, bi ga kpo.

ref: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
text: Ti ga kan liwankpal mɔmɔk aabɔŋ, ki gbiin timi aadichal.

ref: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.”
text: Dan nan ti kpee ti pu, aan ti yakr taah ga sun tiwan ni na.”

ref: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
text: Maabo, taa dii binib bimina aaboln. Taa duun bi chee.

ref: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
text: Baan ŋmaa kal kaa tun titunwanbir. N‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, bi bi ban bi ku ubaa la.

ref: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
text: Naa ŋan ke aa di gaawɔb pen uchakpee aanimbil ni,

ref: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
text: tɔ, kina aanii bi pen ubaa aagaawɔb la, gaawɔb u u pen na ni le u ga kpo.

ref: The wealth you get from crime robs you of your life. Wisdom Speaks
text: Unii umɔk su nnaayupɔɔn na aamɔfal door la. Unii umɔk aabimbin bir na aadoon le ye nkun. Nlan aah yin si pu na

ref: Wisdom shouts in the streets wherever crowds gather.
text: Li pel man. Nlan le yin ntim, ni kinyaŋ ponn ni,

ref: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
text: ki tar mpɔɔn pu ntikpaam aabisamɔi chee, ni binib aah kuuni nin chee na ke:

ref: “How much longer will you enjoy being stupid fools? Won't you ever stop sneering and laughing at knowledge?
text: “Bijɔrb, ni ban ni yunn kijɔrk ni kinye? Ni ban ke ni laa nlan ki ti saa bayoonn? Ni ga sil bae mbaem aa?

ref: Listen as I correct you and tell you what I think.
text: Li pel man maasurm, m ga tii nimi nsurm mu ŋan na, ki yakr maalan tii nimi.

ref: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
text: Ni yii maasurm, kaa gee ke m mɔk nimi mbamɔn.

ref: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
text: m ga ŋa nimi mbɔnyun, buyoonn i fuu ni nimi ke kitaabuŋ, ki joo ni nimi tibɔbir, aan ni bi iween sakpiin ni na.

ref: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
text: N‑yoonn ngbaan le ni ga yin mi, le maan gar nimi. Ni ga tee mban ki ban mi nwiin pu, ni kinyeek, kaan kan mi.

ref: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
text: N‑yoonn mɔmɔk naa di nlan yin nibaa, ki yii, naan kii tii Uwumbɔr.

ref: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
text: Ni yii maasurm n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, kaa ŋun tii mi buyoonn m mɔk nimi mbamɔn na.

ref: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
text: Kina pu le ni ga kan naah ban pu na, le nimi nibaa aabimbin ga cha ni buŋ.

ref: Sin and self-satisfaction bring destruction and death to stupid fools.
text: Bijɔrb aah yii nlan na le cha bi kpoi. Bijɔrb aah yii, kaan ŋun pu na le ku bi.

ref: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
text: Unii umɔk ŋun tii mi na aan kan tibɔbir tibaa. U ga li kpa lifuur, kaan li san ijawaan.”

ref: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
text: Maabo, bae maah mɔk si tiwan ni na, ki taa suln maah tuk si ke aa ŋa pu na daalbaadaal.

ref: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
text: Li ŋun tiwan ni mɔk nlan na, ki pɔɔk aabaa ki bee naatataa.

ref: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
text: Mbamɔn, li mee ban nlan; ki li gaŋni ban tiwan aatataa aabeem.

ref: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
text: Li ban kina aawan, ke saah ban tikunabr ni liwankpal li bɔr na pu na.

ref: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
text: Aa yaa ŋani kina kan, aa beer naah ŋan sakpen pu ke aa li san Uwumbɔr ijawaan, aan ki bee waabɔr na.

ref: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
text: Uwumbɔr le tii nlan; uma chee le nlan, ni ichiin, ni tiwan aatataa aabeem nyani.

ref: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
text: U ter binib bi aabimbin ŋan na, le ki kii bi.

ref: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
text: U kiir binib bi gee biŋeen aatɔtiib na, ni binib bi di bibaa tii u na.

ref: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
text: Aa ga ŋa nlan, le saalan ngbaan ga tii si mmɔɔn.

ref: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
text: Saalan mu cha aa beer tiwan aatataa na ga li kii si,

ref: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
text: ki nyan si kinimbɔŋ ni. Mu ga nyan si binib bi aamɔliin ban tibɔr,

ref: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
text: aan bi di nsanyaan di lii, ki ye kinimbɔŋdam,

ref: Most of all they enjoy being mean and deceitful.
text: ki ye binib bi kani mmɔɔn, baatunwanbir, ni kijɔrk aatunwanbir pu,

ref: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
text: ki ye binib bi unii aan ŋmaa puk kipupuk bi pu na.

ref: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
text: Aa ga ŋmaa nyaŋ upiidagoor u suln u ni uchal aah puu tipuur ti na bɔr, ki nyan uchal aapuwɔb, ki pɔɔni ubaa ke u di kimɔmɔɔn nyaŋ si na.

ref: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
text: Aa yaa dii u buen udo kan, aa dii nsan mu cha nkun ni na la. Aa yaa chaa nima kan, aa duun kitekpiitiŋ a.

ref: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
text: Unii ubaa aa kee buen ti mann u ki ki gir ni. Udaan aa ki gir ni limɔfal aasan ni.

ref: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
text: Kina pu na, aa li dii binib bi aabimbin ŋan na aah dii nsan mu na.

ref: If you are honest and innocent, you will keep your land;
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na, ni binib bi kaa kpa beebee na ga li bi timi aatiŋ kee pu,

ref: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
text: le Uwumbɔr ga chuu nyan bibiindam ni titunwanbirdam kitiŋ ngbaan pu, ke baah ŋɔi tisufabir lir pu na la.

ref: My child, remember my teachings and instructions and obey them completely.
text: Maabo, taa suln maah tuk si pu na. Li teer maah tuk si ke aa ŋa pu na n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
text: Maamɔkm ga tii si liwangol, ni limɔfal li fɔk na.

ref: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.
text: Taa cha ngeehm ni gaakii ŋmar si. Di ni gbin aaneen ni, ki ŋmee ni paan aapobil pu.

ref: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
text: Aa yaa ŋani kina kan, Uwumbɔr ni binib mu aasui ga li piin aa pu.

ref: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
text: Di aasui mɔmɔk kii tii Uwumbɔr. Taa li joo saah dak ke aa nyi pu na tun.

ref: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
text: Teer Uwumbɔr bɔr, saatuln mɔmɔk ni, le u ga mɔk si nsanyaan.

ref: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
text: Taa dakl daalbaadaal ke aa nyi jer saah nyi pu na; kii tii Uwumbɔr, ki yii titunwanbir aatum.

ref: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
text: Di saajikaar ti ŋan na tii Uwumbɔr ipiin ki li pak u.

ref: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
text: Aa yaa ŋani kina kan, saapil ga gbiin njikaabim, le ndapɔm ga gbiin saadabuu mɔmɔk.

ref: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
text: Maabo, Uwumbɔr yaa sak si kan, ŋun mbamɔm, ki kii ke nsurm ngbaan ye mbamɔn la.

ref: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
text: Uwumbɔr sur binib bi u gee bi na, ke te aah sur waabo u u kpa u pu limakl na pu na la.

ref: God blesses everyone who has wisdom and common sense.
text: Uwumbɔr aanyoor bi unii u kan nlan ki kpa ŋuntii na pu la.

ref: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
text: Tinyoor bi kina aawan ni, ki jer ŋimombil, kina aawan kpa tinyoor ki jer salmaa.

ref: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
text: Nlan kpa tinyoor ki jer nleenyaan; nlan ŋan jer saah neen tiwan nimɔk na.

ref: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
text: Nlan tii si liwangol, ni limɔfal li fɔk na, ni kipak la.

ref: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
text: Nlan ga ŋmaa tii si mmɔɔn aamɔfal, ki ga li joo si mbamɔm ki ti saa saadoon.

ref: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
text: Binib bi kan nlan na kpa mpopiin. Nlan ga tii bi limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
text: Uwumbɔr nan di nlan le ki di naan dulnyaa, waalan le u di kitaapaak siin kaah bi nin chee na.

ref: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
text: Waalan le cha ŋimɔɔ puu, ki cha ntaalangbam tii kitiŋ utaal.

ref: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
text: Maabo, li joo nlan ni mbaem mbamɔm. Taa cha ni nya aa chee daalbaadaal.

ref: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
text: Ni ga tii si limɔfal li ye mmɔɔn, ni mpopiin aamɔfal na.

ref: You will walk safely and never stumble;
text: Nibaa aan ŋa si saasan ni, le aa ga chuun, kaan gbeer nibaa.

ref: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.
text: Aa yaa cha aa ti doon geen kan, saan li san ijawaan, le aa ga geen mbamɔm.

ref: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
text: Saan li san ijawaan i ga lir si, ke yaah ga lir ubiindaan, ke kitaabuŋ aah lir unii pu na.

ref: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.
text: Uwumbɔr ga li kii si. Waan cha aa koo gaawɔb ubaa ni.

ref: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
text: N‑yoonn mumɔk aah ga ŋman na kan, aa ŋa tiŋann tii binib bi ban ti na.

ref: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.
text: Aa yaa ŋmaa ter aaŋeen aatɔ dandana kan, taa bui u ke u li kii fen aan aa fe ter u.

ref: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
text: Taa gor tiwan ni ga bii aaŋeen aatɔ u koo gbɔk si ki kpa aa pu limakl na.

ref: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
text: Taa kpak unii u kaa tun si taani na kinikpakpak.

ref: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
text: Taa li kpa lipiipoln binib bi bir na pu, ki mu taa tun baah tun ŋitun ŋi na,

ref: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
text: ba pu? Uwumbɔr aa gee binib bi tun titunwanbir na, li ki tee tuk binib bi aabimbin ŋan na waabɔbɔrkaan.

ref: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.
text: Uwumbɔr puuni lir bibiindam aadichal pu, le ki ŋani waanyoor ŋani binib bi aabimbin ŋan na aadichal pu.

ref: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
text: Waa di binib bi kpa kigaak na yin nibaa, le ki lik faar binib bi sunn bibaa taab na.

ref: You will be praised if you are wise, but you will be disgraced if you are a stubborn fool.
text: U ga tii bilandam liyimbil li nyuun na, le ki ga di inimɔɔn kpee bijɔrb, baajɔrk pu.

ref: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
text: Maabim, li ŋun tiwan ni mɔmɔk nite mɔk nimi na. Pel mbamɔm, ki li kpa nlan man.

ref: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.
text: Maah bi mɔk nimi tiwan ni na ŋan, kina pu na, teer ni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk man.

ref: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father
text: Maah nan laa ye ubo waatiir, ki ye nte ni nna aabobaal na, nte nan mɔk mi tiwan.

ref: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
text: U ga nan len ke, “Teer maah tuk si pu na n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ki taa suln ni daalbaadaal. Ŋa maah mɔk si pu na, ki li kpa limɔfal.

ref: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
text: Kan nlan, kan nlan mu aa ga di bee tiwan na. Taa suln maah tuk si pu na, ki taa li ye tafalaaŋundaan.

ref: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
text: Taa di nlan mee, le mu li kii si; li gee mu aan mu ga li kii si mbamɔm.

ref: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
text: Nlan aakam le ye tiwankpaan ni aa ga ŋa na. Li ban nlan ki jer tiwan ni mɔmɔk aa neen na.

ref: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
text: Li gee nlan, le mu ga ŋa si unikpaan. Gaa mu ki kii aan mu joo ni si liyimbil.

ref: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
text: Muma le ga li ye saayimbil li nyuun ki kpa kipak na.”

ref: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
text: Maabo, ŋun tii mi. Kii maah tuk si pu na mbamɔm, ki li kpa limɔfal li fɔk na.

ref: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
text: N‑yoonn mu aa dii nlan aasan na kan, nibaa aan ŋmaa leŋ saasan, le buyoonn aa bi san na kan, saan gbeer nibaa.

ref: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
text: Li teer saah bae tiwan ni na n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Saabaen le ye saamɔfal, li kii mu mbamɔm.

ref: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
text: Taa chaa kinimbɔŋdam aah chaa nin chee na. Taa dii bibiindam aah mɔk si pu na.

ref: Turn aside and keep going. Stay away from them.
text: Taa ŋa ni kpala. Nya kinimbɔŋ chee. Yii ki, ki gir dii saasan.

ref: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.
text: Bibiindam yaa kaa tun titunwanbir kan, baa geeni. Bi yaa kaa tii ubaa titotonn kan, bi dɔ waa la.

ref: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
text: Mbiin ni linikul ye bi chee tijikaar ni ndaan la.

ref: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
text: Mbimbinyaandam aah dii nsan mu na naahn nwiin aah puu pu na la, mu wiin, le ki moo wolni ki ti saa buyoonn mu ga nya ni kookoo na.

ref: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
text: Tɔ, bibiindam aasan ma bɔɔn ke kinyeek na la. Bi lir, le ki mu aa waa baah gbeer tiwan ni na.

ref: My child, listen carefully to everything I say.
text: Maabo, li pel maah len pu na mbamɔm. Li pel maamɔbon mbamɔm.

ref: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
text: Taa cha ŋi nya aa chee daalbaadaal. Teer ŋi ki li joo ŋi aasui ni.

ref: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
text: Ŋi ga tii unii umɔk bee ŋaatataa na limɔfal ni mpɔɔn.

ref: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
text: Li nyi saah dak pu na; saabimbin naahn saalandak la.

ref: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
text: Taa len tibɔr ti kaa gbii na. Taa li neen inyamɔn ni tibɔr ti ŋmanni na.

ref: Keep looking straight ahead, without turning aside.
text: Cha aayil li yaa paacham ni limakl, taa timm aayil ni inimɔɔn.

ref: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
text: Dakl lik saah ga tun pu na mbamɔm, ki cha saah ŋani tiwan nimɔk na li ye mbamɔn.

ref: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
text: Nya kinimbɔŋ chee ki li chuun mbamɔm. Taa cha aataal libaa yenn mbamɔn chee.

ref: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
text: Maabo, pel mbamɔm, ki ŋun maalan ni mbaem.

ref: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
text: Kina kan, aa ga li nyi saah ga li bi pu na, ki cha saamɔliin mɔk ke aa kpa nlan.

ref: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
text: Nibaakan aaŋeen aatɔ aapuu aamɔgban ga li mirk ke tisiir na,

ref: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
text: U ga di si kunn bitekpiib chee. Waah chuun waasan mu pu na cha nkun ni la.

ref: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
text: Waa bi limɔfal aasan ni; le ki nya do ki ti nya do kaa nyi tiwan ni bi ŋani na.

ref: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.
text: Njapɔtiib, li pel dandana wee man, ki taa suln maah bi len pu na man.

ref: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
text: Li san kina aapii man. Taa duun waabisamɔb man.

ref: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
text: Ni yaa ŋa kina kan, binib bibaa le ga nan gaa naah kpa liyimbil li na, le ni ga kpo nimi aanachipɔnn ni, bibiindam aaŋaal ni.

ref: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.
text: Mbamɔn, bicham le ga gaa nimi aawangol, le naah tun ki kan tiwan ni na ga kpaln bibaa yaan.

ref: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
text: Aa ga li dɔ saakun aawandookaan pu ki du, ki donn kpakl kpakl,

ref: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.”
text: le ki nan kpaan yoork mbaa binib ni.”

ref: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
text: Cha aasui li bi aapuu baanja ni, ki di saageehm tii uma baanja.

ref: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
text: Saah ma mbim mu bipiib biken chee na aan ŋa si tinyoor.

ref: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
text: Ni ŋan ke saabim muun ki nan ter sin la, naa ye biniyayam.

ref: Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.
text: Kina pu na, li kpa aapuu chee mpopiin ki kan mmɔɔn usapɔɔn u aa nan yoor na chee,

ref: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
text: u kpa kinyaan ki bi suuna ke upeeman na la. Cha waanyaan tii si mpopiin ki cha u di waageehm tii si.

ref: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
text: Maabo, ba ŋa aa joo saageehm tii upii uken? Ba ŋa aa tee gee aaŋeen aatɔ aapuu aanyaan ki jer aayoo?

ref: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.
text: Uwumbɔr kani saah ŋani tiwan ni na mɔmɔk. U waa si saasachun mɔmɔk ni.

ref: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.
text: Ubiindaan aatunwanbir ye gaawɔb la. Uma ubaa aatunwanbir le chur u.

ref: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
text: Waah kaa ŋmaa chur ubaa pu na le ku u. Waajɔrk sakpeŋ le ga tun u waakaakul ni.

ref: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
text: Maabo, aa puu tipuur ke aa ga gaa ubaa aapɔln ki pa aa?

ref: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
text: Aa yaa koo kina aabɔr ni kan, saah ga ŋa pu ki nya na sɔ. Ŋa mala ki buen udaan chee ki ti gaŋ u ke u di cha pinn si.

ref: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
text: Taa li dɔ geen. Taa sil ke aa fuur waahr aan ki nin buen.

ref: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
text: Nya gaawɔb ngbaan ni mala ke unyoon, bee upeeyun aah ŋmar ukpan pu na.

ref: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.
text: Bigbanyakdam, lik man inyann aah bi pu na ki bae mbaem i chee.

ref: Ants don't have leaders,
text: Yaa kpa usaloln, kaa kpa ubɔr, bee ujojoor,

ref: but they store up food during harvest season.
text: i mu tee kuuni yaajikaar lipeel la, ki gor ki kii kiseek.

ref: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
text: Bayoonn aan ugbanyakdaan ga finn ngeen pu? U ga doon ki yunn kinye?

ref: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
text: Waamɔliin le ye ke, “Cha m doon geen siib, m ga bɔɔb ŋŋaal ki fuur siib.”

ref: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.
text: Tɔ, buyoonn u dɔ geen na le igiin ga dan ki nan chuu u ke unaayuk‑pɔɔl na.

ref: Worthless liars go around
text: Nifam mam ni bibiindam le geei inyamɔn.

ref: winking and giving signals to deceive others.
text: Bi kae binimbil ki yoor si iŋaal ke bi ŋmann si la,

ref: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
text: le ki bi dak tibɔbir baasuuwanbir ngbaan ni, ki fikr tibɔkpokr ni kookoo.

ref: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
text: Nimina pu na, tibɔbir yaa ga pii bi kan, baan li nyi ti pu, le bi ga kan iween i ga ku bi na.

ref: always keep it in mind and never forget it.
text: Li joo baabɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, ki di ti laŋ ŋa aapobil ni.

ref: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
text: Aa yaa cha nsan kan, baamɔkm le ga di si buen, ki li kii si kinyeek, ki sur si nwiin pu.

ref: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
text: Baamɔkm ye nwiin mu moor lak lak na la, baasurm ga ŋmaa mɔk si saah ga li bi pu na.

ref: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
text: Baamɔkm ga ŋmaa nyan si bipiidagoob chee, ki ga nyan si aaŋeen aatɔ aapuu aamɔmɔɔn ni.

ref: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
text: Taa cha baanyaan chuu si, ki taa cha baadagoonimbil chuu si.

ref: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
text: Uja ga ŋmaa di liboroboro kpiln libaa aamombil daa pateer, le aa yaa doon aaŋeen aatɔ aapuu chee kan, ni ga ŋmaa gaa saamɔfal aa chee.

ref: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
text: Aa ga ŋmaa di mmii tam aabiŋ aan mu taa gaa saawanpeenkaan aa?

ref: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
text: Aa ga ŋmaa chuun mmiisakɔn ni aan mu taa wu aataa aa?

ref: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
text: Aa yaa ban aaŋeen aatɔ aapuu kan, ni mu bir kina la. Unii umɔk ŋa kina na ga ji falaa.

ref: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
text: Nkon yaa joo unaayuk aan u ti sun tijikaar kan, baan lik seen u;

ref: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
text: bi yaa chuu u kan, u ga pa waah sun pu na nfum mulole, u ga di waawankpal mɔmɔk pa ni pu.

ref: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
text: Uja umɔk gɔr kidagook na aa kpa nlan kpala. U bi bii ubaa la.

ref: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.
text: Upii aachal aaŋuul fiir sakpen buyoonn lipiipoln joo u na la; waah ga teen uja ngbaan pu na aa kpa ndoon.

ref: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
text: Waan gaa tipar tibaa kina pu. Ipiin ibaa aa bi ki ga ŋmaa sɔŋ usui.

ref: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
text: Maabo, teer maah tuk si pu na, ki taa suln maah bui si ke aa ŋa pu na.

ref: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.
text: Ŋa maah tuk si pu na ki li kpa limɔfal. Li dii maah mɔk si pu na mbamɔm ke saah kii saanimbil pu na.

ref: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
text: Li joo maamɔkm n‑yoonn mɔmɔk; ŋmee mu paan aapobil pu.

ref: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
text: Mu ga nyan si aaŋeen aatɔtiib aapuutiib bi kpa kimɔmɔɔn na chee. Upiininsun

ref: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
text: N‑yoonn mubaa le m nan si baa maatakolu ki lik lipaal,

ref: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
