text: Le upii ngbaan to u nsan ni; u nan buu ubaa ke upiidagoor na, le ki bi dak waalandak uyil ni.

ref: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
text: U nan ye upii u kaa san inimɔɔn ki chuun kpak kitiŋ ponn ni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na la,

ref: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.
text: bee ki si tilɔlɔnn ni, n‑yoonn mubaa mu kan, kitiŋ ni, mubaa mu kan, kinyaŋ ni.

ref: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
text: U nan di uŋaal kpal unachipɔɔn ngbaan, ki moor utakpiln, ki lik unimbil ni chimm, le ki bui ke,

ref: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
text: “M toor maatork din le ki kan tinann kitork ngbaan ni.

ref: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
text: M di ŋikekenyaan ŋi nyan ni Ijipt aatiŋ ni na le paan maawandookaan pu.

ref: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
text: M di tulalee tiib bi bi yin bi ke mir, ni alos, ni sinamonn na le di yɔk yɔk u pu.

ref: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
text: Nchal aa bi linampal. U buen nsan kaan gir ni mala.

ref: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
text: U joo ŋimombil ŋi wiir na kaan gir ni ki ti saa ŋikpaakoo ŋilee.”

ref: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
text: Upii ngbaan nan ŋa kina le ki di waabɔnyɔk chuu unachipɔɔn ngbaan, le u kii waamɔmɔɔn ngbaan.

ref: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
text: Libuul ngbaan ni le u san dii u ke unaa u bi joo u cha bi ti kɔr u na, ki naahn ke upeel u yuk jaa jaa ke u ti koo gaawɔb ponn ni na,

ref: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
text: ki cha nin chee mpiin ga ti too chaar upobil na. U nan naahn unyoon u cha u ti koo kipɔɔk ni na la, kaa nyi ke waamɔfal bi tibɔr ni.

ref: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
text: Tɔ, maabim, li pel man. Ŋun tii man maah len pu na.

ref: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
text: Taa cha kina aapii koo nisui ni man; taa chuun ban u man.

ref: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
text: U bii bijab pam, ki junn bijab bi kaa kpa nkahm na aamɔfal.

ref: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
text: Ni yaa buen udo kan, ni bi nkun aasan ni la. Mu ye nsan mu cha kitekpiitiŋ ni la.

ref: With great understanding, Wisdom is calling out
text: Li pel man. Nlan le yin nimi. Ichiin le yin nimi.

ref: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
text: Mu bi ŋijoo pu, ki chuun isan ni, ki si isayakr mɔmɔk ni ki yin.

ref: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
text: Mu si ntim aabisamɔi ki yin, ki len ke;

ref: “I am calling out to each one of you!
text: “M gaŋni si, unibɔn; m yin unii umɔk bi kitiŋ pu na.

ref: Listen, because what I say is worthwhile and right.
text: Li pel man maamɔbonyaan ŋee; ŋi mɔmɔk ye ibamɔn la.

ref: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
text: Maah len pu na ye mbamɔn la; maa geei inyamɔn.

ref: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
text: Maah len tiwan ni mɔmɔk na ye ibamɔn la, nibaa aa ye inyamɔn, bee tiwan ni ga cha aa yenn na.

ref: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
text: Ni wiin chain unii u kpa nlan na chee la, ni nyan dɔ mpaan pu unii u kpa ichiin na chee la.

ref: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
text: Lee maamɔkm ki di cha ŋimombil, lee nnyim ki di cha salmaa.

ref: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
text: Min le ye nlan, m ŋan jer nleen mu ŋan sakpen na. Nlan ŋan jer saah neen tiwan ni mɔmɔk na.

ref: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
text: Min le ye nlan, m kpa ŋuntii, m kpa ichiin le ki nyi tiwan ni ŋan na, ni ni kaa ŋan na.

ref: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
text: Saah ga nyuŋ Uwumbɔr pu na le ye ke aa yii kinimbɔŋ; maa gee kigaak, ni inimpoo, ni kinimbɔŋ aasan, ni inyamɔn aamɔliin.

ref: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
text: M ŋani laasaab waahr le ki tun maatuln. M kpa ichiin, le ki pɔɔ.

ref: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
text: M ter bibɔrb le bi joo baanib, le ki ter biyidam le bi siini ikaal i ŋan na.

ref: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
text: M gee binib bi gee mi na; unii umɔk ban mi na ga kan mi.

ref: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
text: M kpa liwankpal ni kinyuŋ, ni liwangol li kaan doo na, ni ibamɔn m tii nimi.

ref: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
text: Saah ga kan tiwan ni m chee na ŋan jer salmaa u ŋan sakpen na, ki ŋan jer ŋimombil mɔmɔk.

ref: I always do what is right,
text: M chuun mbimbinyaan, ni ibamɔn aasan ni la,

ref: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
text: le ki joo liwankpal tii binib bi gee mi na, ki joo nkam gbiini baadichal ni.

ref: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
text: Min le Uwumbɔr nan pue naan njan, waahr aan u nin naan tiwan nibaa.

ref: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
text: Min le u nan pue naan njan, le dulnyaa nin piin.

ref: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
text: M nan bi waahr le nnyusakpem nin naan, n‑yoonn ngbaan inyunbun aa nan kee bi.

ref: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
text: M nan bi waahr le Uwumbɔr nin naan ŋijoo ni ŋigongon,

ref: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
text: m nan bi le Uwumbɔr nin naan kitiŋ ni kaakpaakon, ni njan aatan ti ga gbiin liŋaakul libaa na.

ref: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
text: M nan bi le u di kitaapaak siin kaabuul ni, ki taln ntaalangbam ti siin nnyusakpem aanaanmɔk,

ref: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
text: m nan bi le u di ntaalangbam di ŋa kitaapaak ni, m nan bi le u chuu piir nnyusakpem aanyunbun

ref: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
text: le ki bui nnyusakpem aanyun ke mu taa ki fii ti jer waah siin mu nin chee na. M nan bi le u naan kitiŋ aatinyikl.

ref: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
text: M nan si u chee ke unii u bi mɔk udimaar na la; min le nan ye waawiin mɔmɔk aamɔɔn, le ki kpa u chee mpopiin n‑yoonn mɔmɔk,

ref: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.
text: m nan kpa dulnyaa pu mpopiin, le nsui piin unibɔn pu.

ref: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
text: Tɔ, maabim, li pel m chee man. Ŋa maah len pu na man, ki li kpa mpopiin.

ref: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
text: Li pel baah mɔk nimi tiwan ni na man. Li kpa nlan man, ki taa lik mu fam kpala.

ref: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
text: Unii u ŋun tii mi na kpa mpopiin; unii u ka maadichal aabisamɔb, ki ka kii mi iwiin mɔmɔk na ga li kpa mpopiin.

ref: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
text: Unii u kan mi na kan limɔfal la, le Uwumbɔr ga li gee u.

ref: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
text: Unii umɔk aa ban kan mi na tii ubaa titotonn la; unii umɔk kaa gee mi na gee nkun la.”

ref: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
text: Nlan le maa lidichal, le ki maa ŋitakpal aajaatɔlk tiib bilole kiir lidichal ngbaan.

ref: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
text: Mu nan ku kiwakork ke mu ji njim, le ki di tiwan ni nu mɔ na ŋmal ndaan ni, le ki gor ni mɔmɔk siin.

ref: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
text: Mu nan tun mu aanaagbiisapɔm ke bi ti sil kitiŋ ni nin chee paa sakpen sakpen na ki yin ke,

ref: “Everyone who is ignorant or foolish is invited!
text: “Nimi maa‑nyi‑nibaa‑dam, dan man,” le ki bui bijɔrb ke,

ref: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
text: “Dan ki nan ji maajikaar, ki nyu maadaan mu m ŋa na.

ref: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
text: Nya maa‑nyi‑nibaa‑dam chee man, ki kan limɔfal. Li dii nlan aasan man.”

ref: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
text: Taa sur unii u yoor ubaa paacham sakpen na, u ga li nan si nsurm ngbaan pu. Tɔ, aa yaa sur ulandaan ma kan, u ga li gee si.

ref: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
text: Saah di tiwan nimɔk tuk ulandaan na moo kpae u nlan la. Tiwan ni aa di tuk unii u kpa mbimbinyaan na moo kpae u nlan la.

ref: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
text: Aa yaa ban aa li kpa nlan kan, puen bee Uwumbɔr ke uma le yeh kipak mɔmɔk. Aa yaa bee Uwumbɔr u ye Chain na kan, aa sil kpa nlan.

ref: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
text: Nlan ga di ŋibin pam moo kpee saamɔfal pu.

ref: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
text: Sin u kpa nlan na le ga kan tinyoor, le sin u yii nlan na ga ji falaa.

ref: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
text: U ka waadichal aabisamɔb, bee kitiŋ ni, nin chee paa sakpen sakpen na,

ref: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
text: “Maa‑nyi‑nibaa‑dam, dan man,” le ki bui bijɔrb ke,

ref: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
text: “Nnyun sukaan mɔ jer aabaa yoo. Tijikaar sukaan mɔ jer aabaa yaar.”

ref: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
text: Solomonn aayataŋak sɔ: Ubolandaan aate nyu u pu baala la; le ujɔr ma aana aasui bii u pu.

ref: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
text: Aa yaa di inyamɔn kan liwangol kan, laa kpa si tinyoor tibaa; le ibamɔn ma ga nyan si nkun ni.

ref: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
text: Uwumbɔr aan cha bininyaam chuun nkon, le kaan tii ubiindaan ma nibaa.

ref: At harvest season it's smart to work hard, but stupid to sleep.
text: Ulandaan chee waajikaar buyoonn ti biir na la; ni ye inimɔɔn sakpiin le ke aa li dɔ geen lijikaacheel yoonn.

ref: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
text: Uninyaan ga kan Uwumbɔr aanyoor. Ubiindaan aamɔmɔɔn le biini waabimbin mu kaa ŋan na pu.

ref: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
text: Binib yaa teer uninyaan bɔr kan, ni joo ni bi tinyoor la, le bi ga suln ubiindaan ma bɔr mala.

ref: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
text: Bilandam gaal nsurm mu ŋan na la. Binib bi len kijɔrk aabɔr na ga kuln.

ref: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na bi ŋŋmarm, ni lifuur ni la, le binib bi aabimbin aa ŋan na ma ga koo tibɔr ni.

ref: Deceit causes trouble, and foolish talk will bring you to ruin.
text: Unii u joo ibamɔn bɔrni na ban tibɔr la, le unii u len kijɔrk aabɔr na ga kuln.

ref: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
text: Unibamɔnn aamɔliin ye limɔfal aanyunbun la, le ubiindaan ma joo kimɔmɔɔn bɔrni waabimbin mu kaa ŋan na.

ref: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
text: Kinanaŋ ban tibɔr la, le ngeehm ma kuln taani mɔmɔk.

ref: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.
text: Bilandam kani nlan le ki joo mu, le bijɔrb aamɔliin ni kijaak chee aa daa tɔb.

ref: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
text: Biwankpadam aawangol le kii bi, le igiin mu ku bigiim.

ref: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
text: Tiŋann aanyoor le ye limɔfal, le titunwanbir moo tii titunwanbir.

ref: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
text: Binib bi ŋun tii nsurm na kpa limɔfal, le binib bi kaa kii ke unii sur bi na bi tibɔbir ni.

ref: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
text: Unii u joo waananaŋ bɔrni na ye unyamɔndaan la. Unii u mu ye ubɔmbɔtukr na mu ye ujɔr la.

ref: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
text: Aa yaa gbaa tibɔr sakpen kan, saa pɔɔ titunwanbir aakoom ni. Aa yaa kpa nlan kan, li ŋmin suuna.

ref: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
text: Uninyaan aamɔbon naahn tikunabr ti ŋan na la; le ubiindaan ma aalandak aa kpa tinyoor tibaa.

ref: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
text: Uninyaan aamɔbon ga ter kinipaak, le igbaan ga ŋmaa ku si.

ref: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
text: Uwumbɔr aanyoor le tii si liwankpal. Aabaa aatusakpeln aan ŋmaa ŋa si uwankpadaan.

ref: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
text: Aa yaa tun taani ki kpa mpopiin kan, ni ye kijɔrk la. Binib bi kpa ichiin na kpa mpopiin nlan pu la.

ref: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na kani baah ban pu na la, le bibiindam kani baah san tiwan ni ijawaan sakpen na.

ref: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
text: Kitaabuŋ daar, le ki joo bibiindam cha, le bininyaam ma kpa ŋŋmarm n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
text: Taa cha ugbanyakdaan ŋa lituln libaa tii si; u ga li bi ke tiwan ni mɔɔn na aah koo aamɔb ni kan, ni bi pu na, bee iŋmanyuu aah koo aanimbil ni kan, ni bi pu na.

ref: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
text: Kii tii Uwumbɔr, ki li kpa limɔfal li fɔk na. Bibiindam kpoi kaa fuur baakundaal.

ref: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
text: Bininyaam aamakl joo ni bi mpopiin la, le bibiindam ma aan kan nibaa.

ref: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
text: Uwumbɔr le kii binib bi aabimbin ŋan na, le ki tee kuln binib bi tun taani na.

ref: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na ga kan ŋŋmarm n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, le bibiindam ma aan yunn kitiŋ kee pu.

ref: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na len nlan aamɔbon la, le lilambil li len tibɔbir na ga ŋmin chii.

ref: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na nyi tibɔnyaan ti bi ga len na, le bibiindam ma len tibɔr ti wu na n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
text: Uwumbɔr nan binib bi joo beebee aawaŋaŋkaan ŋaŋni tiwan na. Usui piin tiwaŋaŋkaan ni ye nibamɔnn na pu.

ref: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
text: Naan yunn le binib bi mak sakpen na ji inimɔɔn. Ni ye nlan ke aa li bi suuna.

ref: If you do the right thing, honesty will be your guide. But if you are crooked, you will be trapped by your own dishonesty.
text: Aa yaa ye unii u ŋan na kan, saabimbinyaan le kii si. Binib bi kpa beebee na aabeebee le kuln bi.

ref: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
text: Nwiin mundaal aa ni nkun ga kan tɔb na, liwankpal aan ŋmaa gaa si lii, le saabamɔn ma ga gaa si lii.

ref: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
text: Ibamɔn le tii uninyaan lifuur, le mbiindaan ma ga joo ni ubaa aalirm.

ref: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
text: Mbimbinyaan le gaal ubamɔndaan lir, le saah kaan ŋmaa nyu unii u pu baala na aakumɔŋ chur u ŋani tibɔr ni.

ref: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na nya tibɔbir ni la; le ti tee choo bibiindam ma chee.

ref: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
text: Binib bi kaa nyi Uwumbɔr na aabɔlen ga ŋmaa kuln saamɔfal, le binib bi aabimbin ŋan na aalan ga ŋmaa nyan si tibɔr ni.

ref: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na yaa mee Uwumbɔr aanyoor ŋa kitiŋ pu kan, ki kani liyimbikpaan la; le bibiindam ma aamɔbon joo ni kitiŋ aadoon.

ref: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
text: Aa yaa bii aaŋeen aatɔtiib aayimbil kan, ni ye kijɔrk la. Aa yaa kpa nlan kan, li ŋmin suuna.

ref: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.
text: Ubaa aan di tibɔbɔrkaan tuk ubɔmbɔtukr, tɔ, aa ga ŋmaa mak unii u ŋmaa joo tibɔbɔrkaan na pu.

ref: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
text: Litimbol yaa kaa kpa ujojoor u kpa nlan kan, li ga lir la. Bisusurb yaa wiir kan, ni mɔk ke ŋŋmarm bi le na.

ref: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
text: Upii u aabimbin ŋan na kpa kipak binib chee, le binib bi aabimbin pɔɔ na kan liwankpal.

ref: Kindness is rewarded— but if you are cruel, you hurt yourself.
text: Aa yaa kpa tiŋann kan, aa tii aabaa le tiŋann. Aa yaa kpa mbiin kan, aa tii aabaa le titotonn.

ref: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
text: Unii umɔk aanimbil man ke u ŋa tiwan ni ŋan na ga li kpa limɔfal, tɔ, unii umɔk aanimbil man ke u tun titunwanbir na ga kpo.

ref: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.
text: Uwumbɔr aa gee binib bi kpa tilandakwanbir na, le ki tee gee binib bi ŋani ni ŋan na.

ref: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
text: Li nyi gbin gbin ke titunwanbirdam ga kan ntafadaan, le binib bi aabimbin ŋan na ma ga ŋmar.

ref: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
text: Upii u kpa kinyaan kaa kɔ nibaa na aanyaan naahn salmaa aabɔmbik ki too ugbeer aamɔfajuln pu na la.

ref: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
text: Bininyaam aah ban tiwan ni na nya n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ki ŋan la, le bibiindam ma yaa kan baah ban pu na kan, ni wu unii mɔmɔk.

ref: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
text: Binib bibaa tii baamombil bisui mɔmɔk, le ki moo kani liwankpal. Bibaa mu tii ki chur bibaa le ki moo ŋani bigiim.

ref: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
text: Li kpa tiŋann sakpen aan ki moo kan liwangol. Ter biken aan ki mu kan nterm.

ref: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
text: Binib puuni lir unii u joo njikaabim siini ke mu moo ŋa kidaak na pu, le ki pak unii u nyan waajikaabim siin kinyaŋ ni ke binib daa na.

ref: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
text: Unii umɔk ban ke ni li ŋan na ga kan kipak, le umɔk ban tibɔr na ga kan kina.

ref: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
text: Binib bi di baanaadii tii liwangol na ga lir ke lipeel aafar na, le binib bi kpa mbimbinyaan na ga kan liwangol ke kiseek ni aafar na.

ref: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
text: Unii u ban tibɔr tii waadichal na ga nan lann tiwan mɔmɔk. Bijɔrb le ga li ye bilandam aanaagbiib n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
text: Mbimbinyaan tii limɔfal la, le mbiin ma junni li.

ref: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
text: Bininyaam kani baapar dulnyaa ni do la, kina pu na, li nyi gbin gbin ke mbiindam ni titunwanbirdam ga kan ntafadaan.

ref: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
text: Uwumbɔr aasui piin bininyaam pu, le ki ji binib bi kpokl titunwanbir na tibɔr.

ref: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
text: Mbiin aa biini unii pu, le binib bi aabimbin ŋan na ma nyal si kib.

ref: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
text: Upii u aabimbin ŋan na le ye uchal aamakl, ni mpopiin; le upii u jinni uchal inimɔɔn na bi ke mbuunkpok na le uchal aakpab ni.

ref: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
text: Bininyaam ga joo si mbamɔm; bibiindam ma ban bi ŋmann si la.

ref: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
text: Bibiindam aamɔbon ye linikul la, le bininyaam ga gaa baah faani binib bi na lii.

ref: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
text: Bibiindam kani baadoon le kaa kpa yaabitiib, le bininyaam ma aadichal aa kpa ndoon.

ref: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
text: Aa yaa kpa ichiin kan, aa ga kan kipak; aa yaa ye ulatiir kan, binib ga lik seen si.

ref: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
text: Aa yaa po bi Uwumbɔr aah naan si pu na ki tun ki kani ki ji kan, ni soor ni ke aa di aabaa ŋa unikpaan ki tee chuun nkon.

ref: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
text: Uninyaan lik waawakor mbamɔm la, le bibiindam ma ŋani baawakor mbiin.

ref: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
text: Ukpaal u tun sakpen na kpa sakpen ke u ji, le ni ye kijɔrk ke aa li chuun tun ŋitun ŋi kaa kpa tinyoor tibaa na.

ref: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
text: Bibiindam aah ban tiwan ni ke bi ŋa na, le ye ke bi kan titunwanbir aatuln ki tun, le binib bi aabimbin ŋan na ma si chob.

ref: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
text: Ubiindaan aabɔlen le chur u ŋani tibɔr ni, le ubamɔndaan ma nyani ubaa tibɔr ni.

ref: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.
text: Saamɔliin ni saatuln le ga tii si saapar, nima le ga tii si tiwan ni ŋeer si na.

ref: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
text: Bijɔrb dak n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ke bi kpa mbamɔn la. Bilandam ma pel nsurm la.

ref: Losing your temper is foolish; ignoring an insult is smart.
text: Liŋuul yaa chuu ujɔr kan, u kpaan cha binib beer la. Ulandaan ma aan gar lisiibil.

ref: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
text: Aa yaa len ibamɔn kan, ni toor tibɔr la, le inyamɔn ma joo ni tiwan ni kaa ŋan na.

ref: Sharp words cut like a sword, but words of wisdom heal.
text: Bɔyɔli tii iween ke kijaak aajuk aah ga tii iween pu na la, le nlan aamɔliin tii laafee.

ref: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
text: Nnyamɔn aa yunni, le mbamɔn ma aa kpa ndoon.

ref: An evil mind is deceitful, but gentle thoughts bring happiness.
text: Binib bi kpokl tibɔbir na ŋmanni bibaa la, le binib bi tun ki ban kinyaan na ma ga kan mpopiin.

ref: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na aa kani tibɔbir, le bibiindam ma kani tibɔbir ŋmeen.

ref: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
text: Uwumbɔr aa gee binyamɔndam, le ki kpa mpopiin binib bi len ibamɔn na pu.

ref: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
text: Bilandam joo baah nyi pu na bisui ni la, le bigbaam ma joo baa‑maa‑nyi gbaa kiloŋ mooni.

ref: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
text: Aa yaa tun sakpen kan, aa ga kan tininkpir, le ligbanyakl ma ga ŋa si unaagbiija.

ref: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
text: Ilandak yaa muk si kan, saan li kpa mpopiin, le ilinsoon ga ŋmaa tii si mpopiin.

ref: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
text: Unii u aabimbin ŋan na ye ujɔ aasanmɔkr la, le bibiindam ma aasan joo bi yenni.

ref: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
text: Aa yaa kpa ligbanyakl kan, saan kan saah ban pu na daalbaadaal, le aa yaa tun sakpen kan, aa ga kan liwangol.

ref: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
text: Mbimbinyaan le ye nsan mu cha limɔfal ni na; le mbiin ye nsan mu cha nkun ni na.

ref: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
text: Ubolandaan aate yaa sur u kan, u pel nsurm ngbaan la, le unii u kpa kipupuk na ma aan keei waataani pu.

ref: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
text: Bininyaam kani tipar baamɔliin ni la, le binib bi ŋmanni biken na chuun ban titunwanbir.

ref: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
text: Chuu aabaa saamɔliin chee ki li kpa limɔfal. Unii u len tibɔr yɔl yɔl na junni waamɔfal la.

ref: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
text: Ugbanyakdaan yaa po gee u li neen tiwan sakpen pu na kan, waan ŋmaa kan ni. Unii u tun sakpen na ma ga kan waah ban pu na mɔmɔk.

ref: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na aa gee inyamɔn, le bibiindam ma aamɔbon kpa inimɔɔn ni tilaar.

ref: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
text: Mbimbinyaan le kii binib bi kaa kpa taani ubaa na; le mbiin ye titunwanbirdam aalirm.

ref: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
text: Binib bibaa ŋmanni ke bi ye biwankpadam la, le kaa kpa nibaa. Bibaa mu ŋmanni ke bi ye bigiim la, le ki tee kpa liwangol.

ref: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
text: Uwankpadaan joo waamombil le kii ubaa, le ubaa aa faani ugiin ma.

ref: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na bi ke nwiihn mu wiin chain na la; le bibiindam ma naahn karyaa u ban u junn na.

ref: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
text: Kigaak joo ni kijaak baanja la. Aa yaa ban nsurm kan, ni soor.

ref: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
text: Aa yaa kan liwangol dafir kan, naan yunn le li nya aaŋaal ni. Aa yaa di kitotoŋ kan liwangol kan, aa moo kani la.

ref: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
text: Limakl yaa ti doo kan, lipobil mu doo le na, le aa yaa dak tiwan pu aan ki kan ni kan, mmɔɔn ti ku si la.

ref: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
text: Aa yaa yii nsurnyaan kan, aa bi ban tibɔr la; gaa mu aan ki li kpa limɔfal.

ref: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
text: Bilandam aamɔkm ye limɔfal aanyunbun mu kaa foor na la; buyoonn saamɔfal nan bi linimaln ni na kan, mu ga gaa si lii.

ref: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
text: Ichiin tii unii kipak la, le saa kaan ŋmaa nyu binib bi pu baala na ma tak ndoon aasan la.

ref: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
text: Bilandam dakl waahr le ki nin ŋa tiwan, le bigbaam ma joo baa‑maa‑nyi gbaa kiloŋ mooni.

ref: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
text: Unii u kaa gee ke u bae na ga li ye ugiin ni unimɔɔnii la. Unii umɔk gaal nsurm na kani kipak la.

ref: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
text: Ni ye kinyaan le ke aa kan saah ban tiwan ni na. Bigbaam le aan ŋmaa siir cha titunwanbir.

ref: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
text: Li dii bilandam aan ki kan nlan. Aa yaa jɔnn bigbaam kan, aa junn saamɔfal la.

ref: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
text: Tibɔbir dii titunwanbirdam nin chee mɔk bi cha na la, le binib bi aabimbin ŋan na aapar ye tiwan ni ŋan na.

ref: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
text: Uninyaan ga li kpa liwangol li uyaabitiib ga nan kan na, le binib bi aabimbin ŋan na ga nan gaa titunwanbirdam aawangol.

ref: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
text: Baah kaa ko kitiŋ ki pu na ba ga tii bigiim tijikaar sakpen, le bibiindam cha ki dɔ fam.

ref: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
text: Aa yaa kaa dar aajapɔɔn aatafal kan, saa gee u. Aa yaa ba gee u kan, aa ba ga sur u.

ref: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na kpa sakpen bi ji, le bibiindam ma chuun nkon n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
text: Bipiib aalan le maa ŋidichal, le kijɔrk ber ŋi.

ref: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
text: Cha saabimbin li ŋan ki mɔk ke aa san Uwumbɔr ijawaan; li ye ubeebeedaan ki mɔk ke saa san u.

ref: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
text: Ujɔr aapupuk le cha u len tibɔr sakpen; ulandaan aamɔliin le kii u.

ref: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
text: Inaa yaa kaa bi i dar saakuu kan, saapil ga li ye nkuun la, le i yaa bi kan, li ga li gbii njikaabim.

ref: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
text: Unii u yoor ubaa paacham sakpen na aan ŋmaa kan nlan, le bilandam ma yaa ban bi bae kan, naa pɔɔ bi.

ref: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
text: Nyan aabaa bijɔrb chee; baa kpa nibaa ki ga mɔk si.

ref: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
text: Bijɔrb yaa tun titunwanbir kan, naa muk bi, le bilandam ma ban chapinn.

ref: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
text: Saamɔɔn ye saawan la, le saapombiin mu ye saawan. Saan ŋmaa yakr kina aawan tii ubaa.

ref: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
text: Utunwanbirdaan aadichal ga ber, le uninyaan ma aadichal beenin si.

ref: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
text: Saah dak ke nsan mu ye nsanyaan na le ga ŋmaa di si buen nkun ni.

ref: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
text: Tilaar ga ŋmaa bɔr mpombiin. Tilaar ngbaan yaa ti doo kan, mpombiin ngbaan ga li beenin bi.

ref: You harvest what you plant, whether good or bad.
text: Titunwanbirdam ga kan tiwan ni ŋeer bi na. Bininyaam mu ga kan baatun aapar.

ref: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
text: Ujɔr ma gaal tibɔr mɔmɔk keei la, le bilandam ma lik baah chuun pu na.

ref: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
text: Bilandam chur bibaa le kaa koo tibɔr ni, le bigbaam ma bi yɔl yɔl le ki tun kaa dakl lik.

ref: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
text: Unii u aasui fiir mala mala na tun kijɔrk aatuln la; binib aa gee unii u ŋmanni bi na.

ref: Stupidity leads to foolishness; be smart and learn.
text: Maa‑nyi‑nibaa‑dam kani baajɔrk aah ban pu na la, le bilandam ma aapar ye ichiin.

ref: The wicked will come crawling to those who obey God.
text: Titunwanbirdam ga gbaan binib bi aabimbin ŋan na chee le ki gaŋ bi ke bi san bi kinimbaak.

ref: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
text: Unii ubaa aa gee ugiin, hali u ni unii u koo gbɔk tɔb na aa gee u, le uwankpadaan ma kpa jɔtiib sakpen.

ref: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
text: Aa yaa ban mpopiin kan, li ŋani bigiim tiŋann; aa yaa lik seen ubaa kan, ni ye titunwanbir la.

ref: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
text: Aa yaa tun litunyaan kan, aa ga kan kipak ni lisil binib biken chee, le aa yaa tun titunwanbir kan, aa yenni la.

ref: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
text: Li tun ki kan tinyoor, aa yaa ka ki gbaa tibɔr baanja kan, aa ga ŋa ugiin la.

ref: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
text: Bilandam aapar le ye liwangol, bijɔrb ma aah kan pu na le ye kijɔrk ŋmeen.

ref: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
text: Useeraadaan u len ibamɔn na gaal binib aamɔfal lir la; u yaa geei inyamɔn kan, u joo binib kooh la.

ref: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
text: Unii u san Uwumbɔr ki pak u na ban ŋŋmarm ni lifuur le tii u ni waadichal.

ref: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
text: Aa ban ke aa nya nkun ni ii? Li pak Uwumbɔr ki san u ijawaan aan ki kan limɔfal.

ref: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
text: Ubɔr aapak ni waapɔɔn nyan ni waanib aah wiir pu na chee la; ubɔr yaa kaa kpa binib kan, waa ye nibaa.

ref: It's smart to be patient, but it's stupid to lose your temper.
text: Aa yaa bi suuna kan, aa kpa nlan, tɔ, saaŋuul yaa fiir mala mala kan, aa mɔk binib saah ye ugbaan pu na la.

ref: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
text: Nsuudoon le tii tiwon laafee, le lipiipoln bi ke mbuunkpok na.

ref: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
text: Aa yaa muk bigiim kan, aa seei Uwumbɔr u naan bi na la; aa yaa ŋa ugiin tiŋann kan, aa nyuŋni Uwumbɔr la.

ref: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
text: Bibiindam le joo baatunwanbir kulni baamɔfal, le bininyaam ma kpa limakl nkun ni.

ref: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
text: Nlan bi unii u kpa nlan na aalandak mɔmɔk ni; bijɔrb ma aa nyi nlan aawan nibaa.

ref: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
text: Mbimbinyaan tii litimbol mpɔɔn ni kipak la; le titunwanbir ma ye litimbol mɔmɔk aanimɔɔn.

ref: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.
text: Bibɔrb aasui piin baatutum bi nyi baatuln na pu la, le ki dar baatutum bi jinni bi inimɔɔn na aatafal.

ref: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
text: Ngarm mu bi suuna na sɔŋni liŋuul la, le mmɔpɔɔn aagarm fiini liŋuul.

ref: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
text: Binib bi kpa nlan na yaa len tibɔr kan, bi moo tii nlan kinyaan la, le bigbaam ma aabɔr punni kijɔrk.

ref: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.
text: Lilambil li sɔŋni sui na tii limɔfal la, le mbiin aamɔbon ma kulni limɔfal.

ref: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
text: Ni ye kijɔrk le ke aa yii aate aah mɔk si pu na; ni ŋan ke aa gaa waasurm.

ref: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na aawangol dɔ kii bi la, le limukl yoonn kan, bibiindam ma lann baawangol.

ref: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
text: Binib bi kpa nlan na le joo nlan tii biken, naa ye bijɔrb.

ref: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
text: Uwumbɔr aa gee bibiindam aatork, le usui piin bininyaam aameel pu.

ref: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
text: Uwumbɔr aa gee titunwanbirdam aabimbin, le ki gee binib bi ŋani tiwan ni ŋan na aabimbin.

ref: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
text: Aa yaa tun titunwanbir kan, aa ga kan ntafadaan mu bir ki pɔɔ na, sin u kaa gee nsurm na ga kpo la.

ref: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
text: Hali kitekpiitiŋ aan ŋmaa di tiwan ni bi ki ponn ni na bɔr Uwumbɔr; kina pu na, unibɔn ga ŋa kinye aan ki di waalandak bɔr Uwumbɔr?

ref: Those who sneer at others don't like to be corrected, and they won't ask help from someone with sense.
text: Binib bi yoor bibaa paacham sakpen na aa gee nsurm, baa kpaan baa bilandam ke bi mɔk bi nlan.

ref: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
text: Bilandam ban bi moo bae la, le bigbaam ma aasui piin maanyi pu.

ref: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
text: Ugiin aabimbin ye u limukl la, le binib bi aasui piin na ji mmɔɔn n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
text: Ni ŋan ke aa li ye ugiin ki san Uwumbɔr ki jer ke aa li kpa sakpen ki bi tibɔr ni.

ref: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
text: Aa yaa ji tikpifar saah gee binib bi na chee kan, ni soor ni ke aa ŋmɔ unaamɔn nin chee kinanaŋ bi na.

ref: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
text: Binib bi aasui fiir mala mala na joo ni kinikpakpak la, le limɔr ma joo ni nsuudoon.

ref: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
text: Aa yaa ye ugbanyakdaan kan, aa kani limukl ŋipepel mɔmɔk pu la, tɔ, aa yaa si chob kan, saan kan tibɔr daalbaadaal.

ref: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
text: Ubolandaan aate aasui piin u pu la. Ujɔr baanja le lik una fam.

ref: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
text: Bigbaam aasui piin baajɔrk aatuln pu la, le bilandam ma ŋani ni ŋan na.

ref: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
text: Nsurm yaa kaa bi kan, ilandak beer fam la, le bisusurb yaa wiir kan, i toor.

ref: Giving the right answer at the right time makes everyone happy.
text: Aa yaa kan tibɔnyaan taayoonn kan, ni tii mmɔɔn la.

ref: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
text: Bilandam aasan cha paacham limɔfal chee la, naa ye nsan mu cha taab nkun ni na.

ref: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
text: Uwumbɔr ga kuln binib bi yoor bibaa paacham sakpen na aadichal, le ki tee ga li kii ukpopii aawangol ma.

ref: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
text: Uwumbɔr aa gee ilandak i kaa ŋan na, le ki neen kijɔtiik aamɔbon ma.

ref: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
text: Ukumɔndaan ban tibɔr tii waadichal la, le unii u yii igaŋgaŋlik na kpa limɔfal.

ref: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
text: Bininyaam dakl lik tibɔr aatataa waahr le ki nin gar. Titunwanbirdam ma gar mala le ki ban tibɔr.

ref: The Lord never even hears the prayers of the wicked, but he answers the prayers of all who obey him.
text: Uwumbɔr daa bibiindam chee, le ki ŋun binib bi aabimbin ŋan na ma aameel.

ref: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
text: Binib bi laa limɔmumukl na tii mpopiin la, le tibɔnyaan mu pɔɔk itaakpab.

ref: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
text: Unii umɔk kpa ŋuntii nsurm chee na kpa nlan le na.

ref: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
text: Unii umɔk yii nsurm na, aa gee ubaa. Aa yaa kpa ŋuntii nsurm chee kan, aa ga moo kan nlan.

ref: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
text: Aa yaa san Uwumbɔr kan, ni ye inimbiwoln la. Waahr aan aa kan bunyuŋ na, see aa suln aabaa taab.

ref: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.
text: Unibɔn aalandak nyani usui ni la, le yaadoon tee bi Uwumbɔr chee.

ref: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
text: Unibɔn ma dak ke waabimbin mɔmɔk ŋan la, Uwumbɔr baanja mu le nyi unibɔn aabimbin aah bi pu na.

ref: Share your plans with the Lord, and you will succeed.
text: Di saalandak mɔmɔk ŋa Uwumbɔr aaŋaal ni, le ki kan tinyoor saalandak ngbaan ni.

ref: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
text: Uwumbɔr aah ŋa tiwan ni mɔmɔk na kpa naah ga ti doo pu na, hali bibiindam aatafadaan aawiin daal bi la.

ref: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
text: Uwumbɔr aa gee unii u yoor ubaa paacham na; waan cha u nya ntafadaan ni kpala.

ref: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
text: Li dii mbamɔm ki li si chob aan Uwumbɔr di saatunwanbir cha pinn si. Kii tii Uwumbɔr ki taa kan tibɔbir tibaa.

ref: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
text: Uwumbɔr aasui yaa piin aa pu kan, saadim ga kpaln aajɔtiib la.

ref: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
text: Aa yaa di ibamɔn kan siib kina kan, ni ŋan jer ke aa di inyamɔn kan liwangol li wiir na.

ref: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
text: Unibɔn ga ŋmaa ŋa waalandak usui ni, Uwumbɔr mu le ga tee mɔk u waah ga ŋa pu na.

ref: Rulers speak with authority and are never wrong.
text: Ubɔr aamɔbon nyan ni Uwumbɔr chee la, kina pu na, umɔb ni taa li kpa inyamɔn.

ref: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
text: Tiwaŋaŋkaan ni ye nibamɔnn na nyan ni Uwumbɔr chee la. Uma le ŋa tiwaŋaŋkaan mɔmɔk naah bi pu na.

ref: Justice makes rulers powerful. They should hate evil
text: Bibɔrb aa gee titunwanbir, ba pu? ibamɔn pu le nnaan mɔmɔk kpa mpɔɔn.

ref: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
text: Ulandaan pɔɔni ubaa ki tii ubɔr mpopiin la; ubɔr aaŋuul ga ŋmaa joo ni nkun.

ref: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
text: Ubɔr yaa lik faar unii kan, ni naahn ntaalangbam mu joo ni utaal kiseek ni na la, limɔfal bi nima chee.

ref: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
text: Ni ŋan ki ti nyaŋ ke aa li kpa nlan ni ichiin, ki jer salmaa ni ŋimombil.

ref: Too much pride will destroy you.
text: Kipupuk joo ni libiil la, le kigaak joo ni nkun.

ref: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
text: Ni ŋan ke aa sunn aabaa taab ki li ye ugiin, ki jer ke aa li ŋmal binib bi yoor bibaa paacham na ni, ki yakr bi chee baah sun biken aawan ni na.

ref: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
text: Li pel mmɔkm mbamɔm, ki kan tinyoor saatuln ni; kii tii Uwumbɔr aan ki li kpa mpopiin.

ref: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
text: Bi nyi unii u kpa nlan ki muun mu ni na bɔr waaŋuntii pu na. Waamɔliin mɔ, le binib keei tii u.

ref: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
text: Nlan le ye limɔfal aanyunbun ki tii bilandam, le aa yaa pɔɔni aabaa ki mɔk bigbaam kan, ni bii n‑yoonn.

ref: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
text: Binib bi kpa ichiin na dakl lik waahr le ki nin len; le baah len pu na mu moo tii nnyuum.

ref: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
text: Imɔliinyaan naahn tisiir la, i mɔ ki tii si laafee.

ref: Sometimes what seems right is really a road to death.
text: Saah dak ke nsan mu ŋan na ga ŋmaa di si buen nkun ni.

ref: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
text: Titunwanbirdam ban isan i bi ga di bii biken na la; hali baamɔbon ga ŋmaa see si ke mmii aah seer pu na la.

ref: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
text: Bibiindam le ye bibɔmbɔtukb; bi ban tibɔr, le ki bii kijɔtiik.

ref: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
text: Binib bi aabimbin pɔɔ na ŋmanni bijɔtiib le ki joo bi kooni tibɔbir ni.

ref: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na aapar le ye limɔfal li fɔk na, iyikpipiin ye tiwan ni ŋan ki kpa kipak na la.

ref: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
text: Unibɔn too inaan ke u di bee Uwumbɔr aageehn, tɔ, Uwumbɔr ubaa le nyi waah ga gar pu na.

ref: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
text: Aa yaa ŋman lisaaŋmiil ki kpa nsuudoon kan, ni ŋan jer ke aa ji njim sakpem lidichal li ponn ni ye tibɔr ŋmeen na.

ref: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
text: Unaagbiija u kpa nlan na ga gaa udindaan aajapɔɔn u kaa sɔ na chee ute aapɔɔn ki nan gaa waafaal ngem.

ref: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
text: Mmii le bi joo tɔŋni salmaa ni tikunabr, Uwumbɔr mu le tɔŋni unibɔn aasui lik.

ref: Troublemakers listen to troublemakers, and liars listen to liars.
text: Titunwanbirdam le pel ilandak i kaa ŋan na, le binyamɔndam mu pel inyamɔn aabɔr.

ref: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
text: Aa yaa laa bigiim kan, aa seei Uwumbɔr u naan bi na la. Aa yaa di aaŋeen aatɔ aafalaa ŋa saapopiin kan, Uwumbɔr ga daa aatafal.

ref: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
text: Bijaninkpiib kpa biyaabitiib pu kipupuk ke bibilb aah kpa kipupuk bitetiib pu pu na la.

ref: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
text: Bijɔrb aa kpa tinyoor aabɔr tibaa bi len, le biyidam ma aa geei inyamɔn.

ref: A bribe works miracles like a magic charm that brings good luck.
text: Binib bibaa dak ke igaŋgaŋlik tun ke nnyɔk na la; bi kpa gaakii ke i ga ŋmaa ŋa tiwan mɔmɔk tii bi.

ref: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
text: Aa yaa ban ke binib li neen si kan, di cha pinn bi buyoonn bi tun si taani na. Aa yaa teer taani bɔr kan, ni ga ŋmaa bii kijɔtiik.

ref: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
text: Aa yaa sur ulandaan nfum mubaa kan, u bae mala ki jer saah ga gbaa ujɔr nfum nkub pu na.

ref: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
text: Nkun ga fuu ni bibiindam bi ban tibɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na, ke ntuundaan u kpa mbiin na la.

ref: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
text: Aa yaa to takɔ u binib ku waabim mɔmɔk na nsan ni kan, ni ŋan jer ke aa ti kan ujɔr aah bi tun waajɔrk aatuln pu na.

ref: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
text: Aa yaa di titunwanbir pan tiŋann kan, titunwanbir aan ki nya saadichal ni daalbaadaal.

ref: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
text: Kinikpakpak aah ga piin pu na naahn mmɔgbaamii la; goo ki aan ki taa ki foor kpee.

ref: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
text: Tiwan nilee nee mɔmɔk bir Uwumbɔr chee la: nima le ye ke aa bii unii u kaa kpa taani na, bee aa tii ubiindaan mbamɔn.

ref: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
text: Ujɔr yaa ji waamombil tiwan aabaem pu kan, naa kpa u tinyoor tibaa, ba pu? waa kpa kpakpaln aalan.

ref: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
text: Jɔtiib mɔk tɔb ngeehm n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la. Naabitiib ma yakr tibɔbir la.

ref: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
text: Li gee kinimbɔŋ aatataa le ye ke aa li gee libɔbaln. Aa yaa kpa kipupuk n‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, aa bi ban tibɔr la.

ref: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
text: Unii umɔk dakl lik ki ki len tibɔbir na aan kan tinyoor tibaa, kinimbɔŋ ŋmeen le u ga kan.

ref: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
text: Ubo u tun kijɔrk aatuln na aate aanyoor le ye kinimbaak ni mpombiin.

ref: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
text: Mpopiin tii si laafee la. Aa yaa kpa mpombiin n‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, ni ye nkun mu kaan ku si mala na la.

ref: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
text: Bibɔjirb bi kpa beebee na looni gaal igaŋgaŋlik la, kina pu na, mbamɔn aan ŋmaa ŋa.

ref: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
text: Unii u chi na lik ban isanyaan la, le ujɔr ma piini waah gee lipepel li na.

ref: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
text: Unii u nyi ubaa pu na aa len n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Binib bi bi suuna na kpa nlan.

ref: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
text: Binib bi kaa gee kaa biken chee na aatafal aa bi biken aabɔr ni; bi ga yii tiwan ni binib biken nyi ke ni ye tiwanyaan na.

ref: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
text: Ujɔr yaa bee tiwan aatataa, bee waa bee kan, utafal aa bi ni ni; waah ban pu na le ye ke u mɔk waah nyi sakpen pu na.

ref: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
text: Unii aamɔbon ga ŋmaa li kpa nlan, ki nyoo ke nnyusakpem aah nyoo pu na, ki bi chain ke nkpen mu puu na.

ref: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.
text: Naa ŋan ke aa kpee unii u jin libɔkpol na pu, ki cha unii u aabɔr ŋan na lann waabamɔn.

ref: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
text: Ujɔr yaa piin kinikpakpak kan, u bi ban tigbar la.

ref: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
text: Ujɔr yaa len tibɔr kan, u bi kulni waamɔfal la; ubaa aamɔliin le chur u.

ref: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
text: Libɔmbɔtukl mɔ sakpen, ti neen sakpen ke ti pel li.

ref: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
text: Ugbanyakdaan aa ŋan ke unii u bii tiwan na aah kaa ŋan pu na la.

ref: It's stupid and embarrassing to give an answer before you listen.
text: Pel waahr ki nin gar tibɔr. Aa yaa kaa ŋa kina kan, aa ye ujɔr, ki ga kan inimɔɔn la.

ref: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
text: Aa ban ke aa kan uninyuun aa? Tii u ipiin, le naan ki li pɔɔ.

ref: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
text: Bipɔɔndam bilee yaa kpak tɔb libɔjil ni kan, too inaan ki cha Uwumbɔr kuln tibɔr ngbaan.

ref: Making up with a friend you have offended is harder than breaking through a city wall.
text: Ter aana aabo aan u li kii si ke ligoln li kii kitisakpeŋ na. Tɔ, aa ni uma yaa jaa kan, waan ki cha aa koo ni waadichal ni.

ref: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.
text: Saamɔliin mɔmɔk le ye saamɔfal.

ref: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
text: Saamɔliin le ga ŋmaa gaa si lii, le ki ga ŋmaa junn saamɔfal mu; kina pu na, li nyi ki gaa saamɔliin aah joo ni si tiwan ni na.

ref: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
text: Kan upii ki bee ke aa kan tiwanyaan la; ni mɔk ke Uwumbɔr gee si la.

ref: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
text: Ugiin yaa len kan, ni ŋan ke u sunn ubaa taab mbamɔm, le uwankpadaan ma yaa gar kan, ni ye kigaak ŋmeen la.

ref: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
text: Kijɔtiik kibaa aa yunni, le jɔtiib bibaa mu jer unii ni una aabo.

ref: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
text: Aa yaa ye ugiin ki bi chob saabimbin ni kan, ni soor ni ke aa li ye ujɔr ni unyamɔndaan.

ref: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
text: Nlan yaa kaa bi unimandaan chee kan, ni ye fam la; aa yaa ŋani tiwan kaa chur aabaa kan, ni joo si kooni tibɔr ni la.

ref: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
text: Binib bibaa joo baajɔrk aatun le junni baamɔfal, le ki tee galni Uwumbɔr.

ref: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.
text: Unii mɔmɔk ban bininyuum aajɔtiik la; unii mɔmɔk jɔnni binib bi tii baaterm na la.

ref: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
text: Hali ugiin aanaabitiib aa yin u nibaa, kina pu na, naa ye iwaan ke ugiin aa kpa jɔ. U po gee u pɔɔn ubaa, ba pu? waan ŋmaa daa ubaa tam ni ubaa.

ref: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
text: Bae saah ga ŋman pu na ki tii aabaa nterm; li teer saah bae tiwan ni na ki kan liwangol.

ref: Dishonest witnesses and liars will be destroyed.
text: Unii ubaa aa geei inyamɔn libɔjil ni ki nya ntafadaan ni, waamɔfal junn la.

ref: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule in place of a king.
text: Bijɔrb taa li bi mmɔɔn ni, binaagbiib taa li joo nnaan aanib.

ref: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.
text: Aa yaa ye ulandaan kan, aa ga li chur aabaa tibɔr ni. Ni ye mbimbinyaan sakpem le ke aa taa gar unii u tun si taani na.

ref: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
text: Ubɔr aaŋuul naahn uchinn aah ŋuuni pu na la, le u yaa san si kinimbaak kan, ni naahn unaalantaal.

ref: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
text: Ubogbaan ga ŋmaa joo ni ute aamɔfal aadoon. Upii u muk uchal n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na naahn nnyun mu tuu kpolo kpolo na la.

ref: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
text: Uja ga ŋmaa ji ute aadichal ni ŋimombil aafaal; Uwumbɔr baanja le ga ŋmaa tii u upiilandaan.

ref: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
text: Aa yaa gee kan, li ye ugbanyakdaan, ki li dɔ geen, ki tee li nyi ke aa ga chuun nkon.

ref: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
text: Li joo Uwumbɔr aakaal ki li kpa limɔfafɔfɔŋ; aatafal yaa kaa bi i ni kan, aa ga kpo.

ref: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
text: Aa yaa tii ugiin ipiin kan, ni bi ke saah pinn tiwan tii Uwumbɔr le na, Uwumbɔr ga teen si tiwan ngbaan.

ref: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
text: Daa saabim aatafal n‑yoonn mu bi laa par ki ga ŋmaa bae na. Aa yaa kaa ŋa kina kan, aa bi ter bi ke bi junn baamɔfal la.

ref: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
text: Unii aasui yaa pɔɔ kan, cha u kan kina aapar. Aa yaa nyan u tibɔr ni nfum mubaa kan, aa ga ki gir nyan u lelee.

ref: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
text: Aa yaa ŋun tii nsurm ki ban ke aa bae kan, aa ga nan ŋa nlan daalbaadaal.

ref: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
text: Binib ga ŋmaa kpokl baah gee pu na mɔmɔk; Uwumbɔr aageehn mu le ga ŋa.

ref: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
text: Kukumɔŋ ye inimɔɔn la; binib bi ye bigiim na soor binyamɔndam.

ref: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
text: Kii Uwumbɔr aamɔb ki li kpa limɔfal li fɔk na, ni lipugbiil, ki taa koo tibɔr tibaa ni.

ref: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
text: Binib bibaa kpa ligbanyakl sakpen le kaan ŋmaa di busaa ŋa bimɔi ni.

ref: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
text: Ni ŋan ke kigaak kan ntafadaan, le binib bi kaa nyi nibaa na ga ŋmaa bae nlan. Aa yaa kpa nlan kan, buyoonn bi sur si na le aa ga bae.

ref: Disgraceful children rob their father and chase their mother away.
text: Unimɔɔnii ni maasɔdaan le ga ŋa ute mbiin, bee u jenn nyan una waadichal ni.

ref: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
text: Maabo, aa yaa di cha tiwan aabaem kan, aa ga kpaan suln saah puun nyi tiwan ni na.

ref: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
text: Useeraadaan yaa nyan sil ke u ŋa unii mbiin kan, ibamɔn aa bi nima. Bibiindam gee ke bi lak kinimbɔŋ ki lik la.

ref: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
text: Unii u mɔk ubaa sakpen na aa daa tigbar chee.

ref: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
text: Lidanyul sakpen ŋani unii ujɔr ni kifuukdaan la. Lidanyul ye igbaan la.

ref: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
text: Li san ubɔr u aaŋuul fii na ijawaan, ke saah ga li san uchinn u bi ŋuuni na ijawaan pu na; aa yaa fiin waaŋuul kan, aa pɔ tee ku aabaa.

ref: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
text: Ujɔr mɔk ga ŋmaa piin kinikpakpak; kinyuŋ ki bi na le ye ke aa taa koo kinikpakpak ni.

ref: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.
text: Ukpaayuk u kaa piini likuul buyoonn bikpaab biken piini na aan nan kan nibaa ki chee.

ref: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
text: Unii aalandak bi ke libuln li nyoo na aanyun la, tɔ, unii u kpa ichiin na ga ŋmaa nyan ni i lipaal.

ref: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
text: Unii mɔmɔk len waah si chob ki ŋani tiwan mɔmɔk aah mɔk pu na la, tɔ, saan ŋmaa kan kina aanii.

ref: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
text: Mbim yaa kpa te u aabimbin ŋan aan u ŋani tiwan ni ŋan na kan, bi kpa liyinyaan.

ref: When rulers decide cases, they weigh the evidence.
text: Ubɔr ka libɔjil ni le ki yaa kan titunwanbir kan, u beer ti.

ref: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
text: Unii ga ŋmaa len ke waabimbin aa kpa tijɔŋ, ki bui ke u nyan titunwanbir ni ii?

ref: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
text: Uwumbɔr aa gee binib bi joo tiwaŋaŋkaan ni kaa ye nibamɔnn ŋaŋni tiwan na.

ref: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
text: Aa yaa joo saayoonn geeni kan, aa ga ŋa ugiin. Li tun, le aa ga kan ki ji.

ref: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
text: Ugbaan umɔk puu tipuur ke u ga gaa uchaan aapɔln na ga di ubaa aawangol le di siin lipɔln ngbaan pu.

ref: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
text: Aa yaa bi ji beebee aajikaar kan, ti mɔ la, le saah ti jin ti doo na le ti kpaln ŋitakpabil aamɔb ni.

ref: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
text: Kan nsurm mu ŋan na ki kan linyaŋ; taa di bil bil ti koo butɔb ni kaa ŋa bu aalandak waahr.

ref: Stay away from gossips— they tell everything.
text: Ubɔmbɔtukr aan ŋmaa joo tibɔbɔrkaan. Taa duuni binib bi gbaa tibɔr sakpen na chee.

ref: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
text: Aa yaa puun lii aate bee aana pu kan, saamɔfal ga junn ke karyaa aah junni mbɔmbɔɔn ni pu na la.

ref: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
text: Liwangol li saa nyan kitotoŋ ki kan li na aan ŋa si tinyoor tibaa.

ref: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
text: Taa cha ni li ye si limukl ke aa teen unii taani. Kii tii Uwumbɔr aan u ga toor ti tii si.

ref: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
text: Uwumbɔr aa gee binib bi joo tiwaŋaŋkaan ni kaa ye nibamɔnn na ŋaŋni tiwan na.

ref: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
text: Uwumbɔr le siin ti mɔmɔk aah ga kan pu na; kina pu na, unii ga ŋa kinye ki bee waamɔfal aah ga ti doo pu na?

ref: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
text: Unibɔn aafuur le ye Uwumbɔr aakaryaa, ki lik tiwan nimɔk bi usui ni na la.

ref: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
text: Ubɔr yaa joo ibamɔn, ni mbimbinyaan, ki ŋani binib mɔmɔk naah tok pu na kan, u ga yunn nnaan ni.

ref: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
text: Ti neen tinachipɔnn aapɔɔn, le ki pak tininkpir aayikpipiin.

ref: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
text: N‑yoonn mubaa kan, see ti kan iween sakpiin le ki nin toor timi aabimbin.

ref: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
text: Teer ke Uwumbɔr lik ki nyi saabimbin mɔmɔk, kina pu na, taa dak ke saah ŋani tiwan nimɔk na ŋan la.

ref: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
text: Ŋa ni ŋan ki tok na. Nima le piir Uwumbɔr aasui ki jer saah kɔr tiwakor ti ke aa toor kitork tii u na.

ref: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
text: Bibiindam aagaak ni baanimpoo le joo bi, nima ngbaan mu ye titunwanbir la.

ref: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.
text: Dakl lik mbamɔm ki li kpa sakpen, aa yaa tun bil bil kan, saan kan ni ga ŋeer si na.

ref: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
text: Liwangol li aa di inyamɔn kan li na aan yunn, le ki mu ki ga di si ŋa nkun aamɔkpaween ni.

ref: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
text: Bibiindam aabimbin mu kaa ŋan na le ku bi, bi yii kaan ŋa ni ŋan na.

ref: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
text: Aa yaa nyan ti dɔ kikaafiik ni kan, ni ŋan jer ke aa ni upii u kpa bumɔb sakpen na li kpaan koo lidichal libaa ni.

ref: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
text: Bibiindam aajikaar le ye titunwanbir, baa san ubaa kinimbaak.

ref: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.
text: Unii u kpa kigaak na yaa kan ntafadaan kan, nima chee le bigbaam mu bae nlan. Ulandaan ma ga bae nlan baah mɔk u tiwan ni na chee la.

ref: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
text: Uwumbɔr u bi chain na nyi tiwan nimɔk ŋani bibiindam do na, u ga junn baamɔfal.

ref: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
text: Aa yaa yii saan ŋun ugiin aah wii pu na kan, buyoonn aa mu nan bi wii ki ban nterm na, ubaa aan ŋun.

ref: A secret bribe will save you from someone's fierce anger.
text: Ubaa yaa gee aa pu liŋuul, aan aa bɔr ki tii u ipiin kan, i ga sɔŋ waaŋuul.

ref: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
text: Buyoonn ibamɔn ti ŋa na, bininyaam aasui piir la; le ni tee wu bibiindam ma.

ref: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
text: Unii umɔk yenn nyan nlan chee na, nkun dɔ kii udaan ngbaan.

ref: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
text: Aa yaa di aabaa tii mmɔɔn, ni ndaan, ni tijikaar ti ŋan na kan, naan ŋmaa ŋa si uwankpadaan.

ref: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
text: Mbiin mu bibiindam joo ŋani bininyaam na gir choo bi chee la.

ref: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
text: Bilandam bi liwankpal ni mmɔɔn ni la, le bijɔrb ma ji baamombil mala mala buyoonn bi kan ŋi na.

ref: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
text: Li kpa tiŋann ni tibulchinn, ki li kpa limɔfal li fɔk na; biken ga li pak si ki ŋani si tiŋann.

ref: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.
text: Aa yaa kaa ban aa koo tibɔr ni kan, li nyi saabɔlen.

ref: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
text: Mɔk mi kalmbaanidaan aan m mɔk si ke u ye nnimpoodaan, ni balaadaan, ni maa‑lik‑faar‑daan la.

ref: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
text: Ugbanyakdaan u yii lituln na bi ku ubaa la.

ref: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
text: Ubaa aa tii unyamɔndaan aaseeraa naadii, ulandakdaan ma aaseeraa kan, bi mɔmɔk tii u naadii la.

ref: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
text: Bininyaam nyi bibaa aabɔr; le bibiindam ma pɔɔni bibaa ki ŋmanni baah kaa ye pu na.

ref: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
text: Unibɔn aalan ni ichiin aan ŋmaa nyaŋ Uwumbɔr.

ref: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
text: Aa ga ŋmaa gor saataan ki kiir butɔb, Uwumbɔr mu baanja le tii linyaŋ.

ref: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
text: Bigiim le ye biwankpadam aanaagbiib. Pinn unii chee ŋimombil ki kpaln udaan aanaagbiija.

ref: Troublemakers get in trouble, and their terrible anger will get them nowhere.
text: Aa yaa di titunwanbir bun kan, kinimbɔŋ le ga punn, le saah muk biken pu na ga doo.

ref: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.
text: Li ye ubulchinn daan ki yakr saajikaar tii bigiim. Aa ga kan tinyoor ni pu.

ref: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
text: Chuu nyan man unii u kpa kigaak na nikaasisik ni, aan kinikpakpak, ni kijaak, ni ŋisiibil doo.

ref: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
text: Aa yaa kpa lipobinyaan ni iliinyaan kan, aajɔ le ga li ye ubɔr.

ref: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
text: Ugbanyakdaan ka linampal la, le ki bui ke u yaa nyan kan, uchinn ga chuu u.

ref: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.
text: Kidagook ye gaawɔb la, ki chur Uwumbɔr aaŋuul aah fiir bijab bi pu na la.

ref: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
text: Aa yaa tii biwankpadam ipiin, bee aa yaa muk bigiim ke aa kpaln uwankpadaan kan, aa ga kpaln ugiin le aabaa. Nlan aaliin piitaa na

ref: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.
text: Li pel aan m tuk si bilandam aah len pu na. Bae baah mɔk pu na,

ref: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.
text: le ki li kpa mpopiin buyoonn aa teer baamɔkm ngbaan ki ŋmaa len mu na.

ref: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord.
text: M ban ke aa ŋa Uwumbɔr naadii, kina pu le m ban m tuk si mu dandana wee.

ref: I have written thirty sayings filled with sound advice.
text: M ŋmee nlan aabɔr piitaa le bil si. Mu kpa nlan ni nsurm,

ref: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you. –
text: ki ga mɔk si mbamɔn aah sil ye pu na. Le bi yaa tun si ke aa ti joo ni mu kan, aa ga ti joo ni kinyaan. ‑

ref: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you. –
text: Uwumbɔr le ga len baabɔr tii bi, ki ga ku binib bi ban bi ku bi na. ‑

ref: Don't make friends with anyone who has a bad temper.
text: Taa jɔnn binib bi aasui fiir yɔl yɔl na kijɔtiik.

ref: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
text: Nibaakan aa ga nan gaa baabimbin mu kaa ŋan na, ki mu aan ki ŋmaa kpeln. ‑

ref: Don't guarantee to pay someone else's debt.
text: Taa puu ke aa ga pa aaŋeen aatɔ aapɔln.

ref: If you don't have the money, you might lose your bed. –
text: Aa yaa kaa nan ŋmaa pa kan, bi ga nan kpaan yoor saawandookaan mu. ‑

ref: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
text: Aayaajatiib aah baan upɔnja u na, taa foor u waah si nin chee na. ‑

ref: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
text: Unii u bi ki tun waatuln mbamɔm na jer binib biken, le ki ga li ye bibɔrb aajɔ. ‑

ref: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
text: Taa ji ukumɔndaan chee tijikaar. Taa li kpa lipuul waajikaar pu ke ti ŋan.

ref: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.
text: Aa yaa kal uninyuun chee aa ji tijikaar kan, li nyi waah ye unii u na.

ref: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
text: Aa yaa ŋmaa ji sakpen kan, gii saapuul pu lii.

ref: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
text: Taa ji sakpen ke waah tii si tijikaar ti na ŋan ki mɔ; nibaakan u ban u lik saabimbin aah bi pu na ki ŋmann si la. ‑

ref: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, “Take all you want!” But they don't mean it.
text: U ga bui si ke, “Dan nan ji kpee;” umɔb le len, usui aa kii. Waah dak pu na ye waabimbin aah bi pu na la.

ref: Give up trying so hard to get rich.
text: Li kpa nlan ki taa ku aabaa ke aa ŋa uwankpadaan.

ref: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off. –
text: Saamombil ga ŋmaa fii ke ŋaah kpa ifeen ke likaagiil na la, ki cha si. ‑

ref: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted. –
text: Aa ga wuln saah jin ni na mɔmɔk, le saamɔmɔɔn na bee fam. ‑

ref: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you. –
text: Taa pɔɔk aabaa ke aa tuk ujɔr nlan aabɔr; waan gaa ti. ‑

ref: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.
text: Taa foor aayaaja aapɔnja aah si nin chee na. Taa gaa nkpobim aatiŋ.

ref: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
text: Maabo, li pel, ki li kpa nlan ki li lik saabimbin.

ref: Don't be a heavy drinker or stuff yourself with food.
text: Taa dii binib bi nyu ndaan sakpen na, ni bipusakpemdam.

ref: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear. –
text: Bidanyurb ni bipusakpemdam ga ŋa bigiim la. Saatuln le yaa ye ke aa ji ki doon geen kan, aa ga peen tikekekpir dandana wee. ‑

ref: Pay attention to your father, and don't neglect your mother when she grows old.
text: Ŋun tii aate; ni yaa kaa ba ye u pu kan, saa ba bi. Aana yaa por kan, mɔk u saah neen u pu na.

ref: Make your father truly happy by living right and showing sound judgment.
text: Mbimbinyaandaan aate nyi ni pu u kpa mpopiin na. Aajapɔɔn yaa kpa nlan kan, aa ga li kpa limakl u pu.

ref: Make your parents proud, especially your mother. –
text: Cha aate ni aana li kpa limakl aa pu; tii aana kina aapopiin. ‑

ref: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
text: Maabo, pel mbamɔm ki cha maabimbin li ye limɔkl ki tii si.

ref: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—
text: Bipiib bi gɔr na ye gaawɔb u ga ŋmaa ku unii na la.

ref: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
text: Bi dɔ kii si ke binaayukb na la, le ki cha bijab pam bii baasan. ‑

ref: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
text: Taa cha ndaan ŋmann si; taa lik ke mu ŋan ki man, ki kpenn kidayikuuk ni, ki sunni aaneen ni suuna.

ref: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
text: Aa ga li ka ki waa wayɔlyɔl nibaa aanimbil wɔb, le saan ŋmaa dak, kaan ŋmaa len tibɔr mbamɔm.

ref: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
text: Ni ga li bi ke saah bi nnyusakpem ni, buŋɔb sakpem ponn ni na, le ki saa labr, ki nya do, ki ti saa do.

ref: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
text: Aa ga bui ke, “Nibaakan, m fe kan iween, nibaakan, bi fe gbaa mi la, le maa ki teer, ba ŋa maa ŋmaa fii sil? M ki ban ndaan la.”

ref: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.
text: Taa cha kinimbɔŋdam aabɔr li muk si; ki taa li kpa lipiipoln bi pu.

ref: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.
text: Taa dak ke bibiindam aawan ba li ye saawan, ki taa jɔnn bi kijɔtiik.

ref: All they think about and talk about is violence and cruelty. –
text: Baalandak le ye tibɔr aaŋam, n‑yoonn mumɔk bi waar bimɔi na, bi ban bi sii unii la. ‑

ref: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out. –
text: Ubiindaan aa kpa fen aamakl, waan kan tiwanyaan nibaa. ‑

ref: Use wisdom and understanding to establish your home;
text: Nlan pu le unii ga maa lidichal tɔŋ.

ref: let good sense fill the rooms with priceless treasures. –
text: Tidir ti ponn ni nlan bi na, tiwanyaan, ni liyimbil aawan le bi ti ponn ni. ‑

ref: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.
text: Maabo, li san Uwumbɔr ijawaan ki pak u, ki li pak saabɔrkpaan. Taa dii binib bi yii baamɔi na aabɔr;

ref: Battles are won by listening to advice and making a lot of plans. –
text: ba pu? see aa dakl lik mbamɔm waahr le ki nin ban butɔb, le nsurm nyaan mu aa kan na ga cha aa nyaŋ saadim. ‑

ref: Who knows what sudden disaster the Lord or a ruler might bring? More Sayings That Make Good Sense
text: kina aanib aamɔfal aa cha mɔb pu. Uwumbɔr ni ubɔrkpaan ga ŋmaa tii si tibɔr. Nlan aaliin iken

ref: Wisdom is too much for fools! Their advice is no good. –
text: Unii u kaa kpa nlan na aa beer nlan aabɔr aatataa. Bi yaa bi kpokl tibɔkpaan kan, u ka ŋmin la. ‑

ref: Here are some more sayings that make good sense: When you judge, you must be fair.
text: Bilandam le ki len tibɔr timina mu: Naa ŋan ke ubɔjir li kpa imaagann.

ref: Everyone hates senseless fools who think up ways to sin. –
text: Ujɔr aalandak mɔk ye kinimbɔŋ la. Binib aa gee unii u lik seeni uŋeen aatɔtiib na la. ‑

ref: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.
text: U yaa di mbamɔn tii unii u aabɔr aa ŋan na kan, binib mɔmɔk ga li nan u, le ki puuni lir u pu.

ref: Don't give up and be helpless in times of trouble. –
text: Aa yaa kaa kpa mpɔɔn buyoonn tibɔr muk si na kan, aa sil ye ugiin la. ‑

ref: But if you punish the guilty, things will go well for you, and you will prosper.
text: Ubɔjir u dar binib bi aabɔr aa ŋan na aatafal na ga kan tinyoor ni liyimbinyaan.

ref: Don't fail to rescue those who are doomed to die.
text: Unii yaa kaa tun taani aan bi ban bi ku u kan, ŋa mala ki ti gaa u lii.

ref: Don't say, “I didn't know it!” God can read your mind. He watches each of us and knows our thoughts. And God will pay us back for what we do. –
text: Nibaakan aa ga bui ke naa ye saabɔr, le Uwumbɔr ma nyi ki lik saabimbin. U lik saabimbin, ki nyi ni mɔmɔk. Le u ga pa si saatuln aah ŋeer pu na. ‑

ref: Giving an honest answer is a sign of true friendship.
text: Aa yaa baa unii mbaan, u giin kii si mbamɔm kan, ni mɔk kijɔtiik ki ŋan na la.

ref: Honey is good for you, my children, and it tastes sweet.
text: Maabo, ji tisiir, ti ŋan ki mɔ. Tisiir aah mirk aalambil pu pu na,

ref: Wisdom is like honey for your life— if you find it, your future is bright. –
text: kina le nlan mu ŋan tii aasui. Aa yaa kpa nlan kan, aa ga li kpa limɔfal li ŋan na. ‑

ref: Get your fields ready and plant your crops before starting a home.
text: Aa yaa kaa kee chee saajikaar ki bee ke aa ga ŋmaa joo lidichal kan, taa maa lidichal ki yoor upii.

ref: Don't be a cruel person who attacks good people and hurts their families.
text: Taa li bi ke ubiindaan u ŋa waalandak ke u ti su unibamɔnn ubaa aawan na, bee u ti yoor waadichal mɔmɔk na.

ref: Even if good people fall seven times, they will get back up. But when trouble strikes the wicked, that's the end of them. –
text: Unibamɔnn yaa lir sakpen pu na kan, u ga ki fii sil; le tibɔbir ga ku ubiindaan ma. ‑

ref: Don't accuse anyone who isn't guilty. Don't ever tell a lie
text: Taa ŋa seeraadaan tii unii kaa nyi tibɔr ngbaan aabamɔn. Taa gii inyamɔn paan unii ubaa.

ref: Don't be happy to see your enemies trip and fall down.
text: Saadin yaa kan tibɔr kan, taa cha aasui piir u pu; u yaa gbeer kan, taa li mɔɔni.

ref: The Lord will find out and be unhappy. Then he will stop being angry with them. –
text: Aasui yaa piir u pu kan, Uwumbɔr nyi, kaan li gee kina; nibaakan waan daa utafal. ‑

ref: or say to someone, “I'll get even with you!”
text: Taa bui ke; “M ga ŋa u waah ŋa mi pu na. M ga teen u.”

ref: I once walked by the field and the vineyard of a lazy fool.
text: M nan chuun kpak ugbanyakdaan u ye ujɔr na aasaak la.

ref: Thorns and weeds were everywhere, and the stone wall had fallen down.
text: Ikokon ni timoor le nan muun gaa ki ni. Waah di idɔ i gob ki na nan lir dɔ kitiŋ.

ref: When I saw this, it taught me a lesson:
text: M nan lik nima, ki dakl lik, le ki bae mbaem kisaak ngbaan chee.

ref: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
text: Aa yaa gee kan, li cha ki ti doon geen, doon ki geen. Di aaŋaal bɔɔb aabaa ki li dɔ fuur,

ref: Suddenly poverty hits you and everything is gone!
text: le buyoonn aa dɔ geen na, igiin ga dan nan bib chuu si ke unaayuk na.

ref: Here are some more of Solomon's proverbs. They were copied by the officials of King Hezekiah of Judah.
text: Juda aabɔrkpaan Hesekia aatutum nan ŋmee Solomonn aayataŋak ŋimina.

ref: God is praised for being mysterious; rulers are praised for explaining mysteries.
text: Ti pak Uwumbɔr, waah joo tibɔr ti bɔrni timi na pu, ki pak bibɔrkpaam mu, baah kpiir ni mɔk timi na pu.
