text: “M mu nyi saabɔr mɔmɔk, saah ŋani ni na, ni saah chaa nimɔk na. M nyi saah kpa liŋuusakpeln m pu pu na.

ref: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
text: M ŋun saah kpa liŋuusakpeln ni kigaak pu na, le dandana m ga di njapiin di pui aamɔfal ni, le ki di itangar mu di ŋa aamɔb ni, ki di si giin dii nsan mu aa dii ni ki dan na.”

ref: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year, you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
text: Tɔ, le Aisaya bui ubɔrkpaan Hesekia ke, “Nimina le ga li ye limɔkl ki mɔk nimi tiwan ni ga ŋa na. Libiln limina, ni libiln li ga paan ni na, ni ga ji tijikaar ti naa kon ti, ti punn tibaa pu na la; libiln li ga paan na ma kan, ni ga ŋmaa bu nibaa aajikaar aan ki nan chee ti, ki ga bu ŋisubil aasui ki moo yaasubil mu.

ref: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.
text: Juda aanib bi ŋmar na ga pɔr ke isui i aasubon koo kitiŋ mbamɔm aan i lu ŋisubil sakpen na la.

ref: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will see to it that some who live in Jerusalem will survive.
text: Binib ga li bi Jerusalem aatiŋ ni, ni Sionn Aajool pu ki ŋmar, ba pu? Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan le puu ke ni ga ŋa kina.

ref: I promise that the king of Assyria won't get into Jerusalem, or shoot an arrow into the city, or even surround it and prepare to attack.
text: “Uwumbɔr aah len Asiria Aabɔrkpaan aabɔr ti na sɔ: ‘Waan koo ni kitiŋ kee ponn ni, kaan too mpiin mubaa ki ponn ni. Butɔb aajab bi joo ŋipen kii bibaa na ubaa aan duun ni kitiŋ ngbaan, le baan maa ŋibimbin tam tam kaagon.

ref: After this, King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.
text: Le Asiria aabɔrkpaan Senakerib fenn ki gir buen Ninefa aatiŋ ni.

ref: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
text: Nwiin mubaa daal le u nan bi dooni liwaal Nisrok, laawaadiik ni, le ujapɔtiib bilee, Adramelek, ni Sareser, buen ti di baajaak aajum ku u, le ki san ŋmar buen Ararat aatiŋ pu. Le ujapɔɔn uken, u bi yin u ke Esaradonn na, nab waanaan pu.

ref: Hezekiah turned toward the wall and prayed,
text: Le Hesekia fenn unimbil toŋ lidigbimal ki mee Uwumbɔr ke;

ref: You, Lord, will save me, and every day that we live we will sing in your temple to the music of stringed instruments. Isaiah's Advice to Hezekiah
text: Uwumbɔr, aa cha maaween sɔŋ a. Ti ga gbaa tibar ki gaa ilahn ki pak si. Timi aamɔfal mɔmɔk ni, ti ga gaa ilahn ki pak si Saadichal ni.

ref: About this time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. So I went in and told him, “The Lord says you won't ever get well. You are going to die, and so you had better start doing what needs to be done.”
text: N‑yoonn mumina le ubɔrkpaan Hesekia nan buŋ ki ti gur siib u kpo. Uwumbɔr aabɔnabr Aisaya, u aate nan ye Amos na nan buen u ti mann u, le ki ti bui u ke, “Uwumbɔr bui ke, ‘Gor tiwan mɔmɔk, ba pu? saan ŋmar. Gor ki li kii nkun.’”

ref: I thought I would never again see you, my Lord, or any of the people who live on this earth.
text: M nan dak ke bimɔfadam aadulnyaa wee ni maan ki kan Uwumbɔr kpala, bee unii u fu na ubaa.

ref: “Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord. I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right.” After this, he cried hard.
text: “Uwumbɔr, teer ke m di gaakii tun saatuln ni kipak ŋmeen la, ki pɔɔni mbaa n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ke m ŋa saah ban ke m ŋa pu na,” le ki wii sakpen.

ref: Then the Lord sent me
text: Le Uwumbɔr bui Aisaya

ref: with this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will let you live
text: ke u gir buen Hesekia chee ki ti bui u ke, “Min Uwumbɔr, u ye aayaaja David Aawumbɔr na ŋun saameel, ki kan saanyunyunn; m ga di ŋibin kipiik ni ŋiŋmu kpee saamɔfal pu.

ref: while I protect you and your city from the king of Assyria.
text: M ga gaa si ni Jerusalem aatiŋ kimina Asiria aabɔrkpaan ngbaan chee lii, ki ga li kii kitiŋ ngbaan n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.”

ref: Now I will prove to you that I will keep my promise.
text: Le Aisaya giin gar u ke, “Uwumbɔr ga tii si limɔkl li ga mɔk ke u ga ŋa waah puu tipuur ti na.

ref: Do you see the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway built for King Ahaz? I will make the shadow go back ten steps. Then the shadow went back ten steps. King Hezekiah's Song of Praise
text: Ubɔrkpaan Ahas aah nan maa ŋibimbin ŋi bi taar ki jon na pu, Uwumbɔr ga cha ŋaajunjuŋ ngbaan gir puwɔb ŋibimbin kipiik.” Le kijunjuŋ ngbaan gir puwɔb ŋibimbin kipiik.

ref: This is what Hezekiah wrote after he got well:
text: Hesekia aah pɔɔk na, le u ŋmee kipak aalahn mumina:

ref: I thought I would die during my best years and stay as a prisoner forever in the world of the dead.
text: M nan dak ke n‑yoonn mu maapɔɔn moo fii na le m nan chaa kun kitekpiitiŋ ni, kaan fuu maamɔfal aadoon.

ref: My life was taken from me like the tent that a shepherd pulls up and moves. You cut me off like thread from a weaver's loom; you make a wreck of me day and night.
text: Maamɔfal nan gii ki kuln, ke baah ber libool pu na, ke ukpaluul aah gii likekeln kikpaluudaak ni pu na. M nan dak ke Uwumbɔr doo maamɔfal la.

ref: Until morning came, I thought you would crush my bones just like a hungry lion; both night and day you make a wreck of me.
text: Kinyeek mɔmɔk m wii iween pu la, ki naahn ke uchinn le aah bi kool maakpab na. M nan dak ke Uwumbɔr doo maamɔfal la.

ref: I cry like a swallow; I mourn like a dove. My eyes are red from looking to you, Lord. I am in terrible trouble. Please come and help me.
text: Nneel nan bi siib kina, kaa pɔɔ, le m nan dun ke linanjel aah wii pu na. Maah nan lik paacham pu na nan cha nnimbil wu la. Uwumbɔr, nyan mi tibɔbir timina mɔmɔk ni.

ref: Your words and your deeds bring life to everyone, including me. Please make me healthy and strong again.
text: Uwumbɔr, sin baanja pu le m ga li bi, sin baanja pu; tii mi laafee, ki cha m li bi.

ref: It was for my own good that I had such hard times. But your love protected me from doom in the deep pit, and you turned your eyes away from my sins.
text: Nsui aah bii pu na ga kpaln nsuudoon la. Aa nyan mi tibɔbir mɔmɔk ni; aa di maatunwanbir cha pinn mi a.

ref: No one in the world of the dead can thank you or praise you; none of those in the deep pit can hope for you to show them how faithful you are.
text: Ubaa aa bi kitekpiitiŋ ni ki ga ŋmaa pak si; bitekpiib aan ŋmaa li kpa limakl saabamɔn pu.

ref: Only the living can thank you, as I am doing today. Each generation tells the next about your faithfulness.
text: Binib bi fu na baanja le ga ŋmaa pak si, ke maah pak si dandana wee pu pu na. Tetiib tuk baabim ke aa ŋani saah puu pu na.

ref: I had told King Hezekiah's servants to put some mashed figs on the king's open sore, and he would get well.
text: Le Aisaya bui ubɔrkpaan ngbaan ke u san likakaln aasubil ki di boon lichakpelar ngbaan aan u pɔɔk.

ref: Then Hezekiah asked for proof that he would again worship in the Lord's temple.
text: Le ubɔrkpaan Hesekia baa u ke, “Ba ga li ye limɔkl ki mɔk ke m ga pɔɔk ki ŋmaa buen Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni?”

ref: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
text: Hesekia nan gaa bi, ki chann bi tichann, le ki mɔk bi waawangol: u nan mɔk bi waakunabr, ni waasalmaa, ni tikpin aawan, ni nkpan mu nun mɔ na, ni waajar aajawan mɔmɔk. Tiwan nibaa aa nan gur waadir ni, bee nibaa chee waanaan ni, aan waa mɔk bi.

ref: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah was well, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
text: N‑yoonn mumina, le Babiloŋ aabɔrkpaan, Baladann aajapɔɔn u bi yin u ke Merodak Baladann na, ŋun ke ubɔrkpaan Hesekia dɔ bun, le u ban ipiin ki ŋmee kigbaŋ ki di tun u chee.

ref: “What did you show them?” I asked. Hezekiah answered, “I showed them everything in my kingdom.”
text: “Bi kan ba libɔrdichal ni?” Hesekia bui ke, “Bi kan tiwan mɔmɔk. Tiwan nibaa aa gur tidir ni aan maa mɔk bi.”

ref: Then I told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful.
text: Le Aisaya bui u ke, “Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan bui ke,

ref: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
text: ‘N‑yoonn choo le tiwan nimɔk bi saabɔrchiln ni na, ni tiwan nimɔk aayaajatiib nan di bil ki nan saa din na mɔmɔk ga buen Babiloŋ aatiŋ ni. Nibaa aan gur.

ref: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
text: Bi ga nan yoor sin aabaa aayaabitiib bibaa di buen Babiloŋ aatiŋ ni, aan ki ti lee bi, aan bi li tun lituln ubɔrkpaan ngbaan aadichal ni.’”

ref: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told me, “The message you brought from the Lord is good.”
text: Ubɔrkpaan Hesekia nan dak ke tibɔr ngbaan aatataa le ye ke nsuudoon ga li bi waamɔfal aayoonn, le ki giin kii ke, “Uwumbɔr aah di tibɔr ti tii ni si na ŋan.”

ref: Our God has said: “Encourage my people! Give them comfort.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Sɔŋ maanib aasui, sɔŋ bisui man.

ref: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and announce: Your slavery is past; your punishment is over. I, the Lord, made you pay double for your sins.”
text: Pɔɔk Jerusalem aanib aataakpab. Tuk bi ke bi jin falaa ni yunn sakpen a, le dandana m di baatunwanbir cha pinn bi, m daa bitafal ki ŋaŋ baatunwanbir.”

ref: Someone is shouting: “Clear a path in the desert! Make a straight road for the Lord our God.
text: Unii ubaa bi ki tar ke, “Toor Uwumbɔr aasan nteersakpiin ni man, ki ŋa waasan mu li tok ki tii u.

ref: Fill in the valleys; flatten every hill and mountain. Level the rough and rugged ground.
text: Bi ga di titan gbiin tifatann mɔmɔk, ki ber ŋijoo ni ŋigongon mɔmɔk lii taab, ki ŋa isan imɔk kaa joon na, i li joon tii u.

ref: Then the glory of the Lord will appear for all to see. The Lord has promised this!”
text: Uwumbɔr aah kpa kipak sakpen pu na ga nya mpaan pu aan unibɔn mɔmɔk kan waapak ngbaan. Uwumbɔr ubaa le puu kina.”

ref: Someone told me to shout, and I asked, “What should I shout?” We humans are merely grass, and we last no longer than wild flowers.
text: Nneel mubaa tar ke, “Moon ti.” Le m baa ke, “M moon ba aabɔr?” Le mu gar ke, “Moon ke unibɔn mɔmɔk naahn mmopuun la; baa yunni ki jer mmopuun mu bi timoor ni na.

ref: At the Lord's command, flowers and grass disappear, and so do we.
text: Buyoonn Uwumbɔr cha libuln daa timoor pu na, timoor ga yɔl, le mmopuun mu gbaar. Binib aa yunni ki jer timoor.

ref: Flowers and grass fade away, but what our God has said will never change. Your God Is Here!
text: Mbamɔn, timoor yɔl, le mmopuun gbaar, Uwumbɔr aamɔbon ma aan jer kpala.”

ref: There is good news for the city of Zion. Shout it as loud as you can from the highest mountain. Don't be afraid to shout to the towns of Judah: “Your God is here!”
text: Jerusalem yaab, buen lijool li fɔk na paab man ki ti moon tibɔnyaan ngbaan. Teen mpɔɔn pu ki len ke, Sionn aanib, moon tibɔnyaan ngbaan man. Len mpɔɔn pu ki taa san ijawaan man. Tuk Juda aatim aanib ke Uwumbɔr choo.

ref: Look! The powerful Lord God is coming to rule with his mighty arm. He brings with him what he has taken in war, and he rewards his people.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr choo ke u nan di mpɔɔn joo waanib, ki joo ni binib bi u gaa bi lii na.

ref: The Lord cares for his nation, just as shepherds care for their flocks. He carries the lambs in his arms, while gently leading the mother sheep. Who Compares with God?
text: U ga li joo waanib ke upihdaan aah joo waapiih pu na la; u ga kuun ipihbi nan kpaan tɔb chee, ki yoor i uŋaal ni, ki ga loln inatiib pu nsan suuna. Israel yaab Aawumbɔr u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na

ref: Did any of you measure the ocean by yourself or stretch out the sky with your own hands? Did you put the soil of the earth in a bucket or weigh the hills and mountains on balance scales?
text: Ŋma ga ŋmaa di uŋaapɔtan ŋaŋ nnyusakpem aanyun ki ti bee mu aaŋaŋ, bee u di uŋaal ŋaŋ kitaapaak? Ubaa ga ŋmaa di kitiŋ kee aatan mɔmɔk ŋa kiyinyook kibaa ni ii? Ubaa mu ga ŋmaa di tiwan ni bi joo ŋaŋni tiwan aah nyuun pu na ki di ŋaŋ ŋijoo ni ŋigongon aanyunyuun aa?

ref: Has anyone told the Lord what he must do or given him advice?
text: Ŋma ga ŋmaa tuk Uwumbɔr waah ga ŋa pu na? Ŋma ga ŋmaa mɔk u, bee u sur u?

ref: Did the Lord ask anyone to teach him wisdom and justice? Who gave him knowledge and understanding?
text: Ŋma chee aan Uwumbɔr ga buen ti baa ke u bee tiwan aatataa, bee ki ti bae waah ga ŋa pu na?

ref: To the Lord, all nations are merely a drop in a bucket or dust on balance scales; all of the islands are but a handful of sand.
text: Uwumbɔr ma chee kan, ŋitimbol aa ye nibaa, ŋaa fuu linyunbol libaa; ŋidik ŋi bi dandar na naahn kitangbaak la.

ref: The cattle on the mountains of Lebanon would not be enough to offer as a sacrifice to God, and the trees would not be enough for the fire.
text: Lebanonn aachook ni aapeel mɔmɔk aan ŋeer bi di toor kitork tii timi Aawumbɔr, le kichook ngbaan aasui mu par i tuur kitork aamii.

ref: God thinks of the nations as far less than nothing.
text: Ŋitimbol ngbaan aa ye nibaa u chee.

ref: Who compares with God? Is anything like him?
text: Ti ga di Uwumbɔr ŋaŋ ŋma? Aa ga ŋa kinye ki mɔk waah bi pu na?

ref: Is an idol at all like God? It is made of bronze with a thin layer of gold, and decorated with silver.
text: Waa bi ke liwaal li biwaadam naan na, bee bichaab aah di salmaa boon li aan ki di tikunabr ŋa litaa na.

ref: Or special wood may be chosen because it doesn't rot— then skilled hands take care to make an idol that won't fall on its face. God Rules the Whole Earth
text: Uja u kaa kpa salmaa bee tikunabr na ga di busub bu kaan dur na naan li, le ki ban ukpikpiir u nyi sakpen na, le u kpii u liwaal li ga ŋmaa sil, kaan lir na.

ref: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? Hasn't it been clear since the time of creation?
text: Saa nyi ii? Baa nan tuk si n‑yoonn mu jer na aa? Saa kee ŋun dulnyaa wee aah nan piin pu na aa?

ref: God is the one who rules the whole earth, and we that live here are merely insects. He spread out the heavens like a curtain or an open tent.
text: Uwumbɔr u ka waabɔrjal li bi paacham kitaapaak ni na le nan naan dulnyaa wee; binib bi bi taab na naahn inyann le u chee. U taln kitaapaak ke likekeln na la, ke baah ga ŋa likekeln aabool ki li koo li ponn ni pu na.

ref: God brings down rulers and turns them into nothing.
text: U sunni bitinjoob bi pɔɔ sakpen na taab, le baa ki bi tibaa ni.

ref: They are like flowers freshly sprung up and starting to grow. But when God blows on them, they wilt and are carried off like straw in a storm.
text: Bi naahn tiwan ni laa punn, kaa kee kpa inyaan na la. Uwumbɔr yaa tun ni libuln kan, bi kuur la, le libuln daa bi buen ke likakl na.

ref: The holy God asks, “Who compares with me? Is anyone my equal?”
text: Ti ga di Uwumbɔr u bi chain na ŋaŋ ŋma? Ubaa ki bi ke uma na aa?

ref: Look at the evening sky! Who created the stars? Who gave them each a name? Who leads them like an army? The Lord is so powerful that none of the stars are ever missing. The Lord Gives Strength
text: Waan lik kitaapaak man. Ŋma naan iŋmabi i ni waa i na? U lolni i pu nsan ke bijab bi cha butɔb na la, ki nyi yaa wiir pu na, ki yin i mɔmɔk ni yaayimbil la. Waapɔɔn aah nyaŋ sakpen pu na, i ponn ni ubaa aa wɔŋni.

ref: You people of Israel say, “God pays no attention to us! He doesn't care if we are treated unjustly.” But how can you say that?
text: Kina pu na, Israel yaab, ba ŋa ni dak ke Uwumbɔr aa nyi nimi aamuk bɔr? Ni dak ke ni yaa kaa kan nimi aabamɔn kan, utafal aa bi ni ni ii?

ref: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the eternal God, Creator of the earth. He never gets weary or tired; his wisdom cannot be measured.
text: Naa nyi ii? Naa kee ŋun aa? Uwumbɔr le ye Tidindaan u ga li bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na; uma le naan dulnyaa mɔmɔk. Waa bakr kpala. Ubaa aa nyi waalandak.

ref: The Lord gives strength to those who are weary.
text: U pɔɔk binib bi bak aan biwon yɔl na aataakpab.

ref: Even young people get tired, then stumble and fall.
text: Hali binib bi laa diin na aataakpab yɔl la, binachipɔm aawon ga yɔl;

ref: But those who trust the Lord will find new strength. They will be strong like eagles soaring upward on wings; they will walk and run without getting tired.
text: le binib bima kpa limakl ke Uwumbɔr ga ter bi na ga kan ke bitaakpab moo pɔɔk la. Bi ga fii ke ŋikaagii na; bi ga san, kaan bak; bi ga chuun, le bitaakpab aan yɔl.

ref: He goes after them so quickly that his feet barely touch the ground— he doesn't even get hurt.
text: U san dii bi, kaa kani tibɔbir tibaa; u nan san mala sakpen, le ni naahn ke waah fiir paacham le na.

ref: Who makes these things happen? Who controls human events? I do! I am the Lord. I was there at the beginning; I will be there at the end.
text: Ŋma nan cha nimina ŋa? Ŋma mɔk tibɔkpokr ti nan ŋa na taah ga ŋa pu na? Min Uwumbɔr le nan ŋa kina. Min Uwumbɔr le nan bi mpiin ngbaan, ki ga nan ki li bi ndoon mu.

ref: Islands and foreign nations saw what I did and trembled as they came near. What Can Idols Do?
text: Binib bi bi ntim mu bi dandar ni na kan maah ŋa pu na, le ijawaan chuu bi, le biwon gbaa. Le bi mɔmɔk kuun tɔb chee.

ref: Worshipers of idols comfort each other, saying, “Don't worry!”
text: Biwanŋam ter tɔb ki pɔɔk tɔb aataakpab.

ref: Woodcarvers, goldsmiths, and other workers encourage one another and say, “We've done a great job!” Then they nail the idol down, so it won't fall over. The Lord's Chosen Servant
text: Biwankpiib pak bichaab ke, ‘Ni pɔɔn nibaa.’ Uja u naan liwaal na pɔɔni unii u ga buu li na aataakpab la. Bi ga len ke, ‘Saah buu pu na ŋan,’ le bi di litaln poo li pu mbamɔm.

ref: Israel, you are my servant. I chose you, the family of my friend Abraham.
text: Le nimi maatutum Israel yaab, ni ye binib bi m lee bi na la, njɔ Abraham aayaabitiib.

ref: From far across the earth I brought you here and said, “You are my chosen servant. I haven't forgotten you.”
text: M nyan ni nimi kitiŋ aanaanmɔk; M yin nimi ki nyan ni kitiŋ aalɔlɔnn mɔmɔk ti bi ni daa na ki bui nimi ke, ‘Ni ye maatutum la.’ Maa yii nimi, le ki lee nimi.

ref: Don't be afraid. I am with you. Don't tremble with fear. I am your God. I will make you strong, as I protect you with my arm and give you victories.
text: Taa san ijawaan man. M bi ni chee. Min le ye nimi Aawumbɔr, taa cha nibaa faan nimi man. M ga tii nimi mpɔɔn ki ter nimi; m ga li kii nimi ki nyan nimi tibɔr ni.

ref: Everyone who hates you will be terribly disgraced; those who attack will vanish into thin air.
text: Binib bi gee ni pu liŋuul na ga ji inimɔɔn, baah ga lir pu na. Binib bi jaa nimi kijaak na ga kpo,

ref: I am the Lord your God. I am holding your hand, so don't be afraid. I am here to help you.
text: Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr; M pɔɔk nitaakpab ki bui ke, ‘Taa san ijawaan man; m ga ter nimi.’”

ref: People of Israel, don't worry, though others may say, “Israel is only a worm!” I am the holy God of Israel, who saves and protects you.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Israel yaab, naah par kaa ki kpa mpɔɔn mu pu na, taa san man ijawaan, m ga ter nimi. Min, u ye nimi Israel yaab Aawumbɔr u bi chain na, min le ye u gaal nimi lir na.

ref: I will let you be like a log covered with sharp spikes. You will grind and crush every mountain and hill until they turn to dust.
text: M ga ŋa nimi ke lidipoidabil li laa soon ki nyuun na la. Ni ga poi ŋijoo ki doo ŋi; ŋigongon ga wii ki kpaln kitangbaak.

ref: A strong wind will scatter them in all directions. Then you will celebrate and praise me, your Lord, the holy God of Israel. The Lord Helps the Poor
text: Ni ga di ki mee yaa paacham; le libuln ga daa ki buen, le kitaabuŋ daa ki yaa. Le ni ga mɔɔr nimi ke min le ye nimi Aawumbɔr; ni ga pak mi, nimi Israel yaab Aawumbɔr u bi chain na.

ref: When the poor and needy are dying of thirst and cannot find water, I, the Lord God of Israel, will come to their rescue. I won't forget them.
text: Buyoonn bigiim bi kaa kpa nibaa na ban nnyun kaa kan na, aan nnyunyuu joo bi na, le bineen kuur, n‑yoonn ngbaan le min Uwumbɔr ga kii baameel; min, Israel yaab Aawumbɔr, aan san cha bi.

ref: I will make rivers flow on mountain peaks. I will send streams to fill the valleys. Dry and barren land will flow with springs and become a lake.
text: M ga cha ŋimɔɔ puu ŋigongon ŋi pu aa nan kpa nibaa na, aan inyunbun mu puu ŋifatan ni. M ga cha nteersakpiin pu kpaln tibɔr ŋmeen, aan kitiŋ nin chee aa nan kpa nnyun na kpaln inyunbun i puu na.

ref: I will fill the desert with all kinds of trees— cedars, acacias, and myrtles; olive and cypress trees; fir trees and pines.
text: M ga cha santina aasui punn nteersakpiin pu, ki cha isui i ŋan na, ni olif aakpan aasui muun nima. Kitiŋ kee pu nin chee aa nan kpa nibaa na ga kpaln kichook ki kpa isui sakpiin i ŋan ki pɔɔ na.

ref: Israel, I am your Lord, the source of your life, and I have rescued you. I created everything from the sky above to the earth below.
text: “Min le ye Uwumbɔr u gaal nimi lir na. Min le naan nimi. Min le ye Uwumbɔr u naan tiwan mɔmɔk na. Min baanja le daa taln kitaapaak; maah nan naan kitiŋ kee na, ubaa aa nan ter mi.

ref: I make liars of false prophets and fools of fortunetellers. I take human wisdom and turn it into nonsense.
text: M ŋani bibɔɔb bijɔrb, ki cha baabɔr ti bi len ke ti ga ŋa na beer fam. M yii binimbiwolm aalan, ki mɔk ke baalan ye kijɔrk la.

ref: I am the one who commands the sea and its streams to run dry.
text: Maamɔb aamɔboln le m ga di foor nnyusakpem.

ref: I am also the one who says, “Cyrus will lead my people and obey my orders. Jerusalem and the temple will be rebuilt.”
text: Le m ga bui ubɔrkpaan Sairus ke, ‘Sin le ga joo maanib; aa ga ŋa maah ban ke aa ŋa pu na: aa ga cha bi ki gir maa Jerusalem, ni Maadichal aadinyikl mu.’”

ref: The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one: I have taken hold of your right hand to help you capture nations and remove kings from power. City gates will open for you; not one will stay closed.
text: Uwumbɔr lee Sairus ke u ŋa u ubɔrkpaan. U lee u ke u to butɔb ki nyaŋ ŋitimbol; u tun u ke u ti nyan bibɔrb baanaan ni; Uwumbɔr le ga piir ntisakpem aabisamɔi tii u. Uma Uwumbɔr bui Sairus ke,

ref: As I lead you, I will level mountains and break the iron bars on bronze gates of cities.
text: “Min mbaa le ga toor saasan tii si, m ga ber ŋijoo ni ŋigongon ŋi ŋa taar. M ga kool baah di tikur ŋa ibisamɔi i na mɔmɔk.

ref: I will give you treasures hidden in dark and secret places. Then you will know that I, the Lord God of Israel, have called you by name.
text: M ga nyan ni liwangol mbɔmbɔɔn ni ki nan tii si, le aa bee ke min le sil ye Uwumbɔr, ki bee ke Israel yaab Aawumbɔr ngbaan le yin si ke Sairus.

ref: Cyrus, you don't even know me! But I have called you by name and highly honored you because of Israel, my chosen servant.
text: M lee si ke aa ter maatutunn Israel aanibol, binib bi m lee bi na. Saa nyi mi, le m lee si ki cha aa kan kipak ni nnyuŋ.

ref: Only I am the Lord! There are no other gods. I have made you strong, though you don't know me.
text: Min le ye Uwumbɔr, uken aa ki bi. Saa nyi mi; m mu tee ga tii si mpɔɔn mu aa ban na.

ref: Now everyone from east to west will learn that I am the Lord. No other gods are real.
text: M ga ŋa kina ki cha dulnyaa mɔmɔk aanib bee ke min le ye Uwumbɔr, ke uken aa ki bi.

ref: I create light and darkness, happiness and sorrow. I, the Lord, do all this.
text: Min le naan nwiihn ni mbɔmbɔɔn mu; min le joo ni tinyoor ni tibɔbir mu. Min Uwumbɔr le ŋani nimina mɔmɔk.

ref: Tell the heavens to send down justice like showers of rain. Prepare the earth for my saving power to sprout and produce justice that I, the Lord, create. The Lord's Mighty Power The Lord said:
text: M ga cha linyaŋ nyan ni kitaapaak ke ntaanyun na; le kitiŋ ga waar kimɔb ki gaa, le ki kpaln lifuur ni ibamɔn ŋmeen. Min Uwumbɔr ga cha nimina ŋa.” Uwumbɔr le ye u naani tiwan mɔmɔk na

ref: Israel, you have no right to argue with your Creator. You are merely a clay pot shaped by a potter. The clay doesn't ask, “Why did you make me this way? Where are the handles?”
text: Tiyakr aabuul li bi ke ŋibuu ŋiken na ga ŋmaa kpak uyakmaal kinikpakpak aa? Tiyakr aan ŋmaa baa uyakmaal ke u bi ŋani ba? Libuul aan ŋmaa bui unii u maa li na ke waa nyi nibaa.

ref: Children don't have the right to demand of their parents, “What have you done to make us what we are?”
text: Ŋma ga ŋmaa baa ute ni una ke, “Ba ŋa ni ŋa mi kina?”

ref: I am the Lord, the Creator, the holy God of Israel. Do you dare question me about my own nation or about what I have done?
text: Uwumbɔr u ye Israel yaab Aadindaan u bi chain ki ŋani n‑yoonn mu laa choo na waah gee pu na bui ke: “Naa kpa nsan ke ni baa mi maabim aabɔr, bee ni tuk mi maah ga ŋa pu na.

ref: I created the world and covered it with people; I stretched out the sky and filled it with stars.
text: Min le naan kitiŋ kee, le ki naan unibɔn ke u li bi ki pu. Mbaa aapɔɔn pu le m di daa taln kitaapaak; min le mɔk nwiin, ni uŋmal, ni iŋmabi naah ga ŋa pu na.

ref: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Alone Can Save
text: Min mbaa le pɔɔk ubɔrkpaan Sairus aataakpab ke u tun maatuln ki cha tiwan mɔmɔk sil chob. M ga naar isan imɔk u chuun i pu aan i gɔr na. U ga gir maa maatiŋ Jerusalem, ki gaa maanib lii. Ubaa aa tii u ipiin ke u di tun lituln limina.” Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan le len kina.

ref: My people, I, the Lord, promise that the riches of Egypt and the treasures of Ethiopia will belong to you. You will force into slavery those tall people of Seba. They will bow down and say, “The only true God is with you; there are no other gods.”
text: Uwumbɔr bui Israel yaab ke, “Ijipt ni Kus aatim aawangol ga kpaln nimi yaan la, le Seba aatiŋ aajab bi fɔk sakpen na ga ŋa nimi aanaagbiib; ni ga di tikululn le di dar bi buen. Bi ga gbaan ninimbiin ni le ki gaŋ nimi ki bui ke, ‘Uwumbɔr bi ni chee, uma baanja le ye Uwumbɔr.

ref: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.
text: Israel yaab Aawumbɔr u gaal waanib lir na, u ye Uwumbɔr u bɔrni ubaa pu na la.

ref: Anyone who makes idols will be confused and terribly disgraced.
text: Binib bi naani ŋiwaa na ga ji inimɔɔn; bi mɔmɔk ga ji inimɔɔn.

ref: But Israel, I, the Lord, will always keep you safe and free from shame. Everyone Is Invited
text: Le Uwumbɔr gaa Israel yaab ma lii, le Israel yaab aanyaŋ aan li kpa ndoon; Israel aanib aan ji inimɔɔn daalbaadaal.’”

ref: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says
text: Maa bɔrni ki len maabɔr, kaa joo maah ban m ŋa pu na mu bɔrni. Maa nan ban ke Israel yaab lik ban mi, kitiŋ ki kaa kpa nibaa na ni. Min le ye Uwumbɔr, le ki len ibamɔn; m cha ibamɔn nya mpaan pu.” Dulnyaa Aawumbɔr ni Babiloŋ aawaa

ref: “Why don't you get together and meet me in court? Didn't I tell you long ago what would happen? I am the only God! There are no others. I bring about justice, and have the power to save.
text: Dan man ki nan di nimi aabɔr bil bibɔjirb chee; ki cha binib bi si nipuwɔb na kpokl tɔb. Ŋma nan len n‑yaayoonn na tiwan ni ga ŋa na? Naa nan ye min Uwumbɔr aa? Min le ye Uwumbɔr u ŋan ki gaal waanib lir na. Uken aa ki bi.

ref: “I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.
text: Nimi binib bi mɔmɔk bi dulnyaa wee ni na, fenn gir ni m chee dandana aan ki ŋmar man. Min baanja le ye Uwumbɔr u bi na.

ref: I have made a solemn promise, one that won't be broken: Everyone will bow down and worship me.
text: Maah puu tipuur ti na gbii, kaan kpeln daalbaadaal. M sil puu mbaa pu ke: Unibɔn mɔmɔk ga dan nan gbaan nnimbiin ni, ki puu ke waan nyan mpuwɔb daalbaadaal.

ref: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.
text: Bi ga len ke min baanja pu le unii ga ŋmaa kan linyaŋ ni mpɔɔn; le bimɔk gee m pu liŋuul na ga ji inimɔɔn.

ref: I, the Lord, will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.”
text: Min Uwumbɔr ga gaa Israel aayaabitiib mɔmɔk lii, le bi ga tii mi kipak.

ref: The gods Bel and Nebo are down on their knees, as wooden images of them are carried away on weary animals.
text: Babiloŋ aawaa aadoon le na. Bel ni Nebo nan ye ŋiwaa ŋi bi nan dooni ŋi na la, le dandana ma bi di ŋi buu paan ibon pu, ŋi gur ye ŋitun ŋi nyuun na le ki tii ibon i bak na.

ref: They are down on their knees to rescue the heavy load, but the images are still taken to a foreign country.
text: Ŋiwaa ngbaan aa ŋmaa gaa ŋibaa lii, bi nyaŋ ŋi ki di ŋi buen a. Babiloŋ aawaa aadoon le na.

ref: You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the Lord. Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.
text: “Jakob aayaabitiib, nimi Israel yaab ponn ni bimɔk ŋmar na, li pel m chee man. Buyoonn bi nan ma nimi na, min le nan joo nimi.

ref: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
text: Min le ye nimi Aawumbɔr u joo nimi na ki ti saa buyoonn ni ga por aan niyil piir na. Min le naan nimi le ki ga li joo nimi, min le ga ter nimi ki gaa nimi lii.”

ref: Some people hire a goldsmith and give silver and gold to be formed into an idol for them to worship.
text: Binib piir baamombil aataakɔr ki nyan salmaa; bi ŋaŋni tikunabr aanyunyuun. Bi ga ban uchaa aan u mɔɔ bi liwaal; le ki gbaan ki doon li.

ref: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
text: Bi ga yoor li ki di buŋ bibɔgbin pu, ki ti di li siin, le li si nima, kaan ŋmaa chuun buen nibaa chee. Unii yaa mee li kan, laan ŋmaa kii, kaan ŋmaa nyan u tibɔbir ni.

ref: Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it. The Lord Alone Is God
text: Nimi titunwanbirdam, teer man tibɔr timina; dakl lik maah ŋa pu na man.

ref: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.
text: Teer man tibɔr ti nan ŋa n‑yoonn na; tii naadii man ke min baanja le ye Uwumbɔr, ke ubaa aa ki bi ke min na.

ref: and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.
text: M bi yin ni uja ubaa ke u nya ni liwipuul wɔb; u ga boon ni ke kaasaa na ki nan ŋa maah dak pu na. Min le len, le ni ga ŋa kina.

ref: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
text: Nimi binib bi aatafal pɔɔ aan ni dak ke linyaŋ chee daa na, li pel ni m chee man.

ref: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
text: M joo linyaŋ aawiin mar ni la, mu aa ki daa kpala. Maanyaŋ aan ki yunn kpala. M ga gaa Jerusalem aatiŋ lii, ki joo ni Israel yaab kipak nima.”

ref: Start grinding grain! Take off your veil. Strip off your fancy clothes and wade across rivers.
text: Chuu labr kinaak ngbaan. Nan n‑yon. Chuu nyan saah di likekeln li bii aanimbil wɔb na. Chuu gbabr saakekenyaan ngbaan. Chuu kuun saawando mam ki puur ikpen.

ref: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the holy God of Israel. I am their Savior.
text: Israel yaab Aawumbɔr u bi chain na le gaal timi lir. Waayimbil le ye ke Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan.

ref: Babylon, be silent! Sit in the dark. No longer will nations accept you as their queen.
text: Uwumbɔr bui Babiloŋ aatiŋ ke, “Kal suuna mbɔmbɔɔn ni, ubaa aan ki yin si ke ŋitimbol mɔmɔk aapiibɔr.

ref: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.
text: M nan gee liŋuul maanib pu; ki ŋa bi ke baa kaa ye maanib le na: M nan di bi ŋa saapɔɔn ni, le saa san bi kinimbaak; hali aa nan muk binib bi por na.

ref: You thought that you would be queen forever. You didn't care what you did; it never entered your mind that you might get caught.
text: Aa nan dak ke aa ga li ye upiibɔr le n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, kaa di tibaa ŋa aasui ni, kaa dakl lik naah ga nan doo pu na.

ref: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.
text: Li pel nimina, sin u gee mmɔɔn sakpen na, sin u dak ke aa pɔɔ ki ŋmar na. Aa bui ke aa kpa mpɔɔn ke Uwumbɔr na, ke ubaa aa ki bi ke sin na. Aa nan dak ke saan ŋa ukpopii daalbaadaal, kaan lann mbim.

ref: Your magic powers and charms will suddenly fail, then you will be a widow and lose your children.
text: Naan yunn, liwinbaal le aa ga lann tiwan nilee ngbaan mɔmɔk. Hali saah kpa inyɔk i na aan ter si, le aa ga lann chal ni mbim mɔmɔk.

ref: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, “No one can see me!” You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.
text: Aa nan dak ke aa ŋmar saatunwanbir ni a; aa nan nyi ke ubaa aan kan si. Saalan ni saachiin le ŋmann si koon timoor ni, le aa bui aabaa ke, ‘M ye Uwumbɔr la, ubaa aa ki bi ke min na.’

ref: Keep using your magic powers and your charms as you have always done. Maybe—just maybe— you will frighten somebody!
text: Li joo saanyɔk mɔmɔk, ki chaa bibɔɔb chee; saah fii ubo pu na le aa nan ŋani kina. Nibaakan, ni ga ŋmaa ter si siib; nibaakan, aa ga ŋmaa faan saadim.

ref: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.
text: Hali saah kani nsurm mumɔk na, saa kpa mpɔɔn mubaa. Cha saanib bi lik iŋmabi ki buu tibɔɔr na dan ki nan gaa si lii, bima le bui ke bi ye binib bi bae iŋmabi, ki nyi kitaapaak aapepel mɔmɔk, ki tuk si uŋmal ki ti saa uŋmal tiwan ni ga ŋa si na.

ref: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.
text: Bi ga li bi ke tigbengbir na la, le mmii ga wu ti. Baan ŋmaa gaa bibaa lii, imiigaal ngbaan ga li ton bi chee sakpen, naan li ye mmii mu ton pulpul aan bi wor mu na.

ref: These are the fortunetellers you have done business with all of your life. But they don't know where they are going, and they can't save you.
text: Binib bi lik iŋmabi ki buu tibɔɔr aan aa di aabaa tii bi saamɔfal mɔmɔk ni na aan ŋmaa ter si. Bi ga san ki buen baah nyi nin chee na ki cha si, hali bi ponn ni ubaa aan gur ke u gaa si lii.”

ref: People of Israel, you come from Jacob's family and the tribe of Judah. You claim to worship me, the Lord God of Israel, but you are lying.
text: Nimi Israel aanib bi ye Juda aayaabitiib na, li pel man tibɔr tee: Ni puu tipuur Uwumbɔr aayimbil pu, ki bui ke ni dooni nimi Israel yaab Aawumbɔr la, le naa bi nisui ni kpala.

ref: You call Jerusalem your home and say you depend on me, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.
text: Le ni tee mak ke ni ye Uwumbɔr aatisakpeŋ aanib la, le ki tii Israel yaab Aawumbɔr naadii; waayimbil le ye Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan.

ref: Long ago I announced what was going to be, then without warning, I made it happen.
text: Uwumbɔr bui Israel yaab ke, “N‑yoonn mu jer na le m nan len tiwan ni ga ŋa na; le m kpaan cha ni ŋa.

ref: And I told you these things, so that when they happened you would not say, “The idols we worship did this.”
text: Le m nan puun len nimi aabimbin aah bi pu na n‑yoonn mu jer na, ki mooni tibɔr aan ti nin ŋa, ke m kiir nimi aan ni taa bui ke nimi aawaa le ŋa ti.

ref: You heard what I said, and you have seen it happen. Now admit it's true! I will show you secrets you have never known.
text: Tibɔr timɔk m nan puun len ke ti ga ŋa na mɔmɔk ŋa kina; kina pu na, ni ga kii ke maah nan len pu na ye ibamɔn. Dandana ma, m ga bui nimi tiwachann ni ga dan na la, tiwan ni maa nan kpiir mɔk nimi na.

ref: You have never been willing to listen to what I say; from the moment of your birth, I knew you would rebel. The Lord Warns Israel
text: M nan nyi ke naa ye binib bi unii ga gaa nimi ki kii na, ke unii mɔk nyi ni pu, ke ni ye binib bi kaa kii tii biken na la. Kina pu le naa ŋun kina aabɔr, nima le cha nitafal aa cheen kina aabɔr daalbaadaal.

ref: I, the Lord, am true to myself; I will be praised for not punishing and destroying you.
text: Maah ban ke binib nyuŋ maayimbil na, nima le m chur maaŋuul; m kiir li ke m taa kuln nimi la.

ref: I tested you in hard times just as silver is refined in a heated furnace.
text: M tɔŋ nimi falaa aamii ni, ke baah pu tikunabr mmii ni pu na, le ki kan ke naa kpa tinyoor tibaa.

ref: Israel, my chosen people, listen to me. I alone am the Lord, the first and the last.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Israel aanib, binib bi m yin bi na, li pel m chee, Min le ye Uwumbɔr u ye mpiin ngbaan, ni ndoon ngbaan na, Uwumbɔr baan ngbaan.

ref: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command. The Lord Speaks to the Nations
text: Maaŋaal le nan naan taab aatinyikl, ki daa taln kitaapaak. M yaa yin kitiŋ ni kitaapaak kan, ni choo mala le ki nan sil nnimbiin ni.

ref: Gather around me, all of you! Listen to what I say. Did any of your idols predict this would happen? Did they say that my friend would do what I want done to Babylonia?
text: Ni mɔmɔk kuun ni man ki nan pel. Ŋiwaa ngbaan ponn ni libaa aa nan ŋmaa len ke uja u m lee u na ga nan tak Babiloŋ aatiŋ; u ga ŋa maah tuk u ke u ŋa pu na.

ref: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.
text: Min le nan len ki yin u; m loln u pu nsan ki cha u kan maah ban pu na.

ref: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. It Is Best To Obey the Lord By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me
text: Dandana, foor mar ni m chee man ki nan pel maah ga len pu na. Ki nyan mpiin ngbaan m len maabɔr chain la, le n‑yoonn mɔmɔk m cha maah len pu na gbiini.” Tɔ, Ndindaan Uwumbɔr tii mi Waafuur Nyaan le ki tun mi. Uwumbɔr aah ga ter waanib pu na

ref: with this message: People of Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. For your own good, I teach you, and I lead you along the right path.
text: Nimi Israel yaab Aawumbɔr u bi chain na, Uwumbɔr u gaal nimi lir na bui ke; “Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr u ban ke u mɔk nimi mbimbinyaan, ki mɔk nimi nsan mu pu ni ga dii na.

ref: How I wish that you had obeyed my commands! Your success and good fortune would then have overflowed like a flooding river.
text: Ni yaa nan ba pel maah tuk nimi pu na kan, le tinyoor ba ga li puu choo ni chee, ke nkpen mu aanyun aa foor na. Linyaŋ ba ga dan ni chee, ke nnyusakpem aanyunkpenn na la.

ref: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.
text: Niyaabitiib ba ga li wiir ke limɔɔtambol na la, le m ba ga li kii bi, ubaa taa bii bi.”

ref: Now leave Babylon! Celebrate as you go. Be happy and shout for everyone to hear, “The Lord has rescued his servant Israel!
text: Nya Babiloŋ ni man, li cha man, ni fuur a. Li kpa mpopiin man ki moon tibɔpɔnn ngbaan, cha bi ŋun ni kookoo man ke, “Uwumbɔr gaa waatutunn Israel aanibol lii a.”

ref: But the Lord has promised that none who are evil will live in peace.”
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Titunwanbirdam aa kpa nsuudoon.”

ref: Everyone, listen, even you foreign nations across the sea. The Lord chose me and gave me a name before I was born.
text: Nimi ŋitimbol ŋi bi dandar na, li pel man, nimi binib bi koo dandar na, li pel man. Waahr aan bi nin ma mi na, le Uwumbɔr nan lee mi, ki di mi siin ke m li ye waatutunn.

ref: He made my words pierce like a sharp sword or a pointed arrow; he kept me safely hidden in the palm of his hand.
text: U cha maamɔliin ka ke kijaak aajuk na. U nan joo mi uŋaal ni ki bɔr mi. U naan mi ke mpiin mu ka ki ŋeer bi too mu na la.

ref: The Lord said to me, “Israel, you are my servant; and because of you I will be highly honored.”
text: U nan bui mi ke, “Israel aanibol, sin le ye maatutunn; sin pu, le binib mɔmɔk ga pak mi.”

ref: I said to myself, “I'm completely worn out; my time has been wasted. But I did it for the Lord God, and he will reward me.”
text: Le m bui ke, “M tun pam, le naa kpa tinyoor. Maapɔɔn mɔmɔk doo a, le maa nyan tinyoor tibaa.” Le m tee kpa limakl ke Uwumbɔr ga sil mpuwɔb; u ga pa mi maah tun pu na pu.

ref: Even before I was born, the Lord God chose me to serve him and to lead back the people of Israel. So the Lord has honored me and made me strong.
text: Waahr aan bi nin ma mi na, Uwumbɔr nan nyan mi siin; u nan ŋa mi waatutunn ke m giin ni waanib, ke m giin ni waanib Israel yaab bi yaa na. Uwumbɔr nyuŋni mi; uma le tii mi mpɔɔn.

ref: Now the Lord says to me, “It isn't enough for you to be merely my servant. You must do more than lead back survivors from the tribes of Israel. I have placed you here as a light for other nations; you must take my saving power to everyone on earth.” The Lord Will Rescue His People
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “M kpa lituln li pɔɔ na ke sin maatutunn tun. Naa ye ke aa giin Israel yaab bi ŋmar na aapɔɔn tii bi baanja, m ga cha aa li ye ŋitimbol mɔmɔk aawiihn ki tii dulnyaa aanib mɔmɔk nsan ke bi ŋmar.”

ref: Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. You are slaves of rulers and of a nation who despises you. Now this is what I promise: Kings and rulers will honor you by kneeling at your feet. You can trust me! I am your Lord, the holy God of Israel, and you are my chosen ones. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
text: Israel yaab Aawumbɔr u bi chain, ki gaal bi lir na bui baah lik unii u fam na, aan ŋinibol mɔmɔk yii u, aan u ye bitinjoob aanaagbiija na ke: “Bibɔrb ga kan ke aa nyan saamuk ni le ki ga fii sil ki tii si kipak; Kitiŋ aajojoob mu ga kan kina, le ki gbaan kitiŋ ki nyuŋ si.” Uwumbɔr aah lee waatutunn pu na le ga cha kina ŋa; Israel yaab Aawumbɔr u bi chain na joo waah puu tipuur ti na la. Jerusalem aah gir sil mpɔɔn pu pu na

ref: This is what the Lord says: I will answer your prayers because I have set a time when I will help by coming to save you. I have chosen you to take my promise of hope to other nations. You will rebuild the country from its ruins, then people will come and settle there.
text: Uwumbɔr bui waanib ke, “Ni yaa ŋeer ke m gaa nimi lii kan, le m ga san nimi kinimbaak, aan ki pel nimi aameel. M ga li kii nimi ki joo nimi le ki puu tipuur tii binib mɔmɔk, nimi pu. M ga cha ni ki gir kal nimi aatiŋ ki dɔ fam dandana na pu.

ref: You will set prisoners free from dark dungeons to see the light of day. On their way home, they will find plenty to eat, even on barren hills.
text: M ga bui biyom ke, ‘Li cha man, ni fuur a,’ ki bui binib bi bi mbɔmbɔɔn ni na ke, ‘Dan nwiihn ni man.’ Bi ga li naahn ipiih i ŋmɔ timoor ŋigongon paab na la;

ref: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.
text: nkon ni nnyunyuu aan ki chuu bi. Le nwiin, ni nteersakpiin pu aatotoŋ aan ki see bi, ba pu? u gee bi na le ga li joo bi. U ga mɔk bi uyayak aanyunbun chee.

ref: Then my people will return from distant lands in the north and the west and from the city of Syene. The Lord's Mercy
text: Maanib ga nyan ni dandar, bi ga nya ni ŋŋangan wɔb ni liwilir wɔb, ki nya ni Aswann aatiŋ ki bi ŋŋangii wɔb na.”

ref: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.
text: Kitaapaak ni taab, li gaa mpopiin aalahn man. Cha ŋijoo li gaa ilahn man. Uwumbɔr ga sɔŋ waanib aasui; u ga san waanib bi bi falaa ni na kinimbaak.

ref: The people of Zion said, “The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.”
text: Le Jerusalem aanib bui ke, “Uwumbɔr san cha timi a. Waa ki nyi ti bɔr.”

ref: The Lord answered, “Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.
text: Le Uwumbɔr gar ke, “Upii ga ŋmaa suln waabo bɔr, kaan li gee ubo u u ma na aa? Hali upii yaa suln waabo bɔr kan, mma aan suln ni bɔr.

ref: A picture of your city is drawn on my hand. You are always in my thoughts!
text: Jerusalem, maan ŋmaa suln nibɔr. M ŋmee nimi aayimbil paan ŋŋaal pu.

ref: “Your city will be built faster than it was destroyed— those who attacked it will retreat and leave.
text: Binib bi ga ki gir maa Jerusalem aatiŋ siin na ga fuu ni dandana, le binib bi nan bii si na ga nya.

ref: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord, promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.” Jerusalem's Bright Future
text: Fenn ki lik tiwan ni bi ŋani na. Saanib bi kuuni tɔb chee, ki choo kun ni la. Maah po ye Uwumbɔr u bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu na, kina le aa ga li kpa limakl saanib pu, ke ubɔndinn aah mak waaleenyaan pu pu na.

ref: Jerusalem is now in ruins! Nothing is left of the city. But it will be rebuilt and soon overcrowded; its cruel enemies will be gone far away.
text: Saatingbaln nan bii ki kuln, le dandana ma li ga li par ki tii binib bi choo bi nan koo li ponn ni na. Le binib bi nan kuln saatingbaln ngbaan na ga li gur daa aa chee.

ref: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city,
text: Saanib bi bi ti ma bi tinaagbiir ponn ni na ga nan bui si daalbaadaal ke, ‘Kitiŋ kee par sakpen a. Kpee timi kitiŋ aan ti koo ki ni.’

ref: and Jerusalem will ask, “Am I really their mother? How could I have given birth when I was still mourning in a foreign land? Who raised these children? Where have they come from?”
text: Le aa ga bui ke; ‘Ŋma ma mbim mue mɔmɔk tii mi? Maabim nan wɔŋ, le maa nan ki ŋmaa ma biken. Bi nan di mi buen tinaagbiir ni; ŋma kpiin mbim mue? M nan gur mbaa baanja la, mbim mue mɔmɔk nyan ni la chee?’”

ref: The Lord God says: “I will soon give a signal for the nations to return your sons and your daughters to the arms of Jerusalem.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr bui waatimbol ke: “M ga tii ŋitimbol limɔkl aan bi kunn ni saabim.

ref: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord. You won't be disappointed if you trust me.” The Lord Is on Our Side
text: Bibɔrkpaam ga li naahn aatetiib la; le bipiibɔrb naahn aanatiib. Bi ga sunn bibaa taab aanimbiin ni ki nyuŋ si; bi ga sunn bibaa taab ki mɔk si baapak, le aa bee ke min le ye Uwumbɔr; unii umɔk ka kii maaterm na aan lir.”

ref: He will make those cruel people dine on their own flesh and get drunk from drinking their own blood. Then everyone will know that the Lord is our Savior; the powerful God of Israel has rescued his people.
text: M ga cha binib bi muk si na ku tɔb ki ŋmɔ tɔb; bi ga nyun tɔb aasin gbii ke baah nyun ndaan le na. Le unibɔn mɔmɔk bee ke min le ye Uwumbɔr u gaal si lir ki cha aa fuur na. Bi ga bee ke min le ye Israel yaab Aawumbɔr u kpa mpɔɔn sakpen na.”

ref: I came and called out, but you didn't answer. Have I lost my power to rescue and save? At my command oceans and rivers turn into deserts; fish rot and stink for lack of water.
text: Ba nan ŋa maanib yii kaa kii tii mi buyoonn m nan buen m ti gaa bi lii na? Ba nan ŋa baa kii buyoonn m nan yin bi na? Maa ki kpa mpɔɔn m di gaa bi lii la aa? Maamɔliin baanja le ga cha nnyusakpem foor, ki cha ŋimɔɔ mɔmɔk kpaln kitikuun, le ŋaajan kpo nnyunyuu pu.

ref: I make the sky turn dark like the sackcloth you wear at funerals.” God's Servant Must Suffer
text: M ga ŋmaa cha kitaapaak bɔln, ke kaah bi wii binib bi kpo na aakpowiil le na.” Uwumbɔr aatutunn aah pak u pu na

ref: The Lord God gives me the right words to encourage the weary. Each morning he awakens me eager to learn his teaching;
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr mɔk mi maah ga len pu na aan ki pɔɔk binib bi aataakpab yɔl na aataakpab. U cha m jek ke m pel waah ban u mɔk mi pu na kichakpiik mɔmɔk ni.

ref: he made me willing to listen and not rebel or run away.
text: Uwumbɔr tii mi ntafaŋum, le m kii kaa yii waamɔb, kaa fenn mpuwɔb tii u.

ref: I let them beat my back and pull out my beard. I didn't turn aside when they insulted me and spit in my face.
text: M di mpuwɔb tii binib bi gbaa mi na. Maa nan bui binib bi seei mi ki dar gui maalangbaln aakor ki teei timɔɔtan lɔi mi na ke bi di cha.

ref: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr aah ter mi pu na, baasiibil aan ŋa mi nibaa. M gor mbaa ki kii ke m gaa ŋi, m nyi ke maan ji inimɔɔn,

ref: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr le si mpuwɔb. Ŋma ki bi ki ga mɔk ke maabɔr aa ŋan? Bi mɔmɔk ga wɔŋ doo; bi ga wɔŋ ke ŋikpandakur aah ŋman likekeln li na aah ga char char pu na la.

ref: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.
text: Nimi bi mɔmɔk pak Uwumbɔr ki kii waatutunn aabɔr na, nibaakan ni ga li chuun isan i bɔɔn na ni, ni mu tee tii Nidindaan Uwumbɔr naadii, ki li mak u pu.

ref: Go ahead and walk in the light of the fires you have set. But with his own hand, the Lord will punish you and make you suffer.
text: Nimi bi mɔmɔk dak ke ni bii biken doo na, nimi nibaa aalandak ngbaan le ga doo nimi. Uwumbɔr ubaa le ga cha kina ŋa; ni ga ji falaa sakpen.

ref: God chose Abraham and Sarah to be your ancestors. The Lord blessed Abraham, and from that one man came many descendants.
text: Dakl ki lik man niyaaja Abraham aabɔr, ni Sara, niyaa u ma nimi na. Maah nan yin Abraham na, waa nan kpa ubo, le m tii mmɔɔnyunsɔm ŋa upuu pu ki tii u mbim; m cha uyaabitiib wiir sakpen.

ref: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs. The Lord's Victory Will Last
text: M ga san Jerusalem yaab kinimbaak, ni bimɔk koo kaalangbenn ni na. Kitiŋ ngbaan gur ye nteer la, le m ga ŋa ki tikpin aasaak; ki ga li naahn maah nan ŋa ki Edenn ni na la. Mpopiin ni mmɔɔn ŋmeen le ga li bi ki ni, le bi ga li gaa kipak ni idoon aalahn ki pak mi.

ref: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.
text: Maanib, li pel man, li pel maah len pu na man: M joo maamɔkm tii ŋitimbol mɔmɔk; maakaal ga woln binimbil.

ref: Those who live across the sea are eagerly waiting for me to rescue them. I am strong and ready; soon I will come to save and to rule all nations.
text: M ga dan mala ki nan gaa bi lii; n‑yoonn mu m ga di nyaŋ binib na ŋɔŋni a. Min mbaa le ga li joo ŋitimbol mɔmɔk. Ntim mu bi dandar na aanib ka kii mi ke m dan; bi ka kii mi, ki kpa limakl ke m ga nan gaa bi lii.

ref: Look closely at the sky! Stare at the earth. The sky will vanish like smoke; the earth will wear out like clothes. Everyone on this earth will die like flies. But my victory will last; my saving power never ends.
text: Waan lik kitaapaak ngbaan; lik taab mu, kitaapaak ngbaan ga wɔŋ ke iŋmanyuu na; le kitiŋ mu ga ji deer ki ti doo ke likekekpokl na, le kaanib ga kpoi ke tisibir na. Le maah ga joo ni ŋŋmarm mu na aan li kpa ndoon; maanyaŋ mu aan li kpa ndoon.

ref: If you want to do right and obey my teaching with all your heart, then pay close attention. Don't be discouraged when others insult you and say hurtful things.
text: Li pel man, nimi bi nyi tiwan ni ye mbamɔn na, binib bi di maamɔkm ŋa bisui ni na, li pel man. Binib yaa ŋani nimi mbɔnyun ki seei nimi kan, ni taa san ijawaan;

ref: They will be eaten away like a moth-eaten coat. But my victory will last; my saving power will never end. A Prayer for the Lord's Help
text: bi ga dur ke ŋikpandakur aah ŋman likekeln li na aah ga dur pu na la. Le maah ga joo ni ŋŋmarm mu na aan li kpa ndoon; maanyaŋ ga li bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.”

ref: Wake up! Do something, Lord. Be strong and ready. Wake up! Do what you did for our people long ago. Didn't you chop up Rahab the monster?
text: Uwumbɔr, fii ki ter timi. Di saapɔɔn gaa timi lii; ter timi ke saah nan ŋa pu n‑yaayoonn na. Sin le nan chɔi chɔi nnyusakpem ni aapeewanbiik Rahab.

ref: Didn't you dry up the deep sea and make a road for your people to follow safely across?
text: Ni nan ki ye sin le cha nnyusakpem aanyun foor le ki ŋa nsan mu ponn ni, aan saah nan bi gaal binib bi lir na ŋmaa puur.

ref: Now those you have rescued will return to Jerusalem, singing on their way. They will be crowned with great happiness, never again to be burdened with sadness and sorrow. The Lord Gives Hope
text: Saah gaa binib bi lii na ga di mpopiin fuu Jerusalem, ki ga li gaa ilahn ki tar ni mpopiin. Bi ga li kpa mpopiin n‑yoonn mɔmɔk; bi ga nya kinimbaak, ni mpombiin ponn ni ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: I am the Lord, the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Min le pɔɔk nitaakpab. Ba ŋa ni san unibɔn u ga kpo na ijawaan? Ba ŋa ni san unibɔn u ga kpo mala ke timoor na?

ref: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?
text: Ni suln Uwumbɔr u naan nimi na bɔr aa? Uma le nan daa taln kitaapaak, ki baan kitiŋ aatinyikl. Ba ŋa ni san ijawaan n‑yoonn mɔmɔk binib bi muk nimi na aaŋuul pu, ki san binib bi ban bi ku doo nimi na? Baaŋuul aan ki pii nimi daalbaadaal.

ref: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.
text: Binib bi ye biyom na, m ga gaa bi lii dandana; bi ga kan limɔfal li fɔk na, ki kan tijikaar timɔk bi ban na.

ref: I will help them because I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful, who makes the ocean roar.
text: Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr; Min le kur nnyusakpem, le ki cha mu aanyunkpenn kpa kifuuk, Maayimbil le ye ke Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan.

ref: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, “Jerusalem, your people are mine.” A Warning to Jerusalem
text: Min le daa taln kitaapaak, le ki baan kitiŋ aatinyik; le m bui Jerusalem yaab ke, ‘Nimi le ye maanib. M tii nimi maamɔkm, le ki joo ŋŋaal kii nimi.’” Jerusalem aafalaa aadoon

ref: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up! You've drunk too much from the cup filled with the Lord's anger. You have swallowed every drop, and you can't walk straight.
text: Fii sil, Jerusalem yaab, fii sil man. Nyal ki fii sil man paacham. Ni jin ntafadaan aafalaa u Uwumbɔr gee liŋuul ki tii nimi ke ni ji na; ni jin falaa ngbaan, le u cha ni chuun gbeer.

ref: Not one of your many children is there to guide you or to offer a helping hand.
text: Ubaa aa bi ki ga mɔk nimi nsan, ubaa aa ki bi nimi aanib ponn ni ki ga dar nimi.

ref: You have been destroyed by war and by famine; I cannot comfort you.
text: Tibɔbir nfum mulee le lir ni pu: butɔb bii nimi aatiŋ kookoo, le nimi aanib kpoi nkon. Ubaa aa bi u san nimi kinimbaak.

ref: The Lord your God is angry, and on every street corner your children lie helpless, like deer trapped in nets.
text: Nimi aanib aa ki kpa mpɔɔn, le ki lir kitiŋ ponn ni, ŋilɔlɔk mɔmɔk ni; bi naahn ukpan aataŋ aah chuu ikulun i na la. Bi kan Uwumbɔr aaŋuul aah pɔɔ pu na.

ref: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention
text: Nimi Jerusalem aanib bi ji falaa na, nimi bi chuun gbeer ke naah nyun ndaan le na,

ref: to the Lord your God, who defends you and says, “I have taken from your hands the cup filled with my anger that made you drunk. You will never be forced to drink it again.
text: Nidindaan Uwumbɔr si nipuwɔb ki bui ke, “M bi nyani falaa u m nan di tii nimi maaŋuul ponn ni na la. Naan ki ji falaa u cha ni chuun gbeer ke naah nyun ndaan le na.

ref: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up and be strong. Holy city of Zion, dress in your best clothes. Those foreigners who ruined your sacred city won't bother you again.
text: Jerusalem, ki pɔɔk, ki ki li nyuun ke saah nan bi pu na. Uwumbɔr aatiŋ ki bi chain na, di saakekenyaan gbab. Binib bi dii ŋiwaa ki kpa tijɔŋ na aan ki koo aa ponn ni.

ref: Zion, rise from the dirt! Free yourself from the rope around your neck. Suffering Will End
text: Sin Jerusalem, gbuk gaa aabaa lii. Fii nyan titan ni ki kal saabɔrjal pu. Nimi Sionn aanib bi ye binaagbiib na, chuu gbinn tikululn ti bi di baa nimi na.

ref: The Lord says: My people, you were sold, but not for money; now you will be set free, but not for a payment.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr bui waanib ke, “Naah nan kpaln binaagbiib na, ubaa aa nan pan ni pu ŋimombil; kina pu na, ni yaa ban ni nya tinaagbiir ngbaan ni kan, ubaa aan ki pa ŋimombil.

ref: and now another nation has taken you prisoner for no reason at all. Your leaders groan with pain, and day after day my own name is cursed.
text: Tiwanbaan ngbaan le ki ŋa Babiloŋ ni mu: ni ye binaagbiib la, le baa pan ni pu tipar tibaa. Binib bi joo nimi na puk tipupukr ki mak ki lik seeni mi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: My people, you will learn who I am and who is speaking because I am here. A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
text: N‑yoonn choo le ni ga bee ke m sil ye Uwumbɔr ki bui nimi tibɔr tee.”

ref: What a beautiful sight! On the mountains a messenger announces to Jerusalem, “Good news! You're saved. There will be peace. Your God is now King.”
text: Ni ga li kpa mpopiin ke ntuun ga nyan ni ŋijoo paab, ki joo ni tibɔnyaan ti tii nsuudoon na. U mooni linyaŋ ki bui Sionn aatiŋ ke, “Saawumbɔr le joo dulnyaa.”

ref: Everyone on guard duty, sing and celebrate! Look! You can see the Lord returning to Zion.
text: Binib bi kii kitisakpeŋ ngbaan na bi tar, baah kpa mpopiin pu na, le bi kpaan ki tar. Binimbil waa Uwumbɔr aah ki gir choo Sionn pu na.

ref: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.
text: Nimi Jerusalem aalangbenn, fii ki li tar mpopiin pu, Uwumbɔr gaa waatiŋ lii, ki sɔŋ waanib aasui.

ref: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God. A Command To Leave Babylon
text: Uwumbɔr ga di waapɔɔn mu bi chain na gaa waanib lii, le dulnyaa aanib mɔmɔk kan.

ref: Leave the city of Babylon! Don't touch anything filthy. Wash yourselves. Be ready to carry back everything sacred that belongs to the Lord.
text: Nimi bimɔk joo Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aawan na, nya Babiloŋ ni man. Taa cha tijɔŋ aawan nibaa meeh nimi; li bi chain ki nya man.

ref: You won't need to run. No one is chasing you. The Lord God of Israel will lead and protect you from enemy attacks. The Suffering Servant
text: N‑yoonn mumina ma kan, naan li ban mala ke ni nya; naan li ban ke ni san ŋmar. Nidindaan Uwumbɔr le ga cheen nimi aan ki li kii nimi ŋipepel mɔmɔk pu. Ututunn u ji falaa na

ref: The Lord says: My servant will succeed! He will be given great praise and the highest honors.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Maatutunn ga nyaŋ waatuln; bi ga nyuŋ u sakpen.

ref: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.
text: Lijinjiir nan chuu binib bi nan kan u na; u nan char char, kaa ti ki naahn unibɔn.

ref: My servant will make nations worthy to worship me; kings will be silent as they bow in wonder. They will see and think about things they have never seen or thought about before.
text: U mu ga ŋa ŋinibol pam chain, u pu le bibɔrb ga li ka waa bimɔi, kaa kpa tibaa bi len. Bi ga kan tiwan ni unii ubaa aa mɔk bi na, ki bee tiwan ni baa ŋun ni pu na aatataa.”

ref: Has anyone believed us or seen the mighty power of the Lord in action?
text: Le binib ngbaan giin kii ke, “Ŋma ba ga pak tibɔr ti ti len dandana na? Ŋma ba ga dak ke Uwumbɔr aaŋaal bi tibɔr tee ni?

ref: Like a young plant or a root that sprouts in dry ground, the servant grew up obeying the Lord. He wasn't some handsome king. Nothing about the way he looked made him attractive to us.
text: Ni nan ye Uwumbɔr aageehn ke waatutunn nyal sil ke busub bu si nteer pu ki kpa inyaan na. Waa kpa kinyaan ni bunyuŋ ni ga cha binib li neen u na. Nibaa aa nan bi u chee ki ŋan, nibaa aa bi, ki ga daa timi dan u chee.

ref: He was hated and rejected; his life was filled with sorrow and terrible suffering. No one wanted to look at him. We despised him and said, “He is a nobody!”
text: Ti lik u fam ki yii u; u nan kan falaa ni iween. Ubaa aa ban ke u lik kan u, ti suln ubɔr ke waah kaa ye nibaa le na.

ref: He was wounded and crushed because of our sins; by taking our punishment, he made us completely well.
text: Timi aatunwanbir pu le bi gbaa u, le uwon ŋa ibuun. Waah gaa timi aatafadaan pu na, le Uwumbɔr cha ti pɔɔk, Ti kan laafee waah gaa tigbar ti na pu la.

ref: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.
text: Ti mɔmɔk naahn ipiih i yenn na la, timɔk cha taah gee niwɔb na, le Uwumbɔr di titunwanbir ngbaan aafalaa tun u, ntafadaan ngbaan ba ŋeer timi la.

ref: He was painfully abused, but he did not complain. He was silent like a lamb being led to the butcher, as quiet as a sheep having its wool cut off.
text: Bi nan ŋa u mbiin pam, le u gaa ni mɔmɔk suuna; waa nan waar umɔb ki len tibaa. U nan ŋmin ke baah ban bi kɔr upihbo kan, u ŋmin pu na la, ki naahn ke baah ban bi chee upiih aakokor kan, u ŋmin pu na, waa nan waar umɔb ki len tibaa.

ref: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.
text: Bi nan chuu u ki jin u tibɔr, ki di u buen bi ti ku u, le unii ubaa aan ŋmaa len uyaabitiib pu. Timi aanib aatunwanbir pu le bi nan ku u.

ref: The Lord decided his servant would suffer as a sacrifice to take away the sin and guilt of others. Now the servant will live to see his own descendants. He did everything the Lord had planned.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Ni nan ye maageehn le ke u ji falaa; waakun nan ye kitork ki ga joo ni chapinn na la. Le ni tii u nsan u kan uyaabitiib; u ga li kpa limɔfal li fɔk na, aan maah ban pu na ŋa uma pu.

ref: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord. Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.
text: U yaa jin falaa kan, nee aapuwɔb le u ga kan mpopiin; le ki ga bee ke waa jin falaa fam. Maatutunn bamɔnn u m gee u na ga gaa binib pam aatafadaan le m di cha pinn bi baatunwanbir.

ref: The Lord will reward him with honor and power for sacrificing his life. Others thought he was a sinner, but he suffered for our sins and asked God to forgive us.
text: Le m ga tii u nkakaa mu nyuun na lipepel li bi bininyuum, ni mpɔɔndam aakaasisik ni na. U di waamɔfal tii waageehn pu, ki yakr titunwanbirdam chee baapal. U gaa titunwanbirdam pam aasisiiyaan, ki mee Uwumbɔr ke u di cha pinn bi.”

ref: Sing and shout, even though you have never had children! The Lord has promised that you will have more children than someone married for a long time.
text: Jerusalem, aa nan bi ke upii u kaa kpa mbim na la, le dandana ma aa ga ŋmaa teen ki gaa ilahn ni mpopiin. Dandana aa ga kan mbim ki jer upii u aachal aa kee buen nibaa chee ki cha u na.

ref: Make your tents larger! Spread out the tent pegs; fasten them firmly.
text: Wii saadiik ki maa ki waa sakpen na, cha ŋipal li fɔk ki cha ilɔkdɔ mu li pɔɔ.

ref: You and your descendants will take over the land of other nations. You will settle in towns that are now in ruins.
text: Aa ga moo ban kitiŋ kpee saatiŋ pu ŋipepel mɔmɔk pu; saanib ga ki gaa ntim mu ŋitimbol ŋiken nan gaa bi chee na. Ntisakpem mu binib san cha mu na ga ki gbiin binib.

ref: Don't be afraid or ashamed and don't be discouraged. You won't be disappointed. Forget how sinful you were when you were young; stop feeling ashamed for being left a widow.
text: Taa san ijawaan man; naan ki ji inimɔɔn; ubaa aan ki lik seen nimi. Aa ga suln saah kaa nan si chob pu na aabɔr, ki suln buyoonn aa nan gur ka ke ukpopii na mu.

ref: The Lord All-Powerful, the Holy God of Israel, rules all the earth. He is your Creator and husband, and he will rescue you.
text: U naan si na ga li bi ke chal na le aa chee, waayimbil le ye Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan. Israel yaab Aawumbɔr u bi chain na le ga gaa si lii, uma le ye dulnyaa mɔmɔk aayidaan.

ref: You were like a young wife, brokenhearted and crying because her husband had divorced her. But the Lord your God says, “I am taking you back!
text: Israel aatimbol, aa naahn upiisapɔɔn u aachal san cha u aan ilandak joo u na la. Le Uwumbɔr di si giin ni u chee ki bui ke:

ref: I rejected you for a while, but with love and tenderness I will embrace you again.
text: “M nan san cha si siib; le ki ga ki di ngeehm yoor si.

ref: For a while, I turned away in furious anger. Now I will have mercy and love you forever! I, your protector and Lord, make this promise.” The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
text: M nan di liŋuul le ki san cha si siib, le m ga di maageehm mɔk si ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.” Kina le Uwumbɔr u gaa si lii na len.

ref: I once promised Noah that I would never again destroy the earth by a flood. Now I have promised that I will never again get angry and punish you.
text: “Nowa aayoonn na m nan puu tipuur ke nwam aan ki ji kitiŋ kee. Le dandana m ki puu ke maan ki gee liŋuul aa pu: maan ki kae si, kaan ki daa aatafal mu.

ref: Every mountain and hill may disappear. But I will always be kind and merciful to you; I won't break my agreement to give your nation peace. The New Jerusalem
text: Nibaakan ŋijoo ni ŋigongon ga wur lir, le maageehm mu m kpa tii si na aan doo; maah puu tipuur ke m ga tii si nsuudoon na, m ga li beenin joo ti.” Kina le Uwumbɔr u gee si na len. Jerusalem u ga li bi n‑yoonn mu choo na

ref: Jerusalem, you are sad and discouraged, tossed around in a storm. But I, the Lord, will rebuild your city with precious stones; for your foundation I will use blue sapphires.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Jerusalem, sin u kpa kinimbaak na, kitiŋ ki kaa kpa uteter, kaa kpa ubaa aan u sɔŋ kisui na, m ga di ŋitakpanyaan le ki ki di maa saadinyikl.

ref: I will teach your children and make them successful.
text: Min mbaa le ga mɔk saanib maasan, ki tii bi liwangol ni nsuudoon.

ref: You will be built on fairness with no fears of injustice; every one of your worries will be taken far from you.
text: Ibamɔn ni lituln li ŋan na le ga tii si mpɔɔn. Aa ga fuur limukl ni mbiin pu.

ref: I will never send anyone to attack your city, and you will make prisoners of those who do attack.
text: Unii yaa tak si kan, maa nyi udaan aabɔr; unii umɔk ban si kijaak na ga lir.

ref: Don't forget that I created metalworkers who make weapons over burning coals. I also created armies that can bring destruction.
text: Min le naan uchaa u tuur mmii ki mɔɔ tijawan na. Min le ki naan butɔb aaja u joo tijawan ku na.

ref: Weapons made to attack you won't be successful; words spoken against you won't hurt at all. My servants, Jerusalem is yours! I, the Lord, promise to bless you with victory.
text: Le tijawan nibaa aan ŋmaa tii si titotonn; aa ga li kpa ngarm ki tii unii umɔk galn si na. M ga li si maatutum aapuwɔb ki tii bi linyaŋ.” Uwumbɔr le len kina.

ref: If you are thirsty, come and drink water! If you don't have any money, come, eat what you want! Drink wine and milk without paying a cent.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Dan man, unii umɔk nnyunyuu joo u na, nnyun le na do. Nimi bimɔk aa kpa ŋimombil na, dan man, nan daa tijikaar ki ji man. Dan man, nan daa ndaan ni nnaabiin man, naan pa limombil libaa.

ref: Why waste your money on what really isn't food? Why work hard for something that doesn't satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and you will enjoy the very best foods.
text: Ba ŋa ni joo ŋimombil daa tiwan ni kaan gbiin lipuul na? Ba ŋa ni ji nimi aapal aan nkon beenin joo nimi? Li pel ki ŋa maah len pu na man, aan ki ji tijikaar ti mɔ sakpen na.

ref: I made him the leader and ruler of the nations; he was my witness to them.
text: M nan ŋa u ŋitimbol mɔmɔk aayidaan; le ki cha bi kan maapɔɔn aah bi pu na u pu.

ref: You will call out to nations you have never known. And they have never known you, but they will come running because I am the Lord, the holy God of Israel, and I have honored you. God's Words Are Powerful
text: Dandana ni ga kuun biwɔwɔm aatimbol; n‑yoonn mubaa, baa nan nyi nimi, le dandana ma bi ga san ki nan kpaan ni chee. Min, Nidindaan Uwumbɔr, nimi Israel yaab Aawumbɔr u bi chain na ga cha nimina mɔmɔk ŋa kina; m ga nyuŋ nimi ki tii nimi liyimbil.”

ref: Turn to the Lord! He can still be found. Call out to God! He is near.
text: Fenn toŋ Uwumbɔr ki mee u man, n‑yoonn mu u laa duun nimi na.

ref: Give up your evil ways and your evil thoughts. Return to the Lord our God. He will be merciful and forgive your sins.
text: Cha bibiindam di cha baah bi mbiin mu ni na ki kpeln baalandak. Cha bi fenn toŋ Tidindaan Uwumbɔr u san binib kinimbaak ki cha pinni titunwanbir mala na.

ref: The Lord says: “My thoughts and my ways are not like yours.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Maalandak aa ye nimi yoo, le maabimbin mu ni nimi yoo aa kpaan.

ref: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, my thoughts and my ways are higher than yours.
text: Kitaapaak aah daa kitiŋ pu na, kina le maabimbin ni maalandak ŋan jer nimi yoo.

ref: “Rain and snow fall from the sky. But they don't return without watering the earth that produces seeds to plant and grain to eat.
text: Maamɔboln naahn likpakpal ni utaal u nyani kitaapaak ki nan sɔŋni kitiŋ na, ki cha tijikaar muuni, ki tii binib njikaabim mu bi bu na, ni tijikaar bi ji.

ref: That's how it is with my words. They don't return to me without doing everything I send them to do.” God's People Will Celebrate
text: Kina le ga li ye ŋimɔbon ŋi m ga len na, ŋaan yii maah ban ke ŋi ŋa pu na; ŋi ga ŋa tiwan nimɔk m tun ŋi ke ŋi ti ŋa na.

ref: When you are set free, you will celebrate and travel home in peace. Mountains and hills will sing as you pass by, and trees will clap.
text: Ni ga di mpopiin le ki di nya Babiloŋ aatiŋ ni; bi ga cheen nimi nya kitiŋ ngbaan ni, ni mpopiin la. Le ŋijoo ni ŋigongon ga teen ilahn lii; isui mu ga di mpopiin teen mpɔɔn pu.

ref: Cypress and myrtle trees will grow in fields once covered by thorns. And then those trees will stand as a lasting witness to the glory of the Lord.
text: Lisalaasiil aasui le ga li gur bi ikokon aah nan bi nin chee na; le ikpasɔi muun nin chee ikokon nan si na. Limɔkl limina ga li bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na, ki teer nimi, min Uwumbɔr aah ŋa pu na.”

ref: The Lord said: Be honest and fair! Soon I will come to save you; my saving power will be seen everywhere on earth.
text: Uwumbɔr bui waanib ke, “Li ŋani man tiwan ni ŋan ki tok na, ba pu? naan ki yunn le m ga gaa nimi lii.

ref: Foreigners who worship me must not say, “The Lord won't let us be part of his people.” Men who are unable to become fathers must no longer say, “We are dried-up trees.”
text: Uwɔwɔnja u kpaan Uwumbɔr aanib chee na taa bui ke, “Uwumbɔr aan cha m ni waanib kpaan doon u.” Baah kpaa uja u na taa dak ke waah kaan ŋmaa maa mbim na, waan ŋmaa ŋmal Uwumbɔr aanib ni.

ref: To them, I, the Lord, say: Respect the Sabbath, obey me completely, and keep our agreement.
text: Uwumbɔr bui kina aaja ke, “Aa yaa pak mi ki joo maakpaakool daal mbamɔm, ki ŋani maah gee pu na, ki gaa ki kii maah puu tipuur ti na kan,

ref: Then you will be like monuments in my temple with your names written on them. This will be much better than having children, because these monuments will stand there forever.
text: saayimbil ga yunn Maadichal ni, ni maanib ni, ki jer saah ba ga li kpa mbijabim ni mpiibim pu na. Baan suln aabɔr kpala.”

ref: Foreigners will follow me. They will love me and worship in my name; they will respect the Sabbath and keep our agreement.
text: Le Uwumbɔr bui biwɔwɔm bi kpaln waanib, ki gee u ki dii u na, ki joo waakpaakool daal, ki gaa waah puu tipuur ti na ki kii mbamɔm na ke:

ref: I will bring them to my holy mountain, where they will celebrate in my house of worship. Their sacrifices and offerings will always be welcome on my altar. Then my house will be known as a house of worship for all nations.
text: “M ga di nimi dan Sionn, maagongoln li bi chain na pu, ki tii nimi mpopiin Maameen Aadichal ni, ki gaa nimi aapiin aatork ki ni toor maabimbiln paab na. Bi ga yin Maadichal ke Mmeen Aadichal, nin chee ŋinibol mɔmɔk mee mi na la.”

ref: I, the Lord, promise to bring together my people who were taken away, and let them join the others. God Promises To Punish Israel's Leaders
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr u nyan ni waanib Israel yaab tinaagbiir ni na, puu ke u ga nyan binib biken nan kpee bi pu. Uwumbɔr bii Israel yaab aaninkpiib

ref: Come from the forest, you wild animals! Attack and gobble up your victims.
text: Uwumbɔr bui biwɔwɔm aatimbol ke ŋi dan ke tipeewanbir na ki nan di waanib nab.

ref: You leaders of Israel should be watchdogs, protecting my people. But you can't see a thing, and you never warn them. Dozing and daydreaming are all you ever do.
text: U bui ke, “Israel yaab aakikiirb mɔmɔk ye bijoom la. Ni ye baatuln ke bi sur maanib, le baa nyi nibaa. Bi naahn ibɔja i kaa gbei na la, bi po dɔ geen la, le ki daŋni tidaŋ. Bi gee ngeen jer tiwan mɔmɔk.

ref: You stupid leaders are a pack of hungry and greedy dogs that never get enough. You are shepherds who mistreat your own sheep for selfish gain.
text: Bi naahn ibɔ i kaa ji babr na la. Bi ye bisalolm bi kaa kpa nlan na. Bi mɔmɔk ŋani baah gee pu na la, le ki ban bibaa aanyaan.

ref: You say to each other, “Let's drink till we're drunk! Tomorrow we'll do it again. We'll really enjoy ourselves.”
text: Bi len le ke, ‘Cha ti ban man ndaan; aan ki nyu taah gee pu na. Fen ga fe li mɔ jer din.’”

ref: but in death they find peace for obeying God. The Lord Condemns Idolatry
text: Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na yaa kpo kan, bi kani nsuudoon ni lifuur, nkun ni.

ref: You people are unfaithful! You go to fortunetellers, and you worship idols. Now pay close attention!
text: Nimi titunwanbirdam, dan do man aan Uwumbɔr nan ji nimi tibɔr. Nimi ni bibɔɔb, ni bidagoob, ni pateer tiib ye tiwanbaan la, ubaa aa jer uken.

ref: Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at? Look how your sins have made fools of you.
text: Ŋma aan ni ŋani u yaansara? Ŋma aan nimi binyamɔndam yuul?

ref: All you think about is sex under those green trees where idols are worshiped. You sacrifice your children on altars built in valleys under rocky slopes.
text: Ni doo bipiib chee tiwaachur ni, ke ni dooni ŋiwaa ŋi kpa mmaal na la. Ni joo nimi aabim ti toor kitork titakpalunn ni, ikpen aafataŋ ni.

ref: You have spread out your beds on the tops of high mountains, where you sacrifice to idols.
text: Ni chaa ŋijoo paab ti toor kitork le ki doo bipiib chee nima.

ref: Even in your homes you have placed pagan symbols all around your huge beds. Yes, you have rejected me, sold yourselves to your lovers, and gone to bed with them.
text: Ni joo nimi aanyɔbombom ki joo siini nimi aabisamɔi. Ni yii mi, le ni ni nibɔtiib, bi ni pa bi ŋimombil waahr aan ki nin doon bi chee na yiir nimi aawanpeenkaan, ki jon ti dɔ nimi aawandookaan ni wiir na pu. Nima chee le ni ŋani naah gee pu na.

ref: You smear on olive oil and all kinds of perfume to worship the god Molech. You even seek advice from spirits of the dead.
text: Ni ŋmir nimi aatulalee ni nimi aakpan le ki chaa ti dooni liwaal Molek. Ni yaa ban ŋiwaa kan, ni ga tun binib bi buen dandar, hali kitekpiitiŋ ni.

ref: Though you tired yourself out by running after idols, you refused to stop. Your desires were so strong that they kept you going.
text: Ni muk nibaa ki lik ban ŋiwaa ŋiken, kaan di cha. Ni dak ke nimi aawaabir ngbaan tii nimi mpɔɔn la, kina pu na, naa bakr kpala.

ref: Did you forget about me and become unfaithful because you were more afraid of someone else? Have I been silent so long that you no longer fear me?
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Ŋiwaa ŋi cha ijawaan chur nimi na ye ŋma, le ni tuk mi inyamɔn aabɔr ki suln m pu kookoo? Maah ŋmin suuna kaa ki gar nimi ni yunn sakpen na, le naa ki pak mi ii?

ref: Ask your idols to save you when you are in trouble. Be careful though— it takes only a faint breath to blow them over. But if you come to me for protection, this land and my holy mountain will always belong to you. The Lord Helps the Helpless
text: Ni yaa wii ki ban nterm kan, ni cha nimi aawaa ngbaan ter nimi. Litakpiln libaa aabuln le ga daa ŋi di buen. Le binib bi gaa mi ki kii na ma ga li bi kitiŋ ngbaan pu ki ga li dooni mi Maadichal ni.” Uwumbɔr aah puu ke u ga tii waanib laafee pu na

ref: The Lord says, “Clear the road! Get it ready for my people.”
text: Uwumbɔr ki len ke, “Cha maanib gir ni m chee. Chuu nyan tiwan nimɔk laŋ baasan na. Naan nsan ki gor mu siin man.

ref: Our holy God lives forever in the highest heavens, and this is what he says: Though I live high above in the holy place, I am here to help those who are humble and depend only on me.
text: “Min le ye paacham Aawumbɔr u bi chain ki bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na. M bi nin chee paa ki bi chain na la, le ki mu ki bi binib bi sunn bibaa taab aan bisui bii buyoonn bi bee ke bi tun titunwanbir na chee, ki ga pɔɔk bitaakpab ki sɔŋ bisui.

ref: My people, I won't stay angry and keep on accusing you. After all, I am your Creator. I don't want you to give up in complete despair.
text: M tii maanib limɔfal, kina pu na, maan ki galn bi ki gee liŋuul bi pu ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. M yaa ŋa kina kan, bi ga fik.

ref: Your greed made me furious. That's why I punished you and refused to be found, while you kept returning to your old sinful ways.
text: Baatunwanbir ni baakumɔŋ pu le m nan gee bi pu liŋuul, le ki nan daa bitafal ki san cha bi. Le baa nan kpeln, ki beenin dii baasan.

ref: I know what you are like! But I will heal you, lead you, and give you comfort, until those who are mourning
text: “M kan baah ŋa pu na, m mu tee ga tii bi laafee. M ga loln bi pu nsan ki ter bi, ki ga sɔŋ binib bi wii na aasui.

ref: start singing my praises. No matter where you are, I, the Lord, will heal you and give you peace.
text: M tii binib bi duun na, ni binib bi dandar na mɔmɔk nsuudoon. M ga tii maanib laafee.

ref: But I, the Lord, have promised that none who are evil will live in peace.
text: Titunwanbirdam aa kpa nsuudoon.” Uwumbɔr aah len pu na le na.
