ref: Shout the message! Don't hold back. Say to my people Israel: You've sinned! You've turned against the Lord.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Li tar man mpɔɔn pu naah gee pu na. Bui maanib Israel yaab baatunwanbir pu.

ref: Day after day, you worship him and seem eager to learn his teachings. You act like a nation that wants to do right by obeying his laws. You ask him about justice, and say you enjoy worshiping the Lord.
text: Binib bee dooni mi iwiin mɔmɔk, ki len ke bi neen ke bi li nyi maabimbin ki kii maakaal. Bi bui ke bi ban m tii bi ikaal i bi chob na la, ki bui ke bi neen ke bi li dooni mi.”

ref: You wonder why the Lord pays no attention when you go without eating and act humble. But on those same days that you give up eating, you think only of yourselves and abuse your workers.
text: Binib ngbaan baa ke, “Ba ŋa ti lulni bumɔb, le Uwumbɔr aatafal aa bi ti ni? Ba ŋa ti sunn tibaa taab, le waa pel ti chee?” Uwumbɔr bui bi ke, “Mbamɔn aah ye pu na le ye ke n‑yoonn mu ni lul bumɔb na, le ni bi ban nibaa aageehn le ki muk nimi aatutum.

ref: You even get angry and ready to fight. No wonder God won't listen to your prayers!
text: Nimi aamɔlul aayoonn le ni waar le ki kpak ki jaa. Ni dak ke kimɔlul kimina aaboln ga cha m pel nimi aameel aa?

ref: Do you think the Lord wants you to give up eating and to act as humble as a bent-over bush? Or to dress in sackcloth and sit in ashes? Is this really what he wants on a day of worship?
text: Ni yaa lul bumɔb kan, le ni muk nibaa, le ki tiin niyil ke kimook ki yɔl na, ki di tiwan ni saak kuub na aakekeln yar, ki di nfatan yɔk yɔk ŋi pu, ki doon paan. Nimina le ni yin bumɔb aalulm aa? Ni dak ke nima ngbaan ga piir nsui ii?

ref: I'll tell you what it really means to worship the Lord. Remove the chains of prisoners who are bound unjustly. Free those who are abused!
text: “Maah ban kimɔlul ki aaboln na sɔ: Chuu nyan man limukl aakululn ti ni di buu bigiim na, ni inyamɔn aatuln li ni di tun bi na bi pu, ki cha bi li chuun bibaa pu.

ref: Share your food with everyone who is hungry; share your home with the poor and homeless. Give clothes to those in need; don't turn away your relatives.
text: Yakr man nimi aajikaar tii nkon aah joo binib bi na, ki piir nimi aadichal tii bigiim bi kaa kpa nkookoo yaan na. Tii binib bi kaa kpa nibaa peeni na bi peen, ki li joo nido yaab man.

ref: Then your light will shine like the dawning sun, and you will quickly be healed. Your honesty will protect you as you advance, and the glory of the Lord will defend you from behind.
text: “N‑yoonn ngbaan le maaŋann ga dan ni chee ki wiin ke kichakpiik ni aawiin na, le nimi aabuun mɔmɔk ga yann mala. M ga li bi ni chee n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ki gaa nimi lii; maah ga li bi ni chee pu na ga li kii nimi ŋipepel mɔmɔk pu.

ref: When you beg the Lord for help, he will answer, “Here I am!” Don't mistreat others or falsely accuse them or say something cruel.
text: Le ni yaa mee mi kan, m ga kii nimi aameel. Ni yaa yin mi kan, m ga kii nimi. “Ni yaa kuln limukl, ni lik‑seen, ni tibɔbir mɔmɔk,

ref: Give your food to the hungry and care for the homeless. Then your light will shine in the dark; your darkest hour will be like the noonday sun.
text: ki yaa tii nkon aah joo binib bi na tijiir, ki cha binib bi lann na mu kan kan, n‑yoonn ngbaan le mbɔmbɔɔn mu maln goln nimi na ga daa labr nwiihn mu wiin ke nwiin pu aawiin na.

ref: The Lord will always guide you and provide good things to eat when you are in the desert. He will make you healthy. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water or like a stream that never runs dry.
text: Le m ga li kii nimi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ki tii nimi tiwan ni ŋan na. M ga cha ni li kpa laafee ki pɔɔ. Ni ga li bi ke tikpin aasaak ki kaa lann nnyun na la, ki naahn uyayak aanyunbun mu kaa foor na.

ref: But first, you must start respecting the Sabbath as a joyful day of worship. You must stop doing and saying whatever you please on this special day.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Aa yaa joo likpaakool daal ke nwiin mu bi chain na, kaa ban aabaa aanyoor nwiin ngbaan daal; aa yaa pak maawiin mu bi chain na, kaa buen lisachuln, kaa tun lituln, kaa len bɔyɔlyɔl nwiin ngbaan daal kan,

ref: Then you will truly enjoy knowing the Lord. He will let you rule from the highest mountains and bless you with the land of your ancestor Jacob. The Lord has spoken!
text: aa ga kan mpopiin mu nyan ni saah tun maatuln pu na ni. M ga cha dulnyaa mɔmɔk li pak si, le aa ga ji mmɔɔn, kitiŋ ki m nan di tii aayaaja Jakob na pu. Min Uwumbɔr le len kina.”

ref: The Lord hasn't lost his powerful strength; he can still hear and answer prayers.
text: Taa dak man ke Uwumbɔr aa kpa mpɔɔn ke u gaa nimi lii, bee u kpaa sakpen, kaan ki ŋun naah yin u pu ki ban nterm na.

ref: Your sins are the roadblock between you and your God. That's why he doesn't answer your prayers or let you see his face.
text: Ni ye nimi aatunwanbir pu le waa ŋun nimi aayim ngbaan. Nimi aatunwanbir le yakr nimi Uwumbɔr chee naa ŋmaa dooni u.

ref: Your talk is filled with lies and plans for violence; every finger on your hands is covered with blood.
text: Ni ye binyamɔndam, binib bi ban kijaak na, ni binikurb la.

ref: You falsely accuse others and tell lies in court; sin and trouble are the names of your children.
text: Naa kpa ibamɔn, ki mu joo tibɔr chaa bibɔjirb chee. Ni si inyamɔn pu le ke ni di ji tibɔr ngbaan. Ni joo nimi aalandak ki ban ke ni di tun biken titotonn.

ref: You hurry off to do wrong or murder innocent victims. All you think about is sin; you leave ruin and destruction wherever you go.
text: N‑yoonn mɔmɔk ni dak ke ni ŋa ni kaa ŋan na la, le naa taani kpala kina aaŋam. Naa sii ki dakl lik waahr aan ki nin ku unii u kaa tun taani ubaa na. Nin chee mɔk ni jer na ye mbiin ŋmeen la,

ref: You don't know how to live in peace or to be fair with others. The roads you make are crooked; your followers cannot find peace. The People Confess Their Sins
text: le unii umɔk bi nin chee ni bi na kan, udaan aa kee kan lifuur. Naah ŋani nimɔk na aa kpa ibamɔn. Ni dii nsan mu gɔr na la, le unii umɔk dii nsan ngbaan na aan kan lifuur. Binib aah kpiir baatunwanbir pu pu na

ref: No one has come to defend us or to bring about justice. We hoped for a day of sunshine, but all we found was a dark, gloomy night.
text: Binib ngbaan bui ke, “Dandana ti bee naah ŋa pu aan Uwumbɔr aan gaa timi binib bi muk timi na chee lii na. Ti mak nwiihn pu le ti li chuun dii, le ni ye mbɔmbɔɔn ŋmeen la,

ref: We feel our way along, as if we were blind; we stumble at noon, as if it were night. We can see no better than someone dead.
text: le ti chuun tuul ke bijoom na. Ti chuun nwiin pu le ki gbeer, ke naah ye kinyeek le na, ki naahn ke taah bi kitekpiitiŋ ni le na.

ref: We growl like bears and mourn like doves. We hope for justice and victory, but they escape us.
text: Ijawaan joo timi, le tiwon yɔl. Ti neen ke Uwumbɔr nan nyan timi limukl ni, ni tiwan ni kaa ŋan na ponn ni, le nibaa aa ŋani.

ref: How often have we sinned and turned against you, the Lord God? Our sins condemn us! We have done wrong.
text: “Uwumbɔr, taah tun si titunwanbir ti na nyaŋ. Timi tibaa aataani galni timi la. Ti nyi taah tun pu na mɔmɔk.

ref: We have rebelled and refused to follow you. Our hearts were deceitful, and so we lied; we planned to abuse others and turn our backs on you.
text: Ti yii si, kaa si aapuwɔb, kaa dii saasan. Ti muk biken, ki fenn tipuwɔb tii si. Timi aalandak, ni timi aamɔliin mɔmɔk ye inyamɔn la.

ref: Injustice is everywhere; justice seems far away. Truth is chased out of court; honesty is shoved aside.
text: Ibamɔn daa ti chee, kaan ŋmaa mar ni timi. Binib aah wiir nin chee na, mbamɔn gbeer la, kaan ŋmaa kan mpaan nima.

ref: Everyone tells lies; those who turn from crime end up ruined. The Lord Will Rescue His People When the Lord noticed that justice had disappeared, he became very displeased.
text: Mbamɔn par sakpen, le unii umɔk di cha titunwanbir aaŋam na ga kan ke uma le titunwanbirdam muk.” Uwumbɔr gor ke u gaa waanib lii Uwumbɔr kan nimina, le naa mɔɔr u, ibamɔn aah kaa bi pu na.

ref: It disgusted him even more to learn that no one would do a thing about it. So with his own powerful arm, he won victories for truth.
text: Ni gar u pam ke ubaa aa bi u ter baah muk binib bi na. Kina pu na, u ga di ubaa aapɔɔn le di gaa bi lii, ki ji linyaŋ ngbaan.

ref: Now the Lord will get furious and do to his enemies, both near and far, what they did to his people.
text: U ga daa waadim aatafal baah tun taani ki ŋeer pu na, ni binib bi bi dandar aatim ni na mu.

ref: He will attack like a flood in a mighty windstorm. Nations in the west and the east will then honor and praise his wonderful name.
text: Ki nya liwipuul ki ti saa liwilir wɔb, bi ga li san u ni waapɔɔn. U ga dan ke limɔɔl li puu mala mala na la, ki naahn libuln li pɔɔ na.

ref: The Lord has promised to rescue the city of Zion and Jacob's descendants who turn from sin.
text: Uwumbɔr bui waanib ke, “M ga dan Jerusalem ki nan sil nichaŋ ni, ki nan gaa nimi bi yii nimi aatunwanbir na lii,

ref: The Lord says: “My people, I promise to give you my Spirit and my message. These will be my gifts to you and your families forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.”
text: ki cha m ni nimi puu tipuur tii tɔb. M di maapɔɔn ni maakaal tii nimi ke ni li ye nimi yaan ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na, ki nya din ki joo cha na, ni ga kii maamɔb ki mɔk nimi aabim, ni niyaabitiib ke bi kii maamɔb ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu choo na.”

ref: Jerusalem, stand up! Shine! Your new day is dawning. The glory of the Lord shines brightly on you.
text: Jerusalem, fii sil, ki li wiin ke nwiin na; Uwumbɔr aanyuŋ aah wiin chain pu na bi wolni aa pu.

ref: The earth and its people are covered with darkness, but the glory of the Lord is shining upon you.
text: Ŋitimbol ŋiken pu ga li ye mbɔmbɔɔn la, le Uwumbɔr aawiihn ga woln aa ma pu; waah wiin chain pu na ga li bi aa chee.

ref: Nations and kings will come to the light of your dawning day. Crowds Are Coming to Jerusalem The Lord said:
text: Ŋitimbol ga kuun dan saawiihn chee, le bibɔrb san dan saataak ki bi wolni na chee.

ref: Open your eyes! Look around! Crowds are coming. Your sons are on their way from distant lands; your daughters are being carried like little children.
text: Lik goln aabaa ki kan tiwan ni bi ŋani na: Saanib bi kuuni ke bi kun ni la. Aajapɔtiib ga nyan ni dandar; Bi ga yoor aabisatiib ŋmam ke baah ŋmamni mbim pu na la.

ref: When you see this, your faces will glow; your hearts will pound and swell with pride. Treasures from across the sea and the wealth of nations will be brought to you.
text: Aa ga kan nimina, le aasui piir chak chak. Aawon ga li gbaa aasui aah piir pu na pu. Bi ga li joo ni ŋitimbol aawangol ki nan tii si; ŋitimbol ngbaan aawangol ga puur nnyusakpem ki pii ni si.

ref: Your country will be covered with caravans of young camels from Midian and Ephah. The people of Sheba will bring gold and spices in praise of me, the Lord.
text: Laakumii tiib pam ga ki nyan ni Midiann, ni Efa aatim ni ki fuu ni. Bi nyan ni Seba, ki joo ni salmaa ni tulalee. Binib ga len tibɔnyaan ngbaan, bi ga len Uwumbɔr aah ŋa pu na.

ref: Every sheep of Kedar will come to you; rams from Nebaioth will be yours as well. I will accept them as offerings and bring honor to my temple.
text: Bi ga joo ni Kedar ni Nebayof aapiih mɔmɔk nan tii Jerusalem yaab ke bi di toor ipiin aatork Uwumbɔr aabimbiln paab aan ni piir usui. Uwumbɔr ga moo nyuŋ Waadichal ki jer laah nan kan pu na.

ref: What is that sailing by like clouds or like doves flying home?
text: Ni ye ba aaŋɔsakpiin ki san mala mala ke ntaalangbam na, ki naahn ŋinanjel le aah choo kun ni na?

ref: On those distant islands your people are waiting for me, the Lord. Seagoing ships lead the way to bring them home with their silver and gold. I, the holy Lord God of Israel, do this to honor your people, so they will honor me. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt The Lord said:
text: Ni ye iŋɔi i nyan ni dandar na la, i joo ni Uwumbɔr aanib le choo kun ni. Bi joo ni salmaa ni tikunabr la, ke bi nan di nyuŋ timi Israel yaab Aadindaan Uwumbɔr u bi chain ki cha ŋitimbol pak timi waanib na aayimbil.

ref: Jerusalem, your city walls will be rebuilt by foreigners; their rulers will become your slaves. I punished you in my anger; now I will be kind and treat you with mercy.
text: Uwumbɔr bui Jerusalem ke, “Biwɔwɔm le ga ki gir maa saagon, le baabɔrb li ye saanaagbiib. Maaŋuul ponn ni le m nan daa nitafal, le dandana wee ma m ga mɔk nimi maanimbaasaln, ni maah gee nimi pu na.

ref: Your gates will be open day and night to let the rulers of nations lead their people to you with all their treasures.
text: Jerusalem aagon aabisamɔi aan ki piin nwiin pu ni kinyeek, le ŋinibol aabɔrb ga li joo ni baawangol ki ponn ni.

ref: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be wiped out.
text: Le ŋinibol ŋi kaa tun lituln tii nimi na ga kuln kookoo.

ref: Wood from Lebanon's best trees will be brought to you— the pines, the firs, and the cypress trees. It will be used in my temple to make beautiful the place where I rest my feet.
text: Binib ga di bunaasub ni lisalaasiil ni isui imɔk bi Lebanonn aachook ni ki ŋan ki pɔɔ na giin maa sin Jerusalem, ki ŋa Maadichal kinyaan, ki moo nyuŋ maatiŋ.

ref: The descendants of enemies who hated and mistreated you will kneel at your feet. They will say, “You are Zion, the city of the Lord, the holy One of Israel.”
text: Binib bi muk si na aajapɔtiib ga dan ki nan gbaan kitiŋ aanimbiin ni. Binib bimɔk nan lik seen si n‑yoonn mu jer na ga dan nan gbaan kitiŋ ki doon si. Bi ga yin si ke ‘Uwumbɔr aatiŋ’, ki ki yin si ke, ‘Sionn, Israel yaab Aawumbɔr u bi chain na aatiŋ’.

ref: You were hated and deserted, rejected by everyone. But I will make you beautiful, a city to be proud of for all time to come.
text: Ubaa aan ki lik si fam, kaan ki li nan si, kitiŋ ki baanib nan san cha ki aan ki ye tilangbenn na. M ga tii si mpɔɔn ni kinyaan nin chee mmɔɔn ga li bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na.

ref: You will drain the wealth of kings and foreign nations. You will know that I, the mighty Lord God of Israel, have saved and rescued you.
text: Ŋitimbol ni bibɔrb le ga li tun tii si, ke ubo aana aah kpiini u pu aan u ti chikr na. Aa ga bee ke min Uwumbɔr le gaa si lii; min Israel yaab Aawumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan na le gaa si lii kookoo.

ref: I will bring bronze and iron in place of wood and stone; in place of bronze and iron, I will bring gold and silver. I will appoint peace and justice as your rulers and leaders.
text: Buyoonn ni ban mbɔman na m ga tii nimi salmaa, buyoonn ni ban tikur ni idɔ na, m ga tii nimi tikunabr ni mbɔman, le buyoonn ni ban litakpal na, m ga tii nimi tikur. Binib bi joo nimi na aan ki li muk nimi; m ga cha bi di ibamɔn ni nsuudoon le di joo nimi.

ref: Violence, destruction, and ruin will never again be heard of within your borders. “Victory” will be the name you give to your walls; “Praise” will be the name you give to your gates.
text: Naan ki ŋun tijar aafuuk pu daalbaadaal; libiil aan ki dan nimi aatiŋ ni daalbaadaal. M ga li kii nimi ke ligoln na la; ni ga pak mi, maah gaa nimi lii pu na pu.

ref: You won't need the light of the sun or the moon. I, the Lord your God, will be your eternal light and bring you honor.
text: Nwiin aan ki li ye nimi aawiihn nwiin pu, le uŋmal mu aan ki li ye nimi aawiihn kinyeek; min Uwumbɔr le ga li ye nimi aawiihn mu kaan junn na, maanyuŋ aawiihn le ga li wiin ni pu.

ref: Your sun will never set or your moon go down. I, the Lord, will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will come to an end.
text: Nimi aapombiin aayoonn ga doo. Min Uwumbɔr le ga li ye nimi aawiihn mu kaan junn na, ki ye nwiihn mu wiin ki yunni jer nwiin ni uŋmal aawiihn na.

ref: Your people will live right and always own the land; they are the trees I planted to bring praise to me.
text: Jerusalem aanib mɔmɔk ga li tun ŋitun ŋi tok chob na la, ki ga li yeh kitiŋ ngbaan mɔmɔk ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Min le naan bi ki kaan bi ke bi kpiir maapɔɔn mɔk unibɔn mɔmɔk.

ref: Even the smallest family will be a powerful nation. I am the Lord, and when the time comes, I will quickly do all this.
text: Hali Jerusalem aadichawaatiir li bi ki bi suuna na ga kpaln litimbol li kpa mpɔɔn sakpen na la. N‑yoonn mu ŋeer na yaa fuu ni kan, m ga cha kina ŋa woween. Min le ye Uwumbɔr.”

ref: The Spirit of the Lord God has taken control of me! The Lord has chosen and sent me to tell the oppressed the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, and to announce freedom for prisoners and captives.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr di Waafuur Nyaan gbiin mi, u lee mi ki tun mi ke m tuk bigiim tibɔnyaan tee; u tun mi ke m nan sɔŋ binib bi kpa mpombiin na aasui, ki tuk binaagbiib ke m gaa bi lii a, ki tuk biyom mu ke bi kan bibaa a.

ref: This is the year when the Lord God will show kindness to us and punish our enemies. The Lord has sent me to comfort those who mourn,
text: U tun ni mi ke m nan moon ke n‑yoonn fuu ni, buyoonn Uwumbɔr ga gaa waanib lii ki nyaŋ waadim na. U tun ni mi ke m nan sɔŋ binib bi wii na aasui,

ref: especially in Jerusalem. He sent me to give them flowers in place of their sorrow, olive oil in place of tears, and joyous praise in place of broken hearts. They will be called “Trees of Justice,” planted by the Lord to honor his name.
text: ke m nan tii binib bi wii Sionn ni na mpopiin ni nsuudoon, bi taa ki wii, ki gaa kipak aalahn, ni taa li ye ikpowiil. Bi ga li naahn isui i Uwumbɔr ubaa bun i na la. Bi mɔmɔk ga li ŋani tiwan ni si chob na la, le binib ga pak Uwumbɔr, waah tun pu na pu.

ref: Then they will rebuild cities that have been in ruins for many generations.
text: Bi ga gir maa ntim mu nan gur ye tilangbenn na.

ref: They will hire foreigners to take care of their sheep and their vineyards.
text: Maanib, biwɔwɔm le ga li ye nimi aanaagbiib. Bima le ga li kpaa nimi aawakor, ki ko nimi aasar, ni nimi aadaan aasui aasar ni.

ref: But they themselves will be priests and servants of the Lord our God. The treasures of the nations will belong to them, and they will be famous.
text: Le binib ga li nyi nimi, ke ni ye Uwumbɔr aatotoorb, timi Aawumbɔr aatutum. Ni ga ji ŋitimbol ŋiken aawangol, ki li mak ke ni ye nimi yaan la.

ref: They were terribly insulted and horribly mistreated; now they will be greatly blessed and joyful forever. The Lord Loves Justice
text: Nimi aanimɔɔn doo a. Ni ga li bi nibaa aatiŋ ni la, le nimi aawangol moo kpee aan nimi aapopiin mu aan li kpa ndoon.

ref: I, the Lord, love justice! But I hate robbery and injustice. My people, I solemnly promise to reward you with an eternal agreement.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “M gee ibamɔn le kaa gee limukl ni titunwanbir. Maah ye mbamɔndaan na, m ga pa maanib, le ki puu tipuur ti kaan doo na tii bi.

ref: Your descendants will be known in every nation. All who see them will realize that they have been blessed, by me, the Lord. Celebrate and Shout
text: Maanib ga li kpa liyimbisakpeln ŋitimbol mɔmɔk ni; unii umɔk kan bi na ga bee ke bi ye binib bi m ŋa tinyoor ŋa bi pu na la.”

ref: I celebrate and shout because of my Lord God. His saving power and justice are the very clothes I wear. They are more beautiful than the jewelry worn by a bride or groom.
text: Jerusalem mɔɔni Uwumbɔr aah ŋa pu tii u na pu. U gor ubaa ke usapɔɔn u ban u kun uchal do na aah gor ubaa pu pu na la. Uwumbɔr di ŋŋmarm ni linyaŋ di peen u.

ref: The Lord will bring about justice and praise in every nation on earth, like flowers blooming in a garden.
text: Njikaabim aah ŋani pu ki ti punn ki muuni na, kina le Tidindaan Uwumbɔr ga gaa waanib lii, le ŋitimbol mɔmɔk pak u.

ref: Jerusalem, I will speak up for your good. I will never be silent till you are safe and secure, sparkling like a flame.
text: M ga len ki pɔɔk Jerusalem yaab aataakpab; maan di cha limeel ni pu see ni ŋmar, le nimi aaŋann li wiin ke kinyeek aamii aah wiin pu na.

ref: Your great victory will be seen by every nation and king; the Lord will even give you a new name.
text: Jerusalem, ŋitimbol ga kan saatunyaan. Ŋaabɔrb ga kan saawangol, le aa ga li kpa liyimbipɔln, liyimbil li Uwumbɔr ubaa ga tii si na.

ref: You will be a glorious crown, a royal headband for the Lord your God.
text: Aa ga li ŋan ki wiin chain ke tiwan ni kpa kidaak saakpen na, ki ga li bi ke kibɔryikpupuk na le Uwumbɔr chee.

ref: Your people will take the land, just as a young man takes a bride. The Lord will be pleased because of you, just as a husband is pleased with his bride.
text: Unachipɔɔn aah yoor upii u kaa nyi uja na pu na, kina le Uwumbɔr u naan si na ga yoor si ŋa upuu. Unachipɔɔn aah yoor ubɔɔn aan ni mɔ u pu na, kina le Uwumbɔr aasui ga li piin aa pu.

ref: Jerusalem, on your walls I have stationed guards, whose duty it is to speak out day and night, without resting. They must remind the Lord
text: Sin Jerusalem, saagon paab le m ga kaan bikikiib; bi taa li ŋmin nwiin pu ni kinyeek mu. Bi li teer Uwumbɔr tipuur ti u puu na, ki taa cha u suln ti.

ref: and not let him rest till he makes Jerusalem strong and famous everywhere.
text: Bi taa cha u fuur kpala ki ti saa buyoonn u ga ki giin Jerusalem siin kaasisiiyaan, ki ŋa ki kitiŋ ki dulnyaa mɔmɔk pak na.

ref: The Lord has given his word and made this promise: “Never again will I give to your enemies the grain and grapes for which you struggled.
text: Uwumbɔr puu tipuur ti pɔɔ na, le waapɔɔn pu u ga ŋa waah puu pu na ke: “Saadim aan ki di saajikaabim ŋa baajikaar, le biwɔwɔm mu aan ki nyu nimi aadaan.

ref: As surely as you harvest your grain and grapes, you will eat your bread with thankful hearts, and you will drink your wine in my temple.”
text: Nimi bi bun ki nan chee nimi aajikaabim na, le ga nan ji ŋaasaa aan ki pak Uwumbɔr. Nimi bi ŋum ki lik ndaan aasubil aasui na, le ga nyu ŋaadaan min Uwumbɔr Aadichal aachin ni.”

ref: People of Jerusalem, open your gates! Repair the road to the city and clear it of stones; raise a banner to help the nations find their way.
text: Jerusalem aanib, nya kitiŋ ngbaan ni man, ki naan nsan kiir nimi aanib bi gir choo kun ni na. Naan nsan mu waa na man; nyan ŋitakpal mɔmɔk man, ki siin limɔkl aan ŋitimbol mɔmɔk bee ke

ref: Here is what the Lord has said for all the earth to hear: “Soon I will come to save the city of Zion and to reward you.
text: Uwumbɔr bi mooni kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk pu ke: “Bui Jerusalem aanib ke Uwumbɔr choo u nan gaa nimi lii, ki joo ni binib bi u gaa bi lii na.”

ref: Then you will be called, ‘The Lord's Own People, The Ones He Rescued!’ Your city will be known as a good place to live and a city full of people.”
text: Bi ga li yin nimi ke, “Uwumbɔr aanib bi bi chain na,” ki ki yin nimi ke, “Binib bi Uwumbɔr gaa bi lii na.” Bi ga yin Jerusalem ke, “Kitiŋ ki Uwumbɔr gee ki na,” ki ki yin ki ke, “Kitiŋ ki Uwumbɔr aan suln ki bɔr na.”

ref: Who is this coming from Bozrah in Edom with clothes stained red? Who is this hero marching in his glorious uniform? “It's me, the Lord! I have won the battle, and I can save you!”
text: “Ŋma ye u nyan ni Bosra aatiŋ ki bi Edom ni na ki choo na? Ŋma ye u pee tiwanyaan ni man na, ki chuun ni mpɔɔn ŋmeen ki choo na?” Uwumbɔr u kpa mpɔɔn sakpen ki ga ŋmaa gaa unii lii na le choo ke u nan moon waanyaŋ.

ref: What are those red spots? Your clothes look stained from trampling on grapes.
text: “Ba ŋa waawanpeenkaan man sakpen kina, ki naahn ke waah bi nyani ŋisubil aanyun ke u di ŋaa ndaan le na?”

ref: “I alone trampled the grapes! None of the nations helped. I trampled nations in my anger and stained my clothes with their blood.
text: Le Uwumbɔr kii ke, “M taa taa ŋitimbol ngbaan ke ndaan aasubil na la, le ubaa aa dan nan ter mi. Maaŋuul ponn ni le m taa taa bi pu, le baasin meeh meeh maawanpeenkaan.

ref: I did this because I wanted to take revenge— the time had come to rescue my people.
text: Le m dakl ke n‑yoonn mu m ga di gaa maanib lii na fuu ni a; ni ŋeer ke m daa baadim aatafal.

ref: No one was there to help me or to give support; my mighty arm won the battle, strengthened by my anger.
text: Maah nan lik kaa kan ubaa u ter mi na, ni nan ŋa mi iwaan pam. Le maaŋuul pɔɔk ntaakpab, le m nyaŋ maadim mbaa.

ref: In my fury I trampled on nations and made them drunk; their blood poured out everywhere on earth.” The Lord's Goodness to His People
text: Maaŋuul ponn ni le m nan taa taa ŋitimbol ki yaa ŋaanib ki di baamɔfal aasin kpir kitiŋ.” Uwumbɔr aah gee Israel yaab pu na

ref: I will tell about the kind deeds the Lord has done. They deserve praise! The Lord has shown mercy to the people of Israel; he has been kind and good.
text: Le m bui ke m ga len Uwumbɔr aageehm aah kaa door pu na; m ga pak u waah ŋa pu tii timi na pu. U ŋa tinyoor ti nyuun na ŋa Israel yaab pu, waageehm, ni waanimbaasaln pu.

ref: The Lord rescued his people, and said, “They are mine. They won't betray me.”
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Bi ye maanib la; baan ŋmann mi.”

ref: It troubled the Lord to see them in trouble, and his angel saved them. The Lord was truly merciful, so he rescued his people. He took them in his arms and carried them all those years.
text: Kina pu le u nyan bi baafalaa ni. Naa nan ye waatuun, uma Uwumbɔr ubaa le nan gaa bi lii. Waageehm ni waanimbaasaln pu le u gaa bi lii. N‑yoonn mu jer na le u nan kii bi,

ref: Then the Lord's people turned against him and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he became their enemy and attacked them.
text: le bi nan yii u ki nyan upuwɔb, le ni tii Waafuur Nyaan mpombiin. Kina pu le Uwumbɔr kpaln baadin, le ki jan bi kijaak.

ref: But his people remembered what had happened during the time of Moses. Didn't the Lord bring them and their leaders safely through the sea? Didn't he give them his Holy Spirit?
text: Le bi teer n‑yoonn mu jer na, Uwumbɔr aatutunn Moses aayoonn, le ki baa ke, “Uwumbɔr u nan nyan waanib aaninkpiib nnyusakpem ni na bi la chee dandana wee? Uwumbɔr u nan di Waafuur Nyaan tii Moses na bi la chee?

ref: His Spirit gave them rest, just as cattle find rest when led into a valley. The name of the Lord was praised for doing these things. A Prayer for Mercy and Help
text: Baah peer inaa chaa kifataŋ ki kpa timoor na ponn ni pu na, kina le Uwumbɔr tii waanib lifuur. U loln waanib pu nsan ki cha waayimbil kan bunyuŋ. Linimbaasaln ni nterm aameel

ref: Please, Lord, look down from your holy and glorious home in the heavens and see what's going on. Have you lost interest? Where is your power? Show that you care about us and have mercy!
text: Uwumbɔr, saah bi paacham nin chee ni bi chain ki kpa kipak na, san timi kinimbaak. Saalandak mu aa nan kpa ti pu na bi la chee? Saapɔɔn bi la chee? Saageehm ni saanimbaasaln bi la chee? Taa suln tibɔr.

ref: Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob have both rejected us. But you are still our Father; you have been our protector since ancient times.
text: Sin le ye tite. Tiyaajatiib Abraham ni Jakob aa ki nyi timi, le sin Uwumbɔr ma le ye tite u gaal timi lir n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na.

ref: Why did you make us turn away from you, our Lord? Why did you make us want to disobey you? Please change your mind! We are your servants, your very own people.
text: Ba ŋa aa cha ti yenn saasan chee? Ba ŋa aa cha titafal pɔɔ sakpen kina aan ti fenn tipuwɔb tii si? Gir ni, saanib bi ye saatutum ki ye sin yaab n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na chee.

ref: For a little while, your temple belonged to us; and now our enemies have torn it down.
text: Timi aadim nan jenn nyan timi saanib bi bi chain na n‑yoonn mubaa, ki gbaa wii Saadichal.

ref: We act as though you had never ruled us or called us your people.
text: Aa ŋani timi ke sin le aah kaa nan joo timi n‑yoonn mubaa na, le ni naahn ke taah kaa nan ye saanib n‑yoonn mubaa le na.

ref: Be a spark that starts a fire causing water to boil. Then your enemies will know who you are; all nations will tremble because you are nearby.
text: Ŋi ga li gii ke nnyuntom aah leer pu na la. Dan ki nan kpiir saapɔɔn mɔk saadim, ki cha ŋitimbol aawon li gbaa aanimbiin ni.

ref: Your fearsome deeds have completely amazed us; even the mountains shake when you come down.
text: N‑yoonn mubaa aa nan sunn ni ki nan ŋa lijinjiir aawan ni taa nan dak ni pu na; ŋijoo nan kan si le ki san ijawaan ki dam.

ref: You are the only God ever seen or heard of who works miracles for his followers.
text: Ubaa aa kee kan, bee u ŋun Uwumbɔr uken pu u bi ke sin, u ŋani ŋitun ŋee aaboln tii binib bi mak aa pu na.

ref: You help all who gladly obey and do what you want, but sin makes you angry. Only by your help can we ever be saved.
text: Aa yin binib bi gee ke bi li ŋani ni ŋan na, binib bi teer saah ban pu na, ke bi dan aa chee. Aa nan gee ti pu liŋuul, le ti nan beenin tun titunwanbir; hali saaŋuusakpeln ponn ni ti nan beenin tun titunwanbir ki nyan ni n‑yaajayoonn.

ref: We are unfit to worship you; each of our good deeds is merely a filthy rag. We dry up like leaves; our sins are storm winds sweeping us away.
text: Ti mɔmɔk tun titunwanbir; hali tima aah dak ke taah tun pu na ŋan sakpen na ye tijɔŋ le ki ti doo. Timi aatunwanbir pu, ti naahn tifar ti kuur aan libuln daar cha na la.

ref: No one worships in your name or remains faithful. You have turned your back on us and let our sins melt us away.
text: Ubaa aa fenn toŋ ni si ki mee si; ubaa aa chaa aa chee ki ban nterm. Aa di aabaa bɔr ti chee, ki di timi mee, timi aatunwanbir pu.

ref: You, Lord, are our Father. We are nothing but clay, but you are the potter who molded us.
text: Uwumbɔr, sin le ye tite. Timi le ye tiyakr, le aa ye uyakmaal. Sin le naahn timi,

ref: Don't be so furious or keep our sins in your thoughts forever! Remember that all of us are your people.
text: kina pu na, taa gee ti pu liŋuusakpeln timi aatunwanbir pu. Ti ye saanib la. San timi kinimbaak.

ref: Every one of your towns has turned into a desert, especially Jerusalem.
text: Ubaa aa ki bi saatim mu nan bi chain na ponn ni, le Jerusalem mu kpaln tilangbenn,

ref: Zion's glorious and holy temple where our ancestors praised you has been destroyed by fire. Our beautiful buildings are now a pile of ruins.
text: le Saadichal li bi chain ki ŋan aan tiyaajatiib nan dooni si nima na, wun mmii a. Taah nan gee nin chee mɔmɔk na kpaln tilangbenn la.

ref: So watch out! Someday that place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley, because you will bury your dead there until you run out of room,
text: Kina pu na, n‑yoonn choo le baan nan ki yin nima chee ke Tofef, bee Hinom Aafataŋ. Bi ga nan li gur yin nima chee ke Linikul Aafataŋ la. Mpaan aah kaa ga nan ki li bi bi sub binib pu na, le bi ga nan li gur sui binib nima.

ref: and then bodies will lie scattered on the ground. Birds and wild animals will come and eat, and no one will be around to scare them off.

text: “N‑yoonn ngbaan na, Juda aabɔrb, ni baaninkpiib, ni bitotoorb, ni maabɔnabtiib, ni binib bi mɔmɔk koo Jerusalem ponn ni na aakpab ga nya yaakaakul ni.

ref: who loved and worshiped the sun, moon, and stars. These bones will be scattered and left lying on the ground like trash, where the sun and moon and stars can shine on them.
text: Baah ba ga kuun i pu ki sub i na, baakpab ga li dɔ kitiŋ ke tinaabin na la. I ga yaa ki dɔ aan nwiin, ni uŋmal, ni iŋmabi li waa i. Nimina ye tiwan ni binib ngbaan nan gee ki tun lituln tii ni, ki buu ni chee tibɔɔr, ki dooni ni na.

text: Le titunwanbir aatimbol limina aanib bi ŋmar, ki koo maah cha bi yaa ki bi nin chee na, ga li neen nkun ki jer ke bi li fu. Min Uwumbɔr le len kina.” Titunwanbir, ni ntafadaan aabɔr

text: M pel suuna, le kaa ŋun ubaa len ibamɔn. Ni ponn ni ubaa kina aasui aa bii waabiin pu; ubaa le aa len ke, ‘M tun taani la.’ Ni mɔmɔk cha naah gee nin chee na ke utaan le aah san cha butɔb ni na.

ref: Storks, doves, swallows, and thrushes all know when it's time to fly away for the winter and when to come back. But you, my people, don't know what I demand.
text: Hali inaakpaapiin nyi buyoonn i ga gir na; le ŋinanjel, ni naakpaa mam, ni ikpasiinyoon nyi buyoonn i ga tiir ntim na. Le maanib ma aan nyi ikaal i m joo lik bi na,

ref: You say, “We are wise because we have the teachings and laws of the Lord.” But I say that your teachers have turned my words into lies!
text: Ni ga ŋa kinye ki bui ke ni kpa nlan ki nyi maakaal? Lik man, bigbaŋmeeb na le di beebee kpeln maakaal.

ref: Your wise men have rejected what I say, and so they have no wisdom. Now they will be trapped and put to shame; they won't know what to do.
text: Nimi aalandam jin inimɔɔn a; bilan ŋmal le bi koo sil sisik ni. Bi yii maamɔboln; ba aalan aan bi ki kpa?

ref: I'll give their wives and fields to strangers. Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
text: Kina pu le m ga di baakpaakon tii bikpaacham, ki di bipuutiib tii bijab biken. Binib bi pɔɔ na, ni bi kaa pɔɔ na mɔmɔk pɔɔni bibaa ke bi di beebee le kan ŋimombil. Hali maabɔnabtiib ni bitotoorb ji binib la.

ref: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
text: Bi ŋani ke maanib aabuun aah kaa ye nibaa le na. Bi len le ke, ‘Ni mɔmɔk ŋan,’ le naa ŋan kpala.

ref: They should be ashamed of the way they live, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else.
text: Maanib aa nan san inimɔɔn baajɔŋ aatun ŋee pu. Mbamɔn, baa nan san inimɔɔn kpala; naa kpaan nyi naah ga mɔk pu ke inimɔɔn joo nimi na. Kina pu le ni ga lir ke biken aah lir pu na; m yaa nan daa nitafal kan, naadoon le na. Min Uwumbɔr le len kina.

ref: I will wipe them out. They are vines without grapes; fig trees without figs or leaves. They have not done a thing that I told them! I, the Lord, have spoken. The People and Their Punishment
text: “M nan ban ke m kuun maanib, ke uja aah kuuni waajikaar pu na la; le bi tee naahn ŋisubil aasub bu kaa lu na, ki naahn likakaln li kaa lu na; hali laafar gbar a. Kina pu le m cha biwɔwɔm gaa kitiŋ ngbaan.”

ref: The people of Judah say to each other, “What are we waiting for? Let's run to a town with walls and die there. We rebelled against the Lord, and we were sentenced to die by drinking poison.
text: Le Uwumbɔr aanib bui ke, “Ba ŋa ti ka ŋmin kina? Dan man, aan ti san buen ntim mu bi maa ŋigon gob mu na ponn ni ki ti kpo nima. Tidindaan Uwumbɔr le siin ke ti kpo; u di njinn le tii timi ke ti nyu, ba pu? ti tun titunwanbir la.

text: Le Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Li lik man. M ga di iwaa tun ni ni chee, iwaa i kpa liluul li inyɔk aan ŋmaa ŋa i nibaa na, le i nan junn nimi.” Jeremia aasui aah bii waanib pu pu na

text: Maapombiin aan ŋmaa sɔŋ; nsui bii sakpen a.

ref: The people complain, “Spring and summer have come and gone, but still the Lord hasn't rescued us.”
text: Le binib ngbaan wii ki len ke, “Kitotoŋ jer, le lijikaacheel mu jer, le Uwumbɔr aa gaa timi lii.”

text: Inyɔk aa bi Gilead aatiŋ ni ii? Bi teei binib na aa bi nima chee ee? Tɔ, ba ŋa ubaa aa ŋmaa tii maanib laafee?

ref: I wish that my eyes were fountains of tears, so I could cry day and night for my people who were killed.
text: N‑yil yaa ba ye nnyunbun, aan nnimbil mu ye uyayak aanyunbun kan, m ba ga li wii nwiin pu ni kinyeek, baah ku maanib bi na pu.

ref: I wish I could go into the desert and find a hiding place from all who are treacherous and unfaithful to God. The Lord Answers Jeremiah
text: M yaa ba kan nkakaayaan nteersakpiin ni kan, m ba ga fii buen nima ki cha maanib. Baa dii Uwumbɔr, bi mɔmɔk nyan upuwɔb la.

ref: The Lord replied: Lies come from the mouths of my people, like arrows from a bow. With each dishonest deed their power increases, and not one of them will admit that I am God.

text: M taa daa bitafal nima pu uu? M taa teen kina aatimbol aa? Min Uwumbɔr le len kina.”

ref: I weep for the pastureland in the hill country. It's so barren and scorched that no one travels there. No cattle can be found there, and birds and wild animals have all disappeared.

text: Uwumbɔr nan ki bui ke, “N‑yoonn choo, le m ga nan daa Ijipt, ni Juda, ni Edom, ni Amonn, ni Moab, ni nteersakpiin ni aanib bi chee biyigbeer pu aayikpir na aatafal. Ba pu? text: Bi di Speenn aatiŋ aakunabr le ki boon baawaa ngbaan le ki di Ufas aatiŋ aasalmaa mu boon ŋi, nimina mɔmɔk ye uwanŋar aatuln la; bi joo nsiin ni ŋitan ŋi man chauŋ aan ukpaluul u nyi sakpen na luu ŋi na le peeni ŋi.

text: Tɔ, nimi le ga bui bi ke ŋiwaa le aa nan naan taab ni paacham; ŋi ga nan kuln. Ŋaan nan ki li bi dulnyaa wee ni nibaa chee. Nlahn mu pak Uwumbɔr na

text: Jerusalem aanib, bijab gob nimi a; kuun nimi aawan man.

ref: But I told them, “Our leaders were stupid failures, because they refused to listen to the Lord. And so we've been scattered like sheep.
text: Le m gar ke, “Timi aayidam ye bilatiirb la; baa baa Uwumbɔr ke u mɔk bi. Nima le cha bi lir, le timi aanib yaa tɔb chee.

ref: “Sounds of destruction rumble from the north like distant thunder. Soon our towns will be ruins where only jackals live.” Jeremiah Prays
text: Li pel man. Tibɔchann fuu ni a. Kinikpakpak sakpeŋ fii ŋŋangan wɔb aatimbol ni; laajab ga cha Juda aatim mɔmɔk kpaln nteersakpiin nin chee ikakal koo na.”

ref: I know, Lord, that we humans are not in control of our own lives.
text: Uwumbɔr, m nyi ke unii ubaa aa ye ubaa aabimbin aaninkpel; ubaa aa kpa waamɔfal aapɔɔn;

text: Di saaŋuul toŋ ŋitimbol ŋi kaa dooni si na, ni binib bi yii si na wɔb. Bi ku saanib, bi kuln timi pel pel, le ki cha timi aatiŋ kpaln ŋilangben.

text: Uwumbɔr nan ki bui mi ke, “Buen Juda aatim, ni Jerusalem aatiŋ ponn ni. Moon maabɔr nima ki bui binib ngbaan ke bi pel maah puu tipuur ti na tii bi, ki kii maamɔb.

text: Maah nan nyan ni biyaajatiib Ijipt aatiŋ ni na, m nan sak bi mbamɔm ke bi kii maamɔb, le ki beenin sakr bi ki nan saa din wee.

ref: have always been stubborn. You have refused to listen, and instead you have done whatever your sinful hearts have desired. You have not kept the agreement we made, so I will make you suffer every curse that goes with it.
text: Le bi nan yii, kaa pel, kaa ki kii maamɔb mu. Bi mɔmɔk nan yii, ki beenin kpa tafalaaŋun, ki tun titunwanbir cha. M nan bui bi ke bi li joo tipuur ti m puu tii bi na, le bi yii. Kina pu le m nan cha ntafadaan mu bi tipuur ngbaan ni na dan bi pu.”

ref: The Lord said to me: Jeremiah, the people of Judah and Jerusalem are plotting against me.
text: Uwumbɔr nan ki bui mi ke, “Juda ni Jerusalem aanib bi kpokl m pu la.

ref: They have sinned in the same way their ancestors did, by turning from me and worshiping other gods. The northern kingdom of Israel broke the agreement I made with your ancestors, and now the southern kingdom of Judah has done the same.
text: Bi gir buen biyaajatiib bi nan yii maah bui bi ke bi tun pu na aatunwanbir ni la; bi nan dooni ŋiwaa la. Israel ni Juda yaab mɔmɔk bii tipuur ti m ni biyaajatiib nan puu tii tɔb na.

ref: Here is what I've decided to do. I will bring suffering on the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and no one will escape. They will beg me to help, but I won't listen to their prayers.
text: Tɔ, le min Uwumbɔr sak bi ke m ga cha libiil dan bi pu, le baan ŋmar. Bi yaa wii yin mi ki ban nterm kan, maan pel bi chee.

ref: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people or beg me to rescue them. If you do, I won't listen, and I certainly won't listen if they pray!
text: Jeremia, taa mee limeel tii binib ngbaan, taa gaŋ mi bi pu. Bi yaa bi tibɔr ni ki yin mi ki ban nterm kan, maan gar bi.”

ref: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: You are my chosen people, but you have no right to be here in my temple, doing such evil things. The sacrifices you offer me won't protect you from disaster, so stop celebrating.
text: Uwumbɔr nan ki bui ke, “Binib bi m gee bi na le bi tun titunwanbir na. Baa kpa nsan ke bi li bi Maadichal ponn ni. Bi dak ke bi yaa puur tipuur ki joo tiwakor toor ipiin aatork kan, bi ga ŋmaa nya tibɔbir ni la aa? Nima ngbaan aan ŋmaa tii bi mpopiin.

ref: Once you were like an olive tree covered with fruit. But soon I will send a noisy mob to break off your branches and set you on fire.
text: N‑yoonn mubaa m nan yin bi ke olif aasub bu kpa tifar mbamɔm ki lu ŋisubil ŋi ŋan na la; tɔ, dandana ma kan, mmii ga dam ke utaal aah gbenni pu na, le mu wun tifar ngbaan, ki kool ibon lii kitiŋ.

ref: I am the Lord All-Powerful. You people of Judah were like a tree that I had planted, but you have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal, just as the northern kingdom did. And now I'm going to pull you up by the roots. The Plot To Kill Jeremiah *
text: “Min Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan le nan bun Israel ni Juda yaab; tɔ, n‑yoonn mue ma kan, m ban m joo ni tibɔbir le nan lii bi pu. Baah tun taani pu na le bi joo ni kina nan lii bibaa pu; bi toor kitork tii liwaal Baal, le ki cha maaŋuul fii bi pu.” Baah kpokl ke bi ku Jeremia pu na

ref: Some people plotted to kill me. And like a lamb being led to the butcher, I knew nothing about their plans.
text: Uwumbɔr nan bui mi maadim aah nan bi kpokl m pu pu na.

ref: I prayed, “Lord All-Powerful, you always do what is right, and you know every thought. So I trust you to help me and to take revenge.”
text: Le m mee limeel ke, “Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan, aa ji binib tibɔr ibamɔn pu la; aa tɔŋni binib aalandak ni bisui. M di maabɔr ŋa aaŋaal ni, kina pu na, m ga li ka le ki lik saah ga teen binib ngbaan pu na.”

ref: Then the Lord said: Jeremiah, some men from Anathoth say they will kill you, if you keep on speaking for me.
text: Maatiŋ Anatof aajab bibaa nan ban ke bi ku mi, le ki bui mi ke m yaa beenin mooni Uwumbɔr aabɔr kan, bi ga ku mi.

ref: But I will punish them. Their young men will die in battle, and their children will starve to death.
text: Le Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan bui ke, “M ga daa bitafal. Baanachipɔm ga kpoi butɔb ni, le nkon mu ku baabim.

ref: And when I am finished, no one from their families will be left alive.
text: M siin n‑yoonn mu tibɔbir ga pii ni Anatof aanib na, le n‑yoonn ngbaan yaa nan fuu ni kan, bi ponn ni ubaa aan ŋmar.”

ref: Whenever I complain to you, Lord, you are always fair. But now I have questions about your justice. Why is life easy for sinners? Why are they successful?
text: “Uwumbɔr, m yaa ban m ni sin kpak tibɔr pu kan, aa ga li kpa mbamɔn. Tɔ, m mu tee ga baa si ibamɔn aabɔr tibaa pu. Ni ŋa kinye aan bibiindam kani liwangol? Ni ŋa kinye aan beebeedam nya tibɔr ni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk?

ref: You plant them like trees; you let them prosper and produce fruit. Yet even when they praise you, they don't mean it.
text: Sin le naan bi, le bi fii ki kpa inyaan; bi muuni le ki pɔr. N‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, bi len aa pu tibɔnyaan la, le kaa tee dak aa pu kpala.

ref: But you know, Lord, how faithful I've always been, even in my thoughts. So drag my enemies away and butcher them like sheep!
text: Tɔ, Uwumbɔr, aa nyi mi; aa kani maah tun pu na, ki nyi maah gee si pu na. Dar titunwanbirdam ngbaan ke ipiih na buen bi ti kɔr bi; li kii bi ki ti saa buyoonn bi ga ku bi na.

ref: How long will the ground be dry and the pasturelands parched? The birds and animals are dead and gone. And all of this happened because the people are so sinful. They even brag, “God can't see the sins we commit.” The Lord Answers Jeremiah
text: Timi aatiŋ ga li kuun kina ki ti saa bayoonn? Timoor ti bi ikpaakon ni na mu yɔl yɔl. Tiwakor ni inyoon kpoi timi aanib aatunwanbir pu la; bima le len ke, ‘Uwumbɔr aa kani taah tun pu na.’”

ref: Jeremiah, if you get tired in a race against people, how can you possibly run against horses? If you fall in open fields, what will happen in the forest along the Jordan River?
text: Le Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Jeremia, aa ni binib yaa san kpak aan aa bak kan, aa ga ŋa kinye aan aa ni itaan san kpak? Aa yaa kaan ŋmaa sil nteer pu kan, aa ga ŋa kinye ki koo Jɔɔdann aachook ni?

ref: Even your own family has turned against you. They act friendly, but don't trust them. They're out to get you, and so is everyone else. The Lord Is Furious with His People
text: Hali aana aabim bi ye saadichal ni aanib na, le di si ti bii; bi kpee binib bi tak si na pu a. Bi ga li len aa chee kijɔtiik aabɔr, aa mu taa kii tii bi.” Uwumbɔr aasui aah bii waanib pu pu na

ref: I loved my people and chose them as my very own. But now I will reject them and hand them over to their enemies.
text: Uwumbɔr len ke, “Ntafal aa ki bi Israel yaab ni, M yii maah nan lee litimbol li na. M di binib bi m gee bi na ŋa baadim aapɔɔn ni.

ref: My people have turned against me and roar at me like lions. That's why I hate them.
text: Binib bi m nan lee bi na fii sil m pu; bi ŋuuni m pu ke uchinn u bi kichook ni na la, kina pu le maa ki gee bi.

ref: My people are like a hawk surrounded and attacked by other hawks. Tell the wild animals to come and eat their fill.
text: Maanib bi m lee bi na naahn unyoon u kaasaa mam mann gob u na la. Yin ni ipeel aan i mu nan ji njim ngbaan.

ref: My beautiful land is ruined like a field or a vineyard trampled by shepherds and stripped bare by their flocks.
text: Biyidam bi ye biwɔwɔm na pam le bi maasubil aasaak ni; bi taa taa maajikaar bil kitiŋ; bi cha maatiŋ ki nan ŋan sakpen na kpaln nteersakpiin.

ref: A destroying army marches along desert roads and attacks everywhere. They are my deadly sword; no one is safe from them.
text: Bijab nyan ni nteersakpiin aatim ni le ki nan jenn gaa maanib aawan. M tun ni butɔb le ke bu nan bii doo kitiŋ ngbaan mɔmɔk; ubaa aan kan lifuur nima.

ref: My people, you planted wheat, but because I was furious, I let only weeds grow. You wore yourselves out and gained only shame! The Lord Will Have Pity on Other Nations
text: Maanib nan bun imuul, le ki tee nan chee timoor; bi nan tun le kitotoŋ nyan, le kaa nan kan nibaa. Maaŋuusakpeln pu le baajikaar aa ŋa.” Uwumbɔr aah nan puu tipuur ti tii binib bi ka Israel yaab chee na pu na

ref: The Lord said: I gave this land to my people Israel, but enemies around it have attacked and robbed it. So I will uproot them from their own countries just as I will uproot Judah from its land.
text: Uwumbɔr nan bui ke, “M kpa tibɔr tibaa m tuk binib bi ka maanib Israel yaab chee aan ki kuln kitiŋ ki m nan di tii bima Israel yaab na. M ga nyan bibiindam ngbaan baatim ni ke baah chuu ŋɔb busub pu na la, le ki gaa Juda aanib bi chee lii.

ref: But later, I will have pity on these nations and bring them back to their own lands.
text: M yaa nyan bi buen kan, m ga san bi kinimbaak; m ga giin ni linibol mɔk nan kaan laatiŋ ni, laatiŋ pu.

ref: They once taught my people to worship Baal. But if they admit I am the only true God, and if they let my people teach them how to worship me, these nations will also become my people.
text: Bi yaa gaa maanib aah dii nsan mu na, ni bisui mɔmɔk, ki puur tipuur ke, ‘Uwumbɔr u bi na’ pu, ke baah nan cha maanib puur tipuur tii liwaal Baal pu na kan, bi mu ga li bi maanib ponn ni ki ga kan liwangol.

ref: However, if they don't listen to me, I will uproot them from their lands and completely destroy them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
text: Tɔ, litimbol li kaan kii maamɔb na kan, m ga ŋɔb li kookoo ki kuln li. Min Uwumbɔr le len kina.”

ref: The Lord told me, “Go and buy a pair of linen shorts. Wear them for a while, but don't wash them.”
text: Uwumbɔr nan bui mi ke m buen ti daa ŋitanyaan aachutageln ki di yiin; ki ki bui mi ke m taa di u bɔ nnyun ni.

ref: So I bought a pair of shorts and put them on.
text: Le m nan ti daa li ki di yiin.

ref: “Take off the shorts. Go to Parah and hide the shorts in a crack between some large rocks.”
text: “Li cha Peraf Aamɔɔl ni, ki ti di li bɔr kitakpaluŋ kibaa ni, nima chee.”

ref: And that's what I did.
text: Le m buen ti di li bɔr Peraf aamɔɔl chee.

ref: Some time later the Lord said, “Go back and get the shorts.”
text: Naah joo cha na, le Uwumbɔr nan bui mi ke m gir buen Peraf Aamɔɔl chee, ki ti nyan ni lichutageln ngbaan.

ref: I went back and dug the shorts out of their hiding place, but the cloth had rotted, and the shorts were ruined.
text: M nan gir buen ki bee nin chee m nan di li bɔr na, le m kan ke li bii, kaa ki ŋan.

ref: Jeremiah, I will use Babylonia to destroy the pride of the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
text: “Kina le m ga bii Juda ni Jerusalem yaab aagaak sakpeŋ ngbaan.

ref: The people of Judah are evil and stubborn. So instead of listening to me, they do whatever they want and even worship other gods. When I am finished with these people, they will be good for nothing, just like this pair of shorts.
text: Titunwanbirdam ngbaan yii kaa kii maamɔb. Bi beenin kpa mbiin ni tafalaaŋun ke baah nan bi pu na la, le ki dooni ŋiwaa, ki tun tii ŋi. Kina pu na, bi ga ŋa ke lichutageln lee aah kaa ki li bi tibaa ni pu na.

ref: These shorts were tight around your waist, and that's how tightly I held onto the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. I wanted them to be my people. I wanted to make them famous, so that other nations would praise and honor me, but they refused to obey me. Wine Jars The Lord said:
text: M ba ban ke Israel ni Juda aanib mɔmɔk li bub joo mi kin kin ke lichutageln aah ŋeer kichaŋ sab pu na la. M nan ŋa kina ke bi li ye maanib ki joo ni kipak ni inyuŋ nan tii mi la; le bi yii kaa kii maamɔb.” Lidabuul aabɔr

ref: Jeremiah, tell the people of Judah, “The Lord God of Israel orders you to fill your wine jars with wine.” They will answer, “Of course we fill our wine jars with wine! Why are you telling us something we already know?”
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr nan ki bui mi ke, “Jeremia, bui Israel aanib ke ni ŋan ke lidabuul mɔk li gbii ndaan la. Bi ga bui ke bi nyi ke ni ŋan ke lidabuul mɔk li gbii ndaan.

ref: Then say to them: I am the Lord, and what I'm going to do will make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem appear to be full of wine. And the worst ones will be the kings of David's family and the priests and the prophets.
text: Le aa ga bui ke min Uwumbɔr ga cha kitiŋ kee aanib mɔmɔk nyu ndaan ki ti gbii; bibɔrb bi ye David aayaabitiib na, ni bitotoorb, ni maabɔnabtiib, ni Jerusalem aanib mɔmɔk ga nyu gbii.

ref: Then I will smash them against each other like jars. I will have no pity on the young or the old, and they will all be destroyed. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Will Be Taken Away
text: Le m ga di binib bi por na, ni bi kaa por na yur tɔb aan bi wiil ke ŋidabuu na. Kinimbaak, ni mpombiin, ni nsuugar mbaa aan kiir mi ke m taa ku bi.” Jeremia aah sak binib bi kpa kigaak na pu na

ref: People of Judah, don't be too proud to listen to what the Lord has said.
text: Israel aanib, Uwumbɔr len a. Sunn nibaa taab man ki pel u chee man.

ref: You hope for light, but God is sending darkness. Evening shadows already deepen in the hills. So return to God and confess your sins to him before you trip and fall.
text: Nyuŋ Nidindaan Uwumbɔr man waahr aan u nin joo ni mbɔmbɔɔn, mu ga cha ni li gbeer ŋijoo paab ki cha nwiihn mu ni mak mu pu na kpaln mbɔmbɔɔn na.

ref: If you are too proud to listen, I will weep alone. Tears will stream from my eyes when the Lord's people are taken away as prisoners.
text: Ni yaa kaan pel kan, m ga wii libɔɔl ni, nimi aagaak pu. Baah ga di Uwumbɔr aanib buen tinaagbiir ni pu na, m ga wii, le maanyunyunn ti li puu.

ref: The Lord told me to tell you that your king and his mother must surrender their thrones and remove their crowns.
text: Le Uwumbɔr bui mi ke, “Bui ubɔr ni una ke bi fii baabɔrjal pu, ba pu? baabɔryikpupur ti ŋan sakpen na chikr lir kitiŋ a.

ref: The cities in the Southern Desert are surrounded; no one can get in or out. Everyone in Judah will be taken away.
text: Bidim gob Juda aatim mu bi ŋŋangii wɔb na; ubaa aan ŋmaa bɔ bijab ni ki ti fuu bi chee. Bi di Juda aanib mɔmɔk buen tinaagbiir ni a.”

ref: Jerusalem, you were so proud of ruling the people of Judah. But where are they now? Look north, and you will see your enemies approaching.
text: Jerusalem aatiŋ, lik, saadim le nyan ni ŋŋangan wɔb ki choo na. Binib bi bi di ŋa aaŋaal ni na bi la chee, saanib bi aa nan mak bi pu sakpen na bi la?

ref: You once trusted them to help, but now I'll let them rule you. What do you say about that? You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.
text: Binib bi aa nan dak ke bi ye aajɔtiib na yaa nan nyaŋ si ki joo si kan, aa ga len kinye? Aa ga nan li bi iween ni, ke upii u ban u maa na la.

ref: Do you know why your clothes were torn off and you were abused? It was because of your terrible sins.
text: Aa yaa nan baa ke ba ŋa nimina ŋa si, le saakeken kar kar aan bi chuu si mpɔɔn ki doon aa chee kan, aa li nyi ke saatunwanbir nyaŋ sakpen a.

ref: Can you ever change and do what's right? Can people change the color of their skin, or can a leopard remove its spots? If so, then maybe you can change and learn to do right.
text: Unii u aawon bɔn na ga ŋmaa kpeln ti ŋa ti man na aa? bee upeenaamuun ga ŋmaa nyan uwon aah tuur tuur pu na aa? Bi yaa ga ŋmaa ŋa kina kan, nimi bi tun titunwanbir ŋmeen na mu ga ŋmaa kpeln ki ŋa ni ŋan na.

ref: I will scatter you, just as the desert wind blows husks from grain tossed in the air.
text: Uwumbɔr ga yaa nimi ke nteersakpiin ni aabuln aah daar timoor yaani pu na la.

ref: I won't change my mind. I, the Lord, have spoken. You rejected me and worshiped false gods. *
text: U bui ke nimi aadoon le ga li bi na. Waah siin ke u ga ŋa nimi pu na le na, ba pu? ni suln ubɔr le ki di naadii tii ŋiwaa.

ref: So I'll rip off your clothes and leave you naked and ashamed for everyone to see. You are doomed! Will you ever be worthy to worship me again?
text: U kan nimi, ni tun tijɔŋ aatuln. U kan naah chuun ban ŋiwaa ŋigongon paab, ni ikpaakon ni, ke uja aah neen uŋeen aatɔ aapuu pu, bee utanja aah neen utaninkpel pu na. Jerusalem aanib, nimi aamɔfal junn a. Bayoonn aan ni mu ga ŋaŋ?

ref: Rulers send their servants to the storage pits for water. But there's none to be found; they return in despair with their jars still empty.
text: Biwankpadam na tun baanaagbiib ke bi ti lu ni nnyun; le bi buen ŋibun ni, kaa ti kan nnyun; le ki tu ŋibukuun gir ni. Bilan ŋmal, le bitaakpab yɔl, le bi bɔrni.

text: Utaal aah kaa nun aan kitiŋ kuur na, bikpaab aasui bii, le bi bɔrni.

ref: A deer gives birth in a field, then abandons her newborn fawn and leaves in search of grass.
text: Timoor aah kaa bi pu na le upeemaninkpel siir cha waabipɔm timoor ni.

ref: Wild donkeys go blind from starvation. So they stand on barren hilltops and sniff the air, hoping to smell green grass. The Lord's People Pray
text: Le timoor ni aabon si ŋigongon paab ki fuur pɔkaa pɔkaa ke iŋɔk na, yaah kaa kan tijikaar pu na le yaa ki waa mbamɔm.

ref: We rejected you and did evil, so we deserve to be punished. But if you rescue us, Lord, everyone will see how great you are.
text: Le maanib wii yin mi ke, ‘Timi aatunwanbir galni timi la, Uwumbɔr, ter timi ke saah nan puu ke aa ga ŋa pu na. N‑yoonn n‑yoonn pam le ti fenn tipuwɔb tii si; ti tun si titunwanbir.

ref: You're our only hope; you alone can save us now. You help us one day, but you're gone the next.
text: Sin baanja pu le Israel yaab mak; sin le nan nyan timi tibɔbir ni. Ba ŋa aa gur bi timi aatiŋ pu ke uchaan na, ki bi ke usachuln u ban u doon timi aatiŋ ni kinyeek kibaa baanja na?

ref: Did this disaster take you by surprise? Are you a warrior with your hands tied? You have chosen us, and your temple is here. Don't abandon us! The Lord's Answer
text: Ba ŋa aa bi ke uja u tibɔr nan lir u na; ba ŋa aa bi ke uja u kaa ki kpa mpɔɔn ke u ter timi na? Uwumbɔr, ni sil ye mbamɔn ke aa bi ti chee. Ti ye saanib la, taa di timi lii.’”

ref: My people, you love to wander away; you don't even try to stay close to me. So now I will reject you and punish you for your sins. I, the Lord, have spoken. Lying Prophets
text: Uwumbɔr len binib bee aabɔr ke, “Bi gee ke bi fenn bipuwɔb tii mi, le kaan chuu bibaa. Kina pu le nsui aa piin bi pu. M ga teer taani u bi tun na, ki daa bitafal baatunwanbir pu.”

ref: The Lord said, “Jeremiah, don't ask me to help these people.
text: Uwumbɔr nan bui mi ke, “Taa bui mi ke m ter binib bee.

ref: They may even go without eating and offer sacrifices to please me and to give thanks. But when they cry out for my help, I won't listen, and I won't accept their sacrifices. Instead, I'll send war, starvation, and disease to wipe them out.”
text: Hali bi yaa lul bumɔb kan, maan pel baaterm aawiil; le bi yaa toor kitork ki see ki mmii ni tii mi, ki tii mi njikaabim aapiin kan, nsui aan piir bi pu. Maah ga ŋa pu na le ye ke m ku bi butɔb, ni nkon, ni iween ni.”

ref: I replied, “The other prophets keep telling everyone that you won't send starvation or war, and that you're going to give us peace.”
text: Le m bui ke, “Ndindaan Uwumbɔr, aa nyi ke saabɔnabtiib tuk binib ngbaan ke butɔb, bee nkon aan li bi, bi bui bi ke aa nan puu ke nsuudoon baanja le ga li bi timi aatiŋ pu.”

ref: The Lord answered: They claim to speak for me, but they're lying! I didn't even speak to them, much less choose them to be my prophets. Their messages come from worthless dreams, useless fortunetelling, and their own imaginations.
text: Le Uwumbɔr gar mi ke, “Bibɔnabr ngbaan joo maayimbil le geei inyamɔn; maa nan tun bi, kaa tii bi maamɔboln, kaa tii bi nsan mubaa. Tibɔkpiirkaan ti bi joo len na aa nyan ni m chee; baah len ke tiwan ni ga ŋa na aa kpa tinyoor, bima bibaa le dakl ti.

ref: And everyone who listens to them will be killed, just as they deserve. Their dead bodies will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem, because their families will also be dead, and no one will be left to bury them.
text: Baah di tibɔr tee tuk binib bi na mu ga kpo nkun baan ngbaan la. Bi ga di baanikpol mae Jerusalem aatiŋ ponn ni, le ubaa aan li bi ki sub bi. Nimina ga ŋa bi mɔmɔk, bi ni bipuutiib, ni bijapɔtiib, ni bibisatiib. M ga cha bi pa baatunwanbir pu.”

ref: Jeremiah, go and tell the people how you feel about all this. So I told them: “Tears will flood my eyes both day and night, because my nation suffers from a deadly wound.
text: Uwumbɔr nan bui mi ke m tuk binib ngbaan maapombiin aah bi pu na ki bui bi ke, “M wii nwiin pu ni kinyeek la, taa cha m di cha iwiil, maanib aah kan titotonn sakpen, ni iween i na pu.

ref: In the fields I see the bodies of those killed in battle. And in the towns I see crowds dying of hunger. But the prophets and priests go about their business, without understanding what has happened.” Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
text: M yaa nyan buen timoor ni kan, m kani binib bi bi ku bi butɔb ni na la; m yaa buen ntim ni kan, m kani nkon aah ku binib bi na la. Uwumbɔr aabɔnabtiib ni bitotoorb chuun tun baatun, le kaa tee nyi baah bi ŋani pu na.” Binib ngbaan aah gaŋ Uwumbɔr pu na

ref: Have you rejected Judah, Lord? Do you hate Jerusalem? Why did you strike down Judah with a fatal wound? We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.

ref: We and our ancestors are guilty of rebelling against you.

text: Teer saah nan puu pu na ki taa lik seen timi; taa cha inimɔɔn dan Jerusalem pu, nin chee saapak aabɔrjal bi na. Taa bii tipuur ti timi ni sin nan puu tii tɔb na.

ref: Idols can't send rain, and showers don't fall by themselves. Only you control the rain, so we put our trust in you, the Lord our God.

ref: When your enemies attack, I will scatter you like dust blown by an eastern wind. Then, on that day of disaster, I will turn my back on you. The Plot against Jeremiah
text: M ga cha maanib yaa baadim chee, ke liwipuul wɔb aabuln aah daar titan pu pu na. M ga fenn mpuwɔb tii bi; maan ter bi buyoonn bi bi tibɔbir ni na.” Baah kpokl Jeremia pu pu na

ref: Some of the people said, “Let's get rid of Jeremiah! We will always have priests to teach us God's laws, as well as wise people to give us advice, and prophets to speak the Lord's messages. So, instead of listening to Jeremiah any longer, let's accuse him of a crime.” Jeremiah Prays about His Enemies
text: Le binib ngbaan bui ke, “Cha ti lik taah ga ŋa Jeremia pu na. Bitotoorb ga li bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ki mɔk timi, bilankpalb mu ga ŋmaa sur timi, bibɔnabr mu ga nabr Uwumbɔr aabɔr tii timi. Cha ti ban ngalm tii u man, ki taa ki pel waah len pu na.”

ref: Please, Lord, answer my prayer. Make my enemies stop accusing me of evil.
text: Le m mee limeel ke, “Uwumbɔr, pel maah len pu na ki ŋun maadim aah len maabɔr pu na.

ref: I tried to help them, but they are paying me back by digging a pit to trap me. I even begged you not to punish them.
text: Tibir le bi joo pa tiŋann aa? Bi gbii libuul bil mi ke m nan lir li ponn ni. Teer maah nan dan aa chee ki nan gaŋ si bi pu ke aa taa daa bitafal saaŋuul ponn ni pu na.

ref: But now I am asking you to let their children starve or be killed in war. Let women lose their husbands and sons to disease and violence.
text: Tɔ, Uwumbɔr, cha nkon ku baabim; cha bi kpoi butɔb ni. Cha baapiib lann bichatiib ni baabim; cha iween ku bijab, aan baanachipɔm mu kpoi butɔb ni.

ref: These people have dug pits and set traps for me, Lord. Make them scream in fear when you send enemy troops to attack their homes.
text: Cha kinipaak nan loon bi ki gaa baawangol; cha ijawaan chuu bi aan bi wii mpɔɔn pu. Bi gbii libuul bil mi ke m nan lir li ponn ni, ki pen mi gaawɔb mam.

ref: You know they plan to kill me. So get angry and punish them! Don't ever forgive their terrible crimes.
text: Tɔ, Uwumbɔr, aa nyi baah kpokl pu ke bi ku mi na. Taa di baatunwanbir cha pinn bi, ki taa di cha baataani. Buyoonn saaŋuul fii na kan, mee bi lii ki nyaŋ bi.”

ref: The Lord said: Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop and buy a clay jar. Then take along some of the city officials and leading priests
text: Uwumbɔr nan bui mi ke m buen ti daa tiyakr aabuul. U nan ki bui mi ke m cha binib ngbaan aayidam bibaa, ni bitotoorb bi por na bibaa li dii mi,

ref: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and you kings of Judah and you people of Jerusalem had better pay attention. I am going to bring so much trouble on this valley that everyone who hears about it will be shocked.
text: Uwumbɔr nan bui mi ke m len ke, “Juda aabɔrb, ni Jerusalem aanib, li pel man, min Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan, u ye Israel yaab Aawumbɔr na aah kpa pu m len na. M ban m joo ni tibɔbir nan lii libuul lee pu, le unii umɔk ŋun ti pu na aapobil ga yuk.

ref: The people of Judah stopped worshiping me and made this valley into a place of worship for Baal and other gods that have never helped them or their ancestors or their kings. And they have committed murder here, burning their young, innocent children as sacrifices to Baal. I have never even thought of telling you to do that.
text: le ki maa liwaal Baal aabimbin ke bi li joo baabim toor kitork ki seer mmii ni ŋipaab tii li. Maa nan bui bi daalbaadaal ke bi ŋa kina; kina aa nan kpaan koo n‑yil ponn ni.

ref: So watch out! Someday this place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley!
text: Kina pu na, n‑yoonn ga fuu ni le baan ki yin do ke Tofef, bee Hinom Aafataŋ. Bi ga li gur yin do ke Linikul Aafataŋ ni la.

ref: You people of Judah and Jerusalem may have big plans, but here in this valley I'll ruin those plans. I'll let your enemies kill you, and I'll tell the birds and wild animals to eat your dead bodies.
text: Do le m ga bii Juda ni Jerusalem aanib aalandak mɔmɔk. M ga cha baadim nyaŋ bi, ki ku bi butɔb ni. Le m ga di ŋinikpol ngbaan tii inyoon, ni ipeel, i di ŋa tijikaar.

ref: I will turn Jerusalem into a pile of rubble, and every passerby will be shocked and horrified and will make insulting remarks.
text: Maah ga joo ni tibɔbir ti nan lii do na ga ŋa unii umɔk jer do na lijinjiir ni iwaan.

ref: And while your enemies are trying to break through your city walls to kill you, the food supply will run out. You will become so hungry that you will eat the flesh of your friends and even of your own children.
text: Bidim ga gob kitiŋ ngbaan ki ban ke bi ku kaanib. Baah ga gob ki pu na ga li bir sakpen, le binib bi bi ki ponn ni na ga ŋmɔ tɔb ki kpaan ŋmɔ bibaa aabim.”

ref: Jeremiah, as soon as you have said this, smash the jar while the people are watching.
text: Uwumbɔr nan ki bui mi ke m di libuul na yu wii bijab bi dii mi buen na aanimbil ni,

ref: Then tell them that I have also said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warn you that I will shatter Judah and Jerusalem just like this jar that is broken beyond repair. You will bury your dead here in Topheth, but so many of you will die that there won't be enough room.
text: ki bui bi ke Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan len ke, “M ga wii kitiŋ kee, ni binib bee, aan ni li bi ke tiyakr aabuul lee aah wii pu kaan ki kpaan pu na. Binib aah kaan ki kan mpaan pu ki sub baanib na, bi ga sub binib Tofef Aafataŋ kee ni.

ref: I will make Jerusalem as unclean as Topheth, by filling the city with your dead bodies. I will do this because you and your kings have gone up to the roofs of your houses and burned incense to the stars in the sky, as though they were gods. And you have given sacrifices of wine to foreign gods. Jeremiah Speaks in the Temple Courtyard
text: Jerusalem aadichal, ni Juda aabɔrb aadichal, ni ŋidichal ŋi mɔmɔk pu bi nan seer tulalee aayon tii iŋmabi, ni nin chee bi nan joo ndaan kpir tii ŋiwaa na mɔmɔk pu, ga li kpa tijɔŋ ke Tofef na la.”

ref: I went to Topheth, where I told the people what the Lord had said. Then I went to the temple courtyard and shouted to the people,
text: Le m nan siir Tofef, nin chee Uwumbɔr nan tun mi ke m ti moon waabɔr na. M nan buen Uwumbɔr Aadichal aachiln ni le ki ti bui binib ngbaan ke

ref: “Listen, everyone! Some time ago, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, warned you that he would bring disaster on Jerusalem and all nearby villages. But you were stubborn and refused to listen. Now the Lord is going to bring the disaster he promised.”
text: Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan, u ye Israel yaab Aawumbɔr na le len ke, “M ga cha ntafadaan dan kitiŋ kee, ni ntim mu bi gbɔk ki na pu, ke maah len ke m ga ŋa pu na, ba pu? bi kpa tafalaaŋun, kaa pel maah tuk bi pu na.”

ref: Pashhur son of Immer was a priest and the chief of temple security. He heard what I had said,
text: Imer aajapɔɔn Pasur, u nan ye bitotoorb bi bi Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aayidaan na aah ŋun maah bi mooni tibɔr ngbaan na,

ref: and so he hit me. Then he had me arrested and put in chains at the Benjamin Gate in the Lord's temple.
text: le u bui ke bi gbaa mi, ki di tikululn baa mi kaan mbisamɔb mu bi Uwumbɔr Aadichal chee, aan bi yin mu ke Benjaminn Aabisamɔb na.

ref: The next day, when Pashhur let me go free, I told him that the Lord had said: No longer will I call you Pashhur. Instead, I will call you Afraid-of-Everything.
text: Kitaak aah woln aan Pasur cha bi chuu baar mi lii na, le m bui u ke, “Uwumbɔr le aa nan yin si ke Pasur. Waah nan tii si liyimbil li na le ye ke ‘Ijawaan bi ni kookoo.’

ref: You will be afraid, and you will bring fear to your friends as well. You will see enemies kill them in battle. Then I will let the king of Babylonia take everyone in Judah prisoner, killing some and dragging the rest away to Babylonia.
text: Uwumbɔr ubaa le len ke, ‘M ban m cha aa li ye ijawaan aawan ki tii sin aabaa ni aajɔtiib la, le baadim ga di kijaak aajum ku bi aanimbil ni. M ga di Juda aanib mɔmɔk di ŋa Babiloŋ aabɔr aapɔɔn ni; u ga chur bibaa tinaagbiir buen waatiŋ pu, le ki ku biken mu.

ref: Pashhur, you are guilty of telling lies and claiming they were messages from me. That's why I will let the Babylonians take you, your family, and your friends as prisoners to Babylonia, where you will all die and be buried. Jeremiah Complains to the Lord
text: Sin Pasur ma, ni saadichal kan, bi ga chur ni mu tinaagbiir buen Babiloŋ aatiŋ ni. Nima chee le aa ga ti kpo le bi sub sin ni aajɔtiib bi mɔmɔk aa nan geei inyamɔn pam tuk bi na.’” Jeremia aah di waabɔr tuk Uwumbɔr pu na

ref: You tricked me, Lord, and I was really fooled. You are stronger than I am, and you have defeated me. People never stop sneering and insulting me.
text: Uwumbɔr, aa ŋmann mi la, ki nan sil ŋmann mi. Aa pɔɔ ki jer mi, le ki nyaŋ mi. Unii mɔmɔk laa mi la, bi ŋani mi yaansara le nwiin ti lir.

ref: You have let me announce only injustice and death. Your message has brought me nothing but insults and trouble.
text: M yaa ban m len tibɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, m tar ke, “Kijaak, libiil.” Uwumbɔr, maah joo saabɔr mooni na pu, le bi lik mi fam, ki ŋani mi mbɔnyun.

ref: Sometimes I tell myself not to think about you, Lord, or even mention your name. But your message burns in my heart and bones, and I cannot keep silent.
text: Le m yaa tee bui ke, “M ga suln Uwumbɔr bɔr, kaan ki len tibɔr waayimbil pu” kan, le saabɔr bi ke mmii na ki wu nsui ni. M pɔɔni mbaa ke m taa len ti, le kaa ti ki ŋmaa joo ti.

ref: I heard the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid. Now's our chance to accuse Jeremiah!” All of my so-called friends are just waiting for me to make a mistake. They say, “Maybe Jeremiah can be tricked. Then we can overpower him and get even at last.”
text: M ŋun binib mɔmɔk looni len ke, “Ijawaan aabɔr bi ni mɔmɔk la. Cha ti di waabɔr buen bininkpiib chee man.” Hali njɔtiibamɔm ka kiir maalirm la. Bi len le ke, “Nibaakan ti ga ŋmaa ŋmann u, le ki chuu u ki teen u.”

ref: But you, Lord, are a mighty soldier, standing at my side. Those troublemakers will fall down and fail— terribly embarrassed, forever ashamed.
text: Uwumbɔr, le si ma si mpuwɔb, ki kpa mpɔɔn ni linyaŋ, le binib bi muk mi na ga lir. Baah kaan kan baah ban pu na, le ga cha bi kpaln binimɔɔnib ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: Lord All-Powerful, you test those who do right, and you know every heart and mind. I have told you my complaints, so let me watch you take revenge on my enemies.
text: Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan, le aa ma joo ibamɔn tɔŋni binib, aa nyi tiwan ni bi bisui, ni baalandak ni na. Kina pu na, cha m kan saah ga teen maadim pu na, ba pu? m di maabɔr ŋa sin le aaŋaal ni.

ref: I sing praises to you, Lord. You rescue the oppressed from the wicked.
text: Gaa ilahn tii Uwumbɔr man. Pak Uwumbɔr man. U gaal bigiim titunwanbirdam chee lir.

ref: Put a curse on the day I was born! Don't bless that day.
text: Puun lii nwiin mundaal bi nan ma mi na pu. Suln nwiin mundaal nna nan ma mi na bɔr.

ref: Put a curse on the man who told my father, “Good news! You have a son.”
text: Puun lii uja u nan ti bui nte ke, “Ni ye ubijabo la, aa kan ubijabo,” ki cha usui piir na pu.

ref: May that man be like the towns you destroyed without pity. Let him hear shouts of alarm in the morning and battle cries at noon.
text: Cha u li bi ke ntim mu Uwumbɔr kuln mu, kaa san mu kinimbaak na. Cha u li ŋun iween aawiil pu kichakpiik ni ki ŋun butɔb aakuun pu nwiin aakaasisik ni,

ref: He deserves to die for not killing me before I was born. Then my mother's body would have been my grave.
text: waah kaa nan ku mi nna aaponn ni pu na pu. Tɔ, nna aaponn ni le ba ga li ye maakaakul.

ref: Why did I have to be born? Was it just to suffer and die in shame?
text: Bi nan ma mi ke m nan ŋa ba? Bi nan ma mi ke m nan li bi tibɔr, ni kinimbaak ŋmeen ni, le ki ti kpo nnimɔɔnkun aa?

ref: King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.” So they came to me and said,
text: Juda aabɔr Sedekia nan tun ni Malkia aajapɔɔn Pasur, ni Maaseya aajapɔɔn Sefania, u ye utotoor na m chee ke,

ref: “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
text: “Ti gaŋ si ke aa len Uwumbɔr chee tibɔr tii timi, Babiloŋ Aabɔr Nebukadnesar ni waajab aah bi gob timi aatiŋ pu na pu. Nibaakan, Uwumbɔr ga tun waajinjiir aatuln libaa tii timi, ki cha Nebukadnesar gir upuwɔb.”

ref: Then I told them that the Lord had said: People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death.
text: Le Uwumbɔr ki bui mi ke m tuk binib ngbaan ke, “Li pel man, min Uwumbɔr ban ke ni lee isan ilee yee ponn ni mubaa la; nsan mu cha limɔfal ni na, ni nsan mu cha nkun ni na.

ref: The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city.
text: Unii umɔk gaar kitiŋ ngbaan ni na ga kpo butɔb, ni nkon, ni iween ni. Le uma nyan ki ti di ubaa tii Babiloŋ aanib bi bi tak kitiŋ ngbaan na kan, waan kpo, u ga ŋmar.

ref: I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Warns the King of Judah *
text: M siin ke maan cha kitiŋ kee ŋmar, m siin ke m kuln ki la. M ga di ki tii Babiloŋ yaab aabɔr le u see ki mmii. Min Uwumbɔr le len kina.” Juda aanaanjirb aah ga kan ntafadaan mu na

ref: and I will punish you as you deserve. I'll set your palace on fire, and everything around you will go up in smoke.
