ref: You chose kings and leaders without consulting me; you made silver and gold idols that led to your downfall.
text: “Maanib leer baabɔrb, le kaa ŋɔɔni m pu. Bi leer baasalolm, le kaa ŋɔɔni m pu. Bi di baakunabr ni salmaa le ki naan ŋiwaa; ŋima le ga kuln bi.

ref: City of Samaria, I'm angry because of your idol in the shape of a calf. When will you ever be innocent again?
text: Maa gee Samaria aanib aah di salmaa naan unaaja u ke u ye liwaal ki dooni u na. Maaŋuul fii bi pu sakpen a. Bayoonn aan bi ga di cha ŋiwaa aabɔr?

ref: Someone from Israel built that idol for you, but only I am God. And so it will be smashed to pieces.
text: Israel aawanaann ubaa le naan li, laa ye Uwumbɔr. Samaria yaab aah dooni salmaa aanaaja u na ga wii yuk yuk.

ref: If you scatter wind instead of wheat, you will harvest a whirlwind and have no wheat. Even if you harvest grain, enemies will steal it all.
text: Bi yaa bun libuln kan, kitaabuŋ le bi ga nan chee. Njikaabim mu bi nkpaakon ni kaa biir na aan ŋmaa ŋa tijikaar. Hali mu yaa biir kan, biwɔwɔm le ga di mu ŋmɔ.

ref: Israel, you are ruined, and now the nations consider you worthless.
text: Israel gur bi ke ŋitimbol ŋiken aah bi pu na la, kaa bi tibaa ni ke libuul li wii na,

ref: You are like a wild donkey that goes its own way. You've run off to Assyria and hired them as allies.
text: ki kpa tafalaaŋun ke iŋoob na. Israel aanib bi bibaa pu la. Bi buen Asiria aatiŋ pu ti ban nterm, le ki pan ŋitimbol ŋiken ŋimombil ke ŋi ter bi.

ref: You can bargain with nations, but I'll catch you anyway. Soon you will suffer abuse by kings and rulers.
text: Le m ga kuun bi ki daa bitafal. Naan yunn le Asiria aabɔrkpaan ga di limukl pii bi, le bi ga lir ki biln kitiŋ iween pu.

ref: Israel, you have built many altars where you offer sacrifices for sin. But these altars have become places for sin.
text: “Israel aanib aah moo maa kitork aabimbin ke bi kan titunwanbir aachapinn na, kina le bi moo kani nin chee bi ga tun titunwanbir na.

ref: You sacrifice your best animals and eat the sacrificial meals, but I, the Lord, refuse your offerings. I will remember your sins and punish you. Then you will return to Egypt.
text: Bi toor kitork tii mi, le ki ŋmɔ kaanann. Le min Uwumbɔr aasui aa piin bi pu, le m ga teer baatunwanbir n‑yoonn mumina ki daa bitafal ti pu; m ga giin bi Ijipt aatiŋ ni.

ref: Israel, I created you, but you forgot me. You and Judah built palaces and many strong cities. Now I will send fire to destroy your towns and fortresses.
text: “Israel aanib maa ŋibɔrdichal, le ki tee suln Uwumbɔr u naan bi na bɔr. Juda aanib maa ntim mu kpa tijawan aan bi maa ŋigon gob mu na. Le m ga cha mmii wu baabɔrdichal ni ntim ngbaan.”

ref: Israel, don't celebrate or make noisy shouts like other nations. You have been unfaithful to your God. Wherever grain is threshed, you behave like prostitutes because you enjoy the money you receive.
text: Israel aanib, taa ki ji nimi aajim ke binib bi kaa nyi Uwumbɔr na aah ŋani pu na. Ni fenn nipuwɔb tii nimi Aawumbɔr le kaa keei waamɔb. Kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk pu, ni di nibaa kooh ke upiidagoor na le ki di tii liwaal Baal, le ki gee tijikaar ti ni dak ke u joo pa nimi na.

ref: But you will run short of grain and wine,
text: Tɔ, naan yunn le nimi aajikaar, ni olif aakpan aan ki ŋeer nimi, le ndaan mu ga doo.

ref: and you will have to leave the land of the Lord. Some of you will go to Egypt; others will go to Assyria and eat unclean food.
text: Israel aanib aan ki li bi Uwumbɔr aatiŋ pu, bi ga gir buen Ijipt aatiŋ ni, ki ga ti li ji tijikaar ti bi kɔ na Asiria aatiŋ ni.

ref: You won't be able to offer sacrifices of wine to the Lord. None of your sacrifices will please him— they will be unclean like food offered to the dead. Your food will only be used to satisfy your hunger; none of it will be brought to the Lord's temple.
text: Baan ti ŋmaa tii Uwumbɔr ndaan aapiin, biwɔwɔm aatim ngbaan ni, kaan ŋmaa di baatork buen unimbiin ni. Biwɔwɔm ngbaan aajikaar ga bii umɔk jin ti na, ke baah jin likpuul ponn ni aajikaar pu na la. Bi ga li ji ti ke ti lee baakon la; ti ponn ni tibaa aan ŋmaa koo Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni ki ye ipiin tii u.

ref: You will no longer be able to celebrate the festival of the Lord.
text: Le n‑yoonn yaa nan fuu ni ke bi ji njim ki nyuŋ Uwumbɔr kan, baan li nyi baah ga ŋa pu na.

ref: Even if you escape alive, you will end up in Egypt and be buried in Memphis. Your silver treasures will be lost among weeds; thorns will sprout in your tents.
text: Libiil yaa nan fuu ni ki yaa binib ngbaan kan, le Ijipt yaab ga kuun bi. Bi ga kuun bi ti sub Memfis aatiŋ ni la. Le timoor ni ikokon ga gaa baadichal ni baawangol aah nan si nin chee n‑yoonn mubaa na.

ref: Israel, the time has come. You will get what you deserve, and you will know it. “Prophets are fools,” you say. “And God's messengers are crazy.” Your terrible guilt has filled you with hatred.
text: Ntafadaan aayoonn fuu a, n‑yoonn ngbaan binib ga kan ni ŋeer bi na. Kina yaa nan ŋa kan, Israel yaab ga bee ni. Ni bui ke, “Uwumbɔr aabɔnabr umina ye ujɔr la. Unii u Nfuur Nyaan fir u pu ngbaan na aa ki kpa nlan la.” Nimi aatunwanbir aah nyaŋ na le kinanaŋ gbiin nimi.

ref: Israel, the Lord sent me to look after you. But you trap his prophets and flood his temple with your hatred.
text: Uwumbɔr tun ni mi ke ubɔnabr na, ke m nan sak waanib Israel yaab. Le m yaa buen nimɔk na kan, ni pɔɔni nibaa ke ni chuu mi ke unyoon na. Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aanib aadin le ye uma Uwumbɔr aabɔnabr.

ref: You are brutal and corrupt, as were the men of Gibeah. But God remembers your sin, and you will be punished. Sin's Terrible Results
text: Baatuln mɔmɔk ponn ni ye titunwanbir le kaa kpa ŋitataa, ke baah nan bi Gibea aatiŋ ni pu na. Uwumbɔr ga teer baatunwanbir le ki daa bitafal ti pu. Israel aatunwanbir ni taapar

ref: Israel, when I, the Lord, found you long ago it was like finding grapes in a barren desert or tender young figs. Then you worshiped Baal Peor, that disgusting idol, and you became as disgusting as the idol you loved.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Maah nan puen kan Israel na, ni nan bi ke unii aah kan ŋisubil nteersakpiin ni kan, ni bi pu na la. Maah nan puen kan niyaajatiib na, ni nan bi ke aa yaa kan ŋikakan ŋi puen puir na kan, ni bi pu na la. Baah nan fuu ni Peor Aajool chee na, le bi piin ki gur dooni liwaal Baal, le ki ŋa fam ke ŋiwaa ŋi bi gee ŋi na.

ref: And so, Israel, your glory will fly away like birds— your women will no longer be able to give birth.
text: Israel aayimbil ga fii buen ke unyoon na, le baan ki maa mbim, bipudam mu aan ki li bi, baan ki dek mbim aapuu.

ref: Even if you do have children, I will take them all and leave you to mourn. I will turn away, and you will sink down in deep trouble.
text: Tɔ, bi yaa ma mbim kan, m ga yoor bi mɔmɔk kaan gur ubaa. N‑yoonn mu m siir cha binib bee na kan, tibɔbir pam le ga kan bi.”

ref: Israel, when I first met you, I thought of you as palm trees growing in fertile ground. Now you lead your people out, only to be slaughtered. Hosea's Advice
text: M waa Efraim aanib bi lipepel li ŋan na ni, ke Taya aatiŋ na. Efraim mu ga nya baabim bi ti ku bi.

ref: Our Lord, do just one thing for your people— make their women unable to have children or to nurse their babies. The Lord's Judgment on Israel
text: Ba aan m ga bui ke aa ŋa binib bee? Cha baapiib kpaln biŋoob. Cha bi taa ki ŋmaa kpiin baabipɔm. Uwumbɔr aah ga ji Israel yaab tibɔr pu na

ref: Israel, I first began to hate you because you did evil at Gilgal. Now I will chase you out of my house. No longer will I love you; your leaders betrayed me.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Baatunwanbir mɔmɔk nan piin Gilgal aatiŋ ni la. Maa ki gee bi nima chee. Le baah tun titunwanbir ti na pu, m ga jenn nyan bi maatiŋ pu. Maan ki li kpa bi pu ngeehm; baasalolm mɔmɔk fii sil m pu la.

ref: Israel, you are a vine with dried-up roots and fruitless branches. Even if you had more children and loved them dearly, I would slaughter them all. Hosea Warns Israel
text: Israel aanib bi ke busub bu aanyaan kuur aan bu aa ki lu na la. Baan ki maa mbim, le bi ti ki ma bi kan, m ga ku baah gee baabim bi sakpen na.” Uwumbɔr aabɔnabr aah len Israel yaab aabɔr pu na

ref: Israel, you disobeyed my God. Now he will force you to roam from nation to nation.
text: Maah dii Uwumbɔr u na ga yii waanib, baah kaa ŋun tii u pu na pu. Bi ga kpaln bichayiim le ŋitimbol ponn ni.

ref: You were a healthy vine covered with grapes. But the more grapes you grew, the more altars you built; the better off you became, the better shrines you set up for pagan gods.
text: Israel aanib nan bi ke ŋisubil aasub bu lun ŋisubil sakpen na la. Buyoonn bi moo kan liwangol na, le bi too maa ŋiwaa aatork aabimbin kpae. Buyoonn baatiŋ moo ŋani tijikaar na, le bi too toor ŋiwaa ŋi bi dooni na ke ŋi li ŋan.

ref: You are deceitful and disloyal. So you will pay for your sins, because the Lord will destroy your altars and images.
text: Binib bi aasui ni ye ŋŋmann ŋmeen na ga ji baatunwanbir aafalaa. Uwumbɔr ga gbaa wii baawaa ni ŋaabimbin ngbaan ki tur ŋi lir.

ref: “We don't have a king,” you will say. “We don't fear the Lord. And what good are kings?”
text: Binib ngbaan ga piin ki bi len ke, “Taah kaa san Uwumbɔr na le taa kpa ubɔr. Tɔ, ubɔr ba ga ŋmaa ŋa ba tii timi?”

ref: All who live in Samaria tremble with concern for the idols at sinful Bethel. The idol there was the pride of the priests, but it has been put to shame; now everyone will cry.
text: Binib bi koo Samaria aatiŋ ni na ga san ijawaan ki wii, baah ga lann salmaa aanaaja aawaal li bi naan siin Bef Afenn ni na pu. Bi ni bitotoorb bi dooni liwaal ngbaan na ga wii li pu. Buyoonn baadim chuu nyan laasalmaa aanyaan na le bi ga li kaani.

ref: It will be taken to Assyria and given to the great king. Then Israel will be disgraced for worshiping that idol.
text: Bi ga di liwaal ngbaan buen ti pa Asiria aabɔrkpaan. Israel yaab aah dii nsurm mu na pu le bi ga ji inimɔɔn ki kpaln binimɔɔnib.

ref: Like a twig in a stream, the king of Samaria will be swept away.
text: Bidim ga di baabɔr buen ke lidɔchɔl aah dee nnyun pu ki cha pu na la.

ref: The altars at sinful Bethel will be destroyed for causing Israel to sin; they will be grown over with thorns and thistles. Then everyone will beg the mountains and hills to cover and protect them. The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
text: Afenn aagongon pu aawaa ŋi Israel aanib dooni ŋi na ga ber. Ikokon ni timoor le ga gaa kitork aabimbin ngbaan. Binib ga bui ŋijoo ke, “Bɔr timi man,” le ki bui ŋigongon ke, “Biin ti pu man.” Uwumbɔr aah bui ke u ga ji Israel yaab tibɔr ti na

ref: Israel, you have never stopped sinning since that time at Gibeah. That's why you will be attacked at Gibeah.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Israel yaab aah nan tun mi titunwanbir Gibea aatiŋ ni buyoonn na, baa kee di cha. Kina pu le butɔb ga pii bi Gibea aatiŋ ni.

ref: Your sins have doubled, and you are rebellious. Now I have decided to send nations to attack and put you in chains.
text: M ga pii titunwanbirdam bimina ki daa bitafal. Ŋitimbol ga kpaan ki tak bi, le m ga daa bitafal, baah tun titunwanbir sakpen pu na pu.

ref: Once you were obedient like a calf that loved to thresh grain. But I will put a harness on your beautiful neck; you and Judah must plow and cultivate the ground.
text: “Israel nan bi n‑yoonn mubaa ke unaasal u bi bae tiwan mbamɔm na la, le ki gor kii ke u poi idi. Le m nan di ndɔ puin usil mu ŋan na pu, le ki di iŋmin pui u ke u tun lituln li pɔɔ jer kina na. M cha Juda dar ŋikujal, le ki cha Israel dar nkucham.

ref: Plow your fields, scatter seeds of justice, and harvest faithfulness. Worship me, the Lord, and I will send my saving power down like rain.
text: Le m bui ke, ‘Ko nkpaakopɔɔn tii nibaa man, di mbimbinyaan bu, ki nan chee naah di nibaa tii mi pu na aanyoor. Ni ŋeer ke ni fenn gir ni min Uwumbɔr chee, le m ga dan ki nan di tinyoor gbiin nimi.’

ref: You have planted evil, harvested injustice, and eaten the fruit of your lies. You trusted your own strength and your powerful forces.
text: Le ni yii ki di titunwanbir bun ki nan chee taanyoor. Ni jin nimi aanyamɔn aah joo ni pu na la. “Naah mak nimi aataan aatɔroku tiib, ni nimi aajab aawiwiir pu na,

ref: So war will break out, and your fortresses will be destroyed. Your enemies will do to you what Shalman did to the people of Beth-Arbel— mothers and their children will be beaten to death against rocks.
text: le butɔb ga lir nimi aanib pu, le nimi aatim mu kpa tijawan ki pɔɔ na mɔmɔk ga kuln. Ni ga li bi ke ubɔr Salmann aah nan kuln Bef Arbel aatiŋ butɔb ni, ki ku natiib ni baabim pu na la.

ref: Bethel, this will be your fate because of your evil. Israel, at dawn your king will be killed.
text: Betel aatiŋ aanib, kina ga ŋa nimi, naah tun titunwanbir sakpen ti na pu. Butɔb aah ga piin buyoonn na, le Israel yaab aabɔr ga kpo.”

ref: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.
text: Uwumbɔr len ke, “Israel aah nan laa ye ubo pu na, m nan gee u, le ki nan yin u nyan ni Ijipt aatiŋ ni ke maabo na.

ref: But as the saying goes, “The more they were called, the more they rebelled.” They never stopped offering incense and sacrifices to the idols of Baal.
text: Tɔ, buyoonn m moo yin u na, le u moo san m chee. Maanib toor kitork tii liwaal Baal la, le ki seer nnyɔknii tii ŋiwaa ŋiken.

ref: I took Israel by the arm and taught them to walk. But they would not admit that I was the one who had healed them.
text: Tɔ, m mu le nan mɔk Israel lisachuln. M yoor maanib ŋmam ŋŋaal ni, le baa nyi ke min le joo bi.

ref: I led them with kindness and with love, not with ropes. I held them close to me; I bent down to feed them.
text: M di ngeehm ni lineen daa bi dan mbaa chee. M nan yoor bi paacham ki di buŋ mbɔgbiln pu; m nan sɔɔn taab ki kpiin bi.

ref: But they rejected me, and so must return to Egypt; now Assyria will rule them.
text: “Bi yii kaan gir ni m chee, kina pu le bi ga ki gir Ijipt aatiŋ ni, le Asiria aabɔr ti li joo bi.

ref: My people are determined to reject me for a god they think is stronger, but he can't help.
text: Bi nyan sil ke bi nya m chee la. Bi ga wii lituln li nyik bi pu na pu, le ubaa mu aan tuur bi.

ref: Israel, I can't let you go. I can't give you up. How could I possibly destroy you as I did the towns of Admah and Zeboiim? I just can't do it. My feelings for you are much too strong.
text: Israel, m ga ŋa kinye ki di si lii? M ga ŋa kinye ki di si mee? M ga ŋmaa kuln si ke maah nan bii Adma aatiŋ pu na aa? M ga ŋmaa ŋa si ke maah nan ŋa Seboyim aatiŋ pu na aa? Nsui aan cha m ŋa si kina, ba pu? m gee si sakpen a.

ref: Israel, I won't lose my temper and destroy you again. I am the Holy God— not merely some human, and I won't stay angry.
text: Maan daa aatafal maaŋuul ponn ni; maan ki kuln Israel yaab, ba pu? M ye Uwumbɔr la, maa ye unibɔn. Min u bi chain na bi ni chee. Maan dan ni chee maaŋuul ponn ni.

ref: I, the Lord, will roar like a lion, and my children will return, trembling from the west.
text: “M yaa nan ŋuun baadim pu ke uchinn na kan, maanib ga dii mi. Bi ga nya liwilir wɔb ki dan m chee mala.

ref: They will come back, fluttering like birds from Egypt or like doves from Assyria. Then I will bring them back to their homes. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel and Judah Compared
text: Bi ga nya ni Ijipt aatiŋ ni mala ke inyoon na, ki nya ni Asiria aatiŋ ni mala ke ŋinanjel na. M ga ki giin ni bi bido bido. Min Uwumbɔr le len kina.” Israel ni Juda aanib aabɔr aah bii pu na

ref: Israel is deceitful to me, their loyal and holy God; they surround me with lies, and Judah worships other gods.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Israel aanib di inyamɔn ni ŋŋmann le gob mi, le Juda aanib beenin yiil min Uwumbɔr u bi chain ki tun maah len pu na aamɔb.

ref: All day long Israel chases wind from the desert; deceit and violence are found everywhere. Treaties are made with Assyria; olive oil is taken to Egypt. Israel and Judah Condemned
text: “Israel aanib aah tun pu kichakpiik ni ki ti saa kinyeek na aa kpa tinyoor, le ki ye libiil ŋmeen. Mbimbin mu pɔɔ na ni inyamɔn le moo kpae bi ponn ni. Bi ni Ijipt ni Asiria yaab kpaani kimɔbaan la.”

ref: The Lord also brings charges against the people of Judah, the descendants of Jacob. He will punish them for what they have done.
text: Uwumbɔr kpa Juda aanib pu ngalm, le ki ga daa Israel aatiŋ aatafal, kaanib aatuln pu. U ga giin baah tun pu na le pa bi.

ref: Even before Jacob was born, he cheated his brother, and when he grew up, he fought against God.
text: Biyaaja Jakob ni ujaantɔ Esɔ nan mɔn, bi mɔmɔk bilee aah nan laa bi bina aaponn ni pu na; le Jakob aah nan chikr na, le u ni Uwumbɔr mɔn,

ref: At Bethel, Jacob wrestled with an angel and won; then with tears in his eyes, he asked for a blessing, and God spoke to us there.
text: u ni Uwumbɔr aatuun nan mɔn le u nyaŋ mu. U nan wii ki mee ban tinyoor. Le Uwumbɔr dan tiyaaja Jakob chee Betel aatiŋ ni, ki nan len u chee tibɔr.

ref: God's name is the Lord, the Lord God All-Powerful.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan nan ye. Liyimbil li bi ga li joo dooni u na le ye Uwumbɔr.

ref: You say to yourself, “I'm rich! I earned it all on my own, without committing a sin.” The Lord Is Still the God of Israel
text: Bi len le ke, ‘Ti ye biwankpadam la. Ti kan liwangol sakpen. Le ubaa aan ŋmaa galn timi ke ti ji biken.’

ref: Israel, I, the Lord, am still your God, just as I have been since the time you were in Egypt. Now I will force you to live in tents once again, as you did in the desert.
text: Le min Nidindaan Uwumbɔr, u nyan ni nimi Ijipt aatiŋ ni na, ga ki cha ni ki gir li koo igban aaboo ni, ke naah nan koo pu buyoonn m dan ni chee nteersakpiin ni na.

ref: I spoke to the prophets— often I spoke in visions. And so, I will send my prophets with messages of doom.
text: “M nan len bibɔnabr chee tibɔr, le ki kpiir tibɔkpiirkaan pam tuk bi, le ki cha bi sak maanib.

ref: Gilead is terribly sinful and will end up ruined. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal on altars made of stones, but those stones will be scattered in every field.
text: Tɔ, ŋiwaa le bi dooni ŋi Gilead aatiŋ ponn ni, le binib bi dooni ŋi na ga kpoi. Bi kɔr inaaja Gilgal aatiŋ ni toor kitork, le ŋiwaabimbin ŋi bi nima chee na ga kpaln ŋitakpakpuk le ikpaakon ni.”

ref: I sent the prophet Moses to lead Israel from Egypt and to keep them safe.
text: Uwumbɔr nan tun ubɔnabr ke u ti nyan Israel yaab tinaagbiir ni Ijipt ni, ki li joo bi.

ref: Israel, I will make you pay for your violent crimes and for insulting me.
text: Israel aanib cha Uwumbɔr aaŋuul fii ni ti nyaŋ, baatunwanbir ŋeer nkun la. Uwumbɔr ga daa bitafal titunwanbir ti bi di tii u na pu.

ref: When your leaders spoke, everyone in Israel trembled and showed great respect. But you sinned by worshiping Baal, and you were destroyed.
text: N‑yoonn mu jer na, Efraim aanibol yaa nan len kan, ijawaan nan chur ŋinibol ŋi gur na la; ŋi mɔmɔk nan lik Efraim aanibol pu la. Le binib ngbaan dooni liwaal Baal, le ki ga kpo kina pu.

ref: Now you continue to sin by designing and making idols of silver in the shape of calves. You are told to sacrifice to these idols— yes, even to kiss them.
text: Baah beenin naani tikur aawan ki dooni ni na, le bi beenin tun titunwanbir, bi dooni tikunabr aawaa ŋi unibɔn di waalan naan ŋi uyil ni, ki di uŋaal ŋa ŋi na. Le bi bui ke, “Toor kitork tii ŋi man.” Binib ga ŋa kinye ki moor ŋiwaa ŋi bi naan ŋi ke inaaja na?

ref: And so, all of you will vanish like the mist or the dew of early morning, or husks of grain in the wind or smoke from a chimney.
text: Kina pu le binib ngbaan ga wɔŋ ke kichakpiik ni aakpakpal na, ki wɔŋ ke limaln li wɔŋni kichakpiik ni na. Bi ga fii buen ke libuln aah daar kimook lipaal pu cha na la, ki naahn iŋmanyuu aah nya kidadiik aadipimoor ni pu na.

ref: I, the Lord, have been your God since the time you were in Egypt. I am the only God you know, the only one who can save.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “Min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr u nan nyan ni nimi Ijipt aatiŋ ni na. Naa ki kpa Uwumbɔr uken ki kpee m pu. Min baanja le ye u gaal nimi lir na.

ref: I took care of you in a thirsty desert.
text: M nan kpiin nimi nteersakpiin mu aatiŋ kuun na ni.

ref: I fed you till you were satisfied, then you became proud and forgot about me.
text: Le naah ti koo kitiŋ ki ŋan na ponn ni na, le ni nan jin bab, le ni ŋeer nimi, le ni kpaln bigaadam ki suln mbɔr.

ref: Now I will attack like a lion, ambush you like a leopard,
text: Kina pu le m ga tak nimi ke uchinn na. M ga doon nsan ni kiir nimi ke unaamuun na.

ref: and rip you apart like a bear robbed of her cubs. I will gnaw on your bones, as though I were a lion or some other wild animal.
text: M ga tak nimi ke kipeewanbiik ki aabim wɔŋ na, le ki daa par nimi. M ga di nimi ŋmɔ mala ke uchinn na libuul ngbaan ni, ki daa par par nimi ke kipeewanbiik na.

ref: Israel, you are done for. Don't expect help from me.
text: “Israel aanib, m ga kuln nimi. Le ubaa aan ŋmaa ter nimi.

ref: You wanted a king and rulers. Where is your king now? What cities have rulers?
text: Ni nan bui ke ni ban ubɔr ni bisalolm la; tɔ, bi ga ŋa kinye ki gaa litimbol ngbaan lii?

ref: In my anger, I gave you a king; in my fury, I took him away. Israel's Terrible Fate The Lord said:
text: Maaŋuul ponn ni le m nan tii nimi bibɔrb, le maaŋuusakpeln ni m nan ki gaa bi.

ref: Israel, your terrible sins are written down and stored away.
text: “M ŋmee Israel aatunwanbir ni kaataani bil, le ki di tigbann ngbaan bil mbamɔm.

ref: Should I, the Lord, rescue you from death and the grave? No! I call death and the grave to strike you like a plague. I refuse to show mercy.
text: Maan nyan binib ngbaan nkun ni, kaan nyan bi nkun aapɔɔn ni. Nkun, li joo ni saabiil. Kitekpiitiŋ, li joo ni saabiil. Maan ki san binib bimina kinimbaak.

ref: No matter if you prosper more than the other tribes, I, the Lord, will wipe you out, just as a scorching desert wind dries up streams of water. I will take away your precious treasures.
text: Israel pɔr ke timoor na la, le m tee ga cha libuln li ton ki nyan ni liwipuul wɔb nteersakpiin ni na dan ki nan foor baayayak aanyunbun, ni ŋibun. Li ga yoor tiwanbankaan mɔmɔk buen.

ref: Samaria will be punished for turning against me. It will be destroyed in war— children will be beaten against rocks, and pregnant women will be ripped open.
text: Samaria aatiŋ aanib aah yii maamɔb na, bi ŋeer ntafadaan. Bi ga kpoi butɔb ni, le bidim di baabipɔm yur ku, ki saa gber bipudam aapuu.”

ref: Israel, return! Come back to the Lord, your God. Sin has made you fall.
text: Nimi Israel aanib, gir ni Nidindaan Uwumbɔr chee. Nimi aatunwanbir le cha ni gbeer ki lir.

ref: Assyria can't save us, and chariots can't help. So we will no longer worship the idols we have made. Our Lord, you show mercy to orphans.” The Lord Promises To Forgive
text: Asiria yaab aan ŋmaa gaa timi lii, le butɔb aataan mu aan ŋmaa ter timi. Taan ki bui timi aawaa ke ŋima le ye timi Aawumbɔr. Uwumbɔr, aa san binib bi kaa kpa nterm na kinimbaak.” Uwumbɔr aah puu limɔfapɔln li tii Israel yaab na

ref: Israel, you have rejected me, but my anger is gone; I will heal you and love you without limit.
text: Uwumbɔr bui ke, “M ga giin ni maanib mbaa chee. M ga li gee bi ni nsui mɔmɔk; maaŋuul aan ki fii bi pu.

ref: I will be like the dew— then you will blossom like lilies and have roots like a tree.
text: M ga li bi Israel aanib chee ke utaal aah bi pu kitiŋ ki kuun na chee pu na la. Bi ga pɔnn ke nsupuun na la; bi ga chɔbaan ke Lebanonn aatiŋ aasui na la.

ref: Your branches will spread with the beauty of an olive tree and with the aroma of Lebanon Forest.
text: Baanachipɔm ga li kpa limɔfal, ki li ŋan ke olif aakpan aasui na. Bi ga li kpa mbaan ke Lebanonn aasantina aasui na la.

ref: You will rest in my shade, and your grain will grow. You will blossom like a vineyard and be famous as the wine from Lebanon.
text: Bi ga ki li gur bi maajoom ni la. Bi ga kpenn ke kisaak na, ki ga lu ŋisubil ke ndaan aasui na. Bi ga li kpa liyimbil ke Lebanonn aasubil aadaan na.

ref: Israel, give up your idols! I will answer your prayers and take care of you. I am that glorious tree, the source of your fruit.
text: Israel aanib aatafal aan ki li bi ŋiwaa ni; m ga kii baameel ki li joo bi. M ga li kii bi ke busub bu aafar aa gbaar na la; min le ye nin chee baanyoor mɔmɔk ga nya ni na.” Kookoo aabɔr

ref: If you are wise, you will know and understand what I mean. I am the Lord, and I lead you along the right path. If you obey me, we will walk together, but if you are wicked, you will stumble.
text: Cha binib bi kpa nlan na bee tibɔr ti ŋmee do na aatataa, ki di ti ŋa bisui ni. Uwumbɔr aasan le ŋan, le binib bi aabimbin ŋan na dii ima le ki kpa limɔfal, le titunwanbirdam ma aatafal aa bi i ni, le ki gbeer ki lir.

ref: I am Joel the son of Pethuel. And this is the message the Lord gave to me. Locusts Cover the Land
text: Uwumbɔr aah di tibɔr ti tuk waabɔnabr Petuel aajapɔɔn Joel na sɔ: Binib wii tijikaar aah bii pu na pu

ref: Swarm after swarm of locusts has attacked our crops, eating everything in sight.
text: Itoon pam dan ki nan lir tijikaar pu. Itoon ibaa aah ŋman gur ni na, itoon iken nan di ŋman.

ref: Sober up, you drunkards! Cry long and loud; your wine supply is gone.
text: Finn ki li wii man, nimi bidagbiib; nimi bi ye bidanyurb na, li wii man; ŋisubil ŋi bi joo ŋaa ndapɔm na mɔmɔk bii doo a.

ref: A powerful nation with countless troops has invaded our land. They have the teeth and jaws of powerful lions.
text: Itoon dan ki wiir pam ki nan gob timi aatiŋ a; i kpa mpɔɔn ki wiir ke litambol na; le yaanyin ka ke uchinn aanyin na.

ref: Our grapevines and fig trees are stripped bare; only naked branches remain.
text: I ŋman bii timi aadaan aasui mɔmɔk, ki ŋman bii timi aakakan doo a. I ŋman lar tidapɔr mɔmɔk le ki cha ŋisubil ŋmeen.

ref: Grieve like a young woman mourning for the man she was to marry.
text: Nimi binib, li wii man, ke usapɔɔn aah ban u mɔn uja u na aah kpo kan, u wii pu na.

ref: Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple. His servants, the priests, are deep in sorrow.
text: Njikaabim ni ndaan aa bi ti di tii ipiin Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni; Uwumbɔr aatotoorb aa kan nibaa bi di toor kitork tii Uwumbɔr, le ki wii ikpowiil.

ref: Mourn for our farms and our vineyards! There's no wheat or barley growing in our fields.
text: Nimi bi ye bikpaab na, li wii man; nimi bi lik nimi aakpaakon na, li wii man, ba pu? idi, ni imuul, ni tijikaar mɔmɔk bii doo a.

ref: Grapevines have dried up and so has every tree— figs and pomegranates, date palms and apples. All happiness has faded away. Return to God
text: Ndaan aasubil aasui ni ŋikakan mɔmɔk bii doo a; le ŋisubil aasui mɔmɔk yɔl ki kpoi doo. Binib mɔmɔk aasuupiin doo a.

ref: Mourn, you priests who serve at the altar of my God. Spend your days and nights wearing sackcloth. Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple.
text: Nimi bitotoorb bi dooni Uwumbɔr waatork aabimbiln taab na, peen tiwan ni saak kuub na ki li wii man. Li cha Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni ki ti li wii ikpowiil, ki taa geen man. Njikaabim ni ndaan aa bi ni di toor kitork tii nimi Aawumbɔr.

ref: Tell the leaders and people to come together at the temple. Order them to go without eating and to pray sincerely.
text: Cha binib mɔmɔk lul bumɔb man; yin binib mɔmɔk aan bi kuun ni. Kuun binib bimɔk ye bisalolm na, ni Juda aatiŋ aanib mɔmɔk aan bi mɔmɔk dan Nidindaan Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni ki nan wii yin u.

ref: Our food is already gone; there's no more celebrating at the temple of our God.
text: Ti si lik kaa kpa nterm mubaa, le timi aajikaar mɔmɔk bii doo. Mpopiin mubaa aa bi timi Aawumbɔr Aadichal ni.

ref: Seeds dry up in the ground; no harvest is possible. Our barns are in bad shape, with no grain to store in them.
text: Kitiŋ aah kuur pu na, le njikaabim mɔmɔk kpoi doo ki ponn ni. Njikaabim mubaa aa bi aan ti di siin, kina pu na, timi aapikuun na mɔmɔk lir doo a.

ref: Our cattle wander aimlessly, moaning for lack of pasture, and sheep are suffering.
text: Inaa aah kaa kan timoor i ŋmɔ na, le i wii ni mpombiin; le ipiih mɔmɔk ji falaa.

ref: I cry out to you, Lord. Grasslands and forests are eaten by the scorching heat.
text: Uwumbɔr, m wii mpɔɔn pu ki yin si la, ba pu? timoor ni isui mɔmɔk kuur, ke mmii le aah wun ni mɔmɔk na.

ref: Wild animals have no water because of you; rivers and streams are dry, and pastures are parched.
text: Hali timoor ni aawakor wii mpɔɔn pu ki yin si la, ba pu? ibun mɔmɔk foor a.

ref: Sound the trumpet on Zion, the Lord's sacred hill. Warn everyone to tremble! The judgment day of the Lord is coming soon.
text: Pii kakaan man; faa nkuun Sionn aajool li ye Uwumbɔr aajool ki bi chain na paab. Juda aatiŋ aanib, cha niwon li gbaa man. Uwumbɔr aawiin peen ni a.

ref: It will be dark and gloomy with storm clouds overhead. Troops will cover the mountains like thunderclouds. No army this powerful has ever been gathered before or will be gathered again.
text: Nwiin ngbaan daal ga li bɔɔn ki bi timm, mu ga li bɔɔn ki kpa ntaalangbam pam. Kitoonpaak ngbaan choo ki naahn mbɔmbɔɔn sakpiin mubaa le aah biini ŋijoo paab na. Tiwan nimina aaboln aa kee ŋa, kaan ki ŋa daalbaadaal.

ref: They roar over mountains like noisy chariots, or a mighty army ready for battle. They are a forest fire that feasts on straw.
text: Yaah bi yuk ŋijoo paab pu na naahn itaan aatɔroku tiib la; ki naahn timokuun aah gaal mmii ni pu na la. I chol tɔb pu ke butɔb aajab aah gor bibaa ki kii butɔb pu na la.

ref: The very sight of them is frightening.
text: Ijawaan chur unii umɔk waa yaah choo pu na.

ref: They charge straight ahead, without pushing each other; even arrows and spears cannot make them retreat.
text: ubaa mu aa punn uken aamɔb pu. Yaah ga jer nin chee na, tiwan nibaa aa bi ki ga leŋ yaasan ke i taa jer.

ref: They swarm over city walls and enter our homes; they crawl in through windows, just like thieves.
text: I ga chii ki buen kitiŋ ponn ni; ki fii labr ŋigon pu, ki joi ŋidichal pu, ki diir takolu tiib koo tidir ponn ni ke binaayukb na.

ref: They make the earth tremble and the heavens shake; the sun and moon turn dark, and stars stop shining.
text: I yaa choo kan, kitiŋ deŋni la, le kitaapaak jii. Nwiin ni uŋmal mɔmɔk bɔnn chirm, le iŋmabi aa ki wiin.

ref: The Lord God leads this army of countless troops, and they obey his commands. The day of his judgment is so terrible that no one can stand it. The Lord's Invitation
text: Uwumbɔr tar ke utaal na ki tuk waatɔb aajab baah ga ŋa pu na. Waajab bi kii tii waamɔb na wiir ki kpa mpɔɔn. Uwumbɔr aawiin ngbaan daal kan, ubaa aan li wii aan uŋeen aatɔ ka laa. Ubaa aan ŋmar nwiin ngbaan daal. Kpeln nimi aabimbin mbamɔm man

ref: The Lord said: It isn't too late. You can still return to me with all your heart. Start crying and mourning! Go without eating.
text: Uwumbɔr len ke, “Hali dandana, kpeln nimi aabimbin mbamɔm man, ki lul bumɔb, ki li wii ikpowiil, ki gir ni m chee.

ref: Don't rip your clothes to show your sorrow. Instead, turn back to me with broken hearts. I am merciful, kind, and caring. I don't easily lose my temper, and I don't like to punish.
text: Cha nimi aasuugar mɔk nimi aapombiin, naa ye ke ni daa kar nimi aawanpeenkaan baanja.” Gir ni Nidindaan Uwumbɔr chee man. U kpa tiŋann ki ye unimbaasaln daan la; u kpa limɔr ki ŋmaa joo waah puu tipuur ti na; n‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, u gor ki kii ke u di cha pinn binib. Waa ban ke u daa bitafal.

ref: I am the Lord your God. Perhaps I will change my mind and treat you with mercy. Then you will be blessed with enough grain and wine for offering sacrifices to me.
text: Nibaakan, Nidindaan Uwumbɔr ga kpeln waalandak, ki ga ŋa waanyoor ŋa ni pu aan ni kan tijikaar sakpen. Le ni ga ŋmaa tii u njikaabim ni ndaan aapiin.

ref: Sound the trumpet on Zion! Call the people together. Show your sorrow by going without food.
text: Pii kakaan Sionn aajool paab man; cha binib mɔmɔk lul bumɔb ki kuun bi mɔmɔk kpaan.

ref: Tell my servants, the priests, to cry inside the temple and to offer this prayer near the altar: “Save your people, Lord God! Don't let foreign nations make jokes about us. Don't let them laugh and ask, ‘Where is your God?’ ” The Lord Will Bless the Land
text: Bitotoorb bi tun Uwumbɔr aatuln, waatork aabimbiln ni Waadichal aabisamɔb aakaasisik ni na; ni li mee Uwumbɔr ni tinyunyunn ke: “Uwumbɔr, san saanib kinimbaak. Taa cha ŋinibol ŋiken lik timi fam ki ŋa timi mbɔnyun ki len ke, ‘Nimi Aawumbɔr ngbaan bi la?’” Uwumbɔr aah cha kitiŋ ki gir pu na

ref: The Lord was deeply concerned about his land and had pity on his people.
text: N‑yoonn ngbaan le Uwumbɔr ki san waatiŋ kinimbaak; u san waanib kinimbaak.

ref: In answer to their prayers he said, “I will give you enough grain, wine, and olive oil to satisfy your needs. No longer will I let you be insulted by the nations.
text: U kii baameel ki len ke: “Dandana wee m ban m tii nimi tijikaar ni ndaan, ni olif aakpan, aan ni mɔɔr nimi. Ŋinibol ŋiken aan ki lik seen nimi.

ref: and wild animals to stop being afraid. Grasslands are green again; fruit trees and fig trees are loaded with fruit. Grapevines are covered with grapes.
text: Tiwakor, taa cha ijawaan li joo nimi man. Nimi aamoŋmɔpaan ki boln timosɔnn isui mɔmɔk lun ŋisubil, le ŋikakan ni ŋisubil ŋiken moo kpee.

ref: People of Zion, celebrate in honor of the Lord your God! He is generous and has sent the autumn and spring rains in the proper seasons.
text: Sionn aatiŋ aanib, cha nisui li piin man, li mɔɔni Nidindaan Uwumbɔr aah ŋa pu tii nimi na pu. U tii nimi kiseek ni aataal, ki ŋeer naah ban pu na; ki cha utakuutaal ni unaalantaal mu nun mbamɔm ke waah ti nu pu na.

ref: Grain will cover your threshing places; jars will overflow with wine and olive oil. The Lord Will Rescue His People
text: Ŋijikaapaa mɔmɔk ga gbiin tijikaar; ndaan aasubil ni nkpan mu ga li wiir.

ref: I, the Lord your God, will make up for the losses caused by those swarms and swarms of locusts I sent to attack you.
text: M ga giin itoon aah di nimi aajikaar ti mɔmɔk ŋman ŋibin ŋi jer na ki ki di tii nimi. Min le nan tun ni itoon i wiir sakpen ngbaan na.

ref: My people, you will eat until you are satisfied. Then you will praise me for the wonderful things I have done. Never again will you be put to shame.
text: Dandana wee ma kan, ni ga kan sakpen ki ji bab. Ni ga pak Nidindaan Uwumbɔr u ŋa lijinjiir aawan ngbaan ki tii nimi na. Ubaa aan ki lik seen min Uwumbɔr aanib.

ref: Israel, you will know that I stand at your side. I am the Lord your God— there are no other gods. Never again will you be put to shame. The Lord Will Work Wonders The Lord said:
text: N‑yaayoonn ngbaan, le nimi Israel yaab ga bee ke m bi nikaasisik ni, ki bee ke min Uwumbɔr le ye Nidindaan, ubaa aa ki bi ki kpee m pu. Ubaa aan ki lik seen maanib. Uwumbɔr aawiin daal

ref: Later, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will have dreams, and your young men will see visions.
text: “N‑yoonn mu choo na, m ga di Maafuur Nyaan di ŋa maanib mɔmɔk pu: nijapɔtiib ni nibisatiib ga nabr min Uwumbɔr aah len pu na; nimi aaninkpiib ga daŋ tidaŋ, le nimi aanachipɔm ga kan lijinjiir aawan.

ref: In those days I will even give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women.
text: N‑yoonn ngbaan le m ga nan di Maafuur Nyaan ŋa maanaagbiijab ni maanaagbiipiib mu pu.

ref: I will work wonders in the sky above and on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
text: M ga ŋa lijinjiir aawan kitaapaak ni, ni kitiŋ pu; nsin, ni mmii, ni iŋmanyuu ga li bi.

ref: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before that great and terrible day when I appear.
text: Nwiin ga bɔln, le uŋmal mann ke nsin na waahr aan Uwumbɔr aawiin daal nin fuu ni. Mu ga li ye nwiin sakpiin mu kpa ijawaan na la.

ref: Then I, the Lord will save everyone who faithfully worships me. I have promised there will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and among them will be my chosen ones.
text: Liyaadaal ngbaan unii umɔk mee Uwumbɔr na, uma le ga ŋmar ke Uwumbɔr aah len pu na ke, ‘Bibaa bi Jerusalem aatiŋ ni ki ga ŋmar; bima le ye binib bi m lee bi ke bi ga ŋmar na.’”

ref: At that time I, the Lord, will make Judah and Jerusalem prosperous again.
text: Uwumbɔr len ke, “N‑yoonn ngbaan kan, m ga giin Juda ni Jerusalem aatim aawangol tii mu,

ref: Then in Judgment Valley I will bring together the nations that scattered my people Israel everywhere in the world, and I will bring charges against those nations. They divided up my land
text: le ki kuun ŋitimbol mɔmɔk ki nan ji ŋi tibɔr Libɔjil Aafataŋ ni. Baah tun maanib pu na le m ga ji bi tibɔr. Bi jenn yaa Israel yaab koon ntiyayam ponn ni, le ki chuu yakr maatiŋ Israel ngbaan.

ref: and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
text: Bi too inaan ke bi lik unii u ga li yeh binaagbiib bi bi chur na. Bi kooh mbijabim ni mpiibim ki di bi ŋa tinaagbiir ponn ni ke bi di ilik ngbaan pa pateer tiib ni ndaan pu.

ref: You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened.
text: “Taya, ni Saidonn, ni ntim mumɔk bi Filistia aatingbaan na, ba le ni ban ke ni ŋa mi? Ni pɔɔni nibaa ke ni pa mi lipɔln la aa? Kina le yaa ye nimi aalandak kan, m ga giin pa nimi mala.

ref: You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples.
text: Nimi le yoor maakunabr ni maasalmaa ki yoor maawangol ki di ti ŋa nimi aawaa aadir ni.

ref: You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.
text: Nimi le yoor Juda ni Jerusalem aanib ki di bi buen dandar, ki ti di bi kooh tii Griik yaab.

ref: But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you.
text: Dandana wee ma kan, m ban m buen ti nyan ni bi nin chee ni ti di bi kooh tii na la. M ga ŋa nimi ke naah nan ŋa bi pu na,

ref: I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment in Judgment Valley
text: le ki cha binib di nijapɔtiib ni nibisatiib kooh tii Juda yaab; le bi mu di bi kooh tii Seba yaab bi bi dandar na. Min Uwumbɔr le len kina.

ref: Say to the nations: “Get ready for war! Be eager to fight. Line up for battle and prepare to attack.
text: Moon tibɔr tee ŋitimbol mɔmɔk ponn ni ke: ‘Gor ki kiir butɔb man; yin nimi aajab bi ga ja kijaak na man; kuun nimi aatɔb aajab mɔmɔk ki li chuun man.

ref: Make swords out of plows and spears out of garden tools. Strengthen every weakling.”
text: Di nimi aakuu mɔɔ kijaak aajum man, ki di nimi aakpaacha tiib mɔɔ tikpaatunn. Hali binib bi bun na mɔmɔk ga buen butɔb ni.

ref: Hurry, all you nations! Come quickly. Ask the Lord to bring his warriors along.
text: Nimi ŋitimbol ŋimɔk mann goln na, ŋa mala ki dan man, ki kuun tɔb kifataŋ ni.’” Uwumbɔr, cha saajab sunn ni ki nan tak bi.

ref: You must come now to Judgment Valley, where the Lord will judge the surrounding nations.
text: “Ŋitimbol mɔmɔk, gor nibaa, ki dan Libɔjil Aafataŋ ni, nin chee Uwumbɔr ga ji binib tibɔr na. Le min Uwumbɔr ga kal ki ji ŋitimbol ŋimɔk mann goln na tibɔr.

ref: They are a field of ripe crops. Bring in the harvest! They are grapes piled high. Start trampling them now! If our enemy's sins were wine, every jar would overflow.
text: Bi ye bibiindam la; gaa bi lii kitiŋ man ke baah bar ŋikalmaan pu na; muen bi ke baah mueni ŋisubil pu ki nyani ŋaanyun aan mu ti wiir na man.”

ref: Crowds fill Decision Valley. The judgment day of the Lord will soon be here—
text: Binib ŋichur ŋichur le gbii Libɔjil Aafataŋ ngbaan ni. Nima chee le Uwumbɔr aawiin ngbaan ga gbeen fuu ni mala.

ref: no light from the sun or moon, and stars no longer shine.
text: Nwiin ni uŋmal ga bɔln, le iŋmabi aan ki li wiin. Uwumbɔr ga ŋa tinyoor ŋa waanib pu

ref: From the heart of Jerusalem the Lord roars like a lion, shaking the earth and sky. But the Lord is a fortress, a place of safety for his people Israel. God Will Bless His People
text: Uwumbɔr tar ke uchinn na Sionn aajool pu; uneel nyan ni Jerusalem aatiŋ ni, ke utaal aah tar pu na; le kitiŋ ni kitaapaak jii. U mu tee ga li kii waanib.

ref: I am the Lord your God. And you will know I live on Zion, my sacred hill, because Jerusalem will be sacred, untouched by foreign troops.
text: “N‑yoonn ngbaan, le nimi Israel yaab ga bee ke min le ye Nidindaan Uwumbɔr. M bi Sionn, maajool li bi chain na pu la; Jerusalem ga li ye kitiŋ ki bi chain na la; le kaadim aan ki ŋmaa nyaŋ ki daalbaadaal.

ref: On that day, fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains. And your cattle and goats that graze on the hills will produce a lot of milk. Streams in Judah will never run dry; a stream from my house will flow in Acacia Valley.
text: N‑yoonn ngbaan kan, ŋijoo mɔmɔk pu ga li ye ikpaakon la; le inaa ga li bi ŋigongon mɔmɔk pu; le Juda aakpen mɔmɔk ponn ni ga li kpa nnyun pam. Nnyun ga li puu nyan ni Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni, ki sɔŋ Sitim Aafataŋ.

ref: Egypt and Edom were cruel and brutal to Judah, without a reason. Now their countries will become a barren desert,
text: Ijipt ni Edom aatim ga kpaln nin chee nnyun aa bi na la. Litambol ŋmeen le ga li gur bi nima, ba pu? bima le buen ti tak ki ku Juda aanib bi kaa tun taani ubaa na.

ref: I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel. Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel,
text: Tibɔr ti Amos u ye upihkpaal ki nyan ni Tekoa aatiŋ ni na nan len na sɔ. Ŋibin ŋilee waahr aan kitiŋ nin deŋ na, n‑yoonn ngbaan le Usia nan ye Juda aabɔrkpaan aan Jehoas aajapɔɔn Jeroboam mu nan ye Israel aabɔrkpaan na, le Uwumbɔr nan kpiir Israel aatiŋ aabɔr timina mɔmɔk tuk Amos.

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Syria for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged logs with spikes over the people of Gilead.
text: Uwumbɔr len ke, “Damaskus yaab aah tun titunwanbir n‑yoonn mɔmɔk pu na, kina le ga cha m sil daa bitafal. Bi ŋa Gilead yaab mbiin sakpen.

ref: Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.
text: Kina pu na, m ga cha mmii wu ubɔrkpaan Hasael aabɔrdichal, ki see ubɔrkpaan Ben‑Hadad aadichal ŋi fɔk ki pɔɔ na mɔmɔk mmii.

ref: I will break through the gates of Damascus. I will destroy the people of Wicked Valley and the ruler of Beth-Eden. Then the Syrians will be dragged as prisoners to Kir. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Philistia
text: M ga gbaa wii Damaskus aatiŋ aabisamɔi mɔmɔk, le ki jenn nyan Afenn Aafataŋ ni aanib ni Bef Edenn aayidaan. Le bi ga chur Siria aanib mɔmɔk tinaagbiir ki di bi buen Kir aatiŋ ni.” Filistia aatiŋ yaab

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Philistia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
text: Uwumbɔr ki len ke, “Filistia yaab Gasa aatiŋ aah tun titunwanbir n‑yoonn mɔmɔk pu na, kina le ga cha m sil daa bitafal. Bi ŋa litimbol mɔln aanib mbiin ki di bi kooh tii Edom yaab.

ref: That's why I will burn down the walls and fortresses of the city of Gaza.
text: Kina pu na, m ga cha mmii wu Gasa aatiŋ aagon, ni kaadichal ŋi fɔk ki pɔɔ aan bi maa kiir bibaa na mɔmɔk.

ref: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron, and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Phoenicia
text: M ga chuu nyan Filistia yaab aatim Asdod ni Askelonn aayidam. M ga daa baatiŋ Ekronn aanib aatafal, le Filistia yaab bi mɔmɔk gur na ga kpoi.” Taya aatiŋ yaab

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Phoenicia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
text: Uwumbɔr ki len ke, “Taya aatiŋ aanib aah tun titunwanbir n‑yoonn mɔmɔk pu na, kina le ga cha m sil daa bitafal. Bi ŋa ntimɔln aanib mbiin ki di bi kooh tii Edom yaab, kaa joo limaantɔl aajɔtiik ki bi nan puu tii tɔb na.

ref: That's why I will send flames to burn down the city of Tyre along with its fortresses. Judgment on Edom
text: Kina pu na, m ga cha mmii wu Taya aatiŋ aagon, ni kaadichal ŋi fɔk ki pɔɔ aan bi maa kiir bibaa na mɔmɔk.” Edom aatiŋ yaab

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.
text: Uwumbɔr ki len ke, “Edom yaab aah tun titunwanbir n‑yoonn mɔmɔk pu na, le ga cha m sil daa bitafal. Bi tee mban ki ban bi ŋa binaabitiib Israel yaab mbiin ki ku bi, kaa san bi kinimbaak. Baaŋuul pɔɔ kaa sɔŋni kpala.

ref: Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah. Judgment on Ammon
text: Kina pu na, m ga cha mmii wu baatiŋ Temann aagon, ni baatiŋ Bosra aadichal ŋi fɔk ki pɔɔ aan bi maa kiir bibaa na mɔmɔk.” Amonn aatiŋ yaab

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.
text: Uwumbɔr ki len ke, “Amonn yaab aah tun titunwanbir n‑yoonn mɔmɔk pu na, kina le ga cha m sil daa bitafal. Baah nan jaa kijaak ki ban ntim bi kpee baatiŋ pu na, bi nan ŋa Gilead yaab mbiin pam ki saa gber baapudam aapuu ki nyan mbipɔm.

ref: Ammon's king and leaders will be dragged away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: Le baadim ga di baabɔrkpaan ni waaninkpiib buen tinaagbiir ni.”

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Moab for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They made lime from the bones of the king of Edom.
text: Uwumbɔr ki len ke, “Moab yaab aah tun titunwanbir n‑yoonn mɔmɔk pu na, kina le ga cha m sil daa bitafal. Bi nan jinn Edom aabɔrkpaan aakpab inimɔɔn ki see i mmii ki cha i wun ki ti kpaln nfatan.

ref: Now I will send fire to destroy the fortresses of Kerioth. Battle shouts and trumpet blasts will be heard as I destroy Moab
text: M ga cha mmii wu Moab aatiŋ, ki see baatiŋ Keriof aadichal ŋi fɔk ki pɔɔ aan bi maa kiir bibaa na mɔmɔk. Buyoonn butɔb aajab ga li tar aan kakaan tiib wii ki kpa kifuuk na, le Moab aanib ga kpoi.

ref: with its king and leaders. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Judah
text: M ga ku Moab yaab aayidaan ni baaninkpiib mɔmɔk.” Juda aatiŋ yaab

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Judah for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They have rejected my teachings and refused to obey me. They were led astray by the same false gods their ancestors worshiped.
text: Uwumbɔr ki len ke, “Juda yaab aah tun titunwanbir n‑yoonn mɔmɔk pu na, kina le ga cha m sil daa bitafal. Bi lik maamɔkm fam, kaa kii maamɔb. Biyaajatiib aah nan dii inyamɔn aawaa ŋi na le ŋmann bi koon timoor ni.

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Israel for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They sell honest people for money, and the needy are sold for the price of sandals.
text: Uwumbɔr ki len ke, “Israel yaab aah tun titunwanbir n‑yoonn mɔmɔk pu na, kina le ga cha m sil daa bitafal. Bi joo bininyaam le kooh ke bi di teen baapɔln, hali bigiim bi kaan ŋmaa pa ŋinaatak aadaak na, bi kooh bi mu la.

ref: They smear the poor in the dirt and push aside those who are helpless. My holy name is dishonored, because fathers and sons sleep with the same young women.
text: Bi jon ki taar binib bi kaa kpa mpɔɔn na pu, le ki tur bigiim lir isan ni. Le uja ni ute kpaani unaagbiipiibo baan, kina le bi bii maayimbil li bi chain na.

ref: They lie down beside altars on clothes taken as security for loans. And they drink wine in my temple, wine bought with the money they received from fines.
text: Bijab doo kitork aabimbin mɔmɔk ponn ni, tiwanpeenkaan ni bi gaa bigiim chee ki joo teeni baah jin ŋipɔln ŋi pu na la. Maadichal ni, bi nyu ndaan mu bi gaa baapɔlndam chee na la.

ref: Israel, the Amorites were there when you entered Canaan. They were tall as cedars and strong as oaks. But I wiped them out— I destroyed their branches and their roots.
text: “Maanib, nimi pu le m nan ku doo Amonn yaab, bima le ye bijab bi nan fɔk ke santina aasui ki pɔɔ ke ŋikpan aasui na.

ref: I had rescued you from Egypt, and for forty years I had led you through the desert. Then I gave you the land of the Amorites.
text: Min le nyan ni nimi Ijipt aatiŋ ni, ki di nimi dii nteersakpiin ni, ŋibin imonko ilee, le ki di Amor yaab aatiŋ tii nimi, le ki kpaln nimi aatiŋ.

ref: I chose some of you to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. People of Israel, you know this is true. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: Min le nan lee nijapɔtiib bibaa bi li ye maabɔnabtiib, le ki lee biken mu bi li ye maatutum bi puu ke baan nyu ndaan kpala na. Israel yaab, m gii la aa? Min Uwumbɔr le len kina.

ref: But you commanded the prophets not to speak their message, and you pressured the Nazirites into drinking wine.
text: Le ni cha maatutum ngbaan nyu ndaan, ki bui maabɔnabtiib na ke bi taa nabr maabɔr.

ref: And so I will crush you, just as a wagon full of grain crushes the ground.
text: Dandana, m ga ŋa nimi ke unii u tu lituln aan li nyaŋ u na la.

ref: No matter how fast you run, you won't escape. No matter how strong you are, you will lose your strength and your life.
text: Hali, binib bi ŋmaa san sakpen na aan ŋmar; bipɔɔndam aapɔɔn ga doo, le butɔb aajab aan ki ŋmaa gaa bibaa lii.

ref: Even if you are an expert with a bow and arrow, you will retreat. And you won't get away alive, not even if you run fast or ride a horse.
text: Binib bi joo itɔi na aan ki ŋmaa sil ki too, le bitaasam aan ŋmaa san ŋmar, bijab bi dik itaan pu na mu aan ŋmaa ŋmar.

ref: You may be brave and strong, but you will run away, stripped naked. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: Liyaadaal ngbaan kan, hali butɔb aajab bi kaar sakpen na ga di baajawan mae ki san.” Uwumbɔr le len kina.

ref: People of Israel, I rescued you from Egypt. Now listen to my judgment against you.
text: Israel yaab, linibomɔln li Uwumbɔr nyan li Ijipt aatiŋ ni na, li pel man nimi aabɔr ti u len na.

ref: Of all nations on earth, you are the only one I have chosen. That's why I will punish you because of your sins. The Work of a Prophet
text: “Dulnyaa aanibol mɔmɔk ponn ni, nimi baanja le m nyi nimi ki lik nimi, nibaa taa ŋa nimi. Nima le cha nimi aatunwanbir bir sakpen, ki cha m ga sil daa nitafal.” Uwumbɔr aabɔnabr aatuln

ref: Can two people walk together without agreeing to meet?
text: Bijab bilee aan ŋmaa kpaan piin lisachuln kaa puen kpokl waahr.

ref: Does a lion roar in the forest unless it has caught a victim? Does it growl in its den unless it is eating?
text: Uchinn yaa kaa kee kan tinann kan, waan teen kipɔɔk ni. Uchinn u laa diin na yaa kaa chuu nibaa waabuu ni kan, waa ŋuuni.

ref: How can anyone catch a bird without using a net? Does a trap spring shut unless something is caught?
text: Tijikaar yaa kaa bi gaawɔb ni kan, unyoon aan koo u ni aan u chuu u. Nibaa yaa kaa taa gaawɔb pu kan, waan too.

ref: Isn't the whole city frightened when the trumpet signals an attack? Isn't the Lord the one who brings disaster on a city?
text: Ukpiin yaa wii kitiŋ ni kan, ijawaan chur binib mɔmɔk la. Tibɔbir aan ŋmaa koo ni kitisakpeŋ ni kaa nyan ni Uwumbɔr chee.

ref: Whatever the Lord God plans to do, he tells his servants, the prophets.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr aa ŋani waawan nibaa kaa puen di ni kpiir mɔk waatutum bi ye waabɔnabtiib na.

ref: Everyone is terrified when a lion roars— and ordinary people become prophets when the Lord God speaks. Samaria Is Doomed
text: Uchinn yaa ŋuun kan, ijawaan chur binib mɔmɔk la. Tidindaan Uwumbɔr yaa len tibɔr kan, ŋma bi kaan nabr ti tii biken? Samaria aatiŋ aadoon

ref: Here is a message for the leaders of Philistia and Egypt— tell everyone to come together on the hills of Samaria. Let them see the injustice and the lawlessness in that city.
text: Moon ki tuk binib bi mɔmɔk bi Ijipt ni Asdod aabɔrdichal ni na ke, “Kuun man ki buen ŋijoo ŋi mann goln Samaria aatiŋ na, ki ti lik tiwan yɔl yɔl ni titunwanbir ti bi ŋani nima chee na.”

ref: The Lord has said that they don't even know how to do right. They have become rich from violence and robbery.
text: Uwumbɔr le len ke, “Binib bimina di baah gaa tiwan ni mpɔɔn na le di gbiin baadichal sakpiin ngbaan ponn ni. Baa nyi baah ga ŋa pu ki ŋa tiwan ni ŋan na.

ref: And so the Lord God has sworn that they will be surrounded. Enemies will break through their defenses and steal their treasures.
text: Kina pu na, baadim le ga mann goln baatiŋ, ki nyaŋ baajab bi to butɔb na, ki gbaa wii baadichal sakpiin ngbaan.”

ref: The Lord has promised that only a few from Samaria will escape with their lives and with some broken pieces of their beds and couches. It will be like when a shepherd rescues two leg bones and part of a sheep's ear from the jaws of a lion. The Altars at Bethel
text: Uwumbɔr ki len ke, “Samaria aanib bi ka ŋibɔrjal pu na ga nan gur siib ke Uchinn yaa chuu upiih ki ŋman kan, unaakpaal ga ti kan waah ŋman gur itaayakr bee litafal libaa pu na la. Kina le Samaria aanib siib ga ŋmar, le lijal ni tiwandookaan aageln baanja ga li gur baawangol ponn ni.”

ref: The Lord God All-Powerful told me to speak this message against Jacob's descendants:
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan ki len ke, “Li pel man, ki sur Jakob aayaabitiib

ref: When I, the Lord, punish Israel for their sins, I will destroy the altars at Bethel. Even the corners of the altar will be left in the dirt.
text: ke bundaal m ga daa Israel yaab aatafal baatunwanbir pu na kan, m ga gbaa wii ŋiwaabimbin ŋi bi Betel aatiŋ ni na mɔmɔk. Ŋibimbin ngbaan mɔmɔk aamɔju ga wii ki lir kitiŋ.

ref: I will tear down winter homes and summer homes. Houses decorated with ivory and all other mansions will be gone forever. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: M ga wii naah maa lipeel aadichal, ni kiseek aadichal ŋi na mɔmɔk. Naah di iluub aanyin di ŋa tidir ti pu ke ti li ŋan na mɔmɔk ga lir; lidichasakpeln libaa aan gur kaan bii.”

ref: You women of Samaria are fat cows! You mistreat and abuse the poor and needy, then you say to your husbands, “Bring us more drinks!”
text: Samaria aapiib, li pel man tibɔr timina, nimi bi filk ke Basann aanaa i jin ki bab na, nimi bi muk binib bi kaa kpa mpɔɔn, ni bigiim na, nimi bi muk nichatiib ke bi li tii nimi ndaan n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na, li pel man.

ref: I, the Lord God, have sworn by my own name that your time is coming. Not one of you will be left— you will be taken away by sharp hooks.
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr aah bi chain kaa kpa tijɔŋ tibaa na, u puu ke, “Iwiin ibaa choo, le bi ga nan di ijapiin dar nimi buen; ni mɔmɔk ga li bi ke ijan i ijapiin chur i na la.

ref: You will be dragged through holes in your city walls, and you will be thrown toward Harmon. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel Refuses To Obey The Lord said:
text: Bi ga dar fuul nimi ki di baan mae ligoln aah wii nin chee na, Harmonn wɔb.” Israel yaab aah kaan bae pu na aabɔr

ref: Bring offerings to show me how thankful you are. Gladly bring more offerings than I have demanded. You really love to do this. I, the Lord God, have spoken! How the Lord Warned Israel
text: Di nimi aaboroboro tii Uwumbɔr ki doon u waah ter nimi pu na, ki li kpa kipupuk naah ki tii ipiin i kpee na pu. Naah gee ke ni li ŋani tiwan ni na le na.

ref: I, the Lord, took away the food from every town and village, but still you rejected me.
text: “Min le nan lii nimi nkon, nimi aatikpaan ponn ni, le naa kee gir ni m chee.

ref: Three months before harvest, I kept back the rain. Sometimes I would let it fall on one town or field but not on another, and pastures dried up.
text: Min le nan chuu utaal buyoonn nimi aajikaar nan ban utaal sakpen na. M nan cha utaal nu kitiŋ kibaa ni, kaa nu kiken ni. Utaal nan nun bukpaab bubaa ni, le buken ma kuur.

ref: People from two or three towns would go to a town that still had water, but it wasn't enough. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: Binib nan di nnyunyuu ki nyan kitiŋ kibaa ponn ni, ki buen kitiŋ kiken ponn ni, ki dak ke nnyun bi nima, le bi mɔmɔk aa ti ŋmaa kan bi nyu. Nimina mɔmɔk mu aa cha ni gir ni m chee.

ref: I dried up your grain fields; your gardens and vineyards turned brown. Locusts ate your fig trees and olive orchards, but even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: “M nan tun ni libuln li ton sakpen na ke li nan kuur nimi aajikaar. Le itoon dan nan di nimi aasar mɔmɔk ŋman, ki ŋman nimi aawanyukaan aasui, ni ŋisubil, ni nkpan aasui mu. Nee mu aapuwɔb na, naa ki gir ni m chee.

ref: I did terrible things to you, just as I did to Egypt— I killed your young men in war; I let your horses be stolen, and I made your camp stink with dead bodies. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: “Le m tun ni iween nan lii ni pu ke maah nan di lii Ijipt aatiŋ ni pu na. M nan ku nimi aanachipɔm butɔb ni, ki di nimi aataan mu buen. Le ŋinikpol aanunun gbiin nimɔfataabun ni, ni nimi aakookoo yaan chee. Nee aapuwɔb na, naa di cha nimi aatunwanbir ki gir ni m chee ke m di cha pinn nimi.

ref: I destroyed many of you, just as I did the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. You were a burning stick I rescued from the fire. But even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: “M nan doo nimi bibaa ke maah nan doo Sodom ni Gomora yaab pu na. Nimi bi nan ŋmar na nan naahn limiidɔtɔgeln la. Nee mu aa cha ni gir ni m chee.” Min Uwumbɔr le len kina.

ref: I created the mountains and the wind. I let humans know what I am thinking. I bring darkness at dawn and step over hills. I am the Lord God All-Powerful!
text: Uma Uwumbɔr le naan ŋijoo sakpiin, ki naan libuln mu. U joo waakaal kpiir tuk unibɔn; u kpeln nwiin pu ŋani kinyeek. U chuun dulnyaa wee ni, nin chee fɔk sakpen na. Waayimbil sɔ: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan.

ref: Listen, nation of Israel, to my mournful message:
text: Israel aanib, li pel man nkpolahn mu m gaa ni pu na:

ref: You, dearest Israel, have fallen, never to rise again— you lie deserted in your own land, with no one to help you up.
text: Israel aatiŋ lir a, kaan ki fii sil kpala. Ki kpo bee kitiŋ, le ubaa aan ter ki, ki fii sil.

ref: The Lord God has warned, “From every ten soldiers only one will be left; from a thousand troops, only a hundred will survive.”
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr le len ke, “Israel aatiŋ kibaa ponn ni ga nyan butɔb aajab lichur ke bi ti to butɔb, le nkub baanja le ga ŋmar ki gir ni; le kiken mu ga nyan nkub, le kipiik baanja le ga ŋmar ki gir ni.”

ref: The Lord keeps saying, “Israel, turn back to me and you will live!
text: Le Uwumbɔr bui Israel yaab ke, “Dan m chee man, aan ki kan limɔfal.

ref: Don't go to Gilgal or Bethel or even to Beersheba. Gilgal will be dragged away, and Bethel will end up as nothing.”
text: Taa ki buen Beerseba ke ni ti mee limeel. Taa buen Betel, ke ni ban mi. Betel aatiŋ ga nan doo fam la. Taa buen man Gilgal aatiŋ ni mu, bi ga di nima yaab buen tinaagbiir ni.”

ref: Turn back to the Lord, you descendants of Joseph, and you will live. If you don't, the Lord will attack like fire. Bethel will burn to the ground, and no one can save it.
text: Li cha man Uwumbɔr chee ki ti kan limɔfal. Ni yaa kaa ŋa kina kan, u ga dan Israel yaab pu ke kimosakpeŋ aamii na la. Mmii ngbaan ga wu Betel yaab, le ubaa aan ŋmaa junn mu.

ref: You people are doomed! You twist the truth and trample on justice.
text: Nimi bi len ibamɔngangal ki ji binib biken baabamɔn pu na, ni kpoi doo a.

ref: But the Lord created the stars and put them in place. He turns darkness to dawn and daylight to darkness; he scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth.
text: Uwumbɔr le naan iŋmabi, ni paacham aawan mɔmɔk. U kpeln mbɔmbɔɔn ki di ŋa nwiihn, ki di nwiin pu mu kpeln ŋa kinyeek. Uma le yin nnyusakpem aanyun, ki joo kpir kitiŋ pu. Waayimbil le ye Uwumbɔr.

ref: You people hate judges and honest witnesses;
text: Nimi le nan binib bi len ibamɔn kaa gee inyamɔn aabɔr na.

ref: you abuse the poor and demand heavy taxes from them. You have built expensive homes, but you won't enjoy them; you have planted vineyards, but you will get no wine.
text: Ni muk bigiim le ki gaal baah kpa tijikaar ni tiwan siib ni na. Kina pu na, naan koo ŋitakpal aadichanyaan ŋi ni maa siin na ni, kaan nyu naah ŋum ŋisubil aasui i na aadaan mu.

ref: I am the Lord, and I know your terrible sins. You cheat honest people and take bribes; you rob the poor of justice.
text: M nyi nimi aatunwanbir sakpenn ti ni ŋani na aakahm. Ni ŋani binibamɔm mbiin, le ki gaal igaŋgaŋlik, le ki cha bigiim aa ŋmaa kani ibamɔn libɔjil ni.

ref: Times are so evil that anyone with good sense will keep quiet.
text: Kina pu na, kinimbɔŋ aayoonn ngbaan kan, unii u kpa nlan na ga li ŋmin suuna la.

ref: If you really want to live, you must stop doing wrong and start doing right. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, will then be on your side, just as you claim I am.
text: Cha tiwan ni ŋan na li ye tiwan ni ni ban na, ki taa li ban kinimbɔŋ aabɔr, ki li kpa limɔfal; le Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan ga sil li bi ni chee, ke naah len ke u bi ni chee pu na.

ref: Choose good instead of evil! See that justice is done. Maybe I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be kind to what's left of your people. Judgment Is Coming
text: Li nan kinimbɔŋ man, ki li gee tiwan ni ye ibamɔn na, aan ki cha ibamɔn li bi libɔjil ponn ni. Nibaakan, Uwumbɔr ga san binib bi gur linibol limina ni kaa kpoi na kinimbaak.

ref: This is what the Lord has sworn: Noisy crying will be heard in every town and street. Even farmers will be told to mourn for the dead, together with those who are paid to mourn.
text: Kina pu na, Tidindaan Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na le len ke, “Kinimbaak aawiil le bi ga li kaani kitisakpeŋ aasan pu. Hali bikpaab ga nyan ni baasar ni ke bi nan wii binib bi kpoi na aakpowiil ki ter baah pan binib bi ke bi wii ikpowiil na.

ref: Your vineyards will be filled with crying and weeping, because I will punish you. I, the Lord, have spoken! When the Lord Judges
text: Ndaan aasubil aasar mɔmɔk ponn ni ye ikpowiil ŋmeen la. Nimina mɔmɔk ga ŋa, ba pu? m choo m nan daa nitafal la.” Uwumbɔr le len kina.

ref: You look forward to the day when the Lord comes to judge. But you are in for trouble! It won't be a time of sunshine; all will be darkness.
text: Naan nan li ŋan tii nimi bi kii Uwumbɔr aawiin ngbaan na. Nwiin ngbaan daal aan nan joo ni tiwan nibaa ni ŋan. Ba pu? mu ga nan li ye libɔmbɔln ŋmeen kaan li kpa nwiihn.

ref: You will run from a lion, only to meet a bear. You will escape to your house, rest your hand on the wall, and be bitten by a snake.
text: Ni ga nan li naahn ke unii aah san uchinn chee ki ti tooh upeenaamuun nsan ni pu na la, ki li bi ke unii u kun ni linampal ki nan di uŋaal paan ligoln pu aan uwaa kpaan juu u pu na la.

ref: The day when the Lord judges will be dark, very dark, without a ray of light. What the Lord Demands
text: Uwumbɔr aawiin ngbaan daal ga joo ni libɔmbɔln ŋmeen la, naan li ye nwiihn; mu ga li ye nwiin mu bɔɔn timm kaan li wiin kpala na la.

ref: I, the Lord, hate and despise your religious celebrations and your times of worship.
text: Uwumbɔr ki len ke, “Maa gee naah kuuni ki ji njim ki dooni mi pu na; naa ŋan m chee kpala.

ref: No more of your noisy songs! I won't listen when you play your harps.
text: Di cha naah gaa ilahn mpɔɔn pu ki gbaa tibar ki tii mi na man. Maan pel.

ref: But let justice and fairness flow like a river that never runs dry.
text: Naah ga ŋa pu ki piir nsui na sɔ: Cha ibamɔn ni mbimbinyaan li wiir ke limɔɔl aanyun aah wiir kaa door pu na.

ref: Israel, for forty years you wandered in the desert, without bringing offerings or sacrifices to me.
text: “Israel aanib, maa nan ban kitork ni ipiin ibaa ŋibin imonko ilee ŋi ponn ni m nan di nimi dii ni litambol ŋmeen aatiŋ ni na ni chee.

ref: Now you will have to carry the two idols you made— Sakkuth, the one you call king, and Kaiwan, the one you built in the shape of a star.
text: Tɔ, dandana wee, naah dii ki toor liwaal Sakuf li ye nimi aawaabɔr na, ni liwaal Kaiwann li ye liŋmabil aanaŋ na, nima pu na, ni ga li joo tiwanaankaan ngbaan

ref: I will force you to march as captives beyond Damascus. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken!
text: le m ga di nimi buen tinaagbiir ni, kitiŋ ki bi Damaskus aatiŋ aapuwɔb na ni,” Tidindaan u aayimbil ye Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan na le len kina.

ref: Do you rulers in Jerusalem and in the city of Samaria feel safe and at ease? Everyone bows down to you, and you think you are better than any other nation. But you are in for trouble!
text: Nimi bi bi dafir Sionn aatiŋ ni, ni nimi bi dak ke ni kan limɔfal Samaria aatiŋ ni na, naan nan li ŋan ni pu, nimi bi ye linibokpaan Israel na aaninkpiib, nimi bi binib biken chaa ni chee ki ti ban nterm na,

ref: Look what happened to the cities of Calneh, powerful Hamath, and Gath in Philistia. Are you greater than any of those kingdoms?
text: li cha ti lik man Kalne aatisakpeŋ na, ki buen man Hamaf aatisakpeŋ ki kpa mpɔɔn na, ki sunn buen Filistia yaab aatisakpeŋ Gaf chee. Mu aa ŋan ki jer Juda ni Israel aanaan. Le mu aatingbaan mu aa wiir jer nimi yoo.

ref: You rich people lounge around on beds with ivory posts, while dining on the meat of your lambs and calves.
text: Nimi bi dɔ nimi aawandookaan ni diin ki ŋan na pu, ki ji n‑yaan ni nkpan na, naa ga nan li ŋan tii nimi kpala.

ref: You sing foolish songs to the music of harps, and you make up new tunes, just as David used to do.
text: Ni gee ke ni li naani ilahn ke David aah nan naani pu na, ki joo gbaa tibar.

ref: You drink all the wine you want and wear expensive perfume, but you don't care about the ruin of your nation.
text: Ni nyu ndaan tiyikur ti wiir na ponn ni, ki ŋani tulalee tiib bi nu mɔ sakpen na, kaa tee wii Israel aah ga bii pu na aakpowiil.

ref: So you will be the first to be dragged off as captives; your good times will end.
text: Kina pu na, nimi le ga puen buen tinaagbiir ni. Le nimi aajim mɔmɔk ga doo.

ref: The Lord God All-Powerful has sworn by his own name: “You descendants of Jacob make me angry by your pride, and I hate your fortresses. And so I will surrender your city and possessions to your enemies.”
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan le tii nsurm mumina: “M nan Israel yaab aagaak, kaa neen baadichasakpiin ŋi kpa kinyaan ni tiwan mɔmɔk na. M ga di baatiyil ni tiwan ni mɔmɔk bi ki ponn ni na di tii baadim.”

text: Itaan san ŋitakpasakpiin pu uu? Bijab joo inaaja ko nima aa? Le nimi tee di ibamɔn kpaln njinn, ki di mbamɔn kpaln inyamɔn.

text: Kina pu na, Uwumbɔr le len sin Amasia chee na, ‘Aapuu ga kpaln upiidagoor le kitiŋ kimina ponn ni, le bi ga ku saabim mu butɔb ni. Bi ga yakr saatiŋ tii biniyayam, le sin aabaa ga ti kpo kitiyayaŋ ni la. Le bidim ga sil chuu Israel yaab ki di bi buen kitiyayaŋ ni.’”

text: Ni bui nibaa ke, “Taan ŋmaa kiir ke iwinyaan daal ti jer waahr aan ti nin kooh timi aajikaar. Bayoonn aan likpaakool aawiin ga doo, aan ti ki piin ki kooh timi aawan, ki cha ti tii kidaak ki pɔɔ na, ki di tiwaŋaŋkaan ni kaa ye nibamɔnn na di ŋaŋ ki ji biwandaab?

text: Titunwanbirdam bi ŋmal maanib ni na ga kpoi butɔb ni, binib bi mɔmɔk len ke, ‘Uwumbɔr aan cha kinimbɔŋ duun ni timi’ na ga kpoi.” Baah ga ki gir maa Israel aatiŋ pu na
