text: Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aapɔɔn pu le m tun lijinjiir aatun, ke bi bee waah kpa mpɔɔn pu na. Kina le m mooni Kristo aabɔnyaan mɔmɔk Jerusalem ponn ni, ki di ti saa Ilirikum aatiŋ ni.

ref: But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation.
text: Nnimbil nan man ke m moon Kristo aabɔnyaan tee, binib aah kaa kee ŋun ti pu nin chee na. Maa nan ban m buen biken aah puen moon ti nin chee na.

ref: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
text: Ba pu? ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ponn ni ke, “Binib bi kaa kee ŋun waabɔr na, bi ga ŋun, ki bee taatataa.” Pɔɔl aah ŋa nlandak ke u mann Rom yaab pu na

ref: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.
text: Tɔ, maah ban m moon tibɔnyaan tee nima chee na, nima pu le maa kee kan nsan ke m dan ni chee.

ref: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
text: Ŋibin pam aakaasisik ni, le nnimbil man ke m dan ni chee. Maah kaa ki kpa lituln do chee na na, m ban ke m dan ni chee dandana wee la.

ref: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
text: M yaa cha Speenn aatiŋ ni kan, m ban ke m dii ni chee, ki nan mann nimi, ki yunn ni chee siib, aan ki li kpa mpopiin. Nima kan, ni ga ŋmaa ter mi m buen Speenn aatiŋ ni.

ref: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
text: Ba pu? Yesu aanib bi bi Masedonia aatim ni, ni Akaya aatim ni na, nan too ŋimombil baageehn pu ki di ŋa ŋŋaal ni, ke m ti di tii Uwumbɔr aanib bi ye bigiim na Jerusalem ponn ni.

ref: This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles.
text: Ni ye mbamɔn la, baageehn pu le bi nan tii bi. Ni ŋan ke bi tii bi; ba pu? tibɔnyaan tee nan nyan ni Jerusalem aanib chee le ki fuu ni bi chee. Nima le ni ŋan ke bi mu tii bi ipiin.

ref: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
text: M yaa fuu Jerusalem ki ti tii bi ipiin ngbaan kan, m ga nyan nima chee, ki dii ni chee, le ki nin buen Speenn aatiŋ ni.

ref: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
text: M nyi ke m yaa fuu ni ni chee kan, Kristo ga ŋa tinyoor sakpen ki ŋa ti pu.

ref: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
text: Nnaabitiib, Tidindaan Yesu Kristo pu, ni Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aageehn pu, m gaŋ nimi ke ni li mee Uwumbɔr linimaln ki tii mi,

ref: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
text: ke u biin m pu, aan Judea aatiŋ aanib bi kaa gaa Yesu ki kii na taa ku mi, ki mee u ke maah ga tii Uwumbɔr aanib ipiin i na, i ga li mɔ bi.

ref: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
text: Ni yaa mee Uwumbɔr kina tii mi aan u yaa kii kan, m ga fuu ni ni chee, ki ga li kpa mpopiin. Le m ni nimi aataakpab ga pɔɔk.

ref: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
text: Uwumbɔr u tii timi nsuudoon na li bi ni mɔmɔk chee. Amii.

ref: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
text: Tɔ, m ban ke ni gaa tina aabo Fiibi. U ye upii u ter Yesu aanib bi bi Senkrea aatiŋ ni na la.

ref: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
text: U nan ter binib pam ki ter m mu. Nima na, ni mu gaa u Tidindaan pu, naah ŋeer Uwumbɔr aanib pu na, ki li ter u waah ga li ban pu na.

ref: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
text: Ni doon Prisila ni uchal Akuila tii mi. Bi ye maatutuŋeer tiib Yesu Kristo aatuln ponn ni la.

ref: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.
text: M pu le bi mɔmɔk ba ga kpo. Nima le m dooni bi. Naa ye mi baanja le dooni bi. Yesu aanib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na mɔmɔk mu dooni bi.

ref: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
text: Ni doon Yesu aanib bi kuuni bido na. Ni doon njɔ Epanetus, u m gee u na, ki tii mi. Uma le puen gaa Kristo ki kii, Asia aatiŋ ni.

ref: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
text: Ni doon Mari tii mi. U nan tun lituln pam ki ter nimi.

ref: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
text: Ni doon nnaabitiib Andronikus ni Junia. Bi nan bi kiyondiik ni m chee. Bi kpa liyimbil Yesu aakpambalb chee, ki nan puen mi ki gaa Kristo ki kii.

ref: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
text: Ni doon njɔ Ampliatus tii mi. M gee u sakpen Tidindaan pu la.

ref: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
text: Ni doon njɔ Ubanus tii mi, u ye timi aatutuŋeer Kristo aatuln ponn ni. Ni doon Stakis u m gee u na ki tii mi,

ref: Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ. Greet Aristobulus and his family.
text: ki doon Apeles, u nyaŋ ntɔŋ Kristo pu na, ki doon Aristobulus aachiln ni aanib,

ref: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
text: ki doon nna aabo Herodionn, ki doon Nasisus aachiln ni aanib bi dii Tidindaan na.

ref: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
text: Ni doon Traifina ni Traifosa bi tun lituln tii Tidindaan na, ki doon tina aabogeehn Pesis u tun lituln pam tii Tidindaan na,

ref: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
text: ki doon Tidindaan aanibamɔnn Rufus, ni una u kpaln m mu aana na,

ref: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
text: ki doon Asinkritus ni Flegonn, ni Hemes, ni Patrobas, ni Hemas, ni tinaabitiib bi bi bi chee na,

ref: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
text: ki doon Filologus, ni Julia, ni Nereus ni uninkpan, ni Olimpas, ni Uwumbɔr aanib bimɔk bi bi chee na.

ref: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
text: Ni li dooni tɔb mbamɔm. Yesu Kristo aanib bi bi ŋipepel mɔmɔk ni na dooni nimi. Kookoo aasurm

ref: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
text: Nnaabitiib, m gaŋni nimi ke ni li nyi binib bi jaani nimi ki cha ni lir, ki kpak naah nan bae Uwumbɔr aabɔr ti na. Ni nya bi chee man.

ref: They want to serve themselves and not Christ the Lord. Their flattery and fancy talk fool people who don't know any better.
text: Binib bi bi kina na aa dii Tidindaan Yesu Kristo. Bi dii bima bibaa aasui aah ban pu na la. Bi kpa mmɔmɔɔn ki ŋmanni bininyaam.

ref: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
text: Nimi ma kan, binib mɔmɔk nyi naah kii Yesu Kristo aamɔb pu na. Nima le m kpa ni pu mpopiin sakpen. M ban ke ni li kpa nlan ki li tun lituln li ŋan na, ki li bi chain, ki taa li tun lituln li kaa ŋan na.

ref: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
text: Naan yunn, le Uwumbɔr u tii timi nsuudoon na, ga cha ni di nitaa taa kinimbɔŋ pu. Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu.

ref: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
text: Timoti, u ye maatutuŋeer na dooni nimi. Nnaabitiib Lusius, ni Jasonn, ni Sosipata mu dooni nimi.

ref: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
text: Min Tesius u ŋmee kigbaŋ kee tii Pɔɔl na, m mu dooni nimi Tidindaan pu.

ref: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
text: Cha ti nyuŋ Uwumbɔr. U kpa mpɔɔn ke u cha ni sil mbamɔm. Maah mooni Yesu Kristo aabɔnyaan ti na le len kina. Ti ye tibɔbɔrkaan ti kpiir na la. N‑yaayoonn na ti nan bɔr la.

ref: but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith.
text: Dandana wee, ti nyan mpaan pu. Uwumbɔr aabɔnabtiib nan ŋmee ti waagbaŋ ni. Uwumbɔr, u bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na le siin ke ŋinibol mɔmɔk ŋun tibɔnyaan ngbaan, aan ki bee, ki tii u naadii, ki kii waamɔb.

ref: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
text: Uwumbɔr baanja le kpa nlan. Ubaa aa ki bi. Uma le yeh mpakm Yesu Kristo pu, n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Amii.

ref: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
text: Min Pɔɔl u Yesu Kristo yin mi ke m le ye waakpambal, Uwumbɔr aageehn pu na, m ni tina aabo Sosenes le ŋmee kigbaŋ kee

ref: To God's church in Corinth. Christ Jesus chose you to be his very own people, and you worship in his name, as we and all others do who call him Lord.
text: tii Uwumbɔr aanib bi bi Korint aatiŋ ni na. Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan ŋa nimi bininyaam Yesu Kristo pu, ki yin nimi ke ni li ye waaninyaam, ni binib bimɔk yin Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aayimbil ntim mɔmɔk ni na. U ye Bidindaan, ni ti mu Aadindaan.

ref: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
text: Tite Uwumbɔr ni Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu ki tii nimi nsuudoon. Tinyoor ti bi Yesu Kristo ni na

ref: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
text: N‑yoonn mɔmɔk m dooni Maawumbɔr ni pu. Waah ŋa nimi tiŋann Yesu Kristo pu na, le m dooni u.

ref: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
text: Ba pu? taah nan tuk nimi Kristo aabɔr na, ni gaa ti mbamɔm.

ref: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.
text: Nima pu na, naa lann Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aapiin mubaa, ki bi ki kii bundaln Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ga gir ni na.

ref: And until the day Christ does return, he will keep you completely innocent.
text: U mu ga pɔɔ nimi aataakpab waasan wɔb, ni taa li kpa taani Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aataak daal.

ref: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
text: Uwumbɔr ŋani waah len pu na la. U yin nimi ke ni ni Ujapɔɔn Tidindaan Yesu Kristo li kpaan kijɔtiik ni tɔb. N‑yakr mu bi Yesu Kristo aadidiliib ponn ni na

ref: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
text: Nnaabitiib, m gaŋ nimi Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aayimbil pu ke ni mɔmɔk li ŋun tii tɔb, aan kinikpakpak taa li bi nikaasisik ni; ni li kpa kimɔbaan, ki li kpaan nlandak mubaa.

ref: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
text: Nnaabitiib, Kloe aachiln ni aanib tuk mi ke kinikpakpak bi nikaasisik ni.

ref: They have said that some of you claim to follow me, while others claim to follow Apollos or Peter or Christ.
text: Maah len pu na le ye ke ubaa len ke u dii Pɔɔl la, uken mu len ke u dii Apolos la, uken mu len ke u dii Piita la, uken mu len ke u dii Kristo la.

ref: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
text: Kristo yakr la aa? Bi kpaa min Pɔɔl ndɔpuinkoo pu ki tii nimi ii? Bi muin nimi nnyun ni Pɔɔl aayimbil ni la aa?

ref: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
text: M dooni Uwumbɔr ke maa muin ni ponn ni ubaa nnyun ni, see Krispus ni Gayus baanja.

ref: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
text: Nima pu na, ubaa aan ŋmaa len ke bi muin nimi nnyun ni maayimbil ni.

ref: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
text: M muin Stefanas aachiln ni aanib mu nnyun ni. M mu aa ki teer ke m muin unii uken kpee.

ref: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power. Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
text: Ba pu? Kristo aa tun ni mi ke m nan muin binib nnyun ni. U tun ni mi ke m nan tuk bi waabɔnyaan ngbaan la. Naa ye ke m di binib aalan le tuk bi. M yaa ba ŋa kina kan, ni ba ga cha Kristo aah kpo ndɔpuinkoo pu na ŋa yɔli. Yesu Kristo le ye Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn, ni waalan

ref: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
text: Binib bi ga kuln na, ti yaa tuk bi ke Kristo nan kpo ndɔpuinkoo pu ki tii bi kan, ni bi ke kijɔrk aaliin na le ki tii bi. Ni mu ye Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn le ki tii timi bi ŋmar na.

ref: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
text: Ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ponn ni ke uma Uwumbɔr bui ke, “M ga cha bilankpalb aalan bee yɔli, m ga yii binibiwolm aalan.”

ref: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
text: Bilankpalb bi la? Binibiwolm mu bi la? Dandana aanib bi kpak kinikpakpak na mu bi la? Uwumbɔr cha dulnyaa wee aalan ŋa yɔli.

ref: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
text: Uwumbɔr u kpa nlan na len ke dulnyaa wee aalan aa ŋmaa cha binib bee u. Nima pu na, u gaa binib bi gaa Yesu ki kii na lii, kijɔrk aabɔr ti ti joo tuk binib na pu. Waageehn le na.

ref: Jews ask for miracles, and Greeks want something that sounds wise.
text: Juu yaab ban ke bi kan lijinjiir aawan, le ki nin gaa Yesu ki kii, Griik yaab mu ban nlan.

ref: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
text: Le ti tuk bi Kristo aah kpo ndɔpuinkoo pu ki tii bi pu na. Ni ye liŋuul aabɔr le ki tii Juu yaab, ki ye kijɔrk aabɔr ki tii binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na mu.

ref: Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen.
text: Tɔ, Kristo le ye Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn ni waalan ki tii binib bi u yin bi na, bi ye Juu yaab na, ni bi kaa ye Juu yaab na mu.

ref: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
text: Ba pu? Uwumbɔr aajɔrk kpa nlan jer binib aalan, le waagiin mu kpa mpɔɔn jer binib aapɔɔn.

ref: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.
text: Nnaabitiib, teer naah nan bi pu buyoonn Uwumbɔr yin nimi na. Ni ponn ni, naa ye binib pam le nan kpa nlan, naa ye binib pam le nan ye mpɔɔndam, naa ye binib pam le nan ye mpɔɔn aamaal ni aanib.

ref: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
text: Uwumbɔr nyan binib bi ye bijɔrb dulnyaa ni aanib aanimbil ni na, le ki tee cha binib bi kpa nlan na ji inimɔɔn. U nyan binib bi ye bigiim dulnyaa ni aanib aanimbil ni na, le ki tee cha bipɔɔndam ji inimɔɔn.

ref: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
text: U nyan bigiim, ki nyan binib bi ye fam binib aanimbil ni na, ki nyan binib bi kaa ye nibaa binib aanimbil ni na mu, aan ki ŋa binib bi kpa ipɔɔn na yɔli.

ref: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
text: U ŋa kina ke unii ubaa taa li kpa kipupuk ubaa pu uma Uwumbɔr chee.

ref: You are God's children. He sent Christ Jesus to save us and to make us wise, acceptable, and holy.
text: Uwumbɔr cha ni ni Yesu Kristo kpaan la, ki cha u ye timi aalan. Yesu pu, le u len ke timi aabɔr ŋan, ki ŋa timi waaninyaam, ki gaa timi lii.

ref: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
text: Nima pu na, ni li ŋani naah ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ponn ni pu na ke, “Unii umɔk ban u li kpa kipupuk na, u li kpa kipupuk Uwumbɔr pu.”

ref: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
text: Nnaabitiib, nima pu na, maah nan dan nan tuk nimi Uwumbɔr aabɔr na, maa nan di mmɔmɔɔn ni binib aalan le tuk nimi.

ref: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
text: Ba pu? maa nan ban m dakl tibɔr tibaa nikaasisik ni see Yesu Kristo aabɔr, ni waah kpo ndɔpuinkoo pu pu na aabɔr.

ref: At first, I was weak and trembling with fear.
text: Maah nan bi ni chee na, m nan ye udabur la. Ijawaan pu, le nwon nan gbaa.

ref: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
text: M nan joo Uwumbɔr aaliin tuk nimi, kaa nan joo mmɔmɔɔn ni binib aalan tuk nimi. M nan tuk nimi Uwumbɔr aaliin ki mɔk nimi Waafuur Nyaan aah kpa mpɔɔn pu na;

ref: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
text: ba pu? m nan ban ke ni gaa Yesu ki kii Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn pu, ki taa li ye binib aalan pu. Uwumbɔr aalan

ref: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
text: Tɔ, ti len nlan aabɔr ki tuk binib bi chikr Uwumbɔr aabɔr wɔb na. Nlan ngbaan mu aa ye dulnyaa aalan, ki mu aa ye dulnyaa wee ni aabɔrb aalan. Dulnyaa wee ni aabɔrb aapɔɔn bi bar la.

ref: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.
text: Ti len Uwumbɔr aabɔbɔrkaan aalan mu nan bɔr na aabɔr la. Uwumbɔr aah kaa nan kee naan dulnyaa wee na, u nan dakl nlan mue, ke ti mu ji waamɔɔn.

ref: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
text: Dulnyaa wee ni aabɔr ubaa aa nyi nlan ngbaan. Bi yaa ba nyi kan, baa ba ga kpaa Tidindaan u yeh tiwan mɔmɔk na ndɔpuinkoo pu.

ref: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
text: Ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke, “Tiwan ni binib aanimbil aa kee kan ni, bitafal mu aa kee ŋun ni pu, aan baalandak aa kee dakl naabɔr na, nima le Uwumbɔr ŋa tii binib bi gee u na.”

ref: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
text: Le Uwumbɔr cha Waafuur Nyaan kpiir tiwan ngbaan mɔk timi. Ba pu? Nfuur Nyaan ngbaan nyi tiwan mɔmɔk, ki nyi Uwumbɔr aasui ni aabɔr mu.

ref: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
text: Unibɔn ma kan, ubaa aa nyi usui ni aabɔr. Waawiin mu bi u ni na baanja le nyi. Kina pu na, ubaa aa nyi Uwumbɔr aasui ni aabɔr, Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan baanja le nyi.

ref: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
text: Naa ye dulnyaa wee aabimbin le ti gaa. Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan le ti gaa, aan ki bee tiwan ni Uwumbɔr tii timi, waabulchinn pu na.

ref: Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people.
text: Tibɔr ngbaan le ti joo tuk binib. Naa ye iliin i binib aalan mɔk timi na, le ti joo tuk bi. Ti joo iliin i Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan mɔk timi na la. Ti joo Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aaliin le tuk binib Waafuur Nyaan aabɔr.

ref: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
text: Unii u kaa kpa Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan na, u yii Nfuur Nyaan aabɔr, ki dak ke Nfuur Nyaan aabɔr ye kijɔrk aabɔr la. Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan le cha binib bee mu aabɔr. Nima pu na, unii u kaa kpa Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan na aa ŋmaa bee mu aabɔr.

ref: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
text: Unii u kpa Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan na nyi tibɔr mɔmɔk, le unii ubaa aan bee udaan ngbaan aabimbin.

ref: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
text: Ŋma nyi Uwumbɔr aalandak? Ŋma ga ŋmaa mɔk u waah ga ŋa pu na? Timi le kpa Kristo aalandak.

ref: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
text: Nnaabitiib, maa ŋmaa len ni chee ke maah ga len binib bi kpa Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan na chee pu na. M len ni chee ke maah ga len binib bi dii dulnyaa aasan na chee pu na la. Ni laa ye mbipɔm le Kristo aasan ponn ni.

ref: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
text: Mbipɔm ŋaa libiil la. Baa ŋmaa ŋmɔ tinann. Kina le cha m nan tuk nimi iliin i diin na. Ba pu? naa nan kee ŋmaa beer iliin i pɔɔ na. Dandana wee naa kee nin bee.

ref: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
text: Ba pu? ni laa beenin bi ke binib bi dii dulnyaa aasan na la. Ni ponn ni bibaa kpa lipiipoln ki kpak tɔb kinikpakpak. Nima le mɔk ke ni dii ke dulnyaa aanib aah dii pu na, ki ŋani ke dulnyaa yaab na.

ref: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
text: Ubaa yaa len ke u dii Pɔɔl, le uken mu yaa len ke u dii Apolos kan, naa naahn dulnyaa yaab aa?

ref: Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen.
text: Ŋma ye Apolos? Ŋma ye Pɔɔl? Ti po ye Uwumbɔr aatutum bi ter nimi ke ni gaa Yesu ki kii na la. Ti mɔmɔk tun lituln li Uwumbɔr tii timi ke ti tun na la.

ref: I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow.
text: Min le bun tijikaar, le Apolos ŋani nnyun; Uwumbɔr le cha ti punni ki muuni.

ref: What matters isn't those who planted or watered, but God who made the plants grow.
text: Nima na, unii u bun na, ni unii u ŋani nnyun na, aa ye nibaa. Uwumbɔr u cha ti punni ki muuni na, uma le ye u nyuun na.

ref: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
text: Unii u bun na, ni unii u ŋani nnyun na kpaan la. Uwumbɔr ga tii unii mɔmɔk waapar, waatuln aah ŋeer pu na.

ref: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
text: Ba pu? ti ni Uwumbɔr kpaan le ki tun lituln. Ni bi le ke Uwumbɔr aasaak na. Ni bi le ke Uwumbɔr aadiik na.

ref: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
text: Uwumbɔr aah ter mi pu na, le m ye kidiik aatotoor aaninkpel u kpa nlan, ki maa kidiik ngbaan aadinyikl na. Le bi mu paa na maa li pu. Unii mɔmɔk li nyi waah ga ŋa pu ki maa lidinyikl ngbaan paab na.

ref: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
text: Binib mɔmɔk aatuln ga nan nya mpaan pu. Bundaln Uwumbɔr ga ji binib tibɔr na, liyaadaal ngbaan ga mɔk baatuln aah ye pu na. Liyaadaal ngbaan mmii aataak daal le na. Mmii ngbaan ga tɔŋ lik binib mɔmɔk aatuln aah bi pu na.

ref: We will be rewarded if our building is left standing.
text: Binib mɔmɔk aah maa lidinyikl paab pu na, mmii yaa kaa gaa kan, bi ga kan baatuln aapar.

ref: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
text: Mmii ngbaan yaa gaa unii aah maa pu na kan, waan kan waatuln aapar. Uma ubaa ga ŋmar, ki ga li bi ke unii u ŋmar mmii ni na.

ref: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
text: Naa nyi ke ni ye Uwumbɔr aadiik aa? Naa nyi ke Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan bi ni ni ii?

ref: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
text: Unii yaa bii Uwumbɔr aadiik kan, Uwumbɔr ga bii udaan ngbaan. Ba pu? Uwumbɔr aadiik bi chain la. Nimi le ye kidiik ngbaan.

ref: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
text: Ni taa ŋmanni nibaa. Unii yaa bi nikaasisik ni ki dak ke u kpa dulnyaa wee ni aalan kan, cha u di nlan ngbaan lii, aan ki kan Uwumbɔr aalan.

ref: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
text: Ba pu? dulnyaa wee ni aalan ye kijɔrk le Uwumbɔr chee. Ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke, “U chur bilankpalb baalan ni,”

ref: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
text: ki ki ŋmee ke, “U nyi bilankpalb aalandak, ke i ye yɔli la.”

ref: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
text: Min Pɔɔl, ni Apolos, ni Siifas, ni dulnyaa wee, ni limɔfal, ni nkun, ni tiwan ni bi dandana na, ni tiwan ni ga li bi n‑yoonn mu choo na mɔmɔk ye nimi yaan la. Ni mu ye Kristo yaab la.

ref: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
text: Kristo mu ye Uwumbɔr yoo la.

ref: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.
text: Ni ŋan ke ni bee ke ti ye Kristo aatutum la. Uwumbɔr di waabɔbɔrkaan ŋa tiŋaal ni ke ti di tuk binib.

ref: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
text: Bi yaa di tiwan ŋa unii aaŋaal ni kan, ni ŋan ke u ŋa ni mbamɔm.

ref: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.
text: Mma kan, nimi, bee dulnyaa ni aanib yaa ji mi tibɔr kan, ntafal aa bi ni ni. M mu aa ji mbaa tibɔr.

ref: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.
text: Maa nyi tiwan nibaa nsui ni aan naa ŋan. Nimina mu aa mɔk ke maabɔr ŋan Uwumbɔr chee. Tidindaan le ye u ji mi tibɔr na.

ref: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
text: Nima pu na, ni yaa kaa kee ŋeer kan, ni taa ji unii ubaa tibɔr, see Tidindaan nan gir ni. Uma le ga kpiir tiwan ni bɔɔ mbɔmbɔɔn ni na, ki kpiir unibɔn mɔmɔk aalandak. Liyaadaal ngbaan kan, Uwumbɔr ga pak binibamɔm mɔmɔk.

ref: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
text: Nnaabitiib, maah len pu na, m len ŋaŋ m ni Apolos aabɔr, ke m ter nimi la. M ban ke ni dii Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ aah len pu na. Ni taa li kpa kipupuk ubaa pu ki lik uken fam.

ref: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
text: Ŋma ŋa si le aa jer uken? Saah kpa ni na, naa ye Uwumbɔr le tii si ii? Uwumbɔr aah tii si na, ba ŋa aa kpa kipupuk ke uma le aah kaa tii si na?

ref: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
text: Ni dak ke ni puun kan tiwan bab a, ki ye bipɔɔndam, ki kpaln bibɔrb, ki cha timi a. Ni yaa ba sil ye bibɔrb aan ti mu li ye bibɔrb ni chee kan, ni ba ga li mɔ timi.

ref: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
text: Ba pu? m dak ke Uwumbɔr ŋa timi waakpambalb puwɔb yaab. Ti naahn bijab bi, bi ga ku bi binib aanimbil ni na la. Ti ye lijinjiir aawan le dulnyaa wee ni. Ti ye lijinjiir aawan, binib ni Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib aanimbil ni.

ref: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
text: Kristo pu, ti ye bijɔrb la; le nimi ye bilankpalb Kristo aasan ni. Ti ye bigiim la; le nimi ye bipɔɔndam. Ni kan nnyuŋ binib chee; le tima ye fam bi chee.

ref: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
text: Nkon le joo timi, nnyunyuu mu joo timi, le ki nan saa dandana wee. Ti peeni tiwanchar la. Le binib gbaa timi. Taa kpa taah ga li koo nin chee na.

ref: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
text: Ti tun lituln linimaln, ki joo timi aaŋaal imina le ki tun. Binib seei timi la, le ti bui bi ke, “Uwumbɔr ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu.” Bi ŋani timi falaa la, le ti ji limɔr.

ref: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
text: Bi bii timi la, le ti len bi imɔliinyaan. Bi ŋani timi ke dulnyaa aajɔŋ, ni litapuln pu aabir na la, le ki nan saa din.

ref: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
text: Maa ŋmee tibɔr ngbaan m jinn nimi inimɔɔn. M ban m sur nimi ke maabigeehm na la.

ref: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus,
text: Ba pu? ni yaa kpa bimɔmɔkb ŋichur kipiik Kristo aasan ni kan, ni kpa te ubaa baanja la. Min le ye nite. Kinye? maah nan tuk nimi tibɔnyaan tee na, le m kpaln nite Yesu Kristo aasan ni.

ref: and I want you to be like me.
text: Nima pu na, m gaŋni nimi, ni li dii ke maah dii pu na.

ref: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
text: Nima le m ga cha Timoti dan ni chee. U ye maabogeehn Tidindaan aasan ni, ki bi mbamɔm. U ga teer nimi maah dii Kristo aasan pu na, ki ga teer nimi ke m tuk Kristo aanib bi bi ŋipepel mɔmɔk ni na ke bi mu dii kina.

ref: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
text: Ni ponn ni bibaa kpa kalmbaani, ki dak ke maan dan ni chee.

ref: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
text: Tidindaan yaa kii kan, m ga dan ni chee dandana wee, ki nan bee binib bi kpa kalmbaani na aabimbin. Maan lik baaliin. M ga lik ke Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn bi bi chee aan mu aa bi.

ref: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
text: Uwumbɔr aanaan aa ye iliin. Mu ye mpɔɔn la.

ref: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
text: Ni ban ke m dan ki li joo ni ntafadaan, aan ni ban ke m dan ki li joo ni ngeehm aaliin ni nsuudoon la?

ref: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
text: Tɔ, bi tee len ke kininsuŋ aatuln bi nikaasisik ni, ke ni ponn ni ubaa gaa ute aapuu. Hali binib bi kaa dii Uwumbɔr aasan na aa ŋani kina.

ref: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
text: Nimi ŋani kina la, ki mu kpa kalmbaani. Ba ŋa naa bii nisui? Ni ŋan ke ni nyan unii u ŋa kina na nikaasisik ni.

ref: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
text: ni di udaan ngbaan ŋa kinimbɔŋ aaŋaal ni, ke ki cha uwon ji falaa dulnyaa wee ponn ni. Nima le waawiin ga ŋmar bundaln Tidindaan ga ji binib tibɔr na.

ref: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
text: Naa ŋan ke ni li kpa kipupuk. Naa nyi ke boroboro aanyɔk siib le cha boroboromɔn duuni ii?

ref: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
text: Nima pu na, cha ti li ji Lakr‑jer aajim, ki ŋmɔ boroboro u kaa kpa nnyɔk na, ki di boroboro aanyɔkpok lii. Maah len pu na le ye ke ti li dak ilandak i ŋan na, ki li ŋani mbamɔm, ki di bakaa ni titunwanbir lii.

ref: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
text: Tɔ, m nan ŋmee kigbaŋ ki tuk nimi ke ni ni bidagoob taa kpaan tɔb chee.

ref: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
text: Maa len dulnyaa aanib pu; dulnyaa aanib bi ye bidagoob, ni binimandam, ni binib bi ji biken pempem na, ni biwaadam na, naa ŋmaa nya bi chee, see ni nyan dulnyaa wee ni.

ref: I was talking about your own people who are immoral or greedy or worship idols or curse others or get drunk or cheat. Don't even eat with them!
text: Maah len pu na le ye ke unii u len ke u dii Kristo aasan na, u yaa ye udagoor, bee unimandaan, bee uwaadaan, bee ŋisiibil daan, bee udagbiir, bee unii u ji binib pempem na kan, ni ni udaan ngbaan taa kpaan. Hali ni taa ji u chee tijikaar.

ref: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
text: Tɔ, ni ponn ni ubaa ni uŋeen aatɔ yaa kpa tibɔr kan, ba ŋa ni chaa bibɔjirb chee, binib bi kaa dii Uwumbɔr aasan na aanimbiin ni, bi ti len tibɔr ngbaan, kaa cha Uwumbɔr aanib len ti?

ref: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?
text: Naa nyi ke Uwumbɔr aanib ga ji dulnyaa yaab tibɔr aa? Ni yaa ga ji dulnyaa yaab tibɔr kan, naa ŋmaa toor tibɔr waatiir aa?

ref: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
text: Naa nyi ke ti ga ji Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib tibɔr aa? Ŋmaninkabaa dandana wee aabɔr?

ref: Why do you take everyday complaints to judges who are not respected by the church?
text: Nima pu na, tibɔr yaa bi nikaasisik ni kan, cha binib bi ye biwaatiib nikaasisik ni na len ti.

ref: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
text: M len ke m jinn nimi inimɔɔn la. Ulankpal ubaa aa bi nikaasisik ni ii? Ni ponn ni ubaa aan ŋmaa len tibɔr tii nimi ii?

ref: Why should one of you take another to be tried by unbelievers?
text: le ki cha ubaa ni una aabo cha bibɔjirb chee, ki ti cha binib bi kaa gaa Yesu ki kii na len baabɔr.

ref: But instead, you cheat and rob other followers.
text: Ni ye naabitiib la; le nimi nibaa ŋani tɔb bakaa, ki su tɔb kinaayuk.

ref: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
text: Naa nyi ke binib bi aabimbin kaa ŋan na aan kan Uwumbɔr aanaan aa? Ni taa ŋmanni nibaa man; bibɔnbɔnn, ni biwaadam, ni bidagoob, ni bijab bi di biŋeen aatɔtiib kpaln bipiib ki doo bi chee na, ni bijab bi mu di bibaa ŋa bipiib ki cha bijab ŋeen aatɔtiib doo bi chee na,

ref: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.
text: ni binaayukb, ni binimandam, ni bidagbiirb, ni ŋisiibildam, ni binib bi ji biken pempem na, aan kan Uwumbɔr aanaan.

ref: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
text: Ni ponn ni bibaa nan bi kina la; le Uwumbɔr finn nipobil, ki ŋa nimi binib bi bi chain na, ki len ke nimi aabɔr ŋan, Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aayimbil pu, ni timi Aawumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan pu. Cha Uwumbɔr kan nnyuŋ saawon pu

ref: Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.
text: Nimi bibaa bui ke tiwan nibaa aa kɔ. Tɔ, ni mu aa ye tiwan mɔmɔk le ga ter nimi. Tiwan nibaa aa kɔ; m mu aan cha tiwan nibaa chuu mi tinaagbiir.

ref: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
text: Bibaa len ke lipuul pu le tijikaar bi, le tijikaar mu pu, lipuul bi. Tɔ, Uwumbɔr ga cha ni mɔmɔk nilee ŋa yɔli. Timi aawon tee aa bi kidagook aatuln pu, ti bi Tidindaan aatuln pu la. Tiwon mu ye Tidindaan yaan la.

ref: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
text: Uwumbɔr nan fikr Tidindaan nkun ni. Waapɔɔn pu, u ga fikr timi mu nkun ni.

ref: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
text: Naa nyi ke nimi aawon ye Kristo aawon aawan aa? M ga di nwon tee, ti ye Kristo aawan na, ki di kpaan upiidagoor aawon ni ii? Maan ŋa kina kpala.

ref: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
text: Naa nyi ke unii u doon upiidagoor chee na, bi kpaan tiwon tibaa la aa? Ba pu? Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ len ke, “Upii ni uja yaa nyi tɔb kan, bi kpaa tiwon tibaa la.”

ref: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
text: Tɔ, unii u kpaan Tidindaan chee na, bi kpaan nwiinbaan la.

ref: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
text: Ni di cha kidagook aatuln. Unii yaa tun titunwanbir kan, naa bi tiwon ponn ni, see kidagook aatuln. Unii u gɔr kidagook na, u ŋa uma ubaa aawon bakaa la.

ref: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
text: Naa nyi ke nimi aawon ye Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aadiik la aa? Uwumbɔr tii nimi Waafuur Nyaan, le mu bi ni ni.

ref: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
text: Uwumbɔr daa nimi le ki pan. Naa yeh nibaa, Uwumbɔr le yeh nimi. Nima pu na, ni di nimi aawon tun lituln li ga nyuŋ Uwumbɔr na.

ref: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
text: Naah ŋmee mi kigbaŋ tibɔr ti pu na, ni ŋan ke uja taa li nyi upii.

ref: Well, having your own husband or wife should keep you from doing something immoral.
text: Tɔ, kidagook aatuln pu, ni ŋan ke uja mɔmɔk li kpa uma ubaa aapuu, upii mɔmɔk li kpa uma ubaa aachal.

ref: Husbands and wives should be fair with each other about having sex.
text: Upii yaa ban uchal kan, u taa yii, uja mu yaa ban upuu kan, u taa yii.

ref: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
text: Upii aa joo uwon, uchal le joo ti. Uja mu aa joo uwon, upii le joo ti.

ref: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
text: Ubaa taa yii uken, see ni puen kii tii tɔb ki laa di cha siib, aan ki li kpa n‑yoonn ki mee Uwumbɔr, [ki lul bumɔb,] le ki ki kpaan tɔb chee. Ni yaa kaa ki kpaan tɔb chee kan, kinimbɔŋ ga tɔŋ nimi ni tun kidagook aatuln. Ba pu? naan ŋmaa chuu nibaa.

ref: In my opinion that is what should be done, though I don't know of anything the Lord said about this matter.
text: Maah ga len tibɔr ti na le ye ke m ga cha ni ŋa kina, maa len ke see ni ŋa kina.

ref: I wish all of you were like me, but God has given different gifts to each of us.
text: Maageehn le ye ke ni mɔmɔk li bi ke maah bi pu na. Uwumbɔr mu tii unii mɔmɔk uma ubaa aapiin. Ti mɔmɔk aapiin aa kpaa. U tii ti mɔmɔk mbaabaa la.

ref: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
text: Bijaakpaab, ni bisapɔm, ni bikpopiib, m tuk nimi la, ni ŋan ke ni li bi kina, ke maah bi pu na.

ref: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
text: Ni mu yaa kaa ŋmaa chuu nibaa kan, cha bijab din bipiib, bipiib mu mɔn. Bijab ni bipiib yaa yoor tɔb kan, ni soor ni binimbil li man tɔb pu, kaa kan.

ref: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband
text: Bipiijoob ni bichadam, m ga tuk nimi naah ga ŋa pu na, naa ye min le tuk nimi, Tidindaan le tuk nimi, ke upii taa di uchal lii.

ref: should either stay single or go back to her husband. And a husband should not leave his wife.
text: U yaa di uchal lii kan, u li bi ubaa, see u ki gir buen uchal chee, bi ti took. Uja mu taa jenn upuu.

ref: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
text: Binib bi gur na, Tidindaan aa len baabɔr. Min le tuk bi ke uja u ye Yesu aanii na yaa kpa puu u kaa ye Yesu aanii na kan, upii ngbaan yaa kii ke u li bi u chee kan, u taa jenn u.

ref: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
text: Unii u kaa ye Yesu aanii na yaa ban u di upuu, bee uchal u ye Yesu aanii na lii kan, cha u li cha. Naa ye limukl. Uwumbɔr yin timi ke ti li kpa nsuudoon.

ref: And besides, how do you know if you will be able to save your husband or wife who isn't a follower? Obeying the Lord at All Times
text: Upii, aa nyi ke sin pu aachal ga ŋmar aan waan ŋmar? Uja, aa nyi ke sin pu aapuu ga ŋmar aan waan ŋmar? Tibɔkpaan le ye ke aa kii Uwumbɔr aamɔb

ref: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
text: Tɔ, Tidindaan aah tii unii mɔmɔk pu na, u li bi kina. Unii mɔmɔk aah nan bi pu aan Uwumbɔr nan yin u na, u li bi kina. Maah ga tuk nimi pu na, kina le m tuk Yesu aanib bi bi ŋipepel mɔmɔk ni na.

ref: If you are already circumcised, don't try to change it. If you are not circumcised, don't get circumcised.
text: Ubaa yaa nan ye uchakpangendaan aan Uwumbɔr nan yin u na kan, u li bi kina, u taa toor li. U mu kaa ye uchakpangendaan aan Uwumbɔr nan yin u na kan, u taa ki gii.

ref: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
text: Lichakpangeel aa kpa tinyoor. Unii yaa kaa gii kan, ni mu aa kpa tinyoor. Ti yaa kii Uwumbɔr aamɔb kan, nima le kpa tinyoor.

ref: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
text: Unii mɔmɔk aah nan bi pu aan Uwumbɔr nan yin u na, u li bi kina.

ref: Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should.
text: Uwumbɔr aah nan yin si na, aa yaa ye unaagbiija kan, taa cha ni li wu si. Aa mu yaa ga ŋmaa nya tinaagbiir ngbaan ni kan, nya ki li bi aabaa.

ref: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.
text: Tidindaan mu yaa yin unii u ye unaagbiija na kan, u ye Tidindaan aanii u u gaa u lii na la. Kina le ni ye ke Tidindaan yaa yin unii u kaa ye unaagbiija na kan, u ye Kristo aanaagbiija la.

ref: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
text: Yesu daa nimi le ki pan. Nima pu na, ni taa li ye binib aanaagbiib.

ref: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
text: Binachipɔm ni bisapɔm aabɔr kan, Tidindaan aa tuk mi; waanimbaasaln pu, le m ye unibamɔnn, ki ga tuk nimi maah dak pu na.

ref: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
text: Dandana aafalaa pu, m dak ke ni ŋan ke unii li bi ke waah bi pu na.

ref: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
text: Aa yaa kpa puu kan, taa li ban ke aa jenn u. Aa yaa kaa kpa puu kan, taa ki ban.

ref: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
text: Uja mu yaa din upii kan, naa bir. Usapɔɔn mu yaa mɔn uja kan, naa bir. Bipiijoob ni bichadam mu ga kan falaa dulnyaa wee ni. Le maa ban ke ni kan falaa ngbaan.

ref: My friends, what I mean is that the Lord will soon come, and it won't matter if you are married or not.
text: Nnaabitiib, maah len pu na le ye ke n‑yoonn mu gur na, mu par a. Nima pu na, binib bi kpa puutiib na, bi li bi ke baah kaa kpa le na;

ref: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
text: Binib bi kpa dulnyaa ni aawan ki joo tun baatuln na, bi taa cha binimbil li man ni pu; ba pu? dulnyaa wee, ni waawan bi jer la.

ref: I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord.
text: Maa ban ke nibaa li muk nimi nisui ni. Uja u kaa kpa puu na, utafal bi Tidindaan aabɔr ni la. U dakl waah ga ŋa pu ki piir Tidindaan aasui na la.

ref: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
text: Uja u kpa puu na, utafal bi dulnyaa wee ni aabɔr ni la, u dakl waah ga ŋa pu ki piir upuu aasui na la,

ref: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
text: le waalandak yakr mfum mulee. Upii u kaa kpa chal na, bee usapɔɔn u kaa nyi uja na, utafal bi Tidindaan aabɔr ni la; u ban ke uwon ni waawiin li bi chain. Upii u kpa chal na, utafal bi dulnyaa wee ni aabɔr ni la, u dakl waah ga ŋa pu ki piir uchal aasui na la.

ref: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
text: M ban m ter nimi la. Nima le cha m len kina. Naa ye ke m ban m leŋ nimi la. M ban ke ni li ŋani tiwan mɔmɔk mbamɔm, ninimbil li man Tidindaan aabɔr pu, nibaa taa leŋ nimi.

ref: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
text: Uja yaa kpa bisal u jer lichamɔln na, ki yaa dak ke u jinn ubisal inimɔɔn aan ni yaa muk u kan, cha u ŋa waah ban pu na, cha u kunn ubisal ngbaan uchal do. Naa bir.

ref: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
text: N‑yoonn mumɔk upii ni uchal bi na, upii ye uchal yoo la. Uchal yaa kpo kan, u ga ŋmaa mɔn uja u dii Tidindaan aasan na aan u gee u na.

ref: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
text: Tɔ, joo cha kitork aanann aabɔr wɔb na, ti nyi ke ti mɔmɔk kpa nnyim. Nnyim cha binib kpa kipupuk la. Ngeehm le ter binib ke bi dii Uwumbɔr aasan mbamɔm.

ref: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
text: Unii yaa dak ke u nyi tiwan kan, waa kee nyi waah ba ga li nyi pu na.

ref: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
text: Unii mu yaa gee Uwumbɔr kan, Uwumbɔr beer udaan ngbaan.

ref: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
text: Joo cha kitork aanann aajim aabɔr na, ti nyi ke ŋiwaa ŋimɔk bi dulnyaa wee ni na aa ye nibaa. Ti nyi ke Uwumbɔr ubaa baanja le bi.

ref: Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords.
text: Ŋiwaa ni tiwan ni binib dooni ni na bi paacham ni taab, ki wiir.

ref: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
text: Tima kan, ti kpa Uwumbɔrbaan, u ye Tite na. Uma le nan naan tiwan mɔmɔk. Ti bi ke ti li ŋani waageehn la. Ti kpa Tidindaan ubaa mu la. Uma le ye Yesu Kristo. Uma le Uwumbɔr nan cha u naan tiwan mɔmɔk. Uma pu le ti bi.

ref: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
text: Binib bibaa mu aa nyi kina. Bi nan dii ŋiwaa ni yunn. Nima pu na, bi yaa ŋman kitork aanann kan, ti ye kitork aanann le bi chee, le ni ŋa bi ilandak.

ref: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
text: Tɔ, tijikaar aan ŋmaa cha ti piir Uwumbɔr aasui; ti yaa jin, bee ti yaa kaa jin kan, naa kpa taani.

ref: Don't cause problems for someone with a weak conscience, just because you have the right to eat anything.
text: Aa mu yaa nyi ke ŋiwaa aa ye nibaa kan, li nyi ki taa cha unii u kaa kee nyi Uwumbɔr aasan mbamɔm na tun titunwanbir.

ref: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
text: Unii u kaa nyi Uwumbɔr aasan mbamɔm na yaa kan si, u kpa nnyim na, ji tijikaar ŋiwaa aadichal ni kan, u mu ga li kpa lipobil ki ŋmɔ kitork aanann, ki lir.

ref: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
text: Nima pu na, tijikaar tibaa yaa kiir nna aabo, Uwumbɔr aasan ni kan, maan ki ji tijikaar ngbaan kpala, aan ki taa kiir nna aabo, Uwumbɔr aasan aadiim.

ref: I am free. I am an apostle. I have seen the Lord Jesus and have led you to have faith in him.
text: Tɔ, maa ye Yesu aakpambal aa? Maa yeh mbaa aa? Maa kan Tidindaan Yesu uu? Naah gaa Yesu ki kii na, maatuln le na Tidindaan pu.

ref: Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.
text: Biken yaa dak ke maa ye Yesu aakpambal kan, ni nyi ke m ye. Naah gaa Tidindaan ki kii na, nima le mɔk ke m ye waakpambal.

ref: When people question me, I tell them
text: Kina le m tuk binib bi ban bi baa mi na.

ref: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.
text: Maah tuk binib Uwumbɔr aabɔr na, maa ŋeer bi tii mi tijikaar ni tiwanyukaan aa?

ref: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
text: Maa ŋeer m mu li ŋani ke bikpambalb biken, ni Tidindaan aanaatiib, ni Siifas aah ŋani pu na, ki li joo upii ubaa u mu li dii mi lisachuln ni ii?

ref: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
text: M ni Banabas baanja le ye binib bi mooni Uwumbɔr aaliin ki tun lituln liken kpee ke ti ji ii?

ref: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
text: Unii yaa ye butɔb aaja kan, baa pa u lipal aa? Unii yaa ko kisaak kan, waan ji tijikaar ti bi ki ni na aa? Unii yaa kpaa inaa kan, waan wub nnaabiin aa?

ref: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
text: Ni ŋmee nkaal ngbaan ni, Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke, “Aa yaa joo unaaja poi idi kan, aa taa buu umɔb.” Uwumbɔr aatafal bi inaaja aabɔr baanja ponn ni la aa?

ref: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
text: Waah len pu na, waa len ke u ter ti mu la aa? Mbamɔn, timi pu le ni ŋmee kina. Ba pu? ni ŋan ke unii u ko kisaak na, ni unii u poi njikaabim na li kpa limakl ke bi ga kan ni ponn ni ki ji.

ref: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
text: Ti nan tuk nimi Uwumbɔr aabɔr la. Ti yaa gaa ni chee dulnyaa ni aawan kan, naa ye sakpen.

ref: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
text: Binib biken yaa kpa nsan ke bi gaa tiwan ni chee kan, taa kpa nsan ki jer bi ii? Ti kpa nsan, ti mu aa nan gaa; ba pu? taa ban ti leŋ Kristo aabɔnyaan. Nima pu, le ti nan ji falaa mɔmɔk.

ref: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
text: Naa nyi ke binib bi tun lituln Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni na ji nima la aa? Binib bi toor kitork tii Uwumbɔr na, bi mu ji nima la.

ref: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
text: Kina le Tidindaan nan len ke binib bi mooni tibɔnyaan tee na, bi mu li ji ti ponn ni.

ref: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
text: M mu kpa nsan m mu li ji kina; le maa ŋa kina. Maah ŋmee pu na, maa ŋmee ke binib ŋa kina ki tii mi. Maah kaa gaal nibaa binib chee na, nima le m kpa kipupuk. Maa ban ke m li kpa kipupuk yɔli.

ref: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
text: M yaa tuk binib tibɔnyaan tee kan, maan ŋmaa li kpa kipupuk ti pu. Ni muk mi ke m tuk bi. M yaa kaa tuk binib tibɔnyaan tee kan, tibɔbir ga li bi m pu.

ref: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
text: M yaa tuk binib tibɔnyaan tee maageehn pu kan, m ba ga li ban lipal. Ni yaa kaa ye maageehn kan, ni ye lituln li Uwumbɔr tii mi ke m li tun na la.

ref: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
text: Nima pu na, maapar ye ba? Ni ye ke m li mooni tibɔnyaan tee aan binib ŋun ki taa pa nibaa. M kpa nsan ke m li gaal tiwan bi chee, ki mu aa gaal.

ref: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
text: Maa ye unii ubaa aanaagbiija. M mu di mbaa ŋa binib mɔmɔk aanaagbiija, aan ki moo kan binib tii Kristo.

ref: When I am with the Jews, I live like a Jew to win Jews. They are ruled by the Law of Moses, and I am not. But I live by the Law to win them.
text: Juu yaab chee, m bi ke Juu yaab na, aan ki kan Juu yaab ki tii Kristo. Binib bi dii Moses aakaal na chee, m mu bi ke baah bi pu na, aan ki kan binib bi dii Moses aakaal na, ki tii Kristo. Mma aa bi Moses aakaal taab.

ref: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
text: Binib bi kaa dii Moses aakaal na chee, m mu bi ke baah bi pu na, aan ki kan binib bi kaa dii Moses aakaal na, ki tii Kristo. Maa len ke maa dii Uwumbɔr aakaal. M dii Kristo aakaal la.

ref: When I am with people whose faith is weak, I live as they do to win them. I do everything I can to win everyone I possibly can.
text: Binib bi ye bidaburb Kristo aasan ni na, m bi ke baah bi pu na la, aan ki kan bi mu ki tii Kristo. Binib mɔmɔk aabɔŋ chee, m po bi ke baah bi pu na la. M ŋani tiwan mɔmɔk maah ga ŋmaa ŋa pu na, aan ki cha binib bibaa ŋmar.

ref: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
text: Tibɔnyaan tee pu le m ŋani tiwan mɔmɔk, aan m ni binib biken mu kpaan ki kan tinyoor ti ponn ni.

ref: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
text: Nima pu na, maa san ke unii u san kaa nyi budabu pu u san na. Maa gbaa ke unii u gbaa fam na;

ref: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
text: m muk maawon le ti kii maamɔb. Ni yaa kaa ye kina kan, m ga tuk biken tibɔnyaan tee, le min mbaa ga nan bee yɔli.

ref: Friends, I want to remind you that all our ancestors walked under the cloud and went through the sea.
text: Nnaabitiib, m ban ke ni bee ke ntaalangbam nan sunn ni ki mɔk tiyaajatiib nsan. Le Uwumbɔr nan tii bi nsan nnyusakpem aakaasisik ni, bi puur.

ref: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
text: Le bi ponn ni binib pam mu aa nan piir Uwumbɔr aasui. Kina pu na, bi nan kpo ki bee kipɔɔk ni.

ref: What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things.
text: Tibɔr timina ye nsurm le ki tii timi, ke ti taa ban tiwan ni kaa ŋan na, ke baah nan ban pu na.

ref: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
text: Ni mu taa dii ŋiwaa, ke bi ponn ni bibaa aah nan dii pu na; ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke, “Binib ngbaan nan kal ki ŋman kitork aanann, ki nyu ndaan gbii, le ki fii ki tun kininsuŋ aatun.”

ref: Some of those people did shameful things, and in a single day about
text: Ni mu taa tun kidagook aatuln ke bi ponn ni bibaa aah nan tun pu ki cha binib ŋichur moninko ni ŋitaa kpo liwinbaal na.

ref: Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.
text: Tɔ, binib bibaa ga bui ke tiwan nibaa aa kɔ. Ni mu aa ye tiwan mɔmɔk le ŋan. Tiwan nibaa aa kɔ. Ni mu aa ye tiwan mɔmɔk le ga ter timi aan ti dii Uwumbɔr aasan mbamɔm.

ref: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
text: Ni mu taa tɔŋ Tidindaan ke bi ponn ni bibaa aah nan tɔŋ u pu ki cha iwaa junn ku bi na.

ref: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
text: Ni mu taa ŋulni ke bi ponn ni bibaa aah nan ŋulni pu ki cha Uwumbɔr aakun aatuun ku bi na.

ref: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
text: Tibɔr ngbaan nan ŋa bi kina ki ye limɔkl le ki mɔk binib. Bi nan ŋmee ti Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni, ke ni li ye nsurm le ki tii timi bi bi kookoo aayoonn na.

ref: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
text: Nima pu na, unii u dak ke u si chob na, u li nyi ki taa lir.

ref: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
text: Naa kee kan ntɔŋ mu pɔɔ ki jer unibɔn mɔk aah kani pu na. Uwumbɔr ye mbamɔndaan, kaan cha ni kan ntɔŋ mu jer nimi na. Ni yaa kan ntɔŋ kan, u ga toor nsan tii nimi, ni nyaŋ ntɔŋ ngbaan. Nima le ni ga li kpa limɔr ntɔŋ ponn ni.

ref: My friends, you must keep away from idols.
text: Njɔtiib, nima pu na, di ŋiwaa lii ki di cha ŋaabɔr.

ref: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
text: M len ni chee ke maah ba ga len bilankpalb chee pu na la. Maah ga len pu na, ni dakl ki lik naatataa.

ref: When we drink from the cup we ask God to bless, isn't that sharing in the blood of Christ? When we eat the bread we break, isn't that sharing in the body of Christ?
text: Ti yaa yoor Uwumbɔr aayinyook ki doon u ki pu, ki nyu kan, ni ye Kristo aasin le ti kpaan nyu. Taah gii boroboro ki ŋman na mu, ni ye Kristo aawon le ti kpaan ŋman.

ref: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
text: Boroboro ngbaan ye boroboro kpiln libaa la. Nima le mɔk ke ti kpaan tiwon tibaa la; ba pu? ti mɔmɔk kpaan ŋman boroboro kpiln libaa la.

ref: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
text: Dakl lik man Juu yaab aah ŋani pu na. Binib bi toor kitork tii Uwumbɔr ki ji na, bi ni u kpaan la.

ref: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
text: Maah len pu na le ye ke liwaal ye nibaa aa? Tijikaar ti bi di tii li na ye nibaa aa? Naa ye.

ref: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
text: Maah len pu na le ye ke binib bi kaa dii Uwumbɔr aasan na yaa toor kitork kan, bi toor ki tii tiwan ni kaa ye Uwumbɔr na la, kinimbɔŋ le bi toor tii. Maa ban ke ni ni kinimbɔŋ li kpaan.

ref: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
text: Naan ŋmaa yoor Tidindaan aayinyook ki nyu, ki gir ki ti nyu kinimbɔŋ aayinyook ni. Naan ŋmaa ŋmɔ Tidindaan aaboroboro, ki gir ti ŋmɔ kinimbɔŋ aanann mu.

ref: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
text: Ti ban Tidindaan li kpa lipiipoln ti pu uu? Ti kpa mpɔɔn jer u uu? Ni li nyuŋni Uwumbɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk

ref: We should think about others and not about ourselves.
text: Ubaa taa li lik ki ban ubaa aanyoor baanja. U li lik ki ban uŋeen aatɔtiib aanyoor mu.

ref: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
text: Tinann ti bi kooh kinyaŋ ni na, ni ga ŋmaa daa ti ki ŋmɔ, ki taa baa ke ti ye ba aanann, ki taa cha nimi aalandak li muk nimi ti pu.

ref: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
text: Ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke, “Uwumbɔr le yeh dulnyaa ni tiwan nimɔk bi u ponn ni na.”

ref: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
text: Unii u kaa gaa Yesu ki kii na yaa ŋa tijikaar ki yin nimi kan, ni yaa buen kan, waah di tijikaar ti siin nimi na, jim man, ki taa baa ke ti ye kitork aanann la aa? ki taa cha nimi aalandak li muk nimi.

ref: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
text: Maah len pu na le ye ke aa yaa jin kan, u mu ga ji, le waalandak ga muk u, ke waah ŋa pu na aa ŋan.

ref: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.
text: Ni taa ŋa tiwan ni ga kiir Juu yaab Uwumbɔr aasan ni na, ki taa kiir binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na mu, ki taa kiir Uwumbɔr aanib mu.

ref: I always try to please others instead of myself, in the hope that many of them will be saved.
text: Ni li ŋani ke maah ŋani pu na. M piir binib mɔmɔk aasui tiwan mɔmɔk ni, ke bi ŋmar. Maa ban mi baanja aanyoor. M ban bi mɔmɔk kan tinyoor, aan ki ŋmar la.

ref: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
text: Ni li dii maataabuu man, ke maah dii Kristo aataabuu pu na. Uwumbɔr aadoon aakaal

ref: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.
text: M pak nimi; ba pu? ni teer mi tiwan mɔmɔk ponn ni, ki ŋani maah mɔk nimi pu na la.

ref: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
text: Tɔ, m ban ke ni bee ke uja mɔmɔk aayidaan le ye Kristo; upii mɔmɔk mu aayidaan le ye uchal; Kristo aayidaan le ye Uwumbɔr.

ref: This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.
text: Uja yaa mee Uwumbɔr, bee u yaa nabr Uwumbɔr aah len pu na, ki laa chik kiyikpupuk kan, u jinn uyidaan inimɔɔn a.

ref: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
text: Upii mu yaa mee Uwumbɔr, bee u yaa nabr Uwumbɔr aah len pu na, kaa buu kiyibubuuk kan, u jinn uyidaan inimɔɔn. Ni bi ke waah kuu tiyikpir le na.

ref: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
text: Upii yaa kaa buu kiyibubuuk kan, ni kpa inimɔɔn ke waah chee tiyikpir le na. Upii u chee tiyikpir, bee u chuu kuu tiyikpir na, ni kpa inimɔɔn. U yaa kaa buu kiyibubuuk kan, ni mu kpa inimɔɔn. Nima pu na, ni ŋan ke u buu kiyibubuuk.

ref: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
text: Uja yaa mee Uwumbɔr kan, u taa chiŋ kiyikpupuk uyil pu; ba pu? u naahn Uwumbɔr, ki ye waasil la. Upii mu ye uja aasil la.

ref: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
text: Uwumbɔr aah nan naan uja na, u nan nyan uja aasikaakpab le ki di naan upii, naa ye upii aasikaakpab le u nan nyan di naan uja.

ref: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
text: Uja pu, le u nan naan upii. Naa ye upii pu le u nan naan uja.

ref: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
text: Nima pu na, Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib mu pu, ni ŋan upii buu kiyibubuuk uyil pu, ki mɔk ke u bi kichadiik ni.

ref: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
text: Upii nan nyan ni uja ni. Uja mu nyan ni upii ni. Le bi mɔmɔk nyan ni Uwumbɔr chee.

ref: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
text: Ni dakl lik man. Upii yaa mee Uwumbɔr ki yaa kaa buu kiyibubuuk kan, naa ŋan.

ref: But long hair is a beautiful way for a woman to cover her head.
text: Upii mu yaa kpa tiyikpir fɔfɔk kan, waanyaan le na. Ba pu? Uwumbɔr tii bipiib tiyikpir fɔfɔk ti li bii bi pu la.

ref: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
text: Unii ubaa yaa kaa kii kina ki ban u kpak kinikpakpak kan, m tuk nimi la, taa ki kpa nkaal muken. Uwumbɔr aanib mu aa kpa nkaal muken. Tidindaan aajim (Matiu

ref: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
text: Njan aabɔr le ye ke m ŋun ke naah kuuni tɔb chee na, ni kpak tɔb kinikpakpak, ki yakr tɔb. Le m pak maah ŋun pu na tibaa, ke ni sil ŋani kina la.

ref: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
text: Nnyamɔn aamɔmɔkb ga li bi ni ponn ni ki cha ni bee binib bi ye mbamɔndam na.

ref: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
text: Nimi bibaa puen ji nimi yaan nibaabaa. Le ni ponn ni bibaa aa ji babr. Bibaa mu nyu gbii.

ref: The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.
text: Ba pu? n‑yoonn mumɔk ni ga ŋmɔ boroboro ngbaan, ki nyu tiwanyukaan ngbaan na, ni mooni ke Tidindaan nan kpo ni pu la, ki ti saa bundaln u ga gir ni na.

ref: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
text: Unii yaa ŋman ki yaa nyun, ki yaa kaa bee Tidindaan aawon aatataa kan, u ga cha Uwumbɔr daa utafal.

ref: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
text: Baah jin tijikaar ti doo na, le u yoor kiyinyook ki doon Uwumbɔr, le ki bui bi, “Tiwanyukaan ngbaan ye tipuupɔln ti Uwumbɔr puu tii nimi na, maasin pu. N‑yoonn mumɔk ni ga ti nyu tiwanyukaan ngbaan na, ni li ŋani kina ki teer mbɔr.”

ref: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
text: Tidindaan le nan tuk mi, le m mu tuk nimi kina, ke kinyeek ki Judas nan kooh u na, kinyeek ngbaan le Tidindaan Yesu nan yoor boroboro

ref: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
text: le ki doon Uwumbɔr, le ki gii, ki bui bi, “[Gaa man ki ŋmɔ.] Nwon le na. Nimi aatunwanbir pu, le m tii tiwon tee. Ni li ŋmɔ kina aan ki li teer mbɔr.”

ref: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
text: Nima pu na, unii yaa ŋman Tidindaan aaboroboro ngbaan, ki nyu waawanyukaan ngbaan, kaa tii u lisil kan, u sii Tidindaan aawon ni waasin.

ref: This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink.
text: Nima pu na, cha unii mɔmɔk lik waabimbin aah bi pu na aan ki nin ŋmɔ boroboro ngbaan ki nyu tiwanyukaan ngbaan.

ref: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
text: Nima le cha ni ponn ni pam ye bidaburb, pam mu aa kpa laafee, pam mu kpo.

ref: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
text: U mu yaa daa titafal kan, u chiini timi ke u taa bii timi bundaln u ga ji dulnyaa aanib tibɔr na la.

ref: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
text: Nnaabitiib, nima pu na, ni yaa kuun tɔb chee ki ti ji kan, ni mɔmɔk li kii tɔb ki kpaan ji.

ref: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
text: Nkon yaa chuu u na kan, cha u ji udo aan ki nin dan. Nima na, ni yaa nan kuun tɔb chee kina kan, ni taa kan ntafadaan ni pu. Tibɔr ti gur na, m yaa nan dan kan, m ga toor ti mu.

ref: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
text: Ni nyi ke naah kaa nan kee dii Uwumbɔr aasan na, ni nan dii ŋiwaa ŋi ye bibirb na. Ŋi nan cha ni yenni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la.

ref: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
text: Nima pu na, m ban ke ni bee ke Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aapɔɔn yaa cha unii len tibɔr kan, waan ŋmaa sii Yesu. Unii ubaa mu aan ŋmaa len ke Yesu le ye Udindaan see Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan le ga cha u len kina.

ref: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
text: Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aapiin aabɔŋ aabɔŋ le bi; Nfuur Nyaanbaan ngbaan le tii timi ipiin ngbaan mɔmɔk.

ref: There are different ways to serve the same Lord,
text: Lituln aabɔŋ aabɔŋ mu bi; Tɔ, Dindaan baan mu le ti tun tii.

ref: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
text: Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn le cha binib tun lituln aabɔŋ. Le Uwumbɔr u cha unii mɔmɔk tun lituln ngbaan mɔmɔk na, u ye ubaa.

ref: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.
text: Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan tii unii mɔmɔk waapiin, ke u di ter Uwumbɔr aanib biken.

ref: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
text: Mu cha ubaa len nlan aaliin. Muma muchachaan ngbaan cha ubaa mu beer tibɔr ki len.

ref: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
text: Muma muchachaan le cha ubaa mu gaa Uwumbɔr ki kii mbamɔm. Muma muchachaan ngbaan le tii ubaa mu mpɔɔn mu cha bibum pɔɔk.

ref: or the power to work mighty miracles. Some of us are prophets, and some of us recognize when God's Spirit is present. Others can speak different kinds of languages, and still others can tell what these languages mean.
text: Mu tii ubaa mu mpɔɔn u tun lijinjiir aatun. Mu cha ubaa mu nabr Uwumbɔr aah len pu na. Mu cha ubaa mu beer mu ye Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan na, ni mu kaa ye na. Mu cha ubaa mu len iliin yayan. Mu cha ubaa mu nabr iliin yayan ngbaan.

ref: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
text: Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan muchachaan ngbaan le cha unii mɔmɔk tun lituln ngbaan mɔmɔk. Mu tii unii mɔmɔk ipiin aabɔŋ aabɔŋ mu aah ban pu na la. Tiwon aawan aabɔr

ref: The body of Christ has many different parts, just as any other body does.
text: Tiwon kpa tiwan pam, ki tee ye tiwonbaan la. Kristo aanib mu bi kina la. Bi wiir, ki mu ye unibaan la.

ref: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
text: Ti ponn ni bibaa ye Juu yaab, bibaa mu ye binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na, bibaa mu ye binaagbiib, bibaa mu ye bimalb, le Yesu gbiin ti mɔmɔk Nfuur Nyaan baan, ki ŋa timi unibaan. U cha ti mɔmɔk kan Nfuur Nyaan baan la.

ref: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
text: Tɔ, tiwon aa kpa tiwan nibaa baanja. Ti kpa tiwan kipaak la.

ref: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
text: Kitaafaak yaa bui ke, “Maah kaa ye kiŋaalfaak na, maa ye tiwon aawan” kan, naa ye tiwon aawan aa?

ref: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
text: Litafal mu yaa bui ke, “Maah kaa ye linimbil na, maa ye tiwon aawan” kan, naa ye tiwon aawan aa?

ref: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
text: Tiwonmɔn yaa ba ye linimbil ŋmeen kan, ti ba ga ŋa kinye ki ŋun? Ti yaa ba ki ye litafal ŋmeen kan, ti ba ga ŋa kinye ki ŋun nnun?

ref: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
text: Naah ye pu na, Uwumbɔr le di tiwon aawan mɔmɔk saŋ tɔb ponn ni, waah ban pu na.

ref: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
text: Tiwonmɔn yaa ba ye liwanbaal kan, ni ba ga li ye tiwon aa?

ref: It takes many parts to make a single body.
text: Naah ye pu na, tiwon kpa tiwan aabɔŋ aabɔŋ, le ki ye tiwonbaan.

ref: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
text: Nima pu na, linimbil aan ŋmaa tuk kiŋaalfaak, “Maa ban si.” Liyil mu aan ŋmaa tuk titaafar, “Maa ban nimi.”

ref: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
text: Tiwon nin chee kaa kpa mpɔɔn ke niken na, see ni mu li bi.

ref: We take special care to dress up some parts of our bodies. We are modest about our personal parts,
text: Tiwon nin chee lann lisil na, ti ga tii nima chee lisil ki jer niken. Le tiwon nin chee kaa ŋan na, ti ga ŋa nima chee ni ŋaŋ.

ref: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
text: Le tiwon nin chee ŋan na, naa ki ban nterm. Uwumbɔr le di tiwon aawan saŋ tɔb ni, ki di lisil tii nin chee ni lann lisil na.

ref: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
text: Nima na, tiwon aawan aan li kpak tɔb kinikpakpak, ni ga li ter tɔb ke naah ter nibaa pu na la.

ref: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
text: Tiwon nibaa chee yaa ji falaa kan, ni mɔmɔk ga kpaan ji falaa kina. Nibaa chee mu yaa kan nnyuŋ kan, ni mɔmɔk ga li kpa mpopiin.

ref: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
text: Nimi le ye Kristo aawon. Unii mɔmɔk ye waawon aawan nibaabaa la.

ref: First, God chose some people to be apostles and prophets and teachers for the church. But he also chose some to work miracles or heal the sick or help others or be leaders or speak different kinds of languages.
text: Uwumbɔr di timi ŋa waanib ponn ni la; njan, bibaa ye Yesu aakpambalb; lelee, bibaa mu ye Uwumbɔr aabɔnabtiib; taataa, bibaa mu ye bimɔmɔkb; le u tii bibaa mu mpɔɔn bi tun lijinjiir aatun; ki tii bibaa mu mpɔɔn ke bi cha bibum pɔɔk; bibaa mu ye biteterb; bibaa mu ye biyidam; bibaa mu len iliin yayan.

ref: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
text: Ti mɔmɔk ye Yesu aakpambalb aa? Ti mɔmɔk ye Uwumbɔr aabɔnabtiib aa? Ti mɔmɔk ye bimɔmɔkb aa? Ti mɔmɔk kpa mpɔɔn ki tun lijinjiir aatun aa?

ref: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
text: Ti mɔmɔk ŋmaa tii bibum laafee ee? Ti mɔmɔk len iliin yayan aa? Ti mɔmɔk ŋmaa nabr iliin yayan ngbaan aa?

ref: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
text: Tɔ, cha ninimbil li man ipiin i ŋan ki jer iken na pu. Cha m mɔk nimi nsan mu ŋan ki jer muken na.

ref: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
text: Unii yaa ŋmaa len binib aaliin ni Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib aaliin, ki yaa kaa gee binib kan, u bi ke tiwangbaakaan ni libɔluln na la.

ref: What if I could prophesy and understand all mysteries and all knowledge? And what if I had faith that moved mountains? I would be nothing, unless I loved others.
text: U yaa ŋmaa nabr Uwumbɔr aah len pu na, ki yaa bee tibɔr ti bɔɔ na mɔmɔk, ki yaa bee mbeen mɔmɔk, ki yaa kpa naadii u ga ŋmaa foor ŋijoo na, ki yaa kaa gee binib kan, waa ye nibaa.

ref: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
