text: U yaa di waawan mɔmɔk kpiin bigiim, ki yaa cha binib di u pun mmii ni Yesu pu, ki yaa kaa gee binib kan, naa kpa tinyoor Uwumbɔr chee.

ref: rude. Love isn't selfish or quick tempered. It doesn't keep a record of wrongs that others do.
text: kaa kpa inimpoo, kaa ye ukumɔndaan, kaa ye uŋuudaan, kaa dak tilandakbir binib pu,

ref: Love rejoices in the truth, but not in evil.
text: kaa kpa mpopiin uŋeen aatɔ aatunwanbir pu; u kpa mpopiin mbamɔn pu.

ref: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
text: Ngeehm ga li bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Uwumbɔr aabɔnabr aaliin ma kan, i ga doo. Iliin yayan ma kan, i mu ga doo. Mbeem ma kan, mu ga doo.

ref: We don't know everything, and our prophecies are not complete.
text: Dandana wee ti nyi ligeln, ki nabr Uwumbɔr aah len pu na ligeln,

ref: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
text: le buyoonn ti ga kan tiwamɔn na kan, ti ga di ligeln lii.

ref: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
text: Maah nan ye ubo na, m nan len ibiliin la, ki nan beer tiwan mbim aah beer pu na, ki dak mbim aah dak pu na. Maah ŋa unii na, le m di cha mbim aabɔr.

ref: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
text: Dandana, ni bi ke ti lik kinimbilikr, ki lik puu na la; n‑yoonn mu choo na, tiwan nibaa aan nan ki li bi tinimbiin ni ki doŋ timi tiwan nibaa chee. Ti ga li waa tiwan mɔmɔk chain. Dandana m nyi ngem. N‑yoonn mu choo na, m ga nan li nyi ni mɔmɔk, ke Uwumbɔr aah nyi maabɔr mɔmɔk pu na.

ref: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.
text: Tɔ, naadii, ni limakl, ni ngeehm, ni mɔmɔk nitaa le bi; ngeehm mu le jer ni mɔmɔk.

ref: Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy.
text: Pɔɔk nibaa man ki li gee binib, ki cha ninimbil li man Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aapiin pu; ni mu tee li ban ipiin i ga cha ni nabr Uwumbɔr aah len pu na, ki jer naah ban ipiin iken mɔmɔk pu na.

ref: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
text: Ba pu? unii u len iliin yayan na, waa len binib chee, Uwumbɔr chee le u len; ubaa aa ŋun waah len pu na. Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan cha u len tibɔr ti bɔɔ na la.

ref: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
text: Unii u nabr Uwumbɔr aah len pu na, u len binib chee, ki ter bi ke bi dii Uwumbɔr aasan mbamɔm, ki pɔɔk bitaakpab, ki sɔŋni bisui.

ref: By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church.
text: Unii u len iliin yayan na, u ter ubaa ke u dii Uwumbɔr aasan mbamɔm la. Unii u nabr Uwumbɔr aah len pu na, u ter Yesu aanib ke bi dii Uwumbɔr aasan mbamɔm la.

ref: I am glad for you to speak unknown languages, although I prefer that you would prophesy. In fact, prophesying does much more good than speaking unknown languages, unless someone can help the church by explaining what you mean.
text: Ni mɔmɔk yaa len iliin yayan kan, ni ga li mɔ mi; ni mɔmɔk mu yaa nabr Uwumbɔr aah len pu na kan, ni ga li mɔ mi ki jer kina. Unii u nabr Uwumbɔr aah len pu na, u jer unii u len iliin yayan na, see unii u ga nabr iliin yayan ngbaan na bi. U yaa nabr iliin yayan ngbaan kan, u ga ter Yesu aanib ke bi dii Uwumbɔr aasan mbamɔm.

ref: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
text: Nnaabitiib, m yaa dan ni chee ki nan len iliin yayan baanja kan, ni ga ter nimi ii? Aayii. Naan ter nimi, see m tuk nimi Uwumbɔr aah kpiir tibɔr ti tuk mi na, bee m tuk nimi mbeen mu nyan ni Uwumbɔr chee na, bee m nabr Uwumbɔr aah len pu na, bee m mɔk nimi Uwumbɔr aabɔr.

ref: If all musical instruments sounded alike, how would you know the difference between a flute and a harp?
text: Tɔ, tiwangbaakaan mu yaa kaa wii mbamɔm kan, ni ye fam la. Ni yaa ye liwul, bee ni yaa ye kibeek kan, ni yaa kaa wii mbamɔm kan, ubaa aan bee naah wii pu na.

ref: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
text: Unii yaa pii ukpiin, kaa pii mbamɔm kan, baan kuun tɔb chee ke bi ti to butɔb.

ref: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
text: Ni mu bi kina la. Nilambil yaa kaa len iliin i si mbamɔm na kan, binib ga ŋa kinye ki ŋun naah len pu na? Ni len tii libuln la.

ref: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.
text: M mu yaa kaa ŋun unii ubaa aaliin kan, m ga li ye uwɔwɔnja le u chee, u mu ga li ye uwɔwɔnja le m chee.

ref: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
text: Nima pu na, unii yaa len iliin yayan kan, u li mee Uwumbɔr ke u cha u nabr iliin yayan ngbaan.

ref: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
text: Ba pu? m yaa mee Uwumbɔr ki len iliin yayan kan, Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan le cha m mee kina, nlandak aa dak.

ref: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
text: Kina pu na, ni ŋan ke m ŋa kinye? M ga mee Uwumbɔr, Waafuur Nyaan aah ga cha m mee pu na, ki mee maalandak mu aah ga cha m mee pu na. M ga gaa ilahn Waafuur Nyaan aah ga cha m gaa pu na, ki gaa ilahn maalandak mu aah ga cha m gaa pu na.

ref: Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, “Amen”?
text: Aa yaa doon Uwumbɔr, Waafuur Nyaan aah cha aa doon u pu na kan, unii yaa bi nikaasisik ni, kaa nyi Uwumbɔr aasan kan, u ga ŋa kinye ki len ke saah doon Uwumbɔr pu na ye mbamɔn; ba pu? waa ŋun saah len pu na.

ref: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.
text: Mbamɔn, saah doon Uwumbɔr pu na, ni ŋan, ni mu aa ter udaan ngbaan ke u dii Uwumbɔr aasan.

ref: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
text: M dooni Uwumbɔr ke m len iliin yayan ki jer ni mɔmɔk.

ref: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
text: M mu yaa bi Yesu aanib aakaasisik ni, ki yaa len maalandak aaliin iŋmu baanja, aan ki mɔk bi Uwumbɔr aabɔr kan, ni soor ni m len iliin yayan ŋichur kipiik.

ref: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
text: Ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke Uwumbɔr len ke, “M ga di biwɔwɔm bi len ŋitimbol yayan aaliin na len binib ngbaan chee, hali m yaa ŋa kina kan, baan pel.”

ref: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?
text: Nima pu na, Yesu aanib mɔmɔk yaa kuun tɔb chee, aan bi mɔmɔk yaa len iliin yayan kan, binib bi kaa nyi Yesu aasan na, bee binib bi kaa gaa u ki kii na, bi yaa koo ni kan, baan len ke ni waar la aa?

ref: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
text: Le ni mɔmɔk yaa nabr Uwumbɔr aah len pu na kan, unii u kaa gaa Yesu ki kii na, bee unii u kaa nyi Yesu aasan na yaa koo ni kan, ni mɔmɔk aah len pu na le ga cha waalandak li muk u, ki cha u bee waatunwanbir aah bi pu na,

ref: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
text: ki cha usui ni aabɔr nya mpaan pu. Nima pu le u ga gbaan kitiŋ, ki pak Uwumbɔr, ki len ke ni ye mbamɔn, Uwumbɔr sil bi nikaasisik ni. Naah ga li dooni Uwumbɔr pu na

ref: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
text: Nnaabitiib, maah len pu na ye kinye? Ni yaa nan kuun tɔb chee kan, ubaa ga li ban ke u gaa nlahn, uken mu ga li kpa mmɔkm, ubaa mu ga li kpa Uwumbɔr aah kpiir pu ki tuk u na, uken mu ga li kpa iliin yayan, ubaa mu ga ŋmaa nabr iliin yayan ngbaan. Naah ga ŋa tiwan ni mɔmɔk na, ni li ŋani tiwan ni ga ter Uwumbɔr aanib ke bi dii waasan mbamɔm na.

ref: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
text: Ni ponn ni bibaa yaa ban bi len iliin yayan kan, cha binib bilee, bee bitaa len. Binib bi len na taa jer bitaa. Cha bi len ubaabaa, ki cha ubaa mu nabr baah len pu na.

ref: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
text: Unii u ga ŋmaa nabr iliin yayan ngbaan na yaa kaa bi kan, cha bi ŋmin Uwumbɔr aadiik ni, ki li len bibaa ni Uwumbɔr chee.

ref: Two or three persons may prophesy, and everyone else must listen carefully.
text: Cha Uwumbɔr aabɔnabtiib bilee bee bitaa mu len, ki cha biken lik baah len pu na.

ref: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
text: Uwumbɔr yaa kpiir tibɔr ki mɔk unii u mu ka nikaasisik ni na kan, cha unii u puen len na ŋmin waahr aan uleler mu len.

ref: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
text: Le ni mɔmɔk ga ŋmaa nabr Uwumbɔr aah len pu na ubaabaa. Ni yaa ŋa kina kan, ni mɔmɔk ga ŋmaa bae Uwumbɔr aabɔr, le ni ga pɔɔk ni mɔmɔk aataakpab.

ref: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.
text: Nfuur Nyaan yaa cha unii nabr Uwumbɔr aah len pu na kan, u ga ŋmaa chuu ubaa ki li kii n‑yoonn mubaa.

ref: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
text: Uwumbɔr aa ban kifuuk, u ban suuna la.

ref: the women must not be allowed to speak. They must keep quiet and listen, as the Law of Moses teaches.
text: Bipiib li ŋmin Yesu aanib aakuun ponn ni na. Baa kpa nsan ke bi len. Ni bi kina Yesu aanib aakuun mɔmɔk ponn ni la. Ni ŋan bi li keei bichatiib aamɔi. Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ mu len kina la.

ref: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
text: Bi yaa ban bi bee tiwan kan, cha bi baa bichatiib linampal. Ba pu? upii yaa len Yesu aanib aakuun ni kan, ni kpa inimɔɔn la.

ref: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
text: Uwumbɔr aabɔr puen nyan ni nimi le chee ee? Tibɔr ngbaan pii nimi baanja la aa?

ref: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
text: Tɔ, unii yaa dak ke u ye Uwumbɔr aabɔnabr kan, bee u yaa dak ke u kpa Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aapiin kan, cha u bee ke maah ŋmee pu tii nimi na, ni ye Tidindaan aah len pu na la.

ref: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
text: Unii yaa kaa gar maah ŋmee pu na kan, ni mu taa gar u.

ref: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
text: Nnaabitiib, nima pu na, cha ninimbil li man ke ni nabr Uwumbɔr aah len pu na, ki taa bui unii ubaa ke u taa len iliin yayan.

ref: But do everything properly and in order.
text: Ni mu li ŋani tiwan mɔmɔk, ni li dii nsan.

ref: My friends, I want you to remember the message I preached and that you believed and trusted.
text: Nnaabitiib, m ban m teer nimi maah nan tuk nimi tibɔnyaan ti na la. Ni nan gaa tibɔnyaan ngbaan, ki sil ti pu.

ref: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
text: Tibɔnyaan ngbaan mu pu le ni ŋmar. Ni yaa joo maah tuk nimi ti na mbamɔm, ki yaa kaa gaa ti ki kii fam kan, ni ŋmar a.

ref: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
text: Maah nan gaa tibɔnyaan ngbaan na, tima le m nan di tuk ni mu. Ti ye tibɔkpaan ki jer tibɔr mɔmɔk. Tibɔnyaan ngbaan le ye ke Kristo nan kpo timi aatunwanbir pu. Ni ŋmee kina Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni.

ref: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
text: Le bi nan di u di sub. Iwiin itaa daal le Uwumbɔr fikr u nkun ni. Ni ŋmee kina Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni.

ref: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
text: Le waadidiliib bi jer ikui iŋmu na mu nan kpaan kan u. Bi ponn ni pam beenin bi, le bibaa mu kpo.

ref: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.
text: Jems mu nan kan u, le bikpambalb mɔmɔk mu kan u.

ref: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
text: Gbelngbeln yaan le m mu kan u. Min u bi ke baah ker ubo u lii na, m mu kan u.

ref: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
text: Yesu aakpambalb mɔmɔk jer mi. Maa ŋeer ke bi yin mi ke Yesu aakpambal; ba pu? m nan ŋa waanib falaa.

ref: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
text: Le Uwumbɔr aah ter mi pu na, m bi ke maah bi pu dandana na. Waah ter mi pu na, waa ter mi yɔli. M tun lituln ki jer Yesu aakpambalb mɔmɔk. Ni mu aa ye min le tun lituln ngbaan. Uwumbɔr aaterm mu bi m chee na le cha m tun.

ref: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
text: Nima pu na, min le yaa nan tuk nimi tibɔnyaan ngbaan, bee bima le yaa nan tuk nimi kan, ti mɔmɔk tuk nimi kina la, ni mu gaa ti ki kii kina. Uwumbɔr aanib aah ga fikr nkun ni pu na

ref: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
text: Tɔ, taah nan tuk nimi ke Uwumbɔr fikr Kristo nkun ni na, ni ŋa kinye aan ni ponn ni bibaa ki len ke binib bi kpo na aan fikr nkun ni.

ref: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
text: Bi yaa len ke binib bi kpo na aan fikr nkun ni kan, ni mɔk ke Uwumbɔr aa fikr Kristo nkun ni.

ref: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.
text: Uwumbɔr yaa kaa nan fikr Kristo nkun ni kan, taah tuk nimi tibɔnyaan ti na mu ye yɔli la. Ni mu gaa ti ki kii yɔli la;

ref: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
text: ni mu mɔk ke ti mɔn nnyamɔn paan Uwumbɔr; ba pu? ti len ke u fikr Kristo nkun ni. Ni yaa ye mbamɔn ke binib bi kpo na aan fikr nkun ni kan, ni mɔk ke Uwumbɔr aa fikr Yesu mu nkun ni.

ref: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
text: Ba pu? Bi yaa len ke binib bi kpo na aan fikr nkun ni kan, ni mɔk ke Uwumbɔr aa fikr Kristo mu nkun ni.

ref: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
text: Uwumbɔr yaa kaa nan fikr Kristo nkun ni kan, ni gaa u ki kii yɔli, ki beenin bi nimi aatunwanbir aapɔɔn ni.

ref: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
text: Binib bi nan dii Yesu ki kpo na mu, ni mɔk ke bi mu bee yɔli.

ref: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
text: Ti yaa kpa limakl Kristo pu dulnyaa wee ponn ni baanja kan, ti kpa kinimbaak ki jer binib mɔmɔk.

ref: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.
text: Tɔ, ni ye mbamɔn la, Uwumbɔr sil fikr Kristo nkun ni. Uma le ye njan aanii u puen fikr nkun ni na, le ki mɔk ke binib bimɔk kpo na mu ga nan fikr nkun ni.

ref: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
text: Uja ubaa pu, le nkun bi. Uja ubaa mu pu, le binib bi kpo na mu ga fikr nkun ni.

ref: Adam brought death to all of us, and Christ will bring life to all of us.
text: Adam pu, le binib mɔmɔk kpu. Kristo pu, le binib mɔmɔk ga kan limɔfal.

ref: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
text: Kina le bi ga li paa tɔb pu. Kristo le ye njan aanii u puen fikr nkun ni na. U yaa gir ni kan, binib bi ye uyaab na mu ga fikr nkun ni.

ref: Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.
text: Tiwan nimina mɔmɔk yaa ti ŋa kan, le tiwan mɔmɔk ga doo. N‑yoonn ngbaan le u ga kuln waadim aabɔŋ mɔmɔk aapɔɔn, ki di nnaan na tii Ute Uwumbɔr,

ref: Christ will rule until he puts all his enemies under his power,
text: ki ga li joo tiwan mɔmɔk ki nan saa buyoonn Uwumbɔr di waadim mɔmɔk ŋa utaapɔtan ni na.

ref: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
text: Kookoo aadin u u ga bii u na le ye nkun.

ref: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.
text: Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ le len ke u di tiwan mɔmɔk di ŋa Kristo aataapɔtan ni ke ni kii waamɔb. Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ aah len ke u cha tiwan mɔmɔk kii Kristo aamɔb na, nima le aa mɔk ke Uwumbɔr ubaa mu ga kii waamɔb.

ref: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
text: Uwumbɔr yaa cha tiwan mɔmɔk kii Kristo aamɔb kan, le Kristo, u ye Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn na, u mu ga kii Uwumbɔr u nan cha tiwan mɔmɔk kii waamɔb na aamɔb. Nima kan, Uwumbɔr le ga li joo tiwan mɔmɔk pel pel.

ref: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
text: Tɔ, ni muin binib bibaa nnyun ni, ke bi sil binib bi kpo na aasisiiyaan la. Bibaa yaa bui ke binib bi kpo na aan fikr nkun ni kan, ba pu ni muin binib nnyun ni baasisiiyaan?

ref: And why do we always risk our lives
text: Binib yaa kaan fikr nkun ni kan, ba pu ti kani linimaln n‑yoonn mɔmɔk?

ref: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
text: Nnaabitiib, idaa mɔmɔk m chuun nkun ni la. M kpa kipupuk ni pu Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aasan ni, nima le cha m len kina.

ref: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
text: Finn ngeen pu man, ki tun lituln li ŋan na, ki taa ki tun titunwanbir. Ni ponn ni bibaa aa nyi Uwumbɔr. M len kina ke m jinn nimi inimɔɔn la. Tiwon ti fikr nkun ni na aabɔr

ref: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
text: Le unii ubaa ga baa ke, “Binib bi kpo na ga ŋa kinye ki fikr nkun ni? Bi yaa fikr nkun ni kan, tiwon ngbaan aaboln ga li bi kinye?”

ref: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.
text: Ujɔr, aa yaa di lijikaabuul bun kan, li yaa kaa kpo kan, laan punn.

ref: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
text: Le Uwumbɔr tii lijikaabuul ngbaan tiwon, waah gee pu na. U tii lijikaabuul mɔmɔk aawon aabɔŋ aabɔŋ la.

ref: People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike.
text: Tiwan mɔmɔk aawon aa kpaan. Binib aawon bi tibaa, tiwakor mu aawon bi tibaa, inyoon mu aawon bi tibaa, ijan mu aawon bi tibaa.

ref: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
text: Paacham aawan mu bi la, le ki cha kitiŋ aawan. Paacham aawan kpa kinyaan, kitiŋ aawan mu kpa kinyaan. Naanyaan mu aa kpaan.

ref: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
text: Nwiin, ni uŋmal, ni ŋiŋmabil kpa kinyaan; ni mu aanyaan aa kpaan; ŋiŋmabil mɔmɔk aanyaan mu aa kpaan.

ref: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
text: Binib yaa nan fikr nkun ni kan, ni ga nan li bi kina la. Tiwon ti bi di sub na, ni ye tiwan ni ga bur na la. Ni yaa fikr nkun ni kan, ni ga nan li ye tiwon ti kaan ŋmaa bur na la.

ref: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
text: Ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke Uwumbɔr nan naan njan aanii Adam, ki tii u limɔfal. Kookoo yoo le ye Nfuur Nyaan mu tii timi limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na. Uma le ye Kristo.

ref: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
text: Njan, ti kpa dulnyaa wee ni aawon. Lelee le ti ga kan tiwon ti ga ŋeer Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aah ban pu na paacham.

ref: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
text: Uwumbɔr nan di titan le naan njan aanii Adam. U nyan ni kitiŋ la. Lelee aanii, u ye Kristo na, uma le nyan ni Uwumbɔr do.

ref: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
text: Binib bi ye kitiŋ yaab na bi ke unii u Uwumbɔr nan di titan ki naan u na aah bi pu na la. Binib bi ye Uwumbɔr do yaab na, bi mu bi le ke unii u nyan ni paacham na aah bi pu na.

ref: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
text: Ti naahn unii u Uwumbɔr nan di titan ki naan u na la. Kina le ti ga li naahn unii u nyan ni Uwumbɔr do na mu.

ref: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
text: Nnaabitiib, maah len pu na le ye ke tiwon ti ye tinann ni nsin na aan ŋmaa koo Uwumbɔr aanaan ni paacham. Ni ga bur na mu aan ŋmaa le ye ni kaan bur na.

ref: I will explain a mystery to you. Not every one of us will die, but we will all be changed.
text: Li pel man, m ga tuk nimi tibɔr ti bɔɔ na. Timi bibaa ga kpo, bibaa mu ga pii Kristo aah ga gir ni bundaln na. Le ti mɔmɔk aawon ga kpeln.

ref: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
text: Kakaan yaa wii kookoo yaan kan, libuul ngbaan ni le ti ga kpeln. Naan pii linimbil aah ga kab pu na. Kakaan ga nan wii, le binib bi kpo na ga fikr nkun ni, kaan ki bur. Le Uwumbɔr ga kpeln timi aawon.

ref: Our dead and decaying bodies will be changed into bodies that won't die or decay.
text: See tiwon ti ga bur na kpaln tiwon ti kaan ki bur na, tiwon ti ga kpo na mu kpaln ti kaan kpo na.

ref: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
text: Tiwon ti ga bur na yaa nan kpaln ti kaan bur na, aan tiwon ti ga kpo na yaa nan kpaln tiwon ti kaan ki kpo na kan, liyaadaal ngbaan le Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ aah len pu na ga gbiin ke, “Uwumbɔr nyaŋ nkun, ki kuln mu.

ref: Where is its victory? Where is its sting?”
text: Nkun aapɔɔn bi la chee? Nkun aaween ki bi la chee?”

ref: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
text: Titunwanbir le ye nkun aaween. Uwumbɔr aakaal le ye titunwanbir aapɔɔn.

ref: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
text: Le ti dooni Uwumbɔr; ba pu? Tidindaan Yesu Kristo pu le u tii timi bunyaŋ.

ref: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
text: Nnaabigeehm, nima pu na, n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ni li tun Tidindaan aatuln sakpen, ki taa cha nibaa leŋ nimi. Ni li bi li ni; ba pu? ni nyi ke ni yaa tun lituln tii Tidindaan kan, naa tun fam.

ref: When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
text: Tɔ, tibɔr ti bi ki joo cha ipiin i ni ga too ki tii Yesu aanib bi bi Judea aatiŋ ni na, ni li ŋani maah tuk Yesu aanib Galasia aatiŋ ponn ni ke bi li ŋani pu na.

ref: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
text: Likpaakool daal mɔmɔk, ni mɔmɔk aah kan tinyoor pu na, ni di ngem bil, ki li kii buyoonn m ga labr ni na. Nima kan, m yaa nan fuu ni kan, naan ki piin ki li too ŋimombil.

ref: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
text: Ni lee ni ponn ni bibaa. M yaa nan fuu ni kan, m ga tii bi tigbann, ki tun bi, ke bi di naah too ipiin i na ki di buen ti tii Yesu aanib bi bi Jerusalem na.

ref: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
text: Ni yaa ŋeer m mu buen nima chee kan, m mu ga dii bi. Pɔɔl aalandak

ref: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
text: M ban m bɔ dii Masedonia aatim ni. M yaa bɔ dii nima chee kan, m ga dii ni ni chee.

ref: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
text: Nibaakan, m ga li bi ni chee ki yunn, nibaakan, kakab yoonn ga ti jer. Nima kan, ni ga ter mi m gor ki ki buen maah cha nin chee na.

ref: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
text: M yaa nan fuu ni ni chee kan, maa ban m nan li bi ni chee iwiin siib. Tidindaan yaa kii kan, m ban ke m nan li bi ni chee ki yunn la.

ref: I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
text: Tɔ, m ga li bi Efesus aatiŋ ni do ki ti saa Pentekost daal;

ref: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
text: ba pu? m kpa nsan sakpen ke m tuk binib Yesu aabɔnyaan tee. Le maadim mu wiir.

ref: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
text: Timoti yaa nan fuu ni ni chee kan, ni taa ŋaab ulan; ba pu? u mu tun Tidindaan aatuln ke maah tun pu na la.

ref: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
text: Nima pu na, ubaa taa lik u fam. Ni ter u man aan u gor ki ki chuun buen nibaa chee ni mpopiin, aan ki ki gir ni m chee; m nyi ubɔr ke u ni tinaabitiib ga fuu ni.

ref: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
text: Tina aabo Apolos ma kan, m gaŋ u sakpen ke u dii tinaabitiib ki dan ni chee, le waa ban ke u dan dandana wee. U yaa kan nsan kan, u ga dan ni chee. Kookoo aabɔr

ref: Show love in everything you do.
text: Naah tun lituln limɔk na, ni li gee tɔb man.

ref: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
text: Ni nyi Stefanas ni waachiln ni aanib aabɔr, ke bima li puen Akaya aatiŋ aanib mɔmɔk ki dii Yesu aasan. N‑yoonn mɔmɔk bi kpa liyabr ki ter Yesu aanib.

ref: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
text: Nnaabitiib, m gaŋ nimi, ni dii binib bimɔk bi kina na, ni binib bimɔk kpaan ti chee ki tun Uwumbɔr aatuln linimaln na aasan.

ref: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.
text: Stefanas, ni Fotunatus, ni Akaikus aah fuu ni na, le m kpa mpopiin. Naah kaa bi m chee na, le bi leŋ nimi aaleleŋ.

ref: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
text: Baah fuu ni na, bi pɔɔk ntaakpab, ni ni mu aataakpab. Ni li pak binib bi bi kina na.

ref: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
text: Uwumbɔr aanib bi bi Asia aatim ni na dooni nimi. Akuila ni upuu Prisila, ni Tidindaan Yesu aanib bi kuuni bido na mu dooni nimi mbamɔm waayimbil pu.

ref: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
text: Tinaabitiib mɔmɔk dooni nimi. Ni mu doon tɔb ke naabitiib aah gee tɔb pu na.

ref: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
text: Min Pɔɔl le ŋmee maaŋmeen ki dooni nimi.

ref: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
text: Unii yaa kaa gee Tidindaan kan, Uwumbɔr aabɔbir li bi u pu. Tidindaan, dan.

ref: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
text: Tidindaan Yesu ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu.

ref: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
text: M gee ni mɔmɔk Yesu Kristo pu.

ref: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
text: Min Pɔɔl u ye Yesu aakpambal Uwumbɔr aageehn pu na, m ni tina aabo Timoti le ŋmee kigbaŋ kee tii nimi Uwumbɔr aanib bi bi Korint aatiŋ ni na, ni waanib bimɔk bi Griis aatim mɔmɔk ni na.

ref: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
text: Tite Uwumbɔr ni Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu, ki tii nimi nsuudoon. Pɔɔl di idoon tii Uwumbɔr

ref: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.
text: Cha ti pak Uwumbɔr u ye Tidindaan Yesu Kristo Aate na. U ye Tite u san timi kinimbaak sakpen ki sɔŋ tisui na.

ref: He comforts us when we are in trouble, so that we can share this same comfort with others in trouble.
text: Timi aafalaa mɔmɔk ponn ni u sɔŋni tisui, ke ti mu ga ŋmaa sɔŋ binib bi bi falaa mɔmɔk aabɔŋ ni na aasui. Ti mu ga sɔŋ bisui ke Uwumbɔr aah sɔŋ tisui pu na.

ref: We share in the terrible sufferings of Christ, but also in the wonderful comfort he gives.
text: Kristo pu, le ti ji falaa sakpen. Kristo pu, le Uwumbɔr sɔŋ tisui sakpen.

ref: We suffer in the hope that you will be comforted and saved. And because we are comforted, you will also be comforted, as you patiently endure suffering like ours.
text: Taah ji falaa pu na, ni pu le ti ji falaa, ke ti sɔŋ nisui ki ter nimi, ni ŋmar. Uwumbɔr yaa sɔŋ tisui kan, ni pu le u sɔŋ tisui, ke ti mu sɔŋ nisui, ke ni li kpa limɔr ki ji falaa ke ti mu aah ji falaa pu na.

ref: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
text: Nima pu na, ti dak ke naan gir puwɔb. Ba pu? ti nyi ke ni yaa ji falaa ke taah ji falaa pu na kan, Uwumbɔr ga sɔŋ nisui, ke waah sɔŋ tisui pu na.

ref: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
text: Tinaabitiib, ti ban ke ni bee taah nan ji falaa pu Asia aatiŋ ni na. Falaa ngbaan nan muk timi ki ti chaar jer. Taa nan dak ke ti ga ki li bi.

ref: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
text: Timi tibaa nan len ke ti ga kpo. Ni ŋa kina ke ti bee ke taan ŋmaa ter tibaa. Uwumbɔr u fikr binib nkun ni na baanja le ga ŋmaa ter timi.

ref: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
text: U nyan timi ijawaan aakun ni, ki beenin nyani timi. Ti pak ke u ga ki nyan timi.

ref: Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers. Paul's Change of Plans
text: Ni mu aah mee Uwumbɔr tii timi pu na, ni ter timi la. Binib aah mee Uwumbɔr tii timi ki wiir pu na, le u ga ŋa tinyoor ŋa ti pu. Nima le binib pam ga doon Uwumbɔr tii timi. Pɔɔl aalandak aah kpeln pu na

ref: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.
text: Ti kpa kipupuk; ba pu? ti nyi tisui ni ke ti bi chain. Timi aabimbin bi mbamɔm Uwumbɔr aah ban pu na. Binib aalan le aa cha ti bi mbamɔm, Uwumbɔr aaterm pu, le cha ti bi mbamɔm joo cha dulnyaa wee ni aanib wɔb, ki moo bi mbamɔm joo cha niwɔb.

ref: just as you already partly understand us. Then when our Lord Jesus returns, you can be as proud of us as we are of you.
text: Dandana ni bee timi aabimbin ngem aah bi pu na. M kpa limakl ke bundaln Tidindaan Yesu ga gir ni na, ni ga sil bee ke ni ga li ŋmaa kpa kipupuk ti pu, ke ti mu aah ga li kpa kipupuk ni pu pu na.

ref: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others?
text: Maah nan len ke m ga dan na, maa len fam la; maah dak ke m ga ŋa pu na, ni ye ke m dii binib aalan la aa? Ni dak ke m ye unii u aalandak kpelni yɔl yɔl na la aa?

ref: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
text: Uwumbɔr aah ye mbamɔndaan na, ti mu aa kpelni timi aalandak yɔl yɔl.

ref: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
text: M ni Silfanus ni Timoti nan tuk nimi Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn Yesu Kristo aabɔr. Uma le aa ye unii u aalandak kpelni yɔl yɔl na. U ŋani waah len pu na n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Christ says “Yes” to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say “Amen” for us to the glory of God.
text: U pu, le Uwumbɔr gbiin waah puu tipuur ti wiir na mɔmɔk. Nima pu na, u pu le ti bui ke, “Amii,” le ki nyuŋ Uwumbɔr.

ref: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
text: Uwumbɔr le ter ti ni nimi ke ti dii Kristo mbamɔm, ki lee timi ke ti tun waatuln.

ref: and put his Spirit in our hearts to show that we belong only to him.
text: U daan timi ke uma le yeh timi, ki di Waafuur Nyaan ŋa tisui ni, ke u mɔk timi waah ga tii timi pu na n‑yoonn mu choo na.

ref: God is my witness that I stayed away from Corinth, just to keep from being hard on you.
text: M puu Uwumbɔr ke m len mbamɔn la; maa nan ban ke m kae nimi, nima le cha m nan len ke maan dan ni chee Korint aatiŋ ni n‑yoonn ngbaan.

ref: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
text: Taa joo nimi mpɔɔn; naah gaa Yesu ki kii mbamɔm na, le ti ban ti ter nimi ni li kpa mpopiin. Timi aatuln le na.

ref: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.
text: M nan di ŋa nsui ni, ke maan ki dan ni chee ki nan tii nimi mpombiin.

ref: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
text: Ba pu? nimi le ye binib bi tii mi mpopiin na. M yaa bii nisui kan, naan ki ŋmaa tii mi mpopiin.

ref: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
text: Nima le cha m nan ŋmee kigbaŋ ngbaan tii ni nimi. Maa ban m dan ki nan li kpa mpombiin ni pu. Ni ye binib bi ba ga ŋmaa ŋa mi mpopiin na la. M nyi nimi aabimbin, ke m yaa kpa mpopiin kan, ni mu ga li kpa mpopiin.

ref: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
text: Maah nan ŋmee kigbaŋ ngbaan m tii nimi na, nsui nan bii sakpen. M nan wii pam. Maa nan ŋmee kigbaŋ ngbaan ke m tii nimi mpombiin, m nan ban ke ni bee maah gee nimi sakpen pu na la. Di cha pinn unii u tun si taani na

ref: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
text: Ni ponn ni ubaa yaa tun titunwanbir ki bii nsui kan, naa ye nsui baanja le u bii, ni mɔmɔk aasui le u bii. M mu aa ban ke m len tibɔr ngbaan ki ti chaar jer.

ref: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
text: Ni ponn ni pam aah kii ki daa utafal pu na, nima le ŋeer.

ref: When people sin, you should forgive and comfort them, so they won't give up in despair.
text: Dandana ni ŋan ke ni di cha pinn u, ki sɔŋ usui, u taa li kpa mpombiin ki ti chaar jer.

ref: You should make them sure of your love for them.
text: Nima pu na, m gaŋ nimi, ni cha u sil bee naah gee u pu na.

ref: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
text: M nan ban m bee nimi aabimbin aah bi pu na, ke ni ga kii maamɔb mɔmɔk aan naan kii. Nima le cha m nan ŋmee kigbaŋ ngbaan tii nimi.

ref: I will forgive anyone you forgive. Yes, for your sake and with Christ as my witness, I have forgiven whatever needed to be forgiven.
text: Ni yaa di cha pinn unii kan, m mu ga di cha pinn u. Maah di cha pinn u pu na, ni pu le m di cha pinn u, ki si Kristo aasisiiyaan.

ref: I have done this to keep Satan from getting the better of us. We all know what goes on in his mind.
text: M di cha pinn u, ke kinimbɔŋ taa nyaŋ timi; ba pu? ti nyi kaah ban ki bii timi pu na. Ilandak aah nan joo Pɔɔl pu na

ref: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
text: M nan buen Troas aatiŋ ni, m ti moon Kristo aabɔnyaan. Maah fuu ni na, le Tidindaan tii mi nsan ke m tun waatuln ngbaan.

ref: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
text: Le maah kaa kan nna aabo Taitus nima chee na, maa ŋmaa fuur lii nsui ni. Nima le m chɔi nima chee aanib, le ki siir buen Masedonia aatiŋ ni. Yesu Kristo pu le ti nyaŋni

ref: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
text: Tɔ, cha ti doon Uwumbɔr mbamɔm. N‑yoonn mɔmɔk u cha ti nyaŋni kinimbɔŋ, Kristo aapɔɔn pu, ki cha ti buen ni kookoo, ki tuk binib waabɔr ke bi bee u. Waabɔr mɔ ke tulalee aah nu mɔ pu na.

ref: In fact, God thinks of us as a perfume that brings Christ to everyone. For people who are being saved, this perfume has a sweet smell and leads them to a better life. But for people who are lost, it has a bad smell and leads them to a horrible death. No one really has what it takes to do this work.
text: Ti mu bi Uwumbɔr chee ke tulalee aayon mu nu mɔ na la; ba pu? Kristo bi tisui ni. Binib bi ŋmar na ŋun waah nu mɔ pu na, ki kan limɔfal; ba pu? bi gaa u ki kii. Binib bi kaa ŋmar na mu ŋun ki kan nkun; ba pu? baa gaa u ki kii. Ubaa ga ŋmaa tun Uwumbɔr aatuln ubaa pu uu? Aayii.

ref: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
text: Ti mu aa mooni Uwumbɔr aabɔr ŋimombil pu ke binib pam aah ŋani pu na. Uwumbɔr le tun timi ke ti moon waabɔr. Nima pu le ti ye binib bi len mbamɔn na, ki mooni Uwumbɔr aabɔr unimbil ni, Kristo aapɔɔn pu.

ref: Are we once again bragging about ourselves? Do we need letters to you or from you to tell others about us? Some people do need letters telling about them.
text: Ni dak ke ti piin ke ti ki nyuŋ tibaa aa? Taa bi ke binib bibaa aah bi pu na, ki ban ke binib ŋmee kigbaŋ ki pak timi na, ti tii nimi. Ti ban ke ni ŋmee kigbaŋ ki pak timi ii? Aayii.

ref: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.
text: Nimi nibaa le ye kigbaŋ ki pak timi na ki ŋmee tisui ni. Ba pu? binib yaa lik nimi aabimbin aah bi pu na kan, bi ga bee ke ti mɔk nimi nsanyaan la.

ref: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
text: Bi ga bee ke ni ye kigbaŋ ki nyan ni Kristo ni na, le u cha ti ŋmee ki. Taa nan di ngbaŋmeemoon le ŋmee ki. Uwumbɔr u ye limɔfadaan na Aafuur Nyaan le ŋmee ki. Ŋŋmeen ngbaan aa ŋmee ŋitakpal pu, ni ŋmee binib aasui ni la.

ref: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
text: Kristo pu, le ti kpa limakl kina, Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni, nima le cha ti len kina.

ref: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
text: Taa len ke ti ga ŋmaa ŋa nibaa tibaa aapɔɔn pu. Timi aapɔɔn nyan ni Uwumbɔr chee la.

ref: He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
text: Uma le tii timi mpɔɔn ke ti tuk binib waah puu tipuupɔln ti na. Taa tuk bi ke bi yaa kaa kii Moses aakaal mɔmɔk kan, bi ga kpo. Ti tuk bi ke Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan le ga tii bi limɔfal. Ba pu? Moses aakaal mɔk timi ke ti ŋeer nkun, Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan le tii timi limɔfal.

ref: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
text: Moses aakaal nan ŋmee ŋitakpapapan pu, ki nan fuu ni ni mpɔɔn aafuun la. Uwumbɔr aah nan cha Moses tii Israel yaab nkaal mu bi door na, Moses aanimbil wɔb nan wiin chain, le binib aanimbil aa ŋmaa lik u. Tɔ, nkaal mu mɔk timi ke ti ŋeer nkun na aah nan joo ni nwiihn kina na,

ref: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
text: Uwumbɔr yaa tii timi Waafuur Nyaan kan, Nfuur Nyaan ngbaan ga li joo ni nwiihn ki ti jer kina.

ref: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
text: Moses aakaal mu nan joo ni nwiihn na aa ki kpa nwiihn; ba pu? tibɔnyaan ngbaan aawiihn jer nwiihn ngbaan la.

ref: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
text: Moses aakaal mu jer na yaa nan kpa nwiihn kan, tibɔnyaan ti ga li bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na le kpa nwiihn ki ti jer kina.

ref: This wonderful hope makes us feel like speaking freely.
text: Taah kpa limakl tibɔnyaan tee pu na, nima le ti kpa lipobil ki len.

ref: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
text: Taa bi ke Moses na. U nan di likekeln biin unimbil wɔb, ke Israel yaab taa kan nkaal mu nan bi door na aah nan cha unimbil wɔb wiin chain pu na.

ref: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
text: Bitafal nan pɔɔ. Bi yaa karn Uwumbɔr aagbakpok kan, baa beer naatataa ki nan saa dandana. Ba pu? unii aan ŋmaa bee naatataa see u gaa Kristo ki kii.

ref: When the Law of Moses is read, they have their minds covered over
text: Bi yaa karn Moses aakaal kan, baa beer naatataa ki nan saa dandana.

ref: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
text: Unii yaa fenn ki dii Tidindaan kan, u ga bee naatataa.

ref: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
text: Tidindaan ni Nfuur Nyaan ye Unibaan la. Nfuur Nyaan aah bi nin chee na, lifuur bi nima.

ref: So our faces are not covered. They show the bright glory of the Lord, as the Lord's Spirit makes us more and more like our glorious Lord.
text: Ti mɔmɔk waa Tidindaan aah wiin chain pu na. Nibaa aa bi ki dok timi ke ti taa li waa u. Tidindaan u ye Nfuur Nyaan na le cha ti bi kpelni, ki naŋni u, ki moo wolni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, ke waah wiin chain pu na.

ref: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
text: Tɔ, Uwumbɔr aanimbaasaln pu, le u tii timi waatuln ke ti tun. Nima le timi aataakpab aa yɔl.

ref: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
text: Ti yii inimɔɔn aatuln, ni mbɔmbɔɔn aatuln, kaa ŋmanni binib, kaa kpelni Uwumbɔr aabɔr. Ti bi Uwumbɔr aanimbil ni la. Nima le cha ti tuk binib waabɔr mbamɔm, aan bi mɔmɔk bee ke ti len mbamɔn.

ref: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
text: Binib bi kaa ŋmar na baanja le aa bee tibɔnyaan tee aatataa.

ref: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
text: Kinimbɔŋ ki joo dulnyaa aanib na le jɔb binib bi kaa gaa Yesu ki kii na aanimbil, ke tibɔnyaan tee taa woln binimbil. Tibɔnyaan tee tuk timi Kristo aah ŋan sakpen pu na. U ye Uwumbɔr aanaŋ la.

ref: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
text: Taa mooni timi tibaa aabɔr. Ti mooni Yesu Kristo aabɔr la, ke uma le ye binib mɔmɔk Aadindaan. U pu le ti ye nimi aatutum.

ref: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
text: Uwumbɔr u nan len ke “Cha nwiihn woln mbɔmbɔɔn ni” na, uma le woln tinimbil, ke ti bee waah ŋan sakpen pu na. Yesu Kristo aabimbin aah bi pu na le mɔk timi Uwumbɔr aah ŋan sakpen pu na.

ref: We are like clay jars in which this treasure is stored. The real power comes from God and not from us.
text: Timi bi kaa kpa mpɔɔn na, Uwumbɔr di tibɔnyaan ti kpa mpɔɔn sakpen na ŋa tiŋaal ni, aan binib bee ke tibɔnyaan ngbaan aapɔɔn nyan Uwumbɔr chee, naa ye ti chee.

ref: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
text: Limukl aabɔŋ le pii timi, ki mu aa nyaŋ timi. N‑yoonn mbaa le timi aalan ŋmal, le ti tee kpa limakl.

ref: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
text: Binib ŋani timi falaa, le Uwumbɔr aa di cha timi. Bi lii timi kitiŋ, ki mu aa ku timi.

ref: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
text: Yesu pu, le binib ban bi ku timi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Baah kaa ku timi na, nima le mɔk ke Yesu aamɔfal aapɔɔn bi timi bi ga kpo na ni.

ref: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
text: Nkun dii timi la, le ni kan limɔfal.

ref: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
text: Tɔ, unii u nan ŋmee Uwumbɔr aalahn aagbaŋ na ŋmee ke u gaa Uwumbɔr ki kii, le ki len. Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan le cha ti mu gaa u ki kii kina, le ki len.

ref: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
text: Ti bee ke Uwumbɔr u nan fikr Tidindaan Yesu nkun ni na, ga fikr timi bi mu kpaan Yesu chee na nkun ni, ki ga li joo timi ni nimi ki di buen ubaa chee.

ref: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
text: Ni pu, le ti ji falaa ngbaan mɔmɔk. Binib bi gaa Uwumbɔr na yaa kpae kan, binib bi ga li dooni Uwumbɔr na mu ga li wiir, ki ga nyuŋ u. N‑yoonn mu choo na aabɔr

ref: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.
text: Nima le cha tiwon aa yɔl. Tiwon timina bi diŋni iwiin mɔmɔk la. Timi aawiin aapɔɔn kpae iwiin mɔmɔk la.

ref: These little troubles are getting us ready for an eternal glory that will make all our troubles seem like nothing.
text: Dandana aafalaa aan yunn, kaa wiir. Falaa ngbaan pu, le ti ga kan mpopiin ki ti nyaŋ, n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
text: Titafal aa bi tiwan ni ti waa ni na ni, titafal bi taah kaa waa tiwan ni na le ni. Taah waa tiwan ni na aan li bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Taah kaa waa tiwan ni na, nima le ga li bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
text: Tɔ, ti nyi ke tiwon timina yaa kpo kan, tiwon ti ga li bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na bi paacham. Uwumbɔr le toor tiwon ngbaan ki tii timi.

ref: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.
text: Taah bi dulnyaa wee ni na, le ti ji falaa, ki du. Tinimbil man ke ti kan timi aawon ti bi paacham na.

ref: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
text: Ti yaa kan tiwon ngbaan kan, timi aawiin aan chuun mu ŋmeen.

ref: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
text: Ni ye mbamɔn, timi bi bi dulnyaa wee ni na, falaa muk timi, le ti du. Naa ye ke ti ban ke timi aawiin li chuun muŋmeen. Ti ban ke ti kan tiwon ti bi paacham na. Ti ban ke ti di tiwon ti ga kpo na lii, ki kan tiwon ti ga li bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.
text: Uwumbɔr le toor tiwon ngbaan tii timi, ki tii timi Waafuur Nyaan ke u mɔk timi ke u ga tii timi waah nan puu tipuur ti na.

ref: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
text: Nima le cha ti kpa lipobil n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Ti nyi ke taah laa bi dulnyaa wee ni buyoonn na, taa bi Tidindaan do paacham.

ref: But we live by faith, not by what we see.
text: Ti dii gaakii aasan, taa dii tiwan ni tinimbil waa ni na.

ref: We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord.
text: Le ti kpa lipobil. Ti yaa di tiwon timina lii, ki kun Tidindaan do paacham kan, ni ga li mɔ timi.

ref: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
text: Ti yaa bi kitiŋ do, bee ti yaa bi paacham kan, ti ban ke ti piir usui la.

ref: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
text: Nima le cha ti san Tidindaan, ki sur binib ke bi li dii u. Uwumbɔr nyi timi aabimbin aah bi pu na. M dak ke ni mu nyi timi aabimbin.

ref: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
text: Naa ye ke ti bi pak tibaa la. Ti ban ke ti tii nimi ŋitaa ŋi pu ni ga li kpa kipupuk ti pu na, aan ni bee naah ga kii pu ki len tii binib bi lik biken paacham, ki kpa kipupuk bi pu, kaa lik bisui ni na.

ref: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
text: Bi yaa len ke ti waar kan, Uwumbɔr pu le ti bi kina. Ti yaa kpa laasaab kan, ni pu le ti kpa, ke ti ter nimi.

ref: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
text: Kristo aah gee timi pu na le junni tiwon ni, ki cha ti bi kina. Ti nyi ke unibaan nan sil binib mɔmɔk aasisiiyaan ki gaa baakun ki kpo, nima le bi mɔmɔk kpo.

ref: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
text: U nan kpo binib mɔmɔk pu, ke binib bi laa bi na taa ki ŋani baageehn, bi li ŋani waageehn; ba pu? u nan kpo bi pu ki fikr nkun ni.

ref: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.
text: Taan ki lik unii ubaa paacham ke dulnyaa ni aanib aah lik pu na. N‑yoonn mubaa ti nan lik Kristo kina la. Ti mu aa ki lik u kina.

ref: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
text: Nima pu na, unii umɔk kpaan Kristo chee na, u ye unipɔɔn la. Udaan aabimbikpok jer a, ki kpeln mbimbipɔɔn.

ref: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
text: Mbimbipɔɔn ngbaan nyan ni Uwumbɔr chee la. Kristo pu, le Uwumbɔr di timi kpaan ubaa chee, ke ti taa ki li ye waadim, ki tii timi lituln ke ti kpaan binib u chee.

ref: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
text: Maah len pu na le ye ke Kristo aah nan kpo na, nima le tii Uwumbɔr nsan ke u di dulnyaa ni aanib kpaan ubaa chee, ki di cha baatunwanbir pinn bi. U di tichandaan aaliin imina ŋa tiŋaal ni, ke ti tuk binib.

ref: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
text: Ti sil Kristo aasisiiyaan, le ki gaŋni nimi. Ni bi ke Uwumbɔr ubaa le aah gaŋni nimi na. Ti gaŋni nimi ki tii Kristo, ke ni gir ni Uwumbɔr chee man.

ref: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
text: Kristo aa nan tun titunwanbir tibaa. Timi aatunwanbir pu, le Uwumbɔr nan daa utafal. Timi bimɔk kpaan Kristo chee na, Uwumbɔr len ke timi aabɔr ŋan.

ref: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
text: Timi bi kpaan Uwumbɔr chee ki tun waatuln na le gaŋni nimi, ni taa gaa Uwumbɔr aaterm yɔli.

ref: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
text: Uma Uwumbɔr le len ke, “Naah ŋeer pu na, le m pel saameen. Bundaln ni ŋeer ke m gaa si lii na, le m ter si.” Li pel man, din le ni ŋeer. Din le ye n‑yoonn mu u ga gaa si lii na.

ref: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
text: Taa ŋani tiwan ni ga leŋ unii ubaa Uwumbɔr aasan ni na, aan ubaa taa len ke timi aatuln kpa taani.

ref: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
text: Timi aabimbin aah bi pu na, nima le mɔk binib ke ti ye Uwumbɔr aatutum. Kinye pu? ti kan falaa, ni limukl, ni tibɔr, ki ji limɔr, ni mɔmɔk ponn ni.

ref: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
text: Binib lue timi ŋinaalab, ki laŋ timi tiyondir ponn ni, ki ŋma tijar ti pu. Ti tun lituln linimaln, kaa geeni kinyeek, ki lann tijikaar.

ref: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
text: Timi aabimbin bi chain la. Ti bee Uwumbɔr aabɔr, ki kpa limɔr, ni tibulchinn, ki gbii Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan, ki gee binib mbamɔm,

ref: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
text: ki tuk bi Uwumbɔr aabɔr ti ye mbamɔn na. Ti kpa Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn. U len ke timi aabɔr ŋan, nima le ye tijawan ti bi tiŋangii ni tiŋangan ni na.

ref: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
text: Binib bibaa nyuŋni timi, bibaa mu seei timi. Bibaa bii timi, bibaa mu pak timi. Bibaa len ke ti ŋmanni binib la. Le ti tee len ibamɔn.

ref: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
text: Taa kpa liyimbil binib chee. Ti kpa liyimbil Uwumbɔr chee la. Nkun dii timi, le ti beenin bi. Uwumbɔr cha falaa pii timi, ki mu aa cha u ku timi.

ref: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
text: Tisui bii la. Yesu pu, le ti kpa mpopiin n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Ti ye bigiim la, le ki ŋa binib pam biwankpadam Uwumbɔr chee. Taa kpa dulnyaa wee ni aawan nibaa, ti kpa paacham aawan mɔmɔk. Nimina mɔmɔk le mɔk ke ti sil ye Uwumbɔr aatutum.

ref: Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you.
text: Nimi Korint aatiŋ aanib, ti tuk nimi tiponn ni aabɔr mɔmɔk. Ti gee nimi sakpen.

ref: We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us.
text: Naa ye ke timi le aa gee nimi. Ni ye ke nimi le aa gee timi.

ref: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
text: M len nimi ke uja aah ga len waabim pu na. Ni li gee mi man, ke maah gee nimi pu na. Ni taa dii binib bi kaa dii Yesu Kristo na aasan

ref: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
text: Ni taa kpaan binib bi kaa gaa Yesu ki kii na chee man. Binib bi ŋan na, ni binib bi kaa ŋan na ga ŋmaa kpaan tɔb chee ee? Nwiihn ni mbɔmbɔɔn ga li ŋmaa kpaan bi ii?

ref: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
text: Kristo ni kinimbɔŋ ga li ŋmaa kpaan kimɔbaan aa? Unii u dii Yesu aasan na, ni unii u kaa dii na aabimbin kpaan aa?

ref: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
text: Uwumbɔr aadiik ni ŋiwaa kpaan aa? Naa kpaan. Timi le ye Uwumbɔr u ye limɔfadaan na aadiik. Uma ubaa le nan len ke, “M ga li bi maanib aasui ni, ki chuun bikaasisik ni. M ga li ye Baawumbɔr, bi mu ga li ye maanib.”

ref: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
text: Nima le cha Uwumbɔr ki bui ke, “Nya binib bi kaa dii mi na ponn ni man, ki li bi nibaa, ki di cha titunwanbir, le m ga gaa nimi.

ref: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
text: M ga li ye Nite; ni mu ga li ye njapɔtiib ni mbisatiib. Min Uwumbɔr u kpa mpɔɔn mɔmɔk na, le len kina.”

ref: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
text: Maanigeekaab, Uwumbɔr aah puu tipuur tee ki tii timi na, cha ti di cha lituln li kaa ŋan na mɔmɔk, ni ilandak i kaa ŋan na mɔmɔk, ki li san u, ki li ye binib bi bi chain ki doo na. Pɔɔl aapopiin

ref: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
text: Ni li gee timi man. Taa ŋa ubaa bakaa, ki mu aa bii ubaa, ki mu aa ji unii ubaa aawan.

ref: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
text: Maa len kina ke m galn nimi. Maah tuk nimi pu na, ti gee nimi la. Ti yaa kpo, bee ti yaa bi kan, ti po gee nimi la.

ref: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
text: M kpa lipobil sakpen le ki len nimi. M kpa kipupuk sakpen ni pu. Nsui sɔŋ mbamɔm la. Timi aafalaa mɔmɔk ponn ni, m kpa mpopiin ni pu ki ti nyaŋ.

ref: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
text: Tɔ, taah nan fuu Masedonia aatiŋ ni na, taa ŋmaa fuur. Ti nan kan limukl, ŋipepel mɔmɔk ni. Binib nan kpak timi kinikpakpak. Nimi aabɔr mu pu le ilandak nan joo timi.

ref: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
text: Uwumbɔr u sɔŋni binib bi kpa mpombiin na aasui na, uma le cha Taitus fuu ni ti chee ki nan sɔŋ tisui. Waah fuu ni na, nima le cha tisui sɔŋ.

ref: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
text: Naa ye nima baanja le sɔŋ tisui. U tuk timi nimi aabimbin aah ŋan pu na. Nima le cha tisui sɔŋ. U tuk timi ke ninimbil man ke ni ki kan mi, ke ni kpa mpombiin nimi aatunwanbir pu, ke ninimbil man ke ni kii maamɔb. Nima le cha m moo kpa mpopiin.

ref: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
text: Maah nan ŋmee kigbaŋ tii nimi na, kigbaŋ ngbaan nan bii nisui ni yunn pɔkaa. Nisui aah nan bii na, le ni gar mi. Dandana, naa ki gar mi.

ref: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
text: M kpa mpopiin la. Naa ye ke nisui aah bii na le cha m kpa mpopiin. Nimi aapombiin le cha ni kpeln nimi aabimbin, nima le cha m kpa mpopiin. Uwumbɔr nan cha ni kpa mpombiin nimi aatunwanbir pu. Nima le kigbaŋ ki nan bii nisui na nan ŋa nimi tinyoor.

ref: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
text: Ba pu? Uwumbɔr yaa cha unii kpa mpombiin waatunwanbir pu kan, nima le ga cha u kpeln waabimbin ki ŋmar. Naan ki gar u. Tɔ, dulnyaa wee ni aapombiin joo ni nkun la.

ref: Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter.
text: Uwumbɔr aah cha ni kpa mpombiin pu na, ni kan naah ŋa nimi tinyoor pu na. Nitafal bi waabɔr ni. Ni gee liŋuul titunwanbir pu, ki ban ni nyan nibaa tibɔr ngbaan ni, ki san Uwumbɔr ijawaan, ki ban ni ki kan mi, ki ban ni ŋa Uwumbɔr aageehn, ki ban ni daa unii u tun titunwanbir na aatafal. Naah ŋa kina na, ni mɔk ke naa kpa taani ubaa tibɔr ngbaan ponn ni.

ref: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
text: Maah nan ŋmee kigbaŋ ngbaan tii nimi na, naa ye unii u tun titunwanbir na pu le m nan ŋmee ki, kaa ye bakaa aah kan u na pu le m ŋmee ki. M nan ban ke Uwumbɔr mɔk nimi naah gee timi mbamɔm pu na. Nima le cha m ŋmee ki,

ref: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
text: le tisui sɔŋ ni pu. Taitus aah nan bi ni chee na, le usui sɔŋ nimi aabimbinyaan pu, le ni ŋa u mpopiin. Nima le cha ti mu kpa mpopiin sakpen.

ref: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
text: M nan pak nimi u chee, le naa jinn mi inimɔɔn. Taah tuk nimi tibɔr ti na mɔmɔk, ti len mbamɔn la. Kina le taah nan pak nimi Taitus chee pu na, ti len mbamɔn.

ref: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
text: U teer naah nan gaa u pu na, ki teer naah san u, ki pak waah len pu na, ki kii waamɔb. Nima le cha u moo gee nimi.

ref: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
text: M bee ke ni ga li beenin ŋani tiwan mɔmɔk mbamɔm. Nima le m kpa mpopiin ni pu.

ref: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
text: Tinaabitiib, ti ban ke ni bee Uwumbɔr aah ŋa tinyoor ŋa Yesu aanib bi bi Masedonia aatim ni pu na.

ref: Although they were going through hard times and were very poor, they were glad to give generously.
text: Bi nan kan falaa, ni ntɔŋ, ni igiin sakpen a. Le bi mu nan kpa mpopiin ki ti nyaŋ. Baagiin ponn ni, le bi nan kpa tibulchinn, ki tii Uwumbɔr ipiin sakpen.

ref: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
text: M ga ŋmaa ji seeraa ki tii bi, ke baah kpa tiwan ni na, bi tii u, ki jer kina. Baageehn pu, le bi tii,

ref: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
text: ki gaŋ timi ke ti gaa ipiin ngbaan, aan ki di tii Yesu aanib bi lann na. Ni mɔ bi ke bi ter bi la.

ref: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
text: Bi tii ki jer taah nan dak pu na. Njan, le bi di bibaa tii Tidindaan, le ki nin di bibaa tii ti mu, Uwumbɔr aageehn pu.

ref: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
text: Nima pu na, Taitus aah nan cha ni piin ki bi too ŋimombil ke ni tii Uwumbɔr na, le ti bui u ke u pɔɔn ubaa ki cha ni too ŋimombil ngbaan ki doo.

ref: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
text: Ni ŋa Yesu naadii, le ki bee waabɔr, ki ga ŋmaa tuk biken. Ninimbil man waatuln pu. Le ni gee timi. Naah ŋani tiwan nimina mɔmɔk ki ti chaar jer na, ni li nyi ki tii ipiin mu ki ti jer kina.

ref: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
text: Maah len pu na, naa ye ke m muk nimi ke ni tii. M tuk nimi ke Yesu aanib biken aanimbil man ke bi tii u ipiin, ke m bee ni mu aah gee u pu na.

ref: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
text: Ni nyi Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aah kpa tibulchinn pu na. U nan ye uwankpadaan la. Nimi pu le u ŋa ugiin. Waah ŋa ugiin na, nima le cha ni mu ŋa biwankpadam.

ref: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
text: Cha ninimbil li man ke ni tii naah ga ŋmaa tii pu na, aan ki too ipiin ngbaan doo.

ref: It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
text: Unii yaa gee ke u tii Uwumbɔr ipiin ki yaa tii u waah kpa pu na kan, Uwumbɔr ga gaa la. Uwumbɔr aa ban ke unii tii ki jer waah kpa pu na.

ref: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair
text: Maa ban ke m ŋa nimi falaa ke m ter biken. M ban ke ni mɔmɔk ŋaŋ la.

ref: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
text: Maah len pu na le ye ke naah kpa sakpen pu dandana na, ni ŋan ke ni ter binib bi kaa kpa na. Ni mu yaa nan lann daalbaadaal kan, bi yaa nan kpa sakpen kan, bi mu ga ter nimi. Kina le ni mɔmɔk ga ŋaŋ.

ref: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
text: Ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke, “Unii u nan kan sakpen na aa nan ji ki gur. Unii u mu nan kan siib na aa nan lann.” Taitus ni uŋeen aatɔtiib

ref: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
text: Tɔ, m doon Uwumbɔr u cha Taitus ban u ter nimi na ke ti mu aah ban ti ter nimi pu na.

ref: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
text: Ti bui u ke u pɔɔn ubaa ki dan ni chee, le u kii. Unimbil man ke u dan, waageehn pu le u ga dan.

ref: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
text: Le ti ga cha tina aabo ubaa mu dii u dan ni chee. Tina aabo ngbaan aah mooni Yesu aabɔnyaan pu na le cha Yesu aanib mɔmɔk pak u sakpen.

ref: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
text: Bi mu nyan u ke u dii timi ke ti buen ti ter Uwumbɔr aanib bi ye bigiim na. Nima le ga nyuŋ Tidindaan, ki mɔk bi ke ti ban ti ter tɔb la.

ref: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.
text: Ti ga li joo ŋimombil sakpen ke ti tii bi. Taa ban ke unii ubaa bii timi ke ti gur tibaa ngem.

ref: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
text: Tidindaan nyi ke ti ŋani mbamɔm la. Ti ban ke binib mu bee ke ti ŋani mbamɔm.

ref: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
text: Nima le ti ga tun tina aabo uken u mu dii Taitus mam ki dan ni chee. N‑yoonn mɔmɔk ti nan lik tina aabo ngbaan aabimbin aah bi pu na, ki kan ke unimbil man Uwumbɔr aatuln pu. U pak nimi ke ni ga ŋa maah ban pu na, nima le cha u moo ban ke u dan ni chee.

ref: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
text: Binib yaa baa nimi Taitus aabɔr kan, ni tuk bi ke u ye maatutuŋeer u ter mi m tuk nimi Yesu aabɔnyaan na la. Ubaa yaa baa nimi tinaabitiib bi dii Taitus na aabɔr kan, ni tuk u ke bi ye Yesu aanib aatutum la. Baabimbinyaan pu, le binib nyuŋni Kristo.

ref: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
text: Ni li mɔk bi ni Yesu aanib mɔmɔk naah gee Uwumbɔr aanib pu na, ki ter bi, ke taah nan pak nimi pu na.

ref: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.
text: Maa ki ban m ŋmee kigbaŋ ki tuk nimi naah ga ter Yesu aanib bi bi Jerusalem ni pu na.

ref: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
text: M nyi ke ni ban ni ter bi. M nan pak nimi Masedonia aanib chee, ki bui bi ke nimi bi bi Griis aatiŋ ni na nan ban ni ter Yesu aanib giina. Ninimbil aah man ke ni ter Uwumbɔr aanib pu na, nima le cha bi ponn ni pam mu ban bi ter bi.

ref: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
text: Le m ban m cha tinaabitiib bimina buen ni chee, aan bi ti kan ke taah nan pak nimi pu na, ti gbii la. Ni ga li bi ke maah nan len pu na, ki gor ke ni too ŋimombil ngbaan.

ref: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
text: Ni yaa kaa ye kina kan, Masedonia aatiŋ aanib bibaa yaa dii mi ki fuu ni ni chee, ki kan ke naa kee gor kan, ni ga jinn mi inimɔɔn, naa ye mi baanja aanimɔɔn, ti mɔmɔk aanimɔɔn. Ba pu? ti nan pak nimi bi chee.

ref: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
text: Nima le m dak ke ni ŋan m gaŋ tinaabitiib bimina ke bi loln m pu nsan ki buen ni chee, ki ter nimi ni too ŋimombil ngbaan, naah nan puu tipuur ti na. M yaa fuu ni kan, m ga nan mui ni too ŋi ki doo. Nima le ga mɔk ke ni too ŋi, nimi aageehn pu, naa ye ke bi nan muk nimi le ni too ŋi.

ref: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
text: M tuk nimi la, unii u bun tijikaar siib na ga nan chee siib la. Unii u mu bun tijikaar sakpen na ga nan chee sakpen la.

ref: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
text: Unii mɔmɔk aah di pu ŋa usui ni ke u ga tii ni na, cha u tii kina. U taa tii ni mpombiin, ki taa tii limukl aatiin. Ba pu? Uwumbɔr gee unii u tii ni mpopiin na la.

ref: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
text: Uwumbɔr ga ŋmaa ŋa tinyoor mɔmɔk ŋa ni pu, aan ni taa lann nibaa. Ni ga li kpa ki gur, ki ga ŋmaa tii binib bimɔk lann na.

ref: The Scriptures say, “God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.”
text: Ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke, “Ubulchindaan tii bigiim sakpen, waaŋann aa kpa ndoon.”

ref: God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need.
text: Uwumbɔr u di ŋijikaabil di tii unii u bu tijikaar na, ki tii binib tijikaar bi ji na, uma le ga tii nimi naah ban pu na mɔmɔk, ki jer kina, aan ni moo ter binib biken.

ref: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
text: Ni yaa moo ter binib kan, Uwumbɔr le ga moo tii nimi. Naah ga tii timi ipiin ke ti tii biken na, nima le binib pam ga doon Uwumbɔr ipiin ngbaan pu.

ref: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
text: Ni yaa ter Yesu aanib ki tii bi baah lann pu na kan, nima le binib pam ga doon Uwumbɔr mbamɔm.

ref: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
text: Ni yaa ter bi kan, nima le ga mɔk bi ke ni gaa Kristo aabɔnyaan ki kii, ki kpa tibulchinn, ki yakr naah kpa tiwan ni na tii bima, ni biken mɔmɔk. Nima le ga cha bi nyuŋ Uwumbɔr,

ref: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
text: ki mee u tii nimi, ki li gee nimi, Uwumbɔr aah cha ni kpa tibulchinn sakpen pu na.

ref: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
text: Cha ti doon Uwumbɔr u tii timi Ujapɔɔn u jer ipiin mɔmɔk na man.

ref: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.
text: Min Pɔɔl mbaa gaŋni nimi la. Ni ponn ni bibaa len ke maah nan bi ni chee na, maa kaar nimi, ke m yaa bi nibaa chee kan, m kpa lipobil ki ŋmee kigbaŋ ki sur nimi. Min Pɔɔl bi suuna ke Kristo aah bi pu na, ki gaŋni nimi ke ni toor nimi aabimbin man,

ref: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.
text: aan m yaa fuu ni ni chee kan, m taa chiin ni ponn ni bibaa. M nyi ke m yaa fuu ni ni chee kan, m ga ŋmaa li kpa lipobil ki chiin binib bi len ke ti dii dulnyaa ni aanib aah dii pu na.

ref: We live in this world, but we don't act like its people
text: Ni ye mbamɔn ke ti po ye binib la. Ni mu aa ye binib aajaak le ti jaa,

ref: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments
text: ki mu aa di binib aapɔɔn le jan kijaak ngbaan. Ti di Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn mu bii kinimbɔŋ aapɔɔn mɔmɔk na le jan ki. Ti len ki nyaŋ binib bi kpak Uwumbɔr aabɔr kinikpakpak na,

ref: and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ.
text: ki nyaŋ binib bi kpa kalmbaani ki dak ke bi kpa nlan ki jer Uwumbɔr na. Ti cha ilandak mɔmɔk kii Kristo aamɔb.

ref: And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.
text: Ti yaa bee ni ponn ni binib bi ga kii Uwumbɔr aamɔboln na, le ti ga ŋmaa daa binib bi gur kaa kii na aatafal.

ref: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
text: Tɔ, ni lik binib paacham la aa? Ubaa yaa bi ni ponn ni ki len ke u ye Kristo aanii kan, cha u teer ke ti mu ye Kristo aanib ke waah ye pu na la.

ref: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
text: Tidindaan tii mi tininkpir ke m ter nimi ni dii u mbamɔm, waa tii mi tininkpir ngbaan ke m bii nimi. M yaa puk kipupuk ki jer maah ba ga puk pu na kan, maan ji inimɔɔn.

ref: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.
text: Ni taa li dak ke m ban m ŋmee kigbaŋ ki ga li kpa nimi ijawaan na.

ref: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
text: Bibaa len ke m ŋmee tigbann ke mpɔɔndaan na, ke m yaa bi ni chee kan, maa pɔɔ, maaliin aa bi tibɔr tibaa ni.

ref: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
text: Cha binib ngbaan aaboln bee ke ti yaa ŋmee kigbaŋ ponn ni taah ga ŋa pu na kan, ti yaa fuu ni kan, ti ga ŋa kina la.

ref: We won't dare compare ourselves with those who think so much of themselves. But they are foolish to compare themselves with themselves.
text: Taa ban ke ti di tibaa ŋaŋ binib bi yoor bibaa paacham na, kaa ban ke ti len ke ti ye bi ponn ni bibaa. Baa kpa nlan. Bi lik tɔb aabimbin aah bi pu na, ki ŋaŋni bibaa la.

ref: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
text: Tima kan, taan li kpa kipupuk ki lakr taah tun lituln pu na. Ti ga li kpa kipupuk Uwumbɔr aah siin lituln li ki tii timi na pu. Taah nan tuk nimi waaliin na, nima le ye lituln ngbaan ponn ni ngem.

ref: We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
text: Ti nan puen biken ki fuu ni ni chee ki tuk nimi Kristo aabɔnyaan tee. Taah ŋani kina na, ti po tun lituln li Uwumbɔr siin timi na la.
