ref: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
text: Taa ban mpakm biken aatuln pu. Ti kpa limakl ke ni ga moo dii Yesu aasan mbamɔm, ki ga ter timi ke ti tun Uwumbɔr aatuln sakpen, waah siin li pu ki tii timi na.

ref: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
text: Le ti ga ŋmaa buen ntim mu daa ki jer nimi aatiŋ na, ki ti tuk binib tibɔnyaan tee. Taan buen biken aah tun lituln nin chee na, kaa ban ke bi pak timi biken aatuln pu.

ref: The Scriptures say, “If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.”
text: Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ len ke, “Unii umɔk ban ke u puk kipupuk na, cha u puk kipupuk Uwumbɔr pu.”

ref: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
text: Unii yaa pak ubaa kan, nima le aa mɔk ke Uwumbɔr aanimbil gbiin u. Uwumbɔr yaa pak unii kan, nima le mɔk ke Uwumbɔr aanimbil sil gbiin u.

ref: Please put up with a little of my foolishness.
text: Tɔ, m yaa len kijɔrk aaliin siib kan, ni pɔɔn nibaa man ki li kpa limɔr m pu.

ref: I am as concerned about you as God is. You were like a virgin bride I had chosen only for Christ.
text: M gee nimi sakpen ke Uwumbɔr aah gee nimi pu na. Ni bi ke usapɔɔn u kaa nyi uja na aah bi pu na, le m ban m di nimi tii Kristo, ni li dii uma baanja.

ref: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
text: M san ijawaan ke binib ga ŋmann nimi, ni taa ki dii Kristo mbamɔm, ke kinimbɔŋ aah nan ŋmann Adam aapuu Iif pu na.

ref: We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message.
text: Unii yaa fuu ni ni chee ki yaa tuk nimi tibɔr yayan ti kaa ye taah nan tuk nimi Yesu aabɔr ti na kan, ba ŋa ni ji limɔr u pu? Ba ŋa ni gaa tibɔr ti kaa ye Yesu aabɔnyaan, kaan cha ni kan Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan na? Taah nan tuk nimi Yesu aabɔnyaan tee na, tibɔr ngbaan le nan cha ni kan Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan.

ref: I think I am as good as any of those super apostles.
text: Binib bi ŋmanni ke bi ye Yesu aakpambalb na, maa dak ke bi jer mi.

ref: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
text: Nibaakan, maan ŋmaa len ke unii u bae mbaem sakpen na aah len pu na. M mu nyi Yesu aabɔr mbamɔm, ki ŋeer ti mɔmɔk tuk nimi, binib aanimbil ni.

ref: Was it wrong for me to lower myself and honor you by preaching God's message free of charge?
text: M nan sunn mbaa taab ke m yoor nimi paacham; kinye pu? m nan tuk nimi Uwumbɔr aabɔnyaan, kaa jin nimi kidaak. Maah ŋa kina na, ni kpa taani ii?

ref: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
text: Buyoonn m nan bi ni chee ki lann maah ban pu na, maa muk nimi ke ni ter mi. Tinaabitiib bi nyan Masedonia aatiŋ ni na nan joo ni maah ban tiwan ni na mɔmɔk. Maah nan bi pu n‑yoonn ngbaan na, m ga li beenin bi kina la, kaan muk nimi ke ni ter mi.

ref: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
text: Kristo pu le m len mbamɔn, maan muk unii ubaa nibaa chee Griis aatiŋ ponn ni ke u ter mi.

ref: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
text: Ba pu? Ni ye ke maa gee nimi le ki len kina aa? Uwumbɔr nyi ke m gee nimi la.

ref: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
text: M ga li beenin tuk nimi Yesu aabɔr, kaan ji nimi kidaak. Biŋmaŋmannim bi ji nimi kidaak na aan ŋmaa pak bibaa ki len ke bi bi ke taah bi pu na.

ref: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
text: Binib ngbaan ŋmanni nimi la. Baa ye Kristo aakpambalb. Bi ŋmanni nimi ke bi tun waatuln, ki mu aa tun.

ref: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
text: Baah ŋani kina na, ni taa cha ni gar nimi. Kinimbɔŋ kibaa ŋmanni ke ki ye Uwumbɔr aatuun u wiin chain na.

ref: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
text: Kinimbɔŋ aatutum yaa ŋmanni ke bi ye bininyaam kan, ni taa cha ni gar nimi. Uwumbɔr ga daa bitafal baatuln aah ŋeer pu na. Pɔɔl aah ji falaa Yesu Kristo pu pu na

ref: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
text: M ki tuk nimi la, ni taa dak ke m ye ujɔr. Ni mu yaa dak ke m ye ujɔr kan, ni li kpa limɔr m pu, ki cha m mu pak mbaa siib.

ref: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
text: Maah ga len pu na aa ye Tidindaan aabɔr aaboln. Maah ga pak mbaa pu na, m ga len ke ujɔr na la.

ref: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
text: Binib pam le bi ki pak bibaa dulnyaa ni aawan pu. Nima le m mu ga pak mbaa.

ref: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
text: Ni dak ke ni kpa nlan. Ba ŋa ni ji limɔr bijɔrb pu ki kpa mpopiin?

ref: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
text: Maah len pu na le ye ke unii yaa chuu nimi tinaagbiir, bee u ji nimi aawan, bee u ŋmann nimi, bee u kpa kalmbaani, bee u faa nimi kitapak kan, le ni kpa limɔr u pu.

ref: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
text: Taah kaa muk nimi kina na, le ni bii timi, ke taa kpa mpɔɔn aa? Unii ubaa yaa kaar ke u pak ubaa kan, m mu kaar kina la. M len ke ujɔr na la.

ref: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.
text: Biŋmaŋmannim ngbaan ye Hiibru yaab la aa? M mu ye. Bi ye Israel yaab la aa? M mu ye. Bi ye Abraham aayaabitiib la aa? M mu ye.

ref: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
text: Bi ye Kristo aatutum la aa? M mu ye ki jer bi. M ŋa nimi gafara la, m len ke ujɔr na la. M nan tun Kristo aatuln ki jer bi, ki koo tiyondir ponn ni ki jer bi. Kristo pu, binib nan gbaa mi ŋinaalab ki ti chaar jer. M nan kani linimaln, naa nan pɔɔ ke m kpo.

ref: Five times my own people gave me
text: Nfum muŋmu le Juu yaab gbaa mi linaalab nfum piitaa ni muwae.

ref: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
text: Rom yaab nan gbaa mi ŋidabil nfum mutaa la. Binib nan mae mi ŋitakpal nfum mbaa la. Nfum mutaa le iŋɔi liin nnyusakpem ni ki cha mi. Kinyeek kibaa ni nwimɔn le m nan bi likpaln pu nnyusakpem ni.

ref: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
text: M nan chuun ŋisachun n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, ki kani linimaln nnyun ni, le ki kani linimaln bififiirb chee, le ki kani linimaln maanib Juu yaab chee, le ki kani linimaln binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na chee, le ki kani linimaln ntim ponn ni, ni kipɔɔk ni, ni nnyusakpem ni, le ki kani linimaln binib bi ŋmann ke bi ye Yesu Kristo aanib na chee.

ref: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
text: M tun Yesu Kristo aatuln linimaln, ki kani falaa, kaa geeni kinyeek. Nkon ni nnyunyuu mɔk nan joo mi. M nan lann tijikaar. Tiwoor nan joo mi. Maawanpeenkaan aa nan fuu tiwoor ngbaan.

ref: Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches.
text: Naa ye falaa umina baanja le m kan. Ilandak joo mi iwiin mɔmɔk Yesu aanib mɔmɔk pu.

ref: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
text: Ubaa yaa kaa kpa mpɔɔn kan, ni yɔl m mu aawon la. Ubaa yaa tɔŋ uken ke u tun titunwanbir kan, ni fiini maaŋuul la.

ref: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
text: Tɔ, m yaa puk kipupuk kan, m ga puk kipupuk maadabur aabɔr pu la.

ref: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
text: Tidindaan Yesu Aate Uwumbɔr, u yeh mpakm n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na, uma le nyi ke m len mbamɔn la.

ref: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
text: Maah nan bi Damaskus aatiŋ ni, Ubɔr Aretas aayoonn na, le kitiŋ ngbaan aaninkpel nan ban u chuu mi, le ki cha waatɔb aajab si kii kitiŋ na aabisamɔb chee, ke bi nan chuu mi.

ref: But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.
text: Le njɔtiib di mi ŋa kibɔɔkuuk sakpeŋ ni, ki ti di mi laan takolu u bi kitiŋ ngbaan aagoln pu na, le m nyan uŋaal ni.

ref: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
text: See m puk kipupuk. Ni mu aa kpa tinyoor. M ga tuk nimi Tidindaan aah mɔk mi lijinjiir aawan pu ki kpiir tibɔr ti tuk mi na.

ref: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
text: Tɔ, dandana wee, m gor ke m dan ni chee taataa. Maan li ban nibaa ni chee. M ban nimi la, naa ye nimi aamombil. Mbim aa kpiini tetiib, tetiib le kpiini mbim. Ni bi ke maabim na la.

ref: As I said, only God really knows if this man was in his body at the time.
text: M po nyi ke Uwumbɔr yoor mi buen paacham, Paradais ni.

ref: But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell.
text: Le m ŋun tibɔr ti maan ŋmaa tuk unii ubaa na. Uwumbɔr aa kii ke m len ti.

ref: I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.
text: Lijinjiir aawan ngbaan pu, le m ga puk kipupuk. Maan pak mbaa, m ga puk kipupuk maadabur aabɔr pu la.

ref: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
text: M yaa ban m puk kipupuk kan, maan le ye ujɔr; ba pu? m ga len mbamɔn la. M mu aan puk kipupuk. Ba pu? maa ban ke unii ubaa pak mi ki jer maah ŋeer pu na. M ban ke bi lik maabimbin aah bi pu na, ki pel maah len pu na, le ki bee maah bi pu na.

ref: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
text: Tɔ, Uwumbɔr aah nan mɔk mi lijinjiir aawan sakpen pu na, waa ban ke m yoor mbaa paacham lijinjiir aawan ngbaan pu. Nima le u cha limukl li nyan ni kinimbɔŋ chee na muk mi. Limukl ngbaan wu mi ke nkokon aah saa tiwon kan, ni wu pu na.

ref: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
text: Le m mee Tidindaan nfum mutaa ke u nyan mi limukl ngbaan ni.

ref: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
text: Le waa kii, le ki bui mi ke waaterm le ga cha m nyaŋ limukl ngbaan; ba pu? unii u kaa kpa mpɔɔn na ga li kpa waapɔɔn mbamɔm. Le m kpa mpopiin ki kpa kipupuk maadabur aabɔr pu, aan ki li kpa Kristo aapɔɔn.

ref: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
text: M yaa kan idabur, ni ŋisiibil, ni falaa, ni limukl, ni tibɔr, Kristo pu kan, le ni mɔ mi; ba pu? maah kaa kpa mbaa aapɔɔn buyoonn na, le m kpa Kristo aapɔɔn. Pɔɔl aatafal aah bi Korint aatiŋ aanib ni pu na

ref: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
text: Ni yaa ba pak mi kan, ni ba ga li ŋan. Naah kaa pak mi na, nima le cha m pak mbaa ke ujɔr na. M yaa kaa bi tibɔr tibaa ni kan, binib bi ŋmanni ke bi ye Yesu aakpambalb na aa jer mi.

ref: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
text: Maah nan bi ni chee na, m nan tun lijinjiir aatun Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn pu, ki nan kpa limɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Nima le mɔk ke m ye Yesu aakpambalb mbamɔm.

ref: You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
text: Yesu aanib biken jer nimi kinye? Maah kaa muk nimi ke ni tii mi nibaa na le cha bi jer nimi ii? Nimina yaa kpa taani kan, m ŋa nimi gafara la.

ref: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
text: Nima le ni mɔ mi ke m di mbaa tii nimi, ki tun lituln linimaln ke m ter nimi. M yaa moo gee nimi kan, nimi aageehm bar la aa?

ref: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
text: Ni ye mbamɔn, maa nan ŋani nimi falaa ke ni tii mi nibaa. Le ni ponn ni bibaa len ke m nan ŋmanni nimi, ki jin nimi aawan. M jin nimi aawan kinye?

ref: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
text: Maah nan cha binib buen ni chee na, bi ponn ni ubaa nan jin nimi aawan ki tii mi ii? Aayii.

ref: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
text: M nan gaŋ Taitus ke u buen ni chee, le ki cha tina aabo uken mu dii u. Taitus jin nimi aawan nibaa aa? Aayii. Ti kpaan nlandak mubaa la. Maah ŋani pu na, u mu ŋani kina la. Ti mɔmɔk dii kitaabuk kibaa la.

ref: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
text: Ni dak ke ti len ke ti nyan tibaa tibɔr ni la aa? Taa ŋani kina kpala. Ti bi Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni, ki len Kristo aah ban pu na. Maanigeekaab, ti ban ke ti ter nimi ke ni moo dii Uwumbɔr aasan mbamɔm. Nima le cha ti len.

ref: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
text: M san ijawaan ke m yaa fuu ni ni chee kan, naah bi pu na aan li mɔ mi, m mu aah ga li bi pu na aan li mɔ nimi mu. M san ijawaan ke m ga nan mui ni bi kpak tɔb kinikpakpak, ki kpa lipiipoln tɔb pu, ki gee liŋuul tɔb pu, ki yakr tɔb, ki sii tɔb, ki bii tɔb, ki kpa kalmbaani, ki ŋma tijar,

ref: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
text: ke m yaa fuu ni ni chee ki kan ke ni ponn ni pam tun titunwanbir, ni tijɔŋ aatuln, ki gɔr kidagook, ki ŋani tiwan ni kaa ŋan na, kaa kpeln nimi aabimbin kan, ni ga bii nsui sakpen. Le Maawumbɔr ga cha m ji inimɔɔn ni pu.

ref: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
text: Tɔ, m ga dan nan mann nimi taataa la. Ni yaa galn unii ubaa kan, maan gar nimi, see biseeraadam bilee, bee bitaa len.

ref: During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning.
text: Maah nan mann nimi lelee na, m nan sur ni ponn ni bimɔk tun titunwanbir na. Dandana wee, maah kaa bi ni chee na, m ki sur bi ke maah nan sur bi njan pu na, ke m yaa fuu ni kan, m ga daa bitafal.

ref: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!
text: Nima le ga mɔk nimi ke Kristo le cha m len. Waa ye udabur ni chee, u kpa mpɔɔn ni chee.

ref: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
text: U nan di waapɔɔn lii ki cha bi kpaa u ndɔpuinkoo pu. Dandana, u fu Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn pu la. Timi bi mu kpaan u chee na aa kpa mpɔɔn. Ti mu aah kpaan u chee na, ti mu fu Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn pu, ki ga ŋmaa mɔk nimi mpɔɔn ngbaan.

ref: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
text: Ni lik nimi aabimbin aah bi pu na man, ke ni sil tii Yesu Kristo naadii aan naa tii. Ni taa lik maabimbin aah bi pu na man, ni li lik nimi nibaa aabimbin aah bi pu na. Naa bee ke Yesu Kristo bi ni ni ii? U bi ni ni la; u yaa kaa bi ni ni kan, naa ye waanib mbamɔm.

ref: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
text: M kpa limakl ke ni ga bee ke timi le ye waanib mbamɔm.

ref: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
text: Ti mee Uwumbɔr tii nimi, ke ni taa tun titunwanbir. Naa ye ke ti ban ti mɔk nimi timi aabamɔn la. Ni yaa po dak ke taa ye Yesu aanib mbamɔm kan, ti po ban ke ni tun lituln li ŋan na la.

ref: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.
text: Ba pu? taan ŋmaa di mpɔɔn mu Uwumbɔr tii timi na, ki leŋ tibɔnyaan tee. Ti ban ke tibɔnyaan ngbaan loln nsan la.

ref: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
text: Ti yaa kaa kpa mpɔɔn, le nimi le kpa mpɔɔn kan, ni mɔ timi la. Le ti mee Uwumbɔr tii nimi ke ni toor nimi aabimbin.

ref: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
text: M ŋmee kigbaŋ kee, ke maah kaa bi ni chee na, m yaa nan fuu ni ni chee kan, m taa chiin nimi, ki mɔk nimi maapɔɔn. Nima le cha m ŋmee ki. Tidindaan le tii mi tininkpir ke m ter nimi ni dii waasan mbamɔm. Waa tii mi tininkpir ngbaan ke m di bii nimi.

ref: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
text: Nnaabitiib, tibɔr ti gur na le ye ke m ban m chɔi nimi la. Toor nimi aabimbin man. Sɔŋ tɔb aasui man. Ni li kpa kimɔbaan ni nsuudoon man, le Uwumbɔr u gee timi ki tii timi nsuudoon na ga li bi ni chee.

ref: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
text: Ni li dooni tɔb mbamɔm man. Uwumbɔr aanib bimɔk bi do na dooni nimi.

ref: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will bless you and be kind to you! May God bless you with his love, and may the Holy Spirit join all your hearts together.
text: Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aanimbaasaln, ni Uwumbɔr aageehm, ni Waafuur Nyaan aamɔbaan li bi ni mɔmɔk chee.

ref: From the apostle Paul and from all the Lord's followers with me. I was chosen to be an apostle by Jesus Christ and by God the Father, who raised him from death. No mere human chose or appointed me to this work. To the churches in Galatia:
text: Min Pɔɔl ni nnaabitiib bimɔk bi m chee na dooni nimi Yesu aanib bi bi Galasia aatim ni na. Yesu Kristo ni Tite Uwumbɔr u fikr u nkun ni na le ŋa mi waakpambal. Naa ye unibɔn le ŋa mi, kaa ye binib le di lituln ngbaan tii mi.

ref: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
text: Tite Uwumbɔr ni Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu, ki tii nimi nsuudoon.

ref: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
text: Tite Uwumbɔr aageehn pu, le Kristo nan kpo timi aatunwanbir pu, ke u nyan timi dulnyaa wee aatunwanbir ni.

ref: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
text: Uwumbɔr le yeh mpakm n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Amii. Tibɔnyaan baan baanja le bi

ref: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
text: Kristo aanimbaasaln pu, le Uwumbɔr yin nimi ke ni dii u. Ni tee gar mi pam; ba pu? ni ban ni di Uwumbɔr lii mala, ki gaa tibɔyayan,

ref: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
text: ti kaa ye tibɔnyaan na. Binib bibaa bi, ki muk nimi, ki ban bi kpeln Kristo aabɔnyaan tee.

ref: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
text: Timi le yaa tuk nimi tibɔr ti kaa ye taah nan tuk nimi tibɔnyaan ti na, bee ni ti ki ye Uwumbɔr aatuun u nyan ni Uwumbɔr do na le tuk nimi tibɔyayan tee kan, cha Uwumbɔr puun lii u pu.

ref: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
text: Taah nan tuk nimi pu na, m ki tuk nimi dandana wee, ke unii ubaa yaa tuk nimi tibɔyayan ti kaa ye naah nan gaa tibɔnyaan ti na kan, cha Uwumbɔr puun lii u pu.

ref: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
text: M ban m piir binib aasui le aan Uwumbɔr aasui? M ban ke binib pak mi ii? Aayii. M yaa ban ke binib pak mi kan, maa ba ga li ye Kristo aatutunn. Pɔɔl aah ŋa Yesu Kristo aatutunn pu na

ref: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
text: Nnaabitiib, m ban ke ni bee ke maah nan tuk nimi tibɔnyaan ti na, taa nyan ni binib chee.

ref: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
text: Maa nan gaa ti binib chee. Unii ubaa aa di ti tuk mi. Yesu Kristo ubaa le kpiir ti tuk mi.

ref: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.
text: Ni nan ŋun maabimbin aah nan ye pu buyoonn m nan dii Juu yaab aasan na. M nan ŋa Uwumbɔr aanib falaa sakpen a, ki ban ke m kuln bi.

ref: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
text: M nan dii Juu yaab aasan ki jer ŋŋeen aatɔtiib ponn ni pam aah dii pu na. Nnimbil nan man tiyaajatiib aakaal pu.

ref: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
text: kaa buen Jerusalem ki ti kpokl binib bi puen ye Yesu aakpambalb na chee. M nan buen Arabia aatiŋ ni ki ti bi nima mbaa ki mee Uwumbɔr, le ki nin gir buen Damaskus aatiŋ ni.

ref: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
text: Ŋibin ŋitaa aah jer na, le m buen Jerusalem m ti mann Piita, ki nan bi u chee iwiin kipiik ni iŋmu.

ref: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
text: Maa nan ki kan Yesu aakpambal ubaa kpee, see Jems u ye Tidindaan aanaal na baanja.

ref: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
text: Maah ŋmee pu tii nimi na, Uwumbɔr nyi ke maa mɔn nnyamɔn.

ref: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
text: Tɔ, le m nyan Jerusalem, ki buen Siria aatiŋ ni, ni Silisia aatiŋ ni.

ref: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
text: N‑yoonn ngbaan Kristo aanib bi nan bi Judea aatim ni na aa nan kee kan mi, kaa nyi mi.

ref: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.
text: Bi po ŋun ke uja u nan ŋani bi falaa na, dandana wee u chuun mooni tibɔnyaan ti u nan ban u bii ti na.

ref: And because of me, they praised God.
text: Nima le cha bi nyuŋ Uwumbɔr m pu.

ref: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
text: Ŋibin kipiik ni ŋinaa aah jer na, le m ni Banabas gir buen Jerusalem. Taitus mu nan dii timi.

ref: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
text: Uwumbɔr nan tuk mi ke m buen Jerusalem. Nima le cha m buen. Le m ni Yesu aanib aaninkpiib kuun tɔb chee tibaa, le m ŋeer tuk bi tibɔnyaan ti m mooni binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab chee na; ba pu? m nan ban ke bininkpiib ngbaan kii maah tun Uwumbɔr aatuln pu na, maatuln taa bee fam.

ref: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
text: Tɔ, Taitus u nan bi m chee na ye Griik aanii la. Le Yesu aanib aaninkpiib ngbaan aa muk u ke u gii uchakpaln.

ref: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
text: Binib bibaa bi, ki ŋmanni ke bi dii Yesu Kristo, ki kpaan ti chee; bima le nan ban ke bi gii u. Bi kpaan ti chee ke bi lik taah gaa tibaa pu ki dii Yesu aasan kaa ki dii Moses aakaal na. Le bi nan ban ke bi muk timi ti ki dii Moses aakaal.

ref: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
text: Le taa kii baah ban pu na kpala. Taa nan ban unii ubaa kpeln Yesu aabɔnyaan tee ki tuk nimi tibɔyayan.

ref: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.
text: Yesu aanib aaninkpiib bi kpa liyimbil na, baah bi pu na, naa ye nibaa m chee; ba pu? Uwumbɔr aa pak ubaa ki jer uken, binib ngbaan aa len ke m di tibɔr tibaa ki kpee maah mooni tibɔr ti na pu.

ref: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
text: Bi bee ke Uwumbɔr lee mi ke m di Yesu aabɔnyaan tuk binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na, ke waah nan lee Piita u ti tuk Juu yaab pu na.

ref: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
text: Uwumbɔr u tii Piita mpɔɔn ke u ti tuk Juu yaab Yesu aabɔnyaan na, uma le tii m mu mpɔɔn ke m tuk binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na.

ref: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
text: Le Jems, ni Piita, ni Jɔnn, bi ye Yesu aanib aaninkpiib na, bee Uwumbɔr aah ter mi waatuln ponn ni pu na, le bi di biŋaal tii m ni Banabas ke naabitiib pu na, ki kii ke ni ŋan ke ti buen binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na chee, aan bi mu buen Juu yaab chee.

ref: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
text: Bi nan ban ke ti li teer ki ter binib bi ye bigiim bi ponn ni na. M mu aanimbil man ke m ter bi. Pɔɔl aah kae Piita pu na

ref: When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong.
text: Tɔ, Piita aah fuu ni Antiok aatiŋ ni na, le m kpak u; ba pu? u nan kpa taani la.

ref: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
text: M nan kan ke baa dii Yesu aabɔnyaan mbamɔm. Le m tuk Piita bi mɔmɔk aanimbil ni ke, “Aa ye Juu aanii la. Aa yaa dii binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na aah dii pu na, kaa ki dii Juu yaab aasan kan, ba ŋa aa muk binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na ke bi dii Juu yaab aasan?” Gaakii pu le Uwumbɔr ga gaa binib lii

ref: We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles.
text: Tɔ, ti ye Juu aamaal ni la. Taa ye binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab bi ye titunwanbirdam na;

ref: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
text: Taah kpaan Kristo chee ke ti ŋmar pu na, nima le mɔk ke timi Juu yaab ye titunwanbirdam ke binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na mu aah ye pu na. Nimina mɔk ke Kristo ban titunwanbir aa? Aayii.

ref: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
text: M nan yii Moses aakaal ki dii Yesu aasan la. M yaa ki dii nkaal ngbaan kan, nima le ga ŋa mi utunwanbirdaan.

ref: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
text: Maa ki dii nkaal ngbaan ke unii u kpo na aah kaa ki dii pu na la. Ni naahn ke nkaal ngbaan aah ku mi le na. M yii nkaal ngbaan ke m li bi Uwumbɔr aah ban pu na la.

ref: I have died, but Christ lives in me. And I now live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me.
text: M nan kpo Kristo chee ndɔpuinkoo pu, le m mu beenin fu; naa ki ye min Pɔɔl le fu. Kristo le fu m ni. Uma Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn u gee mi ki nan kpo m pu na, uma le m gaa u ki kii, nima pu le m bi.

ref: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
text: Maa yii Uwumbɔr aanimbaasaln. Maah len pu na le ye ke unii yaa bui ke waah dii Moses aakaal na, nima le ga gaa u lii kan, u bui ke Yesu nan kpo fam le na.

ref: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
text: Galasia aatiŋ aanib, bijɔrb, ŋma ŋmann nimi ke ni taa ki dii mbamɔn? Ti nan tuk nimi Yesu Kristo aah nan kpo ndɔpuinkoo pu pu na. Ni bi ke ninimbil aah kan le na.

ref: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
text: Cha m baa nimi mbaan mbaa. Naah dii Moses aakaal na le cha ni gaa Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aan naah ŋun Yesu aabɔnyaan tee ki gaa u ki kii na le cha ni gaa?

ref: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?
text: Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aapɔɔn pu, le ni nan piin ki dii waasan. Ni ye bijɔrb ki dak ke ni ga ŋmaa dii u nimi nibaa aapɔɔn pu uu?

ref: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
text: Uwumbɔr aah tun litukpaan ki tii nimi na, ni ye fam la aa? M mak ke laa ye fam.

ref: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
text: Uwumbɔr nan tii nimi Waafuur Nyaan ki tun lijinjiir aatun nikaasisik ni. Naah dii Moses aakaal na le cha u ŋani kina aan naah ŋun Yesu aabɔnyaan tee ki gaa u ki kii na le cha u ŋani kina?

ref: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
text: Nimina mɔk timi ke binib bi gaa Uwumbɔr ki kii na, bima le ye Abraham aayaabitiib.

ref: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
text: Ni ki ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke Uwumbɔr nan bee ke binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na ga nan gaa u ki kii ki ŋmar. Baah kaa nan kee gaa u ki kii buyoonn na, le u nan puen tuk Abraham tibɔnyaan tee, ki bui u, “Aa pu, le m ga ŋa tinyoor ŋa ŋinibol mɔmɔk pu.”

ref: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
text: Nima pu na, Uwumbɔr ga ŋa tinyoor ŋa binib bi gaa u ki kii na pu, ke waah nan ŋa tinyoor ŋa Abraham u nan gaa u ki kii na pu na.

ref: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.”
text: Tɔ, binib bimɔk dii Moses aakaal ke bi ŋmar na, Uwumbɔr aamɔpuur bi bi pu la. Ba pu? ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke, “Uwumbɔr aamɔpuur bi unii umɔk yii, kaa dii ikaal ni mmɔkm mumɔk bi Nkaal aagbaŋ ni na pu la.”

ref: The Law isn't based on faith. It promises life only to people who obey its commands.
text: Moses aakaal bi, le ki cha naadii mu bi. Nkaal ngbaan len ke unii u dii mu mbamɔm na ga li kpa limɔfal.

ref: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.
text: Ti bii nkaal ngbaan la, nima le Uwumbɔr aamɔpuur bi ti pu. Le Kristo nyan timi mmɔpuur ngbaan ni; kinye pu? u nan kpo ndɔpuinkoo pu ki di mmɔpuur ngbaan di tun uma ubaa aayil pu, ke baah nan ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni pu na ke, “Unii umɔk bi kpaa u ndɔpuinkoo pu na, Uwumbɔr aamɔpuur bi u pu la.”

ref: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
text: Uwumbɔr nan ŋa tinyoor ŋa Abraham pu. Le Yesu Kristo nan kpo ti pu ke binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na mu kan tinyoor ngbaan. Le ti yaa gaa Yesu ki kii kan, ti ga gaa Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan, waah nan puu tipuur ti ke u ga tii timi na. Nkaal na, ni tipuur ngbaan

ref: My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement.
text: Nnaabitiib, m ga di binib aabɔr ki di ŋaŋ Uwumbɔr aabɔr aah bi pu na la. Unii yaa puu tipuur, ki ŋmee waayimbil ti pu kan, ubaa aan ŋmaa kpeln ti, kaan ŋmaa ŋa ti fam.

ref: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
text: Uwumbɔr nan puu tipuur tii Abraham ni uyaabil la. Waa len ke uyaabitiib, kaa len ke kinipaak, u len ke unibaan la. U nan len ke uyaabil la. Uma le ye Kristo.

ref: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
text: Tipuur ngbaan pu le Uwumbɔr nan ŋa tinyoor ŋa Abraham pu. Nima le mɔk ke u ga ŋa tinyoor ŋa ti mu pu, tipuur ngbaan pu. Naa ye ke ti dii nkaal ngbaan le ga cha u ŋa tinyoor ŋa ti pu.

ref: What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people.
text: Ni yaa ye kina kan, ba pu Uwumbɔr nan tii binib nkaal ngbaan? U nan tii bi nkaal ngbaan ke bi bee titunwanbir aah ye pu na. U ban ke nkaal ngbaan li bi ki nan saa buyoonn Abraham aayaabil ga fuu ni na. Abraham aayaabil ngbaan le Uwumbɔr nan puu tipuur ngbaan tii u. Uwumbɔr nan cha waatuuntiib di nkaal ngbaan tii Moses, ke u di tii binib.

ref: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
text: Uwumbɔr nan cha waatuuntiib ni Moses le tii binib nkaal ngbaan. Uwumbɔr ubaa le nan puu tipuur na ki tii Abraham. Nkaal ngbaan aatuln

ref: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.
text: Moses aakaal kpak Uwumbɔr aah puu tipuur ti na aa? Aayii. Nkaal ngbaan yaa ba ŋmaa tii timi limɔfal kan, nkaal ngbaan pu le ti ba ga ŋmar.

ref: The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith.
text: Buyoonn Yesu aa nan kee fuu ni na, Moses aakaal nan dii timi ki nan saa buyoonn Yesu nan dan dulnyaa ni na ke ti gaa u ki kii.

ref: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
text: Nkaal ngbaan nan ye ukikiir ki kii timi, ki nan saa buyoonn Yesu fuu ni na, aan ti gaa u ki kii le ki ŋmar.

ref: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
text: Dandana wee Yesu le ti gaa ki kii. Moses aakaal aa ki joo timi.

ref: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
text: Nimi bimɔk gaa Yesu Kristo ki kii na, u pu le ni ye Uwumbɔr aabim.

ref: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
text: Baah nan muin nimi nnyun ni, Kristo aayimbil pu na, ni gaa Kristo aabimbin la.

ref: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
text: Naah kpaan Yesu Kristo ni na, ni mɔmɔk ye unibaan la. Juu yaab ni binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na, ni binaagbiib ni mmaal aabim, ni bijab ni bipiib, ni mɔmɔk ye unibaan la.

ref: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
text: Ni ye Kristo aanib la. Nima le ni ye Abraham aayaabitiib. Le ni ni u ga kan tiwanyaan ni Uwumbɔr nan puu tipuur ke u ga tii nimi paacham na.

ref: Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs.
text: Maah len pu na le ye ke ubo u ga ji lifaal na le yeh ute aawan mɔmɔk; le waah laa ye ubo buyoonn na, waa jer unaagbiija.

ref: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.
text: U bi waaninkpiib ni bimɔmɔkb aaŋaal ni, ki nan saa nwiin mu ute siin na.

ref: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
text: Ti mu bi kina la. Buyoonn taa nan kee nyi Yesu aabɔr na, dulnyaa aawanbir nan joo timi tinaagbiir la.

ref: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
text: Naah nan ŋeer n‑yoonn mu na, le Uwumbɔr nan tun ni Ujapɔɔn. Upii le nan ma u. Juu yaab aakaal le nan joo u,

ref: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
text: ke u gaa binib bi dii nkaal ngbaan na lii, aan Uwumbɔr ŋa timi waabim.

ref: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
text: Taah ye Uwumbɔr aabim na, le Uwumbɔr tun ni Ujapɔɔn Aafuur Nyaan tisui ni. Muma le cha ti yin Uwumbɔr ke Tite.

ref: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
text: Nima pu na, saa ki ye unaagbiija. Aa ye Uwumbɔr aabo la. Saah ye waabo na, aa ga kan waah puu tipuur ti na [Kristo pu]. Pɔɔl aatafal aah bi Galasia yaab ni pu na

ref: Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real.
text: Buyoonn naa nan kee nyi Uwumbɔr na, ŋiwaa ŋi kaa ye Uwumbɔr na nan joo nimi tinaagbiir la.

ref: But now you know God, or better still, God knows you. How can you turn back and become the slaves of those weak and pitiful powers?
text: Dandana wee, ni nyi Uwumbɔr, le u mu nyi nimi. Ba ŋa ni ban ni labr ki ki dii dulnyaa aawanbir mu kaa kpa mpɔɔn, kaa ŋmaa ter nimi na? Ba ŋa ni ban ke tiwanbir ngbaan ki li joo nimi tinaagbiir?

ref: You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years.
text: Ni joo nwiin aakpaakool, ki joo uŋmal mu aakpaakool, ki joo libiln mu aakpaakool la.

ref: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
text: M nan tun Uwumbɔr aatuln linimaln nikaasisik ni. Le ni muk mi nsui ni, ke nibaakan maatuln ga nan ŋa yɔli la.

ref: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
text: Idabur nan joo mi. Ni nyi ke idabur ngbaan nan tii mi nsan njan ke m dan nan tuk nimi Yesu aabɔnyaan.

ref: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
text: Le ni ŋa mi tibulchinn, kaa lik mi fam, kaa yii mi ke m ye iween aanii. Ni nan gaa mi ke naah ba ga gaa Uwumbɔr aatuun, bee Yesu Kristo pu na.

ref: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
text: Ni nan kpa mpopiin m pu la. Mpopiin ngbaan ki bi la chee dandana wee? M nyi ke ni yaa ba ga ŋmaa lokr nimi aanimbil ngbaan ki di tii mi kan, ni ba ga lokr ŋi tii mi.

ref: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
text: Dandana wee, maah sur nimi ki tuk nimi mbamɔn na, nima le cha m kpaln nimi aadin aa?

ref: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
text: Binib bi tuk nimi tibɔyayan na, binimbil man ni pu la. Baabɔr mu aa ŋan. Bi ban ke bi nyan nimi Yesu aasan ni. Bi ban ke ninimbil li man bi pu, aan ni dii bi.

ref: It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you.
text: Binib aanimbil yaa man nsanyaan pu kan, nima le ŋan. Ni ŋan, maah bi ni chee buyoonn na, ki ŋan maah kaa bi ni chee buyoonn na mu.

ref: My children, I am in terrible pain until Christ may be seen living in you.
text: Maabim, ni wu mi ke imalween aah chuu upii kan, ni wu pu na, ki nan saa buyoonn ni ga chikr Kristo aasan ni na.

ref: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled. Hagar and Sarah
text: M ban ke m li bi ni chee dandana wee, ki kpeln maamɔboln; ba pu? nlan ŋmal nimi aabɔr pu la. Sara ni unaagbiipii Hagar aamɔkl

ref: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
text: Nimi bi ban ni dii Moses aakaal na, naa nyi nkaal ngbaan aah len pu na aa?

ref: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
text: Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ len ke Abraham nan kpa japɔtiib bilee. Unaagbiipii nan ma ubaa, mmaal aabo mu ma uken.

ref: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
text: Unaagbiipii ngbaan ma kan, u po ma ubijabo binib aah ma pu na la. Mmaal aabo ma kan, Uwumbɔr le nan puu tipuur tii u ke u ga maa ubijabo, le u ma u.

ref: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
text: Bipiib bilee ngbaan aabɔr kpa ŋitaa la. Unaagbiipii u bi nan yin u ke Hagar na nan ma nnaagbiibim la. Hagar aabɔr ŋaŋ Moses aakaal la; ba pu? Moses aakaal joo binib tinaagbiir la. Uwumbɔr nan tii Moses nkaal ngbaan Sainai aajool paab.

ref: Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
text: Sainai aajool bi Arabia aatiŋ ni la. Hagar aabim mu nan bi nima la. Jerusalem aatiŋ ki bi dulnyaa ni na naahn unaagbiipii Hagar la; ba pu? Jerusalem aanib ye binaagbiib la. Moses aakaal le joo bi tinaagbiir.

ref: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
text: Le Jerusalem aatiŋ ki bi paacham na aanib ye mmaal aabim. Timi le ye waabim.

ref: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
text: Ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke, “Upii u kaa ma mbim na, u li kpa mpopiin. Imalween aah kaa chuu upii u na, u li tar mpopiin ngbaan pu; ba pu? upii u aachal yii u na aabim wiir ki jer upii u kpa chal na aabim.”

ref: My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was.
text: Nnaabitiib, ti bi ke mmaal aabijabo Aisak aah nan bi pu na la; ba pu? Uwumbɔr aah puu tipuur ti na le cha ti ye waabim.

ref: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
text: N‑yoonn ngbaan unaagbiipii aabijabo nan muk mmaal aabijabo Aisak u bi nan ma u Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aapɔɔn pu na. Dandana wee, ni bi kina la. Binib bi dii Juu yaab aakaal na muk timi bi ye Uwumbɔr aabim Waafuur Nyaan aapɔɔn pu na la.

ref: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
text: Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ len kinye? Ki len ke Uwumbɔr nan bui Abraham, “Nyan unaagbiipii na ni waabo; unaagbiipii aabo na aa kpa nsan u ji lifaal mmaal aabo na chee.”

ref: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
text: Nnaabitiib, maah len pu na le ye ke taa ye unaagbiipii aabim, ti ye mmaal aabim la.

ref: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
text: Kristo nan gaa timi lii, ke ti taa ki li bi tinaagbiir ni. Nima pu na, ni li si mbamɔm, ki taa cha tiwan nibaa ki li joo nimi tinaagbiir.

ref: I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised.
text: Ni li pel mbamɔm, min Pɔɔl le tuk nimi ke ni yaa gii lichakpaln ke ni ŋmar kan, Kristo aan ŋa nimi tinyoor.

ref: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
text: Nimi bi ban ke ni dii Moses aakaal ke ni ŋmar na, ni yakr Kristo chee la, ki di Uwumbɔr aaterm lii a.

ref: But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ.
text: Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan bi ti ni. Le ti gaa Yesu ki kii. Nima le cha ti kii bundaln Uwumbɔr ga nan len ke timi aabɔr ŋan na.

ref: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
text: Ti yaa kpaan Yesu Kristo ni kan, lichakpangeei aa ye tibɔkpaan. Unii yaa kaa gii kan, ni mu aa ye tibɔkpaan. Ti yaa gaa Yesu ki kii, ki mu yaa gee binib kan, nima le ye tibɔkpaan.

ref: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
text: Ni nan dii Yesu mbamɔm la. Ŋma kiir nimi ke ni taa ki kii waabɔr ti ye mbamɔn na?

ref: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
text: Binib bi kiir nimi na aabɔr aa nyan ni Uwumbɔr u yin nimi na chee.

ref: A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough,
text: Boroboro aanyɔk siib le cha boroboro mɔmɔk duuni.

ref: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
text: Tɔ, naah ye Tidindaan aanib na le m bee ke naan dii nnyamɔn aamɔkm. Ntafadaan ga pii binib bi muk nimi na.

ref: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
text: Nnaabitiib, binib bibaa len ke m tuk binib ke bi li geei ŋichakpan aan ki ŋmar. Ti yaa gbii kan, ba pu Juu yaab beenin ŋani mi falaa? Ti yaa gbii ke m tuk binib ke bi li geei ŋichakpan aan ki ŋmar kan, Yesu aadɔpuinkoo aabɔr aa ba ga cha Juu yaab gee liŋuul.

ref: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
text: Cha binib bi muk nimi lichakpangeei pu na lee nyan bibaa aajawan.

ref: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
text: Nnaabitiib, Uwumbɔr yin nimi ke u nan gaa nimi lii la. Waah gaa nimi lii na, ni taa ki li ŋani nimi aabimbikpok aah ban pu na. Ni li gee tɔb ki li ter tɔb.

ref: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
text: Uwumbɔr aakaal mbaa len ke, “Aa li gee aana aabo ke saah gee aabaa pu na.” Aa yaa joo nkaal ngbaan kan, Uwumbɔr aakaal mɔmɔk le aa joo.

ref: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
text: Ni mu yaa kpa lipiipoln ki kpak tɔb kinikpakpak kan, ni li nyi, ni ga kuln tɔb. Nfuur Nyaan ni unibɔn aabimbin

ref: If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires.
text: M tuk nimi la, cha Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan le joo nimi man, ki taa ŋani nimi aabimbikpok aah gee pu na.

ref: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
text: Ni yaa dii Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aah ban pu na kan, Moses aakaal aa dii nimi.

ref: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.
text: Mbimbikpok aatuln bi lipaal la. Binib bi dii kina na le gɔr kidagook, ki tun tijɔŋ aatuln, ni inimɔɔn aatuln,

ref: They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are
text: ki dii ŋiwaa, ki chuun ji inyɔk, ki nan binib, ki ban tibɔr, ki kpa lipiipoln, ki kpa liŋuul, ki kpa kukumɔŋ, ki kpak tɔb kinikpakpak, ki yakr tɔb,

ref: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
text: ki kpa iniman, ki ku binib, ki nyu ndaan gbii, ki gbiir bidagbiib aagbiir, ki tun lituln limina mɔk aaboln. M ki sur nimi ke maah nan sur nimi n‑yoonn mu jer na pu na, ke binib bi ŋani kina na aan koo Uwumbɔr aanaan ni.

ref: God's Spirit makes us loving, happy, peaceful, patient, kind, good, faithful,
text: Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan le cha binib gee tɔb, ki kpa mpopiin, ni nsuudoon, ni limɔr, ni tibulchinn, ni mbimbinyaan, ni ibamɔn,

ref: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
text: ki bi suuna, ki chur bibaa. Nkaal aa bi ki ga kpak binib bi ŋani kina na.

ref: And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires.
text: Binib bi ye Yesu Kristo aanib na, bi yii baabimbikpok aah ban pu na mɔmɔk, ki di mbimbikpok ngbaan kpaa Yesu aadɔpuinkoo pu.

ref: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
text: Ti kpa limɔfal Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan pu. Nima pu na, cha Nfuur Nyaan ngbaan le joo timi.

ref: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
text: Ti taa li kpa kalmbaani, ki taa muk tɔb, ki taa li kpa lipiipoln tɔb pu.

ref: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
text: Nnaabitiib, bi yaa pii unii titunwanbir ni kan, nimi bi nyi Uwumbɔr aasan mbamɔm na, ni li bi suuna ki ter u ke u ki dii mbamɔm, ki li lik aabaa, kinimbɔŋ taa tɔŋ aa mu.

ref: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
text: Kii Kristo aakaal mbamɔm man, ki li ter tɔb nimi aamuk ponn ni.

ref: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
text: Unii u kaa bi tibɔr tibaa ni na yaa dak ke u ye uninyuun kan, u ŋmanni ubaa la.

ref: Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others.
text: Cha unii mɔmɔk dakl lik ke waatuln ŋan aan laa ŋan. Li yaa ŋan kan, u ga li kpa mpopiin uma ubaa aatuln pu. U taa li kpa kipupuk ke waatuln ŋan ki jer una aabo yaan.

ref: We each must carry our own load.
text: Ba pu? unii mɔmɔk kpa uma ubaa aatuln la.

ref: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
text: Tɔ, binib bi bae Yesu aabɔnyaan na, cha bi yakr baah kpa ni na tii unii u mɔk bi tibɔnyaan ngbaan na.

ref: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.
text: Tɔ, ni taa ŋmanni nibaa; ni taa dak ke ni ga ŋmaa ŋmann Uwumbɔr; tiwan ni aa bun na, nima le aa ga nan chee.

ref: If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life.
text: Maah len pu na le ye ke unii yaa ŋani unibɔn aabimbin aah ban pu na kan, u ga kan nkun. Unii yaa ŋani Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aah ban pu na kan, u ga kan limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
text: Cha ti tun litunyaan ki taa di cha; ba pu? ti yaa kaa di cha kan, ni nan saa naayoonn kan, ti ga kan lituln ngbaan aanyoor.

ref: We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord. Final Warnings
text: Nima na, ti yaa kan nsan kan, ti li ŋani binib mɔmɔk tiŋann. Binib bi gaa Yesu ki kii na, ti li ŋani bima le tiŋann sakpen. Kookoo aasurm ni idoon

ref: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
text: Lik man, m di mbaa aaŋaal ŋmee ke ni filk ki tii nimi.

ref: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.
text: Binib bi muk nimi ke ni li geei ŋichakpan na, bi ban ke bi piir Juu yaab aasui, aan bi taa ŋa bi falaa Kristo aadɔpuinkoo aabɔr pu la.

ref: They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised.
text: Tɔ, binib ngbaan geei ŋichakpan la; bima bibaa aa dii Moses aakaal mɔmɔk. Bi po ban ni li geei ŋichakpan, aan bi li kpa kipupuk ke ni ŋa kina.

ref: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
text: Mma kan, m ga li kpa kipupuk tiwan nibaa baanja le pu, nima le ye ke Tidindaan Yesu Kristo nan kpo ndɔpuinkoo pu. Waadɔpuinkoo pu, le dulnyaa wee ni aawan aa ki mɔ m chee, ntafal aa ki bi dulnyaa wee ni aawan ni.

ref: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
text: Unii yaa dii Yesu Kristo aasan kan, lichakpangeei aa ye tibɔkpaan, unii yaa kaa gii kan, ni mu aa ye tibɔkpaan. Mbimbipɔɔn le ye tibɔkpaan.

ref: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
text: Binib bimɔk kii kina na le ye Uwumbɔr aanib, ki ye Israel yaab bamɔm. Uwumbɔr tii bi nsuudoon ki san bi kinimbaak.

ref: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
text: Tɔ, ubaa taa ki muk mi; ba pu? binib aah gbaa mi na aabue bi nwon pu, ki mɔk ke m ye Yesu yoo.

ref: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
text: Nnaabitiib, Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aaŋann li bi nisui ni. Amii.

ref: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
text: Min Pɔɔl, u ye Yesu Kristo aakpambal Uwumbɔr aageehn pu na, le ŋmee kigbaŋ kee tii Uwumbɔr aaninyaam bi bi Efesus aatiŋ ni, ki joo waasan mbamɔm, ki kpaan Yesu Kristo chee na.

ref: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
text: Tite Uwumbɔr ni Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu, ki tii nimi nsuudoon. Uwumbɔr aah tii timi Waafuur Nyaan aanyoor pu na

ref: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven!
text: Cha ti pak Uwumbɔr, u ye Tidindaan Yesu Kristo Aate na. Taah kpaan Kristo ni na, le Uwumbɔr ŋa tinyoor ŋa ti pu, ki tii timi Waafuur Nyaan aapiin mɔmɔk paacham.

ref: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
text: Uwumbɔr aah kaa nan kee naan dulnyaa wee buyoonn na, le u nan nyan timi, Kristo pu, ke ti li ye waanib, ki li bi chain, ki taa li kpa taani ubaa unimbiin ni. U gee timi la.

ref: God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children.
text: Taah kpaan Yesu Kristo chee na, le Uwumbɔr ŋa timi waabim. N‑yaayoonn na, u nan nyan timi ke ti li ye waabim. Nima le ye waageehn, ki ye waah ban pu na.

ref: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
text: Waabogeehn pu le u ŋa tinyoor sakpen ŋa ti pu, nima le ti pak u ki nyuŋni u waabulchinn sakpenn pu.

ref: and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways.
text: ki kpiir tibɔbɔrkaan ti u nan dak usui ni ke u ga ŋa ti na mɔk timi. Kristo pu le u kpiir ti. Waageehn le na.

ref: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
text: Tibɔbɔrkaan ngbaan le ye ke ni yaa nan ŋeer kan, u ga di tiwan nimɔk bi paacham ni taab na kpaan tɔb chee, ki ŋa ni kimɔbaan, ki ŋa Kristo ni mɔmɔk aayidaan.

ref: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
text: U nyan timi bi puen kpa limakl Kristo pu na, ke ti li mɔk binib waah ŋan sakpen pu na, aan bi pak u.

ref: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
text: Ni mu gaa Kristo ki kii la. Naah ŋun Uwumbɔr aabɔr ti ye mbamɔn, ki ye tibɔnyaan ti cha ni ŋmar na, le ni gaa Kristo ki kii. Naah kpaan u ni na, le Uwumbɔr tii nimi Waafuur Nyaan, ke waah nan puu tipuur ti na, ki mɔk ke ni ye waanib la.

ref: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
text: Waah tii timi Waafuur Nyaan na, nima le mɔk ke u ga tii timi waah puu tipuur ti na mɔmɔk, ki ga gaa timi bimɔk ye waanib na lii. Nima pu na, cha ti li pak u, waah ŋan sakpen pu na. Pɔɔl aah mee Uwumbɔr pu na

ref: I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people.
text: M ŋun naah gaa Tidindaan Yesu ki kii, ki gee waanib mɔmɔk pu na,

ref: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
text: nima le m dooni Uwumbɔr ni pu n‑yoonn mɔmɔk,

ref: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
text: ki bee ke u kpa mpɔɔn sakpen ki ti nyaŋ, ki tii timi bi gaa u ki kii na. Mpɔɔn ngbaan le ye mpɔɔn sakpiin

ref: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
text: mu u nan di fikr Kristo nkun ni, ki di u kaan uŋangii wɔb paacham na.

ref: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
text: Uma Kristo bi nima ki kpa mpɔɔn mu jer mpɔɔn mɔmɔk na: u kpa mpɔɔn jer inyɔk, ni ŋiwaa, ni bipɔnib aapɔɔn, ki kpa tininkpir jer tininkpir mɔmɔk, ki kpa mpɔɔn jer dindatiib aapɔɔn mɔmɔk. Waayimbil jer ŋiyimbil ŋimɔk bi dandana wee na, ni ŋimɔk ga li bi n‑yoonn mu choo na.

ref: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
text: Uwumbɔr di tiwan mɔmɔk di ŋa uma Kristo aataapɔtan taab, ki ŋa u tiwan mɔmɔk aayidaan ki tii waanib.

ref: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
text: Waanib le ye uma Kristo aawon, le u gbii bi, ki mu bi tiwan nimɔk bi ŋipepel mɔmɔk na ni.

ref: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
text: U tii nimi limɔfal la. Ni nan tun titunwanbir, kaa nan kii Uwumbɔr aamɔb, nima le naa nan kpa limɔfal.

ref: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
text: Ni nan dii dulnyaa aasan mu kaa ŋan na, ki kii kinimbɔŋ ki ye tiwanbir mɔmɔk aayidaan na aamɔb. Kima le joo binib bi yii Uwumbɔr aamɔb na.

ref: Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
text: Ti mɔmɔk mu nan bi bi ponn ni, ki mu dii taah ban tiwan ni kaa ŋan na pu na, ki ŋani tisui ni tiwon aah gee pu na. Taah nan bi pu na le nan cha Uwumbɔr gee liŋuul ti pu, ke waah gee liŋuul titunwanbirdam biken pu pu na.

ref: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
text: Taah nan tun titunwanbir na, taa nan kpa limɔfal. Taah kpaan Kristo ni na, le Uwumbɔr tii timi limɔfal. Waanimbaasaln pu le u gaa nimi lii.

ref: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
text: Taah kpaan Yesu Kristo ni na, le Uwumbɔr kpaan yoor timi ni uma Kristo, ki cha ti ti kal u chee paacham.

ref: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.
text: N‑yoonn mu choo na, nima le ga mɔk ke Uwumbɔr kpa linimbaasaln sakpen, ki gee timi ki ti nyaŋ, Yesu Kristo pu.

ref: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.
text: Naah gaa Yesu ki kii pu na, le ni ŋmar, Uwumbɔr aanimbaasaln pu. Naa ye nimi nibaa pu le ni ŋmar. Ni ye Uwumbɔr aapiin la.

ref: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
text: Naa ye nimi aatunyaan pu le ti ŋmar, ubaa taa li kpa kipupuk.

ref: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
text: Ti ye Uwumbɔr aawanaankaan la. Taah kpaan Yesu Kristo ni na, le Uwumbɔr ŋa timi binipɔm, ke ti li tun lituln li ŋan na. U nan di lituln ngbaan siin kiir timi, ke ti nan tun li. Nimi ni Yesu Kristo kpaan la

ref: Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised.
text: Nimi bi kaa ye Juu yaab na, Juu yaab yin nimi binib bi kaa geei ŋichakpan na, ki yin bibaa bichakpangeeb; ba pu? bi geei ŋichakpan. Ni teer man, naah nan bi pu n‑yoonn mu jer na.

ref: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
text: N‑yoonn ngbaan, naa nan kpaan Kristo chee, kaa nan ye binib bi Uwumbɔr nyan bi na ponn ni bibaa, kaa nan bi tipuur ti Uwumbɔr nan puu tii bi na ni. Ni nan bi dulnyaa wee ni, kaa nan kpa limakl, kaa nan nyi Uwumbɔr.

ref: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
text: Le dandana wee, naah kpaan Yesu Kristo ni na, nimi bi nan daa Uwumbɔr chee na duun u chee dandana wee, Kristo aasin pu.

ref: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
text: Uma pu le kimɔbaan bi. U nan di timi Juu yaab, ni binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na kpaan unibaan, ki gbaa wii ligoln li nan bi tikaasisik ni na.

ref: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
text: Waah kpo na, u kuln kiduŋ ki nan bi ti ni bikaasisik ni na. U kuln Juu yaab aakaal ni baakoobil, ki di timi Juu yaab, ni binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na kpaan ŋa linibopɔln libaa, bi kpaan u ni na, nima le ti ŋa kimɔbaan.

ref: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
text: Waah kpo ndɔpuinkoo pu na, u di timi ni bima, ki kpaan linibol libaa, ki giin bi Uwumbɔr chee, bi ni Uwumbɔr ti kpaan ki ŋa kijɔtiik. Waah ŋa kina na, le u kuln kiduŋ ki nan bi ti ni bikaasisik ni na.

ref: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
text: Kristo nan dan ki nan tuk nimi bi nan daa Uwumbɔr chee na, ni Juu yaab bi duun u chee na, ke u ga ŋa nimi, ni Juu yaab, ni Uwumbɔr kijɔtiik.

ref: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
text: Kristo pu, le binib bi ye Juu yaab na, ni binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na mɔmɔk kpaani Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan baan ni, ki dan Tite Uwumbɔr chee.

ref: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
text: Nima pu na, nimi bi kaa ye Juu yaab na aa ki ye biwɔwɔm ni bicham Uwumbɔr aanib chee. Ni ye Uwumbɔr aanib ponn ni bibaa, ki ye waamaal mu ponn ni bibaa la.

ref: You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone.
text: Nimi Yesu aanib naahn kidiik la. Bi maa nimi lidinyikl li ye Yesu aakpambalb ni Uwumbɔr aabɔnabtiib na pu la. Yesu Kristo ubaa le ye lidinyikl ngbaan aatakpakpaan.

ref: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
text: Uma pu le kidiik aawan mɔmɔk tɔŋ tɔb pu, ki ŋa kidiik ki bi chain na, ki tii u.

ref: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
text: Naah kpaan u ni na, ni mu ye kidiik ngbaan aawan ponn ni nibaa, ki ŋa kidiik ki Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan bi ki ponn ni na.

ref: Christ Jesus made me his prisoner, so I could help you Gentiles.
text: Nima pu na, min Pɔɔl mee Uwumbɔr tii nimi la. M ye Yesu Kristo aayom, nimi bi kaa ye Juu yaab na pu.

ref: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
text: M dak ke ni ga li ŋun Uwumbɔr aah san mi kinimbaak pu ki cha m tuk nimi waah gee nimi pu na.

ref: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
text: U nan kpiir tibɔbɔrkaan mɔk mi. M puun ŋmee ti kigbaŋ kee ponn ni siib.

ref: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
text: Ni yaa karn maah ŋmee pu na kan, ni ga bee maah nyi Kristo aabɔbɔrkaan pu na.

ref: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.
text: Uwumbɔr aa nan kpiir tibɔbɔrkaan ngbaan mɔk n‑yaayoonn na aanib. Dandana wee le Waafuur Nyaan kpiir ti, ki mɔk Yesu aakpambalb ni waabɔnabtiib bi bi chain na.

ref: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
text: Tibɔbɔrkaan ngbaan le ye ke timi Juu yaab, ni nimi bi kaa ye Juu yaab ki gaa Yesu aabɔnyaan tee na, ga kpaan ki yakr Uwumbɔr aawanyaan, ki kpaan ki li ye Yesu Kristo aanib, ki kpaan ki li bi Uwumbɔr aah nan puu tipuur ti na ni, Yesu Kristo pu.

ref: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
text: Uwumbɔr aanimbaasaln pu, le u san mi kinimbaak ki ŋa mi tibɔnyaan tee aatutunn, ki tii mi mpɔɔn ke m tun lituln ngbaan.

ref: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
text: Maa pii Uwumbɔr aaniwaatiir ubaa, le u mu tee tii mi litunyaan limina, ke m buen binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na chee, ki ti moon tibɔnyaan tee, ki tuk bi Kristo aah ŋan sakpen pu na,

ref: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
text: ki kpiir tibɔbɔrkaan mɔk binib mɔmɔk, ke binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na mu ga ŋmar. Uwumbɔr u nan naan tiwan mɔmɔk na le nan bɔr tibɔbɔrkaan ngbaan ki nan saa dandana.

ref: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
text: U ŋa kina ke waatuuntiib bi bi paacham na yaa kan Juu yaab ni bi kaa ye Juu yaab na aah kpaan tɔb chee ki ŋa Yesu aanib pu na kan, bi ga bee uma Uwumbɔr aah kpa nlan mɔk aabɔŋ pu na.

ref: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
text: N‑yaayoonn na le u nan len ke u ga ŋa kina Tidindaan Yesu Kristo pu.

ref: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.
text: Taah gaa Yesu ki kii ki kpaan u ni na, nima le ti kpa lipobil ke ti dan Uwumbɔr chee ki nan doon u, ki taa li san ijawaan.

ref: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
text: Nima pu na, m gaŋ nimi, ke ni taa cha nitaakpab yɔl maah ji falaa ni pu pu na. Maafalaa le ye nimi aaterm. Yesu Kristo aah gee timi pu na

ref: I kneel in prayer to the Father.
text: Nima pu le m gbaan Tite Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni.

ref: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.
text: Waah ye Tite na, nima le mɔk timi te aabimbin bamɔnn aah bi pu na.

ref: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
text: Waah kpa mpɔɔn sakpen pu na, le m mee u ke u tii nimi mpɔɔn nisui ni, Waafuur Nyaan pu,

ref: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
text: ki ki mee u ke Kristo li bi nisui ni, naah gaa u ki kii pu na, ki ki mee u ke ngeehm li bi ni chee mbamɔm,

ref: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
text: ki ki mee u ke ni ni waanib mɔmɔk ŋmaa bee Kristo aah gee nimi sakpen ki ti nyaŋ pu na.

ref: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
text: Waah gee timi pu na jer unii aah ga ŋmaa bee pu na. M ban ke ni bee waah gee nimi pu na aan nimi aabimbin li bi ke waah bi pu na mbamɔm.

ref: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
text: Yesu Kristo aanib aah kpaan u ni na, bi li nyuŋni Uwumbɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ki ti saa dulnyaa wee aadoon, ki li nyuŋni u n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Amii.

ref: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
text: Min Pɔɔl, u bi kiyondiik ni Tidindaan pu na, m gaŋni nimi, ni li dii mbamɔm. Uwumbɔr aah yin nimi ke ni li dii u pu na, ni li dii u kina.

ref: Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other.
text: Ni li sunni nibaa taab man, ki li bi suuna, ki li kpa suklaa n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, ki li gee tɔb, ki li kpa limɔr tɔb pu.

ref: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
text: Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aah kpaan nimi unibaan pu na, ni li pɔɔni nibaa man, ki li kpaan kimɔbaan, ki li beenin ye unibaan.

ref: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
text: Timi Yesu aanib mɔmɔk kpaan ki ye tiwonbaan ti ye waawon na la. Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan baan le bi. Uwumbɔr yin nimi ki tii nimi limakl libaa ke ni ga ŋmar.

ref: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
text: Uwumbɔr ubaa u ye ti mɔmɔk Aate na mu bi. U ye ti mɔmɔk Aayidaan ki cha ti mɔmɔk tun waatuln la, ki bi ti mɔmɔk ni.

ref: Christ has generously divided out his gifts to us.
text: Kristo yakr ipiin tii ti mɔmɔk waah ban pu na la.

ref: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
text: Ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke, “Waah buen paacham na u joo binaagbiib pam, ki di ipiin tii binib.”

ref: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
text: Naah ŋmee ke u buen paacham na, ni mɔk ke u puen nyan ni paacham le ki sunn ni kitiŋ kee pu, le ki nin ki gir buen paacham.

ref: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
text: U sunn ni kitiŋ kee pu na mu ye u buen paacham na, ki bi ŋipepel mɔmɔk, ki ye dulnyaa wee mɔmɔk, ni paacham mɔmɔk Aayidaan.

ref: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
text: ki li kpaan kimɔbaan, uma u ye Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn na aasan ni, ki bee u mbamɔm, ki chikr waasan ni, ki li kpa mbimbinyaan ki ti doo, uma Kristo aah tii timi pu na.

ref: We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place.
text: Ti taa ki li ye mbim. Biŋmaŋmannim bi kpa nnyamɔn aalan ke bi di ŋmann binib na yaa tuk nimi tibɔyayan ti kaa ye Kristo aabɔr na kan, ni taa dii bi.

ref: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
text: Ti li kpa ngeehm ki li len ibamɔn man, aan timi aabimbin mɔmɔk li moo naahn Kristo u ye timi Aayidaan na.

ref: of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love. The Old Life and the New Life
text: Kristo aah joo timi pu na, le ti mɔmɔk kpaan tɔb chee, le ki tun ter tɔb waah tii ti mɔmɔk lituln pu na, aan ti mɔmɔk li moo dii u mbamɔm, ki li gee tɔb. Limɔfapɔln li bi Yesu Kristo ni na

ref: As a follower of the Lord, I order you to stop living like stupid, godless people.
text: Ni taa li dii ke binib bi kaa nyi Uwumbɔr na aah dii pu na. Tidindaan aayimbil pu, le m len tibɔr timina. Baalandak mɔmɔk ye ilandak yɔli la.

ref: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
text: Binimbil aa woln. Bitafal aah pɔɔ pu na, le baa nyi Uwumbɔr. Nima le baa kpa limɔfal li Uwumbɔr tii timi na.

ref: and they are so greedy they do all kinds of indecent things.
text: Binimbil man kidagook ni tijɔŋ aatuln pu la. Baalandak aa ki muk bi titunwanbir pu.

ref: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
text: M nyi ke ni ŋun waabɔr ki bae waaliin i ye mbamɔn na.

ref: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
text: Nima pu na, ni di cha nimi aabimbikpok mu kaa ŋan na. Mbimbikpok ngbaan nan cha ni ban tiwan ni kaa ŋan ki ŋmanni nimi na la. Ni taa ki li dii naah nan dii pu na man.

ref: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking
text: Cha Uwumbɔr kpeln nimi aasui aan ki ŋa nimi nsuupɔɔn,

ref: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
text: ki yoor mbimbipɔm mu Uwumbɔr naan mu ki di tii nimi na. Mu ye mbimbinyaan, ki bi chain mbamɔm, ki naahn Uwumbɔr aabimbin la.

ref: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
text: Nima pu na, ni taa ki mɔni inyamɔn. Ni mɔmɔk li len ibamɔn tɔb chee. Ti yaa ŋmanni tɔb kan, ni naahn ke tiwon aawan nibaa le aah ŋmanni niken na.

ref: Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry
text: Ni yaa gee liŋuul kan, ni taa cha nimi aaŋuul ngbaan tun titunwanbir. Ni taa li beenin joo liŋuul ngbaan nwiin ti lir,

ref: and don't give the devil a chance.
text: ki taa tii kinimbɔŋ nsan.

ref: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
text: Binaayukb taa ki su. Cha bi di biŋaal tun lituln li ŋan na linimaln, aan ki kan baah ban pu na, ki tii bigiim mu.

ref: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
text: Ni taa cha iliin i kaa ŋan na nyan nimi aamɔi ni. Ni li len iliin i ŋan na, i ga ter binib bi ŋun na ke bi dii Uwumbɔr aasan mbamɔm.

ref: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
text: Ni taa cha niponn ni li to tɔb pu; ni li nyani liŋuul nisui ni; ni taa li ŋmɔ tɔb pu tijar; ni taa li seei tɔb; ni taa cha kinanaŋ kibaa ki li bi ni chee.

ref: Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
text: Ni li ŋani tɔb tiŋann, ki li san tɔb kinimbaak, ki di cha pinn tɔb ke Uwumbɔr aah di cha pinn nimi, Kristo pu pu na.

ref: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
text: Naah ye Uwumbɔr aabigeehm na, pɔɔk nibaa man, ki li bi ke waah bi pu na.

ref: Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
text: Cha ngeehm li bi ni chee man, ke Kristo aah gee timi pu, ki kpo ti pu, ki ŋa kitork ki piir Uwumbɔr aasui, ki ŋa ti ni Uwumbɔr kijɔtiik na.

ref: You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy.
text: Naah ye Uwumbɔr aanib na, ni taa gɔr kidagook, ki taa tun tijɔŋ aatuln libaa, ki taa li kpa iniman. Ni taa po len lituln limina aaboln aabɔr.

ref: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
text: Ni po nyi ke unii umɔk ye udagoor na, ni unii umɔk ye tijɔŋdaan na, ni unii umɔk ye unimandaan na, aan koo ni Kristo ni Uwumbɔr aanaan ni. Unii yaa kpa iniman kan, liwangol ye liwaal la, le u dii.

ref: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
text: Titunwanbir timina aaboln pu, le Uwumbɔr gee liŋuul binib bi kaa kii waamɔb na pu. Ni taa cha unii ubaa ŋmann nimi ki tuk nimi ke naa bir.

ref: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
text: Ni taa dii binib bi tun kina na.

ref: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
text: N‑yoonn mbaa, ni mu nan bi mbɔmbɔɔn ni la. Dandana, naah kpaan Tidindaan ni na, ni bi nwiihn ni la. Naah bi nwiihn ni na, ni li bi mbamɔm, ke nwiihn ni aanib aah bi pu na.

ref: as you try to please the Lord.
text: Pɔɔk nibaa man, aan ki bee tiwan ni ga piir Tidindaan aasui na.

ref: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
text: Ni taa kpaan binib bi bi mbɔmbɔɔn ni ki tun yɔl yɔl na chee man. Ni tee li sur bi man.

ref: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
