text: Ti yaa po len baah tun lituln li libɔɔl ni na aabɔr kan, ni ye inimɔɔn la.

ref: But the light will show what these things are really like.
text: Tɔ, tiwan mɔmɔk yaa nyan ni mpaan pu kan, le naabimbin ga kpiir chain; nwiihn le nyan ni tiwan mɔmɔk mpaan pu.

ref: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
text: Nima pu le ti gaa ilahn ke, “Si u dɔ geen na, finn aan ki fikr nkun ni, le Kristo ga li wiin aa pu.”

ref: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
text: Nima pu na, ni taa li ye bijɔrb man. Pɔɔk nibaa man ki bee Tidindaan aah ban ke ni ŋa pu na.

ref: Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life.
text: Ni taa nyu ndaan ki gbii man. Ndaan ga bii nimi la. Cha Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan li gbii nimi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk,

ref: When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart.
text: ki li gaa Uwumbɔr aalahn ni ilahn i bi waagbaŋ ni na tɔb chee man, ki li yikr tiwanyikrkaan, ki gaa ilahn tii Tidindaan, ki pak u nisui ni.

ref: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
text: Ni li dooni Tite Uwumbɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, tiwan mɔmɔk pu, Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aayimbil pu.

ref: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
text: Bipiib, ni li keei nichatiib aamɔi, ke naah kii Tidindaan aamɔb pu na;

ref: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
text: ba pu? uja le ye upuu aayidaan ke Kristo aah ye waanib Aayidaan pu na. Kristo aanib ye waawon la. U mu gaal bi lir la.

ref: Wives should always put their husbands first, as the church puts Christ first.
text: Bipiib, ni li keei nichatiib aamɔi tiwan mɔmɔk ponn ni, ke Kristo aanib aah kii waamɔb pu na.

ref: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
text: Bijab, ni li gee nipuutiib, ke Kristo aah gee waanib ki nan kpo bi pu pu na.

ref: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
text: U nan kpo bi pu, ke u ŋa bi chain. Baah ŋun waabɔr na, le u nyan titunwanbir bisui ni, le bi muin bi nnyun ni,

ref: Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
text: ke u di bi tii uma ubaa, bi li bi u chee, ki li ŋan sakpen, ki li bi chain, ki taa li kpa tijɔŋ tibaa, ki taa li kpa taani ubaa.

ref: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
text: Kina le ni ŋan ke bijab li gee bipuutiib ke baah gee bibaa aawon pu na. Uja u gee upuu na, u gee ubaa la.

ref: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
text: Unii ubaa aa kee nan uma ubaa aawon. U kpiini ti, ki joo ti tiŋann, ke Kristo aah joo waanib pu na;

ref: because we are each part of his body.
text: ba pu? timi Kristo aanib le ye waawon.

ref: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
text: Ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke, “Nima le cha uja ni upii nya cha bitetiib ni binatiib, ki ti kpaan tɔb chee, ki ŋa unibaan.”

ref: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
text: Tibɔr timina le ye tibɔkpaan ti ye mbamɔn na, le m di tibɔr ngbaan ŋaŋ Kristo ni waanib.

ref: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
text: Nima pu na, uja mɔk aah gee ubaa pu na, u li gee upuu mu kina. Upii mɔk mu li pak uchal.

ref: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
text: Mbim, ni li keei nitetiib ni ninatiib aamɔi Tidindaan pu; ba pu? nima le ŋan.

ref: and you will have a long and happy life.”
text: u ga ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu, ki tii nimi limɔfafɔfɔŋ dulnyaa wee ni.

ref: Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord. Slaves and Masters
text: Tetiib, ni taa fiini nimi aabim aaŋuul. Ni li joo bi mbamɔm, ki sur bi, ki tuk bi Tidindaan aabɔr. Binaagbiib ni dindatiib aabɔr

ref: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
text: Binaagbiib, ni li keei nidindatiib bi bi dulnyaa wee ni na aamɔi, ki li san bi, ki tun lituln mbamɔm, ke naah tun lituln pu ki tii Kristo na.

ref: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
text: Bi yaa bi ni chee, bee bi yaa kaa bi kan, ni li tun lituln mbamɔm, ke naah ga tun tii Kristo pu na, ki taa ban ke binib pak nimi. Naah ye Kristo aanaagbiib na, ni li joo nisui mɔmɔk ŋani Uwumbɔr aageehn,

ref: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
text: ki li kpa mpopiin ki tun lituln tii nidindatiib, ke naah ga tun pu tii Tidindaan na, naa ye binib.

ref: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
text: Teer man ke unii umɔk tun litunyaan na, u yaa ye unaagbiija, bee u yaa kaa ye kan, Tidindaan ga tii u waatuln aapar.

ref: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites. The Fight against Evil
text: Dindatiib, ni mu li ŋani nimi aanaagbiib mbamɔm, ki taa faani bi, ki li nyi ke ni ni nimi aanaagbiib kpaan Dindaan baan le paacham. Uma aa pak ubaa ki jer uken. Tijawan ti Uwumbɔr tii timi na

ref: Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong.
text: Nnaabitiib, gbelngbeln yaan le ye ke Tidindaan aah kpa mpɔɔn sakpen pu na, ni li kpa mpɔɔn mu u tii nimi na.

ref: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
text: Yoor man tijawan timɔk Uwumbɔr tii timi na. Nima le ga cha ni ŋmaa yii kinimbɔŋ aanyamɔn aalan.

ref: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.
text: Naa ye binib le ti jaa kijaak. Ti jaa kinimbɔŋ aanikpiwanbir ti bi paacham ki kpa mpɔɔn ki joo dulnyaa aanib bi bi mbɔmbɔɔn ni na le kijaak.

ref: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
text: Nima pu na, ni yoor tijawan timɔk Uwumbɔr tii timi na. Nima le ga cha ni yii kinimbɔŋ, ki nyaŋ ki, ki li beenin si bundaln ki ga jan nimi kijaak na.

ref: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
text: Nima pu na, gor nibaa man ki ti jan kijaak. Ni li joo Uwumbɔr aabɔr ti ye mbamɔn ki naahn ligbapapaln na; ki li kpa mbimbinyaan mu bi ke tikur ti bii kibiŋ pu na;

ref: Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet.
text: ki li tak ŋinaatak ŋi ye tibɔnyaan ti tii timi nsuudoon na;

ref: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
text: ki li ŋani Yesu Kristo naadii, naadii bi ke kipeln ki ga kiir kinimbɔŋ aapiin i wu ke mmii na;

ref: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
text: ki li chik tikur aayikpupuk ki ye Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn mu gaa nimi lii na; ki yoor Uwumbɔr aabɔr ti naahn kijaak aajuk ki Waafuur Nyaan di tii timi na;

ref: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.
text: ki li mee u ki tii m mu, ke u mɔk mi maah ga len pu na, ki tii mi lipobil ke m waar mmɔb ki tuk binib tibɔnyaan tee aabɔbɔrkaan.

ref: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
text: M si Yesu aasisiiyaan, ki bi kiyondiik ni, tibɔnyaan ngbaan pu la. Nima pu na, ni li mee Uwumbɔr ke u tii mi lipobil, ke m tuk binib tibɔnyaan ngbaan, maah ba ga tuk bi pu na. Kookoo aadoon

ref: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
text: Tite Uwumbɔr ni Tidindaan Yesu Kristo tii tinaabitiib nsuudoon, ki cha ni li gee tɔb ki gaa u ki kii mbamɔm.

ref: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ŋa tinyoor ŋa binib bimɔk gee u n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na pu.

ref: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
text: Min Pɔɔl ni Timoti bi ye Yesu Kristo aanaagbiib na dooni waaninyaam bimɔk bi Filipi aatiŋ ni na, ni baaninkpiib ni baateterb mu.

ref: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
text: Tite Uwumbɔr ni Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu, ki tii nimi nsuudoon. Pɔɔl aah mee Uwumbɔr pu na

ref: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
text: Maah teer nibɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk pu na, m dooni Uwumbɔr u m dii u na, ni pu la.

ref: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
text: Maah mee Uwumbɔr tii ni mɔmɔk n‑yoonn mɔmɔk pu na, m mee u ni mpopiin la, ba pu?

ref: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
text: bundaln ni nan gaa Yesu aabɔr ki nan saa din na, ni ter mi ke m tuk binib waabɔnyaan tee la.

ref: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
text: M bee ke Uwumbɔr u nan piin ki bi toor nimi aabimbin na, u ga li beenin ŋani kina ki toor nimi aabimbin ti doo bundaln Yesu Kristo ga gir ni na.

ref: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
text: Maah nyi kina na, ni ŋan; ba pu? m gee nimi la. Ni mɔmɔk nan ter mi kiyondiik ni, ki nan ter mi buyoonn m nan bi bibɔjirb aanimbiin ni na ke m ti len Yesu aabɔnyaan tee aabamɔn.

ref: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
text: Uwumbɔr nyi ke nnimbil man ke m ki kan nimi; ba pu? m gee nimi, Kristo aah tii mi ngeehm pu na.

ref: I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand
text: M mee Uwumbɔr ke ni li moo gee tɔb ki li moo nyi Uwumbɔr aabɔr, ki li kpa nlan nyaan,

ref: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
text: aan ki lee nsan mu ŋan na, aan ki li bi chain, ki taa li kpa taani ubaa bundaln Kristo ga gir ni na.

ref: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
text: M ban ke ni li kpa mbimbinyaan ki li tun lituln li ŋan na n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, Yesu Kristo aapɔɔn pu, aan binib nyuŋ Uwumbɔr ki pak u. Yesu Kristo pu le ti bi

ref: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
text: Nnaabitiib, m ban ke ni bee ke maah bi kiyondiik ni na, nima le cha binib pam ŋun Yesu aabɔnyaan tee.

ref: The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ.
text: Ubɔrkpaan na aajab, ni binib bimɔk bi do na nyi ke Kristo pu le m bi kiyondiik ni.

ref: Now most of the Lord's followers have become brave and are fearlessly telling the message.
text: Maah bi kiyondiik ni na, nima le pɔɔk nnaabitiib aataakpab Tidindaan aasan ni, ki tii bi lipobil ke bi tuk binib Yesu aabɔr ki taa san ijawaan.

ref: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
text: M ga len kinye? Bi yaa mooni Kristo aabɔr lipiipoln pu, bee bi yaa mooni waabɔr ngeehm pu kan, naa muk mi. Bi mɔmɔk aah mooni waabɔr pu na le cha m kpa mpopiin. Ni ye mbamɔn la, m ga li beenin kpa mpopiin, ba pu?

ref: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
text: ni mee Uwumbɔr tii mi la, Yesu Kristo Aafuur Nyaan mu ter mi, le m bee ke nima le ga cha m nya kiyondiik ni.

ref: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
text: Nnimbil man ke binib nyuŋ Kristo m pu. M yaa kpo u pu, bee m yaa kaa kpo u pu kan, m ban ke m li kpa lipobil dandana wee, ke maah kpa n‑yoonn mɔmɔk pu na, ki li len ki taa li san binib inimɔɔn.

ref: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
text: M yaa bi limɔfal ni kan, Kristo pu le m bi. M yaa kpo kan, m ga kan tinyoor.

ref: I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful.
text: M yaa bi kan, m ga tun Uwumbɔr aatuln, le u ga ŋa tinyoor ŋa li pu. Maa nyi maah ga lee pu na;

ref: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
text: nkun ni limɔfal mɔmɔk ŋan la. M ban ke m nya dulnyaa ni, ki ti li bi Kristo chee; ba pu? nima le ga li ŋan sakpen ki jer naah ŋan pu dulnyaa wee ni na.

ref: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
text: Nima pu le m bee ke maan kpo dandana wee. M ga li beenin bi ni chee, ki ter nimi, ni moo gaa Yesu ki kii mbamɔm, ki li kpa mpopiin.

ref: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
text: M yaa ki gir ni ni chee kan, m pu le ni ga nyuŋ Yesu Kristo sakpen.

ref: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
text: Tibɔkpaan le ye ke nimi aabimbin li bi Kristo aabɔnyaan tee aah mɔk nimi pu na, aan m yaa dan nan mann nimi, bee m yaa kaa dan kan, m ga ŋun nimi aabɔr, ke ni si Yesu aachaŋ ni, ki kpa kimɔbaan, ki kpaan tuk binib Yesu aabɔnyaan, ke bi gaa u ki kii.

ref: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
text: Ni taa san nimi aadim ijawaan man. Nima le ga mɔk bi ke bi ga kan ntafadaan mu kaa kpa ndoon na, ki ga mɔk nimi ke Uwumbɔr ga gaa nimi lii.

ref: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
text: Uwumbɔr cha ni gaa Kristo ki kii la, ki cha ni ji falaa mu u pu.

ref: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
text: Ni nan kan maah jin falaa Yesu pu pu na, ki ŋun maah ji falaa u pu dandana wee pu na. Le ni mu bi ji falaa ke maah ji pu na.

ref: Christ encourages you, and his love comforts you. God's Spirit unites you, and you are concerned for others.
text: Tɔ, Kristo pɔɔni nitaakpab, le waah gee nimi pu na sɔŋni nisui, ni ni Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan mu kpaan kijɔtiik, le ni kpa tibulchinn ki san tɔb kinimbaak,

ref: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
text: nima pu na, ni li kpaan kimɔbaan, ki li gee tɔb, ki li kpaan nlandak mbaa. Ni yaa ŋa kina kan, m ga li kpa mpopiin mbamɔm.

ref: Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves.
text: Ni taa li kpa lipiipoln tɔb pu, ki taa li ban ke binib li pak nimi. Ni sunn nibaa taab man, ki li nyuŋni tɔb ki jer nibaa.

ref: Care about them as much as you care about yourselves
text: Ubaa taa li ban uma ubaa aanyoor baanja. Aa li ban ke ni mɔmɔk kan tinyoor.

ref: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
text: Ni sunn nibaa taab man ke Yesu Kristo aah sunn ubaa taab pu na.

ref: Christ was truly God. But he did not try to remain equal with God.
text: U bi ke Uwumbɔr aah bi pu na. U mu aa dak ke ni ye limukl ke u ni Uwumbɔr li ŋak.

ref: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.
text: Waageehn pu le u di cha tiwanyaan nimɔk bi Uwumbɔr do na, ki ŋa ubaa ke unaagbiija na. U kpaln unibɔn,

ref: Christ was humble. He obeyed God and even died on a cross.
text: ki sunn ubaa taab, ki kii Uwumbɔr aamɔb, hali ki ti kpo ndɔpuinkoo pu.

ref: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
text: Nima pu le Uwumbɔr nyuŋ u sakpen ki yoor u paacham, le ki tii u liyimbil li jer ŋiyimbil mɔmɔk na,

ref: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
text: Bi mɔmɔk pel pel ga len binib ni, ke Yesu Kristo le ye tiwan ni binib mɔmɔk Aadindaan. Nima le ga nyuŋ Tite Uwumbɔr. Ni li wiin ke nwiihn na dulnyaa ni

ref: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
text: Nima pu na, nnaabitiib bi m gee bi na, maah kaa bi ni chee na, m ban ke ni kii maamɔb ki jer naah nan kii maamɔb buyoonn m nan bi ni chee pu na. Naah ŋmar pu na, ni li tun Uwumbɔr aatuln ke binib bi ŋmar na aah ba ga tun pu na, ki li san Uwumbɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk;

ref: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
text: ba pu? Uwumbɔr bi tun lituln nisui ni, ke ni li neen ke ni kii waamɔb, ki li ŋani waageehn.

ref: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
text: aan ki li ye Uwumbɔr aabim bi kaa kpa taani, kaa kpa ngalm na. Ni bi titunwanbirdam aakaasisik ni la. Ni li bi ke nwiihn na le dulnyaa wee ni ki wiin bikaasisik ni,

ref: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
text: ki joo ni Uwumbɔr aabɔr ti tii binib limɔfal na. Ni yaa bi kina kan, le m ga li kpa kipupuk ni pu bundaln Kristo ga gir ni na, ke maah tun lituln linimaln ki tuk nimi Uwumbɔr aabɔr na, naa ye fam.

ref: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
text: Ni yaa gaa Yesu ki kii ki tun waatuln mbamɔm kan, m kpa mpopiin ni pu. Bi yaa po ku mi kan, m kpa mpopiin.

ref: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
text: Ni mu li kpa mpopiin sakpen ke maah kpa pu na. Uwumbɔr aatutum Timoti ni Epafrodaitus

ref: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
text: Tɔ, Tidindaan Yesu pu le m kpa limakl ke m ga cha Timoti dan ni chee dandana wee. U yaa nan tuk mi nimi aabɔr aah bi pu na kan, nsui ga sɔŋ.

ref: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
text: Utafal bi ni ni la. Maa ki kpa unii u aatafal bi ni ni, ke utafal aah bi ni ni pu na.

ref: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
text: Biken na mɔmɔk aatafal bi bibaa ni la. Bitafal aa bi Yesu Kristo aatuln ni.

ref: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
text: Ni nyi Timoti aabimbin aah ŋan pu na, ki nyi ke u tun lituln m chee ke ubo aah tun lituln ute chee pu na, ki ti tuk binib Yesu aabɔnyaan tee.

ref: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
text: Nima pu na, m yaa kan maabɔr aah ga doo pu na kan, m ga cha u dan ni chee.

ref: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
text: Tidindaan pu le m nyi ke ni yaa kpee siib kan, m mu ga dan ni chee.

ref: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
text: M dak ke ni ŋan ke m cha tina aabo Epafrodaitus ki gir ni ni chee. U ye maatutuŋeer ni maajaŋeer Tidindaan aasan ni, ki ye nimi aatutunn u dan nan tii mi maah ban pu na.

ref: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
text: Unimbil man ke u ki kan nimi. Naah ŋun ke u bun na, nima le usui bii.

ref: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
text: Ni ye mbamɔn, u nan bun ki ti ban u kpo, le Uwumbɔr san u kinimbaak ki cha u pɔɔk. Waah cha u pɔɔk na, u san m mu kinimbaak, m taa li kpa mpombiin ki kpee mpombiin pu.

ref: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
text: Le m ban ke m cha u gir ni ni chee mala, ni yaa nan kan u kan, ni ga li kpa mpopiin. Le nsui ga sɔŋ.

ref: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
text: Nima pu na, ni gaa u tiŋann Tidindaan pu, ki li kpa mpopiin sakpen, ki nyuŋ u ni binib bimɔk bi ke waah bi pu na;

ref: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
text: ba pu? Kristo aatuln pu, waa nan daa nkun. Waah nan ban u ter mi, naah kaa nan ŋmaa ter mi pu na pu, le u nan kan linimaln.

ref: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
text: Nnaabitiib, kookoo aabɔr le ye ke ni li kpa mpopiin Tidindaan pu. M yaa ki ŋmee ke maah nan ŋmee pu tii nimi na kan, naan muk mi; ba pu? ni ŋan ke ni ki ŋun maah ga ŋmee pu tii nimi na.

ref: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
text: Tɔ, ni li nyi binib bi tun lituln li kaa ŋan na, ki bi ke ibɔ na, ki len ke ni yaa kaa gii lichakpaln kan naan ŋmar na.

ref: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done,
text: Timi bi kpaan Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan chee ki pak u, ki kpa kipupuk Yesu Kristo pu, ki bee ke taan ŋmar tibaa aapɔɔn pu na, timi le kpa lichakpangeei bamɔnn.

ref: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
text: Maah nan ye iwiin iniin aabo na, bi nan gii nchakpaln. M ye Juu yaab aabo, ki ye Benjaminn aanibol ponn ni aanii ubaa la. M ye Hiibru yaab aabo bamɔnn la. M nan dii Moses aakaal, Farisii yaab aah dii pu na.

ref: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
text: Nnimbil nan man ke m ŋa Yesu aanib falaa. M nan dii Moses aakaal mbamɔm, kaa yii nkaal mbaa.

ref: But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless.
text: Nimina mɔmɔk nan ye tinyoor le ki tii mi. Le m yii ni mɔmɔk Kristo pu, ke naa ye nibaa.

ref: Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ
text: Ni ye mbamɔn la, m yii tiwan mɔmɔk ke naa ye nibaa, ke m li nyi Yesu Kristo u ye Ndindaan na. Maah nyi u pu na, nima le jer tiwan mɔmɔk. U pu le m di tiwan mɔmɔk lii, ke ni ye timoor la, ke m gaa uma,

ref: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.
text: ki kpaan u ni. M yaa dii Moses aakaal kan, nima le aan cha Uwumbɔr len ke maabɔr ŋan. Maah gaa Kristo ki kii na, nima le cha Uwumbɔr len ke maabɔr ŋan; m gaa Yesu Kristo ki kii le ki ŋan Uwumbɔr chee.

ref: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did,
text: M ban ke m bee Kristo, ni mpɔɔn mu fikr u nkun ni na, ki ji falaa u pu. M ban ke maabimbikpok kpo ke waah nan kpo pu na,

ref: so that somehow I also may be raised to life. Running toward the Goal
text: aan m mu nan fikr nkun ni. Pɔɔl aanimbil aah man Yesu Kristo aasan pu pu na

ref: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
text: Maa len ke m fuu Yesu aah ban pu na, kaa len ke m ye unii u ŋan ti doo na. M pɔɔni mbaa ke m li bi Yesu Kristo aah ban ke m li bi pu na; ba pu? u gaa mi ki ŋa mi waanii la.

ref: My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead.
text: Nnaabitiib, maa len ke m fuu waah ban pu na. Nnimbil man tiwan nibaa le pu. M suln tiwan ni bi mpuwɔb na, ki pɔɔni mbaa ke m pii tiwan ni bi nnimbiin ni na.

ref: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
text: Yesu Kristo pu le Uwumbɔr yin mi ke m dii nsan mu cha paacham na. Nima le nnimbil man ke m fuu nima, ki ti kan tinyoor ti Uwumbɔr ga tii mi na.

ref: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
text: Nimi bi dii Uwumbɔr aasan mbamɔm na, cha ni mu aanimbil li man kina man. Ni yaa kaa bee waabɔr tibaa mbamɔm kan, u ga mɔk nimi.

ref: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
text: Ti mu aah nyi Uwumbɔr aabɔr mɔmɔk pu na, cha ti li dii kina man.

ref: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
text: Nnaabitiib, ni li kpaan kimɔbaan ki dii maataabuu, ki lik binib bi dii ke taah dii pu na.

ref: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again
text: Tɔ, binib pam aah dii pu na, bi ye Yesu aadɔpuinkoo aadim la. M nan tuk nimi baabɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, ki ki tuk nimi dandana wee, ni tinyunyunn la.

ref: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
text: Baadoon le ga li ye ntafadaan mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Baawumbɔr le ye bipuul. Bi kpa kipupuk inimɔɔn aatuln pu. Baalandak bi dulnyaa wee ni aawan ni la.

ref: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
text: Tima kan, Uwumbɔr do le ye tido, le ti kii bundaln Tidindaan Yesu Kristo u ga gaa timi lii na ga nya ni nima na.

ref: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
text: Nnaabitiib, Tidindaan aah ga ŋmaa ŋa kina ki tii nimi na, ni li si uchaŋ ni. M gee nimi la. Le nimi aabɔr bi nsui ni. Le mponn piin ni pu. Nimi le ye maatuln aanyoor.

ref: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
text: Yuwodia ni Sintiki, m gaŋ nimi, ni li kpaan kimɔbaan Tidindaan pu.

ref: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
text: Maatutuŋeer bamɔnn, m mee aa mu, ter bipiib ngbaan; ba pu? bi ni Klement ni maatutuŋeerb biken nan tun lituln linimaln m chee, ki ter mi m tuk binib Yesu aabɔnyaan tee. Baayimbil ŋmee limɔfal aagbaŋ ki bi paacham na ni.

ref: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
text: Ni li kpa mpopiin Tidindaan pu, n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. M ki tuk nimi la, ni li kpa mpopiin man.

ref: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
text: Ni li bi suuna binib mɔmɔk chee man. Tidindaan ga gir ni dandana wee.

ref: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
text: Ni taa cha ilandak li muk nimi tiwan nibaa pu. Ni li mee Uwumbɔr tiwan mɔmɔk pu, ki gaŋni u, ki dooni u ki tuk u naah ban pu na mɔmɔk.

ref: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
text: Ni yaa ŋani kina kan, Uwumbɔr ga tii nimi nsuudoon mu jer taah nyi pu na. Nisui, ni nimi aalandak ga doon; ba pu? ni kpaan Yesu Kristo chee.

ref: Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise.
text: Nnaabitiib, kookoo yaan le ye ke ni li dak ilandak i ye mbamɔn na, ni i kpa laasaab na, ni i tok na, ni i ye chain na, ni i ŋan na, ni i kpa lisil na. Ni cha ilandak imɔk ŋan ki ŋeer mpakm na li joo nimi.

ref: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
text: Ni nan bae Uwumbɔr aabɔr m chee, ki gaa ti, ki ŋun maah len pu na, ki kan maah ŋani pu na. Ni li dii kina, le Uwumbɔr u tii timi nsuudoon na ga li bi ni chee. Ipiin pu aadoon

ref: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
text: Ni yunn le naa ki kan mi; le nitafal mu beenin bi m ni. Nima le m kpa mpopiin sakpen Tidindaan pu. M bee ke nitafal bi m ni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk; le ni mu aa nan kpa nsan ni ter mi.

ref: I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have.
text: Maa len igiin pu. M yaa kpa sakpen, bee m yaa kpa siib kan, m bae maah ga ŋa pu aan nnimbil gbiin kina na.

ref: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
text: M nyi igiin, ki nyi liwankpal mu. Ni yaa mɔ, bee ni yaa kaa mɔ kan, m yaa ji bab, bee nkon yaa pii mi kan, m yaa kpa sakpen, bee m yaa kaa kpa nibaa kan, m bae maah ga ŋa pu aan nnimbil gbiin kina na.

ref: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
text: Kristo aah tii mi mpɔɔn mu na, m ga ŋmaa ŋa tiwan mɔmɔk.

ref: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
text: Tɔ, naah ter mi maafalaa ni pu na, ni ŋa mbamɔm la.

ref: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
text: Nimi Filipi aatiŋ aanib nyi ke maah nan tuk nimi Yesu aabɔnyaan tee njan ki nin nyan Masedonia aatiŋ ni na, Uwumbɔr aanib ponn ni ubaa aa tii mi ipiin, see nimi baanja. M nan tuk nimi Uwumbɔr aabɔr, le ni mu nan tii mi ipiin.

ref: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
text: Maah nan bi Tesalonika aatiŋ ni na, ni nan tun ni unii nfum mulee u nan tii mi maah ban pu na.

ref: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
text: Naa ye ke m ban ipiin la. Naah tii mi ipiin pu na, nima le ni ga li moo kpa tinyoor. Nima le m ban.

ref: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
text: Naah tii mi tiwan ni na, m gaa ni mɔmɔk ki kpa sakpen. Naah tun ni Epafrodaitus ke u nan tii mi ipiin i na, u nan tii mi i. Naah tii mi ipiin i na, ni naahn kitork ki ŋan na le ki tii Uwumbɔr, le usui piir, le u gaa i.

ref: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
text: Uma Uwumbɔr u m dii u na le ga tii nimi naah lann pu na mɔmɔk; waah kpa liwankpal sakpen paacham pu na, kina le u ga tii nimi, Yesu Kristo pu.

ref: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
text: Cha ti li nyuŋni Tite Uwumbɔr n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Amii. Kookoo aadoon

ref: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
text: Ni doon Yesu Kristo aaninyaam mɔmɔk tii mi. Tinaabitiib bi bi m chee na dooni nimi.

ref: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
text: Uwumbɔr aanib mɔmɔk dooni nimi. Ubɔrkpaan Siisa aatutum bi ye Uwumbɔr aanib na mu dooni nimi mbamɔm.

ref: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
text: Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aaŋann li bi nisui ni. [Amii.]

ref: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
text: Min Pɔɔl u ye Yesu Kristo aakpambal Uwumbɔr aageehn pu na, m ni tina aabo Timoti

ref: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
text: le ŋmee kigbaŋ kee ti tii nimi Uwumbɔr aanib bi ye tinaabitiib ki gaa Kristo ki kii, ki bi Kolose aatiŋ ni na. Tite Uwumbɔr [ni Tidindaan Yesu Kristo] ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu, ki tii nimi nsuudoon. Idoon aameel

ref: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: N‑yoonn mumɔk ti mee Uwumbɔr u ye Tidindaan Yesu Kristo Aate na tii nimi na, ti dooni u ni pu;

ref: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
text: ba pu? ti ŋun ke ni gaa Yesu Kristo ki kii mbamɔm, ki gee Uwumbɔr aanib mɔmɔk;

ref: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
text: ba pu? ni kpa limakl ke ni ga nan kan Uwumbɔr aah di tiwan ni siin nimi paacham na. Ni ŋun ni pu buyoonn ni ŋun tibɔnyaan ti fuu ni ni chee ki ye mbamɔn na chee la.

ref: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
text: Tibɔnyaan ngbaan le cha nimi ni binib bi bi ŋipepel mɔmɔk na tun litunyaan. Binib moo gaal tibɔnyaan ngbaan ki keei, nikaasisik ni, ni ŋipepel mɔmɔk. Naah ŋun ti, ki bee mbamɔm Uwumbɔr aah ŋani nimi tiŋann pu na, le binib moo gaal tibɔnyaan ngbaan ki keei nikaasisik ni, ki nan saa dandana.

ref: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
text: Timi aatutuŋeer Epafras u ti gee u na le nan tuk nimi Uwumbɔr aanimbaasaln pu. Uma Epafras le si timi aasisiiyaan ki tun Kristo aatuln mbamɔm ki ter nimi.

ref: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you. The Person and Work of Christ
text: U tuk timi Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aah cha ni gee binib pu na.

ref: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
text: Nima pu le ti mee Uwumbɔr tii nimi, kaa di cha. Buyoonn ti nan ŋun ni pu ki nan saa dandana wee na, le ti mee Uwumbɔr tii nimi, ke ni ga bee waah ban ke ni li ŋani pu na. Ti mee u ke u tii nimi nlan ni bee Waafuur Nyaan aabɔr,

ref: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
text: aan ki li dii Tidindaan waah ban pu na, aan ki gbiin unimbil, ki tun litunyaan aabɔŋ mɔmɔk, ki moo bee waabɔr.

ref: His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.
text: Ti mee u tii nimi ke waah kpa mpɔɔn sakpen pu na, u tii ni mu mpɔɔn, aan ni li kpa limɔr falaa ponn ni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, ki li kpa mpopiin,

ref: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
text: ki li dooni u; ba pu? uma le ŋa nimi binib bi ŋeer ke bi kan tiwan ni u ga tii waanib, nwiihn aanaan ni na.

ref: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
text: Uma le nan nyan timi mbɔmbɔɔn aanaan ni, ki nabr timi di buen Ujapɔgeehn aanaan ni.

ref: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
text: U ye Uwumbɔr u taa waa u na aanaŋ, ki ye tiwan nimɔk Uwumbɔr naan ni na Aayidaan;

ref: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
text: ba pu? Uwumbɔr nan cha u naan tiwan mɔmɔk, ni bi paacham, ni ni bi kitiŋ na, ni taah waa ni na, ni taah kaa waa ni na; ni yaa ye nnaan, bee ipɔɔn, bee bitinjoob, bee tininkpir, uma le nan naan ni mɔmɔk ke ni li nyuŋni u.

ref: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
text: Uma Yesu le puen tiwan mɔmɔk bi. Uma pu le tiwan mɔmɔk beenin bi.

ref: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
text: Uma le ye waanib Aayidaan. Le waanib mu ye waawon, le u tii bi limɔfal. Uma le puen fikr nkun ni, ki ye tiwan mɔmɔk Aayidaan;

ref: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
text: ba pu? ni mɔ Uwumbɔr ke waah bi pu na, Yesu mu bi kina la.

ref: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
text: Uma Yesu pu, le ni mɔ Uwumbɔr ke u di tiwan ni mɔmɔk bi paacham, ni tiwan ni mɔmɔk bi kitiŋ na tooh kijɔtiik ubaa chee. Waasin nan nyan uwon ni, ndɔpuinkoo pu; waasin ngbaan pu le Uwumbɔr cha tiwan ngbaan mɔmɔk ni uma ŋa kijɔtiik.

ref: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
text: N‑yoonn mbaa ni nan ye biwɔwɔm le Uwumbɔr chee. Ni nan dak ilandak i kaa ŋan na, ki tun lituln li kaa ŋan na, nima le ni nan ye Uwumbɔr aadim,

ref: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
text: le dandana wee u cha ni ni uma ŋa kijɔtiik; ba pu? Ujapɔɔn nan kpo ni pu la. U nan kpo ni pu, ke ni li bi chain, ki li ye bininyaam, ki taa li kpa ngalm mubaa, bundaln u ga di nimi siin Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni na.

ref: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
text: Ni ŋan ke ni li dii u mbamɔm, ki taa di cha waasan, ki taa cha nibaa leŋ nimi. Naah ŋun tibɔnyaan tee na, tibɔr ngbaan tii nimi limakl la. Ni taa di cha limakl ngbaan. Bi moon tibɔnyaan tee, ki tuk binib bimɔk bi dulnyaa wee ni na la. Min Pɔɔl mu ŋa unii u mooni ti na la. Pɔɔl aah ye Yesu Kristo aanib aatutunn pu na

ref: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
text: Tɔ, maah jin falaa u ni pu na, nima le m kpa mpopiin. Kristo nan tuk mi maah ga ji falaa waanib pu pu na, le maah ji falaa tiwon tee ni na, falaa ngbaan u gur na le m ji. Waanib bi m ji falaa bi pu na le ye waawon.

ref: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
text: Uwumbɔr nan ŋa mi waanib aatutunn, ki di lituln siin mi, ke m tun ki ter nimi. Lituln ngbaan le ye ke m tuk nimi waabɔr mɔmɔk pel pel.

ref: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
text: Ti ye tibɔbɔrkaan la. Uwumbɔr nan bɔr ti n‑yaayoonn na aanib, le ki kpiir ti tuk waanib dandana wee.

ref: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
text: U ban ke bi bee tibɔr ngbaan aah ŋan sakpen ki ter ŋitimbol mɔmɔk pu na la. Tibɔbɔrkaan ngbaan le ye ke Kristo bi ni ni. Waah bi ni ni na, nima le ni kpa limakl ke ni ga ji waamɔɔn.

ref: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.
text: Kristo aabɔr ngbaan le ti mooni, ki sur binib mɔmɔk, ki tuk bi waabɔr, waah tii timi nlan pu na. Ti ban ke bi mɔmɔk li kpaan Kristo ni, ki li ye binib bi ŋan doo na. Ti ban ke ti di bi ki mɔk Uwumbɔr la.

ref: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
text: Nima le cha m tun lituln linimaln. M tun lituln ngbaan waapɔɔn sakpiin pu la.

ref: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
text: M ban ke ni bee ke m tun lituln linimaln nimi pu, ni Laodisea aatiŋ aanib pu, ni binib bimɔk kaa kee kan mi na pu,

ref: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
text: ke m pɔɔk bitaakpab. M ban ke ni mɔmɔk li kpaan kimɔbaan, ki li gee tɔb, ki bee Uwumbɔr aabɔr mbamɔm, aan ki li pak ti mbamɔm, ki taa joo beeni. M ban ke ni bee Uwumbɔr aabɔbɔrkaan, ti ye Kristo aabɔr na.

ref: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
text: M tuk nimi kina ke ubaa taa ŋmann nimi la. Unii yaa mɔln inyamɔn i mɔ na ki tuk nimi kan, ni taa kii.

ref: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
text: Maawon aa bi ni chee, le maalandak bi ni ni. Naah gaa Kristo ki kii mbamɔm ki dii waasan mu mbamɔm na, nima le m kpa mpopiin sakpen. Cha Yesu Kristo aabimbin li gbii si

ref: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.
text: Ni nan gaa Yesu Kristo, ki kii ke u ye Nidindaan. Nima pu na, ni li kpaan u ni, ki li dii u man,

ref: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
text: ki too chuu u ke busub aanyaan aah koo kitiŋ pu na, ki li bae waabɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, ki gaa ti ki kii mbamɔm, taah nan tuk nimi pu na, ki li dooni u n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
text: Unii yaa tuk nimi nnyamɔn aalan mu ye fam na kan, ni li nyi man ki taa dii u; nlan ngbaan ye binib aalan mu nyan ni kinimbɔŋ ki joo dulnyaa wee na, naa ye Kristo aabɔr.

ref: God lives fully in Christ.
text: Uwumbɔr aabimbin mɔmɔk bi Yesu Kristo aawon ni.

ref: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
text: Naah kpaan u ni na, le ni kpa limɔfal bamɔln. Uma le ye tininkpir ni ipɔɔn mɔmɔk aayidaan.

ref: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
text: Baah muin nimi nnyun ni na, ni mɔk ke bi di nimi sub Kristo chee la. Baah nyan nimi nnyun ni na, le ni mɔk ke ni ki fikr u chee; ba pu? ni pak ke Uwumbɔr kpa mpɔɔn ki fikr Kristo nkun ni.

ref: You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
text: N‑yoonn mbaa, ni nan tun titunwanbir, kaa nan dii Uwumbɔr aakaal. Nima le naa nan kpa limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na. Naah kpaan Kristo ni dandana wee na, nima le Uwumbɔr fikr nimi. U di cha timi aatunwanbir mɔmɔk pinn timi.

ref: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.
text: Taah ba ga ŋa pu na le ŋmee kigbaŋ pu. Taah kaa ŋa kina na, nima le timi aabɔr bii. Le Kristo aah nan kpo ndɔpuinkoo pu na, nima le Uwumbɔr aa ki len ke timi aabɔr bii.

ref: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
text: Waah kpo ndɔpuinkoo pu na, le u ŋa kinimbɔŋ aapɔɔn mɔmɔk fam, le ki nyaŋ ki, ki jinn ki inimɔɔn, binib aanimbil ni.

ref: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
text: Nima pu na, ni taa cha ubaa galn nimi tijikaar aakoobil pu, bee tiwanyukaan aakoobil pu, bee likpaakool daal aakoobil pu.

ref: These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
text: Ŋikoobil mɔmɔk po ye tiwan ni choo na aajunjuŋ la. U bi na le ye Kristo.

ref: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.
text: Binib bibaa bi ki sunni bibaa taab, ki pak Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib, ki bui ke bi daŋ tidaŋ ki kan lijinjiir aawan, ki kpa kalmbaani, ki dak dulnyaa aalandak i ye fam na. Ni taa cha binib ngbaan bii nimi.

ref: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
text: Baa joo timi aayidaan Kristo. Uma aapɔɔn pu, le ti muun waasan ni, Uwumbɔr aah ban pu na. Uma le kpaan timi kimɔbaan, ke ti li tuk tɔb pu, ke ŋituk ni ŋigir aah cha tiwon aawan mɔmɔk tuk tɔb pu pu na. Ni naahn ke ni kpo ki beenin fu Yesu Kristo pu

ref: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
text: Ni nan kpo Kristo chee la, nima le ni nyan kinimbɔŋ ki joo dulnyaa na aapɔɔn ni. Nima pu na, ba ŋa nimi aabimbin bi ke naah beenin ye dulnyaa yaab le na? Ba ŋa ni kii nkaal mu len ke,

ref: “Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”?
text: “Taa ji nee,” “Taa lakl nee,” “Taa meeh nee” na?

ref: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
text: Binib yaa jin timina mɔmɔk kan, ti doo la. Ŋikoobil ŋimina po ye binib aakaal, ni baamɔkm la.

ref: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
text: Ni naahn nlan la, ki mu aa ye nlan. Bi dooni bisui aah gee tiwan ni na la, ki sunn bibaa taab, ki muk tiwon. Le baah ŋani pu na, naa ter bi ke bi chuu bibaa.

ref: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
text: Ni kpaan fikr Kristo chee la. Nima pu na, cha nitafal li bi paacham aawan ni. Kristo bi nima ki ka Uwumbɔr aaŋangii wɔb.

ref: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
text: Ni li dakl tiwan ni bi paacham na aabɔr, ki di cha tiwan ni bi kitiŋ do na.

ref: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.
text: Ba pu? ni naahn ke ni kpo; le nimi aamɔfal kpaan Kristo ni, ki bi Uwumbɔr chee paacham, le u biin li pu.

ref: Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
text: Kristo, u ye timi aamɔfal na yaa nan gir ni kan, ti mu ga li bi u chee, ki kan nnyuŋ. Mbimbikpok ni mbimbipɔm

ref: Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols.
text: Nima pu na, kuln man tiwon aah ban pu na, ki taa gɔr kidagook, ki taa tun tijɔŋ aatuln, ki taa li ban tiwan ni kaa ŋan na, ki taa li kpa iniman. Unii u kpa iniman na aa dii Uwumbɔr, u dii liwankpal la.

ref: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.
text: Binib bi yii Uwumbɔr aamɔb ki tun titunwanbir timina na, u ga daa bitafal.

ref: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
text: N‑yoonn mbaa, ni mu nan bi bikaasisik ni, ki tun titunwanbir ngbaan.

ref: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
text: Le naah ye Yesu aanib dandana wee na, ni di titunwanbir ngbaan mɔmɔk lii. Ni taa ki gee liŋuul ki li tar binib pu, ki taa ki li kpa kinanaŋ, ki taa ki seei ŋisiibil, ki taa ki len iliin i kaa ŋan na.

ref: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
text: Ni taa mɔln inyamɔn ki tuk tɔb; ba pu? ni nan di nimi aabimbikpok aatuln lii a,

ref: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
text: ki yoor mbimbipɔm la. Uwumbɔr le tii nimi mbimbipɔm ngbaan, ki bi toor mu, ke ni moo bee u, ki li naahn u.

ref: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
text: Naah kpa mbimbipɔm na, naa ki yakr Juu yaab, ni binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na, ni binib bi gii ŋichakpan na, ni binib bi kaa gii na, ni biwɔwɔm, ni timoor ni aanib, ni binaagbiib, ni bimalb. Ni mɔmɔk kpaan la. Kristo le jer tiwan ngbaan mɔmɔk, ki bi waanib mɔmɔk ni.

ref: God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient.
text: Uwumbɔr nan nyan nimi, ki ŋa nimi waaninyaam, ki gee nimi. Nima pu na, ni li kpa linimbaasaln, ni tibulchinn, ki sunn nibaa taab, ki li bi suuna, ki li kpa suklaa,

ref: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
text: Tibɔr ti jer ti mɔmɔk na le ye ke ni li gee tɔb; ba pu? ngeehm di ni mɔmɔk kpaan tɔb chee la, ni li kpaan kimɔbaan mbamɔm.

ref: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
text: Kristo yin nimi ke ni li kpaan tiwonbaan ni, ki li kpa nsuudoon mu u tii nimi na. Nima pu na, cha nsuudoon ngbaan li joo nisui man, ki li dooni Uwumbɔr, waabulchinn pu.

ref: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
text: Cha Kristo aabɔr li bi nisui ni sakpen, ki tii nimi nlan. Ni li tuk tɔb waabɔr, ki li sur tɔb, ki li gaa ilahn i bi Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni na, ni waanib aalahn, ni ilahn i Waafuur Nyaan mɔk nimi na. Ni li gaa ilahn ngbaan, ki li dooni Uwumbɔr nisui ni.

ref: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
text: Ni yaa len kan, ni len Tidindaan Yesu aayimbil pu; ni yaa tun lituln kan, ni li tun waayimbil pu, ki li ŋani tiwan mɔmɔk waayimbil pu, ki li dooni Tite Uwumbɔr u pu. Naah ga li bi pu Tidindaan aasan ni na

ref: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
text: Tɔ, bipiib, ni li keei nichatiib aamɔi. Naah dii Tidindaan na, ni ŋan ke ni li ŋani kina.

ref: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
text: Chatiib, ni li gee nipuutiib, ki taa muk bi.

ref: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
text: Tetiib, ni taa fiini nimi aabim aaŋuul, aan bitaakpab taa yɔl.

ref: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
text: Binaagbiib, ni li keei nidindatiib bi bi dulnyaa ni na aamɔi tiwan mɔmɔk ni. Bi yaa bi ni chee, bee bi yaa kaa bi kan, ni li tun lituln mbamɔm. Ni taa ban binib li pak nimi. Naah san Uwumbɔr na, ni li tun lituln mbamɔm nima pu.

ref: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
text: Naah ŋani tiwan nimɔk na, ni cha nitafal li bi ni ni, ki tun lituln ke naah ba ga tun tii Tidindaan pu na, naa ye binib.

ref: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
text: Tidindaan Kristo le ni tun lituln tii u. Nima le ni bee ke uma le ga pa nimi tipar, waah nan puu tipuur ti ke u ga tii nimi na.

ref: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
text: Unii umɔk tun lituln li kaa ŋan na, Uwumbɔr ga daa utafal waah ŋeer pu na. Uwumbɔr aa pak ubaa ki jer uken.

ref: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
text: Dindatiib, ni li ŋani nimi aanaagbiib mbamɔm; ba pu? ni nyi ke ni mu kpa Dindaan paacham. Nsurm

ref: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.
text: Tɔ, ni mɔmɔk li beenin mee Uwumbɔr linimaln, ki li nyi ki taa geeni, ki li dooni u mmeen ponn ni,

ref: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
text: ki li mee u tii ti mu, ke u tii timi nsan ti moon waabɔr ki tuk binib tibɔbɔrkaan ti ye Kristo aabɔr na. Waabɔnyaan ngbaan pu, le m bi kiyondiik ni.

ref: Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
text: Ni ŋan ke m tuk binib waabɔnyaan ngbaan aatataa mbamɔm. Ni mee Uwumbɔr tii mi ke u ter mi, m tuk bi kina.

ref: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
text: Ni li len ibulchiliin n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, ki li len Uwumbɔr aalambil aah ye pu na. Ni yaa len kina kan, ni ga bee naah ga giin pu ki kii unii mɔmɔk na. Kookoo aadoon

ref: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
text: Tina aabo Tikikus u ti gee u na ga tuk nimi maabɔr mɔmɔk aah bi pu na. U ye timi aatutuŋeer le Tidindaan aatuln ponn ni, ki tun lituln ngbaan mbamɔm.

ref: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
text: M cha u dan ni chee ke u nan tuk nimi, timi aabɔr aah bi pu na, aan ki sɔŋ nisui. Nima le m cha u dan ni chee.

ref: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
text: Onesimus ni uma le dii ni. Onesimus mu ye tina aabo u ti gee u na la. U ter timi mbamɔm, ki ye ni ponn ni aanii ubaa la. Bima le ga tuk nimi do chee na aabɔr mɔmɔk.

ref: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
text: Aristakus u bi kiyondiik ni m chee na dooni nimi. Mak, u ye Banabas aaninkpan aajapɔɔn na, u mu dooni nimi. M nan tuk nimi naah ga ŋa u pu na. U yaa dan ni chee kan, ni gaa u iŋaal ilee.

ref: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
text: Josua Justus mu dooni nimi. Bijab bitaa ngbaan ye Juu yaab la. Juu yaab ponn ni, bima baanja le ye maatutuŋeerb ki tun Uwumbɔr aanaan aatuln. Bijab ngbaan sɔŋ nsui la.

ref: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
text: Epafras mu dooni nimi. U ye ni ponn ni aanii ubaa la, ki ye Yesu Kristo aatutunn. U mee Uwumbɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk linimaln le ki tii nimi, ke ni li dii Uwumbɔr mbamɔm, ki taa di cha, ki kii Uwumbɔr aah gee pu na mɔmɔk.

ref: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
text: M tuk nimi la, Epafras tun lituln linimaln, ki tii nimi, ni Laodisea aatiŋ aanib, ni Hierapolis aatiŋ aanib.

ref: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
text: Luk u ye dɔkta, u ti gee u na mu dooni nimi. Demas mu dooni nimi.

ref: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
text: Ni li dooni tinaabitiib bi bi Laodisea aatiŋ ni na tii timi, ki li dooni Nimfa ni Yesu aanib bi kuuni udo na, tii timi.

ref: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
text: Bi yaa karn kigbaŋ kee tii nimi kan, ni cha bi karn ki tii Yesu aanib bi bi Laodisea aatiŋ ni na mu. Maah ŋmee kigbaŋ ki tii Laodisea aatiŋ aanib na, ni mu karn ki.

ref: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
text: Tuk Akipus ke Tidindaan aah tii u lituln li ke u tun na, u li nyi ki tun li mbamɔm.

ref: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
text: Min Pɔɔl le di ŋŋaal ŋmee idoon imina. Ni teer ke m bi kiyondiik ni la. Uwumbɔr ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu. [Amii.]

ref: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
text: Min Pɔɔl, ni Silfanus, ni Timoti le ŋmee kigbaŋ kee ti tii Yesu aanib bi bi Tesalonika aatiŋ ni ki ye Tite Uwumbɔr ni Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aanib na. Uwumbɔr ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu, ki tii nimi nsuudoon. Tesalonika yaab aabimbin

ref: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
text: N‑yoonn mumɔk ti mee Uwumbɔr na, ti mee u tii nimi, ki dooni u ni mɔmɔk pu.

ref: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
text: Tinaabitiib bi Uwumbɔr gee bi na, ti nyi ke u lee nimi la;

ref: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
text: ba pu? taah tuk nimi waabɔnyaan na, tibɔnyaan ngbaan aa nan ye iliin baanja, Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aapɔɔn nan bi ti ni la, ki cha ni bee ke ti sil gbii. Taah nan bi nikaasisik ni buyoonn na, ni nan bee timi aabimbin aah nan bi pu na. Ti nan bi kina ke ti ter nimi la.

ref: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
text: Le ni nan ŋakni timi ni Tidindaan; ba pu? ni gaa Yesu aabɔr ki kan falaa sakpen tibɔr ngbaan pu, ki mu nan kpa mpopiin mu Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan tii nimi na.

ref: You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia.
text: Naah nan bi pu na, nima le mɔk Yesu aanib bimɔk bi Masedonia ni Akaya aatim ni na, bi mu aah ga li ŋani pu na;

ref: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
text: ba pu? ni nan chuun mooni Tidindaan aabɔr, ki tuk Masedonia ni Akaya aatim aanib. Naa ye nima yaab baanja, ntim mɔmɔk aanib ŋun ke ni gaa Uwumbɔr ki kii la. Nima pu na, taa ki ban ke ti tuk bi nimi aabɔr. Bi puun nyi.

ref: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.
text: Ba pu? binib ngbaan len ke taah nan dan ni chee na, ni nan gaa timi, ki di ŋiwaa lii, ki fenn ki dii Uwumbɔr, u ye limɔfadaan ki ye Uwumbɔr bamɔnn na,

ref: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
text: le ni kii bundaln Ujapɔɔn Yesu ga nyan ni paacham ki gir ni na. Uma le Uwumbɔr nan fikr u nkun ni. Uma le nyan timi ntafadaan mu choo na ni.

ref: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
text: le nima yaab nan ŋa timi falaa, ki yook timi, le ti nin dan ni chee. Binib pam nan kpak timi kinikpakpak, le timi Aawumbɔr tii timi lipobil ke ti tuk nimi waabɔnyaan.

ref: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
text: Taah tuk nimi waabɔnyaan ngbaan na, tibɔr ngbaan aa ye nnyamɔn. Taa ŋmann nimi. Ti nan bi chain la.

ref: You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed.
text: Ni nyi ke taa nan gbaa nimi mmɔmɔɔn aabɔr. Uwumbɔr nyi ke taa nan ye inimandam bi ŋmanni, ke binib taa bee ke ti ye na.

ref: We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us.
text: Taa nan ban ke ni nyuŋ timi, kaa nan ban ke binib biken nyuŋ timi.

ref: But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby.
text: Taah ye Kristo aakpambalb na, ti ba ga li ban ke ni nyuŋ timi. Le taa nan ban kina. Ti nan bi suuna ni chee ke upii aah bi pu waabim chee ki lik bi na la.

ref: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
text: Ti gee nimi la. Nima pu na, ti nan kpa mpopiin ti tuk nimi Uwumbɔr aabɔnyaan. Naa ye tibɔnyaan baanja le ti nan tii nimi, ti nan di tibaa mu tii nimi; ba pu? ti gee nimi pam.

ref: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
text: Nnaabitiib, ni teer taah nan tun lituln linimaln pu na. Ti tuk nimi Uwumbɔr aabɔnyaan, ki tun lituln nwiin pu ni kinyeek mɔk, ke ti ji. Ba pu? taa nan ban ni ji ti pu falaa.

ref: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
text: Nimi bi gaa Yesu ki kii na, ti ŋa nimi mbamɔm la, ki nan bi chain, kaa nan kpa taani ubaa joo cha ni wɔb. Ni ni Uwumbɔr nyi ke ni ye mbamɔn la.

ref: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
text: Ni nyi ke uja aah ŋani waabim pu na, ti nan ŋani nimi ubaabaa kina la;

ref: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
text: ti sur nimi, ki nan sɔŋni nisui, ki gaŋni nimi ke ni li dii Uwumbɔr waah ban pu na. Uma le yin nimi ke ni koo waanaan ni ki nan ji waamɔɔn.

ref: We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you.
text: Ti dooni Uwumbɔr ni pu n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la; ba pu? taah nan tuk nimi Uwumbɔr aabɔr na, ni nan gaa tibɔr ngbaan, ki bee ke naa ye binib aabɔr, ni ye Uwumbɔr aabɔr la. Mbamɔn, ni ye Uwumbɔr aabɔr la, ki kpelni nimi bi gaa u ki kii na aabimbin.

ref: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
text: Nnaabitiib, ni ŋakni Uwumbɔr aanib bi bi Judea aatim ni ki kuuni Yesu Kristo aayimbil pu na; kinye pu? nido yaab aah ŋa nimi falaa pu na, Juu yaab ŋa bi mu falaa kina la.

ref: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
text: Bima Juu yaab nan ku Uwumbɔr aabɔnabtiib ni Tidindaan Yesu mu, ki jenn nyan timi mu. Baa piir Uwumbɔr aasui. Bi ye binib mɔmɔk aadim la,

ref: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
text: ki kiir timi, kaa ban ke ti tuk binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na tibɔnyaan tee, aan bi ŋmar. Juu yaab ngbaan aah ŋani kina na, bi too kpae baatunwanbir pu n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la. Uwumbɔr aaŋuul pii bi kookoo. Pɔɔl aah neen ke u ki gir mann bi pu na

ref: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
text: Nnaabitiib, taah kaa kan nimi ni yunn siib na, naa mɔ timi. Taa nan bi ni chee, timi aalandak ma nan bi ni ni; tinimbil nan man ni pu, le ti nan pɔɔni tibaa ke ti ki kan nimi.

ref: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.
text: Ti nan ban ti gir dan ni chee. Min Pɔɔl, n‑yoonn mɔmɔk m ban ke m gir dan ni chee. Le kinimbɔŋ kiir timi ke ti taa dan.

ref: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
text: Tidindaan Yesu yaa nan gir ni kan, bilabi pu ti ga li kpa limakl, ni mpopiin, ni kipupuk unimbiin ni?

ref: You alone are our glory and joy!
text: Naa ye nimi pu uu? Mbamɔn, ti kpa kipupuk ni mpopiin ni pu.

ref: Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves
text: Taah kaa bi ni chee na, taa ki ŋmaa mɔr, nima le ti len ke ni ŋan ti cha Timoti dan ni chee. Timi baanja le gur Atens aatiŋ ni.

ref: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.
text: Tina aabo Timoti ye Uwumbɔr aatutunn u tuk binib Kristo aabɔnyaan na la. Ti cha u dan ni chee ke u pɔɔk nitaakpab Uwumbɔr aasan ni,

ref: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
text: ubaa taa gir puwɔb falaa ngbaan pu. Nimi nibaa nyi ke falaa ngbaan ye Uwumbɔr aah siin timi pu na la.

ref: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
text: Taah nan bi ni chee na ti nan tuk nimi ke ti ga ji falaa, le ni bee ke ni sil ŋa kina.

ref: At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
text: Le maa ki ŋmaa mɔr. Nima le cha m tun ni Timoti ni chee, ke u nan lik ke ni beenin dii Yesu mbamɔm aan naa dii. Ni muk mi la, m dak ke nibaakan kinimbɔŋ tɔŋ nimi, ki ŋa timi aatuln yɔli.

ref: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
text: Le Timoti ki nyan ni ni chee; dandana u ki fuu ni ti chee, ki tuk timi tibɔnyaan ke ni beenin tii Yesu naadii mbamɔm, ki gee tɔb. U tuk timi ke ti bi nisui ni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, le ni ban ke ni ki kan timi, ke ti mu aah ban ke ti kan nimi pu na.

ref: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
text: Tinaabitiib, ti bi limukl ni ki ji falaa la; le ti ŋun naah tii Yesu naadii pu na, nima le tisui sɔŋ.

ref: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
text: Ni yaa dii Tidindaan aasan ni, kaa di cha kan, nima le ti fuur.

ref: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
text: Nima pu na, taa ki nyi taah ga ki pak Uwumbɔr ni pu pu na; ba pu? ti kpa mpopiin sakpen ki mɔɔni ni pu, Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni.

ref: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
text: Ti mee u linimaln nwiin pu ni kinyeek mɔk ke u cha ti ki kan nimi ki tuk nimi naah kaa kee bee waabɔr pu na.

ref: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
text: M mee Tite Uwumbɔr ni Tidindaan Yesu ke bi tii timi nsan aan ti dan ni chee.

ref: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
text: Tidindaan cha ni li moo gee tɔb ni binib mɔmɔk, ke taah gee nimi pu na.

ref: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
text: U tii nimi mpɔɔn ke ni li bi chain ki taa li kpa taani ubaa Tite Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni, bundaln Tidindaan Yesu ni waanib mɔmɔk ga gir ni na.

ref: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
text: Tinaabitiib, ti nan mɔk nimi naah ga ŋa pu ki piir Uwumbɔr aasui na. Le ni ŋani kina. Ti gaŋni nimi, ki sur nimi Tidindaan Yesu aayimbil pu ke ni li moo ŋani kina.

ref: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
text: Ni bee taah nan sur nimi pu Tidindaan Yesu aayimbil pu na.

ref: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
text: Uwumbɔr aageehn le ye ke ni li bi chain, ki taa gɔr kidagook.

ref: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
text: Ubaa taa cha bipiib aakpeek li bi u ni, ke binib bi kaa nyi Uwumbɔr na aah bi pu na.

ref: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
text: Uja ubaa taa li ban una aabo aapuu ki tun titunwanbir timina. Ti nan tuk nimi ki sur nimi mbamɔm ke Tidindaan dar binib aatafal titunwanbir ngbaan mɔmɔk pu.

ref: God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure.
text: Uwumbɔr yin timi ke ti li bi chain. Waa yin timi ke ti li gɔr kidagook.

ref: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
text: Unii umɔk yii mmɔkm ngbaan na, naa ye binib aamɔkm le u yii, u yii Uwumbɔr u tii nimi Waafuur Nyaan na aamɔkm la.

ref: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
text: Uwumbɔr mɔk nimi naah ga li gee tɔb pu na. Nima pu na, naa ki ban ke m ŋmee kigbaŋ ki tuk nimi naah ga li gee ninaabitiib pu na.

ref: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
text: Ni ye mbamɔn la, ni gee tinaabitiib bimɔk bi Masedonia aatim mɔmɔk ni na. Ti gaŋni nimi, ni li moo gee bi.

ref: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
text: Cha ninimbil li man ke ni li bi suuna, ki li tun nimi aatuln, ki di nimi aaŋaal tun lituln, ke taah nan tuk nimi pu na.

ref: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
text: Ni yaa ŋani kina kan, naan lann nibaa; binib bi kaa dii Uwumbɔr aasan na mu ga pak nimi. Tidindaan aah ga nan gir ni pu na

ref: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
text: Tinaabitiib, ti ban ke ni bee binib bi kpo na aabɔr, aan ki taa li kpa mpombiin, ke binib bi kaa kpa limakl na aah kpa mpombiin pu na.

ref: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
text: Ti pak ke Yesu nan kpo, ki ki fikr nkun ni. Nima pu le ti pak ke Uwumbɔr ga fikr Yesu aanib bi kpo na mu, ki cha bi li dii u bundaln u ga gir ni na.

ref: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
text: Taah ban ti tuk nimi tibɔr ti na, ti ye Tidindaan aabɔr la. Tidindaan aanib bi ga li bi dulnyaa wee ni bundaln u ga gir ni na aan puen binib bi kpo na ki buen paacham.

ref: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
text: Ba pu? Tidindaan ubaa ga nyan ni paacham ki sunn ni. U yaa sunn ni kan, le ti ga ŋun nneel sakpiin, ni Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib aaninkpel aaneel, ni Uwumbɔr aakakaan aawiil.

ref: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
text: Njan, Yesu aanib bi kpo na le ga fikr nkun ni, le Uwumbɔr nin kpaan yoor bi ni waanib bi mu ga li bi n‑yoonn ngbaan na, le bi ti tooh Tidindaan ntaalangbam ni, paacham. Kina le ti ga li bi Tidindaan chee n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
text: Nnaabitiib, naa ki ban ke m ŋmee ki tuk nimi bundaln tiwan nimina mɔmɔk ga ŋa na.

ref: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
text: Ba pu? nimi nibaa nyi mbamɔm ke Tidindaan aawiindaal ga fuu ni ke unaayuk aah fuur ni kinyeek pu na la.

ref: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
text: Buyoonn binib ga len ke bi bi bibaa pu, nibaa aan ŋa bi nibaa na, libuul ngbaan ni le tibɔbir ga lir bi pu. Ni ga li bi ke imalween aah chuu upii pu na la. Baan ŋmaa nyan ti.

ref: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
text: Nnaabitiib, nima aa bi mbɔmbɔɔn ni. Nima pu na, ni taa cha Tidindaan aawiindaal ŋa nimi lijinjiir ke unaayuk aah fuur ni pu na.

ref: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
text: Ba pu? ni mɔmɔk ye nwiihn ni aabim la. Ni ye nwiin pu aabim la. Taa ye kinyeek yaab, kaa ye mbɔmbɔɔn ni yaab.

ref: Others may sleep, but we should stay awake and be alert.
text: Nima pu na, ti taa li geeni, ke biken aah geeni pu na. Cha ti li kii, ki chuu tibaa man.

ref: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.
text: Binib bi dɔ geen na, kinyeek le bi dɔ geen. Binib bi nyu ndaan gbii na, kinyeek le bi gbii.

ref: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
text: Tima ye nwiin pu aabim la, nima pu na, cha ti chuu tibaa man. Cha ti tii Yesu naadii, ki li gee tɔb. Ti yaa ŋani kina kan, nima le ga biin ti pu, ke tikur ti bii kibiŋ pu na. Le ti yaa kpa limakl ke ti ga sil ŋmar kan, ni ga li bi ke tikur aayikpupuk ki bii tiyil na.

ref: God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Uwumbɔr aah lee timi na, waa lee timi ke u gee liŋuul ti pu, u lee timi ke ti ŋmar Tidindaan Yesu Kristo pu la.

ref: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
text: Uma le nan kpo ti pu. Nima pu na, ti yaa bi, bee ti yaa kpo bundaln u ga gir ni na kan, ti ga buen ti li bi u chee.

ref: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
text: Nima pu na, ni li pɔɔni tɔb aataakpab, ki li ter tɔb, ni li moo dii Uwumbɔr aasan mbamɔm, ke naah ŋani pu dandana wee na. Kookoo aasurm ni idoon

ref: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
text: Tinaabitiib, ti gaŋ nimi, ke ni li pak nimi aaninkpiib bi tun Tidindaan aatuln nikaasisik ni, ki sur nimi waasan ni na.

ref: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
text: Ni li pak bi mbamɔm, ki li gee bi baatuln pu. Ni mɔmɔk li kpaan kimɔbaan man.

ref: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
text: Tinaabitiib, ti gaŋ nimi, ke ni sur binib bi kaa ban bi tun lituln na, ki li pɔɔni binib bi aataakpab yɔl na aataakpab, ki ter binib bi kaa pɔɔ na, ki li kpa limɔr binib mɔmɔk pu.

ref: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
text: Ni taa cha unii ubaa teen uken waah ŋa bakaa u na pu. Pɔɔn nibaa man ki li ŋani tɔb, ni binib mɔmɔk tibulchinn, n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Always be joyful
text: Ni li kpa mpopiin n‑yoonn mɔmɔk,

ref: and never stop praying.
text: ki li mee Uwumbɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk,

ref: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
text: ki li dooni u tiwan mɔmɔk pu. Uwumbɔr aageehn le ye ke ni li ŋani kina; ba pu? ni ye Yesu Kristo aanib la.

ref: Don't turn away God's Spirit
text: Ni taa yii Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aah ban pu na.

ref: and don't have anything to do with evil.
text: Ni yii man isan i kaa ŋan na mɔmɔk aabɔŋ.

ref: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
text: Uwumbɔr u tii timi nsuudoon na, ŋa nimi aabimbin mɔmɔk chain, ki li joo nimi aawiin, ni nisui, ni nimi aawon mbamɔm, ni taa li kpa taani ubaa bundaln Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ga gir ni na.

ref: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
text: Uwumbɔr u yin nimi na ye mbamɔndaan la, ki ga ŋa nimina mɔmɔk.

ref: Friends, please pray for us.
text: Tinaabitiib, ni mee Uwumbɔr tii timi.

ref: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
text: Ni doon tinaabitiib mɔmɔk mbamɔm.

ref: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
text: M gaŋ nimi Tidindaan aayimbil pu ke ni cha bi karn kigbaŋ kee tii tinaabitiib mɔmɔk.

ref: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
text: Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu. [Amii.]

ref: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Min Pɔɔl, ni Silfanus, ni Timoti le ŋmee kigbaŋ kee ti tii Yesu aanib bi bi Tesalonika aatiŋ ni ki ye Tite Uwumbɔr ni Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aanib na.

ref: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
text: Tite Uwumbɔr ni Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu ki tii nimi nsuudoon. Uwumbɔr aah ga daa binib aatafal pu na

ref: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
text: Tinaabitiib, ni ŋan ke ti li dooni Uwumbɔr ni pu n‑yoonn mɔmɔk; ba pu? ni moo gaal Yesu ki kii mbamɔm ki moo gee tɔb la.

ref: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
text: Nima pu le ti puk kipupuk ni pu Uwumbɔr aanib chee, ki tuk bi naah gaa Yesu ki kii ki kpa limɔr, falaa ni limukl mɔmɔk ponn ni pu na.

ref: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
