text: Binib aah ŋani nimi falaa pu na, nima le mɔk ke Uwumbɔr yaa daa bitafal kan, ni ŋan. Naah ji falaa pu na, Uwumbɔr aanaan pu le ni ji. Nima le Uwumbɔr ga len ke ni ŋeer ke ni koo waanaan ngbaan ni.

ref: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
text: Ni ye mbamɔn, Uwumbɔr len ke ni ŋan ke binib bi ŋani nimi falaa na, u mu ŋa bi falaa,

ref: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
text: ki tii timi ni nimi bi ji falaa na lifuur. Ti ga kan lifuur ngbaan bundaln Tidindaan Yesu ga nyan ni paacham ki mɔk waah bi pu na. U ni waatuuntiib ga nyan ni paacham ni mpɔɔn,

ref: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
text: ki li joo ni mmiigaal u nan daa binib aatafal. Binib bi yii Uwumbɔr na, ni binib bi kaa kii Tidindaan Yesu aabɔnyaan tee na, u ga daa bima le aatafal.

ref: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
text: Tidindaan ga nyan bi unimbiin ni, waapɔɔn ni waawiihn sakpiin chee. U ga daa bitafal, ki cha bi ji falaa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
text: Bi ga kan ntafadaan ngbaan bundaln Tidindaan ga gir ni na. Liyaadaal ngbaan le waanib bi mɔmɔk gaa u ki kii na ga nyuŋ u, ki pak u. Ni mu ga li bi waanib ngbaan ponn ni; ba pu? taah tuk nimi Yesu aabɔr na, ni gaa ti ki kii la.

ref: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
text: Nima pu le ti mee timi Aawumbɔr tii nimi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ke u len ke ni ye binib bi ŋeer waayim na, ki ter nimi ke ni li ban ni ŋa tiwan ni ŋan na, ki tii nimi mpɔɔn ke ni li ŋani kina, ki tun lituln li ga mɔk ke ni gaa Yesu ki kii mbamɔm na.

ref: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
text: Ni yaa ŋani kina kan, nima le ga nyuŋ Tidindaan Yesu Kristo, le u mu ga nyuŋ nimi, u ni Uwumbɔr aabulchinn pu.

ref: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
text: Tinaabitiib, ti ban ke ti len ni chee ki joo cha bundaln Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ga gir ni ki nan kuun timi u chee na aabɔr la.

ref: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
text: Bi yaa len ke Tidindaan aawiindaal fuu ni kan, ti gaŋ nimi ke ni taa cha nipobil yuk, ki taa cha ni li muk nimi. Nibaakan, bi ga bui ke Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan mɔk bi kina la, nibaakan, bi ga bui ke ti ŋmee kigbaŋ ki len kina la.

ref: But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear.
text: Ni taa cha ubaa ŋmann nimi kina; buyoonn binib pam ga yii Uwumbɔr na le ga puen fuu ni, le Tidindaan aawiindaal nin fuu ni. Uja u yii Uwumbɔr aakaal mɔmɔk na, u mu ga puen nya mpaan pu. Uwumbɔr siin u ntafadaan la.

ref: He will brag and oppose everything holy or sacred. He will even sit in God's temple and claim to be God.
text: U ga yii Uwumbɔr, ni ŋiwaa, ni tiwan nimɔk binib dii ni na. U ga nyuŋ ubaa ki jer ni mɔmɔk, ki ga kal Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni, ki len ke uma le ye Uwumbɔr.

ref: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
text: Naa teer aa? Maah nan laa bi ni chee na, m nan tuk nimi tibɔr tee.

ref: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.
text: Le ni nyi tiwan ni kiir titunwanbirdaan ngbaan dandana wee na. Waayoonn yaa nan fuu ni kan, u ga nya mpaan pu.

ref: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
text: Titunwanbir ti bɔɔ na, binib ŋani ti dandana wee la. Le unii u kiir titunwanbir ngbaan dandana wee na ga kiir ti, ki nan saa buyoonn Uwumbɔr ga nyan u nima na.

ref: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
text: N‑yoonn ngbaan le titunwanbirdaan ngbaan ga kpiir. N‑yoonn ngbaan le Tidindaan Yesu ga gir ni, ni mpɔɔn, ki pii libuln lii u pu, ki ku u, ki ŋa waapɔɔn mɔmɔk yɔli.

ref: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
text: Titunwanbirdaan ngbaan yaa nan fuu ni kan, u ga li kpa kinimbɔŋ aapɔɔn, ki tun kaatuln, ki li kpa mpɔɔn ki ŋmann ke u tun lijinjiir aatun la,

ref: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
text: ki li kpa nlan mu kaa ŋan na ke u ŋmann binib bi Uwumbɔr ga daa bitafal na. Bi yii Uwumbɔr aabɔr ti ga cha bi ŋmar na, kaa gee ti. Nima le Uwumbɔr ga daa bitafal.

ref: So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie.
text: Baah yii Uwumbɔr aabɔr na, nima le u cha nnyamɔn aapak bi bisui ni, bi li pak nnyamɔn.

ref: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
text: Nima pu na Uwumbɔr ga len ke binib bi gee titunwanbir kaa pak mbamɔn na aabɔr bii a. Uwumbɔr aah lee nimi pu na

ref: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
text: Tɔ, tinaabitiib bi Tidindaan gee bi na, ni ŋan ke ti li dooni Uwumbɔr ni pu n‑yoonn mɔmɔk; ba pu? tiwan mɔmɔk aah nan piin buyoonn na, u nan lee nimi ke ni ŋmar. Waafuur Nyaan ŋa nimi binib bi bi chain ki pak mbamɔn, aan ki ŋmar na.

ref: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Taah tuk nimi Uwumbɔr aabɔnyaan ti na pu, le u yin nimi ke ni ŋmar ki ji Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aamɔɔn.

ref: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
text: Nnaabitiib, nima pu na, ni li dii u mbamɔm, ki taa di cha. Taah tuk nimi Uwumbɔr aabɔr ti, timɔb ni, ni kigbaŋ ni pu na, ni li joo tibɔr ngbaan mbamɔm.

ref: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
text: Tɔ, Tite Uwumbɔr gee timi sakpen. Waabulchinn pu, le u tii timi lipobisoon li kaan doo na, ni limakl nyaan.

ref: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
text: Uma ni Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ubaa pɔɔn nitaakpab, ki tii nimi mpɔɔn ke ni tun litunyaan mɔmɔk, ki len iliinyaan mɔmɔk.

ref: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
text: Tinaabitiib, tibɔr ti gur na le ye ke ni li mee Uwumbɔr ki tii timi, ke u cha waabɔr moon ŋipepel mɔmɔk mala, ki kan mpakm ke naah pak ti pu na,

ref: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
text: ki li mee u ke u nyan timi titunwanbirdam bi kaa ŋan na aaŋaal ni; ba pu? naa ye binib mɔmɔk le gaa Yesu ki kii.

ref: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
text: Tidindaan le ŋani waah len pu na, ki ga tii nimi mpɔɔn, ki biin ni pu, kinimbɔŋ ki kaa ŋan na taa ŋa nimi nibaa.

ref: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
text: Tidindaan pu le ti bee ke ni ŋani taah tuk nimi pu na, ki ga li beenin ŋani kina.

ref: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
text: Tidindaan ter nimi ke ni bee nisui ni Uwumbɔr aah gee nimi pu na, ki li kpa limɔr Kristo aah tii nimi pu na. Ni ŋan ke unii mɔmɔk li tun

ref: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
text: Tinaabitiib, ti tuk nimi Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aayimbil pu la, ninaabitiib bimɔk kaa ban ke bi tun lituln, kaa dii taah tuk nimi pu na, ni nya bi chee.

ref: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
text: Ni bee ke ni ŋan ni li dii ke taah dii pu na. Taah nan bi ni chee buyoonn na, taa nan san ligbanyakl.

ref: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
text: Ti nan pa taah jin tijikaar ti na mɔmɔk pu la, ki tun lituln linimaln nwiin pu ni kinyeek mɔk; ba pu? taa nan ban ni ji ti pu falaa.

ref: We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you.
text: Naa ye ke taa nan kpa nsan ti ji niŋaal ni la. Ti nan ban ti mɔk nimi limɔkl, ni li dii ke taah dii pu na.

ref: We also gave you this rule: If you don't work, you don't eat.
text: Taah nan bi ni chee buyoonn na, ti nan tuk nimi ke unii umɔk kaa ban u tun lituln na kan, u taa ji.

ref: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
text: Ti ŋun ke ni ponn ni bibaa san ligbanyakl, kaa tun lituln libaa, ki chuun koo biken aabɔr ni.

ref: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
text: Binib bi bi kina na, ti tuk bi, ki sur bi Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aayimbil pu, ke bi li bi suuna, ki tun lituln ki kan ki ji.

ref: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
text: Tinaabitiib, nima kan, ni yaa tun litunyaan kan, ni taa cha nitaakpab li yɔl li ponn ni.

ref: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
text: Unii ubaa yaa kaa dii taah tuk nimi kigbaŋ kee ponn ni pu na kan, ni daan udaan ngbaan, ki taa kpaan u chee. Nima le ga cha inimɔɔn chuu u.

ref: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
text: Ni taa ŋani u ke nimi aadin na, ni li sur u ke nina aabo na. Kookoo aabɔr

ref: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
text: Tidindaan u tii timi nsuudoon na tii nimi nsuudoon n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, tiwan mɔmɔk ponn ni. Tidindaan li bi ni mɔmɔk chee.

ref: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
text: Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni mɔmɔk pu.

ref: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
text: Min Pɔɔl ye Yesu Kristo aakpambal la; ba pu? Uwumbɔr u gaal timi lir na, ni Tidindaan Yesu Kristo u tii timi limakl na, bima le len ke m li ye waakpambal.

ref: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
text: M ŋmee kigbaŋ kee m tii si Timoti, u ye maabo bamɔnn Uwumbɔr aasan ni na la. Tite Uwumbɔr ni Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ŋa tinyoor ŋa aa pu, ki san si kinimbaak, ki tii si nsuudoon. Tinyamɔnbɔr aasurm

ref: When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings.
text: Maah nan cha Masedonia aatiŋ ni na, m nan bui si ke aa li beenin bi Efesus aatiŋ ni; ba pu? binib bibaa bi nima ki mɔk binib mmɔkm mu kaa ye Yesu aamɔkm na. Aa sur bi ke bi taa ki mɔk kina,

ref: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
text: ki taa ki joo ŋiyimbil ŋi bi Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni na tiini itiin baah nan ŋani pu na. Nimina le cha binib baa mbaan. Naa ter bi ke bi gaa Yesu ki kii aan ki dii waasan mbamɔm.

ref: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
text: Binib bibaa bi, kaa ki dii kina. Bi yenn la, ki gbaa tɔb chee tibɔr ti ye fam na.

ref: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
text: Bi ban bi li ye bimɔmɔkb bi mɔk binib Uwumbɔr aakaal na, ki mu aa bee baah len pu na aatataa, ki len tibɔr ke binib bi nyi taatataa na, ki mu aa nyi.

ref: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
text: Tɔ, ti nyi ke unii yaa joo Uwumbɔr aakaal, uma Uwumbɔr aah ban pu na kan, nkaal ngbaan ŋan la.

ref: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
text: Ti yaa nyi ke nkaal aa bi bininyaam pu kan, nkaal ngbaan ŋan la. Mu bi tiniwanbir le pu, ni binib bi kaa gee bi ŋun tibɔr na, ni binib bi kaa dii Uwumbɔr aasan na, ni titunwanbirdam, ni binib bi yii Uwumbɔr kaa pak u na, ni binib bi ku bitetiib ni binatiib na, ni binib bi ku biken na,

ref: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
text: ni binib bi gɔr kidagook na, ni bijab bi yii bipiib ki ban bijab na, ni binib bi chur biken tinaagbiir na, ni binib bi chuun mɔni inyamɔn na, ni binib bi puur Uwumbɔr yɔl yɔl na, ni binib bi ŋani tiwan ni kaa dii mmɔkm mu ŋan na. Nkaal ngbaan bi titunwanbir timina mɔmɔk pu la.

ref: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
text: M dooni Tidindaan Yesu Kristo u tii mi mpɔɔn ke m tun lituln ngbaan na la. U len ke m ye mbamɔndaan, ki lee mi ke m tun waatuln.

ref: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
text: N‑yoonn mu jer na, m nan len tibɔbir u pu, ki seei u, ki ŋa waanib falaa. Maah kaa nan gaa u ki kii n‑yoonn ngbaan na, le maa nan nyi ke m ŋani ni kaa ŋan na. Maah kaa nan nyi na, le Uwumbɔr san mi kinimbaak,

ref: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
text: le Tidindaan Yesu Kristo mu gee mi sakpen, ki cha m gaa u ki kii, ki kpaan u ni, ki gee u ni waanib mɔmɔk.

ref: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
text: Yesu Kristo nan dan dulnyaa wee ni ke u nan nyan titunwanbirdam baatunwanbir ni la. Tibɔr timina gbii la. Ni ŋan ke binib mɔmɔk gaa ti ki kii. Min le ye titunwanbirdaan ki jer binib mɔmɔk.

ref: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
text: Le Uwumbɔr san mi kinimbaak. Yesu Kristo ŋa suklaa, min u ye titunwanbirdaan ki jer binib mɔmɔk na pu sakpen la. Waah ŋa mi suklaa pu na, nima le mɔk binib bi ga gaa u ki kii ki kan limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na, waah kpa suklaa pu na.

ref: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
text: Cha ti pak Uwumbɔr, ki nyuŋ u. Uma le ye Uwumbɔr baan; tinimbil aa waa u; u ye Ubɔrkpaan u ga li bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na, kaan kpo. Amii.

ref: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
text: Maabo Timoti, Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan nan cha m len tibɔr aa pu, nima le cha m tuk si saah ga tun Uwumbɔr aatuln pu na. Cha Nfuur Nyaan aabɔr ngbaan tii si mpɔɔn ke aa yii kinimbɔŋ,

ref: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
text: ki tii Yesu naadii mbamɔm, ki taa di cha, ki li ŋani tiwan ni aa bee ke ni tok na. Binib bibaa bi, ki nyi ni ŋan na, ki mu aa ŋani kina. Nima le baa ki dii Yesu aasan.

ref: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
text: Bi ponn ni binib bilee ye Haimeneus ni Aleksanda. Le m di bi ŋa kinimbɔŋ aaŋaal ni ke ki daa bitafal, aan bi bee ke naa ŋan bi ki sii Uwumbɔr.

ref: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
text: Tɔ, tibɔr ti ye tibɔkpaan na le ye ke m ban ke ni li mee Uwumbɔr ki tii binib mɔmɔk, ki li gaŋni u ke u san bi kinimbaak, ki li dooni u bi pu.

ref: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.
text: Ni li mee Uwumbɔr kina ki tii bibɔrb, ni kitiŋ aayidam mɔmɔk, aan ti li bi tibaa pu, ki li kpa nsuudoon, ki li dii Uwumbɔr aasan, ki li ŋani tiwan mɔmɔk mbamɔm.

ref: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
text: Ni yaa mee Uwumbɔr kina kan, ni ŋan, ki piir Uwumbɔr u gaal timi lir na aasui.

ref: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
text: U ban ke binib mɔmɔk ŋmar, aan ki bee waabɔr ti ye mbamɔn na.

ref: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
text: Ba pu? Uwumbɔr ye Uwumbɔr baan la. Uchandatuln ubaa baanja le bi Uwumbɔr ni binib aakaasisik ni. Uma le ye Yesu Kristo u nan kpaln unibɔn,

ref: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
text: Nima pu le Uwumbɔr lee mi ke m li ye Yesu aakpambal, ke m tuk binib bi kaa ye Juu yaab na Yesu aabɔr ngbaan, ke bi gaa u ki kii, ki bee waabɔr ti ye mbamɔn na. Maa mɔn nnyamɔn, maah len pu na gbii la.

ref: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
text: M ban ke bijab bi bi ŋipepel mɔmɔk na mee Uwumbɔr, ki yoor iŋaal paacham. Bi li ye binib bi bi chain na, ki taa li kpa liŋuul, ki taa li kpa kinikpakpak.

ref: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.
text: M ban ke bipiib li pee tiwanpeenkaan ni ŋeer bipiib bi dii Uwumbɔr na, ki li bi suuna, ki taa li kpa kalmbaani, ki taa fiini tiyikpir sakpen siini, ki taa tuun ŋitafajɔn ŋi kpa kidaak na, ki taa gbin nleen mu kpa kidaak na, ki taa li peeni tiwanpeenkaan ni kpa kidaak na.

ref: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
text: Bi li tun litunyaan. Nima le ŋan tii bipiib bi len ke bi dii Uwumbɔr aasan na.

ref: and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention.
text: Bi li ŋmin ki li bae Uwumbɔr aabɔr ki li ŋun tibɔr.

ref: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
text: Maa kii ke bipiib tuk bijab Uwumbɔr aabɔr, kaa kii ke bi li ye bijab aayidam. Bi li ŋmin.

ref: After all, Adam was created before Eve,
text: Ba pu? Uwumbɔr nan puen naan tiyaaja Adam, le ki nin naan upuu Iif.

ref: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
text: Kinimbɔŋ aa nan ŋmann Adam, ki nan ŋmann upii ngbaan la, le u tun titunwanbir.

ref: But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
text: Tɔ, bipiib mu yaa gaa Yesu ki kii, ki gee binib, ki bi chain, ki bi suuna kan, bi ga ŋmar imalween ni.

ref: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
text: Tibɔr tee gbii la, ke unii yaa ban u li ye Yesu aanib aaninkpel kan, ni ŋan; ba pu? li ye lituln li ŋan na la.

ref: That's why officials must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. They must be self-controlled, sensible, well-behaved, friendly to strangers, and able to teach.
text: Ni ŋan ke Yesu aanib aaninkpel taa li kpa taani ubaa. Ni ŋan u li joo upiibaab, ki li chur ubaa tiwan mɔmɔk ni, ki li kpa laasaab, ki li bi mbamɔm, ki li channi bicham tichann, ki li ye unii u ga ŋmaa tuk binib Uwumbɔr aabɔr mbamɔm na.

ref: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
text: U taa li ye udagbiir, ki taa gbaa binib [ki taa li kpa iniman]. U li bi suuna ki taa li kpa kinikpakpak. Unimbil taa li man ŋimombil pu.

ref: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
text: Ni ŋan ke u li joo waachiln ni aanib mbamɔm, ki li joo waabim mbamɔm, aan bi li pak u ki kii waamɔb.

ref: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
text: Ba pu? unii yaa kaa ŋmaa joo waachiln ni aanib mbamɔm kan, u ga ŋa kinye ki li joo Yesu aanib?

ref: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.
text: U taa li ye unii u kaa yunn Uwumbɔr aasan ni na. U yaa ye unii u kaa yunn Uwumbɔr aasan ni na kan, nibaakan, u ga li kpa kigaak, ki kan ntafadaan ke kinimbɔŋ na.

ref: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil. Church Officers
text: Ni ŋan ke Yesu aanib aaninkpel li ye unii u kpa kipak binib bi kaa dii Yesu aasan na chee, aan binib taa galn u ki cha u lir kinimbɔŋ aagaawɔb ni. Biteterb aabɔr

ref: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
text: Ni ŋan ke bi li joo tibɔbɔrkaan ti kpiir, ki ye Yesu aabɔr na, ki li nyi mbimbin mu ŋan na, ki li ŋani kina.

ref: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
text: Binib yaa ban bi li ye biteterb kan, cha Yesu aanib aaninkpiib puen lik baabimbin aah bi pu na waahr, bi yaa kaa kpa taani kan, cha bi li tun biteterb aatuln.

ref: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
text: Ni ŋan ke bipuutiib mu li kpa laasaab, ki li chur bibaa, ki li ŋani tiwan mɔmɔk mbamɔm, ki taa li ye binibiinib.

ref: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
text: Ni ŋan ke Yesu aanib aateterb li joo upii ubaabaa, ki li joo baabim ni baachiln ni aanib mbamɔm.

ref: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
text: Binib bi tun biteterb aatuln ngbaan mbamɔm na ga kan liyimbil, ki li kpa lipobil sakpen ki tuk binib baah ga gaa Yesu Kristo ki kii pu na. Tibɔbɔrkaan kpaan

ref: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
text: Tɔ, m kpa limakl ke naan yunn, m ga dan aa chee. Le maah ŋmee kigbaŋ kee tii ni si na,

ref: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
text: m yaa yunn kan, aa ga bee mbimbin mu ŋan tii Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aanib, bi ye Uwumbɔr u ye limɔfadaan na aanib na. Waabɔr ti ye mbamɔn na bi biŋaal ni la, le bi joo ti.

ref: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
text: Uwumbɔr aah kpiir waasan aabɔr ti tuk timi na, ti ye tibɔkpaan la: U nan yoor unibɔn aawon, ki nyan ubaa mpaan pu. Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan le mɔk ke u ŋan. Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib waa u. Binib moon waabɔr ki tuk ŋitimbol aanib, le binib gaa u ki kii dulnyaa wee mɔmɔk ni. Uwumbɔr nan yoor u ki di buen paacham, ki nyuŋ u.

ref: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.
text: Tɔ, Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan len mpaan pu, ke n‑yoonn mu choo na binib bibaa ga yii Yesu aabɔr, ki kii inyamɔn, ki dii bipɔnib bi ŋmanni bi na.

ref: They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars
text: Bipɔnib ngbaan ga cha binib bibaa ŋmann ke bi mɔk binib Uwumbɔr aasan. Bi ye binyamɔndam la. Baalandak aa ki muk bi baatunwanbir pu.

ref: will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth.
text: Bi ga len ke bijab taa din bipiib, bipiib mu taa mɔn bijab. Bi ga li kɔ tijikaar tibaa. Uwumbɔr le naan tijikaar ngbaan. U ban ke binib bi gaa u ki kii ki nyi mbamɔn na le ji ti, ki doon u ti pu.

ref: Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything.
text: Tiwan nimɔk Uwumbɔr naan ni na, ni ŋan la. Ti taa li kɔ tijikaar tibaa. Ti li ji ti, ki li dooni u ti pu.

ref: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
text: Ba pu? taah ji tijikaar ti ki dooni Uwumbɔr ti pu na, nibaa aa bi ti ni; ba pu? Uwumbɔr len ke ti ŋan. Yesu Kristo aatutunn bamɔnn

ref: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
text: Aa yaa teer Yesu aanib tibɔr timina kan, aa ye Yesu Kristo aatutunn bamɔnn la. Saah bae Yesu aabɔr ki dii nsanyaan pu na, nima le cha saabimbin bi mbamɔm.

ref: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
text: Aa taa gar binyamɔndam ngbaan aatiin; ba pu? itiin ngbaan aa kpa tinyoor ki tii si, kaa mɔk si Uwumbɔr aasan. Chuu aabaa ki bae Uwumbɔr aabɔr.

ref: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
text: Nima le ti tun Uwumbɔr aatuln linimaln; ba pu? ti gaa Uwumbɔr u ye limɔfadaan ki gaal binib mɔmɔk lir na ki kii la. Uma le gaal binib bimɔk gaa u ki kii na lir.

ref: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
text: Mɔk binib tibɔr tee, ki tuk bi ke bi li ŋani kina.

ref: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
text: Taa cha bi lik si fam ke aa ye unachipɔɔn la. Li len iliinyaan, ki li bi mbamɔm, ki li gee binib, ki li tun Uwumbɔr aatuln mbamɔm, ki li bi chain, aan ki li ye limɔkl ki mɔk binib bi gaa Yesu ki kii na baah ga li dii mbamɔm pu na.

ref: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
text: Li karni Uwumbɔr aabɔr tii binib, ki mɔk bi taatataa, ki tuk bi baah ga li ŋani pu na. Li ŋani kina linimaln, ki nan saa buyoonn m ga fuu ni na.

ref: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
text: Taa suln Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aapiin i bi aa ni na, i Uwumbɔr nan tii si buyoonn waabɔnabtiib nan len, aan Yesu aanib aaninkpiib di biŋaal paan aa pu na.

ref: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
text: Maah tuk si pu na, li ŋani kina mbamɔm ki cha aanimbil li man ni pu, aan binib mɔmɔk bee saah dii Yesu aasan mbamɔm pu na.

ref: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
text: Li nyi saabimbin aah bi pu na, ki li nyi saah mɔk binib Yesu aabɔr pu na. Li beenin ŋani maah tuk si pu na. Aa yaa beenin ŋani kina kan, sin aabaa ga ŋmar, le binib bi mu ŋun Yesu aabɔr aa chee na mu ga ŋmar.

ref: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
text: Tɔ, taa kae uja u por na. Li sur u ke aate na. Li ŋani bijab bi kaa por na ke aanaabitiib na.

ref: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
text: Li ŋani bipiib bi por na ke aana na. Li ŋani bipiib bi kaa por na ke aaninkpatiib na, ki li bi chain bi chee.

ref: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
text: Li ter bikpopiib bi sil ye bikpopiib na.

ref: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
text: Ukpopii mu yaa kpa mbim, bee u ti ki kpa yaabitiib le kan, ni ŋan ke bi bae Uwumbɔr aah ban ke bi ter baachiln ni aanib pu na, ki teen binatiib, ni biyaatiib, baah nan kpiin bi pu na; ba pu? nima le piir Uwumbɔr aasui.

ref: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
text: Ukpopii u sil ye ukpopii ki gur ubaa na kpa limakl Uwumbɔr pu la. Le u ga li mee Uwumbɔr ki gaŋni u nwiin pu ni kinyeek.

ref: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
text: Ukpopii u kaa bi mbamɔm na ma kan, u lann limɔfal Uwumbɔr chee ki laa chuun fu.

ref: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.
text: Tuk Yesu aanib ke bi li ŋani maah len pu na, aan bikpopiib bi bi bikaasisik ni na taa li kpa ngalm.

ref: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
text: Unii u kaa ter udo yaab, kaa ter uma ubaa aachiln ni aanib ki jer biken na, u yii Yesu aasan le na, ki ye kiniwanbiik ki jer binib bi kaa gaa Yesu ki kii na.

ref: For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least
text: Ukpopii yaa kaa fuu ŋibin imonko itaa kan, aa taa ŋmee waayimbil bikpopiib aagbaŋ ponn ni. Uchal yaa nan ye ujabaan kan,

ref: She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
text: binib yaa len ke upii ngbaan tun litunyaan: u yaa nan kpiini mbim mbamɔm, ki yaa nan ŋani bicham tichann, ki yaa sunn ubaa taab ki tun lituln tii Yesu aanib, ki yaa nan ter binib bi bi limukl ni na, aan unimbil yaa man litunyaan mɔmɔk pu kan, aa ŋmee waayimbil bikpopiib aagbaŋ ponn ni.

ref: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
text: Taa ŋmee bikpopiib bi kaa por na aayimbil; ba pu? bijab aakpeek yaa chuu bi kan, bi ga di Kristo aatuln lii, ki ban ke bi mɔn tichal,

ref: and become guilty of breaking their promise to him.
text: kaan gbiin baah puu tipuur ti na. Nima le bi ga li kpa ngalm.

ref: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
text: Ki ki kpee na, bi ga li san ligbanyakl, ki ga li chaa ŋidichal ŋidichal ni. Naa ye ke bi ga li san ligbanyakl baanja la, bi ga li ye bibɔtukb la, ki ga li koo binib aabɔr ni, ki ga len naah kaa ba ŋan bi len pu na.

ref: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
text: M ban ke bikpopiib bi kaa por na mɔn tichal, ki maa mbim, ki li lik baachiln ni aabɔr, ki taa tii timi aadim nsan ke bi galn timi.

ref: Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.
text: Ba pu? bikpopiib bibaa yenn, ki dii kinimbɔŋ aasan.

ref: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
text: Tɔ, bikpopiib yaa bi upii u gaa Yesu ki kii na do kan, ni ŋan ke u li ter bi, aan ki taa muk Yesu aanib ke bi ter bikpopiib ngbaan. Nima le bi ga ŋmaa ter bikpopiib bi kaa kpa do yaab na.

ref: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
text: Tɔ, ni ŋan ke Yesu aanib pa baaninkpiib bi joo bi mbamɔm na lipal li wiir na. Yesu aanib aaninkpiib bi tun lituln linimaln, ki mooni tibɔnyaan tee, ki mɔk binib taatataa na, ni ŋan ke bima le aapar li wiir jer biken yaan.

ref: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
text: Ba pu? Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ len ke, “Aa yaa joo unaaja poi idi kan, aa taa buu umɔb,” ki ki len ke, “Ututunn aapar ŋeer u la.”

ref: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
text: Tɔ, bi yaa galn Yesu aanib aaninkpel kan, taa gar baah len pu na, see biseeraadam bilee bee bitaa len kina.

ref: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
text: Kae binib bi tun titunwanbir na Yesu aanib mɔmɔk aanimbil ni, aan bi gur na san ijawaan.

ref: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
text: M sur si Uwumbɔr ni Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ni waatuuntiib bi u nyan bi na aanimbiin ni la, aa li ŋani maah len pu na, ki li joo Yesu aanib mbamɔm, ki taa li kpa imaagann.

ref: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
text: Unii yaa kaa yunn Uwumbɔr aasan ni kan, taa nyan u ke u tun Uwumbɔr aatuln. Taa cha biken aatunwanbir li ye saataani. Cha saabimbin li bi chain.

ref: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
text: Saah kaa kpa laafee kpala kpala na, taa ki nyu nnyun baanja, aa nyu ŋisubil aadaan siib, aan ni ter aaponn ni.

ref: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
text: Binib bibaa aatunwanbir bi mpaan pu, ki tii bi ntafadaan mala. Bibaa mu aatunwanbir aa kpiir mala.

ref: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
text: Kina le litunyaan mu bi lipaal. Li yaa bɔɔ kan, laan li bɔɔ n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
text: Tɔ, Yesu aanib ponn ni bi ye binaagbiib na, bi mɔmɔk li pak bidindatiib mbamɔm, aan binib taa bii Uwumbɔr aayimbil, ni waabɔr.

ref: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
text: Binaagbiib bi kpa dindatiib bi gaa Yesu ki kii na taa lik bidindatiib fam, ke bi ye binaabitiib. Bi li moo tun lituln tii bidindatiib ngbaan ki jer baah ba ga tun pu na; ba pu? dindatiib bi kan tinyoor baatuln ponn ni na ye binib bi gaa Yesu ki kii na la, le bi gee bi. Yesu Kristo aanib aasurm Tuk bi ki sur bi ke bi li ŋani kina.

ref: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aabɔr le ye tibɔnyaan, ki mɔk timi taah ga dii Uwumbɔr aasan mbamɔm pu na. Unii ubaa yaa mɔk bi mmɔkm yayan kaa kii tibɔr ngbaan kan,

ref: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
text: u ye kalmbaanidaan la, kaa nyi nibaa. U gee ke u kpak kinikpakpak ibɔliin aatataa pu. Nima le cha lipiipoln, ni tibɔr, ni ŋisiibil bi, ki cha binib dak ilandak i kaa ŋan na tɔb pu.

ref: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
text: Le binib bi dak ilandakbir na kpak tɔb kinikpakpak. Baa ki nyi mbamɔn. Bi dak ke Uwumbɔr aasan ye liwankpal aasan la. [Nya binib ngbaan chee.]

ref: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
text: Tɔ, unii aanimbil yaa gbiin waah kpa ni na pu ki yaa dii Uwumbɔr aasan kan, nima le ye tinyoor sakpen ki tii u.

ref: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
text: Taah nan dan dulnyaa wee ni buyoonn na, taa nan joo ni nibaa. Taah ga ki nya dulnyaa wee ni buyoonn na, taan ki ŋmaa joo nibaa ki di nya.

ref: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.
text: Nima pu na, taah kpa tijikaar ni tiwanpeenkaan ni na, cha tinimbil gbiin ni.

ref: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
text: Binib bi aanimbil man liwankpal pu na ga kan ntɔŋ, ki lir. Binimbil ga li man kijɔrk aawan sakpenn le pu. Ni ye fam la, ki ga bii bi. Tiwan ngbaan aaboln le cha binib bee fam ki kan ntafadaan mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
text: Binib yaa gee ŋimombil sakpen kan, nima le cha bi tun titunwanbir mɔk aabɔŋ. Binib bibaa aanimbil aah man ŋimombil pu pu na le cha bi yenn, kaa ki dii Yesu aasan, ki kan mpombiin ki ti chaar jer. Nsurm ki tii Timoti

ref: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
text: Saah ye Uwumbɔr aanii na, yii titunwanbir timina mɔmɔk, ki li dii mbimbinyaan, ki li bi Uwumbɔr aah ban pu na, ki li tun waatuln mbamɔm, ki li kpa ngeehm, ni suklaa, ki li bi suuna.

ref: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
text: Yesu Kristo nan tii seeraa nyaan Pontius Pailat aanimbiin ni. Le m sur si, uma Yesu ni Uwumbɔr u tii tiwan mɔmɔk limɔfal na aanimbiin ni

ref: Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
text: ke aa tun Uwumbɔr aah tii si lituln li na mbamɔm, ki li bi chain, ki taa li kpa taani ubaa, ki nan saa Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aah ga gir ni buyoonn na.

ref: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
text: Ni yaa nan ŋeer kan, Uwumbɔr ga cha u gir ni. Uwumbɔr u ti pak u na, uma baanja le ye tiwan mɔmɔk Aayidaan. U ye bibɔrb mɔmɔk Aabɔr, ki ye dindatiib mɔmɔk Aadindaan.

ref: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
text: Uma baanja le ye limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na Aadindaan. U bi nwiihn ni la. Ubaa aan ŋmaa duun mu ni. Ubaa aanimbil aa kee kan u. Ubaa mu aan ŋmaa kan u. Cha binib mɔmɔk nyuŋ u, ki kii waamɔb n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Amii.

ref: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
text: Aa sur binib bi kpa liwankpal dulnyaa wee ni na ke bi taa li kpa kalmbaani, ki taa li kpa limakl liwankpal ngbaan pu. Ba pu? li ye libuln la. Bi li kpa limakl Uwumbɔr pu. U tii timi sakpen, le taa ti ki nyi ni mɔmɔk; u ban ke ti gaa, ki li kpa mpopiin.

ref: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
text: Tuk biwankpadam ngbaan ke bi li ter biken, ki li tun litunyaan sakpen, ki li kpa tibulchinn, ki li ban ke bi yakr baawankpal tii biken.

ref: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
text: Bi yaa ŋa kina kan, bi ga di liwankpal bil paacham. Ni ga li ye nterm nyaan le ki tii bi n‑yoonn mu choo na, le bi ga kan limɔfal li ye libamɔln na.

ref: Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't.
text: Timoti, li joo tibɔr ti Uwumbɔr di ŋa aaŋaal ni na. Binib bibaa len tibɔr yɔl yɔl, ki yii Uwumbɔr aabɔr, ki dak ke bi nyi la, kaa nyi. Yii baah len pu na.

ref: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
text: Ba pu? binib bibaa bi, ki len ke bi nyi nnyim, ki mu yenn, kaa ki dii Yesu aasan. Tɔ, Uwumbɔr ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu.

ref: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
text: Min Pɔɔl ye Yesu Kristo aakpambal Uwumbɔr aageehn pu, ke m ti tuk binib ke Uwumbɔr puu tipuur ke binib bi kpaan Yesu Kristo ni na ga kan limɔfal.

ref: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
text: M ŋmee kigbaŋ kee m tii maabo Timoti u m gee u na la. Tite Uwumbɔr ni Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ŋa tinyoor ŋa aa pu, ki san si kinimbaak, ki tii si nsuudoon. Idoon ni ntaakpab pɔɔn aabɔr

ref: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
text: M yaa mee Uwumbɔr u m tun lituln tii u mbamɔm ke n‑yaajatiib aah nan ŋani pu na kan, m teer aabɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk maameel ni, kinyeek ni nwiin pu, ki dooni u aa pu la.

ref: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
text: M teer maah buen cha si aan aa wii pu na. Le nnimbil man ke m ki kan si, aan ki li kpa mpopiin.

ref: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
text: M teer saah gaa Yesu ki kii mbamɔm pu na. Aayaa Lois ni aana Yunis le nan puen gaa u ki kii. Le m bee ke aa mu sil gaa u ki kii.

ref: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
text: Le Uwumbɔr nan tii si Waafuur Nyaan aapiin buyoonn m nan di ŋŋaal paan aa pu na; le m ban m teer si ke aa fikr ipiin ngbaan.

ref: God's Spirit doesn't make cowards out of us. The Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.
text: Nfuur Nyaan mu Uwumbɔr tii timi na aan ŋa timi bijawaandam. Mu tii timi mpɔɔn, ki cha ti gee binib, ki chur tibaa.

ref: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
text: Nima pu na, tuk binib Tidindaan aabɔr, ki taa san inimɔɔn. Maah bi kiyondiik ni Tidindaan pu na, taa cha inimɔɔn li joo si kina pu. Aa mu li ji falaa Yesu aabɔnyaan tee pu, Uwumbɔr aah tii si mpɔɔn pu na.

ref: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
text: U gaa timi lii, ki yin timi ke ti li bi chain. Naa ye timi aatunyaan pu le u yin timi. Waah kpa tibulchinn pu na, nima le u yin timi waageehn pu. Waah kaa nan kee naan dulnyaa buyoonn na, le u nan ŋa timi tibulchinn ngbaan Yesu Kristo pu.

ref: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
text: Dandana wee, ti kan waah ŋa timi tibulchinn pu na; ba pu? Yesu Kristo, u gaal timi lir na, dan dulnyaa wee ni ki nan kuln nkun, ki tii timi limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na. Waabɔnyaan tee le kpiir kina.

ref: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
text: Uwumbɔr nan nyan mi ke m li ye Yesu aakpambal, ke m li chuun mooni binib waabɔnyaan tee, ki tuk bi taatataa.

ref: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
text: Nima pu le m ji falaa kiyondiik ni. Ni mu aa kpa mi inimɔɔn. Ba pu? m nyi Yesu u m gaa u ki kii na. Maah di mbaa tii u na, m sil nyi ke u ga ŋmaa li joo mi, ki nan saa waagirndaal.

ref: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
text: Aa nan gaa Yesu Kristo ki kii le ki gee u; nima pu na, aa li joo maah tuk si tibɔnyaan ti na mbamɔm.

ref: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
text: Uwumbɔr di tibɔnyaan tee ŋa aaŋaal ni la; aa li joo ti mbamɔm, Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan mu bi ti ni na aapɔɔn pu.

ref: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
text: Aa nyi ke Asia aatiŋ aanib ponn ni pam nan san cha mi. Bi ponn ni binib bilee le ye Fijelus ni Hemojenes.

ref: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
text: Onesiforus pɔɔni ntaakpab kpala kpala. Maah nan bi kiyondiik ni na, inimɔɔn aa nan joo u kina pu. Cha Uwumbɔr san u ni waachiln ni aanib kinimbaak.

ref: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
text: Waah fuu ni Rom aatiŋ ni na, u nan chuun ban mi linimaln le ki ti kan mi.

ref: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
text: Aa sil nyi waah nan ter mi pu Efesus aatiŋ ni na. Tidindaan san u kinimbaak uma Tidindaan aagirndaal.

ref: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
text: Maabo, pɔɔk aataakpab Yesu Kristo aah ter si pu na.

ref: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
text: Aa nan ŋun Uwumbɔr aabɔr m chee kinipaak aanimbil ni. Di tibɔr ngbaan ŋa bijab bi bi mbamɔm ki ga ŋmaa tuk biken na aaŋaal ni.

ref: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
text: Ji falaa Yesu Kristo pu ke waajanyaan na.

ref: Soldiers on duty don't work at outside jobs. They try only to please their commanding officer.
text: Uja u to butɔb na aatafal aa bi dulnyaa wee ni aabɔr ni; ba pu? u ban u piir waaninkpel aasui la.

ref: No one wins an athletic contest without obeying the rules.
text: Unii u san litaasaln na yaa kaa dii litaasaln ngbaan aakaal kan, waan ji litaasaln aanyoor.

ref: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
text: Ukpaal u tun lituln linimaln na, ni ŋan ke uma le puen ji kisaak ngbaan aajikaar.

ref: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
text: Aa dakl lik maah len pu na aatataa, le Tidindaan ga ter si aa bee ni mɔmɔk aatataa.

ref: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
text: Teer Yesu Kristo bɔr. U fikr nkun ni, ki ye Ubɔr David aayaabil la. Maah tuk binib tibɔnyaan ti na le na.

ref: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
text: Tibɔnyaan tee pu, le m ji falaa. Le bi buu mi idɔribi kiyondiik ni, ke bakadaan na. Uwumbɔr aabɔr ma aa buu.

ref: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.
text: Nima pu le m kpa limɔr falaa mɔmɔk ni, binib bi Uwumbɔr nyan bi na pu, aan bi mu kpaan Yesu Kristo ni, ki ŋmar, ki li kpa mpopiin mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: Here is a true message: “If we died with Christ, we will live with him.
text: Tibɔr tee gbii, “Timi aabimbikpok yaa kpo Yesu chee kan, ti ga li kpa limɔfal u chee.

ref: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
text: Ti yaa dii u ki kpa limɔr kan, ti ga ji nnaan u chee. Ti yaa len ke taa nyi u kan, u mu ga len ke waa nyi timi.

ref: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
text: Ti yaa kaa ye mbamɔndam kan, uma beenin ye mbamɔndaan la, waan ŋmaa yii uma ubaa aabimbin.” Ututunn bamɔnn

ref: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
text: Aa li teer binib tibɔr timina, ki sur bi Tidindaan aanimbiin ni ke bi taa li kpak kinikpakpak ibɔliin aatataa pu; ba pu? naa kpa tinyoor, kaa ter binib ke bi dii mbamɔm.

ref: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
text: Cha aanimbil li man ke aa piir Uwumbɔr aasui, ki li ye waatutunn bamɔnn u kaan ji inimɔɔn waatuln pu na, ki li tuk binib Uwumbɔr aabɔr ti ye mbamɔn na, ki mɔk bi taatataa mbamɔm.

ref: Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God.
text: Yii tibɔr ti ye fam na; ba pu? binib bi len kina na ga moo tun titunwanbir.

ref: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
text: Baabɔr aa ŋan, ki ga pɔr ke mbuun aah pɔr pu na la. Bi ponn ni binib bilee le ye Haimeneus ni Filetus.

ref: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
text: Bi yenn kaa ki dii mbamɔn aasan. Bi len ke ti fikr nkun ni a. Baah len kina na, nima le binib bibaa aa ki tii Yesu naadii mbamɔm.

ref: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
text: Tɔ, Uwumbɔr aanib ye waadinyikl li pɔɔ, ki kpa kidaan, ki si na la. Kidaan ngbaan le ye ke, “Uwumbɔr nyi binib bi ye waanib na,” ki ki ye ke, “Binib bi pur Uwumbɔr aayimbil na mɔmɔk di cha titunwanbir.”

ref: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
text: Tɔ, ŋisambil aabɔŋ bi lidichasakpeln ni. Ŋibaa ye salmaa, ŋibaa ye tikur, ŋibaa mu ye busub yaan, ŋibaa mu ye tiyakr. Bi joo ŋibaa tun litukpaan, ki joo ŋibaa tun lituwaatiir.

ref: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
text: Unii yaa di cha titunwanbir mɔmɔk kan, Tidindaan ga cha u tun litukpaan, ba pu? u ga li bi chain ki ŋeer lituln ngbaan, ki gor ke u tun litunyaan mɔmɔk tii Tidindaan.

ref: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
text: Chuu aabaa ki taa dii tiwan ni kaa ŋan na aakpeek ke binachipɔm aah dii pu na. Tun lituln li ŋan na, ki tii Tidindaan naadii mbamɔm, ki li kpa ngeehm, ni nsuudoon. Kpaan binib bi mu bi kina ki joo bisui mɔmɔk mee Tidindaan na chee.

ref: Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble,
text: Yii mbaan mu ye kijɔrk aabaan, kaa kpa ŋitaa na. Aa nyi ke nima le cha binib kpak kinikpakpak.

ref: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
text: Tidindaan aatutunn taa li kpak kinikpakpak. Ni ŋan ke u li ŋani binib mɔmɔk tibulchinn, ki tuk bi Yesu aabɔr mbamɔm, ki li kpa limɔr,

ref: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
text: ki li bi suuna ki sur binib bi kpak u kinikpakpak na. Nibaakan, Uwumbɔr ga cha bi kpeln baabimbin ki bee waabɔr ti ye mbamɔn na,

ref: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
text: ki ki kpaln binib, ki nyan ni kinimbɔŋ ki nan chuu bi ke bi li ŋani kaageehn na aaŋaal ni.

ref: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
text: Tɔ, aa li nyi ke n‑yoonn mu choo na ga li ye falaa aayoonn la.

ref: People will love only themselves and money. They will be proud, stuck-up, rude, and disobedient to their parents. They will also be ungrateful, godless,
text: Ba pu? binib ga li ye bikumɔndam. Binimbil ga li man ŋimombil pu. Bi ga li kpa kipupuk, ki li kpa kigaak, ki li seei binib. Baan li pak bite ni bina, kaan li nyi idoon, kaan li pak Uwumbɔr,

ref: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
text: kaan li gee baamaal aanib, kaan di cha pinn binib. Bi ga li ye binibiinib. Baan ŋmaa chuu bibaa. Bi ga li kpa mbiin, ki ga li nan nsanyaan.

ref: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.
text: Bi ga kooh binib. Baan li kpa ilandak. Bi ga yoor bibaa paacham, ki ga li gee dulnyaa wee ni aawanyaan, kaan li gee Uwumbɔr.

ref: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
text: Bi ga li ŋmanni ke bi dii Uwumbɔr aasan, ki ga lann Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn. Aa taa dii binib ngbaan.

ref: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
text: Bi ponn ni bibaa looni ki koo ŋidichal ponn ni, ki ŋmanni bipiijɔrb bi gbii titunwanbir ki dii bisui aah gee pu na aabɔŋ na.

ref: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
text: Bipiib ngbaan bae mbaem n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, kaa ŋmaa bee Uwumbɔr aabɔr.

ref: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
text: Janes ni Jamberes aah nan kpak Moses kinikpakpak na, bijab ngbaan mu kpak Uwumbɔr aabɔr kina la. Bi dak ilandak i kaa ŋan na, kaa tii Yesu naadii.

ref: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
text: Bi mu aan ki li ŋmanni binib ki yunn; ba pu? binib mɔmɔk ga bee ke bi ye bijɔrb, ke binib aah nan bee Janes ni Jamberes pu na. Kookoo aasurm

ref: Timothy, you know what I teach and how I live. You know what I want to do and what I believe. You have seen how patient and loving I am, and how in the past I put up with
text: Sin ma kan, aa dii maah mɔk si pu na, ki dii maabimbin aah bi pu na. Maah ban ke m li ŋani pu na, aa mu ban kina la. Aa nyi maah tii Yesu naadii pu na, ki nyi maah kpa limɔr, ni ngeehm, ni suklaa pu na.

ref: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
text: Ni ye mbamɔn la, binib bimɔk ye Yesu Kristo yaab ki ban ke bi li bi mbamɔm Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni na, binib ga ŋa bi falaa la.

ref: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
text: Le mbiindam ni biŋmaŋmannim ga moo tun titunwanbir ki li ŋmanni binib, le binib mu gir ki li ŋmanni bi.

ref: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
text: Sin ma kan, aa bae Uwumbɔr aabɔr, ki sil bee ke ti gbii la. Aa li beenin dii kina; ba pu? aa bee ke binib bi mɔk si na ye mbamɔndam la.

ref: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
text: Aa bae Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ aaliin tibir ni la. Iliin ngbaan ga ŋmaa tii si nlan mu ga mɔk si saah ga gaa Yesu Kristo ki kii ki ŋmar pu na.

ref: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
text: Iliin imɔk bi Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni na nyan ni Uwumbɔr chee la. Le i mɔmɔk kpa tinyoor, ki mɔk timi waasan, ki sur timi, ki toor timi aabimbin, ki mɔk timi taah ga li dii mbamɔm pu na.

ref: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
text: Unii u tun Uwumbɔr aatuln na yaa kii iliin ngbaan kan, u ga li bi mbamɔm, ki gor ke u tun litunyaan mɔmɔk.

ref: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
text: Yesu Kristo ga gir ni ki nan ji nnaan, ki ji binifuub ni bitekpiib tibɔr; m sur si uma ni Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni la,

ref: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
text: li chuun mooni waabɔr. Ni yaa ŋeer, bee naa kee ŋeer kan, aa li mooni waabɔr, ki kae binib, ki li kpaa bi, ki li sur bi, ki li kpa limɔr ki tuk bi Uwumbɔr aabɔr, ki taa di cha.

ref: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
text: Ba pu? n‑yoonn choo, le binib aan ki pel mmɔkm mu ŋan na. Bitafal aan li bi mu ni. Bi ga li ban bimɔmɔkb bi ga tuk bi bisui aah gee tibɔr ti na la.

ref: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.
text: Bi ga yii mbamɔn, ki li ban ke bi ŋun itiin.

ref: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
text: Sin ma kan, chuu aabaa n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, ki ji suklaa falaa ponn ni, ki tuk binib tibɔnyaan tee, ki tun lituln li Uwumbɔr di siin si na mɔmɔk.

ref: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
text: Mma kan, m bi ke kitork na la; bi ban ke bi ku mi Yesu aabɔr pu la. Ni gur siib, maan ki li bi dulnyaa wee ni.

ref: I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful.
text: M pɔɔn mbaa Uwumbɔr aasanyaan ni, ki tun maatuln doo, ki joo Yesu aabɔnyaan mbamɔm,

ref: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
text: le Uwumbɔr len ke maabɔr ŋan, ki di tinyoor bil kiir mi paacham. Tidindaan u ji binib tibɔr mbamɔm na, le ga ti di tinyoor ngbaan tii mi bundaln u ga gir ni na. Naa ye mi baanja le u ga tii. U ga tii binib bimɔk gee u ki ban ke u ki gir ni na. Pɔɔl ubaa aamɔboln

ref: Come to see me as soon as you can.
text: Tɔ, pɔɔn aabaa ki dan m chee mala;

ref: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
text: ba pu? Kreskens buen Galasia aatiŋ ni, Taitus mu buen Dalmasia aatiŋ ni. Demas gee dulnyaa wee ni aawan, ki di mi lii, ki buen Tesalonika aatiŋ ni.

ref: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
text: Luk baanja le bi m chee. Li joo ni Mak ki dan. U ga ŋmaa ter mi, Uwumbɔr aatuln ni.

ref: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
text: M cha Tikikus buen Efesus aatiŋ ni.

ref: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
text: Aa yaa choo kan, aa li joo ni maabɔkul li m nan di bil Troas aatiŋ ni, Kapus do na, ki li joo ni maagbann, ki taa suln tigbann waatiir ngbaan bɔr.

ref: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
text: Uchaa u bi yin u ke Aleksanda na nan ŋa mi bakaa sakpen. Tidindaan ga teen u waah tun bakaa pu na.

ref: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
text: U kpak taah mooni tibɔnyaan ti na kinikpakpak ki ti chaar jer, nima pu na, aa mu li nyi u.

ref: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
text: Maah nan puen ban m len tibɔr bibɔjirb aanimbiin ni ki nyan maabamɔn na, ubaa aa nan sil mpuwɔb, bi mɔmɔk nan san cha mi la. Uwumbɔr taa chuu bi taani ni pu.

ref: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
text: Tidindaan le nan sil mpuwɔb, ki tii mi mpɔɔn m len waabɔr mɔmɔk, aan bi mɔmɔk ŋun. Waa cha ubɔjir len ke bi ku mi.

ref: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
text: Tidindaan ga nyan mi binib aah ban bi ŋa mi bakaa u na mɔmɔk ponn ni. U ga biin m pu ki li joo ni mi waanaan ni paacham. Uma le yeh nnyuŋ n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Amii. Kookoo aadoon

ref: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
text: Aa doon Prisila, ni Akuila, ni Onesiforus aachiln ni aanib tii mi.

ref: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
text: Erastus beenin bi Korint aatiŋ ni. Trofimus bun la, nima le m cha u bee Miletus aatiŋ ni.

ref: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
text: Pɔɔn aabaa ki dan m chee aan kakab yoonn nin fuu ni. Yubulus, ni Pudens, ni Linus, ni Klɔdia ni tinaabitiib mɔmɔk dooni si.

ref: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
text: Tidindaan li bi saawiin chee. Uwumbɔr ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu.

ref: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I encourage God's own people to have more faith and to understand the truth about religion.
text: Min Pɔɔl, m ye Uwumbɔr aatutunn, ki ye Yesu Kristo aakpambal, ke m ter Uwumbɔr aah nyan binib bi na ke bi gaa u ki kii, ki bee waabɔr ti gbii na. Waabɔr ngbaan ter bi, ke bi li bi waah ban pu na.

ref: Then they will have the hope of eternal life God promised long ago. And God never tells a lie!
text: Waabɔr pu le bi kpa limakl ke bi ga li kpa limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na. Uwumbɔr u kaa mɔni inyamɔn na, uma le nan puu tipuur n‑yaayoonn na, ke u ga tii timi limɔfal ngbaan.

ref: So, at the proper time, God our Savior gave this message and told me to announce what he had said.
text: Naah nan ŋeer na, le uma Uwumbɔr u gaa timi lii na kpiir limɔfal ngbaan aabɔr, ki tuk mi ke m li chuun mooni ti.

ref: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
text: M bi ŋmee kigbaŋ kee m tii si Taitus u ye maabo bamɔnn Yesu Kristo aasan ni na. Tite Uwumbɔr ni Yesu Kristo u gaal timi lir na ŋa tinyoor ŋa aa pu, [ki san si kinimbaak,] ki tii si nsuudoon. Taitus aah tun lituln li Krete aatiŋ ni na

ref: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you,
text: Tɔ, m cha aa bee Krete aatiŋ ni ke aa tun lituln li kaa kee tun na, ki lee binib bi ga li ye Yesu aanib aaninkpiib ntim mɔmɔk ponn ni na.

ref: they must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. Their children must be followers of the Lord and not have a reputation for being wild and disobedient.
text: Aa lee bijab bi kaa kpa taani ubaa, ki kpa upii ubaabaa, ki kpa mbim bi gaa Yesu ki kii, kaa ŋani bakaa, kaa ye tafalaaŋundam na.

ref: Church officials are in charge of God's work, and so they must also have a good reputation. They must not be bossy, quick-tempered, heavy drinkers, bullies, or dishonest in business.
text: Uwumbɔr aanib bi baaninkpel aaŋaal ni la, nima pu le ni ŋan ke u taa li kpa taani ubaa, ki taa li tun uma ubaa aageehn, ki taa li ye liŋuuldaan, ki taa li ye udagbiir, ki taa gbaa binib; unimbil taa li man ŋimombil pu.

ref: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.
text: Ni ŋan ke u li ye unii u channi bicham tichann na, ki li gee lituln li ŋan na, ki li kpa laasaab, ni mbimbinyaan, ki li bi chain, ki li chur ubaa,

ref: They must stick to the true message they were taught, so their good teaching can help others and correct everyone who opposes it.
text: ki li joo taah nan tuk u tibɔnyaan ti ye Uwumbɔr aabɔr bamɔnn na, aan ki mɔk binib mmɔkm mu ŋan na, ki pɔɔk bitaakpab, ki len tibɔr ki nyaŋ binib bi kpak u kinikpakpak na.

ref: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
text: Ba pu? binib pam le bi ki ye tafalaaŋundam, ki len tibɔr yɔl yɔl, ki ŋmanni binib. Juu yaab ponn ni bibaa le ŋani kina ki jer biken na.

ref: But you must make them be quiet. They are after money, and they upset whole families by teaching what they should not.
text: Ni ŋan ke aa cha bi ŋmin; ba pu? bi mɔk binib mmɔkm mu kaa ba ye bi mɔk bi na, ki cha ŋidichal ŋibaa ponn ni aanib mɔmɔk yenn. Ŋimombil pu, le bi ŋani kina. Naa ŋan.

ref: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
text: Krete aatiŋ aanib ponn ni ubaa, u nan ye ulankpal na, nan bui ke, “Krete aatiŋ aanib ye binyamɔndam n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la. Bi naahn ipeel i kaa ŋan na la. Bi ye bigbanyakdam, ki ye bipuusakpendam.”

ref: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
text: Ulankpal ngbaan aah len pu na ye mbamɔn la. Nima pu na, kae bi mbamɔm, aan bi li dii Yesu aasan chob,

ref: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
text: ki taa gar Juu yaab aatiin, ki taa gar binib bi yii Yesu aabɔnyaan na aamɔkm.

ref: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
text: Tiwan mɔmɔk bi chain binib bi bi chain na chee la. Binib bi kaa bi chain, kaa gaa Yesu ki kii na, tiwan nibaa aa bi chain ki tii bi. Baalandak mu aa ŋan. Baa ki nyi lituln li ŋan na, ni li kaa ŋan na.

ref: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
text: Bi len ke bi nyi Uwumbɔr, le baah tun pu na mɔk ke baa nyi u. Uwumbɔr aa gee baah ŋani pu na. Baa kii waamɔb, kaa ŋmaa tun litunyaan libaa.

ref: Titus, you must teach only what is correct.
text: Sin ma kan, mɔk binib mmɔkm mu ŋan na.

ref: Tell the older men to have self-control and to be serious and sensible. Their faith, love, and patience must never fail.
text: Tuk bininkpiib ke bi li chur bibaa tiwan mɔmɔk ni, ki ŋeer kipak, ki li kpa laasaab, ki li dii Yesu aasan chob, ki li gee binib, ki li kpa limɔr.

ref: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
text: Tuk bipininkpiib mu ke bi li san Uwumbɔr tiwan mɔmɔk ni, ki taa li ye binibiinib, ki taa li ye bidagbiib. Ni ŋan ke bi mɔk mmɔkm mu ŋan na,

ref: so the younger women will be loving wives and mothers.
text: ki mɔk bipininkpisapɔm ke bi li gee bichatiib ni baabim,

ref: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
text: ki li kpa laasaab, ki taa gɔr kidagook, ki li lik lichiln ni aatuln mbamɔm, ki li kpa tibulchinn, ki li keei bichatiib aamɔi, aan ubaa taa bii Uwumbɔr aabɔr.

ref: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.
text: Sur binachipɔm mu ke bi li chur bibaa.

ref: Always set a good example for others. Be sincere and serious when you teach.
text: Sin aabaa mu li ŋani tiwan mɔmɔk chob, aan ki li ye limɔkl ki tii biken. Tuk binib Uwumbɔr aabɔr mbamɔm, ki li kpa laasaab.

ref: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.
text: Li len iliin i bi chob kaa kpa ngalm na, aan udin ubaa taa ŋmaa bii timi. Nima kan, inimɔɔn ga chuu u.

ref: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners
text: Tuk binaagbiib ke bi li keei bidindatiib aamɔi, ki piir bisui tiwan mɔmɔk ni, ki taa kpak bi kinikpakpak,

ref: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior. God's Kindness and the New Life
text: ki taa su baawan, ki li bi mbamɔm tiwan mɔmɔk ni. Bi yaa bi kina kan, baabimbinyaan ga mɔk binib ke Uwumbɔr u gaal timi lir na aasan le ŋan.

ref: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
text: Ba pu? ti kan Uwumbɔr aah kpa tibulchinn pu na. Waabulchinn pu le binib mɔmɔk ga ŋmaa ŋmar.

ref: He taught us to give up our wicked ways and our worldly desires and to live decent and honest lives in this world.
text: Waabulchinn mɔk timi ke ti yii lituln limɔk kaa ŋan na, ki taa ki dii tiwan ni kaa ŋan na aakpeek, ki li chur tibaa mbamɔm, ki li dii mbamɔm, ki li bi Uwumbɔr aah ban pu na dulnyaa wee ni.

ref: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
text: U nan kpo ti pu ke u gaa timi lii ki nyan timi titunwanbir mɔmɔk ni, aan ti li bi chain, ki li ye waanib, ki li ye binib bi aanimbil man ke bi tun litunyaan na.

ref: Teach these things, as you use your full authority to encourage and correct people. Make sure you earn everyone's respect.
text: Uwumbɔr aah tii si tininkpir pu na, tuk binib tibɔr timina, ki pɔɔk bitaakpab, ki sur bi, ki taa cha ubaa lik si fam.

ref: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful
text: Teer bi ke bi li pak kitiŋ aayidam, ni binib bi kpa tininkpir na, ki kii baamɔi, ki gor ke bi tun litunyaan mɔmɔk,

ref: and not say cruel things or argue. They should be gentle and kind to everyone.
text: ki taa bii unii ubaa, ki taa kpak binib kinikpakpak. Bi li kpa kijɔtiik binib biken chee, ki li bi suuna binib mɔmɔk chee.

ref: We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
text: N‑yoonn mbaa timi tibaa nan ye bijɔrb, kaa kii Yesu aamɔb. Kinimbɔŋ nan ŋmann timi la. Tinimbil nan man tiwan ni kaa ŋan na aabɔŋ pu. Tisui aah gee tiwan ni na le ti nan ban. Ti nan gee baka baka aatuln, ki nan kpa lipiipoln, ki nan ye binib bi ubaa aa gee bi na, ki mu nan nan tɔb.

ref: God our Savior showed us how good and kind he is.
text: Le Uwumbɔr u gaal timi lir na mɔk timi waah kpa tibulchinn ki gee timi pu na,

ref: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.
text: ki gaa timi lii. Naa ye timi aatunyaan pu le u gaa timi lii, waanimbaasaln pu le u gaa timi lii. Le Waafuur Nyaan gir ma timi, ki tii timi limɔfapɔln, ki finn tipobil ni.

ref: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.
text: Taah kpaan Yesu Kristo u gaal timi lir na ni na, le Uwumbɔr ŋa timi tibulchinn ki tii timi Waafuur Nyaan.

ref: Jesus treated us much better than we deserve. He made us acceptable to God and gave us the hope of eternal life.
text: Waabulchinn pu le u len ke timi aabɔr ŋan, ki tii timi limakl ke ti ga kan limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
text: Tibɔr ngbaan gbii la. M ban ke aa li tuk binib tibɔr ngbaan n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, aan binib bi gaa Uwumbɔr ki kii na aatafal li bi litunyaan ponn ni. Nimina le ŋan ki kpa tinyoor ki tii binib.

ref: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
text: Yii mbaan mu ye kijɔrk aabaan na, ki taa kpak kinikpakpak niyaajatiib aayimbil pu. Aa taa jaa kijaak, ki taa kpak kinikpakpak Uwumbɔr aakaal aatataa pu. Nimina mɔmɔk ye fam la, kaa kpa tinyoor tibaa.

ref: Warn troublemakers once or twice. Then don't have anything else to do with them.
text: Unii yaa bi ki cha Yesu aanib yakr tɔb chee kan, aa sur u nfum mulee. U yaa kaa di cha kan, yii u.

ref: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
text: Aa bee ke unii u bi kina na yenn a, ki tun titunwanbir. Uma ubaa aatunwanbir le mɔk ke waabɔr bii. Kookoo aasurm

ref: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
text: M yaa cha Atemas, bee Tikikus dan aa chee kan, pɔɔn aabaa ki dan m chee Nikopolis aatiŋ ni; m ŋa nlandak nsui ni ke m ga li bi nima chee kakab yoonn.

ref: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
text: Pɔɔn aabaa ki ter Senas, u ye ubɔjir na, ni Apolos, ke bi piin baasachuln, ki taa cha bi lann baasachuln aawan nibaa.

ref: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
text: Binib bimɔk bi m chee na dooni si. Aa ti doon binib bi gaa Yesu ki kii ki gee timi na. Uwumbɔr ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni mɔmɔk pu. [Amii.]

ref: From Paul, who is in jail for serving Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is like a brother because of our faith. Philemon, you work with us and are very dear to us. This letter is to you
text: Min Pɔɔl u bi kiyondiik ni Yesu Kristo pu na, ni tina aabo Timoti le ŋmee kigbaŋ kee ti tii si Filemonn, u ye timi aatutuŋeer u ti gee u na,

ref: and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.
text: ni Yesu aanib bi kuuni aado na, ni Afia u ye tininkpan na, ni Akipus u ye timi aatutuŋeer Yesu aasan ni na.

ref: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
text: Tite Uwumbɔr ni Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu, ki tii nimi nsuudoon. Filemonn aageehm ni waagaakii

ref: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
text: N‑yoonn mumɔk m mee Maawumbɔr na, m mee u tii si, ki dooni u aa pu;

ref: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
text: ba pu? m ŋun saah tii Tidindaan Yesu naadii, ki gee u ni Uwumbɔr aanib mɔmɔk pu na.

ref: As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us.
text: Saah tii Kristo naadii pu na, le aa nyi tiwanyaan nimɔk ti kpa u pu na, le m mee Uwumbɔr ke nima le ga cha aa yakr tiwanyaan ngbaan tii biken.

ref: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
text: Nna aabo, saah gee binib pu na, nima le tii mi mpopiin sakpen, ki sɔŋ nsui; ba pu? saah ŋani pu na, aa pɔɔk Uwumbɔr aanib aataakpab la. Pɔɔl aah gaŋ Onesimus pu pu na

ref: Christ gives me the courage to tell you what to do.
text: Nima pu na, maah ye Kristo aatutunn na, m ba ga li kpa lipobil ki cha aa ŋa tiwan ni ŋan na,

ref: But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ,
text: tɔ, maah gee si na, nima le m gaŋni si kaakaan. Min Pɔɔl u si Yesu Kristo aasisiiyaan, ki bi kiyondiik ni dandana wee u pu na,

ref: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
text: m gaŋni si ki tii maabo Onesimus; maah bi kiyondiik ni na le m kpaln ute Uwumbɔr aasan ni.

ref: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
text: N‑yoonn mubaa waa nan kpa tinyoor aa chee; le dandana ma u kpa tinyoor aa chee, ni m mu chee.

ref: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
text: M ba gee ke u li bi m chee ki li si saasisiiyaan ki ter mi buyoonn m bi kiyondiik ni tibɔnyaan tee pu na.

ref: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
text: Aa mu yaa kaa kii kan, maan ŋa nibaa see aa kii. Maa ban ke m muk si ke aa ter mi. M ban ke aa ter mi saageehn pu la.

ref: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
text: Nibaakan, u yakr aa chee ni yunn siib, aan u ki gir ni aa chee ki li bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
text: Dandana wee, waa ki bi ke unaagbiija na. U jer unaagbiija. U ye tina aabo u ti gee u na la. M yaa gee u kan, aa ga li gee u ki jer kina; ba pu? u ye saanaagbiija, ki mu ye aana aabo Tidindaan pu.

ref: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
text: Nima pu na, aa yaa len ke m ye saatutuŋeer Uwumbɔr aatuln ponn ni kan, gaa u ke saah ba ga gaa mi pu na.

ref: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
text: U yaa nan koo saataani ni, bee u yaa joo saapɔln kan, cha ni li ye maapɔln.

ref: With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life.
text: Min Pɔɔl le di ŋŋaal ki ŋmee kina, m ga pa tii si. Maan len ke saapɔln li bi m chee na le ye saamɔfal.

ref: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
text: Nna aabo, taah kpaan Tidindaan ni na, piir nsui, ki pɔɔk ntaakpab uma Kristo pu.

ref: Please get a room ready for me. I hope your prayers will be answered, and I can visit you.
text: Ni gur na le ye ke m ban ke aa toor nkookoo yaan ki siin mi. Naah bi mee Uwumbɔr ki tii mi na, m kpa limakl ke u ga cha m gir ni ni chee. Kookoo aadoon

ref: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
text: Epafras u mu bi m chee kiyondiik ni, Yesu Kristo pu na, dooni si.

ref: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
