text: Nwiin yaa puu ki toŋ kan, le timoor ga yɔl, le mmopuun gbaar, kaa ki kpa kinyaan. Kina le biwankpadam mu ga kpo, ki cha baawan mɔmɔk. Ntɔŋ aabɔr

ref: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.
text: Tɔ, unii u kan ntɔŋ ki kpa limɔr na, Uwumbɔr aanyoor bi u pu. Ba pu? u yaa kan ntɔŋ ki si mbamɔm kan, u ga kan ipiin i ye limɔfal li Uwumbɔr nan puu tipuur ke u ga tii binib bi gee u na.

ref: Don't blame God when you are tempted! God cannot be tempted by evil, and he doesn't use evil to tempt others.
text: Unii yaa kan ntɔŋ kan, u taa len ke Uwumbɔr le tɔŋ u; ba pu? Uwumbɔr aa gee titunwanbir, ki mu aa tɔŋni unii ubaa.

ref: We are tempted by our own desires that drag us off and trap us.
text: Unii aakpeek yaa cha u ban ke u nya Uwumbɔr aasan ponn ni ki tun usui aah gee pu na kan, nima le cha u kani ntɔŋ.

ref: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.
text: Kikpeek yaa dek lipuul kan, ki maa titunwanbir la; titunwanbir yaa chikr kan, ti maa nkun la.

ref: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
text: Nnaabitiib bi m gee bi na, ni taa ŋmann nibaa.

ref: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father who created all the lights in the heavens. He is always the same and never makes dark shadows by changing.
text: Ipiin imɔk ŋan ki ye mbamɔm na nyan ni paacham la. I nyan ni Tite Uwumbɔr u nan naan iwiihn imɔk bi paacham na chee la. Uma le aa kpelni ke nwiin ni uŋmal aah kpelni pu na, kaa kpa mbɔmbɔɔn.

ref: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth. Hearing and Obeying
text: U tii timi waabɔr ti ye mbamɔn na, ki ŋa timi waabim. Waageehn le na. U ban ke ti jer waah naan tiwan ni mɔmɔk na. Pel ki ŋa

ref: My dear friends, you should be quick to listen and slow to speak or to get angry.
text: Nnaabitiib bi m gee bi na, ni bee nimina la. Ni ŋan ke unii mɔmɔk li gee ke u pel, ki taa len mala, ki taa gee liŋuul mala;

ref: If you are angry, you cannot do any of the good things God wants done.
text: ba pu? binib aaŋuul aa tun Uwumbɔr aatunyaan.

ref: You must stop doing anything immoral or evil. Instead be humble and accept the message planted in you to save you.
text: Nima pu na, ni di cha titunwanbir ni tiwan nimɔk kaa ŋan na, ki li bi suuna, ki gaa tibɔr ti Uwumbɔr di ŋa nisui ni na; tibɔr ngbaan ga gaa nimi lii.

ref: Obey God's message! Don't fool yourselves by just listening to it.
text: Ni li ŋani waamɔboln aah len pu na. Ni yaa pel, ki yaa kaa ŋani kan, ni ŋmanni nibaa la.

ref: If you hear the message and don't obey it, you are like people who stare at themselves in a mirror
text: Unii yaa pel tibɔr ngbaan ki yaa kaa ŋani taah len pu na kan, u bi le ke unii u lik kinimbilikr ni, ki waa unimbil wɔb aah bi pu na.

ref: But you must never stop looking at the perfect law that sets you free. God will bless you in everything you do, if you listen and obey, and don't just hear and forget.
text: Tɔ, unii yaa dakl lik nkaal mu ye mbamɔm ki gaal timi lir na, ki yaa beenin dii mu, ki yaa kaa ye unii u pel ki sulni na kan, ki ye unii u ŋani mu aah len pu na kan, Uwumbɔr ga ŋa tinyoor ŋa udaan ngbaan aatuln pu.

ref: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.
text: Unii yaa len ke u dii Uwumbɔr aasan, u yaa kaa chuu ulambil kan, u ŋmanni ubaa la. Waa dii le na. Ni ye fam la.

ref: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
text: Unii yaa ter nkpobim ni bikpopiib baabɔr ni, ki yaa joo ubaa chain, ki di cha titunwanbir mɔmɔk kan, uma le dii Tite Uwumbɔr mbamɔm, ki bi chain Uwumbɔr aanimbil ni.

ref: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.
text: Nnaabitiib, ni tii Tidindaan Yesu Kristo u yeh mpakm na naadii la. Naah tii u naadii pu na, ni taa pak ubaa ki jer uken.

ref: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.
text: Unii u ŋmaa salmaa aabɔmbik ki pee tiwanyaan na yaa koo naah dooni Uwumbɔr kidiik ki ponn ni na, aan ugiin u pee tiwanchar na mu yaa koo ni kan,

ref: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.
text: ni yaa pak unii u pee tiwanyaan na, ki bui u ke, “Kal do lijal li ŋan na pu,” ki bui ugiin ngbaan ke, “Sil nima,” bee aa bui u ke, “Kal kitiŋ ntaa chee,” kan,

ref: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.
text: nima le mɔk ke ni kpa imaagann, ki dak ilandak i kaa ŋan na ki ŋaŋni binib la.

ref: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.
text: Nnaabitiib bi m gee bi na, ni li pel man. Uwumbɔr nyan binib bi ye bigiim dulnyaa wee ni na ke bi gaa u ki kii ki li ye biwankpadam u chee, ki ji nnaan mu Uwumbɔr nan puu tipuur ke u ga tii binib bi gee u na.

ref: You mistreat the poor. But isn't it the rich who boss you around and drag you off to court?
text: Nimi le lik bigiim fam. Bilabi muk nimi ki joo nimi tii bibɔjirb? Naa ye biwankpadam aa?

ref: Aren't they the ones who make fun of your Lord?
text: Bima le seei Kristo u tii nimi waayimbinyaan na.

ref: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.
text: Uwumbɔr aanaan aakaal mu bi waagbaŋ ni na le ye ke, “Aa li gee aana aabo ke saah gee aabaa pu na.” Ni yaa sil ŋani kina kan, nima le ŋan.

ref: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.
text: Ni mu yaa pak ubaa ki jer uken kan, ni tun titunwanbir la. Uwumbɔr aakaal galn nimi ke ni bii mu la.

ref: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.
text: Unii yaa bii nkaal mubaa baanja kan, u bii ikaal mɔmɔk le na.

ref: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.
text: Uwumbɔr u len ke “Taa gɔr kidagook” na, uma le len ke, “Taa ku unii.” Aa yaa kaa gɔr kidagook, ki yaa ku unii kan, aa bii ikaal mɔmɔk le na.

ref: Speak and act like people who will be judged by the law that sets us free.
text: Ni li nyi naah len pu na, ni naah tun lituln pu na; ba pu? Uwumbɔr ga ji nimi tibɔr, nkaal mu gaal binib lir na aah dii pu na.

ref: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
text: Unii u kaa san binib kinimbaak na, Uwumbɔr ga ji u tibɔr, kaan san u mu kinimbaak. Unii u san biken kinimbaak na, Uwumbɔr ga san u mu kinimbaak. Li tun saagaakii aah mɔk pu na

ref: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
text: Nnaabitiib, unii yaa len ke u gaa Yesu ki kii, u yaa kaa tun litunyaan kan, ni kpa tinyoor aa? U yaa gaa Yesu ki kii kina kan, nima le ga cha u ŋmar aa?

ref: If you know someone who doesn't have any clothes or food,
text: Tina aabo ubaa yaa kaa kpa tiwanpeenkaan, kaa kpa tijikaar kan,

ref: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
text: ni ponn ni ubaa yaa bui u ke, “Uwumbɔr ter si, ki tii si tiwanpeenkaan, ki kpiin si,” kaa tii u waah lann pu na kan, ni kpa tinyoor aa?

ref: Faith that doesn't lead us to do good deeds is all alone and dead!
text: Aa yaa len ke aa gaa Yesu ki kii ki yaa kaa tun litunyaan kan, ni ye yɔli le na.

ref: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
text: Unii yaa len ke, “Ubaa gaa Yesu ki kii la, ubaa mu tun litunyaan la,” m mu ga bui u, “Aa yaa kaa tun lituln nyaan kan, saan ŋmaa len ke aa gaa Yesu ki kii. Maatunyaan mu le ga mɔk si ke m gaa Yesu ki kii.”

ref: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
text: Aa pak ke Uwumbɔr baan le bi. Nima le ŋan. Kinimbɔŋ mu pak kina, le ki san ijawaan pam.

ref: Does some stupid person want proof that faith without deeds is useless?
text: Si ujɔr, cha m tuk si, aa yaa len ke aa gaa Uwumbɔr ki kii, kaa tun litunyaan kan, ni ye yɔli la.

ref: Well, our ancestor Abraham pleased God by putting his son Isaac on the altar to sacrifice him.
text: Tiyaaja Abraham nan tun litunyaan. Nima le nan mɔk ke waabɔr ŋan Uwumbɔr chee; ba pu? u nan di ujapɔɔn Aisak ki di paan kitork aabimbiln paab, u di toor kitork tii Uwumbɔr.

ref: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
text: Ni kan ke waah gaa Uwumbɔr ki kii pu na, le u tun litunyaan. Waatunyaan ngbaan mɔk ke u gaa Uwumbɔr ki kii mbamɔm.

ref: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
text: Le ni gbiin Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ aah len pu na ke, “Abraham nan gaa Uwumbɔr aamɔboln ki kii, kina pu na le Uwumbɔr gaa u ke u ye uninyaan u chee.” Le Uwumbɔr yin u ke ujɔ.

ref: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
text: Ni kan ke Uwumbɔr ga len ke unii aabɔr ŋan litunyaan pu, naa ye naadii baanja pu.

ref: For example, Rahab had been a prostitute. But she pleased God when she welcomed the spies and sent them home by another way.
text: Kina le Rahab u nan ye upiidagoor na nan chann Josua aatutum tichann, ki tuk bi ke bi dii nsan yayan aan baadim taa kan bi. Nima pu le waabɔr nan ŋan Uwumbɔr chee.

ref: Anyone who doesn't breathe is dead, and faith that doesn't do anything is just as dead!
text: Tiwon ti kaa kpa nwiin na, ti kpo le na, kina le naadii u kaa kpa litunyaan na mu kpo.

ref: My friends, we should not all try to become teachers. In fact, teachers will be judged more strictly than others.
text: Nnaabitiib, bimɔmɔkb taa li wiir; ba pu? ni nyi ke timi bi ye bimɔmɔkb na, Uwumbɔr ga ji timi tibɔr ki jer biken.

ref: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
text: Ba pu? ti mɔmɔk yenni sakpen. Unii yaa kaa yenni waabɔlen ponn ni kan, uma le ye unibamɔnn, ki ga ŋmaa chuu tiwon mɔmɔk ti taa ŋa bakaa.

ref: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.
text: Ti joo itangar ŋani itaan aamɔi ni, ke i kii tii timi. Le ti ga ŋmaa cha i dii taah ban pu na.

ref: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
text: Lik iŋɔsakpiin aah bi pu na. I ye isakpiin la. Le libuln li pɔɔ na daar i joo cha laah cha ni wɔb na. Bi mu ki joo tiŋɔpann waatiir ŋaal i, ki cha i dii buŋɔŋaab aah ban ni wɔb na.

ref: Our tongues are small too, and yet they brag about big things. It takes only a spark to start a forest fire!
text: Kina le lilambil mu ye tiwan waatiir tiwon ponn ni, ki puk tipupuk sakpen. Lik, mmii waatiir aah ga ŋmaa wu kichoosakpeŋ pu na.

ref: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
text: Le lilambil ye mmii ki ye tiwan ni kaa ŋan na timi aawon ni, ki ga ŋmaa bii tiwon mɔmɔk, ki wu binib aabimbin. Lilambil aamii nyan ni kinimbɔŋ chee la.

ref: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
text: Binib ga ŋmaa tiŋ ipeel aabɔŋ mɔmɔk, ni inyoon aabɔŋ mɔmɔk, ni tiwan ni baar na aabɔŋ mɔmɔk, ni ijan aabɔŋ mɔmɔk. Bi ga ŋmaa tiŋ ni mɔmɔk aabɔŋ.

ref: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
text: Ubaa mu aan ŋmaa tiŋ lilambil. Li ye tiwan ni kaa ŋan, kaa fuur na, le ki gbii liluul.

ref: My dear friends, with our tongues we speak both praises and curses. We praise our Lord and Father, and we curse people who were created to be like God, and this isn't right.
text: Bumɔb buchachaan ngbaan le pak Uwumbɔr, le ki ki len tibɔbir. Nnaabitiib, naa ŋan ke ni li ŋani kina.

ref: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
text: Nnyun mu mɔ na, ni mu kaa mɔ na, ga ŋmaa nya nnyunbun baan ni ii?

ref: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
text: Likakaln ga ŋmaa lu tikpasɔnn aa? Lichachar ga ŋmaa lu ŋikakanbil aa? Kina le nnyun mu diin na ni mu mɔ na mɔmɔk aa ŋmaa li bi nnyunbubaan ni. Nlan mu nyan ni paacham na

ref: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
text: Tɔ, unii ubaa bi ni ponn ni ki kpa nlan ni ŋuntii ii? Ni ŋan ke waabimbinyaan le mɔk ke u kpa. U li bi suuna, ki li kpa nlan, ki tun litunyaan.

ref: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
text: Tɔ, lipiipoln ni kinikpakpak yaa bi nisui ni kan, ni taa li kpa kipupuk ke ni kpa nlan, ki taa mɔn nnyamɔn ki paan mbamɔn pu.

ref: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
text: Nlan mumina aaboln aa nyan ni Uwumbɔr chee. Mu ye dulnyaa wee ni aalan la. Naa ye Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aalan. Mu ye kinimbɔŋ aalan la.

ref: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
text: Ba pu? lipiipoln ni kinikpakpak aah bi nin chee na, tijar ni lituln li kaa ŋan na mɔmɔk bi nima chee la.

ref: But the wisdom that comes from above leads us to be pure, friendly, gentle, sensible, kind, helpful, genuine, and sincere.
text: Le unii u kpa nlan mu nyan ni Uwumbɔr chee na, u bi chain, ki kpa nsuudoon, ni mbimbisuuna, ki ŋun tii binib, ki kpa linimbaasaln sakpen, ki tun litunyaan sakpen, kaa kpa imaagann, ki ye mbamɔndaan.

ref: When peacemakers plant seeds of peace, they will harvest justice.
text: Binib bi par kijaak na le joo ni nsuudoon, ki ga kan tinyoor ti ye mbimbinyaan na.

ref: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
text: Tɔ, butɔb ni kijaak ki bi nikaasisik ni na, ni nyan ni la chee? Naa ye nimi aakpeek le jaa kijaak nisui ni ii?

ref: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
text: Ninimbil man tiwan pu la, le naa kpa. Nima le ni ku binib. Tiwan aakpeek bi nisui ni la, le naa ŋmaa kan ni, nima le ni jaa kijaak, le ki to butɔb. Naah kaa mee Uwumbɔr ke u tii nimi na, nima le naa kpa.

ref: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.
text: Ni mee Uwumbɔr ke u tii nimi tiwan ni kaa ŋan u chee na, nima pu le naa kan. Ni mee u ki ban tiwan ni ga ku nimi aakpeek na la.

ref: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
text: Ni di Uwumbɔr lii a, ke upiidagoor aah di uchal di lii pu na. Naa nyi ke dulnyaa aajɔtiik le ye Uwumbɔr aadiŋ aa? Nima pu na, unii u ban dulnyaa aajɔtiik na, u ye Uwumbɔr aadin la.

ref: Do you doubt the Scriptures that say, “God truly cares about the Spirit he has put in us”?
text: Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ len ke, “Unii yaa joo waawiin dooni tiwan ki cha Uwumbɔr kan, Uwumbɔr kpa lipiipoln sakpen a.” Ni dak ke ni len kina fam la aa?

ref: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, “God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.”
text: Tɔ, Uwumbɔr tii timi nterm ki jer kina, le waagbaŋ len ke, “Uwumbɔr yiil kalmbaanidam, le ki lik faar binib bi sunni bibaa taab na.”

ref: Surrender to God! Resist the devil, and he will run from you.
text: Nima pu na, ni kii Uwumbɔr aamɔb man. Ni yii kinimbɔŋ man, le ki ga san nya ni chee.

ref: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
text: Ni foor malni Uwumbɔr man, le u mu ga foor mal nimi. Nimi titunwanbirdam, di nimi aatunwanbir lii man. Nimi bi ban ni dii dulnyaa aasan, ni Uwumbɔr aasan mu na, toor nisui man.

ref: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.
text: Ni li kpa mpombiin nimi aatunwanbir pu, ki li wii. Cha nimi aalaar kpaln iwiil. Cha nimi aapopiin kpaln mpombiin.

ref: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
text: Ni sunn nibaa taab man Tidindaan aanimbiin ni, le u ga nyuŋ nimi. Ni taa galni tɔb man

ref: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
text: Nnaabitiib, ni taa bii tɔb. Unii yaa bii una aabo ki yaa galn u kan, u bii Uwumbɔr aakaal ki galn mu la. Aa yaa galn nkaal ngbaan kan, saa ye unii u ŋani nkaal aah len pu na, aa ye unii u galni mu la.

ref: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone? Warning against Bragging
text: Uwumbɔr baanja le ye u tii timi nkaal na, ki ye nkaal Aadindaan, ki ye u ji binib tibɔr na. Uma baanja le ga ŋmaa gaa timi lii, ki ga ŋmaa bii timi. Aa ye ŋma ki galn aaŋeen aatɔ? Kipupuk aabɔr

ref: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
text: Li pel man, nimi bi len ke, “Din, ke nibaakan fen, ti ga fe buen kitiŋ kibaa ni, ki ti ŋa nima libiln libaa, ki daa tiwan, ki ŋa kitiirk ki kan tinyoor,”

ref: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
text: naa nyi tiwan ni ga fe ŋa fen na. Nimi aamɔfal bi kinye? Li naahn likpakpal li ŋub siib ki ki kpaan woln na la.

ref: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
text: Le ni tee kpa kalmbaani ki puk kipupuk. Ni yaa puk kipupuk kina kan, naa ŋan.

ref: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
text: Nima pu na, unii yaa nyi lituln li ŋan na, kaa ŋani li kan, u tun titunwanbir le na.

ref: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
text: Nimi biwankpadam, ni li pel man. Ni li wii ki li kaani falaa u ga pii nimi na pu.

ref: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
text: Nimi aawankpal bii a. Ŋikpaambil moo nimi aakeken a.

ref: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.
text: Ni di ŋimombil bil, le ŋi daŋ a. Ŋaah daŋ pu na, nima le mɔk ke nimi aabɔr bii a, ki ga ji nimi aawon ke mmii na. Naah kuun liwankpal li wiir na bil na, ni kuun ntafadaan mu wiir ki ga pii nimi kookoo aataadaal na la.

ref: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
text: Ni ji bitutum bi chee tijikaar tii nimi na pem pem, kaa pa bi. Le bi bi ki wii baapal pu. Le Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan ŋun baah wii pu na.

ref: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.
text: Ni bi dulnyaa wee ni, ki piir nisui, ki ŋani naah gee pu na mɔmɔk, ki kpiini nibaa ki filk sakpen a; ni bi ke inaa i filk aan bi kɔr i na la.

ref: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who couldn't even fight back. Be Patient and Kind
text: Nimi le bii bininyaam ki ku bi, le baa kpa mpɔɔn bi nyan bibaa nimi aaŋaal ni. Limɔr ni limeel

ref: My friends, be patient until the Lord returns. Think of farmers who wait patiently for the autumn and spring rains to make their valuable crops grow.
text: Nnaabitiib, nima pu na, ni li kpa limɔr ki ti saa bundaln Tidindaan ga gir ni na. Lik man, ukpaal aah kpa limɔr pu ki kii buyoonn waasaak ga nan ŋa tijikaar nyaan na. U kpa limɔr ki kii unaalantaal ni utakuutaal aah ga nan nu pu na.

ref: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
text: Ni mu li kpa limɔr man, ki pɔɔk nitaakpab; ba pu? buyoonn Tidindaan ga gir ni na peeni.

ref: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
text: Nnaabitiib, ni taa ŋulni tɔb pu man aan Uwumbɔr taa ji nimi tibɔr. Ni gur siib, u ga ji binib tibɔr.

ref: My friends, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They were patient, even when they had to suffer.
text: Nnaabitiib, bibɔnabr bi nan len Uwumbɔr aayimbil ni na, ni lik baah nan jin falaa ki kpa limɔr pu na, ni ye limɔkl le ki tii nimi.

ref: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
text: Binib bi kpa limɔr falaa ponn ni ki ti saa naadoon na, bima le ti len ke bi kan Uwumbɔr aanyoor. Ni ŋun Job aah nan kpa limɔr falaa ponn ni pu na, ki kan Uwumbɔr aah nan ter u pu falaa ngbaan aapuwɔb na. Ni kan ke Uwumbɔr kpa linimbaasaln sakpen, ki san binib kinimbaak.

ref: My friends, above all else, don't take an oath. You must not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. “Yes” or “No” is all you need to say. If you say anything more, you will be condemned.
text: Nnaabitiib, ni jer ni mɔmɔk na le ye ke ni taa puu nibaa pu. Ni taa puu paacham pu, ki taa puu kitiŋ pu, ki taa puu tiwan nibaa pu. Ni po len ke “Een,” bee “Aayii,” ki len mbamɔn. Ni yaa po len kina kan, Uwumbɔr aan daa nitafal.

ref: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.
text: Ni ponn ni ubaa yaa kpa falaa kan, u li mee Uwumbɔr. Ni ponn ni ubaa yaa kpa mpopiin kan, u li gaa ilahn ki pak Uwumbɔr.

ref: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
text: Ni ponn ni ubaa yaa bun kan, cha u yin Yesu aanib aaninkpiib, ke bi dan ki nan mee Uwumbɔr tii u, ki di nkpan meen u, Tidindaan aayimbil pu.

ref: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
text: Bi yaa mee Uwumbɔr ki pak ke u ga tii u laafee kan, mmeen ngbaan le ga cha ubun ngbaan pɔɔk, le Tidindaan ga fiin u. U yaa tun titunwanbir kan, u ga di cha pinn u.

ref: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
text: Nima pu na, ni kpiir nimi aatunwanbir ki tuk tɔb, ki mee Uwumbɔr tii tɔb, aan u tii nimi laafee. Unii u dii Uwumbɔr aasan mbamɔm na yaa mee Uwumbɔr linimaln kan, waameel kpa mpɔɔn sakpen.

ref: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
text: Elaija nan ye unibɔn ke ti mu aah ye pu na la. Le u mee Uwumbɔr linimaln ke utaal taa nu. Le ŋibin ŋitaa ni iŋmal iloob utaal aa nan nun kitiŋ ngbaan ni.

ref: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.
text: Le u ki mee Uwumbɔr, le utaal nun, le tijikaar ŋa.

ref: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.
text: Nnaabitiib, ni ponn ni ubaa yaa yenn mbamɔn aasan chee kan, unii yaa giin u mbamɔn chee kan,

ref: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
text: u bee ke unii u giin titunwanbirdaan waah yenn pu na, u nyan waamɔfal nkun ni la, ki cha Uwumbɔr di cha pinn titunwanbir pam.

ref: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
text: Tite Uwumbɔr nan nyan nimi waageehn pu, ki cha Waafuur Nyaan ŋa nimi chain, ni li keei Yesu Kristo aamɔb, aan Uwumbɔr di cha pinn nimi Yesu aasin pu. Uwumbɔr ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu, ki tii nimi nsuudoon pam. Limakl li bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na

ref: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
text: Cha ti pak Uwumbɔr u ye Tidindaan Yesu Kristo Aate na; ba pu? u san timi kinimbaak sakpen a, ki gir ma timi lelee, ki di timi ŋa waabim. U nan fikr Yesu Kristo nkun ni. Nima le ti kpa limakl li bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na.

ref: God has something stored up for you in heaven, where it will never decay or be ruined or disappear.
text: Ti mak ke ti ga sil kan tinyoor ti Uwumbɔr di siin paacham kiir timi na. Tinyoor ngbaan aan ŋmaa bii, kaan ŋmaa wɔŋ, kaan doo.

ref: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
text: Naah gaa Yesu ki kii na, nima le Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn biin ni pu, ki ti saa buyoonn ni ga kan waah ga gaa nimi lii mbamɔm pu na, kookoo aataadaal.

ref: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.
text: Nima le ni kpa mpopiin. Ni yaa po kpa mpombiin ni yunn siib dandana wee, falaa aabɔŋ ponn ni kan, ni li kpa mpopiin;

ref: Your faith will be like gold that has been tested in a fire. And these trials will prove that your faith is worth much more than gold that can be destroyed. They will show that you will be given praise and honor and glory when Jesus Christ returns.
text: ba pu? falaa ngbaan ga mɔk ke ni gaa Yesu ki kii mbamɔm aan naa gaa. Naah gaa u ki kii pu na jer salmaa u ga bii na. Bi joo salmaa pu mmii ponn ni ke bi lik ke u ŋan aan waa ŋan. Kina le Uwumbɔr cha ni ji falaa ke u lik ke ni gaa u ki kii mbamɔm aan naa gaa. Ni yaa gaa u ki kii mbamɔm kan, le ni ga kan mpakm ni nnyuŋ bundaln Yesu Kristo ga nyan ubaa mpaan pu na.

ref: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
text: Naa kee kan u, le ni gee u. Ninimbil aa waa u dandana wee, le ni gaa u ki kii. Nima le ni kpa mpopiin sakpen, ki pak Uwumbɔr, kaa ŋmaa len naah kpa mpopiin ki ti saa pu na.

ref: you are to be saved. This is why you have faith.
text: Naah gaa Yesu ki kii na, le u gaa nimi lii.

ref: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
text: Tɔ, n‑yaayoonn na aabɔnabtiib bi nan tuk binib Uwumbɔr aah ga ter nimi pu na, nan dakl lik mbamɔm, ki ban ke bi bee Uwumbɔr aah ga ŋa pu ki gaa binib lii na.

ref: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
text: Le Kristo Aafuur Nyaan mu nan bi bibɔnabr ngbaan ponn ni na mɔk bi ke uma Kristo ga ji falaa, le ki nin kan nnyuŋ falaa ngbaan aapuwɔb. Le bi nan ban bi bee ke ulau ga ji falaa ngbaan, ki ban bi bee buyoonn u ga ji falaa ngbaan na.

ref: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
text: Le Uwumbɔr nan mɔk bi ke baah len tibɔr ti na, baa len ke bi ter bima bibaa, bi len ke bi ter nimi la. Le ni ŋun tibɔr ngbaan dandana wee. Uwumbɔr cha Waafuur Nyaan nyan ni paacham ki tii binib mpɔɔn bi tuk nimi tibɔnyaan tee. Tibɔnyaan timina le Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib ban ke bi bee taatataa. Ni li bi chain man

ref: Be alert and think straight. Put all your hope in how God will treat you with undeserved grace when Jesus Christ appears.
text: Nima pu na, ni li dak ilandak i ŋan na, ki li chur nibaa, ki li kpa limakl n‑yoonn mɔmɔk; ba pu? Yesu Kristo yaa nyan ubaa mpaan pu kan, u ga ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu la.

ref: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
text: Ni li keei Uwumbɔr aamɔb. Buyoonn naa nan kee nyi nsan mu ŋan na, le ni nan dii nisui aah gee pu na. Ni taa ki dii kina.

ref: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
text: Cha nimi aabimbin mɔmɔk li bi chain, ke Uwumbɔr u yin nimi na aabimbin aah bi chain pu na.

ref: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
text: Ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke Uwumbɔr bui nimi, “Min Uwumbɔr bi chain la; nima pu na, ni mu li bi chain man.”

ref: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
text: Ni yaa mee Uwumbɔr kan, ni yin u ke Nite la. Nima pu na, ni li san u buyoonn ni bi na; ba pu? waa pak ubaa ki jer uken. U ga ji binib mɔmɔk aabɔr baah tun pu na.

ref: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
text: Niyaajatiib nan bi mbimbin yɔl yɔl ponn ni. Ni nyi ke u gaa nimi lii ki nyan nimi mbimbin ngbaan ponn ni. Naa ye tiwan ni ga bii ke ŋimombil na, le u di pan ki gaa nimi lii.

ref: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
text: Uwumbɔr aa nan kee naan dulnyaa le ki nyan Kristo ke u li ye kitork ngbaan. Naah nan ŋeer na, le u dan dulnyaa wee ni, nimi pu.

ref: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
text: U pu, le ni gaa Uwumbɔr ki kii. U nan fikr u nkun ni ki nyuŋ u. Nima pu le ni gaa Uwumbɔr ki kii ki kpa limakl.

ref: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
text: Ni kii Uwumbɔr aabɔr ti gbii na la. Nima le cha nimi aabimbin bi chain. Le ni sil gee ninaabitiib. Nima pu na, ni li beenin gee tɔb mbamɔm.

ref: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
text: Ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke, “Binib mɔmɔk bi ke timoor na la. Baanyaan bi ke mmopuun na la. Timoor yɔl mala, le mmopuun mu gbaar,

ref: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
text: Uwumbɔr aamɔboln ma ga li bi ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.” Limɔboln ngbaan le ye tibɔnyaan ti bi tuk nimi na.

ref: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
text: Nima pu na, ni taa ki li kpa kinanaŋ, ki taa ki ŋmanni tɔb, ki taa li ye binib bi ŋmanni ke bi ŋan na, ki taa li kpa lipiipoln, ki taa li bii binib.

ref: Come to Jesus Christ. He is the living stone people have rejected, but which God has chosen and highly honored.
text: Dan Tidindaan u ye limɔfadaan na chee man. U naahn litakpal li bidimaab yii li na la. Le Uwumbɔr lee u ke u ŋan sakpen.

ref: And now you are living stones being used to build a spiritual house. You are also a group of holy priests, and with the help of Jesus Christ you will offer sacrifices that please God.
text: Ni mu bi ke ŋitakpal ŋi kpa limɔfal na. Uwumbɔr di nimi maa lidichal ke Waafuur Nyaan li bi li ni. U ban ke ni li ye uma ubaa aatotoorb, ki li tun waatuln, Waafuur Nyaan aapɔɔn pu. Yesu Kristo pu, le u ga gaa nimi aatuln ngbaan.

ref: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.”
text: Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ len ke, “Lik, m lee litakpal li ŋan na ki di bil Sionn aatiŋ ni. M di litakpal ngbaan ki di siin kaalɔlɔŋ ni, le unii umɔk gaa u ki kii na aan ji inimɔɔn.”

ref: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
text: Nimi bi gaa u ki kii na, u ŋan ni chee sakpen la. Le binib bi kaa gaa u ki kii na, bi li nyi ke Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ len ke, “Litakpal li bidimaab yii li na, lima le ye litakpajal,”

ref: But you are God's chosen and special people. You are a group of royal priests and a holy nation. God has brought you out of darkness into his marvelous light. Now you must tell all the wonderful things he has done. The Scriptures say,
text: Tɔ, nimi bi gaa Uwumbɔr ki kii na le ye waanileekaam. Ni ye Uwumbɔr u ye Ubɔrkpaan na aatotoorb, ki ye litimbol li bi chain na, ki sil ye Uwumbɔr aanib. U lee nimi ke ni li tuk binib waah ŋan sakpen pu na; ba pu? u nyan nimi mbɔmbɔɔn ni, ki di koon waawiihn mu ŋan sakpen na ni.

ref: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
text: N‑yoonn mbaa naa nan ye Uwumbɔr aanib. Dandana wee ni ye Uwumbɔr aanib la. N‑yoonn mbaa Uwumbɔr aa nan san nimi kinimbaak. Dandana wee u san nimi kinimbaak. Uwumbɔr aatutum

ref: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
text: Maanigeekaab, ni ye biwɔwɔm ni bisachum dulnyaa wee ni la. Nima pu na, m gaŋ nimi, ni taa kii nisui aah gee pu na; ba pu? nisui aah gee pu na kiir nimi Uwumbɔr aasan ni.

ref: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
text: Ni bi binib bi kaa dii Uwumbɔr aasan na aakaasisik ni la. Ni li tun lituln li ŋan na bi chee. Le bi yaa bii nimi ke ni ye bakadam kan, nimi aatunyaan chee bi ga kan ke ni ŋan. Nima le ga cha bi nyuŋ Uwumbɔr bundaln u ga ji binib tibɔr na.

ref: The Lord wants you to obey all human authorities, especially the Emperor, who rules over everyone.
text: Tɔ, ni li keei nimi aaninkpiib mɔmɔk aamɔi Tidindaan pu. Ni li keei nimi aabɔrkpaan u joo binib mɔmɔk na aamɔb.

ref: God wants you to silence stupid and ignorant people by doing right.
text: Uwumbɔr ban ke ni tun litulnyaan aan ki cha bijɔrb bi kaa nyi nibaa ki bii nimi na ŋmin la.

ref: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.
text: Ni bi nibaa pu la. Nima le aa tii nimi nsan ke ni li chuun ŋani bakaa. Ni li bi ke Uwumbɔr aatutum aah ba ga li bi pu na.

ref: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
text: Ni li pak binib mɔmɔk, ki li gee binib bimɔk dii Yesu aasan na, ki li san Uwumbɔr, ki li pak ubɔrkpaan na. Yesu Kristo aafalaa aamɔkl

ref: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
text: Binib bi ye binaagbiib ni ponn ni na, ni li pak nidindatiib mbamɔm, ki li keei baamɔi. Bi yaa ye binibamɔm, bee bi ti ki ye bakadam kan, ni li pak bi.

ref: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
text: Unii u kaa ŋa nibaa na, bi yaa ŋa u falaa aan u yaa ji limɔr Uwumbɔr pu kan, nima le ŋan Uwumbɔr chee.

ref: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
text: Bi yaa gbaa nimi, nimi aatunwanbir pu aan ni yaa ji limɔr kan, nima le aan cha ubaa pak nimi. Ni mu yaa kan falaa nimi aatunyaan pu, ki yaa ji limɔr kan, nima le ga piir Uwumbɔr aasui.

ref: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
text: Ba pu? Uwumbɔr yin nimi bi dii u na ke ni li ji falaa; ba pu? Kristo mu nan jin falaa ni pu. Nima le ye limɔkl ki tii nimi, ke ni li dii waataabuu.

ref: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
text: Waa nan ŋa titunwanbir aatuln libaa, ki mu aa nan mɔn nnyamɔn mubaa.

ref: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
text: Baah seei u na, waa giin sii bi. Waah jin falaa na, waa len ke u ga teen bi. U di ubaa ŋa Uwumbɔr u ji tibɔr mɔmɔk mbamɔm na aaŋaal ni la.

ref: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
text: U nan kpo ndɔpuinkoo pu timi aatunwanbir pu, ki sil timi aasisiiyaan ki gaa timi aatafadaan. Nima pu na, ni di titunwanbir mɔmɔk lii, ki li dii mbimbin mu ŋan na. Waah gaa tigbar ti na pu, le Uwumbɔr tii nimi laafee.

ref: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
text: Ni nan bi ke ipiih i yenn na, le dandana wee, ni gir ni Kristo chee. U kpaa nimi ke upihkpaal aah kpaa ipiih pu na, ki kii nimi aamɔfal.

ref: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
text: Bipiib, ni li keei nichatiib aamɔi. Ni yaa keei baamɔi, aan chatiib yaa bi, kaa kii Uwumbɔr aabɔr kan, nibaakan bi ga gaa u ki kii nimi aabimbinyaan pu. Hali ni yaa kaa len tibaa kan,

ref: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
text: bi ga kan ke ni san Uwumbɔr ki kpa mbimbin mu bi chain na.

ref: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.
text: Bipiib, tiwan ni ga cha ni li ŋan na aa ye tiyikpir ti buu na, kaa ye nleen mu kpa kidaak na, kaa ye tiwanpeenkaan nyaan.

ref: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
text: Tiwan ni ga cha ni li ŋan na le ye mbimbin mu ŋan na. Ni yaa kpa mbimbin suuna kan, nima le ye kinyaan ki kaan fir, ki ŋan sakpen Uwumbɔr chee na.

ref: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
text: N‑yaayoonn na aapiib bi nan bi chain ki kpa limakl Uwumbɔr pu na, nan keei bichatiib aamɔi, nima le nan cha bi kpa kinyaan ki nan ŋan binib chee.

ref: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
text: Sara nan ŋani kina la. U nan keei uchal Abraham aamɔb, ki yin u ke udindaan. Ni yaa tun lituln li ŋan na, ki yaa kaa san ijawaan ibaa Uwumbɔr aasan ni kan, ni kpaln Sara aabisatiib la.

ref: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
text: Bijab, ni mu li nyi naah joo nipuutiib pu na. Bipiib aa kpa mpɔɔn ke bijab aah kpa pu na, nima na, ni li pak bi; ba pu? nimi ni bima le ga kpaan kan Uwumbɔr aapiin i ye limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na. Ni li joo bi mbamɔm, nimi aameel taa ŋa yɔli. Ji mbimbinyaan aafalaa

ref: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.
text: Kookoo aabɔr le ye ke ni mɔmɔk li kpaan kimɔbaan, ki cha nitafal li bi tɔb ni, ki li gee tɔb ke naabitiib na, ki li san tɔb kinimbaak, ki sunn nibaa taab.

ref: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
text: Binib yaa ŋa nimi bakaa kan, ni taa teen bi. Bi yaa sii nimi kan, ni taa sii bi ki teen. Ni bui bi ke, “Uwumbɔr ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu;” ba pu? Uwumbɔr yin nimi ke u ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu la.

ref: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
text: Ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke, “Unii yaa ban ke u li kpa mpopiin, ni mbimbin mu mɔ na kan, u taa ki len tibɔbir, ki taa ki mɔni inyamɔn,

ref: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
text: ki taa ki tun lituln li kaa ŋan na; u tun lituln li ŋan na, ki li ban nsuudoon linimaln;

ref: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
text: ba pu? Tidindaan Uwumbɔr aatafal bi bininyaam ni, ki ŋun baameel n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, le ki yiil binib bi tun titunwanbir na.”

ref: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
text: Tɔ, ninimbil yaa man lituln li ŋan na pu kan, ubaa ga ŋa nimi bakaa aa?

ref: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
text: Ni mu yaa kan falaa lituln li ŋan na pu kan, Uwumbɔr aanyoor bi ni pu la. Ni taa san unii ubaa ijawaan, ki taa cha ilandak li joo nimi.

ref: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
text: Ni li pak Kristo nisui ni, ki di u ŋa Nidindaan. Ni li gor n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, unii yaa nan baa nimi kan, ni ga ŋmaa tuk u naah kpa limakl pu na. Ni tuk u suuna, ki pak Uwumbɔr.

ref: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
text: Ni li ŋani ni ŋan na n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, le naah dii Kristo mbamɔm ki kpa mbimbin mu ŋan na na, nima le ga cha inimɔɔn chuu binib bi sii nimi ki len nimi tibɔbir na.

ref: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
text: Ni yaa ye Uwumbɔr aageehn ke aa ji falaa litunyaan pu kan, ni soor ni aa ji falaa titunwanbir pu.

ref: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
text: Ba pu? Kristo ubaa nan kpo nfum mbaa timi aatunwanbir pu. Kristo u ye uninyaan na nan kpo timi bi ye tiniwanbir na pu, ke u di ti ni Uwumbɔr kpaan. Bi nan ku waawon, le Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan tii u limɔfal,

ref: Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison.
text: le u nan buen ki ti len tibɔnyaan binib aawiin i bi kiyondiik ni, kitekpiitiŋ ni na chee.

ref: They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.
text: Bi nan bi Nowa aayoonn, kaa nan kii Uwumbɔr aamɔb, le u nan jin limɔr bi pu, ki kii n‑yoonn mu Nowa nan ti kpii buŋɔb doo na. Binib biniin baanja le nan koo buŋɔb ngbaan ni, le ki ŋmar nnyun pu.

ref: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
text: Yesu Kristo nan buen paacham ki ti bi Uwumbɔr aaŋangii wɔb. Le Uwumbɔr di waatuuntiib, ni paacham yaab, ni kinimbɔŋ ni kaapɔɔn mɔmɔk ŋa Yesu Kristo aaŋaal ni.

ref: Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning.
text: Tɔ, Kristo aah nan joo unibɔn aawon na, u nan jin falaa. Nima pu na, ni mu kii ke ni ga ji falaa man, ke waah nan kii pu na. Waah nan jin falaa tiwon ponn ni pu na le u nan kuln titunwanbir.

ref: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
text: Nima pu na, naah laa bi dulnyaa wee ni na, ni taa ki kii nisui aah gee pu na, ni li keei Uwumbɔr aah gee pu na.

ref: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
text: Ni nan tun titunwanbir n‑yoonn mu jer na; ni ŋeer kina. Ni nan ŋani ke binib bi kaa nyi Uwumbɔr na aah ŋani pu na, ki dii bipiib, ki dii tiwan ni kaa ŋan na aakpeek, ki nan kuuni tɔb ki nyun ndaan gbii, ki tun lituln li kaa ŋan na, ki dii ŋiwaa ŋi sukr ponn ni na.

ref: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
text: Naah kaa ki kpaani titunwanbirdam ngbaan chee ki ŋani kina na, ni gar bi la, le bi seei nimi.

ref: But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead.
text: Bi ga sil Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni ki len baah tun pu na. U gor ke u ji binib bi fu na, ni binib bi kpo na tibɔr.

ref: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
text: Nima le cha bi nan tuk binib bi kpo na Uwumbɔr aabɔnyaan tee. Bi nan kpo ke unibɔn mɔk aah kpo pu na. Le bi nan tuk bi Uwumbɔr aabɔnyaan tee, ke bi kan nsan ki gaa u ki kii aan baawiin kan Uwumbɔr aamɔfal ki li bi u chee. Ni li ye Uwumbɔr aatutunyaam

ref: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
text: Tɔ, ni gur siib le tiwan mɔmɔk ga doo. Nima pu na, ni li kpa laasaab, ki chur nibaa, ki mee Uwumbɔr.

ref: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
text: Tiwan ni jer tiwan mɔmɔk na le ye ke ni li gee tɔb mbamɔm; ba pu? aa yaa gee unii kan, aa ga di cha pinn u titunwanbir pam.

ref: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
text: Ni li channi tɔb tichann ki taa ŋulni.

ref: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
text: Uwumbɔr tii ni mɔmɔk Waafuur Nyaan aapiin la. Waah tii nimi ipiin aabɔŋ aabɔŋ na, ni di ipiin ngbaan ter biken.

ref: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
text: Uwumbɔr yaa tii unii ipiin ke u len Uwumbɔr aabɔr kan, u teer ke ni ye Uwumbɔr aabɔr le u len. Uwumbɔr yaa tii unii ipiin ke u ter biken kan, u li ter bi Uwumbɔr aah tii u mpɔɔn pu na. Ni li nyuŋni Uwumbɔr tiwan mɔmɔk ni, Yesu Kristo pu. Uma le yeh mpakm ni mpɔɔn n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Amii. Yesu Kristo aadidiliib aah ji falaa pu na

ref: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
text: Ni li kpa mpopiin; ba pu? ni yaa ji falaa u Kristo nan jin na kan, ni ga li kpa mpopiin sakpen bundaln u ga gir ni ki nan mɔk waah nyuun pu na.

ref: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
text: Bi yaa sii nimi Kristo aayimbil pu kan, Uwumbɔr aanyoor bi ni pu la; ba pu? Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan mu ŋan sakpen na bi ni ni. [Bima le seei Kristo, le nima pak u.]

ref: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
text: Le ni ponn ni ubaa yaa jin falaa linikul pu, bee kinaayuk pu, bee baka baka pu, bee libɔbaln pu kan, nima aa ŋan.

ref: Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him.
text: Tɔ, unii yaa jin falaa Yesu Kristo aasan pu kan, u taa cha inimɔɔn li joo u. U li pak Uwumbɔr waah ye Yesu Kristo yoo na pu.

ref: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
text: Ni ŋeer Uwumbɔr piin ki ji binib tibɔr. U ga puen ji waanib le tibɔr, le ki nin ji biken tibɔr. U yaa puen ji timi waanib tibɔr kan, binib bi kaa kii waabɔnyaan na aabɔr ga doo kinye?

ref: “If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God?”
text: Ni ŋmee Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ ni ke, “Ni yaa pɔɔ bininyaam ŋmar kan, titunwanbirdam bi kaa pak Uwumbɔr na ga tee ŋa kinye ki ŋmar?”

ref: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
text: Nima pu na, unii yaa ji falaa Uwumbɔr aageehn pu kan, u li tun lituln li ŋan na, ki di ubaa ŋa Uwumbɔr u nan naan u ki ye mbamɔndaan na aaŋaal ni.

ref: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
text: Tɔ, m ye Yesu aanib aaninkpel, ki nan kan Kristo aah jin falaa pu na, ki tuk binib kina. M mu ga ji waamɔɔn mu ga nya mpaan pu na. Nima pu na, m gaŋ nimi bi ye Yesu aanib aaninkpiib na,

ref: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
text: ni li ter Uwumbɔr aanib bi bi nido na, ke upihkpaal aah lik waapiih pu na. Ni taa ter bi limukl aaterm. Ni li ter bi nimi aageehn, Uwumbɔr aah ban pu na. Ni taa ter bi ŋimombil pu, ni li ter bi ni mpopiin.

ref: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
text: Uwumbɔr di bi ŋa niŋaal ni la. Ni taa ŋani ke naah ye bidindatiib le na. Cha nimi aabimbinyaan mɔk bi baah ga dii pu na.

ref: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
text: Ni yaa ŋani kina kan, buyoonn upihkpaaninkpel ga gir ni na, ni ga kan lipal li mɔ sakpen ki ga li bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say, “God opposes proud people, but he helps everyone who is humble.”
text: Nimi bi kaa por na, ni li keei binib bi kpeln nimi na aamɔb. Ni mɔmɔk li sunni nibaa taab, ki li ter tɔb. Ba pu? Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ len ke, “Uwumbɔr yiil kalmbaanidam, le ki lik faar binib bi sunni bibaa taab na.”

ref: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
text: Nima pu na, ni li sunni nibaa taab, Uwumbɔr u yeh mpɔɔn mɔmɔk na aaŋaal ni. Le ni yaa nan ŋeer kan, u ga nyuŋ nimi.

ref: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
text: Limukl limɔk muk nimi na kan, ni di li mɔmɔk ŋa Uwumbɔr aaŋaal ni; ba pu? utafal bi ni ni.

ref: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
text: Ni li kpa laasaab ki li nyi; ba pu? kinimbɔŋ ki ye nimi aadin na chuun gonni, ki ban ke ni di Uwumbɔr aasan lii. Ki bi ke uchinn u chuun tar, ki ban unii u ki ga chuu ki ŋmɔ na la.

ref: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
text: Ni yii u man. Ni gaa Uwumbɔr ki kii mbamɔm man, ki taa di cha. Ni nyi ke ninaabitiib bi bi dulnyaa wee ni na mu bi ji falaa ke naah ji pu na la.

ref: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
text: Ni yaa ji falaa ni yunn siib kan, Uwumbɔr ga ter nimi, ki tii nimi mpɔɔn ni li dii u mbamɔm, ki taa gir puwɔb. Ba pu? nterm mɔmɔk nyan ni uma le chee. U nan yin nimi Kristo pu, ke ni nan ji waamɔɔn n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
text: Uma le yeh mpɔɔn mɔmɔk n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Amii. Kookoo aadoon

ref: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
text: Tɔ, m nyi ke Silfanus, u ye tina aabo na, bi mbamɔm la. Uma le ter mi le m ŋmee kigbaŋ waatiir kimina tii nimi ki pɔɔk nitaakpab, ki tuk nimi mbamɔn ke maah ŋmee pu na le ye Uwumbɔr aabɔr, ki ye mbamɔn. Ni taa di ti lii.

ref: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
text: Yesu aanib bi bi Babiloŋ aatiŋ ni na dooni nimi. Bi ye binib bi Uwumbɔr nyan bi na. Maabo Mak mu dooni nimi.

ref: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
text: Ni li dooni tɔb ke binib bi gee tɔb na. Uwumbɔr tii nimi bimɔk ye Kristo yaab na nsuudoon.

ref: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
text: Min Simonn Piita u ye Yesu Kristo aakpambal ni waatutunn na le ŋmee kigbaŋ kee m di tii nimi bi gaa timi Aawumbɔr Yesu Kristo u gaal timi lir na ki kii na. Waah ŋan sakpen pu na le u cha ni gaa u ki kii ke ti mu aah nan gaa u ki kii pu na.

ref: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
text: Naah nyi Uwumbɔr ni Tidindaan Yesu pu na, bi ŋa tinyoor ŋa ni pu ki tii nimi nsuudoon pam. Uwumbɔr aah nyan timi ki yin timi pu na

ref: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
text: Waapɔɔnsakpiin pu, le u tii timi tiwan nimɔk ga ter timi ke ti kan limɔfal ki dii u mbamɔn na. Taah nyi u pu na, nima le cha u tii timi. U nan mɔk timi ke u ŋan sakpen, ki kpa mbimbinyaan, ki yin timi ke ti dii u,

ref: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
text: ki puu tipuur ti ŋan sakpen na tii timi. Binib kpa iniman la. Nima le titunwanbir bi dulnyaa wee ni. Ni yaa gaa Uwumbɔr aah puu tipuur ti na kan, ni ga nya titunwanbir ngbaan ni, ki gaa Uwumbɔr aabimbin.

ref: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
text: Nimi aabimbin yaa moo bi kina mbamɔm kan, nima le ga cha ni bee Tidindaan Yesu Kristo mbamɔm, ki tun waatuln sakpen, ki ŋa tinyoor tii u.

ref: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
text: Unii u lann mbimbin ngbaan aaboln na kan, u jɔb la. U suln ke Uwumbɔr nan finn u ki nyan titunwanbir ti nan bi usui ni na.

ref: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
text: Nnaabitiib, Uwumbɔr aah nyan nimi ki yin nimi pu na, ni li pɔɔni nibaa ki cha nimi aabimbinyaan li mɔk ke ni sil ye waanib. Ni yaa ŋa kina kan, naan lir.

ref: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
text: Uwumbɔr ga tii nimi nsan ke ni koo Tidindaan Yesu Kristo u gaal timi lir na aanaan mu ga li bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na ni.

ref: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
text: Nima pu le m ga li teer nimi tibɔr timina n‑yoonn mɔmɔk. Ni ŋun ti, ki nyi ti, ki joo ti mbamɔm.

ref: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
text: M mu dak ke ni ŋan ke m li teer nimi, ki fiin nimi aalandak, maah laa bi tiwon tee ni buyoonn na.

ref: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
text: M nyi ke naan yunn, le m ga di tiwon tee lii, Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aah nan tuk mi pu na.

ref: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
text: Le m ga pɔɔk mbaa ki tii nimi kigbaŋ ki ga li teer nimi tibɔr tee n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, ki joo cha maakundaal aapuwɔb na. Binib bi aanimbil kan Yesu Kristo aah wiin chain pu na

ref: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
text: Ti nan tuk nimi ke Tidindaan Yesu Kristo kpa mpɔɔn sakpen ki ga ki gir ni. Taah tuk nimi pu na aa ye itiin. Ti gbii la. Tinimbil kan waah kpa mpɔɔn sakpen pu na.

ref: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
text: Ti nan bi u chee buyoonn Tite Uwumbɔr nan pak u ki nyuŋ u na. Uwumbɔr aaneel nan nyan ni paacham nin chee wiin chain na, ki bui ke, “Njapɔɔn u m gee u na sɔ. Nnimbil gbiin uma la.”

ref: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
text: Timi tibaa nan ŋun nneel ngbaan nyan ni paacham, buyoonn ti nan bi u chee Uwumbɔr aajool paab na.

ref: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
text: Nima le mɔk timi ke Uwumbɔr aabɔnabtiib aah nan len Yesu aabɔr pu na, bi len mbamɔn la. Ni ŋan ke ni kii baah len pu na. Baaliin bi ke karyaa u wiin mbɔmbɔɔn ni na aah bi pu na. I ga woln ninimbil ki ti saa buyoonn Yesu Kristo ga gir ni ki nan woln ninimbil mbamɔm na.

ref: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
text: Tibɔkpaan le ye ke ni li nyi ke Uwumbɔr aabɔnabr aaliin ibaa aa ye bima bibaa aalandak le bi joo ŋmee.

ref: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
text: Naa ye bima bibaa aageehn pu le cha bi len. Bi nan len Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aah cha bi len pu na.

ref: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
text: Biŋmaŋmannim mu nan bi Israel yaab ponn ni n‑yoonn ngbaan, ki ŋmanni ke bi ye Uwumbɔr aabɔnabr la. Le biŋmaŋmannim ga li bi ni mu ponn ni, ki ga li looni ki mɔk nimi nnyamɔn aamɔkm mu ga bii nimi na. Hali bi ga yii Tidindaan u nan gaa bi lii na. Nima pu le Uwumbɔr ga daa bitafal mbamɔm mala.

ref: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.
text: Binib pam ga dii baasanwanbir ngbaan. Bi pu le binib ga sii mbamɔn aasan na.

ref: They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.
text: Bi ga li kpa iniman ki ga ŋmann nimi, ke bi ji nimi. Ni yunn le Uwumbɔr nan puun len ke baabɔr bii. Naan yunn le u ga daa bitafal.

ref: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
text: Hali Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib bi nan tun titunwanbir na, Uwumbɔr aa nan di cha bi, u daa bitafal la. U buu bi idɔribi, ki di bi lii mmii mu kaan junn na ni, mbɔmbɔɔn ni, bi li bi nima ki ti saa bundaln u ga ji bi tibɔr na.

ref: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
text: Waa nan di cha dulnyaakpok aanib mu. U nan cha nnyun jin dulnyaakpok, ki kuln binib bi kaa san u na; ki gaa Nowa u nan mooni waabɔnyaan na lii; ki gaa binib bilole lii ki kpee Nowa pu.

ref: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
text: Tɔ, Uwumbɔr nan bii Sodom ni Gomora aatim ki cha mu kpaln nfatan, ki kuln ntim ngbaan aanib. Ni ye limɔkl la, le ki mɔk titunwanbirdam Uwumbɔr aah ga daa bitafal pu na.

ref: Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him.
text: Uninyaan ngbaan nan bi baatiŋ ni, ki kan baah tun yɔl yɔl pu na, ki ŋun baah len iliinbir pu na. Waah nan ye uninyaan na, le baatunwanbir bii usui iwiin mɔmɔk.

ref: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
text: Tɔ, nimina mɔmɔk le mɔk timi ke Tidindaan ga ŋmaa nyan binib bi san u na ntɔŋ ni, ki ga ŋmaa li dar titunwanbirdam aatafal ki ti saa bundaln u ga ji bi tibɔr na.

ref: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
text: Binib bi dii tiwon aah ban pu na, ki gɔr kidagook, kaa kii unii ubaa aamɔb na, Uwumbɔr ga daa bitafal ki jer waah ga daa biken aatafal pu na. Biŋmaŋmannim bi bi ni ponn ni na aatafal pɔɔ la. Baa san unii ubaa. Bi seei Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib, kaa san ijawaan.

ref: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
text: Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib kpa mpɔɔn ki jer bi, ki mu aa galn bi, kaa seei bi Tidindaan aanimbiin ni.

ref: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
text: Binib ngbaan ŋani baah gee pu na, ki bi ke ipeel i binib chur i ki ku i na la. Bi sii Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib, kaa nyi baah bi pu na. Bima bibaa aatunwanbir le ga kuln bi.

ref: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
text: Baah ŋa binib falaa pu na, bi mu ga kan falaa. Baageehn le ye ke bi gɔr kidagook nwiin pu. Baah bi nikaasisik ni pu na, bi bi ke tijɔŋ aah likr likekeln pu pu na la. Baah ji ni chee tijikaar na, baalandak bi baatuln li kaa ŋan na ponn ni la.

ref: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
text: Binimbil yaa kan upii kan, bi ban u la, kaan ŋmaa di cha titunwanbir. Bi ŋmanni binib bi kaa nyi Uwumbɔr aasan mbamɔm na ke bi yenn. Bisui bae iniman la. Uwumbɔr aamɔpuur bi bi pu la.

ref: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
text: Bi yii nsanyaan le ki yenn, ki dii Beor aajapɔɔn Balaam aah nan dii pu na. U nan gee titunwanbir aanyoor la.

ref: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
text: Le Uwumbɔr sur u waatunwanbir pu, ki cha ubon u ye ubir na di unibɔn aaneel ki sur u, u taa tun uwaar aatuln.

ref: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
text: Biŋmaŋmannim ngbaan naahn inyunbun i kaa kpa nnyun na, ki naahn utaal u yun ki bɔln ki joo libuln kaa nu na la. Uwumbɔr ga di bi ŋa mbɔmbɔɔn sakpiin ni, n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
text: Bi len kalmbaani aaliin i ye fam na, ki ŋmanni binib bi kaa dii Uwumbɔr aasan ni yunn na, ki tɔŋni bi ke bi ŋa tiwon aah gee pu na ki gɔr kidagook,

ref: They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
text: ki bui bi ke bi ga gaa bibaa la. Bima bibaa ye titunwanbir aanaagbiib la; tiwan ni nyaŋ unii na joo u tinaagbiir la.

ref: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
text: Binib yaa nyi Tidindaan Yesu Kristo u gaal timi lir na, ki nyan ni titunwanbir ti bi dulnyaa wee ni na aan titunwanbir ngbaan ki nyaŋ bi kan, baadoon ga li bir ki jer baapiin aah nan bi pu na.

ref: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
text: Bi yaa kaa ba nyi nsanyaan ngbaan kan, ni ba ga li soor ni baah nyi mu aan ki yii Yesu aabɔnyaan ti bi ŋun na.

ref: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
text: Bi gbiin ŋiyataŋak aah len pu na ke, “Ubɔja gir ki ti jin waawuln la. Ugbeer u fu nnyun na gir ti koo tikpakpar ni, ki weei la.”

ref: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
text: M ban ke ni li teer tibɔr ti Uwumbɔr aabɔnabnyaam nan len n‑yaayoonn na, ki li teer Tidindaan u gaa timi lii na aabɔr ti timi waakpambalb tuk nimi na.

ref: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
text: Njan, m ban ke ni li nyi ke binib bi dii bisui aah ban pu na ga li bi kookoo aayoonn, ki ga ŋa nimi mbɔnyun,

ref: and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
text: ki ga bui ke, “Yesu Kristo aah puu tipuur ti ke u ga gir ni na, u bi la chee? Buyoonn titetiib nan kpo ki nan saa dandana wee na, tiwan mɔmɔk beenin bi ke naah nan bi pu buyoonn Uwumbɔr naan dulnyaa wee na la.”

ref: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
text: Baageehn pu, le bi suln ke n‑yaayoonn na, Uwumbɔr nan di umɔb len, le ki naan paacham, ni kitiŋ ki nyan ni nnyun ni, ki bi nnyun aakaasisik ni na.

ref: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.
text: Nnyun le nan jin dulnyaakpok, ki bii u.

ref: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
text: Bi suln ke Uwumbɔr aaliin ichachaan ngbaan le joo paacham ni kitiŋ ki bi dandana wee na, ki nan saa buyoonn u ga see paacham ni taab mmii, ki kuln titunwanbirdam na; liyaadaal ngbaan le u ga ji bi tibɔr ki bii bi.

ref: Dear friends, don't forget that for the Lord one day is the same as
text: Maanigeekaab, ni taa suln ke liwinbaal naahn ŋibin lichur le Tidindaan chee. Ŋibin lichur mu naahn liwinbaal le u chee.

ref: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
text: Tidindaan aan taan ke u ŋa waah puu tipuur ti na, ke binib bibaa aah dak pu na. U ji limɔr ni pu la, kaa ban ke unii ubaa bii. U ban ke binib mɔmɔk kpeln baabimbin ki ŋmar la.

ref: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
text: Tidindaan aawiindaal ga fuu ni ke unaayuk aah fuur ni pu na la. Liyaadaal ngbaan le paacham ga faa kifuuk sakpen ki jer. Mmii mu ton sakpen na ga donn paacham aawan mɔmɔk. Kitiŋ, ni tiwan nimɔk bi kitiŋ pu na mu ga gaa mmii.

ref: Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live.
text: Tiwan nimina mɔmɔk aah ga bii kina na, ni ŋan ke ni li ye ba aanibol? Ni ŋan ke ni li bi chain, ki li san Uwumbɔr,

ref: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
text: ki li lik Uwumbɔr aawiindaal aah ga fuu ni buyoonn na, ki cha ninimbil li man nwiin ngbaan pu. Liyaadaal ngbaan, le paacham ga gaa mmii ki donn. Mmii mu ton sakpen na ga donn paacham aawan mɔmɔk.

ref: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
text: Uwumbɔr mu aah nan puu tipuur ti na, ti kpa limakl ke paacham pɔɔn ni kitipɔŋ ga li bi. Nima chee le tiwan mɔmɔk ga li bi mbamɔm.

ref: My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace.
text: Maanigeekaab, naah kpa limakl kina na, ni li pɔɔni nibaa ki li bi suuna, ki li bi chain, ki taa li kpa taani ubaa Uwumbɔr chee bundaln u ga lik nimi aabimbin aah bi pu na.

ref: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
text: Tidindaan aah jin limɔr, kaa gir ni mala na, ni bee ke u tii binib nsan ke bi ŋmar le waahr, le u nin gir ni. Tinaabogeekoo Pɔɔl mu nan ŋmee kigbaŋ tii ni nimi, ki tuk nimi kina, Uwumbɔr aah tii u nlan pu na.

ref: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
text: Waagbann mɔmɔk ponn ni u ŋmee Uwumbɔr aawiindaal aabɔr, ki mɔk nimi tibɔr timina. Tibɔr ti pɔɔ unii bee taatataa na tibaa mu bi waagbann ponn ni. Le binib bi kaa kpa nlan ki ga ŋmaa yenn mala na kpeln taatataa, ke baah kpeln Uwumbɔr Aagbaŋ aabɔr tiken pu na. Nima pu na, Uwumbɔr ga daa bitafal.

ref: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
text: Maanigeekaab, ni puen bee baah ŋani pu na. Naah dii mbamɔm pu na, ni li nyi man, ki taa dii titunwanbirdam aanyamɔn aan ki yenn.

ref: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
text: Ni moo gaa Tidindaan Yesu Kristo u gaal timi lir na aaterm, ki li moo bae waaliin. Uma le yeh mpakm dandana wee ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Amii.

ref: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
text: Timi Yesu aakpambalb le ban ke ti tuk nimi limɔfal aabɔr. Tibɔr ngbaan ye Yesu aabɔr la. U nan bi n‑yaayoonn na, ki beenin bi. Ti nan ŋun waah len pu na. Tinimbil nan kan u, ki lik mbamɔm waah bi pu na. Tiŋaal nan meeh u.

ref: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
text: Yesu, u ye limɔfal ngbaan na, nan di ubaa mɔk timi. Le ti kan u. Nima pu le ti ji seeraa, le ki tuk nimi limɔfal ngbaan aabɔr. Yesu le ye limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na daan. N‑yoonn mɔmɔk u nan bi Tite Uwumbɔr chee, le ki di ubaa nan mɔk timi.

ref: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
text: Ti tuk nimi taah kan pu na, ni taah ŋun pu na, aan ti ni nimi li kpaan kijɔtiik. Ni ye mbamɔn la, taah kpaan kijɔtiik na, ti ni Tite Uwumbɔr ni Ujapɔɔn Yesu Kristo le kpaan kijɔtiik ngbaan.

ref: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
text: Ti ban ke ti li kpa mpopiin mbamɔm, nima pu le ti ŋmee tibɔr timina tii nimi. Uwumbɔr ye nwiihn la

ref: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
text: Ti nan ŋun tibɔr timina Yesu chee la, le ki tuk nimi. Tibɔr ngbaan le ye ke Uwumbɔr ye nwiihn la. Mbɔmbɔɔn mubaa aa bi u chee.

ref: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
text: Ti yaa len ke ti ni Uwumbɔr kpaan kijɔtiik ki yaa beenin dii mbɔmbɔɔn aasan kan, ti mɔn nnyamɔn la, kaa dii mbamɔn aasan.

ref: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
text: Ti yaa dii nwiihn aasan ke Uwumbɔr aah bi nwiihn ni pu na kan, ti kpaan kijɔtiik tɔb chee la. Le Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn Yesu Kristo aasin finni tipobil ki nyani titunwanbir mɔmɔk.

ref: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
text: Ti yaa len ke taa ye titunwanbirdam kan, ti ŋmanni tibaa la; mbamɔn aa bi tisui ni.

ref: But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
text: Uwumbɔr ŋani waah len pu na ki ye mbamɔndaan la. Ti yaa kpiir timi aatunwanbir tuk u kan, u ga di cha pinn timi aatunwanbir, ki finn tipobil, ki nyan tiwan ni kaa ŋan na mɔmɔk.

ref: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
text: Ti yaa len ke taa tun titunwanbir kan, ti yin Uwumbɔr unyamɔndaan la. Waabɔr aa bi tisui ni.

ref: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
text: Maabim, maa ban ke ni tun titunwanbir. Nima le cha m ŋmee tibɔr tee tii nimi. Unii mu yaa tun titunwanbir kan, ti kpa uchandatuln Tite Uwumbɔr chee. Uchandatuln ngbaan ye Yesu Kristo la, uma le ye mbamɔndaan.

ref: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.
text: Ti yaa kii Uwumbɔr aamɔb kan, nima le cha ti bee ke ti nyi u.

ref: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
text: Unii yaa len ke u nyi Uwumbɔr, ki yaa kaa kii waamɔb kan, u ye unyamɔndaan la; mbamɔn aa bi usui ni.

ref: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
text: Maanigeekaab, naa ye nkaal pɔɔn le m ŋmee tii nimi. Ni ye nkaal kpok la. Naah nan piin ki dii Yesu aasan na, ni ŋun nkaal ngbaan, le ki di nan saa din. Nkaal kpok ngbaan le ye tibɔr ti ni ŋun na.

ref: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
text: Tɔ, maah bi ŋmee nkaal mu na ye nkaal pɔɔn la. Yesu nan ŋa nkaal ngbaan aah len pu na. Ni mu ŋani mu aah len pu na la. Nimina mɔk ke mu ye mbamɔn. Mbɔmbɔɔn bi jer la. Nwiihn bamɔnn bi wolni la.

ref: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
text: Unii yaa len ke u bi nwiihn ni ki yaa nan una aabo kan, u beenin bi mbɔmbɔɔn ni la, le ki di nan saa din.

ref: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
text: Unii umɔk gee una aabo na bi nwiihn ni la. Tiwan ni ga cha unii lir na aa bi nwiihn ni.

ref: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
text: Unii umɔk nan una aabo na bi mbɔmbɔɔn ni la, le ki dii mbɔmbɔɔn aasan. Mbɔmbɔɔn ngbaan jɔb unimbil la, nima le waa nyi waah cha nin chee na.

ref: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
text: Maabim, Uwumbɔr di cha pinn nimi aatunwanbir Yesu aayimbil pu. Nima pu le m ŋmee tibɔr tee tii nimi.

ref: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
text: Ntetiib, ni nyi Yesu u nan bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na. Nima pu le m ŋmee tibɔr tee tii nimi. Binachipɔm, ni nyaŋ kinimbɔŋ ki kaa ŋan na. Nima pu le m ŋmee tibɔr tee tii nimi.

ref: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
text: Maabim, ni nyi Tite Uwumbɔr. Nima pu le m ŋmee tibɔr tee tii nimi. Ntetiib, ni nyi Yesu u nan bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na. Nima pu le m ŋmee tibɔr tee tii nimi. Binachipɔm, ni kpa mpɔɔn, le Uwumbɔr aabɔr bi nisui ni, le ni nyaŋ kinimbɔŋ ki kaa ŋan na. Nima pu le m ŋmee tibɔr tee tii nimi.

ref: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
text: Tɔ, ni taa li gee dulnyaa wee aasan. Ni taa li gee dulnyaa wee ponn ni aawan. Unii yaa gee dulnyaa wee aasan kan, waa gee Tite Uwumbɔr.

ref: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
text: Binib aanimbil man tiwan ni kaa ŋan na pu. Binimbil man baah kan tiwan ni na pu. Bi kpa kalmbaani baawan pu. Tiwan nimina mɔmɔk ye dulnyaa wee aasan la, naa ye Tite Uwumbɔr aasan.

ref: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
text: Dulnyaa wee ga doo. Tiwan ni binib aanimbil man ni pu na, ni mu ga doo. Unii umɔk ŋani Uwumbɔr aageehn na ga li bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Yesu Kristo aadin

ref: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
text: Maabim, ni yaa kpee siib kan, kookoo aayoonn ga fuu ni. Ni nan ŋun ke Yesu aadin ga dan. Dandana wee Yesu aadim fuu ni ki wiir. Nima pu le ti nyi ke ni yaa kpee siib kan, kookoo aayoonn ga fuu ni.

ref: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
text: Binib bi ye Kristo aadim na nyan ti chee. Bi mu aa nan ye timi aanib. Bi yaa ba ye timi aanib kan, bi ba ga li beenin bi ti chee. Bi nyan ti chee ke ti bee ke bi ponn ni ubaa aa ye timi aanii.

ref: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
text: Naa ye ke naa nyi mbamɔn ngbaan le cha m ŋmee tibɔr tee tii nimi. Ni nyi mbamɔn, ki mu nyi ke nnyamɔn mubaa aa ye mbamɔn. Nima pu le m ŋmee tibɔr tee tii nimi.

ref: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
text: Ŋma ye unyamɔndaan? Unyamɔndaan ye unii u len ke Yesu aa ye Kristo u gaa timi lii na. Udaan le ye Kristo aadin. U yii Tite Uwumbɔr ni Ujapɔɔn mɔk.
