ref: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
text: Unii umɔk yii Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn na yii Uwumbɔr mu la. Unii umɔk gaa Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn na gaa Uwumbɔr mu la.

ref: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
text: Naah nan piin ki dii Yesu aasan ki di nan saa din na, ni ŋun waabɔr la. Ni li nyi ki cha tibɔr ngbaan li beenin bi nisui ni. Tibɔr ngbaan yaa beenin bi nisui ni kan, ni ga kpaan Tite Uwumbɔr ni Ujapɔɔn chee la.

ref: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
text: M ŋmee tibɔr tee tii nimi, ke m tuk nimi binib bi ban bi ŋmann nimi na pu.

ref: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
text: Nimi le Yesu nan tii Waafuur Nyaan. Waafuur Nyaan ngbaan beenin bi ni ni. Nima pu na, naa ki ban ke unii ubaa mɔk nimi waabɔr. Waafuur Nyaan le mɔk nimi Uwumbɔr aabɔr mɔmɔk. Waafuur Nyaan aah mɔk nimi pu na, ni ye mbamɔn la, naa ye nnyamɔn. Nima pu na, kii man Waafuur Nyaan aah mɔk nimi pu na, ki li kpaan Yesu chee n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

ref: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
text: Maabim, ni li kpaan Yesu chee n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, aan ti li kpa lipobil ki taa san inimɔɔn u chee bundaln u ga gir ni na.

ref: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
text: Ni nyi ke Yesu ye mbamɔndaan la. Nima pu le ni bee ke unii umɔk ŋani ni ŋan na ye Uwumbɔr aabo.

ref: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
text: Lik Tite Uwumbɔr aah gee timi sakpen pu na. U yin timi ke waabim. Le ti mu sil ye waabim. Dulnyaa aanib aa nyi Uwumbɔr. Baah kaa nyi Uwumbɔr na, nima pu le baa nyi ti mu.

ref: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
text: Maanigeekaab, dandana wee ti ye Uwumbɔr aabim la. Taa kee nyi taah ga nan li bi pu na. Ti po nyi ke Yesu yaa nan gir ni kan, ti ga kan waah bi pu na. Nima pu le ti mu ga li naahn u.

ref: This hope makes us keep ourselves holy, just as Christ is holy.
text: Unii umɔk kpa Yesu pu limakl ngbaan na, u ŋani ubaa chain la, ke Yesu aah ye chain pu na.

ref: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
text: Unii umɔk tun titunwanbir na, u ŋani Uwumbɔr aakaal aah kɔ pu na la; ba pu? unii yaa ŋa Uwumbɔr aakaal aah kɔ pu na kan, nima le ye titunwanbir.

ref: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
text: Unii umɔk bi Yesu ni na aan ki li beenin tun titunwanbir. Unii umɔk beenin tun titunwanbir na aa kan u, ki mu aa nyi u.

ref: Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself.
text: Maabim, taa cha unii ubaa ŋmann nimi. Unii umɔk ŋani ni ŋan na, udaan ye unibamɔnn ke Yesu aah ye unibamɔnn pu na la.

ref: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
text: Unii umɔk tun titunwanbir n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na, u ye kinimbɔŋ aanii la. Ba pu? kinimbɔŋ aah nan piin buyoonn na, ki po tun titunwanbir la. Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn aah nan dan dulnyaa wee ni na, u nan dan ke u nan ŋa kinimbɔŋ aatuln yɔli la.

ref: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
text: Unii umɔk ye Uwumbɔr aabo na, Uwumbɔr aabimbin bi u ni. Nima pu, waan ki li beenin tun titunwanbir. Ute le ye Uwumbɔr. Nima pu, waan ŋmaa dii titunwanbir aasan.

ref: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
text: Unii umɔk kaa ŋani ni ŋan na aa ye Uwumbɔr aabo. Unii umɔk kaa gee una aabo na, u mu aa ye Uwumbɔr aabo. Nima le cha ni beer binib bi ye Uwumbɔr aabim na, ni binib bi ye kinimbɔŋ aabim na. Ni li gee tɔb

ref: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
text: Taa cha ti li bi ke Keenn na. U nan ye kinimbɔŋ ki kaa ŋan na aanii la, le ki ku unaal. Ba pu u ku unaal? Uma Keenn aatuln aa nan ŋan. Unaal ma aatuln nan ŋan. Nima le nan cha u ku u.

ref: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
text: Nnaabitiib, dulnyaa aanib yaa nan nimi kan, taa cha ni gar nimi man.

ref: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
text: Taah gee tinaabitiib na, nima le cha ti bee ke ti nyan nkun ni, ki kpa limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na. Unii umɔk kaa gee una aabo na, u beenin bi nkun ni la.

ref: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
text: Unii umɔk nan una aabo na, u ye unikur la. Ni nyi ke unikur ubaa aa kpa limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.
text: Yesu nan sil timi aasisiiyaan ki kpo ti pu. Nima le cha ti bee ngeehm aah ye pu na. Ni ŋan ke ti mu ga ŋmaa kpo tinaabitiib pu.

ref: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
text: Unii yaa kpa liwankpal ki yaa kan una aabo bi igiin ni ki yaa kaa san u kinimbaak kan, Uwumbɔr aageehm aa bi usui ni.

ref: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
text: Maabim, taa cha ti li gee binib timɔb ni baanja. Nima ye fam la. Cha ti li gee bi mbamɔm, ki li ter bi.

ref: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
text: Nima le ga cha ti bee ke ti dii mbamɔn aasan. Nima le ga cha ti li kpa nsuudoon Uwumbɔr chee.

ref: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
text: Ti yaa dak tisui ni ke timi aabɔr bii kan, cha ti li teer ke Uwumbɔr jer tisui, ki nyi tiwan mɔmɔk.

ref: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
text: Maanigeekaab, ti yaa bee tisui ni ke timi aabɔr aa bii kan, ti kpa lipobil Uwumbɔr chee.

ref: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
text: Ti kii waamɔb la, ki ŋani tiwan ni piir usui na. Nima pu, taah mee u tiwan ni na, u tii timi.

ref: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
text: Waah tuk timi ke ti li ŋani pu na le ye ke: ti gaa Ujapɔɔn Yesu Kristo ki kii, ki li gee tɔb, uma Yesu aah tuk timi pu na.

ref: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
text: Unii umɔk kii Uwumbɔr aamɔb na, u bi Uwumbɔr ni. Uwumbɔr mu bi u ni. U tii timi Waafuur Nyaan, nima le cha ti bee ke u bi ti ni.

ref: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
text: Maanigeekaab, binib yaa len ke bi kpa Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan kan, ni taa pak bi mɔmɔk. Ni lik baah len pu na, aan ki bee ke ni ye Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan le cha bi len aan naa ye. Biŋmaŋmannim chuun dulnyaa wee ni ki wiir, ki len ke bi ye Uwumbɔr aabɔnabtiib, kaa ye.

ref: and you can know which ones come from God. His Spirit says that Jesus Christ had a truly human body.
text: Ubɔnabr umɔk len ke Yesu Kristo nan kpaln unii ki dan dulnyaa wee ni na, uma le kpa Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan. Nima le ga cha ni bee binib bi kpa Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan na, ni binib bi kaa kpa na.

ref: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
text: Ubɔnabr umɔk len ke Yesu aa kpaln unii na kan, udaan ngbaan aa kpa Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan. U ye Kristo aadin aabɔnabr la. Ni nan ŋun ke Kristo aadin aabɔnabtiib ga dan. Dandana wee, bi fuu ni dulnyaa ni a.

ref: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
text: Maabim, ni ye Uwumbɔr yaab la. Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan mu bi nisui ni na jer kinimbɔŋ ki bi dulnyaa wee ni na. Nima pu le ni nyaŋ Yesu aadin aabɔnabtiib ngbaan.

ref: These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language.
text: Bi ye dulnyaa yaab la. Nima pu le bi len dulnyaa aabɔr, le dulnyaa aanib pel baah len pu na.

ref: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
text: Tima kan, ti ye Uwumbɔr yaab la. Unii umɔk nyi Uwumbɔr na pel taah len pu na. Unii umɔk kaa ye Uwumbɔr yoo na aa pel taah len pu na. Nimina le ga cha ti bee binib bi kpa Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan mu ye mbamɔn na, ni binib bi ye Yesu aadin aabɔnabtiib na. Uwumbɔr ye ngeehm la

ref: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
text: Maanigeekaab, cha ti li gee tɔb. Ba pu? u cha binib gee tɔb na le ye Uwumbɔr. Unii umɔk gee unaabitiib na, u ye Uwumbɔr aabo la, ki nyi Uwumbɔr.

ref: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
text: Uwumbɔr ye ngeehm la. Nima pu na, unii u kaa gee unaabitiib na, waa nyi Uwumbɔr.

ref: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
text: Uwumbɔr nan tun ni Ujapɔnbaal dulnyaa wee ni ke ti nan kan limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na u pu. Nimina le mɔk timi ke u gee timi.

ref: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
text: Ngeehm aa ye ke timi le gee Uwumbɔr. Ngeehm ye ke Uwumbɔr le gee timi, ki tun ni Ujapɔɔn dulnyaa ni, u nan sil timi aasisiiyaan ki di ubaa toor kitork tii Uwumbɔr, timi aatunwanbir pu. Uma pu, le Uwumbɔr ga di cha pinn timi.

ref: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
text: Maanigeekaab, Uwumbɔr aah gee timi sakpen kina na, ni ŋan ke ti mu li gee tɔb.

ref: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
text: Unii ubaa aa kee kan Uwumbɔr. Ti yaa gee tɔb kan, Uwumbɔr bi ti ni la, nima le ti gee tɔb mbamɔm, waah ban pu na.

ref: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
text: Tɔ, u tii timi Waafuur Nyaan. Nima le cha ti bee ke ti bi u ni, u mu bi ti ni.

ref: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
text: Tinimbil nan kan Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn, le ti jin seeraa ke Ute tun ni u dulnyaa wee ni, ke u nan gaa dulnyaa ni aanib lii.

ref: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
text: Unii umɔk len binib aanimbil ni ke Yesu le ye Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn na kan, Uwumbɔr bi u ni la, u mu bi Uwumbɔr ni.

ref: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
text: Ti nyi Uwumbɔr aah gee timi pu na, ki pak ke u gee timi la. Uwumbɔr ye ngeehm la. Unii umɔk gee binib n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na, u bi Uwumbɔr ni la, Uwumbɔr mu bi u ni.

ref: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
text: Ti gee binib mbamɔm ke ti li kpa lipobil bundaln Uwumbɔr ga ji binib tibɔr na. Ba pu? Yesu aah bi pu na, ti mu bi kina le dulnyaa wee ni.

ref: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
text: Unii u gee Uwumbɔr na aa san ijawaan. Unii yaa kpa ngeehm mbamɔm kan, ngeehm ngbaan nyan ijawaan u ni. Unii u san ijawaan na aa gee Uwumbɔr mbamɔm; ijawaan ye falaa la.

ref: We love because God loved us first.
text: Uwumbɔr le nan puen gee timi. Nima pu le ti mu gee u.

ref: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
text: Unii yaa len ke u gee Uwumbɔr ki yaa nan una aabo kan, u ye unyamɔndaan la. U yaa kaa gee una aabo u unimbil waa u na kan, u ga ŋa kinye ki li gee Uwumbɔr u unimbil aa waa u na?

ref: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
text: Yesu aah nan tuk timi pu na le ye ke: unii u gee Uwumbɔr na, u li gee una aabo mu.

ref: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
text: Unii umɔk pak ke Yesu ye Kristo u gaa timi lii na, udaan ngbaan ye Uwumbɔr aabo la. Unii umɔk gee ubo aate na, u ga li gee waabo mu.

ref: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
text: Ti yaa gee Uwumbɔr ki kii waamɔb kan, nima le cha ti nyi ke ti gee waabim.

ref: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
text: Ti yaa gee Uwumbɔr kan, naatataa le ye ke ti kii waamɔb. Le waamɔb aa pɔɔ.

ref: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.
text: Ba pu? binib bimɔk ye Uwumbɔr aabim na nyaŋni dulnyaa aatɔŋ. Taah gaa Yesu ki kii na, nima le cha ti nyaŋni dulnyaa aatɔŋ.

ref: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
text: Ulau nyaŋni dulnyaa aatɔŋ? Unii umɔk pak ke Yesu ye Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn na, uma le nyaŋni dulnyaa aatɔŋ. Yesu Kristo aaseeraadam

ref: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.
text: Kina le Uwumbɔr ji seeraa ki mɔk ke Yesu sil ye Ujapɔɔn. Ti pak binib aaseeraa la. Uwumbɔr aaseeraa jer binib yoo.

ref: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
text: Unii umɔk gaa Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn ki kii na, u pak Uwumbɔr aah len pu na. Unii umɔk kaa pak Uwumbɔr aah len pu na, u yin Uwumbɔr unyamɔndaan la; kinye pu? waa pak Uwumbɔr aah len Ujapɔɔn aabɔr pu na.

ref: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
text: Uwumbɔr aah len pu na le ye ke u tii timi limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na, ke limɔfal ngbaan bi Ujapɔɔn ni.

ref: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
text: Unii umɔk kpa Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn na le kpa limɔfal ngbaan. Unii umɔk kaa kpa Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn na aa kpa limɔfal ngbaan. Limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na

ref: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
text: M ŋmee tibɔr tee tii nimi bi gaa Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn ki kii na, ke ni bee ke ni kpa limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.
text: Ti kpa lipobil ki mee Uwumbɔr ki bee ke ti yaa mee u tiwan ni ye waageehn na kan, u ŋun timi aameel la.

ref: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
text: Ti yaa bee ke u ŋun timi aameel kan, ti bee ke ti kan taah mee u tiwan ni na la.

ref: Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly.
text: Unii yaa kan una aabo tun titunwanbir ti kaan cha u kpo na kan, u ga mee Uwumbɔr tii u. Le Uwumbɔr ga tii u limɔfal. Binib bi tun titunwanbir ti kaan cha bi kpo na, Uwumbɔr ga tii bi limɔfal. Le titunwanbir ti cha binib kpo na mu bi. Maa len ke ni li mee Uwumbɔr tii binib bi tun titunwanbir ngbaan na.

ref: Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
text: Lituln limɔk kaa ŋan na po ye titunwanbir la. Titunwanbir ti kaan cha binib kpo na mu bi.

ref: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
text: Ti nyi ke unii umɔk ye Uwumbɔr aabo na aa ki tun titunwanbir; ba pu? Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn kii u, le kinimbɔŋ aan ŋmaa ŋa u nibaa.

ref: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
text: Ti nyi ke ti ye Uwumbɔr aabim la, ki nyi ke dulnyaa aanib mɔmɔk bi kinimbɔŋ aaŋaal ni la.

ref: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
text: Ti nyi ke Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn nan dan ki nan tii timi nlan ke ti bee Uwumbɔr, u ye Uwumbɔr bamɔnn na la. Ti bi Ujapɔɔn Yesu Kristo ni, nima le ti bi Uwumbɔr bamɔnn mu ni. Uma le ye Uwumbɔr bamɔnn, ni limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na daan.

ref: Children, you must stay away from idols.
text: Maabim, ni nyan nibaa ŋiwaa ni man.

ref: From the church leader. To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth.
text: Min Jɔnn u ye uninkpel na le ŋmee tibɔr tee tii nimi Yesu aanib, nimi bi Uwumbɔr nyan bi na. M gee nimi mbamɔm la. Naa ye min baanja le gee nimi. Binib bimɔk nyi mbamɔn na mu gee nimi.

ref: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
text: Mbamɔn pu, le ti gee nimi. Mbamɔn ngbaan bi tisui ni, ki ga li bi ti chee n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
text: Tite Uwumbɔr, ni Yesu Kristo u ye Tite Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn na, ga ter timi, ki san timi kinimbaak, ki tii timi nsuudoon, ki cha ti li dii mbamɔn aasan, ki li gee tɔb. Mbamɔn ni ngeehm

ref: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
text: M kan ke ni ponn ni bibaa dii mbamɔn aasan, Tite Uwumbɔr aah tuk timi pu na. Le ni ŋa mi mpopiin sakpen.

ref: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
text: Yesu aanib, m gaŋ nimi, cha ti mɔmɔk li gee tɔb man. Maa ŋmee nkaal pɔɔn tii nimi. Taah nan piin ki dii Yesu aasan na, ti nan ŋun nkaal ngbaan la, le ki di nan saa din.

ref: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
text: Biŋmaŋmannim chuun dulnyaa wee ni ki wiir. Bi len ke Yesu Kristo aa nan kpaln unii ki dan dulnyaa wee ni. Bima le ye biŋmaŋmannim ki ye Kristo aadim.

ref: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
text: Li nyi man, taa cha nimi aatuln bee yɔli. M ban ke ni kan naah tun lituln li na aapiin mɔmɔk la.

ref: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
text: Unii umɔk kaa beenin dii Kristo aabɔr, ki di tibɔyayan kpee ti pu na kan, waa gaa Uwumbɔr. Unii umɔk beenin dii Yesu aabɔr na kan, u gaa Tite Uwumbɔr ni Ujapɔɔn mɔmɔk la.

ref: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
text: Unii yaa dan ni chee ki joo ni tibɔr ti kaa ye Kristo aabɔr na kan, ni taa cha u koo ni nido. Hali ni taa doon u.

ref: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
text: Unii u doon u na kpaln ubakaatɔ le na. Kookoo aabɔr

ref: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
text: M kpa tibɔr sakpen ki ban m tuk nimi; m mu aa ban m ŋmee ti kigbaŋ kee ponn ni. M dak ke m ga mann nimi, ki len ni chee, aan ti li kpa mpopiin mbamɔm.

ref: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
text: Ninaabitiib bi Uwumbɔr lee bi na dooni nimi la.

ref: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
text: Min Jɔnn u ye uninkpel na dooni si, njɔgeehn Gayus. M gee si mbamɔm la.

ref: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
text: Njɔgeehn, m mee Uwumbɔr tii si, ke aa li kpa laafee, ki kani tinyoor, ke saawiin aah kpa tinyoor Uwumbɔr chee pu na.

ref: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
text: Tinaabitiib bibaa dan do, ki nan tuk mi saah dii mbamɔm pu na. Le ni ŋa mi mpopiin sakpen a. Aa sil dii mbamɔm la.

ref: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
text: M yaa ŋun ke maabim dii mbamɔm kan, ni ŋani mi mpopiin la. Nibaa aa bi ki ŋani mi mpopiin ki jer kina.

ref: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
text: Njɔgeehn, m nyi ke aa ter Yesu aanib bi ye bicham na n‑yoonn mɔmɔk; saah kaa nyi bi na mu, aa ter bi la. Saah ŋani kina na, aa ŋani mbamɔm la.

ref: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
text: Bi tuk m ni Yesu aanib bi bi do na saah gee bi pu na. Aa pɔɔk aabaa, ki li beenin ter bi baasachuln ponn ni. Ter bi Uwumbɔr aah ban pu na.

ref: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
text: Yesu pu, le bi chuun tuk binib waabɔr, kaa gaal tiwan nibaa binib bi kaa dii Yesu aasan na chee.

ref: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
text: Nima pu, ni ŋan ke timi bi dii Yesu aasan na li ter bi. Ti yaa ter bi kan, ti ter bi ke bi tuk binib Yesu aabɔr ti ye mbamɔn na la.

ref: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
text: M nan ŋmee tibɔr tibaa tii Yesu aanib. Le Diotrefes aa gar ti. U ban ke u li ye Yesu aanib aayidaan.

ref: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
text: U len tibɔbir ki geei inyamɔn paani timi. Waah ŋa kina na, waa faar. Tinaabitiib yaa dan kan, waa channi bi tichann. Binib bi ban ke bi chann bi tichann na, u kiir bi, kaa kii, ki ban ke u jenn nyan bi Yesu aanib ponn ni. M yaa fuu ni kan, m ga baa u waah ŋani pu na, aan ti nyan mpaan pu.

ref: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
text: Njɔgeehn, taa dii unii u kaa ŋan na aataabuu. Li dii unii u ŋan na aataabuu. Unii umɔk ŋani ni ŋan na kan, u ye Uwumbɔr yoo la. Unii umɔk ŋani ni kaa ŋan na kan, waa nyi Uwumbɔr.

ref: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
text: Binib mɔmɔk pak Demetrius. Waah dii mbamɔn aasan pu na le mɔk ke u ye unii. Ti mu pak u. Aa bee ke taah len pu na, ti gbii la. Kookoo aabɔr

ref: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
text: M kpa tibɔr sakpen, ki ban m tuk si. Maa ban m ŋmee ti kigbaŋ kee ponn ni.

ref: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
text: M dak ke ni yaa kpee siib kan, m ga kan si, ki len aa chee.

ref: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
text: Uwumbɔr tii si nsuudoon. Yesu aanib bi bi do na dooni si. Aa doon Yesu aanib bi bi aa chee na mɔmɔk ubaabaa tii timi.

ref: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
text: Min Juud, u ye Yesu Kristo aatutunn, ni Jems aanaal na le ŋmee tibɔr tee tii nimi bi Uwumbɔr lee nimi na. U gee nimi, ki joo nimi Yesu Kristo pu la.

ref: I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love! False Teachers
text: M mee Uwumbɔr ke u moo san nimi kinimbaak, ki tii nimi nsuudoon, ki cha ni li gee tɔb mbamɔm. Bibiindam aah ŋani pu na

ref: My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people.
text: Maanigeekaab, nnimbil nan man ke m ŋmee kigbaŋ ki tuk nimi Uwumbɔr aah gaal timi lir pu na aabɔr tii nimi. M mu aa ŋmee kina; ba pu? ni muk mi ke m ŋmee kigbaŋ ki gaŋ nimi ke ni li pɔɔni nibaa ki li joo Uwumbɔr aabɔr, ki yii binib bi bii ti na. Uwumbɔr le nan di tibɔr ngbaan tii waaninyaam. Ubaa taa kpeln ti.

ref: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
text: Budabu cha m gaŋni nimi kina na le ye ke binib bibaa nan koo ni nikaasisik ni, ki ŋmanni nimi. Baa san Uwumbɔr. Bi len ke Uwumbɔr aah di cha pinn timi pu na, ti yaa gɔr kidagook kan, waan daa titafal. Bi yii Tidindaan Yesu Kristo. Uma baanja le ye Tidindaan. N‑yaayoonn na, Uwumbɔr aabɔnabtiib nan ŋmee ke Uwumbɔr ga daa bibiindam ngbaan aatafal.

ref: Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them.
text: Ni nyi maah ga tuk nimi pu na mɔmɔk. Le m ban m teer nimi. Uwumbɔr nan nyan Israel yaab Ijipt aatiŋ ni ki gaa bi lii. Le u mu nan ku bi ponn ni binib bi kaa gaa u ki kii na.

ref: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
text: Teer man, Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib bi nan di cha Uwumbɔr aah tii bi lituln li na, ki nyan ni bido paacham na aabɔr. Uwumbɔr nan buu bi tikululn ti baan ŋmaa buur ti na, ki di bi ŋa mbɔmbɔɔn mu bi kitiŋ aataab na ni, ki nan saa nwiin mundaln u ga ji bi tibɔr ki siin bi ntafadaan na.

ref: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
text: Teer man, Sodom ni Gomora aatim, ni itingbaan na aanib bi nan gɔr kidagook, ki mu yii bipiib ki ban bijab na aabɔr. Uwumbɔr nan daa bitafal, ki di bi ŋa mmii mu kaan junn na ni, ni le ye nsurm ki tii titunwanbirdam mɔmɔk.

ref: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.
text: Le bibiindam bi bi nikaasisik ni na aa gar nsurm ngbaan. Bi mu ŋani ke binib ngbaan aah nan ŋani pu na la. Bi len ke bi daŋ tidaŋ ti mɔk bi ke bi gɔr kidagook, ki seei Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib, ki taa kii unii ubaa aamɔb na.

ref: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
text: Maikel u ye Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib aaninkpel na aa nan gee ke u sii kinimbɔŋ. U ni kinimbɔŋ nan kpak kinikpakpak Moses aawon pu, ke ulau ga yoor u. Maikel mu aa gee ke u sii kinimbɔŋ ki bii ki. U nan po bui ki ke, “Uwumbɔr li kae si.”

ref: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
text: Bibiindam ngbaan ma seei Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib la, kaa nyi baah bi pu na. Bi ŋani bisui aah gee pu na, ke ipeel i kaa dak ilandak na aah ŋani pu na. Nima le Uwumbɔr ga daa bitafal.

ref: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
text: Tibɔbir bi bi pu la. Bi yii Uwumbɔr aamɔb ke Keenn aah nan yii pu na. Bi mɔk binib mmɔkm mu kaa ŋan na ŋimombil pu, ke Balaam aah nan ŋa pu na. Bi yii baaninkpiib aamɔi ke Kora aah nan yii pu na. Uwumbɔr ga bii bi mu.

ref: These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit.
text: Ni yaa kpaan ni ji tijikaar Uwumbɔr aadiik ni kan, bi sak nikaasisik ni ke tijɔŋ aah likr libɔkul pu pu na; ba pu? bi kpaan ji ni chee, kaa san Uwumbɔr. Bi ban ke bi kpiin bibaa baanja la. Baa kpa tinyoor. Bi naahn utaal u yun ki bɔln ki joo ni libuln kaa nu na la; ki naahn isui i kaa lu ŋisubil ki kpo ki kpukr lir na la.

ref: Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
text: Bi tun inimɔɔn aatuln la, ki naahn nnyusakpem aanyunkpenn ti ŋani tipupukr ni tijɔŋ nnyun aagbaan na la, ki ki naahn ŋiŋmabil ŋi kaa chuun ŋaasan ni na. Uwumbɔr ga di bi ŋa mbɔmbɔɔn ni, n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
text: Tɔ, Enok, u nan ye Adam aayaabisɔsɔk loloob na, nan puun len Uwumbɔr aah ga ŋa bibiindam ngbaan pu na ke, “Li pel man, Uwumbɔr ni waatuuntiib ŋichur kipiik ga dan

ref: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
text: ki nan ji binib mɔmɔk tibɔr, ki ga bii titunwanbirdam mɔmɔk; ba pu? bi yii Uwumbɔr, ki tun titunwanbir waah kaa gee pu na, ki len tibɔbir u pu.”

ref: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want. More Warnings
text: Bibiindam ngbaan ŋulni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk; tiwan nibaa aa mɔ bi chee. Bi dii tiwan ni kaa ŋan na aakpeek, ki len mpɔɔn pu ki kpa kipupuk, ki pak biwankpadam, ŋimombil pu. Nsurm ni nsakm aabɔr

ref: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Maanigeekaab, teer man Tidindaan Yesu Kristo aakpambalb aah nan tuk nimi pu na,

ref: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
text: ke kookoo aayoonn ni, binib ga li bi ki ŋani bininyaam mbɔnyun, ki dii tiwan ni kaa ŋan na aakpeek, Uwumbɔr aah kaa gee pu na.

ref: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
text: Binib ngbaan yakr Yesu aanib la, ki dii bisui aah gee pu na, kaa kpa Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan.

ref: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
text: Maanigeekaab, naah gaa Uwumbɔr aabɔr ti ye chain na pu na, ni li moo dii waasan mbamɔm, ki li mee u Waafuur Nyaan aapɔɔn pu,

ref: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
text: ki li ye binib bi Uwumbɔr ga li gee bi na, ki kii buyoonn Tidindaan Yesu Kristo ga tii timi limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na, waanimbaasaln pu na.

ref: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.
text: Binib bibaa joo beeni la. San bidam kinimbaak man,

ref: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
text: ki ter bibaa mu ke bi ŋmar ki nya ntafadaan ni. San bibaa mu kinimbaak man, ki li nan baatunwanbir ti ŋa bi tijɔŋ na, ki li san ijawaan baatunwanbir taa doo nimi. Kipak aameel

ref: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
text: Uwumbɔr baan baanja le bi. Tidindaan Yesu Kristo pu le u nyan timi ntafadaan ni, ki gaa timi lii. Uwumbɔr le yeh nnyuŋ, ni mpakm, ni mpɔɔn mɔmɔk, ni tiwan mɔmɔk, n‑yoonn mu jer na, ni dandana wee, ni n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Amii.

ref: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
text: Tibɔr tee le Uwumbɔr nan tuk Yesu Kristo ke u nan kpiir tuk waatutum. Ti ye tibɔr ti ga ŋa woween na la. Le Yesu nan tun waatuun ke u buen waatutunn Jɔnn chee ki ti tuk u tibɔr ngbaan.

ref: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
text: Uwumbɔr ni Yesu Kristo aah tuk Jɔnn tibɔr ti, ki mɔk u tiwan ni na, le u ŋmee ni mɔmɔk kigbaŋ ponn ni.

ref: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
text: ki ŋa timi waanaan ni aanib bi ye bitotoorb na, ke ti li tun lituln tii Ute Uwumbɔr. Uma Yesu le ye uyimbidaan, ki kpa mpɔɔn mɔmɔk n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Amii.

ref: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.
text: Lik, u ga dii ntaalangbam ni ki dan. Binib mɔmɔk aanimbil ga kan u. Binib bi nan saa u na mu ga kan u. U pu, le ŋinibol ŋimɔk bi dulnyaa wee ni na ga wii. Ni ye mbamɔn la. Amii.

ref: The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!” A Vision of the Risen Lord
text: Tidindaan Uwumbɔr, u yeh mpɔɔn mɔmɔk, ki nan bi, ki beenin bi, ki ga li bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na le len ke uma le ye Alfa ni Omega, mpiin ngbaan ni ndoon ngbaan. Yesu aah kpiir ubaa mɔk Jɔnn pu na

ref: I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus.
text: Min Jɔnn u ye nina aabo na, m ni nimi kpaan ki ji falaa ni suklaa Yesu pu, ki ye waanaan ni aanib. Uwumbɔr aabɔr ni Yesu aabɔnyaan tee pu, le bi nan di mi kaan lidikl li bi yin li ke Patmos na pu.

ref: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
text: Tidindaan aakpaakool daal le Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan nan fir m pu. Le m ŋun nneel sakpiin len mpuwɔb ke kakaan na,

ref: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
text: Le m fenn lik ke m bee udaan u len m chee kina na. Maah fenn na, le m kan salmaa aawan ni pu karyaa tiib tɔŋni na tiwan nilole,

ref: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.
text: ni unii u naahn Unibɔn Aabo na, bi bikaasisik ni, ki pee libɔkul li pii utaafar na, ki buu salmaa aagbapapaln ubiŋ chee.

ref: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
text: Uyil ni waayikpir piin chain, ke tikokonn na. Unimbil wiin ke mmii na.

ref: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.
text: Utaafar mu wiin ke baah pur tikur ti mmii ni na aah wiin pu na. Uneel mu fuuk ke bunyɔb sakpem aanyun na.

ref: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
text: Le u joo iŋmabi ilole uŋangii ni. Kijaak aajuk ki ka ŋipepel mɔmɔk ŋilee na mu bi umɔb ni. Unimbil wɔb wiin chain, ke nwiin aah wiin chain pu nwiin pu na.

ref: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
text: Maah kan u na, le m lir gbaan unimbiin ni ke maah kpo le na. Le u di uŋangii paan m pu, ki bui mi ke, “Taa san ijawaan. Min le ye mpiin ngbaan ni ndoon ngbaan.

ref: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
text: Min le ye umɔfadaan. M nan kpo, le ki fikr, ki ga li bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na, ki joo nkun ni kitekpiitiŋ aasaafii tiib.

ref: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.
text: Nima pu na, ŋmee saah kan pu na, ki ŋmee naah bi pu dandana wee na, ki ŋmee naah ga nan ŋa pu n‑yoonn mu choo na na.

ref: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
text: Saah kan iŋmabi ilole i ŋŋangii ni, ki kan salmaa aawan ni pu karyaa tiib tɔŋni na tiwan nilole na, naatataa le ye ke iŋmabi ilole ngbaan si maanib bi bi ntim mulole ngbaan ni na aatuuntiib aasisiiyaan. Karyaa tiib aah tɔŋni tiwan ni pu, aan ni ye nilole ngbaan mu si maanib bi bi ntim mulole ngbaan ni na aasisiiyaan.

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
text: “Ŋmee kigbaŋ tii maanib bi bi Efesus aatiŋ ni na aatuun ke min Yesu u joo iŋmabi ilole ngbaan ŋŋangii ni, ki chuun salmaa aawan ni pu karyaa tiib tɔŋni na tiwan nilole na aakaasisik ni na le len tibɔr timina:

ref: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
text: M nyi naah tun lituln linimaln pu na, ki nyi naah kpa limɔr pu na, ki nyi ke ni yii bibiindam, ke ni lik binib bi ŋmanni ke bi ye maakpambalb kaa ye na aabimbin aah bi pu na, ki bee ke bi ye biŋmaŋmannim la.

ref: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
text: Ni kpa limɔr la. M pu, le ni ji falaa, kaa bakr.

ref: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
text: Tɔ, m mu galn nimi; ba pu? naa ki gee mi ke naah nan gee mi njan pu na.

ref: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.
text: Teer man naah nan bi pu, kaa ki bi kina dandana wee na, ki kpeln nimi aabimbin man, ki ki li ŋani ke naah nan ŋani njan pu na. Ni yaa kaa kpeln nimi aabimbin kan, m ga dan ni chee ki nan chuu nyan nimi aakaryaa ngbaan, le naan ki li ye maanib.

ref: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
text: Tɔ, ni mu nan Nikolas aanib aah tun pu na. Naah nan baatuln na, nima le ŋan; m mu nan baah tun pu na.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
text: “U kpa litafal na kan, u ŋun Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aah tuk maanib pu na. “Unii umɔk nyaŋ na, m ga cha u moo limɔfal aasubil ŋi bi Uwumbɔr do, aan bi yin nima chee ke Paradais na. Simina aatiŋ aanib aabɔr

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
text: “Ŋmee kigbaŋ tii maanib bi bi Simina aatiŋ ni na aatuun ke min Yesu u ye mpiin ngbaan ni ndoon ngbaan, ki nan kpo ki ki fikr na le len tibɔr timina:

ref: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
text: M nyi naah ji falaa sakpen pu na, ki ye bigiim pu na; ni mu tee ye biwankpadam le Uwumbɔr chee. M nyi binib bibaa aah sii nimi pu na. Bi len ke bi ye Juu yaab, le kaa ye; bi ye kinimbɔŋ aanib la.

ref: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
text: Ni ga ji falaa dandana wee; ni mu taa san ijawaan man. Kinimbɔŋ ga di ni ponn ni bibaa ŋa kiyondiik ni, aan ni kan ntɔŋ, le ni ga ji falaa iwiin kipiik. Ni li dii maasan mbamɔm ki nan saa nkundaal man. Le m ga nan tii nimi lipal li ye limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
text: “U kpa litafal na kan, u ŋun Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aah tuk maanib pu na. “Unii umɔk nyaŋ na aan kan lelee aakun. Pegamum aatiŋ aanib aabɔr

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
text: “Ŋmee kigbaŋ tii maanib bi bi Pegamum aatiŋ ni na aatuun ke min Yesu u kpa kijaak aajuk ki ka ŋipepel mɔmɔk ŋilee na le len tibɔr timina:

ref: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
text: M nyi naah bi nin chee na, ke ni bi kitiŋ ki ye kinimbɔŋ aatiŋ na ponn ni la. Ni mu beenin si nchaŋ ni la, kaa yii mi. Buyoonn bi nan ku maaseeraadaan bamɔnn Antipas nikaasisik ni, kinimbɔŋ aah bi nin chee na, naa nan yii mi.

ref: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
text: Tɔ, m mu galn nimi tibɔr tibaa pu. Ba pu? Ni ponn ni bibaa joo Balaam aamɔkm; uma le nan mɔk Ubɔr Balak waah ga ŋa pu ki tɔŋ Israel yaab bi ti ŋmɔ libaawol aanann, ki gɔr kidagook, aan Uwumbɔr daa bitafal na.

ref: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
text: Binib bibaa mu bi ni ponn ni, ki ŋani kina, ki dii Nikolas aanib aamɔkm kina.

ref: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
text: Nima pu na, kpeln nimi aabimbin man. Ni yaa kaa kpeln nimi aabimbin kan, m ga fuu ni mala, ki di kijaak aajuk ki bi mmɔb ni na jan binib ngbaan.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone. The Letter to Thyatira
text: “U kpa litafal na kan, u ŋun Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aah tuk maanib pu na. “Unii umɔk nyaŋ na kan, m ga tii u tijikaar ti bɔr aan bi yin ti ke mana na, ki ga tii u litakpapiln li liyimbipɔln ŋmee li pu na. Ubaa aan li nyi liyimbipɔln ngbaan; unii u gaa li na baanja le ga li nyi. Tiataira aatiŋ aanib aabɔr

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
text: “Ŋmee kigbaŋ tii maanib bi bi Tiataira aatiŋ ni na aatuun ke min Uwumbɔr Aajapɔɔn u kpa ŋinimbil ŋi wiin ke mmii na, ni titaafar ti wiin ke baah pur tikur ti mmii ni na aah wiin pu na le len tibɔr timina:

ref: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.
text: M nyi naah tun pu na, ki gee binib pu na, ki gaa mi ki kii pu na, ki kpa limɔr pu na, ki tun lituln dandana wee ki jer naah nan tun njan pu na.

ref: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
text: Tɔ, m mu galn nimi; ba pu? ni ŋmin ki lik Jesebel, upii u len ke u ye Uwumbɔr aabɔnabpii kaa ye na. U ŋmanni maatutum, ki tuk bi ke bi yaa gɔr kidagook ki ŋman libaawol aanann kan, naa bir.

ref: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
text: M tii u nsan ke u kpeln waabimbin, u mu aa ban u di cha kidagook aatuln.

ref: I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop.
text: U ni binib bi dii ki gɔr kidagook na yaa kaa kpeln baabimbin ki di cha waatuln kan, m ga cha bi ji falaa sakpen,

ref: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
text: ki ga ku waabim mu. Le maanib bi bi ŋipepel mɔmɔk na ga bee ke min le nyi bisui ni aah bi pu na. M ga tii ni ponn ni unii mɔmɔk waatuln aah ŋeer pu na.

ref: I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end.
text: Binib bimɔk nyaŋ ki tun maatuln n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na, m ga tii bi tininkpir bi li joo ŋinibol na, ke maah gaa Nte Uwumbɔr chee tininkpir pu na.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
text: “U kpa litafal na kan, u ŋun Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aah tuk maanib pu na.

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.
text: “Ŋmee kigbaŋ tii maanib bi bi Sadis aatiŋ ni na aatuun ke min u kpa Uwumbɔr Aafuur mulole ki joo iŋmabi ilole ŋŋaal ni na le len tibɔr timina: M nyi naah tun pu na, ki nyi ke ni naahn ke ni kpa limɔfal le na, ki mu tee kpo.

ref: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.
text: Fiin man, ki toor nimi aabimbin, ki dii Uwumbɔr mbamɔm ki jer naah dii u pu dandana wee na; nimi aatuln aa gbiin Uwumbɔr aanimbil.

ref: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
text: Nima pu na, teer man naah nan ŋun Uwumbɔr aabɔr ki gaa ti pu na. Ni li keei ti man, ki kpeln nimi aabimbin. Ni yaa kaa finn ngeen pu kan, m ga dan ni chee ke unaayuk aah ga dan pu na. Naan li nyi buyoonn m ga dan ni chee na.

ref: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.
text: Tɔ, ni ponn ni bibaa bi Sadis aatiŋ ponn ni, kaa tun titunwanbir. Bima le ga chuun m chee paacham, ki pee ŋibɔkupiin; ba pu? bi ŋeer kina.

ref: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
text: Unii umɔk nyaŋ na, m ga peen u libɔkupiln. Maan chuu ber waayimbil limɔfal aagbaŋ ni. M ga len ke u ye maanii, Nte Uwumbɔr ni waatuuntiib aanimbiin ni.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Philadelphia
text: “U kpa litafal na kan, u ŋun Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aah tuk maanib pu na. Filadelfia aatiŋ aanib aabɔr

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
text: “Ŋmee kigbaŋ tii maanib bi bi Filadelfia aatiŋ ni na aatuun, ke min Yesu u ye chain, ki ye mbamɔn, ki kpa Ubɔr David aasaafii na, yaa piir mbisamɔb kan, ubaa aan ŋmaa piin mu; m yaa piin mu mu kan, ubaa aan ŋmaa piir mu,

ref: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.
text: min le len tibɔr timina: M nyi naah tun pu na. M bee ke ni kpa mpɔɔn siib. Ni joo maabɔr, kaa yii maayimbil. M piir mbisamɔb tii nimi, le ubaa aan ŋmaa piin mu.

ref: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
text: M ga cha kinimbɔŋ aanib bi mɔn nnyamɔn ke bi ye maanib, kaa ye na, dan ni chee ki nan gbaan kitiŋ ninimbiin ni, ki bee ke m gee nimi la.

ref: You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through.
text: Ni kii maabɔr, ki kpa limɔr. Nima pu na, m mu ga li lik nimi, ki nyan nimi falaa u ga pii dulnyaa aanib mɔmɔk ki tɔŋ bi na ni.

ref: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
text: M ga gir ni mala. Ni li beenin dii maasan mbamɔm ke naah dii pu dandana wee na, ubaa taa leŋ nimi aapiin nsan ni.

ref: Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
text: Unii umɔk nyaŋ na, m ga ŋa u jatɔlk Maawumbɔr Aadichal ni, le u ga li bi nima n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. M ga ŋmee Maawumbɔr aayimbil, ni waatiŋ ki ye Jerusalem pɔɔn ki ga nyan ni u chee paacham na aayimbil u pu. M ga ki ŋmee maayimbipɔln mu u pu.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
text: “U kpa litafal na kan, u ŋun Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aah tuk maanib pu na. Laodisea aatiŋ aanib aabɔr

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
text: “Ŋmee kigbaŋ tii maanib bi bi Laodisea aatiŋ ni na aatuun ke min Yesu u ye mbamɔn, ki len ibamɔn, ki ye Uwumbɔr aah nan naan tiwan ni mɔmɔk na aayidaan na, le len tibɔr timina:

ref: I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other.
text: M nyi naah tun pu na; naa soon kaa ton mu; m ba ga li gee ke ni li soon, bee ni li ton.

ref: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
text: Ni bi ke kinyubɔbɔɔk ki kaa ton kaa soon mu na la; nima pu le m ga tii nimi mmɔb ni lii.

ref: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
text: Ni len ke ni ye biwankpadam ki kan liwangol kaa lann nibaa, kaa tee nyi ke ni kpa kinimbaak, ki ye bigiim, ki ye bijoom, ki si niŋmeen la.

ref: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
text: Nima pu na, m sur nimi ke ni daa m chee salmaa u bi di pu mmii ni aan u ŋa chain na, aan ki sil li ye biwankpadam; ki daa m chee tiwanpeenkaan ni piin na ki di peen, aan binib taa ki kan naah si niŋmeen pu na; ki daa m chee linimbil aanyɔk ki di mee ninimbil aan ki likr.

ref: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.
text: Maah gee binib bimɔk na, m sur bi ki dar bitafal. Nima pu na, cha ninimbil li man aan ni kpeln nimi aabimbin man.

ref: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
text: Li pel man, m si mbisamɔb chee ki kpaar jaaleŋ. Unii umɔk ŋun maaneel ki piir tii mi na, m ga koo ni u chee, ki nan ji u chee tijikaar, u mu ga ji m chee.

ref: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
text: Unii umɔk nyaŋ na, m ga cha u kal m chee maabɔrjal pu, ke m mu aah nan nyaŋ pu ki kal Nte Uwumbɔr chee waabɔrjal pu pu na.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
text: “U kpa litafal na kan, u ŋun Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan aah tuk maanib pu na.”

ref: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.”
text: Waah len ti doo na, le m kan Uwumbɔr do aabisamɔb piir. Le nneel mu naahn kakaan ki len m chee njan na le len ke, “Dan paacham do, le m ga mɔk si budabu ga sil ŋa n‑yoonn mue aapuwɔb na.”

ref: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.
text: Libuul ngbaan ni le Uwumbɔr Aafuur Nyaan yoor mi buen paacham. Le m ti kan libɔrjal si Uwumbɔr do; ubaa mu ka li pu.

ref: The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
text: U ka li pu na wiin chain ki piin, ki man. Waakpimanja u ye likal na mu lur goln libɔrjal ngbaan.

ref: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.
text: Le ŋijal moninko ni ŋinaa mu si gob libɔrjal ngbaan. Bininkpiib moninko ni binaa mu ka ŋijal ngbaan pu, ki pee tiwanpiln, ki chik salmaa aayikpupur.

ref: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.
text: Libɔrjal ngbaan chee moor lak lak ke utaal aah moor pu na, kifuuk mu faa ke utaal aah tar pu na. Karyaa bilole mu wiin libɔrjal ngbaan aanimbiin ni, ki ye Uwumbɔr Aafuur mulole la.

ref: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.
text: Libɔrjal aanimbiin ni wɔb naahn nnyusakpem, ki wiin chain ke kinimbilik aah wiin pu na. Le tiwanfuurkaan ninaa mu si gob libɔrjal ngbaan. Tiwanfuurkaan ngbaan aanimbiin ni, ni nipuwɔb mu nan ye ŋinimbil ŋmeen la.

ref: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
text: Le nibaa naahn uchinn, nibaa mu naahn unaajabo, nibaa mu aanimbil wɔb naahn unii la, nibaa mu naahn libɔrwiin li laani na.

ref: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
text: Ni mɔmɔk nan kpa ifeen iloloob, ki mu nan kpa ŋinimbil tiwon mɔmɔk pu. Nwiin pu ni kinyeek mɔmɔk, naa fuur; n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ni len ke, “Chain, chain, Tidindaan Uwumbɔr u yeh mpɔɔn mɔmɔk na ye chain la. U nan bi, ki beenin bi, ki ga li bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.”

ref: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.
text: Tiwanfuurkaan ninaa ngbaan le len kina, ki di mpakm, ni lisil, ni idoon tii Uwumbɔr u ka libɔrjal pu, ki ga li bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

ref: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
text: “Tidindaan Uwumbɔr, si le ŋeer ke ti pak si, ki nyuŋ si, ki ŋeer aa li kpa mpɔɔn; ba pu? si le naan tiwan mɔmɔk. Saageehn pu le aa nan naan tiwan mɔmɔk. Saageehn pu le ni mɔmɔk bi.”

ref: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.
text: Le m kan Uwumbɔr u ka libɔrjal pu na ŋub kigbaŋ uŋangii ni. Kigbaŋ ngbaan nan kpa ŋŋmeen ŋipepel mɔmɔk, ki dab ŋimɔgbin nfum mulole.

ref: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?”
text: Le m ŋun Uwumbɔr aatuun mpɔɔndaan len mpɔɔn pu ke, “Ŋma ŋeer u dabr kigbaŋ ngbaan ki kpar ki?”

ref: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
text: Le baa kan unii ubaa paacham, bee kitiŋ, bee kitiŋ aataab, u ga ŋmaa kpar kigbaŋ ngbaan ki lik ki ponn ni na.

ref: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
text: Baah kaa kan unii u ŋeer u kpar kigbaŋ ngbaan ki lik ki ponn ni na, nima pu le m wii pam.

ref: Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
text: Le bininkpiib na ponn ni ubaa bui mi ke, “Taa ki wii. Lik, Yesu u pɔɔ ke uchinn, ki ye Juda aanibol ni aanii ubaa, ki ye Ubɔr David aayaabil na le nyaŋ, ki ga ŋmaa dabr kigbaŋ ki bi dab ki nfum mulole na, ki kpar ki.”

ref: Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
text: Le m kan Upihbo si libɔrjal, ni tiwanfuurkaan ninaa, ni bininkpiib na aakaasisik ni. Upihbo ngbaan kpa libuel uneen ni ke baah kɔr u le na, ki kpa iyiin ilole ni ŋinimbil ŋilole ŋi ye Uwumbɔr Aafuur mulole mu Uwumbɔr tun ni mu ŋipepel mɔmɔk dulnyaa wee ni na.

ref: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.
text: Le Upihbo ngbaan buen Uwumbɔr u ka libɔrjal pu na chee, ki ti gaa kigbaŋ ngbaan uŋangii ni.

ref: Then they sang a new song, “You are worthy to receive the scroll and open its seals, because you were killed. And with your own blood you bought for God people from every tribe, language, nation, and race.
text: Le bi gaa ilahnpɔɔn ki tii Upihbo ngbaan ke, “Si le ŋeer aa gaa kigbaŋ ngbaan ki dabr ki; ba pu? aa nan kpo ki di saasin daa binib tii Uwumbɔr; binib ngbaan nyan ŋitimbol mɔmɔk aanib bi bi dulnyaa wee ni, ki len iliin imɔk bi dulnyaa wee ni na,

ref: You let them become kings and serve God as priests, and they will rule on earth.”
text: Aa ŋa bi saanaan ni aanib bi ye bitotoorb na, bi ti tun lituln tii timi Aawumbɔr, le bi ga li joo dulnyaa mɔmɔk.”

ref: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them,
text: Le m lik ki kan Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib ŋichur ŋichur, kaa ti nyi baakahm. Bi si gob Uwumbɔr aabɔrjal, ni tiwanfuurkaan, ni bininkpiib ngbaan.

ref: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
text: Le m ŋun bi mɔmɔk len mpɔɔn pu ke, “Upihbo u bi nan kɔr u na le ŋeer u kan yiko, ni liwankpal, ni nlan, ni mpɔɔn, ni nnyuŋ, ni mpakm, ni idoon.”

ref: Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying, “Praise, honor, glory, and strength forever and ever to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!”
text: Le m ŋun binib bi bi paacham na, ni binib bi bi kitiŋ na, ni binib bi bi kitiŋ aataab na, ni tiwan nimɔk bi nnyusakpem ni na, ni Uwumbɔr aah naan tiwan nimɔk na mɔmɔk len ke, “Uwumbɔr u ka libɔrjal pu na, ni Upihbo ngbaan le yeh mpakm, ni lisil, ni nnyuŋ, ni mpɔɔn, n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.”

ref: The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
text: Le tiwanfuurkaan ninaa ngbaan kii ke “Amii.” Bininkpiib ngbaan mu nan gbaan Uwumbɔr ni Upihbo ngbaan aanimbiin ni ki doon bi.

ref: At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!”
text: M kan Upihbo ngbaan chuu dabr kigbaŋ ki bi nan dab ki nfum mulole pu na nibaa. Le m ŋun tiwanfuurkaan ninaa ngbaan ponn ni nibaa len ke utaal aah tar pu na ke, “Dan.”

ref: Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.
text: Le m lik ki kan utapiin. Unii u dik u pu na joo butɔm. Le bi tii u linyaŋ aayikpupuk u di chiŋ. Le u buen u ti nyaŋ binib, ki sil ti nyaŋ bi.

ref: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come out!”
text: Le Upihbo ngbaan nan ki chuu dabr kigbaŋ ngbaan aadam leler. Le m ŋun tiwanfuurkaan leler len ke, “Dan.”

ref: Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.
text: Le utaman mu fuu ni. Bi nan tii unii u dik utaman ngbaan pu na kijaak aajuk sakpeŋ, le Uwumbɔr tii u mpɔɔn ke u cha dulnyaa aanib to butɔb ki ku tɔb.

ref: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come out!” Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand.
text: Le Upihbo ngbaan ki chuu dabr ndam tatar. Le m ŋun tiwanfuurkaan tatar len ke, “Dan.” Le m lik ki kan utanbɔn. Unii u dik utanbɔn ngbaan pu na nan joo tiwan ni bi joo ŋaŋni tijikaar na uŋaal ni.

ref: I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
text: Le m ŋun nneel len tiwanfuurkaan ninaa ngbaan aakaasisik ni ke, “Tijikaar taa li wiir, taadaak li pɔɔ. Tɔ, taa bii nkpan ni ŋisubil aawanyukaan.”

ref: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come out!”
text: Le Upihbo ngbaan ki chuu dabr ndam nanar. Le m ŋun tiwanfuurkaan nanar aaneel len ke, “Dan.”

ref: Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.
text: Le m lik ki kan utanyɔnyɔn. Unii u dik u pu na aayimbil ye Nkun. U bi yin u ke Kitekpiitiŋ na mu dii u. Le Uwumbɔr tii bi mpɔɔn ke bi di kijaak aajum, ni nkon, ni iween, ni ipeel ku dulnyaa aanib lipepel nanar wɔb.

ref: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith.
text: Le Upihbo ngbaan ki chuu dabr ndam ŋmuŋmur. Le m kan binib aawiin kitork aabimbiln taab, Uwumbɔr do. Bi ye binib bi bi nan ku bi na. Bi nan mooni Uwumbɔr aabɔr ki tuk binib Yesu aabɔnyaan. Nima le cha bi ku bi.

ref: They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
text: Le binib ngbaan aawiin teen mpɔɔn pu ke, “Tidindaan u ye chain ki ye mbamɔn na, ni ga yunn ki ti saa kinye pu aan aa ga ji dulnyaa aanib bi ku timi na aabɔr ki daa bitafal?”

ref: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
text: Le Uwumbɔr peen bi mɔmɔk tikparpipiin, ki bui bi ke u siin ke binib ku bitutuŋeen aatɔtiib bi mɔmɔk dii Yesu na, ke baah nan ku bi pu na. Bi laa fuur siib ki nan saa n‑yoonn ngbaan.

ref: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
text: Le m kan Upihbo ngbaan ki chuu dabr ndam loloob. Le kitiŋ deŋ sakpen. Le nwiin bɔln ke likekebɔln na. Le uŋmal mann ke nsin na.

ref: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
text: Iŋmabi nyan ni paacham ki lir kitiŋ ke kibuŋ aah ker ŋisubil ŋi kaa puir na lir pu na.

ref: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
text: Kitaapaak kpab ki buen ke baah kpai kikapeek pu na. Le ŋijoo ni ŋidik mɔmɔk fii foor.

ref: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.
text: Le dulnyaa aayidam, ni bibɔrb, ni butɔb aajab aayidam, ni biwankpadam, ni bipɔɔndam, ni binaagbiib mɔmɔk, ni bimalb mɔmɔk bɔr titakpalunn ni, ni ŋitakpasakpiin taab ŋijoo paab,

ref: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.
text: ki bui ŋijoo ni ŋitakpal ke, “Lir ti pu, ki biin ti pu, aan Uwumbɔr u ka libɔrjal pu na taa li waa timi, Upihbo ngbaan mu aaŋuul taa pii timi;

ref: That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
text: ba pu? baaŋuul aawiin sakpiin daal fuu ni a. Ŋma ga ŋmaa sil?”

ref: After this I saw four angels. Each one was standing on one of the earth's four corners. The angels held back the four winds, so that no wind would blow on the earth or on the sea or on any tree. These angels had also been given the power to harm the earth and the sea. Then I saw another angel come up from where the sun rises in the east, and he was ready to put the mark of the living God on people. He shouted to the four angels,
text: Le m kan Uwumbɔr aatuun uken nyan ni liwipuul wɔb ki dan paacham, ki joo ni Uwumbɔr u ye limɔfal daan na aadaan, ki nan teen mpɔɔn pu, ki tuk Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib binaa bi Uwumbɔr tii bi mpɔɔn ke bi bii kitiŋ ni nnyusakpem na ke,

ref: “Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
text: “Ni taa bii kitiŋ, bee nnyusakpem, bee isui ki li kii buyoonn ti ga nan daan timi Aawumbɔr aatutum aayigbeer pu na.”

ref: Then I heard how many people had been marked on the forehead. There were
text: Le m ŋun baah daan binib bi na aakahm. Bi nan ye binib ŋichur nkub ni imonko ilee ni ŋinaa, ki nyan ni Israel aanibol mɔmɔk ni.

ref: and said, “Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen!”
text: ki len ke, “Ni ye mbamɔn, timi Aawumbɔr le yeh mpakm, ni nnyuŋ, ni nlan, ni idoon, ni lisil, ni yiko, ni mpɔɔn n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na. Amii.”

ref: After this, I saw a large crowd with more people than could be counted. They were from every race, tribe, nation, and language, and they stood before the throne and before the Lamb. They wore white robes and held palm branches in their hands,
text: Nimina aapuwɔb le m kan kinipaak sakpeŋ. Ubaa aa ti ki nyi baakahm. Bi nyan ŋitimbol mɔmɔk aanib bi bi dulnyaa wee ni ki len iliin imɔk bi dulnyaa wee ni na, ki si Uwumbɔr aabɔrjal ni Upihbo ngbaan aanimbiin ni, ki pee tikparpipiin, ki ŋub tibɔkpafar biŋaal ni,

ref: as they shouted, “Our God, who sits upon the throne, has the power to save his people, and so does the Lamb.”
text: ki teen mpɔɔn pu ke, “Timi Aawumbɔr u ka libɔrjal pu na, ni Upihbo ngbaan le nan gaa timi lii.”

ref: The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God
