text: Le n li baan Baa-n, wee un ji sei ni utiter uba wan na li gbaa be nin ni n-yonn biɛn.

ref: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
text: Ni ma ye ibamɔn a Naaŋin. Dulinya nan a ninfob kaa li fir gaa wi, nan bu-n baa nyi kan wi, laa baan bin biɛ wi. Amaa ni nyi u, nan bu-n u be nin ni le ki li be ni ni.

ref: I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you.
text: Maa li jiɛn ni wee ni be ni binba ke nkpeebimi; n li dan ni ban.

ref: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
text: Naa li yuuri, dulinya nan yaab kaa ji li kami, amaa nim li kam. Nan bu-n maah yin gbaa be nin n miɛfolin, ni mu yin be le nin limiɛfol.

ref: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
text: Lidaal nmɔn ni na li biɛ ke n be nin n Baa le, le ni be nin min, le n be nin ni.

ref: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
text: Wan biɛn chee ki ŋmag n siimin kaah ban man ke, u ma ye wan jiɛm. Wan jiɛm ke u li kan njiɛm n Baa ban, le n mu li jiɛ u ki ta nba ki wɔɔn u.”

ref: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
text: Le Judasi len ke, “Amaa, Uyudaan, ba ŋa wee a yin ta a ba ki wɔɔn ti wee kaa yin wɔɔn dulinya yaabaa?”

ref: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
text: Le Yisa jiin ke, “Ni ye wan jiɛm ke, u li ŋa maah wɔɔn man. N Baa li jiɛ u, le n Baa nin min li dan u ban ki nan be u ban.

ref: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
text: Wan kaa jiɛm kaa li ŋa maah wɔɔn man nin ni. Imɔbon yan ni gbir nan kaa ye n yaa mɔboi yi; i ye Baa wan nan tumin a mɔboi le.

ref: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
text: N pag ni nan biɛn maah la be ni ban nin le.

ref: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
text: Amaa Utiter, Kasi a Naaŋ, wan wee Baa-n yin tun u n yinl bu-n, li wɔɔn ni niwann biɛn ki tiɛr ni niwann nan biɛn wee n nan bei ni.

ref: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
text: Nposɔɔn li be ni ni; nposɔɔn man be n nin le n ta sei ni. Maa sei ni ke dulinya kaah tenn man nin ni. Ni laa che ni mug ni sufu ki laa san bijawaami.

ref: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
text: “Ni gbir maah ke, ‘N yin fɔɔr le ki ji jirin ni ban.’ Ni ye ke a jiɛm ke, a li jɔɔ nmɔn na, maah chaa Baa-n ban nin, nan bu-n Baa-n li yab ki jom.

ref: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
text: Daandaan nan n bei ni le wee nin ni ŋa, wee ni nan ŋa ke ni li ŋa yada.

ref: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
text: Maa ji li pag nin ni ki yuuri, nan bu-n dulinya nan a bɔrbig le chaan nin. Waa jɔɔ n pɔɔmi,

ref: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
text: amaa ni kpaa le nin dulinya nan n tinn ki biɛ ke n jiɛ Baa-n le ki tun waah wɔɔnim man nin dede. “Ni che ti fɔɔr do; daandaan nan.

ref: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
text: Min le ye busub bamɔm, le n Baa le ye ukpadaan.

ref: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
text: U gaar ibon yan biɛn be nni wee kaa lo iloon nin le ki jaar, le ki mann gbar ibon yan biɛn lo iloon nin wee yin mann lo iloon.

ref: You are already clean because of what I have said to you.
text: Nim pii be le chasi, nan bu-n maah nan bei ni imɔbon yan nin bu.

ref: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
text: Ni li be nin ma, wee n mu li be nin ni. Nbon kaa li fir lo iloon mitɔɔli; ni kpaan le mi li tɔ busub a nyagil bu. Ni mu kaa li fir lo iloon ni see ke ni be nin min.

ref: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.
text: “Min le ye linyagil; le ni ye ibon. Ni ye ke uninfosaal be nin min wee n be nin u ke, u li lo iloon takpem; naa ye n bu ke naa li fir ŋa niba.

ref: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
text: Ni ye wan biɛn kaa lagin be nin min ke, u nann nbon man bi gaa jaa wee mi koor le; ibon nmɔn a bosu le bi pii, ki jaar nŋmi-n le yin gaa boor.

ref: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.
text: Ni ye ke ni be nin min wee n mɔleen be nin ni ke, ni baan naah ban nan biɛn bu ke, ni li kan ni.

ref: When you become fruitful disciples of mine, my Father will be honored.
text: Ni nan li ye n Baa a pag, ke ni lo iloon takpem, ki wɔɔn ni ba ke ni ye n bɔɔnɔɔb le.

ref: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
text: “Ke Baa-n kaah nan jiɛm man nin, man le n mu jiɛ ni. Daandaan nan li be nin n jiɛmin yaan na.

ref: If you obey me, I will keep loving you, just as my Father keeps loving me, because I have obeyed him.
text: Ni ye ke ni chee sei n siimin ke, ni li be nin n jiɛmin yaan, ke maah chee sei n Baa a siimin man wee ki be u jiɛmin yaan man nin.

ref: I have told you this to make you as completely happy as I am.
text: N bei ni ni nan le ke n mɔm li be ni ban wee ni mɔm ngbeen.

ref: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
text: N mɔsiinl ye nan le: Ni li jiɛ tab ke maah jiɛ ni man nin.

ref: The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them.
text: Njiɛm takpem kaa be ki jon nin uninfosaal nta u miɛfol ki kpenn u jɔtiibi.

ref: And you are my friends, if you obey me.
text: Ni ye ni ŋa n siimin kaah len man ke ni ye n jɔtiib le.

ref: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
text: Maa ji yin yi ni bitoontumi, nan bu-n utoontunn kaa nyi u daau a toon yi. Amaa, n yi ni n jɔtiib le, nan bu-n maah biɛ nan n Baa ban nin n che ni mu biɛ na.

ref: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
text: Nim li kaa nan gann mi, amaa min li nan gann ni ke ni lo iloon yan kaa jɔɔ diɛmi. Wee Baa-n li sei ni niwann nan biɛn wee ni baan u n yinl bu.

ref: So I command you to love each other. The World's Hatred
text: N siim sɔ: Ni li jiɛ taba. Dulinya nan a ninaŋ

ref: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.
text: “Ni ye dulinya nan yaab nan ni ke, ni li nyi ke bi nan chinn nan min le.

ref: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
text: Ni ye ke ni ye dulinya nan yaab ke, ki li jiɛ ni ke ki yaabin. Naah ye man nin, naa ye dulinya nan yaabi, amaa n nan gann ni ki nyan ni dulinya nan yaan na. Mambu le dulinya nan nan ni.

ref: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
text: Ni li tiɛr imɔbon yan wee n nan pag ki sei nin na: ‘Utoontunn kaa yab jon u daau wi.’ Ni ye bi nan mugirim ke, bi li mugir ni mu. Ni ye bi chee sei n wɔɔm ke, bi li chee sei ni mu a wɔɔm.

ref: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
text: Bi yin ŋaa ni nan le n yinl bu, nan bu-n baa nyi Wan nan tunimi.

ref: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
text: Maa nan bi dan ki nan pag sei bi ke, baa bi li jɔɔ tibir a galin yi, amaa, daandaan nan, baa ji li fir ke baa nyi bi bir bu.

ref: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
text: Wan nam ke u nan n Baa baantɔɔl le.

ref: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.
text: Ni ye ke maa nan bi ŋa niwann nan wee uba kaa fir ŋa bi sisiigin ke, baa bi jɔɔ tibir a galin yi. Amaa daandaan nan bi nan kan ligaril a siɛrama, le ni biɛn yɔli bi nan min nin n Baa biɛn le.

ref: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
text: Amaa ni nan li ye nin gbeen nsiimin kaah nan sɔb man nin: ‘Bi nam le laa jɔɔ bu.’

ref: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.
text: “Utiter, wan wee n yin tun u wee un nyann Baa-n ban nin, ki ye ibamɔn a naaŋ kan nyann Baa-n ban nin dan ke, u li ji n siɛra.

ref: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
text: Ni ye ni mu nji n siɛra le, nan bu-n ni be n ban le npiinimin na.

ref: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.
text: Ni niɛ biɛn, N nan bei na wee nin che ni laa kɔɔ kulɔŋi.

ref: You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor.
text: Bi li nyann ni kuwonjiɛndiigin; ibamɔn buu, n-yonn chaan le wan biɛn yin kuŋ le tiɛr ke u tun itoon le ki tenn Uwonbɔr.

ref: They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me.
text: Bi li tun ni nan biɛn, nan bu-n baa nyi Baa-n bee min ni.

ref: I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said. The Work of the Holy Spirit I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things.
text: N nan bei ni ni nan le, wee n-yonn nmɔn nan foo ke ni li tiɛr maah nan kpaan nin. Maah la nan be ni ban nin bu le maa nan bei ni man ni. Kasi a naaŋ kaah tun man

ref: But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going.
text: “Daandaan nan n chaa wan nan tumin ban le, amaa ni ni uba kaa baam ke, ‘A chaa laa?’

ref: You are very sad from hearing all of this.
text: Maah len man nin bu, ni pooi bii le.

ref: But I tell you I am going to do what is best for you. This is why I am going away. The Holy Spirit cannot come to help you until I leave. But after I am gone, I will send the Spirit to you.
text: Amaa n bei ni ibamɔn le: N fɔr ke ni yin kpiɛ nim le. Maa jon ke, Utiterin kaa yin dan ni ban ni; amaa n jon ke, n li tun u ni ban.

ref: The Spirit will come and show the people of this world the truth about sin and God's justice and the judgment.
text: U nan dan ke, u li ji dulinya tibɔr le dulinya nlu, nin Uwonbɔr a buchin binbem, nin U bɔjil ki wɔɔn:

ref: The Spirit will show them that they are wrong about sin, because they didn't have faith in me.
text: Ki jiin tibir paam bi galin na, nan bu-n bininfob kaa ŋam yada;

ref: They are wrong about God's justice, because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me again.
text: le ki jiin nbuchin binbem paam bi galin na, nan bu-n n chaa Baa-n ban le, nan yaan wee naa ji li kami;

ref: And they are wrong about the judgment, because God has already judged the ruler of this world.
text: le ki jiin libɔjil paam bi galin na, nan bu-n daandaan nan dulinya a bɔrbigin pii biiu.

ref: I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand.
text: “N jɔɔ tibɔr pam n pag sei ni, tan yab jon ni tuli kaah li gbir man.

ref: The Spirit shows what is true and will come and guide you into the full truth. The Spirit doesn't speak on his own. He will tell you only what he has heard from me, and he will let you know what is going to happen.
text: Amaa u ma, wan ye ibamɔn a naaŋin, nan dan ke, u li che ni biɛ ibamɔn biɛn. Waa li pag u tɔɔl a pɔɔm bu; u li pag waah gbir tan nin a binba le, le u li bei ni niwann nan la chaan nin ŋa.

ref: The Spirit will bring glory to me by taking my message and telling it to you.
text: U li ta kupag ki seim ki ta nan ye n yann nin ki wɔɔn ni.

ref: Everything the Father has is mine. This is why I have said that the Spirit takes my message and tells it to you. Sorrow Will Turn into Joy
text: Niwann nan biɛn wee Baa-n ye-n ye n yann le. Ni ma bu le n ke kinaaŋin li ta maah ye nan ki wɔɔn ni wee ni biɛ.” Lipoobiil nin nmɔn

ref: Jesus told his disciples, “For a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.”
text: “Ni kpiɛ wama ke naa ji yin gami, le ni bɔɔn wama mu ni ji li kam.”

ref: They said to each other, “What does Jesus mean by saying that for a little while we won't see him, but after a while we will see him? What does he mean by saying he is going to the Father?
text: Le u bɔɔnɔɔbin biba baan tab ke, “Ba ŋa wee u len ke, ‘Ni kpiɛ wama ke naa ji yin gami, le ni bɔɔn bu ke ni ji li kam.’ Le ki ji len ke, ‘Nan bu-n n chaa Baa-n ban lee’?”

ref: What is this ‘little while’ that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.”
text: Le bi gbaa baan tab ke, Waah ke ‘ni kpiɛ wama ke’ nmɔn, ni taai ye baa? Taa biɛ nan wee u pag nmɔn ni.”

ref: Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said: You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.
text: Le Yisa nan kan ke bi ban bin baan u le ni taai, le u bei bi ke, “Ni baan tab le maah len ke ‘Ni kpiɛ wama ke naa ji yin gami, le ni bɔɔn bu ke ni li kamin’ a taai yaa?

ref: I tell you for certain that you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but later you will be happy.
text: N bei ni ibamɔn le, ni li mɔɔ ki fabin amaa le ni mɔ dulinya yaab. Ni sufu li bii, amaa ni sufu biil nmɔn li kpann nmɔn.

ref: When a woman is about to give birth, she is in great pain. But after it is all over, she forgets the pain and is happy, because she has brought a child into the world.
text: Upii be maa kibig ke ni wu u le nan bu-n u yonni li foo; amaa ni ye u ma u bigin ki diɛ ke u tamir nwunwun nin bu le ni mɔ u waah ma kibig ŋa dulinya nin bu.

ref: You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel.
text: Man le ni ye ki sei ni: Daandaan nan le ye ni sufu biil a yonni, amaa n ji li kan ni le ni jɔɔ nmɔn, le uba kaa li fir ta ni mɔm nmɔn ki sin jiɛn ni.

ref: When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
text: Lidaal nmɔn nan foo ke naa ji na yin baanim niba. N bei ni ibamɔn le, n Baa li sei ni nan biɛn wee ni baan n yinlin bu.

ref: You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.
text: Naah yuur ki nan kpaa daandaan nan naa la baan ni ba n yinl bu. Ni baan na wee ki gaa, wee ni mɔm nmann gbeen. Taah nyaŋ dulinya man

ref: I have used examples to explain to you what I have been talking about. But the time will come when I will speak to you plainly about the Father and will no longer use examples like these.
text: “Maah le gbaa pag tenn ni pag woon a poolin nin, n-yonn chaan le maa ji na li pag ileen nmɔn a booli yi amaa n yin pag npaan nin le ki jiin n Baa-n paam.

ref: You will ask the Father in my name, and I won't have to ask him for you.
text: Lidaal nmɔn ni na li baan naah ban nan n yinl bu. Maa ke min le na yin baan Baa-n ki sei ni.

ref: God the Father loves you because you love me, and you believe I have come from him.
text: Aai, Baa-n tɔɔl jiɛ ni nan bu-n naah jiɛm wee ki ŋaam yada ke n nyann Uwonbɔr ban nin bu.

ref: I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.
text: N nyann Baa-n ban le ki kɔɔn dulinya ni; daandaan nan n nya dulinya ni le ki chaa jir Baa-n ban.”

ref: The disciples said, “Now you are speaking plainly to us! You are not using examples.
text: Le Yisa a bɔɔnɔɔbin ke, “Daandaan nan a pag ni ween le kaa ji pag liwool a poolin ni.

ref: At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.”
text: Daandaan nan ti kan ke a nyi niwann biɛn hali kaa ji ban u ba n baaniŋ ibinbaan ni. Ni ma che ti ŋaaŋ yada ke a nyann Uwonbɔr ban le.”

ref: Jesus replied: Do you really believe me?
text: Le Yisa bei ke, “Ni ŋa yada njoorimin le!

ref: The time will come and is already here when all of you will be scattered. Each of you will go back home and leave me by myself. But the Father will be with me, and I won't be alone.
text: Amaa n-yonn chaan, le ki pii foon na, le ni na li worin, ki kun ni niin yin uba ba uba ba. Ni biɛn na yin jiɛn nbinba le, ni biɛn yɔli maa be nbinba, nan bu-n n Baa be nim.

ref: I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.
text: “N bei ni ni niɛ nan, naah li ŋa man wee ni li jɔɔ nposɔɔn nni. Dulinya nan yaan ni li kan tibɔmugkaar. Amaa ni che ni sufu li pɔɔu! N nyaŋ dulinyau.”

ref: After Jesus had finished speaking to his disciples, he looked up toward heaven and prayed: Father, the time has come for you to bring glory to your Son, in order that he may bring glory to you.
text: Yisa kaah nan len man nmɔn, ni bɔɔn bu le U yaar lig paab le ki miɛ Uwonbɔr ke: “N baa, n-yonn nmɔn foo u. Che A bija n kan kupag wee A bija mu n pagiŋ.

ref: And you gave him power over all people, so he would give eternal life to everyone you give him.
text: Nan bu-n fin le sei u tininkper a pɔɔm le u jon bininfob biɛn ke un sei ban biɛn wee A ta sei win limiɛfol lan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛm.

ref: Eternal life is to know you, the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, the one you sent.
text: Daandaan nan limiɛfol lan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛm nmɔn ye nan le: Ke bin biɛ fin wan ye ibamɔn a Wonbɔru win, nin Yisa Masiya, wan wee a tun nin.

ref: I have brought glory to you here on earth by doing everything you gave me to do.
text: N ŋmagin kupag nan dulinya-n le n nan seiŋ maah diɛ litoonl lan wee A nan ta seim ke n tun nin.

ref: Now, Father, give me back the glory I had with you before the world was created.
text: Le daandaan nan, n Baa, seim kupag A nintogil ni, kupag kan wee n nan kan A ban n-yonn man wee dulinya kaa la nan naan nin.

ref: You have given me some followers from this world, and I have shown them what you are like. They were yours, but you gave them to me, and they have obeyed you.
text: “N kpiiriŋ ki wɔɔn bininfob ban wee A nan ta seim dulinya nan yaan nin na. Bi nan ye A yaab le; Fin le ta bi seim le bi chee A mɔleen.

ref: They know that you gave me everything I have.
text: Daandaan nan bi nyi ke niwann nan biɛn wee A ta seimin nyann Fin ban le.

ref: I told my followers what you told me, and they accepted it. They know I came from you, and they believe you are the one who sent me.
text: Nan bu-n n ta imɔleen yan wee A ta seimin ki sei ba, le bi gaa i. Bi nyi ibamɔn ke n nyan Fin ban le, ki ŋa yada ke Fin le tunim.

ref: I am praying for them, but not for those who belong to this world. My followers belong to you, and I am praying for them.
text: N miɛ le ki tenn bi. Maa miɛ tenn dulinya, amaa ban wee A ta bi seimin, nan bu-n bi ye A yaab le.

ref: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine, and they will bring glory to me.
text: Maah jɔɔ ban ye A yaab le, le Ŋaah jɔɔ ban nin biɛn ye n yaab. Le n kan kupag bi ban.

ref: Holy Father, I am no longer in the world. I am coming to you, but my followers are still in the world. So keep them safe by the power of the name you have given me. Then they will be one with each other, just as you and I are one.
text: Maa ji yin be dulinya nan yaan ni, amaa bi ma la be dulinya nan yaan, min chaan A ban le. Baa wan be kasi, guur bi A yinlin a pɔɔm bu, liyinl lan wee A ta sei min bu, naah li ŋa man wee bin ŋa nba ke taah ye nba man nin.

ref: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power you have given me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost, except the one who had to be lost. This happened so that what the Scriptures say would come true.
text: Maah la nan be bi ban nin, n nan guu bi le ki ŋmag bi A yinl lan wee A nan ta seim nmɔn a pɔɔm bu. Bi ni uba kaa bori see gab yɔli a ninfo win naah li ŋa man wee nin gbeen naah sɔb man Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin nin.

ref: I am on my way to you. But I say these things while I am still in the world, so my followers will have the same complete joy that I do.
text: “N chaan A ban le daandaan nan, amaa n pag ni niɛ nan n-yonn man wee n la be dulinya nan yaan ni le, naah li ŋa man wee bin gbee nin n mɔmin bi sufu ni.

ref: I have told them your message. But the people of this world hate them, because they don't belong to this world, just as I don't.
text: Min le ta A mɔleen yin ki sei bi le dulinya yaab nan bi, nan bu-n baa ji ye dulinya yaab jigin ke maah kaa ye dulinya a ninfou man nin.

ref: Father, I don't ask you to take my followers out of the world, but keep them safe from the evil one.
text: N wonmiɛl kaa ye A nyan bi dulinya nan yaan ni, amaa n miɛ le ke A guur bi ki nyan bi tibir daan a nɔɔn.

ref: They don't belong to this world, and neither do I.
text: Baa ye dulinya yaabi, hali a li ke maah kaa ye dulinya a ninfou man nin.

text: Le Piita baan u ke, “Ba ŋa wee ni kpaag bimɔb, ki mag Uyudaan a Naaŋ aa? Lig! Ban ta a chal ki tan pii-n a taai li dɔ ntimansanmɔnn nan, bi ji li yuur a mu.”

ref: At once she fell at Peter's feet and died. When the young men came back in, they found Sapphira lying there dead. So they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
text: Libol nmɔn, le u mu nyiɛr lu u tum ki kpo. Le binaachipɔmin kɔɔn ki nan kan waah kpo dɔ, le bi ji yuur u mu nyan ki tan pii u bagin u chal.

ref: The church members were afraid, and so was everyone else who heard what had happened. Peter's Unusual Power
text: Le bijawaam nan mann choo biwonjiɛm a laguŋin nin ban biɛn nan gbir nan tun nmɔn takpem. Ligaril nin lijinjeel a toon

ref: The apostles worked many miracles and wonders among the people. All of the Lord's followers often met in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch.
text: Itoon nin nan tun ligaril a siɛra nin lijinjeel a toon le takpem bininfobin a sisiigin. Biwonjiɛm biɛn nan ti lagin tab Solomɔnn a dɔŋin le.

ref: No one outside their group dared join them, even though everyone liked them very much.
text: Hali nin bininfobin kaa nan jɔɔ li nungbeel bi ni-n, baa nan fir lagin bi ban ni, amaa le ki sin nan pag ki don Yisa a bɔɔnɔɔbin takpem.

ref: Many men and women started having faith in the Lord.
text: Nin nima biɛn ni, le bijab nin bipiib takpem nan ŋa Uyudaan yada le nin kpiɛ bi kanlin.

ref: Then sick people were brought out to the road and placed on mats. It was hoped that Peter would walk by, and his shadow would fall on them and heal them.
text: Mambu le bininfob nan nyan nin bibaarib, ki paan bi gadum nin tiwandɔɔn wann bu, nsan gbaan ke Piita nan chaa jo n-yonn man ke, u jinjiim li lu bibam bu.

ref: A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed. Trouble for the Apostles
text: Le bininfob ban be Jerusalam a tinbumin mu tu bibaarib, nin ban wee nnaanbiim mugir bin ki dan, le bi biɛn nan kan kutebug. Baah nan mugir Itoon man

ref: The high priest and all the other Sadducees who were with him became jealous.
text: Le biminmanib a yudaau nin u tab biɛn ban ye Sadusi yaab nan jɔɔ lipiiponl nin itoon nin.

ref: They arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail.
text: Le bi choo itoon nin ki kɔɔn bi kuloondiig kan bi loog bininfob biɛn.

ref: But that night an angel from the Lord opened the doors of the jail and led the apostles out. The angel said,
text: Amaa lidaal a nyiɛg le Uyudaan a malaka jiirin ki nan loor kuloondiigin a naanganl, ki nyan itoon nmɔn niin.

ref: “Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.”
text: Le ki bei bi ke, “Ni li chaa iwonjiɛn niin nan yaan, ki tan sir, ki bei bininfobin limiɛfol pɔnl nan a bɔr biɛn na.”

ref: So they went into the temple before sunrise and started teaching. The high priest and his men called together their council, which included all of Israel's leaders. Then they ordered the apostles to be brought to them from the jail.
text: Baah gbir u bɔr nmɔn, le bi jon ki tan kɔɔ iwonjiɛn niin nmɔn yaan, njakpanyiɛn ki piin ki wɔɔn bininfob. Biminmanib a yudaau nin u tabin kaah nan dan ni, le bi yin Iziral yaab a yudamin biɛn, le ki tun ke bin tan nyan Yisa a toon yin kuloondiigin ni ki ta bi dan.

ref: The temple police who were sent to the jail did not find the apostles. They returned and said,
text: Amaa baah nan tan fo kuloondiig nmɔn yaan ki tan lig, kaa nan kan bi, le ki jir bisanliibin ban ki tan bei bi ke,

ref: “We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.”
text: “Ti foo kuloondiigin ki miin inaangan nin kpal le; le ban guun si ki guu, amaa le ti loor kaa kan uba kuloondiigin a poolin ni.”

ref: The captain of the temple police and the chief priests listened to their report, but they did not know what to think about it.
text: Ban guu iwonjiɛn niin a ninkpelu nin biminmanib a yudamin kaah gbir man nin, le ni ŋa bi kuŋmaruŋ nin lijinjeel, nan na li ŋa.

ref: Just then someone came in and said, “Now those men you put in jail are in the temple, teaching the people!”
text: Le uba kɔɔn, ki nan bei bi ke, “Ni lig! Bijab ban wee ni ta ŋa kuloondiigin nin, bi si iwonjiɛn niin ki wɔɔn bininfob Uwonbɔr a bɔr.”

ref: The captain went with some of the temple police and brought the apostles back. But they did not use force. They were afraid that the people might start throwing stones at them.
text: Iyaayoo nmɔn le ban guu iwonjiɛn niin nin a ninkpelu nin u tabin jon ki tan ta itoon nin ki jirin. Baa nan nyan bi nin npɔɔn ni, nan bu-n bi nan san bijawaam le ke bininfobin na li gabir bi itangbag.

ref: When the apostles were brought before the council, the high priest said to them,
text: Baah nan ta itoon nin jirin n-yonn man nin, le bi che bi sir Juu yaab a yudam a nintogil, wee biminmanib a yudaan win baan bi ibinbaan,

ref: “We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.”
text: Le u len ke, “Ti nan sei ni bimɔb nin inunman, ke ni laa wɔɔn bininfob li yinl nan ni, ke lig naah ta nwɔɔnim nmɔn ki yar Jerusalam a gbanann biɛn, wee ki che Yisa a cham nan yin be ti nɔɔn.”

ref: Peter and the apostles replied: We don't obey people. We obey God.
text: Le Piita nin u tooi tabin jiin ke: “Ni kpaa le nin ti chee Uwonbɔr a mɔb le ki jiɛn uninfosaal a mɔb!

ref: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life
text: Yisa wan wee ni pii nan kpa u lidapunpunl bu wee u kpe-n, Uwonbɔr wan ye ti Wonbɔru nan fiin u nkumin na.

ref: and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven.
text: Le ki don u ki tan kaan U baan tɔɔl a nɔɔjiim paam, ki ŋa u ki Bɔrbig nin Ufeer, ke Iziral yaabin kpenn bi binbema, wee un jiɛn bi toonbir ki per bi.

ref: We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.
text: Tim nin Kasi a Naaŋin le ye ni nan a siɛradam, le Uwonbɔr ta U Kasi a Naaŋ nmɔn sei ban cheel U mɔb.”

ref: When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles.
text: Juu yaab a yudamin kaah gbir man n-yonn man nin, le bi ŋuui fii, le bi ban bin ku bi.

ref: But one of the members was the Pharisee Gamaliel, a highly respected teacher. He ordered the apostles to be taken out of the room for a little while.
text: Amaa Farasiim a ninfou uba nan be niin, le u yinl ye Gamaliɛl, u nan ye wan wɔɔnn Uwonbɔr a siim le, le bininfob biɛn tenn u jilima, le u fii sir Juu yaab a yudam a laguŋ nmɔn yaan, ki len ke bin laan ta itoon nmɔn ki nyan nkaafiin wamau;

ref: Then he said to the council: Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men.
text: le ki sin bei biyudam nmɔn ke, “Hei Iziral yaab, ni li nyi naah ke ni ŋa bininfob nan man nan fa.

ref: Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
text: U kum a bɔɔn, le Judasi wan nan ye Galilii a ninfo win mu nyan ki sir lininfo kanl a yonn, ki wɔɔn u ba, ki kpenn bininfob takpem a lam le bi nɔɔ u. Le bininfob ji nan ku u, le u bɔɔnɔɔbin biɛn worin.

ref: So I advise you to stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If what they are planning is something of their own doing, it will fail.
text: Mambu, n kpaan ni le ke ni paan jaa bininfob nmɔn na! Ki che bi li chaau! Wee ni ye bi toon nmɔn ye bininfosaalib yaan le ke, naa yin tun ni.

ref: But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God. The council members agreed with what he said,
text: Amaa ni ye ni nyan Uwonbɔr ban ke, naa li fir gɔɔ bi. Ni li kan ke ni kɔnn Uwonbɔr le.”

ref: and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.
text: Le biyudam nmɔn nin chee Gamaliɛl a mɔb ki yin itoon nin ki kɔɔn, ki che bi boo bi ki ta bi jaa, ki sei bi bimɔb ke, bi li nyi ki laa mɔɔn Yisa a yinl nmɔn ni.

ref: The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus.
text: Le itoon nin nan nyan Juu yaab a yudamin ban nin nmɔn, nin baah kpaan nin bin ji ifa Yisa a yinl bu-n.

ref: Every day they spent time in the temple and in one home after another. They never stopped teaching and telling the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
text: Lidaal biɛn ke bi chaa iwonjiɛn niin ni le, le ki jin mɔɔn Yisa a yinl bininfob a niin yin, ke Yisa le ye Masiya, ki ji mɔɔn u bɔŋann nin.

ref: A lot of people were now becoming followers of the Lord. But some of the ones who spoke Greek started complaining about the ones who spoke Aramaic. They complained that the Greek-speaking widows were not given their share when the food supplies were handed out each day.
text: N-yonn man wee Yisa a bɔɔnɔɔb nan mann kpiɛgin, le Juu yaab ban pag Girig a leen yin, nan ŋulin Juu yaab ban pag Hiiburu a leen yin bu, nan bu-n bi pukɔɔi kaa nan gaan tijiir naah bi ye bi li gaan man ni ni.

ref: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, “We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables.
text: Le itoon piig nin bilee-n yin Yisa a bɔɔnɔɔbin biɛn ki lagin tab, ki bei bi ke, “Naa ŋan nin ti jiɛn Uwonbɔr a bɔr a mɔɔnim ki paar tijiir a tolimin ni.

ref: My friends, choose seven men who are respected and wise and filled with God's Spirit. We will put them in charge of these things.
text: N nabum, ni lig wee ki gann bijab bilile ni sisiigin, ban wee ni nyi ke bi gbee nin Kinaaŋin nin nlam gɔr kaam, wee ti ta man a toon ki sei bi,

ref: We can spend our time praying and serving God by preaching.”
text: wee tim nta ti tɔɔl a saŋi ki ŋa liwonmiɛlin, nin Uwonbɔr a bɔrin a wɔɔnimin.”

ref: This suggestion pleased everyone, and they began by choosing Stephen. He had great faith and was filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they chose Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and also Nicolaus, who worshiped with the Jewish people in Antioch.
text: Ni nan gbee bininfobin biɛn a numa, le bi gann Sitifin, wan gbee nin Kasi a Naaŋ ki jɔɔ yada nan, nin Filib, Pirokorusi, nin Nikanor, nin Timonn, nin Pamenasi, nin Nikolasi, wan nan nyan Antiɛg wee ki kpenn u wonjiɛnl ki nɔɔ Juu yaab a wonjiɛnlin.

ref: These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work.
text: Le bi ta bi jon itoon nan ban, le bi ta bi nɔɔi ki paan bi bu ki miɛ Uwonbɔr ki sei bi.

ref: God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord. Stephen Is Arrested
text: Le bi mann mɔɔn Uwonbɔr a bɔrin. Le Yisa a bɔɔnɔɔb ban be Jerusalam nan a kanl nan kpiɛ weem weem, le Uwonbɔr a minmanib takpem chee Yisa a bɔŋann nin ki ŋa u yada. Baah nan choo Sitifin man

ref: But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves “Free Men.” They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him.
text: Le bininfob biba nan fii ki yii Sitifin a bɔr, bi nan ye ‘Yemba’ le ki nyan ban nan kan nŋmarim ki be Juu yaab a wonjiɛn bolin bi nan nyan Sarene nin Alɛgzandira nin Silisiya, nin Asiya le. Le bi biɛn nan piin ki far limɔkpel nin Sitifin.

ref: But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him.
text: Amaa baa nan fir pag nyaŋ Sitifin ni, nan bu-n u na pag nin nlam gɔr kaam le nin Kinaaŋ a pɔɔm.

ref: So they talked some men into saying, “We heard Stephen say terrible things against Moses and God!”
text: Le bi kɔɔ bininfob biba bu ki gbaa bi ke bin len ke, “Ti gbir waah pag imɔbon iba ki sugir Moziz nin Uwonbɔr.”

ref: They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.
text: Baah len man n-yonn man nin, le bininfobin, nin bininkpeebin, nin ban wɔɔnn Uwonbɔr a siimin a ŋuui fii, le bi fii ki choo Sitifin, ki ta u jon Juu yaab a yudamin ban.

ref: Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, “This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses.
text: Le bi ji ŋmag bininfob biba ni, ki ke bin por tibɔkar ke, “Iyoo biɛn uja nan le choon le ki pag ki bii iwonjiɛn niin nin Moziz a siimin.

ref: We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.”
text: Nan bu-n ti gbir u ke Yisa wan ye Nazarif a ninfo win li ber iwonjiɛn niin ki ji kpenn Moziz a kaal lan wee u nan ta sei ti nan.”

ref: Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.
text: Le ban nan lagin ka Juu yaab a yudam a laguŋ nmɔn yaan biɛn nan ta bi numbili ki kpaa Sitifin, ki nan kan u num paam kaah nann Malaka a num.

ref: The high priest asked Stephen, “Are they telling the truth about you?”
text: Le biminmanib a yudaau baan Sitifin ke, “Baah galiŋ man nan sin ye ibamɔn naa?”

ref: Stephen answered: Friends, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he had moved to Haran.
text: Le Sitifin jiin ke, “N nabum nin n baam, ni pel n bɔr nan na man! N-yonn man wee ti yaaja Abiraham nan be Mesopotamiya a tingbɔŋin, iyaayoo ki miin waa la jon Haran ni, le Uwonbɔr a pag degir u bu.

ref: God told him, “Leave your country and your relatives and go to a land that I will show you.”
text: Ki bei u ke, ‘Nya a tiŋin nin a ninfobin; wee ki li chaa kitiŋ kan wee n li wɔɔn niŋ nan.’

ref: Then Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, Abraham came and settled in this land where you now live.
text: “Iyaayoo nmɔn le u fii ki jiɛn Chalidiɛn a tiŋ nmɔn, le ki jon ki tan kal Haran. U baa a kum a bɔɔn le Uwonbɔr che u fii niin, ki dan kitiŋ kan yaan wee ni nin be nan.

ref: God didn't give him any part of it, not even a square meter. But God did promise to give it to him and his family forever, even though Abraham didn't have any children.
text: Waa nan sei u kitiŋ a faali, hali waa nan ta kitiŋ nmɔn a bɔgil wama ki sei wi. Amaa le ki siin limɔsiinl ke u li sei, u ma nin u yaabili ki tiŋ nmɔn, hali nin Abiraham kaah kaa la nan jɔɔ kibig nan.

ref: God said Abraham's descendants would live for a while in a foreign land. There they would be slaves and would be mistreated
text: Uwonbɔr nan bei u nan le: ‘A yaabili na yin ye bicham le kitiŋ kan kaa ye bi yaagi, le bi li ŋa bi biyom niin, ki kan limugil takpem, ki tan kpaa ibin kobina.

ref: But he also said, “I will punish the nation that makes them slaves. Then later they will come and worship me in this place.”
text: Amaa N li dar libol lan che bi tun tenn bi ke biyom nan a tul. Ni bɔɔn bu, N li nyan bi kitiŋ nmɔn yaan, ki dan kitiŋ nan yaan, ki nan jiɛnim.’

ref: God said to Abraham, “Every son in each family must be circumcised to show you have kept your agreement with me.” So when Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him. Later, Isaac circumcised his son Jacob, and Jacob circumcised his twelve sons.
text: Uwonbɔr nan siin lipunjiil a mɔsiinl le ki sei Abiraham. Le Abiraham nan ma Azig, le ki nan jii u punl iween itaa daal. Le Azig mu nan ma Jekɔb, le Jekɔb mu nan ma u naachim piig nin bilee-n, ban ye ti yaajaninkpeebin.

ref: These men were our ancestors. Joseph was also one of our famous ancestors. His brothers were jealous of him and sold him as a slave to be taken to Egypt. But God was with him
text: “Jekɔb a naachim nmɔn kaah nan jɔɔ lipiiponl bi waal Josef bu-n, le bi nan choo u kɔɔr sei Ijibir yaab ke uyomin. Amaa Uwonbɔr nan be nin u,

ref: and rescued him from all his troubles. God made him so wise that the Egyptian king Pharaoh thought highly of him. The king even made Joseph governor over Egypt and put him in charge of everything he owned.
text: le ki nyan u limugil nmɔn biɛn nin. Ki sei Josef nlam, ki che Ijibir a bɔr yudaau Faro ban u bɔr; ki ŋa u uyudaan Ijibir a tiŋin nin u niin biɛn.

ref: Everywhere in Egypt and Canaan the grain crops failed. There was terrible suffering, and our ancestors could not find enough to eat.
text: “Le nkom nan lu Ijibir a tiŋin nin Kenn a tiŋin biɛn, le fala choo bininfob ke ni bir, le ti yaajam a jiir par.

ref: But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.
text: Jekɔb kaah nan gbir ke tijiir be Ijibir n-yonn man ni, le u tun u buwaab niin. Ni ma nan ye bi chinchinn a chaam Ijibir.

ref: It was on their second trip that Joseph told his brothers who he was, and the king learned about Joseph's family.
text: “Bi chaam man nan kpiɛ milee-n, le Josef nin che u nabum nmɔn biɛ u, le Faro nin biɛ Josef a niin yaab.

ref: His father went to Egypt and died there, just as our ancestors did.
text: “Le Jekɔb nin u niin yaab fii jon Ijibir ki tan kal, bi nan be niin le u ma nin ti yaajam biɛn nan kpo.

ref: Later their bodies were taken back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor.
text: Le bi ta bi gbanann kun Sekim ki tan pii kukaag kan wee Abiraham nan ta ilig ki daa ki Hamor a naachim ban nin.

ref: Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
text: “N-yonn kaah nan nan mal nin Uwonbɔr ngbeen U mɔsiinl lan wee U nan siin sei Abiraham nan, ki miin ti ninfob Iziral yaab ban nan be Ijibir ni nan yab pam.

ref: Another king was ruling Egypt, and he didn't know anything about Joseph.
text: Ni bɔɔn bu le ubɔr uba nan jin Ijibir a naam, u mu kaa nan nyi Josef bu.

ref: He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them. He even made them leave their babies outside, so they would die.
text: Le ubɔr nmɔn nan ŋmag ti ninfobin nŋmag birim, ki to bi bu takpem, ki ji mug ti yaajamin ke bin nyan bi biliɛm bi niin yin ki ta bi gaba wee bin kpo.

ref: During this time Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him in their home.
text: “Iyaayoo le bi nan nan ma Moziz, le waah nann u biliɛtabi, ki be u baa a niin iŋmal itaa.

ref: Then when they were forced to leave him outside, the king's daughter found him and raised him as her own son.
text: Baah nan nyan u iniin n-yonn man nin, le u bɔrin a bisa kan u ki ta u ki wubir u, ke u tɔɔl a bija-n.

ref: Moses was given the best education in Egypt. He was a strong man and a powerful speaker.
text: Le bi nan wɔɔn Moziz nlam man biɛn wee Ijibir yaab jɔɔ, le u ŋa uninfoja u leen yin nin u toon yin.

ref: One day he saw an Egyptian mistreating one of them. So he rescued the man and killed the Egyptian.
text: Waah nan choon gɔnn bi nan, le ki nan kan Ijibir a ninfou kaah mugir Iziral a ninfou, le u dan ki nan fee u ki jaa, ki ku Ijibir a ninfo win.

ref: Moses thought the rest of his people would realize God was going to use him to set them free. But they didn't understand.
text: Moziz nan tiɛr ke u tɔɔl a ninfob Iziral yaab li biɛ ke Uwonbɔr ta u ma le ke un fee bi jaa, amaa le baa biɛ.

ref: The next day Moses saw two of his own people fighting, and he tried to make them stop. He said, “Men, you are both Israelites. Why are you so cruel to each other?”
text: Le ni won kutaag, le u ji kan Iziral yaab bilee kaah be kɔn. Le u ban waah li ŋa bi man wee bin jir ki mɔŋ nin tab, le ki bei bi ke, ‘Ni lig ni ye nnabum le nin tab; ke ba ŋa wee ni boo tab baa?’

ref: But the man who had started the fight pushed Moses aside and asked, “Who made you our ruler and judge?
text: “Amaa le wan mugir u kpiɛgin tir Moziz ki jaa ngbaan ki baan u, ‘Ŋma ŋaaŋ ti yudaau, nin ti bɔjiru waa?

ref: Are you going to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?”
text: A yin kum le ke ŋaah won ku Ijibir a ninfo win man nin naa?’

ref: When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.
text: Moziz kaah gbir man n-yonn man nin, le u guun ki nyan Ijibir, ki jon Midiya a tiŋin ki tan be niin ki ye uchaan, ki nan kɔɔn upii ki ma nbijam milee.

ref: Forty years later, an angel appeared to Moses from a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
text: “Ibin pina a bɔɔn, le malaka degir Moziz bu ki nann nŋmipeen ki gaan kukunkɔɔg bu ki mal Sina a jɔɔl bu.

ref: Moses was surprised by what he saw. He went closer to get a better look, and the Lord said,
text: “Moziz kaah kan man nin, le ni ŋa u ligaril. Le u fɔɔr mal ke un mann lig, le ki gbir Uyudaan a kukɔl ke,

ref: “I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” Moses started shaking all over and didn't dare to look at the bush.
text: ‘Min le ye ni yaajam a Weem, ki ye Abiraham a Weem, ki ye Azig nin Jekɔb a Weem.’ Le bijawaam kɔɔ Moziz, le u nin si ki jegil kaa ji fir lig niin ni.

ref: The Lord said to him, “Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy.
text: “Le Uyudaan bei u ke, ‘Pir a naatagiya; ke ŋaah si nan yaan nmɔn ye kasi a bol le.

ref: With my own eyes I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now I am sending you back to Egypt.”
text: N kan Ijibir yaab kaah mugir N tɔɔl a ninfob Iziral yaab Ijibir a tiŋin man na, ki ji gbir bi fabin ya. Man le N jiirin ke N nan fee bi ki jaa. Mambu, dan wee N tuŋ wee a jir Ijibir.’

ref: This was the same Moses that the people rejected by saying, “Who made you our leader and judge?” God's angel had spoken to Moses from the bush. And God had even sent the angel to help Moses rescue the people and be their leader.
text: “Moziz nmɔn le Iziral yaab nan yii u ki baan u ke, ‘Ŋma ŋaaŋ ti yudaau nin ti bɔjiru waa?’ Amaa u ma le Uwonbɔr gann ke u le ye bi yudaau nin bi feeru, le u ma Uwonbɔr che Malaka pag sei Moziz kumɔɔchiɛg a ŋmiimin, ki tun u niin.

text: Waah nan tan foo niin ki kan Uwonbɔr kaah sei bi literil man nin, le ni mɔŋ u, le u kɔɔn bi biɛn lipoobil, ki bei bi ke bi li nɔɔ Uyudaan nin bi sufu biɛn nin ibamɔn.

ref: Barnabas was a good man of great faith, and he was filled with the Holy Spirit. Many more people turned to the Lord.
text: Banabasi nan ye uninfoŋan le, ki gbee nin Kasi a Naaŋ nin yada, le ki nan ta-n bininfob takpem ki sei Uyudaan.

ref: Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul.
text: Le Banabasi jon Tarsusi a tiŋin, ke un tan ban Sɔɔl,

ref: He found Saul and brought him to Antioch, where they met with the church for a whole year and taught many of its people. There in Antioch the Lord's followers were first called Christians.

ref: During this time some prophets from Jerusalem came to Antioch.
text: Iyaayoo nmɔn le bilinlem biba nyan Jerusalam, ki dan Antiɛg a tiŋin.

ref: One of them was Agabus. Then with the help of the Spirit, he told that there would be a terrible famine everywhere in the world. And it happened when Claudius was Emperor.
text: Bi ni uba a yinl le nan ye Agabu. Le Kinaaŋ nan che u len ke nkom takpem li lu Rom yaab a tingbɔŋin. .

ref: The followers in Antioch decided to send whatever help they could to the followers in Judea.
text: Le Yisa a bɔɔnɔɔbin lol ke bin ter biwonjiɛn tab ban be Judiya a tiŋin uninfo biɛn kaah li fir man a tarig.

ref: So they appointed Barnabas and Saul to take their gifts to the church leaders in Jerusalem.
text: Le bi sin nan ŋa man, ki ta bi teril nmɔn tun Banabasi nin Sɔɔl, ke bin ta tan sei biwonjiɛn sanliib n na.

ref: At that time King Herod caused terrible suffering for some members of the church.
text: Iyaayoo nmɔn le Ubɔr Herɔd nan choo biwonjiɛm bibam, ki ban un mugir bi.

ref: He ordered soldiers to cut off the head of James, the brother of John.
text: U nan che bi ta takoobi le ki ku Jemisi wan ye Jɔnn a kpelin.

ref: While Peter was being kept in jail, the church never stopped praying to God for him. Peter Is Rescued
text: Piita kaah nan be kuloondiigin nin, amaa le biwonjiɛm a laguŋ mu nan miɛ Uwonbɔr linunmanl ki tenn u. Piita kaah nyan kuloondiigin man

ref: The night before Peter was to be put on trial, he was asleep and bound by two chains. A soldier was guarding him on each side, and two other soldiers were guarding the entrance to the jail.
text: Herɔd nan lol ke ni won njakpanyiɛn ke, u li nyan Piita ki ji u tibɔr, le Piita dɔ biguguub bilee a sisiigin ki jiɛn le bi ta tikulor tilee ki baan u, le ban guun nmɔn a ni bibam mu guu kuloondiigin a timansanmɔnn.

ref: Suddenly an angel from the Lord appeared, and light flashed around in the cell. The angel poked Peter in the side and woke him up. Then he said, “Quick! Get up!” The chains fell off his hands,
text: Libol nmɔn le Uyudaan a malaka degirin, le nwonween wonn kuloondiig nmɔn yaan. Le u dam dam Piita a bɔsipar ki fiin u, ki bei u ke, “Fii weema.” Le tikulorin pir ki lu.

ref: and the angel said, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” Peter did what he was told. Then the angel said, “Now put on your coat and follow me.”
text: Le malaka n bei u ke, “Yeem a wan yɔɔr ki tag a naatagiya.” Le Piita ŋa man. Le malaka n ji bei u ke, “Ta a kinkenl gaba ki li nɔɔm ni.”

ref: They went past the two groups of soldiers, and when they came to the iron gate to the city, it opened by itself. They went out and were going along the street, when all at once the angel disappeared.
text: Le bi nan jon lagir chinchinn a guguuru n bu, le ki ji lagir umiɛn nin bu, ki nin tan foo tikur a naanganl lan leg ntimansanmɔnn man chaa kitiŋ poolin nin. Le linaanganl nmɔn loor litɔɔl ki sei bi, le bi n-yaan nkaafiin. Ki nɔɔ nsan ki chaa, le malaka-n bor ki jiɛn Piita.

ref: Peter now realized what had happened, and he said, “I am certain that the Lord sent his angel to rescue me from Herod and from everything the Jewish leaders planned to do to me.”
text: Le Piita a num wonn, le u len ke, “Daandaan nan le n nin biɛ ke ni sin ye ibamɔn le ke Uwonbɔr le tun u malaka le u dan nan nyam Herɔd a nɔɔn, ki ji nyam Juu yaab kaah bi ban bin ŋam man nin.”

ref: Then Peter went to the house of Mary the mother of John whose other name was Mark. Many of the Lord's followers had come together there and were praying.
text: Waah biɛ man nin bu, le u jon Jɔnn Mag a na Meri a niin, ki miin bininfob takpem pii lagin niin ki miɛ Uwonbɔr le.

ref: Peter knocked on the gate, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer.
text: Le Piita kpaar kpaar nkaafiin a naanganl, le usapɔɔn toontunn, wan a yinl ye Roda dan linaanganl nmɔn ban ke un jee ŋma yen naa.

ref: When she heard Peter's voice, she was too excited to open the gate. She ran back into the house and said Peter was standing there.
text: Le ki biɛ Piita a niɛn, ki guun jir bininfobin ban nin nmɔn takpen, le kaa ji loor linaanganlin ni, ki tan bei bi ke, “Piita be nkaafiin.”

ref: “You are crazy!” everyone told her. But she kept saying it was Peter. Then they said, “It must be his angel.”
text: Le bi bei u ke, “A waar le.” Waah nan gbaa pag bi ke ni sin ye man nin, le bi ke, “Ni li ye u tinaaŋ le.”

ref: But Peter kept on knocking, until finally they opened the gate. They saw him and were completely amazed.
text: Amaa le Piita le si ki kpaar linaanganl, le bi nan loor linaanganl nmɔn ki kan u, le ni gar bi.

ref: Peter motioned for them to keep quiet. Then he told how the Lord had led him out of jail. He also said, “Tell James and the others what has happened.” After that, he left and went somewhere else.
text: Le u don u nɔɔ ke bin ŋmin tifura, le ki wɔɔn bi Uyudaan kaah nyan u kuloondiigin man. Le u bei bi ke, “Ni li chaa ki tan bei Jemisi nin biwonjiɛmin nan tun nan a bɔr,” le u fɔɔr jiɛn bi ki yaar jon niba paam.

ref: The next morning the soldiers who had been on guard were terribly worried and wondered what had happened to Peter.
text: Naah nan wonn kutaag, le ni mug ban guu kuloondiigin, kaa ye wama, nan bu-n baa nyi Piita kaah be nan yaan ni.

ref: Herod ordered his own soldiers to search for him, but they could not find him. Then he questioned the guards and had them put to death. After this, Herod left Judea to stay in Caesarea for a while. Herod Dies
text: Le Herɔd sei bimɔb ke bin ban u ni, le bi ban ban kaa kan wi, le u baan ban guu kuloondiigin ibinbaan, ki sei nsan ke bin ku ba. Ni bɔɔn bu le Herɔd nyan Judiya ki jiir Sizariya, ki tan be nin yaan wama. Herɔd a kum a bɔr

ref: Herod and the people of Tyre and Sidon were very angry with each other. But their country got its food supply from the region that he ruled. So a group of them went to see Blastus, who was one of Herod's high officials. They convinced Blastus that they wanted to make peace between their cities and Herod,
text: Herɔd nan kɔnn Taya nin Sidom yaab le; le bi lagin tab ki ban nsan bin tan kan u. Baah nan kan nsan nmɔn Basitusi wan ye ubɔr Herɔd a toontunn wan wee u nan ŋau yada nban nin, le bi faa u tisandann, nan bu-n bi jiir nan nya ubɔr n yaa tiŋin le.

ref: and a day was set for them to meet with him. Herod came dressed in his royal robes. He sat down on his throne and made a speech.
text: Le ubɔr Herɔd gann lidaal liba, ki yee u naam a daala ki nyan nan kal u naangbɔŋ bu, le ki pag sei bininfobin.

ref: The people shouted, “You speak more like a god than a man!”
text: Le bi tiɛn ke, “Likukɔl nan ye nween a kukɔl le, naa ye uninfosaali.”

ref: At once an angel from the Lord struck him down because he took the honor that belonged to God. Later, Herod was eaten by worms and died.
text: Libol nmɔn le Uyudaan a malaka che kuwiɛnbirug choo Herɔd le igoor jin u le u kpo, waah kaa nan pagir Uwonbɔr nbu.

ref: And after Barnabas and Saul had done the work they were sent to do, they went back to Jerusalem with John, whose other name was Mark.
text: N-yonn man wee Banabasi nin Sɔɔl diɛ bi toon yan wee bi nan jon ke bin tan tun nin, le bi ta Jɔnn Mag ki nyan Jerusalam ki jir kun Antiɛg.

ref: The church at Antioch had several prophets and teachers. They were Barnabas, Simeon, also called Niger, Lucius from Cyrene, Manaen, who was Herod's close friend, and Saul.
text: Antiɛg a tiŋin, biwonjiɛm a laguŋ nan jɔɔ bilinlem nin ban wɔɔnn: Bi nan yi bi ke Banabasi nin Simiɛn wan a yinl ji nan ye Naga, nin Lusiɛsi, wan nan nyan Sarene, nin Manann nin Sɔɔl.

ref: While they were worshiping the Lord and going without eating, the Holy Spirit told them, “Appoint Barnabas and Saul to do the work for which I have chosen them.”
text: Baah nan be jiɛn Uwonbɔr ki lolig imɔɔŋin, le Kasi a Naaŋ nan bei bi ke, “Ni nyam Banabasi nin Sɔɔl, wee bin tun itoon yan wee N yin bi ke bin tun ni.”

ref: Everyone prayed and went without eating for a while longer. Next, they placed their hands on Barnabas and Saul to show that they had been appointed to do this work. Then everyone sent them on their way. Barnabas and Saul in Cyprus
text: Le bi lol imɔɔŋ ki miɛ Uwonbɔr, ni bɔɔn bu le bi ta bi nɔɔi paan bi bu, le ki che bi jon. Saipuru a tiŋ a bɔr

ref: After Barnabas and Saul had been sent by the Holy Spirit, they went to Seleucia. From there they sailed to the island of Cyprus.
text: N-yonn nmɔn le Kasi a Naaŋ nan ta bininfob bilee nmɔn ki nyan nsan bu, le ki che bi jon Selesiya ki tan kɔɔ kuŋaluŋ niin ki jon Saipuru.

ref: They arrived at Salamis and began to preach God's message in the synagogues. They also had John as a helper.
text: Baah nan foo Salami nan, le bi kɔɔ Juu yaab a wonjiɛndirin le ki mɔɔn Uwonbɔr a bɔr ki tenn bi. Jɔnn le nan be bi ban ki ter bi.

ref: Barnabas and Saul went all the way to the city of Paphos on the other end of the island, where they met a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus. He practiced witchcraft and was a false prophet.
text: Le bi choon ligungonl lan be nnyum a sisiigin nmɔn ki tan foo Pafosi. Nin yaan le bi nan kan unyɔgdaan u ba, u yinl nan ye Bar-Yisa, u nan ye Juu yaab a ninfou le ki mal ke u ye Uwonbɔr a linlenu le,

ref: He also worked for Sergius Paulus, who was very smart and was the governor of the island. Sergius Paulus wanted to hear God's message, and he sent for Barnabas and Saul.
text: u nan be ubɔr yudaan ban le, ubɔr nmɔn a yinl nan ye Seregu Pɔɔlu, u nan ye ulandaan le, le ki yin Banabasi nin Sɔɔl ke bin nan pag Uwonbɔr a bɔr wee un gbir.

ref: But Bar-Jesus, whose other name was Elymas, was against them. He even tried to keep the governor from having faith in the Lord.
text: Amaa le unyɔgdaan nmɔn, wan a yinl ji ye Elimasi, Girig a leen yin nin, nan pɔɔn u ba ke un ŋɔɔr ubɔrin wee un la ŋa yada.

ref: Then Saul, better known as Paul, was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked straight at Elymas
text: Le Sɔɔl wan a yinl ji ye Pɔɔl nan gbee nin Kasi a Naaŋ, le ki lig unyɔgdaan nin chiim ki ke,

ref: and said, “You son of the devil! You are a liar, a crook, and an enemy of everything that is right. When will you stop speaking against the true ways of the Lord?
text: “A ye ulinlar a big le, ki ye nan ŋan biɛn a dataag! A gbee nin kularug le iyoo biɛn nin nbiin. A li jiɛn ki laa labir Uyudaan a bamɔn yin ki ŋa ti tibɔkaraa?

ref: The Lord is going to punish you by making you completely blind for a while.” Suddenly the man's eyes were covered by a dark mist, and he went around trying to get someone to lead him by the hand.
text: Daandaan nan Uyudaan li dar a tul. U li che a jɔɔn ki nin yuur ke ŋaa la kan nween ni.” Libol nmɔn, le liŋunl nin libunbɔnl jiirin u bu, le u nin choon tulin, ki ban u ba n da u.

ref: When the governor saw what had happened, he was amazed at this teaching about the Lord. So he put his faith in the Lord. Paul and Barnabas in Antioch of Pisidia
text: Ubɔr uyudaan nin kaah kan nan tun nin, le u ŋa yada, nan bu-n waah nan kan ntinnim man nyan Uyudaan ban nin le ni ŋa u ligaril. Antiɛg kan be Pisidiya a tiŋin nin a bɔr

ref: Paul and the others left Paphos and sailed to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them and went back to Jerusalem.
text: Baah nan nyan Pafosi nan, le Pɔɔl nin u ninɔɔtab kɔɔ kuŋaluŋ ki jon Pega kan be Pamfiliya a tiŋin nin, nin yaan le Jɔnn jiɛn bi ki jir Jerusalam.

ref: The rest of them went on from Perga to Antioch in Pisidia. Then on the Sabbath they went to the synagogue and sat down.
text: Le bi nyan Pega, ki jon Antiɛg kan be Pisidiya a tiŋin nin. Le likpakɔɔl daal foo le bi kɔɔ kuwonjiɛndiigin ki ka.

ref: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the leaders sent someone over to tell Paul and Barnabas, “Friends, if you have anything to say that will help the people, please say it.”
text: Baah karin Moziz a siim nin Uwonbɔr a linlem a sɔbim n-yaan a bɔɔn bu, le kuwonjiɛndiig nmɔn a ninkpeeb bei Pɔɔl nin Banabasi ke, “Ti na a bum, ni ye ke ni jɔɔ tibɔŋann tan wee ni yin pag pɔɔg ti gbanann ke, ni paga.”

ref: Paul got up. He motioned with his hand and said: People of Israel, and everyone else who worships God, listen!
text: Le Pɔɔl fii sir ki don u nɔɔ le ki piin pag ke, “Nim Iziral yaab nin nim ban kaa ye Juu yaab ki jiɛn Uwonbɔr nan, ni pelim man!

ref: The God of Israel chose our ancestors, and he let our people prosper while they were living in Egypt. Then with his mighty power he led them out,
text: Iziral yaab, a Wonbɔru le gann ti yaajamin ki che bi pɔr takpem, n-yonn man wee bi la nan be Ijibir a tiŋin nin, le Uwonbɔr ta u pɔɔm ki nyan bi kitiŋ nmɔn yaan.

ref: Make sure what the prophets have said doesn't happen to you. They said,
text: Ni li guu ni ba man, ki laa che bilinlem nan kaah len man nin n ji ni.

ref: He destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan and gave their land to our people.
text: le u bii ibol ilile yan be Kenann a tiŋin nin, le ki che u tɔɔl a ninfob gaa kitiŋ nmɔn le ki kpann bi faal.

ref: Later, God removed Saul and let David rule in his place. God said about him, “David the son of Jesse is the kind of person who pleases me most! He does everything I want him to do.”
text: Ni bɔɔn bu le u nan pir Sɔɔl a naam nmɔn, le ki jin Defid. U nan pag Defid a bɔr ke: ‘N kan Defid wan ye Jesi a bigin le N num gbee; nan bu-n u li tun nan biɛn wee n ban.’

ref: God promised that someone from David's family would come to save the people of Israel, and this one is Jesus.
text: Uja nan a yaabili ni, le Uwonbɔr nyan Yisa wan ye ufeerin, ke un fee Iziral yaab ki jaa, ke waah nan siin limɔsiinl man nin.

ref: But before Jesus came, John was telling everyone in Israel to turn back to God and be baptized.
text: Amaa Jɔnn le nan chinn dan ki nan mɔɔn ki sei Iziral yaab biɛn ke bin kpenn bi binbema, wee un fu bi Uwonbɔr a nyunful.

ref: Then, when John's work was almost done, he said, “Who do you people think I am? Do you think I am the Promised One? He will come later, and I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
text: Jɔnn kaah nan nan be diɛr u toon nni, le u baan bi ke, ‘Ni tiɛr ke n ye ŋmiɛ? Maa ye Uma. Aai, amaa Uwonbɔr a Masiya wan yin ŋɔɔrin n bɔɔn ki dan nin, maa kpaan nin n gbin u naatagi a ŋmimi.’

ref: Now listen, you descendants of Abraham! Pay attention, all of you Gentiles who are here to worship God! Listen to this message about how to be saved, because it is for everyone.
text: Le Pɔɔl ji len ke, “N nabum, nim ban ye Abiraham a yaabili, nin nim ban kaa ye Juu yaab wee ki san Uwonbɔr nan, tim bu le bi ta feegab a bɔrin ki sein.

ref: The people of Jerusalem and their leaders didn't realize who Jesus was. And they didn't understand the words of the prophets they read each Sabbath. So they condemned Jesus just as the prophets had said.
text: Jerusalam yaab nin biyudam kaa nan biɛ Yisa, nin nima biɛn ni, bi nan ku u le ni gbeen bilinlem a bɔr tan wee bi jɔɔ karin likpakɔɔl daal biɛn nin.

ref: They did exactly what the Scriptures said they would. Even though they couldn't find any reason to put Jesus to death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed. After Jesus had been put to death, he was taken down from the cross and placed in a tomb.
text: Baah nan ŋa Yisa man ki diɛ ke Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋ kaah wɔɔn man nin, le bi tabir u lidapunpunl bu, ki ta u pii kukaagin.

ref: But God raised him from death!
text: Amaa le Uwonbɔr fiin u nkumin,

ref: Then for many days Jesus appeared to his followers who had gone with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. Now they are telling our people about him.
text: le ban nan nɔɔ u ki nyan Galilii ki chaa Jerusalam nan, ni nan ga u le idaa biɛn. Daandaan nan bi ma nin ye u siɛra jib ki sei ti ninfob.

ref: God made a promise to our ancestors. And we are here to tell you the good news
text: Ti bei ni tibɔŋann nin le: Tan wee Uwonbɔr nan siin limɔsiinl ki sei ti yaajamin.

ref: that he has kept this promise to us. It is just as the second Psalm says about Jesus, “You are my son because today I have become your Father.”
text: U gbeen limɔsiinl nmɔn ki sei tim ban ye bi yaabili n na ki fiin Yisa nkumin na. Ke naah sɔb ilan yan kpiɛ milee n yaan ke: ‘Fin le ye N bija; dinan le N ŋa a baa.’

ref: God raised Jesus from death and will never let his body decay. It is just as God said, “I will make to you the same holy promises that I made to David.”
text: Ibamɔn ke Uwonbɔr nan fiin u nkumin na, le waa buri, ni piin imɔbon nan yaan le: ‘N yin ta tikaar tan ye kasi a kaar tan wee N nan siin limɔsiinl ki sei Defid nan le.’

ref: And in another psalm it says, “God will never let the body of his Holy One decay.”
text: Man le ni ji nan sɔb kugbɔŋ nan a niba yaan ki len ke: ‘Ŋaa li che a poopendaau a gbanann n bur kukaagin ni.’

ref: When David was alive, he obeyed God. Then after he died, he was buried in the family grave, and his body decayed.
text: “Defid nan tun nan wee Uwonbɔr wɔɔn u ke un tun u tɔɔl a yonn nin le, ni bɔɔn bu le u kpo; le bi pii u u yaajam a karin, le u gbanann bur.

ref: But God raised Jesus from death, and his body did not decay.
text: Amaa wan wee Uwonbɔr fiin u nkumin nin, u gbanann kaa buri.

ref: My friends, the message is that Jesus can forgive your sins! The Law of Moses could not set you free from all your sins.
text: “Mambu, n nabum n ban ni li nyi ke Yisa bu le tibir a jiɛn per a mɔleen yin pag sei ni.

ref: “Look, you people who make fun of God! Be amazed and disappear. I will do something today that you won't believe, even if someone tells you about it!”
text: ‘Ni lig man, nim bininfob ban yɔɔl nan, Ni che nin gar ni wee ni gbanann n kpo, N yin tun niwann niba le idaa nan yaan, le naa yin ŋa ni yada, hali ni ye uba le bei ni ke gbaa.’

ref: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people begged them to say more about these same things on the next Sabbath.
text: Pɔɔl nin Banabasi kaah nyan kuwonjiɛndiig nmɔn yaan nin, le bininfob nmɔn balin bi ke bin pɔɔn biba wee ki nan jirin likpakɔɔl daal lan chaan nin, ki nan wɔɔn bi tibɔr nmɔn ki kpiɛ.

ref: After the service, many Jews and a lot of Gentiles who worshiped God went with them. Paul and Barnabas begged them all to remain faithful to God, who had treated them with undeserved grace.
text: Bininfobin kaah nan worin nin, le Juu yaab takpem nin ibol yan nan jiɛn bi kaal wee ki nɔɔ Juu yaab a kaalin, ni nan nɔɔ Pɔɔl nin Banabasi. Le bi pag nin bi ki balin bi ke, bi li nɔɔ Uwonbɔr nin u nyunyunbasanlin.

ref: The next Sabbath almost everyone in town came to hear the message about the Lord.
text: Likpakɔɔl daal lan paan nin a daal kaah nan nan foo, ni nan gur wama le nin kitiŋ nmɔn a ninfob biɛn n dan ki nan gbir Uyudaan a bɔr.

ref: When the Jewish people saw the crowds, they were very jealous. They insulted Paul and spoke against everything he said.
text: Juu yaab kaah nan kan kuninfogbaluŋin le ni ŋa bi lipiiponl, le bi pag bii Pɔɔl a wɔɔmin.

ref: But Paul and Barnabas bravely said: We had to tell God's message to you before we told it to anyone else. But you rejected the message! This proves that you don't deserve eternal life. Now we are going to the Gentiles.
text: Le Pɔɔl nin Banabasi le pag nin lipoobil ke, “Ti chinn pag tibɔr nan ki sei nim Juu yaab le. Amaa naah yii tibɔr nmɔn, ki ji tiɛr ke naa ŋan nin ni kan limiɛfol lan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛmin bu, ni ma che ti jiɛn ni, le ki chaa ban kaa ye Juu yaab ban.

ref: The Lord has given us this command, “I have placed you here as a light for the Gentiles. You are to take the saving power of God to people everywhere on earth.”
text: Uyudaan kaah ke ti ŋa man sɔ: ‘Min le ŋa ni ban kaa ye Juu yaab n yaa weem, ke nim bu le Uwonbɔr yin fee dulinya yaab ki jaa.’

ref: This message made the Gentiles glad, and they praised what they had heard about the Lord. Everyone who had been chosen for eternal life then put their faith in the Lord.
text: Ban kaa nan ye Juu yaabin kaah gbir man nin, le ni mɔŋ bi, le bi sei Uyudaan a bɔr nmɔn jilima. Le ban wee Uwonbɔr gann ke bin kan limiɛfol lan kaa jɔɔ diɛmin ŋa yada.

ref: The message about the Lord spread all over this region.
text: Le Uyudaan a bɔr nmɔn mann mɔɔn kitiŋ nmɔn a logil biɛn.

ref: But the Jewish leaders went to some of the important men in the town and to some respected women who were religious. They turned them against Paul and Barnabas and started making trouble for them. They even chased them out of this part of the country.
text: Amaa le Juu yaab fiin bipiib ban ye biwonsam ki ye biyudam nin kitiŋ nmɔn a yudam. Le bi mugir Pɔɔl nin Banabasi ki ŋɔɔr bi ki nyan bi tiŋin.

ref: Paul and Barnabas shook the dust from that place off their feet and went on to the city of Iconium.
text: Le Pɔɔl nin Banabasi pir pir bi nɔɔi, ki sin yaar jon Ikoniɛm.

ref: But the Lord's followers in Antioch were very happy and were filled with the Holy Spirit.
text: Le ni mɔŋ bibɔɔnɔɔbin le bi gbee nin Kasi a Naaŋ.

ref: Paul and Barnabas spoke in the synagogue in Iconium, just as they had done at Antioch, and many Jews and Gentiles put their faith in the Lord.
text: Pɔɔl nin Banabasi kaah nan foo Ikoniɛm nan, le bi kɔɔ Juu yaab a wonjiɛndirin, ke baah pii ti ŋaan man nin. Niin le bi nan pag nbamɔm, le Juu yaab nin ban kaa ye Juu yaab takpem ŋa yada.

ref: But the Jews who did not have faith in him made the other Gentiles angry and turned them against the Lord's followers.
text: Amaa Juu yaab ban kaa nan chee ŋa yada-n nan bii ban kaa nan ye Juu yaabin a sufu le. Le bi ŋuui fii biwonjiɛmin bu.

ref: Paul and Barnabas stayed there for a while, having faith in the Lord and bravely speaking his message. The Lord gave them the power to work miracles and wonders, and he showed that their message about his gift of undeserved grace was true.
text: Pɔɔl nin Banabasi nan be niin ki yuura, ki jɔɔ lipoobil ki pag Uyudaan a bɔr ki tenn bininfob, le Uyudaan nmɔn sei bi npɔɔn le bi pag u nyunyunbasanl a bɔr, ki tun ligaril a siɛra nin lijinjeel a toon.

ref: The people of Iconium did not know what to think. Some of them believed the Jewish group, and others believed the apostles.
text: Le kitiŋ nmɔn a ninfob bɔgir nin tab; biba nan si Juu yaabin a chaŋ le, le biba mu si Yisa a tooi yin a chaŋ.

ref: Finally, some Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, decided to make trouble for Paul and Barnabas and to stone them to death.
text: Le Juu yaab nin ban kaa ye Juu yaabin, nin bi tiŋ nmɔn a yudam lagin tab, ki lol ke bin jin itoon nin fala ki gabir bi itangbag.

ref: In Lystra there was a man who had been born with paralyzed feet and had never been able to walk.
text: Le uja u ba nan be Lisitira ki ye kiwɔbig, bi nan ma u ki miin u ye kiwɔbig le, kaa nyi chonn ni.

ref: The man was listening to Paul speak, when Paul saw that he had faith in Jesus and could be healed. So he looked straight at the man
text: Le u nan pelig Pɔɔl a mɔleen yin. Le Pɔɔl lig u chiim, ki biɛ ke u jɔɔ yada kan li sei u kutebug,

ref: and shouted, “Stand up!” The man jumped up and started walking around.
text: le u yin u nmɔpɔɔn ke, “Fii sir a taai buu!” Le u yug sir paab ki nin choon.

ref: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they yelled out in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have turned into humans and have come down to us!”
text: Bininfobin kaah nan kan Pɔɔl kaah tun man nin, le bi nin piin ki pag papaab Likoniya yaab a leen yin ke, “Itingban le kpann uninfosaal ki jiirin ti ban!”

ref: The people then gave Barnabas the name Zeus, and they gave Paul the name Hermes, because he did the talking.
text: Le bi yin Banabasi a yinl ke Ziɛu, ki yin Pɔɔl mu a yinl ke Hemesi, nan bu-n u ma nan ye wan pag tibɔr.

ref: The temple of Zeus was near the entrance to the city. Its priest and the crowds wanted to offer a sacrifice to Barnabas and Paul. So the priest brought some bulls and flowers to the city gates.
text: Le bi tingbanl lan wee bi yi ke Ziɛu wee u diig si kitiŋ nmɔn a gbaamin a minmanu nan ŋmag inaaja nin tifar ki nan sir kitiŋ nmɔn a timansanmɔnn, nan bu-n u ma nin kuninfogbaluŋin nan ban bin mann kumanug le ki sei Pɔɔl nin Banabasi.

ref: When the two apostles found out about this, they tore their clothes in horror and ran to the crowd, shouting:
text: Amaa Banabasi nin Pɔɔl kaah nan gbir baah len man nmɔn, le bi sufu bii, le bi dar bi daalam par par, ki guun kɔɔ kuninfogbaluŋin yaan, le ki tann ke:

ref: Why are you doing this? We are humans just like you. Please give up all this foolishness. Turn to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and everything in them.
text: “Bininfob nan, ba ŋa wee ni tun man naa? Ti tɔɔl le ye bininfob le ke naah ye man nin. Ti ŋmagin tibɔŋann le ti nan sei ni wee ni jiɛn dulinya nan a wann yɔɔra wee ki li nɔɔ Uwonbɔr Wan fo-n, Wan naan paab nin tum nin imɔg nin nan biɛn be i yaan.

ref: In times past, God let each nation go its own way.
text: Yaayoo nna, U nan che ibol biɛn ŋaan baah ban man le.

ref: But he showed he was there by the good things he did. God sends rain from heaven and makes your crops grow. He gives food to you and makes your hearts glad.
text: Nin man biɛn ni, Waa nan ŋa niba wee naa jin siɛra, U wɔɔn U binbenŋam le ki che u taal nu ki che tiwanbukaar biɛn lo iyoo biɛn ki tenn ni tijiir takpem le ki che ni mɔ ni.”

ref: Even after Paul and Barnabas had said all this, they could hardly keep the people from offering a sacrifice to them.
text: Hali Pɔɔl nin Banabasi kaah le pag man ni nmɔn biɛn na, ni nan pɔɔ le nin bin fir gɔɔ kuninfogbaluŋin nmɔn ke bi laa mann kumanug ki sei bi.

ref: Some Jewish leaders from Antioch and Iconium came and turned the crowds against Paul. They hit him with stones and dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead.
text: Le Juu yaab biba nyan Antiɛg kan be Pisidiya a tiŋin, nin Ikoniɛm a tiŋin, ki dan ki nan pag ki sei kuninfogbaluŋin ki bii Pɔɔl nin Banabasi. Le bi gabir Pɔɔl itangbag ki fuul u nyan kitiŋ nmɔn a gbaam, ki tan gab ki nyi ke u kpo le.

ref: But when the Lord's followers gathered around Paul, he stood up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas went to Derbe. Paul and Barnabas Return to Antioch in Syria
text: Amaa bi bɔɔnɔɔbin kaah nan lagin ki gɔɔn win a bɔɔn le u fii ki jir kitiŋ nmɔn yaan. Le ni won kutaag le uma nin Banabasi jon Deba. Baah nan jir Antiɛg a tiŋ kan be Siriya nan man

ref: Paul and Barnabas preached the good news in Derbe and won some people to the Lord. Then they went back to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch in Pisidia.
text: Bi nan mɔɔn tibɔŋann nmɔn le kitiŋ nmɔn yaan le bininfob takpem ŋa bi bɔɔnɔɔb. Le bi jir jon Lisitira, nin Ikoniɛm nin Antiɛg,

ref: They encouraged the followers and begged them to remain faithful. They told them, “We have to suffer a lot before we can get into God's kingdom.”
text: ki pɔɔgir bi bɔɔnɔɔbin a gbanann nin bi sufu ke bi mann sir bi yada bu nin ibamɔn na. “Ni kpaa le nin ti kɔɔ tibɔmug kaarin takpem wee ki nin nan kɔɔ Uwonbɔr a naamin.”

ref: Paul and Barnabas chose some leaders for each of the churches. Then they went without eating and prayed that the Lord would take good care of these leaders who had trusted in the Lord.
text: Le Pɔɔl nin Banabasi nan gann biwonjiɛm a laguŋ ni biba le ki ŋa bi bisanliib tiwonjiɛndir biɛn nin, le ki lol bimɔb ki miɛ Uwonbɔr, ki ta bi ŋa Uyudaan wan wee bi gaa u jin nan a nɔɔn.

ref: Paul and Barnabas went on through Pisidia to Pamphylia,
text: Baah nan choon Pisidiya a timin ki diɛ-n, ni bɔɔn bu le bi jon Pamfiliya a tiŋin,

ref: where they preached in the town of Perga. Then they went down to Attalia
text: baah nan pag Uwonbɔr a bɔr Pega nan, le bi nyan niin ki jon Ataliɛn.

ref: and sailed to Antioch in Syria. It was there that they had been placed in God's care for the work they had now completed.
text: Le bi nyan Ataliɛn ki kɔɔ kuŋaluŋ ki jir Antiɛg, nin yaan le bi nan ta bi ŋa Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanlin, nin baah tun itoon ki diɛ nbu.

ref: After arriving in Antioch, they called the church together. They told the people what God had helped them do and how he had made it possible for the Gentiles to believe.
text: Baah nan foo Antiɛg nan, le bi bei biwonjiɛm a laguŋin Uwonbɔr kaah ta bi tun man, nin waah loor nsan man ki sei ban kaa ye Juu yaab wee bi ŋa yada man.

ref: Then they stayed there with the followers for a long time.
text: Le bi nan paar nin yaan ki be nin bi bɔɔnɔɔbin ki yuur takpem.

ref: Some people came from Judea and started teaching the Lord's followers that they could not be saved, unless they were circumcised as Moses had taught.
text: Bijab biba le nan nyan Judiya, ki dan Antiɛg, le ki nan wɔɔn biwonjiɛmin ke: “See ke ni jii ni pun, ke Moziz a siimin kaah wɔɔn man nin, naa ye man ke, naa li kan nŋmarimi.”

ref: This caused trouble, and Paul and Barnabas argued with them about this teaching. So it was decided to send Paul and Barnabas and a few others to Jerusalem to discuss this problem with the apostles and the church leaders. The Church Leaders Meet in Jerusalem
text: Le Pɔɔl nin Banabasi fa bi limɔkpel nin kinimaŋ. Le bi gann Pɔɔl nin Banabasi nin biwonjiɛm bibam, ke bin jo Jerusalam, ki tan kan itoon nin nin bisanliibin ki jiin nbinbaan nmɔn paam.

ref: The men who were sent by the church went through Phoenicia and Samaria, telling how the Gentiles had turned to God. This news made the Lord's followers very happy.
text: Le biwonjiɛm a laguŋin nan tun bi, le baah nan choon ki nɔɔ Fonisiya nin Samariya nan, le bi bei bi ban kaa ye Juu yaabin kaah kpenn bi binbem ki ta biba ki sei Uwonbɔr man. Tibɔr nmɔn nan mɔŋ biwonjiɛm pam.

ref: When the men arrived in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church, including the apostles and the leaders. They told them everything God had helped them do.
text: N-yonn man wee bi foon Jerusalam nan, le biwonjiɛm a laguŋ nin Yisa a toon nin bisanliibin gaa bi kuchɔŋ. Le Pɔɔl nin Banabasi bei bi niwann nan biɛn wee Uwonbɔr che bi tun.

ref: But some Pharisees had become followers of the Lord. They stood up and said, “Gentiles who have faith in the Lord must be circumcised and told to obey the Law of Moses.”
text: Le biwonjiɛm ban nan si Farasii yaab a chaŋin fii sir ki ke, “Ni kpaa le nin ban kaa ye Juu yaabin jii bi pun, ki chee sei Moziz a siimin.”

ref: The apostles and church leaders met to discuss this problem about Gentiles.
text: Le itoon nin nin bisanliibin lagin tab ki pag ki jiin nbinbaan nmɔn paam.

ref: They had talked it over for a long time, when Peter got up and said: My friends, you know that God decided long ago to let me be the one from your group to preach the good news to the Gentiles. God did this so they would hear and obey him.
text: Bi nan pag ti ni yuur le Piita nan nan fii sir ki ke, “N nabum, ni nyi ke iyoo yan jon nin, Uwonbɔr nan gannim le ni poolin ke n pag tibɔŋann nin ki sei ban kaa ye Juu yaab, wee bin gbir ki ŋa yada.

ref: He knows what is in everyone's heart. And he showed he had chosen the Gentiles, when he gave them the Holy Spirit, just as he had given his Spirit to us.
text: Uwonbɔr wan nyi uninfosaal a sufu ni nin, u ma gaa ban kaa ye Juu yaab ki sei bi Kasi a Naaŋ, ke waah nan sei ti man nin.

ref: God treated them in the same way that he treated us. They put their faith in him, and he made their hearts pure.
text: Waa wiɛr tim nin bima, nan bu-n U ŋunn bi sufu le bi yada bu.

ref: Now why are you trying to make God angry by placing a heavy burden on these followers? This burden was too heavy for us or our ancestors.
text: Ke daandaan nan, ba ŋa wee ni ban ni mag Uwonbɔr aa? Wee ki ban ni ta kunaajadaag kan wee tim bee ti baam kaa fir tun ki ta tun biwonjiɛm nan naa?

ref: But we believe that we will be saved by the gift of undeserved grace from our Lord Jesus Christ, just as the Gentiles are.
text: Aai! Tim ŋa yada ke ti Yudaau Yisa a nyunyunbasanl bu le ti kan nŋmarim, ke bi mu kaah kan man nin.”

ref: Everyone kept quiet and listened as Barnabas and Paul told how God had given them the power to work a lot of miracles and wonders for the Gentiles.
text: Le kulaguŋin nmɔn yaab jir ŋmin soon, ki nin pelig Banabasi nin Pɔɔl kaah pag Uwonbɔr kaah ta bi tun ligaril a siɛra nin lijinjeel a toonl man, ban kaa ye Juu yaabin a sisiigin.

ref: After they had finished speaking, James said: My friends, listen to me!
text: Baah nan pag ki diɛ n-yonn man nin, le Jemisi pag paab ke: “N nabum, ni pelim man.

ref: Simon Peter has told how God first came to the Gentiles and made some of them his own people.
text: Simɔnn bei ti Uwonbɔr a baga kaah be ban kaa ye Juu yaabin bu man na, nin waah nyan bi ni bibam wee bi ye u tɔɔl yaab man na.

ref: This agrees with what the prophets wrote,
text: Bilinlem a mɔleen yin chee sei ke naah sɔb man nin na:

ref: “I, the Lord, will return and rebuild David's fallen house. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again.
text: ‘Ni bɔɔn bu N li jirin, Ki mann ŋuun Defid a nanboŋ kan lu-n. Ki mann tan bii-n, ki che min sir,

ref: Then other nations will turn to me and be my chosen ones. I, the Lord, say this.
text: ni bu bininfob ban gur le ban Uyudaan, nin ban biɛn kaa ye Juu yaab wee ki jɔɔ n yinlin, Uyudaan wan tun man nmɔn le len man’

ref: I promised it long ago.”
text: nan wee ti pii nyi ibin yan jon.”

ref: And so, my friends, I don't think we should place burdens on the Gentiles who are turning to God.
text: Le Jemisi ji mann bei bi ke, “Mambu min len le ke ti laa ta nan pɔɔ ki sei ban kaa ye Juu yaab wee ki ban bin ta biba ki jirin Uwonbɔr ban nni.

ref: We should simply write and tell them not to eat anything that has been offered to idols. They should be told not to eat the meat of any animal that has been strangled or that still has blood in it. They must also not commit any terrible sexual sins.
text: Amaa ti li sɔb kugbɔŋ le ki sei bi, ki bei bi wee bi laa ji ibawol a jiiri, ki laa tun iwanchɔgin toon lipiibanlin bee lijabanlin ni, ki laa ŋma kuwankobug kan wee bi ŋmaan ŋmaan ki ku a nann ni, ki laa ji nchami.

ref: We must remember that the Law of Moses has been preached in city after city for many years, and every Sabbath it is read in our synagogues. A Letter to Gentiles Who Had Faith in the Lord
text: Nan bu-n Moziz a siimin, ti yaajam a yonn le u nan mɔɔn nsiimin kitiŋ biɛn nin, le bi karin nsiim nmɔn tiwonjiɛndirin likpakɔɔl daal biɛn.” Baah sɔb kugbɔŋ ki sei Yadadam ban kaa ye Juu yaab man

ref: The apostles, the leaders, and all the church members decided to send some men to Antioch along with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Silas and Judas Barsabbas, who were two leaders of the Lord's followers.
text: Le itoon nin bisanliibin, nin biwonjiɛmin biɛn lol ki nyan bibam bi ni, ki tun bi ma nin Pɔɔl nin Banabasi le bi jon Antiɛg. Le bi nan gann Judasi, nin Silasi. Bijab bilee nmɔn le nan ye biwonjiɛm nmɔn a sanliib.

ref: They wrote a letter that said: We apostles and leaders send friendly greetings to all of you Gentiles who are followers of the Lord in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia.
