ref: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.
text: Uwonbɔr kaah sam kunyunyunbaag kan nin bu le n bei ni biɛn nan ke: Uba laa tiɛr ke u ye lininfo gbingbemil ki jon waah be man nni, amaa che uninfo biɛn li tiɛr ibamɔn a bɔjil ki tenn u bau, ke yada kan wee Uwonbɔr ta sei win kaah kpaa man nin.

ref: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.
text: A li ke ti biɛn nan kaah jɔɔ gbanann tiba wee ti jɔɔ ibɔg man ni, igbanann bɔg nmɔn biɛn kaa lagin tun litoonl liba,

ref: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.
text: man mu le ye ni Masiya ni, ti ninfo gbaluŋ le lagin ki ŋa tigbanann tiba, le ligbanann bɔgil liba ye igbanann bɔg yan gurin yaan le.

ref: God has also given each of us different gifts to use. If we can prophesy, we should do it according to the amount of faith we have.
text: Ti jɔɔ ipiin balbal le, ke Uwonbɔr kaah sei ti U nyunyunbasanl lan nin. Ni ye wan a piin ye ilinlen leen a pagim ke, che un ta tun u yada kaah kpaan man.

ref: If we can serve others, we should serve. If we can teach, we should teach.
text: Ni ye wan a piin ye un tun ke, che un tun; wan a piin ye u li wɔɔn ke, che un wɔɔn;

ref: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully. Rules for Christian Living
text: ni ye wan a piin ye u li pɔɔgir u tab a gbanann ke, che u li pɔɔgira; ni ye wan a piin ye u li chaar tijiir ki ter bitab bi bɔr mugkaarin ke, che u li pu man na; ni ye wan a piin ye un ŋa usanliir le ke, che u li jɔɔ nsaliibinben nbamɔm; ni ye wan a piin ye u li san bininfob kunyunyunbaag le ke, che u li ŋaan man nin npopeen na.

ref: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.
text: Ni kpaa le nin njiɛm le ye ibamɔn. Ni li nan nan ye tibir; ki li ŋmag nan ŋan nin kenken.

ref: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.
text: Ni ta ni baga ki ŋa kunabitiig a jiɛmin yaan. Ki li tenn tab jilima ki jon ni tɔɔl.

ref: Never give up. Eagerly follow the Holy Spirit and serve the Lord.
text: Ni laa san ligbanyagili, amaa wee ki li ŋmag kinaaŋin ni sufu ni, ki li tun tenn Uyudaan na.

ref: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.
text: Ni che ni li mɔ na ni tama ni, ki li jɔɔ limɔril ni bɔr mugkaarin, ki li jɔɔ yada ni wonmiɛlin.

ref: Take care of God's needy people and welcome strangers into your home.
text: Ni li por naah jɔɔ nan ki tenn Uwonbɔr a ninfob ban ye bilanjiimin na. Ki li ŋaan bininfob tiŋann na.

ref: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.
text: Ni li kaab tikaar jaar ban mugir ni buu; ni li kaaba ki laa poog imɔɔŋ ki ŋaan bi.

ref: When others are happy, be happy with them, and when they are sad, be sad.
text: Ni li jɔɔ nmɔn nin naah mɔ ban nin na; ki li wii nin ban wii-n na.

ref: Be friendly with everyone. Don't be proud and feel that you know more than others. Make friends with ordinary people.
text: Ni li be nin tab nin nmɔn na. Ni laa jɔɔ kalanbaani; amaa ni chee ki li be nin bilanjiima. Ni laa wɔɔn ni biɛmi.

ref: Don't mistreat someone who has mistreated you. But try to earn the respect of others,
text: Ni laa ta uba a bir ki yɔ wi. Maan ni ba ki tun nan ŋan uninfo biɛn a numin.

ref: and do your best to live at peace with everyone.
text: Ni ye a bi li fir ke, naah tɔɔ a bu nan, li be nin nposɔɔn nin uninfo biɛn na.

ref: Dear friends, don't try to get even. Let God take revenge. In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I am the one to take revenge and pay them back.”
text: Ni laa ta tibir ki yɔ tibiri, n jɔtiib, amaa ŋa npaan sei Uwonbɔr a ŋuufiiŋin, ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke: “Ni ye min le n jiin; min le yin yɔ bi,” Uyudaan le len man.

ref: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
text: Amaa: “Ni ye nkom jɔɔ a dataag ke, a jim mu; ni ye nnyunyum jɔɔ u ke, a sei mu nnyum wee un nyu. Ni ye a tun ni niɛ nan ke, a yin jin u ifa le.”

ref: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
text: Ni laa che tibir n nyaŋ ni, amaa ni ta nan ŋan ki nyaŋ tibira.

ref: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.
text: Ni kpaa le nin uninfo biɛn n chee sei ubɔr yudaan a ninkper a pɔɔm kaah wɔɔn man, nan bu-n tininkper a pɔɔm li kaa be kaa ye Uwonbɔr kaah siin man ni. Tininkper a pɔɔm man be-n Uwonbɔr le ta mi ŋa.

ref: Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it.
text: Ni ma bu ban ŋmag tininkper a pɔɔmin kaa ye kuwansanwaŋ ki sei bininfob ban tun nan ŋan ni, amaa ban kaa tun nan ŋan nin. A ban a li be a wiib ki laa san wan ŋmag tininkper a pɔɔmin naa? Man ke li tun nan ŋan na wee un pagiŋ.

ref: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.
text: Ni ma bu u ye Uwonbɔr a toontunnu wan li tun nan ŋan le ki sei ni. Amaa ni ye a tun nan kaa ŋan ke, a li san bijawaama, nan bu-n waa ŋmag takoobi yɔli. U ye Uwonbɔr a toontunnu le, wan wee U ta u siin U ŋuufiiŋin yaan ke un dar wan tun titoonbir a tul.

ref: But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.
text: Mambu, ni kpaa le nin ti li jɔɔ limɔcheel ki tenn ban ŋmag tininkper a pɔɔm, wee ni laa ye taah li ŋa man ki nya litudarilin a binba, amaa naah li ŋa man wee ni potiɛl nlaa galin ni.

ref: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
text: Ni niɛ nan bu le ni yɔ lampo, ni ma bu ban ŋmag tininkper a pɔɔm ye Uwonbɔr a toon tum le, ban ta bi saŋi biɛn sei tininkper a pɔɔm a siimin a ŋmagim.

ref: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
text: Nsiim man ye, “Laa tun iwanchɔgin toon ni,” “Laa ku,” “Laa su,” “Laa jɔɔ linunchɔril a kpiɛg a wann bu,” nin nsiim man gurin biɛn, i lagin ki be lisiinjal liba nan yaan le: “Li jiɛ a kunkɔɔn tab ke ŋaah jiɛ a ba man nin.”

ref: No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands. The Day When Christ Returns
text: Njiɛm kaa tenn kunkɔɔn tab kidaŋi mambu njiɛm ye nan gbeen nsiimin le.

ref: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.
text: Ni ŋaam nan, ni biɛm taah be n-yonn man daandaan nan a taai ya. Isaŋ foo nin ni ligir ni jiɛmin na, nan bu-n ti feegabin mal ti ki jon taah nan chinn ŋa yada n-yonn man nin na.

ref: Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light.
text: Kutaag a wonim mala; le nweehn be forin le nmɔn. Ni ma bu ni che ti ta libunbɔnl a toon yin ki bil ngbaan wee ki ta nwonween a gbaginu ki yee.

ref: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.
text: Ni che ti binbem li ween na, a li ke ti be nweehn le-n, ki laa ye ban nyu ndaam a booli biɛn bee bidanyugbeebi, ki laa tun iwanchɔgin toon ti piibanlin bee ti jabanlin nin iwanjaab toon a boolin yi, ki laa jɔɔ imɔkpel nin lipiiponli.

ref: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
text: Amaa ni ta Uyudaan Yisa Masiya ki yee ke kuwan yee waŋin, ki laa ban nsan man wee ni li nɔɔ ki tun tigbanann a kɔlisa birugin a bami.

ref: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.
text: Ni gaam wan a yada kaa pɔɔ-n na, wee ki laa ji tab tibɔr tan ye limɔkpel a bɔri.

ref: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.
text: Uninfo uba a yada bu li fir che un ji tijiir a booli biɛn, amaa uninfo wan a yada kaa pɔɔ-n, u ji tikpinfar a binba le.

ref: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
text: A ye ŋma wee ki li fir galin uba a toontunnu waa? U tɔɔl a yudaau ban le u sisiim bee u lum yin nya. U li sir, Uyudaan li fir che un sir.

ref: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.
text: Uninfo uba tiɛr ke lidaal liba ŋan jon yan gurin na, le uba mu tiɛr ke idaa biɛn ye nba le. Che uninfo biɛn n nɔɔ waah tiɛr man u potiɛlin.

ref: Any followers who count one day more important than another day do it to honor their Lord. And any followers who eat meat give thanks to God, just like the ones who don't eat meat.
text: Wan ŋa lidaal liba kasi ki tiɛr ke li ŋan jon idaa yan gurin, u ŋaan man ki tenn Uyudaan le jilima. Uninfo wan kaa kɔ tijiir tiba nan, u ji ti ki tenn Uyudaan le jilima, ni ma bu u poor Uwonbɔr le ki nin ji; wan mu kɔ tijiir tibam nan, u kɔ ti ki tenn Uyudaan le jilima, le ki poor Uwonbɔr.

ref: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.
text: Ti ni uba kaa fo be u binba bu, le ti ni uba kaa kpeg u binba bu.

ref: Whether we live or die, it must be for the Lord. Alive or dead, we still belong to the Lord.
text: Ni ye ti fo be ke, ti be ki sei Uyudaan le, ni ye ti ji kpo ke, ti kpo ki sei Uyudaan le. Ni ma bu ti fo bee ti kpo ke, Uyudaan le ye ti.

ref: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
text: Ni niɛ nan bu, le Masiya nan kpo ki fii nkumin naah li ŋa man wee U li ye ban fo nin ban kpo a Yudaau.

ref: Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us.
text: Ke fin, ba ŋa wee a ji a nabig tibɔraa? Bee ba ŋa wee a yin a nabig yɔlii? Nan bu-n ti biɛn na li sir Uwonbɔr a nintogil tibɔr a ji bol.

ref: In the Scriptures God says, “I swear by my very life that everyone will kneel down and praise my name!”
text: Ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke: “Maah ye Uwonbɔr wan fo-n, Uyudaan le len, idun biɛn na li gbaan N nintogil; ilanbil biɛn na li kpiir ki bei Uwonbɔr.”

ref: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do. Don't Cause Problems for Others
text: Ni ma bu, ti biɛn nan na li pag ki wɔɔn Uwonbɔr ti toon kaah ye man. Laa che a kpiɛtiib nlu

ref: We must stop judging others. We must also make up our minds not to upset anyone's faith.
text: Mambu ni che ti ta tab a bɔr a jim jiɛn na. Ki che ni li be ni sufu ni ke naa yin ye litangbag gbiɛrikaal bee naa yin leg ni nabig a sami.

ref: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
text: Maah be Uyudaan Yisa ni-n bu, maa biɛn ni, tijiir tiba kaa be ki ye tijaginn ti baan tɔɔli. Amaa ni ye uba tiɛr ke tijiir tiba ye tijaginn ke, man ke u ma ban le ti ye tijaginn.

ref: If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for.
text: Ni ye a nabig a sufu bii ŋaah ji tijiir tan nin bu ke, man ke ŋaa ji nɔɔ njiɛm a sami. Laa che ŋaah ji tijiir tan nin bii a nabig kan wee Masiya nan kpo u bu-n ni.

ref: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
text: Laa che bininfob n pag ki bii nan wee a chee ke ni ŋanin ni.

ref: God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit.
text: Nan bu-n Uwonbɔr a naamin kaa ye tijikaar nin tiwann nyuwann a bɔri, amaa mi ye nbuchin binben le, nin nposɔɔn, nin nmɔn Kasi a Naaŋin yaan,

ref: If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people.
text: nan bu-n uninfo wan ye Masiya a toontunn u wee ki tun man ke ni gbeeg Uwonbɔr a num le, le bininfob chee sei ke ni ŋan.

ref: We should try to live at peace and help each other have a strong faith.
text: Mambu ni che ti pɔɔn ti ba ki tun nan li ta nposɔɔn dan nin nan li pɔɔg tab a sufu ti yada-n.

ref: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
text: Laa bii Uwonbɔr a toonl tijikaar bu. Tijiir biɛn ŋan, amaa naa ŋan nin uninfo n ji tijiir tan li che u kpiɛg n gbiɛr ki lu.

ref: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
text: Naa ŋan nin a ŋman tinann bee a nyu ndaam bee a tun nan li che a nabig n lu.

ref: What you believe about these things should be kept between you and God. You are fortunate, if your actions don't make you have doubts.
text: Mambu ŋaah ŋa tiwann nan yada man a sufu ni li be fin nin Uwonbɔr a sisiigin na. Tikaar be uninfo wan kaa galin uba waah chee sei nan nin bu.

ref: But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.
text: Amaa wan jɔɔ nbiɛnim ki jiin waah ji tijiir tan nin paam wee ki sin jin ti ke u bii u bau. Nan bu-n waah jin nan nin kaa nyan u yada-n ni; nan mu wee a tun wee naa nyan a yada ni ke ni ye tibir le.

ref: If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves.
text: Tim ban a yada pɔɔ-n ye ti ter ban a yada kaa pɔɔ-n bi tugi a tumin le, wee ki laa ban ti tun nan li gbee ti tɔɔl a numi.

ref: We should think of their good and try to help them by doing what pleases them.
text: Che ti biɛn nan ntun nan li gbee a kunkɔɔn tab a num u tɔɔl a ŋann bu, wee u yada n mann yabig.

ref: Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, “The people who insulted you also insulted me.”
text: Ni ma bu hali Masiya kaa nan tun nan li gbee u tɔɔl a numi, amaa a li ke naah sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke: “Tisugir tan wee bi sugiriŋin lu min bu le.”

ref: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.
text: Uwonbɔr wan tenn limɔril nin ngbananpɔɔn nin un sei ni nmɔkpaa a tinaaŋ wee ni li nɔɔ Masiya,

ref: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
text: wee ni ye ni jɔɔ sufu uba nin mɔbiba ke ni li fir pag Uwonbɔr wan ye Uyudaan Yisa Masiya a baa-n. Tibɔŋann nin kaah nan mɔɔn sei ban kaa ye Juu yaabin man

ref: Honor God by accepting each other, as Christ has accepted you.
text: Ni gaam tab, ke Masiya kaah gaa ni man nin, naah li ŋa man wee ni fir ta npagim ki sei Uwonbɔr.

ref: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came,
text: Ni ma bu le min bei ni ke Masiya ye Juu yaab a toontunn u Uwonbɔr a bamɔn bu le, ke nin gbeen U mɔsiinl lan nan siin sei ti yaajamin,

ref: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, “I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.”
text: wee ban kaa ye Juu yaabin pag Uwonbɔr U nyunyunbasanl bu, ke naah sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke: “Mambu n li pag fin Uwonbɔr a yinl ban kaa ye Juu yaabin a sisiigin; n li gaah liwonpagil a lai ki don a yinl.”

ref: The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, “Come and celebrate with God's people.”
text: Jigin Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋ len ke, “Ni che ni li mɔ ni nin U ninfob nan na, nim ban kaa ye Juu yaab nan.”

ref: Again the Scriptures say, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles. All you nations, come and worship him.”
text: Le jigin, “Pagim Uyudaan, nim ban biɛn kaa ye Juu yaab nan, wee ki gaah ilan ki pag U, nim bininfob nan biɛn”

ref: Isaiah says, “Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.”
text: Le jigin, Azaya a gbɔŋin ni sɔb ke, “Jesi a sibonlin yin pɔɔ le ki pa donn, wan yin fii ki gaa kutingbɔŋ nan ki ŋmagin; ban kaa ye Juu yaabin na yin jɔɔ tama u ma bu le.”

ref: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope. Paul's Work as a Missionary
text: Che tama a Wonbɔru win gbeen ni nmɔn biɛn nin nposɔɔn naah ga U jin nin bu, wee ni li jɔɔ tama kan yab ki tan lagir, Kasi a Naaŋin a pɔɔm bu. Nan bu che Pɔɔl nan sɔb kugbɔŋ nan nin lipoobil

ref: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
text: N nabum, min tɔɔl kaa biɛni, ni tɔɔl gbee nin nbinben ŋan, ki jɔɔ nbiɛm takpem, ki li fir wɔɔn tab nbamɔm.

ref: But I have spoken to you plainly and have tried to remind you of some things. God treated me with undeserved grace!
text: Maah nan sɔb lipoobil a bɔr tan ki sei ni-n nann le ke n ji tiɛr ni le-n, nan bu-n Uwonbɔr kaah sam kunyunyunbaagin bu,

ref: He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.
text: ke n ŋa Masiya a toontunnu ki sei ban kaa ye Juu yaabin ki ta Uwonbɔr a bɔŋann nin tun itoon ke uminmanirin, wee Uwonbɔr n gaa ban kaa ye Juu yaabin ke kumanug kan wee Kasi a Naaŋ ŋa ki kasi-n.

ref: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.
text: Mambu n jɔɔ ligbingbanfaal Masiya bu nin maah tun litoonl lan ki tenn Uwonbɔr.

ref: In fact, all I will talk about is how Christ let me speak and work, so that the Gentiles would obey him.
text: Maa li nyi ki pag niba wee naa ye Masiya kaah taam tun litoonl lan ni, ke n liin ban kaa ye Juu yaabin a sam ki wɔɔn bi wee bin chee Uwonbɔr a mɔb nin maah wɔɔn bi man nin maah tun man.

ref: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
text: Le ni ma ye siɛra nin ligaril a toon a pɔɔm nin Kinaaŋin a pɔɔmin. Ni bu naah nyan Jerusalam ki tan kpaa Dalimasiya a yerin, n mɔɔn Masiya a bɔŋann nin ki diɛ niin na.

ref: But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation.
text: N le gbaa boŋ le ke n mɔɔn tibɔŋann nin nan yaan wee bininfob kaa la nyi gbir Masiya a bɔrin ni, wee ni laa ye ke n maa tɔɔn uba a fiɛl bu le.

ref: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
text: Amaa ke naah sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke: “Baah kaa nan bei ban u bu-n li kan, le ban kaa nan gbir li biɛ ni taai.” Pɔɔl kaah nan bon un gɔnn Rom a tiŋ man

ref: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.
text: Ni ma nan gbaa leg ki che maa kan nsan ki li dan ni ban ni.

ref: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
text: Amaa daandaan nan niba yaan kaah kaa ji be n tun tiyerin nan yaan nan, wee n mu a potiɛl le be ni ban ibin takpem ke n kan ni nan,

ref: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
text: n bon le ke n na yin jo Sipenn ke n li kan ni. N jɔɔ tama ke n naah yin jo jo ke n li gɔnn ni, wee ki che ni terim n jo n sanchonlin, ni bɔɔn bu ki miin n pii jin taah lagin be-n a mɔm wamau.

ref: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
text: Nan bu-n Masedoniya nin Akaya yaab nan jɔɔ nmɔn ke bin chaar ki sei biwonjiɛm ban nan ye faladam ki be Jerusalam.

ref: This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles.
text: Ni nan mɔ bi le ke bin tun man, le ibamɔn ni sin kpaan nin bin chaar man ki sei bi. Ni ma bu ni ye ban kaa ye Juu yaabin lagin por nin Juu yaabin Kinaaŋ a kaarin ke, ni kpaan nin bin ji lagin por nin Juu yaab bi wann yɔɔr a kaar.

ref: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
text: Ni bɔɔn bu ni ye n tan tun diɛ wee ki kan ke bi gaa ipiin nmɔn ke, n li nɔɔn nan gɔnn ni wee ki jo jo Sipenn.

ref: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
text: N nyi ke n nan dan ni ban ke, n na yin ŋmag Masiya a kaarin le takpem ki dan.

ref: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
text: N nabum, n balin ni le, ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya nin Kinaaŋin a jiɛm bu, ni kpiɛ n bu n gbaalin ki miɛ Uwonbɔr sei ma.

ref: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
text: Ni li miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn ma wee n fir ŋmar ki nya Judiya yaab ban kaa ye biwonjiɛmin a nɔɔn wee Uwonbɔr a ninfob ban be Jerusalam nan a num ngbee maah yin tun nan nin,

ref: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
text: wee Uwonbɔr a bam bu n fir dan ni ban nin nmɔn wee min nin nim n mann pɔŋ.

ref: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
text: Nposɔɔn a Wonbɔru li be nin ni biɛn. Ibamɔn.

ref: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
text: N pag ti ninsa Fiibi wan tun Uwonbɔr a toon Sechariya a wonjiɛm a laguŋin sei na.

ref: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
text: N bei ni le ke u dan ke ni gaam u ke naah kpaan Uyudaan a ninfob li gaan bi tab man Uyudaan a yinl bu, wee ki ter u waah li ban literil lan ni ban, nan bu-n u ter bininfob takpem pam, nin min gbaa tɔɔl.

ref: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
text: Poor Pirisila nin Akula, ban ye n toon tun tab Yisa ni-n.

ref: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.
text: Bi nan ta bi miɛfol ŋa kidaŋin le min bu. Naa ye n yaa binba amaa biwonjiɛm a laginn ban kaa ye Juu yaabin biɛn a pool sɔɔn bi bu.

ref: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
text: Poor biwonjiɛm a laguŋ ban lagin tab bi niin yin nin mu. Poor n jɔ kpaarimɔɔn Epenetusi, wan nan chinn ŋa Masiya yada Asiya a yerin nin.

ref: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
text: Poor Meri wan nan tun itoon takpem ki ter ni-n.

ref: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
text: Poor Anduroniku nin Juniɛsi ban ye n bol yaab ki ji ye n loondiig kɔɔn tabin. Bi jɔɔ liyinl Masiya a tooi yin ban, bi nan chinn ŋa Masiya yada nin ma.

ref: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
text: Poor Ampilatusi, wan wee n jiɛ Uyudaan ni-n.

ref: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
text: Poor Uribanusi, wan ye ti toon tun kpiɛg Masiya ni-n, nin n jɔ kpaarimɔɔn Sitachisi.

ref: Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ. Greet Aristobulus and his family.
text: Poor Apelesi, wan a binbem wee bi mag lig ki miin u si bogiliba Masiya ni-n. Poor Aritobulusi a niin yaab biɛn na.

ref: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
text: Poor Herodiyon, wan ye n bol a ninfou win na. Poor Narisisu a niin yaab ban be Uyudaan nin ni-n na.

ref: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
text: Poor Tirafena nin Tirafosa, bipiib ban tun itoon nin linunmanl ki sei Uyudaan nin na. Poor n jɔ kpaarimɔɔn Perisi, upii wan mu ji nan tun itoon nin linunmanl ki sei Uyudaan nin na.

ref: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
text: Poor Rufusi, wan ye uninfo gann kaa Uyudaan nin, nin u na wan ye min tɔɔl a na-n na.

ref: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
text: Poor Asinkiritusi, nin Filigonn, nin Hemesi, nin Patirobasi, nin Hemasi, ki nin kpiɛ n nabum ban be bi ban nin na.

ref: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
text: Poor Filogusi, nin Juliya, nin Neresi nin u ninsa, nin Olimpasi, ki nin kpiɛ biwonjiɛm ban be bi ban nin na.

ref: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
text: Ni poor tab nin jilimau. Biwonjiɛm a laginn nin biɛn poor ni. Nwɔɔm man joor

ref: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
text: N nabum, n balin ni le, ni li dibir bininfob ban jɔɔ nbɔgirim chaan ki nan legin ni samin wee naa chee sei nwɔɔm man wee ni tinn nin. Ni li lɔg ba.

ref: They want to serve themselves and not Christ the Lord. Their flattery and fancy talk fool people who don't know any better.
text: Bininfob nmɔn a booli kaa tun tenn ti Yudaau Masiya, amaa bi tun bi tɔɔl a kɔlisa bu le. Bi jɔɔ kulandiiŋ nin nmɔmɔm le ki lar bininfob ban a lam par bi-n.

ref: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
text: Bininfob biɛn gbir limɔcheel lan wee ni jɔɔ-n buu, ni bu che ni mɔm le takpem ni bu; amaa n ban ni che ni num li ween le niwann nan ŋan bu, wee ki laa che ni nɔɔ be titoonbirin ni.

ref: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
text: Nposɔɔn daan Uwonbɔr li taah Sintani ki mar ni taatum ke naa yuuri. Ti Yudaau Yisa a nyunyunbasanl li be nin ni.

ref: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
text: Timoti, wan ye n toon tun kpiɛgin, poor ni, le Lusiɛsi, nin Jasonn, nin Sosipata ban ye n bol yaabin mu poor ni.

ref: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
text: Min, Teritusi wan kpiɛ Pɔɔl wee ti sɔb kugbɔŋ nan poor ni Uyudaan a yinl bu.

ref: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
text: Daandaan nan che ti pag Uwonbɔr wan fir ta ni siin tibɔŋann nin bu nin maah mɔɔn Yisa Masiya wan nin bu, ki ta jiin tibɔkpiirikaar tan nan woo hali yaayoo-n nin,

ref: but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith.
text: amaa daandaan nan ti kpiir ki dɔ npaan nin le, ilinlen leen a sɔbimin yaan, le Uwonbɔr wan kaa jɔɔ diɛm nan a siimin bu, wee ibol biɛn nŋa U yada ki chee U mɔb,

ref: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
text: ni pagim Uwonbɔr wan a binba ye ulandaan nan, hali nin n-yonn man kaa jɔɔ diɛm! Ibamɔn.

ref: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
text: Pɔɔl wan wee Masiya nan yin u ki ta u ŋa u toom Uwonbɔr a bam bu-n, nin ti na a big Sositenesi,

ref: To God's church in Corinth. Christ Jesus chose you to be his very own people, and you worship in his name, as we and all others do who call him Lord.
text: le sɔb ki poor nim biwonjiɛm a laginn ban be Korenti a tiŋin, nin ban wee Uwonbɔr ŋa bi u yaab Masiya bu-n, le u yin bi ki ŋa bi kasi nin ban biɛn be nan yaan biɛn ki yi ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a yinl ke bi yudaau nin ti mu a yudaau win.

ref: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
text: Ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl nin nposɔɔn li be ni bu. Tinyɔɔr tan be Yisa ban

ref: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
text: N poor Uwonbɔr iyoo biɛn ni bu, nin waah san ni kunyunyunbaag Masiya bu.

ref: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
text: Masiya a bɔr tan wee ti nan wɔɔn ni-n, ni gaa ti nbamɔma.

ref: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.
text: Ni bu naa lann Uwonbɔr a Naaŋ a piini ke naah ŋa sili ki guu ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a jirimin.

ref: And until the day Christ does return, he will keep you completely innocent.
text: U li ŋmag ni nbamɔm hali nin ndiɛm, wee ni laa nan jɔɔ igalin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a jirin daali.

ref: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
text: Uwonbɔr wan yin ni ke ni li jɔɔ nɔɔnintab nin U bija Yisa Masiya wan ye ti Yudaau win, U ye yada daan le. Nbɔgirim man be biwonjiɛm a sisiigin

ref: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
text: N nabum, n balin ni le ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a yinlin, ke ni biɛn chee sei taba wee nbɔgirim laa be ni sisiigin ni, wee ni li jɔɔ nmɔkpaa man pɔɔ nin lipotiɛl liba.

ref: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
text: N nabum, Kiloe a niin yaab biba beim ke ni jɔɔ limɔkpel le nin tab.

ref: They have said that some of you claim to follow me, while others claim to follow Apollos or Peter or Christ.
text: Nan wee n pag nmɔn ye nan le: Ni ni uba ke “Min nɔɔ Pɔɔl le”, le uba mu ke “Min nɔɔ Apolosi le”; le uba mu ji ke “Min nɔɔ Piita le”; le utɔ mu ke “Min nɔɔ Masiya le.”

ref: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
text: Masiya nmɔn bɔgir lee? Bi nan kpaa Pɔɔl le lidapunpunl bu ni buu? Bee bi fun ni Uwonbɔr a nyunful Pɔɔl a yinl buu?

ref: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
text: N poor Uwonbɔr nin maah kaa fun ni ni uba Uwonbɔr a nyunfuli see Kerepusi nin Gayɔsi a binba.

ref: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
text: Ni bu, uba kaa li fir len ke bi fun u Uwonbɔr a nyunful n yinlin ni.

ref: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power. Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
text: Nan bu-n Masiya kaa tum ke n na li fu bininfob le, amaa u tum ke n nan mɔɔn u bɔŋann nle. Tan kaa ye uninfosaal a biɛmi, ni ye man ke Masiya a kum lidapunpunl bu li ŋa yɔli. Masiya le ye Uwonbɔr A lam nin U pɔɔm

ref: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
text: Masiya a kum lidapunpunlin bu-n a bɔr ye ijɔrig le ki sei ban borin, amaa tim ban kan feegabin n ma ni ye Uwonbɔr a pɔɔm le.

ref: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
text: Ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke, “N li bii bilandam a lam ki che bibiɛndam a biɛm npaar yɔli.”

ref: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
text: Ni ye man ke, ulandaan nin be laa? Bee ubiɛndaan nin be laa? Bee ban jɔɔ nnyinyin dulinya nan yaan nin be laa? Naah ye Uwonbɔr taa dulinya nan a lam le ki labir ijɔrig aa?

ref: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
text: Uwonbɔr tɔɔl a lamin bu che dulinya nan yaab a lam kaa fir biɛ wi. Ni nan gbee Uwonbɔr a num nin baah nan ke nan ye ijɔr leen nin kaah nan mɔɔn wee bininfob ban nan ŋa yada-n kan feeja-n bu.

ref: Jews ask for miracles, and Greeks want something that sounds wise.
text: Juu yaab ban bin kan ligaril a toonl le, le Girig yaab mu ban nlam,

ref: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
text: amaa ti mɔɔn Masiya a kum lidapunpunl bu nle: Tibɔr nmɔn ye litangbag gbiɛrikaal le Juu yaab ban, le ki ji ye ijɔr leen ban kaa ye Juu yaabin ban.

ref: Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen.
text: Amaa ban wee Uwonbɔr yin bin, Juu yaab nin Girig yaabin, bi ma nyi Masiya kaah ye Uwonbɔr a pɔɔm nin u lam.

ref: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
text: Uwonbɔr a jɔrigi jɔɔ nlam jon uninfosaal a lama, le Uwonbɔr a daburigi mu pɔɔ jon uninfosaal a pɔɔma.

ref: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.
text: N nabum, ni li tiɛr naah nan ye ban, n-yonn man wee Uwonbɔr nan yin ni. Ni takpem kaa nan ye ban jɔɔ nlam tininforin nin; takpem mu kaa nan ye jilima a ninfobi; le ni takpem mu kaa nan ye nnaam a ninfobi.

ref: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
text: Amaa Uwonbɔr gann ban wee dulinya nan yaab yi bi ke tijɔri nle ke bin jin ban ke bi ye dulinya nan a landamin ifa; ki ji gann ban wee dulinya yaab yi bi ndaburimin ke bin jin ban ye bipɔɔndam dulinya nan yaan nin ifa.

ref: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
text: U gann nim ban kaa ye nnaam a ninfob dulinya nan yaan nin nim ban kaa nan ye niba-n, amaa le ki ŋa nan wee dulinya yaab tiɛr ke ni ye niba-n yɔli.

ref: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
text: U ŋa man le ke uba nlaa fir fa ligbingbanl U nintogili.

ref: You are God's children. He sent Christ Jesus to save us and to make us wise, acceptable, and holy.
text: U ma Uwonbɔr bu le nim be nin Masiya, le u tenn ti U tɔɔl a lam. U ma ŋa ti bibuchim, ki ŋa ti kasi, le ki sei ti nkpenim a manug.

ref: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
text: Ke naah sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin man ni, ke, “Wan far u gbingbanl ke, u li far u gbingbanl Uyudaan kaah tun nan nin bu.”

ref: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
text: N nabum, maah nan dan ni ban ni, maa nan mɔɔn Uwonbɔr a bɔr ki tenn ni nin nmɔmɔn bee nbiɛn takpen ni.

ref: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
text: Amaa maah nan be ni ban ni, maa nan ban n biɛ niba ki ji kpiɛ see Yisa Masiya nin u kum lidapunpunl nbu.

ref: At first, I was weak and trembling with fear.
text: N nan dan ni ban nin idaburig, le bijawaam jɔɔm le n gbanann jegil.

ref: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
text: Naa ye bininfosaalib a biɛm le n jɔɔ mɔɔn Uwonbɔr a bɔrin ki tenn ni, amaa ni nyan Kasi a Naaŋin le nin u pɔɔmin

ref: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
text: Naah li ŋa man wee ni yada laa be bininfosaalib a biɛm bu, amaa wee ki li be Uwonbɔr a pɔɔm bu. Uwonbɔr a lamgɔrikaam a bɔr

ref: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
text: Ti pag nlam a bɔr ki tenn binunwondam ban chegir Uwonbɔr a samin nin le, amaa naa ye dulinya nan a lam man wee bi jɔɔ wɔɔn nni bee dulinya nan a bɔrtiib ban kaa na yin jɔɔ tinyɔɔr kaah ŋmag nlam man n ni.

ref: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.
text: Aai, ti pag Uwonbɔr a lam man woo n-yaa bɔr le, amaa le Uwonbɔr pii nan chinn ŋa nlam man li sei ti jilima nmɔn a sili ki guun ti le mi saŋi nin foo.

ref: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
text: Dulinya nan a a bɔrtiib, uba kaa be ki nyi nlam nmɔn ni. Bi bi nyi mi ke, baah nan bi li kpaa ti Yudaau, wan ye jilimadaan nni.

ref: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
text: Ke naah sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke, “Linunbil kaa kan ni, Litul mu kaa gbiri, le uninfosaal a sufu mu kaa nyi, nan wee Uwonbɔr ŋa ni sili ki guun ban ban win ni.”

ref: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
text: Amaa Uwonbɔr ma che U Naaŋin kpiir ki wɔɔn ta, U Naaŋ nmɔn le feen niwann biɛn, hali nin Uwonbɔr kaah woon tibɔr tan gbaa.

ref: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
text: Ni ŋma nyi Uninfosaal a potiɛl wee naa ye uninfosaal nmɔn a naaŋ kan be u ni nnaa? Man le ye ni, uba kaa nyi Uwonbɔr a potiɛli see Uwonbɔr a Naaŋin a binba.

ref: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
text: Kinaaŋ kan wee ti gaa-n, kaa ye dulinya nan a naaŋi, amaa ki ye Kinaaŋ kan nyan Uwonbɔr ban le. U li che U naaŋin ter ti wee ti biɛ u piini nmɔn.

ref: Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people.
text: Taah pag imɔleen yan nmɔn kaa nyan Uninfosaal a wɔɔnim a lamin ni, amaa imɔleen nmɔn nyan Kinaaŋin le, yan ye kinaaŋ a mɔleen ki wɔɔn ibamɔn ni.

ref: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
text: Wan kaa jɔɔ Kinaaŋ nmɔn kaa cheel tibɔr tan nya Uwonbɔr a Naaŋin ban ni, tibɔr nmɔn ye ijɔr leen le ki sei u, le waa li fir biɛ ti taai yi, nan bu-n ti ye kinaaŋ a leen le.

ref: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
text: Uninfo wan jɔɔ Kinaaŋ nmɔn man feen niwann biɛn le ki biɛ ni taai, amaa uninfo uba kaa li fir biɛ u yaa binbem.

ref: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
text: A li ke naah sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke, “Ŋma nyi Uwonbɔr a potiɛlaa wee ki li fir wɔɔn waa?” Amaa tim ma jɔɔ Masiya a potiɛl.

ref: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
text: N nabum, maa li fir pag ki sei ni ke maah bi li pag ki sei kinaaŋ a ninfob man nni, amaa n yin pag ki sei ni ke maah bi li pag ki sei dulinya nan yaab man nle, ke bininfob ban nann nbuwaab finfim ban la biɛn nwonjiɛn binben nle.

ref: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
text: N tenn ni nbiim le, naa ye bisaabi, naa la nan kpaan nin bisaabi. Hali daandaan nan naa la kpaan nin bisaabi.

ref: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
text: Ni le la be le ke dulinya yaabin, ni la jɔɔ lipiiponl le nin limɔkpel ni sisiigin, ni toon kaa be le ke dulinya yaab a toon yaa?

ref: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
text: Ni ye uba ke u nɔɔ Pɔɔl le, wee uba mu ke u nɔɔ Apolosi ke, naa tun le ke dulinya yaab kaah tun man nin nnaa?

ref: Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen.
text: Nin ni ma biɛn nan a bɔɔn, ŋma ye Apolosi? Ke ŋma ye Pɔɔl aa? Ti le ye bitoontum le, ban wee Uyudaan nan ta itoon ki ŋa uninfo uba biɛn a nɔɔn wee ni ŋa yada-n.

ref: I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow.
text: Min le nan bun iwanbool, le Apolosi mu wur nnyum amaa Uwonbɔr le che ni pan ki yabig.

ref: What matters isn't those who planted or watered, but God who made the plants grow.
text: Wan bun nin wan wur nnyum kaa ye niba, Uwonbɔr le ye niba, nan bu-n U ma che ni pan ki yabirig chaa.

ref: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
text: Wan bun nin wan wur nnyum ye nba le, bi biɛn yin gaa tiyɔr bi toon kaah ye man le.

ref: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
text: Tim le ye Uwonbɔr a toon tun tab; nim le ye Uwonbɔr a kpaab ki ji ye Uwonbɔr a diig.

ref: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
text: Uwonbɔr kaah sam kunyunyunbaag nbu, n bil lifiɛl le ke litanma kpegilin, le uba maa tɔɔg li bu, amaa uninfo biɛn li nyi waah maa ki tɔɔg li bu man.

ref: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
text: u toonl nmɔn li wɔɔn liba la ye lan, nan bu-n Yisa a jirin daal nŋmi li na yin kpiir li ki mag uninfo biɛn a toonl ki lig li ŋam kaah ye man.

ref: We will be rewarded if our building is left standing.
text: Ni ye nŋmi kaa gaa waah maa nan nin ke u li kan u yɔr.

ref: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
text: Wan yaal gaa nŋmi ke, u li lann u yɔr, amaa u baantɔɔl ma li kan nŋmarim, le ki nin be ke uninfo wan ŋmar ki nyan nŋmi ni.

ref: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
text: Naa nyi ke nim le ye Uwonbɔr a wonjiɛndiig nnaa, le Uwonbɔr a Naaŋ be ni nii?

ref: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
text: Ni ye, wan bii Uwonbɔr a wonjiɛndiig n ke, Uwonbɔr mu li bii u yaadaan; Uwonbɔr a wonjiɛndiigin ye kasi a diig le, le ni mu le ye kudiig nmɔn.

ref: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
text: Ni laa lar niba. Ni ye uba tiɛr ke u ye ulandaan le dulinya nan yaan ke, un ŋaam u ba “kujɔrug” wee ki fir ŋa ulandaan.

ref: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
text: Dulinya nan yaab a lam ye ijɔrig le Uwonbɔr ban. Ke naah sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke, “Uwonbɔr ta bilandam a lam le ki pen choo bi;”

ref: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
text: ki ji sɔb niba yaan ke, “Ti yudaau nyi bilandam a potiɛri kaah ye yɔli.”

ref: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
text: Naah ye Pɔɔl, bee Apolosi, bee Piita, bee dulinya nan, bee limiɛfol, bee nkum, bee daandaan nan nin iyoo yan chaan ni, nim le ye ni biɛn,

ref: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
text: Masiya le ye ni, le Uwonbɔr mu ye Masiya.

ref: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.
text: Man bu ni ŋan bininfob li nyi ke ti ye Masiya a toontum le, Uwonbɔr ta U bɔwoonkaar ki ŋa ti nɔɔn ke ti ta pag ki bei bininfob.

ref: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
text: Daandaan nan ni kpaa talar le ke ban wee bi ŋa bi yada-n n tun bi toon nbamɔm.

ref: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.
text: N baga kaa be naah ji n bɔr man bee dulinya a ninfob kaah ji n bɔr man ni, maa ji n ba a bɔr gbaa.

ref: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.
text: Maa tiɛr n galin yi, amaa naa wɔɔn ke maa tun tibiri, Uyudaan le ji n bɔr.

ref: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
text: Ni bu ni laa ji uba tibɔr daandaan nan wee n-yonn kaa la foo, ni li guu n-yonn man wee Uyudaan na li foon. U ma na li nyan nan be libunbɔnlin nween ni, ki kpiir tibir tan be uninfo a sufu-n npaan ni, iyaayoo bininfob biɛn na li kan bi pɔg Uwonbɔr ban.

ref: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
text: Daandaan nan, n nabum, nim a nyɔɔr bu le n bigin ni niɛ ki sei min nin Apolosi, ke ni tinn ti ban n wɔɔm man ke, “Ni la tun ki lagir nan sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin nin bu” wee nin che ni laa jɔɔ kalanbaani uba bu ki jon u kpiɛgi.

ref: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
text: Ŋma che a jɔɔ nbɔgirim a tab ban naa? Ba wee a jɔɔ wee naa ye bi seiŋ lee? Ke ni ye bi seiŋ le ke, ba ŋa wee ni far igbingban ke baa pu ni lee?

ref: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
text: See ni pii jɔɔ nan biɛn wee ni ban! See ni pii ye bijɔɔndam le! See ni pii ye bibɔrtiib le! Amaa naa ye timi. N sin bi ban ke na ni ŋa bibɔrtiiba, wee ti mu n ŋa bibɔrtiib ki kpiɛ ni bu.

ref: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
text: Min ban ke, n tiɛr ke Uwonbɔr gann tim ban ye itoon nan le ki jiin ti bɔɔn ke taa kpaa talar le liwonjiɛnlin ni. Ki nann bininfob ban wee bi li ku ti npaan ni ki ŋa ti ligaril a ninfob ban wee bi pag ki galin ti wee dulinya nan a ninfob nin Malakam ligin.

ref: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
text: Tim ye tijɔri le ki sei Masiya, amaa nim ye bilandam le Masiya ban! Tim ye ndaburim le, amaa nim ye bipɔɔndam le! Ni jɔɔ jilima, amaa tim kaa jɔɔ jilima!

ref: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
text: Ki nan kpaa iniɛ a yoo nkom nin nnyunyum jɔɔ ti le, ti yee tiwanchar le, le bi boo ti, le ti choon yelin kaa jɔɔ binbeboli.

ref: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
text: Ti nɔɔi le ti jɔɔ tun itoon nin inunman. Bi poo imɔɔŋ ŋa ti ke, ti mu kaab ikaab ŋan le ki tenn bi, bi mugir ti le amaa le ti mu chee sei bi.

ref: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
text: Ni ye bi jɔɔ ti kutingbiig ke ti jiin tibɔŋann le. Ki nan kpaa daandaan nan ti nann tiwanchɔgin le dulinya nan yaan, ki ji nan dulinya nan a fatanpol a mɔɔr.

ref: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
text: Maa sɔb ni niɛ ke n jin ni ifa le, amaa n kpaan ni le, naah ye nbibankaam nbu.

ref: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus,
text: Nin naah le jɔɔ ban wɔɔnn ni Masiya a bɔr turpiig nan biɛn na, naa jɔɔ baam takpemi, Masiya a bɔŋann nbu le n nan ŋa ni baa.

ref: and I want you to be like me.
text: Mambu n balin ni le, ni li nɔɔ n binbem ma.

ref: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
text: Mambu le n tun Timoti, n bija wan wee n ban wee u si ibamɔn Uyudaan a samin ni. U li tiɛr ni maah jɔɔ nbinben man Masiya-n wee ni nɔɔ nan wee n wɔɔn nan yaan biɛn wee n be nin ni tiwonjiɛndirin.

ref: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
text: Ni ni biba tiɛr ke maa yin dan nan gɔnn ni, ni ma bu le bi jɔɔ kalanbaani.

ref: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
text: Ni ye Uyudaan chee ke, n li gɔnn ni daandaan nan, naa ye kalanbaanidam nan a pipagir a binba bu le n na yin ligi, amaa n ban n kan npɔɔn man wee bi jɔɔ le.

ref: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
text: Uwonbɔr a naamin kaa ye tipipagir a binba amaa mi ye npɔɔn le.

ref: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
text: Ni ban ni laa? Ni ban n dan ki nan dar ni tul le bee n dan nin njiɛm a Naaŋ nin jiininbaa?

ref: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
text: Ni ye ibamɔn le ke iwanjaab toon be ni sisiigin, nan wee ban kaa ye biwonjiɛm kaa li chee tun ni: N gbir ke uba be do ki dɔɔ nin u baa a poo.

ref: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
text: Le ni jɔɔ kalanbaani! Naa bi ye ni li mɔr le ki sin nyan uja wan tun iwanjaab toon nmɔn ni gbanann nin naa?

ref: I am with you only in my thoughts. But in the name of our Lord Jesus I have already judged this man, as though I were with you in person. So when you meet together and the power of the Lord Jesus is with you, I will be there too.
text: Ni ye ni nan lagin tab Uyudaan Yisa a yinlin bu wee n be ni ban nin Kinaaŋin ke, wee ti Yudaau Yisa a pɔɔmin be nin ti ke,

ref: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
text: ni ta uninfo wan tun man nmɔn ki ŋubin Sintani a nɔɔn na wee un bii u binben biim a gbanann nmɔn, wee u naaŋ n nan kan nŋmarim Uyudaan a dan daal.

ref: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
text: Naa ŋan nin ni li far ligbingbanli, naa nyi ke boroboro a nyɔgim wama le che boroboro yom fugir ki do nnaa?

ref: Get rid of the old yeast! Then you will be like fresh bread made without yeast, and this is what you are. Our Passover lamb is Christ, who has already been sacrificed.
text: Ni bu, ni jiɛn ni binben kpegim n na, ki ŋa bininfob pɔm ke naah pii be man ni. Bi ta Masiya wan ye ti yuglagir a peebigin mann kumanuga.

ref: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
text: Ni bu ni che ti ji yuglagir a chiig wee ki laa jɔɔ nbinben kpeg man ye titoonbir nin npooton, amaa ki li kpenn ki ŋa bininfob pɔm ki li si nbamɔm nin ibamɔn na.

ref: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
text: N gbɔŋ kan wee n sɔb ki sei ni-n, n pii bei ni ke ni laa nɔɔ bininfob ban tun iwanjaab toon nni.

ref: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
text: Naa ye ni nyan niba dulinya nan a ninfob ban tun iwanjaab toon, bee linunchɔril bee ban ji bitab dulim bee ban mann ibawol nle. Ni ye man ke, see ke ni nyan ni ba dulinya nan yaan.

ref: I was talking about your own people who are immoral or greedy or worship idols or curse others or get drunk or cheat. Don't even eat with them!
text: Amaa n sɔb ki bei ni ke ni laa jɔɔ nɔɔ nin tab nin ban yi biba ke biwonjiɛm wee ki sin chon tun iwanchɔgin toon lipiibanl bee lijabanl, bee kujaŋuuŋ bee libawomanil bee kutingbiig bee bidanyub bee ban ji bitab dulim. Ni laa lagin ki ka nin u yaadaan ki ji tijiiri.

ref: Why should I judge outsiders? Aren't we supposed to judge only church members?
text: Ni ye n toonl le ke n ji ban kaa ye biwonjiɛm tibɔraa? Naa ye ti ji ban ye biwonjiɛmin nlee?

ref: God judges everyone else. The Scriptures say, “Chase away any of your own people who are evil.”
text: Uwonbɔr le yin ji ban kaa ye biwonjiɛmin tibɔr. “Ni ŋɔɔr bipootondamin ni ban na.”

ref: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
text: Ni ye ni ni uba jɔɔ limɔkpel nin u kpiɛg wee ki ta ti jon ban kaa ye biwonjiɛmin ban ke bin tan ji ti ke, naa bi ye un ta jo ban ye biwonjiɛmin ban lee?

ref: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?
text: Naa nyi ke biwonjiɛm le na yin ji dulinya nan yaab tibɔraa? Ke ni ye nim le na yin ji dulinya nan yaab tibɔr ke, ba ŋa naa kpaan nin ni mann nbɔfinfim nan naa?

ref: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
text: Naa nyi ke ti na li ji Malakam tibɔraa? Ke ŋma nin chaa baan dulinya nan yaab a binbem maa!

ref: Why do you take everyday complaints to judges who are not respected by the church?
text: Ni ma bu ni ye ni jɔɔ limɔkpel nin tibɔr nmɔn a bol ke, ni ta tibɔr nmɔn ki ŋa ban kaa jɔɔ tininkper biwonjiɛmin wee bin ji ti.

ref: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
text: N jin ni ifa nin maah len man nmɔn na. Limɔkpel dan nim a sisiigin ke, nim kaa jɔɔ ulandaan wan li fir mann tibɔr nmɔn naa?

ref: Why should one of you take another to be tried by unbelievers?
text: Le ni tug tab ki chaa bibɔjib ban, hali nin ban kaa ye biwonjiɛmin, le bi ji ni bɔr!

ref: When one of you takes another to court, all of you lose. It would be better to let yourselves be cheated and robbed.
text: Ibamɔn buu, naah ji tab a bɔr man ni pii wɔɔn ke ni luu. Ba ŋa wee ŋaa ban a chee igalin naa? Ba ŋa wee ŋaa chee bin jiŋ dulim maa?

ref: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
text: Naa nyi ke bipootondam kaa na li kɔɔ Uwonbɔr a naamin naa? Ni laa lar niba: Bininfob ban tun iwanchɔgin toon lipiibanl bee lijabanl bee bibawomanib, bee iwanchɔgin toon bee bijab ban chon tun iwanjaab toon bee bijab ban taar bijatab ki kpann bipiibin,

ref: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.
text: bee binaayigib, bee kujaŋuuŋ, bee bidanyub bee bitingbiib, bee ban ji tab dulim bi niɛ nan biɛn kaa na yin kɔɔ Uwonbɔr a naamin ni.

ref: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
text: Nim bibam nan ye man le. Amaa le Uwonbɔr ŋunn ni bir, ki ŋa ni kasi, ki ke ni bɔr ŋan Uyudaan Yisa Masiya a yinlin nin Uwonbɔr a Kasi a Naaŋin bu. Che ni gbanann ndon Uwonbɔr a yinl

ref: Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.
text: Ni ni biba len ke, “Niwann biɛn kaa bi kɔ.” Amaa naa ye niwann biɛn le li ter ti. Ni ke, “Niwann biɛn kaa bi kɔ.” Amaa maa yin che niba nŋaam tiyomiri.

ref: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
text: “Tijiir ye lipool yaal le, le lipool ye tijiir yaan.” Ni ye ibamɔn le, amaa Uwonbɔr li bii niwann nilee nmɔn biɛn. Tigbanann kaa ye nan wee ti li jɔɔ tun iwanjaab toon ni, amaa ti ye Uyudaan yaan le, le Uyudaan mu ye tigbanann.

ref: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
text: Uwonbɔr a pɔɔm bu le fiin Uyudaan nkumin, U na li fiin ti mu nkumin.

ref: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
text: Naa nyi ke ni gbanann tug nin Masiya a gbanann lee? Ke n ta Masiya a gbanann nmɔn ki lagin nin wan tun iwanjaab toon naa? Naa li firi.

ref: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
text: Bee naa nyi ke wan ta uba ki tugin nin wan tun iwanjaab toon ke, bi nin ye gbanann tiba lee? Ke naah sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke, “Bi bilee nmɔn le ŋa gbanann tiba-n.”

ref: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
text: Amaa wan ta uba ki tugin nin Uyudaan ke, udaan nin Uyudaan nin jɔɔ Kinaaŋ kiba le.

ref: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
text: Ni guun nya iwanjaab toon nin na man. Tibir tan biɛn wee uninfosaal tun kaa be u gbanann ni, amaa wan tun iwanjaab toon ke, u tun ki bii u tɔɔl a gbanann le.

ref: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
text: Naa nyi ke ni gbanann ye Kasi a Naaŋ a diig lee? Naa ye u ma le Uwonbɔr ta u ki sei ni nnaa? Naa ye niba

ref: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
text: Uwonbɔr le daa ni kudaapɔɔrug, ni ma bu ni che ni gbanann le jɔɔ jilima ki tenn Uwonbɔr a.

ref: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
text: Naah nan sɔb kugbɔŋ seim tibɔr tan bu-n, ke ni ŋan nin uja nlaa kɔɔn upii-n.

ref: Well, having your own husband or wife should keep you from doing something immoral.
text: Amaa iwanjaab toon kaah yab nbu, ni ŋan nin uja biɛn li jɔɔ u poo, le upii biɛn mu li jɔɔ u chal.

ref: Husbands and wives should be fair with each other about having sex.
text: Ni ŋan nin uja nta uba ki sei u poo, le upii mu nta uba ki sei u chal.

ref: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
text: Upii a binba kaa ye u gbanann nmɔn ni, amaa u chal mu le ye u gbanann nmɔn, uja mu a binba kaa ye u gbanann ni, amaa u poo mu le ye ti.

ref: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
text: Ni laa yiin tab a dɔɔmi, man ke ni nan chee sei tab ke ni la yin ta isaŋ iba le ki miɛ Uwonbɔr. Wee ni bɔɔn bu ke ni jir ki lagin tab wee Sintani nlaa fir bigin ni n yonn man wee ni nan walin ni ŋmag ni baa guri.

ref: I wish all of you were like me, but God has given different gifts to each of us.
text: Min bi ban ke uninfo biɛn li be ke maah be man nan le, amaa Uwonbɔr sei uninfo biɛn nin u piini le, uba a piin be iba ki jiɛn utɔyaan.

ref: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
text: N pag ki tenn ban kaa la kɔɔn bipiib, nin ban kaa la kun bijab nin ipukɔɔ nle, ke bi bi jiɛn lipiikɔɔnl bee lijakunl wee ki bi be ke maah be man nan ke, ni bi ŋan.

ref: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
text: Amaa ni ye baa li fir choo biba ke, ni ŋan nin bin kɔɔn bipiib bee bin kun bijab, nin bi li jɔɔ nmɔsanyunsɔɔm wee bi sufu gaan nŋmi.

ref: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband
text: Bipiidam nin biniinpiib le n siig nsiim nan ki tenn ni : Naa ŋan nin upii nnya ki jiɛn u chali.

ref: should either stay single or go back to her husband. And a husband should not leave his wife.
text: Amaa ni ye u nyan u chal ban ke, un la ji kun uja uba, amaa un jirim u chal nmɔn a niin. Uja mu nlaa yii u poo.

ref: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
text: Nim ban gurin mu le n bei nan, : Ni ye ni ni uba kɔɔn upii wan kaa ye uwonjiɛn ni, wee ki fir be nin u chal ke, u la yii wi.

ref: If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him.
text: Ni ye upii mu jɔɔ chal wee u chal nmɔn kaa ye uwonjiɛn ke, wee ki li fir be nin u chal ke u la yii wi.

ref: Your husband or wife who isn't a follower is made holy by having you as a partner. This also makes your children holy and keeps them from being unclean in God's sight.
text: Uja wan kaa ye uwonjiɛn nmɔn labir Uwonbɔr a ninfou u poo nbuu, le upii wan kaa ye uwonjiɛn nmu labir Uwonbɔr a ninfou u chal nbuu. Naa bi ye man ke ni buwaab kaa bi li fir be kasi, amaa ibamɔn buu, Uwonbɔr gaa bi le ki ŋa bi kasi.

ref: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
text: Amaa ni ye wan kaa ye uwonjiɛn ban un yii u chal bee u poo ke ni che u li chaau. Naa ye limugil le ke u li be nin wan kaa ye uwonjiɛn nmɔn ni.

ref: And besides, how do you know if you will be able to save your husband or wife who isn't a follower? Obeying the Lord at All Times
text: Fin upii nan yin ŋa nii ki biɛ ke ŋaa li fir fee a chal ki jaa? Fin uja mu a yin ŋa nii ki biɛ ke ŋaa li fir fee a poo ki jaa? Li be ke Uwonbɔr kaah ban a li be man nin

ref: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
text: Nin ni ma biɛn ni, che uninfo biɛn li ŋmag Uyudaan kaah ban u li be man nin, ke waah pii nan be man wee Uwonbɔr yin win. Nsiim man wee n ta sei biwonjiɛm a laginn biɛn le yen.

ref: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
text: A jii ke ni ye yɔli le, ŋaa ti ji jii ke ni ye yɔli le. Nan kpaa talar ye ni ŋmag Uwonbɔr a siimin le.

ref: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
text: Ni che uninfo biɛn li be ke waah nan be man wee Uwonbɔr yin win.

ref: Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should.
text: A nan ye uyom le Uwonbɔr yin ŋaa? Laa che nin mugiriŋi, amaa a nyi ŋaah li ŋa man ki nya tiyomirin ke, a ŋaam.

ref: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.
text: Wan nan ye uyom wee Uyudaan yin u ke, waa ji ye uyom Uyudaan ban ni, man mu le wan mu nan ye uba wee Uyudaan yin u ke, u nin ye Masiya a yomu le.

ref: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
text: Uwonbɔr daa ni le ki yɔn; Mambu ni laa ji ŋa bininfob a yomi yi.

ref: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
text: Daandaan nan, nim ban kaa la nyi bipiib nin ban kaa la nyi bijab nan man, Uyudaan kaa seim nsan ke n bei ni niba, amaa Uyudaan a nyunyunbasanl bu le n ji ni bɔr ke uninfobamɔn nin.

ref: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
text: Daandaan nan a bɔr mugkaar nbu, n tiɛr ke ni ŋan nin ni li be ke naah be man nan.

ref: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
text: A kɔɔn upii waa? Laa ji gbaar a yii wi. Ŋaa la kɔɔn upii? Laa ji ban upii a kɔɔn ni.

ref: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
text: Amaa ni ye a kɔɔn upii ke naa ye tibiri, usapɔɔn wan kaa la nyi uja mu kun uja ke, naa ye tibiri, amaa ban jɔɔ bipiib bee chiɛb li kan tibɔmugkaar bi binbemin, le n ban nnyan bi tibɔmugkaar nmɔn yaan.

ref: My friends, what I mean is that the Lord will soon come, and it won't matter if you are married or not.
text: Maah ban n wɔɔn ni nan sɔ, n nabum, n-yonn kaa ji yabi, naah nyan daandaan nan ki jɔɔ chaa, ban jɔɔ bipiib li be ke ban kaa jɔɔ bipiibin;

ref: It will be all the same if you are crying or laughing, or if you are buying or are completely broke.
text: ban mɔr, li be ke baa mɔr len, le ban jɔɔ npopeen li be ke baa jɔɔ npopeen len, le ban daag tiwann yɔɔr li be ke tiwann yɔɔr nmɔn kaa ye bi yaan len;

ref: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
text: ban jɔɔ dulinya nan a wan yɔɔr ki jɔɔ tun bi toon yin, bi li be ke bi baga kaa be niin len. Nan bu-n dulinya kaah be man daandaan nan ni, naa li yuuri ni li fɔɔr ki jo.

ref: I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord.
text: N ban ni li be ni wiib le ki laa che niba mugir ni, ujakpag a baga be u Yudaau a toon yin le, le u gbaar waah li ŋa man wee nin gbee Uyudaan a num.

ref: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
text: Amaa upiidaan ma a baga be dulinya a wan yɔɔrin le, waah li ŋa man wee nin gbee u poo a num,

ref: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
text: ni bu u potiɛl bɔgir le, upii wan kaa kun uja bee usapɔɔn wan kaa nyi uja mu a baga be Uyudaan a toon ni le, nin waah li ŋa man ki ta u gbanann nin u naaŋ ki sei Uyudaan nbamɔm. Amaa wan jɔɔ chal ma lig dulinya nan a wan yɔɔr le, nin waah li ŋa man wee nin gbee u chal a num.

ref: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
text: N pag ni niɛ nan ni yaa ŋam bu le, naa ye n ban n mug ni le amaa naah li ŋa man wee ni laa jɔɔ nbɔgirim Uyudaan ban ni.

ref: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
text: Ni ye uja jɔɔ kijakpeŋ wee u nan gbee upii, wee uja nmɔn jɔɔ lipotiɛl u bu kaa li fir choo uba ke, che un tun waah ban man, ni ŋan nin bin kɔɔn tab, waa tun tibiri.

ref: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
text: Ni bu wan kɔɔn u jakpeŋ ke ni ŋan, amaa wan mu kaa kɔɔn u jakpeŋ ke, u tun nan ŋan ki jon wan kɔɔn u jakpeŋa.

ref: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
text: Upii jɔɔ u chal wee u la be u miɛfolin ke, u chal nmɔn le ye u. Amaa ni ye u chal nmɔn kpo ke, u li fir kun uja wan wee u ban, amaa waah yin kun wan nmɔn li ye wan nɔɔ Uyudaan.

ref: However, I think I am obeying God's Spirit when I say she would be happier to stay single.
text: Amaa min ban ma ke, ni ye u be kaa ji kun uja ke, ni li mɔ u ki jon nin waah li kun ujau, Uwonbɔr a Naaŋ le che n pag man.

ref: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
text: Ki jiin tibawojiir paam: Ti nyi ke ti biɛn jɔɔ nbiɛm. Nbiɛm mu che uninfo far ligbingbanl le, amaa njiɛm ma pɔɔgir uninfo le.

ref: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
text: Wan tug ke u nyi niba ke, u yaadaan kaa la nyi waah bi ye u li nyi man ni.

ref: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
text: Amaa uninfo wan ban Uwonbɔrin, u ma le Uwonbɔr nyi.

ref: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
text: Tɔ, ki ta jiin ibawol a jiir a jim paam: Ti nyi ke ibawol ye yɔli le dulinya nan yaan, le nweenba kaa ji be ki kpiɛ Uwonbɔr uba nmɔn bu.

ref: Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords.
text: Hali baah yi nan iween nin i be papaab bee dulinya nan yaan ke ni, “iween” takpem nin “biyudam” takpem sin be,

ref: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
text: tim ban ma ke, Uwonbɔr uba kpeŋileŋ le be, u ma ye ti Baa Uwonbɔr wan nan naan niwann biɛn, le Uyudaan uba kpeŋileŋ mu le be u ma ye Yisa Masiya, u ma bu le tiwann biɛn nan naan, le ti mu be u ma bu le.

ref: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
text: Amaa naa ye uninfo biɛn le nyi man ni. Bininfob biba la jɔɔ libawol manil a potiɛl le bi sufu ni, ni bu ni ye bi jin man a jiir ke, ti nann tibawojiir le, bi yada mu kaah kaa pɔɔ-n, bi ban ni ye tibir le.

ref: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
text: Amaa tijiir kaa li fir che ti mal Uwonbɔr ban ni; taa jin ti ke naa yin kpiɛ ti niba, ti mu ji jin ti ke naa yin war ti niba.

ref: Don't cause problems for someone with a weak conscience, just because you have the right to eat anything.
text: Amaa ni li nyi man, wee ki laa che ni wiib a binbem nkpann litangbag gbiɛrikaal ndaburim a samin ni.

ref: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
text: Ni ye uninfo wan a yada waar kan fin wan jɔɔ nbiɛm nan be ji tijiir nbawodiin ke, naah li pɔɔg u sufu wee un ji tibawojiiraa?

ref: When you sin by hurting a follower with a weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
text: Ni ye a tun man a bir ki sei a nabum ban a yada kaa pɔɔ nan ki che idaburig choo bi ke, Masiya le a ŋa tibir.

ref: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
text: Ni bu, ni ye nan wee n ji-n li che n na big n tun tibir ke, maa ji li ŋman tinann ni, wee ki che un lu.

ref: I am free. I am an apostle. I have seen the Lord Jesus and have led you to have faith in him.
text: Maa ye n baa? Maa ye ntoon naa? Maa kan ti Yudaau Yisa nmɔn naa? Naa ye nim le ye n toon nmɔn a nyɔɔr ti Yudaau nnaa?

ref: Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.
text: Ni ye maa ye Yisa a toom biba ban ke, amaa nim ban man nbiɛnim kaa be, n ye ntoon le ni ban, nim le ye ndaagim man wɔɔn ke n sin ye ntoon le Uyudaan ban.

ref: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.
text: Nsan kaa be nin ti li ji ki nyuu?

ref: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
text: Nsan kaa be nin ti ta uwonjiɛnpii ki che u li nɔɔ ti choon ke ti toontuntab nin ti Yudaau a watiib nin Piita kaah ŋaan man n naa?

ref: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
text: Bee ni ye min nin Banabasi a binba le ye ti tun ki jin tibaa?

ref: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
text: Utɔtogir ula ba tog bitɔb wee ki ji jinn ubaa? Bee ŋma li ŋu isiig yan lo iloon wee kaa li ji isiig nmɔn a loon yaa? Bee ŋma kpaa inaa wee kaa li nyu nnaabiim maa?

ref: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
text: Ni sɔb Moziz a siim n-yaan ke, “Laa ta niba ki bon kinaajag a mɔb, n-yonn man wee u be kuur idi.” Uwonbɔr a baga be inaa a binba ni lee?

ref: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
text: Ibamɔn tim le u pag ki sei, naa ye man naa? Nn, ni sɔb sei tim le, nan bu-n wan ko nin wan kuur biɛn jɔɔ tama uba le ke bi naah li por idi nmɔn.

ref: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
text: Taah li gaa dulinya nan a wan yɔɔr tan ni ban nin yab ki jon Kinaaŋ a bim man wee ti ta bu-n ni sufu-n ni waa?

ref: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
text: Ni ye biba jɔɔ nsan nin bin gaa literil ni ban ke, tim kaa jɔɔ nsan nmɔn ki jon baa? Amaa, taa ta nsan nmɔn tun mi toon yi. Amaa le ki ji fala a booli biɛn ta kaa ban niba nlegin Masiya-n a bɔŋann ni a mɔɔnimin bu.

ref: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
text: Naa nyi ke ban tun Uwonbɔr a wonjiɛn niin n-yaan, bi jiir nya niin lee, le ban mu mann kumanug Uwonbɔr a binbinl bu-n mu por nan wee bi mann libinbinl bu-n lee?

ref: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
text: Mambu le Uyudaan sei bimɔb ke ban mɔɔn u bɔŋann nin a jiir nya tibɔŋann nmɔn yaan le.

ref: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
text: Amaa maa ta nsan nmɔn ki tun itoon ni. Kaa ji sɔb ni niɛ ke ni seim niba. N kpo ke ni sɔ nin uba n che n gbingbanfaal n ŋa yɔli.

ref: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
text: Hali n mɔɔn tibɔŋannin ke, maa li fir fa n gbingbanli, amaa ni kpaa talar le ke n mɔɔn ti. Ni li bir ki seim ni ye maa mɔɔn tibɔŋann nmɔn ke.

ref: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
text: Ni ye n bi tun nin n tɔɔl a wiib ke, n bi kpaan nin n ga tiyɔra, amaa naa ye min tɔɔl a wiib bu ke, man ke Uwonbɔr kaah siinim ke n tun man le yen.

ref: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
text: Ke n yɔr le ye ni laa? Ni ye nan le: Tibɔŋannin nmɔn a mɔɔnimin ni ye n mɔɔn ti le ki tenn bininfob le bin gbir ki laa yɔ niba, n jɔɔ nsan nin n gaa niba bi ban amaa n mu kaa gaan ni.

ref: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
text: Hali maah ye nba wee uba a yomu kaa yem nan, n ta nba le ki kpann uyom ki sei bininfob biɛn, ke n che bininfob takpem ndan Yisa ban.

ref: When I am with the Jews, I live like a Jew to win Jews. They are ruled by the Law of Moses, and I am not. But I live by the Law to win them.
text: Ni ye n jon Juu yaab ban ke, n be le ke Juu a ninfou win, naah li ŋa man wee Juu yaab n kan nŋmarim. N ji jon ban wee nsiimin ŋmag bin ban ke, n be le ke nsiim nmɔn kaah ŋmag ban ni, , naah li ŋa man wee nsiim nmɔn kaah ŋmag ban ni n kan nŋmarim

ref: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
text: Ni ye n be ban kaa nɔɔ nsiimin ban ke, n ta nba le ŋa wan kaa nɔɔ nsiim, ke bin kan nŋmarim. .

ref: When I am with people whose faith is weak, I live as they do to win them. I do everything I can to win everyone I possibly can.
text: Maah nan be nin ban a yada waarin, n nan be le ke wan a yada waarin, naah li ŋa man wee bin kan nŋmarim. N che n binbem be le ke bininfob biɛn a binbem kaah be man ni, naah li ŋa man wee n fir fee bininfob bibam ki jaa.

ref: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
text: Tibɔŋann nbu le n tun ni niɛ nan biɛn, ke n nan ji ni nyɔɔr.

ref: You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win!
text: Naa nyi ke bitaaguum gu ke, utaaguun uba kpeŋileŋ le yin guun ki ji ki gaa tiyɔraa? Ni bu, ni li gu nin inunman na wee ki gaa tiyɔr.

ref: Athletes work hard to win a crown that cannot last, but we do it for a crown that will last forever.
text: Bitaaguum biɛn ŋmag biba le ntinnim biɛn ni. Bi ŋaan man ki ban bin gaa tiyɔr tan kaa yuur le, amaa tim ŋaan man ki ban ti ga tiyɔr tan yuur kaa jɔɔ ndiɛm le.

ref: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
text: Mambu min kaa be ke uninfo wan gu yɔli yɔli n ni, n mu kaa be ke unɔɔkufaar wan far ki lan nni.

ref: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
text: Aai, n mug n gbanann le ki ŋa ti tiyomir, ke maah mɔɔn tibɔŋannin ki tenn n tab man ni, ni bɔɔn bu min tɔɔl n laa nan lann n yɔri.

ref: Friends, I want to remind you that all our ancestors walked under the cloud and went through the sea.
text: N nabum maa ban ni laa nyi ibamɔn nni, ke ti yaajam biɛn nan lagin be kitilangbɔŋ a lɔŋin le, ki lagin don limɔgil.

ref: All of them also ate the same spiritual food
text: Bi biɛn nan lagin jin kinaaŋ a jiir nna,

ref: and drank the same spiritual drink, which flowed from the spiritual rock that followed them. That rock was Christ.
text: ki ji nan lagin nyun kinaaŋ a nnyumin; bi nan nyun nnyum man nan nyan kinaaŋ a tangbapiig kan nɔɔn bi nle, kutangbapiig nmɔn nan ye Masiya le.

ref: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
