text: Ni biɛn yɔli, Uwonbɔr a sufu kaa nan sɔɔn bi ni takpem bu! Le bi nan kpo ki yal dɔ dɔ kukunkɔɔg bu.

ref: What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things.
text: Tibɔr tan be nan ye limagil le ki sei ti, ke ti laa tiɛr nan bir ke baah nan be man nni.

ref: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
text: Ni laa nɔɔ itingban ke bi ni bibam kaah nan ŋaan man nni, ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke, “Bininfobin nan kal le ki jin ki nyun, le ki fii ki gel itingban.”

ref: Some of those people did shameful things, and in a single day about
text: Ti laa tun iwanjaab toon ke bi ni bibam kaah nan tun man nni, wee weemba daal bininfob turpilee nin bita nan kpo nni.

ref: Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.
text: Ni ni biba len ke, “Niwann biɛn kaa kɔ” amaa naa ye niwann biɛn le jɔɔ tinyɔɔri. “Niwann biɛn kaa kɔ” amaa naa ye niwann biɛn le jɔɔ literili.

ref: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
text: Ti laa mag Uyudaan ni, ke bi ni bibam kaah nan bigin U man wee iwaalab nan junn bi ku nni.

ref: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
text: Ni laa ŋulin ni, ke bi ni bibam kaah nan ŋulin man wee nkum a malaka nan dan ki nan ku bi nni.

ref: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
text: Ni niɛ nan biɛn nan tun ki ye limagil le ki sei bi, ni nan ye ikpaan le ki sɔb dɔ ki sei tim ban nan joor bɔɔn dulinya nan a diɛmin.

ref: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
text: Ni bu wan nyi ke u si nbamɔm ke, un choo u bau wee ki laa lu.

ref: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
text: Nbigim le kaa be ki nyaŋ ni see nbigim man be nin uninfosaal biɛn n yaa binba. Uwonbɔr ye u bamɔndaan le, waa li che nbigim n foon ni ban ki jo ni pɔɔm a tarigi. Amaa ni ye nbigim foon ni ban ke, u ji li fir naan nsan ki sei ni wee ni nɔɔ nya ki mann sir mi bu.

ref: My friends, you must keep away from idols.
text: Man bu n jɔtiib, ni nyan ni ba libawol manilin na.

ref: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
text: N pag tenn bilandam le, ni mu n tug ki jiin nan wee n pag nan paam ma.

ref: When we drink from the cup we ask God to bless, isn't that sharing in the blood of Christ? When we eat the bread we break, isn't that sharing in the body of Christ?
text: Naa ye kiyiinyɔɔg kan wee ti tenn Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpoog wee ki nyu ki poolin ni ye Masiya a cham lee? Boroboro kan wee ti war war ki ŋman ni, kaa ye Masiya a gbanann lee?

ref: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
text: Ni ye boroboro konl liba le, amaa tim yaba, le ki lagin ki ŋa gbanann tiba, nan bu-n taah lagin ki ŋman boroboro konl liba n bu.

ref: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
text: Lig Iziral yaab: Naa ye bi ma lagin ki ŋma kumanug a nann tan wee bi mann libinbinl bu nna?

ref: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
text: Ke n wɔɔn ke kumanug ye niba lee, bee libawol ye niba lee?

ref: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
text: Aai kumanug kan wee ban kaa ye biwonjiɛm mann ni, bi mann tenn nnaanbiim le amaa naa ye Uwonbɔr i, n mu kaa ban ni li mann ki tenn nnaanbiimi.

ref: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
text: Naa li fir nyu Uyudaan a yiinyɔɔgin, ki jin nyu nnaanbiim a yiinyɔɔgin ni. Naa li fir ji Uyudaan a jiir wee ki ji nnaanbiim a jiiri.

ref: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
text: Ti ban ti fiin ti Yudaau a piiponl lee? Ti pɔɔ ki jon u waa?

ref: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
text: Li ŋma tinann tan wee bi kɔɔr kinyaŋin na, wee ki laa baan ibinbaan yan li mugir a potiɛli,

ref: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
text: “Uyudaan le ye kutingbɔŋ nan nin niwann nan biɛn be ki yaan.”

ref: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
text: Wan kaa ye uwonjiɛn baaniŋ tijiir wee a yin ji ke, li ji nan biɛn wee u ta siin nna ki laa baan ibinbaan yan li mugir a potiɛli.

ref: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
text: uninfo u miɛnin a potiɛl bu le n pag nan, naa ye fin ni. Ni bi yin ŋa nii wee n wiib a binbem nmugir uba a potiɛlaa?

ref: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
text: Ni ye n sei Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpoog n jiirin bu ke, ni yin ŋa niin wee uba n pag ki bii n yinl tijiir tan bu wee n sei Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpoog n buu?

ref: When you eat or drink or do anything else, always do it to honor God.
text: Ni ye ni jin, bee ni nyun bee ni ŋa nan biɛn ke, ni che nin don Uwonbɔr a yinl.

ref: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.
text: Ni laa che uba nlu waah ye Juu a ninfou, bee Girig a ninfou, bee uwonjiɛn ni.

ref: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
text: Ni li be ke maah be man nin nna, ke n mu kaah be ke Yisa kaah be man ni. Sadiga a yilim a bɔr kuwonjiɛndiigin

ref: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.
text: N pagir ni nin naah tiɛr nbu ki la biɛn nin nɔɔ maah nan wɔɔn ni nan biɛn ni.

ref: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
text: Daandaan nan n ban ni biɛ ke uja biɛn a Yudaau ye Masiya le, upii mu a Yudaau ye u chal le, le Masiya mu a Yudaau ye Uwonbɔr.

ref: This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.
text: Uja wan chig kiyuchigirig wee ki miɛ Uwonbɔr bee ki mɔɔn Uwonbɔr a bɔr ke, u yaa daan kaa sei u yul nmɔn jilima.

ref: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
text: Le upii wan mu kaa yil sadiga wee ki miɛ Uwonbɔr bee ki len ilinlen leen ke, waa sei u yul nmɔn jilima, le ni nann ke u koo u yul nmɔn le-n.

ref: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
text: Ni ye upii kaa ban un yil sadiga ke, ni ŋan nin un chiɛ u yul bee ki koo u yukper nmɔn, man mu ji ye ifa ke, see ke u yil sadiga.

ref: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
text: Uja kaa kpaan un chig kiyuchigirig kuwonjiɛndiigin ni, nan bu-n waah jɔɔ Uwonbɔr a nunaŋ wee ki ji ye npagim ki sei Uwonbɔr nbu; amaa upii ma ye npagim le ki sei uja.

ref: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
text: Nan bu-n, naa ye upii a gbanann le bi ta naan uja, amaa uja a gbanann le bi ta naan upii;

ref: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
text: Naa ye uja le bi nan naan ki sei upii, amaa upii le bi nan naan ki sei uja.

ref: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
text: Ni niɛ nan bu nin malakam bu, ni kpaan nin upii li jɔɔ siɛra a wan u yul bu, wee nin wɔɔn ke u chal jɔɔ u pɔɔm.

ref: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
text: Upii kaah nan nyan uja a gbanann nin ni, man le upii mu ma uja. Amaa niwann biɛn nya Uwonbɔr ban le.

ref: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
text: Ni baan ni bau njee ni ŋan nin upii li miɛ Uwonbɔr wee kaa yil sadigaa?

ref: But long hair is a beautiful way for a woman to cover her head.
text: upii mu jɔɔ tiyukper fufɔgir ke, naa ye u jilima le yen naa? Tiyukper fufɔgir nmɔn le bi ta sei u ke u li jɔɔ piig u yul.

ref: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
text: Amaa ni ye uba ban un fa limɔkpel ki jiin tibɔr nan bu ke, tim nin tiwonjiɛn tab kaa jɔɔ nan wee ti li tun ki kpiɛ ni niɛ bu. Uyudaan a jiir a jim (Matiu

ref: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
text: Maah yin wɔɔn ni nan nan, maa yin pag ni, naah ti lagin tab ki pag nan nin kaa mann ni, amaa ni bii ni le.

ref: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
text: Chinchinn n gbir ke ni ye ni lagin tab biwonjiɛm a laguŋ ke, nbɔgirim be ni sisiigin le, le n sin kan ke ni ye ibamɔn le.

ref: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
text: Naa jɔɔ nbiɛnimi, ni ye ni li jɔɔ nbɔgirim le ni sisiigin wee nin wɔɔn ban ye bibamɔndamin kaah ye ban ni sisiigin.

ref: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
text: naah be ji n-yonn man ni, ni ji mɔnn tab le, uba kaa guu u kpiɛgi. Uba mɔɔr nkom le, le uba mu nyun ki gbee.

ref: The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.
text: Iyoo yan biɛn wee ni ŋman boroboro nan wee ki nyun kiyiinyɔɔg nan yaan ke, ni mɔɔn Uyudaan a kumin le nin waah na li jirin.

ref: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
text: Nan bu-n, wan ŋman wee ki nyun wee kaa sin feen ki biɛ Uyudaan a gbanann nmɔn a taai ke, u jin ki nyun litudaril le ki jaa uba bu.

ref: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
text: Man nmɔn jigin baah nan jin diɛ a bɔɔn le u ji yuur kiyiinyɔɔg, ki len ke, “Kiyiinyɔɔg kan ye Uwonbɔr a poopɔnn tan ye n yaa chamin nsɔ, ni li tun man n-yonn man biɛn wee nin nan nyun ke, ni li tiɛr nbu.”

ref: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
text: Maah nan gaa nan Uyudaan ban ni, ni ma le n mu ta sei ni: Kunyiɛg kan wee bi nan kɔɔr Yisa-n, le u nan yuur boroboro,

ref: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
text: waah sei Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpoog ki diɛ n yonn man ni, le u war war le ki ke, “N gbanann sɔ, tan ye ni yaan, ni li ŋaan man wee ki li tiɛr nbu.”

ref: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
text: Mambu wan ŋman boroboro nan bee ki nyun u yiinyɔɔg n-yaan wee kaa sin nɔɔ nsan man li sei Uwonbɔr a yinlin jilima ke, u yaa daan tun tibir ki sei u Yudaau a gbanann nin u chamin na.

ref: This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink.
text: Uninfo biɛn ye un mann dibir uba le nbamɔm, wee ki nin fir ŋman boroboro-n wee ki nyu kiyiinyɔɔg n-yaan.

ref: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
text: Mambu le ni ni bibam gbarig ki buŋ le ni ni bibam kpeg.

ref: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
text: Amaa ni ye Uyudaan jin ti tibɔr ke, ti ga litudaril le na li ŋa man wee ti laa won nan kpo nin dulinya yaabi.

ref: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
text: Mambu n nabum, ni ye ni nan lagin ni ji ke ni guur taba.

ref: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
text: Ni ye nkom jɔɔ wan ke un chinn ji u niin na, wee ni lagin tab ke nin laa ta tibɔr a jim foon ni. Tibɔr tan gurin, n nan dan ke n li wɔɔn ni.

ref: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
text: Ni nyi ke naah kaa nan ye biwonjiɛm n-yonn man ni, ni nan che bi ta ibawol yan kaa fin pagin ki lar ni kɔɔn kulɔŋ.

ref: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
text: Mambu le n bei ni ke, uninfo wan jɔɔ kasi a Naaŋ a pɔɔm ki pag kaa li fir poo bimɔb ki ŋa Yisa, uba mu kaa li fir ke, “Yisa ye Uyudaan ni,” see kinaaŋin be u ni.

ref: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
text: Kasi a Naaŋ a piini be le balbal, amaa Kasi a Naaŋ ye kiba le.

ref: There are different ways to serve the same Lord,
text: Itoon ni be le balbal amaa le Uyudaan ye u ba.

ref: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
text: Itoon a tum mu be le balbal, amaa Uwonbɔr uba le che ni niɛ nan tun bininfobin.

ref: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.
text: Uninfo biɛn nan gaa Kasi a Naaŋin kaah sei u ipiin yan ni, bininfob biɛn a teril bu le.

ref: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
text: Kasi a Naaŋ che biba pag nlam a bɔr, Kasi a Naaŋ nmɔn a piini le che biba pag nin nbiɛm Kinaaŋ kiba nmɔn a pɔɔmin,

ref: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
text: Kasi a Naaŋ nmɔn le che biba jɔɔ yada, le ki sei biba mu ipiin yan wee bi jɔɔ teb bibaarib, Kinaaŋ kiba nmɔn a pɔɔm bu,

ref: or the power to work mighty miracles. Some of us are prophets, and some of us recognize when God's Spirit is present. Others can speak different kinds of languages, and still others can tell what these languages mean.
text: Kinaaŋ kiba nmɔn le sei uba ligaril a toon a pɔɔm, ki sei uba ilinlen leen a pagim a piini, ki sei uba npɔɔn le u biɛr nnaam a bɔgirim, ki sei uba mu ileen pɔɔn a booli a pagim, le ki sei uba mu ileen pɔɔn nmɔn a kar wɔɔn a pɔɔm.

ref: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
text: Ni niɛ nan biɛn ye Kinaaŋ kiba nmɔn a toonl le, le u ta sei uninfo biɛn waah ban man. Tigbanann tiba tan jɔɔ nbɔgirim takpem

ref: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
text: Ti biɛn nan fun Kasi a Naaŋ nmɔn le nin kinaaŋ kiba nin gbanann tiba, ŋaah ye Juu a ninfou bee Girig a ninfou wi, ŋaah ye uyom bee ŋaah ye a ba, Kinaaŋ kiba nmɔn le bi nan ta sei ti nyun.

ref: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
text: Tigbanann nmɔn kaa lagin ye gbanann bɔgil liba, amaa ti jɔɔ ibɔg takpem le.

ref: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
text: Ni ye litaal len ke, “Maah kaa ye nnɔɔ-n, maa kpiɛ tigbanann nin ke, man kaa li fir che un nya tigbanann nin ni.

ref: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
text: Litul mu len ke, “Maah kaa ye nnumbimin ni bu maa kpiɛ tigbanann nin ke,” man kaa li fir che un nya tigbanann nin ni.

ref: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
text: Tigbanann biɛn bi lagin ki ye nnumbim ke, ni bi yin ŋa niin wee tigbanann li gbiraa? Ke tigbanann bi lagin ki ye litul ke, ni bi yin ŋa niin wee tin gbir nbaamaa?

ref: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
text: Amaa Uwonbɔr lagin igbanann bɔg nmɔn biɛn nba le waah ban ti man.

ref: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
text: Ni ye igbanann bɔg nmɔn biɛn bi ye ligbanann bɔgil liba ke, tigbanann nmɔn biɛn bi yin be laa?

ref: It takes many parts to make a single body.
text: A le ke naah ye man ni, tigbanann jɔɔ ibɔg ibɔg le, amaa ti ye nba le.

ref: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
text: Nnumbim kaa li fir bei nnɔɔ ke, “Maa baŋi!” Le liyul mu kaa li fir bei itaa ke, “Maa ban ni!”

ref: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
text: Amaa igbanann bɔg yan be kaa jɔɔ npɔɔn nin kaa bi be ke, tigbanann kaa bi li fir tun ni,

ref: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
text: Igbanann bɔg yan ŋan ni, kaa ban nterimi. Amaa Uwonbɔr le ta igbanann bɔg nmɔn, ki tugin tab le ki ta jilima takpem sei ligbanann bɔgil lan kaa jɔɔ jilima nmɔn.

ref: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
text: Ni bu naa kpaan tigbanann li jɔɔ nbɔgirimi. Amaa wee igbanann bɔg nmɔn a baga li be tabin.

ref: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
text: Ni ye ligbanann bɔgil liba ji fala ke, igbanann bɔg yan gurin biɛn mu ji fala nmɔn le, ni ye ligbanann bɔgil liba kan jilima ke, ni mɔ igbanann bɔg yan gurin le.

ref: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
text: Daandaan nan ni ye Masiya a gbanann le, ni biɛn le ye tigbanann nmɔn a bɔgi.

ref: First, God chose some people to be apostles and prophets and teachers for the church. But he also chose some to work miracles or heal the sick or help others or be leaders or speak different kinds of languages.
text: Biwonjiɛmin, Uwonbɔr nan gann itoon le chinchinn, le ki paan bilinlem, ban kpiɛ mitaa le u gann ban wɔɔnn, le ki nin paan ban tun ligaril a toon, le ki ji paan ban jɔɔ kutebug a piini, nin ban li fir ter bitab, le ki gann bitoontum sanliib, nin ban pag ileen pɔɔn a booli.

ref: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
text: Ti biɛn le ye itoon naa? Ti biɛn le ye bilinlem maa? Ti biɛn le ye ban wɔɔnn naa? Ti biɛn le tun ligaril a toon yaa?

ref: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
text: Ti biɛn le jɔɔ kutebug a piin yaa? Ti biɛn le pag ileen pɔɔn naa? Ti biɛn le kar wɔɔn naa?.

ref: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
text: Amaa ni li ban ipiin yan jon i biɛn na. Ke n ji li wɔɔn ni nsan man ŋan jon niwann biɛn.

ref: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
text: Ni ye n pag bininfosaalib a leen nin Malakam a leen, amaa wee kaa jɔɔ njiɛm ke, n nann kileŋ le bee libulonl ki mɔr yɔli.

ref: What if I could prophesy and understand all mysteries and all knowledge? And what if I had faith that moved mountains? I would be nothing, unless I loved others.
text: Ni ye n jɔɔ ilinlen leen a piini, ki fin biɛr tibɔwoonkaar biɛn, ki jɔɔ nbiɛm biɛn, hali ki jɔɔ yada kan wee n li fir pag wee ijɔɔ nfii, amaa wee kaa sin jɔɔ njiɛm ke n ye yɔli le.

ref: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
text: Ni ye n ta maah jɔɔ nan biɛn ki sei faladam, hali ki nan ta n gbanann sei bin nyɔɔ nŋmi wee kaa sin jɔɔ njiɛm ke, maa jɔɔ tinyɔɔri.

ref: Love is patient and kind, never jealous, boastful, proud, or
text: Njiɛm ye limɔril le, tininforin le ye njiɛm, maa ye lipiiponli, maa ye ligbingbanl faali, maa ye kalanbaani.

ref: rude. Love isn't selfish or quick tempered. It doesn't keep a record of wrongs that others do.
text: Njiɛm kaa ye wɔɔnimba, kaa ye kujaŋuuŋi, kaa ji ye kiŋuufiiŋ yɔli yɔli, kaa sɔb tibɔbir bilig sufu ni.

ref: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
text: Njiɛm kaa wiiri. Amaa ilinlen leen na li diɛ; le ileen pɔɔn a pagim na li jo, le nbiɛm a tarig na li kpaa.

ref: We don't know everything, and our prophecies are not complete.
text: Ti nyi tibɔr nmɔn wama le, ti pag ilinlen leen wama le.

ref: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
text: Amaa nnyinyin man gbeen nin nan dan ke, nnyinyin man kaa gbeen nin biɛn li fɔɔr.

ref: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
text: Maah nan ye kibigin, n nan pag le ke kibigin, ki tiɛr ke kibigin, ki biɛr ke kibigin, amaa maah nin nan gbee uninfo nan n ta linaakpaanlin le ki jaa.

ref: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
text: Daandaan nan ti ga amaa nin nann taah lig niɛnu le, taa ga nbamɔmi; amaa n-yonn chaan le ti na li kan nbamɔm nin nnumbim. Daandaan nan n nyi wama le amaa n-yonn chaan le n na li biɛ ni biɛn ke Uwonbɔr kaah nyim biɛn man ni.

ref: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.
text: Daandaan nan tiwann titaa nan le be, ti ma ye Yada, Tama nin Njiɛm, amaa njiɛm mu le jon ni biɛn.

ref: Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy.
text: Ni li nɔɔ njiɛm ki sin li ban Kinaaŋ a piini, ni nunman li ye ilinlen leen a piin.

ref: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
text: Wan pag ileen pɔɔn ke, waa pag tenn uninfosaali, amaa u pag tenn Uwonbɔr le. Uba kaa biɛr i taai amaa u pag liwool a bɔr nmɔn kinaaŋ a pɔɔmin le.

ref: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
text: Amaa wan pag ilinlen leen ke u pag tenn bininfob le npɔɔn, ki pɔɔgir bi gbanann nin ibalin.

ref: By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church.
text: Wan pag ileen pɔɔn ke, u pag pɔɔgir uba le, amaa wan pag ilinlen leen ke u pag ter biwonjiɛm le.

ref: I am glad for you to speak unknown languages, although I prefer that you would prophesy. In fact, prophesying does much more good than speaking unknown languages, unless someone can help the church by explaining what you mean.
text: N bi ban ni biɛn li pag ileen pɔɔn, amaa n jann ban ni pag ilinlen leen le. Wan pag ilinlen leen jon wan pag ileen pɔɔn na, see u kar wɔɔn le nin ter biwonjiɛm.

ref: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
text: N nabum, ni ye n dan ni ban ki nan pag ileen pɔɔn ke, ni ye baa a ŋan ki sei naa, wee naa ye n ta tibɔkpiirikaar dan ni ban bee nbiɛm bee ilinlen leen bee nwɔɔnim a mɔbonl laa?

ref: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
text: Wan pee bitɔb a wol wee kaa pee yin bitɔtob ke, ŋma yin ŋa bitɔb a silii?

ref: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
text: Ni ye man le, see ke a pag ileen pɔɔn wee i ween, naa ye man ke bi yin ŋa niin ki biɛ? A le yin pag ki tenn nfaam le.

ref: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.
text: Ni ye maa nyi uba kaah pag tibɔr tan ki tenn nim ke, n ye libobanl le udaan ban le u mu ye libobanl n mu ban.

ref: If you really want spiritual gifts, choose the ones that will be most helpful to the church.
text: Ni ye man le. Ni sufu kaah ban Kasi a Naaŋ a piini nbu-n, ni che ni sufu mu li be ipiin yan li ter biwonjiɛm ma.

ref: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
text: Mambu wan pag ileen pɔɔn ke un miɛ Uwonbɔr wee un che un fir ki wɔɔn nan wee u pag nmɔn a taai.

ref: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
text: Ni ye n miɛ Uwonbɔr ileen pɔɔn nin ke, n naaŋin le n miɛ, amaa n sufu ni naa jɔɔ tinyɔɔri.

ref: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
text: Ke n ni yin ŋa nii? N li miɛ Uwonbɔr n naaŋin, le ki ji miɛ u n sufu ni, n li gaah ilan n naaŋin ki ji gaah n sufu ni.

ref: Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, “Amen”?
text: Ni ye a pagir Uwonbɔr a naaŋin a binba ke, ni yin ŋa niin wee uninfo wan be ni sisiigin kaa nyi ŋa len nan ni n len ke “Ibamɔn naa”?

ref: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.
text: Nba ke a wonpagil nmɔn ŋan amaa naa ye nan pɔɔg uba a sufu.

ref: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
text: N poor Uwonbɔr nin maah fir pag ileen pɔɔn a booli ki jon ni biɛn.

ref: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
text: Amaa ni ye n be biwonjiɛmin ke, n nɔɔ li pag imɔbon ŋan iŋmu yan li ter n tab ki jon nin n pag ileen pɔɔn a booli imɔbon turpiiga.

ref: My friends, stop thinking like children. Think like mature people and be as innocent as tiny babies.
text: N nabum, ni laa tiɛr ke nbuwaabi. Amaa tibir ma paam ke ni li be ke nbiliɛmin, amaa ni potiɛlin ni li be ke binunwondama.

ref: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
text: Nsiimin yaan ni sɔb ke, “N yin ta ban pag ileen pɔɔn a booli a booli nle nin bininfocham a mɔgbai le ki pag sei bininfob nan, amaa nin ni ma biɛn na, baa yin pel n bɔr nmɔn ni,” Uyudaan le len man.

ref: Languages others don't know may mean something to unbelievers, but not to the Lord's followers. Prophecy, on the other hand, is for followers, not for unbelievers.
text: Ileen pɔɔn ye siɛra le ki sei ban kaa ŋa yada-n amaa naa ye yadadami; ilinlen leen ma pag tenn yadadam le naa ye ban kaa ŋa yada nni.

ref: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?
text: Ni ye biwonjiɛm biɛn lagin tab, wee bi biɛn piin ki pag ileen pɔɔn, wee biba kaa biɛ ni taai bee ban kaa ŋa yada-n yaa ni biba kɔɔn ke, baah li len ke ni waar lee?

ref: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
text: Amaa ni ye biwonjiɛm lagin tab ki pag ilinlen leen wee wan kaa ŋa yada bee wan kaa biɛ ni taai kɔɔn ki gbir ke, u li ji uba tibɔr ni biɛn bu ke u ye tibirdaan le.

ref: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
text: Iyaayoo le u sufu ni a bɔwoonkaar biɛn li nyan npaan ni, le un gbaan tum ki jiɛn Uwonbɔr ki len ke, “Uwonbɔr sin be nin ni.” Biwonjiɛm kaah li kaa ki jiɛn Uwonbɔr man

ref: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
text: N nabum, ti ji yin len ke baa? Ni lagin tab ni jiɛn Uwonbɔr ke, uba jɔɔ ilan, bee nwɔɔnim, le utɔ mu jɔɔ tibɔkpiirikaar, le uba mu pag ileen pɔɔn a booli, le uba mu jɔɔ karwɔɔn. Ni niɛ nan biɛn ye nin tun le ki sei biwonjiɛm npɔɔn.

ref: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
text: Ni ye uba pag ileen pɔɔn ke, ni ninfob bilee bee bita li fir pag amaa ni ye bi li pag le ki tenn tab le uba mu n karwɔɔn.

ref: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
text: Ni ye karwɔɔn kaa be ke, wan pag ileen pɔɔn nmɔn nŋmi na, wee ki pag sei u baantɔɔl nin Uwonbɔr.

ref: Two or three persons may prophesy, and everyone else must listen carefully.
text: Bilinlem bilee bee bita li fir pag wee ban gurin mu n dibir nbamɔm ki biɛ tibɔr nmɔn kaa len man.

ref: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
text: Amaa ni ye tibɔkpiirikaar dan nim ban kan n yaa ni uba ban wee u yin pag ke, wan bi chinn be pagin nŋmi-n na.

ref: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
text: Ni biɛn li fir pag ilinlen leen ki tenn tab wee nin che ni biɛn n kan ntinnim ki ji pɔɔg ni gbanann.

ref: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.
text: Bilinlem le ye bi naam a pɔɔm ki fir ŋmag mi.

ref: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
text: Uwonbɔr kaa ye kuŋmaruŋ a Wonbɔru wi. Nin tiwann tan ye yɔli, amaa U ye wan tun nin ni sam bu le. Ke naah be man biwonjiɛm biɛn a sisiigin ni,

ref: the women must not be allowed to speak. They must keep quiet and listen, as the Law of Moses teaches.
text: bipiib nŋmi-n bi mɔɔŋi soon n-yonn man wee ni be ni jiɛn Uwonbɔr a. Nsan kaa be nin bin pag tibɔri, naa kpaan nin bin ŋa bisanliib ke Uwonbɔr a siim kaah wɔɔn man nin.

ref: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
text: Ni ye bi ban bin biɛ niba ke, bin baan bi chiɛb bi niin yin; ni ye ifa le nin upii n pag tibɔr kuwonjiɛndiigin.

ref: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
text: Uwonbɔr a bɔrin piin nim ban lee? Bee ti foon ni yaa binba ban lee?

ref: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
text: Ni ye uba tiɛr ke u ye ulinlenn bee u jɔɔ Kinaaŋ a piini ke, ni ŋan nin u yaadaan n biɛ ke nan wee n sɔb ki sei ni nan ni ye Uyudaan a siim le.

ref: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
text: Ni ye u yii ni niɛ ke, ni mu a baga laa be u ni.

ref: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
text: Ni ma bu n nabum, ni che ni sufu li be ilinlen leen a pagimin, ki laa kɔɔg ileen pɔɔn a booli a pagimi.

ref: But do everything properly and in order.
text: Amaa ki che niwann biɛn li tun ki nɔɔ tab nin ni sam bu-u.

ref: My friends, I want you to remember the message I preached and that you believed and trusted.
text: N nabum, n ban n tiɛr ni maah nan mɔɔn tibɔŋann tan ki sei ni wee ni gaa ti ki ŋmag nle.

ref: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
text: Tibɔŋann nan bu ni ŋmara, ni ye ni ŋmag tibɔr tan wee n nan mɔɔn sei ni nbamɔm ke. Naa ye man ke ni yada li gab yɔli.

ref: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
text: Nan wee n gaa-n ni ma le n mu ta sei ni le ni ye nan kpaa talar chinchinn: Ke Masiya kpo ti yaa bir bu le ke naah sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋ man ni,

ref: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
text: le bi nan pii u, le u fii nkumin iween itaa daal ke naah sɔb man ni,

ref: Christ appeared to Peter, then to the twelve.
text: u nan degirin Piita bu, le ki ji degir u tooi piig nin bilee-n mu bu.

ref: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
text: Ni bɔɔn bu le u nan degir u nabum ban nan yab ki jon bininfob kobiŋmu-n bu n-yonn nmɔn, bi ni takpem la be bi miɛfolin, amaa biba ma kpou.

ref: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.
text: U nan degir Jemisi bu, le ki nan degir u tooi nbiɛn bu.

ref: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
text: Ni biɛn nan a joorim, le u degir min tɔɔl bu, min wan wee u nan yim ke uyom a dann ni.

ref: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
text: Min le nan joor bɔɔn itoon nmɔn yaan kaa bi kpaan nin bi li yim ntoon ni, nan bu-n n nan mugir Uwonbɔr a ninfob le.

ref: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
text: Amaa Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl bu le n ye maah ye wan nan, le u nyunyunbasanl lan be n ni nmɔn kaa ye yɔli. Nan bu-n n tun ki jon itoon nin biɛn na, amaa naa ye min le tun ni Uwonbɔr nyunyunbasanl lan nan be n ban ni-n le tun.

ref: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
text: Ke naah ye min bee bi miɛ ni, tibɔŋann nan le ti mɔɔn, tibɔŋann nmɔn le ni mu ŋa ti yada. Ti kum a fiim a bɔr

ref: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
text: Amaa ni ye tibɔrin mɔɔn ke Masiya nan fii nkumin na ke, niin wee nim bibam ke nkum a fiim kaa bee?

ref: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
text: Ni ye nkum a fiim kaa be ke, Mambu ke Masiya gbaa tɔɔl kaa nan fii nkumin ni.

ref: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.
text: Masiya kaa nan bi fii nkumin ke, taah mɔɔn tibɔŋann tan ni ye yɔli le, nin ni yada wan wee ni ŋaan.

ref: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
text: Mambu ke ti ŋa tibɔkar a siɛradam ki sei Uwonbɔr a, nan bu-n ti jin siɛra ke Uwonbɔr nan fiin Masiya nkumin na. Amaa nkum a fiim kaa be ke, man ke Uwonbɔr mu kaa nan fiin Masiya nkumin ni.

ref: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
text: Ni ye nkum a fiim kaa be ke, man ke Masiya tɔɔl kaa nan fiin nkumin ni.

ref: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
text: Masiya kaa nan bi fii nkumin ke, ni yada bi ye yɔli le, le tibir la be ni bu.

ref: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
text: Ni bi wɔɔn ke ban kpo nin Masiya-n bora.

ref: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
text: Ni ye taah be ti miɛfolin nin bu le ti jɔɔ tama nin Masiya ke, man ke ti jɔɔ kunyunyunbaag ki jon bininfob biɛn na.

ref: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.
text: Amaa ni ye ibamɔn le, Masiya sin nan fii nkumin na, u ma ye chinchinn a ninfou wan fii nkumin.

ref: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
text: Uninfo kaah nan ta nkum ki dan dulinya nan yaan ni, man mu le uninfo ji ta nkum a fiim ki dan.

ref: Adam brought death to all of us, and Christ will bring life to all of us.
text: Adam bu le bininfob biɛn kpeg, Masiya mu bu bininfob biɛn li kan limiɛfol.

ref: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
text: Uninfo biɛn nin u kum a fii yoo, Masiya le chinn fii, le ban ye u ninfob mu na li fii u jirin daal.

ref: Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.
text: Ni bɔɔn bu le dulinya a diɛm nfoon, u nan nyaŋ nnaam kaah ye niwann nan biɛn nin mi pɔɔm ke ni bɔɔn bu u yin ta nnaamin ki ŋa u Baa Uwonbɔr a nɔɔn le.

ref: Christ will rule until he puts all his enemies under his power,
text: Masiya le yin ŋmag niwann biɛn ki tan kpaa iyoo yan wee Uwonbɔr na li nyaŋ u dataam biɛn.

ref: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
text: Kidataag kan wee u na li bii joor ye nkum le.

ref: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.
text: “U ta niwann biɛn ki ŋa u nɔɔn na.” Amaa naa wɔɔn ke Uwonbɔr tɔɔl kpiɛ niin ni, U ma ta niwann biɛn ki ŋa Masiya a nɔɔn.

ref: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
text: Ni ye U tun ni niɛ nan ke, bija-n tɔɔl yin be u ma wan ta niwann biɛn ŋa u nɔɔn n ban le, le Uwonbɔr nin ye niwann biɛn ki ŋmag niwann biɛn.

ref: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
text: Daandaan nan ni ye, nkum a fiim kaa be ke, baah fun ban bitakpiib a nyunfulin yin ŋa nii? Ni ye bitakpiib kaa fii nkumin ke, ba ŋa wee bininfob fu nnyum ki tenn baa?

ref: And why do we always risk our lives
text: Ke babu wee ti le be kininbɔŋin iyoo biɛn naa?

ref: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
text: N nabum, n be nkum a daŋin le lidaal biɛn, n jɔɔ ligbingbanfaal nin taah jɔɔ nbinben man ti Yudaau Masiya-n nin bu, ni ma bu le n len man.

ref: What do you think I gained by fighting wild animals in Ephesus? If the dead are not raised to life, “Let's eat and drink. Tomorrow we die.”
text: Ke ni ye n kɔn Efesusi a tiŋ a ninfob ban nann kulɔŋ a wankorin bininfob a potiɛri bu ke, ba a nyɔɔr wee n kan naa? Ni ye nkum a fiim kaa be ke, “Ni che ti ji ki nyu, wee won ke ti won kpo.”

ref: Don't fool yourselves. Bad friends will destroy you.
text: Ni laa che uba nlar ni. “Kujɔtiibirug bii nbinben ŋan le.”

ref: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
text: Ni che ni lam njirin, wee ni li be ke naah bi ye ni li be man ni, wee ki laa ji tun tibiri; nim bibam kaa nyi Uwonbɔr i. N len man le ke n jin ni ifa. Tigbanann a fiim a bɔr

ref: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
text: Amaa uba li baan ke, “Ban kpo na yin fii nkumin niin? Bi gbanann na yin be niin?”

ref: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.
text: Kujɔrugaa! Ŋaah bun nan ni kaa li pa, see ke ni kpo.

ref: Wheat seeds and all other seeds look different from the sprouts that come up.
text: Ni ye a bun niba ke, ŋaa ŋu ligbaamil lan yin be nni, amaa ni le yin ye biwanboolib le, nba ke idi bee niba.

ref: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
text: Amaa Uwonbɔr le tenn tigbanann waah ban man, le ki tenn biwanboolib biɛn mi tɔɔl a gbanann.

ref: People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike.
text: Tigbanann biɛn kaa piɛ, bininfob a gbanann be tiba le, le tiwankor a gbanann be tiba, le nnɔɔm a gbanann be tiba, le ijan mu yaal be tiba.

ref: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
text: Paab a gbanann be le, ki jiɛn tum a gbanann, amaa paab a gbanann a ŋam be nbinba le, ki jiɛn tum a gbanann a ŋam.

ref: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
text: Nween a ŋam be nbinba le, le uŋmal a ŋam be nbinba, le iŋmabil mu a ŋam mu be i binba, iŋmabil a ŋam kaa piɛ nin tabi.

ref: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
text: Nkum a fiim mu na yin be man le, tigbanann tan wee bi ta pii-n bur le, amaa ti nan fii ke, taa ji yin buri;

ref: As surely as there are physical bodies, there are spiritual bodies. And our physical bodies will be changed into spiritual bodies.
text: Bi pii ti dulinya a gbanann le, amaa le ti fii nin Kinaaŋ a gbanann, dulinya nan a gbanann be ke, kinaaŋ mu a gbanann be.

ref: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
text: Man le ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke, “Chinchinn a ninfou Adam nan ye wan fo le,” le Adam wan joorin mu ye wan tenn kinaaŋ a miɛfol.

ref: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
text: Kinaaŋ kaa nan chinn ki dan ni, dulinya nan a gbanann le nan chinn ki dan, ni bɔɔn bu le Kinaaŋ a gbanann mu ŋɔɔrin ni.

ref: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
text: Chinchinn a ninfo win nan nyan titann nin le, le uninfo wan kpiɛ milee n mu nyan paab.

ref: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
text: Dulinya nan a ninfob be le ke uja wan nan nyan titann ni nin le, le ban ye paab yaabin mu be ke uja wan nyan paabin.

ref: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
text: A li ke taah jɔɔ uja wan nan nyan titann nin nan a nunaŋin, man mu le ti ji yin jɔɔ uja wan nyan paab nan mu a nunaŋ.

ref: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
text: N nabum, n bei ni le ke, tigbanann nin ncham kaa li fir kɔɔ Uwonbɔr a naamin ni, le nan bur mu kaa li fir kɔɔ nan kaa bur a naamin ni.

ref: I will explain a mystery to you. Not every one of us will die, but we will all be changed.
text: Ni pelim man, n yin wɔɔn ni tibɔwoonkaar le. Ti biɛn nan kaa yin kpo, amaa ti biɛn na li kpenn.

ref: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
text: Lidaal nmɔn, binum a gabinim nin bi ligirim kunaatuŋ joor kaagin li mɔ, kunaatuŋ nmɔn nan mɔ ke, bitakpiib na li fii nkumin nin tigbanann ŋan, le ti mu n kpenn.

ref: Our dead and decaying bodies will be changed into bodies that won't die or decay.
text: Ni kpaa talar le ke tigbanann tan burin nkpann tigbanann tan kaa li buri, le tigbanann tan kpegin, mu nkpenn tigbanann tan kaa kpegi.

ref: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
text: Ni ye nan bur kpann nan kaa burin wee nan kpeg kpann nan kaa kpegin ke, ileen yan pag ki sɔb bilin yin ŋa ibamɔn le, “Nkum kaa kan nnyaŋimi.”

ref: Where is its victory? Where is its sting?”
text: “Nkum a nyaŋim be laa? Nkum, a pɔɔm man wee a jɔɔ junn nin be laa?”

ref: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
text: Nkum a jum ye tibir le, le tibir mu a pɔɔm nya nsiimin le.

ref: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
text: Amaa Uwonbɔr le ye kunɔɔpoog; U ma sei ti n nyaŋim ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya bu.

ref: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
text: Mambu n nabum, ni mann sir nbamɔma. Ni laa che niba n boon ni, ki li tun u yudaan a toon yin iyoo biɛn na, nan bu-n ni nyi ke ni toon yan wee ni tun ki tenn u yudaan ni kaa yin gab yɔli.

ref: When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
text: Daandaan nan n ban n pag ki jiin ipiin yan li tenn biwonjiɛmin paam le: Ni ŋaam ke maah wɔɔn Galantiya yaab a wonjiɛm a laginn ke bi li ŋaan man ni.

ref: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
text: Likpakɔɔl daal biɛn ke, ni biɛn li nyan ŋaah tun ki kan man a piin ki biliga, wee n nan foon ke ipiin a chaarim n laa ji be.

ref: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
text: Wee ni ye n foon ke, n li sɔb kugbɔŋ, kan ta li wɔɔn bininfob ban wee ni gann ni, wee bin ta ni piini yan wee ni ŋaan ki chiɛn Jerusalam.

ref: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
text: Ni ye n nan lig ki miin ni kpaa talar nin n mu jo ke, bi li chiɛn nim. Pɔɔl a boni

ref: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
text: Ni ye n jon Masedoniya ke, ni bɔɔn bu n li dan ni ban n yin nɔɔ Masedoniya paam le.

ref: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
text: Nba ke n na li be ni ban wama, bee nin kufaag a yonn, wee ni terim nin n sanchon nan yaan biɛn wee n chaa.

ref: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
text: Maa ban n dan nan kan ni daandaan nan wee ni li ye paab a gɔnni yi, n jɔɔ tama nin n nan ji isaŋ ni ban ni ye Uyudaan chee ke.

ref: I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
text: N li be Efesusi a tiŋin hali ki tan kpaa Pentikosi a daal,

ref: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
text: nan bu-n itoon takpem a naanganl loor le ki seim nin n tun, amaa le bininfob takpem mu kaa chee seim nin n tun ni.

ref: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
text: Timoti nan dan ni ban ke, ni che u li be ni ban na wee ki laa che u lam yugiri, nan bu-n, u tun ti Yudaau a toon yin le ke maah tun man ni.

ref: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
text: Uba laa yii ki laa gaa wi. Ni che u nan nya ni ban ki jirin n ban nin nposɔɔn. N lig u ma nin ti nabumin nsan bu.

ref: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
text: Daandaan nan ki jiin ti na a big Apolosi paam: N balin u le ke u ma nin ti nabumin nnɔɔ dan ni ban, le waa ban un jo daandaan nan ni. Amaa ni ye u nan kan nsan ke u li jo. Imɔbon yan joor

ref: Keep alert. Be firm in your faith. Stay brave and strong.
text: Ni li guu niba man, ki che ni yada li pɔɔu, ki li ye bininfob ban jɔɔ lipoobil nin npɔɔn.

ref: Show love in everything you do.
text: Ni li tun niwann biɛn nin njiɛma.

ref: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
text: Ni nyi Sitefanasi nin u niin yaab le nan ye chinchinn a ninfob ban kpenn bi binbem ki ŋa biwonjiɛm Akaya a tiŋin, bi ta biba le ki sei itoon nin ki tun ki tenn Uwonbɔr a ninfob. N nabum, n balin ni le,

ref: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
text: ni chee sei bininfob nmɔn a bosuu, nin bi toontunn nunman damin.

ref: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.
text: N nan jɔɔ npopeen Sitefanasi nin Fotunatusi, nin Akakusi kaah nan foon nin, nan bu-n bi nan ŋa nan wee ni bi li ŋa seimin na.

ref: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
text: Bi pɔɔg min nin nim a sufuu. Man a ninfob kpaan nin ni gaa ba.

ref: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
text: Biwonjiɛm a laginn ban be Asiya a yerin nin poor ni. Akula nin Pirisila nin biwonjiɛm ban lagin ki jiɛn Uwonbɔr bi niin yin ni poor ni pam Uyudaan a yinlin.

ref: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
text: N nabum ban biɛn be do nan poor ni. Ni li poor tab nin jilimau. Njoorim a poori

ref: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
text: Min Pɔɔl le ta n tɔɔl a nɔɔ ki sɔb ipoor nan.

ref: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
text: Wan kaa ban ti Yudaau ke, limɔpool be u bu. Dan ti Yudaau.

ref: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
text: Ti yudaau Yisa a nyunyunbasanl li be ni bu.

ref: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
text: N ban ni biɛn Masiya a yinl bu. Ibamɔn.

ref: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
text: Min Pɔɔl wan wee Uwonbɔr a bam bu wee n ŋa Masiya a toom nan, min nin ti na a big Timoti, le sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn Uwonbɔr a ninfob ban be Korenti, nin u ninfob gannkaab ban biɛn be Akaya a tingbɔŋin biɛn.

ref: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
text: Ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl nin nposɔɔn li be ni bu. Pɔɔl kaah sei Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpoog man

ref: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.
text: N pagir Uwonbɔr wan ye Yisa Masiya a baa-n; ti Baa wan san ti kunyunyunbaag ki jɔɔ nposɔɔn biɛn.

ref: He comforts us when we are in trouble, so that we can share this same comfort with others in trouble.
text: Ti Baa wan sɔŋir ti sufu a bɔmugkaar biɛn ni, wee ti mu li fir sɔŋir ban be limugilin a sufu, lisufusɔŋil lan wee ti nan gaa Uwonbɔr ban ni.

ref: We share in the terrible sufferings of Christ, but also in the wonderful comfort he gives.
text: Ti fala a jim Masiya a yinl bu kaah yab man nin, man le ti sufu sɔŋil mu na yin yabig ki tan lagir u ma Masiya bu.

ref: We suffer in the hope that you will be comforted and saved. And because we are comforted, you will also be comforted, as you patiently endure suffering like ours.
text: Ti jin fala ke, ni ye ni yaa sufu sɔŋil le nin feegab; ni ye ti kan lisufusɔŋil ke, ni ye nim a sufu sɔŋil le lan li sei ni limɔril ki che ni fir ji fala ke taah ji man ni.

ref: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
text: Mambu ti jɔɔ tama ni bu ke ni pɔɔ, nan bu-n ti nyi ke naah le ji ti fala man ni, man mu le ni yin kan ti sufu sɔŋil.

ref: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
text: N nabum, maa ban ni laa nyi fala wan wee ti jin Asiya a yerin paamin ni. Ti nan kan limugil takpenl lan yab ki jon ti pɔɔm a tariga, ki che ti jaa tama ti tɔɔl a miɛfol bu.

ref: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
text: Nan bu-n, ti nan tiɛr ke nkum kaa ji fɔg nin ti, amaa ni niɛ nan tun ki wɔɔn ti ke ti laa far ti baantɔɔl a gbingbanli, amaa wee ki li far ligbingbanl Uwonbɔr wan fiin bitakpiib nkumin ni bu.

ref: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
text: U ma nyan ti nkum a daŋ takpeŋ n-yaan, U li nyan ti. U ma bu le ti jɔɔ tama ke U yin gbaa nyan ti le,

ref: Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers. Paul's Change of Plans
text: a li ke naah ter ti nin liwonmiɛlin man ni, ni ma yin che bininfob takpem n sei Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpoog tim bu, waah san ti kunyunyunbaag nbu le u jiin bininfob takpem a miɛm. Pɔɔl kaah kpenn u boni man

ref: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.
text: Daandaan nan taah jɔɔ ligbingbanfaal lan sɔ: Ti potiɛl jin ti siɛra ti binbem dulinya nan a ninfobin, nin ni baantɔɔl a sisiigin, ti kasi a binbem nin ibamɔn nin nya Uwonbɔr ban le. Naa ye dulinya nan a lam le che ti tun man ni, amaa ni ye Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl bu le.

ref: I am not writing anything you cannot read and understand. I hope you will understand it completely,
text: Taa sɔb nan wee naa li fir karin ni bee naa li fir biɛ. Amaa n jɔɔ tama ke,

ref: just as you already partly understand us. Then when our Lord Jesus returns, you can be as proud of us as we are of you.
text: naah pii biɛ ti wama tiwann man ni, ni na li biɛ ti takpem wee ki fir fa ligbingbanl ti bu, ke ti mu kaah na li jɔɔ ligbingbanfaal ni bu man ti Yudaau Yisa a jirin daalin.

ref: I was so sure of your pride in us that I had planned to visit you first of all. In this way you would have the blessing of two visits from me—
text: Maah nan jɔɔ tidindann ni niɛ nan n bu, ni ma che n lol ke n chinn gɔnn ni wee ni ji tinyɔɔr nfim milee.

ref: once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea.
text: N nan lol le ke, n nan chaa Masedoniya ke, n burin ki nan gɔnn ni, wee ki ji nan nyan Masedoniya ke, n jirin ni ban, wee ni terim wee n jo Judiya.

ref: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others?
text: Maah lol man nmɔn n lol jagilangbiɛ le, a li ke dulinya yaab kaah ŋaan man ni, wee n ke, “Nn, nn,” ki ji ke, “Aai, aai” kufoorug kiba a poolin naa?

ref: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
text: Amaa ni ye ibamɔn le ke Uwonbɔr kaah ye yada daan nin bu, tibɔr tan wee ti jɔɔ tenn ni nan kaa ye “Nn” nin “Aai” le.

ref: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
text: Amaa Uwonbɔr a bija Yisa Masiya wan wee min nin Silasi nin Timoti nan mɔɔn u bɔr ki sei nin, waa ye “Nn” nin “Aai,” amaa u ma bu ke iyoo biɛn u “Nn” le ye “Nn” le.

ref: Christ says “Yes” to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say “Amen” for us to the glory of God.
text: Ni ma bu ni baga kaa be nin Uwonbɔr kaah siin imɔsiin yan biɛn nni, i ye “Nn” le, Masiya bu. Le u ma Masiya bu “Ibamɔn” yan wee ti pagin, i ye kupag le ki donn Uwonbɔr.

ref: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
text: Daandaan nan Uwonbɔr le che tim nin nim si nbamɔm Masiya ni. U ma gann ti le ti jɔɔ nbɔgirim,

ref: and put his Spirit in our hearts to show that we belong only to him.
text: ki daag ti waah ye ti a daagim, ki ta u naaŋin ŋa ti sufu ni, le ni wɔɔn ke u li sei ti nan biɛn wee U siin limɔsiinlin.

ref: God is my witness that I stayed away from Corinth, just to keep from being hard on you.
text: Uwonbɔr le ye n siɛradaan ke nin nan ŋan nin n ŋmiɛ ni maah kaa ji nan jirin Korenti a tiŋin ni.

ref: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
text: Taa li fir mugir ni ki wɔɔn ni naah li ŋa yada man ni, amaa ti tun nin ni le ni yaa mɔm bu, nan bu-n naah jɔɔ yada nbu le ni si kenken.

ref: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.
text: Mambu le n nin bon n sufu ni ke, maa ji yin gɔnn ni, wee ni kan nan wi.

ref: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
text: Ni ye n bii ni sufu ke, ŋma ji yin penn n sufu kaa ye nim ban wee n bii ni sufu nnaa?

ref: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
text: Ni bu le n nan sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ke, maa ban n dan ki nan kan npoobiin ban bi li che ni li mɔm n ban ni. N jɔɔ tidindann ni biɛn nan bu, ke ni biɛn na li ji n mɔm.

ref: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
text: Maah nan sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn ni, n nan sɔb nin npoobiin le takpem nin tinyinyinn, naa ye ke n nan ban n bii ni sufu le, amaa n nan ban ni biɛ maah ban ni takpem man le. Wan galin a jiɛn per a bɔr

ref: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
text: Ni ye uba ta npoobiin ki foon ke, waa bii n yaa binba a sufu, amaa u bii ni biɛn a sufuu gbaa, maa ban n ŋa li kinimaŋ tan lagiri.

ref: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
text: Ni takpem kaah dar u tul man ni, ni kpaan wa.

ref: When people sin, you should forgive and comfort them, so they won't give up in despair.
text: Amaa daandaan nan ni ŋan nin ni jiɛn per u, amaa wee ki sɔŋir u sufu, wee ki laa che npoobiim n kɔɔ ki tan lagiri.

ref: You should make them sure of your love for them.
text: N balin ni le, ni che ni bam nmann pɔŋ nin u.

ref: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
text: Ni nan bu le n sɔb ki mag ni njee ni sin chee n mɔb biɛn waa?

ref: I will forgive anyone you forgive. Yes, for your sake and with Christ as my witness, I have forgiven whatever needed to be forgiven.
text: Ni ye ni jiɛn wan a bir ki per u ke, n mu jiɛn per wa. Le nan wee n jiɛn perin, hali ni ye niba le n jiɛn per ke, nim bu le n jiɛn per u Masiya a nintogil,

ref: I have done this to keep Satan from getting the better of us. We all know what goes on in his mind.
text: wee Sintani n laa kan npɔɔn ki lar ti. Nan bu-n ti nyi u san kaah ye man. Pɔɔl a sufu kaah kaa nan dɔ Tirosi a tiŋin man

ref: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
text: Maah nan foo Tirosi a tiŋin ke n mɔɔn Masiya a bɔŋann ni, le n biɛ ke Uyudaan sin loor u toon a naanganl ki sei ma.

ref: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
text: Amaa maah kaa nan kan n na a big Tatusi nin yaan ni bu che n sufu kaa nan dɔ, nibu le n chabir nin yaan yaab, le ki jon Masedoniya. Yisa bu le ti kan nnyaŋim

ref: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
text: Amaa Uwonbɔr le ye kunɔɔpoog, nan bu-n iyoo biɛn U lii ti sam ki pee nnyaŋim a naatuŋ Masiya a pɔɔm bu. U bɔr mɔ le ke tulaali a baam kaah mɔ man ni, le u che ti mɔɔn ti ilog biɛn.

ref: In fact, God thinks of us as a perfume that brings Christ to everyone. For people who are being saved, this perfume has a sweet smell and leads them to a better life. But for people who are lost, it has a bad smell and leads them to a horrible death. No one really has what it takes to do this work.
text: Ban kaa kan feegabin ma ban, ti jɔɔ nbaam man che nkum forin le, amaa ban kan feegabin ma ban ti jɔɔ nbaam man che limiɛfol forin le. Ŋma kpaan nin itoon nmɔn naa?

ref: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
text: Taa ye bininfob takpem ban ŋmag Uwonbɔr a bɔr nmɔn wee ti ye kpoŋkpoŋ ki sei bin ni, amaa Uwonbɔr kaah tun ti n bu le ti jɔɔ ibamɔn a pipagir ki be u nintogil ki pag Yisa a pɔɔm bu.

ref: Are we once again bragging about ourselves? Do we need letters to you or from you to tell others about us? Some people do need letters telling about them.
text: Ti piin ki pagir ti ba le jigin naa? Ni kpaa talar le ke uba n sɔb ti siɛra a gbɔŋ ki sei ni bee ti gaa siɛra a gbɔŋ ni ban ke biba kaah ŋaan man n naa?

ref: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.
text: Nim baantɔɔl le ye ti siɛra a gbɔŋ, ki sɔb dɔ ti sufu ni le bininfob biɛn karin ki nyi.

ref: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
text: Nim le wɔɔn ke ni nann kugbɔŋ kan nyann Masiya ban le, ki ye ti toon a siɛra, naa ye ngbansɔbmɔɔn le bi ta sɔbi amaa Uwonbɔr wan fo-n a Naaŋ, naa ye litangbagil bu le bi sɔb paan ni, amaa bininfob a sufu ni.

ref: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
text: Tidindann nan a bosu ye ti yaan le Masiya bu Uwonbɔr ban.

ref: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
text: Taa wɔɔn tiba ke ti li fir tun niba nin ti tɔɔl a pɔɔmi, amaa taah fir tun nan ni nyan Uwonbɔr ban le.

ref: He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
text: U che ti ye bitoontunŋam ban fir mɔɔn tipoopɔnn ni le, naa ye nan sɔb dɔ, amaa ti nyan Kinaaŋin le; nan sɔb dɔ-n ma ku le amaa le Kinaaŋ ma tenn limiɛfol.

ref: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
text: Ni ye itoon nan le che nkum foon ke, wee bi nan sɔb litangbagil bu-n, iyaayoo le Uwonbɔr nmɔn a weem takpem jiirin ki nan won ki nyagin Moziz a num paam, nwonween nmɔn kaah nan nyagin man ni n bu, Iziral yaab kaa nan fir ligi, ni ye itoon nmɔn le nan che nkum foon ki biɛ che nwonween takpen foon ke,

ref: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
text: Kasi a Naaŋ a toon-yin kaa li jɔɔ jilima nin nwonween ki jo man naa?

ref: If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious?
text: Ni ye itoon yan ku bininfobin che jilima foon ke, ibuchin toon yan che jilima chaan nin ma li jo man!

ref: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
text: Nan nan ye jilima-n kaa ji jɔɔ jilima daandaan nan ni, nin ti ta ki mag nwonween takpen man kaa jɔɔ diɛm nan ni.

ref: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
text: Ni ye nan wiir nan che jilima foon ke, nan kaa wiir ma a jilima li jo man.

ref: This wonderful hope makes us feel like speaking freely.
text: Mambu taah jɔɔ tama kan nin bu le che ti jɔɔ lipoobil.

ref: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
text: Taa ye Moziz wan nan ta likinkenl ki piin u num paam ke Iziral yaabin laa kan nwonween man yin jo nbu.

ref: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
text: Amaa bi le laa ye tukangbirdam le, hali nin dinan, ni ye bi karin Moziz a gbann nin ke, likinkenl nmɔn la deg bi num paam le. Laa la degiri. Nan bu-n Masiya a binba bu le li degir.

ref: When the Law of Moses is read, they have their minds covered over
text: Hali nin dinan, bi karin Moziz a a gbann nmɔn ke, likinkenl nmɔn le la deg bi sufu le.

ref: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
text: Amaa ni ye uba kpenn ki nɔɔ Uyudaan ke, likinkenl nmɔn degir u num paam ma.

ref: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
text: Uwonbɔr ye kinaaŋ le, Uwonbɔr a Naaŋ kaah be nan yaan ni, ye nbaa mu be niin le.

ref: So our faces are not covered. They show the bright glory of the Lord, as the Lord's Spirit makes us more and more like our glorious Lord.
text: Amaa tim ban wee likinkenl kaa deg ti num paamin, le ti kan ti Yudaau kaah jɔɔ tiŋann man takpem, le ni kpenn ti le ti nann u, le ti yaa ŋam nmɔn kpiɛg, le tiŋam nmɔn nyan Uwonbɔr wan ye kinaaŋin ban le.

ref: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
text: Naah ye Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl bu le u ta itoon nan ki ŋa ti nɔɔn ni, nibu che naa gbɔɔ ti gbanann ni.

ref: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
text: Amaa ti yii tibɔwoonkaar nin ifa a tooi le, taa lar uba, bee ki bii Uwonbɔr a bɔri. Amaa ibamɔn a wɔɔm a poolin le ti ta tiba ki wɔɔn uninfo biɛn a potiɛl kaah wɔɔn u ke un nɔɔ man wee nin gbee Uwonbɔr a num.

ref: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
text: Nibu, ni ye Uwonbɔr a bɔŋann nin pag ki woon ke, ni pag woon ban bor Uwonbɔr a samin nin le.

ref: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
text: Dulinya nan a weem jɔɔn ban kaa ye biwonjiɛm a potiɛriya, ni bu baa ga Masiya a bɔŋann nin a wonweemi, u ma ye Uwonbɔr a nunaŋ.

ref: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
text: Naa ye ti mɔɔn ti baantɔɔl a bɔr le, amaa ti mɔɔn Yisa Masiya a bɔr le, ke u ma ye ti Yudaau, le tim ye ni toontum, Yisa bu.

ref: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
text: Uwonbɔr kaah nan len ke, “Che nwonween nwonn libunbɔnlin.” U ma che u wonweem ween ti sufu ni, ke un sei ti nbiɛm a weem man li sei Uwonbɔr kupag Masiya a num paam.

ref: We are like clay jars in which this treasure is stored. The real power comes from God and not from us.
text: Amaa ti jɔɔ njɔɔm man be tiyɔgir a binboli yin, le ni wɔɔn ke npɔɔn man jon niwann biɛn nyan Uwonbɔr ban le, amaa naa ye tim ban ni.

ref: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
text: Ti kan nton a booli biɛn, amaa naa nyaŋ ti. Ti kan limugil takpem amaa tigbanann kaa gbɔɔ.

ref: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
text: Bi mugir ti takpem, amaa Uwonbɔr kaa jiɛn ti. Bi fa ti jaa tum, amaa kaa ku ti.

ref: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
text: Tim ban fo nan, ti be nkum a nɔɔn le Yisa bu, naah li ŋa man wee u miɛfol n kpiir ti gbanann nin.

ref: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
text: Ni bu nkum be mi toon ni le ti ni, amaa le limiɛfol mu be mi toon yin ni bu.

ref: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
text: Ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke, “N ŋa yadau; ni ma bu le n pag.” Kinaaŋ kiba nmɔn le ti mu ŋa yada le ki pag,

ref: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
text: nan bu-n ti nyi wan nan fiin Yisa nkumin, u ma na yin fiin tim ke waah nan fiin Yisa man ni, ki ta tim nin nim ki jo u baan tɔɔl ban.

ref: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
text: Ni niɛ nan biɛn ye tinyɔɔr le ki sei ni, wee Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl n foo bininfob takpem, wee bin sei Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpoog takpem nin kupag. Yada a binbem

ref: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.
text: Mambu che naa gbɔɔ ti gbanann ni. Hali ti gbanann kaah le bagirin gbaa, amaa ti naaŋin ma mann pɔŋir le iween biɛn.

ref: These little troubles are getting us ready for an eternal glory that will make all our troubles seem like nothing.
text: Nan bu-n fala kan kaa kpiɛg wee ti jin ki wama nan, ni ma yin che ti kan kupag kan yab ki jon ni biɛn nan.

ref: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
text: Naa ye ti num paa nan be npaan ni nin bu le, amaa ti num paa nan woo-n bu le. Nan be npaan ni nin kaa yin yuuri, amaa nan woo-n le yin yuur.

ref: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
text: Ti nyi ke dulinya nan a gbanann tan nann kunanboŋ wee ti be nan ber ke, ti jɔɔ iniin yan wee Uwonbɔr maa, iniin yan kaa jɔɔ nlumi ki be Uwonbɔr a niin, iniin yan wee uninfosaal kaa maa yi.

ref: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.
text: Ni bu ti nin jegil le ki guu lidaal lan wee Uwonbɔr naah li ta ti ki kɔɔn iniin nmɔn yaan.

ref: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
text: Nan bu-n ti nan kɔɔ iniin nmɔn yaan ke, taa na yin gaan ni.

ref: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
text: Amaa taah be tigbanann tan nann kunanboŋin nin, ti dun le ki fabin. Naa ye ke taa ji ban tigbanann nin a binbem le, amaa ti ban Uwonbɔr a niin le, wee lidaal nan foo ke limiɛfol n nan niɛ tigbanann tan kpegin wee nin diɛ.

ref: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.
text: Uwonbɔr le ŋa ti sili ki guun nan be nan paam, ki ta u Naaŋ ki sei ti le ni ye siɛra ke u li sei ti nan biɛn wee U siin limɔsiinlin.

ref: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
text: Ni ma bu, ti jɔɔ tidindann le iyoo biɛn ki nyi ke taah be tigbanann a niin yin ni, taa be Uyudaan ban ni.

ref: But we live by faith, not by what we see.
text: Yada bu le ti be, taa be ti num kaah ga nan nin bu.

ref: We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord.
text: N len na, ti jɔɔ tidindann, n bi li ban ke na ti pii bi nyan tigbanann a niin nan yaan na ki kun Uyudaan ban na.

ref: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
text: Nibu, ti num man le nin ti penn u sufu, taah be tigbanann a niin nan yaan, bee taah kaa be ti yaan ni.

ref: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
text: Mambu, ti nyi naah ye ti li san Uwonbɔr man, nibu le ti pɔɔgir bininfob a gbanann baah li ta biba ki jirin u ban man. Uwonbɔr nyi ti binbem kaah be man, le n jɔɔ tama ke ni mu nyi n sufu ni naah ye man.

ref: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
text: Naa ye ti pagir tiba le ni ban jigin ni, amaa ti tenn ni nsan le, wee ni fir faa igbingban ti bu, naah li ŋa man wee ni fir kan njiim ki sei ban far igbingban baah ga nan nbu ki jon nan be sufu nin bu.

ref: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
text: Ni ye ti yelig le ke, Uwonbɔr bu le ti ye man; ti mu kaa ji yelig ke, nim bu le ti ye man.

ref: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
text: Masiya a bamin le ŋmag ti, taah biɛ ke uninfo uba le kpo ki sei bininfob biɛn ni, ni bu bininfob biɛn kpeg le.

ref: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
text: Bininfob biɛn bu le u nan kpo, ke ban fo-n la ji be bi ba bu, amaa ki li be ke wan nan gaa bininfob biɛn a kum ki kpo ki ji fiin nkumin ni.

ref: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.
text: Daandaan nan ki jɔɔ chaa, taa ji lig uba ke dulinya nan a ninfob kaah lig u man nni. Hali taah nan lig Yisa man ni, taa ji lig u man ni.

ref: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
text: Ni bu uninfo wan be Masiya ban ke, udaan nin ye uninfopɔɔn le, u binben kpegim nbiɛn jon na, le nbinben pɔɔn dan!

ref: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
text: Ni niɛ biɛn nyan Uwonbɔr ban le, u ma che ti jir mɔŋ nin U Masiya bu, le ki sei ti jir mɔŋ a toon.

ref: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
text: Ke Masiya bu le Uwonbɔr jir ki mɔŋir nin dulinya a ninfob, kaa ji kaan bininfob a bir tan wee bi tun ni. Le ki ta jir mɔŋ a bɔr ki sei ti.

ref: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
text: Mambu ti ye ban si Masiya a taalin le, le Uwonbɔr be nin ti ki che ti yi bininfob. Yisa bu le ti balin ni: Ni jir ki mɔŋ nin Uwonbɔr a.

ref: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
text: Tim bu le Uwonbɔr nan che wan kaa jɔɔ tibir labir tibirdaan, u ma bu le ti na yin ŋa Uwonbɔr a buchim.

ref: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
text: Tim ban ye Uwonbɔr a toontunn tab, ti balin ni le, ni laa che u nyunyunbasanlin n gab yɔli.

ref: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
text: U len ke, “Iyoo kaah nan nan foo nin n gbir ni miɛmin, n nan pel ni miɛma, Iyoo kaah nan nan foo nin bininfob n kan feegabin, n nan ter na.” N bei ni le, daandaan nan le ye Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl, daandaan nan le ye feegab a daal.

ref: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
text: Taa ta litangbagil gbiɛrikaal ki bil uba a samin ni, mambu uba kaa li fir kan ti galin ti toon yin ni.

ref: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
text: Ti ga fala nin limugil nin tibɔr, amaa le ki jɔɔ limɔril takpenl ki ta tiba ki sei itoon nin nin ni wan biɛn ni, taah ye Uwonbɔr a toontumin nbu,

ref: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
text: le bi boo ti, ki kɔɔn ti tiloondirin, ki gaan tijar ti bu, le ti le tun itoon nmɔn nin inunman nin nkom kaa jiɛn nyiɛgi;

ref: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
text: ti ye bipopendam le, ki jɔɔ nnyinyin, limɔril nin nbinben ŋan ki gbee nin Kasi a Naaŋ nin njiɛm,

ref: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
text: Ibamɔn a pipagir nin Uwonbɔr a pɔɔmin; nin tibuchinn a kunkɔntiɛr tan be ti nɔɔjiim nin ti nɔɔgam paamin;

ref: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
text: biba tenn ti jilima le biba mu kaa tenn ti jilima, biba pag ki mann ti le biba mu pag ki bii ti; ti ye bibamɔn pagib le amaa le bi yin ti tibɔkardam;

ref: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
text: bi nyi ti, amaa le ti be ke baa nyi ti le-n; ti kpeg le amaa le ki sin fo, bi boo ti le amaa le kaa ku ti;

ref: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
text: ti jɔɔ npoobiin, amaa le iyoo biɛn ke ni mɔ ti, ti ye faladam le, amaa le ti che bininfob takpem kpann bijɔɔndam; taa jɔɔ niba, amaa le ki sin jɔɔ niwann biɛn.

ref: Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you.
text: Ti pii pag ti poolin a bɔr biɛn ki bei nim Korenti yaaba, ki loor ti sufu ki sei na.

ref: We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us.
text: Taa ŋmiɛ ni ti bami, amaa nim le ŋmiɛ ti ni bam.

ref: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
text: Ni ŋaam ke taah ŋaan man ki tenn nin, n pag tenn ni ke n baantɔɔl a buwaab le-n, ni mu nloor ni sufuu man. Ni li nyi ban kaa ye biwonjiɛmin a larug bu

ref: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
text: Ni laa por kudaag kuba a kpikpiɛl nin ban kaa ye biwonjiɛmin ke inaaja ilee kaah por man nni. Nmɔkpaa mi la be bibuchim nin bipootondam a sisiigin naa? Bee nween nin libunbɔnl jɔɔ ba a nɔɔ nin tab baa?

ref: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
text: Yisa nin Sintani li fir lagin tab baa? Uwonjiɛn nin wan kaa ye uwonjiɛn li fir jɔɔ nmɔkpaa?

ref: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
text: Kuwonjiɛndiig nin kutingbandiig jɔɔ baa a mɔcheel nin tab baa? Tim le ye Uwonbɔr wan fo-n a diig. A li ke Uwonbɔr kaah len ke, “N li be nin bi, ki li choon nin bi, Ki li ye bi Wonbɔru, wee bi mu ye n ninfob.”

ref: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
