text: “Man bu ni nya bi ban na, ki li jɔɔ nbɔgirim, Uyudaan le len man. Ni laa maa niwann nan ye tijaginn ni, wee N gaa ni.”

ref: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
text: “Wee N li ye ni Baa, le ni mu li ye N naachim nin N bisiɛm, Uyudaan wan jɔɔ npɔɔn le len man.”

ref: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
text: A li ke taah jɔɔ limɔsiinl man ni, n jɔtiib, ni che ti ŋa tiba kasi ki nya nan ye tijaginn ni ki sei tigbanann nin kinaaŋ nna, wee ki li be nbamɔm ki li jɔɔ kasi a binbem nin jilima ki tenn Uwonbɔr. Pɔɔl a popeem

ref: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
text: Ni loor ni sufu ki sei ta man. Taa tun ki bii uba, taa ta kuŋmaruŋ dan uba a binbemin ni, kaa jin uba dulimi.

ref: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
text: Maa pag ni niɛ ke n bii ni le; n pii bei ni ke ni be ti sufu ni, tim nin ye nba le ti miɛfolin bee nkumin.

ref: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
text: N jɔɔ tidindann takpem ni bu; nin ligbingbanfaal ni bu, n jɔɔ ngbanann pɔɔn takpem, nin ti yaa bɔmugkaarin biɛn n gbee nin nmɔn le.

ref: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
text: Taah nan foo Masedoniya a tiŋin ni, tigbanann kaa nan kan lifoorili, ti nan kan limugil ilog biɛn ni, ikɔn nan be itingbaa-n, le bijawaam mu nan be ti sufu ni,

ref: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
text: amaa Uwonbɔr wan sɔŋir bipoobiindam a sufu-n nan sɔŋ ti sufu Tatusi a damin na,

ref: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
text: Naa ye u dam n-yaa binba le nan sɔŋ ti sufu, amaa lisufusɔŋil lan wee ni nan ta sei u nbu. U nan bei ti naah ban ni kam man na, ni poobiim nin ni baga kaah be n ni man, naah li ŋa man wee nin mɔŋim ki jo naah nan mɔm man ni.

ref: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
text: Hali ni ye n gbɔŋ nmɔn nan bii ni sufu ke, naa mug mi, ni nan mugim mau, n kan ke n gbɔŋ nmɔn nan dam na, amaa naa nan yuuri.

ref: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
text: Amaa daandaan nan n jɔɔ npopeen, naa ye ni sufu kaah nan bii n bu, amaa ni sufubiil nmɔn kaah che ni binbem kpenn nbu. Ni nan ye Uwonbɔr a bamin le ni sufu bii amaa naa nan sei ni kidaŋ ti bu.

ref: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
text: Biwonjiɛm a poobiim che bi ga nkpenim man tenn bi nŋmarim le mambu npoobiim nmɔn a bosu kaa mugir bi, amaa dulinya nan ma a poobiim jɔɔ nkum le chaan.

ref: Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter.
text: Ni lig biwonjiɛm a poobiim nan kaah tun nan ni ni: Ni che ni jɔɔ inunman, ki kɔn ni bamɔn bu, le ni ŋuui fii, ki san bijawaam, ki ban ni kam le ki ta ni ba sei, nin naah ŋa sili ki ban ibamɔn ngann man, naah tun man nmɔn, ni sin wɔɔn ke naa jɔɔ niba a galin tibɔr nmɔn yaan ni.

ref: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
text: Maah nan sɔb kugbɔŋ nmɔn ki sei ni, naa nan ye uninfo kaah tun tibir bu le n nan sɔb ki, bee naa ye uninfo wan wee u galin u nbu le n sɔb ki. Amaa n nan ban ni tɔɔl nbiɛ ni baga kaah be ti paam man Uwonbɔr a nintogil, ni man nan che n sɔb ki.

ref: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
text: Ni niɛ nan biɛn bu ti jɔɔ ngbanann pɔɔn. Nan ji kpiɛ ti tɔɔl a gbanann pɔɔm nmɔn bu ye nan le, ti pooi nan pen taah nan kan Tatusi wee u jɔɔ nposɔɔn nin bu.

ref: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
text: N faa ligbingbanl Tatusi ban ni bu-u, le naa jim ifa. Amaa taah nan bei ni nan biɛn wee ni ye ibamɔn nin, ni ma che taah faa ligbingbanl Tatusi ban nibu n mu ŋa ibamɔn na.

ref: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
text: Waah ban ni man u sufu nni, mann kpiɛg le, ni ye u nan tiɛr ni biɛn kaah jɔɔ limɔcheel ki tenn u man ke, nin naah nan gaa u ki san u bijawaam ki jegil man.

ref: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
text: Ni ŋaam nmɔn na, nibu n li fir jɔɔ tidindann takpem nin ni.

ref: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
text: Daandaan nan ti nabum, ti ban ni biɛ Uwonbɔr kaah san Masedoniya a wonjiɛm a laginn kunyunyunbaag man le.

ref: Although they were going through hard times and were very poor, they were glad to give generously.
text: Nin bi fala nin bi bigim takpem a poolin, ni biɛn yɔli, ni nan mɔŋ bi le takpem le bi nan pu Uwonbɔr ipiin nin npopeen.

ref: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
text: Nan bu-n n ji bi siɛra ke bi sei baah jɔɔ nan le, ke nin jon bi pɔɔm a tarig. Bi tɔɔl a bam bu,

ref: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
text: bi nan balin ti ke ti sei bi nsan wee bin ta bi nɔɔi ki kɔɔn biwonjiɛm a teril nmɔn yaan weem.

ref: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
text: Bi nan ŋa ki jon taah bi tiɛr ke bi li fir ŋa man na, amaa bi nan chinn ta biba le ki sei uyudaan; le ki nin ta biba ki sei ti le ti ŋmag Uwonbɔr a bam.

ref: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
text: Mambu le ti nan kpaan Tatusi ke taa pii nan piin ki tun man ni, u li tun man na ki diɛ linyunyunbasanl a toonl nan ni tɔɔl ban na.

ref: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
text: Amaa naah jɔɔ nan yaba: Ni yada, nin ni pipagir, nin ni nyinyim, nin linunmanl nin njiɛm wee ni jɔɔ nin ti, ni mu che ni nyunyunbasanl a piini li yaba.

ref: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
text: Maa siin nsiim le ki sei ni, amaa n wɔɔn ni kpiɛtiib kaah tun nin linunmanl man le. Ke n mag ni jiɛm kaah ye man.

ref: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
text: Ni nyi ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl kaah ye man. U nan ye uwandaan le, amaa nim bu le u kpann faladaan, naah li ŋa man wee u fala nmɔn n che ni kpann biwandam.

ref: A year ago you were the first ones to give, and you gave because you wanted to. So listen to my advice.
text: N kpaani sɔ, nan li ŋan ki sei ni tibɔr nan yaan: Jirib n-yaan nim le nan chinn ki sei ni piini kaah ye nan, naa ye naah li pu n-yaa binba amaa ni wɔɔn naah jɔɔ kɔlisa nin ni tun man le.

ref: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
text: Daandaan nan ni gbaar itoon nmɔn na, wee naah jɔɔ kɔlisa ki jiɛ itoon yan nin nfir nɔɔ tab, naah li fir ki ŋa man.

ref: It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
text: Ni ye a sei Uwonbɔr nin nbam ke, Uwonbɔr li gaa ipiin nmɔn ŋaah jɔɔ nan, kaa ye ŋaah kaa jɔɔ nan ni.

ref: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair
text: Ti boni kaa ye ti tun ni itugi wee ni kpiɛtiib ma li foori, amaa ni biɛn a tugi li kpaa dede.

ref: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
text: Naah jɔɔ wee ni yab daandaan nan ni, ni ŋan nin ni ter ban kaa jɔɔ nna, wee ni ye ke ni mu kaa nan jɔɔ ke, bi mu li ter ni, ni niɛ le li che ni biɛn li kpaa nin tab,

ref: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
text: a li ke naah sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke, “Wan nan chiɛ takpemin, waa nan jɔɔ ki tan lagiri, le wan nan chiɛ wama-n, naa nan waari.” Tatusi nin u ninɔɔtab a bɔr

ref: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
text: Uwonbɔr n gaa kunɔɔpoog nin waah che Tatusi a baga be ni ban, ke n baga kaah be ni ban man ni.

ref: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
text: Nan bu-n taah balin u ke un jo ni ban ni, u cheeu, le u baantɔɔl a num man nin un dan ni ban, nin u bam.

ref: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
text: Ti li che ti na big kiba nnɔɔ u ki dan ni ban. Ti na a big nmɔn kaah mɔɔn Uwonbɔr a bɔŋann nin man ni bu che biwonjiɛm a laginn biɛn pagir u le.

ref: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
text: Nan kpiɛ, biwonjiɛm a laginn nin le ji gann u ke u li nɔɔ ta wee ti tu ipiin yan wee bi nan ŋaan wee yin don uyudaan baantɔɔl a yinl, ki ji wɔɔn taah jɔɔ linunmanl nin ti ter man.

ref: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.
text: Ti ban taah li ŋa man le wee bininfob nlaa bii ti yinl ki ke ti ban niba ipiin nmɔn yaan ni.

ref: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
text: Ti boni kaa ye ti tun nan ŋan Uwonbɔr a numbimin a binba le, amaa ti ban ti tun nan ŋan le bininfobin tɔɔl a numin.

ref: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
text: Nan kpiɛ, ti yin che ti na a big kiba le nnɔɔ bi ki dan, wan wɔɔn ti waah jɔɔ kɔlisa man nin niwann biɛn ni nin iyoo biɛn, waah jɔɔ tidindann takpem ni bu nbu.

ref: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
text: Tatusi ma bu ke, u ye n toontunkpiɛg le ni sisiigin; amaa ti na bum n ma si biwonjiɛm a laginn a taai-n le, ki ye jilima sei Masiya.

ref: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
text: Mambu ni wɔɔn bijab nan na ban bi man, nin nan bu wee ti jɔɔ kalanbaani ni bu, wee biwonjiɛm a laginn nin kan.

ref: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.
text: Naa kpaa talar nin n sɔb kugbɔŋ ki bei ni naah li tun ki tenn biwonjiɛm man ni.

ref: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
text: N nyi naah ban ni ter bi. N gbaa far ligbingbanl le ni bu Masedoniya yaab ban, ki bei bi ke nim ban be Akaya a timin ni, jirib n-yaan ni nan ŋa sili le nin ni ter, ni yaa nunmanl bu che Masedoniya yaab mu ban bin ter le.

ref: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
text: Amaa n tun ti nabum nan le ke taah nan far ligbingbanl nan bu-n kaa ye yɔli, amaa ni ŋan ni ŋa sili ke maah pii bei bi man ni.

ref: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
text: Ni ye Masedoniya a tiŋ a ninfob nan nɔɔm foon ni ban ki miin naa la ŋa sili ke, ifa li jim, le naa ye n yaa binba le ifa nmɔn yin ji amaa ti biɛn a fai, nan bu-n ti nan fa ligbingbanl nibu bi ban na.

ref: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
text: Mambu le n tiɛr ke ni ŋan nin n balin ti nabumin, wee bi chinn gɔnn ni wee ki mann tibuchinn a piini yan wee ni nan siin limɔsiinlin ki diɛ. Le i ŋa sili ke ibuchin piin ni, ni ma wɔɔn ke ni ŋa ni tɔɔl a bamin le naa ye uba le mug ni.

ref: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
text: Ni li tiɛr ni niɛ, wan bun idi wama ke u na yin chiɛ wama le, le wan mu bun idi nin tibuchinn ke u mu na yin chiɛ takpem le.

ref: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
text: Uninfo biɛn n pu u piini waah tiɛr man u sufu ni, ki laa pu nin npoobiin ni, bee uba n mug wi, nan bu-n Uwonbɔr ban wan pu ipiin nin npopeen le.

ref: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
text: Le Uwonbɔr le che U nyunyunbasanl takpem li be ni bu, wee niwann biɛn nin iyoo biɛn ke, ni li jɔɔ naah ban nan biɛn, wee ni che ke ni fir tun itoon biɛn.

ref: The Scriptures say, “God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.”
text: Ke naah sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke, “U ta U piin ki yaal sei faladam U buchin kaa jɔɔ diɛmi.”

ref: God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need.
text: Uwonbɔr wan tenn bininfob idibool wee bi bu-n, ki ji tenn bi tijiir wee bi ji-n, U ma le li sei ni idibool ki che yin nɔb, man le U li che ni chiɛ ibuchin di takpem.

ref: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
text: Ni li ŋa biwandam niwann biɛn ni, wee ki li pu kulaguŋin iyoo biɛn, tim bu ni piini nmɔn li kpann kupag ki tenn Uwonbɔr.

ref: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
text: Litoonl lan wee ni tun nan kaa pa ye nan tenn biwonjiɛm baah ban nan le, amaa nitɔɔl che Uwonbɔr ga npagim le takpem.

ref: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
text: Naah ter bi nbu, ni ma wɔɔn naah ye ban, bininfob li pag Uwonbɔr nin limɔcheel lan wee ni jɔɔ ki kpenn ni binbem ki sei Masiya u bɔŋann nbu-n, nin naah por ipiin ni ki sei bi nin bininfob biɛn man.

ref: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
text: Baah miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn nin, bi sufu le kun ni, Uwonbɔr kaah ta nyunyunbasanl lan kaa jɔɔ tarig ki sei ni nbu.

ref: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
text: Ni che ti sei Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpoog, nin waah sei ti ipiin yan kaa jɔɔ nmagimi.

ref: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.
text: Min Pɔɔl wan jɔɔ jiininba nin nbinben ŋan Masiya ban ni, le tenn ni bimɔb nan, min wan wee ni ke n be ni ban ke n san bijawaamin amaa wee n nyan ngbaan ke n jɔɔ lipoobilin!

ref: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.
text: N balin ni le ke n nan dan ni ban n-yonn man ke n laa jɔɔ lipoobil a li ke maah tug man ki jiin ban tug ke ti be dulinya nan a binbem le nni.

ref: We live in this world, but we don't act like its people
text: Ni ye ibamɔn le ke ti be dulinya-n le, amaa taa kɔn dulinya nan a kɔnli.

ref: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments
text: Tikunkɔntiɛr tan wee ti jɔɔ kɔn likɔnl nmɔn ni, kaa ye dulinya nan a kunkɔntiɛri. Amaa ti ye tan jɔɔ Uwonbɔr a pɔɔm man li fir bii Sintani a pɔɔm le.

ref: and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ.
text: Ti pag bii limɔkpel nin kalanbaanidam ban ke bi jɔɔ nlam ki jon Uwonbɔrin. Ti nyaŋir ipotiɛ biɛn, ki che ni cheel Masiya a mɔb.

ref: And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.
text: Ni ye ni jɔɔ limɔcheel ke, ni bɔɔn bu ti mu li ŋa sili ki dar tukangbirdam biɛn a tuli.

ref: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
text: Nim lig nan wee uninfo fir ga nin u numbim a binba nle. Ni ye uba jɔɔ tidindann ke u ye Masiya yaau ke, u li nyi ke ti mu ye Masiya yaab le, ke waah ye man ni.

ref: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
text: Hali ifa kaa li jɔɔ mi, ni ye n fa ligbingbanl npɔɔn man wee ti Yudaau sei ti ke ti ter ni nbu ke, amaa wee kaa tir ni jaa tum ke, ifa kaa li jɔɔm mambu.

ref: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.
text: Maa ban n li sɔb n gbann nan ki yugin ni lami.

ref: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
text: Bininfob biba ke, “Pɔɔl a gbann ni nann le ke upɔɔndaan uba-n, amaa le u nan foon ti ban n-yonn man ke, u ye ulanjiin le, le u mɔboi kaa ji jɔɔ npɔɔn ni.”

ref: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
text: Ni ŋan bininfob nmɔn nbiɛ ke taah kaa be ni ban wee ki sɔb tigbann nin ke ti tun man ni, ti nan foon n-yonn man ke, man le ti yin tun.

ref: We won't dare compare ourselves with those who think so much of themselves. But they are foolish to compare themselves with themselves.
text: Taa ban ti ta tiba ki bigin nin ban donn biba. Ni ye bi bigin biba ki jɔɔ biba ki wɔɔn tab ke, baa jɔɔ nlami.

ref: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
text: Amaa tim ma, taa li don tiba ki jo ti toon kaah ye man ni, amaa ti le yin che ti gbingbanfaal be Uwonbɔr kaah sei ti itoon yan ni yaan le, itoon yan for ni ban ni.

ref: We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
text: Taa far ligbingbanl ki lagiri, a li ke taa bi dan ni ban le ke, ti bi li fa lagir, nan bu-n ti nan ta Masiya a bɔŋanni ki wɔɔn na.

ref: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
text: Taa far ligbingbanl ki lagir bininfob biba a toon bu. Ti jɔɔ tama ke, ni yada kaah yabirig chaa-n, ti toon kaah ye nan ni sisiigin li yabig takpem,

ref: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
text: wee ti li fir jo ntim man fɔg ki jon ni yaa tiŋin, ki mɔɔn tibɔŋann nmɔn. Taa ban ti fa ligbingbanl uba kaah tun nan u yerin nin ni.

ref: The Scriptures say, “If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.”
text: Amaa “Wan far ligbingbanl ke, un faam u gbingbanl Uyudaan bu.”

ref: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
text: Naa ye uninfo wan pagir uba le bi num gbee, amaa see wan wee Uyudaan a num gbeen.

ref: Please put up with a little of my foolishness.
text: N tiɛr ke ni li jɔɔ limɔril n jɔr leen nan bu; amaa ni pii ŋaan man le.

ref: I am as concerned about you as God is. You were like a virgin bride I had chosen only for Christ.
text: N jɔɔ lipiiponl nim bu, lipiiponl lan nyan Uwonbɔr ban. N ta ni ki sei chal uba le kpeŋileŋ, u ma ye Masiya, naah li ŋa man wee n ta ni ki sei u wee ni li ye kasi a piikalin.

ref: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
text: Amaa nlam yugir nim bu, nan bu-n n nyi bininfob kaah li dan ki nan lar ni ki ŋmarin ni potiɛri, ki ke ni laa ji nɔɔ Yisa nbamɔmi, a li ke uwaa kaah nan lar Iif man nin.

ref: We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message.
text: Ni ye uba dan ni ban ki nan bei ni Yisa uba a bɔr wee naa ye Yisa wan a bɔr wee ti nan pagin ke, bee kinaaŋ kan kaa ye Kasi a Naaŋ nke, bee tibɔr tan kaa ye Yisa a bɔŋanni ke, ti ma le ni gaan nbamɔm weem.

ref: I think I am as good as any of those super apostles.
text: Amaa maa tiɛr ke ban ke bi ye itoon ki ye bipɔɔndamin a ni uba jomi.

ref: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
text: Nba ke maa ye wan kan ntinnim wee ki li pag tibɔri, amaa n jɔɔ nbiɛm. Ti che ni niɛ le won ni num kasi niwann biɛn ni.

ref: Was it wrong for me to lower myself and honor you by preaching God's message free of charge?
text: Ni nan ye tibir lee nin maah nan jiin nba tum ke ni kan ndom ki mɔɔn Uwonbɔr a bɔŋann nin yɔli ki tenn ni nnaa?

ref: I robbed other churches by taking money from them to serve you.
text: Ni nann ke n nan su biwonjiɛm a laginn biba le ki gaan literil bi ban ke n ter ni.

ref: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
text: Maah nan be ni ban n-yonn man wee kaa jɔɔ niba-n, amaa maa nan mugir ni ke ni seim niba, ti nabum ban nyan Masedoniya nan seim maah ban nan na. N ŋmag nba le kaa ban n li mugir uba, n le ji yin ŋa man le.

ref: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
text: Ni ye ibamɔn le ke Masiya a bɔŋann nin a bamɔn kaah be n ban ni bu, uba kaa be Akaya a tingbɔŋ nan yaan ki che n ta n gbingbanfaalin ki jiɛn ni!

ref: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
text: Ke babuu? Ni niɛ wɔɔn ke maa ban ni lee? Uwonbɔr ma nyi maah ban ni.

ref: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
text: N le yin tun le ke maah tun man ni, ni ma li che ban ban bin ta biba kpaag nin ti-n nlaa kan nsan nin tiwann tan wee bi far ligbingbanl n bu.

ref: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
text: Bi yaa ninfobol ye tibɔkar a tooi le, ki lar ke bi ye bitoontum le, ki ta biba kpann Masiya a tooi.

ref: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
text: Naa ye ligarili. Man le Sintani baantɔɔl nan ta uba kpann nween a malaka.

ref: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
text: Naa ye ligaril li, ni ye Sintani a toontum ta biba kpann bitoontun buchim ke. Bi joorimin le bi na li kan bi toon nmɔn kaah kpaan bi man. Pɔɔl kaah jin fala waah ye ntoon bu man

ref: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
text: Jigin n li pag ke: Uba nlaa yim kujɔrugi. Amaa ni ye ni yim kujɔrug ke, ni gaam naah bi li gaa kujɔrug man ni, wee n fir fa ligbingbanl wama.

ref: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
text: Maah far ligbingbanl nan bu-n maa pag ke Uyudaan ni, amaa n pag le ke kujɔrugin.

ref: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
text: Bininfob takpem kaah far igbingban ke dulinya yaab kaah ŋaan man ni, n mu li fa n gbingbanl.

ref: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
text: Ni nunween takpen nan bu le che ni mɔ ni, le ni jɔɔ limɔril nin tijɔri!

ref: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
text: Ni jɔɔ limɔril nin uba kaah ta ni ki ŋa u yomi, bee ki pen ni bee ki ŋalig ni, bee ki yin ni yɔli, bee ki pebir ni ntapam!

ref: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
text: Ni ye ifa le ki seim nin ti daburigi kaah kaa nan che ti tun man ni! Uninfo uba kaah jɔɔ lipoobil ki li fir fa ligbingbanlin, min pag le ke kujɔrugin-woo, le ki mu jɔɔ lipoobil ki li fir fa ligbingbanl.

ref: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.
text: Bi ye Hiiburu yaab lee? N mu ye Hiiburu a ninfou le. Bi ye Iziral yaab lee? N mu ye Iziral a ninfou le. Bi ye Abiraham a yaabili lee? N mu ye Abiraham a yaabil le.

ref: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
text: Bi ye Masiya a toontum lee? Min jon ba, ki kɔɔ tiloondirin ke naa jɔɔ tarigi, le bi boom inaanbaan te-n, le n kan kininbɔŋ kan mal nkum jigin.

ref: Five times my own people gave me
text: Itaa iŋmu le Juu yaab boom inaanbaan pitaa nin iwiɛ.

ref: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
text: Rom yaab nan boom ilanbɔn nfim mitaa. Bininfob nan gabirim itangbag isaŋ iba ki nyi ke n kpou. Tiŋalin nan labirim ki chigin nnyumin nfim mitaa, le n be limɔgilin liwonmunl nin kunyiɛmuŋ.

ref: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
text: N sanchonl a poolin, n nan ti ga kininbɔŋ ikpen ni, ki ji ga kininbɔŋ bininfob ban feen ban, nin n tɔɔl a tiŋ a ninfob ban, nin ban kaa ye Juu yaab ban, ki ji ga kininbɔŋ ntintakpemin, nin itindoo-n nin imɔgin nin n nabum ban choon ki larin ban.

ref: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
text: N tun itoon nin linunmanla, ki be kaa dɔ jiɛn ni; nkom nin nnyunyum nan ti chorim le, amaa le maa ji; le tiwar choom le n wan yee waŋ kaa foomi.

ref: Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches.
text: Naa ye nima a binba le n nan kan ni, biwonjiɛmin a laginn biɛn a mugil bu le che n baga be bi bu.

ref: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
text: Ŋma gbarig, wee min kaa gbarigaa? Ŋma wee bi che u kɔɔ tibirin, wee n sufu kaa gaan nŋmi?

ref: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
text: Ni ye n yin fa ligbingbanl ke, n li fa ligbingbanl wɔɔn n daburigi nbu le.

ref: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
text: Ti Yudaau Yisa a Baa Uwonbɔr wan ŋan nin npagim iyoo biɛn ni, U ma nyi maah kaa por tibɔkari.

ref: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
text: Maah nan be Damasiko a tiŋin n-yonn man ni, ubɔr Aritasi a bɔrbig nan ban un choom le ki nan che bitɔtogib si kitiŋ nmɔn a timansanmɔnn ki guu ke bin choom.

ref: But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.
text: Amaa le bi nan taam ki kpeen kukachiɛgin, ki nan taam lann kitiŋ nmɔn a gonl a bolin, le n nan nyan uja nmɔn a nɔɔn.

ref: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
text: Ni le ye n li far ligbingbanl le. Hali nin naah kaa jɔɔ tinyɔɔr nan biɛn ni, n li wɔɔn ni zii nin tibɔkpiirikaar tan nyan Uyudaan ban.

ref: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
text: Daandaan nan n ŋa sili le ke n dan nan gɔnn ni wee nin kpiɛ nfimitaa. Maa nan yin ye litugil le ki sei ni, nan bu-n naa ye naah jɔɔ nan nle n ban ni, amaa nim le n ban. Nan bu-n naa ye nbuwaab le ban tiwann ki siig ban ye bi, amaa ban ye bi le ban tiwann ki siig nbuwaab.

ref: As I said, only God really knows if this man was in his body at the time.
text: Le n nyi uja nan naah ye tigbanann bee naah kaa ye tigbanann ni maa nyi, amaa Uwonbɔr ma nyi,

ref: But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell.
text: le u don paab, nin yaan nmɔn le u nan gbir imɔbon yan wee uninfosaal kaa jɔɔ npɔɔn nin un pagi.

ref: I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.
text: N li fa ligbingbanl uja nan a bosu bu, amaa maa li fa ligbingbanl n baantɔɔl bu, see n daburigi a binba bu.

ref: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
text: Hali ni ye n gann ki ke n fa ligbingbanl ke, maa li ŋa kujɔrugi, nan bu-n n yin pag ibamɔn le. Amaa maa yin fa ligbingbanli, wee nin che uba npagim ki jo npagim man kpaan nim mi ki jiin maah tun man bee maah pag nan ni.

ref: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
text: Nan bu wee maa far ligbingbanl ki tan lagirin ye maah nan kan kpiir wɔɔn takpem nbu, le nkunkon man ye Sintani a toom min chɔgim ki paar be n gbanann ni ke nin mugirim wee n laa donn n baa ki tan lagiri.

ref: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
text: N balin Uyudaan nfim mitaa ke un nyan nkunkon nmɔn n ban na.

ref: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
text: Amaa le u beim ke, “Maah saŋ kunyunyunbaag man ni kpaan nin ŋa, N pɔɔm jɔɔ yaag idaburigin le.” Ni bu n li fa ligbingbanl takpem n daburigi yin bu, wee Masiya a pɔɔm li be n ban.

ref: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
text: Mambu, Masiya le che n num gbee, n daburigin, n sugirin, limugilin, fala a poolin, ki ga tibɔmugkaar. Ni ye idaburig choom ke, iyaayoo le n jɔɔ npɔɔn. Pɔɔl a baga kaah be Korenti yaabin man

ref: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
text: N ŋa nba le kujɔrug, amaa nim le che n ŋa man. Nim le bi li pagim, nan bu-n hali maa le ye niba ke, amaa ban lar ke bi ye “itoon pɔɔndamin,” kaa jomi.

ref: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
text: Nan wɔɔn ntoon kaah ye wan ye siɛra nin limagil nin ligaril a toonl le. N nan tun ni niɛ biɛn ni ban nin limɔril le takpem.

ref: You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
text: Ba a bɔgirim be nim nin ni wonjiɛn tab bimiɛnin a sisiigin naa? Maah kaa nan ye litugil ki sei ni nbuu? Ni jiɛn per ma.

ref: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
text: Ni li mɔŋim pam, ni ye n ta n faal biɛn nin npɔɔm ki ter ni ke. Ni ye n ban ni takpem ke, nim ma yin bam wama lee?

ref: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
text: Ni che ni li ye man na, maa ye litugil ki sei ni. Nin ni ma biɛn ni, ni ke n ye kibibirig le ki pen choo ni!

ref: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
text: Maah tun bininfob ban ni ban nin, bi ni uba jin ni dulim min buu?

ref: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
text: N nan balin Tatusi ke un dan ni ban, ki ji nan che ti na a big kiba mu chiɛn u. Tatusi nan nyi ki jin ni dulim waa? Min nin u ma kaa piɛ kinaaŋ le nin nsan n baa?

ref: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
text: Ni tiɛr ke ti degin tiba le ni ban naa? Ti be Uwonbɔr a nintogil le ki pag ke ban be Masiya-n ni; n jɔtiib, nan biɛn wee ti tun ni, ni ye nan li sei ni ngbananpɔɔn le.

ref: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
text: N lam yugir nin n dan wee kaa na yin kan ni maah ban ni li be man nni, wee ni mu kaa yin kam naah ban n li be man ni. N san bijawaam le nba ke limɔkpel na li be, bee lipiiponl, bee lijagaal, bee nbɔgirim bee kutingbiig, bee libɔɔnsul bee kalanbaani chɔgiŋ, nin kuŋmaruŋ.

ref: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
text: N san bijawaam le ni ye n ji jirin ni ban ke Uwonbɔr li seim jiininba ni nintogil, n na li jɔɔ lisufubiil nin ban tun tibir wee kaa la kpenn bi binbemin ki nyan tijaginn nin iwanjaab toon nin nwanchɔgin binben, ni ma nin ye bi tooi.

ref: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
text: Ni niɛ le yin kpiɛ maah gɔnn ni nfim mitaa. “Ni kpaa talar le nin tibɔr biɛn li jɔɔ siɛradam bilee bee bita.”

ref: During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning.
text: N pii nan sei ni ikpaan maah nan be ni ban nfim milee nna. Daandaan nan hali maah kaa le ji be ni ban ni, n le ji kpaan ni le. N nan jirin ke, maa yin jiɛn ban pii chinn ŋa tibir bee ban gurin a tuli a darimi,

ref: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!
text: naah ban ni biɛ ke Masiya le sin jɔɔm ki pagi. Waa ye kidaburig le ni sisiigin ni, u jɔɔ npɔɔn ni ban.

ref: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
text: Nin ni bamɔn, bi nan kpaa u lidapunpunl bu u daburigi ni, ni biɛn yɔli u jɔɔ limiɛfol Uwonbɔr a pɔɔm bu. Man nmɔn bu le ti mu jɔɔ u daburigi nmɔn, ni biɛn yɔli Uwonbɔr a pɔɔm bu ti mu li jɔɔ limiɛfol nin Yisa ki tun ki tenn ni.

ref: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
text: Ni mag ni bau njee ni sin be nin yadaa; ni baan ni bau. Naa nyi ke Masiya be ni ban naa? Wee naa ye ni lu ni magilin le-n.

ref: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
text: Le n ga jin ke ni li biɛ ke taa lu limagilin ni.

ref: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
text: Daandaan nan ti miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn ni ke ni laa tun niba a biri. Naa ye ke bininfob n kan taah nyaŋ limagilin man ni, amaa ti ban ni tun nan ŋan, hali gbaa ni yin nann ke ti walin gur le-n.

ref: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.
text: Taa li fir tun niba ki bii ibamɔn nmɔn ni, amaa ti le yin tun ibamɔn le.

ref: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
text: Ni mɔ ti le n-yonn man wee ti jɔɔ idaburig amaa wee nim pɔɔ ke; ti wonmiɛl ye nan li mann ni le.

ref: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
text: Mambu le n sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn ni, ni ye maa be ni ban ke, wee ki nan dan ni ban n-yonn man ke n laa fiin n ŋuul npɔɔm bu. Ti yudaau nan seim npɔɔn nmɔn ke n ter ni le, naa ye n bii ni.

ref: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
text: Ni joorimin n nabum, n chabir ni le, ni li ban nbinben ŋan na, ni gbirim maah len nan nan, ni li jɔɔ lipotiɛl libau, ki li be nin nposɔɔn, le Uwonbɔr wan jɔɔ njiɛm nin nposɔɔni li be nin ni.

ref: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
text: Ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl nin nposɔɔn li be ni bu,

ref: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
text: u ma ti yudaau Yisa nmɔn le ta uba ki siin ti taalin ti yaa toonbirin, ke un nyan ti dulinya birig kan a yonn wee ti be nan, ke ti Baa Uwonbɔr kaah ban man nin,

ref: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
text: Uma wan ye kupag hali nin n-yonn man kaa jɔɔ ndiɛmi. Ibamɔn. Tibɔŋann tiba kpeŋileŋ le be

ref: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
text: Ni garim pam nin naah labir weem ki jiɛn Uwonbɔr wan yin ni Masiya a nyunyunbasanl bu-n wee ki labir nɔɔ tibɔr tan be ti binba nmɔn,

ref: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
text: taa le ye tibɔŋann ma kolibi. Ibamɔn buu bininfob biba li yin ta kuŋmaruŋ ki ŋa ni sufu ni ki degin ni Masiya a bɔŋann nmɔn.

ref: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
text: Amaa hali tim bee malaka le nyan papaab ki yin mɔɔn tibɔŋann wee ti be tiba kaa ye tan wee ti pii mɔɔn ki sei nin nke, che nŋmi man kaa jɔɔ njunimin ngaa u!

ref: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
text: Ke taah pii nan len man nin, le n ji bei ni daandaan nan: Ni ye uba mɔɔn tibɔŋann wee taa ye tan wee ni nan gaa-n ke, che nŋmi man kaa jɔɔ njunimin ngaa u!

ref: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
text: N gbaar ki ban bininfob le n ke n toon ŋan bee Uwonbɔr aa? Bee n ban bininfob a num le n gbee maa? Ni ye n le la bi gbaar ban bininfob a num le n gbeem ke, maa bi yin ye Masiya a yomu wi. Pɔɔl kaah nan ŋa Yisa a toom man

ref: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
text: N nabum, n ban ni li nyi ke tibɔŋann tan wee n nan pagin, naa ye uninfosaal le ŋa ti.

ref: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
text: Maa gaa ti uninfosaal ban ni, naa ye uba mu le ta ti ki wɔɔnimi; amaa, n gaa ti Yisa Masiya wan kpiir ti ki wɔɔnimin ban le.

ref: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.
text: Ni pii gbir maah nan jɔɔ nbinben man n-yonn man wee n nan nɔɔ Juu yaab a wonjiɛn samin a bɔra, nin maah nan mugir biwonjiɛm a laguŋ linunmanl ki gbaar ban n bii liwonjiɛnl man.

ref: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
text: N nan lii Juu yaab takpem tim Juu yaab a wonjiɛn samin, min nin ban nan yegin, n nan jɔɔ inunman takpem ki nɔɔ n yaajam a kaal kaah wɔɔn man.

ref: to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone.
text: ki kpiir U bija wan be n ni-n ki wɔɔn ke n ta u ki mɔɔn ki sei ban kaa ye Juu yaabin, maa nan gbeer uba,

ref: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
text: n mu kaa jon Jerusalam ke n tan kan ban nan chinn ye itoon n ni, amaa libol nmɔn n nan jon Arabiya le, ni bɔɔn bu le n jir Damasiko.

ref: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
text: Ibin itaa a bɔɔn, le n nan jon Jerusalam n tan gɔnn Piita ki biɛ u, le ki nan be u ban iweehn piig nin iŋmu.

ref: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
text: Maa nan kan Yisa a tooi bimiɛnin a ni uba, see ti Yudaau a waal Jemisi a binba.

ref: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
text: Uwonbɔr buu, naa ye tibɔkar le n por ki sɔb tenn ni.

ref: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
text: Ni bɔɔn bu le n jon Siriya nin Silisiya.

ref: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
text: N-yonn nmɔn, biwonjiɛm a laginn ban nan be Judiya a tingbɔŋin ki be Masiya ni-n kaa nan nyimi.

ref: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.
text: Bi le nan gbir bininfob biba le kaah pag ke: “Uja wan nan mugir ti-n, mu nin mɔɔn yada kan wee u nan ban un choo bii nle ki tenn bininfob.”

ref: And because of me, they praised God.
text: Le bi don Uwonbɔr a yinl min bu.

ref: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
text: Ibin piig nin ina a bɔɔn le n ji nan jon Jerusalam, min nin Banabasi. N nan ta Tatusi tɔɔl jon na.

ref: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
text: Uwonbɔr le nan kpiir wɔɔnim ke n jo, ki tan bei bi tibɔŋann tan wee n ti mɔɔn ban kaa ye Juu yaab ban nin. Amaa n nan yin biwonjiɛn sanliibin a binba le ki wɔɔn bi, nan bu-n, n nan san le kaa ban maah tun nan nin bee nan wee n la yin tun nin n gab yɔli.

ref: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
text: Hali Tatusi, wan nan be n ban nin, nin waah le nan ye Girig a ninfou nmɔn biɛn ni, baa nan mugir u ke un jii u punli.

ref: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
text: Tibɔr nmɔn nan nyan nnabum man por tibɔkar tenn bi ba ke bi mu ye Yisa a bɔɔnɔɔbin le, bi nan be ti sisiigin le ki pigir ti ki ban bin biɛ taah gaa ti ba Masiya bu man wee ki ŋa ti nsiim a yomi.

ref: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
text: Taa nan chee sei bi hali wama, naah li ŋa man wee tibɔŋannin a bamɔn li be nin ni.

ref: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.
text: Ban wee bi lig bi ki miin bi ye ban kpaa talarin, baah nan ye bininfob ban nin kaa jɔɔ nbɔgirim min ban ni; Uwonbɔr kaa ji bininfob tibɔr baah nann man ni, bininfob nmɔn kaa kpiɛgim niba imɔleen n-yaan ni.

ref: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
text: Amaa, baah kan nan n ban ye Uwonbɔr kaah gannim ke n mɔɔn u bɔŋann nin ki sei ban kaa ye Juu yaab ke waah nan gann Piita ke un mɔɔn tibɔŋann nmɔn ki sei Juu yaab man nin.

ref: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
text: Uwonbɔr wan nan tun nin Piita wee u nan ye ntoon ki sei Juu yaabin, Uwonbɔr nmɔn le tun nin n mu le n ye ntoon ki sei ban kaa ye Juu yaabi.

ref: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
text: Jemisi nin Piita ki kpiɛ Jɔnn ban wee bi lig ki miin bi ye bininfojabin, bi tɔɔl nan biɛ ke Uwonbɔr le seim itoon gannkaa nmɔn; ni ma che bi nan sei min nin Banabasi inɔɔ. Ni ma nan ye chee sei tab a nɔɔseil. Tim nin bi ma nan chee sei tab ke min nin Banabasi li mɔɔn tibɔŋannin ki tenn ban kaa ye Juu yaaba, wee bi mu li mɔɔn ti ki tenn Juu yaab.

ref: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
text: Nan biɛn wee bi nan pag joor ye le ke ti li tiɛr bilanjiim bu, nan wee n jɔɔ linunmanl ki ban n tun. Pɔɔl kaah fuun Piita bu Antiɛg man

ref: When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong.
text: Piita kaah nan foon Antiɛg nan, n nan yii u bɔrin le u numin, nan bu-n u le sin nan jɔɔ igalin le.

ref: He and the others hid their true feelings so well that even Barnabas was fooled.
text: Le Juu yaab ban nan be niin nmɔn mu kpiɛ Piita bu u larug nmɔn yaan, bi larug nmɔn nan boon Banabasi tɔɔla.

ref: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
text: Maah nan nan kan baah tun man nin kaa nɔɔ tibɔŋannin a bamɔn yin, le n bei Piita bininfobin biɛn a nintogil ke, “A ye Juu a ninfou le, amaa a be le ke ban kaa ye Juu yaabin, ŋaa nann Juu a ninfou wi. Ni ŋa nii wee a mugir ban kaa ye Juu yaab ki ban bin nɔɔ Juu yaab a kaalaa?

ref: We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles.
text: “Tim ban wee bi ma ti wee ti ye Juu yaab, wee kaa ye ban kaa ye Juu yaab tibirdam nan,

ref: But we know that God accepts only those who have faith in Jesus Christ. No one can please God by simply obeying the Law. So we put our faith in Christ Jesus, and God accepted us because of our faith.
text: ti nyi ke naa ye uninfo wan ŋmag nsiim le bi ke u ye uninfo ŋan Uwonbɔr ban ni, amaa ban ŋa Yisa Masiya yada-n. Ti tɔɔl ŋa Masiya yada le ke nin che ti bɔr li ŋan Uwonbɔr ban, ti yada n bu, amaa naa ye taah ŋmag nsiim n bu, uba kaa li fir ŋa uninfo ŋan Uwonbɔr ban nsiimin bu.

ref: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
text: Ni ye ke, taah ban ti ŋa bininfoŋam Masiya nin, ni nan wɔɔn ke ti baantɔɔl ye tibirdam ke, ni ji wɔɔn ke Masiya si tibirdam a chaŋ lee? Naa ye man kolibi.

ref: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
text: Ni ye n bi jir maa nan wee n nan choo bii n le ke, ni ma bi wɔɔn ke n ye wan bii nsiim le.

ref: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
text: Uwonbɔr a siimin bu le n kpo sei nsiim nmɔn, ke n fir ki be Uwonbɔr kaah ban man.

ref: I have died, but Christ lives in me. And I now live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me.
text: Bi nan kpaam lidapunpunl bu le nin Masiya le naa ji ye min le be, amaa Masiya nmɔn le be nim. Limiɛfol lan wee n jɔɔ be nin tigbanann nin, n be nin yada le Uwonbɔr a bija-n bu, wan jiɛm wee ki ta u ba seimin.

ref: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
text: Maa yii Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanlin ni, ni ye nbuchin binben bi nɔɔ nsiim bu le ke, Masiya bi kpo yɔli le!”

ref: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
text: Nim Galantiya yaab, tijɔri nan! Unyɔgdaan u la baa ŋmarin ni sufuu? Yisa Masiya a kum lidapunpunlin bu a bɔr nan kar ki wɔɔn ni npaan nin ni tɔɔl a numin.

ref: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
text: N ban n biɛ niwann niba le kpeŋileŋ ni ban: Naah ŋmag Uwonbɔr a siimin bu le che ni gaa Kinaaŋin bee naah gbir tibɔŋannin ki ŋa ti yada-n buu?

ref: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?
text: Ni jɔrig lee? Nim ban nan piin nin Uwonbɔr a Kasi a Naaŋ a pɔɔm nan, ni nin gbaar ban ni ta uninfosaal a pɔɔm le ki jooraa?

ref: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
text: Naah jin fala wan takpem nan ye yɔli lee? Ke ni sin ye ke ni ye yɔli ke,

ref: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
text: Uwonbɔr nan ta U Kasi a Naaŋin ki sei ni nin ligaril a toon yan wee U nan tun ni sisiigin nin ke naah ŋmag nsiim nbu le, bee naah gbir tibɔŋannin ki ŋa ti yada n buu?

ref: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
text: Mambu, ni biɛm ke bininfob ban ŋa yada nan ye Abiraham a yaabili le.

ref: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
text: Ni ji sɔb dɔ Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke, bininfob ban kaa ye Juu yaab nan a bɔr na li ŋaŋ bi yada bu. Baah kaa la nan gbir tibɔŋannin n-yonn man nin le U nan chinn mɔɔn ti sei Abiraham ke, “Fin bu, N li kaab tikaar jaa dulinya nan yaab biɛn bu.”

ref: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
text: Mambu ban ŋa u yada kan tikaar ke Abiraham, wan ye yada daan nin, kaah kan man nin.

ref: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.”
text: Bininfob ban biɛn nɔɔ nsiim ke bin kan nŋmarimin, limɔpool be bi bu, nan bu-n ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke, “Wan biɛn kaa nɔɔ nsiim man biɛn sɔb dɔ nsiim a gbɔŋin ke, limɔpool be u bu.”

ref: No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
text: Ibamɔn, nsiimin bu ke uba kaa be wee Uwonbɔr ke u bɔr ŋan ni, nan bu-n, “Ubuchin le be yada bu.”

ref: The Law isn't based on faith. It promises life only to people who obey its commands.
text: Amaa nsiim kaa nɔɔ nin yada; nan bu-n, “Uninfo wan tun nsiimin kaah wɔɔn man nin li be nsiim nmɔn bu.”

ref: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.
text: Masiya nan ta u ba le ki mann nkpenim a manug ki fee ti nyan nsiim a mɔpool lan nan nɔɔ ti-n ki jaa, waah nan gaa ti a sisibol ki sir ki che limɔpool nmɔn jin u nbu, nan bu-n ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke: “Limɔpool be wan biɛn bi jɔn u busub bu.”

ref: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
text: U nan sei ti nkpenim a manug le ke Masiya bu le ban kaa ye Juu yaabin mu nkan tikaar tan wee Uwonbɔr nan ŋa Abiraham bu-n ni, ke ni ye ti ŋa yada ke, ti li kan Kinaaŋ kan wee U nan siin limɔsiinl ke U li sei ti-n. Nsiim nin limɔsiinl a bɔr

ref: My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement.
text: N nabum, n ban n ta idaa biɛn a binbem le ki mag wɔɔn ni tibɔr nan. Bininfob kaah lagin ki poo tipoor tan ke, uba kaa li fir bii ti bee ki ta niba kpiɛ ni bu man nin, man le ye ni niɛ mu.

ref: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
text: Limɔsiinl nmɔn nan siin ki sei Abiraham nin u yaabil le. Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋ kaa ke, “Nin a yaabili yi” wee ni wɔɔn ke kuninfogbaluŋi amaa u nan ke “Nin a yaabil”, le ni wɔɔn ke uninfo uba u ma ye Masiya.

ref: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
text: Ni ye nsiim a ŋmagim bu le Uwonbɔr tenn bininfob U faal ke, mambu ke waa bi li sei uba lifaal U mɔsiinlin bu, amaa ni nan ye Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl bu le U sei Abiraham U faal nmɔn limɔsiinlin bu.

ref: What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people.
text: Ke babu wee Uwonbɔr nan siin nsiim nmɔn naa? Nsiim a biim bu le Uwonbɔr nan ta nsiim nan ki sei bininfob ki kpiɛ U mɔsiinl bu, ki ban nsiim nmɔn li ŋmag bi hali nin n-yonn man wee Abiraham a yaabil lan wee U ma Uwonbɔr nan siin limɔsiinl ki sei-n kaah na li foon. Le malakam ta nsiim nmɔn ŋubin usandanfaar a nɔɔn.

ref: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
text: Usandanfaar nan kaa si uninfo uba bu; amaa Uwonbɔr ye uba le. Nsiim kaah be nan bu

ref: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.
text: Mambu nsiim kɔn nin Uwonbɔr a mɔsiinlin lee? Naa ye man ni! Ni ye Uwonbɔr bi siin nsiim man li fir sei uninfo limiɛfol ke, U bi li ke bininfob ye bibuchim le U ban, nsiim nmɔn a ŋmagim bu.

ref: But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
text: Amaa Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin bei ke, uninfo biɛn be tibir a loondiigin le, naah li ŋa man wee Uwonbɔr kaah nan siin limɔsiinl ke U li sei ban ŋa Yisa Masiya yada lifaal lan nin, bi yada nmɔn bu le U yin sei bi.

ref: The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith.
text: Yada nan kaah kaa la nan foon nin, nsiimin nan ŋa ti biloondiikɔɔb le, le ki loon ti ki nan kpaa n-yonn man wee Uwonbɔr nan kpiir yada a ŋaam a bɔr ki wɔɔn ti-n.

ref: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
text: Mambu, nsiim nmɔn nan ye uguguur le ki jɔɔ ti chaa Masiya ban, naah li ŋa man wee Uwonbɔr n len ke ti bɔr ŋan yada bu.

ref: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
text: Daandaan nan yada a ŋaam a sam kaah dan nan, nsiimin kaa ji ye ti guguuru wi.

ref: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
text: Ni biɛn nan ye Uwonbɔr a buwaab le naah ŋa Masiya yada-n bu.

ref: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
text: Nim ban wee bi fun ni Uwonbɔr a nyunful Masiya a yinlin nin, nim le ta Masiya ki yee ke kuwan yeewaŋin.

ref: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
text: Mambu, nbɔgirim kaa ji be ban ye Juu yaab nin ban kaa ye Juu yaab a sisiigin ni, kaa be biyom nin ban ye bi ba nan a sisiigin ni, kaa be bijab nin bipiib mu a sisiigin ni, ni ma bu ni biɛn ye nba le Masiya ni.

ref: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
text: Ni ye Masiya le ye ni ke, man ke ni ye Abiraham a yaabili le, ki li ji u faal ke Uwonbɔr a mɔsiinlin kaah wɔɔn man nin.

ref: Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs.
text: Maah len man nmɔn wɔɔn le ke ufaajir nmɔn kaah le la ye kibigin, nin waah le jɔɔ nan nmɔn biɛn yɔli, waa yin jɔɔ nbɔgirim nin uyomi.

ref: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.
text: U yin be ban guu win nin u toon tun ninkpeebin a nɔɔn le, hali ki nan kpaa u baa kaah nan siin u n-yonn man nin.

ref: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
text: Man mu le ye ti, taah la nan ye nbuwaab Yisa a samin yaan nin, dulinya nan a maabiyiɛrug nan ŋmag ti le ke biyomin.

ref: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
text: N-yonn nmɔn kaah nan nan foon biɛn nin, le Uwonbɔr tun U tɔɔl a bija, wan wee upii ma u, wee nsiim ŋmag u,

ref: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
text: ke un ŋa nkpenim a manug ki nyan ban be nsiim nmɔn yaan nin, wee ti kpann Uwonbɔr a bibamɔm.

ref: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
text: Naah ye Uwonbɔr a buwaabin bu le Uwonbɔr tun U big nmɔn a Naaŋ le ki dan ki nan be ti sufu ni, le kinaaŋ nmɔn yi ke, “Ti dindaau, ti baa.”

ref: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
text: Mambu, ŋaa ji ye uyomi, amaa a nin ye Uwonbɔr a big le; ŋaah ye U big n bu, le U ŋaaŋ U faajiru mu. Pɔɔl a baga kaah be Galantiya yaabin man

ref: But now you know God, or better still, God knows you. How can you turn back and become the slaves of those weak and pitiful powers?
text: Amaa daandaan nan ni nin nyi Uwonbɔr, bee Uwonbɔr nyi ni, ke ba ŋa wee ni ji ban ni jir ki nɔɔ dulinya nan a maabiyiɛrug kan ye idaburig nin kunyunyunbaag a binbem nan naa? Ni ban ni kpann tiwann nmɔn a yomi le jigin naa?

ref: You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years.
text: Ni ji iweehn nin iŋmal nin iyoo nin ibin a chiig le!

ref: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
text: N san ni bijawaam le, maah tun nan ki jiin ni paamin nan gab yɔli bu.

ref: My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me
text: N nabum n balin ni le, ni li be ke min na, ke maah be ke nim man nin. Naa galimi.

ref: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
text: Ke naah nyi man nin, maah nan bu-n bu le n nan chinn ki mɔɔn tibɔŋann nan ki sei ni.

ref: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
text: Hali nin n wiɛn nmɔn kaah nan mugir ni nan biɛn na, amaa naa nan yim yɔli bee ki yii mi, ni gaam le ke Uwonbɔr a malaka-n, ki ji gaam ke Masiya baantɔɔlin.

ref: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
text: Ni mɔmin biɛn be laa? N li fir ji siɛra ke, ni ye ni bi li fir ke, ni bi li chee ki logir ni numbili ki seim.

ref: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
text: Amaa daandaan nan n nin kpann ni dundaau le maah bei ni ibamɔn nin buu?

ref: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
text: Bininfob biba jɔɔ inunman ki ban ni ta ni baga ŋa bi ni, amaa naa ye ni ŋam bu le bi ŋaan nmɔn ni. Bi ban bin ta ni ŋa bicham ti ban, naah li ŋa man wee ni li jɔɔ inunman ki ta ni baga ŋa bi ni.

ref: It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you.
text: Ni ŋan ni li jɔɔ inunman, ni ye ni tun nin ni ŋam bu, wee ni li ye man ki jɔɔ chaa ki laa ye n-yonn man wee n nan be ni ban a binba.

ref: My children, I am in terrible pain until Christ may be seen living in you.
text: N bijiɛkaam, ni wum le ke nmarwiɛn kaah choo upii ke ni wuu man nin, ki nan kpaa n-yonn man wee ni na li chegir Masiya a sam nan yaan.

ref: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled. Hagar and Sarah
text: N bi ban n li be ni ban daandaan nan wee ki mann kpenn n kukɔl, nan bu-n n lam ŋmarin le ni bu. Hega nin Sɛra a magil

ref: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
text: Ni beim ni, nim ban ban nsiim li ŋmag ni nan, naa nyi nsiim nmɔn kaah len man naa?

ref: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
text: Ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke Abiraham nan jɔɔ nbijabum milee le, uba a na nan ye uyom le wan gurin mu a na nan ye upii wan ye uba.

ref: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
text: U bija wan wee upiiyomin nan maa-n, u nan ma u le ke bininfob kaah maa man nin; amaa u bija wan wee upii wan ye uba-n nan maa-n, u nan ma u le ke Uwonbɔr kaah nan siin u mɔsiinl man nin.

ref: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
text: Ni niɛ li fir ta, pag wonn a poolin ke, bipiib bilee nan si Uwonbɔr a poor a kerim milee a sisiimin le, uyom nmɔn a yinl li nan ye: Hega; le u si tipoor tan wee Uwonbɔr nan poo Sinai a jɔɔl a paabin a sisiim, le ki nan ma u big tiyomirin.

ref: Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
text: Daandaan nan Hega si ki sei Sinai a jɔɔl lan be Arabiya a tiŋin nin le, ki nann dulinya nan a Jerusalam le, nan bu-n u ma nin u buwaab be tiyomirin le.

ref: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
text: Amaa Jerusalam kan be papaab nan ma ye u ba le, le ki ye ti na.

ref: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
text: Ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke: “Upiiŋɔɔbee, che ni li mɔŋa, fin wan kaa la nyi ma nbuwaab nan; li yigin ki le sɔɔlin na, fin wan kaa la nyi nmarwiɛn a tom nan; nan bu-n upii wan a chal yii u nan a buwaab yab ki jon upii wan jɔɔ chal nan a buwaaba.”

ref: My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was.
text: N nabum daandaan nan ni nann Azig le, ni ye Uwonbɔr a buwaab le, U mɔsiinlin bu.

ref: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
text: Iyaayoo nmɔn, baah nan ma wan ke bininfob kaah maa bi buwaab man nin, nan mugir wan wee bi ma u Kinaaŋ a pɔɔmin nin, ni ye man le daandaan nan.

ref: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
text: Amaa Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin bei ke nii? “Ŋɔɔr upiiyomin nin u bigin ki jaau, upiiyom a big nin upii wan ye u ba nan a big kaa li fir lagin por lifaali.”

ref: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
text: Mambu n nabum, taa ye upiiyom nmɔn a buwaabi, amaa ti ye upii wan ye u ba nan a buwaab le.

ref: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
text: Ye n ba bu le Masiya nan nyan ti tiyomirin. Mambu mann sir nbamɔma, ki laa ji ta tiyomir a naajadaag paan a baa bu.

ref: I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised.
text: Ni gbirim! Min Pɔɔl bei ni le ke ni ye ni la ŋmag lipunjiil a siimin ke, ni wɔɔn ke Masiya kaa jɔɔ tinyɔɔr tiba biɛn ki sei ni.

ref: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
text: Nim ban pɔɔn ni ba ke Uwonbɔr n len ke ni bɔr ŋan nsiim a ŋmagim bu-n, ni pii bɔgir ni ba Masiya ban na, ki nyan ni ba Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl n-yaan na.

ref: But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ.
text: Amaa yada bu, le kinaaŋ sei ti npɔɔn le ti jɔɔ tama ki guu nbuchin binben a yonn.

ref: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
text: Ni ma bu Masiya ban, taah jii ti pun bee taah kaa jii kaa kpaa talari. Nan kpaa talar le ye yada kan be npaanin nin njiɛm.

ref: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
text: Ni nan ti tun nbamɔm le. Ke ŋma ŋɔɔr ni ke ni laa ji nɔɔ ibamɔn nmɔn naa?

ref: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
text: Kularug nmɔn kaa nyan Uwonbɔr wan yin ni ban ni.

ref: A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough,
text: “Boroboro a nyɔgim wama le che boroboro a yom fugir ki do.”

ref: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
text: Uyudaan bu n jɔɔ tidindann ke naa ji li jɔɔ lipotiɛl liba kpiɛ. Uninfo wan ŋmarin ni potiɛl nmɔn ke, Uwonbɔr li dar u daan a tul, ni baga kaa be waah ye wan ni.

ref: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
text: N nabum, ni ye n la bi mɔɔn lipunjiil a bɔr le ke, ba ŋa wee bi ji mugirim maa? Ni ye man ke igalin yan nan ŋa lidapunpunl bu n gab yɔliu.

ref: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
text: Min bi ban ke bininfob ban mugir ni lipunjiil bu nan n bin jiɛn lipunjiil wee ki li faar bi bau.

ref: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
text: N nabum, Uwonbɔr le nan yin ni le ni kpann ban ye biba. Amaa ni li nyi ni nɔɔ ye nba nmɔn bu ki tun tigbanann a kɔlisa a toon; amaa ni li tun tenn tab nin njiɛma.

ref: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
text: Nsiim nmɔn biɛn li lagin ki ŋa lisiinjal lan len ke: “Li jiɛ a kunkɔɔn tab ke ŋaah jiɛ a ba man nin.”

ref: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
text: Ni ye ni gbaa boo tab ki tenn tab ndam ke, ni li nyi ke ni li bii tab. Kinaaŋ nin tigbanann a binbem a bɔr

ref: If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires.
text: N bei ni le, ni li nɔɔ Kinaaŋ a binbema, wee tigbanann a bir a kɔlisa a toon laa be nin ni.

ref: The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should.
text: Tigbanann kaah ban nan nin kaa chee sei kinaaŋ kaah ban nan nin ni, le kinaaŋ mu kaah ban nan nin kaa chee sei tigbanann kaah ban nan nin ni. I kɔn nin tab le, ni ma le che naa fir tun naah ban nan ni.

ref: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
text: Amaa ni ye kinaaŋin lii ni sam ke, nsiim kaa ŋmag ni.

ref: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.
text: Tigbanann a binbem be npaan ni le, ni ma ye: Iwanchɔgin toon lipiibanlin bee lijabanlin, tijaginn a toon, nwanchɔgin binben,

ref: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
text: nin linunchɔril, lidanyugbeel, nin lidanyugbeel a toonbir, nin ban tun man a booli. N bei ni le ke maah pii nan bei ni man nin, ban tun man nmɔn kaa na li kɔɔ Uwonbɔr a naamin ni.

ref: God's Spirit makes us loving, happy, peaceful, patient, kind, good, faithful,
text: Amaa kinaaŋin a looi le ye njiɛm, nmɔn, nposɔɔn, limɔril, tiŋann, nbinben ŋan, si nba bu,

ref: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
text: nin jiininba, ki kpiɛ choonba. Nsiim nba kaa ji be wee ki li bii ban tun nan ni.

ref: And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires.
text: Masiya kaah ye ban nin ta tigbanann a kɔlisa nin bi binben biimin biɛn ki kpaa lidapunpunl buu.

ref: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
text: Taah be kinaaŋin bu-n, ni che ti nɔɔ kinaaŋ nmɔn a tabogi.

ref: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
text: Ni laa che ti li jɔɔ kalanbaani nin tab, bee ki fiin tab a ŋuui, bee ki li jɔɔ linunchɔril nin tabi.

ref: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
text: N nabum, ni ye ni kan uba tun titoonbir ke, nim ban be nin Kinaaŋin ni ter mu soon wee un mann ki sir nbamɔm, amaa wee ki li nyi ni ba bu, naa ye man ke ni mu li kɔɔ libiginlin.

ref: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
text: Ni li tug tab a tugi ya man, ni ye ni ŋaan man ke, ni li gbeen Masiya a siimin.

ref: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
text: Ni ye uninfo tiɛr ke u ye niba, wee kaah sin ye niba ke, u lar u ba le.

ref: Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others.
text: Uninfo biɛn nmag u ba a toon ya. Wee ki nin fir ki fa u gbingbanl u toon ŋan bu, ki laa jɔɔ u ba magir u kpiɛgi,

ref: We each must carry our own load.
text: uninfo biɛn ntum u tɔɔl a tugil.

ref: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
text: Bininfob ban gaa Uwonbɔr a bɔŋann nin a wɔɔmin, ni kpaa le nin bin por baah jɔɔ niwann ŋann nan biɛn ki sei wan wɔɔnn bi.

ref: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.
text: Ni laa che bin lar ni: Uwonbɔr kaa ye kuwanlawaŋi. Uninfosaal chiɛ waah bun niwann nan le.

ref: If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life.
text: Wan bun u tɔɔl a gbanann a bam a wan booli ke, u na yin chiɛ nkum le; wan mu bun iwanbool yan gbee kinaaŋin a num ke, u na yin chiɛ limiɛfol lan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛmin le kinaaŋ ban.

ref: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
text: Mambu ni laa che ti bag itoon ŋan a tum bu, ni ye taa jiɛn itoon ŋan a tum ke ti na li kan tinyɔɔr n-yonn man chaan nan.

ref: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
text: Ni kan maah ta min tɔɔl a nɔɔ ki sɔb isɔb gbingbem yan ki sei na!

ref: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.
text: Bininfob ban ban bin wɔɔn biba a ŋam npaan ni nin bi ma mugir ni ke ni jii ni pun. Nan bu che bi ŋaan man ye baa ban biba nmugir bi Masiya a dapunpunlin bu.

ref: They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised.
text: Ban jiil bi pun nmɔn gbaa kaa nɔɔ nsiimin ni, nin ni ma biɛn ni le ki ban ni jii ni pun wee bi li jɔɔ far bi gbingban ni gbanann a binbem bu.

ref: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
text: Min kaa li nyi ki fa ligbingbanli, see ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a dapunpunlin a binba bu, u dapunpunl nmɔn le ku kutingbɔŋ nan a kɔlisa n gbanann nin, le n mu a kɔlisa nyan kutingbɔŋin na.

ref: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
text: Uninfo wan jii nin wan kaa jii kaa ye niba; nan kpaa talar le ye kuwonaaŋ pɔŋin.

ref: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
text: Uwonbɔr a posɔɔm nin u nyunyunbasanl li be ban nɔɔ nwɔɔm nan bu, hali nin ban ŋa Uwonbɔr a bɔŋann nin yada-n ban ye Juu yaab nin ban kaa ye Juu yaabin biɛn.

ref: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
text: N bɔjoor kaar ye nan le, uba laa ji mugirimi, n pii jɔɔ Yisa a daagim n gbanann nin.

ref: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
text: N nabum, ti Yudaau Yisa a nyunyunbasanl li be nin ni naam. Ibamɔn.

ref: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
text: Min Pɔɔl wan ye Masiya a toom Uwonbɔr a bamin nin, N sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn Uwonbɔr a ninfogann kaab ban be Efesusi, ki si bi yada-n Masiya ban nin:

ref: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
text: Ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl nin nposɔɔn li be nin ni. Kinaaŋ a kaar tan be Masiya ni

ref: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven!
text: Pagim Uwonbɔr wan ye ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a Baa, wan ŋa tikaar jaa ti bu, tikaar tan biɛn nyan papaab ki ye Kinaaŋ a kaar tan be nin Masiya nan.

ref: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
text: Uwonbɔr kaah kaa la nan naan dulinya n-yonn man nin, le U nan gann tim ke ti li be kasi ki laa jɔɔ igalin U ban ni. U jiɛm bu,

ref: God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children.
text: U pii nan lol ke U li ta ti ki kpann U buwaab Yisa Masiya bu, U nan lol man le U nungbeelin nin U bam,

ref: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
text: che ti pag Uwonbɔr U jilima nin U nyunyunbasanl lan wee U sei ti yɔli U bijiɛkaagin ni.

ref: and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways.
text: Le U kpiir wɔɔn ti nan wee U nan woon lol U bamin ke un tun nin Masiya, U nungbeel a ŋamin nin,

ref: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
text: n-yonn nmɔn nan foo ke, U ni li tun ki gbeen U lol nmɔn, ki lagin waah nan naan nan papaab nin tum biɛn, wee Masiya li ye uyudaan.

ref: God always does what he plans, and this is why he appointed Christ to choose us.
text: Masiya ni le Uwonbɔr nan gann ti mu, ki ta ti kpann U tɔɔl a ninfob nin waah ban niwann biɛn ntun man U bamin,

ref: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
text: wee tim ban chinn jɔɔ tama Masiya ni-n, nsei U kupag nin jilima.

ref: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
text: Ni tɔɔl nan kpiɛ ki be nin Masiya le, naah nan gbir imɔleen yan ye ibamɔn nin, ki ye ni feeja a bɔŋann nin. Naah ŋa yada-n bu, le Uwonbɔr ta U yaa daagim ki daag ni, lan ye limɔsiinl Kasi a Naaŋin,

ref: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
text: Kasi a naaŋ nmɔn li ye lifaal nmɔn a siɛra hali nin n-yonn man wee ti na li kan nkpenim a manug tim ban ye U ninfobin, tim li pagir U ki tenn U kupag. Pɔɔl a wonmiɛl

ref: I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people.
text: Mambu n-yonn man wee n nan gbir naah ŋa ti Yudaau Yisa yada nin naah jiɛ Uwonbɔr a ninfogannkaab a bɔr man nin,

ref: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
text: n tenn Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpoog ni bu kaa ta jiɛn ni, ki tiɛr ni bu n wonmiɛlin.

ref: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
text: N le miɛ ti Baa wan ye ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a Wonbɔru, ki ye ti Baa wan ye jilimadaan nin ke, Un sei ni Kinaaŋ a lam nin kpiir wɔɔn, wee ni mann biɛ U nbamɔm.

ref: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
text: N ji miɛ Uwonbɔr le ke Un ligir ni sufu wee ni biɛ tama kan bu wee U yin ni-n, ki ji biɛ U jilima takpenl a faal lan wee U nan siin limɔsiinl ki sei U ninfogannkaabin,

ref: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
text: nin U pɔɔn takpem man yab kaa jɔɔ magim wee U ta sei tim ban ŋa U yada-n. Npɔɔn nmɔn tun ki nann lipɔɔn gbingbemil le,

ref: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
text: U pɔɔm nmɔn le U nan ta ki fiin Masiya nkumin ki ta U kaan U nɔɔjiim paam papaab,
