ref: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
text: niin le Masiya be ki jɔɔ npɔɔn man jon nnaam a pɔɔm, ki jon tininkper a pɔɔm, ki jon ipɔɔn biɛn, nin nnaam a yerin, ki jon iyin yan be daandaan nan nin yan la yin dan n-yonn man chaan nin na.

ref: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
text: Le Uwonbɔr ta niwann biɛn ŋa u nɔɔn, le ki gann u ke u li ye biwonjiɛn a laguŋ a yudaau.

ref: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
text: Biwonjiɛm a laguŋ nmɔn le ye U gbanann, le U gbanann nmɔn gbee nin U ma Masiya a pɔɔm, le U mu gbee nin niwann biɛn.

ref: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
text: Nim bu ke, ni nan ye bitakpiib le nin ban bii nsiim ni toonbir bu.

ref: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
text: Naah nan be nsiim a biim nin ni toonbirin ki nɔɔ dulinya nan a sam nin kutingbɔŋ nan a yudaau a naamin, nin kinaaŋ kan tun nin bininfob ban kaa jɔɔ limɔcheelin.

ref: Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
text: Ti biɛn nan be nsiim a biim nin tibirin nmɔn yaan le, ki tun ti tɔɔl a gbanann a kɔlisa a toon, ki tun nan mɔ ki sei ti gbanann a bam nin ti sufu. A li ke bi ma-n, ti nan ye ban li ji Uwonbɔr a ŋuufiiŋin a fala le.

ref: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
text: le U che ti jɔɔ limiɛfol nin Yisa, hali nin taah le nan kpo nin taah bii nsiimin. U nyunyunbasanl bu le ni kan feegab.

ref: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
text: Le Uwonbɔr lagin fiin tim nin Masiya, ki kaan tim nin uma paab a naamin, taah be nin Masiya nan bu,

ref: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.
text: U nan tun ni niɛ ke n-yonn man chaan nan u li wɔɔn uninfo biɛn u nyunyunbasanl lan kaa jɔɔ magimin, ki wɔɔn ti u binbenŋam Masiya bu.

ref: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.
text: Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl bu le ni kan nŋmarim, naah ŋa Yisa yada-n bu, naa ye ni tɔɔl a toon ŋan bu, ni ye Uwonbɔr a piini le,

ref: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
text: uba kaa li fir fa ligbingbanli, nan bu-n naa ye u tɔɔl a toonl li.

ref: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
text: Uwonbɔr le naan tim, Yisa Masiya bu le u sei ti itoon ŋan a binbem, ke ti li tun man wee u pii nan lol ke ti li tun nin na. Ni ye nba le Yisa ni

ref: Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised.
text: Mambu ni li tiɛr ke n-yonn man nan jon wee nim ban kaa nan ye Juu yaab wee Juu yaab nan yi ni “tipunjorin”, wee ki sin yi biba “ban jii-n”, ,

ref: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
text: Ni li tiɛr ke iyaayoo nmɔn ni nan bɔgir nin Yisa u, baa nan kaan ni kpiɛg Uwonbɔr a ninfogannkaabin ni, ni nan ye bicham le, kaa ji kpiɛ limɔsiinl a poorin yaan ni, kaa jɔɔ tama, kaa jɔɔ Uwonbɔr dulinya nan yaan ni.

ref: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
text: Amaa daandaan nan, ni nin be nin Yisa le, nim ban a bol nan fɔg nin Yisa nan, ni nin fɔɔr ki mal wa, Yisa Masiya a chamin bu.

ref: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
text: Nan bu-n uma baan tɔɔl le ye ti posɔɔm, u nan che tim Juu yaab nin ban kaa ye Juu yaabin lagin ki ŋa uninfo uba ki tir ligonl lan nan ye nbɔgirim a gonl ki be ti sisiigin nin ki jaa,

ref: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
text: u tɔɔl a gbanann le u nan ta junn Juu yaab a siim nin bi kɔɔi biɛn. Ke un che nposɔɔn ndan ibol ilee nmɔn a sisiigin, wee bin lagin ki li ye libol liba,

ref: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
text: Masiya a kum lidapunpunlin bu, ku kidataag kan be bi sisiigin nin, ki taa bi ki lagin tigbanann tiba kpeŋileŋ, ki taa bi jir mɔŋ nin Uwonbɔr.

ref: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
text: U nan dan ki mɔɔn nposɔɔn a bɔŋann sei nim ban a bol nan fɔg ki mɔɔn nposɔɔn a bɔŋann nmɔn ki sei ban nan mal.

ref: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
text: Masiya bu le kinaaŋ kiba nmɔn ta ibol ilee nmɔn biɛn foon ti Baa Uwonbɔr ban.

ref: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
text: Mambu, nim ban kaa ye Juu yaabin kaa ji ye ibol iba yaab bee bichami, amaa nim nin Uwonbɔr a ninfogannkaabin nin ye kitiŋ kiba a buwaab le, ki ye Uwonbɔr a niin yaab,

ref: You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone.
text: lifiɛl lan wee Yisa a tooi nin bilinlemin nan tɔɔn li bu-n, li ma bu le n mu tɔɔn le Yisa Masiya ye litangbagil lan ye lifiɛl nmɔn a pɔɔm.

ref: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
text: Uma bu le kudiig a maan biɛn tɔɔ tab bu, ki che ni choo tab ki kpann kasi a wonjiɛn niin Uyudaan ni.

ref: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
text: Uma bu le ni mu lagin ki maa kudiig kan yaan wee Uwonbɔr be nin Kinaaŋin.

ref: Christ Jesus made me his prisoner, so I could help you Gentiles.
text: Ni niɛ nan bu, le min Pɔɔl wan ye uloondiikɔɔr Masiya nin ban kaa ye Juu yaabin bu-n.

ref: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
text: N nyi ke ni pii gbir ke Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl a toon bu, le U nan ta litoonl nan seim ke n tun nim bu,

ref: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
text: ni ma ye waah nan kpiir tibɔwoonkaar ki wɔɔm, ke maah pii sɔb ti kugbɔŋ nan yaan wama-n.

ref: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
text: Ni ye ni karin maah sɔb nan nmɔn ke, ni li biɛ maah nyi Masiya a bɔwoonkaar man,

ref: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.
text: Uwonbɔr kaa nan kpiir tibɔwoonkaar nmɔn ki wɔɔn n-yonn man nan jon nin a ninfobi, amaa daandaan nan Kinaaŋin kpiir tibɔwoonkaarin ki wɔɔn Uwonbɔr a kasi a tooi nin u linlema.

ref: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
text: U bɔwoonkaar nmɔn ye nan le, tibɔŋann nmɔn bu le ban kaa ye Juu yaabin fir ki lagin jin lifaal nin Iziral yaab, ki lagin ye gbanann tiba a ninfob, ki jɔɔ waah nan siin limɔsiinl lan Masiya bu-n ki por nin tab.

ref: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
text: Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl bu le n kpann tibɔŋann nan a yomu Uwonbɔr a piini yan wee u seim u pɔɔm a toon yin nin.

ref: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
text: Min le joor kaa yabi Uwonbɔr a ninfob nmɔn biɛn a sisiigin, amaa ni biɛn yɔli, Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl bu le U gannim ki seim nsan ke: N mɔɔn ki wɔɔn ban kaa ye Juu yaabin Masiya a jɔɔm man kaa li fir ban kan ni,

ref: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
text: ki che uninfo biɛn n mann biɛ Uwonbɔr a bɔwoonkaarin a toon kaah ye man, wee Uwonbɔr, wan nan naan niwann biɛn nin, nan ŋmag ti liwoolin n-yonn man nan jon nin.

ref: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
text: Uwonbɔr a boni nan ye le ke daandaan nan, biwonjiɛm a laguŋ bu, Uwonbɔr a lam a booli ye nin ta wɔɔn nnaam a pɔɔm nin tininkper a pɔɔm man be paabin,

ref: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
text: Uwonbɔr nan ŋa ni niɛ nan ke waah gbeen u lolim man kaa jɔɔ diɛmin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya nin.

ref: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.
text: Taah ŋa Yisa yada ki be u ni nbu, le ti jɔɔ lipoobil ki li foo Uwonbɔr ban, nin tidindann.

ref: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
text: Ni ma bu, n balin ni le, ni laa che ni gbanann ngbɔɔ maah ji fala wan ni bu nni, ni ye kupag le sei ni. Masiya a jiɛm

ref: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.
text: Uma ban le U niin yaab ban be papaab nin dulinya nan yaan biɛn a yin nyann.

ref: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
text: N miɛ Uwonbɔr le ke Un ta U jɔɔm a pagim ki pɔɔg ni gbanann nmɔn U Naaŋ kan be ni nin bu,

ref: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
text: wee Masiya li be ni sufu-n ni yada bu. Le n miɛ u ke un che ni fir ki sir nbamɔm ki baan inyaan njiɛmin,

ref: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
text: wee ni li jɔɔ npɔɔn nin Uwonbɔr a ninfob gannkaab biɛn ki fir biɛ Masiya a jiɛm a yiyalim nin mi fufɔgim nin mi kpikperim nin mi nyunyɔɔm kaah ye man,

ref: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
text: ki biɛ Masiya a jiɛm kaah jon nnyinyin biɛn man, wee nin gbeen nin Uwonbɔr a magim nin U binbenŋam ke naah gbeen Uwonbɔr ban man nin.

ref: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
text: U ma Uwonbɔr ye kupag biwonjiɛm a laguŋ nin Masiya ni ki tan kpaa n-yonn man nan jon nin a ninfob biɛn, nin n-yonn man kaa jɔɔ diɛm nan! Ibamɔn.

ref: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
text: Min wan ye uloondiikɔɔr Uyudaan a toon yin bu-n, n balin ni le ke ni che ni binbem nkpaan ni yim man wee ni nan ga-n.

ref: Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other.
text: Ni jiin niba, ki li be soon, ki li jɔɔ limɔril nin njiɛm nin tab.

ref: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
text: Ni pɔɔn niba ki li ŋmag Kinaaŋ a mɔkpaamin nin nposɔɔn.

ref: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
text: Tigbanann tiba nin Kinaaŋ kiba le be, ke baah nan yin ni tama kiba bu a yim man nin,

ref: We have only one Lord, one faith, and one baptism.
text: Uyudaan uba, yada kiba, Uwonbɔr a nyunful nba;

ref: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
text: Uwonbɔr uba, nin ti biɛn a Baa, wan jon niwann biɛn, nin niwann biɛn bu, nin niwann biɛn nin.

ref: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
text: Ni ma bu le ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke: “Waah nan don papaab n-yonn man nin; u nan ŋmag biyom takpem ma, le ki sei bininfob ipiin.”

ref: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
text: (“U nan don papaab” a taai ye nii wee naa wɔɔn ke u nan jiirin kutingbɔŋ nan yaan a tum tum lee?

ref: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
text: Uma wan nan jiirin nin, le ye wan ji nan don papaab ki tan jon lagir kitilangbɔŋ bu naah li ŋa man wee un gbeen kutingbɔŋ nan biɛn.)

ref: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
text: Nin ti biɛn nan n nan fir kpaag bimɔb ti yada-n wee ki chegir ki biɛ Uwonbɔr a bija-n, wee ti binbemin gbee ki foo Masiya a binbemin a magir.

ref: We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place.
text: Taa ji yin ye nbuwaab tirimi, wee bilinlarib a wɔɔnimin li jɔɔ ti ki yeŋ ke kubulunkpoŋ kan wee kunyungbɔŋ daar ki yeŋ chaa kaah ban nan paami.

ref: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
text: Amaa ibamɔn nin njiɛm a pagim bu, ti yin nɔb le ki kpiɛ Masiya wan ye liyulin nin niwann biɛn a poolin.

ref: of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love. The Old Life and the New Life
text: U ma bu le ti gbanann tug ki ŋmag tab, le tigbanann nmɔn tug tab ki maa tab kpiɛg nin njiɛm, le ligbanann bɔgil biɛn tun litoonl. Limiɛfol pɔnl lan be Masiya ni

ref: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
text: Bi biɛm ye libunbɔnl le, le baa kpiɛ Uwonbɔr kaah sei limiɛfol lan nin yaan ni, nan bu-n baa nyi niba le ki sin ji ye tukangbirdam.

ref: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
text: N nyi naah gbir u bu, le bi tinn ni u bɔr ki wɔɔn ni ibamɔn yan be Yisa ni nmɔn.

ref: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
text: Bi nan wɔɔn ni, ki jiin ni binben kpegimin paam ke, ni nya ni binben kpegimin yaan na, mi ye kɔlisa birug kan lar ni le;

ref: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking
text: ki pɔŋ ni binbem nin ni potiɛl;

ref: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
text: wee ki ta tigbanann pɔnn tan wee Uwonbɔr nan naan nin ki yee ki li nann Uwonbɔr nin ibamɔn a buchinn nin kasi a binbem.

ref: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
text: Mambu ni laa ji por tibɔkar ki tenn tabi, uninfo biɛn li pag ibamɔn ki tenn u kunkɔɔn taba, ke ti biɛn ye tigbanann tiba a ninfob le.

ref: Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry
text: “Ni ye a ŋuul fii ke a laa tun tibiri”: Ki laa che nween n nan lu wee a ŋuul kaa la sɔŋi,

ref: and don't give the devil a chance.
text: ki laa sei Sintani nsan ni.

ref: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
text: Wan nan ti su ke, ni kpaa talar le un jiɛn nnaayigim, amaa wee ki li tun na, ki ta u tɔɔl a nɔɔi ki li ŋaan nan ŋan na, wee ki li fir kan niba ki por sei bilanjiim.

ref: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
text: Ni laa che tibɔbir nyann ni mɔn ni, amaa ni li pag nan li fir ter ni kpiɛtiib, wee nin ŋa tinyɔɔr ki sei ban peligin.

ref: Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
text: Ni laa bii Uwonbɔr a Kasi a Naaŋ a sufu, wan wee Uwonbɔr taah daag ni nkpenim a manugin a daal.

ref: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
text: Ni laa che ni pooi to tab bu, ni laa che ni ŋuui fii wee ni gaan tijar tab bu, ni laa kɔn ki sugir tabi, nima nmɔn nin kininaŋ biɛn ni.

ref: Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
text: Ni li ŋaan tab tiŋanna, ki li san tab kunyunyunbaaga, ki li jiɛn tab a bir ki per ke Uwonbɔr kaah jiɛn per ti Masiya bu man nin.

ref: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
text: Mambu ni li toog Uwonbɔr a, naah ye U bijiɛkaamin,

ref: Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
text: ki li be njiɛm a binbema, ke Masiya kaah jiɛ ti ki ta u ba ki mann kumanug kan jɔɔ nbaam mɔɔm ki sei Uwonbɔr ti bu man nin.

ref: You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy.
text: Amaa ni laa che ti gbir iwanchɔgin toon lipiibanlin bee lijabanlin a wama ni sisiigin ni, bee ki laa tun tijaginn a toon iba, bee kujaŋuuŋ, nan bu-n naa ŋan nin Uwonbɔr a Kasi a ninfob li be man ni.

ref: Don't use dirty or foolish or filthy words. Instead, say how thankful you are.
text: Ki jiɛn ifa a geli nin ijɔr leen nin igel pɔɔr yan kaa kpaan ni, amaa nan kpaan nin ti li ŋaan ye liwonpagil le.

ref: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
text: Ni nyi ni niɛ nan bu: Ke uninfo wan tun iwanchɔgin toon upiibanlin bee ujabanlin, bee tijaginn a toon, bee kujaŋuuŋ ke, u yaa daan ye utingban kɔɔr le, le kaa na yin kan niba Masiya nin Uwonbɔr a naamin ni.

ref: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
text: Ni laa che uba n ta tibɔyɔɔr nan ki lar ni, ni ma che Uwonbɔr a ŋuul fii ban kaa jɔɔ limɔcheelin bu.

ref: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
text: Mambu ni laa jɔɔ nɔɔ nin tab nin bi.

ref: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
text: Ni gbaa tɔɔl la nan be libunbɔnlin le, amaa le ti Yudaau bu, ni nin kpann ban be nwonweenin le daandaan nan. Mambu ni li be ke nwonween a buwaaba,

ref: as you try to please the Lord.
text: ni baan ki biɛ nan gbee Uyudaan a num.

ref: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
text: Ni laa che ni nɔɔ be libunbɔnl a toon yan kaa jɔɔ nyɔɔr nmɔn yaan ni, amaa wee ki nyan ti npaan ni na.

ref: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
text: Ni ye ifa le nin uninfo n pag limɔyiildaan nmɔn kaah woog ki tun nan a bɔr.

ref: But the light will show what these things are really like.
text: Amaa ni ye nwonween wonn niwann biɛn bu ke, ni nya npaan ni le ki ga,

ref: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
text: nwonween le wonn niwann biɛn bu le ti ga. Mambu le ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke, “Fin wan dɔ jiɛn nan, ligira, fii nkumin na, wee Masiya a wonweem nwonn a bu.”

ref: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
text: Mambu ni laa be ijɔrig a binbemi, amaa ni biɛm Uyudaan a bam kaah ye man.

ref: Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life.
text: Ni laa nyu ndaam ki gbee, ke lidanyulin le nwanchɔgin binben nya, amaa wee ki che Uwonbɔr a Kasi a Naaŋin gbeen ni.

ref: When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart.
text: Ni li pag tenn tab nin ilan na, liwonpagil a lan, nin Kinaaŋ a lan. Ki li gaah ilan ki pagir Uyudaan ni sufu-n na,

ref: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
text: ni li pagir ti Baa Uwonbɔr iyoo biɛn nin niwann biɛn nin na ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a yinl bu. Biniinpiib nin bichiɛb a bɔr

ref: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
text: Biniinpiib, ni taam ni ba ki sei ni chiɛb ke naah ta ni ba ki sei Uyudaan man nin.

ref: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
text: Nan bu-n uja le ye u poo a yudaau ke Masiya kaah ye biwonjiɛm a yudaau man nin, biwonjiɛm le ye Masiya a gbanann, le U mu ye bi feeru.

ref: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
text: Piidam, ni li jiɛ ni piiba, ke Masiya kaah jiɛ biwonjiɛm man wee ki kpo bi bu-n,

ref: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
text: ki nan ban bi li be kasi, ki nan ta Uwonbɔr a mɔleen ki ŋunn bi nnyumin,

ref: Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
text: naah li ŋa man wee un ta biwonjiɛm a laguŋ kan nyaginin ki sei u baa, wee tijaginn tiba laa sal bi ni bee bi laa jɔɔ tijaginn ni bee igalin iba, amaa wee ki li be kasi ki laa jɔɔ igalin ni.

ref: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
text: Ni ye man le, piidam ye bi li jiɛ bi piib le ke bi tɔɔl a gbanann nin. Uja wan jiɛ u poo ke u jiɛ u ba le.

ref: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
text: Nan bu-n, uba kaa be ki nan u tɔɔl a gbanann ni, amaa u jinn ti le ki mann ti, ke Masiya kaah mann biwonjiɛm man nin,

ref: because we are each part of his body.
text: nan bu-n tim li ye U gbanann nmɔn a bɔgi.

ref: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
text: “Ni niɛ nan bu le uja ye un nya u baa nin u na ban le uma nin u poo nkpaag bimɔb, wee bi bilee nmɔn lagin ki ŋa gbanann tiba.”

ref: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
text: Ti ye tibɔr bamɔn tan woo le, amaa min pag Masiya nin biwonjiɛm a laguŋ a bɔr le.

ref: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
text: Ni ma bu, ni biɛn nan li jiɛ ni piib ke naah jiɛ ni ba man nin, wee uniinpii mu li tenn u chal jilimau.

ref: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
text: Nbuwaab, Uyudaan bu ni li cheel ni baam nin ni nam a mɔba, ke man le ŋan.

ref: Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord. Slaves and Masters
text: Bibaam, ni laa fiin ni buwaab a ŋuui; amaa ni tinn bi nbamɔma ki wɔɔn bi ti Yudaau a bɔr. Biyom nin biyudam a bɔr

ref: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
text: Biyom, ni li jɔɔ limɔcheel nin jilima ki tenn ni dulinya a yudam ki li san bi bijawaam, ki li tun itoon ki tenn bi nin ni sufu biɛn, ke naah bi li jɔɔ limɔcheel ki tenn Masiya man nin.

ref: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
text: Ni laa jɔɔ limɔcheel ki tenn bi ke bi num ngbee ni n-yonn man wee bi be ni ban ni, amaa ni li jɔɔ limɔcheel nan li gbee Uwonbɔr a num nin ni sufu biɛn naah ye Masiya a yomin bu.

ref: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
text: Ni li tun biyom a toon kaah ye man nin ni sufu biɛn na wee ni li ye ke ni tun tenn Uyudaan le amaa naa ye bininfobi.

ref: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
text: Nan bu-n ni nyi ke Uyudaan na li yɔ uninfo biɛn u toon ŋan kaah ye man, ŋaah ye uyom bee ŋaah ye a ba.

ref: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites. The Fight against Evil
text: Le nim biyudam, ni mu li ŋaan ni yomi tiŋanna, ki laa kɔɔn bi bijawaami, ki li nyi ke nim nin bi ma a yudaau be papaab le, waa gann uba ki jiɛn u tɔ. Uwonbɔr a gbaginu nin tijawann a bɔr

ref: Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong.
text: Nan joor ye nan le, ni li jɔɔ ngbananpɔɔn nin Uyudaan nin u pɔɔn takpemin bu.

ref: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
text: Ni ta Uwonbɔr a gbaginu ki yeeu wee ki fir to ulinlaril nin u lol birimin.

ref: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.
text: Taa kɔnn nin bininfob ban ye tigbanann nin nchamin ni, amaa ti kɔnn nin nnaam a pɔɔm, nin tininkper a pɔɔm, nin dulinya nan a bunbɔnl a pɔɔm, nin nnaanbiim man be paabin a pɔɔm.

ref: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
text: Mambu ni ta Uwonbɔr a gbaginu-n ki yeeu, wee ni ye lidabiril daal nmɔn nan foon ke, ni fir baan ki sir, wee ni bɔɔn bu ni ye ni fir ŋa niwann biɛn ki yin sir ke.

ref: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
text: Ni mann ki baan sir nbamɔm, ki ta ibamɔn a changbam ki lol ni cham, ki li jɔɔ nbuchin binben man be ke tukur tan wee bi jɔɔ piig ligbingbanl bu-n,

ref: Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet.
text: ki ŋaam sili ki ta tibɔŋann tan tenn nposɔɔn nin ki kpann inaatag ki tag.

ref: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
text: Nan kpiɛ ni niɛ nan biɛn bu ye, ni ta yada ki kpann nan li guu ni wee ni fir ki ŋmar ulinlaril a piin yan nyɔɔr nŋmi-n.

ref: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
text: Ni ta feeja kpann utɔtogir a jabig ki chig, nin Uwonbɔr a bɔŋann tan ye Kasi a Naaŋ a takoobi ki li ŋmag.

ref: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.
text: Ki li miɛ ki tenn n mu ni, wee ni ye n-yonn man n nan yaar n mɔb ke, n fir kan tibɔr ki mɔɔn tibɔwoonkaar nan ki laa san bijawaami,

ref: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
text: tibɔwoonkaar nmɔn bu le n ye ntoon le bi lolim tikulor nan, ni li miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn ma, wee n fir ki mɔɔn tibɔŋann nmɔn naah kpaan nin n mɔɔn ti man ki laa san bijawaami. Njoorim a poori

ref: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
text: Ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a posɔɔm, nin u jiɛm, nin yada li be ti nabumin biɛn bu.

ref: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl li be ban biɛn jiɛ ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya nin njiɛm man kaa jɔɔ diɛmin.

ref: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
text: Min Pɔɔl nin Timoti, tim ban ye Masiya a yomi, Le sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn Uwonbɔr a ninfob gannkaab ban be Masiya nin ki be Filipi a tiŋin, ki kpiɛ ban ye biwonjiɛn sanliib nin bititeribin:

ref: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
text: Ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl nin nposɔɔn li be nin ni. Pɔɔl kaah nan miɛ Uwonbɔr sei Filipi yaab man

ref: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
text: N tenn Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpoog n-yonn man biɛn wee n tiɛr ni bu.

ref: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
text: Iyoo biɛn ni ye n miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn ni biɛn nan ke, n miɛ nin nmɔn le,

ref: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
text: nan bu-n naah terim man tibɔŋann nmɔn a toon yin npiinim ki nan kpaa daandaan nan,

ref: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
text: n jɔɔ tidindann, ki nyi ke Uwonbɔr wan piin itoon ŋan nan nin ni-n, u yin ŋmag ni man le hali nin n-yonn man wee u na yin diɛ itoon ŋan nmɔn, Masiya a jirin daal.

ref: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
text: Ni ŋan nin maah tiɛr ni biɛn nan bu, naah be n sufu-n nin bu; maah be libaalin bee maah pag ki wɔɔn ki mann tibɔŋannin, ni biɛn nan por Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanlin nin ma.

ref: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
text: Uwonbɔr le ye n siɛradaau, ki nyi maah ban n kan ni bu man nin Masiya a jiɛmin.

ref: I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand
text: N miɛ Uwonbɔr le ke: Ni jiɛm nmɔn n mann ki kpiɛ ki ji kpiɛ ni nlamin nin nbiɛmin,

ref: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
text: wee nin che ni fir ki gann niwann nan ŋan ki be kasi kaa jɔɔ igalin ki nan kpaa Masiya a dan daal,

ref: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
text: ki gbee nin nbuchin binben man nyan Yisa Masiya ni, ki li ye kupag ki tenn Uwonbɔr. Masiya bu le ti be

ref: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
text: N nabum, n ban ni biɛ ke niwann nan ŋaam nan bu le che tibɔŋann nmɔn fir mɔɔn.

ref: The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ.
text: Ni ma nan che bitɔtogib ban guu ibɔr niin nin, nin ibɔrniin a ninfob biɛn nan biɛ ke Masiya bu le n be libaalin.

ref: Now most of the Lord's followers have become brave and are fearlessly telling the message.
text: N baal nan bu, ni che n nabum takpem ban nɔɔ Uyudaan a samin, pɔɔg bi gbanann ki pag Uwonbɔr a bɔrin nin lipoobil kaa san bijawaami.

ref: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
text: Ni ye ibamɔn le ke, biba mɔɔn Masiya a bɔr nmɔn ki jɔɔ linunchɔril le nin lipiiponl, amaa le biba mu mɔɔn ti nin ti ŋam bu.

ref: They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him.
text: Ban tun nin njiɛmin bi ma nyi ke Uwonbɔr le taam ŋa do ke n ji tibɔŋann nan a siɛra.

ref: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
text: Ban tun nin linunchɔril nin lipiiponl mɔɔn ti nin kujaŋuuŋ le, naa nan ye lipotiɛŋanli, ki tiɛr ke bin ban tibɔr ki jaa min bu n-yonn man wee bi nan baanim tikulorin.

ref: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
text: Ke ni niɛ nan yin ŋa baa? Nan kpaa talar le ye baah mɔɔn Masiya a bɔrin nsan man biɛn bu-n, naah ye tipotiɛbir bee ibamɔn a sam buu, Masiya a bɔrin pii mɔɔn na. Mambu ni mɔm le. Nn ni le yin gbaa mɔm le,

ref: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
text: ni ma bu le n nyi ke ni wonmiɛl nin Masiya a Naaŋin yaa terim bu, nan dan n bu nan biɛn li labir ki seim nŋmarim.

ref: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
text: N nunman nin n tama ye le ke, n laa ji ifa, amaa wee ki li jɔɔ lipoobil daandaan nan nin iyoo biɛn, hali ni ye n kpo le bee n fo ke ni, n che Masiya a yinl nkan ndom n gbanann nin.

ref: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
text: Min bu ke, ni ye n fo be ke, Masiya bu le n be, n mu ti ji kpo ke, ni ye tinyɔɔr le.

ref: I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful.
text: Ni ye n be ki fo nin n gbanann ke, n toon yin li lo iloon. Nin ni ma biɛn ni n yin gann ni labaa? Maa nyi!

ref: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
text: N be niwann nilee nmɔn a sisiigin le: N sufu ban ke n nya dulinya nan yaan ki tan li be Masiya ban, ni ma ŋan takpem;

ref: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
text: Ni niɛ bu ni che n biɛ ke n la li be, ki li gbaa be nin ni wee ni jo nintogil nin nmɔn nin yada,

ref: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
text: wee n ji nan be ni ban ke, ni mɔm man wee ni jɔɔ nin Masiya nan n mann gbeen ni min bu.

ref: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
text: Nan biɛn ŋa ke, ni che ni binbem li be ke Masiya a bɔŋann nin kaah wɔɔn ni man ni. Wee ni ye n dan ni ban ki nan gɔnn ni bee maa dan ni wee ki sin gbir ni bu ke, n li nyi ke ni si nbamɔm nin kinaaŋ kiba, ki lagin jɔɔ lipotiɛl liba ki kɔn ni yada wan wee ni jɔɔ tibɔŋann nin bu,

ref: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
text: naah kaa san bininfob ban fann ni nan. Ni ma ye siɛra ki wɔɔn bi ke baa li kan nnyaŋim mi, amaa nim li kan n nŋmarim man nyan Uwonbɔr ban.

ref: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
text: Uwonbɔr pii sei ni nsan ke ni li tun tenn Masiya wee ni laa pa ye naah ŋa u yada n yaa binba, amaa ke ni ji fala mu u bu.

ref: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
text: Ke ni tɔɔl kaah be ligbaal lan yaan wee ni kam wee n be-n, daandaan nan n le la be li ma yaan le nan.

ref: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
text: ni bi li mɔŋim pam ni ye ni potiɛl bi nann tab, wee ni jɔɔ njiɛm nba, ki jɔɔ kinaaŋ kiba nin ibonn iba.

ref: Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves.
text: Ni laa jɔɔ npooton a bam bee ki far igbingban ni, amaa ni li jɔɔ jiininba ki li tenn ni kpiɛtiib jilima ki jo ni ba.

ref: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
text: Ni che ni binbem li be ke Masiya a binbemin:

ref: Christ was truly God. But he did not try to remain equal with God.
text: U jɔɔ Uwonbɔr a nunaŋ le, amaa waa tiɛr ke un ta u ba kpaag nin Uwonbɔr bee niwann nan wee u li choo,

ref: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.
text: amaa u ŋa u baa le ke waa ye niba le-n, le ki jɔɔ uyom a binbem, le ki jɔɔ uninfosaal a nunaŋ.

ref: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
text: Ni ma bu le che Uwonbɔr don u papaab le ki sei u liyinl lan yab jon iyin biɛn,

ref: So at the name of Jesus everyone will bow down, those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth.
text: ke ni ye bi nan pur Yisa a yinl ke idun biɛn li gbaan tum, papaab nin tum nin kutingbɔŋ kan be tumtum nan,

ref: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
text: le lilanbil biɛn na li pag npaan ni ke Yisa Masiya le ye Uyudaan, wee Uwonbɔr wan ye ti Baa n kan kupag. Ni li nyagin ke nwonweenin dulinya nan yaan

ref: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
text: Ni ma bu n jɔtiib, naah jɔɔ limɔcheel n-yonn man wee n be ni ban nin, ni le li jɔɔ limɔcheel nmɔn n-yonn man wee maa nan be ni ban na, ni tugir ki li tun ke bininfob ban kan nŋmarimin ki li san bijawaam ki li jegila.

ref: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
text: Uwonbɔr le tun nin ni le ki che ni tun ni U bamin ke waah ban ni tun man.

ref: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
text: wee ki laa jɔɔ igalin ni ki li be kasi, ke Uwonbɔr a buwaab ban kaa jɔɔ igalin, naah be dulinya biig kan yaan nin titoonbirdam a sisiigin nin bu, wee ni li nyagin ke iŋmabil yan be kutingbɔŋ nan yaan nin,

ref: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
text: ke naah ta limiɛfol a bɔr wɔɔn bi man nin, naah li ŋa man wee n li fir fa ligbingbanl Masiya a jirin daal ke n taguunl nin n baginn kaa gab yɔli.

ref: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
text: Hali ni ye bi kpaarim le wur ke libawol a daam le bi ta mann kumanug ki jiin ni yada kan wee ni jɔɔ nin Uwonbɔr n bu ke, n pool peen le ni mɔm ni biɛn nan bu.

ref: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
text: Ni ma bu ni li jɔɔ npopeen wee ni li mɔ nin ma. Timoti nin Ipaforɔditusi

ref: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
text: N jɔɔ tama ke ni ye Uyudaan Yisa chee ke n li tun Timoti wee un dan ni ban weem, n mu bi li kan ngbananpɔɔn ni ye n gbir ni bu ke.

ref: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
text: Maa ji jɔɔ uba ki kpiɛ u bu, wee u baga sin be ni ni ibamɔn nin.

ref: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
text: Ban gurin biɛn a baga be bi baantɔɔl a toon yin le, naa ye Yisa Masiya a toon yin ni.

ref: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
text: Amaa ni tɔɔl nyi Timoti kaah pɔɔn u ba man, nan bu-n u be ke kibijag kaah be u baa a nintogil man nin le, u terim le tibɔŋann nmɔn a mɔɔnimin.

ref: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
text: N jɔɔ tama ke n tun u ni ban le weem ni ye n biɛ n bɔr a sam ke.

ref: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
text: Le n jɔɔ tidindann Uyudaan bu ke min tɔɔl li dan daandaan nan.

ref: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
text: Amaa n tiɛr ke ni ŋan nin n che n na a big Ipaforɔditusi wan ye n toontunn kpiɛg nin n tɔtog kpiɛg wee ki ji ye ni toom wee ni nan tun u wee u nan terimin n jirin ni ban.

ref: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
text: U bi ban un kan ni biɛn nan, u sufu kaa dɔ naah nan gbir ke u bu-n bu.

ref: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
text: Ni sin ye ibamɔn le, u nan buŋ ki yin kpo le, amaa le Uwonbɔr san u kunyunyunbaag, naa ye u binba bu, amaa u ji nan san n mu kunyunyunbaaga, le ki nyam npoobiin a booli yin.

ref: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
text: Ni ma bu n jɔɔ inunman ki ban un jirin ni ban, wee ni ye ni ji kan u ke nin mɔŋ ni wee n mu n nya n potiɛri nin.

ref: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
text: Ni gaam u nin nmɔn takpen uyudaan a yinl bu, ki sei bininfob ban be ke u ma nan jilimau,

ref: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
text: nan bu-n ni nan gur wama nin un kpo Masiya a toon yin bu, ki ta u miɛfol ki tun ki seim naah kaa bi li fir terim nan ni.

ref: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
text: Ni joorimin n nabum, ni che ni li mɔ ni Uyudaan buu! Naa ye tibɔr mugkaar ki seim nin n ji sɔb maah nan sɔb nan sei ni-n jigin ni, ni ma yin guu ni.

ref: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
text: Ni li nyi bininfob ban ye ibɔ nan, ki ye titoonbirdam wee ki jiil bi gbanann chɔr nan bu.

ref: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done,
text: Tim le ye ban gaa ibamɔn a pun jiil nmɔn, tim ban jiɛn Uwonbɔr kinaaŋin nin, le ki jɔɔ jilima taah be nin Masiya n bu, tim kaa jɔɔ tidindann tigbanann bu,

ref: although I could. Others may brag about themselves, but I have more reason to brag than anyone else.
text: min tɔɔl jɔɔ nan bu che n jɔɔ ti ma a dindann. Ni ma bu ni ye uninfo uba len ke u jɔɔ tidindann tigbanann bu ke, min jɔɔ takpem ki jon wa:

ref: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
text: Baah nan mam a ween iniin daal le bi nan jii n punl, n ye Iziral a ninfou le, ki nyan Bɛnjamɛnn a bolin, ki ye Hiiburu a ninfou tob tob; ki jiin nsiim mu paam ke, n ye Farasii le;

ref: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
text: ni ye nsiim nmɔn a ŋmagim a nunmanl bu ke, n nan mugir biwonjiɛm a laguŋ; ni ye nbuchin binben nin limɔcheel ki tenn nsiimin ke, maa jɔɔ igalin ni.

ref: But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless.
text: Amaa nan biɛn nan ye tinyɔɔr ki seimin daandaan nan min lig ki miin ni ye yɔli le, Masiya bu.

ref: Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ
text: Ni la yab ki jon ni tɔɔ, maah ta niwann biɛn gab nin maah gaa Masiya n yudaau wan jɔɔ tinyɔɔr ki jon niwann biɛn nin, uma bu le n ta niwann biɛn gab. Min ban ke ni ye lifatanpol a mɔɔr le naah li ŋa man wee n fir ki gaa Masiya,

ref: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.
text: wee ki li be nin u, wee ki laa jɔɔ min tɔɔl a buchin binbem man nyan nsiimin yaan ni, amaa maah ŋa Masiya yada n bu le n jɔɔ nbuchin binben man nyan Uwonbɔr ban n yada n bu.

ref: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did,
text: N ban n li nyi Masiya le nin u kum a fiim a pɔɔmin ki li jɔɔ nɔɔnintab nin u, ki ji fala wan wee u nan jin nin, ki li be ke uma nin u kumin,

ref: so that somehow I also may be raised to life. Running toward the Goal
text: ni ye niwann biɛn ke, n na li kan nkum a fiim. Li guu chaa a num kaah paa nan bu-n ban

ref: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
text: Naa wɔɔn ke min nyaŋ ni niɛ biɛn le, bee min yaa binbem ŋan ki tan diɛ, amaa n pɔɔn nba le ki gbaar n choo nan bu wee Masiya nan choo min.

ref: My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead.
text: N nabum, maa tiɛr ke n baan tɔɔl a nɔɔ la ŋub ni. Amaa maah ŋa man ye nan le: N tam nan pii tun jon nin bu le ki gbaar ban nan la be n nintogilin bu,

ref: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
text: n jɔɔ inunman le ki gu chaa n num kaah paa nan bu-n ban ke n tan pii tiyɔr tan bu wee Uwonbɔr yim papaab Masiya bu-n.

ref: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
text: Tim ban biɛn chegir Uwonbɔr a samin nin li jɔɔ potiɛl liba ti sufu ni. Ni ye ni potiɛi kaa nan chee nan bu ke, Uwonbɔr li che ni biɛ ni taai.

ref: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
text: Ni le yin che ti li be nin taah nan kan nan nin.

ref: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
text: N nabum, nim nin ni tabin biɛn li nɔɔ maah mag man ki wɔɔn ni nna, wee ki biɛ ban a binbem nɔɔ nsan man wee ti nan sei ni-n.

ref: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again
text: A li ke maah pii gbaa bei ni man nin, hali ki nin bei ni nin tinyinyinn ke, bininfob biba a binbem ŋa Masiya a dapunpunlin a dataag le.

ref: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
text: Bi na yin joor nŋmi-n le, bi weem le ye bi pooi, le bi pag ye bi fai. Bi potiɛl biɛn be dulinya nan a wan yɔɔrin le.

ref: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
text: Amaa tim ye papaab a tinbum le. Ti ŋa sili le ki guu ufeer wan yin nya niin ki dan nin, Uma ye Uyudaan Yisa Masiya,

ref: has power over everything, and he will make these poor bodies of ours like his own glorious body.
text: Uma wan ta u pɔɔm ki lagin niwann biɛn u nintogilin, u li kpenn ti gbanann tan kaa pɔɔ-n ki ŋa ti u jilima a gbanann.

ref: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
text: Ni ma bu n nabum, nim ban wee n ban wee ki yuur ni kam nan, nim li ye n mɔm nin n naan yuchigirig, njɔtiib, ni ma bu le ni kpaan ni mann sir nbamɔm Uyudaan a samin!

ref: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
text: N balin Yuwodiɛ le ki balin Sintiche ke, Uyudaan bu bin pɔɔn biba ki li jɔɔ nmɔkpaau.

ref: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
text: Ni ye ibamɔn le n bei nim ban ye n naajadaag tug tab bamɔm nan, ni ter bipiib ban pɔɔn biba ki kpiɛ n bu wee ti mɔɔn tibɔŋann nan na, nin Kilɛmenn nin ban biɛn ye n toontunn tabin, wee bi yin be limiɛfol a gbɔŋin yaan nin.

ref: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
text: Ni che ni li mɔ ni naah be Uyudaan nin iyoo biɛn na. N ji yin mann bei ni le ke: Ni che ni li mɔ na!

ref: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
text: Ni ta ni binbenŋamin ki che ni li ye siɛra ki sei bininfob biɛn na. Ke Uyudaan malin na.

ref: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
text: Ni laa jɔɔ npotiɛ bii-n ni niwann niba bu, amaa ki li miɛ Uwonbɔr naah ban nan bu, ki li tenn U kunɔɔpoog, ki bei U naah ban nan.

ref: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
text: Le Uwonbɔr a posɔɔm, man yab ki lagir uninfosaal a biɛm bu-n le che ni ŋmag Masiya ni sufu ni nin ni potiɛlin.

ref: Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise.
text: Ni joorimin, n nabum, nan ye ibamɔn, nin nan ye jilima, nin nan ŋan, nin nan be kasi, nin nan ye njiɛm, nin linungbeel, ni ye niwann ŋan ki tan lagir bee ki be kasi ke, ni li tiɛr tiwann nmɔn buu.

ref: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
text: Niwann nan wee ni tinn n ban bee ki gaa n ban bee ki gbir n ban nin ni li jɔɔ tun itoon na man. Wee nposɔɔn a Wonbɔr win li be nin ni. Waah poor ipiin bu man

ref: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
text: Uyudaan bu ni mɔŋim pam nin n-yonn takpem man jon wee ni ji nan mann wɔɔn ni baga kaah be n ni man. Ni ye ibamɔn le, ni baga be n ni, amaa naa jɔɔ npaan man wee ni ta wɔɔn le.

ref: I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have.
text: Naa ye maah lann niba bu le n pag man nin, amaa n tinn le ki che n num gbee maah jɔɔ nan n-yonn biɛn nin.

ref: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
text: N nyi maah kaa nan jɔɔ niba ke ni ye man, ki ji nyi maah nan jɔɔ takpem mu ke ni ye man. N tinn le ki nyi liwool lan ye linungbeel naah ye man niwann biɛn nin, ni baga kaa be maah jin gbee bee maah choon nin nkomi, ni baga kaa be maah jɔɔ takpem bee maah kaa jɔɔ.

ref: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
text: N li fir tun niwann biɛn Masiya kaah seim ngbananpɔɔn man nin bu.

ref: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
text: Amaa ni nan tun tiŋann pam nin naah nan terim n bɔr mugkaarin.

ref: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
text: Nan kpiɛ ni bu, nim Filipi yaab nyi, maah nan nyan Masedoniya, n-yonn man nan jon wee n nan chonn mɔɔn tibɔŋannin nin, biwonjiɛm a laguŋ kiba kaa la nyi ki terim niba nseimin nin ngamin ni, see nim a binba;

ref: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
text: hali maah la nan be Tesalonika n-yonn man wee ki nan ban literilin, ni le nan gbaa terim le.

ref: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
text: Naa ye n ban ipiin le, amaa n ban ni kan tinyɔɔr tan yin kpiɛ naah jɔɔ nan nin le.

ref: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
text: N gaa tiyɔr takpem ke ti yab tan lagira; n nin jɔɔ nan biɛn wee n ban, maah gaa ipiin yan biɛn wee ni nan ta sein Ipaforɔditusi n ni. Ki ye kumanug kan jɔɔ nbaam mɔɔm wee Uwonbɔr a num gbee le.

ref: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
text: Le n Wonbɔru li ta U jilima a jɔɔm man be Masiya nin ki sei ni.

ref: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
text: Ti Baa Uwonbɔr n gaam kupag n-yonn nin n-yonn. Ibamɔn. Ipoor yan joor

ref: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
text: Ni poor Uwonbɔr a ninfogannkaabin biɛn Masiya a yinl buu. N nabum man be n ban nin poor ni.

ref: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
text: Uwonbɔr a ninfogannkaab biɛn poor ni, naah tɔɔ ban bu ubɔr Siiza a niin yaab ke n poor ni nbamɔma.

ref: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
text: Uyudaan Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl li be ni naamin. Ibamɔn.

ref: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
text: Pɔɔl wan ye Masiya a toom Uwonbɔr a bam bu-n, nin ti na a big Timoti,

ref: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
text: Le sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn nim ban ye ti nabum ban be kasi ki si bogil liba Masiya ni Kolosiya a tiŋin ni. Ti Baa Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl nin u posɔɔm li be nin ni. Kunɔɔpoog a wonmiɛl

ref: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Ti tenn Uwonbɔr wan ye ti Yudaau Yisa a Baa-n kunɔɔpoog, iyoo yan biɛn wee ti miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn ni-n,

ref: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
text: nan bu-n ti gbir naah ŋa Yisa yada man, nin naah jiɛ Uwonbɔr a ninfo gannkaabin man na,

ref: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
text: yada nin njiɛm man bun ki nya tama kan dɔ papaab ki guu ni, wee ni pii gbir ibamɔn a mɔleen yan ye tibɔŋann nin,

ref: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
text: wee ki dan ni ban nin. Tibɔŋann nmɔn lo iloon le ki yabirig dulinya nan yaan biɛn, ke naah nan ti tun man ni sisiigin lidaal lan wee ni nan gbir ti, ki biɛ Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanlin nin libamɔn yan be ipoolin nin biɛn.

ref: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
text: Ni nan tinn Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl nmɔn ti toontunn kpiɛg Epafarasi wan wee ti ban win ban le, wan sir ti taalin ki ye Yisa a toontunnu wan si bogil liba-n,

ref: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
text: Ni niɛ nan bu, lidaal lan wee ti gbir ni bu-n, taa ta Uwonbɔr a miɛm ni bu ki jiɛn ni, le ki le miɛ Uwonbɔr ke Un gbeen ni nnyinyin man ye u bam ki sei ni kinaaŋ a lam nin nbiɛm.

ref: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
text: Ti miɛ ni niɛ le ke ni fir be nbinben man kpaan ki gbee Uyudaan a num niwann biɛn nin: Ki lo iloon yan ye itoon ŋan biɛn a looi, ki yabirig nin Uwonbɔr a nyinyim.

ref: His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.
text: Uma Uwonbɔr wan jɔɔ ipɔɔn biɛn nan n pɔɔg ni gbanann, U pag takpoŋin bu wee ni li jɔɔ pɔɔninba nin limɔril nin nmɔn,

ref: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
text: wee ni li tenn ti Baa Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpoog, wan sei ni npaan ke nim nin uninfo gannkaabin nan por lifaal lan be nwonween a naam a yerin nin yaan nin.

ref: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
text: Nan bu-n U fee ti libunbɔnl a pɔɔmin na, le ki ta ti ki kɔɔn u bijiɛkaag a naam a yerin nin,

ref: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
text: Masiya le ye Uwonbɔr wan wee taa ga win a nunaŋ, uma ye kibininkpeeg kan yab jon kuwonaaŋ biɛn.

ref: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
text: Uma bu le niwann biɛn nan naan: Nan be papaab nin tum, nan wee ti ga nin nan wee taa ga, naah ye kunaangbɔŋ bee ipɔɔn bee nnaam a pɔɔm bee tininkper a pɔɔm; uma nan naan niwann biɛn le ki ye niwann biɛn.

ref: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
text: U nan be ke niwann niba kaa la nan be, uma bu le niwann biɛn choo tab ki ŋmag.

ref: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
text: Uma ye tigbanann a yudaau, biwonjiɛm a laguŋ; ki ye npiinim nin kibininkpeeg kan nyan bitakpiib a sisiigin. Naah li ŋa man wee u li ye wan chinn niwann biɛn ni.

ref: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
text: Nan bu-n, Uwonbɔr nan jɔɔ linungbeel le u bu, U binbemin biɛn kaah nan gbee u ni-n.

ref: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
text: Uma bu le Uwonbɔr nan che niwann biɛn jir mɔŋ nin tab, Yisa a cham man nan nyan lidapunpunl bu-n le che nposɔɔn dan.

ref: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
text: Iyoo iba naa nan kpiɛ Uwonbɔr a ninfobin ni, ki ye Uwonbɔr a dataam ni potiɛlin nin ni binben biimin bu.

ref: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
text: Amaa daandaan nan, Masiya a gbanann a kum nbu le Uwonbɔr jir ki mɔŋ nin ni, ke Un ta ni sei wee ni li be kasi u numin, ki laa jɔɔ tijaginn wee bin galin ni,

ref: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
text: ni ye ni yin gbaa be nin ni yada ke, ki si chib, kaa fɔɔr tama kan wee tibɔŋann nin ŋmagin ke, ti ma ye tibɔŋann tan wee ni gbirin, wee bi mɔɔn ti sei kuwonaaŋ biɛn dulinya nan yaan, tan bu wee min Pɔɔl kpann utoontunn. Pɔɔl a toon kaah ye man biwonjiɛm a laguŋin

ref: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
text: Daandaan nan ni mɔm, nin maah jin fala kan nim bu-n, le n la gbee nin fala nmɔn le n gbanann nin ki jin nan la paar Masiya a fala a jimin paam, u gbanann nmɔn le ye biwonjiɛm a laguŋ.

ref: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
text: N nin kpann biwonjiɛm a laguŋin a toontunnu le, litoonl lan wee Uwonbɔr ta seimin, ke n ta U mɔleen yin biɛn ki sei ni,

ref: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
text: tibɔwoonkaar tan wee Uwonbɔr nan woon ibin nin n-yonn man nan jon nin, amaa wee U nin kpiir ki wɔɔn U ninfogannkaabin daandaan nan.

ref: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
text: Bininfogannkaab nmɔn le Uwonbɔr nan gann ke bin kpiir liwool a bɔrin ki wɔɔn ban kaa ye Juu yaabin, liwool a pag kan yabin, ni ma ye Masiya wan be nin ni-n, ki ye kupag a tama-n.

ref: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.
text: Yisa nmɔn le ti mɔɔn, ki kpaan bininfob ki wɔɔn bi nlam a booli biɛn, naah li ŋa man wee ti ŋa uninfob biɛn kasi ki sei Uwonbɔr, Masiya ni.

ref: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
text: Ni niɛ nan bu le n tun ki gbaar nin u pɔɔm biɛn man pɔɔ lagir ki be nni ki tun nin.

ref: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
text: Nan bu-n n ban ni biɛ maah gbaar nim nin Laodisiya yaab bu man le, nin ban kaa laa nyi kan min tɔɔlin.

ref: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
text: N lol ye n che bi sufu le npɔɔg, wee bi lagin tab nin njiɛm, wee bi li jɔɔ nbiɛm man yab, wee ki li fir biɛ Uwonbɔr a bɔwoonkaar ti ma ye Masiya,

ref: but all wisdom and knowledge are hidden away in him.
text: uma ban le nlamgɔrikaam nin nnyinyin gbee le ki woo.

ref: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
text: N bei ni ni niɛ le, ni laa che uba n ta limɔkpel lan nann ibamɔn nin ki lar ni.

ref: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
text: Nan bu-n, hali maah kaa be ni ban nin tigbanann ni, n be ni ban kinaaŋin le ni mɔm, le ban n kan naah si nbamɔm man nin naah ŋmag ni yada-n man kenken Masiya ni. Limiɛfol lan gaa ngbeenim Masiya nin

ref: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.
text: Ni ma bu, naah pii nan gaa Masiya ke Uyudaan nan, ni li gbaa be u ban na,

ref: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
text: ki baan inyaan ki yabig nin uma, ki pɔɔg ni yada-n ke baah nan wɔɔn ni man nin, ki che ni nɔɔpoog li yaba ki tenn Uwonbɔr.

ref: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
text: Ni laa che uba n ta uninfosaal a biɛm man kaa jɔɔ nyɔɔrin ki lar ni kɔɔn tiyomirin ni, ni ma nyan bininfob a kaalin le nin kutingbɔŋ nan a maabiyiɛrugin, naa nyan Yisa ban ni.

ref: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
text: le Uwonbɔr ta Masiya le ki gbeen ni, wan ye npɔɔn biɛn nin tininkper a pɔɔm a yudaau win.

ref: Christ has also taken away your selfish desires, just as circumcision removes flesh from the body.
text: Masiya ni le ni kan lipunjiil, ki nyan tibir a binbemin, naa ye lipunjiil lan wee bininfosaalib ta bi nɔɔi ki jii amaa Masiya le jii ni

ref: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
text: n-yonn man wee bi nan lagin pii ni nin Masiya Uwonbɔr a nyunfulin ni, wee ni ji fii nkumin nin Masiya ni yada-n Uwonbɔr a pɔɔm man nan fii-n u nkumin ni.

ref: You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
text: Ni nan ye bitakpiib le ni birin n-yonn iba, le kaa jɔɔ lipunjiil a bir a binbemin, le Uwonbɔr che ni jɔɔ limiɛfol Masiya ni. Le ki jiɛn per ti biɛn nan a bir,

ref: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.
text: Uwonbɔr nan pir nsiim nin mi sɔbim man kaa nan chee sei ti-n, wee ki kɔn nin ti nle ki choo mi nyan le ki kpaa mi lidapunpunl bu.

ref: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
text: Masiya kaah nan nyaŋ bitindam nin tininkper a pɔɔmin, u nan nyan bi npaan ni le ki che bininfob biɛn kan bi le ki ŋa bi tiyomirin waah nan nyaŋ bi lidapunpunl bu-n.

ref: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
text: Mambu, ni laa che uba n ji ni tibɔr naah ji tijiir tan bee naah nyu nan bu bee ki jiin liwonjiɛnl a chiig paam bee uŋmapɔɔn a chiig bee likpakɔɔl daal a chiig bu.

ref: These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
text: Ti nan le ye tiwann tan yin dan nin a jinjiim amaa niwann bamɔn nin be Masiya ni le.

ref: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.
text: Ni laa che uba n ta tibɔkar a jiininba nin malakam a jiɛnim ki lar ni wee ni lann ni yɔri. U yaa daan nɔɔ waah ga nan biɛn tininforin nin le, naa ye kinaaŋin ni, u donn uba u potiɛlin le naa jɔɔ bu.

ref: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
text: Waa ji tug nin Masiya wan ye ni yulin ni, wan bu wee tigbanann biɛn tugin, uma ŋmag tigbanann le ti ŋmag tab nin tijiin, le ti yabirig ke Uwonbɔr kaah ban ti li yabirig man. Taah kpeg ki fo nin Masiya man

ref: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
text: Ni nan lagin ki kpo nin Yisa ki sei kutingbɔŋ a maabiyiɛrugaa, ba ŋaa wee ni la be ke ni ye kutingbɔŋ nan a ninfob lee, ni chee sei kutingbɔŋ nmɔn a siim man ke:

ref: “Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”?
text: “Laa ŋmagi! Laa lenn ni! Laa maa n lee!”?

ref: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
text: Ni niɛ nan biɛn ye ti wonleen le ki yin boon nin taah jɔɔ nan tun, nan bu-n ni ye uninfosaal a siim nin nwɔɔm le.

ref: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
text: Ibamɔn, nsiim nmɔn nann man jɔɔ nlamgɔrikaam le, nin bi tɔɔl a bam a wonjiɛnl, nin bi bɔkar a jiininba, nin baah mug ki ŋmag bi gbanann man, amaa baa ŋmag nsiim man jɔɔ tinyɔɔr ki li nyan bi tigbanann a kɔlisa nin ni.

ref: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
text: Mambu, ni nan fii nin Yisa nkumin na, ni ta ni sufu ki sei paab a naamin a wan yɔɔrin na, nan yaan wee Yisa ka Uwonbɔr a nɔɔjiim paamin.

ref: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
text: Ni ta ni potiɛl ki ŋa paab a naam a wann bu-u, ki laa ta ni potiɛl ki ŋa dulinya nan a wan yɔɔr bu.

ref: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.
text: Nan bu-n ni kpou, le ni miɛfol woo Masiya ni le ki be Uwonbɔr ban.

ref: Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
text: Masiya wan ye ni miɛfolin nan degirin ke, iyaayoo nim nin uma na li degirin nin kupag. Limiɛfol kpegil nin limiɛfol pɔnl

ref: Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols.
text: Mambu ni ku nan ye dulinya nan a binbem man be nin ni na: Nan ye iwanchɔgin toon, nin ni piibanlin bee ni jabanlin, nin tijaginn a toon, nin nmɔsanyunsɔɔm, nin titoonbir nin kujaŋuuŋ ni ma ye libawol manil.

ref: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.
text: Ni niɛ nan bu Uwonbɔr a ŋuufiiŋ chaan ban tun man nmɔn bu.

ref: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
text: Ni nan ti jɔɔ man a binben n-yonn man wee ni nan be-n.

ref: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
text: Amaa daandaan nan ni kpaa le nin ni choo ni ba nyan ni niɛ biɛn nin, ni ma ye liŋuul, nin kiŋuufiiŋ, nin kininaŋ, nin kutingbiig nin timɔleenbir tan nya ti mɔɔŋi yin.

ref: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
text: Ni laa por tibɔkar ki tenn ni tabi, nan bu-n ni pii pir ni binben kpeg a ŋaarin ki gaba,

ref: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
text: ki yee nbinben pɔɔn le, nbinbem nmɔn le Uwonbɔr pɔŋir mi nin nyinyimin le mi nann uma wan naan min.

ref: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
text: Ni ma kaa jɔɔ nbɔgirim ban ye Juu yaab nin Girig yaabin, ban jii bi pun nin ban kaa jii bi pun, ban ye bicham nin bidindamin, nin ban jɔɔ kulɔŋ a binbem nin ban jɔɔ kufɔŋ a binbem, biyom nin ban ye bi ba, amaa Masiya le ye bi biɛn le ki be bi biɛn ni.

ref: God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient.
text: Mambu, naah ye Uwonbɔr a ninfogannkaabin wee u jiɛ ni ki ŋa ni kasi-n, ni ta linyunyunbasanl nin tiŋann, nin jiininba, nin nbinben ŋan nin limɔril ki kpann daala ki yee u.

ref: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.
text: Ni li jɔɔ limɔril nin taba, wee ki jiɛn per tab a galin, ki jiɛn per tab ke Uyudaan kaah jiɛn per ni man nin.

ref: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
text: Nin tiyeer nan biɛn, nan jon ni biɛn ni ye ni li jiɛ taba, njiɛm li lagin ni biɛn ki ŋmag nin nmɔkpaa man be kasi.

ref: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
text: Ni che Masiya a posɔɔmin li ŋmag ni sufu, ke naah ye tigbanann tiba a ninfob wee u yin nposɔɔn ni. Ni li tenn Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpooga.

ref: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
text: Ni che Masiya a bɔŋann nin li be nin ni nbamɔma, wee ni li wɔɔn ni tab, ki gbeer tab nin nlamgɔrikaam, ki li gaah ilan, liwonpagil a lan, nin Kinaaŋ a lan nin linungbeel ni sufu ni ki sei Uwonbɔr.

ref: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
text: Mambu ni ŋaan nan biɛn ke, naah ye ni mɔleen bee ni toon ke, ni ŋa ni biɛn Uyudaan Yisa a yinl bu, ki li tenn Uwonbɔr wan ye Baa-n kunɔɔpoog u bu. Biwonjiɛm kaah li be nin tab man limiɛfol pɔnlin

ref: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
text: Biniinpiib, ni chee sei ni chiɛba, man le kpaan Uyudaan ban.

ref: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
text: Bijab ni li jiɛ ni piiba, ki laa ŋmag bi nin titintann ni.

ref: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
text: Baam, ni laa to ni buwaab bu, wee bi gbanann ngbɔɔ.

ref: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
text: Biyom, ni li cheel ni dulinya nan a yudam a mɔɔŋi niwann biɛn na, ni li tun man wee ni laa ye iyoo yan a binba wee bi lig ni, ke bi num ngbee ni, amaa wee ki li tun man nin ni sufu biɛn nin jilima ki tenn Uyudaan na.

ref: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
text: Ni tun nan biɛn ke, ni li tun nin ni sufu biɛn, ke ni tun tenn Uyudaan le, naa ye uninfosaali,

ref: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
text: naah nyi ke ni na li gaa lifaal Uyudaan ban nin wee ni ye tiyɔrin. Ni ma bu Uyudaan Masiya le ni tun ki tenn.

ref: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
text: Wan tun titoonbir na li gaa u toonbir nmɔn a yɔr, le naa jɔɔ njiɛm a gannimi.

ref: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
text: Biyudam, ni li ŋaan ni yomi tiŋann nin nan kpaan na, nan bu-n, ni nyi ke ni tɔɔl jɔɔ Uyudaan wan be paab. Nwɔɔnim

ref: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.
text: Ni li ta ni ba ki sei liwonmiɛl, ki li guu ni ba ki tenn Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpooga.

ref: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
text: Ki ji li miɛ U ki tenn ti, wee Uwonbɔr n loor nsan ki sei ti mɔleen yin, wee ti fir mɔɔn Masiya a bɔwoonkaarin, nan bu-n, tan bu wee n be libaalin ni.

ref: Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
text: Ni li miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn ma wee n fir mɔɔn ti nbamɔm, ke naah kpaa n mɔɔn ti man nin.

ref: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
text: Ni che ni bɔr a pagim li gbee nin linyunyunbasanl ki mɔ ke n-yaamin, wee ni li nyi naah li jiin bininfob biɛn a binbaan yin man. Ipoor yan joor

ref: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
text: Tachikusi li bei ni n bɔr biɛn, u ye ki na big jiɛkaag le wan si bogil liba u toon yin ki ye ti toontunn kpiɛg Uyudaan a toon yin,

ref: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
text: nan bu wee n tun u ni ban ye ni biɛ ti binbem kaah ye man, wee un pɔɔg ni sufu.

ref: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
text: Uma nin Onesemosi le yin nɔɔ dan, wan ye ti na big jiɛkaag ki si bogil liba-n, ki ye ni ni uba-n. Bi li bei ni nan biɛn ŋaan do.

ref: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
text: Arisitakusi, wan wee bi loon u ki kpiɛ n bu-n, u mu poor ni. Le Banabasi a pool a bija Mag mu poor ni.

ref: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
text: Josuwa wan wee bi yi Jasitusi mu poor ni. Bijab bita nmɔn le ye Juu a ninfob ban kpiɛg n bu wee ti tun Uwonbɔr a naam a toon yin nmɔn. Bi sɔŋir n sufu pam.

ref: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
text: Epafarasi, wan ye ni ni uba wee ki ji ye ni toontunn kpiɛg Masiya a toon nin mu poor ni. U miɛ Uwonbɔr le nin linunmanl iyoo biɛn ki tenn ni, ke ni sir kenken ki li ye bininfob chegirikaab ban tun Uwonbɔr a bam.

ref: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
text: N jin siɛra ke u sin tun nin linunmanl ki sei nim nin Laodisiya a tiŋ a ninfob nin Herapolisi a tiŋ a ninfoba.

ref: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
text: Ti jɔ Lug, wan ye utebirin, uma nin Demasi mu poor ni.

ref: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
text: Ni poor ti nabum ban be Laodisiya nna, ki ji poor ti ninsa Ninfa nin biwonjiɛm a laguŋ kan be u niin ni.

ref: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
text: Ni karin kugbɔŋ nan ki diɛ a bɔɔn ke, ni pɔɔn niba wee bin karin ki, ki sei biwonjiɛm a laguŋ kan be Laodisiya nna wee ni mu n karin kugbɔŋ kan be Laodisiya a wonjiɛm ban nin na.

ref: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
text: Ni bei Achipusi ke “Pɔɔn a ba ki diɛ litoonl lan wee Uyudaan nan ta seiŋ ke a tun nin na.”

ref: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
text: Min, Pɔɔl, n tɔɔl a nɔɔ le n ta ki sɔb ipoor nan. Ni laa tam n baalin bu. Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl li be ni bu.

ref: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
text: Min Pɔɔl nin Silasi nin Timoti; Le sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn Tesalonika a wonjiɛm a laguŋ kan wee ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin ti yudaau Yisa Masiya ye-n; Uwonbɔr a kaar nin nposɔɔn li be nin ni. Tesalonika yaab a yada nin bi binbem a bɔr

ref: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
text: Ti le poor Uwonbɔr le ni biɛn nan bu, ki tiɛr ni bu ti wonmiɛlin.

ref: we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ. The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
text: Ti tiɛr ni bu ti Baa Uwonbɔr ban, ni yada a ŋaam nin ni jiɛm a toon nin ni tama kan wee ni jɔɔ nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya nbu le che ni si nbamɔm.

ref: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
text: Ti nabum, ti nyi ke ni ye ban wee Uwonbɔr ban le, ki gann ni ki ta ni ŋa U ninfob,

ref: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
text: nan bu-n tibɔŋann tan foon ni ban nin, kaa nan ye imɔleen a binba, amaa ti nan jɔɔ npɔɔn le nin Kasi a Naaŋ. Le ban nan mɔɔn ti-n chee ti nin yada. Taah nan be ni ban nin, ni nan nyi ti binbem kaah ye man nim bu.

ref: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
text: Ni nan toog tim nin ti Yudaau a binbem le; nin naah nan ji fala kan nin biɛn yɔli, ni nan gaa tibɔŋann nmɔn le nin npopeen man wee Kasi a Naaŋ ta sei ni-n.

ref: You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia.
text: Ni ma bu le che nim kpann limagil ki sei biwonjiɛm ban biɛn be Masedoniya nin Akaya a timin.

ref: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
text: Ti yudaau a bɔŋann nmɔn kaa nan nyan ni ban ki kɔɔ Masedoniya nin Akaya a binba le, amaa naah ŋa Uwonbɔr yada kan nin pii kɔɔ ilog nan biɛn na. Ni ma bu naa ji kpaan ti pag ni ki kpiɛ,

ref: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.
text: bininfobin biɛn pag ki jiin naah nan gaa ti man, taah nan dan ni ban n-yonn man nin, nin naah nan jiɛn ni bawoli ki dan Uwonbɔr ban man, ke ni jiɛn Uma ibamɔn a Wonbɔru wan fo-n,

ref: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
