text: ki li guu U bija wan yin nyann papaab ki dan nin, wan wee U fiin nkumin nin, Uma ye Yisa wan nyan ti Uwonbɔr a ŋuufiiŋ kan chaan nin yaan.

ref: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
text: Ti nabum, ni tɔɔl nyi ke ti dam ni ban kaa gab yɔli.

ref: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
text: Ni nyi taah nan be Filipi a tiŋin wee bi sugir ti ki jin ti fala man, biba nan gbaar le ke bin gɔɔ ti wɔɔnimin, amaa Uwonbɔr a pɔɔmin le ti kan lipoobil ki mɔɔn U bɔŋann nan ki tenn ni.

ref: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
text: Taah bei ni tibɔr tan nan kaa ye kuŋmaruŋi, kaa ji ye ti jɔɔ lipotiɛbiril liba le, kaa ye kularug mu.

ref: God was pleased to trust us with his message. We didn't speak to please people, but to please God who knows our motives.
text: Amaa ti pag le ke ban wee Uwonbɔr ke bi ŋan nin, Uma ta tibɔŋann nmɔn ki ŋa ti nɔɔn, ni ma bu taa ban ti pag ki penn bininfob a sufu amaa ti ban ti penn Uwonbɔr wan magir ti potiɛlin a sufu le.

ref: You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed.
text: Ni nyi ke taa la nyi ki dan nan pag ni nmɔmɔmi, bee tibɔr tan degin kujaŋuuŋ a bɔri, Uwonbɔr le ye ti siɛra daau.

ref: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
text: Taah jiɛ nim takpemin bu le che ti nan mɔɔn Uwonbɔr a bɔŋann nin ki sei ni, naa ye tibɔŋann nin a binba amaa ki ban ti junn ti miɛfol ni bu taah ban nim takpem n bu.

ref: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
text: Ibamɔn buu, n nabum, ni li tiɛr ke taah mɔɔn Uwonbɔr a bɔŋann nin ki tenn nin, ti yaa baginn nin ti pɔɔninba-n; ti tun itoon nin le nween nin kunyiɛg naah li ŋa man wee ti laa ye litugil ki sei ni ni uba.

ref: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
text: Nim nin Uwonbɔr le ye ti siɛradam, taah nan be nin nim ban ŋa yada-n, ti nan be kasi le ki jɔɔ nbuchin binben, kaa jɔɔ igbarigi.

ref: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
text: Ni nyi ke ti le ŋmag nim le ke baa kaah ŋmag u baan tɔɔl a buwaab man nin,

ref: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
text: ki pɔɔgir ni gbanann, ki sɔŋir ni sufu, ki balin ni ke ni li be nbinben ŋan man gbeeg Uwonbɔr wan yin ni ki ta ni kɔɔn U naam man jɔɔ jilima-n a num.

ref: We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you.
text: Ti mu le poor Uwonbɔr le iyoo biɛn, nan bu-n, naah gaa Uwonbɔr a bɔr tan wee ni gbir ti ban nin, ni chee sei tibɔr nmɔn le ke taa ye bininfosaalib a bɔri, amaa ke ti sin ye Uwonbɔr a bɔr ibamɔn le, tan tun nin nim ban ŋa yada-n.

ref: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
text: Amaa nim ban ye ti nabum nan, ni toog biwonjiɛm a laginn ban be Judiya wee ki be Masiya ni nle. Ni jin fala ni tɔɔl a bol yaabin le ke biwonjiɛm a laginn nmɔn kaah nan jin fala Juu yaab a nɔɔn man nin,

ref: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
text: bi ma nan ku Yisa nin bilinlemin ki mugir ti mu. Bi nan fiin Uwonbɔr a ŋuul pam. Le ki ji ŋa bininfob biɛn a dataag

ref: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
text: ki gbaar ban baah li ŋa man wee ti laa pag sei ban kaa ye Juu yaabin wee bin kan nŋmarimi. Man nmɔn le che bi bir lagin ki nan kpaa man. Le Uwonbɔr a ŋuul fii bi bu le u dar bi tul ni joorimin. Pɔɔl kaah jɔɔ kɔlisa nin un ji gɔnn bi man

ref: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
text: N nabum, baah nan fee ki nyan ti wee ti nan fɔɔr sin jiɛn ni-n, ni nan ye tigbanann nin le amaa naa nan ye lipotiɛlin ni, ti gbaar le ke ni ye man biɛn ke ti le ji li kan ni.

ref: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.
text: Ti bi ban ti dan ni ban le, min Pɔɔl baan tɔɔl le gbaar le ki le gbaar, amaa le sintani kaa sei ti nsan ni.

ref: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
text: Ti tama nin ti mɔm ye baa, bee ti nyaŋim a yuchigirig kan wee ti na yin ta kan jilima u Yudaan Yisa ban u jirin daalin ye ki laa? Naa ye nimaa?

ref: You alone are our glory and joy!
text: Ibamɔn nim le ye ti pag nin ti mɔm.

ref: Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves
text: Taah kaa ji nan na li fir ŋmag tiba n-yonn man nin, le ti nan tiɛr ke ni ŋan nin ti laan paar Atensi ti binba.

ref: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.
text: Ti tun Timoti wan ye ti toon tun kpiɛg Uwonbɔr a toon n-yaan wee ki mɔɔn Masiya a bɔŋann nle ni ban, ke un nan pɔɔg ni gbanann nin ni yada-n,

ref: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
text: wee u ba n laa lu u yada-n limugil nan bu. Ni tɔɔl nyi ke ni ye Uwonbɔr a wiib le ke ti kan limugil nmɔn a booli.

ref: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
text: Ibamɔn, taah nan be ni ban nin, ti le nan gbaa bei ni ke ti li kan limugil. Le ni sin tun ke naah nyi ni bu nbamɔm man nin.

ref: At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
text: Ni ma bu ni che maah kaa ji nan na li fir ŋmag n ba-n, le n nan tun ke bin nan lig ni yada kaah si man. N nan san bijawaam le ke, nba ke ulinlaril n par lar ni wee ti yaa baginn n gab yɔli.

ref: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
text: Amaa Timoti le la nyan ni ban le ki foon ti ban ki ŋmagin tibɔŋann ki ta jiin ni yada nin ni jiɛm paam. U bei ti ke ni le la tiɛr ti bu le ki bi ban ni kan ti, ke ti mu kaah le ban ti kan ni man nin.

ref: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
text: Mambu n nabum, nin ti mugil nin ti fala a jimin biɛn nin, ti jɔɔ ngbanann pɔɔn ki jiin ni yada kan wee ni jɔɔ n paam.

ref: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
text: Daandaan nan, naah si nbamɔm Uyudaan a samin nan man, ti sin fo.

ref: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
text: Ipoor takpen ilaba wee ti yin ta sei Uwonbɔr ni buu ki jiin nmɔn man biɛn wee ti jɔɔ Uwonbɔr a nintogil ni buu?

ref: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
text: Nween nin kunyiɛg ti le miɛ Uwonbɔr ki bi ban ti kan ni jigin wee ki ter ni nan par ni yada-n.

ref: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
text: Ti Baa Uwonbɔr baan tɔɔl nin ti Yudaau Yisa n mann nsan ki sei ti wee ti dan ni ban.

ref: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
text: Uyudaan n che njiɛm man wee ni jɔɔ ban ni tabin n mann tann ki pii uninfo biɛn, ke ti yaa bamin kaah be nin ni man nin.

ref: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
text: Un pɔɔg ni sufu wee ni laa jɔɔ igbarigi ki li be kasi ti Baa Uwonbɔr a nintogil n-yonn man wee ti Yudaau Yisa na li foon nin u kasi a ninfobin.

ref: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
text: N nabum, ni joorimin, ti wɔɔn ni na li ŋa man wee ni binbem li gbeeg Uwonbɔr a num, ke naah pii be man nin. Daandaan nan ti balin ni le ki bei ni ke ni le li gbaa be man na Uyudaan Yisa a yinlin.

ref: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
text: Ni nyi nwɔɔnim man wee ti ta sei ni Uyudaan Yisa a pɔɔmin.

ref: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
text: Ni ye Uwonbɔr a bam le ke ni li be kasi wee ki nyan ni ba iwanchɔgin toon nin ni jabanlin bee ni piibanlin;

ref: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
text: ki laa jɔɔ nmɔsanyunsɔɔm ke ban kaa ye Juu yaab wee kaa nyi Uwonbɔr n kaah be man n ni;

ref: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
text: ni ma bu tibɔr nan yaan uba laa tun ki bii u kpiɛg bee ki ji u kpiɛg dulimi. Uyudaan li dar bininfosaalib ban biɛn tun tibir nan a booli a tul, ke taah pii chinn bei ni ki kpaan ni man nin.

ref: God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure.
text: Uwonbɔr kaa yin ti ke ti li jɔɔ tijaginn ni, amaa ke ti li jɔɔ kasi a binbem.

ref: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
text: Mambu uninfo wan yii kaa nɔɔ nwɔɔnim nan ke, naa ye uninfosaal le u yii amaa u yii Uwonbɔr wan sei ni U Kasi a Naaŋin le.

ref: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
text: Daandaan nan ki jiin kunabitiig a jiɛmin paam, naa ji ye ti sɔb le ki sei ni, Uwonbɔr le wɔɔn ni tɔɔl naah li jiɛ tab man.

ref: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
text: Le ni ye ibamɔn le, ni sin ban n nabum man biɛn be Masedoniya a tiŋin nin. Jigin ti balin ni le ke ni mann tun man takpema.

ref: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
text: Ni che ni li ye ni toonl ke ni li be nbinben ŋan, ki che ni baga li be ni tɔɔl a toon yin ki li jɔɔ ni nɔɔi tun ki jiu, ke taah bei ni man nin,

ref: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
text: naah li ŋa man wee ni binbem li ye jilima ki sei ban kaa ye biwonjiɛmin, wee ni laa be uba bu. Uyudaan a dam

ref: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
text: N nabum, taa ban ni li be ki laa nyi ban dɔɔn jiɛn nin bu, bee ki jɔɔ npoobiin ke bininfob ban gur kaa jɔɔ tama-n kaah be man nni.

ref: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
text: Ti ŋa yada ke Yisa kpo ki fii nkumin na, ni ma bu che ti jɔɔ yada ke Uwonbɔr le ŋmagin ban nan dɔɔn jiɛn Yisa nni ki dan.

ref: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
text: Uyudaan baan tɔɔl a mɔbonl le ti bei ni ke, tim ban la be ti miɛfolin wee ki guu Uyudaan a damin, taa na yin chinn ban dɔɔn jiɛn nni.

ref: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
text: Uyudaan baan tɔɔl li nya papaab ki jiirin, ki nan sei bimɔb nin nkukɔ pɔɔn wee ti gbir malakam a ninkpelu a kukɔl nin Uwonbɔr a natun yinkaagin a mɔr, le bininfob ban nan gaa Yisa wee ki nin kpe-n li chinn fii nkumin.

ref: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
text: Le ni bɔɔn bu, le tim ban mu la fo wee ki gur be dulinya nan yaan nin mu li yug lagin nin bi ki too Uyudaan kitilangbɔŋin. Le ki nin gbaa be nin Uyudaan iyoo biɛn.

ref: Encourage each other with these words.
text: Mambu ni ta imɔbon nan ki pɔɔg tab a gbanann na man.

ref: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
text: Daandaan nan, n nabum, naa kpaa talar nin ti sɔb ki wɔɔn ni n-yonn bee idaa,

ref: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
text: nan bu-n ni nyi nbamɔm ke Uyudaan a dan daal na yin be le ke unaayig kaah chaan kunyiɛg man nin.

ref: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
text: N-yonn man wee bininfob li len ke “Nposɔɔn dan na bi gaa bi ba-n,” libol nmɔn le tibɔbir li dan bi bu, ni na yin be le ke nmarwiɛn kaah choo upii ke ni be man nin, le baa li ŋmari.

ref: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
text: Amaa nim, n nabum nan ma, naa be libunbɔnlin ni, mambu ni laa che lidaal nmɔn n nan lir ni ke unaayig a dan ni.

ref: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
text: Ni biɛn nan ye nwonween nin nweehn a buwaab le. Taa ye kunyiɛg bee libunbɔnl a ninfobi.

ref: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.
text: Ban dɔ jiɛn nin jiɛn kunyiɛg le, ban mu nyu ndaam gbeegin mu nyugbeeg kunyiɛg le.

ref: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
text: Amaa tim kaah ye nweehn a ninfobin, ni che ti li chor ti bau, ki li jɔɔ yada nin njiɛm man li guu ti gbanann, ki li jɔɔ nŋmarim a tama man wee ti li ta chig ti yul bu ke kijabig.

ref: God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Uwonbɔr kaa gann ti ke ti nan ji fala le U ŋuufiiŋin ni, amaa ke ti nan kan nŋmarim ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya bu.

ref: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
text: U kpo tim bu le, a lig le bee a jiɛn le ke ni, ti na li lagin ki be nin U.

ref: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
text: Ni ma bu ni li pɔɔg tab a gbanann ki li kpiɛg tab bu ke naah pii ŋaan man nin na. Nwɔɔnim man joor nin ipoor

ref: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
text: N nabum, ti balin ni le, ni li tenn ban pɔɔn biba ni sisiigin ki ye ni sanliib Uyudaan a samin ki wɔɔn ni nwonjiɛn binben nin jilimau.

ref: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
text: Ni li tenn bi jilima takpema, ki li jɔɔ njiɛm nin bi toon yin bu. Ni li be nin nposɔɔn nin taba.

ref: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
text: Ti balin ni le, n nabum, ni kpaan ban ye bigbanyagdamin na, ki pɔɔg ban san bijawaamin a sufuu, ki ter ban a yada kaa pɔɔ-n, ki li jɔɔ limɔril nin uninfo biɛn na.

ref: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
text: Ni laa che uba nta tibir ki yɔ tibiri, amaa ni pɔɔn niba ki li jɔɔ nbinben ŋan nin tab nin uninfo biɛn.

ref: and never stop praying.
text: Ni li miɛ Uwonbɔr iyoo biɛn na;

ref: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
text: niwann biɛn a poolin ke ni li poor Uwonbɔr a, Uwonbɔr a bam le yen ki sei ni Masiya bu.

ref: Don't turn away God's Spirit
text: Ni laa junn Kinaaŋ a ŋmiimin ni;

ref: or ignore prophecies.
text: ni laa yin ilinlen leen yɔli.

ref: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
text: Ni mag i biɛn liga, ki gann yan ŋan ki li ŋmaga.

ref: and don't have anything to do with evil.
text: Ni nyan niba tibir biɛn a tumin na.

ref: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
text: Che Uwonbɔr tɔɔl, wan ye nposɔɔn a Uwonbɔr win n ŋa ni kasi niwann biɛn nin. Ki che ni naaŋ nin ni sufu nin ni gbanann biɛn n laa nan jɔɔ igbarig ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a dan daali.

ref: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
text: Uwonbɔr wan yin ni nan li tun man, U ye yada daan le.

ref: Friends, please pray for us.
text: N nabum, ni li miɛ Uwonbɔr tenn ta.

ref: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
text: Ni poor ti nabumin biɛn nbamɔma.

ref: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
text: N bei ni le Uyudaan a nintogil ke ni karin kugbɔŋ nan ki sei n nabumin biɛn na.

ref: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
text: Ti yudaau Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl li be ni bu.

ref: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Min Pɔɔl nin Silasi nin Timoti, Le sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn biwonjiɛm a laguŋ kan be Tesalonika ki be nin ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya bu:

ref: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
text: Ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl nin nposɔɔn li be ni bu. Tibɔr a jim tan na li be Masiya a damin

ref: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
text: N nabum, ni ye ti poor Uwonbɔr le ni bu, ni ŋan nin ti ŋa man, nan bu-n ni yada-n le mann yabirig le takpem, le njiɛm man wee ni jiɛ tabin mann kpiɛg le.

ref: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
text: Ni ma bu Uwonbɔr a ninfob a laginn nan a sisiigin, ti far ligbingbanl le ni bu nin naah jɔɔ limɔril nin yada limugil nin libiginl biɛn a poolin wee ni la biɛ nin jɔɔ yada n bu.

ref: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
text: Ni niɛ biɛn ye siɛra le ki wɔɔn ke Uwonbɔr a bɔjil ŋan, le ni joorimin bi li kan ni ki kpiɛ bininfob ŋamin Uwonbɔr a naam man bu wee ni ji fala nan.

ref: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
text: Uwonbɔr ye ubuchin le: Ban mugir ni-n, U li yɔ bi ki jiin,

ref: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
text: ki sei nim ban wee bi mugir ni-n lifooril, nin ti biɛn. Ni na yin ŋa n-yonn man wee Uyudaan Yisa nan kpiir ki nyan papaab nin nŋmipeen nin u malakam ban jɔɔ npɔɔn nin.

ref: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
text: U li dar ban kaa nyi Uwonbɔr a tuli nin ban kaa ŋa ti Yudaau Yisa a bɔŋann nin yada-n.

ref: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
text: Bi li ji fala wan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛmi bi tudaril nmɔn a poolin. Uwonbɔr na li ŋɔɔr bi ki nyan Uyudaan ban ki che bin lann u pɔɔm man jɔɔ jilima-n,

ref: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
text: lidaal lan wee u nan dan un nan gaa u pag kasi a ninfob nin u jilima ban biɛn ŋa u yada-n ban nin. Ni tɔɔl kpiɛ niin na, ni ŋa tibɔr tan wee ti pag sei nin yadau.

ref: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
text: Naah be ti sufu-n nin bu, le ti miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn ni iyoo biɛn, ke ti Wonbɔru n ŋa ni bininfob ŋam ke waah yin ni ki ban ni li be man nin, ki che naah tiɛr nan biɛn n ŋa n ŋam ki sei ni u yaa pɔɔm bu, ki che ni gbaar ni yada a toonlin.

ref: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
text: Ti miɛ Uwonbɔr le ke un che ti Yudaau Yisa a yinlin kan kupag ni ni, wee ni mu n kan kupag u ni, ti Wonbɔru nin Uyudaan Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl bu.

ref: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
text: Ki jiin ti Yudaau Yisa a dam paam nin taah na yin lagin U ban man, le ti balin ni ke, n nabum,

ref: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
text: ni laa che nin ŋmarin ni potiɛli, bee ki yugin ni lam ki ta jiin ilinlen leen yan wee bibam pag bee tibɔr beikaar bee kugbɔŋ kan nyan bi ban ki ke tim ban le ki nyan nin. Imɔleen yan forin nin kaah len ke ti Yudaau a dam a daa-n pii foon nin bu.

ref: But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear.
text: Ni laa che uba n ta niba lar ni, lidaal nmɔn kaa la yin foo see ke wan kɔnn nin bininkpeeb nin limɔyiildaan nin nyan npaan ni, wan a binbebol ye nŋmi-n nin.

ref: He will brag and oppose everything holy or sacred. He will even sit in God's temple and claim to be God.
text: Waa yin chee sei iween yan wee bi jiɛn nni, le ki sin yuur uba paab ki jo iween nmɔn, le ki ta uba ki siin Uwonbɔr a binbebol ki ke u ye Uwonbɔr le.

ref: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
text: Naa tiɛr ke maah nan be ni ban nin, n nan gbaa bei ni ni niɛ nan biɛn naa?

ref: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.
text: Le ni nyi ni wan nan la ŋmag u daandaan nan, naah li ŋa man wee un nan kpiir uba n-yonn man kpaan nin un nyan.

ref: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
text: Npɔɔn man woo limɔyiildaan nmɔn a bɔɔn nin pii piin itoon na; amaa wan la ŋmag mi wee maa tun nin, le la ŋmag man le, hali nin Uwonbɔr kaah na li nyan nan ŋmag mi nmɔn.

ref: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
text: Le limɔyiildaan nmɔn n nin kpiirin, wan wee Uyudaan Yisa na yin foor u mɔb a faam ki ku u, u dan daal nmɔn u na li bii limɔyiildaan nmɔn.

ref: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
text: Limɔyiildaan nin na yin dan nin Sintani a pɔɔmin le, ki nan tun ligaril nin lijinjeel a toon ki ji tibɔkar a siɛra,

ref: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
text: u li ta u binben biim nmɔn ki lar bininfob ki bii bi, baah yii ibamɔn yan li sei bi nŋmarimin bu.

ref: So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie.
text: Ni ma bu le Uwonbɔr ta kuŋmaruŋ a pɔɔm ŋa bi sufu ni ke nin che bi li pag tibɔkar

ref: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
text: wee ni joorimin Uwonbɔr na li bii ban biɛn kaa ŋa ibamɔn nin yada wee ki sin gann tibirin. Feeja bu le Uwonbɔr gann ni

ref: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
text: Ni ye ti le li poor Uwonbɔr le iyoo biɛn ni bu, n nabum, nim ban wee Uyudaan jiɛ, nan bu-n npiinimin Uwonbɔr nan gann ni le ke ni kan nŋmarim Kinaaŋin a pɔɔmin ki ŋa ni u kasi a ninfob nin naah ŋa ibamɔn nin yada-n.

ref: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Tibɔŋann tan wee ti pag tenn nin le Uwonbɔr ta yin ni, ke nim nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya n nan lagin kan u jilima-n.

ref: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
text: Ni ma bu n nabum, ni mann sir nbamɔm ki li ŋmag taah wɔɔn ni man nin, naah ye imɔleen le ti pag bee kugbɔŋ le ti sɔb sei ni ke ni.

ref: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
text: Ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya nin ti Baa Uwonbɔr, wan jiɛ ti nin U nyunyunbasanlin bu n kɔɔn ti lipoobil ki sei ti tama ŋaŋ,

ref: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
text: Un sei ni lipoobil ki pɔɔg ni gbanann nin itoon ŋan nin imɔleen ŋan.

ref: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
text: Ni joorimin, n nabum, ni li miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn ta wee Uyudaan a bɔrin fir mɔɔn weem wee bin gaa ti nin jilima, ke naah nan gaa ti man nin.

ref: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
text: Ki ji miɛ Uwonbɔr ke un nyan ti bipootondam nin tininfobir a nɔɔn, nan bu-n naa ye uninfo biɛn le jɔɔ yada.

ref: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
text: Amaa Uyudaan ye yada daan le, u li pɔɔg ni gbanann ki guur ni wee kininbɔŋ n laa kan ni.

ref: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
text: Uyudaan che ti jɔɔ tidindann ni bu ke ni tun, ki le mann tun ke taah bei ni man nin.

ref: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
text: Uyudaan n che ni biɛ Uwonbɔr a jiɛm nin limɔril lan nyan Masiya ban nin. Naah kpaan ti tun itoon man

ref: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
text: Uyudaan Yisa Masiya a yinl bu, le ti bei ni ke, n nabum, ni nyan ni num ki sin jiɛn n nabum man biɛn san ligbanyagil kaa be taah wɔɔn bi ke bi li be man nni.

ref: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
text: Ni baan tɔɔl nyi nbamɔm ke ni ni ye ni li tun le ke taah tun man ni. Taah nan be ni ban nin, taa nan san ligbanyagil,

ref: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
text: bee ki jin uba a jiir yɔli wee kaa yɔn ti bu. Amaa ti pɔɔn tiba le ki tun nween nin kunyiɛg, naah li ŋa man wee ti laa ye litugil ki sei ni ni uba.

ref: We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you.
text: Nan bu che ti tun nin kaa ye ke taa bi li fir ji ni wan yɔli amaa ti ŋa limagil le ki wɔɔn ni ke ni li nɔɔ.

ref: We also gave you this rule: If you don't work, you don't eat.
text: Hali n-yonn man wee ti nan be ni ban ni, ti nan sei ni nsiim ke: “Wan yii kaa tun ke, u mu laa ji.”

ref: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
text: Ti gbir ke biba be ni sisiigin ki ye bigbanyagdam. Baa tun nin inunman ni; amaa le ki sin jɔɔ bi nɔɔi kɔɔn biba a bɔrin.

ref: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
text: Bininfob nmɔn a bol le ti jɔɔ Uyudaan Yisa Masiya a yinl ki kpaan bi ke bin pɔɔn biba wee ki tun ki kan bi tɔɔl a jiir ki ji.

ref: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
text: Amaa nim ma bu ke, n nabum, ni laa ke ni bagir itoon ŋan a tum bu.

ref: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
text: Ni ye uba kaa chee ti wɔɔnim man be kugbɔŋ nan yaan nan ke, ni li mann nyi u bu ki laa che ni baga be u ni, wee ifa n choo u.

ref: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
text: Nin ni ma biɛn ni, laa ta man a ninfobol kpann a dataagi, amaa kpaan mu ke a nabigin. Tibɔjoor kaar

ref: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
text: Uyudaan wan ye nposɔɔndaan baan tɔɔl n sei ni nposɔɔn isaŋ biɛn nin niwann biɛn nin. Uyudaan li be nin ni biɛn.

ref: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
text: Ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl li be ni biɛn bu.

ref: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
text: Min Pɔɔl wan wee Uwonbɔr ŋaam Masiya a toomin, wan ye ti feeru nin Masiya wan bu wee ti jɔɔ tama-n,

ref: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
text: N sɔb tenn Timoti wan ye n big bamɔŋ yada bu nle: Ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Masiya a linyunyunbasanl nin nposɔɔn li be a bu. Pɔɔl kaah wɔɔn Timoti waah li kɔn tibɔkar a wɔɔnim bu man

ref: When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings.
text: Ke maah pii nan beiŋ man n-yonn man wee n nan jon Masedoniya-n, li be Efesusi wee ki che bininfob bibam nlaa ji wɔɔn tibɔkari,

ref: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
text: ki che bin nyan biba bi yaajam a bɔkpegir tan ye tibɔkar a teeni ki nyan bi yaajam a yiin npaamin. Ni ma che limɔkpel forin kaa ye Uwonbɔr a niin a toonl lan ye yada nbu.

ref: You must teach people to have genuine love, as well as a good conscience and true faith.
text: Nwɔɔnim nan a num kaah paa nan bu ye njiɛm le, man nyan kasi a sufu-n nin ipotiɛ ŋan nin ibamɔn a yada-n.

ref: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
text: Bininfob bibam yii ni niɛ le, ki tur ki kɔɔ ileen yan kaa jɔɔ bu a pagimin.

ref: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
text: Bi ban bi li ye ban wɔɔnn nsiim le, amaa baa nyi baah pag nan nmɔn ni bee nan wee bi pag nin tidindann nmɔn ni.

ref: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
text: Ti nyi nsiim nmɔn kaah ŋan, ni ye uninfo ŋmag mi nbamɔm ke.

ref: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
text: Ti ji nyi nsiimin kaah kaa siin sei ban ye bibuchimi, amaa ban ye tukangbirdam, nin ban kaa san Uwonbɔr, nin tibirdam, nin tijagindam nin ban galin Uwonbɔr, nin ban ku bi baam, nin ban ku bi nam nin bininfokub,

ref: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
text: nin ban tun iwanjaab toon, nin ban yii bi piib wee ki dɔ nin bijab tabin, nin ban jɔɔ biyom kpeŋ nin ban ye tibɔkardam, nin ban ji tibɔkar a siɛra, nin ban biɛn kaa nɔɔ ibamɔn a wɔɔnimin,

ref: of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me. Being Thankful for God's Kindness
text: ni niɛ nan le ye jilima a bɔŋann tan nyan tikaar a Wonbɔru ban, le u ta ŋa n nɔɔn ke n li mɔɔn na. Uwonbɔr kaah san Pɔɔl kunyunyunbaag man

ref: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
text: N poor ti Yudaau Masiya, nin waah seim npɔɔn, ki ŋaam yada daan, ki taam ŋa u toon yin.

ref: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
text: Hali maah le nan sugir u, ki mugir u, ki pag tibɔbir ki tenn win, u nan sam kunyunyunbaaga, nan bu-n maa nan nyi maah tun nan ni, maah kaa nan jɔɔ yada-n bu.

ref: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
text: Ti yudaau nan kpaar u nyunyunbasanl takpem le ki jaa n bu, ki ji kpiɛ yada nin njiɛm man be Masiya nin.

ref: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
text: Ni niɛ nan ye ibamɔn le, ni kpaan nin bininfob n gaa ti nbamɔm: Masiya nan dan dulinya nan yaan ke u nan fee tibirdam le jaa, min le ye tibirdaan ki jon bi biɛn.

ref: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
text: Amaa ni niɛ bu le Uwonbɔr nan sam kunyunyunbaag, ke min wan ye chinchinn a birdaau win, wee Masiya n fir wɔɔn u mɔril lan kaa jɔɔ tarig wee ni li ye limagil ki sei ban li ŋa Yisa yada ki kan limiɛfol lan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛmi.

ref: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
text: Daandaan nan, Ubɔr wan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛm, wan kaa kpegi, wan wee baa ga, Uwonbɔr uba, Uma ŋan nin jilima nin kupag hali nin iyoo yan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛmi. Ibamɔn.

ref: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
text: N bija, Timoti, n jɔɔ ikpaan nan ki ŋaan a nɔɔn, ikpaan nmɔn ye bilinlem kaah pii nan pag man ki jiin a paamin le. Ni ye a nɔɔn min nbamɔm ke a fir kɔn likɔnŋanl.

ref: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
text: Li ŋmag a yada nin a potiɛŋamin na. Biba nan yii mi le ki che bi yada bii.

ref: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
text: Bi ma ye Hamenasi nin Alɛgzanda, ban wee n ta bi ŋubin Sintani a nɔɔn ke un dar bi tul wee bin jiɛn Uwonbɔr a sugir.

ref: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
text: Chinchinn, n bei ni le ke, ni li miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn ni ba, ki li miɛ u ki tenn ni kpiɛtiib, ki li tenn Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpoog bininfob biɛn buu,

ref: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.
text: ki li miɛ ki tenn bibɔrtiib nin biyudam biɛn wee ti fir be soon nin nposɔɔn ki li jɔɔ nwonjiɛn binben ki li be kasi.

ref: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
text: Ni niɛ le ŋan, ki gbee Uwonbɔr wan fee ti gabin a num,

ref: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
text: wan ban bininfob biɛn n kan feegab wee ki biɛ nbamɔmin.

ref: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
text: Nan bu-n, Uwonbɔr ye uba le, le usandanfaar mu ye uba ki be Uwonbɔr nin bininfob a sisiigin, uja nmɔn le ye Masiya,

ref: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
text: Ni niɛ nan bu le Uwonbɔr gannim ki ŋaam wan mɔɔn nin ntoon. N pag ibamɔn le, maa por tibɔkari, ki ye wan wɔɔn ban kaa ye Juu yaab yada a bamɔn.

ref: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
text: N ban bijab kaah be nan yaan biɛn ndon bi kasi a nɔɔi ki miɛ Uwonbɔr, wee ni laa jɔɔ sufu fiiŋ bee limɔkpeli.

ref: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.
text: N mu ji ban bipiib n yee tiwann yɔɔr tan ŋan ki nɔɔn bi le, tan kaa jɔɔ igalin, bee ifa a yukper loli, bee salima bee nlanbim bee tiwann yɔɔr tan jɔɔ kudaapɔɔrugi,

ref: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
text: amaa wee ki li tun nan ŋan na, ni ma ŋan ki sei bipiib ban ke bi jiɛn Uwonbɔr.

ref: and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention.
text: Upii ye un tinn le ki li be soon nin limɔcheel.

ref: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
text: Maa sei upii npaan ke un wɔɔn ni bee u li jɔɔ npɔɔn ki jon uja, u ye u li ŋmin le.

ref: After all, Adam was created before Eve,
text: Adam le bi nan chinn naan, le ki nin naan Iif.

ref: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
text: Naa ye Adam le Sintani nan lari, upii le Sintani nan lar le u labir tibirdaan.

ref: But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
text: Amaa bipiib li kan feegab, nin baah le maa nbuwaab nan biɛn na, ni ye bi le la si bi yada bu ki jɔɔ njiɛm nin kasi a binbem ke.

ref: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
text: Ni niɛ nan ye ibamɔn le: Ni ye uninfo tiɛr u sufu ni ke u ban un ŋa uwonjiɛn sanliir ke, ni kpaan nin un tun itoon ŋan.

ref: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
text: ki laa ye udanyugbeer, ki laa ye ukɔnban ni, amaa ki li ye wan be soon, ki laa ye umɔkpefari bee ulig ban ni.

ref: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
text: Ni kpaa talar le nin u li ye wan fir ŋmag u niin yaab nbamɔm, wee u buwaab mu li tenn u jilima.

ref: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.
text: U laa ye wan yɔɔn ta uba sei Yisa, ni ye man ke u na li kpann kalanbaanidaan ki nan kan litudaril ke ulinlarin.

ref: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil. Church Officers
text: Ni kpaa le nin u li ye wan jɔɔ jilima ban kaa ye biwonjiɛmin ban, wee ki laa ji ifa ki lu ulinlarin a kurug n-yaan ni. Bititerib ban ter biwonjiɛm a bɔr

ref: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
text: Ni kpaa le nin bi li ŋmag yada a bɔwoonkaar tan ye ibamɔn nin, wee bi sufu li ween.

ref: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
text: Ni kpaa le nin bin mag bititerib nmɔn a binbem ki lig, ni ye baa jɔɔ igalin ke, bin jiɛn bi wee bin ŋa bititerib.

ref: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
text: Ni ye man le ki sei bititerib nmɔn a piib mu, bi li ye ban jɔɔ jilima, ki laa ye bibɔɔnsubi, amaa wee ki laa ye ban jɔɔ kiŋuufiiŋi ki li be soon ki ye ban wee bininfob ŋa bi yada.

ref: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
text: Ni kpaa le nin utiter li jɔɔ upii uba kpeŋileŋ ki ji li ye wan li fir ŋmag u buwaab nin u niin yaab biɛn nbamɔm.

ref: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
text: Ban tun nbamɔm kan sisibol ŋan na ki jɔɔ lipoobil takpem nin bi yada wan wee bi jɔɔ nin Masiya-n. Tibɔwoonkaar tan polig

ref: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
text: Hali nin maah le jɔɔ tama ke n li dan ki nan gɔnniŋ daandaan nan nin, n sɔb kugbɔŋ nan le n seiŋ ikpaan,

ref: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
text: ni ye maa dan weem ke, kugbɔŋ nmɔn li che a biɛ bininfob a binbem kaah ye man Uwonbɔr a niin, ban ye Uwonbɔr wan fo a wonjiɛmin, ki ye kijaantelig nin ibamɔn a fiɛl.

ref: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
text: Ti biɛn chee tibɔwoonkaarin kaah polig man ti wonjiɛnlin na: U nan degirin nin tigbanann na, Kinaaŋ nan wɔɔn waah kan nnyaŋim man na, Malakam nan kan wa, Bi nan mɔɔn u bɔr ki sei ibol biɛn na, Bi nan ŋa u yada dulinya nan yaan na, U nan ta u don paab nin jilimau.

ref: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.
text: Kinaaŋ len na, ke idajoorikaa-n, bininfob bibam na li ta bi yada gab, ki nin nɔɔ nnaanbiim man ye bilinlarib nin npɔniim kaah wɔɔn nan.

ref: They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars
text: Nwɔɔm nmɔn nya bitingbiib ban larin ban le, ban a potiɛl denn ke bi ta kukurug toŋ le tabin nin.

ref: will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth.
text: Bi kɔɔg bininfob le lipiikɔɔnl nin lijakunl, nin tijiir tibam a jim, tan wee Uwonbɔr naan ki ta sei tim ban ŋa u yada ki nyi ibamɔn nin, ke ti ga wee ki sei U kunɔɔpoogin.

ref: Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything.
text: Nan wee Uwonbɔr naan nin biɛn ŋan, ti laa yii niba ni ye ti gaa ni nin kunɔɔpoog ke,

ref: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
text: nan bu-n Uwonbɔr a bɔr nin liwonmiɛl le che tijiir nmɔn be kasi. Masiya a toontunn ŋau a bɔr

ref: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
text: A ta ni niɛ nan ki wɔɔn a nabum ke, a li ŋa usanliiŋan Masiya a toontumin, ŋaah nɔɔ ibamɔn a yada nin nwɔɔn ŋam man wugiriŋin.

ref: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
text: Laa nɔɔ ban kaa ye biwonjiɛmin a teeni nin tinaakpabɔri, pɔɔn a ba ki li jɔɔ nwonjiɛn binben.

ref: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
text: nan bu-n ti jɔɔ tama Uwonbɔr wan fo-n ban, wan ye bininfob biɛn a feeru win, naah jann tɔɔ ban bu ye ban ŋa u yada n le.

ref: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
text: Siin nsiim wee ki wɔɔn ni niɛ nan.

ref: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
text: Laa che bin lig ki ziɛŋ ŋaah ye kibipɔliŋ nbu, amaa ŋa limagil ki wɔɔn yadadam a pipagirin, a miɛfolin, a bamin, a yada-n nin a kasi a toon yin.

ref: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
text: Hali nin maah na li dan n-yonn man, a li jɔɔ isaŋ ki karin Uwonbɔr a bɔr nmɔn ki tenn bininfoba, wee ki li mɔɔn ti ki li jɔɔ ti wɔɔn ba.

ref: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
text: Laa che a piin yin ŋa yɔli, nan ye ilinlen leen ki seiŋ n-yonn man wee bininkpeeb nan ta bi nɔɔ-i paan a bu-n.

ref: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
text: Li jɔɔ inunman tibɔr nan yaan man, ki ta a gbanann biɛn ki sei ba, ni ma yin che bininfob biɛn n kan a kpaarim.

ref: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
text: Li nyi a ba bu, ki li ŋmag a wɔɔmin nbamɔm. Li jɔɔ inunman bi bu, nan bu-n ni ye a ŋaan man ke, a li fee a ba nin ban pelig a wɔɔm nmɔn ki jaa.

ref: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
text: Laa fuun wan joŋ bu, amaa pag u nin nniɛn diin ke a baa-n. Li ŋmag nnachipɔnbum ke a na bumin,

ref: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
text: ki li ŋmag bipiininkpeeb ke a namin, ki ji li ŋmag nbisiɛm ke a ninsiɛbin nin kasi a binbem.

ref: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
text: Li lig ipukɔɔ yan sin ban literilin nbamɔm nin jilima.

ref: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
text: Amaa lipukɔɔl lan jɔɔ nbuwaab bee iyaabil ke, nbuwaab nin iyaabili nmɔn le ye bin chinn tinn biwonjiɛnl a sam ki li jɔɔ tun ki lig bi niin yaab, bi ŋa man ke bi li yɔ ki jiin bi baam nin bi yaajam kaah nan tun nan ki sei bin, Uwonbɔr a num kaah gbeeg nan le yen.

ref: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
text: Lipukɔɔl lan sin ban nterimin wee kaa jɔɔ wan li ter win, u tama be Uwonbɔr ban le, le u miɛ Uwonbɔr ki ban nterim nween nin kunyiɛg.

ref: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
text: Amaa lipukɔɔl lan ta liba ki sei tigbanann a bam ma pii kpou, hali nin waah le la fo-n nan biɛn yɔli.

ref: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.
text: Ta nwɔɔm nan ki wɔɔn bininfob nmɔn na, wee bi laa jɔɔ igalin ni.

ref: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
text: Ni ye wan kaa ter u maali, nin naah jann tɔɔ ban bu u tɔɔl a niin yaab ke, u yaa daan kaa ji ŋa yada le nmɔn, ni bu u bir ki jon wan kaa ye uwonjiɛn na

ref: For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least
text: Lipukɔɔl lan kaa la foo ibin piloob kaa kpiɛ ipukɔɔ a kanlin ni, see wan jon ibin piloob, ki ye wan wee u chal ŋa u yada,

ref: She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
text: wee bininfob nyi u nbamɔm u toon ŋan bu, ki ta jiin waah wubiri u buwaab man, nin waah tun jiininba a toon ki tenn biwonjiɛm man, nin waah gaan bicham u niin man, nin waah li tenn ban be limugilin literil lan, nin waah ta u ba ki sei itoon ŋan nin biɛn man.

ref: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
text: Amaa bipiisapɔm ban ye ipukɔɔ n ma, laa ta bi yin ki kpiɛ nin yaan ni. Nan bu-n ni ye bi kɔlisa nan jir tigbanann a bam paam ke, bi yiin Yisa le ki ban bin kun tichar.

ref: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
text: Nan kpiɛ, ni che bi bii bi saŋi le, ki jin kɔɔ bininfob a niin yin ki chaa, naa ye bi bii bi saŋ a binba le, amaa bi su libɔɔnsul le ki jɔɔ linunmanl lan kaa jɔɔ nyɔɔri, ki kɔɔ tibɔr tan kaa nyan bi-n

ref: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
text: Ni bu n kpaan bipiisapɔm ban ye ipukɔɔ nbiɛn le ke bin kum bijab, ki maa nbuwaab, ki li lig bi niin nbamɔm wee ki laa che kidataagin n kan npaan ki ŋa kutingbiigin.

ref: Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.
text: Biba pii fɔra ki labir bi bɔɔn kpaa ki nin nɔɔ Sintani le.

ref: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
text: Ni ye upii wan ye uwonjiɛn wee ki jɔɔ ipukɔɔ u niin ke, ni ŋan nin un lig bi, ki laa che ipukɔɔ nmɔn a bɔmugkaar li tu biwonjiɛm bu, wee biwonjiɛmin nmɔn nfir lig ban le sin jɔɔ tibɔmugkaarin.

ref: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
text: Bininkpeeb ban wɔɔnn biwonjiɛm a toon nbamɔmin kpaan nin bin kan jilima nkerim milee, naah jann tɔɔ ban bu le ye ban a toonl ye bi li mɔɔn ti ki wɔɔn nin.

ref: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
text: Nan bu-n Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋ len ke, “Laa lol kinaajag a mɔb n-yonn man wee u be kuur idi,” le “Ni ŋan nin u toontunn biɛn n gaa u toon a yɔr.”

ref: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
text: Laa chee ki ke uninkpel galin ni, see ke bininfob bilee bee bita le lagin tab ki jin siɛra.

ref: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
text: Ban tun tibir ke, a fuun bi bu kubabugin na, wee ban gurin n kan ikpaan.

ref: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
text: Uwonbɔr a nintogil, nin Masiya a nintogil nin Malaka gannkaabin a nintogil le n kpaaniŋ ke, a chee nwɔɔm nan wee ki laa jɔɔ nbɔgirim bee ki gann ki ban uba ki jiɛn utɔ ŋaah tun nan biɛn nin ni.

ref: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
text: Laa jegil ki ta a nɔɔi ki paag bininfob bu, ki laa kpiɛ ban tun tibir bu wee ni tun ni. Li ŋmag a ba kasi.

ref: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
text: Laa nyu nnyum a binba, amaa ki li nyu ndaam wama wamau a powiɛn nin ŋaah buŋir iyoo biɛn nbu.

ref: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
text: Bininfob bibam a bir pii dɔ npaan ni le, ki pii chinn dɔ ki ye bin ji bi tibɔr le; le bi ba mu a bir na li nya npaan ni ni bɔɔn bu.

ref: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
text: Man mu le ji ye ni, itoon ŋan mu be npaan ni le, hali itoon ŋan yan kaa be npaan ni nin kaa li fir woon ni.

ref: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
text: Ban biɛn wee tiyomir a naajadaag paa bi bu nan, n chee sei biyudam nin linungbeel nin jilima takpem wee Uwonbɔr a yinl nin taah wɔɔn nan nin nlaa ye kutingbiig.

ref: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
text: Biyom ban a yudam ye biwonjiɛmin n laa ziɛn bi, nan bu-n bi ye nnabum le nin tab. Amaa ni ye bin mann ter bi le nbamɔm, nan bu-n ban ji bi toon nmɔn a nyɔɔr ye biwonjiɛm le, ban wee biyudamin jiɛ. Ni niɛ le ye nan wee ni li jɔɔ wɔɔn ki pɔɔgir bi gbanann. Tibɔkar a wɔɔm nin ibamɔn a jɔɔm

ref: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Wan wɔɔn tibɔkar a wɔɔm wee kaa chee nwɔɔm bamɔm man wee ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya wɔɔn nin liwonjiɛnl a wɔɔmin ke,

ref: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
text: u ye kalanbaanidaan wan donn uba le kaa sin nyi niba. Ki ji ye wan a mɔsanyum sɔɔn, nin wan a sufu be limɔkpel a famin nin tibɔyɔɔr a pagimin, nin lipiiponl lan jɔɔ nbɔgirim chaan ki che taa nyi ki biɛn tab,

ref: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
text: ki far limɔkpel nin bininfob ban tiɛr tipotiɛbir bi sufu-n nin, bi lann bibamɔn le ki nyi ke liwonjiɛnl ye njɔɔm a wan le.

ref: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
text: Amaa uninfo a num gbee nan wee u jɔɔ liwonjiɛnlin nin ke, ni ye tinyɔɔr le takpem ki sei u.

ref: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
text: Taa ŋmag niba ki dan dulinya nan yaan ni, ti mu kaa li fir ta niba ki nya dulinya nan yaan ni.

ref: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.
text: Amaa ni ye ti jɔɔ tijiir nin tiwann yeewann ke, ti num li gbee taah jɔɔ nan nmɔn.

ref: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
text: Bininfob ban ban bin ŋa bijɔɔndamin, bi ma kɔɔ nbigimin, nin kupeŋin nin ijɔrig takpem a wann nin kɔlisa kan ye kidaŋ ki bii bininfob wee bi lurin.

ref: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
text: Lilig banl ye titoonbir biɛn a sibonl le. Bininfob ban ban ilig ki tan lagir nmɔn a yada bora, le bi sufu nin gbee nin npoobiin takpem. Nwɔɔm man wee Pɔɔl nan ta wɔɔn Timoti

ref: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
text: Amaa fin, wan ye Uwonbɔr a ninfo nan, guun ki nya ni niɛ nan yaan biɛn na, pɔɔn a ba ki li jɔɔ nbuchin binben, nin nwonjiɛn binben, nin yada, nin njiɛm, ki li jɔɔ lipoobil ki li be soon.

ref: Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened.
text: Kɔm likɔnŋanl nin yada. Li ŋmag limiɛfol lan kaa jɔɔ diɛmin, lan bu wee Uwonbɔr nan yiŋin, wee a ŋa siɛra ŋaŋ ki kpiir ki wɔɔn siɛradam takpemin.

ref: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
text: Uwonbɔr a nintogil, wan tenn niwann biɛn limiɛfol nin Masiya, wan nan sir Pontiɛ Palati a nintogil ki ŋa siɛra ŋaŋ n bu, n kpaaniŋ le

ref: Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
text: ke a li ŋmag nsiim nan ki laa jɔɔ igalin ni, hali nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya kaah na li degirin,

ref: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
text: N-yonn man wee ni na yin ŋa Uma Uwonbɔr a saŋi, tikaardaan wan le ŋmag, ki ye bibɔrtiib biɛn a bɔru nin biyudam biɛn a yudaau,

ref: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
text: U yaa binba ni le limiɛfol lan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛmin be, ki be nween man yaan wee uba kaa li fir foon niin ni, uba kaa la nyi kan wi, bee ki li fir kan wi. Uma kpaan nin jilima ki ye npɔɔn takpendaan hali nin iyoo yan kaa jɔɔ diɛmi. Ibamɔn.

ref: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
text: Kpaan ban ye bijɔɔndam dulinya kan yaan wee ti be nan ke bi laa jɔɔ kalanbaani bee ki ta bi tama ki ŋa njɔɔm man kaa si bogiliba nan yaan ni, amaa bin che bi tama li be Uwonbɔr ban, wan tenn ti njɔɔm man biɛn wee ti jɔɔ ter tiba-n.

ref: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
text: Bei bi wee bi li tun nan ŋan na, ki li ye bijɔɔndam itoon ŋan nin, ki li por baah jɔɔ nan ki tenn taba ki laa jɔɔ woog tabi.

ref: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
text: Bi ŋa man ke, bi li bil lifaal ki sei biba lan ye lifiɛl lan pɔɔ ki guu n-yonn man chaan nan, wee bin nan fir kan limiɛfol lan ye ibamɔn a miɛfol.

ref: Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't.
text: Timoti, li mann ŋmag nan wee Uwonbɔr ta ŋa a nɔɔn ke a li ŋmagin nbamɔma. Jiɛn tijɔrbɔr tan ye limɔkpel wee kaa jɔɔ nyɔɔr kaa biɛ ji ye Uwonbɔr yaar wee bibam yin ni nlamin na,

ref: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
text: nan bu-n bininfob ban ke bi jɔɔ man a biɛm nmɔn bor bi yada-n na. Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl li be ni biɛn bu.

ref: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
text: Min Pɔɔl wan ye Masiya a toom Uwonbɔr a bam bu-n, le u ke n mɔɔn limiɛfol a bɔr tan wee Uwonbɔr nan siin limɔsiinl Masiya bu-n,

ref: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
text: le n sɔb ki tenn Timoti wan ye n bibankaagin: Ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Masiya a nyunyunbasanl nin nposɔɔn li be a bu. Kunɔɔpoog a seim nin Pɔɔninba

ref: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
text: N poor Uwonbɔr wan wee n jiɛn u nan, ke n yaajam kaah nan ŋaan man nin, nin lipotiɛŋanl, n wonmiɛlin n tiɛr nibu n sufu ni, nween nin kunyiɛg.

ref: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
text: N nan tiɛr a nyinyinn mɔɔŋin bu ke, ni ban n kaŋ le wee nin mɔŋim.

ref: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
text: N tiɛr yada bamɔŋ kan wee a jɔɔ-n bu, ki ye yada kan wee a yaa Lɔsi nin a na Yunisi nan jɔɔ n-yaa booli le, le n nyi ke a tɔɔl jɔɔ yada nmɔn.

ref: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
text: Ni niɛ nan bu le n tiɛriŋ ke a figir Uwonbɔr a piin yan be a ni-n, maah nan ta n nɔɔi ki paan a bu n-yonn man ni.

ref: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
text: Mambu laa san ifa nin a ji ti Yudaau a siɛra bee min wan ye u loondikɔɔru win a siɛra, amaa Uwonbɔr a pɔɔm bu che min nin fin nlagin ki ji fala tibɔŋann nan bu,

ref: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
text: Uma nan fee ti gab ki yin ti ke ti li be kasi a miɛfolin na, naa ye taah tun nan bu, amaa ni ye u baantɔɔl kaah lol man le nin u nyunyunbasanlin bu. U nan san ti kunyunyunbaag Masiya bu hali n-yonn man nan jon nin,

ref: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
text: amaa daandaan nan ni kpiir ki wɔɔn ta, ti feegab daan Masiya wan degirin ti bu-n bu, wan nyaŋ nkum wee ki che limiɛfol nin tigbanann tan kaa kpegin nɔɔ tibɔŋann bu ki dan nin.

ref: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
text: Tibɔŋann nan bu, le Uwonbɔr nan gannim ki ŋaam umɔleenmɔɔn, nin ntoon nin wan wɔɔnn.

ref: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
text: Ni ma che n ji fala ke maah ji man nan. Nin ni ma biɛn ni, ifa kaa jɔɔmi, nan bu-n n nyi wan wee n ŋa u yada-n, le n nyi ke u sin li guurim ki nan kpaa u jirin daal.

ref: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
text: Ŋaah gbir man n ban nin, li ŋmag nwɔɔm bamɔm man wee n ta wɔɔn niŋ nbamɔm, nin yada nin njiɛm Masiya bu.

ref: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
text: Li ŋmag tinyɔɔŋann tan wee bi nan ta wɔɔniŋ nna, Kasi a Naaŋ kan be ti ni-n li teriŋ wee a fir ŋmag ti nbamɔm.

ref: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
text: A nyi ke ban biɛn nan be Asiya a yerin n nan labir bi bɔɔn kpaa ma, bi ni bibam le ye Faajɛlusi nin Hɛrimojɛnesi.

ref: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
text: N miɛ Uwonbɔr le ke un san Onesiforusi a niin yaab kunyunyunbaag, nan bu-n u ye wan nan pɔɔgir n sufu le, le ifa kaa nan jɔɔ wi nin tikulor tan nan lolim nbu.

ref: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
text: Waah nan foon Rom a tiŋin nin, u nan bam le linunmanl hali ki nan kan n bol.

ref: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
text: Ti yudaau n san u kunyunyunbaag u jirin daal! A baantɔɔl nyi waah nan terim Efesusi a tiŋin man.

ref: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
text: Mambu, n bija, fin che a gbanann li pɔɔu Masiya a nyunyunbasanlin bu.

ref: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
text: Ta tibɔr tan wee a gbir n pag kuninfogbaluŋ a numin nin, ki wɔɔn bininfob ban si nbamɔm wee ki mu ye ban li fir wɔɔn bi kpiɛtiibin.

ref: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
text: Kpiɛ ti bu ki ji fala ŋaah ye Masiya a tɔtogir wan ŋan nin bu.

ref: Soldiers on duty don't work at outside jobs. They try only to please their commanding officer.
text: Utɔtogir kaa jɔɔ u nɔɔ kɔɔn ban kaa ye bitɔtogib a bɔrin ni, nan bu-n u ban un tun nan li gbee bitɔtogib a yudaau a num le.

ref: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
text: Ukpaar wan a num man le ye wan yin chinn kan u tol tikpajiirin.

ref: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
text: Li tiɛr nan wee n len nan bu, Uyudaan li che a biɛ ni biɛn.

ref: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
text: Li tiɛr Yisa Masiya wan nan fii nkumin ki ye Defid a yaabilin bu. N bɔŋann nin sɔ,

ref: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
text: tan bu wee n ji fala hali ke bi nan lolim tikulor a li ke tukangbirdaan nin. Amaa uba kaa li fir lol Uwonbɔr a bɔri.

ref: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.
text: Mambu le n pɔɔn nba niwann biɛn nin Uwonbɔr a ninfob gannkaab nbu, ke bi mu n kan nŋmarim man be Masiya nin, nin jilima kan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛmin.

ref: Here is a true message: “If we died with Christ, we will live with him.
text: Tibɔr nan ye ibamɔn le; Ni ye ti kpo nin u ke, ti mu ji na li jɔɔ limiɛfol nin u;

ref: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
text: ni ye ti pɔɔn tiba ke, ti mu wo li ji u nnaamin. Ni ye ti yii u ke, u mu wo li yii ti

ref: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
text: ni ye taa si bogiliba ke, uma le yin si bogiliba le, nan bu-n waa li fir yii u baantɔɔl a binbemi. Uwonbɔr a num kaah gbee utoontunn wan

ref: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
text: Li gbaa tiɛri bi tiwann nan biɛn na, kpaan bi Uwonbɔr buu, ke bin nyam tibɔyɔɔr a pagimin, taa jɔɔ nyɔɔri, amaa ni bii ban pelig nle.

ref: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
text: Pɔɔn a ba ki ta a ba sei Uwonbɔr ke wan wee U ganniŋ, ke utoontunn wan kaa san ifa wee ki ŋmag Uwonbɔr a bɔr tan ye ibamɔn nin nbamɔm.

ref: Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God.
text: Nyam a ba tibɔr tan kaa kpaan nin uwonjiɛn li pag n-yaan, nan bu-n bininfob ban be man nmɔn a bol mann fɔbig le nin Uwonbɔr.

ref: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
text: Bi wɔɔm nmɔn li yann ke libiɛl kaah pɔr tigbanann nin man nin. Bi ni bibam le ye Hamenasi nin Filetusi,

ref: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
text: ban bor kaa nɔɔ ibamɔn a samin. Bi ke nkum a fiim pii jon na, mambu che bi bii bibam a yadau.

ref: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
text: Nin ni ma biɛn yɔli, Uwonbɔr kaah pii bil lifiɛl lan nin sir nbamɔma, le u daagim a sɔbim paa li bu: “Uyudaan nyi ban ye u yaab,” le “Wan biɛn mu ban un nɔɔ Uyudaan ke, un kpenn u binbema ki nya titoonbir a tumin na.”

ref: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
text: Iniin takpen a poolin jɔɔ tiwann tan bi jɔɔ ŋaan tijiir a booli, naa ye salima nin tikur ninann a binba le bi ta naan ti, amaa tidaar nin tiyɔgir mu yaar be niin; bi jɔɔ tibam ki tun kuchiig daal le, le ki jɔɔ titɔ mu tun idaa biɛn a toon.

ref: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
text: Ni ye uninfo ŋmag uba nin tibuchinn kaa tun tibir ke, bi li ta u ki tun ibuchin toon, yan ye kasi, ki ŋan sei Uyudaan wee ki ŋa sili nin un tun itoon ŋan nin ke.

ref: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
text: Guun nya kuninfopɔŋ a kɔlisa birug n-yaan na, ki li jɔɔ nbuchin binben na, nin njiɛm, nin limɔril nin nposɔɔn, amaa wee ki li lig fin nin ban a sufu ween wee bi yi ti Yudaau ki ban literilin.

ref: Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble,
text: Nyam a nɔɔ ijɔrig nin nlinliim a mɔkpel faalin na, nan bu-n a nyi ke ni jɔɔ ikɔn le chaan.

ref: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
text: Naa ŋan nin Uyudaan a toontunnu li ban ikɔn ni, amaa u li jɔɔ nbinben ŋan nin bininfob biɛn, ki li ye wan li fir wɔɔn, ki li jɔɔ limɔril.

ref: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
text: Ni kpaa le nin u li be soon ki fir wɔɔn ban yii u bɔrin, ki li jɔɔ tama ke Uwonbɔr li sei bi nkpenim man li wɔɔn bi ibamɔn nin,

ref: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
text: wee bi lam n jirin, wee bin ŋmar ki nya ulinlaril a peŋ kan wee u ta pen choo bi wee bi tun u bamin.

ref: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
text: Amaa ni li nyi man: Idaa yan na yin joorin na li bir takpem.

ref: People will love only themselves and money. They will be proud, stuck-up, rude, and disobedient to their parents. They will also be ungrateful, godless,
text: Bininfob na yin jiɛ bi ba le, ki ye ban ban ilig, nin ligbingbanfaal, nin kalanbaani, ki sugir bininfob, kaa ji li gbir sei bi baam nin bi nami, ki li ye ban kaa jɔɔ linungbeeli nin ban kaa jɔɔ kasi a binbem,

ref: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
text: kaa li jɔɔ njiɛm nin tabi, kaa li jiɛn tab a bir per bi, nin kutingbiig, kaa li fir ŋmag biba, ki ye ban jɔɔ npooton nin ban kaa jiɛ nan ŋan ni,

ref: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.
text: bi na li nya tab a bɔɔn, ki ye ban kaa tiɛri, ki donn biba, bi na yin ban dulinya nan a wann ŋann le ki jon Uwonbɔr,

ref: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
text: bi na yin jɔɔ nwonjiɛn binben le tigbanann nin, amaa le ki sin yii liwonjiɛnl a pɔɔm. Ni laa che nim nin bi ma jɔɔ nɔɔ nin tabi.

ref: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
text: Bi yaa ni bibam le woog kɔɔ bininfob a niin yin ki lar tipiijɔri ban a sufu gbee nin titoonbir wee ki nɔɔ bi sufu a bamin biɛn nin,

ref: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
text: bipiib nmɔn le tinn le iyoo biɛn, amaa le kaa biɛr ibamɔn nni.

ref: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
text: A li ke Janesi nin Jambiresi kaah kaa nan chee sei Moziz man ni, man le bininfob nan mu kaa chee sei ibamɔn nni, bi tiɛr nan bir le, kaa jɔɔ yada.

ref: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
text: Amaa baa li fir lar bininfob ki chaari, nan bu-n bininfob nmɔn biɛn li biɛ ke bi ye tijɔri le, ke baah nan biɛ Janesi nin Jambiresi bu man ni. Nwɔɔm man joor a bɔr

ref: Timothy, you know what I teach and how I live. You know what I want to do and what I believe. You have seen how patient and loving I am, and how in the past I put up with
text: Amaa fin Timoti, a nyi n wɔɔnimin kaah ye man, nin n binbem, nin n lol, nin n yada, nin n mɔril, nin n bam nin maah pɔɔn nba man,

ref: trouble and suffering in the cities of Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. Yet the Lord rescued me from all those terrible troubles.
text: nin baah mugirim man, nin n fala a jim, nin tiwann tan biɛn nan kam Antiɛg, nin Ikoniɛm nin Lisitira, nin maah nan pɔɔn nba ki kan limugil lan. Nin ni ma biɛn Uyudaan nan nyan ma.

ref: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
text: Ibamɔn, uninfo wan biɛn ban un be Uwonbɔr a bam Masiya a yinl bu li kan limugil,

ref: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
text: le tininfobir nin bilinlarib a toonbir li mann kpiɛ, le bin lar bitab le bi tab mu nlar bi.

ref: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
text: Amaa fin ma, le li ŋmag nan wee a tinn ki ŋa ni yada-n na, nan bu-n a nyi ban tinniŋ tibɔŋann nmɔn,

ref: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
text: naah nyan a buwaan nin na, a pii nyi Uwonbɔr a kasi a bɔrin, nan che a jɔɔ nlam ki kan nŋmarim man nyan a yada kan wee a jɔɔ nin Masiya-n.

ref: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
text: Tibɔr tan biɛn be Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ni ye Uwonbɔr a mɔleen le, tibɔr nmɔn jɔɔ tinyɔɔr ki jiin nwɔɔnim nin ikpaan, nin nbuchin binben paam,

ref: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
text: wee nin che Uwonbɔr a ninfou a binbem li ŋan, wee un fir tun itoon ŋan biɛn.

ref: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
text: Uwonbɔr a nintogil nin Masiya wan na yin ji ban fo nin ban kpo a bɔr, wee ti lig waah na yin degirin nin u naamin, le n kpaaniŋ nan:

ref: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
text: Li mɔɔn tibɔr nmɔn na; ŋaam sili iyoo biɛn, ki li tenn bi ikpaan ki gbeer bi, ki pɔɔgir bi gbanann ki li jɔɔ limɔril nin maaninba a wɔɔnim.

ref: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
text: Iyoo chaan le bininfob kaa ji na yin pelig ibamɔn a wɔɔmi. Amaa le ki nɔɔ bi sufu a bam, bi na li lagin ban wɔɔnn takpem ke bin pag bi tuli kaah saag ki ban bin gbir nan ni.

ref: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.
text: Bi na yin ŋal bi tuli le ki yii ibamɔn a gbirim, amaa le ki sin pelig nwɔɔm man kaa ye ibamɔn nin.

ref: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
text: Amaa fin ma, li ŋmag a ba n-yonn biɛn, ki li pɔɔn a ba a fala a jimin; ki wɔɔn bininfob tibɔŋann nan, ki li tun litoonl lan wee Uwonbɔr ta seiŋin biɛn na.

ref: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
text: Bi pii kpaarim wur le ke kumanug a daamin, le isaŋ foou nin n fɔr dulinya nan yaan na.

ref: I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful.
text: N kɔn likɔnŋanla, n diɛ n taguunla, ki sin ŋmag n yada.

ref: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
text: Daandaan nan n buchin yuchigirig ŋa sili ki dɔ guum, kan wee Ubuchin yudaan wan ye ubɔjirin na yin ta ki yɔm lidaal nmɔn, naa yin ye n yaa binba, amaa u na li yɔ ban guu waah na yin degirin lidaal lan nin tɔɔl. Pɔɔl nin Timoti a binba a bɔr

ref: Come to see me as soon as you can.
text: Pɔɔn a ba wee ki dan n ban weem ni,

ref: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
text: Nan bu-n, Demasi kaah ban dulinya nan nbu che u jiɛnim le ki jon Tesalonika. Kiresensi mu jon Galantiya, le Tatusi mu jon Dalimasiya

ref: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
text: Lug a binba le be n ban. Yin Mag wee fin nin uma nnɔɔ dan, nan bu-n u terim n toon yin pam.

ref: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
text: N tun Tachikusi Efesusi a tiŋin na.

ref: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
text: A chaan ke a ta n war a daala nni, kan wee n nan ta jiɛn Karipusi ban Tirosi a tiŋin ni, nin n gbann sɔb kaarin nan kpaa talar nin n gbann tan kaa la sɔbin.

ref: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
text: Alɛgzanda wan ye ucha-n ŋaam nan kaa ŋan na. Uyudaan li yɔ u ki jiin waah tun nan nmɔn bu.

ref: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
text: A mu li nyi a ba bu ki ta jiin u paam, nan bu-n u yii ti bɔrin na.

ref: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
text: Chinchinn maah nan kɔn n ba bu-n, u ba kaa nan kpiɛ n bu, amaa bininfob biɛn nan yiim le. Uwonbɔr n laa dar bi tuli

ref: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
text: Amaa le Uyudaan sir n bɔɔn ki seim npɔɔn, wee min bu U bɔrin n fir mɔɔn nbamɔm wee ban kaa ye Juu yaabin ngbir ti. Le u nan nyam ugbegin a mɔn.

ref: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
text: Uyudaan li nyam niwanbirilin kaah li legim nan yaan biɛn, wee ki nan taam kun U paab a naamin yaan soon. Uma ye npagim nin isaŋ yan kaa jɔɔ diɛmi. Ibamɔn. Ipoor yan joor

ref: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
text: Poor Pirisila nin Akula nin Onesiforusi a niin yaaba.

ref: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
text: Erasitusi nan paar Korenti a tiŋin na, le Tirofimusi mu buŋ le n jiɛn u Miletusi a tiŋin.

ref: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
text: Pɔɔn a ba ki dan wee kutafaag a yonn n nin foon. Ebulusi, nin Pudensi nin Linusin nin Kiladiya nin bi nabumin biɛn poorin.

ref: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
text: Uyudaan li be nin a naaŋ. Linyunyunbasanl li be a bu.

ref: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I encourage God's own people to have more faith and to understand the truth about religion.
text: Min Pɔɔl wan ye Uwonbɔr a yomu nin Yisa Masiya a toomin, le Uwonbɔr tum u ninfo gannkaab ban, ke n ter bi bi yada-n wee bin biɛ ibamɔn a bɔr tan wɔɔn nwonjiɛn binben nin,

ref: So, at the proper time, God our Savior gave this message and told me to announce what he had said.
text: le iyoo kaah nan nan foo-n le u nyan tibɔr nmɔn nween ni ke Uma Uwonbɔr wan ye ti feeru win kaah wɔɔnim ke n mɔɔn ti man nin,
