text: Bi nan daar bibam nyɔɔrug le ki boo bi, le ki lol bibam tikulor ki kɔɔn bibam mu tiloondirin.

ref: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.
text: Bi nan gabir bi itangbag, ki jiil bibam por milee lee, ki ta takoobi ki ku bibam. Bibam nan yee tipeegbann le nin tiŋɔɔgbann, ki ye faladam, le bininfob mugir bi ki ŋaan bi nan kaa ŋan.

ref: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
text: Dulinya kaa nan kpaan bi. Bi nan choon yelin le kukunkɔɔg nin ijɔɔ a paab, ki dɔɔ titangbafiɛrin nin ifalin.

ref: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
text: Bi niɛ nan biɛn bi yada bu le Uwonbɔr nan pag bi, amaa le bi ni uba kaa gaa nan wee Uwonbɔr nan siin limɔsiinl ke U li sei bin ni.

ref: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
text: Uwonbɔr nan bon ibonn yan ŋan le ki sei ti ke tim nin bi ma nan lagin ki be ke u li ŋa bi kasi.

ref: Such a large crowd of witnesses is all around us! So we must get rid of everything that slows us down, especially the sin that just won't let go. And we must be determined to run the race that is ahead of us.
text: Mambu taah jɔɔ siɛradam takpem ban gɔɔn jin ti nan, ni che ti ta nan biɛn li legin ti samin ki gab nin tibir tan fir chor ti-n, ni che ti nyigin ki guun ti taguunl lan dɔ guu ti nan.

ref: We must keep our eyes on Jesus, who leads us and makes our faith complete. He endured the shame of being nailed to a cross, because he knew later on he would be glad he did. Now he is seated at the right side of God's throne!
text: Ni che ti ta ti num ki tɔɔn Yisa bu, wan ye ti yada a piinim nin njoorimin. U nan jin fala lidapunpunl bu nin limɔril kaa san ifa, nmɔn man nan dɔ guu nbu, ki kal Uwonbɔr a naangbɔŋ bu u nɔɔjiim paam.

ref: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.
text: Ni li tiɛr waah kan limugil tibirdam ban kaa nan chee win a nɔɔn nin bu, wee nin laa che ni gbanann ngbarig wee ni ta ni yada gabi.

ref: None of you have yet been hurt in your battle against sin.
text: Naah kɔn nin tibirin, naa la kɔn tan foo nan yaan ye ni nyan ni chami.

ref: But you have forgotten that the Scriptures say to God's children, “When the Lord punishes you, don't make light of it, and when he corrects you, don't be discouraged.
text: Ni tam imɔleen yan wee Uwonbɔr ta pɔɔg ni gbanann ki yin ni u buwaab ki ke: “N big, Uyudaan dar a tul ke, laa yin li yɔli, ni ye U fuun a bu ke, laa che a gbanann ngbɔɔ,

ref: The Lord corrects the people he loves and disciplines those he calls his own.”
text: nan bu-n Uyudaan kpaan ban wee U jiɛ-n le, le ki dar wan biɛn wee U chee sei u ke u ye a bigin a tul.”

ref: Be patient when you are being corrected! This is how God treats his children. Don't all parents correct their children?
text: Chee sei limugil a tuntomin na ke ni ye ikpaan le; Uwonbɔr ŋmag ni le ke u buwaabin. Bibolinba wee ki baa kaa kpaan kaa?

ref: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.
text: Ni ye baa kpaan ni , man ke naa ye u baantɔɔl a bimarimi.

ref: Our earthly fathers correct us, and we still respect them. Isn't it even better to be given true life by letting our spiritual Father correct us?
text: Nan kpiɛ, ti biɛn nan jɔɔ ti baam ban ma ti tininforin nin, ki kpaan ti le ti tenn bi jilima ni bu. Mambu ni ŋan ti chee sei wan ye ti naaŋ a Baa-n ke nin jo man wee ki fo!

ref: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.
text: Ti baam nan ti kpaan ti le wama baah tiɛr ke ni ŋan man; amaa Uwonbɔr ma kpaan ti le naah ŋan sei ti bu, naah li ŋa man wee ti por u kasi a binbemin.

ref: It is never fun to be corrected. In fact, at the time it is always painful. But if we learn to obey by being corrected, we will do right and live at peace.
text: Ikpaan a yoo kaa jɔɔ nmɔni, amaa ni ye nton le. Ni bɔɔn bu ke, le nim ban mu tinn nmɔn nkan nbuchin binben nin nposɔɔn. Nwɔɔm nin ikpaan

ref: Now stand up straight! Stop your knees from shaking
text: Mambu, ni tann ni nɔɔi yan bagin nin ni dun yan kaa pɔɔ nna.

ref: and walk a straight path. Then lame people will be healed, instead of getting worse. Warning against Turning from God
text: “Ni mann nsan man tel ki sei ni taai,” wee ni laa nyaŋ kuwɔbigi, amaa wee un kan kutebug.

ref: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.
text: Ni pɔɔn niba ki li jɔɔ nposɔɔn nin bininfob biɛn wee ki li be kasi; naa jɔɔ kasi a binbem ke uba kaa li fir kan Uyudaan ni.

ref: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.
text: Ni laa che uba n nan lann Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanli, wee nin laa che nton a sibonl npa ki yabig ni sufu-n ni wee nin ta kuŋmaruŋ ki dan ki bii bininfob takpemi.

ref: Watch out for immoral and ungodly people like Esau, who sold his future blessing for only one meal.
text: Ni laa che ni ni uba n tun iwanchɔgin toon upiibanlin bee ujabanlin ni, bee kaa jɔɔ nwonjiɛn binben ke Esɔɔ, wan nan kɔɔr u ninkper a faal kisaayiig kiba bu nni.

ref: You know how he later wanted it back. But there was nothing he could do to change things, even though he begged his father and cried.
text: Ni bɔɔn bu, a li ke naah nyi man nin, waah nan nan ban un gaa lifaal nmɔn a kaarin u baa nan yiiu, waa nan fir kpenn u baa a potiɛli, nin waah le nan ban tikaar nmɔn ki mɔr nin tinyinyinin biɛn yɔli.

ref: You have not come to a place like Mount Sinai that can be seen and touched. There is no flaming fire or dark cloud or storm
text: Nim kaa foo lijɔɔl lan wee ni li fir ma li wee li gaan nŋmi nni; nan yaan wee nibɔɔngem ki ŋmin sulim wee ntafapɔɔrim daar;

ref: or trumpet sound. The people of Israel heard a voice speak. But they begged it to stop,
text: kunaatuŋ kaah mɔr nan yaan bee likukɔlin kaah pag ileen yan, wee ban nan gbirin nan balin ke u laa ji pag ileen nmɔn sei bi,

ref: because they could not obey its commands. They were even told to kill any animal that touched the mountain.
text: nan bu-n baa nan li fir ŋmag nsiimin kaah wɔɔn man nin ke: “Hali ni ye kuwankobug le maa lijɔɔl nmɔn ke, bin gabir ki itangbag ki kuu.”

ref: The sight was so frightening that Moses said he shook with fear.
text: Baah nan kan nan nin nan jɔɔ bijawaam le, le Moziz len ke “Bijawaam le jɔɔm le n gbanann jegil.”

ref: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.
text: Amaa nim foon Zayɔnn a Jɔɔlin ban na, papaab a Jerusalam n-yaan, Uwonbɔr wan fo-n a tiŋin, ni foon malakam turil mu a tuturil a mɔmin a laguŋ n-yaan na,

ref: Here you will find all of God's dearest children, whose names are written in heaven. And you will find God himself, who judges everyone. Here also are the spirits of those good people who have been made perfect.
text: ni foon biwonjiɛm ban ye nbininkpeemin ban na, ban a yin sɔb dɔ papaabin. Ni foon Uwonbɔr, wan ye bininfob biɛn a bɔjiru win ban na, bininfob buchim ban a naaŋ ŋa kasi,

ref: And Jesus is here! He is the one who makes God's new agreement with us, and his sprinkled blood says much better things than the blood of Abel.
text: ni foon Yisa wan ye usandanfaar tipoopɔnn n bu ban na, nin ncham jɔg kaam man pag ibamɔn ki jon Ebiɛl a chamin ban na.

ref: Make sure you obey the one who speaks to you. The people did not escape, when they refused to obey the one who spoke to them at Mount Sinai. Do you think you can possibly escape, if you refuse to obey the one who speaks to you from heaven?
text: Ni laa nyi yii Uwonbɔr wan pag nan ni. Ni ye baa nan ŋmar baah nan yii wan a kpaan yin dulinya nan yaan nin ban ke, ŋma nin nan chaa baan timaa, ni ye ti labir ti bɔɔn kpaa wan be papaab ki kpaan ti nan ke naa?

ref: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.
text: Iyaayoo nmɔn, Uwonbɔr a kukɔl nan che dulinya dam le, amaa daandaan nan u siin limɔsiinl ki ke, “Maa ji yin che dulinya a binba n dami, amaa n li che paab mu n dam.”

ref: The words “once again” mean that these created things will someday be shaken and removed. Then what cannot be shaken will last.
text: Imɔbon yan len ke, “N ji li chee-n,” wɔɔn ke tiwann tan dam ki ye tiwann naan kaarin na li choo nyan ki jiɛn tan kaa yin damin paar.

ref: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.
text: Mambu taah gaan nnaam a yerin man kaa li fir dam nan, ni che ti pag Uwonbɔr, ki li jiɛn u nin jilima nin bijawaam,

ref: Our God is like a destructive fire!
text: ni ma bu “Ti Wonbɔru nmɔn ye nŋmi man gaan le.”

ref: Keep being concerned about each other as the Lord's followers should.
text: Ni li jiɛ ni kpiɛtiib ke ni nabuma.

ref: Be sure to welcome strangers into your home. By doing this, some people have welcomed angels as guests, without even knowing it.
text: Ni laa tami wee ki li gaan bichama, nan bu-n ni ŋaan man ke, bibam gaan malakam le kaa nyi.

ref: Remember the Lord's people who are in jail and be concerned for them. Don't forget those who are suffering, but imagine you are there with them.
text: Ni li tiɛr ban be tiloondirin nin bu, a li ke ni gbaa tɔɔl be tiloondirin le-n, nin ban wee bi mugir bin a li ke ni mu ji bi fala nmɔn le-n.

ref: Have respect for marriage. Always be faithful to your partner, because God will punish anyone who is immoral or unfaithful in marriage.
text: Lipiikɔɔnl nin lijakunl ye ti biɛn li tenn li jilima le, lipiikɔɔnl nin lijakunl a didɔɔbol ye ni li be kasi le, nan bu-n Uwonbɔr na li ji ban tun iwanchɔgin toon nin tibɔr bipiib banlin nin bija banlin.

ref: Don't fall in love with money. Be satisfied with what you have. The Lord has promised that he will not leave us or desert us.
text: Ni choo niba nin ilig a jiɛma, wee ki che ni num ngbee nan wee ni jɔɔ-n, nan bu-n Uwonbɔr len ke, “Maa li nyi ki jiɛn ni; maa li nyi ki yii ni.”

ref: This should make you feel like saying, “The Lord helps me! Why should I be afraid of what people can do to me?”
text: Ni ma bu le ti pag nin tidindann ke, “Uyudaan le ye wan terim; ni bu jawaam kaa jɔɔmi. Uninfosaal li fir ŋaam baa?”

ref: Don't forget about your leaders who taught you God's message. Remember what kind of lives they lived and try to have faith like theirs.
text: Ni li tiɛr ni sanliib ban nan pag Uwonbɔr a bɔr ki sei nin. Ni li tiɛr bi binbem kaah nan nan joor man na, wee ki li toog bi yada kaah nan ye man nin.

ref: Don't be fooled by any kind of strange teachings. It is better to receive strength from God's gift of undeserved grace than to depend on certain foods. After all, these foods don't really help the people who eat them.
text: Ni laa che nwɔɔncham nan a booli biɛn nboon ni. Ni ŋan nin ti sufu n kan npɔɔn Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanlin bu, naa ye ikaal a jiir tan kaa ter ban ji ti nni.

ref: But we have an altar where even the priests who serve in the place of worship have no right to eat.
text: Ti jɔɔ kumanug a binbinl lan wee ban tun itoon tiwonjiɛn nanbonn nin kaa jɔɔ nsan nin bin ji li bu a jiiri.

ref: After the high priest offers the blood of animals as a sin offering, the bodies of those animals are burned outside the camp.
text: Ni ma bu biminmanib a yudaau nan ti ŋmag tiwankor a cham le ki kɔɔ kasi mu a kasi a bolin le ti ye tibir a manug, amaa le ki nyɔɔ tiwankor nmɔn bi laguŋ nmɔn a gbaam.

ref: Jesus himself suffered outside the city gate, so his blood would make people holy.
text: Mambu le Yisa mu nan jin fala ntingbaan kitiŋ nmɔn a timansanmɔnn, ki ta u tɔɔl a cham ke un nyan bininfob tibirin.

ref: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.
text: Ni che ti jo u ban kulaguŋ nmɔn a gbaam, ki tan ji ifa yan wee u jin nin.

ref: On this earth we don't have a city that lasts forever, but we are waiting for such a city.
text: Nan bu-n dulinya nan yaan taa jɔɔ kitiŋ kan li gbaa be, amaa ti lig kitiŋ kan la yin danin le.

ref: Our sacrifice is to keep offering praise to God in the name of Jesus.
text: Mambu, Yisa a yinlin bu, ni che ti li pagir Uwonbɔr kumanug a pag kan nya timɔgban yin ki wɔɔn U yinlin.

ref: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.
text: Ni laa tam itoon ŋan a tumi, ki li por tab naah jɔɔ nan na, man a manug le Uwonbɔr a num gbee.

ref: Obey your leaders and do what they say. They are watching over you, and they must answer to God. So don't make them sad as they do their work. Make them happy. Otherwise, they won't be able to help you at all.
text: Ni li jɔɔ limɔcheel nin ni sanliib wee ki chee sei bi ninkper a pɔɔma. Bi baga be nin ni, ki ye bininfob ban na li wɔɔn baah tun nan. Ni chee sei ba wee bi toon li ye nmɔn, ki laa ye litugili, naa ye man ke naa na yin ŋan sei ni.

ref: Pray for us. Our consciences are clear, and we always try to live right.
text: Ni li miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn ta. Ti nyi ke ti jɔɔ potiɛri yan ween le ti ban ti li be jilima a binbemin niwann biɛn nin.

ref: I especially want you to pray that I can visit you again soon. Final Prayers and Greetings
text: N tɔɔl le balin ni le ke, ni li miɛ Uwonbɔr a wee Un che n jirin ni ban daandaan nan. Ndiɛm a miɛm

ref: God gives peace, and he raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death. Now Jesus is like a Great Shepherd whose blood was used to make God's eternal agreement with his flock.
text: Uwonbɔr wan ye nposɔɔndaan wan nan ta tipoor tan kaa jɔɔ diɛmin a cham ki fiin ti yudaau Yisa wan ye upeekpaaŋanin nkumin nin,

ref: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.
text: un sei ni nan ŋan biɛn wee ni ta tun u bam, ki che ni tinn nan li gbee u num, Yisa Masiya, wan ŋan nin npagim iyoo yan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛm bu. Ibamɔn. Imɔbon yan joor

ref: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.
text: N nabum, n balin ni le ke, ni li jɔɔ limɔril wee ki gaa n kpaan nan a bɔra, nan bu-n tibɔr wama le n ta sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki sei ni.

ref: By now you surely must know that our friend Timothy is out of jail. If he gets here in time, I will bring him with me when I come to visit you.
text: N ban ni li nyi ke bi loor ti nabig Timoti kuloondiigin ki jaau. Ni ye u foon weem ke, n li ta u ki dan wee ti nan kan ni.

ref: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.
text: Ni poor ni sanliib nin Uwonbɔr a ninfobin nan. Itali yaab poor ni.

ref: I pray that God will be kind to all of you!
text: Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl be ni biɛn bu.

ref: From James, a servant of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ. Greetings to the twelve tribes scattered all over the world. Faith and Wisdom
text: Min Jemisi wan ye Uwonbɔr nin Uyudaan Yisa Masiya a yomu-n: N poor Uwonbɔr a ninfob ibol piig nin ilee yan yal be dulinya nan a logi ina nan biɛn nin. Yada nin nlam

ref: My friends, be glad, even if you have a lot of trouble.
text: N nabum, ni ye nbigim man biɛn dan ni bu ke, ni che ni li ye nmɔn takpen ki sei na,

ref: You know you learn to endure by having your faith tested.
text: nan bu-n ni nyi ke ni yada a magim mann kpiɛg ni limɔril le.

ref: But you must learn to endure everything, so you will be completely mature and not lacking in anything.
text: Ni kpaa le nin limɔril n diɛ mi toonl wee nin che ni gbee bininfob nbamɔm, wee niba n laa par ni.

ref: If any of you need wisdom, you should ask God, and it will be given to you. God is generous and won't correct you for asking.
text: Ni ye ni ni uba par nlam ke, u yaadaan n miɛm Uwonbɔr wan tenn bininfob nin tibuchinn wee kaa galin uba-n li ta sei u.

ref: But when you ask for something, you must have faith and not doubt. Anyone who doubts is like an ocean wave tossed around in a storm.
text: Amaa u miɛ ke, ni kpaa le nin un ŋa Uwonbɔr yada ki laa biɛn ni, nan bu-n wan jɔɔ nbiɛnim nann limɔgil a nyungbɔŋ le, man wee nfaam daar mi ki yeŋin.

ref: If you are that kind of person, you can't make up your mind, and you surely can't be trusted. So don't expect the Lord to give you anything at all. Poor People and Rich People
text: u ye ipotiɛ ilee daan le, kaa si bogiliba nan biɛn wee u tun ni. Fala nin njɔɔm

ref: Any of God's people who are poor should be glad he thinks so highly of them.
text: Kinabig kan jɔɔ jiininba iyoo biɛn n nan kan ndom ke, ki na li fa ligbingbanl.

ref: But any who are rich should be glad when God makes them humble. Rich people will disappear like wild flowers
text: Amaa wan ye uwandaan dulinya nan yaan wee Uwonbɔr nan jiin u tum ke, u daan li far ligbingbanla, nan bu-n u na yin kpo le ke nsipuumin.

ref: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business. Trials and Temptations
text: Babu nween pɔɔ wee ntuton nin fa kisiigin ke, npuumin koor le ki lu le mi ŋamin bii. Man mu le ni ye ki sei uwandaan, n-yonn man wee u tiɛr ke u toon li jo nintogilin, iyaayoo le u kpeg. Nmagim nin nbiginim

ref: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.
text: Tikaar be wan jɔɔ limɔril limagil a poolin nin bu, nan bu-n ni ye u nyaŋ limagil ki diɛ ke u li kan u naan yuchigirig kan ye limiɛfol wee Uwonbɔr nan siin limɔsiinl ke u li ta sei ban ban win.

ref: Don't blame God when you are tempted! God cannot be tempted by evil, and he doesn't use evil to tempt others.
text: Ni ye nbigim kan wan ke, un laa len ke “Uwonbɔr li bigin mi.” Nan bu-n libiginl liba kaa be ki li fir bigin Uwonbɔr i, le U mu kaa bigin uba;

ref: We are tempted by our own desires that drag us off and trap us.
text: amaa uninfo biɛn ga nbiginim, n-yonn man wee u potiɛ bir a bam dar u ki chor u nle.

ref: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.
text: Tɔ, ni bɔɔn bu a bam nmɔn choo lipool ke, mi yin ma tibir le, le tibir nmɔn nan yabig ke, mi mu nmaa nkum.

ref: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
text: N nabubankaam, ni laa che bin lar ni.

ref: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father who created all the lights in the heavens. He is always the same and never makes dark shadows by changing.
text: Nan ŋan nin nan be kasi biɛn ye ipiin yan nyan paab le, ki nyan ti Baa wan jɔɔ papaab a weemin, wan kaa kpenn ke nbɔɔm kaah kpenn man nin.

ref: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth. Hearing and Obeying
text: U yaa wiib bu le U ma ti, ibamɔn a mɔleen yin bu, ke nin che ti kpann u bininkpeem waah naan nan biɛn ni. Ngbirim nin ntum

ref: My dear friends, you should be quick to listen and slow to speak or to get angry.
text: N nabum ni li nyi ni niɛ nan bu: Ni ŋan nin uninfo li gbir weenweem, ki li pag soonsoon, wee u ŋuul mu n laa fii weenweemi.

ref: If you are angry, you cannot do any of the good things God wants done.
text: Uninfosaal a ŋuufiiŋ kaa che Uwonbɔr a buchinn forin ni.

ref: You must stop doing anything immoral or evil. Instead be humble and accept the message planted in you to save you.
text: Mambu, ni nyam niwann nan biɛn ye tijaginn nin nbinben biin nin, wee ki jiin niba tum ki gaa imɔleen yan wee bi ta sei nin, imɔleen nmɔn le li fee ni ki jaa.

ref: Obey God's message! Don't fool yourselves by just listening to it.
text: Ni laa pelig imɔleen nin a binba, wee ki lar niba. Ni tum yaah len man nin.

ref: If you hear the message and don't obey it, you are like people who stare at themselves in a mirror
text: Wan pel imɔleen nan amaa wee kaa ŋa yaah len man nin ke, u nann uninfo kaah lig u nundaag niɛnu ni le,

ref: But you must never stop looking at the perfect law that sets you free. God will bless you in everything you do, if you listen and obey, and don't just hear and forget.
text: Amaa uninfo lig Uwonbɔr a siim man be kasi wee ki tenn wiibin, wee ki le gbaa ŋaan man kaa tamir nan wee u gbirin, amaa wee ki ŋaan imɔleen nin kaah len man nin ke, tikaar li be ubu waah yin tun nan biɛn nin.

ref: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.
text: Ni ye uba tiɛr ke u ye uwonjiɛn wee kaa chor u lanbil ke, u lar uba le, u wonjiɛnl nmɔn ye yɔli le.

ref: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
text: Liwonjiɛnl lan wee ti Baa a num gbeeg ke li ye kasi kaa jɔɔ tibir ye nan le: Nkpeebim nin ipukɔɔ a terim bi bɔmugkaarin nin choonba ki jiin dulinya nan a ŋmaruŋ paam.

ref: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.
text: N nabum naah ŋa ti yudaau Yisa Masiya wan ye kupag daan nin yada man ni, ni laa gann tabi.

ref: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.
text: Ni ye uba dan ni laguŋin ki yee tiwanŋann nin salima a gbiɛŋ, wee faladaan mu nan kɔɔn ki yee tiwanchar ke,

ref: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.
text: ni ye ni sei wan yee tiwanŋann nin jilima ki bei u ke, “Kikaabol ŋaŋ sɔ kalim” amaa wee ki bei faladaan nin ke, “Fin li si doo,” bee “Kalim tum,” ke,

ref: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.
text: naa ye nganim le ni ŋa ni sisiigin nmɔn naa? Ki labir bibɔjib ni potiɛbir buu?

ref: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.
text: N nabum; ni pela man: Naa ye Uwonbɔr le gann ban ye faladam kutingbɔŋ nan a poolin, ke bi li ye biwandam yada a ŋaam bu, wee ki nan ji paab a naam a faal lan wee Uwonbɔr siin limɔsiinl ke u li sei ban ban win naa?

ref: You mistreat the poor. But isn't it the rich who boss you around and drag you off to court?
text: Amaa le nim sug faladam. Naa ye biwandamin le jɔɔ ni ki mugir ki chor ni chaa tibɔr a jim a dirin ni naa?

ref: Aren't they the ones who make fun of your Lord?
text: Naa ye bi ma pag ki bii Masiya a yin ŋanl lan wee Uwonbɔr ta sei ni nnaa?

ref: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.
text: Ni ye a ŋmag nnaam a siim man be Uwonbɔr a mɔleen yin nin ki ke, “Li jiɛ a kunkɔɔn taba ke ŋaah ban a ba man nin,” ke a ŋa man ke a ŋa choba.

ref: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.
text: Ni ye a gann bininfob ke a ŋa tibira ki ye wan bii nsiim.

ref: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.
text: Wan ŋmag nsiimin biɛn, amaa wee ni ŋa le u bii nsiim nmɔn miba ke, u bii nsiim man gurin biɛn na.

ref: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.
text: Amaa wan len ke, “Laa tun iwanchɔgin toon ni,” uma le ji len ke, “Laa ku.” Ni ye ŋaa tun iwanchɔgin toon amaa wee ki ku ke, a ye wan bii nsiim le.

ref: Speak and act like people who will be judged by the law that sets us free.
text: Ni li paga, wee ki sin li tun ke bininfob ban wee bi na li ji bi tibɔr nsiim man tenn feeja-n,

ref: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
text: nan bu-n, ban kaa san bikpiɛtiib kunyunyunbaagin, Uwonbɔr mu na li ji bi tibɔr kaa yin san bi kunyunyunbaagi. Linyunyunbasanl jon tibɔr a jima. Yada a ŋaam nin itoon a tum

ref: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
text: N nabum, ni ŋam ye baa, ni ye uninfo ke u jɔɔ yada wee u yada nmɔn kaa tun itoon ke, yada nmɔn a bosu li fir fee u jaa?

ref: If you know someone who doesn't have any clothes or food,
text: Che ti ke a nabig wan ye kibijag bee kibisiɛg be wee kaa jɔɔ tiwanyeer bee tijiir tan li ji.

ref: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
text: Le ni ni uba bei u ke, “Li chaa nin nposɔɔn na,” ki ji bei u ke, “Uwonbɔr li seiŋ wee a ji gbee,” wee kaa ŋa nan wee u ban ki sei u ke, ni ŋam ye baa?

ref: Faith that doesn't lead us to do good deeds is all alone and dead!
text: Ni ye man le, yada a ŋaam a binba wee yada nin itoon kaa nɔɔ tab ke, yada kpiiŋ le yen.

ref: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
text: Amaa uba li len ke, “Fin le jɔɔ yada, le n mu tun itoon.” Wɔɔm a yada kan kaa tun itoon nin ni, wee n wɔɔniŋ n yada nin n toon yan wee n tun.

ref: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
text: Ni ŋa yada ke Uwonbɔr ye u ba le kpeŋileŋ. Ni ŋan! Nnaanbiim gbaa tɔɔl ŋa yada man le ki san bijawaam.

ref: Does some stupid person want proof that faith without deeds is useless?
text: Fin kujɔrug nan, a ban a biɛ ke yada wan kaa tun itoon ye yɔlii?

ref: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
text: Ni kan ke u yada nin u toon nan lagin tab le ki tun, le u yada nan ŋa nbamɔm u toon a tum bu.

ref: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
text: Le ni nan gbeen Uwonbɔr a mɔleen yan len ke, “Abiraham nan ŋa Uwonbɔr yada, le U ŋa u tibuchinn,” le ki nan yin u ke Uwonbɔr a jɔ.

ref: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
text: Ni kan ke uninfo a toon ŋan bu le bi ke u ye uninfoŋan amaa naa ye u yada a binba bu.

ref: For example, Rahab had been a prostitute. But she pleased God when she welcomed the spies and sent them home by another way.
text: Naa ye man mu jigin le Rahab wan nan ye lipiijagɔɔril nmu bi nan yin u ubuchin, waah nan ta kudiig ki sei ban nan dan bin nan pigir lig kitiŋ nmɔn ki ji nyan bi wee baa ku bin nnaa?

ref: Anyone who doesn't breathe is dead, and faith that doesn't do anything is just as dead!
text: A li ke tigbanann tan kaa jɔɔ kinaaŋ kaah ye tigbanann kpiinn man nin, man le yada a ŋaam kan kaa tun itoon mu ye yada kpiiŋ.

ref: My friends, we should not all try to become teachers. In fact, teachers will be judged more strictly than others.
text: N nabum, ni takpem nlaa ban ni ŋa ban wɔɔnn ni, nan bu-n, ni pii nyi ke tim ban wɔɔnn nin, a bɔr a jim na li pɔɔ ki jo bininfob biɛn yaal.

ref: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
text: Tiwann takpemin, ti biɛn tun ki bura. Ni ye uba kaa nyi ki pag burin u pipagirin ke, u yaadaan ye kasi daan le, ki li fir ŋmag u gbanann nbamɔm.

ref: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.
text: Ni ye ti lee itaan a mɔɔŋi itangalig ke yin ŋa taah ban man ke, ti li fir labir bi gbanann ki kpaa taah ban nan paam.

ref: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
text: Bee ni taam tiŋalin ki ŋa siɛra. Hali tiŋalin kaah le yab man wee ntafaam daar ti chaan, ni biɛn yɔli, amaa kisalaabig le wan donn n jɔɔ donn tiŋalin, le ki jɔɔ chaa waah ban nan paam.

ref: Our tongues are small too, and yet they brag about big things. It takes only a spark to start a forest fire!
text: Lilanbil mu ye kiwanbig man le tigbanann nin, amaa le ki far ligbingbanl takpem. Lig! Nŋmi wama kaah lu timɔɔrin ke min nyɔɔ kutingbɔŋ man.

ref: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
text: Lilanbil mu tɔɔl ye nŋmi le, ki ji ye dulinya nan a bɔbir ki be tigbanann a yagi biɛn, ki tenn tigbanann nmɔn biɛn tijaginn, ki jɔɔ nŋmi nyɔɔr tigbanann nmɔn a binbemin biɛn, le Sintani a ŋmiim man kaa junn nin mu nnyɔɔ lilanbil nmɔn.

ref: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
text: Tiwankor a booli nin nnɔɔm a booli nin iwaalab a booli nin iwanfol yan be limɔgilin biɛn nan, uninfo le jɔɔ ni biɛn a pɔɔm,

ref: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
text: amaa uba kaa jɔɔ lilanbil a pɔɔmi. Lilanbil jɔɔ tibir, ki gbee nin tilabir tan ku.

ref: My dear friends, with our tongues we speak both praises and curses. We praise our Lord and Father, and we curse people who were created to be like God, and this isn't right.
text: Bimɔb biba nmɔn le tibɔŋann nin tibɔbir nya. N nabum, naa kpaan ke ni li ye man ni.

ref: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
text: Kinyunbuŋ kiba li fir bun nnyum man mɔ ki ji bun nnyum man ye n-yaam maa?

ref: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
text: N nabum, bikinkam a sub li fir lo tisaan naa? Bee kigansiig li fir lo ikinkan naa? Man mu le ni ye kinyunbuŋ kan bun n-yaam a nyum kaa li fir bun nnyum man mɔ. Nlam man nyan paab

ref: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
text: Ŋma ye ulandaan nin ubiɛndaan ni sisiigin naa? Ni che un wɔɔn ni u binben ŋam a lam a toon yan ye jiininba a toon nmɔn.

ref: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
text: Amaa ni ye ni jɔɔ lipiiponl nin npooton ni sufu ni ke, ni laa far igbingban Mambu bee ki yii ibamɔn ni.

ref: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
text: “Nlam nmɔn a bosu kaa nyan paab a naamin ni amaa mi ye dulinya nan a lam man kaa gbee nin Kinaaŋ ki ye ulinlaril yaamin le.

ref: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
text: Nan yaan wee linunchɔril nin kujaŋuuŋ a don nba a potiɛl be-n nin yaan le kuŋmaruŋ nin titoonbir be.

ref: But the wisdom that comes from above leads us to be pure, friendly, gentle, sensible, kind, helpful, genuine, and sincere.
text: Amaa nlam man nyan paab a naamin nin, chinchinn mi ma ye kasi ki ye man jɔɔ limɔril nin jiininba, ki gbee nin linyunyunbasanl nin nbinben ŋan, nin ibamɔn a pagim.

ref: When peacemakers plant seeds of peace, they will harvest justice.
text: Ban jɔɔ limɔril ki bu tibur nin nposɔɔn nin, bi na li chiɛ nin tibuchinn.

ref: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
text: Ba che ikɔn nin imɔkpel be ni sisiigin naa? Naa ye ni nyan ni gbanann a bam man be nin ni ki kɔn nin ni n lee?

ref: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
text: Ni ban niba amaa le kaa ga ni. Ni bu le ni jɔɔ linunchɔril ki ku bininfob, amaa naa li fir kan nan wee ni ban nmɔn ni. Ni jɔɔ imɔkpel ki kɔn nin tab. Naa jɔɔ naah ban nan nni, nan bu-n naa miɛ Uwonbɔr i.

ref: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.
text: Ni ye ni miɛ ke, naa ga, nan bu-n ni miɛ nin tipotiɛbir le, ni miɛ ke ni ta ŋa ni baantɔɔl a gbanann a bam le.

ref: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
text: Nim ban kaa si bogiliba nan, naa nyi ke nim ban jɔɔr dulinya nan kujɔtiigin ŋa Uwonbɔr ni dataag lee? Wan jɔɔr dulinya nan kujɔtiig ke, udaan ŋa Uwonbɔr u dataaga.

ref: Do you doubt the Scriptures that say, “God truly cares about the Spirit he has put in us”?
text: Bee ni tiɛr ke Uwonbɔr a bɔr kaah len man ni kaa jɔɔ bu lee? Ke Kinaaŋ kan wee Uwonbɔr ta ŋa ti ban nin ki jɔɔ linunchɔril takpem maa?

ref: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, “God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.”
text: Amaa le u san ti kunyunyunbaag takpem. Mambu le Uwonbɔr a bɔr len ke, “Uwonbɔr yiin kalanbaanidam le, amaa le ki sin san ban jɔɔ jiininba kunyunyunbaag.

ref: Surrender to God! Resist the devil, and he will run from you.
text: Mambu ni taam niba ki sei Uwonbɔr a. Ni tom Sintani, wee un guun ki jiɛn ni.

ref: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
text: Ni fɔɔr mal Uwonbɔr a, wee Uwonbɔr mu nfɔɔr ki mal ni. Nir ni nɔɔi ya, nim tibirdam nan, ki ŋa ni sufu kasiu, nim ipotiɛ ilelee dam nan.

ref: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.
text: Ni li jɔɔ npoobiin na, ki li mɔr ki kuun na. Kpenn ni laar ŋa timɔra ki che ni mɔm nlabir lisufubiila.

ref: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
text: Jiin ni ba ki sei Uyudaan na, wee Un yuur ni paab. Ikpaan ki jiin tab a bɔr a jim paam

ref: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
text: N nabum, ni laa jɔɔ kutingbiig nin tabi. Wan pag tibɔbir ki sei u nabig bee ki jin u tibɔr ke, u pag galin nsiimin le, ki jin nsiim nmɔn tibɔra. Ni ye a jin nsiim tibɔr ke, ŋaa ŋmag mi le nmɔn, a ye wan jin nsiim nmɔn le tibɔr.

ref: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone? Warning against Bragging
text: Uwonbɔr a binba le siig nsiim, ki ji li fir ji bininfob tibɔr, ki biɛ li fir fee bininfob gab, bee ki bii bininfob. Amaa fin, a ye ŋma ki li fir ji a kunkɔɔn tau tibɔraa? Ikpaan ki jiin ligbingbanfaal paam

ref: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
text: Ni pela man, nim ban ti ŋa ke ni len ke, “Dinan bee won ti wo li jo kitiŋ poolin ki tan ji libinl niin ki kpeŋ kpoŋkpoŋ ki kan ilig.”

ref: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
text: Ba ŋaa? Naa nyi nan wo li ŋa won ni. A miɛfol ye baa? Ni nann le ke liŋunl kaa lu ke naa yuur wee ki fɔr man ni.

ref: You should say, “If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.”
text: Amaa naah ye ni pag man ye nan le, “Ni ye Uyudaan a bam ke, ti li be ki tun ni niɛ bee ni niɛ.”

ref: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
text: Ke naah ye man nin, ni far igbingban le ki jɔɔ kalanbaani, ni gbingbanfaal nmɔn ye yɔli le.

ref: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
text: Mambu wan nyi itoon ŋan yan bi ye un tun, wee kaa tun ke, u ŋa tibira.

ref: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
text: Nim bijɔɔndam, ni pela man, ni li mɔra ki li kuun na, nan bu-n fala kan yin dan ni bu-n bu.

ref: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
text: Ni jɔɔmin biɛn bura, le ipɔgliɛn liɛ ni wann yɔɔr biɛn ki bii u.

ref: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.
text: Ni salima nin ni kurninann nin kɔɔ likurila. Likuril nmɔn le li ye siɛra ki li gaa ni gbanann ke nŋmi-n. Ni taah ifaa le ki woon idaajoorikaan.

ref: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
text: Lig! Ni jin bitoontum ban tun ni kpaan nin dulima, kaa yɔn bi. Le bi mɔr, bidichiɛb nmɔn a mɔr kɔɔ Liwonbɔr Gbingbemil a tuli yin na.

ref: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.
text: Ni be naah ban man le dulinya nan yaan, ki nɔɔ ni gbanann a bam, ki don ni ba. Ni ŋaam nmɔn polig ni gbanann le lidaal lan wee bi na yin kɔr ni.

ref: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who couldn't even fight back. Be Patient and Kind
text: Ni nan pag ki bii bipopendam ma, ki ku ban kaa nan kɔnn nin ni-n. Limɔril nin liwonmiɛl

ref: My friends, be patient until the Lord returns. Think of farmers who wait patiently for the autumn and spring rains to make their valuable crops grow.
text: Mambu n nabum, ni mɔra, hali ki nan kpaa ti Yudaau a jirim. Ni lig ukpaar kaah jɔɔ limɔril man ki guu u kpaab kaah na li ŋa tijiir, naah yuur unalantaal a yonn ki nan kpaa utakotaal a yoo.

ref: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
text: Ni mu li jɔɔ limɔrila, ki li si nbamɔma, nan bu-n Uyudaan a damin mala.

ref: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
text: Ni laa ŋulin nin tabi, n nabum, ni ye man ke bi na li ji ni tibɔr. Ubɔjirin si ntimɔsan!

ref: My friends, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They were patient, even when they had to suffer.
text: N nabum, nim le ye limagil ki jɔɔ limɔril fala a poolin, ki si bilinlem ban mɔɔn Uyudaan a yinlin a taai-n.

ref: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
text: Ke naah nyi man ni, ni ye tinyɔɔr le ki sei ban jin fala. Ni gbir Job kaah nan jɔɔ limɔril man u fala a jimin, ki ji kan ni joorim Uwonbɔr kaah tun nan ki sei wa. Uyudaan ye Unyunyunbasann le.

ref: My friends, above all else, don't take an oath. You must not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. “Yes” or “No” is all you need to say. If you say anything more, you will be condemned.
text: N nabum, nan jon ni biɛn ye le ke, laa poo paab a naamin bee dulinya bee niba a wan ni. Che a “Nn” li ye nn, le a “Aai” mu li ye aai, wee bi laa galiŋi.

ref: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.
text: Ni ni uba be tibɔmugkaarin naa? Un miɛm Uwonbɔr. Ni ni uba jɔɔ lipoopenl laa? Ni che un gaah ilan ki pag Uwonbɔr.

ref: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
text: Ni ni uba buu? Un yim biwonjiɛm a ninkpeeb wee bin miɛ Uwonbɔr sei u ki sin war nkpam ki jaa ubu Uyudaan a yinlin.

ref: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
text: Bi miɛ nin yada ke, ubaar nmɔn li pɔɔg, Uyudaan li fiin u paab. Ni ye u ŋa tibir le ke, u li kan jiɛn per.

ref: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
text: Mambu, ni kpiir ni bir ki wɔɔn taba, ki li miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn taba wee ni kan kutebug. Ubuchinn a wonmiɛl jɔɔ npɔɔn le mitoon yin.

ref: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
text: Elaja nan ye uninfosaal le ke taah ye man nan, u nan miɛ nin linunmanl ke utaal nlaa nu, le utaal kaa sin nan nun kitiŋ nmɔn yaan ki tan kpaa ibin itaa nin iŋmal iloob.

ref: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.
text: Le u ji nan nan miɛ Uwonbɔr, le utaal nun, le tijiir naan.

ref: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.
text: N nabum, ni ye ni ni uba bor kaa nɔɔ ibamɔn a samin, wee uba ta u jiin nin ibamɔn a sam nmɔn yaan ke,

ref: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
text: ni li tiɛr ni niɛ: Wan biɛn fir labir tibirdaan wan borin ki jiin siin ibamɔn a samin yaan ke, udaan fee tibirdaan nmɔn nkum a nɔɔn na, ki li che tibirdaan nmɔn n kan feegab u bir takpemin bu.

ref: From Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To God's people who are scattered like foreigners in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
text: Min Piita wan ye Yisa Masiya a toomin, Le sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn Uwonbɔr a ninfogannkaab ban ye bicham ki be dulinya ni, ki yal kɔɔ ntimin ki be Pɔntusi nin Galantiya nin Kapadosiya nin Asiya nin Batiniya,

ref: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
text: ban wee bi nan gann, wee ti Baa Uwonbɔr pii nan nyi ke bi li gann bin, ŋa bi kasi, Kasi a Naaŋ a toon bu-n, ki che bi chee Yisa a mɔb le u cham n ŋunn bi: Linyunyunbasanl nin nposɔɔn li be ni bu takpem. Tama kan fo a bɔr

ref: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
text: Ipoor ye Uwonbɔr wan ye ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a Baa-n yaal le! U nyunyunbasanl takpenlin bu ti kan nmaal pɔɔn man be tama kan fo-n, waah nan fiin Yisa Masiya nkumin,

ref: God has something stored up for you in heaven, where it will never decay or be ruined or disappear.
text: ki sei ti lifaal lan kaa li nyi buri, bee ki bii bee ki wiiri. Le li be paab ki guu nim,

ref: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
text: ban wee Uwonbɔr a pɔɔm guu ni-n, ni yada bu-n, hali nin feegab a nyɔɔr kaah na li foon, tan ŋa sili ki na li kpiir iyoo yan na yin joorin.

ref: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.
text: Ni niɛ nan bu ni mɔ ni le takpem, hali naah le jin fala kan daandaan nan wee kaa li yuurin a booli biɛn nin yɔli.

ref: Your faith will be like gold that has been tested in a fire. And these trials will prove that your faith is worth much more than gold that can be destroyed. They will show that you will be given praise and honor and glory when Jesus Christ returns.
text: I niɛ nan dan le, ke ni yada kan ŋan jon salima kan burin, hali nŋmi kaah le mann salima kan li fir bii-n gbaa, yada nmɔn li wɔɔn ke ni ye ibamɔn le, ki ta kupag nin jilima dan ni joorimin, ni ye Yisa Masiya nan kpiirin ke.

ref: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
text: Hali naah kaa le kan u nni, amaa ni jiɛ u; nin hali naah kaa le la kan u daandaan nan gbaa, ni ŋaa u yadau, mambu le ni gbee nin nmɔn man kaa jɔɔ magimi,

ref: you are to be saved. This is why you have faith.
text: nan bu-n ni gaan ni yada a nyɔɔr le, nin ni naam a feeja.

ref: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
text: Ki ta jiin feegab nan paam, bilinlem ban nan pag ke linyunyunbasanl li foon ni ban nin, bi nan feen le nin linunmanl le bi baga be niin takpem,

ref: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
text: ke bin kan iyoo yan nin naah li ŋa man wee Masiya a Naaŋ kan be bi ni nan chinn kan le ki wɔɔn bi Masiya a fala a jim nin kupag kan li ŋɔɔrin.

ref: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
text: Ni nan kpiir ki wɔɔn bi ke baa nan tun tenn biba le, amaa nim. Bilinlemin kaah nan pag tiwann tan wee ni gbirin wee ban mɔɔn tibɔŋann nin mɔɔn ti sei ni Kasi a Naaŋ kan nyan paabin a pɔɔm bu-n. Hali malakam ban bin biɛ tiwann nmɔn le. Nbinben ŋan a yim

ref: Be alert and think straight. Put all your hope in how God will treat you with undeserved grace when Jesus Christ appears.
text: Mambu, ni ŋaam ni potiɛl sili ki tun itoon; ni choom niba; ki ta ni tama biɛn ki ŋa linyunyunbasanl lan wee bi na li sei nin, n-yonn man wee Yisa Masiya na yin kpiirin nin.

ref: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
text: Naah ye nbuwaab ban jɔɔ limɔcheelin, ni laa ji nɔɔ kɔlisabirug, kan wee naa la nan nyi wee ki nɔɔ nni.

ref: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
text: Amaa Uwonbɔr wan yin ni kaah be kasi man nin, ni mu li be kasi nin ni toon biɛn nin na;

ref: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
text: ni ma bu ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke: “Ni li be kasiu, nan bu-n min Uwonbɔr be le kasi.”

ref: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
text: Nan bu-n naah yin ti Baa wan ji bininfob biɛn a bɔr nin bi toon kaah ye man wee kaa gann nin, ni bu ni che ni binbem li be ke ni ye bicham le dulinya nan yaan ki li san Uwonbɔr bijawaam nin jilimau.

ref: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
text: Nan bu-n ni nyi ke naa ye tiwann tan boon ke tikurninann bee salima le Uwonbɔr nan ta mann nkpenim a manug ki fee ni ki nyan nbinben man kaa jɔɔ bu wee ni yaajam nan ta sei ni-n ni,

ref: You were rescued by the precious blood of Christ, that spotless and innocent lamb.
text: amaa ni nan ye Masiya wan a cham ŋan nin le, Masiya wan ye kipeebig kan kaa jɔɔ igalin bee kidaŋi.

ref: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
text: Uwonbɔr nan gann u le ki nin naan dulinya, amaa le ki nan kpiir u wɔɔn idajoorikaa nan yaan nim bu.

ref: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
text: Uma bu le ni ŋa Uwonbɔr yada, wan nan fiin Yisa nkumin ki sei u kupag, mambu ni yada a ŋaam nin ni tama be Uwonbɔr ban le.

ref: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
text: Naah mann niba kasi wee ki jɔɔ ibamɔn a mɔcheelin wee ki jiɛ ni nabum ibamɔn ni, ni li jiɛ tab nin ni sufu biɛn na.

ref: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
text: Ni ma bu “Bininfob biɛn nann timɔɔr le, le bi pag biɛn nann nmɔɔpuum man be kulɔŋ; timɔɔr koor le, le nmɔɔpuum mu lur,

ref: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
text: amaa Uyudaan a mɔleen ma le gbaa be le.” I ma ye imɔleen yan wee bi nan ta mɔɔn sei ni.

ref: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
text: Mambu, ni jiɛn niwann nan ye kininaŋ nin kularug, nin bilinlarib a toon nin linunchɔril nin kutingbiig a booli biɛn na.

ref: Be like newborn babies who are thirsty for the pure spiritual milk that will help you grow and be saved.
text: Ni li be ke nbiliɛmin, ki li jiɛ Kinaaŋ a biim man be kasi-n na, wee nin che ni yabig ni feegabin,

ref: You have already found out how good the Lord really is.
text: daandaan nan naah len ki biɛ ke Uyudaan ŋan ni.

ref: Come to Jesus Christ. He is the living stone people have rejected, but which God has chosen and highly honored.
text: Naah chaan Uyudaan ban nin, wan ye limiɛfol a tangbagil lan wee bininfob yii win, amaa le Uwonbɔr a num gbee u le U gann win,

ref: And now you are living stones being used to build a spiritual house. You are also a group of holy priests, and with the help of Jesus Christ you will offer sacrifices that please God.
text: ni mu tɔɔl be le ke itangbag yan fo-n, le U ta ni ki ma iniin wee ni li ye kasi a minmanib, wee ni li mann kinaaŋ a manug kan wee Uwonbɔr a num gbee Yisa Masiya bu-n.

ref: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.”
text: Nan bu-n ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke: “Lig, n ta litangbagil liba ki bil Zayɔnn, litangbagil gann kaal lan jɔɔ linungbeel ki ŋmag lifiɛl, le wan gaa u jin biɛn kaa li ji ifa.”

ref: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
text: Ki ta jiin nim ban ŋa yada-n paam, litangbagil nmɔn jɔɔ linungbeel. Amaa ban kaa ŋa yada ma ban, “Litangbagil lan bitanmaab yii lin nan labir litangbagil lan ŋmag nmaan nni le,”

ref: But you are God's chosen and special people. You are a group of royal priests and a holy nation. God has brought you out of darkness into his marvelous light. Now you must tell all the wonderful things he has done. The Scriptures say,
text: Amaa nim ye bininfob gannkaab le, ki ye bininfob ban ye ibɔrniin a minmanib, ki ye kasi a bol, ki ye Uwonbɔr yaab, ke ni pag Uma wan yin ni ki nyan ni libunbɔnlin ki ta ni ŋa ligaril a wonweem n-yaan nin.

ref: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
text: Isaŋ iba naa nan ye bininfobi, amaa daandaan nan ni ye Uwonbɔr a ninfob le; isaŋ iba naa nan kan linyunyunbasanli, amaa daandaan nan ni kan linyunyunbasanla. Uwonbɔr a yomi

ref: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
text: N jɔtiib, n balin ni le, naah kaa ye dulinya nan yaab wee ki sin be dulinya nan ki ye bichamin, ni jiɛn titoonbir a kɔlisau, tan kɔnn nin ni naamin.

ref: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
text: Ni li be nbinben ŋan nmɔn a bosuu ban kaa ye biwonjiɛmin a sisiigin na, hali baah le galin ni ke ni tun tibirin na, ni biɛn yɔli ni li che bin kan ni toon ŋan ki sei Uwonbɔr kupag lidaal lan wee U nan yin gɔnn ti.

ref: The Lord wants you to obey all human authorities, especially the Emperor, who rules over everyone.
text: Ti Yudaau bu, ni li cheel ban wee bininfob siin bi tininkper a pɔɔmin biɛn a mɔɔŋi ya, naah ye ubɔraa wee u pɔɔm jon tininkper a pɔɔm,

ref: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.
text: bee bitinŋmagib, bi ma le u tun bi ke bin dar tibirdam a tuli wee ki pag ban tun itoon ŋan nin.

ref: God wants you to silence stupid and ignorant people by doing right.
text: Nan bu-n ni ye Uwonbɔr a wiib le ke ni tun itoon ŋan nan li loon tijɔri tan kaa nyi niba-n a mɔleen.

ref: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.
text: Ni li be ke ban ye bi ba-n, amaa ni laa jɔɔ ye nba a binbem nmɔn ki tun tibiri; ki li be ke Uwonbɔr a toontum kaah be man nin.

ref: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
text: Ni sei uninfo biɛn jilima kan kpaan u: Ni li jiɛ ni wonjiɛn tab a linlaginn na, ni li san Uwonbɔr ki li tenn ubɔr yudaan jilimau. Masiya a fala a jim a magil

ref: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
text: Nim ban ye biyomi, ni gaam ni yudam a mɔɔŋi nin jilima biɛn, wee nin laa ye ban ŋan wee bininfob a num gbee bin a binba, amaa hali nin ban a pooi to-n gbaa tɔɔl.

ref: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
text: Nan bu-n, ni ye usaal kan nan kpaan a nan wi wee ki sin jɔɔ limɔril waah tiɛr Uwonbɔr bu-n ke, u li kan npagim Uwonbɔr ban.

ref: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
text: Amaa a ŋa tibir wee bi booŋ a toonbir nmɔn bu wee a jin fala ke, baa nyɔɔr wee a kan naa? Amaa ni ye a jin fala itoon ŋan bu ki jɔɔ limɔril ke, ni ma le a li kan npagim Uwonbɔr ban.

ref: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
text: Ni nan bu le Uwonbɔr nan yin ni, nan bu-n Masiya nan jin fala ni bu-u, ki wɔɔn ni limagil, ke ni li nɔɔ u tabogi ya.

ref: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
text: “Waa nan tun niba a biri, le kularug mu kaa nan nyi nyan u mɔnn ni.”

ref: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
text: Baah nan sugir win, waa nan sug bi ki jiin ni; waah nan jin fala-n, waa nan fann uba, amaa u nan ta u ba le ki ŋa Uwonbɔr wan ji bininfob biɛn a bɔr kaah kpaa man nin a nɔɔn,

ref: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
text: Uma tɔɔl le nan tu ti yaa bir u gbanann nin lidapunpunl bu, wee nin che ti kpo tibir bu ki kan limiɛfol nbuchin binben nin ban; u daŋin bu le ni kan kutebug.

ref: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
text: Ni nan nann ipee yan bor le, amaa daandaan nan ni jir Upeekpaar nin Wan guu ni tinaamin ban na.

ref: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
text: Nim biniinpiib, man mu le ye ni, ni li cheel ni chiɛb a mɔɔŋi ya, ni ye bi ni uba kaa ŋa Uwonbɔr a bɔr yada ke, ni binbem bu bi li ŋa yada, ke naa kpaa talar nin ni pag niba gbaa,

ref: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
text: ni ye bi kan ni kasi nin ni jilima a binbem ke.

ref: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.
text: Ni laa che ni ŋinŋam be npaan ni, a li ke ni yukper a lolim bee salima a liɛnbim, bee ikinken ŋan a yeem bu.

ref: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
text: Amaa ni che niba a manim li be ni sufu ni, nŋinŋan man kaa wiiri ki be soon nin kinaaŋin, ni ma ye nŋan man wee Uwonbɔr a num gbee takpem.

ref: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
text: Yaayoo ni, kasi a piib ban nan ŋa Uwonbɔr yada-n, man le bi nan ŋaan ki ŋaŋir biba. Bi nan cheel bi chiɛb a mɔɔŋi le,

ref: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
text: ke Sɛra wan nan chee Abiraham a mɔb wee ki yi u ke u yudaau win. Ni ye Sɛra a bisiɛm le, ni ye ni tun nan ŋan wee kaa san bijawaam ke.

ref: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
text: Nim bipiidam, man mu le ye ni, ni mu li cheel tenn ni piiba, ki li nyi ke bi ye bilanjiim le ni ban, ki li tenn bi jilima ke nim nin bi ma biɛn na li gaa Uwonbɔr a piinŋan yan ye limiɛfolin, wee niba laa li fir legin ni wonmiɛli. Fala a jim itoon ŋam bu

ref: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.
text: Nan joor, ni biɛn li jɔɔ nmɔkpaau wee ni baga li be tabin na; ni li jogir taba, ki li jiɛ tab ke nnabumin, ki li san tab kunyunyunbaag nin jiininba.

ref: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
text: Ni laa jɔɔ tibir ki yɔ tibiri bee ki laa sug ban sug ni ki jiin ni, amaa ni li kaab tikaar ŋan tenn ban kaa ŋaa ni choba, ni niɛ nan bu le Uwonbɔr nan yin ni ke ni nan kan tikaar a faal.

ref: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
text: Ni ma bu ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke, “Wan jiɛ limiɛfol wee u num nkan idaa yan ŋan ke, un choom u lanbil tibɔbir a pagimin nin u mɔgbai kularug a leen yin.

ref: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
text: Ni kpaa le nin un jiɛn tibir a tum wee ki li tun itoon ŋan; ki li ban nposɔɔn a sam wee ki li nɔɔ mi.

ref: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
text: Nan bu-n Uyudaan a num paa bibuchim bu le, le ki pelig bi wonmiɛl iyoo biɛn, amaa Uyudaan a num kaa paa ban tun titoonbirin bu.”

ref: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
text: Ni ye a num man itoon ŋan a tum bu ke, uba be ki li fir seiŋ kidaŋaa?

ref: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
text: Amaa hali ni le ye ni ji fala itoon ŋan bu ke, tikaar be ni bu. “Ni laa san bininfob kaah san nan bijawaamin nni; ni laa che ni lam yugiri.”

ref: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
text: Amaa ni taam Masiya ki ŋa ni sufu ni wee u li ye ni Yudaau. Ki sin li ye ban ŋa sili iyoo biɛn ki guu uninfo wan biɛn li baan ni nan bu wee ni jɔɔ tama. Amaa ni ŋa man nin nbinbem ŋan nin jilima,

ref: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
text: ki che ni potiɛl li ŋan na, wee ban pag bii ni nin kininaŋ ni binbenŋam Masiya ni-n nji ifa bi tingbiig nmɔn bu.

ref: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
text: Nan bu-n ni ye ni jin fala itoon ŋan a tum bu wee ni ye Uwonbɔr a bam ke, ni sɔ nin ni ji fala titoonbir bu.

ref: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
text: Nan bu-n nba le Masiya nan kpo ki sei tibirdam biɛn, ubuchin nan gaa ban kaa ye bibuchim a kum ki kpo, ke un che ni foo Uwonbɔr ban. Bi nan ku u le tigbanann ni le u ji kan limiɛfol Kinaaŋ bu,

ref: Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison.
text: Kinaaŋin bu le u ji nan jon ki tan mɔɔn tibɔŋann nin ki sei nnaam man be kuloondiigin ni,

ref: They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.
text: ban nan jɔɔ limɔyiil iyaayoo yan nan jon nin wee Uwonbɔr nan jin limɔril ki guu bi Nowa a yonn, wee Nowa nan be kpee kuŋaluŋin. Kuŋaluŋ nmɔn yaan bininfob wama le nan kɔɔ ki ye bininfob biniin, bi man nan kan nŋmarim nnyum nmɔn yaan,

ref: Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death.
text: le nnyum nan, nin si Uwonbɔr a nyunfulin lan fee ni mu gabin a taai yin, kaa ye tigbanann a jaginn a funya, amaa tipoor tan wee ti poo ke ti li jɔɔ nbinben ŋan ki jiin Uwonbɔr paamin bu, li fee ni ki gab Yisa Masiya a kum a fiim bu.

ref: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
text: Yisa wan nan don paab ki be Uwonbɔr a nɔɔjiim paam nin Malakam nin tininkper a pɔɔm nin ipɔɔn biɛn yan cheel u mɔbin.

ref: Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning.
text: Mambu, Masiya kaah nan jin fala u gbanann nin man nin, ni ŋaam sili ki li ŋmag u binbem nmɔn na, nan bu-n wan jin fala u gbanann nin nin diɛ tibir a manuga.

ref: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
text: Naah ŋa man nin, waa che u binbem a joorim dulinya nan yaan ye tigbanann a kɔlisa, amaa Uwonbɔr kaah ban man.

ref: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
text: Nan bu-n ni nan jin isaŋ takpem le iyoo yan nan jon nin ki tun nan wee ban kaa ye biwonjiɛmin gann ki tun. Bi nan tun nan ye nwanchɔgin toon, nin kɔlisabirug, nin lidanyugbeel, nin lidanyugbeel a toonbir, ki lagin tab ki nyu ndaam gbeeg, ki mann ibawol.

ref: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
text: Bi tiɛr ni ye tichann le naah kaa ji kɔɔn nin titoonbir a toon takpemin ni, mambu le bi lagin tisugir ki tunn ni.

ref: But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead.
text: Amaa bi na li pag baah tun man ki sei wan ŋa sili ki li ji ban fo nin ban kpo a bɔrin.

ref: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
text: Ni nan bu le bi nan mɔɔn tibɔŋann nin hali ki sei ban kaa ji be bi miɛfolin daandaan nan nin, wee bin ji bi tibɔr uninfosaal a gbanann bu, amaa le bi li kan limiɛfol kinaaŋin bu. Ban ŋmag Uwonbɔr a piini nbamɔm a bɔr

ref: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
text: Tiwann biɛn a diɛm mala. Mambu ni che ni potiɛri li ween na wee ki li chor ni ba wee ni li fir miɛ Uwonbɔr.

ref: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
text: Nan jon niwann biɛn ye ni li jiɛ tab le nbamɔm, nan bu-n njiɛm deginn tibir takpem bu le.

ref: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
text: Ni li gaan tab kuchɔŋa ki laa ŋulin tab bu.

ref: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
text: Uninfo biɛn n taam ipiin yan wee Uwonbɔr sei win, ki ter u kpiɛtiib nbamɔm nin nŋmagŋam Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl kaah ye man balbal.

ref: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
text: Ni ye uba pag ke, u li pag tibɔr tan ye Uwonbɔr a mɔleen ya. Ni ye wan yin tun ke, u li tun nin npɔɔn man wee Uwonbɔr ta sei win na, wee niwann biɛn ni Uwonbɔr a yinl n kan kupag Yisa Masiya bu. Kupag nin npɔɔn ye u yaan le hali nin iyoo yan kaa jɔɔ diɛmi. Ibamɔn. Uwonjiɛn kaah li ji fala man

ref: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.
text: N jɔtiib, ni laa che nin gar ni nin naah ji limagil a nanwi a fala-n ni, a li ke ni ye tiwanchann le ni ban ni.

ref: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
text: Amaa ni che ni li mɔ na nin naah por ki ji Masiya a fala-n bu, wee ni nan kan nmɔn takpen u pagin a kpiirimin.

ref: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
text: Ni ye bi sug ni Masiya a yinlin bu ke, ni kan tikaara, nan bu-n Kinaaŋ a pag nin Uwonbɔr be nin ni.

ref: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
text: Ni ye ni jin fala ke, nin laa ye ke uninfokur a fala a jimi bee unaayig bee wan tun titoonbir biɛn ni, bee wan tugin bininfobi.

ref: Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him.
text: Amaa uninfo jin fala waah ye uwonjiɛn nbu ke, u laa san ifa, amaa udaan npag Uwonbɔr nin waah jɔɔ uwonjiɛn a yinl nmɔn na.

ref: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
text: Ni ma bu isaŋ foou nin Uwonbɔr npiin ki ji U niin yaab tibɔra; ke ni ye ni yin piin nin tim ke, ke ban kaa chee Uwonbɔr a bɔŋann nin yaal na li be nii?

ref: “If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God?”
text: Le, “Ni ye ni pɔɔ ki sei nin bibuchim nkan nŋmarim ke, ke ban kaa jɔɔ nween nin tibirdam yaal na li be nii?”

ref: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
text: Mambu, ban ji fala Uwonbɔr a bam bu-n bi le li tun nan ŋan na, ki ta biba ki sei bi yada daan wan naan bin ki le li tun nan ŋan iyoo biɛn na.

ref: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
text: Nim ban ye bininkpeeb ni sisiigin ni, n balin ni le maah ye ni ninkpekpiɛgin, wan jin siɛra Masiya a fala a jim nin min wan na li kan n tol u pag a kpiirimin nin:

ref: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
text: Ni li kpaa Uwonbɔr a peei yan wee u taa ŋa ni nɔɔn nin na, ki li tun ke uwonjiɛn sanliira wee ni laa ye bi mug ni le amaa ni tɔɔl a bam bu, ke Uwonbɔr kaah ban ni li be man nin; kaa ye ilig a bam bu, amaa ki li ye ban ŋa sili nin ni tun;

ref: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
text: ki laa ta ni mug ban wee Uwonbɔr ta bi ŋa a nɔɔn nin ni, amaa che fin le li ye limagil ki sei ipee nmɔn.

ref: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
text: Wee upeekpaabɔr nan degirin ke, a kan kupag a yuchigirig kan kaa wiirin.

ref: All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say, “God opposes proud people, but he helps everyone who is humble.”
text: Binaachipɔm, man mu li ye ni, ni li jɔɔ limɔcheel ki tenn ban jon ni. Ni biɛn, ni ta jiininba ke tiwann yɔɔr tan wɔɔn ke ni jɔɔ jiininba ki sei tab, nan bu-n, “Uwonbɔr yiin kalanbaanidam le, amaa le ki san jiininbadam kunyunyunbaag.”

ref: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
text: Mambu, ni jiin niba, Uwonbɔr a nɔɔ man jɔɔ npɔɔn nin ban na, wee iyoo nmɔn nan foo ke, u nan don ni paab.

ref: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
text: Ni taa ni bɔmugkaar biɛn ki sei wa nan bu-n u baga be nin ni.

ref: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
text: Ni choom niba ki li nyi niba bu. Ni dataag ulinlaril le choon le jin ke ugbegin wan ŋuun ki ban uninfo un choo niɛ-n.

ref: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
text: Ni laa chee, ki li ŋmag ni yada kenken na, nan bu-n ni nyi ni nabum ban be dulinya munl nan biɛn be man a fala ni le.

ref: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
text: Le Uwonbɔr wan ye linyunyunbasanl biɛn daan ni, wan yin ni ke ni kan u pag kan kaa jɔɔ diɛm Masiya nin, naah jin fala wama a bɔɔn nin, Uma tɔɔl le ji li jiin ni siin ni yada-n ki che ni pɔɔg, le ni sir kenken.

ref: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
text: Uma kpaan nin npɔɔn n-yonn yan kaa jɔɔ diɛmi. Ibamɔn. Ipoor yan joor

ref: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
text: Silasi wan wee n nyi ke u ye uwonjiɛn ibamɔn nin, li terim le n sɔb kugbɔŋ nan wama, ke n pɔɔg ni gbanann wee nin jin siɛra ke nan be nan ye Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl le ibamɔn. Mambu ni li ŋmag ni nin nbamɔma.

ref: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
text: Ni nabum ban be Babilɔnn ki ye ban wee Uwonbɔr nan lagin gann nin nimin, poor ni, le n bija Mag mu poor ni.

ref: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
text: Ni li poor tab nin njiɛma. Nposɔɔn li be nim ban biɛn be Masiya ni-n.

ref: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
text: Min Simɔnn Piita wan ye Yisa Masiya a toontunnu nin u toomin, Le sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn ban wee Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a buchin binbem bu che bi kan yada kan ŋan ke ti yaagin:

ref: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
text: Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl nin nposɔɔn li be ni bu takpem, naah biɛ Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Yisa nbu. Uwonbɔr a yim nin U gannim

ref: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
text: Waah jɔɔ Uwonbɔr a pɔɔm man nin bu che ti jɔɔ taah ban nan limiɛfolin biɛn nin nwonjiɛn binben taah biɛ u nbu, wan yin ti u baantɔɔl a pag nin u ŋam bu-n.

ref: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
text: Ni niɛ nan bu, le u sei ti imɔsiin takpen yan ŋan wee ni ma bu nin che ni por Uwonbɔr a wonaaŋ a pɔɔm wee ki ŋmar dulinya a ŋmaruŋin kan nyann tibir a kɔlisa-n.

ref: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
text: Ni ye nbinben ŋan nan a bosu magir ni ki kpiɛ ke, mi li che naa li walin gurin bee naa li ye ban kaa jɔɔ nyɔɔri, ni biɛm ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya ni.

ref: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
text: Amaa ni ye wan kaa jɔɔ nbinben nan ke, udaan a num kaa ga nan fɔgi u jɔɔn na, ki pii tam ke Masiya nan ŋunn u bir kpegirin na.

ref: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
text: Mambu, n nabum, ni biɛn pɔɔn niba nin linunmanl ki che ni yim nin ni gannimin li ye ibamɔn na. Nan bu-n ni ye ni ŋa man ke, naa li lu,

ref: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
text: man le li che ni ga ipoor ŋan ki kɔɔ nnaam man kaa jɔɔ diɛm ti Yudaau nin ti feeru Yisa Masiya nin.

ref: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
text: Mambu, n le yin gbaa tiɛr ni le tiwann nmɔn bu, hali naah pii nyi ki si kenken ki baa ibamɔn yan wee ni jɔɔ daandaan nan ni.

ref: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
text: N tiɛr ke ni ŋan nin n li ligir ni potiɛl, n miɛfol kaah la be n gbanann nin,

ref: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
text: nan bu-n naa li yuuri le n ta ti bil ngbaan, ke ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya kaah kpiir wɔɔnim man nin.

ref: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
text: N li pɔɔn nba niwann biɛn nin, ki ŋa nan kpaa talar ke n ŋa, wee ni bɔɔn bu n nan fɔɔr ni ban ke ni li fir tiɛr ni niɛ nan biɛn bu. Masiya a siɛra jib a pag

ref: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
text: Taa nɔɔ nlam a teeni isaŋ yan wee ti nan taah wɔɔn ni ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a pɔɔm nin u dam a bɔrin ni, amaa ti ye siɛra jib le ban a num nan kan u jilima-n.

ref: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
text: Nan bu-n u nan kan jilima nin kupag ti Baa Uwonbɔr ban n-yonn man wee, likukɔl nan nyan U jilima a pagin yaan ki len ke, “N bija sɔ, wan wee N jiɛ; uma le N num gbee.”

ref: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
text: Ti baantɔɔl a tuli nan gbir likukɔl nan kaah nyan paab ki len man, tim nin uma kaah nan lagin be kasi a jɔɔl bu-n.

ref: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
text: Le ti ta bilinlem a mɔboi yin ki ŋa ibamɔn, ni pɔɔn niba ki mann pel ya, a li ke nwonween kaah wonn libunbɔnlin man nin, ki nan kpaa kutaag kaah na li wonn wee njakpanyiɛn a ŋmabili nwonn ni sufu ni.

ref: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
text: Nan jon ni biɛn, ni kpaa le nin ni biɛ ke ilinlen leen yan sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin nin kaa nyan ulinlenn baantɔɔl a kar wɔɔn nin ni.

ref: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
text: Ni ma bu-n ilinlen leen kaa nan nyan uninfosaal a sufu a bamin le, amaa Uwonbɔr a Kasi a Naaŋ le nan be bininfob ban le ki che bi pag ilinlen leen.

ref: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
text: Amaa tibɔkar a linlem mu nan be bininfob nmɔn ban, ke ban wɔɔnn tibɔkar kaah na li be ni mu ban man nin. Bi na li woon ki ta nan kaa ye ibamɔn ki wɔɔn ni, hali ki yii Uyudaan wan jɔɔ npɔɔn biɛn wee ki nan daa bin, ki ban nbiin man yin dan weem ki jaar biba bu.

ref: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.
text: Bininfob takpem na li nɔɔ bi fai nmɔn a sam, le ki che ibamɔn a samin kaa jɔɔ jilima.

ref: They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.
text: Tibɔkardam a jaŋuuŋ nbu, bi na li teen iteen baah li ŋa man ki ji ni dulim, nan na yin bii bin a sili pii beera, le nan yin bii bin kaa dɔ jiɛn ni.

ref: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
text: Ni ma bu Uwonbɔr kaa nan jiɛn malakam ban nan tun tibirin nni, amaa le ki nan ta bi jaa nŋmi-n, nan yaan wee ntuton be-n wee bi nan kan tibɔr a jim.

ref: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
text: Waa nan jiɛn yaaja yoo a ninfob a bir ki per bi wee ki nan che nnyum jin ban kaa jɔɔ ween nin, le ki nyan Nowa, wan nan mɔɔn tibuchinn a binbem, nin bininfob bilile.

ref: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
text: Le U nan bii Sodom nin Gomoriya ki nan che bi gaa nŋmi ki nan kpann nfatam, ki ŋa bi limagil ke ban kaa jɔɔ nween nin kaah na li kan man.

ref: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
text: Ni ye Uyudaan ŋa man biɛn ke, U nyi waah li ŋa man ki fee ban ye biwonjiɛmin ki jaa bi mugilin, amaa le ki guu ban kaa ye bibuchimin tibɔr a ji daal, nin waah na tugir ki dar bi tuli man.

ref: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
text: Ni niɛ nan sin ye ibamɔn le ki jann tɔɔ ban nɔɔ kuŋmaruŋ kan ye bi gbanann a bamin ziɛn tininkper a pɔɔma. Bi ye ban jɔɔ ipoobil le nin ban jɔɔ kalanbaani, baa san bijawaam nin bin ŋa kutingbiig nin paab a wann naan wann tan fo;

ref: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
text: hali malakam, kaah le jɔɔ tigbanann a pɔɔn takpemin gbaa, baa jɔɔ kutingbiig a galin ki tenn ban be papaabin Uyudaan a nintogili.

ref: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
text: Amaa bilinlarib nan, bi wɔɔn biba le ki sugir tibɔr tan biɛn wee baa nyi ti taai. Bi nann kulɔŋ a wankor le, tiwann naan wann tan kaa nyi niba, tan be wee bi nan chor tan kɔr, bi na li kpo ke tiwankorin.

ref: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
