text: Bi na li yɔ bi ki jiin baah jin bininfob fala nbu. Bi ye ban a num gbee tigbanann a kɔlisa a toon yan wee bi tun nwonween nin le. Bi ji ye bifadam ban kaa san igalin le, hali bi le lagin ki ji nin ni tijiir ke, bi nyann bi mɔm bilig npaan nin le.

ref: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
text: Bi num gbee iwanchɔgin toon le, baa jiɛn tibir a tumi; le ki lar ban kaa si bogiliba-n; ki ye ban nyi kujaŋuuŋ a toon, limɔpool be bi bu!

ref: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
text: Bi ta nsan man telin le gab ki bor ki nɔɔ Balaam Bɔɔr a bija, wan ban npooton a yɔrin.

ref: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
text: Amaa Uwonbɔr nan che kiboŋ kan kaa pag tibɔr ta usaal a kukɔl ki fuun ulinlenn nmɔn bu ki ŋɔɔr u waarug a toon yin.

ref: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
text: Bininfob nmɔn nann kinyunbuŋ kan kaa jɔɔ nyum le nin liŋunl lan wee nfaam daar li chaa-n le. Libunbɔnjal le siin ki guu bi.

ref: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
text: Bi mɔɔŋi kaa jɔɔ nyɔɔri, kalanbaani a mɔleen le bi jɔɔ, ki lar ban ban bin nya tigbanann a kɔlisa a toon yin ni, le bi jir kuŋmaruŋ a toon yin.

ref: They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
text: Bi bei bininfob le ke bi na li kan yemba amaa le bi baantɔɔl ye tibir a yomi, nan bu-n nan nyaŋir uninfo ŋaan u tiyomir le.

ref: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
text: Ni ye baah nyan dulinya nan a ŋmaruŋin, baah nyi ti Yudaau nin ti feeru Yisa Masiya-n, wee ni ye kuŋmaruŋ nmɔn ji choo bi ki nyaŋ bi ke, bi joorim na li bir ki jo bi piinim.

ref: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
text: Ni ye baa bi nyi tibuchinn a samin ke, ni bi li ŋan ki sei bi ki jon nin baah nyi mi wee ki labir bi bɔɔn ki kpaa kasi a siim man wee bi nan ta sei bi nna.

ref: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
text: Le bi ŋaar nmɔn wɔɔn ke ibɔŋal yan bi gaa-n ye ibamɔn le: Yan len ke, “Kibɔg wul ke ki jir tan ji ki wulin nin le,” le “Udool mu fun nnyum ke, u ji jir le ki tan fu nnyunbunyiɛm.”

ref: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
text: N ban ni li tiɛr imɔleen yan wee kasi a linlem nan pag isaŋ yan nan jon nin, nin nsiim man wee ti Yudaau nin ufeerin nan che u tooi yin ta sei nin.

ref: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
text: Chinchinn, ni kpaa le nin ni li nyi ke idajoorikaa-n bininfob ban yɔɔlin na li dan, ki ta bi yɔɔlim nmɔn ki nɔɔ bitɔɔl a gbanann a kɔlisa birugin.

ref: and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
text: Bi na li len ke, “Waah nan siin limɔsiinl ke u li dan nin, u dam nmɔn be laa? Hali ti baam a kum a bɔɔn ki nan kpaa daandaan nan, niwann biɛn le la be le ke dulinya a naan yonn nin.”

ref: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
text: Amaa bi yii le kaa tiɛr ke isaŋ yan nan jon nin Uwonbɔr nan pag imɔleen le i naan paab nin tum, nnyum le u nan ta naan dulinya a tingbɔŋ, ki che kutingbɔŋ nmɔn nyan nnyumin.

ref: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.
text: Nnyum nmɔn le nan jin bi ki bii dulinya iyaayoo nmɔn.

ref: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
text: Uwonbɔr a mɔleen iba nmɔn le U ji ta guu papaab nin tum kan be daandaan nan ke nŋmi n nan gaa, ni si le ki guu tibɔr a ji daal nin ban kaa ye biwonjiɛmin a biim.

ref: Dear friends, don't forget that for the Lord one day is the same as
text: Amaa ni laa tam ni niɛ nan bu, n jɔtiib: Ti Yudaau ban, lidaal liba nann ibin turil le, ibin turil mu nann weemba le.

ref: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
text: Ti Yudaau kaa ye wan sɔɔn wee kaa ŋmag u mɔsiinlin ni, a li ke biba kaah tiɛr nsusɔɔn bu man nin. U jɔɔ limɔril le nin ni, kaa ban uba n nan kpo, amaa u ban uninfo biɛn nkpenn u binbem le.

ref: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
text: Amaa ti Yudaan a dam nmɔn na yin nann unaayig a dann le. Papaab na li fɔɔr nin tifur takpenn; le nŋmi na li gaa tiwann tan be papaabin, le tum nin tiwann tan be tum nmɔn na li dɔɔn yɔli.

ref: Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live.
text: Tɔ, ni niɛ biɛn kaah na li gab yɔli nan, ni kpaan ni li ye ŋmam maa? Ni kpaan ni li be nbinben man ye kasi le nin nwonjiɛn binben,

ref: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
text: a li ke naah lig Uwonbɔr a daal wee ki ban ke li pii bi foon nin. Lidaal nmɔn le nŋmi na yin gaa ki bii papaab, le nŋmi nmɔn a tuntom na li che tiwann tan be paab ndenn.

ref: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
text: Amaa taah ŋmag U mɔsiinlin, tim le guu papaab pɔŋ nin tum pɔŋin le, bibuchim a niin yin.

ref: My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace.
text: Ni ma bu n jɔtiib, naah guu ni niɛ nan bu, ni pɔɔn niba ki li jɔɔ kasi a binbem wee ki laa jɔɔ igalin Uwonbɔr ban ni, wee ki li jɔɔ nposɔɔn nin Uwonbɔr.

ref: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
text: Ni li nyi ni sufu ni ke ti Yudaau a mɔrilin ye nan sei ni nŋmarim le, a li ke ti nabig jiɛkaag Pɔɔl kaah sɔb sei ni Uwonbɔr kaah sei u nlam man ni.

ref: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
text: U le sɔb man le u gbann biɛn nin, ki pag jɔɔ jiin tibɔr nan paam. U gbann nmɔn jɔɔ tiwann tiba tan pɔɔ nin uninfo nbiɛ ni taai, nan wee bininfob ban kaa nyi niba, kaa si bogil liba-n, taar ti ki labir ti tibɔkar, ke baah pii ŋaan Uwonbɔr a mɔleen iba man ni, wee i bii bitɔɔlin.

ref: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
text: Mambu, n jɔtiib, naah pii nyi ni niɛ nan bu nan, ni li guu niba wee ki laa che ban kaa jɔɔ nsiim nan nlar ni ki kɔɔn kulɔŋ wee ni lu ni sisibol ŋanlin ni.

ref: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
text: Amaa ni li yabirig nin ti Yudaau nin ti feeru Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl nin u nyinyimin na. Uma kpaan kupag daandaan nan nin isaŋ yan kaa jɔɔ diɛmi! Ibamɔn.

ref: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
text: Wan nan be npiinimin, wee ti gbir u bu-n, wee ti num kan win, le ti lig u, hali ki ta ti nɔɔi maa win, uma le ti mɔɔn ki jiin u paam ke u ye limiɛfol a mɔbonl le.

ref: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
text: Limiɛfol nmɔn degirin na; ti kan limiɛfol nmɔn ki jin li siɛrau, limiɛfol lan kaa jɔɔ diɛm nmɔn a bɔr le ti pag ki tenn ni nan, lan nan be Baa-n ban nin, li degirin ti buu.

ref: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
text: Ti bei ni nan wee ti kan ki sin gbir le, ke nin che ni mu li jɔɔ nɔɔ nin tab nin tim. Le ti nɔɔ nin tab nmɔn be ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin U big Yisa Masiya ban le.

ref: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
text: Ti sɔb ni niɛ nan ki tenn ni, ke nin che ti li jɔɔ nmɔn biɛn. Uwonbɔr ye nwonween le

ref: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
text: Tibɔr tan wee ti gbir u ban sɔ, le ti bei ni nan: Uwonbɔr ween le; libunbɔnl kaa be U ban kolibi.

ref: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
text: Ni ye ti ke ti jɔɔ nɔɔnintab nin Uma le amaa le ki la choon libunbɔnlin ke, tibɔkar le ti por nmɔn taa be nin ibamɔn ni.

ref: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
text: Amaa ni ye ti choon nwonween nin, a li ke waah be nwonween nin man nin ke, tim nin nim jɔɔ nɔɔnintab, le Yisa wan ye U Bija-n a cham li ŋunn ti biɛn nan a bir.

ref: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
text: Ni ye ti ke taa jɔɔ tibir ke, ti lar ti ba le, le ibamɔn kaa be ti ban ni.

ref: But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
text: Ni ye ti nyan ti bir ki bei u ke, u ye yada daan le ki tun nan ŋan, u li jiɛn ti bir biɛn ki per ti, ki ŋa ti kasi ki nyan ti ta kaa jɔɔ buchin binben biɛn nin.

ref: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
text: Ni ye ti ke taa jɔɔ tibir ke, man ke ti ta Uwonbɔr le ki ŋa tibɔkardaan le U mɔleen yin kaa be ti ban ni.

ref: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
text: N bijiɛkaam, n sɔb kugbɔŋ nan le ki tenn ni, ke nin laa che ni tun tibiri. Amaa ni ye ke uba tun tibir ke, ti jɔɔ wan gaa pag tenn ti Baa-n ki kpiɛ ti bu, Yisa Masiya, Ubuchin daan nin.

ref: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
text: Uma ye tibir a manug kan ŋunn ti bir, le naa ye tim a binba a bir bu amaa nin dulinya munl nan biɛn a bir.

ref: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.
text: Ti nyi ni ye ti chee Uwonbɔr a siimin ke, ni ma li che ti biɛ U.

ref: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
text: Wan len ke, “N nyi u,” amaa wee kaa tun Uwonbɔr kaah siin man nin ke, udaan por tibɔkar le, le ibamɔn nin kaa be u ban ni.

ref: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.
text: Amaa wan biɛn chee u mɔbonlin ke, Uwonbɔr a jiɛm ŋa ibamɔn udaan ban na. Ni niɛ nan le che ti biɛr taah be nin Uwonbɔr man:

ref: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ. The New Commandment
text: Wan ke u be nin Uwonbɔr ke, ni kpaa le nin u li be ke Masiya kaah nan be man nin. Nsiim pɔm a bɔr

ref: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
text: N jɔtiib, naa ye nsiim pɔm le n sɔb ki tenn ni, amaa nsiim kpegim, man wee ni nan jɔɔ npiinimin nin. Nsiim kpegim le ye tibɔr tan wee ni gbirin.

ref: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
text: Nin ni ma biɛn nin, nsiim pɔm le n sɔb ki tenn ni, le ti kan ni bamɔn u ni nin ni ni, nan bu-n libunbɔnl fɔɔr le chaa le ibamɔn a wonweem pii nyagin le.

ref: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
text: Wan ke uma be nwonween nin amaa wee ki sin nan u nabig ke, udaan la be libunbɔnlin le.

ref: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
text: Wan jiɛ u nabig ke, udaan be nwonween nin le, le niba kaa be u ban ki li che un gbiɛri.

ref: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
text: Amaa wan nan u nabig ke, udaan be libunbɔnlin le ki choon jin; kaa nyi waah chaa nan paami, nan bu-n libunbɔnl nmɔn che u jɔɔn na.

ref: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
text: N buwaab, n sɔb kugbɔŋ nan le ki tenn ni, nan bu-n Masiya a yinl bu ni kan tibir a jiɛn pera.

ref: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
text: N sɔb kugbɔŋ nan le ki tenn nim ban ye baam, nan bu-n ni nyi u wan nan be npiinimin nbu. N sɔb le ki tenn nim ban ye iwanpɔlin, nan bu-n ni nyaŋ titoonbir daan nin na. N sɔb le ki tenn nim ban ye n buwaab, nan bu-n ni biɛ ti Baa-n nna.

ref: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
text: N sɔb le ki tenn nim ban ye baam, nan bu-n ni nyi wan nan be npiinimin. N sɔb le ki tenn nim ban ye iwanpɔlin, nan bu-n ni jɔɔ npɔɔn, le Uwonbɔr a mɔleen be nin ni, le ni nyaŋ tibirdaan nin na.

ref: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
text: Ni laa jiɛ dulinya bee nan ye dulinya nan a wann ni. Ni ye uba jiɛ dulinya ke, ti Baa a jiɛmin kaa be udaan ban ni.

ref: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
text: Niwann nan biɛn be dulinya nan yaan nan, uninfosaal a toonbirin a bam, inunbil a kɔlisa nin ligbingbanfaal waah jɔɔ nan nin waah li fir tun nan, naa nyan ti Baa ban ni, amaa ni nyan dulinya nan yaan le.

ref: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
text: Dulinya nin ki kɔlisa li jo, amaa wan tun Uwonbɔr kaah ban man ke, udaan yin gbaa be le ki chaa. Masiya a dataag

ref: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
text: N bijiɛkaam, iyoo yan joor sɔ, ke naah pii gbir ke Masiya a dataag chaan nin, hali daandaan nan gbaa Yisa a dataam takpem dan na. Mambu le ti biɛ ke ni ye iyoo joor kaa le.

ref: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
text: Bi nyan ti ban na, amaa baa sin ye ti yaabi. Bi bi ye ti yaab ke, bi bi li paar ti ban; amaa baah nyan ti ban nin nmɔn le wɔɔn ke bi ni uba kaa ye ti yaa wi.

ref: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
text: Amaa Kasi daan nin kpaar nkpam ki wur ni buu, le ni biɛn nyi ibamɔn nin.

ref: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
text: Naa ye naah kaa nyi ibamɔn nin bu le n sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn ni, amaa naah nyi ibamɔn nin nbu, nan bu-n tibɔkar kaa nya ibamɔn nin ni.

ref: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
text: Ŋma ye tibɔkardaan naa? Wan kaa chee ke Yisa le ye Masiya-n. Udaan ye Masiya a dataag le. U yii Baa-n nin U bigin le.

ref: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
text: Wan yii Bija-n ke udaan kaa jɔɔ Baa-n ni; wan gbir sei Bija-n ke, udaan jɔɔ Baa-n mu.

ref: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
text: Ni che naah nan gbir nan npiinimin nin li be ni sufu ni na. Ni ye ni tun man ke ni mu li be Bija-n nin Baa-n ban.

ref: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
text: N sɔb ni tiwann nan le ki tenn ni ki jiin ban ban bin lar ni ki kɔɔn kulɔŋ nbu.

ref: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
text: Nim bu ke naah nan gaa likpanwuril lan nin be ni ban, ni bu naa ji ban uba nwɔɔn ni. Amaa a li ke likpanwuril nmɔn kaah wɔɔn ni niwann biɛn nin, wee likpanwuril nmɔn ye ibamɔn nin, kaa ye kularugin, a li ke likpanwuril nmɔn kaah wɔɔn ni man nin, ni li be u ban na.

ref: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
text: Tɔ daandaan nan n bijiɛkaam ni li be u ban na, wee u nan degirin ke ti li jɔɔ tidindann ki laa san ifa u jirimin daali.

ref: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
text: Ni nyi ke u ye ubuchin ke, ni ŋan nin ni li nyi ke wan biɛn tun nan ŋan ke, Yisa le ma udaan.

ref: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
text: Ni lig ti Baa Uwonbɔr kaah pu ki jiɛ ti tan lagir man, ke bi li yi ti ke Uwonbɔr a buwaab! Man mu le ti sin ye! Nan bu wee dulinya yaab kaa nyi ti-n ye baah kaa nyi Uwonbɔr nle.

ref: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
text: N jɔtiib, daandaan nan ti ye Uwonbɔr a buwaab le, le taah na yin be man kaa la kpiir wɔɔn ti. Amaa ti nyi ke u nan degirin ke, ti yin be le ke uma-n, nan bu-n ti na yin kan u le ke waah be man nin.

ref: This hope makes us keep ourselves holy, just as Christ is holy.
text: Uninfo wan biɛn jɔɔ tama Uwonbɔr ni ke, udaan ŋa uba le kasi ke Yisa kaah be man ni.

ref: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
text: Wan tun tibir ke u bii nsiima; ibamɔn bu, tibir kaa ŋmag nsiimi.

ref: You know Christ came to take away our sins. He isn't sinful,
text: Amaa ni nyi ke u nan degirin un nan ta ti yaa bir le. Le u ni tibir kaa be.

ref: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
text: Wan biɛn be nin Yisa kaa gbaa tun tibiri. Le wan gbaa tun tibir mu kaa la kan u bee ki nyi wi.

ref: Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself.
text: N bibankaam, ni laa che uba nlar ni ki kɔɔn kulɔŋi. Wan tun nan ŋan nin uma ye ubuchin, a li ke Yisa kaah ye ubuchin man nin.

ref: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
text: Wan tun nan bir ke u ye ulinlaril a ninfou le, nan bu-n ulinlaril pii ye wan tun tibir le npiinimin na. Nan bu wee Uwonbɔr a Bija nan degirin ni, nan ye un bii ulinlaril a toon le.

ref: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
text: Uwonbɔr kaah ma wan biɛn kaa yin gbaa tun tibiri, nan bu-n Uwonbɔr a nunaŋ be u ni, ni bu waa li fir gbaa tun tibiri, Uwonbɔr kaah ma win bu.

ref: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
text: Ni niɛ le che ti biɛr ban ye Uwonbɔr a buwaab nin ban ye ulinlaril a buwaab: Ban kaa tun nan ŋan bee kaa jiɛ bi nabumin kaa ye Uwonbɔr a buwaabi. Ni li Jiɛ taba

ref: From the beginning you were told we must love each other.
text: Tibɔr tan wee ni gbir npiinimin nin sɔ: Ke ti li jiɛ taba.

ref: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
text: Ni laa be ke Keenn ni, wan nan ye ulinlaril a ninfou wee ki nan ku u waalin nni. Babu wee u nan ku u waalaa? Nan bu-n u toon yin nan ye tibir le, le u waal mu a toon nan ye tibuchinn.

ref: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
text: Ni laa che nin gar ni, n nabum, ni ye dulinya yaab nan ni ke.

ref: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
text: Ti nyi ke ti pii nyan nkumin ki kɔɔ limiɛfolin na, nan bu-n taah jiɛ ti nabumin bu. Uninfo wan kaa jiɛ ke udaan la be nkumin le.

ref: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
text: Wan nan u nabig ke u ye uninfokur le, le ni nyi uninfokur kaa jɔɔ limiɛfol lan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛmin ni.

ref: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.
text: Ni niɛ nan le che ti biɛr njiɛm kaah ye nan: Yisa Masiya kaah nan gaa ti kum ki kpe-n. Ni ŋan nin ti mu nkpo ti nabum bu.

ref: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
text: Ni ye uba jɔɔ dulinya nan a faal wee ki kan u nabig wan ban literil, amaa wee kaa jogir u ke, Uwonbɔr a jiɛm yin ŋa nii ki be udaan ban naa?

ref: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
text: N buwaab, ni laa che ti jiɛm ye imɔleen bee lilanbil a binba, amaa ni li nɔɔ nin itoon nin ibamɔn. Lipoobil a jɔɔm Uwonbɔr a nintogil

ref: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
text: Ni niɛ nan bu le ti biɛr ke ti nɔɔ ibamɔn, le ni che ti jɔɔ lipoobil Uwonbɔr ban,

ref: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
text: iyoo yan wee ti sufu bii ti ke ti jɔɔ igalin ke, ti li nyi ke Uwonbɔr jon ti sufu nmɔn na, ki ye wan nyi niwann biɛn.

ref: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
text: N jɔtiib, ni ye ti sufu kaa bii ti ke, ti jɔɔ tidindann Uwonbɔr ban,

ref: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
text: ki li kan nan biɛn wee ti miɛ U, nan bu-n ti chee U siima, ki tun nan li gbee U num.

ref: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
text: U siim sɔ: Ke ti ŋaam U bija Yisa Masiya a yinl yada, wee ki li jiɛ tab ke waah siin ti man nin.

ref: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
text: Ban chee U siimin be U ban le, le U mu be nin bi. Ni nan le che ti biɛr ke U be nin ti: Kinaaŋ kan wee U sei ti nbu le che ti nyi.

ref: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
text: N jɔtiib ni laa ŋa kinaaŋ biɛn yada, amaa ni mag kinaaŋ biɛn njee ki nyan Uwonbɔr ban na, nan bu-n tibɔkar a linlem takpem dan dulinya nan yaan na.

ref: and you can know which ones come from God. His Spirit says that Jesus Christ had a truly human body.
text: Naah li ŋa man ki biɛ Uwonbɔr a Naaŋ sɔ: Kinaaŋ kan biɛn len ke Yisa Masiya nan dan nin uninfosaal a gbanann le ke, u nyan Uwonbɔr ban le,

ref: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
text: amaa kinaaŋ kan biɛn kaa chee Yisa ke kaa nyann Uwonbɔr ban ni. Kinaaŋ nmɔn ye Yisa a dataag le, kan wee ni pii gbir ki bu ke ki chaan nin, hali daandaan nan gbaa ki pii be dulinya nan yaan.

ref: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
text: Nim, n bijiɛkaam, ni nyan Uwonbɔr ban le ki nyaŋ ba, nan bu-n wan be ni ban nin yab ki jon wan be dulinya nan yaan nna.

ref: These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language.
text: Bi nyan dulinya nan yaan le, ni bu le bi pag dulinya a bɔr, le dulinya yaab pelig bi bɔr nmɔn.

ref: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
text: Tim nyan Uwonbɔr ban le, le uninfo wan biɛn nyi Uwonbɔr pelig ti bɔr, amaa wan kaa nyan Uwonbɔr ban kaa pelig ti bɔri. Taah ŋaan man ki biɛr ibamɔn a Naaŋ nin tibɔkar a naaŋ le yen. Uwonbɔr le ye wan jiɛ

ref: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
text: N jɔtiib, ni che ti li jiɛ taba, nan bu-n njiɛm nyan Uwonbɔr ban le. Uninfo wan biɛn jɔɔ njiɛm ke Uwonbɔr le ma u, le u nyi Uwonbɔr.

ref: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
text: Uninfo wan kaa jiɛ u tab ke waa nyi Uwonbɔr i, nan bu-n Uwonbɔr ye wan jiɛ le.

ref: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
text: Uwonbɔr kaah wɔɔn ti waah jiɛ ti man sɔ: U nan tunn U bija gaŋin dulinya nan yaan ke nin che ti kan limiɛfol kibig nmɔn bu.

ref: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
text: Njiɛm sɔ: Naa ye ti jiɛ Uwonbɔr le, amaa Uma jiɛ ti, le ki tunn U bija le u nan mann tibir a manug ti yaa bir bu.

ref: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
text: N jɔtiib, Uwonbɔr kaah jiɛ ti kagin, ni ye ti mu li jiɛ tab le.

ref: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
text: Uba kaa la nyi kan Uwonbɔr i; amaa ni ye ti jiɛ tab ke, Uwonbɔr li be nin ti, le U jiɛm n ŋa dede ti ban.

ref: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
text: Ti nyi taah be nin Uwonbɔr le U mu be nin ti, nan bu-n U sei ti U naaŋin na.

ref: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
text: Le ti kan ki jin siɛra ke ti Baa-n le nan tunn U Bija ke un nan ŋa dulinya nan a feeru.

ref: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
text: Uninfo wan chee ke Yisa ye Uwonbɔr a Bija ke, Uwonbɔr be udaan ban, le udaan mu be nin Uwonbɔr.

ref: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
text: Ni bu ti pii nyi le ki ŋa yada nin Uwonbɔr a jiɛm man wee U jɔɔ nin ti-n. Uwonbɔr ye wan jiɛ le. Wan jiɛ ke, udaan be nin Uwonbɔr le, le Uwonbɔr mu be nin udaan.

ref: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
text: Ni niɛ nan bu, njiɛm ŋa dede ti ban na le ti li fir jɔɔ tidindann tibɔr a jidaal, nan bu-n ti nann U le dulinya nan yaan.

ref: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
text: Njiɛm kaa jɔɔ bijawaami. Amaa chasi a jiɛm ŋɔɔ bijawaam le ki nyann, nan bu-n bijawaam ye litudaril le. Uninfo wan san bijawaam kaa be chasi njiɛmin yaan ni.

ref: We love because God loved us first.
text: Ti jiɛ U nan bu-n Uma nan chinn jiɛ ti.

ref: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
text: Ni ye uba len ke, “N jiɛ Uwonbɔr,” amaa wee ki nan u nabig ke, udaan ye tibɔkardaan le. Nan bu-n wan kaa jiɛ u nabig kan wee u ga win ke, waa li fir jiɛ Uwonbɔr wan wee waa ga win ni.

ref: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
text: Le U sei ti nsiim nan: Uninfo wan biɛn jiɛ Uwonbɔr ke, ni kpaa le nin u li jiɛ u nabig mu.

ref: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
text: Uninfo wan biɛn ŋa yada ke Yisa le ye Masiya ke, Uwonbɔr le ma u, le uninfo wan biɛn jiɛ Baa-n jiɛ U bigin tɔɔl.

ref: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
text: Ni niɛ nan le ye taah biɛr ke ti jiɛ Uwonbɔr a buwaab man: Ti li jiɛ Uwonbɔr wee ki li nɔɔ U siim.

ref: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
text: Taah li jiɛ Uwonbɔr man sɔ: Ti chee U siimin na. Le U siim nmɔn kaa ye litugili,

ref: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.
text: Uwonbɔr kaah ma nan biɛn nyaŋ dulinyau. Nnyaŋim man nyaŋ dulinya sɔ: Hali ti yada-n.

ref: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
text: Ŋma ye u ki nyaŋir dulinyaa? Wan le ŋa yada ke Yisa ye Uwonbɔr a bija-n.

ref: Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful.
text: Yisa Masiya le ye wan nan dan nin nnyum nin ncham. Naa ye nnyum a binba bu le u nan dan ni, amaa nnyum nin ncham bu. Le Kasi a Naaŋ jin ni siɛra, nan bu-n Kinaaŋin ye ibamɔn le.

ref: In fact, there are three who tell about it.
text: Nan bu-n tiwann titaa le jin ni siɛra:

ref: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
text: Kinaaŋin, nin nnyum nin ncham; le tiwann titaa nmɔn jɔɔ limɔcheel nin tab.

ref: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.
text: Ti cheel uninfosaal a siɛra le, amaa Uwonbɔr a siɛra le polig jon man, nan bu-n ni ye Uwonbɔr a siɛra kan wee U jin U bija-n bu le.

ref: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
text: Wan biɛn ŋa Uwonbɔr a bija nan yada jɔɔ siɛra nan u sufu ni. Wan kaa ŋa Uwonbɔr yada ta U ki labir tibɔkardaan na, nan bu-n waa ŋa yada Uwonbɔr a siɛra kan wee U jin U bija-n bu.

ref: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
text: Siɛra nmɔn sɔ: Uwonbɔr sei ti limiɛfol lan kaa jɔɔ diɛma, le limiɛfol nmɔn be U Bija-n ban le.

ref: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
text: Wan jɔɔ Bija-n jɔɔ limiɛfol; wan kaa jɔɔ Uwonbɔr a Bija-n ke waa jɔɔ limiɛfoli. Limiɛfol lan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛm

ref: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
text: N sɔb tiwann nan ki tenn nim ban ŋa Uwonbɔr a Bija a yinlin yada ke nin che ni biɛ ke ni jɔɔ limiɛfol lan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛm.

ref: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.
text: Nan bu wee ti jɔɔ tidindann Uwonbɔr ban sɔ: Ni ye ti miɛ U nan nɔɔ nin U sufu a bam ke, U gbir ti miɛm le.

ref: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
text: Le ni ye ti nyi ke U gbir ti miɛm ke, ti nyi ke taah miɛ U nan bu biɛn ti li kan.

ref: Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly.
text: Ni ye uba kan u nabig tun tibir tan kaa joor nin nkum ke, un miɛm wee Uwonbɔr n sei udaan limiɛfol. N pag jiin ban a bir kaa ye bin kpo nle. Tibir tiba be ki ye nkum. Naa ye ti a bir le n ke un miɛ.

ref: Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
text: Itoon yan a tum kaa kpaan biɛn ye tibir le, amaa tibir tiba be kaa joor nin nkumi.

ref: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
text: Ti nyi uninfo wan biɛn wee Uwonbɔr ma win kaa gbaa tun tibiri. Wan wee Uwonbɔr nan ma-n le guu u, le ulinlaril kaa li fir sei u kidaŋi.

ref: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
text: Ti nyi taah ye Uwonbɔr a buwaab, le dulinya munl nan be ulinlaril a nɔɔn.

ref: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
text: Le ti ji nyi Uwonbɔr a big kaah dan ki nan sei ti nbiɛm, ke nin che ti biɛ Uma wan ye ibamɔndaan nin. Le ti mu be nin Uma wan ye ibamɔndaan nmɔn, hali nin U big Yisa Masiya. U ye ibamɔn a Wonbɔru le nin limiɛfol lan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛm.

ref: Children, you must stay away from idols.
text: N buwaab, ni nyam niba ibawolin.

ref: From the church leader. To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth.
text: Min uninkpel, Le sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn upii gannkaa nin u buwaabin, wan wee n jiɛ u nin ibamɔn nin, le naa ye n binba le jiɛ wi, amaa ban biɛn nyi ibamɔn ni mu jiɛ u le,

ref: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
text: nan bu-n ibamɔn yan be ti ban ki yin gbaa be ti ban chaan bu.

ref: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
text: Ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin Yisa Masiya wan ye Baa-n a Bija-n a nyunyunbasanl, nin nposɔɔn li be ti ban ibamɔn nin njiɛm. Ibamɔn nin njiɛm

ref: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
text: Ni seim nmɔn takpen le maah kan ke a buwaab biba nɔɔ ibamɔn a samin, ke ti Baa kaah siin ti man nin.

ref: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
text: Daandaan nan upii jiɛkaa, maa sɔb n siinpɔm le ki tenn niŋi, amaa nsiim man wee ti pii nan gbir npiinimin nin. N beiŋ le ke ti li jiɛ taba.

ref: Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.
text: Njiɛm sɔ: Ke ti li nɔɔ U siimin. A li ke naah nan gbir man npiinimin nin, U siim ye le ke ti li choon nin njiɛm.

ref: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
text: Bilinlarib takpem, ban kaa chee ke Yisa Masiya dan nin tigbanann le dulinya nan yaan nin, bi nyan le ki yal dulinya nan yaan. Bininfob nmɔn a bosu ye bilinlarib le nin Yisa a dataam.

ref: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
text: Ni bu ni li lig niba nbamɔm ki laa che nan wee ni tun nin n lu yɔli, amaa wee ki li ye ban li kan tiyɔr biɛn.

ref: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
text: Uninfo wan paa lagir wee kaa gbaa be Masiya a wɔɔmin yaan ke, waa jɔɔ Uwonbɔr i; wan gbaa be nwɔɔmin yaan ke, u jɔɔ Baa nin Bija-n le.

ref: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
text: Ni ye uba dan a ban wee kaa ŋmag Yisa a wɔɔmin ke, laa che un kɔɔ a niin bee a poor wi.

ref: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
text: Wan poor u ke, udaan ye wan kpiɛ u bu le bi tun npooton a toon. Imɔbon yan joor

ref: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
text: N jɔɔ tibɔr takpem n sɔb sei ni, amaa maa ban n ta kugbɔŋ nin ngbansɔbmɔɔn ki sɔbi. Amaa n jɔɔ tama ke n li gɔnn ni wee ti num n kan tab wee n pag sei ni, wee ti mɔm nmɔn ngbeen.

ref: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
text: A ninsa gannkaa win a buwaab poorin.

ref: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
text: Min uninkpelin, Le sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn n jɔ Gayɔsi, wan wee n jiɛ u nin ibamɔn ni.

ref: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
text: N jɔ, n miɛ Uwonbɔr le a li jiɛn nbamɔm wee niwann biɛn li ŋan ki seiŋ, ke a naaŋ kaah be ni ŋan man nin.

ref: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
text: Ni ŋaam nmɔn pam, nin nnabum biba kaah nan dan ki nan beim ŋaah ŋa yada nin ibamɔn man nin ŋaah gbaa choo nin ibamɔn man.

ref: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
text: Maa jɔɔ npopeen niba bu ki lagir nin maah gbir ke n buwaab nɔɔ ibamɔn a samin ni. Baah pag Gayɔsi man

ref: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
text: N nabig, a jɔɔ yada nin ŋaah tun nan ki tenn nnabumin, hali nin baah le ye bicham a ban nin na.

ref: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
text: Bi bei biwonjiɛm a laguŋ ŋaah jiɛ bi man na. Pɔɔn a ba ki ter bi wee bin chonn bi sanchonl, nan li gbee Uwonbɔr a num.

ref: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
text: Masiya a yinl bu le bi nan nyan, amaa kaa kan niba a teril ban kaa ye biwonjiɛmin ban ni.

ref: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
text: Mambu ni kpaa le nin ti gaa bininfob nmɔn kuchɔŋ wee ti lagin tun nin ibamɔn. Diyotirifisi nin Dimitirusi a bɔr

ref: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
text: N nan sɔb sei biwonjiɛm a laguŋin na, amaa Diyotirifisi, wan ban u li ye usanliirin, kaa chee un gbir sei ti.

ref: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
text: Ni bu ni ye n dan ke, n li wɔɔn waah tun nan, u su ti bɔɔn le ki gbii ti bu. U num kaah kaa la gbee waah tun nan nin, le u nan yii kaa poor nnabumin ni, le ki ji gɔɔ ban ban bin poor bin ki ŋɔɔr bi nyan biwonjiɛm a laguŋin.

ref: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
text: N jɔ laa toog nan biri, amaa li toog nan ŋan na. Uninfo wan tun nan ŋan nyan Uwonbɔr ban le. Le wan tun nan bir kaa kan Uwonbɔr i.

ref: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
text: Bininfob biɛn pag Dimitirusi u, hali nin ibamɔn nin tɔɔla. Ti tɔɔl pag wa, le ni nyi ke ti siɛra nmɔn ye ibamɔn le. Ipoor yan joor

ref: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
text: N jɔɔ tibɔr takpem n sɔb seiŋ, amaa maa ban n ta kugbɔŋ nin ngbansɔbmɔɔn ki sɔbi.

ref: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
text: Min Juud wan ye Yisa Masiya a toontunnu ki ye Jemisi a nabigin, Le sɔb kugbɔŋ nan tenn bininfob ban wee Uwonbɔr yin bin, wee bi ye Uwonbɔr a ninfob jiɛkaab wee Yisa Masiya ŋmag bin:

ref: I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love! False Teachers
text: Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbaag nin nposɔɔn nin njiɛm li be nin ni takpem. Ban wɔɔn tibɔkar

ref: My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people.
text: N jɔtiib, hali maah nan jɔɔ inunman ke n sɔb kugbɔŋ ki sei ni ki ta jiin nŋmarim man wee ti nan por nin tabin paami, n lig ki miin ni kpaa le nin n sɔb ki balin ni wee ni li kɔn yada kan wee Uwonbɔr nan ta ŋubin u ninfogannkaabin a nɔɔn nin buu.

ref: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
text: Ni ma bu bininfob bibam woon ki kɔɔ ni sisiigin na, ban wee bi nan sɔb bi bɔr ke bi li bii bin. Bi ye ban kaa jiɛn Nween le, bi ye ban labir ti Wonbɔru a nyunyunbasanl a bɔrin le, ki nɔɔ iwanchɔgin toon, ki yii Yisa Masiya wan ye ti bɔru nin ti yudaau win.

ref: Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them.
text: Hali naah le pii nyi ni niɛ nan biɛn bu-n, n ban n tiɛr ni le ke Uyudaan nan nyan U ninfob Ijibir a tiŋin na, amaa ni bɔɔn bu U nan bii ban kaa nan ŋa U yada-n na.

ref: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
text: Le malakam ban kaa nan ŋmag bi ninkper a pɔɔm a sisibol amaa wee ki fɔɔr bi baantɔɔl a niin yin nin, Uwonbɔr ta ni niɛ le ŋa libunbɔnlin, ki lol bi tikulor tan kaa jɔɔ chiim ki guu tibɔr a jim lidaal takpenlin daal.

ref: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
text: Ni ye man le a li ke, Sodom nin Gomoriya nin ntim man nan mal bin a ninfob kaah nan tun iwanchɔgin toon bi piibanlin nin bi jabanlin nin ichɔgin. Bi ma ye limagil ki wɔɔn ban nan yin kɔɔ nŋmi-n a fala a jim kaah na li ye man.

ref: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.
text: Man mu jigin, ban dɔgin man nmɔn bii bi baantɔɔl a gbanann le, le ki yiin tininkper a pɔɔm, ki jɔɔ kutingbiig ki tenn paab a wann naan wann tan fo.

ref: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
text: Amaa hali malakam a ninkpelu Maakil, nin Sintani kaah nan far limɔkpel nin tab ulinlenn Moziz a gbanann bu-n, waa nan chee ki jɔɔ kutingbiig a galin nin Sintani, amaa le ki len ke, “Uyudaan li fuun a bu!”

ref: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
text: Amaa bininfob nan ma sugir niwann nan biɛn wee baa biɛ le nin tiwann tan wee bi nyi wee kaa jɔɔ nlamgɔrikaami, ke tiwankor tan kaa jɔɔ potiɛlin, tiwann nmɔn le bii bi.

ref: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
text: Bi woo tibɔbir be bi bu! Bi gaa Kenn a toon le, bi ban tinyɔɔr le weem weem le ki kɔɔ Balaam kaah kɔnn nin bininkpeeb; le ni bii bi Kɔra mɔyiilin bu.

ref: These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit.
text: Bininfob nan ŋaan ni mɔkpaam a jiirin le tijaginn, bi lagin ji nin ni le ke ifa kaa jɔɔ bi, bi ye bipeekpaab ban jinn biba le ki jiɛn tiwankor. Bi nann titalangbann tan kaa jɔɔ utaal wee ntafaam daar mi chaa-n le, ki nann lipiɛl a siigi yan a far soor wee yaa jɔɔ iloon nin ki ŋab lu, wee ki kpo nfim milee-n.

ref: Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
text: Bi nann limɔgil a nyungbann tan fii takpemin le, le bi fai a toon nmɔn nann ke bichiib a puugin. Bi nann iŋmabil yan chon jin le. Uwonbɔr pii mann libunbɔnjal le li si guu bi.

ref: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
text: Enog wan ye Adam a yaabisagira bilile nan, nan pag ilinlen leen ki jiin bininfob nan paama: “Lig, Uyudaan nin U kasidam tuturil a turil le chaan nin,

ref: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
text: ke un ji uninfo biɛn tibɔr, ki choo ban kaa ye biwonjiɛm biɛn baah nɔɔ nan kaa ye liwonjiɛnl a sam ki ŋaan tiŋaar tan kaa ye Liwonjiɛnl a ŋaarin bu, nin titintann a mɔleen yan wee tibirdam ban kaa ye biwonjiɛm pag ki galin Uwonbɔr nan.”

ref: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want. More Warnings
text: Bininfob nmɔn ŋulin le ki ban bitab a galin; bi nɔɔ bi baantɔɔl a gbanann a kɔlisa; ki far bi tɔɔl a gbingban ki jɔɔ nmɔmɔn nin bininfob bi tɔɔl a nyɔɔr bu. Ikpaan nin n wɔɔnim

ref: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Amaa, n jɔtiib, ni li tiɛr nan wee ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a tooi pii nan pagin buu.

ref: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
text: Bi nan bei ni ke, “Iyoo yan na yin joorin, ban yɔɔlin na li be, ki nɔɔ bitɔɔl a wonjiɛnl a kɔlisa birug.”

ref: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
text: Bi ma ye bininfob ban bɔgir ni, ki nɔɔ bi gbanann kaah ban man wee kaa jɔɔ Kinaaŋin.

ref: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
text: Amaa nim, n jɔtiib, ni li kpiɛg ni ba ni kasi a yada wee ki li miɛ Kasi a Naaŋ.

ref: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
text: Ni li ŋmag niba Uwonbɔr a jiɛmin yaan na, ki li guu Uyudaau Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl lan na yin ta ni ki kɔɔ limiɛfol lan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛmin yaan.

ref: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.
text: Ni li san bininfob ban jɔɔ nbiɛnimin kunyunyunbaaga;

ref: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
text: ni yug ni tab nŋmi ni ki fee bi gaba, le bitab mu ni li san bi kunyunyunbaaga ki ŋmarin bijawaam, wee ki li nan bi wanyeewann tan wee kuŋmaruŋ a gbanann ngbarin. Npagim a wonmiɛl

ref: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
text: Ti sei Uwonbɔr wan be U binba wan ye ti feeru ki jɔɔ kupag, nin jilima, nin npɔɔn, nin tininkper a pɔɔm, ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a yinlin, iyoo yan nan jon nin, nin daandaan nan nin iyoo yan kaa jɔɔ diɛm! Ibamɔn.

ref: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
text: Tibɔkpiirikaar tan wee Uwonbɔr nan ta sei Yisa Masiya ke, un ta wɔɔn u toontum nan yin tun daandaan nan. U nan che U malaka le wɔɔn U toontunnu Jɔnn,

ref: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
text: le Jɔnn nan jin siɛra waah kan nan biɛn nin bu, ti ma ye, Uwonbɔr a mɔleen nin Yisa Masiya a siɛra.

ref: God will bless everyone who reads this prophecy to others, and he will bless everyone who hears and obeys it. The time is almost here.
text: Wan karin ilinlen leen yan be kugbɔŋ nan a poolin ke tikaar be udaan bu, le ban mu gbir tibɔr nmɔn ki ta ŋa bi sufu ni ke tikaar be bi bu, nan bu-n iyoo mala. Ipoor yan tenn biwonjiɛm a laginn tilile

ref: From John to the seven churches in Asia. I pray that you will be blessed with kindness and peace from God, who is and was and is coming. May you receive kindness and peace from the seven spirits before the throne of God.
text: Min Jɔnn, le sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn biwonjiɛm a laginn tilile tan be Asiya a yerin ni: Linyunyunbasanl nin nposɔɔn lan nyan Uwonbɔr ban li be nin ni, Uma wan be, nin wan nan be, nin wan yin dan, ki ji nyan ntinaam milile man be u naangbɔŋin u nintogilin li be ni ban.

ref: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
text: Linyunyunbasanl nin nposɔɔn lan ji nyan Yisa Masiya, wan ye ibamɔn a siɛradaau win, kibininkpeeg kan chinn fii nkumin, nin wan ye dulinya nan a bɔrtiib biɛn a bɔru win li be ni ban. Wan jiɛ ti wee ki ta u cham ki nyan ti tibirin nin,

ref: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
text: le ki che ti ŋa u naam a ninfob nin biminmanib ke ti li jiɛn Uwonbɔr wan ye u Baa-n, u binba le kpaan nin kupag nin npɔɔn iyoo nin iyoo! Ibamɔn.

ref: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.
text: Lig, u be titalangbann nin ki chaan, le nnumbim biɛn na li kan u; hali nin ban nan ŋu win li kan u; le dulinya yaab biɛn na li mɔɔ u bu. Ni sin li ŋa man! Ibamɔn.

ref: The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!” A Vision of the Risen Lord
text: “Min le ye Npiinim nin Njoorim,” Uyudaan Uwonbɔr le len man, “Min wan be, nin wan nan be, nin wan yin dan, npɔɔn biɛn daan.” Masiya a zii

ref: I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus.
text: Min, Jɔnn wan ye ni nabig, wee ki ye ni kpiɛg ti fala-n nin ti naamin nin ti mɔril a nyiginimin nan ye ti yaan Yisa bu-n, wee ki nan be ligungonl lan be nnyum a sisiigin Patmosi-n Uwonbɔr a mɔleen bu nin maah ye Yisa a siɛra bu-n.

ref: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
text: Uyudaan a kpakɔɔl daal, n nan be nin Kinaaŋ le, le ki gbir likukɔl kaah tiɛn paab n bɔɔn ki nann kunaatuŋ,

ref: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
text: ki len ke, “Sɔb nan wee a kan nan ki ŋa kugbɔŋ kpabkaagin ki ta tan sei biwonjiɛm a laginn a kerim milile-n na: Ti ma ye Efesusi, nin Simarina, nin Pagamum, nin Tayatira, nin Sadusi, nin Filadelifiya nin Laodisiya.”

ref: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.
text: le filaam a tutɔɔnbol nmɔn uba nan be niin “ki nann uninfosaal a big”, ki yee daala kan fɔg ki tan piin u taabili bu le salima a changbam lol paan u gbingbanl bu.

ref: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
text: Le u yul nin u yukper peen ke tigunn nin, bee liŋunlin, le u num paam be ke nŋmipeen nin.

ref: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.
text: U taai nan nann tukur tan wee bi ta pul nŋmi-n ke ti nyagin man nin le, le u kukɔl a fur nann nnyum puukaam.

ref: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
text: U nan ŋmag iŋmabil ilile le u nɔɔjiim, le takoobi kaaŋ kan jɔɔ imɔɔŋ ilee nyan u mɔnn. Le u num paam nyagin ke nwosisiigin nin.

ref: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
text: Maah nan kan u n-yonn man nin le n lu u ta tum ke utakpiirin. Le u ta u nɔɔjiim ki paan nbu ki len ke, “Laa san bijawaami. Min le ye Npiinim nin Njoorim.

ref: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
text: N ye Wan Fo-n le; N nan kpou, liga n fii nkumin na ki ye wan fo-n le hali nin iyoo yan kaa jɔɔ diɛm! Le ki ŋmag Nkum nin Kitakpiin tiŋ a naanganl a piin.

ref: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.
text: “Mambu, sɔbim ŋaah kan nan na, nan be daandaan nan nin nan na yin ŋa ni bɔɔn.

ref: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
text: Ŋaah kan iŋmabil ilile yan n nɔɔjiim paamin nin salima a filaam a tutɔɔnbol ilile liwoolin nin a taai ye nan le: Iŋmabil ilile-n ye biwonjiɛm a laginn tilile-n a malakam le, le salima a filaam a tutɔɔnbol ilile-n mu ye biwonjiɛm a laginn tilile-n.

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
text: Le u beim ke, “Sɔb sei Efesusi a wonjiɛm a malaka ke: Wan ŋmag iŋmabil ilile u nɔɔjiimin wee ki choon salima a filaam a tɔɔnbol ilile-n a mɔleen sɔ:

ref: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
text: N nyi ni ŋaar, ni nunman nin ni mɔril man. Ki ji nyi naah kaa ban bininfob ban a pooi to, mambu le ni nan mag ban nan ke bi ye itoon wee kaa sin ye-n ki biɛ baah ye tibɔkardam man.

ref: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
text: Ni jɔɔ limɔril le ki jin fala n yinl bu, amaa le naa bagi.

ref: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
text: Amaa nan bu wee n galin ni sɔ: Ni jiɛ-n ni chinchinn a jiɛmin nna.

ref: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.
text: Ni tiɛrim naah nan nyan nan fɔg man wee ki nan lunn! Ni kpenn ni binbema wee ki li tun ke naah nan tun man chinchinn nin na. Ni ye naa kpenn ke, n li dan ki nan yuur ni salima a filaam a tutɔɔnbolin kisisibol.

ref: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
text: Amaa naah ŋaan nan wee ni ŋan sɔ: Ni nan titoonbir tan wee Nikolatan yaab tun ni, ke n baantɔɔl kaah kaa nan ti man nin le.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
text: Wan jɔɔ litul ke, ni che un gbir Kinaaŋ kaah bei biwonjiɛm a laginn man. Wan fir nyaŋ ke, n li sei u npaan wee un ji limiɛfol a siig a looi, yan be Uwonbɔr a kpaabin.” Ntoon man chaa Simarina yaab ban

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
text: Le u ji ke “Sɔb sei Simarina a wonjiɛm a malaka ke: Wan ye Npiinim nin Njoorim, wan nan kpo wee ki ji fii nkumin nin a mɔleen sɔ.

ref: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
text: N nyi ni fala a jim bu nin naah ye faladam, amaa ni ye bijɔɔndam le! Ki nyi biba kaah jɔɔ kutingbiig ki bei ni ke bi ye Juu yaab le amaa kaa sin ye; amaa bi ye Sintani a wonjiɛndiig a ninfob le.

ref: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
text: Ni laa che bijawaam jɔɔ ni fala kan wee ni yin ji nbu. N bei ni le, Sintani li loon nim bibam tiloondirin ki mag ni, le nin che ni ji fala iweehn piig. Ni le li ŋmag ni yadau, hali ni le ye nkum ke ni, wee n nan sei ni limiɛfol a yuchigirig.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
text: Wan jɔɔ litul ke, ni che un gbir Kinaaŋ kaah bei biwonjiɛm a laginn man. Wan fir nyaŋ ke, waa li kan nkum man yin kpiɛ milee-n a daŋ kolibi.” Ntoon man chaa Pagamum yaab ban

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
text: Ki ji ke “Sɔb ki sei Pagamum a wonjiɛm a malaka ke: Wan jɔɔ takoobi kaaŋ imɔɔŋ ilee-n a mɔleen sɔ.

ref: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
text: N nyi naah be nan yaan, nan yaan wee Sintani a naam a gbɔŋ be-n. Amaa le ni sin ŋmag n yinl nbamɔm. Naa ta naah ŋaam yada-n ki jaa, hali nin Antipasi a yonn nin wan nan ye n yada a siɛradaau ibamɔn nin, wee bi nan ku u ni tiŋin ni, Sintani a binbebolin.

ref: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
text: Ni biɛn yɔli, n jɔɔ tiwann wama nan che n galin ni: Ni jɔɔ bininfob biba be ni ban ki ŋmag Balaam a wɔɔmin, wan nan tinn Balag waah li ŋa man wee Iziral yaab n tun tibir ki ŋman tibawonann, ki li tun iwanchɔgin toon.

ref: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
text: Man le ni mu jɔɔ ban ŋmag Nikolatan yaab a wɔɔnim.

ref: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
text: Mambu ni kpenn ni binbem ma! Naa ye man ke, n li dan daandaan nan ki nan ta takoobi kan nyan n mɔbin nin ki kɔnn bi.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone. The Letter to Thyatira
text: Wan jɔɔ litul ke, ni che un gbir Kinaaŋ kaah bei biwonjiɛm a laginn man. Wan fir nyaŋ ke, n li sei u kulɔŋ a boroboro kan woo-n, wee bi yi ke maana-n. N mu ji li sei u litangbag penl lan wee liyinl pɔnl sɔb paan li bu, le wan gaa litangbagil nmɔn a binba le li nyi liyinl nmɔn a taai.” Ntoon man chaa Tayatira yaab ban

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
text: Ki ji ke “Sɔb sei Tayatira yaab a wonjiɛm a malaka ke: Uwonbɔr a bija wan a numbili nann nŋmipeen wee u taafar nyagin ke kukurug kan nyagin nin a mɔleen sɔ.

ref: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.
text: N nyi ni ŋaar, ni jiɛm ni yada, ni toon nin ni nnyiginim, le ni nin tun ki jon naah nan chinn ki tun man nin na.

ref: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
text: Ni biɛn yɔli, Nan wee n jɔɔ ki galin ni sɔ: Ni cheel tenn upii wan wee bi yi u ke Jezebiɛl, wee u yi uba ke ulinlenn nin. Upii nmɔn a wɔɔm che n toontum kɔɔ iwanchɔgin toon nin lipiibanlin nin lijabanlin nin tibawojiir a jimin.

ref: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
text: N sei u isaŋ ke un kpenn u wanchɔgin toon nmɔn na, amaa le waa ban man ni.

ref: I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop.
text: Mambu n li che un dɔɔn nin iwiɛn, ki che ban dɔɔn nin win n ji fala takpem, man ke bi kpenn ki nyan upii nmɔn a binbemin.

ref: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
text: N li ku u buwaab. Le biwonjiɛm a laginn biɛn n biɛ ke min le ye wan dibir bininfob a sufu nin bi potiɛl, le n li yɔ ni biɛn ni ŋaar bu.

ref: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
text: Daandaan nan n bei nim ban gur be Tayatira, wee kaa nɔɔ upii nmɔn a wɔɔm wee kaa ji tinn Sintani kaah yi nan ke tibɔwoonkaarin :

ref: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
text: Ni le li ŋmag nan wee ni jɔɔ-n hali nin maah na li dan.

ref: I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end.
text: Wan fir nyaŋ ki tun maah ban man hali ki nan kpaa ndiɛm ke, n li sei u tininkper a pɔɔm wee un ŋmag ibol biɛn.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
text: Wan jɔɔ litul ke, ni che un gbir Kinaaŋ kaah bei biwonjiɛm a laginn man.”

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.
text: Ki ji ke, “Sɔb sei Sadisi yaab a wonjiɛm a lagim a malaka ke: Wan ŋmag Uwonbɔr a naam milile nin iŋmabil ilile-n a mɔleen sɔ. N nyi ni ŋaar kaah ye man; bininfob nyi ke ni fo le amaa ni kpou.

ref: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.
text: Ni fii paaba! Wee ki pɔɔg nan gur ki ban nin kpe-n, nan bu-n maa kan ni ŋaar tan ŋan ki gbee Uwonbɔr a numi.

ref: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
text: Mambu, ni li tiɛr, nan wee ni gaa ki gbirin; ni chee sei tibɔr nmɔn na, wee ki kpenn ni binbema. Amaa ni ye naa fii paab ke, n li dan ke unaayig a dann nin, le naa yin nyi n-yonn man wee n yin dan ni.

ref: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.
text: Amaa ni jɔɔ bininfob wama Sadisi ban kaa che bi wan yɔɔr gbarin niba. Min nin bi ma na yin lagin chonn ki yee tiwanpenn, nan bu-n bi kpaan nin man le.

ref: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
text: Wan fir nyaŋ ke u li yee tiwanpenn ke baah yee man nin. Maa li nyan udaan a yinl limiɛfol a gbɔŋin yaan ni, amaa le ki na li tiɛr u yinl n Baa nin U malakam a nintogil.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Philadelphia
text: Wan jɔɔ litul ke, ni che un gbir Kinaaŋ kaah bei biwonjiɛm a laginn man.” Ntoon man chaa Filadelifiya yaab ban

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
text: Ki ji ke, “Sɔb sei Filadelifiya a wonjiɛm a laguŋ a malaka: Wan be kasi ki ye ubamɔndaan ki ŋmag Defid a naanganl a piimin a mɔleen sɔ. U loor nan ke uba kaa li fir loon ni, le nan mu wee u loon ke uba kaa be ki li fir loor ni.

ref: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.
text: N nyi ni ŋaar kaah ye man. Ni lig, n loor ntisamɔn le ki sei ni le uba kaa li fir loon ntisamɔn nmɔn ni. N nyi naah jɔɔ npɔɔn wama, amaa ni biɛn yɔli ni ŋmag n mɔleen le kaa yii n yinli.

ref: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
text: N li ŋa ban be Sintani a jiɛndiigin, wee ki ke bi ye Juu yaab amaa wee kaa sin ye Juu yaabin, ki ye bilinlaribin, n li che bin dan ki nan gbaan ni taatum ki tiɛr ke n jiɛ ni.

ref: You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through.
text: Naah nyigin wee ki jɔɔ limɔril ki ŋmag n siimin bu, n na li nyan ni limugil lan yin foon ki nan mag ban be dulinya nan yaan biɛn nin.

ref: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
text: N chaan le daandaan nan. Ni li ŋmag nan wee ni jɔɔ nna, wee uba laa nan fee ni naam a yuchigirigi.

ref: Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
text: Wan nyaŋ ke, n li ŋa udaan Uwonbɔr a diig a jaantelig. Le waa ji li nya niin ni. N li sɔb n Wonbɔru a yinl nin n Wonbɔru a tiŋ kan ye Jerusalam pɔŋin ki paan u bu, kan yin nyan paab n Wonbɔru ban wee ki jiirin nin; le ki ji sɔb n mu a yin pɔnl ki paan u bu.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
text: Wan jɔɔ litul ke, ni che un gbir Kinaaŋ kaah bei biwonjiɛm a laginn man.” Ntoon man chaa Laodisiya

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
text: Le ki ji ke, “Sɔb ki sei Laodisiya a wonjiɛm a malaka ke: Wan a yinl ye Ibamɔn nin, nin ibamɔn a yada a siɛradaan wee ki ŋmag nan biɛn wee Uwonbɔr naan nin a mɔleen sɔ.

ref: I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other.
text: N nyi ni ŋaar kaah ye man, naa ton ni kaa ji sɔɔn ni. N bi ban ke ni li ye ban ton le bee ban sɔɔn!

ref: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
text: Ni bu, naah ton mala mala wee kaa ton kaa ji sɔɔn nin, n yin sii ni le n mɔn ki gab.

ref: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
text: Nim len le ke, ‘N ye uwandaan le; N ye wan jɔɔ le kaa ji ban niba.’ Amaa le kaa biɛ ke ni ye tikpachar le, ki jɔɔ kunyunyunbaag nin faladam ki ye bijɔɔm ban gaan nin ijakpalon.

ref: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
text: Mambu n kpaan ni le ke ni daam salima kan pul nŋmi-n wee ki mann nin n ban, wee ni ŋa biwandam; ki ji daa tiwann yɔɔr penn tan wee ni li yee, ki fir degin ni fai naah gaan nin bu; wee ki daa nnunkpam n ban ki li balig wee ki ga.

ref: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.
text: Ban wee n jiɛ-n, bi ma le n fu bi bu ki dar bi tuli. Mambu ni ŋaam kinunmaŋ ki kpenn ni binbema.

ref: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
text: Min sɔ! N si ntisamɔn ki kpaar linaanganl. Ni ye wan gbir n kukɔl wee ki loor linaanganl ke, n li kɔɔ wee ki nan ji nin u, wee u mu nji nim.

ref: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
text: Wan fir ki nyaŋ ke, n li sei udaan nsan wee min nin uma n nan lagin ki kal n naangbɔŋin bu. A li ke maah nan nyaŋ wee min nin n Baa lagin ki kal U naangbɔŋ bu man nin.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
text: Wan jɔɔ litul ke, ni che un gbir, Kinaaŋ kaah bei biwonjiɛm a laginn man.”

ref: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.”
text: Ni bɔɔn bu le n nan lig, ki kan paab a naam a naanganl kaah loor ki yaa. Le likukɔl lan wee n pii nan chinn gbir wee li nann kunaatuŋin beim ke, “Donn do, wee n wɔɔniŋ nan kpaa talar ki na yin tun ni niɛ nan biɛn a bɔɔn.”

ref: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.
text: Libol nmɔn n nan be nin Kinaaŋ le, ki kan kunaangbɔŋ kaah be paab le uba ka ki bu.

ref: The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
text: Le wan nan ka ki bu nmɔn nan nyagin le ke sataŋ nin lichabilin. Le uwaakpajatooŋ nan jin kunaangbɔŋ nmɔn ki tan to litangbagil lan nann kisikpinnsiig.

ref: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.
text: Le tinaangbann pilee nin tina nan gɔɔn kunaangbɔŋ nmɔn, le bininkpeeb pilee nin bina nan ka ti bu. Bi nan yee tiwann penn le ki chig salima a naam a yuchigirim bi yuli bu.

ref: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.
text: Le kitajug nyagin ki nyan kunaangbɔŋ nmɔn yaan, nin utaal a dundunl nin titintann. Le filaam bilile si niin ki gaan. Ni niɛ nan le ye Uwonbɔr a naam milile.

ref: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.
text: Le niwann niba mu nan be kunaangbɔŋ nmɔn a nintogil ki nann niɛnu a maar tan yaalin ke limɔgilin. Niɛnu a maarin a sisiigin, kunaangbɔŋ nan be, le tiwann naan wann tan fo tina nan be ki gɔɔn ki. Le bi bɔɔn nin bi nintogil biɛn nan ye inunbil.

ref: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
text: Chinchinn a wanfolin nan nann ugbegin le, le wan kpiɛ milee mu nann unaaja, wan kpiɛ mitaa n mu a num nann uninfosaal, le wan kpiɛ bina-n mu nann libaanweenl lan yugiri paab.

ref: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
text: Tiwann naan wan tan fo tina nmɔn biɛn nan jɔɔ tikpinkpann tiloloob, le bi gbanann biɛn ye inunbil, hali nin bi ŋmiɛn nin na. Le nween nin kunyiɛg biɛn baa jiɛn ni le ki ke, “Kasi, kasi, kasi, le ye Uyudaan Uwonbɔr Npɔɔn biɛn daan, wan nan be, ki la be, ki la yin dan.”

ref: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.
text: Ni ye tiwann naan wan tan fo tina-n nan sei wan ka kunaangbɔŋ bu ki gbaa be kaa jɔɔ diɛmin kupag, jilima nin ipoor ke,

ref: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
text: “Ti Yudaau Uwonbɔr, a sin kpaan, a gaa kupag nin jilima nin npɔɔn na nan bu-n fin le nan naan niwann biɛn, a bam bu le bi nan naan niwann biɛn, le ki fo be.”

ref: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.
text: Le n kan wan ka kunaangbɔŋin bu kaah ŋmag kugbɔŋ kpabkaag u nɔɔjiim, le kugbɔŋ nmɔn jɔɔ nsɔbim ku bɔɔn nin ku nintogil, le bi ta tiwann tan tabin tilile ki tabin piin ku bu.

ref: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?”
text: Le n kan malaka wan jɔɔ npɔɔn takpem kaah tann papaab takpem ki len ke, “Ŋma kpaan ki li fir tabir tiwann tabin wan nan wee ki loor kugbɔŋ kpabkaag nmɔn naa?”

ref: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
text: Amaa uba kaa nan be paab a naamin bee dulinya nan yaan bee kitakpiin tiŋ ki na li fir loor kugbɔŋ kpabkaag nmɔn bee ki lig ku poolin ni.

ref: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
text: Le n mɔɔ ki mɔɔ nan bu-n uba kaa nan be ki kpaan un loor kugbɔŋ kpabkaag nmɔn bee ki lig ku poolin ni.

ref: Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
text: Le bininkpeebin a ni uba beim ke, “Laa mɔri! Lig, wan ye ligbeginl wee ki nyan Juda a maalimin nin, ki ye Defid a yaabilin, u nyaŋ niwann biɛn na. U li fir tabir ndaagim mulile-n ki loor kugbɔŋ kpabkaag nmɔn.”

ref: Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.

ref: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.
text: Le u dan ki nan gaa kugbɔŋ kpabkaag nmɔn wan ka kunaangbɔŋin bu a nɔɔjiimin ban.

text: Le bi gaah ilan pɔɔn ki ke, “Fin le kpaan nin a yuur kugbɔŋ nmɔn ki loor ndaagimin, nan bu-n fin le bi nan kɔr, le a ta a cham ki da bininfob ki sei Uwonbɔr ki nyan imaal biɛn nin ileen biɛn, nin bininfob biɛn nin ibol biɛn ni.

ref: You let them become kings and serve God as priests, and they will rule on earth.”
text: Le a jin bi nnaam, ki ta bi ŋa biminmanib ke bi li jiɛn ti Wonbɔru, le bi na li kal kunaangbɔŋin bu.”

ref: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them,
text: Le n lig ki gbir malakam takpem a kukɔli, le bi kanl ye turil turil, nin turpiig a turpiig. Le malakam nmɔn nan gɔɔn kunaangbɔŋin nin tiwann naan wann tan fo tina-n nin bininkpeebin.

ref: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
text: Ki gaah ilan nin ikukɔl yan pɔɔ ki ke, “Kipeebig kan wee bi nan kɔrin le kpaan, nin un gaa npɔɔn nin lifaal, nin nlamgɔrikaam, nin ngbananpɔɔn, nin jilima nin kupag nin ndom!”

ref: The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.

text: Le n lig ki kan waah tabir kuwan tabin waŋ kan kpiɛ miloobin. Le kutingbɔŋ dam takpem. Nween labir libunbɔnl ki nann botu a kinkenl lan wee bi ta tiŋɔɔkor ki naan nin, le uŋmal mu mann ke nchamin,
